novel_info.title: Protect Our Chief
novel_info.author: Ao Wuchang
novel_info.summary: After a car accident, Wang shouzhe has transmigrated to a martial world. Unlike other cases of transmigration, he becomes a clan leader before he knows it.“Hmm, this tasty? What kind of meat was this?”“The fish also offers comfort and an exquisitely delicious taste.”“The rice was not ordinary—each grain was plump, translucent, and chewed with a nice texture”Even if just for the sake of enjoying various delicious meals at every turn, he had to help the Wang family grow stronger and more powerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Starting Today as the Clan Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: Chapter 1: Starting Today as the Clan Leader
Editor:
Atlas Studios
[This book progresses at a slow pace, and the number of new subscriptions to single Chapters continues to rise 24 hours after publication, indicating that at least the storyline of the current 1.6 million words has not collapsed. Readers who enjoy this can follow along with peace of mind~]
...
The year 3145 of the Great Qianlong Chang — the ninth day of the fourth month.
The Ping’an Wang Family, the former patriarch Wang Dingyue passed away at a young age.
After the seven-day mourning period, Wang Shouzhe, as the legitimate son of direct lineage, according to national rules and family protocols, was hosted by Lady Gongsun Hui of the Wang Family and the clan elders, and after reporting to Ancestor Longyan and the ancestors, succeeded as the new clan leader.
The Wang Family is a ninth-grade Black Tortoise Clan registered and assessed by the Daqian Kingdom, its influence limited to the Ping’an Town area of the Changning Guard Region, classified as a lower-rank noble family.
However, they had also seen prosperous times, tracing back to the lineage of the Daqian Wang Family.
A millennium ago, for unknown reasons, the ancestor branched out from the Daqian Wang Family, traveled thousands of miles to Longzuo County, and established the Longzuo Wang Family, laying the foundation for the clan.
At that time, the Longzuo Wang Family was considered a prestigious clan, unmatched in prominence.
Alas, glory does not last forever, nor does prosperity.
After a period of splendor, the family’s power gradually waned.
Subsequently.
In the year 3000 of Longchang, the talented Wang Zhouxuan of the Longzuo Wang Family led his family with a Pioneer Order south to the Changning Guard Region, at the convergence of the Liping Mountain Range and the Anjiang, where they opened up wastelands and established settlements and towns, painstakingly pioneering human habitats, earning accolades, and establishing the Ping’an Wang Family that took root and thrived.
During Ancestor Zhouxuan’s peak, his combat strength reached the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, wielding considerable influence in Ping’an Town.
What made Ancestor Zhouxuan most proud was his legitimate granddaughter, Wang Longyan, who was exceptional in talent. She reached the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm at the age of eighteen, was admitted to the renowned Purple Mansion Academy, and by thirty had broken through to the Spirit Platform Realm, reaching the middle tier of the Spirit Platform Realm before turning sixty, receiving significant nurturing from the Purple Mansion Academy.
Simultaneously, Wang Longyan and Liua Xuanfu of the Shanyin Liu Family were known as the "Double Beauties of Changning," their fame widespread.
In addition, Wang Qiongyuan, the legitimate great-grandson of the ancestor, was also extraordinarily gifted, reaching the Spirit Platform Realm at forty under the nurturing support of the ancestor and taking up the position of clan leader.
At that time, the Wang Family boasted three individuals in the Spirit Platform Realm, their influence extending to the entire Changning Guard Region.
Until the year 3095 of Longchang, when Ancestor Zhouxuan was 145 years old, a long-dormant outbreak of fierce beasts deep in the Liping Mountain suddenly erupted, with Ping’an Town becoming the first disaster area.
To protect the century-old foundation of the family, Ancestor Zhouxuan did not hesitate to hold back the Tier Five Ferocious Beast, the Golden-winged Sun-devouring Tiger, waiting for reinforcements to arrive.
The battle was extremely fierce, with two patriarchs of vassal families going missing in action against the beast tide, their fates unknown. Although the Golden-winged Sun-devouring Tiger and the beast disaster were eventually besieged and killed by the reinforcements from the Changning Guard that followed, the Ping’an Wang Family had already suffered significant damage.
Not only did Ancestor Zhouxuan fall in battle, but the fourth-generation clan leader Wang Qiongyuan, who was initially at the Spirit Platform Realm, as well as the fifth-generation successor Wang Xiaoqi, also perished in the beast disaster.
The fall of two generations at the Spirit Platform Realm of the Ping’an Wang Family led to a significant reduction in strength.
Meanwhile, the two vassal families, the Liu Family and the Zhao Family, had long harbored ambitions, secretly preserving their strength during the beast disaster, with their patriarchs feigning death to escape. After the Wang Family’s decline, they conspired in concerted efforts to annex the Wang Family’s foundation.
At this critical moment, the third-generation clan member Wang Longyan resolutely violated the Purple Mansion Academy’s ordinances, forsaking a promising future to return to the family, taking the initiative to confront and battle against a total of three Spirit Platform Realm experts from the opposition.
Against three opponents, Wang Longyan boldly slew the allied Spirit Platform Realm foes, intimidating the Spirit Platform ancestors of the Liu Family and the Zhao Family.
Regrettably, Wang Longyan’s wounds from this battle were too severe, causing her strength to fall to the initial tier of the Spirit Platform Realm, and her lifespan was greatly diminished.
Yet, even so, Wang Longyan continued to shoulder the heavy burden alone, defending the Ping’an Wang Family with great effort. The Liu Family and Zhao Family dared not overly provoke Wang Longyan, thus resorting to tactics of gradual encroachment.
Time swiftly passed, and another 40 to 50 years went by, without any new emerging Spirit Platform Realm members in the clan, and even the former clan leader Wang Dingyue had passed away.
All the burdens seemed to fall on the young clan leader, Wang Shouzhe!
...
Within the main residence of the Wang Family, inside an ancient, quaint courtyard annex room.
"Young, no, Patriarch~ What’s done is done, please have some food first. If this continues, your body might not hold up. These meals were personally prepared for you by Lady Gongsun." Wang Gui, the personal servant, cautiously carried a purple sandalwood food box, his brows filled with worry.
"Hoo~" Wang Shouzhe exhaled a deep breath, putting aside the "Wang Family Inheritance Records," his eyes regained some clarity, and a thought rose in his mind, "To think, after a car accident, I would transmigrate to a mystical world and inexplicably become the clan leader of a declining Black Tortoise Clan. It’s just a pity that the responsibility seems heavy."
It turns out that three days ago, the original Wang Shouzhe was overly grief-stricken from guarding the spirit and mourning, collapsing in front of his father’s coffin. When he awoke, he had become a transmigrator.
Over the past three days, the process of memory fusion left Wang Shouzhe somewhat dazed, and everyone only thought he was excessively heartbroken and out of sorts, unaware of the substantial reality within, merely following family rules and inheritance protocols to elevate him to the position of clan leader.
After reading the "Wang Family Inheritance Records," Wang Shouzhe gained some understanding of the family and the world. This world he was in was called the "Daqian Kingdom," where Black Tortoise Clans founded the kingdom, the Imperial Family being the largest of such clans, while various smaller and larger Black Tortoise Clans spread like stars throughout the realm.
Intertwined, whether directly or indirectly, they influence the entire Daqian’s politics, economy, and even the country’s lifeline.
Do not underestimate the Wang Family being merely a lower-rank ninth-grade noble family, as in the Changning Ping’an area, it is considered one of the dominant local forces, holding a significant voice in government institutions and the Guardian’s Mansion.
Even back in the generation of Wang Shouzhe’s great-grandfather, the Wang Family was the undisputed noble family in Ping’an Town, with their influence reaching the surrounding areas of Changning Guard.
However, following those two thrilling turnaround battles documented in the "Wang Family Inheritance Records," and the fall of the family’s experts, it had been declining year after year. Even though Ancestor Longyan strained to support them, it was difficult to resist the joint encroachment of the Liu Family and Zhao Family.
Wang Shouzhe always felt that there was something suspicious about that war. Why did the Liu Family and Zhao Family dare to secretly harbor strength and eventually rebel? And why did the reinforcements arrive the latest?
The records were vague, with many things left unexplained. For the moment, Wang Shouzhe decided to remain vigilant.
Afterward, the prior Patriarch, Wang Dingyue, in hopes of turning the tide by cultivating to the Spirit Platform Realm, dared to venture into dangerous outer domains seeking opportunities for a breakthrough.
However, Wang Dingyue’s efforts failed just short of success, and his untimely death in his prime added to the woes of the already declining Ping’an Wang Family.
If no unexpected events occurred, following this development, in the coming decades, the Wang Family’s territories and industries would gradually be devoured and replaced by the other two families in Ping’an Town, and the once-vast and glorious family would deteriorate and collapse, with the family bloodline descending into commoners.
"However, it is quite an interesting world." Wang Shouzhe slightly squinted, thinking silently as he gradually merged with his memories, "It seems that the former Wang Shouzhe, though young, was not a simple character."
Memory told him that Wang Shouzhe was hailed as a youthful genius from an early age, with talent and aptitude in the bloodline seven generations down from Ancestor Zhou Xuan, only slightly inferior to Ancestor Longyan.
With the concentrated nurturing of the family’s resources, Wang Shouzhe reached the high stage of the sixth layer of the Qi Refining Realm at eighteen and wasn’t far from the seventh layer.
This is good news, at least it wasn’t reincarnating into a wastrel.
Next to him, the servant Wang Gui, seeing Wang Shouzhe’s face shifting between clear and cloudy, became even more worried: "Patriarch, please rest first, I’ll go summon a doctor."
"No worries, I’m already fine." Wang Shouzhe stopped his action, "Wang Gui, you go out first, I need to contemplate some things."
"Yes!"
Wang Gui set down the food box and retreated, carefully closing the door.
After Wang Gui left, leaving him alone, Wang Shouzhe finally breathed a sigh of relief, his spirit relaxed. These days, with the vigil and memory integration, he hadn’t been eating well, and his stomach had been growling with hunger. Revitalizing the family and all that would have to wait till after filling his belly and slowly contemplating.
He opened the lid of the exquisite sandalwood food box, and a wondrous aroma of food flowed into his nostrils. The food box was divided into several compartments, with rice, vegetables, meat, and a piece of steamed fish.
Under the stimulus of appetite, he quickly picked up his chopsticks, clamped a piece of meat, and stuffed it into his mouth. The seasoning was ordinary, but the texture was exceptionally rich, with an excellent chewiness, filling his mouth with a fragrant and savory taste, and after swallowing, he could faintly feel a subtle warmth moving within.
Mmm, this is so delicious?
What kind of meat is this? Pork? No, pork is coarse, not this tender. Lamb? No, this meat has no muttony smell at all, the meat aroma thick and juicy, rather resembling the expensive imported beef I occasionally tasted before crossing over.
However, soon, his integrated "memory" informed him that this was Spirit Horned Yak meat, a precious food that could strengthen the physique and aid in cultivation when consumed over time.
As the Young Clan Leader, with extraordinary talent, he was naturally in the top tier of family resources and entitled to such resources.
Wang Shouzhe felt the slight warmth flowing within him, his energy rapidly recovering peculiarly. He couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, truly excellent meat; under the temptation of gourmet food, he quickly devoured the small amount of yak meat with just a few strokes of his chopsticks.
Not entirely satisfied, he then eyed the piece of steamed fish. His merged memory informed him that it was called Red-tailed Spirit Eel. It was a rare spirit fish produced from the nearby Anjiang, belonging to a Tier Two fierce beast level, with a body that could easily grow to several hundred jin, capable of overturning boats, extremely fierce.
Ordinary fishermen, when encountering this kind of fierce beast, feared to evade it, a slight delay in fleeing would undoubtedly lead to capsized boats and drowned people.
This Red-tailed Spirit Eel was captured last year by the former Patriarch Wang Dingyue and some family experts with great skill and luck. After being dissected and pickled, it was stored in the family’s ice cellar as a supplement of spiritual food for the family’s young bloodlines.
The cook had carefully picked out the fish bones; the fish meat was savory, tender, and smooth as it entered the mouth, accompanied by a refreshing and comfortable sensation moving within, immensely delicious and satisfying.
The rice was also not ordinary; the grains were plump and translucent, firm and elastic to chew, with a rich orchid aroma, exactly the famous spiritual food White Jade Ganoderma Rice.
This meal was infinitely flavorful for Wang Shouzhe, instantly dispelling the weakness and lethargy in his body, replaced by vigor and liveliness.
If every meal was eaten like this, cultivation would undoubtedly be exceptionally rapid.
But this obviously wasn’t feasible; now the family was no longer in its former glory. Even his status sequence couldn’t afford such lavish meals, let alone other family members.
Having now become the Patriarch, it was impossible to disregard other family members and endlessly seize their resources to provide for himself. If it truly were like this, it wouldn’t be long before the family would be scattered, accelerating its demise.
Even for eating various gourmet dishes at every meal, the Wang Family must be helped to grow and strengthen.
"System!" Wang Shouzhe lay on the bed, digesting, calmly calling out with his mind.
But after a while, there was no response at all.
Impossible, right? A chill went through Wang Shouzhe’s heart, crossing over without a golden finger, is this rhythm a trap? Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe repeatedly kept trying, yet there was never a trace of the golden finger.
His heart grew colder and colder; in this mystical world, filled with experts and ferocious beasts rampant, how could he play without a golden finger?

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Where Did the System Go?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: Chapter 2: Where Did the System Go?
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"It seems for now, we’ll have to take it step by step." Wang Shouzhe’s expression was somewhat grave, but he soon relaxed. Even without a golden finger, he still had some advantages.
At least after merging the memories, he discovered that although this world had many powerful experts, it lagged behind Earth in terms of people’s livelihood development and advanced thinking, even if he was just an ordinary office worker with a college degree...
Just as Wang Shouzhe was preparing to sum up his advantages.
Suddenly, the servant Wang Gui rushed in hurriedly from outside: "Patriarch, Patriarch, something bad has happened! Sixth Master has been beaten, and he sent someone back to ask for help."
Sixth Master?
Wang Shouzhe frowned slightly, memories surged: "It’s Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai."
Wang Dinghai was Wang Shouzhe’s clan uncle, ranking sixth among the male members of the Ding Generation. He had average talent and cultivation, but was quite good at water, so he was responsible for one of the clan industries, the fishing fleet.
Now that Wang Dinghai had been beaten, there should be some changes in the clan’s fishing fleet side. It’s just the right time to take a closer look at this world.
"Stay calm. Why are you so flustered?" Wang Shouzhe thought of this and calmed down. After a reprimand, he said composedly, "Prepare the carriage, we’ll go take a look."
"Yes, Patriarch." Wang Gui hurriedly responded and ran off to prepare for the trip.
Wang Shouzhe left the room based on his memory and walked slowly towards the main gate of the main residence, observing the main residence’s various architectural facilities and structures along the way, verifying them one by one with the memories in his mind.
On the way, he happened to see his legitimate mother, Lady Gongsun Hui, with a serious expression, leading a few household generals hurriedly toward the front gate.
Wang Shouzhe saluted Gongsun Hui: "Greetings, Lady."
With the merged memories, Wang Shouzhe already knew that he lost his mother at a young age, and Gongsun Hui was the legal wife his late father Wang Dingyue married afterwards, having a legitimate daughter named Wang Luomiao, who was already eight years old this year.
Therefore, although Gongsun Hui was Wang Shouzhe’s legitimate mother, she was not his biological mother. However, she had a kind temperament and always treated Wang Shouzhe as her own, taking care of him in every aspect.
This was quite different from the usual clichés in fantasy novels.
Upon seeing Wang Shouzhe, Gongsun Hui came forward and held his hand with a face full of concern: "Zhe’Er, why did you come out? Have you eaten? Is your health better?"
The other household generals also hurriedly saluted Wang Shouzhe.
"Lady, I’m fine now. I’ve finished the spiritual meal you ordered to be prepared, and I’ll talk to you about it in detail later." Wang Shouzhe calmly withdrew his hand and said solemnly, "Lady, are you leading the household generals to support Sixth Uncle? I’ll accompany you."
Gongsun Hui’s face sank, and after a slight hesitation, she said, "Zhe’Er, since you have inherited the position of Clan Leader, you will face these things sooner or later. Since you’re already well, let’s go and take a look together."
"Yes, Lady."
The two went out through the main gate together. On the main gate’s plaque, the characters for Ping’an Wang Family were written in a bold and elegant style, exuding an extraordinary aura.
However, paired with the mottled paint on the columns and the white lanterns bearing the word "Offering" fluttering in the wind, it highlighted the desolate feeling of the Wang Family’s declining fortunes.
"Patriarch, Lady Gongsun, the carriage is ready." The close servant Wang Gui came running, "The sword and bow are already on the carriage."
After a brief discussion, Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui rode in the same carriage, with the four household generals each on Yellow Steeds guarding the sides, heading towards Anjiang Dingpu Ferry.
On the way, Gongsun Hui recounted the causes and effects one by one.
With the thinking of past and present lives, Wang Shouzhe quickly figured out the actual situation. Anjiang was a great river several hundred feet wide, rich in aquatic products and distinctive, providing long-term economic benefits through the fishing fleet.
But where there are benefits, there are often conflicts. Naturally, none of the Ping’an Three Great Families were willing to give up this fat piece of meat. After various struggles and compromises, the Three Great Families of Ping’an have delineated their territories without crossing boundaries.
Anjiang from Dingpu Ferry to Chaotic Stone Beach, spanning thirty li to the right, was the water domain of the Ping’an Wang Family.
However, in recent years, the other two families have been thriving with talents, expanding their appetites. In the context of limited overall territory, it’s easy for them to get their hands into others’ pots.
The encroachment plan had long been ongoing, with the clan’s territory and industries shrinking year by year. The smaller the territory, the scarcer the resources, making it harder for clan members to grow, thus falling into a vicious cycle.
Moreover, the situation was exacerbated by the fact that Wang Family’s anchor, Ancestor Longyan, seemed to be declining year by year, having been in seclusion for several years. Even when such a big thing happened at home, she did not appear, leading the outside world to speculate whether she could still fight.
The situation was grim, Wang Shouzhe frowned.
That being said, the main residence of the Wang Family was built by the mountains and rivers, only about ten li from Dingpu Ferry through a sturdy roadbed maintained year-round. With the advance household generals paving the way, the carriage took less than a half hour to arrive.
During the initial construction of Ping’an Town, this ferry was already one of the outposts of Changning Guard. After more than a hundred years of development, Dingpu Ferry became a vital North-South transportation hub.
The Three Great Families of Ping’an each established docks, ferries, shops, and other basic facilities here.
There were some simple defensive facilities at the ferry, with walls quite rudimentary at about five or six meters high, only capable of withstanding small-scale fierce beast attacks.
After entering the ferry, Wang Shouzhe and his party went straight to the deep-water dock. Under the long wooden pier stood giant timber columns that required two arms to encircle, extending the length of the pier to depths of three or four meters in the water. Further out, the deep-water area had two transverse piers forming berths.
Docked at the berths were various ships of different sizes, including ferries, merchant ships, and fishing boats.
In the distance, at the end of the pier, two groups of people were confronting each other. Both sides held sticks, knives, and forks, their emotions very intense.
"Wang the Sixth, you’ve got quite some guts. Still daring to bring people to block your Young Master Yongzhou, are you not satisfied with the beating you got?" A young man’s mocking voice rang out.
"You Liu Family little mutt." Another man’s voice was agitated and angry, "You just sneak attacked from underwater, if you’re a real man, let’s rely on our own skills and fight in the water for real. Your Sixth Master Wang will teach you how to behave."
"Wang the Sixth, don’t blame Young Master for looking down on you. You’ve lived all these years in vain, with not a shred of brains." The young man sneered, "Underwater ambush is but one battle tactic. Should we declare that tactics can’t be used before a fight? Haha, you’re living backwards. You might as well roll out of Ping’an Town, stop squandering food."
The young man’s group burst into loud laughter, echoing the cry to roll out of Ping’an Town, roll out of Ping’an Town.
Dingpu Ferry was a mixed crowd, with many travelers and traders gathering to watch the fuss, all kinds of discussions ongoing.
The conflict today was bound to spread to other places through their footsteps and mouths. The Ping’an Wang Family, as the side suffering the loss in this conflict, would also become a laughingstock for a while, a topic of conversation over tea and meals, damaging the Wang Race’s prestige.
"Liu Family little mutt." The man’s face was flushed red, in extreme rage, "You’ve gone too far, your Sixth Master will fight you!"
"Wang Family old dog, come on if you dare!"
A brawl was as imminent as a taut string ready to snap.
"Stop!" Seeing the urgency of the situation, Gongsun Hui hurriedly stepped in between the confrontation to stop it, "Wang Dinghai, Liu Yongzhou, calm down first, and speak properly."
Afraid Lady Gongsun would suffer, Wang Shouzhe waved his hand, and the four Wang Family household generals gathered around, protecting Gongsun Hui in their midst. He followed closely, continuing to observe everything coldly.
Onsite observation and memory told him that the young man in tight-fitting water armor, with a short blade at his waist and a somewhat cocky demeanor, was Liu Yongzhou, a member of the Liu Family’s Yong Generation.
Rumor had it that this young man was skilled in water combat, particularly adept in the Water Escape Technique, and had once wielded a short blade to dive and hunt a Tier One fierce beast, the Red-Scaled Eel, weighing over two hundred jin. He had gained fame at the age of just twenty-three or twenty-four, a prodigy of the Ping’an Liu Family.
The other man, lean and dark-skinned, was obviously a person who lived long on the water. Though his head and arm were injured, wrapped in burlap, he seemed a bit battered.
That man was Wang Shouzhe’s clan uncle—Wang Dinghai, specializing in the clan’s fishing operations in domain waters, also very skilled in water battle fishing. He was the main catcher of the Red-tailed Spirit Eel Wang Shouzhe had eaten earlier.
"Ah, it’s the Wang Family’s Lady Gongsun." The young Liu Yongzhou said with a smile, casually cupping his hands. He then disdainfully mocked Wang Dinghai, "Wang the Sixth, you had a little friction with me, a junior, and you brought out the Clan Sister-in-law to support you. Yongzhou is impressed, very impressed, I can’t compare."
"You..." Wang Dinghai’s dark face reddened with anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Countering Tactics
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: Chapter 3: Countering Tactics
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Chapter Three: Tactical Reversal
...
"Enough." Gongsun Hui’s gentle voice reprimanded, stopping the dispute. She then continued, "Sixth Uncle, don’t be impulsive. Let’s resolve everything calmly."
Gongsun Hui herself was the legitimate daughter of the Shanyang Gongsun Family, the rightful wife of the previous Clan Leader of the Wang Family, and also the legitimate mother of the new Wang Clan Leader. Her status alone was sufficient to mediate and resolve this matter.
Wang Dinghai spoke with agitation, "Fifth Sister-in-law, it’s not that I’m impulsive, but that the Liu family’s kid is going too far. Everyone knows in Ping’an Town, from Dingpu Ferry going thirty miles to Chaotic Stone Beach on Anjiang, it’s the water territory of our Ping’an Wang Family. Yet, that Liu Yongzhou kid repeatedly crossed the line to fish, blatantly crossing it by ten miles this time. If I don’t act to expel him, will there be any place for us Wang Family on Anjiang?"
"Oh, Wang the Sixth, don’t play the villain pretending to be the victim." Liu Yongzhou appeared greatly wronged, "The winds on Anjiang are strong and the waters are swift. Our Liu Family’s territory is upstream on Anjiang, and sometimes the boats can’t be anchored steadily. Instead, you rammed us with a fishing boat right away, and after suffering some losses in the conflict, you actually called your elders. It’s really outrageous, bullying our Liu Family without a Clan Leader or elders?"
Wang Shouzhe had not spoken, quietly observing and contemplating. He was already certain that this time it was the Liu Family who initiated the dispute, most likely to test him as the newly appointed Clan Leader, or perhaps to measure his capabilities as the new head.
If he, as the Clan Leader, lacked skill and courage, the Zhao Family would likely collaborate with them next. A series of plots and conspiracies would flood in like a tide.
"Ahem, ahem!"
Wang Shouzhe coughed twice, calmly walking forward.
"Shouzhe nephew, you’re here too?" Wang Dinghai was delighted, then indignantly said, "Quick, help your Sixth Uncle judge, this kid secretly cheated and ambushed. Your Sixth Uncle is not convinced and wants to have a fair fight again."
"So it’s the Wang Family’s Young Clan Leader, no, it should be Clan Leader here." Liu Yongzhou’s eyes narrowed slightly, revealing a hint of caution and jealousy towards Wang Shouzhe.
Without a doubt, in terms of comprehensive skills, Wang Shouzhe far surpassed him, Liu Yongzhou. Moreover, Wang Shouzhe was only eighteen years old and had already cultivated to the Sixth-Layer High Stage of the Qi Refining Realm, showing great potential for future growth.
Currently, within the Liu Family, there was great apprehension toward Wang Shouzhe. If given the opportunity to advance to the Spirit Platform Realm, the structure of Ping’an Town would undergo a significant change.
Some of the onlookers began to whisper among themselves, seemingly showing great interest in the young newly appointed Clan Leader of the Ping’an Wang Family. Their words implicitly indicated that if the former Wang Clan Leader Wang Dingyue hadn’t died so early, and could have held on for another ten years until the Young Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe fully matured, the situation for the Ping’an Wang Family would have been different.
"Sixth Uncle, victory and defeat are common in military affairs." Wang Shouzhe squinted slightly, lowered his voice, and probed, "But, Sixth Uncle, are you sure you can win decisively? If you lose again in front of everyone, it will damage our Wang Family’s prestige."
"This..." Wang Dinghai hesitated slightly, speaking in a low voice, "I have clashed with that Liu kid several times, usually ending evenly matched, each with our advantages. But today, for some reason, his Water Escape Technique seems to have improved significantly, slipshod like an eel in the water, catching me off guard and costing me. But don’t worry, nephew, your Sixth Uncle will fight to win this round."
Improved significantly, Water Escape Technique?
Haha, this is getting interesting, Wang Shouzhe rubbed his nose, already understanding the opponent’s strategy. They manufactured conflict to fuel Wang Dinghai’s defiant mindset. Then, under everyone’s watchful eyes, allowing Liu Yongzhou, the up-and-coming talent, to defeat Wang Dinghai, reducing the Wang Family’s prestige.
If they could further escalate emotions, signing a wager or something similar, it would be even better. By then, they could bite a significant piece off the Wang Family again.
Wang Shouzhe had a clear judgment of the scene and promptly said, "Sixth Uncle, let me handle this matter."
"This..." Wang Dinghai hesitated momentarily but, seeing Wang Shouzhe’s composed demeanor, calmed down and stepped back, "Shouzhe, be careful, the Liu Family is adept at scheming."
"Rest assured, Sixth Uncle, I won’t let us suffer." Wang Shouzhe reassured, then glanced around, addressing loudly under everyone’s gaze, "As a Black Tortoise Clan, we have always founded our clan on martial strength. As for ancestral territories, if the descendants are incapable of defending it, retreating to a corner is only natural. Liu Yongzhou, your Liu Family’s attempts to encroach on our Wang Family’s fishing grounds is just a petty move. Why not simply fight it out as our ancestors did in a life-and-death duel, and whoever wins gets the other’s fishing grounds?"
"What?"
The crowd erupted with exclamations, a life-and-death arena!? Does the young Wang Clan Leader have to be so aggressive?
Wang Shouzhe was a full five years younger than Liu Yongzhou, yet his direct challenge for a life-and-death duel left Liu Yongzhou’s face alternating between pale and flushed. He didn’t dare to accept, nor could he, so he awkwardly said, "Clan Leader of the Wang Family, you’re joking, how can a Clan Leader step onto a life-and-death stage?"
From this alone, although Liu Yongzhou was outstanding among his peers, he fell short by more than a notch when compared to Wang Shouzhe, who had been groomed as a Young Clan Leader.
"Hehe~" Wang Shouzhe sneered with sarcasm, "Cowardice is cowardice, so why bother dressing it up? Today, I’m here. As long as any of your Liu Family’s Yong generation comes, I’ll take them all on."
"Good! Well said, the new Wang Clan Leader has great spirit!"
"The Black Tortoise Race, establishing its family through martial prowess, is quite interesting. Let’s see how the Liu Family responds. As far as I know, the eldest of the Liu Family’s Yong generation is thirty-six or seven years old, and the youngest is still babbling. I’ve thought it over and can’t figure out who can compete with the Wang Family’s new Clan Leader."
"Brother, how strong is this young man? Can he truly defeat all of Liu Family’s Yong generation?"
"You must be an outsider, aren’t you? That’s our Ping’an Wang Family’s new Clan Leader, Wang Shouzhe, who is just eighteen and nearly reached the high tier of the Qi Refining Realm. It’s said his talent in the Sword Dao is extremely strong, and his swordsmanship has already reached a refined level," a local proudly introduced. "Additionally, Wang Shouzhe has passed the enrollment examination of the Purple Mansion Academy and is soon to enroll, though, unfortunately, the Wang Family encountered such a major incident that he had to forgo his studies."
"The Purple Mansion Academy? Is that the one that’s said to guarantee reaching the Spirit Platform once entered? Impressive, impressive, but such a pity!"
The surrounding discussions reached Wang Shouzhe’s ears, reminding him that not long ago, he did indeed pass the initial selection of the Purple Mansion Academy enrollment.
The Purple Mansion Academy in Longzuo County recruits new students every three years, but their requirements are extremely strict. Within the Changning area, one to three candidates usually pass the initial selection each time and qualify for the retest, and this year Wang Shouzhe was among them.
However, saying someone is soon to enroll is exaggerated; within the whole jurisdiction of Changning Guard, rarely does a Purple Mansion student emerge every ten or eight years. Wang Shouzhe considers himself exceptional but is aware that the probability of passing the retest is less than thirty percent.
The surrounding atmosphere and public opinion began to lean in favor of the Wang Family.
Previously, the conflict and misunderstanding could have damaged the Wang Family’s reputation. But now, instead, it enhanced the Wang Family’s prestige.
"Well done, great-nephew," Wang Dinghai said, full of joy. "You see, how could those kids from the Liu Family still dare to be arrogant?"
Gongsun Hui was also somewhat surprised, not expecting Shouzhe to turn a situation damaging to the clan’s prestige into one disadvantageous to the Liu Family with just a few words.
Before this, her legitimate son had always focused solely on his cultivation, caring very little about other matters. Yet unexpectedly, upon becoming the Clan Leader, he demonstrated considerable skill.
"Good!"
Suddenly, a voice of praise rang out, "Patriarch Wang’s words truly are deafening, admirable! The Black Tortoise Race establishes its family through martial prowess; if you can’t uphold your ancestral legacy, why not retreat to a corner? Indeed, well said!"
A middle-aged man, clad in a brocade robe and exhibiting extraordinary presence, emerged surrounded by several fierce household generals, his expression half-smiling as he stared at Wang Shouzhe.
Upon seeing this person, both Gongsun Hui and Wang Dinghai’s expressions changed: "It’s actually Liu Shengye!"
Especially Gongsun Hui, whose face turned difficult, softly reminded Wang Shouzhe: "Zhe’Er, Liu Family’s Patriarch’s appearance must have some trick; you must proceed cautiously."
Liu Shengye.
Wang Shouzhe’s eyes slightly narrowed; the current Clan Leader of Ping’an Liu Family reputedly didn’t have the strongest martial power within the Liu Family, yet at forty still hadn’t broken through to the Eighth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
However, in Wang Shouzhe’s memory, he was famous for being calculating and deceitful—an infamous smiling tiger. In his clashes with the Wang Family’s previous Clan Leader, Wang Ding Yue, he frequently gained the upper hand and excelled at managing family assets, boosting the Liu Family’s strength significantly.
"So it’s the Patriarch Liu who has graced us with his presence," Wang Shouzhe calmly replied. "Since the Patriarch Liu agrees with my words, do you also consent to the life-or-death arena with Liu Yongzhou?" Without further ado, he first set a trap for Liu Shengye.
"That’s not the case. While patriarch Wang’s words have merit, as a clan leader, can you really bully the young with your senior position?" Liu Shengye curtailed his argument, "Since it’s a life-and-death arena match, naturally it should be identities of similar status for it to be interesting."
His intent was clearly to redirect the battle back to Liu Yongzhou and Wang Ding Hai.
"Patriarch Liu’s words are truly reasonable," Wang Shouzhe earnestly nodded in agreement, "Between our Wang and Liu Families, there’s always been much friction and accumulated grievances. If there’s to be a life-and-death duel, why don’t the two Clan Leaders personally take the stage? It would indeed be a match between equals."
"What?"
Liu Shengye’s face twitched; the Clan Leaders personally engaging in a life-or-death arena? Has Wang Shouzhe gone mad? First, he latches onto Liu Yongzhou, now directly biting Liu Shengye! Is he just biting whoever he can? Was that my intent?
The business travelers and other individuals at the ferry nearby were also plunged into a stunned silence; right off the bat, it was a life-or-death battle between two clan leaders. Is it necessary to be so impulsive?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 4: The Clan Leader Is a Bit Fierce
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: Chapter 4: The Clan Leader Is a Bit Fierce
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Nephew, absolutely not." Wang Dinghai urgently advised, "Patriarch Liu is already forty years old with seasoned experience."
"Zhe’Er, you are too impulsive." Gongsun Hui also appeared flustered, "The clan leader’s status is noble, he’s the stabilizing force of the family..."
If it were a fight with Liu Yongzhou, they’d be happy to see it, after all, the power difference between the two sides is significant. But challenging Liu Shengye directly, the situation is too unclear and overly risky.
On the side, Liu Shengye secretly wiped a cold sweat, luckily, luckily, there’s someone sensible in the Wang Family, they should really persuade this young clan leader of the Wang Family, what is this after all?
How can the main commanders of two armies have a life-and-death duel right off the bat, this is chaos.
Furthermore, he, Liu Shengye, had lived in comfort for many years and hadn’t fought for a long time, a life-and-death duel is no joke.
"Aunt, Sixth Uncle." But Wang Shouzhe interrupted them directly, "The clan leader is also just a member of the family, as a member of the family, everyone has the right and obligation to shed blood and sacrifice for the survival of the family. Not to mention Ancestor Longyan..."
As he spoke, Wang Shouzhe’s emotions grew agitated and indignant, as if about to erupt from repression, the last three words stopped abruptly, forcefully swallowed back down.
"Shouzhe!" Wang Dinghai was suddenly flustered, and hurriedly asked in a low voice, "Ancestor Longyan, she won’t..."
"Don’t worry, she’s fine." Wang Shouzhe’s face was a bit pale, "I’m just distressed that Ancestor has devoted too much for the family in her lifetime, it’s time for us juniors to step forward and spill some blood."
However, no matter how one saw it, what he said seemed like a cover-up.
With that said, Wang Shouzhe turned and stared at Liu Shengye: "Patriarch Liu, since there are so many conflicts between our families, why not take this opportunity to settle it. You and I sign a life-and-death duel agreement, the loser withdraws from the Anjiang Fishery, and the family will not pursue it." His words carried a sense of finality.
"Alright, Clan Leader Wang is indeed a young hero with blood and spirit."
"Since the two families have a conflict, why not resolve it by King against King."
The crowd watching, naturally did not mind the commotion, and the opportunity to see the leaders of the two major families engage in a personal life-and-death duel was a rare spectacle, so immediately, everyone hooted, raising the issue further.
"Damn! This kid is like a hungry wolf? Seeing his dodgy words, could it be... the rumors are true... if so, the situation changes." Liu Shengye shivered, frowned deeply, contemplated for a moment and had an idea, shifted the topic, and displayed a friendly, prosperous demeanor, "Dear Nephew, speaking of it, I and your father are old acquaintances, calling you Dear Nephew is not excessive, right? Our Ping’an Three Families have been rooted in Ping’an Town for many years, all are fellow villagers and neighbors, we should support and take care of each other. Such minor conflicts and contradictions, why go so far, why go so far."
"Then according to Patriarch Liu’s meaning, are you preparing to compensate my Sixth Uncle’s medical expenses?" Wang Shouzhe squinted his eyes, the corners of his mouth raising a sneering smile.
Compensate for medical expenses?
Liu Shengye’s face darkened, but he has always been adept at enduring and pretending to be kind, so he smiled even more amiably, "Conflicts among fellow villagers and neighbors are inevitable, but this time since it’s Yoongzhou’s fault, we naturally have to admit it. Here are thirty Qian Gold, consider it an apology for Brother Dinghai."
After saying this, Liu Shengye took out three Gold Notes each worth ten Qian Gold, and smilingly stuffed them into Wang Shouzhe’s hands, "It’s said that Dear Nephew is a dragon among men, with potential no less than the Ancestor Longyan of those years, and will certainly become the backbone of Ping’an Town in the future."
Thirty Qian Gold?
Wang Shouzhe, who had merged with his memories, knew this was already a huge sum, so he immediately decided to accept it with a smile: "Patriarch Liu is the true stabilizing force of our Ping’an, Shouzhe has just assumed the position of clan leader and shall rely on the guidance of Patriarch Liu in the future."
Certainly! Certainly!
After a hearty laugh or two, Liu Shengye left the Deepwater Wharf District with his Household Generals and Liu Yongzhou.
The crowd gathered to watch, seeing that there wasn’t an actual fight, let out sighs of regret and disappointment, as if missing out on a major spectacle, they dispersed in twos and threes.
"Still, the nephew has means." Wang Dinghai seemed to let out a breath of foul air, happily said, "With a few words, he turned the situation around and let that old fox Liu Shengye willingly apologize."
Yet Gongsun Hui did not show any sign of happiness, her brows knitted with concern instead.
"Sixth Uncle, Aunt, since we’re here, why not board Sixth Uncle’s ship and take a look." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "I’ve never gone to sea with Sixth Uncle since I was little."
"Okay, okay, then Sixth Uncle will take you for a good play." Wang Dinghai said happily, "Later, I’ll show you a fishing technique."
As they were about to board the ship, Wang Shouzhe called several Household Generals to him and whispered some instructions. The generals understood, saluted, and scattered to carry out their tasks.
Wang Shouzhe then, together with Gongsun Hui, followed Wang Dinghai toward the Deep Water Berth.
Meanwhile.
Outside Dingpu Ferry, Liu Yongzhou’s youthful face flushed with difficulty: "Patriarch, we agreed to take a bite out of the Wang Family, how did it end with us apologizing?"
"Yoongzhou, you are still too young." Liu Shengye said smoothly, smiling with hands behind his back, "As the saying goes, everything has its time and place; given the current situation, we must not only avoid proactively provoking the Wang Family, but also be cautious at every juncture to prevent conflicts."
"Patriarch..." Liu Yongzhou was slightly annoyed and puzzled.
"According to my analysis, the old and immortal Wang Longyan is already at the end of her days." Liu Shengye squinted, with intelligence seemingly at his fingertips, "The Wang Family right now is like a dying sick tiger, it’s the most dangerous time. If we push too hard, it might provoke a crazy retaliation. Although our Liu Family is unafraid, we don’t want to let the Zhao Family benefit from the side."
Wang Longyan!
This name is a poisonous thorn stuck in the throat of the Liu Family, one day she doesn’t die, the Liu Family won’t dare to completely tear face with the Wang Family.
"Is this true, Patriarch?" Liu Yongzhou was inexplicably excited.
"Previously, Wang Longyan remained in seclusion and didn’t appear even during such a major event as the change of the Wang family leader, I had three to four guesses." Liu Shengye sneered coldly, "Observing that new Jongze Wang Shouzhe is so impatient as to stake everything for a life-and-death fight with me, it confirmed seven to eight of my conjectures. Hehe, I won’t let him have his way. Soon two to three years, or in four to five years, when Wang Longyan dies..."
"Patriarch? It will take that long?" Liu Yongzhou was a little dumbfounded.
"What do you know? The rise and fall of a family can’t be achieved overnight? We Liu Family have waited for so many years, a few years can’t be endured?" Liu Shengye flicked his sleeve and, supported by his Household Generals, boarded the carriage, "Moreover, before Wang Longyan dies, our Liu Family has a lot of preparatory work to do. We won’t provoke the Wang Family in any way we can. We have a lot of things to prepare before her passing. Just be patient."
"Understood, Patriarch." Liu Yongzhou suppressed his anger, yet helplessly had to see Clan Leader Liu Shengye’s carriage leave.
...
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe had left several Household Generals at the dock performing their tasks, while he and Aunt Gongsun Hui boarded Wang Dinghai’s medium-sized fishing boat named "Dinghai". The ship was approximately of a medium size, as seen from its sails indicating it was a sail-powered vessel.
Wang Dinghai instructed the ship’s crew to set sail from the harbor and wanted to enthusiastically introduce the various facilities on the ship to Wang Shouzhe, but Gongsun Hui, with a serious look, said, "Zhe’Er, Sixth Uncle, let’s talk at the stern."
The two of them obediently followed her to the stern. The ship had a slight sway and started to move out of port.
As they gathered, Gongsun Hui sighed and said, "Zhe’Er, Sixth Uncle, we’ve already arrived, this is important."
"Okay, okay, then Sixth Uncle will show you a good time." Wang Dinghai said happily, "Later I’ll show you a fishing stunt."
Just before boarding the ship, Wang Shouzhe called several Household Generals to his side and whispered some instructions to them. Understanding, the generals saluted and spread out to carry out their tasks.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe, together with Gongsun Hui, follow Wang Dinghai toward the Deep Water Berth.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Ancestor Longyan! Our Trump Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: Chapter 5: Ancestor Longyan! Our Trump Card
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Zhe’er, how... how can you say such things?" Gongsun Hui was taken aback by Wang Shouzhe’s shocking words, as he had always been well-behaved.
"Fifth Sister-in-law, I think Shouzhe’s words make sense." Today, Wang Dinghai was quite impressed with Wang Shouzhe and chimed in immediately, "Ancestor Longyan can only support the family for so long, it’s better for everyone to be mentally prepared."
Gongsun Hui’s expression changed several times before she finally said, "This is family secret. A few days ago, when I reported to Ancestor Longyan, she personally told me that if she doesn’t take action, she can hold things together for twenty years, but if she does... it’s hard to say."
Twenty years? Wang Shouzhe was secretly pondering. This is much longer than he imagined, perhaps there is still a chance for a turnaround.
"Zhe’er, you are the family’s only hope." Gongsun Hui’s face was extremely serious, "Our Wang Family should continue to endure and keep a low profile, using all the family’s strength to help you break through to the Spirit Platform Realm within twenty years. We must not cause any disturbances!"
"Yes, yes, Sixth Uncle will try to catch more spirit fish to sell for funds to gather resources for you." Wang Dinghai also agreed with the plan, "As long as you can reach the Spirit Platform Realm, our Wang Family will truly be saved."
"I reach the Spirit Platform Realm? And then what?" Wang Shouzhe sneered with disdain, "Let’s not say whether I can reach it or not, even if I have the chance, will the Liu Family and Zhao Family just watch and let me break through? Would they give me twenty years? Moreover, even if I luckily break through, I would just be another Ancestor Longyan!"
Wang Shouzhe being a transmigrator, naturally could break free from the traditional thinking of Wang Clan Members.
His words sent a chill through the hearts of Gongsun Hui and Wang Dinghai, who had always lived under the protection of Ancestor Longyan, believing the Liu Family and Zhao Family would not really tear off the mask.
But, if the Wang Shouzhe they pinned all hopes on indeed had the potential to reach the Spirit Platform, would the Liu Family and Zhao Family sit by idly?
"Enough, I purposely hinted that Ancestor’s days are numbered. I believe with Liu Shengye’s cunning strategy, he wouldn’t choose this time to lead the assault and tear into our Wang Family. Therefore, I insist the Household Generals continue sending signals secretly, giving the Liu Family and Zhao Family a countdown of about five years." Wang Shouzhe said coldly, "Whoever dares to provoke us within five years, we’ll fight them to the death, targeting one family to go all out. At critical moments, we might unleash... uh, invite Ancestor Longyan to hold the fort."
In Wang Shouzhe’s view, Ancestor Longyan is the trump card. The greatest value of trump cards is not the moment they are played but their deterrent power beforehand.
"Brilliant." Wang Dinghai slapped his thigh, "Patriarch has calculated well, we are now like a ferocious beast at death’s door, they fear us retaliating desperately. With this, they not only dare not bully us, they will try to curry favor. No wonder that old fox Liu Shengye obediently offered thirty Qian Gold as compensation."
"Not only that, because now our Wang Family has a clear ’expiry date’, such a tempting piece of meat placed upfront, the Liu Family and Zhao Family, who had previously allied because of common enemies, will definitely have other ideas while waiting in silence." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "You know, greed and dissatisfaction are the most basic human nature. The coming situation will definitely become very interesting. If we secretly add fuel to the fire... hehe."
After hearing Wang Shouzhe’s analysis, Gongsun Hui and Wang Dinghai both caught their breath, inadvertently exchanging glances, feeling somewhat fearful. However, at the same time, they both felt a glimmer of hope, a hope for the family to have an opportunity for a turnaround!
"Aunt, Sixth Uncle, this matter is the life-and-death secret of our Wang Race." Wang Shouzhe solemnly clasped his hands, "Firstly, I hope you can keep the secret, and secondly, I hope you can unconditionally trust and support me."
This is Wang Shouzhe’s purpose, as his body is too young, even with the title of clan leader, he is bound to be questioned, thus he can only propose some astonishing ideas to win over key figures and gain allies.
Gongsun Hui is his mother by marriage, and he is also her future reliance, while Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai’s straightforward and open nature makes him easy to win over.
Both Gongsun Hui and Wang Dinghai took a deep breath and solemnly swore.
While the three talked, the medium-sized fishing boat had left the deep-water pier under the crew’s control and entered the rapidly flowing center of the Anjiang.
The vastness of Anjiang exceeded Wang Shouzhe’s imagination, as far as the eye could see, the misty waters stretched boundlessly, with Dingpu Ferry becoming smaller and blurry.
As the boat further entered the depths of Anjiang, the wind and waves grew larger, causing the vessel to sway more violently. Even Wang Shouzhe, with his Sixth Layer Qi Refining Realm peak physical qualities, felt slightly nauseous.
Similarly pampered Gongsun Hui, also turned a little pale, beginning to feel uncomfortable.
"Haha, Fifth Sister-in-law, Shouzhe, fishing boats are not as stable as ferries. When the boat sways, don’t resist the tilt with your body, but go with the flow like a tumbling doll." Wang Dinghai patiently taught them how to handle the pitching of waves.
Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui, both being Black Tortoise Practitioners, having their Profound Qi and physical qualities, quickly adapted to the sway of the boat. Especially Wang Shouzhe, following Wang Dinghai’s example, planted his feet like stakes on the deck, his body rhythmed with the waves until his posture became relaxed and carefree.
"Shouzhe indeed has good talent, let Sixth Uncle perform how I usually catch fish." Wang Dinghai, full of enthusiasm, prepared to show his skills, as there were few relatives in the clan who liked coming to the fishing boat to watch him fish.
"I believe Sixth Uncle’s skills are definitely extraordinary, but let’s have the ordinary fishermen try first." Wang Shouzhe suggested.
Wang Dinghai was taken aback, but then laughed, "Shouzhe, you’re here to test the fishing boat’s standards. All right then, the fishermen on your Sixth Uncle’s flagship fishing boat are all skilled. Wang Goudan, you come and demonstrate for the Clan Leader."
"Yes, Master Hai." A young man in his twenties leaped down from the mast, agile like a monkey. After tidying up a fishing net, he twisted his waist and flung it, sending the net flying from the ship’s side, opening up gracefully in the air into a beautiful large circle,
Splash!
The fishing net, weighed down with heavy sinkers, plunged into the water like an inverted sea bowl and sank to the bottom in a few breaths.
"Good!"
The surrounding fishermen praised in unison.
This is... casting a net, and with quite strong skills.
Wang Shouzhe was able to assess it immediately. Before transmigrating, he was an ordinary office worker who occasionally went fishing with friends. Thus, when browsing Douyin and other video apps, the algorithm would recommend fishing videos, including some videos and live streams of net casting experts.
Even though Wang Shouzhe didn’t play himself, he could tell whether a net was cast well or not. He had to admit, this young man called Goudan had quite a level of skill.
Once Wang Goudan let the net sink, he began to carefully reel in the rope, gathering the net close to the riverbed then gradually pulling it upward. Finally, with a sudden tug, he hauled the entire net onto the boat in an instant.
Got it!
The fishing net had snagged a large fish with white and flowery dorsal fins. Wang Goudan untangled it from the net, captured it, and came over joyfully to claim credit: "Brother Hai, it’s a Nine-star Perch, weighing at least five pounds."
"You’re pretty good, kid. Throw it in the live water tank." Wang Dinghai patted him on the shoulder and praised, then turned to explain to Wang Shouzhe, "Although the Nine-star Perch isn’t a spirit fish, it’s tender and delicious, considered a top-quality fish. Even if sold to a fishmonger, it’s worth a Large Copper. But since our family has fish shops in Changning City, selling what we catch ourselves earns us a few more coins."
Wang Shouzhe nodded in approval. In the Daqian Kingdom, currency is calculated as coins, Large Copper, and Qian Gold. Generally speaking, a pound of rice is only five to ten coins, and it takes a hundred coins to exchange for a Large Copper, making the value of this fish quite significant.
Wang Goudan put the catch into the central live water tank of the fishing boat, a tank that’s in open flow with the outside water to maximize the vitality of the catch.
According to Wang Dinghai, however, only the more valuable catches are given such treatment. The live water tank is also divided into several sections specifically for storing different types of catches.
Thanks to Wang Goudan’s showcase, the other fishermen also began displaying their skills, each with seasoned techniques. The nets they cast were large and round, but the catch wasn’t guaranteed.
Most of the nets pulled up were empty, with only occasional surprises.
After more than an hour, various catches gradually piled up. There were three Nine-star Perches, and even one more expensive Spotted Leopard Mandarin, although weighing only over two pounds, Wang Dinghai indicated it would fetch at least 1 Large Copper and 60 coins. The good catches were reserved for the Clan Leader to enjoy.
On the surface, Wang Shouzhe wore a smile, but inside he was calculating incessantly. This thirty-mile fishing and hunting area is part of the Ping’an Wang Family’s domain, and the family holds this clan asset in high regard, considering it to be an important source of fiscal revenue.
As time went on, Wang Shouzhe grew a bit impatient and said directly, "Sixth Uncle, we’ve demonstrated enough. The skills of the fishermen are indeed impressive. Could we swiftly move on to the main topic and showcase genuine fishing operations?"
Wang Dinghai’s previously radiant expression suddenly froze with confusion: "Shouzhe, haven’t we been demonstrating genuine fishing? Could it be, you’re expecting to see the capture of spirit fish? Some of the smaller spirit fish are caught through luck, while the larger, more aggressive spirit fish require fishing arrows."
Is this professional fishing?
Wang Shouzhe’s face darkened somewhat. In his previous life, out of curiosity, he had tagged along on a professional fishing trip on a colleague’s family relative’s commercial fishing boat. That net alone hauled in more than forty thousand pounds and it was considered poor haul...
As for casting nets, on Earth, it’s purely a recreational fishing tool, just slightly better than fishing rods, meant for leisure. If anyone seriously tried to use casting nets as a professional way to earn a living, their whole family would starve.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Learn About Prohibited Fishing Gear
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: Chapter 6: Learn About Prohibited Fishing Gear
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Shouzhe, do you have any dissatisfaction with our fishing team?" Wang Dinghai asked, lacking confidence.
Dissatisfaction? The dissatisfaction was immense. Wang Shouzhe thought to himself and said gravely, "Sixth Uncle, what is our fishing fleet’s annual output? What are the expenses, and what is the profit?"
Upon hearing this question, Wang Dinghai was dumbfounded, unable to answer such a question.
"Zhe’Er, let me answer that." Gongsun Hui chimed in at this moment, "I’ve been managing the family’s accounts these past years. The fishing fleet has a total of nine small fishing boats and one medium-sized fishing boat. In the past five years, the average annual total catch of ordinary fish is about 6,700 dan, with a revenue of 486 Qian Gold. The annual average catch of spirit fish is 400 jin, yielding a revenue of 120 Qian Gold, with an average annual total revenue of 606 Qian Gold."
This time, it was Wang Shouzhe’s turn to be surprised at Gongsun Hui. Although he knew that his aunt was managing the accounts, he didn’t expect her to be so familiar with the numbers, speaking them aloud instantaneously.
However, the fish catch numbers seemed too low. With ten fishing boats combined, it averages about twenty dan per day, which is about two thousand jin of fish!
"Why look at me like this, Zhe’Er?" Gongsun Hui said calmly, "Your aunt’s Black Tortoise cultivation is not strong, but as the direct daughter of the Shanyang Gongsun Family, mastering the Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art is mandatory. Your father, being the Clan Leader, naturally requires my assistance in managing the accounts."
At this point, Gongsun Hui’s eyes showed a trace of disappointment. Despite her meticulous work on the accounts, with every figure memorized, her efforts were not valued by her husband Wang Dingyue.
This made Wang Shouzhe recall a fact of the Black Tortoise World: marriages among Black Tortoise Clans are always direct lineage to direct lineage. As a direct daughter, Gongsun Hui is destined to marry a Young Clan Leader of another family.
Just as Wang Shouzhe, in the future, would marry a direct daughter from another family.
The topic wandered away, but seeing that Gongsun Hui was so clear about the accounts, Wang Shouzhe was invigorated, "Sixth Uncle previously introduced me to the high-value catches that are prized by nobles, why then is the six thousand seven hundred dan of fish only valued at 486 Qian Gold annually?"
"Your Sixth Uncle wanted to please you with the highlights of our catches. Most of the fish do not hold such high value. In addition, the family also operates a fish stall business, which processes the catches through ice preservation, pickling, and smoking before selling them. Those earnings are counted separately. Family consumption of fish is also recorded in the accounts through Qian Gold purchases." Gongsun Hui explained clearly, "Please, allow me to continue, like with expenses and net profit, for example."
Seeing someone value her work for the first time, Gongsun Hui felt encouraged and said, "As for expenses, considering the current 46 fishermen and workers, the annual cost and monthly allowance are 151 Qian Gold. Maintenance of the ten fishing boats, including repairs of various tools, costs 92 Qian Gold annually. Furthermore, the average annual taxation is 72 Qian Gold, with average annual pension payments being 60 Qian Gold. After deducting all expenses, the average annual net income is 221 Qian Gold. This does not include the family tribute owed to your Sixth Uncle, which is accounted separately."
Hearing this, Wang Dinghai blushed slightly and said sheepishly, "How can the net income be so little? I thought we could bring in at least four or five hundred Qian Gold annually for the family."
"Sixth Uncle, you can verify the accounts anytime if you have doubts." Gongsun Hui replied calmly.
"No, no, not at all, Fifth Sister-in-law, I didn’t mean that." Wang Dinghai hurriedly waved his hands and said, "I’m just a rough man who only knows how to fish. Shouzhe, these boring accounts are no fun to listen to. Let Sixth Uncle show you some skills~"
"No rush, Sixth Uncle." Wang Shouzhe reassured, then frowned and asked Gongsun Hui, "Two questions: first, what is the basis for taxation? Second, what is the pension about?"
"Shouzhe, the winds and waves of Anjiang are strong and unpredictable. On occasion, formidable aquatic ferocious beasts appear." Wang Dinghai quickly explained, "Even if Sixth Uncle is careful, it’s inevitable that some fishermen might perish in Anjiang. Without high wages and pensions, no one would join the fishing team."
"As for taxes, they’re based on the size of the fishing boat. Small boats pay 6 Qian Gold annually, and medium-sized boats pay 18 Qian Gold annually." Gongsun Hui provided an explanation.
Flat tax rates.
Wang Shouzhe understood that in such an economically underdeveloped world, flat tax rates were the most effective.
Having grasped all the information, Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands to Wang Dinghai and said, "Sixth Uncle, I didn’t expect Anjiang’s fishing industry to be so dangerous. I appreciate your contributions to the family over the years."
Wang Dinghai relaxed, laughing awkwardly, "Shouzhe, just don’t blame the fishing team for not making enough money. To be honest, when Fifth Brother was Clan Leader, I proposed the idea of expanding the fishing fleet. Managing ten boats is the same as managing over twenty; it’s not a problem. I could also recruit more fishermen, so we can earn more Qian Gold for the family. After all, the thirty-li stretch of Anjiang can accommodate more than twenty fishing boats without issue. The Liu Family alone has over twenty boats~"
"Ten more boats?" Wang Shouzhe asked, intrigued, "Could you elaborate?" For the family to grow, Qian Gold was the most crucial resource.
"Let me explain." Understanding that Wang Dinghai was not good with numbers, Gongsun Hui interjected, "I am aware of Sixth Uncle’s idea. He wants to add two medium-sized fishing boats and ten small fishing boats. The cost of each medium-sized boat is 120 Qian Gold and each small boat costs 45 Qian Gold, making a total investment of 690 Qian Gold. Assuming we recruit the necessary fishermen, the investment would pay for itself within three years."
"If the accounts balance within three years, it’s worth doing." Wang Shouzhe nodded in agreement, "Even if we stop later, selling the boats won’t result in a loss."
Wang Dinghai’s face lit up, feeling he had found a kindred spirit, patting his thighs and saying, "Fifth Sister-in-law, I told you it could be done. I just don’t understand why, when I’m willing to contribute more to the family, Fifth Brother disagreed."
Gongsun Hui’s expression turned awkward, "Sixth Uncle, you don’t know, but the Wang Family has been short on money in many aspects these years." She sighed inwardly; she actually supported expanding the fleet, but Wang Dingyue was unwilling. Furthermore, her plan to borrow money from her natal family was also firmly opposed by Wang Dingyue.
"Shouzhe, do you agree to expand the fleet?" Wang Dinghai probed.
"Zhe’Er, if you need to expand the fleet," Gongsun Hui hesitated slightly and said, "the auntie can make a trip back to Shanyang to raise some Qian Gold." It is embarrassing to borrow money from her parents, but for the sake of the family’s development, she couldn’t care less.
"No, I do not agree," Wang Shouzhe thought and said.
What?
Wang Dinghai’s face darkened.
Even Gongsun Hui looked at Wang Shouzhe inexplicably; hadn’t they just agreed to do it? Could it be that, like his father, he is too proud to let her raise money?
"This is the time for this," Wang Shouzhe frowned and pondered, "To develop the family, we cannot do without Qian Gold; to obtain more Qian Gold, we must expand the benefits of the family’s property."
"Isn’t that correct? How can we increase the benefits without expanding the fleet?" Wang Dinghai looked eagerly at Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe mysteriously smiled: "Sixth Uncle, you are a fishing expert. I have a few ideas to discuss with you. Have you ever thought about a fishing method called trawling? It’s a cooperative fishing operation method involving two boats."
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe pulled Wang Dinghai down and began to sketch on the deck.
Trawling is a very conventional fishing operation method on Earth; it is a specialized fishing method, and its efficiency is far beyond that of net casting, which is merely an entertainment tool.
If it weren’t for the excellent natural ecology of Anjiang, with Wang Dinghai’s extremely unprofessional fishing methods, he would have lost even his pants.
Of course, because trawling is too powerful, it greatly harms the natural ecological environment, which Wang Shouzhe strongly resists. But now the family faces a situation where, if it doesn’t develop, it will be obliterated.
They might as well abandon natural fishing methods once the family grows stronger.
"Shouzhe, your idea is amazing." Wang Dinghai, being a professional, quickly understood the principles but frowned and said, "However, such a giant net is extremely difficult to make, not to mention our fishing boats can’t pull it, right?"
Can’t pull it!
Alright, Wang Shouzhe immediately understood the problem. Sailing ships are not like diesel-powered machinery boats; they don’t have the strength to pull a giant net.
"Then let’s create a smaller one first, focusing on being able to pull it," Wang Shouzhe said. "Let’s first make a small trawl net, three to four zhang wide and six to seven zhang long with a conical shape. It would be like a big pocket with reverse bristles inside to prevent the fish from escaping..."
"This can be tried," Wang Dinghai’s eyes shone, "I’ll go back and find twenty net weavers to make it together; it will probably be completed in two months."
Twenty people, two months...
Wang Shouzhe was rather helpless about this; the production capacity of this Black Tortoise World is indeed very low. However, because of this, the natural resources of this world are well protected.
Unlike Wang Shouzhe’s world, nearby seas have been almost plowed flat by trawling, leading nations to have to enact various fishing bans. The power of trawling is no joke.
"Don’t rush, Sixth Uncle, take a look at this fishing tool, though not as good as trawling... Its advantage lies in easy operation; if done well, even ordinary people can handle it."
Next, Wang Shouzhe drew another fishing tool for Wang Dinghai, called Maneuvering Trap. This fishing method is somewhat similar to net casting, but net casting covers the catch from top to bottom, and maneuvering trap scoops it from bottom to top.
Maneuvering trap is much more complex overall than net casting, but once the setup and levers are done, it’s simpler than net casting in terms of effort. Its advantage is that once made, any ordinary labor, even minors, can operate it.
Furthermore, maneuvering trap has a more powerful evolved form called Blocking River Net, if it can be made, its destructive power is no less than a small trawl net.
"Shouzhe, where did you get your brilliant ideas?" Wang Dinghai was excited to the point of trembling, "If everything can be realized, we will be rich."
"In some ancient miscellaneous writings when idle," Wang Shouzhe said again, "Sixth Uncle, let’s understand Mesh Cage and Bewildering Formation together..."
These two are naturally strong lethal fishing tools, both already strong enough to be listed among prohibited fishing gear by the nation, showing their superiority; both are passive stationary fishing gear.
After installation and deployment, you just need to go and check at regular intervals, similar to idling in games... Don’t worry about anything, just harvest regularly.
Wang Dinghai was almost driven mad; as a Black Tortoise "professional fisherman," Wang Shouzhe seemed to open a whole new world to him.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Capturing the Red-Scaled Eel
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: Chapter 7: Capturing the Red-Scaled Eel
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Sixth Uncle, these are all family secrets crucial to our rise. Everything must prioritize confidentiality." Wang Shouzhe temporarily abandoned his plan to explain the Lure to him, speaking earnestly.
"I understand. I’ll be extremely cautious with all of this, and when the time comes, I ask the family to assign two Household Generals to me." Wang Dinghai was trembling with excitement, "Additionally, about that transporting zither, I have some ideas. We can quickly transform a transporting zither with a cast net and test the results first. If it’s possible..."
His eyes were shining, eager to start experimenting.
The area from Dingpu Ferry to Chaotic Stone Beach was Wang Family’s territory, where ordinary people neither would nor dared to approach the riverbank. After all, the riverbank was undeveloped and simply cleared before, posing various unintended dangers.
Moreover, the river section meandered with countless secluded, hidden spots. Inspired by Wang Shouzhe, Wang Dinghai, who was familiar with the fishing industry, already burst with multiple schemes and ideas.
Once Wang Shouzhe agreed, Wang Dinghai steered the boat toward a hidden mini dock in the river section. Each mini dock here functioned as a secret little stronghold, capable of multiple uses. A smart rabbit has three burrows, let alone the Wang Family’s fishing fleet.
Beside the small dock, concealed wooden cabins were built as shelters from wind and waves. Wang Dinghai arranged Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui in this humble place, leaving Wang Goudan to serve them, then hurried off.
"It’s the first time seeing Sixth Uncle so bustling," Gongsun Hui remarked emotionally, "It seems the fishing idea you provided, Zhe’Er, will work wonderfully."
"All these were learned from ancient books and untested in practice, hopefully useful for the family," Wang Shouzhe replied with a light smile, then said to Wang Goudan, "Doggy, can you grill fish?"
"I can." Wang Goudan nodded smartly, "Patriarch, I’ll grill some fish now." He said, then dashed off in a flash.
Once only Gongsun Hui and Wang Shouzhe remained, Gongsun Hui scrutinized Wang Shouzhe closely, making him feel a bit uncomfortable before sighing emotionally: "Zhe’Er, you’ve changed, becoming free-spirited and confident. The former you only focused on cultivating under heavy burdens, neglecting everything else. If it weren’t for Mother watching you grow up, one might suspect you were exchanged."
"Aunty, you’re joking. Before, I didn’t have to worry with father around," Wang Shouzhe said with a calm expression, sighed, and continued, "But now that father is gone and the family situation is dire, if I don’t pull myself together, where will the Wang Family head? Aunty, let’s not talk about this. You must be tired from the journey. Get some rest, and we’ll look forward to Sixth Uncle’s surprise later."
Wang Shouzhe took control of the situation, proactively ending the conversation, and led by example in closing his eyes to rest.
Half an hour later, Wang Goudan brought back a few golden-brown grilled fish, with a fragrant aroma wafting. Wang Shouzhe took out two Large Copper coins and tossed them: "Your reward, wait outside."
"Thank you, Patriarch, thank you, Patriarch." Wang Goudan joyfully ran outside.
The grilled fish was shared with Gongsun Hui. Although Doggy’s cooking skills were average, using just a sprinkle of coarse salt, the freshness and quality of the ingredients were outstanding, making Wang Shouzhe savor every bite.
Gongsun Hui was also eating such rustic food for the first time. Her beautiful eyes sparkled with delight as she ate, finding it quite to her taste.
After finishing a few grilled fish, Wang Dinghai’s excited shout came from outside: "Shouzhe, Fifth Sister-in-law, come out and take a look!"
Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui heard the call and went out to the small dock. There, Wang Dinghai had set up a makeshift transporting zither as planned. Goodness, that transporting zither made Wang Shouzhe’s eyebrows twitch. The four support pillars were as thick as arms, and the main beam was even thicker than a thigh.
That thing was so cumbersome, it must weigh two or three hundred pounds, impossible for an ordinary Earthling to manage.
Wang Dinghai stood on the wooden dock, combining his waist and horse with ease, and with a slight exertion, he effortlessly raised the cumbersome transporting zither from the water.
Oh, I forgot that guy is a Qi Refining Realm Fifth Layer Black Tortoise Practitioner, his strength surpassing an ordinary Earthling by more than tenfold.
"Boom!"
The transporting net caught a big fish, which exploded into a wave but was blocked by the net. Before it could react further, it was pulled from the water and lay helpless in the center of the net, ready to be slaughtered. Besides, a few one to three-pound small fish lay silently beside it.
"Good!"
The surrounding fishermen were all cheering excitedly, using simple nets to scoop up their catch with great effort. Although it was just a worthless red carp, its six to seven pounds could fetch several dozen coins, and this also proved the effect of the moving zither.
After that, under Wang Shouzhe’s personal guidance, Wang Dinghai improved the moving zither further, adding tilt rods and counterweights.
The principle is very simple, similar to the seesaw on Earth. However, this seesaw has a triangular shape, with both ends connected by ropes. Properly configured weights on the other end mean that a gentle pressure will lift the zither and net out of the water in a seesaw motion.
This took another two hours, and by the time everything was arranged, it was already dusk, yet everyone’s enthusiasm remained high. In just half an incense stick’s time, one could lift the net once, and it didn’t require much effort.
Of course, empty nets couldn’t be avoided. However, the sky was darkening, and many fish began to stealthily approach the shore in the cover of night, searching for food along the shores, where food is far more abundant than in the middle of the river.
"Boom!" "Splash!"
After several empty nets, there would always be a loud explosion, catching a big fish or something. Occasionally, two or three fish would be caught in one net, exciting the fishermen and Wang Dinghai immensely.
"Shouzhe, we’ve struck it rich!" Wang Dinghai, holding a torch, reported in great joy, "I pulled thirty nets in the last hour, missed five, caught nine big ones, and countless smaller catches.
In just one hour, over a hundred pounds of catch, worth about ten large coppers in total."
This terrifying harvest left Wang Shouzhe a bit dumbfounded; the resources in the Black Tortoise World are indeed much better than those on Earth. But Wang Dinghai added that it was fish spawning season, and night was the best time for fishing, so such a harvest was considered reasonable.
"This thing is much stronger than net casting." Wang Dinghai said excitedly, "Casting nets yields quite a lot too, but the fittest fisherman can cast at most a hundred times a day before running out of energy. But this new tool doesn’t require much physical effort or technique, allowing two fishermen to work in shifts over twelve hours, and it’s much safer since the river shore is slightly less dangerous than the river center."
"Indeed, but you’ve overlooked one advantage, and that’s replicability." Wang Shouzhe, in high spirits, said, "Sixth Uncle, tomorrow find some skilled artisans from the family, refine this crude tool, and gradually spread it. Let’s take advantage of the fish spawning season for another haul this year."
"The most important thing is secrecy." Gongsun Hui added from the side, "Sixth Uncle, manpower cannot be expanded blindly; try to find reliable helpers from collateral relatives."
Everyone added their opinions one after another.
Suddenly!
A loud booming splash.
Wang Goudan shouted fiercely from the other side: "Master Hai, quick, come quickly."
The three looked in unison to see a massive snake-like creature ensnared in the moving zither. Its burst of energy was extremely fierce, and even though two adult fishermen were holding down the moving zither frame and lifting it out of the water, it still thrashed violently in the net, shaking the entire frame.
"It’s a Red-Scaled Eel!" Wang Dinghai’s face showed ecstatic delight, but his expression quickly changed, "Not good, it’s about to break the net."
The Red-Scaled Eel’s sharp teeth bit into the net holes, its body frantically twisting and spinning, instantly tearing a big hole in the fishing net as it naively tried to squeeze out.
Without a word, Wang Dinghai leaped swiftly into the water, swimming rapidly towards the fishing net. Just as the Red-Scaled Eel was about to escape, he reached out his big hand to grip its neck, and with his right hand, he pulled out the Water-Splitting Needle from his waist and fiercely stabbed it in the brain, swirling it around.
Even so, the Red-Scaled Eel continued to entangle him, struggling wildly, showing its tremendously robust life force, until a full incense stick later when it finally died.
