Wang Dinghai dragged it ashore, laying it on the makeshift dock, its body over two zhang long, thicker than a thigh at the thickest point, its entire body covered in red scales.
"A Tier One Aquatic Ferocious Beast, Red-Scaled Eel, Sixth Uncle, this should be an adult Red-Scaled Eel, right? Must weigh a hundred pounds, right?" Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui were also curiously watching.
"Hahaha, not just that, this one weighs at least 150 pounds, worth at least three to fifty Qian Gold." Wang Dinghai sat on the ground, panting, his eyes brimming with excitement, "If this beast gets back into the water, I’m really not sure if I could handle it. But the Red-Scaled Eel is a treasure all over, Patriarch, it’s all thanks to your fortune today, hahahaha~ Tomorrow we’ll take it to Dingpu Ferry to show off a bit."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 8 Wang’s Profound Origin Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: Chapter 8 Wang’s Profound Origin Technique
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
In these familiar waters, Red-Scaled Eels are few in number and hard to come by, and even if you are lucky enough to encounter one, ordinary fishing nets would be torn apart. Catching one requires a combination of luck and skill.
Of course, if you venture into the territory of the Desolate Swamp Evil Water, Red-Scaled Eels become less rare. However, this uncharted and perilous land is likely teeming with dangerous creatures, and even those at the Spirit Platform Realm who wander recklessly could face mortal danger.
With Wang Dinghai’s harvest of this Red-Scaled Eel, the atmosphere suddenly reached a peak, as the fishermen eagerly repaired their nets and continued their spirited endeavors.
Wang Dinghai personally led Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui aboard the boat, and they set sail back to Dingpu Ferry. After reuniting with a few remaining Household Generals, they returned all the way to the main residence.
As night fell, after cleansing themselves, they went to bed for rest.
That night, Wang Shouzhe groped his way into a state of Black Tortoise Cultivation. Due to the fusion of memories, after a brief familiarization, he entered the right track of cultivation.
The Cultivation Technique Wang Shouzhe practiced was called the "Wang’s Profound Origin Technique" Qi Refining Chapter, said to be a method passed down by the earliest ancestors.
This technique cultivates a Profound Origin Qi Force that is balanced and harmonious. It possesses no outstanding strengths but also no fatal weaknesses. However, the further one cultivates in the later stages, the thicker their Profound Power becomes, revealing its subtlety.
Qi Refining Realm!
This is the process by which a Black Tortoise Practitioner refines Profound Qi and strengthens themselves through the purification of Profound Qi. The pure Profound Qi travels along the meridians and acupoints, nurturing them while stimulating each acupoint. These acupoints then generate invisible energy waves in a mysterious rhythm, which spread throughout the body, causing the circulation of blood and Qi to resonate.
As Profound Qi circulates through more acupoints in the body, the strength of this blood and Qi resonance intensifies, until twelve acupoints are successfully linked into a closed loop, and the consumption of Profound Qi reaches its limit, elevating the resonance of blood and Qi to a peak.
Suddenly!
A refreshing sensation spread instantly from the tailbone throughout the body. Wang Shouzhe felt a tingling in his scalp, as if his soul were about to float out, with a mist-like aura rising from the top of his head.
The entire process lasted for ten breaths or so. The intense resonance of blood and Qi within him subsided like a receding tide, transforming into a formless energy that converged toward his lower belly.
A murky breath was expelled from his mouth, and in the empty Qi Sea, a newly born stream of Profound Qi surged like a bubbling spring, soon filling the Qi Sea.
At this moment, Wang Shouzhe could vaguely feel that the newly born Profound Qi in the Qi Sea had grown slightly stronger than before, and his previously tired energy seemed to have recovered significantly, appearing somewhat more powerful.
This completed one cycle of "Profound Origin Technique" cultivation. The practice of Black Tortoise Cultivation is a long and accumulative process, where all formidable individuals are formed through such painstaking accumulation.
However, in this process, there is a significant consumption of blood and Qi. Black Tortoise Practitioners must supplement themselves with food and Elixirs to replenish blood and Qi. Otherwise, such cultivation not only brings no benefit but also depletes blood and Qi to the detriment of the body.
The deeper Black Tortoise Practitioners advance in their cultivation, the stronger their demand for food and nutrition becomes. This is why they establish Noble Families, capitalizing on the family’s form to acquire wealth and abundant resources to support themselves.
Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe recently had abundant nutrition, with vigorous blood and Qi, without refinement.
Assessing his current condition, he immediately began a second cycle...
By dawn, in about two hours, Wang Shouzhe had completed four whole cycles of cultivation. At this point, he felt extremely energetic, with seemingly endless energy within him, clearly sensing some progress in his Cultivation Realm.
However, the previously abundant blood and Qi within his body had been greatly consumed. He could feel a sense of "hunger" from his body, which differed from the usual feeling of an empty stomach, yet was peculiar and distinct.
At the same time, he also felt some "soreness and swelling" and discomfort in his acupoints and meridians. Experience told him that even if his blood and Qi were abundant, he should not continue cultivation in this state. It was necessary to allow the overburdened acupoints and meridians to naturally recover.
Nevertheless, the progress was gratifying. Based on his previous life’s memory and experience, evaluating his current situation, Wang Shouzhe felt that if he could make such progress every day, he would have a chance to break through the bottleneck and reach the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm in less than three months.
It’s just that achieving such an ideal state is almost impossible under normal circumstances. After a large consumption of blood and Qi, relying solely on ordinary food for replenishment is very slow. A substantial amount of Spirit Rice and Spiritual Food is needed for supplementation.
Even as the first sequence in the allocation of clan cultivation resources, Wang Shouzhe currently receives just five catties of White Jade Spirit Rice, five catties of Spirit Fish Flesh, and five catties of Spirit Horned Yak Meat per month!
This amount of energy-rich high-level ingredients is sufficient for him to eat five meals, averaging a replenishment every six to seven days. Additionally, being in the family’s primary cultivation sequence, he is allotted one Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill per month.
The Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill is a higher-grade cultivation resource compared to Spiritual Food, but it is priced at ten Qian Gold each, making it extremely expensive. Clan members further down the cultivation sequence can only request one from the clan when they are about to break through a cultivation tier as an auxiliary aid.
If he could eat Spiritual Food every meal and have a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill every day, Wang Shouzhe estimated that his cultivation speed would take off...
"Patriarch, your breakfast is here." The servant Wang Gui knocked on the door from outside.
"Come in."
Wang Shouzhe got up from the bed, while Wang Gui entered and placed the breakfast aside. After serving the Patriarch to wash and brush his teeth with clear water, he then opened the food box and arranged the contents.
"Huh? A large bowl of White Jade Spirit Rice Porridge, and steamed Spirit Fish preserved fish chunks?" Wang Shouzhe looked curiously at his exquisite breakfast, which, besides the two precious spiritual foods, included several pastries and side dishes to accompany the porridge.
He knew this breakfast was not a regular setup. Though eating spiritual food at every meal could rapidly replenish blood and Qi and maximize cultivation progress, there is a principle of diminishing marginal utility at work here.
Particularly with frequent consumption, it inevitably leads to considerable nutrition wastage, reducing the cost-to-benefit ratio.
The Wang Family is too poor to afford such a luxurious style of cultivation. Moreover, the family has its rules; even a Clan Leader cannot arbitrarily exploit other clan members.
"Patriarch, this was delivered by Miss Xia He, who is by Lady Gongsun’s side," Wang Gui honestly responded, "She said that Lady Gongsun prepared the breakfast personally at dawn. She also brought a message from Lady Gongsun, saying that the Patriarch is at a critical juncture of rushing the late stage of the Qi Refining Realm, so no need to be overly polite."
Indeed!
Wang Gui’s words confirmed Wang Shouzhe’s speculation. This was Lady Gongsun Hui’s share of rations, spared for him. Especially her message of not being overly polite, which preempted Wang Shouzhe’s excuses.
Alright then, don’t waste Lady’s heartfelt intention.
Besides, he believed the future of the family would become brighter and better. At least, with his efforts yesterday, the future earnings of Wang Dinghai’s fishery fleet would more than double, significantly alleviating the strain on family resources.
A meal full of Spiritual Food slightly replenished his depleted blood and Qi, and as the food was digested and transformed, the blood and Qi grew fuller.
After eating and drinking to his fill, Wang Shouzhe contemplated visiting other clan industries to conduct inspections. Whether he liked it or not, he was now completely bound to the Ping’an Wang Family.
And as the Clan Leader, the helmsman, he should have comprehensive knowledge of each aspect of the clan so that he can contemplate the situation as a whole and find ways to revitalize this declining family.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Me! The Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Chapter 9: Me! The Golden Finger
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
For other transmigrators, they all have Goldfinger systems. As long as they silently recite the system, they can easily access a variety of data panels at a glance.
However, without the assistance of a Goldfinger system, Wang Shouzhe is now unafraid. With the experience of his Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai, he gradually discovered that he and the "natives" of this world have huge differences in perspective and thinking.
For example, in terms of cultural knowledge, before transmigrating, he was just an ordinary graduate from a second-tier university, working an ordinary job for several years. On Earth, he was just an inconspicuous member of the vast human sea.
Setting aside kindergarten. Six years of elementary school, six years of middle and high school, and four years of university! The time spent in professionally and systematically learning knowledge amounted to sixteen years, from literature, music, language, philosophy, astronomy, geography, history, politics, to mathematics, physics, chemistry, and computer science, among others.
Most of the knowledge may have already settled into the depths of his brain’s memory, but this vast amount of knowledge, which he can’t recall immediately, forms Wang Shouzhe’s exceptional perspective and logical thinking compared to the natives.
Moreover, before transmigrating, various online texts, short videos, and information had already evolved to the extreme. Swiping on the phone, the day fades to night, another swipe and it’s dawn.
Every day, there are strange knowledge points quietly increasing.
"Perhaps these are my Goldfingers." Wang Shouzhe murmured, his eyes gleaming, "As for the system panel, it’s not difficult to solve. At most, I’ll build a basic panel that needs frequent updating and maintenance myself."
The panel mode can refer to some third-rate construction game panels I’ve played before.
However, before establishing the panel, I still have to personally explore and understand the entire family structure and specific details in depth. Although he has fused with the memories of his predecessor, the predecessor was only eighteen years old.
A lot of time was spent learning and cultivating, with a very shallow understanding of family affairs.
He only knew that the most important pillar industries in the family were three farms, namely "Fenggu Farm," "Xingsheng Farm," and "Xinmao Silkworm Farm." The importance of these three farms to the family far exceeds that of industries like the Fishing Team.
The harvest of each farm is extremely important to the family, so the three farms are currently managed by three experienced elders of the Xiao Generation in the family.
Today, Wang Shouzhe decided to visit the nearby Fenggu Farm first, which is managed by the Xiao Generation elder Wang Xiaozhi.
"Wang Gui, prepare the carriage." Once Wang Shouzhe made up his mind, he gave an order.
Wang Gui acknowledged the order and quickly went to prepare.
Wang Shouzhe then walked slowly towards the main gate, all the while thinking about matters concerning Fenggu Farm. As he reached the courtyard, he heard a lively female voice greeting, "Hello, Fourth Brother."
Wang Shouzhe turned to look and saw two girls, one big and one small, standing not far away. The older one was in her prime youth, wearing a light blue outfit and looking quite beautiful.
The younger one looked about eleven or twelve years old, with braided pigtails, also dressed quite prettily. Due to shyness, she hid behind the older girl but couldn’t help peeking curiously at Wang Shouzhe.
Curiously, both girls carried a large, oddly-shaped box on their backs, which looked quite heavy. Each also carried a sword, appearing ready to go out.
"Oh, it’s Luo Tong and Luo Jing." Wang Shouzhe instantly recognized them and greeted them with a smile, "You two look dressed up, planning to go out?"
The older one was Wang Luotong, who was seventeen years old. The younger one was Wang Luojing, only twelve. Like Wang Shouzhe, they were of the seventh generation descendants passed down from Ancestor Zhou Xuan.
The women of the Black Tortoise family were different from ancient Huaxia. Although ultimately destined for marriage alliances, they had considerable autonomy before marriage. They received quality education, and cultivation, and could even participate in managing family property like men.
"Fourth Brother." Wang Luotong made a courteous bow, a flash of surprise in her eyes, "Recently, the harvest on the farm is near, and Grandpa has been busy and hasn’t had time to return, so I’m taking Luojing to visit him."
In Wang Luotong’s impression, Fourth Brother Wang Shouzhe had always been quite serious. Whenever the siblings met, at most, they just greeted each other briefly and then hurried away. There was never such a pleasant compliment as now.
Wang Shouzhe recalled that both Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing were granddaughters of Elder Wang Xiaozhi, their father being the fourth Wang Dingbang of the Ding Generation. However, Fourth Uncle Wang Dingbang had passed away five years ago.
The naming order for the Wang family’s males was Yu Chen Qiong Xiao, Ding Shou Zong Shi, regardless of direct or collateral lineage. Wang Shouzhe’s father, Wang Dingyue, was the fifth of the sixth generation Ding Generation, while Wang Shouzhe was the fourth among the seventh generation Shou Generation males. However, both Wang Dingyue and Wang Shouzhe were direct lineages of the family, while others were just direct lineages.
The Wang family’s females follow the order of Zhu Long Ling Zhen, Liu Luo Li Ying, like the current pillar Ancestor Longyan, the only living third-generation ancestor in the family.
Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing were the fourth and fifth among the seventh-generation female namesakes. Wang Luomiao, the daughter of Aunt Gongsun Hui, was ranked seventh. However, similarly, Wang Luomiao was a legitimate daughter, holding a different status and position within the family.
The further the family develops, the greater the age gap between generations.
Just like Wang Shouzhe’s seventh-generation Shou or Luo generation, the oldest male Wang Shouxin was already forty-three, older than Wang Dingyue. The youngest seventh-generation Wang Luolan was only five years old.
Additionally, there were already quite a few of the eighth-generation Zong and Li generations, with the oldest, Wang Zongwei, being twenty. However, when he saw little girls like Wang Luojing and Wang Luolan, he had to call them aunt.
Let’s set aside idle talk for now.
After some thought, Wang Shouzhe said, "Are you planning to walk there? I’m also heading to Fenggu Farm. Why not take a carriage with me?"
He knew that the family was becoming increasingly difficult, and it was impossible to provide a dedicated carriage, let alone household generals, for two young girls.
The journey from here to Fenggu Farm was about twenty miles, requiring at least an hour on foot. However, since this area was Wang’s territory and long-developed lands, there shouldn’t be any danger.
Moreover, being female members of the Wang family, they weren’t weak women who couldn’t even crush a chicken.
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Luotong was somewhat flattered and hurriedly thanked him. Wang Luojing also appeared somewhat happy, chirping, "Fourth Brother is so nice."
"Don’t be happy too soon. Fourth Brother will test you on your studies and cultivation along the way." Wang Shouzhe laughed.
"Ah~" The sisters Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing became a bit flustered, especially Wang Luojing, whose pretty little face drooped a little, showing a grievance that it might have been better to walk.
Soon after.
Four household generals guarded Wang Shouzhe’s carriage on yellow steeds from the front and rear. Inside, Wang Luojing was a bit restless traveling with her two sisters, her eyes occasionally darting to the snacks on the small table.
Because of the company of his two sisters, Wang Shouzhe had just asked Wang Gui to prepare some candied fruits and melons, which were placed on a small square table in the middle of the carriage.
"Luotong, I see your aura seems stable at the Peak of Qi Refining Realm Second Layer. How long has it been? Are you preparing to break through?"
As a female, being able to cultivate to the second layer of Qi Refining Realm around the age of seventeen was a testament to her good talents and considerable effort.
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Luotong accepted the fruit, answering somewhat awkwardly, "It’s been over two months now, and I’m preparing to break through."
Wang Shouzhe’s brows furrowed instantly, "It’s been too long; why not use a ’Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill’ to help with the breakthrough? According to family decision, you have the right to claim one."
"That’s because...." Wang Luotong lowered her head, replying somewhat nervously, "Grandfather said the family resources are too tight right now, and it will take some time to have a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill."
"That’s not true." Wang Luojing interjected, her voice crisp, "Grandfather said that now family resources are too tight, it will be a while before we have a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill."
"Luojing, you can’t just blurt things out." Wang Luotong said anxiously.
"Luojing, don’t speak nonsense," Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned a bit serious, "Is Wang Shounuo your brother bullying you? If so, I’ll go teach him a lesson."

chapters.title: Chapter 10 Fenggu Farm
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: Chapter 10 Fenggu Farm
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"That’s not it, it’s just that Grandpa said sister will get married in less than two years." Wang Luojing pouted, "Might as well help brother improve his cultivation a bit more."
"Fourth Brother, I willingly gave it to brother. You, please don’t blame him." Wang Ruotong nervously explained.
According to the clan rules, those who seize resources from others within the clan will be severely punished. However, if given voluntarily, it does not fall within the punishment scope.
"Sigh!"
Wang Shouzhe sighed heavily in his heart. It seems the Fourth Old Master is somewhat favoring males over females. However, this is basically a common phenomenon in the Wang Family nowadays, and it’s all because of poverty.
Wang Shounuo is not like him, Wang Shouzhe, who is the Direct Lineage Young Clan Leader with good talent, regarded as a first priority for cultivation. Naturally, the resources he can usually allocate are far less.
But for a Black Tortoise Practitioner, the younger they cultivate, the higher they can reach; otherwise, as they age, their body deteriorates, and the difficulty of advancing cultivation increases. The Fourth Old Master probably had no choice but to persuade Wang Ruotong to help Wang Shounuo.
"It’s nothing, it’s all my fault if you think about it," Wang Shouzhe sighed and said, "It’s me occupying too many resources, invisibly reducing the shares for my brothers, sisters, and younger siblings."
"Fourth Brother is of direct lineage, with high talent, and is the pillar of the family, so he should be allocated more resources." Wang Luotong showed a bit of admiration and aspiration in her eyes, "I heard from Grandpa that Fourth Brother’s talent is only slightly less than that of Ancestor Longyan, with a great hope of breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm in the future. As long as Fourth Brother becomes Ancestor Spirit Platform, life for our Wang Family will get better."
"Yes, yes, I also heard that Fourth Brother has already been admitted to the Purple Mansion Academy." Wang Luojing, with wide eyes, said excitedly, "If it weren’t for Fifth Uncle’s incident this time, forcing Fourth Brother to stand out as Clan Leader, you’d already be at Purple Mansion Academy now, right? I heard in Purple Mansion Academy there are beautiful sisters everywhere, if Fourth Brother goes, he will definitely marry one back."
Purple Mansion Academy!
To all the young people in the Changning Region, it’s a dreamland, an unattainable dream.
"Don’t talk nonsense; what’s in that yellow-haired little girl’s head of yours?" Wang Shouzhe laughed and glared at her, stuffing her with a few pieces of preserved fruit, "I haven’t even passed the final assessment yet; who knows, I might just get eliminated."
Amidst the laughter, however, Wang Shouzhe felt immense pressure, the pressure of the entire clan’s hopes resting on him.
"In any case, Fourth Brother is the strongest." Wang Luojing clearly had a kind of blind admiration for him.
"The strength of a clan can’t rely on just one person." Wang Shouzhe smiled warmly and looked at Wang Luojing, "You’re also a member of the clan, and you have to work hard too. I think your talent is quite good, reaching the High Tier First Layer at such a young age in the Qi Refining Realm. If you work hard, you might get admitted into the Purple Mansion Academy and be as outstanding as Ancestor Longyan."
"Mm, mm, Jing’er will definitely work hard." Wang Luojing’s eyes were filled with aspiration, "At least I can’t let Luoqiu surpass me again."
Luoqiu?
"Is it Wang Luoqiu from Third Uncle’s family?" Wang Shouzhe said with slight curiosity, "Could it be that she has already reached the Peak First Layer and is about to break through?"
"She has already broken through." Wang Luojing pouted, a little upset, "She even came to show off to me a while ago."
"Her talent is indeed quite good." Wang Shouzhe was somewhat surprised, "I remember she’s only eleven years old, right?" That talent doesn’t seem to fall far short of his.
It seems that the young generation of the Wang Family is no worse than the Liu or Zhao Families, just that resource issues are holding everyone’s growth back. He frowned, pondering continuously.
Take Liu Yongzhou of the Liu Family as an example, at the age of twenty-three or -four, reaching the High Tier Fifth Layer, he is considered quite outstanding among the younger generation. If Wang Ruotong were given ample cultivation resources, her future achievements may not be inferior to Liu Yongzhou’s.
Sadly, firstly, she is a girl. Secondly, the family is too poor.
Later, Wang Shouzhe intentionally or unintentionally tested their cultural studies, only to find that they were average in this aspect, particularly in arithmetic, which was a complete mess.
This made Wang Shouzhe’s face darken, directly scolding, "It is disgraceful, pretty heads with nothing inside. Though the Black Tortoise Clan builds on martial arts, cultural and knowledge foundation is the root of a family’s heritage."
"Fourth Brother, we won’t dare anymore."
"When you return this time, study well, three months later I’ll test you again."
"Oh!"
Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing both dropped their heads.
...
From the Wang Family’s Main Residence to Fenggu Farm, it’s only twenty miles, with a solid hard clay road allowing two carriages to pass, and wheat planted on both sides of the road making the journey smooth.
It’s early midsummer, with lush vegetation on both sides and vibrant vitality. Patches of green wheat sway with the wind like azure waves. This season is the time for wheat spike filling, with the weather fine and sunny, clearly a good omen.
While talking with his two sisters, Wang Shouzhe arrived at Fenggu Farm in less than an hour.
Farmhouses are generally located where the land is relatively fertile. This land is about seven or eight miles from the main stream of the An River, with a small tributary over ten feet wide winding down through Fenggu Farm.
Ancestors diverted this tributary, creating several crosswise channels about three yards wide, making this water area look somewhat like a large "Feng" character from above, thus the ancestors named it Fenggu Farm.
Following the Feng-shaped water source, rows of orderly houses were built. Though simple, each has a front and back yard where they can plant some fruits and vegetables, raise some chickens, and every backyard has simple stone steps leading to the channels for laundry and cooking.
Large and small channels have flocks of ducks and geese playing and feeding, creating a lively clamor.
In front of the houses is well-cultivated fertile land, with expanses of wheat fields swaying in the wind, strikingly vast and beautiful.
What a piece of pastoral scenery.
Living in the city for so long, Wang Shouzhe was instantly captivated by this leisurely and peaceful scene, having initially believed that the Mystical World he crossed into was merely about fighting and confrontation.
He was captivated by this charming and serene scene. When he first traversed, his understanding of the Mystical World was limited to fights.
A household servant had already come ahead to report, but even so, it took Wang Shouzhe and his two sisters about half an hour to wait by the river bank before they were received at Fenggu Farm.
Most farms are settled on relatively fertile lands. Here, an offshoot of the river trickled down through the fields of Fenggu Farm.
A previous ancestor had diverted the branch and horizontally carved out several channels that looked like the character "Feng." This is how Fenggu Farm got its name.
Following its character-shaped waterfront, rows of neatly arranged houses were built, with front and backyards for planting crops and raising poultry, while the backyards have simple stone steps leading to the river channels for washing clothes and cooking.
The canals, big and small, within the farm tremble with the vast fields of wheat swaying in the wind, creating a magnificent panorama.
Initially, a household servant came ahead to report, but even so, Wang Shouzhe and his two sisters still waited for a quarter of an hour along the riverside embankment before continuing to Fenggu Farm.
Yet, as rural farms go, Fenggu Farm was perched on fertile land.
As they approached, there was a stream with its flow diverted by a former ancestor, creating several sideways channels that wove through Fenggu Farm.
By taking advantage of the water from the Feng character-shaped source, a series of neatly arranged rows were built. These simple houses were surrounded by open lands for growing crops, interspersed with small gardens for raising chickens.
The front of the houses opened to meticulously cultivated fields of mature farmland, with broad expanses of wheat swaying in the wind, creating a wonderful sight.
Wang Shouzhe was mesmerized by this serene and relaxed landscape, and the picture drew him in. Before he knew it, his understanding of the Mystical World he’d crossed into had deepened.
Ahead, a household general had already notified them. Still, even so, it was two ke before Wang Shouzhe and his two sisters were waiting by the riverbank, until they finally arrived at Fenggu Farm.
Farmhouses generally settled where the land is most fertile. Here, there is a branch of the river extending through Fenggu Farm.
Past ancestors cut the tributary, creating several horizontal channels, so the area looks like a large "Feng" character, named the Fenggu Farm by them.
With the Feng character-shaped water source, lines of neatly arranged houses were built, each with some space for vegetable gardens and free-ranging chickens, with simple stone slabs in the backyards leading to the channels for laundry and cooking.
In front of us are well-cultivated farmlands, fields of wheat waving in the wind with extraordinary magnificence.
Captivated by this pleasant, tranquil picture, Wang Shouzhe instantly felt drawn into the scene, originally thinking the mystical world he had crossed to was just about the conflicts between martial combat and struggle.
Yet, an earlier report from a household general not stopping us didn’t hinder Wang Shouzhe and his two sisters from waiting by the riverside field edges for about a quarter of an hour before reaching Fenggu Farm.
The farm was located in a fertile landscape, with a small river’s branch flowing through the land, which an older ancestor had diverted, crafting into several horizontal channels passing through Fenggu Farm.
The ancestors creatively named it Fenggu Farm by designing it around the Feng character-shaped water sources, erecting rows of neatly arranged houses equipped with front gardens, backyard vegetable patches, and rudimentary stone steps heading to the channels meant for laundry and cooking.
The front displayed meticulously maintained fields of tillage, where vast spans of wheat fields sway prolifically in the wind, incredibly vast and majestic.
In front of this pleasant and leisurely image, Wang Shouzhe was thoroughly engrossed, having initially crossed into the Mystical World within a comprehension that revolved solely around combat and the struggle for power.
While the servants had arrived earlier to report, even so, Wang Shouzhe and his two sisters had to wait for around two quarters of an hour by the riverbank before finally reaching Fenggu Farm.
Generally, a farm is situated where the land is rich and fertile. Here, a tributary winds its way down, meandering through Fenggu Farm.
Ancestors diverted it sideways to create several channels that resemble a huge "Feng" character, thus naming this site Fenggu Farm.
Following the Feng-shaped water source, a line-up of tastefully arranged simple residences with auxiliary farmyards was constructed, featuring front and backyards mainly for cultivating crops, breeding chickens, and backdoor steps leading to these forked river channels allowing for laundry and cooking to be done.
The front of the residences oversees carefully maintained thriving farmlands, their sprawling wheat fields swaying imposingly with each passing breeze.
As Wang Shouzhe absorbed this relaxing and calming vista, he was taken aback to realize that his initial understanding of this Mystical World — as one confined to constant martial rivalry and confrontation — had been misguided.
Even though prior notification had been sent by a household general, it still took Wang Shouzhe and his sisters two more increments of time to wait at the riverside embankment before reaching their destination at Fenggu Farm.
The farmhouses were strategically positioned on nutrient-rich soil, with a river’s offshoot running through, diverged by foresighted ancestors to fan out into a series of lateral channels that traverse through Fenggu Farm.
This complex network resembled a large "Feng" ideogram, earning it the name "Fenggu Farm."
Rows of simply structured houses, predominantly made from brick and wood, border these water resources. Yards in front offer dedicated vegetable patches and chicken-raising spaces while the adjoining plots are lush croplands that waft rhythmically in the breeze.
As Wang Shouzhe, entranced by the alluring tranquility of this pastoral landscape at Fenggu Farm, he pondered how his initial encounter with the Mystical World was solely defined by martial challenges and confrontations.
One of the household generals had already come ahead to inform them, yet nevertheless, Wang Shouzhe and his sisters had to wait approximately 30 minutes at the embankment until they reached Fenggu Farm properly.
Farms are usually situated on fertile land, and this one is no different. With a nearby river stream redirected by the forebearers now transpiring throughout Fenggu Farm, shaping several waterways.
The landscape follows the outlines of this "Feng" sign, with skillfully arranged rows of structures that accommodate vegetable gardens, chicken coops, doorsteps that lead to the adjoining channels for washing, and expansive wheat fields swaying under the wind’s whispers, hallmarking an impressive and sweeping view.
Absorbed by this delightful and tranquil scene, Wang Shouzhe realized that his initial perception of the Mystical World he had stumbled into was one where martial conflicts reign, overlooking this serene and inviting landscape.
