chapters.title: Chapter 11: The Hope of the Whole Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Chapter 11: The Hope of the Whole Family
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Wang Shouzhe came with a purpose today, but he still remained calm and composed. He casually chatted with Wang Xiaozhi about strange and interesting events. When he mentioned that he and Sixth Uncle, Wang Dinghai, had coincidentally caught a 150-pound Red-Scaled Eel last night, Wang Xiaozhi excitedly slapped his thigh, "That little rascal Dinghai might not catch one in two years, this time it must be thanks to your good fortune."
Although the Red-Scaled Eel is not as good as the Red-tailed Spirit Eel, it is still considered a great tonic and is classified as spiritual food.
Spiritual food is excellent for quickly replenishing the blood and energy of Black Tortoise Practitioners. It is essential for the survival of every Black Tortoise Practitioner. Even for someone like Wang Xiaozhi, who is over seventy and whose cultivation has stagnated and is even gradually regressing, spiritual food is needed from time to time.
Otherwise, the lack of blood and energy would accelerate physical decline and the dissipation of cultivation.
For the younger generation, spiritual food is even more necessary to replenish their blood and energy, allowing them to grow faster and better.
As the two of them chatted and laughed, within half an hour, the cook and two sisters brought out some farmhouse delicacies: fresh chicken, duck, fish, and goose, along with a large pot of braised pork.
"Shouzhe, it’s rare for you to come here, Fourth Grandpa doesn’t have much to entertain you with," Wang Xiaozhi ran into the bedroom and came out shortly after with an ancient-looking wine pot, smiling warmly, "Try this fine wine I’ve cherished for a long time. Feel free to drink as much as you want, and take the rest back if you can’t finish it."
Just as he spoke.
A young man with dark skin, covered in mud, walked in, his voice hearty, "Grandfather, you’re being biased. You never let me have even a sip of this White Jade Spirit Wine, but as soon as Fourth Brother arrives, you bring out the whole pot."
"You little rascal, what makes you think you can compare with Shouzhe?" Wang Xiaozhi burst into laughter and scolded as soon as he saw the young man, "You even managed to come back just in time for the meal; go wash up quickly, and you’ll get a cup."
"Third Brother." Wang Shouzhe greeted with a smile. He knew this was Wang Shounuo, the third in rank among the seventh generation of the Shou Generation in the Wang Family.
"Fourth Brother." Wang Shounuo hurriedly returned the courtesy solemnly, then smiled, "I’ll wash up first and come back to entertain Fourth Brother later." With that, he quickly excused himself.
By the time the bowls, chopsticks, and wine cups were set on the table, Wang Shounuo had taken a quick bath and was sitting right below Wang Shouzhe, smelling the aroma of the dishes and eyeing the pot of White Jade Spirit Rice Wine eagerly, saying cheerfully, "Today I get to enjoy Fourth Brother’s company, it’s been a while since we dined together, I’ll have to toast you a few times later."
"Third Brother, you’ve done so much for the family, it should be me toasting you a few times," Wang Shouzhe replied with a smile.
"Tong’Er, hurry and pour your Fourth Brother a drink." Wang Xiaozhi was in high spirits, his dark face glowing, and casually instructed.
"Yes, Grandfather." Wang Luotong picked up the wine pot and successively poured drinks for Wang Shouzhe, Wang Xiaozhi, and then Wang Shounuo.
This wine was pure white in color and exuded a clear and mellow fragrance. Just a whiff was invigorating.
Just as Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing, the two girls, were preparing to head to the small table in the kitchen to eat, Wang Shouzhe spoke up first, "Fourth Grandpa, I’m not an outsider, Fourth Sister and Fifth Sister can sit down and eat together."
Wang Xiaozhi was taken aback but didn’t want to contradict Wang Shouzhe, so he laughed and said, "Since your Fourth Brother has spoken up, let’s all dine together."
"Thank you, Grandfather, thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing obediently took the seats at the lowest rank.
After that, naturally, there was a lively exchange of toasts.
The two girls quietly ate, occasionally pouring a bit of wine.
"Good wine." After downing half a cup, Wang Shouzhe felt a burning sensation in his abdomen, the energy and blood within his body surging vigorously, his vitality gradually increasing.
This White Jade Spirit Rice Wine was brewed with White Jade Spirit Rice and numerous precious medicinal materials, making its effects of replenishing energy and blood far superior to plain spiritual food.
However, its price was also truly "heartfelt," as a several-jin pot of White Jade Spirit Rice Wine could easily cost several Qian Gold, and even Wang Shouzhe could only afford to indulge in it sparingly.
Furthermore, Spirit Wine should only be used as a supplement to spiritual food, consumed occasionally. Otherwise, if one becomes addicted, being drunk all day is no good.
At this moment, the little girl Wang Luojing, who was silently eating, occasionally glanced at the wine pot, pursing her lips with a somewhat eager expression.
"Luotong can have half a glass, Luojing is too young, she can only have a drop at the bottom of the glass." Wang Shouzhe picked up the wine pot and poured some for his two younger sisters.
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Both girls thanked him happily, clearly having craved the Spirit Wine for quite some time.
At this moment, Wang Xiaozhi’s face twitched slightly, as if feeling a bit of heartache, and he muttered quietly, "Shouzhe, isn’t it a waste to give Spirit Wine to these two girls?"
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched too, it seemed this old man really didn’t hide his preference for sons over daughters.
"Fourth Grandfather, they’re our own children, all the same." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile.
"Not the same, not the same, girls will eventually get married." Wang Xiaozhi continued to mutter painfully, "Shouzhe, you’re at the critical threshold of breaking through to the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, you should drink more. Shounuo, you should drink less and save some for Shouzhe."
Wang Shounuo quickly put down his wine glass awkwardly and chuckled a couple of times.
In the eyes of clan elder Wang Xiaozhi, Wang Shouzhe was the direct-lineage clan leader, and more importantly, the hope and future pillar of the family, even more so than his own grandson Wang Shounuo, let alone his two "losing" granddaughters.
Fortunately, his grandchildren were used to it, and they still managed to have a harmonious meal. Under Wang Xiaozhi’s "guidance", most of the Spirit Wine remained for Wang Shouzhe to enjoy later, along with half a freshly cut pig’s meat.
For Wang Xiaozhi’s blatant "favoritism", Wang Shouzhe was quite helpless and could only go along for now.
After the meal, Wang Shouzhe proposed, "Fourth Grandfather, this time my visit to Fenggu Farm is mainly to learn some agricultural science from you."
"Agriculture?" Wang Xiaozhi frowned deeply, "Shouzhe, you are the head of the clan now, the most important thing is to cultivate diligently and reach the Spirit Platform Realm as soon as possible. Don’t let agricultural matters distract you, Fourth Grandfather and your Third Brother can handle it."
Wang Shouzhe’s purpose was naturally to understand more about Fenggu Farm. If possible, he wanted to explore it with modern thinking to see if there were ways to improve its efficiency.
However, after initial interaction with Wang Xiaozhi, he discovered that this elder was loyal to the family, but his thinking had become rigid due to his age.
Unlike Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai, who was more compliant, suggesting ideas recklessly might anger him. He swiftly changed the direction, "Fourth Grandfather, you misunderstood. As the patriarch, I should know a bit about clan enterprises. How about my Third Brother accompanies me for a tour to enjoy the agricultural scenery?"
"You, alright, alright, just let Shounuo accompany you for half a day. Recently, the wheat has reached the filling period, with many field chores, Fourth Grandfather won’t accompany you." Saying this, Wang Xiaozhi took up his farming tools and headed out quickly.
Hehe~
Though he was already the clan leader, the elders in the family still treated him like a child, hoping he could focus on cultivating to the Spirit Platform Realm.
Did they seem to want to treat him as a mascot?
In fact, if he could live a comfortable life, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t mind being a mascot or a rice bug. Unfortunately, the Wang Clan members were not capable enough, and in just a few decades, the clan’s influence had declined. If things went on like this, the Ping’an Wang Family wouldn’t take long to be completely erased from history.
It was essential to seize the foundation the Wang Family still had and rapidly elevate the clan, at least to maintain some basic self-defense capabilities.
"Fourth Brother, let me take you around, you can ask me if you have any questions at any time." Wang Shounuo stood up and cupped his hands respectfully, he was very polite, even somewhat in awe of Wang Shouzhe.
For one, Wang Shouzhe was the direct-lineage clan leader, and his personal strength surpassed his by many times.
"Thank you, Third Brother." Wang Shouzhe returned the gesture politely.
"We want to go too." Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing chirped in, following happily. Behind them was the servant Wang Gui, carrying a sword and bow, followed by four fully armed Household Generals.
The siblings strolled leisurely through the farm. It was already early summer, the weather was getting hot. The warm wind mixed with humidity brushed against their faces, making the air seem slightly sticky.
"Our Fenggu Farm was personally established by Ancestor Zhou Xuan a hundred years ago." Wang Shounuo said with some pride, "At that time, Ancestor organized the opening of the tributary waterways, dredging silt, consolidating the riverbanks, and built a water gate upstream of Fenggu Valley, creating the embryonic form of Fenggu Farm. Subsequently, clan members continually cultivated and maintained the wasteland, turning this half-dry, half-wet desolate marsh into fertile fields. Through generations of careful management, we now have 3,567 acres of high-grade farmland and 200 households of tenant farmers!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 12 Signs of a Pest Calamity
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12 Signs of a Pest Calamity
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Is there really so much fertile land just at Fenggu Farm, along with two hundred households of tenant farmers?
Wang Shouzhe looked at the crisscrossing paths among the fields, with channels of varying sizes intersecting among them, and he felt a little emotional. This is the family foundation built over a hundred years.
"At Fenggu Farm, we use the traditional winter wheat-summer millet crop rotation. Right now, it’s the busy season when winter wheat is about to mature, and summer millet seedlings are being cultivated," said Wang Shounuo, with a hint of happiness on his face. "This spring, the rain has been plentiful without flooding, and the sunshine has been strong yet not scorching, which is very beneficial for the growth of the winter wheat. It looks like it will be a bountiful harvest season."
Even Wang Shouzhe showed some joy. The difference between a plentiful harvest and a poor one is significant; more grain means more funds for the family to develop.
"No, no." Like a little sidekick, Wang Luojing pouted and said, "Third brother, you’re wrong. The winter wheat this year might not do well."
What?
Wang Shounuo’s smile became somewhat stiff, and he said sternly, "Luojing, you little girl can’t speak nonsense. Even grandfather and some of the old experienced tenant farmers say there’s a ninety percent chance of a good harvest this year. You’re still young; what do you know? If grandfather hears you cursing for a poor harvest, he might scold you again."
Frightened by this, Wang Luojing immediately hid behind Wang Shouzhe.
"Third brother, fifth sister is still young; she doesn’t mean anything by it. Why take it seriously?" Wang Shouzhe smiled and patted her head to comfort her.
"Fourth brother, you don’t know," said Wang Shounuo with a helpless smile. "You’re not aware, but our fifth sister, although young, is quite a clever little imp. She loves playing with all kinds of insects day and night. When she was two or three, she would watch ants in the yard for days. Recently, she begged me to catch some kind of grass what Insect King, and if I didn’t help her, she would cry and roll on the ground. I searched high and low for four or five days before I caught two—completely bitten by mosquitoes."
"It’s the Grasshopper King, recorded in the ancient Insect Scripture," Wang Luojing poked her head out again from behind Wang Shouzhe and earnestly corrected Wang Shounuo, "Brother, you’re so disappointing, with nothing but air in your handsome head. The Black Tortoise Clan may establish their family with martial arts, but culture and knowledge are also the roots of a family’s legacy."
Especially the latter half, which echoed the words Wang Shouzhe used to reprimand them, to mock Wang Shounuo.
Sure enough, Wang Shounuo’s face darkened, and he could only reply dejectedly, "Yes, yes, I lack knowledge. Next time you ask me, I won’t help you catch insects."
"I will ask fourth brother for help. Fourth brother is ten thousand times better than you," Wang Luojing clung to Wang Shouzhe’s sleeve as if she had found a protector, full of confidence.
This made Wang Shouzhe chuckle uncontrollably; she truly seemed to be quite a clever little imp, only shy when in front of him, driving Wang Shounuo nearly to fainting with anger.
"All right, all right, Luojing, tell us, why will the harvest be poor this year when the wind and rain are favorable?" Wang Shouzhe casually asked, "Don’t be afraid, it’s okay even if you’re wrong."
With Wang Shouzhe supporting her, Wang Luojing gained a lot of courage: "Last winter was too warm, and there was only a light snow."
Wang Shounuo immediately rolled his eyes: "Although they say a timely snow promises a good year, it’s just a saying. Will we really have a poor harvest just because it didn’t snow?"
"It’s different," Wang Luojing said very seriously. "Last year was a warm winter, and the spring rain this year has indeed been good. But it hasn’t rained for more than ten days recently, and the weather is hot and dry."
"Luojing," Wang Shounuo said dismissively, "we have already opened the sluice gates on the Fenggu Valley Tributary, so the winter wheat won’t lack water. Also, good sunshine helps the wheat grains grow full."
"But it also helps the honey bees grow," Wang Luojing rolled her eyes.
Honey bees?
Wang Shounuo trembled slightly and hesitated, "Honey bee infestations are unavoidable; they appear every year, and it’s normal for them to cause some yield reduction... Besides, last winter, we put insecticide powder in the farmland."
However, while he said this, his confidence was lacking. Honey bees are the nemesis of winter wheat. Small outbreaks are manageable and may only cause yield reduction, but large-scale outbreaks could spell disaster.
In the Wang Family’s records, the worst case was the honey bee disaster seventy-three years ago, which affected the entire Longzuo County. That year, winter wheat yields dropped by eighty percent, and grain prices surged in no time. Some families could still maintain themselves with stored grains. But many financially weak freemen suffered terribly, resorting to selling their children.
What’s more frightening is that the disaster lasted into the third year, and even some families couldn’t withstand it. If the Purple Mansion Academy hadn’t intervened, bringing large amounts of grain to Longzuo County and making extensive amounts of ancient insecticide powder, the entire Longzuo County might have been barren and desolate.
For a moment, Wang Shouzhe frowned: "Luojing, do you have any way to prove what you said?"
Fenggu Farm and Xingsheng Farm are two large grain bases of the Wang Family. A honey bee outbreak would compound the Wang Family’s current difficulties.
"Brother, you could check more of the filling wheat ears," Wang Luojing’s expression was also a bit solemn.
Feeling a little nervous, Wang Shounuo walked to the field and casually grabbed a wheat ear to inspect it. There were some tiny green dots on the just-starting-to-fill wheat ear.
After checking a few more wheat ears, some had more and some less, but without a doubt, they were all honey bees.
Wang Shouzhe was at the Sixth Layer High Stage of the Qi Refining Realm. His physical qualities and eyesight were far superior to ordinary people. With a glance, he noticed those tiny green dots were plump little bugs. He was slightly stunned; aren’t these aphids?
Wang Shouzhe had very little accumulation of knowledge in this area, barely guessing that these were some kind of aphid. He was not interested in agriculture, and those algorithm-driven apps naturally wouldn’t push content related to this topic.
"Indeed, there are more honey bees this year than in previous years." Wang Shounuo said with doubt, "But isn’t it unlikely to become a pest disaster? Mixing some Insecticide Powder with plant ash should cure it. At most, it might reduce yield slightly compared to last year."
"Brother!" Wang Luojing stomped her foot and said, "I’ve already mentioned there’s something wrong with the climate. Too many insect eggs from last year were left in the soil. In as short as a day or two, or as late as three or four days, a large number of honey bees will break through the soil. In seven or eight days, a second wave is highly likely."
"You few, come over here." Wang Shouzhe called to several tenant farmers working not far away, "Pull out this small patch of wheat and turn over the soil."
"This... Shounuo Young Master..." The tenant farmers looked at Wang Shounuo with doubt and reluctance, unwilling and hesitant to act. These wheat stalks could be harvested in ten days and were precious grains.
"Listen to the Clan Leader." Wang Shounuo dared not offend Wang Shouzhe, so he personally stepped forward to uproot the wheat.
The tenant farmers also shouldered their hoes and began turning the soil.
In no time, that small patch of wheat was pulled out, and the soil was flipped over.
"This..." Wang Shounuo carefully inspected the roots of the uprooted wheat, his face growing intense with shock and disbelief, "How can this be? How can this be?"
On those roots were numerous white dots that were shocking to see. Most of the wheat roots had them, but the quantity varied.
Moreover, if the flipped soil was carefully examined, one would find a large quantity of white dots.
Wang Shounuo felt a chill in his stomach; an ominous premonition arose: "Quick, quickly call grandfather over."
"Quick, notify grandfather and all tenant farmers, to soak the accumulated plant ash immediately." Wang Shounuo had learned agriculture from his grandfather for two years, having some basic skills.
The tenant farmers began working busily.
Not long afterward, Great-Grandfather Wang Xiaozhi had arrived and joined them, his expression was extremely grim, "How can this be? How can there be so many honey bee eggs growing in the soil? After last autumn’s harvest, we clearly plowed deep as usual and spread Insecticide Powder. Is there a problem with the Insecticide Powder?"
"Grandfather, last year was a warm winter..." Wang Luojing carefully reminded from the side.
"Little lass, I’ve been farming all my life, do you think I know less than you?" Wang Xiaozhi seemed as if his tail had been stepped on, angrily rebuking, "Ten years ago was a warm winter too, the climate was exactly the same as this year, and Longzhou had a bumper harvest, grain filled the warehouse! In my opinion, the problem lies with the Insecticide Powder. That damned Qiaan’s Trading Company must have sold fake Insecticide Powder, and I even stocked up a large batch at a low price!"
As they exchanged words, random bits of information Wang Shouzhe had learned came to mind, and he frowned slightly, "Qiaan’s Trading Company has branches all over Longzhou, usually very focused on their reputation. If they sold fake Insecticide Powder causing a pest disaster in Longzhou, they couldn’t bear the consequences. Could it be possible that bees, no, honey bees have developed resistance through repeated confrontations with Insecticide Powder, with some resistant honey bees surviving and gradually forming a widespread resistance?"
In his previous life, although Wang Shouzhe didn’t engage with agriculture, he knew that whether bacteria, viruses, or organisms, they constantly undergo genetic mutation and evolution, which are almost entirely unpredictable but mostly naturally eliminated.
However, it is reasonable that honey bees evolving towards resistance survived repeated confrontations with the Insecticide Powder and gradually multiplied.
But Wang Xiaozhi couldn’t understand what biological evolution meant, simply furrowing his brow and saying, "Shouzhe, don’t spout nonsense here; the Insecticide Powder was working well before, so why isn’t it effective this year?"
"Grandfather, I actually think Fourth Brother’s reasoning makes sense." Wang Luojing said, "Grandfather, haven’t you been complaining over the years, saying the Insecticide Powder seems becoming less effective, why are there honey bees every year?"
Wang Xiaozhi’s face stiffened, growing more unsightly. In recent years, especially since the bumper harvest ten years ago, there has been a trend of honey bees gradually increasing, but since it remained within bearable limits, it merely felt troublesome.
Wang Shouzhe could almost confirm that resistant aphids have multiplied extensively. The warm winter last season kept most of the eggs alive, and this year’s climate favoring aphid growth resulted in the current situation.
This wave of troubles was considerable, even causing Wang Shouzhe to feel a scalp tingling sensation, as he had no ability to concoct a new ’pesticide’...
Truly, when it rains, it pours! Under this disaster, the Wang Family’s days will become even more difficult, right?
"Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing pulled Wang Shouzhe aside, whispering, "I have a solution for the honey bees, but I’m afraid of grandfather, I dare not say it!"
What?
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback, looking at her with disbelief.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Talent! Spirit Insect Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13: Talent! Spirit Insect Master
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Fourth Brother, don’t you believe me?" Wang Luojing’s small face looked a bit downcast.
"Fourth Brother, I suggest you listen to that girl," the older Wang Luotong chimed in, "Luojing may be young, but she’s always loved playing with insects and knows a lot about them. Plus, insects are particularly drawn to her."
"Interesting~" Wang Shouzhe immediately perked up, his eyes shining, "Come, tell your Fourth Brother how you plan to deal with the honey insects. Take your time; we have plenty of time."
"Recently, I’ve often heard Grandpa complain about the abundance of honey insects and how the crops aren’t as plentiful as before," Wang Luojing said weakly, "So I thought, if I could help Grandpa solve the honey insect problem, he’d definitely be happy. Then I could plead with Grandpa not to marry off my sister; I don’t want her to leave~"
Wang Luotong’s face turned somewhat pale, and she hung her head without daring to speak. Such matters were beyond her control.
"If you can truly resolve the honey insect disaster, Fourth Brother here promises to protect you both," Wang Shouzhe assured, "As long as you don’t want to get married, you won’t have to."
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing beamed, "Actually, I’ve seen in the ’Insect Scripture’ that ancient people once used grasshopper insects to control honey insects. However, grasshopper insects have become increasingly rare in recent years. Last year, I raised some honey insects and grasshopper insects, and it worked. So this year, I asked my brother to catch two Grasshopper Kings from the mountains. It took some effort, but I’ve tamed them..."
"Wait..." Wang Shouzhe’s expression changed, "What is the ’Insect Scripture,’ and you managed to tame the Grasshopper King?"
"The ’Insect Scripture’ is just that—an ancient book I found in the family Library Pavilion," Wang Luojing replied innocently, "It explains how to tame insects, and it’s not very difficult. If you want to learn, Fourth Brother, I can teach you."
Not very difficult!?
Wang Shouzhe’s face darkened a bit. Having merged with his predecessor’s memories, he had a fair understanding of the Black Tortoise World. In this world, a small group of people preferred controlling spiritual insects for production or combat, usually referred to as Spirit Insect Masters.
However, Spirit Insect Masters were quite niche, and the talent requirement threshold was very high, even higher than that for Alchemists. It was simple: an ordinary person smarter than average could barely learn alchemy, albeit with vast resources and limited achievements.
But as an occupation, Spirit Insect Master required rare talent for communicating with spiritual insects, without which one couldn’t even touch the field.
Thus, Spirit Insect Masters were extremely niche, unknown to ordinary noble family descendants. As far as Wang Shouzhe knew, only the Changning Xu Family and the Shanyin Liu Family secretly cultivated two Spirit Insect Masters.
If Wang Luojing possessed the talent of a Spirit Insect Master...
In that instant, Wang Shouzhe’s heart began to thump wildly.
"Fourth Brother, what’s wrong?" Wang Luojing waved a hand in front of his face, pouting angrily, "Are you also not believing me?"
"I believe, I believe." Wang Shouzhe nodded rapidly, "My Luojing is the smartest. Fourth Brother is very interested. Let’s go a bit further, and you can demonstrate for Fourth Brother."
"Mm-hmm, those two Grasshopper Kings are on Fourth Brother’s carriage," Wang Luojing, affirmed, seemed very pleased, "I’ll go fetch them with my sister."
Wang Shouzhe suddenly recalled that when he had seen this pair of sisters this morning, he had noticed each carrying a peculiar large box. At the time, he had assumed it was their personal belongings, the personal items of girls shouldn’t be questioned carelessly, so he had merely instructed them to place them on the carriage.
Now he realized they had planned all along to try something at the farm.
"Let the household generals do it." Wang Shouzhe signaled.
The household generals serving from afar immediately ran over swiftly, respectfully asking, "Clan Leader, what are your orders?"
"Wang Wu, Wang Yong. Go to the carriage and bring Miss Luojing’s two boxes."
"Yes, Patriarch."
The two household generals sped away swiftly. In less than a quarter of an hour, they returned, each holding a box.
"Wang Gui, Wang Wu, you guys go to Fourth Grandfather and see if there’s anything you can help with." Wang Shouzhe directed them away, knowing that Wang Xiaozhi seemed to be trying to control aphids using methods like grass ash liquid, so he likely lacked manpower.
The household generals were Black Tortoise Practitioners, whose efficiencies outweighed ordinary tenant farmers when used properly.
Most importantly, since the matter wasn’t confirmed, Wang Shouzhe didn’t want it to become widely known.
Once Wang Gui and the other four household generals left, Wang Shouzhe personally lifted the two big boxes and, with Wang Luotong and Wang Luojing, ran to a remote wheat field.
The three thousand or so acres of land resembled a vast sea. This empty space was perfect for the demonstration.
Wang Shouzhe inspected the wheat ears; sure enough, this wheat field also had some green aphids, those tiny insects, making him feel somewhat squeamish.
"Luojing, show Fourth Brother your methods."
"Mm~ This time, the honey insect outbreak came even earlier than I expected." Wang Luojing’s expression became solemn and anxious as she carefully opened one of the boxes.
Wang Shouzhe curiously glanced into the box and immediately felt a wave of trypophobia, his hairs stood on end. The box was filled with leaves, each sprouting filaments with densely packed small dots.
"Fourth Brother, Sister, help me out." Wang Luojing picked out the "leaves," "Place one leaf every ten feet."
Wang Shouzhe twitched at the corners of his mouth. This little girl was indeed bold, casually commanding even the clan leader. Yet his limbs were obedient, following Wang Luojing’s instructions. With his cultivation realm, holding a "leaf," a casual flick landed it precisely in place.
According to Wang Luojing’s "instructions," approximately a few dozen leaves were needed for each acre of wheat field. With only one of her large boxes open, it held merely a few hundred "leaves," barely enough to cover ten acres—just a drop in the ocean compared to the thousands of acres.
After spending a quarter of an hour placing them, Wang Shouzhe and Wang Luotong stood by Wang Luojing, waiting patiently.
"Fourth Brother, these grasshopper insect eggs are three-day ones," Wang Luojing explained, "They hatch slower in the box but will quickly hatch upon sunlight exposure."
Alright~ You are the expert in this field. Whatever you say goes.
Regarding his area of ignorance, Wang Shouzhe adhered strictly, never overstepping. As time ticked away, in less than half an hour, the initial leaves displayed changes—a swarm of peculiarly shaped insects struggled to break free.
Those leaves were right before their eyes, enabling them to clearly observe the tiny insects—barely two millimeters long, resembling long-shaped beetles with a pair of large pincers on the head, appearing rather grotesque.
Once born, they lay motionless, hanging quietly on the filaments.
After a while, they finally stirred, sliding down the filaments onto the leaves, leisurely spreading outward. They seemed innately aware of food sources, casually climbing up the wheat stalks.
Suddenly!
One encountered an aphid. It struck viciously, clamping the aphid with pincers, stabbing its mouthparts into the aphid to suck, reducing the unfortunate aphid to a husk in under half an hour, wafting away with the breeze.
Subsequently, that grasshopper larva continued climbing, searching for its next prey.
"Impressive!" Wang Shouzhe exclaimed, "What fierce little bugs these are!"
"Fourth Brother, when I raised grasshopper larvae before, I figured it can pupate within ten days, eating close to a thousand honey insects in that time. It’s rather small at birth, only devouring a dozen daily over the first two days," Wang Luojing, accustomed to playing with such things, felt unsurprised.
"If it truly works like this, these roughly ten acres of wheat starting the graining phase, though they will yield slightly less, may be saved," Wang Shouzhe praised while anxiously thinking, "But there are thousands of acres of wheat at Fenggu Farm alone."
"Don’t worry, Fourth Brother; I’m just doing a trial run." Wang Luojing opened the other box, revealing several brightly colored small beetles instead of dense grasshopper larvae.
"Isn’t this..." Wang Shouzhe noticed the familiar beetles and was shocked, "Ladybugs?"
"Fourth Brother recognizes them? But the Insect Scripture calls them Nine-Spotted Beetles, not Seven-Spotted," Wang Luojing pulled out a fist-sized beetle with nine spots, lovingly caressing it, "From now on, you’ll be called the Nine-Star Insect King."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Biological Legion
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14: Biological Legion
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Nine-Star Insect King!
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched a few times. This fifth sister usually doesn’t show off, but privately, she’s somewhat... hair-raising.
"Buzz buzz!"
The fist-sized Nine-Star Insect King’s shell opened, and its membranous wings rapidly flapped in response to her.
Meanwhile, Wang Luojing took out a small emerald bamboo flute from her waist and played it near her lips. It was a unique rhythm, sharp and high-pitched, rather grating on the ears.
But the Nine-Star Insect King was very familiar with that sound, its wings vibrating and emitting a continuous buzzing sound. The other small Nine-Star Insects in the box began to fly out, hovering around the Nine-Star Insect King like an unpredictable cloud.
Under Wang Luojing’s command, the Nine-Star Insect King first attacked the wheat field, followed by a swarm of thousands of insects like a gust of wind. Although they were all ladybugs, these ladybugs from the Black Tortoise World were evidently more ferocious.
They landed on the wilting wheat spikes, grabbing aphids and devouring them. Their combat power was far superior to that of grasshopper larvae, and in just a short time, each Nine-Star Insect eliminated at least five or six aphids.
As this biological army emerged, it truly became invincible.
"Luojing, well done, well done." Wang Shouzhe joyfully praised her, "With skills like yours, our Wang Family’s crops are saved."
"Fourth brother, it’s still not enough," Wang Luojing shook her head, "from the time the wheat grains fill to maturity, it’s just over ten days. The longer we delay, the more likely the yield will reduce."
Her grandfather Wang Xiao Zhi had devoted his life to farming, and she had been exposed to this field since childhood. Without further ado, she pulled out two arm-thick, completely withered-colored insects from the Grasshopper King Box.
"Fourth brother, these two Grasshopper Kings have laid too many eggs; they probably won’t live for another month." Wang Luojing said with some pity and guilt, "I hope they can make one last effort for the family in the end."
As she spoke, she played the bamboo flute again. This time, the sound was completely different from when she commanded the Nine-Star Insect King, very low-pitched. The two dull-colored Grasshopper Kings suddenly awoke and flew off into the distance.
They moved very fast and disappeared without a trace within a few breaths; as they flew, their mouthparts kept trembling, emitting a low-frequency sound.
"Fourth brother, Grasshopper Kings have the ability to summon partners," Wang Luojing explained, "I hope they can gather more partners back; now, there are fewer and fewer grasshoppers in the wild, only some remain in the mountains."
Regarding this, Wang Shouzhe pondered; this was likely due to the Insecticide Powder launched by Purple Mansion Academy. The massive reduction in aphids also led to a decrease in grasshopper colonies.
Currently, there’s a sign of an outbreak of drug-resistant aphids, but the grasshopper swarm can’t keep up, so this time something major might happen.
An hour later, one of the Grasshopper Kings had returned, bringing back an army with them. They danced within the wheat fields, frantically preying on aphids; even more frighteningly, they began laying eggs on the leaves while eating.
By the time dusk fell, another Grasshopper King returned, bringing back more of its kind; this dense grasshopper army made Wang Shouzhe doubt if the aphids in the thousands of acres of wheat fields were enough for them to eat.
Moreover, the numerous eggs they laid would hatch within days, and even the small larvae shouldn’t be underestimated.
Such a spectacular scene gradually caught the attention of the tenant farmers, who then reported it to Wang Xiao Zhi. Upon understanding that his granddaughter Wang Luojing was responsible for this feat upon arriving, Wang Xiao Zhi was so shocked he couldn’t speak for a moment.
In an instant, tears streamed down his face, muttering, "This time, our Wang Family is saved, is saved."
"Fourth grandfather, we have quite a few crops in our other two farms," Wang Shouzhe said, "I won’t participate in the specific affairs; you can discuss them with Luojing." Although Silkworm Manor mainly focused on silkworm farming, it also planted quite a bit of wheat.
"This..." Upon hearing he had to discuss it with his granddaughter, especially the youngest one, Wang Xiao Zhi’s expression turned somewhat grim.
"Fourth grandfather, if you think Luojing is unnecessary, I can take her back, so she doesn’t get in the way here." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile.
"Not unnecessary, not in the way." Wang Xiao Zhi hurriedly shook his head, his old face contorting, showing a smile of appeasement to Wang Luojing, "Luojing, we still need to think of a way to save the other two farms. Whatever you need done, just let grandfather do it."
Wang Shouzhe smiled. Although Wang Xiao Zhi was stubborn and had a patriarchal mindset, his loyalty and sense of belonging to the family were unwavering. Once his perceptions shifted, he still could be a pillar of the family.
Seeing Wang Xiao Zhi changing his attitude, Wang Shouzhe drew him aside, his face solemn, "Fourth grandfather, given the look of this insect disaster, it’s unlikely that our Wang Family alone is affected. Not to mention Longzhou, but near Changning Guard, overall, there might be at least a forty to fifty percent yield reduction."
"Isn’t that a good thing?" Wang Xiao Zhi hesitated, then immediately "chuckled" and said, "Other families reduce yields, so our family has a bumper harvest..."
"In this world, good things and bad things often aren’t absolute." Wang Shouzhe said coldly, "Sometimes, things that appear very good can often turn bad."
Wang Xiao Zhi shuddered, then quickly realized, "Shouzhe, you mean other families would envy us?"
"If it’s only envy, then it’s fine." Wang Shouzhe’s expression grew very serious, "As they say, it’s not the lack that troubles us, but the inequality. If everyone suffers together, there’s nothing to say. But if our Wang Family alone has a bumper harvest, not only would adversarial families complain, but even those families with better relations might harbor resentment. A single misstep could make our Ping’an Wang Family the target of everyone."
"What should be done? Our Wang Family is already in a precarious state; if another..." Wang Xiao Zhi panicked. After all, he’s only a clan elder who had farmed long-term, understanding little in this field.
"Fourth grandfather, don’t be anxious. Sometimes bad things can often turn into good things." Wang Shouzhe confidently smiled, "It depends on how we manipulate the situation to steer it in our favor. Let’s consider this: firstly, the Changning Xu Family, the Shanyang Gongsun Family, and the Shanyin Liu Family; they have long-term marital alliances with our Ping’an Wang Family, naturally close relations, so we should think of ways to assist them."
Actually, among these three clans, Wang Shouzhe had the best impression of the Shanyang Gongsun Family. This was not merely because his current legitimate mother was from the Gongsun Family, but because their familial style was broad and straightforward, not harboring disdain for even the currently humbled Ping’an Wang Family.
Of course, it also had a lot to do with the prior legitimate lineage marriages; currently, the contemporary clan leader of the Gongsun Family, Gongsun Mo’s grandmother Wang Lingdie, came from the Wang Family’s fourth generation direct lineage.
While the Changning Xu Family was originally a very strong Black Tortoise Race, as strong as the Wang Family’s most powerful time. Back then, both their direct lineages intermarried, their relations close.
Unfortunately, later on...
Wang Xiao Zhi nodded with a complex and regrettable expression, "Indeed, those three families have deep marital links with our Wang Family. It’s just a pity about sister Zhenmei..."
Wang Shouzhe knew what he meant. When the Wang Family went through drastic changes, to consolidate relations with the Changning Xu Family, Ancestor Longyan orchestrated the marriage of fifth-generation Wang Family’s direct descendant Wang Zhen Mei to the Xu Family Eldest Legitimate Son.
And Wang Zhen Mei didn’t fail in her mission; years later, she became pregnant with legitimate blood, and the relationship between the two families reached its closest point. Sadly, Aunt Wang Zhen Mei died mysteriously in childbirth, resulting in a tragic outcome of two deaths.
At that time, the Wang Family was overcome with grief; the Xiao generation brothers all went to the Changning Xu Family to cause a commotion, even Ancestor Longyan was alerted and came to personally examine the corpse, finding nothing suspicious and enigmatic before letting it go.
Since then, the close relationship between the Wang Family and the Xu Family developed a crack, marriages among direct veins continued, but not among direct lineages.
Likewise, the relations between the Shanyin Liu Family and the Wang Family are also somewhat complex and difficult to explain in a few words.
Despite the complexity, the blood ties that bind them cannot be erased; when crucial moments come, they must support each other.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Truly Delightful! My Precious Granddaughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: Truly Delightful! My Precious Granddaughter
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"In addition, the Yingxiu Lu Family, Golden Sand Xu Family, and East Port Chen Family are also families that we need to actively support," Wang Shouzhe said seriously. "Over the past forty to fifty years, our Wang Family has intermarried with them, establishing deep relationships with each other."
These three families are not particularly powerful. However, precisely because of this, they have engaged in direct lineage marriages with the now declining Ping’an Wang Family. Among them, the relationship with the Yingxiu Lu Family is the closest, as Wang Shouzhe’s biological mother comes from the direct lineage of the Lu Family.
Currently, the Clan Leader’s wife of the Yingxiu Lu Family, Wang Liuling, is also the sixth generation eldest legitimate daughter of the Wang Family and Wang Shouzhe’s aunt, making the relationship quite complex and close.
"That’s right, these three families are now very close to our Wang Family. So, what is your plan, Shouzhe?" Wang Xiaozhi agreed with a nod. His two daughters, one married into the Shanyang Gongsun Family and the other into the East Port Chen Family. His son, Wang Dingbang, who passed away young, married directly into the Golden Sand Xu Family.
"Fourth Granduncle needs to quickly sort out the cause and impact of this insect plague. I’ll dispatch the household generals to notify these six families overnight," Wang Shouzhe said swiftly. "Among them, the Shanyin Liu Family and Changning Xu Family have already cultivated Spirit Insect Masters within the clan. As long as we provide methods and approaches, I believe it won’t be difficult for them to resolve this crisis themselves. Additionally, the primary businesses of the Golden Sand Xu Family and East Port Chen Family might not be in agriculture, so after fulfilling our duty to notify them, we can focus on minimizing their losses."
Pausing for a moment, Wang Shouzhe continued, "The more challenging cases are the Yingxiu Lu Family and Shanyang Gongsun Family. First, we must fulfill our duty to notify them immediately. In addition, we need to actively aid them, doing our utmost with sincerity. This way, even if they suffer significant losses in the insect plague, they will only feel gratitude and not resentment towards us."
This series of calculations and statements left Wang Xiaozhi stunned. He never expected the sudden outbreak of an insect plague to involve such a complex situation.
More importantly, Wang Shouzhe managed to arrange the matter so thoroughly and meticulously in such a short time, considering all aspects.
"Shouzhe, I underestimated you, and I underestimated Luojing," Wang Xiaozhi sighed with a bitter smile. "Your generation is indeed outstanding. We’re old; the Xiao generation is truly old."
"Fourth Granduncle, you’re too modest. If it weren’t for your generation maintaining the ancestors’ foundation, how would we, the descendants, have a place to stand?" Wang Shouzhe replied humbly, then sneered, "Aside from those six families, especially the Liu Family and Zhao Family..."
Wang Xiaozhi’s expression immediately became serious. "Shouzhe, rest assured, in the next ten days, our Wang Family’s three major farms will completely seal off any information."
However, Wang Shouzhe grinned with narrowed eyes. "The outbreak of an insect plague is impossible to hide. Every family has agricultural experts. Within three days, the entire Changning Guard Region will be in turmoil. By the way, Fourth Granduncle, didn’t you stockpile a batch of Insecticide Powder at a low price?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Xiaozhi’s expression was filled with regret. "Yes, last winter’s Insecticide Powder was at the lowest price in years, and they offered large discounts. I thought, since our three major farms can’t do without Insecticide Powder, I discussed it with the elders and stocked up a large amount, enough for our family to use for three years. Now we still have over 300 Qian Gold worth of goods. It’s a big loss, it’s a big loss. After this insect plague, how can those Insecticide Powders be useful?"
The family is already so strapped for cash, losing over 300 Qian Gold at once is enough to make Wang Xiaozhi feel guilty to his grave.
"The Insecticide Powder shouldn’t be completely ineffective yet?" Wang Shouzhe pondered slightly, his mind racing.
"It’s not completely ineffective, but it’s more difficult to deal with those adult Honey Bees than the eggs," Wang Xiaozhi said with a very serious expression. "I just tried it. It takes double the dosage mixed with ash water to quickly eliminate the Honey Bees, and that’s not even counting the subsequent hatching of more bees."
Following this, Wang Shouzhe threw out question after question like machine-gun fire.
Initially intimidated, Wang Xiaozhi no longer dared to underestimate Wang Shouzhe, patiently answering each question. At seventy-five years of age, he had been involved in farming since he was fifteen, following his father’s footsteps for sixty years, amassing an incredible wealth of experience.
"So, in an average year, the winter wheat per mu yields about 15 Large Copper," Wang Shouzhe rapidly organized the data in his mind. "After deducting taxes, tenant farmer commissions, farm tools, oxen seeds, and the fixed spread of Insecticide Powder, the spread for Insecticide Powder is about 1 Large Copper per mu, leaving a gross margin of 8 Large Copper per mu. If this insect plague is not controlled, assuming a reduction of half, the farm would enter a slight loss phase, with the greater the loss, the more reduction."
"If nothing is done, it could result in a reduction of about seventy percent," Wang Xiaozhi was momentarily empowered, somewhat understanding Wang Shouzhe’s implication, and roughly judged, "If at the outbreak of the insect plague, we increase the input of 2 Large Copper worth of Insecticide Powder, we can control the disaster within a reduction of twenty percent compared to previous years."
"Currently, the Daqian Kingdom implements a unified government grain storage mechanism. Any noble family or merchant daring to speculate on grain prices during good or disastrous years commits a grave crime," Wang Shouzhe continued organizing various conditions. "Therefore, with a seventy percent reduction as the base, for every ten percent reduction in remaining losses, 1 Large Copper 50 Coins would be saved, so reducing the loss by fifty percent is valued at 7 Large Copper 50 Coins. Now the question arises, without a Spirit Insect Master to manage the Honey Bees, is the investment of 2 Large Copper worth of Insecticide Powder worthwhile!?"
"Worth it!" Upon hearing Wang Shouzhe’s analysis, Wang Xiaozhi immediately nodded rapidly. "Even if it’s 4 Large Copper, I would invest." At the same time, his eyes lit up, full of excitement: "Listening to what you say, our family’s stockpile of 300 Qian Gold Insecticide Powder not only isn’t a loss but is worth 600 Qian Gold? Excellent, excellent, luckily those people laughed at me for stockpiling Insecticide Powder."
"It is worth at least 600 Qian Gold. Our family has Fifth Sister Luojing, who is an entry-level Spirit Insect Master specialized in dealing with Honey Bees, so those Insecticide Powders are not needed. However, compared to the entire Changning Guard Region, Spirit Insect Masters are a drop in the bucket, and most families still have to rely on Insecticide Powder to survive the disaster." Wang Shouzhe smiled calmly, "Congratulations, Fourth Granduncle, for making a huge profit for the family."
"Hahaha, fantastic." Wang Xiaozhi laughed until his face was flushed. "My family’s Luojing is truly a treasure, worthy of being my granddaughter Wang Xiaozhi."
Wang Shouzhe twitched at the corners of his mouth. This old granduncle truly is elderly with thick skin. Previously, he was so biased towards males, saying granddaughters were always liabilities. And now, in the blink of an eye, Luojing became a treasure.
However, speaking of which, Luojing, the future Spirit Insect Master, is indeed a treasure. Even if the Insecticide Powders are updated and remain effective in the future, she can save the family one or two hundred Qian Gold yearly in expensive "pesticide costs," and every cent saved is pure profit.
"But, all of this depends on Shouzhe’s fortune." Wang Xiaozhi laughed until he couldn’t close his mouth. "Fourth Granduncle also understands your saying, sometimes bad things often turn into good ones. Shouzhe, you are a blessed person. After you become the clan leader, our Wang Family will undoubtedly fare better and better."
Although superstition should not be upheld, Wang Shouzhe still quite appreciated Wang Xiaozhi’s belief in him.
Moreover, with his advanced thinking, if he did not seize some business opportunities in this insect plague, he would be unworthy of being a transmigrator. The Daqian Government Office strongly controls grain prices, prohibiting speculation, but the Daqian Government Office has not banned the speculation of Insecticide Powder, has it?
A plan was gradually forming in his mind.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 16 Qiaan’s Trading Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16 Qiaan’s Trading Company
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
That night.
Wang Shouzhe’s carriage returned to the main residence once, where he wrote several letters and entrusted them to be dispatched by various household generals.
He promptly reminded the families with whom he had closer ties, to avoid any potential resentment they might feel towards the Wang Family for not suffering during the disaster. Even if they had already discovered signs of the insect disaster, it wouldn’t hurt for the Wang Family to show goodwill.
Apart from this, Wang Shouzhe took only two household generals and rode out overnight. After reaching Dingpu Ferry, they secretly crossed Anjiang on the family fishing boat and sped all the way to Changning Guard City, arriving just as dawn was breaking.
The city walls of Changning City were formidable and shimmering under the sunlight.
The city wall was over ten feet high, entirely constructed from solid black stone bricks. On the battlements were stationed soldiers fully equipped with armor and crossbows. Every few dozen feet, there was also a huge bed crossbow installed for defense.
Though Changning Guard City was classified merely as a county-level city, it appeared more imposing and majestic than many renowned cities on Earth.
It couldn’t be helped; this world was not like ancient Huaxia. In the perilous regions of the Outer Domain, numerous powerful demon beasts and fierce creatures roamed. In case of a beast tide, the high walls and sturdy cities were humanity’s only barriers.
Ping’an Town also had walls, but they paled significantly in comparison to those of the Guard City.
The horses of Wang Shouzhe and his two companions came to a slow stop before the city gate. They dismounted and joined the early risers entering the city. At this time, those entering early were mostly farmers, small vendors, and craftsmen, essentially civilians.
At the sight of Wang Shouzhe and the household generals, elegantly dressed and leading tall horses, they instinctively stepped aside in a show of reverence.
In the Daqian Kingdom, Black Tortoise Clans were the privileged class; even the most destitute of the small clans could not be compared to the commoners.
At the East City Gate.
Two fully armored soldiers approached and examined Wang Shouzhe’s family token. They then respectfully invited him to enter the city.
After entering the city, Wang Shouzhe didn’t linger and led his horse directly to [Qiaan’s Trading Company]. Qiaan’s Trading Company’s business spanned throughout Longzuo County, known for its formidable standing and excellent reputation. The Insecticide Powder crafted by the Purple Mansion Academy was managed by Qiaan’s Trading Company.
This alone brought Qiaan’s Trading Company considerable wealth, let alone their many other ventures beyond the Insecticide Powder.
Presenting the Wang Family’s token, the household generals remained on guard outside while Wang Shouzhe was led by a doorman into a side hall of the trading company to wait. A maidservant served tea and fruits before retreating.
Wang Shouzhe drank his tea calmly, surveying the surroundings. Even though it was just a side hall of a trading company’s branch, it was lavishly decorated. Various precious woods formed screens and furniture, and casually placed antique objets d’art each had considerable value.
With Wang Shouzhe’s relatively "shallow" knowledge, he could still discern the value of the decorations in this side hall. It amounted to several hundred to a thousand Qian Gold, showcasing the immense financial power of Qiaan’s Trading Company, truly worthy of being one of Longzuo’s dominant noble families.
As a transmigrator, Wang Shouzhe naturally understood the psychological tactics employed by Qiaan’s Trading Company.
After waiting for approximately a quarter of an hour.
A plump middle-aged man with a face full of friendly smiles entered: "The Patriarch of the Ping’an Wang Family visiting personally, I failed to welcome you from afar, please forgive me, please forgive me."
Wang Shouzhe squinted his eyes—the seemingly casual pleasantry from the other party contained significant information.
He had only been the clan leader for scarcely two or three days, and the current circumstances of the waning Ping’an Wang Family meant that even a change in leadership wouldn’t catch much attention. Yet, Qiaan’s Trading Company not only noticed but also confirmed his identity within a quarter of an hour.
Truly, this was one of the commercial giants dominating Longzuo; their information-gathering ability was immensely strong. Furthermore, the person seemed to possess the surname Qian and an extraordinary demeanor, likely being a member of Qiaan’s bloodline.
"Not at all, not at all. I came here on my own accord; it’s my great fortune to have the steward personally receive me." Wang Shouzhe responded tactfully and modestly. This person surnamed Qian was, of course, not the shopkeeper.
Given the immense size of Qiaan’s Trading Company, even the shopkeeper of the Changning Branch was a significant figure, unlikely to personally receive a declining family’s Qi Refining Realm clan leader.
After a few exchanges of pleasantries, they both took their seats.
Upon sitting down, they didn’t immediately get to the main point. The steward and Wang Shouzhe made conversation spanning from Ancestor Zhou Xuan to Ancestor Longyan, then to his accomplishments in passing the initial test of the Purple Mansion Academy, demonstrating the steward’s comprehensive preparation.
Given that Wang Shouzhe’s plans were substantial on this trip, he naturally couldn’t appear at a disadvantage, accompanying the steward in idle chatter and inadvertently revealing a superior level of logical and critical thinking compared to the locals of the mystical world.
"What a pity, what a pity. With your knowledge, Younger Brother Shouzhe, if you participated in the retest for the Purple Mansion Academy, becoming an Academy disciple would be a certainty." The steward casually showed greater esteem for Wang Shouzhe, both admiring and lamenting, "The Purple Mansion Academy places emphasis not only on cultivation talent but also values the vision and perspective of its students. I believe that in your hands, the Wang Family will eventually return to its peak, and perhaps even progress further."
"Brother Qian, please don’t tease me." Wang Shouzhe shook his head with a bitter smile, "We of the Ping’an Wang Family seek only to live safely and peacefully, nothing more."
In their courteous exchange, the two had already begun addressing each other as brothers.
"You’re too modest. By the way, Younger Brother Shouzhe, you rushed here overnight to Qiaan’s Trading Company. Is there some significant business you wish to conduct?" After some chitchat, the steward eventually couldn’t suppress his curiosity, steering the conversation to the main topic.
Hearing this, Wang Shouzhe gently placed down his teacup, a composed look in his eyes: "Speaking of it, I truly need Brother Qian’s assistance. I need five thousand bags of Insecticide Powder."
Upon hearing this, the steward’s hand trembled slightly, looking at Wang Shouzhe in disbelief, and after quite some time, he suppressed his dissatisfaction and said, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, are you perhaps making fun of me?"
"Why would Brother Qian say so?" Wang Shouzhe replied with composure, "The grand Qiaan’s Trading Company couldn’t possibly be lacking merely five thousand bags of Insecticide Powder, right?"
"Brother, do you know how substantial an order of five thousand bags of Insecticide Powder is? Each bag of Insecticide Powder weighs about a hundred pounds, diluted, it can be used for a hundred acres of fertile land. Five thousand bags enough for five hundred thousand acres." The steward said, frowning, "Our Changning Guard and all the towns under its jurisdiction combined don’t even amount to about one and a half million acres of fertile land."
"I know." Wang Shouzhe’s expression remained unchanged, his gaze intensely serious.
The steward’s expression gradually became more bemused: "Brother, you’re not joking?"
"Naturally, I am not joking," Wang Shouzhe said, "Even if we, the Ping’an Wang Family, are just a Ninth-Grade Lower-Rank Noble Family, we aren’t so unaware of our limitations."
"Very well, Brother, this is indeed a colossal surprise; I’ll take this deal." The steward responded with an expression of joy, "However, the Changning Branch of Qiaan’s Trading Company only has two thousand bags in stock; the remaining three thousand bags must be transferred from other branches, and that will take at least ten days."
"Why not?" said the steward, with genuine enthusiasm, "In past years, the stock would be at the very limit by the year’s end. This time, the situation with the raw materials used in the Insecticide Powder is more complex. Since the price is good, only a few families are willing to buy in advance. So, this winter, the supply of this batch of Insecticide Powder might... you know, the larger the family, the more well-informed they are."
Heh heh~ Wang Shouzhe smiled to himself after devising a plan, saying, "Since that’s the case." He paused before continuing, "I’m planning something significant here, so I mustn’t appear cowardly. I’ll engage him in casual conversation, subtly showing an edge that’s a bit sharper than the local natives."
Two-thirds full of tea, Wang Shouzhe suddenly paused before gracefully placing his cup. "Brother Qian might not even yet understand what’s behind the concept of a ’futures contract.’" he said, looking at the steward with a serene expression.
""

chapters.title: Chapter 17: No More Bets
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: No More Bets
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Spot goods refer to goods that can be exchanged on the spot, while futures require a specified date for exchange. Brother Qian, didn’t you say you needed to adjust the goods and they could only be exchanged in ten days?" Wang Shouzhe casually shared some knowledge with him.
"Makes sense, after hearing your explanation, Younger Brother Shouzhe, I understand the difference," Steward Qian said with a reinvigorated spirit, his eyes rolling as he whispered, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, these five thousand bags of Insecticide Powder are definitely not self-prepared. Could it be that you’ve found a new business opportunity?"
"Haha, as Brother Qian mentioned, it’s indeed a new business opportunity," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile while sipping his tea. "I’m helping your trading company clear stock while earning a modest profit from it. It’s a win-win situation. Brother Qian, give us a sincere price."
"Hahaha, a win-win situation indeed. Your words are truly interesting, Younger Brother Shouzhe, so I won’t pry further. In that case, these five thousand bags of Insecticide Powder will be given to you at a 10% discount, making it a total of 4,500 Qian Gold."
"Four thousand!"
"Four thousand two hundred is the lowest, Younger Brother."
"Four thousand two hundred it is, but I will use the Ping’an Wang Clan’s credit to pay for the current order," Wang Shouzhe stated calmly. "In a month, I will hand over four thousand two hundred Qian Gold, not a single coin less."
Steward Qian was slightly taken aback but immediately chuckled, "This is feasible, but we must draft a contract. If the payment cannot be made on time, our trading company reserves the right to use any means necessary to collect the payment."
Even though the Wang Clan has fallen into hard times, it is still a Black Tortoise Noble Family with some wealth. Just selling the Fenggu Farm alone would bring at least ten thousand Qian Gold. As long as there’s a contract, the powerful Qiaan’s Trading Company has ways to recover this debt.
"Even if Brother Qian hadn’t mentioned a contract, I would still want to draft one," Wang Shouzhe said seriously. "I am already arranging for merchant ships. In three days, I will send someone to your warehouse to move two thousand bags of Insecticide Powder. The second batch will be in ten days. If your company breaches the contract or fails to deliver the goods, you must pay us three times the contract amount as compensation."
"Do not worry, Younger Brother. The integrity of Qiaan’s Trading Company is the foundation of its standing for hundreds of years," Steward Qian said with a very solemn expression. "One way or another, we will deliver the goods on time and in full."
"I trust in your company’s integrity, but this deal is significant to our little Ping’an Wang Family," Wang Shouzhe also replied with a serious expression. "Having it written and drawn up in black and white makes me feel at ease."
"Since that’s the case, let’s write it down." Steward Qian did not see any reason for their side to breach the contract, after all, it was merely a transaction of a few thousand Qian Gold, which was nothing for the entire Qiaan’s Trading Company.
The two spent a full hour, during which Wang Shouzhe scrutinized every detail, making clear all the terms of the contract.
By the time both parties had signed and sealed the contract, Steward Qian was already sweating. He wiped his brow and smiled wryly, "In all my twenty years in business, this is the first time I’ve seen such detailed contract terms and meticulous wording. But then again, such detailed contract terms avoid unnecessary disputes in the future and have truly opened my eyes and taught me a lesson."
Hehe~
Wang Shouzhe just smiled. What was this? On Earth, some complex commercial contracts were a hundred times more intricate than this rough contract, making it look like a celestial script to laymen.
Finally obtaining the contract, the weight in Wang Shouzhe’s heart seemed to lift.
Although based on his understanding of Qiaan’s Trading Company, even without such a detailed contract, they would not violate their own integrity. The credibility accumulated over hundreds of years is the most valuable asset of a trading company.
As for sending experts to destroy a family for this little amount of money? That was even more impossible.
Although Ancestor Longyan’s days are numbered, she remains a veteran Ancestor Spirit Platform from Purple Mansion Academy. Who knows what trump cards she has hidden? Once she disregards her life and erupts with a strike, it’s highly likely she could take down a Spirit Platform Realm expert.
All reasons considered, this was the risky decision Wang Shouzhe dared to make. There was no choice—the Wang Family was too poor, so poor that they had to scrimp for even a single "Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill," and continuing in such a way would only lead to a vicious cycle.
The only one he felt sorry for might just be this Steward Qian.
Being middle-aged and still just a small steward of a branch in a secluded region indicates he wasn’t born into a high status within the well-rooted Qiaan Family. This loss-making operation might very well have the branch shopkeeper making him take the blame.
"Brother Qian, this cooperation was a pleasure," Wang Shouzhe said as he rose to take his leave, then whispered, "If things turn out as expected, in the near future, I will present you with a grand reward."
Steard Qian was taken aback, then immediately smiled and said, "Thank you, Younger Brother, for the good omen. Let me see you out, Younger Brother Shouzhe." Amidst the laughter and conversation, Steward Qian personally escorted Wang Shouzhe to the main door.
Once he left Qiaan’s Trading Company, Wang Shouzhe’s mood became immensely better. In three days, just three days, he could greatly alleviate the Wang Family’s financial crisis.
"Patriarch."
Two Household Generals who had been waiting at the door approached leading horses, greeting him respectfully.
"Wang Zhong, Wang Yong," Wang Shouzhe smiled, "It’s been a long time since I’ve been out. Accompany me for a stroll in the Guardian City."
"Yes, Patriarch." The two Household Generals responded respectfully, leading the horses and accompanying Wang Shouzhe on a casual stroll within the Guardian City.
When Ancestor Zhou Xuan was alive, Wang Clan was at its peak with forty-seven Household Generals, and the highest-cultivated one reached the Ninth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Now, the Wang Clan has only nine Household Generals, with the highest cultivation at merely the Fifth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Household Generals differ from household servants; they are no longer slave labor but attached citizens, though unlike Foreign Ministers who are contractually hired outsiders.
The majority of Household Generals are trusted individuals nurtured within the clan. They hold a relatively high status and receive good treatment but do not have the freedom to come and go as they please. They are born as Household Generals and die as Household Generals.
Their fate, life, and death are tightly bound to the main family, sharing honor and disgrace. Therefore, many clans often bind exceptional Household Generals with children from collateral or lowborn lines within the family. This not only creates stronger ties but can also enhance the family’s bloodline.
The nine current Household Generals of the Wang Clan are descendants of Household Generals personally nurtured by Ancestor Zhou Xuan, passed down through generations, and are very loyal.
"Wang Zhong, I remember your youngest son is already seven or eight years old?" Wang Shouzhe asked casually, "Has his Black Tortoise Talent been evaluated?"
Wang Zhong hastened to catch up and replied, "Thanks to the Patriarch’s concern, my son participated in this year’s spring talent assessment and was rated as Lower Grade C. He is now being enlightened and starting the meridian nurturing stage in the Clan Academy."
Speaking, he chuckled slightly, clearly very pleased with his son’s talent.
Black Tortoise Talent is first divided by whether it can be rated or not, which determines its potential for cultivation. Among rated talents, there are four levels: Grades A, B, C, and D. Being rated as Lower Grade C is already second tier and worth the clan’s efforts to cultivate.
"Truly, a cub takes after a tiger," Wang Shouzhe praised, "Train hard, and he’ll surpass you in the future."
"Thank you for your kind words, Patriarch." Wang Zhong smiled with crow’s feet at the corners of his eyes. He was thirty-six this year and already had two sons, one older and one younger, both rated with Black Tortoise Talent. The older son, now fifteen, would be an adult in a year and could become a Household General to serve the clan. The younger son had even achieved Lower Grade C talent, entering the key cultivation sequence.
On the other hand, the nearby Household General Wang Yong had a somewhat embarrassed expression. He was about the same age as Wang Zhong, married to a Wang Family collateral woman, and had fathered a son and a daughter.
His son’s Black Tortoise Talent tested unrated, leaving him to study literature. Now seventeen, he works at the Silkworm Manor, while his daughter was only six and yet to test for Black Tortoise Talent. Even if she were to have talent, she was still just a girl.
"Wang Yong, you should seize the last few years and make more efforts with your wife to have another child," Wang Zhong teased with a laugh, "Perhaps you’ll get lucky and have a Lower Grade B boy."
"Go, go, go!" Wang Yong snapped impatiently, becoming somewhat sullen on this topic.
The trio strolled leisurely through Changning Guard City as Wang Shouzhe’s memories of Changning City started to refresh. The city had a permanent population of about 150,000, housing several old Black Tortoise Noble Families, with the Changning Xu Family being the closest to the Ping’an Wang Family.
But ultimately, they were only somewhat close, the difference in their scales growing increasingly vast, no longer on the same playing field. Thus, Wang Shouzhe had no intention of visiting Patriarch Xu of the Xu Family.
Besides traditional farming estates, the Changning Xu Family’s unique enterprise focused mainly on silk weaving workshops.
The cotton and hemp cocoons produced in the entire Changning Guard Region were supplied to several workshops owned by the Xu Family, who then manufactured textiles and silk, selling them throughout the county, yielding considerable profits.
One of Ping’an Wang Family’s pillar industries, the Xinmao Silk Farm, supplied its raw cocoons to the Xu Family in Changning.
