chapters.title: Chapter 18: Spirit Bee Hive
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18: Spirit Bee Hive
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Let’s set aside the small talk for now.
In Changning Guard City, the most bustling areas are the East Market and the West Market. The East Market mainly consists of various street shops selling local specialties from the towns and villages beneath the city, things like fruits, vegetables, livestock, meat, poultry, household goods, and so on. Ping’an Wang’s Fish Stall is located in the East Market.
Wang Shouzhe and his companions, leading their horses, found themselves in what felt like a massive agricultural market, brimming with a wide array of farm products and handicrafts. Besides the large shops owned by wealthy merchants or noble families, there were many independent vendors occupying corners of the market, selling strange and unusual items. These stalls were specially designated by the Changning Government Office for loose cultivators to prevent unmanaged street vending.
Loose cultivators typically don’t have anything valuable, but since they often wander from place to place, the things they sell are very diverse and may occasionally include some novelty items.
"Tier two top-grade fierce beast Black-backed Bear’s gallbladder, only one available, priced at fifteen Qian Gold, no bargaining." A knife-scarred man dressed in beast hide armor was the loose cultivator operating the stall. The stall was laid with a thick bear pelt, upon which hung an air-dried bear’s gallbladder from a branch, with a sign standing nearby giving off an unapproachable aura.
"This bear pelt has a black back and white belly, rich and dense texture; it indeed appears to be the pelt of a Black-backed Bear," household general Wang Zhong quietly remarked, "This bear gall’s inner gall bladder is gold and looks quite good. Fifteen Qian Gold isn’t expensive; reselling it to the Pill Workshop should earn us at least four or five Qian Gold."
Having been taught from a young age to study fierce beast compendiums, Wang Shouzhe could recognize most ordinary fierce beasts and the materials from their bodies, but he only chuckled, "Let’s not be greedy for this bargain." With that, he left without looking back.
"Does the Patriarch think it’s from a swindler? I think the color and appearance of that bear’s gall are excellent; it can’t be wrong." Wang Zhong felt a bit reluctant but obediently followed, casting a somewhat wistful glance, "If the Patriarch isn’t interested in a bit of easy money... perhaps..."
"Fool, the Patriarch must have spotted something odd." Wang Yong glared at him fiercely.
"Haha~ the edges of that bear pelt are dry and blackened, indicating it’s quite old. Though the bear’s gall has been air-dried, the sac still looks fresh, probably extracted no more than three months ago," Wang Shouzhe chuckled, "Wang Zhong, if you want to buy it, I can lend you the money, and you needn’t share any extra profit with me."
He couldn’t help but secretly find it amusing that compared to Earth, swindlers at market stalls in our Black Tortoise World seem so crude, not even bothering to weave an outlandish tale; it’s embarrassingly unprofessional.
"No, no, it’s fortunate that I came out today with the Patriarch," Wang Zhong broke into a cold sweat and complained bitterly, "Indeed, loose cultivators can’t be trusted; there are too many charlatans and tricksters."
"Our Black Tortoise Clan has homesteads and businesses, a foundation and a base. As long as we protect this foundation, we’ll have a continuous stream of cultivation resources," Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "Loose cultivators are rootless wanderers drifting everywhere; all their resources must be self-supported, so their lives are naturally hard, and they easily fall into deceit and theft. Moreover, if they commit a crime, they can easily get away, change appearances, and switch identities with no problem. If loose cultivators could easily obtain resources, then why have our ancestors built careers, expand family properties, sacrificing their very lives to guard the foundation of our family?"
What the Patriarch said made so much sense.
The household generals, Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, gradually grew more and more respectful of Wang Shouzhe; they could already feel the difference between the new Patriarch and the former one, as just a few words could make clear distinctions between the situations of loose cultivators and noble families.
Thus, they grew increasingly wary of the loose cultivators dressed in various attires, occupying stalls with all sorts of miscellaneous items, suspecting each one as a deceiver upon sight.
"How much for this beehive?"
Just then, Wang Shouzhe suddenly squatted down in front of a stall. The stall owner was a somewhat slovenly middle-aged man of about forty or fifty, appearing to be at the Peak of the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm at first glance.
However, this was the common state for most loose cultivators; factors like poor aptitude, lack of systematic cultivation methods, absence of elder guidance, and extremely unstable cultivation resources all contributed to making it difficult for most loose cultivators to make a name for themselves.
The stall owner, upon seeing Wang Shouzhe dressed in finery, with two fully armed and formidable household generals behind him, realized immediately that he was no ordinary person.
Instantly, he swallowed back the exorbitant price and smiled ingratiatingly, "This young master, this is a Tiger-headed Spirit Bee nest, which I risked my life to bring back after stumbling upon it in the mountains. You see, there’s still quite a bit of spiritual honey and bee pupa in this hive; I want to trade it for two Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills."
At the mention of Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills, he gulped slightly.
"Are you robbing me?" Wang Yong’s face changed as he placed a hand on the hilt of his sword, exuding aggression, "This beehive is barely the size of a head; it could yield about two ounces of spiritual honey at most, and the few bee pupa aren’t even enough to stir-fry into a dish; at best, it’s only worth a few Qian Gold."
"Oh, dear sir, please don’t be angry," the stall owner’s face showed a hint of fear as he said, "This beehive is freshly harvested, with many bee pupa still alive. If your family has a Spirit Insect Master, you might even cultivate a Tiger-headed Spirit Bee colony."
Many loose cultivators wander far and wide; their strength isn’t impressive, but they do gain knowledge from their travels.
"You’re overthinking it. There’s no one in the entire Changning Guard Region that has a Spirit Insect Master. It’s just that this item is rare, and we take it to enjoy a novel taste," Wang Shouzhe offered ten Qian Gold, "Enough for you to buy one Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill; take it or leave it. If you demand a coin more, I’ll walk away."
The stall owner hesitated for quite a while before finally accepting, albeit reluctantly, "This young master, in a county it would indeed be worth twenty Qian Gold, but unfortunately, these bee pupa will be dead by the time they’re transported to a county."
Were it not for the fact that the bee pupae wouldn’t survive a few days, the stall owner would’ve truly preferred to travel to a county to sell them, given the ten Qian Gold profit difference. Once the pupae mostly died, the value of the Tiger-headed Spirit Bee nest would plummet.
After the transaction, Wang Shouzhe had Wang Yong pack it up and carry it off; he didn’t bother to exchange further words with the stall owner.
The transaction couldn’t be called a steal, yet it wasn’t a loss either. If gifted to his fifth sister, Wang Luojing, unexpectedly, a miracle might happen, and if she managed to nurture Tiger-headed Spirit Bees, it would add a unique industry to the family.
In the wild, Tiger-headed Spirit Bees were almost extinct, only occasionally found in isolated places; finding them with great effort over half a year might still not yield results.
After strolling about the loose cultivator stalls, no other items sparked interest. Unknowingly, he found himself walking to the middle of the East Market, to his own family’s business—Changning East Market Fish Stall.
Ping’an Wang’s Fish Stall.
The six characters spanned across three of the shopfronts, and compared to the miscellaneous stalls, the fish stall was considerably more tidy and upscale.
Looking at Wang’s Fish Stall, memories surged within Wang Shouzhe, stirring his heart profoundly.
These three shops, along with the courtyard behind them, were the last assets of the Wang Family in Changning Guard City.
After two major wars fifty years ago, the prestige of Ping’an Wang Family plummeted. In an effort to quickly foster a new Spirit Platform Realm expert to support the family, the Wang Family heartlessly liquidated many of their fixed assets in Changning Guard City.
Sadly.
The second uncle Wang Dingtian, who was expected to achieve great things, died at the young age of twenty, not having left any lineage.
The sixth grandpa Wang Xiaohan managed to reach the Ninth Layer in the Qi Refining Realm in his forties and attempted to break through to the Spirit Platform Realm. However, after depleting vast resources, he failed in his attempt; now at sixty-five, Wang Xiaohan remains at the Ninth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Wang Shouzhe’s father, Wang Dingyue, faced an even harsher fate. Lacking resources to support a breakthrough to the Spirit Platform Realm, he recklessly ventured into the Outer Domain seeking opportunity, losing his life as a result.
In truth, if the family had continued to sell off assets, such as the three large farms, they would’ve been able to gather the resources necessary for Wang Dingyue’s breakthrough to the Spirit Platform Realm. However, such an action was a risky all-or-nothing approach. Should it fail, the Ping’an Wang Family would be left destitute overnight.
Wang Shouzhe vaguely sensed that once he reached the Peak of Ninth Layer in the Qi Refining Realm, the family might contemplate selling off all assets for one last gamble on his breakthrough.
However, if it truly came to that, it would only prove Wang Shouzhe’s failure as a transmigrator.
"Fourth brother, why are you here?"
Just as Wang Shouzhe was feeling somewhat emotional, a voice filled with surprise reached him.

chapters.title: Chapter 19: The Legendary Fiancée
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19: The Legendary Fiancée
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
He was a strong adult man wearing coarse cloth, busy at work. He threw a box of salted fish off his shoulder with a thud and greeted him happily.
Wang Shouzhe gathered himself and recognized him as the second in the Shou generation, Wang Shouyi. He cupped his hands and smiled, "Second Brother, why are you dressed like this and even working personally?"
Wang Shouyi smiled helplessly, "Sixth Uncle seems to have gone crazy and sent all the stock of salted fish from the Dingpu Warehouse over here for me to sell quickly. The workers can’t handle it at once, so here I am, unloading the goods."
As he spoke, he pointed to a line of goods-laden horse-drawn carts, practically blocking the road.
Uh... hehe.
Wang Shouzhe naturally knew the reason. It was because of his suggestions and ideas that this year’s fishing team had an absolute boom in catches. If the stockpiled salted fish weren’t dealt with quickly, they’d end up stuck with it when a large amount of fresh catch hit the market.
"Wang Zhong, Wang Yong, lend a hand with unloading." Wang Shouzhe waved his hand.
"Yes, Patriarch." The two Household Generals immediately put down their burdens and went to help. Each was at the Fourth Layer and Fifth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, their strength and physique far exceeding ordinary people.
Additionally, Wang Shouyi was also at the Fifth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. With three Black Tortoise Practitioners working together, the unloading speed shot up.
Of course, Wang Shouzhe was already at the high stage of the Sixth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, and if he joined, the speed would be even faster. However, if he, being the head of the family, were to move salted fish himself, it would tarnish the family’s prestige if word got out.
In less than two quarter-hours, the fish goods on several carts were moved into the warehouse, and the road was clear again.
Afterward, Wang Shouyi, having cleaned himself up, was going to entertain Wang Shouzhe in the backyard, but was declined, and they found a spot inside the fish stall for some tea and a chat.
"Fourth Brother, our fish stall mainly sells salted fish and smoked fish dried goods, fresh fish, and live fish," Wang Shouyi said, personally pouring tea. "Most dried goods like salted fish are bulk-purchased by traveling merchants and sold toward the northwest."
"The fresh fish are sold first to the vendors in Changning Guard City, who come to our stall at dawn to pick up goods. Secondly, we supply fresh fish and live fish to a few restaurants in the city. This part, we’re responsible for delivering, so the price is slightly higher."
"Additionally, some noble families, wealthy merchant families, and so forth have a daily need for fresh fish and live fish. Hence, from dawn to noon, is the busiest time for our fish stall."
With just a few words, Wang Shouzhe understood the operation mode of Wang’s Fish Stall, which mainly aimed to maximize the selling price of the fishing team’s catch output, bringing net profits to the family of about two hundred Qian Gold each year.
And because the net profit wasn’t high, the family had Wang Shouyi of the seventh generation take charge here.
Wang Shouyi’s talent wasn’t very good, only a Lower Grade D, so throughout his life, he could not enjoy family resources comparable to those of Wang Dingyue and Wang Shouzhe, resulting in his being only at the initial stage of the Fifth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm at the age of thirty-three.
Fortunately, Wang Shouyi’s character was steady, hard-working, with no complaints about the family’s resource distribution, and he strove diligently to shoulder one part of the family industry, contributing to the family.
"Second Brother, you’ve worked hard all these years." Wang Shouzhe solemnly cupped his hands.
"Fourth Brother, what are you saying?" Wang Shouyi hurriedly stood up to return the gesture, "As a direct descendant of the family, managing the family industry is my duty, no talk of hardship. As long as you, Fourth Brother, can one day reach the Spirit Platform Realm, our Wang clan members will live a good life."
Spirit Platform Realm! Spirit Platform Realm!
Wang Shouzhe sighed inwardly. Now, the hopes of all family members were pinned on him, Wang Shouzhe. It was this hope that made them work tirelessly without complaint.
"Don’t worry, Second Brother, our Wang family will only get better and better," Wang Shouzhe said confidently with a smile, "By the way, I heard that nephew Zongsheng’s talent is not bad, at Lower Grade C?"
When mentioning Zongsheng, a joyful expression appeared on Wang Shouyi’s honest face as he scratched his head, "That kid is alright, better than his father, it seems my bloodline isn’t bad."
"Haha, Second Brother, that’s because Second Sister-in-law has a good bloodline," Wang Shouzhe teased with a smile, "I know that Second Sister-in-law was a renowned beauty when she was in the Golden Sand Xu Family waiting for marriage, with many families proposing. Yet you managed to stand out and win her heart."
"Fourth Brother, you actually remember that? You were just a child then, right? Hehe, your Second Sister-in-law didn’t fancy those flashy young masters, she chose your Second Brother for his honesty and simplicity." Recalling the matter, Wang Shouyi was filled with pride, "Marrying your Second Sister-in-law was the greatest victory of my life. By the way, Fourth Brother, you’re eighteen this year, right? When do you plan to marry the Liua family daughter?"
Liua family daughter?
Wang Shouzhe paused. If Wang Shouyi hadn’t brought it up, he’d have forgotten that he was engaged to the eldest legitimate daughter of the Liua family.
Logically speaking, the declining Wang family would have difficulty connecting with the Liua’s direct lineage, with the relationship only maintained through occasional marriages between direct veins. It had been generations since the last direct line marriage between the Wang and Liua families.
At that time, the Liua’s legitimate daughter married Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s second son, Wang Yuyou, while Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s second daughter, Wang Zhuwei, was married into the Liua’s direct line.
It’s worth noting that Ancestral Grandmother Zhu Wei gave birth to two sons and a daughter in the Liua family, and currently, the two living Spirit Platform Realm ancestors of the Liua family are one son and one grandson of Ancestral Grandmother Zhu Wei.
It is precisely because of this that Shanyin Liua family always held a sentiment towards the Wang family.
Yet the most formidable among the Liua family isn’t those two Spirit Platform Realm ancestors, but Ancestral Grandmother Zhu Wei’s daughter, Liua Xuanfu.
Back then, Liua Xuanfu of the Liua family and Wang Longyan of the Wang family were not only cousins but also rare prodigious girls, both admitted to the Purple Mansion Academy, which shocked the entire Changning Guard Region.
They were called the Two Beauties of Changning, and their fame surpassed that of ordinary clan’s Spirit Platform ancestors. Furthermore, they both thrived at the Purple Mansion Academy, promising a bright future.
Unfortunately.
After the Wang family faced disaster, Ancestor Longyan had to give up her Elite Disciple status at the academy and return to the family, ending up heavily injured with a greatly reduced lifespan, and never left Changning thereafter.
However, Liua Xuanfu continued to develop at the Purple Mansion Academy, her current situation unknown. But, given the rising strength of the Liua family, it can be deduced that Liua Xuanfu must have fared well at the Purple Mansion Academy.
Therefore, perhaps Ancestor Longyan sacrificed something unknown to secure this last assurance for the family by arranging Wang Shouzhe’s marriage to a direct descendant of the Liua family.
"Fourth Brother, what are you thinking?" Wang Shouyi said with a hearty laugh, "Are you thinking about your fiancée who has yet to come home?"
"Second Brother, Second Brother, let’s not talk about my fiancée now," Wang Shouzhe said, shifting the topic, "Let’s focus on how we can make the family more prosperous. If Uncle Six’s Fishing Team reaches last year’s production levels, it will be beneficial for the family. If that happens, I assure you, our family will certainly have better days ahead, Second Brother."
"Hiss~" Wang Shouyi gasped, "Fourth Brother, don’t joke with me."
Wang Shouzhe’s smile froze on his face, and his gaze turned a bit sharp.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 20 Teaching the Younger Generation
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20 Teaching the Younger Generation
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
In any Black Tortoise Clan, there will be clansfolk who diligently contribute to the family, and naturally, there might also be some degenerate members. Luckily, the family rules of the Ping’an Wang Family are strict, combined with the glory of the ancestors and the pressure of the family’s difficult survival, most clansfolk adhere strictly to their duties.
Yet, the eighth generation of the Zong lineage has produced a good-for-nothing scoundrel.
"Fourth brother, you’re the clan leader now, it’s better not to get involved." Wang Shouyi said with a cold face, "Wait a moment, I’ll be right back."
With that, he stormed out.
Not long after, Wang Shouyi dragged a young man in his twenties back inside. That young man, with a face bruised and swollen from beatings, whimpered continuously, "Second uncle, I was wrong, I truly know I was wrong. Please forgive me this time, don’t tell my father!"
"You little bastard." Wang Shouyi, in a fit of rage, kicked the young man, making him roll a few times on the ground, "You’ve fallen to such a state, and yet you refuse to reflect, shamelessly begging for mercy, wanting me to cover for you?"
"Ouch ouch!"
After howling twice, the young man was about to beg again when he suddenly glanced up and saw an extraordinary young man calmly seated, staring at him expressionlessly.
The young man immediately shivered, as if struck by lightning, a doomsday terror filled his eyes: "Four, four, four-fourth uncle! You-you-you-you..." His body swayed, almost fainting. In such moments, encountering his father would be preferable to running into the fourth uncle.
His father might beat him up, would lock him up for a few months, but afterward he’d be a happy man again.
But this one...
"How much did you lose?" Wang Shouzhe said coldly.
"This little bastard, in just over a month with me, has already owed the casino twenty Qian Gold, plus the private money his mother gave him, and he sold a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill privately, losing a full forty Qian Gold!" Wang Shouyi’s anger burned fiercely; this family fish stall business, with twenty to thirty clerks working hard all year, could only earn a little over two hundred Qian Gold.
This brat was lavish enough to lose forty Qian Gold gambling, with that money he could buy four ’Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills’.
"Fourth uncle, I was wrong, I truly was wrong." The young man collapsed on the ground, repeatedly kowtowing to Wang Shouzhe, "Begging Fourth Uncle to give me another chance."
"The opportunity, you’ve been given too many chances already." Wang Shouyi said angrily, "The family originally let you learn the trade under your big brother at Xinmao Silk Farm. You, instead, mixed with disreputable friends all day and even dared to flirt with respectable women! Later, your grandfather and your mother pleaded for you, letting you join Sixth Uncle’s fleet to work. You complained about the hardship and sneaked to me again. I was wrong, I should never have taken you in! The bustling world of Changning Guard has blinded you."
Wang Shouzhe pondered for a moment before speaking slowly, "Zongwei, you are the eldest of the Zong lineage. You should set an example for your younger siblings, yet you turned out so poorly. Originally, as you’re the son of my big brother, it would be your big brother’s responsibility to educate you. But I, Wang Shouzhe, as a direct lineage of the clan, have the right and duty to discipline ill-mannered clansfolk as the clan leader."
"Four, fourth uncle!" Wang Zongwei trembled into a puddle, "For the sake of my father, f-for my great-grandfather’s sake..."
"Since you like gambling, let Fourth Uncle play a bet with you." Wang Shouzhe said expressionlessly, taking out a Qian Gold and pinching it in his palm, "Guess which hand the Qian Gold is in? If you’re right, today’s incident will be forgotten. If wrong, I won’t trouble you, just want one of your hands, considering your great-grandfather, you’ll afterwards live in peace within the clan like an idle loafer."
"What?" Tears stopped on Wang Zongwei’s face from fear, "Four, fourth uncle, I don’t want to bet, I don’t want to bet."
"Four..." Wang Shouyi’s expression changed, he wanted to plead but was stopped by Wang Shouzhe’s waving hand, only to hear him say coldly, "Today, even if Second Grandpa Wang Xiaohui were here, your grandfather Wang Dingchuang, your father Wang Shouxin were here, it won’t help."
Wang Shouyi shivered, closing his mouth instinctively, not daring to plead further.
Although they were all Wang Clan members, all Shou lineage brothers, Wang Shouzhe was from the direct lineage of the Wang Race and was now the clan leader, cherished by Ancestor Longyan since childhood; how could everyone be the same?
To the Wang Race, even ten scoundrels like Wang Zongwei tied together are not as important as a finger of Wang Shouzhe.
Having intimidated Wang Shouyi, Wang Shouzhe continued staring at Wang Zongwei, coldly saying, "If you refuse to gamble, Fourth Uncle assumes you admit defeat, put your hand forward."
"No no, I’ll bet, I’ll bet." Wang Zongwei said frantically, "I bet the Qian Gold is in Fourth Uncle’s right hand."
"Hehe~" Wang Shouzhe’s eyes flashed coldly, and he slowly opened his empty right palm, "Zongwei, you lost."
"No, don’t! Fourth Uncle, give me one more chance, one more!" Wang Zongwei screamed hysterically, "In the left hand, the Qian Gold is in Fourth Uncle’s left hand."
"You sure?"
"I am sure, I am sure!"
Wang Shouzhe slowly unfolded his left palm, still empty, and his gaze pierced Wang Zongwei like a sharp blade, "Zongwei, one must maintain credibility, whoever gambles must accept the outcome. Wang Zhong, Wang Yong!"
"Yes, Patriarch."
The two household generals responded, lifting the limp Wang Zongwei, whose face was ashen with trembling, only muttering, Fourth Uncle forgive me, forgive me.
"Clang!"
With a chilling glint, Wang Shouzhe drew his sharp sword from its scabbard.
Wang Shouyi couldn’t bear to watch any longer and turned away.
"Slash!"
Wang Shouzhe swung the sword, sword aura flashed by, and the sword returned to its sheath in the next instant.
"Ah~~~~" Wang Zongwei shrieked miserably, "My hand, my hand, it’s gone, it’s gone..." A smell of urine pervaded the air.
Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, the two household generals, disdainfully released him, faces filled with contempt, thinking how the difference was so vast considering they were both the bloodline descendants of Ancestor Zhou Xuan? It’s ironic that this Wang Zongwei is already twenty and two years older than the Patriarch.
"Smack!" Wang Shouyi rushed over, slapped him to stop the screams, angrily and disdainfully said, "Enough, stop screaming, shameful dog, hurry and thank your Fourth Uncle."
"Hand, my... is still, still here..." Wang Zongwei cried with tears and snot, screaming joyfully, while bowing repeatedly to Wang Shouzhe, "Thank you Fourth Uncle, thank you Fourth Uncle. I’ll definitely, definitely be a good person and start over."
"Remember, you owe me a hand, I reserve the right to reclaim it at any time. Also, all your cultivation resources and salary are temporarily confiscated and transferred to, uh~ to Wang Luotong for use." Wang Shouzhe no longer wanted to see him, turned and left, the two household generals quickly followed.
"Thank you Fourth Uncle, thank you Fourth Uncle." Wang Zongwei dared not to object, repeatedly kowtowing.
Wang Shouyi glared fiercely at Wang Zongwei, quickly caught up with Wang Shouzhe, sighed and said, "Fourth brother, I understand your intentions of teaching the little bastard Zongwei a lesson, but...
"But what?" Wang Shouzhe sneered, "Could Second Grandpa or Big Brother come to take his winnings instead?"
"I’m not worried about Grandpa and Big Brother." Wang Shouyi said helplessly, "You see, sister-in-law Xu from Changning Xu Family is of the direct bloodline, pampered and nurtured since childhood with a rather... You revoked Zongwei’s resources, and he deserves it; she can’t find fault. However, giving the resources to Luotong sister might have sister-in-law causing trouble."
"Regardless if sister-in-law is from Xu Family or Liua Family, she is now part of our Wang Family." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "I believe sister-in-law is from a grand noble family, she must be a knowledgeable and reasonable person, she will eventually understand my good intentions."
Wang Shouyi opened his mouth hesitantly, knowing although sister-in-law Xu was fierce, she probably wouldn’t dare to clash directly with Shouzhe, feeling much relieved.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Opening the Door to a New World for Brother 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21: Opening the Door to a New World for Brother 2
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Wang Shouzhe didn’t take this little episode too seriously and shifted the topic to the main point: "By the way, Second Brother, are the live fish the most valuable in your fish stall?"
"Yes, apart from spirit fish, some high-quality live fish are the most valuable. Sea bass, pike, mandarin fish, carp, shad, these are all known for their tenderness and are quite favored by noble families and wealthy merchants. The only requirement is that they must be fresh and alive," Wang Shouyi said with a frown. "Uncle Six’s fishing fleet has live water storage. Once ashore, the live fish need to be delivered to Changning Guard City overnight using a special cart. Even if the time taken is minimal, many mistakes occur. Out of ten, six to seven will die, and once they die, their value drops by half and can only be sold as fresh fish."
Wang Shouzhe pondered for a moment and said, "So, the cost of transportation and the mortality rate of live fish are the two key issues. Solving these two issues, even if the fish catch yield doesn’t increase, can earn a lot more in a year."
The reason he was inspecting various clan industries was to examine every production detail. If he could apply some modern Earth-based optimizations, he’d enhance the clan’s production output.
"If Fourth Brother can find a way to reduce live fish mortality, conservatively, we could confidently make seventy to eighty extra Qian Gold annually," Wang Shouyi said, unable to hide the pain on his face. "Those dead ones would be pure profit."
"It’s hard to say now; I need to see your existing plan, Second Brother."
"Come with me, Fourth Brother." Wang Shouyi led Wang Shouzhe to the backyard of the courtyard, where two carts were parked. Unlike regular carts, they had no passenger compartment, but each housed a large round wooden tub. He said, "One cart carries both water and fish, while the other carries only water. Every hour, some of the water in the fish tub needs to be changed. But even so, when there are too many fish, they still die. I’m considering adding another cart just for water, though this would significantly increase costs."
Upon seeing Wang Shouyi’s methods for transporting live fish, Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched. The number of valuable fish Uncle Six’s team could catch daily wasn’t numerous, at most one or two thousand pounds a day.
And they used such astonishing means to transport them? The fish tubs were surprisingly simple, lacking any oxygenation or filtration; it was just about water exchange!
To change the water, another cart was used just to carry water. And that wasn’t enough; Wang Shouyi even planned to add another cart?
However, Wang Shouzhe knew it wasn’t Wang Shouyi’s fault. This was a Black Tortoise world, where everyone was focused on how to improve cultivation realms and personal martial power.
Of course, not all human elites ignored studying some natural sciences. But even if some did research a part of the findings, they would keep it to themselves, strictly guarding the knowledge, making it hard to spread.
It wasn’t their fault; even if Wang Shouzhe discovered any knowledge, it would only be secretly used by the clan. The thought of disseminating it to benefit other families was out of the question.
In his previous life, when at work, Wang Shouzhe was often a lazy fish with no ambition. On holidays, he often went fishing with friends. After catching more fish, he bought oxygen pumps trying to keep live fish alive for gradual consumption, but found that even with oxygenation, fish still died quickly. After slightly researching and learning simple principles, he understood some fundamentals.
To keep live fish alive for gradual consumption, one must meet three conditions in their tank.
The first is the dissolved oxygen in the water. Fish need oxygen to survive, and the oxygen in the water is limited. The more fish in a bucket, the more oxygen consumed. This can be addressed by aeration.
Second is the cleanliness of the water. Fish waste and food residue produce ammonia and nitrites, and breathing creates nitrogen. These are factors causing fish death. This can be addressed by water changes and filtration.
Furthermore, temperature plays a role. Higher temperatures increase fish activity, leading to more oxygen consumption and more toxic ammonia production. Therefore, maintaining relatively low water temperatures is very effective as well.
Combining these three points, the two entered Wang Shouyi’s study. After a brief thought, Wang Shouzhe sketched a simple diagram on paper: the top of the fish-containing wooden barrel would have a filter with water falling like rain into the tub, using the simplest drip aeration principle.
He also used the simplest terms to explain the principles of oxygen and toxic substances to Wang Shouyi.
Having worked in the fish trade for over a decade, Wang Shouyi quickly grasped Wang Shouzhe’s principles and exclaimed in sudden realization, "Hearing what Fourth Brother said, I suddenly understand many things. The elders once passed down that we must exchange live water because fish need the live energy in water. Without enough live energy, water becomes dead water, and fish die. Fourth Brother’s suggestion of using drip and sprinkle methods to increase live energy in water never crossed my mind."
"This was something I read in ancient texts. Whether it is effective remains to be seen through Second Brother’s experiments," Wang Shouzhe nodded discreetly. The term ’live energy’ is indeed more digestible than the cumbersome term ’oxygen.’
"Fish consume the live energy and expel dead energy; too much waste in water produces toxic gas. Filtering out these wastes using layers of cotton cloth, charcoal, and gravel removes the toxins, naturally preventing fish from dying. Why didn’t I think of this?"
Wang Shouyi grew more animated: "Additionally, what Fourth Brother said about the hot and cold conditions makes sense. The colder it gets, the less likely live fish die during transportation, while in summer, more live fish die. The reason is, in hotter conditions, fish are more active and thus require more live energy... No wonder transporting during the day isn’t as effective as during the night! If only some ice stored in the cellar could be added to the water..."
The theories Wang Shouzhe shared seemed to open a new door for Wang Shouyi. Things that had puzzled him for so long suddenly made sense.
"As long as you understand, Second Brother, you can have the craftsmen make some small devices for trials first," Wang Shouzhe said, glancing at the sky. "It’s getting late, and I still have other matters to attend to, so I’ll take my leave first."
Being the clan leader, Wang Shouzhe wasn’t there to invent. Furthermore, knowing something and doing it are two different things. Getting hands-on with those things might not yield great results.
As long as Wang Shouyi understood the principles, he could take charge of the following work.
"Fourth Brother, don’t rush off." Wang Shouyi held him back. "It’s rare for you to visit the fish stall; I haven’t even treated you properly. Let’s have lunch at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion. The live fish there are all supplied by us, and their dishes taste excellent. I still have many unresolved questions, like the siphon effect for drainage? And what is the principle of using a pump to add live energy to a water tank, and how can one utilize a pump principle to make water flow uphill..."
Enough!
Wang Shouzhe listened to the ’thousands of whys’ and, though a bit overwhelmed, knew it was a good thing. Should Wang Shouyi immerse himself in this field after running the fish stall for many years, future business would only flourish, contributing greatly to the clan.
In Changning Guard, Wang’s Fish Stall wasn’t the only one; over ten noble families were in the fish business. Especially the Liu Family and Zhao Family, whose operations were larger in scale than Wang’s.
The better the fish stall business did, while generating more wealth, they also squeezed out the survival space for the competitors.
So, Wang Shouzhe spent more time with Wang Shouyi, concentrating on a ’starter education.’ Both the siphon effect and hand pumps required pipes. In this world, the use of pipes was quite rudimentary, limited to bamboo, ceramic, and copper types, but they sufficed.
If a manual pump couldn’t be made for now, it wasn’t crucial. Using a simple siphon principle to extract the bottom water and having workers manually pour water on the filtration layer would suffice. This greatly increased the transport capacity of one cart, and the rate of live fish survival was also significantly improved.
Wang Shouyi was utterly absorbed, even during lunch at Hundred Flavors Pavilion; he held onto Wang Shouzhe, asking incessant questions.
"Second Brother, are you saying that Hundred Flavors Pavilion is truly one of the finest restaurants in Changning Guard?" Wang Shouzhe, tasting the dishes at Hundred Flavors Pavilion, found the flavor to be average, elevated only by the quality of ingredients.
Of course, the culinary skill was still above the Wang Race family chefs, but compared to Earth, there was still a considerable gap in flavor.
"Fourth Brother, this meal cost 32 Large Copper 73 coins..." Wang Shouyi’s face turned black with injustice. "This is the hard-earned private money I’ve saved, and you’re still not satisfied with such fine dishes?"
Wang Shouzhe stroked his chin, guessing the gap in flavor was due to monosodium glutamate. In his past life on Earth, MSG and chicken essence pervaded the culinary world, setting his soul’s taste thresholds very high for umami.
If MSG could be recreated, could it become a new industry?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 22 Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22 Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
However, this idea was just a fleeting thought because Wang Shouzhe only knew that the earliest monosodium glutamate was extracted from kelp. However, the content of monosodium glutamate in kelp was very low, making industrial operations difficult.
Modern techniques extract monosodium glutamate from crops like soybeans through microbial fermentation.
Yet Wang Shouzhe was almost completely clueless about the refining process and principles of monosodium glutamate. It was hard to say when he could successfully develop it on his own. Therefore, this get-rich idea had to be set aside for the moment; it would be more prudent to start with improving and optimizing the clan’s industry.
"Second Brother, you understand the principles now. I hope you can experiment and improve quickly; don’t let Uncle Liu’s Fishing Team’s hard work of catching live fish go to waste. Of course, we also need to keep the Wang Family’s secrets secure; I believe you know how to handle this better than I do."
After giving a few reminders, Wang Shouzhe took his leave with his Household Generals.
After receiving the "inheritance," Wang Shouyi was also itching to get started. He was so eager to try it out that he couldn’t even bother to see Wang Shouzhe off. Once successful, the family tradition of fish stalls would be able to show its advantage.
The East City Gate of Changning Guard.
After leaving the city, there was a straight and broad government road.
Wang Shouzhe rode a horse with two Household Generals, and after galloping and stopping for less than half an hour, they arrived at the Changning Ferry in Anjiang.
The Changning Ferry was a Guandu, actually controlled by the Changning Guard Government Office. The reach of the three Noble Families of Ping’an Town stopped here, marking a clear boundary.
A Household General of the Wang Family had been waiting here for a long time. As soon as he saw Wang Shouzhe and the others, he stepped forward to greet them: "Wang Wu greets the Patriarch."
"No need for formalities. Have Madam Da and Fifth Sister arrived?" As Wang Shouzhe left the family overnight, he left a note for Gongsun Hui, instructing her to act according to the plan in the note.
"Reporting to the Patriarch," Wang Wu respectfully said, "Lady Hui and Miss Wu’s carriage is waiting ahead."
Under Wang Wu’s guidance, Wang Shouzhe quickly reunited with Gongsun Hui and the others. After getting on the carriage, Gongsun Hui poured Wang Shouzhe a cup of tea, her brows somewhat furrowed with worry: "Zhe’Er, is what you said in the note really that serious?"
"I’m afraid it’s more serious than imagined." Wang Shouzhe drank some tea to steady himself and said with a frown, "The Qiaan’s Trading Company’s industry is spread throughout Longzuo, yet they haven’t noticed anything. This shows that, at least within Longzuo County, no major force has issued a warning about this disaster."
"How could this be?" Gongsun Hui whispered, her face turning pale, "There are so many great families in the entire Longzuo County, and none of them have noticed? Doesn’t this mean that many civilians will suffer?"
"Madam Da overthinks it. When the sky falls, there will always be taller ones to hold it up. Our small Wang Family’s goal is to go with the flow, survive, and grow strong," Wang Shouzhe said indifferently, "But Madam Da makes a good point. It’s impossible for us to be the first in Longzuo County to notice the insect disaster. Perhaps most people are negligent, but some families will surely notice something unusual and prepare secretly. Or someone might have already issued a warning, but the news hasn’t reached us in Changning yet."
Human nature is universal.
After discovering this matter, Wang Shouzhe immediately kept it strictly confidential, preparing to seize the opportunity to benefit. Most other families that discovered this incident through luck or skill likely thought the same.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe discovered this matter very late, just in time to adapt to the situation. Even publicizing this matter would only cause chaos to break out earlier, which wouldn’t help the overall situation at all.
"Zhe’Er, you’re right. It’s already good if our small family can take care of itself now." Gongsun Hui also said relievedly, "The Daqian Government Office, Purple Mansion Academy, and those grand families will surely step in to provide disaster relief at critical moments. Zhe’Er, the fact that you thought of helping the Gongsun Family at this critical moment is something Madam Da must thank you for on behalf of the Shanyang Gongsun Family."
"Madam Da, what are you saying? The Gongsun Family and our Wang Family have intermarried for generations; our bloodlines have long merged, and we should support each other," Wang Shouzhe smiled and said, "Besides, I haven’t visited my grandfather for a long time to pay my respects to him."
As far as Wang Shouzhe knew, the intermarriage between the Gongsun and Wang families was indeed deep. Take the current Clan Leader of the Gongsun Family, Gongsun Mo, for example. His paternal grandmother came from the Wang Family’s fourth-generation legitimate daughter—Wang Lingdie. Madam Da, Gongsun Hui, had to call her great-grandmother.
Likewise, during the Wang Family’s fourth generation, they married a legitimate daughter from the Gongsun Family, who was Wang Shouzhe’s great-grandmother.
This shows how close the bloodline relationship is between the Gongsun and Wang families.
At the mention of the word "grandfather," Gongsun Hui paused slightly before showing some joy and saying with emotion: "Zhe’Er, you’ve really grown up and matured."
Though Gongsun Hui was not Wang Shouzhe’s biological mother, she was his legitimate mother. Her father, Gongsun Mo, was naturally Wang Shouzhe’s grandfather. However, Wang Shouzhe’s predecessor was rather introverted, being relatively indifferent and distant during the few times he visited Gongsun Mo from childhood to adulthood.
For Gongsun Hui, after marrying Wang Dingyue as a second wife, she only had one legitimate daughter and no legitimate sons, so she devoted all her attention to the legitimate son, Wang Shouzhe.
According to the laws of the Daqian Kingdom and the rules followed by all Black Tortoise Clans, the relationship between a legitimate mother and a legitimate son is formal, regardless of whether they are biologically related or not.
While Gongsun Hui chatted, Fifth Sister Wang Luojing quietly sat there. Even when the conversation was dull, she just blinked and dared not talk too much.
"Luojing, Fourth Brother brought you a gift; see if you like it." Wang Shouzhe took out a parcel and handed it to her.
Wang Luojing opened it and saw a beehive. She was so surprised that she covered her mouth and mumbled, "This beehive is round like a sphere, with hexagonal openings and a slightly crystal jade-like color. Could it be the legendary Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive? Thank you, Fourth Brother, this is wonderful."
Wait, what is a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee?
Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned slightly confused: "Luojing, you haven’t mastered your skills; this is clearly a Tiger-headed Spirit Bee Hive."
Wang Luojing paused, bit her jade finger, and said, "I see, Fourth Brother, you’re testing me again. According to the Insect Scripture, Tiger-headed Spirit Bees and Purple Crystal Spirit Bees look similar at the Tier One Body stage, with the small difference that Purple Crystal Spirit Bees have a slightly more elongated body. However, their hives differ significantly. Tiger-headed Spirit Bee Hives are usually flatter, with slightly coarse openings. On the other hand, Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hives are generally round, with a hive body showing crystal jade-like properties. This is because these Purple Crystal Spirit Bees are still at the Tier One Body stage, showing slight crystal jade-like properties. If they advance to the Tier Two Body stage, the hive will be more than ten times larger and will gradually exhibit a Purple Crystal Jade-like state."
As she spoke, Wang Luojing carefully poured out a few bee pupae, and her little face was full of distress: "The person who harvested the hive was really an idiot. Many pupae turned larvae have died. Oh, this really is Purple Crystal Spirit Bee, but there are only a few dozen surviving pupae left, what a pity!"
"Is it really a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee?" Wang Shouzhe’s face also became a bit peculiar, "Does this count as a stroke of luck?" His predecessor, as the Young Clan Leader, naturally had to learn a lot of knowledge. The Tiger-headed Spirit Bee was relatively common among Spirit Bees, and he was familiar with them.
However, he knew little about the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee, only that it was a rare species capable of reaching Tier Two Spirit Bee.
Gongsun Hui, on the side, was also surprised, covering her mouth and saying, "Zhe’Er, did you really buy this thinking it was a Tiger-headed Spirit Bee Hive? How much Qian Gold did you spend?"
"I was just wandering around the market and came across this hive. I thought of Fifth Sister’s potential as a Spirit Insect Master and bought it for her to play with..." Wang Shouzhe chuckled, "Bargained a bit and it cost ten Qian Gold. Looks like both that Loose Cultivator and I misjudged, hehe~"
"That wasn’t just a misjudgment; you both were blind." Gongsun Hui joked with a smile, "The Purple Crystal Spirit Bee among Tier Two Spirit Bees, once truly mature, produces Purple Crystal Spiritual Honey, which has effects in strengthening the foundation, nourishing the essence, enhancing beauty, and is a primary raw material in various Tier Two Spirit Pills. If it can produce [Purple Crystal Bee King Honey], it becomes a standard Tier Three Spiritual Material, one of the main spiritual materials in the famous Tier Three Spirit Pill [Spirit Awakening Pill]."
"Hiss~" Wang Shouzhe inhaled, "Spirit Awakening Pill, isn’t that the legendary Spirit Pill that can improve Black Tortoise Talent?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 23 Gongsun Family "Young Clan Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23 Gongsun Family "Young Clan Leader
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
The Spirit Awakening Pill can improve talent. It is said to be an elixir specifically developed by a certain Grandmaster of Alchemy to enhance human cultivation talent.
That Grandmaster of Alchemy spent his entire life researching and developing the [Spirit Awakening Pill], but the result was somewhat disappointing since the pill only provides slight improvements for those with lower-grade Black Tortoise talent.
Moreover, it only slightly enhances the Black Tortoise talent, not very significantly.
But even so, the Spirit Awakening Pill is already considered a very high-tier "Divine-Level Pill" for a ninth-grade lower-rank noble family like the Ping’an Wang Family.
Especially for someone like Wang Shouzhe, whose Black Tortoise talent is at the lower-grade A tier, it is extremely practical. It’s said that he is a young genius, just half a step behind Ancestor Longyan of his time, carrying the hope for the family’s future.
However, Wang Shouzhe knew very well that his talent was considered good within the scope of the Changning Guard, with hopes of breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm in the future. But looking at the entire Longzuo County, it was hardly worth mentioning, just barely meeting the admission requirements of the Purple Mansion Academy, and whether they accept him depends on subsequent tests.
Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe was considered outstanding even within the lower-grade A tier, just a step away from having middle-grade talent. If he had the opportunity to take the [Spirit Awakening Pill], there was a chance he could advance further and join the ranks of middle-grade talent, which would make a world of difference.
Ancestor Longyan, Wang Longyan, was genuinely of middle-grade talent.
With a population of hundreds of thousands in Changning Guard, the probability of someone with middle-grade talent appearing was very low. Once they appeared, even the Purple Mansion Academy would actively compete for them, and they would be a key target for cultivation once they entered the academy.
It’s just that the Spirit Awakening Pill is a tier three spirit pill, and its yield is very scarce. Even during the lifetime of Ancestor Zhou Xuan, there was no guarantee he could obtain a Spirit Awakening Pill.
Seeing the constant fluctuation in Wang Shouzhe’s gaze, Wang Luojing, standing to the side, said obediently, "Fourth Brother, I will definitely work hard to get the Spirit Awakening Pill for you."
"Luojing, you should not spoil your fourth brother too much." Gongsun Hui laughed, patting her head, "As for these Purple Crystal Spirit Bees, try to keep them alive if you can, but it’s not a big deal if you can’t. Cultivating a hive of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees from a handful of bee larvae is no easy task. If you fail, consider it gaining experience. Don’t put too much pressure on yourself."
"Aunt is right." Wang Shouzhe quickly added, "Luojing, I bought this beehive just for you to play with, so it’s okay if you waste it. Accumulating experience as a Spirit Insect Master isn’t something that happens overnight."
Wang Luojing was just 12 years old, the equivalent of a sixth grader on Earth. Wang Shouzhe really didn’t want to put too much pressure on her.
"I understand, Aunt, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing responded obediently, then held the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive and pondered over it intently, her gaze extremely focused and fascinated, like she had received her most beloved toy.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe remember that his fifth sister seemed different from ordinary people, having a natural obsession with insects. Even her older brother, Wang Shounuo, had said that Luojing could squat in the yard watching ants for days and nights at the age of two or three.
Oh well, let her tinker as she pleases.
Both Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui sensibly kept quiet, trying their best not to disturb her.
The carriage traveled along the official road, with no bumps, especially once they entered Shanyang Town, where the road was flat and smooth.
The Shanyang Gongsun Family had been operating in this region for over two hundred years, deeply rooted. With some special industries that required high-quality roads, they spent a lot of money on road maintenance every year.
The carriage traveled on flat, solid roads, and upon lifting the curtain, a distant mountain range with towering ridges came into view.
These were the ridges of the Liping Mountain Range, curving around the outskirts of Ping’an Town, piercing through Anjiang, and rising into a prominent mountain ridge.
This segment of the mountain, arched like a dragon’s spine, was even more steep and rugged than other parts of the Liping Mountain Range, hence the name Dragon Ridge Mountain.
The northwest side of Dragon Ridge Mountain is called Shanyin, while the southeast side is called Shanyang.
The Gongsun Family rules Shanyang, while the Liua Family dominates Shanyin.
Wang Shouzhe and his companions entered Shanyang via the Changning Ferry from the official road north of the river to purposely avoid the waters of Mountain Eagle Creek, which were controlled by another major family from Ping’an Town, the Zhao Family.
Upon entering Shanyang, in less than an hour, the sound of hooves filled the air as several riders quickly approached along the road.
Among the riders was Wang An, one of the Wang Family Generals. Wang An had been sent ahead as a messenger to inform the Shanyang Gongsun Family of their itinerary.
In front of Wang Shouzhe’s carriage, Household Generals Wang Wu and Wang Yong rode forward, maintaining a respectful distance between the approaching riders and the carriage.
This was the duty of the Household Generals, even if someone from their side was among the arriving riders.
"Wang Yong, quickly report to the Patriarch." The riders stopped and dismounted, with Wang An loudly announcing, "The Young Clan Leader of the Gongsun Family has personally come to greet the Patriarch and Lady Gongsun."
The voice was loud, and Wang Shouzhe could hear it from inside the carriage.
"It’s brother," said Gongsun Hui, who was normally composed and poised, but now wore a joyful expression like a little girl. However, realizing that there were two juniors, Wang Shouzhe and Wang Luojing, in the carriage, she quickly donned an elder’s demeanor, seriously saying, "Zhe’Er, Luojing, according to etiquette, we should disembark to meet your uncle."
Wang Shouzhe found it very rare to see his aunt display such a girlish demeanor, making him smile inwardly. He then realized that, despite her usual stern and dignified appearance, she was only thirty when she married Wang Dingyue as his second wife at nineteen and gave birth to his sister Luomiao at twenty-two.
If they were on Earth in big cities like Beijing, Shanghai, or Guangzhou, there would be many unmarried women at thirty, typically referring to themselves as girls.
But that’s beside the point.
The two followed Gongsun Hui out of the carriage as the Gongsun Family’s Young Clan Leader approached with two Household Generals.
Gongsun Qiang, the current eldest legitimate son of the Gongsun Family. He was fair-skinned and beardless, with a heroic appearance, and even more striking in his attire, but Wang Shouzhe knew that this Young Clan Leader "uncle" was already thirty-eight years old, with cultivation at the peak of the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
"Little Sister." Gongsun Qiang stepped forward quickly, smiling warmly, "You’ve finally made it back to your parents’ home, and you didn’t even notify your big brother in advance so I could meet you outside Shanyang."
Gongsun Hui was the youngest among her siblings and was often the most doted on, and Gongsun Qiang adored his little sister immensely.
"Brother." Gongsun Hui saluted him graciously and said with a dignified demeanor, "It’s my duty to visit father and brother, so I couldn’t trouble you to come greet me. Zhe’Er, quickly greet your uncle."
She gave Wang Shouzhe a nudge with her gaze.
Understanding, Wang Shouzhe immediately bowed and said, "Shouzhe greets you, uncle."
Gongsun Qiang glared at Wang Shouzhe for quite a while before finally squeezing out a sentence: "You’ve grown a lot, Shouzhe. You’re indeed a heroic talent, far surpassing your father."
Though he was Gongsun Hui’s elder brother, he didn’t hold a good impression of Wang Shouzhe’s father and was somewhat hostile.
The initial reason, of course, was that his beloved little sister ended up as a second wife to an older man, irking him quite a bit.
Later, due to several disagreements with Wang Dingyue’s personality, he simply ceased visiting the Wang Family.
This time, with Wang Dingyue’s passing, he, as a brother-in-law, didn’t pay a visit but instead sent his family’s elders and some direct family members to support them.
Hearing those words, Wang Shouzhe’s face darkened. Although he was a transmigrator, the memories of his predecessor had been integrated with him, so he was equally Wang Shouzhe.
Gongsun Qiang’s inappropriate remarks could not go without response.
"Brother, you mustn’t speak such nonsense." Gongsun Hui’s expression turned angry as she spoke sternly, "Apologize! Otherwise, I’ll immediately return to the Wang Family."
"Uh! Okay, it’s my fault."
Gongsun Qiang quickly chuckled awkwardly and apologized, then bowed slightly to Wang Shouzhe, saying, "Uncle also apologizes to you, hoping you wouldn’t take offense. I just don’t get along with your father, but thinking deeply, his talent and achievements far exceed mine."
His words were not wrong. At forty, Wang Dingyue had already reached the peak of the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm, qualifying to glimpse the Spirit Platform Realm.
As for Gongsun Qiang, reaching that level would still take time and effort.
Even though Gongsun Qiang was thirty-eight, the Young Clan Leader, after all, was just the Young Clan Leader, and his emotions were visible on his face.
But this straightforward character made him not a difficult person to deal with. This was Wang Shouzhe’s evaluation of Gongsun Qiang....

chapters.title: Chapter 24: The Child Follows the Mother
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24: The Child Follows the Mother
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
However, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t casually reveal such evaluations on the surface. Having mingled in workplaces on Earth, he may not be adept at human relations but is certainly competent.
"You’re too kind, uncle." Wang Shouzhe said with neither arrogance nor humility, "Relationships between people depend on fate. Aunt treats me as her own, bestowing upon me a debt as deep as a rebirth. To say nothing of you making a few jokes, even if you scold or beat me, I would harbor no resentment."
The words were spoken with a hidden sharpness, implying to Gongsun Qiang that his respect for him was solely because of his aunt’s kindness. Otherwise, Gongsun Qiang alone would not command such respect.
"Yes, yes. My little sister has been clever and virtuous since childhood, kind-hearted." Gongsun Qiang nodded repeatedly, praising Gongsun Hui offhandedly.
Wang Shouzhe was momentarily speechless. No wonder Elder Gongsun hadn’t stepped down despite his age; it seemed this Young Clan Leader was really not "polished" enough. No wonder he and his "late father" Wang Dingyue found each other disagreeable.
Gongsun Hui on the side couldn’t help but hold her forehead, her cheeks burning with embarrassment. Her elder brother was fine in all respects, except for a lack of emotional intelligence. Did it mean if she weren’t kind enough, she should ostracize or target the young legitimate son who wasn’t hers? What kind of a heartless and vicious person would that make her...
She quickly added, "Zhe’Er is my legitimate son, caring for and raising him is my rightful duty. Oh, brother, how is father’s health?"
Meanwhile, Gongsun Hui sighed inwardly. She hadn’t felt it before, but with Zhe’Er’s performance as he ascended to the position of Clan Leader...
And comparing to her elder brother at home, the gap seemed quite large. She began to worry about the Gongsun Family. Her brother had indeed wasted thirty-eight years eating for nothing.
"Father’s health is quite good." Gongsun Qiang also knew he had misspoken, so he laughed awkwardly twice before saying seriously, "It’s just that recently he’s been in a bad mood, losing appetite and constantly thinking about you. As soon as he heard you were coming back to visit, he urged me to come and fetch you immediately."
"Auntie, the wind outside is strong. It’s better to return to the carriage and hurry on our way." Wang Shouzhe bowed his hands in respect, "I suppose grandfather is already impatiently waiting. I’ll ride with uncle."
The black steed Wang Shouzhe had been riding earlier had been led by household generals and was now put to use.
"Alright, then Zhe’Er, have a good chat with uncle." Gongsun Hui gave a subtle glance and, having said that, led Wang Luojing back to the carriage together.
Wang Shouzhe naturally understood what Gongsun Hui meant. With the Wang Family in decline, they were entirely reliant on Ancestor Longyan’s intimidation and support. If they could strengthen their relationship with the Gongsun Family, it would be highly beneficial to the Wang Family.
Therefore, Wang Shouzhe rode a black horse, walking alongside Gongsun Qiang at the forefront of the group, engaging in casual conversation. His attitude towards Gongsun Qiang was courteous, based on Gongsun Hui’s affection, but he would not go out of his way to please the Gongsun Family without principles or limits.
In any world, whether in-laws or allies, relationships are built on common interest and equal power. The strong won’t respect you any more because of your subservience and flattery.
On the contrary, as Gongsun Qiang looked at Wang Shouzhe, he found this "cheap long nephew" to surpass his peers in both conversation and demeanor, and at such a young age, his cultivation was about to reach the High Tier of the Qi Refining Realm, with boundless future potential.
Such a young talent was unmatched in the entire Shanyang Gongsun Family.
Especially since Gongsun Qiang’s own son, Gongsun Yan, was only a year younger than Wang Shouzhe, and normally seemed fine. But in comparison, Gongsun Qiang became somewhat suffocated with a sense of stifling, and subconsciously felt closer to Wang Shouzhe: "Shouzhe, it’s rare for you to come to Shanyang. Stay a few more days this time, and I’ll have your cousin, Little Yan, accompany you to hunt in the mountains."
"Thank you for your kind offer, uncle." Wang Shouzhe bowed his hands, "But the clan’s affairs are busy, and as the clan leader, after meeting grandfather, I must leave first."
Hearing this, Gongsun Qiang’s heart felt even heavier, his chest tightening. Yes, this cheap nephew became clan leader at just eighteen. He was thirty-eight still only a Young Clan Leader, and even now, the old clan leader had no intention of retiring.
All the way back, Gongsun Qiang was stuffy in his heart, barely speaking a few words.
The main residence of the Shanyang Gongsun Family was built leaning against Dragon Ridge Mountain, steeply positioned, easy to defend and difficult to attack, surrounded by tall, hard walls and arrow towers, exuding an imposing aura.
This time, Wang Shouzhe accompanied as Gongsun Hui’s legitimate son, not visiting as a clan leader for mutual family interaction. Therefore, after a simple ceremonial exchange, he was invited into the main hall at the front.
In the main hall, the current Clan Leader of the Gongsun Family, Gongsun Mo, along with his wife, Gongsun Chen, were seated in the main position, both in formal attire, showing their attention to Gongsun Hui and Wang Shouzhe.
"Unfilial daughter greets father and mother." Gongsun Hui stepped forward to pay respects, tears rolling down her cheeks.
"Hui’er." Gongsun Chen stepped forward to help her daughter up, looking her over with excitement, "Child, you haven’t been back home in three years; are you living well in the Wang Family?"
"Mother, the Wang Family treats your daughter very well, it’s just that... just that Ding Yue..." At this point, Gongsun Hui began to tear up again, deeply saddened.
"Ah, that foolish boy Ding Yue really shouldn’t have recklessly ventured; couldn’t he just stay home with you..." Chen’s old face was both regretful and sorrowful, "Truly hard on our child."
"Alright, you old lady, stop blaming without understanding," Gongsun Mo said solemnly, "As Black Tortoise Practitioners, we should strive and improve. Ding Yue, as clan leader, must have had reasons he couldn’t avoid; he just had bad luck."
"I don’t understand? It’s all your fault, you old man," Gongsun Chen said, slightly agitated, "Saying that Ding Yue had outstanding talent and would reach Spirit Platform in the future, and actually agreeing to remarry our precious daughter to him! You..."
At this point, she seemed to remember that Wang Shouzhe was present, immediately held her tongue, and smiled kindly and warmly at Wang Shouzhe: "Shouzhe, dear, grandmother is just saddened by Ding Yue’s passing and a bit emotional. Ah, child, haven’t seen you for three years, and you’ve grown so heroic and handsome; come, let grandmother have a look."
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but smile inwardly. Now he understood the old saying that a son takes after his mother. Gongsun Qiang’s unguarded mouth likely came from Elder Lady Chen.
He wouldn’t quarrel with an elderly woman. He immediately stepped forward and bowed, "Shouzhe greets grandmother."
"Good, good, this child looks truly handsome." Gongsun Chen held onto Wang Shouzhe, and the more she looked, the more delighted she became. Curiously, she asked, "Shouzhe, are you betrothed? The girls of the Shanyang Gongsun Family are all lovely, do you want..."
Gongsun Hui’s face darkened, and she quickly stepped forward to stop her: "Mother, Shouzhe is my legitimate son and cannot marry a legitimate daughter of the Gongsun Family."
Noble Family intermarriages typically trace back four generations not to be the same person, with exceptions made occasionally for special circumstances.
Gongsun Hui, being Wang Shouzhe’s legitimate mother, though without blood ties, needed to be considered in line with tradition and rules, especially concerning contemporary marriages.
"Legitimate daughters are out, but there are some girls in the direct line..."
Before Gongsun Chen could finish, Gongsun Mo couldn’t help but roar, "Old woman, have you gone mad? Shouzhe is a legitimate son of the Wang Family and a clan leader; how can he marry a girl from direct descent!"
"You old thing, it’s you who’s mad. If there’s no suitable match in the Gongsun Family, then marry a girl from the Chen Family." Gongsun Chen asserted, "Our East Port Chen Family girls are also known for their inner wisdom and outward beauty."
"Mother, the East Port Chen Family also doesn’t have a suitable girl for Shouzhe." Gongsun Hui explained helplessly, "However, Luoyi was already promised to the Young Clan Leader of the Chen Family years ago. They were set to marry this year, but due to Ding Yue’s recent passing, they must wait a year in mourning before they can wed."
"Oh, is it my great-nephew Chen Fangjie?" Gongsun Chen’s face broke into a smile, "I’ve seen Fangjie before; he’s steady in character and quite talented. The Wang Family has good eyes. It’s just a pity for Shouzhe... I’ll ponder on it more..." She held a high status in the Chen Family.
"Mother, please don’t ponder any further." Gongsun Hui hurriedly stopped her matchmaking, "Shouzhe already has a betrothal, specifically to a legitimate daughter of the Shanyin Liu Family."
The Shanyin Liu Family?
Chen’s expression changed instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 25 Shanyang Small Spirit Species (Seeking PP)
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25 Shanyang Small Spirit Species (Seeking PP)
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"What’s so good about the Shanyin Liu Family?" Chen muttered incessantly, "Each one of them looks down on others, always scheming and plotting. If you ask me..."
The Shanyin Liu Family and the Shanyang Gongsun Family were separated only by a Dragon Ridge Mountain, abundant in resources and minerals, leading to frequent friction between the two families. Naturally, their relationship was not on friendly terms.
"Enough! Old lady, how dare you recklessly comment on the marriage alliance between the Wang Family and the Liu Family?" Gongsun Mo could no longer sit still, hurriedly standing up and shouting, "Gongsun Qiang, help your mother back to rest. I have something to discuss with Shouzhe."
Gongsun Qiang quickly assisted the old lady who was still mumbling as she walked, while Gongsun Hui said, "Zhe’er, have a good chat with your grandfather. I’ll go talk to Mother for a while."
Gongsun Hui had achieved her purpose of mediation today, and with her status, it was inappropriate for her to be involved in the conversation between Gongsun Mo and Wang Shouzhe. She then left, holding Wang Luojing’s little hand.
After everyone had left, Wang Shouzhe saluted Gongsun Mo and said, "Shouzhe greets Grandfather."
"No need for formalities, Zhe’er. Come, taste the spirit tea that your grandfather personally cultivated," Gongsun Mo had prepared for Wang Shouzhe’s visit and promptly ordered spirit tea and spirit fruit to be served.
Spirit tea and spirit fruit were luxuries within the Black Tortoise Clan, relying on spirit fields for cultivation. These fields were strategic resources for each family. Gongsun Mo cultivated a few acres of spirit fields, specifically to entertain distinguished guests.
As for the Ping’an Wang Family, they had only enough spirit fields left to grow White Jade Spirit Rice, insufficient for the clan’s consumption. Naturally, they wouldn’t use them to plant spirit tea and spirit fruit, which had poor economic returns.
"Thank you, Grandfather." With spirit tea and spirit fruit offered, Wang Shouzhe naturally didn’t hold back and began to enjoy them after sitting down.
Inside the tea cup carved from Spirit Jade, the tea was red and fragrant, its aroma refreshing, invigorating upon inhalation. Taking a sip, the slight bitterness filled his mouth, yet in the next moment, a sense of coolness surged through his head, making Wang Shouzhe feel clear-minded and dispelling any gloomy thoughts.
"Good tea." Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but praise, "This spirit tea is rich, aromatic, and leaves a lasting aftertaste. It helps calm the mind and clear away distractions."
"Haha, I didn’t expect Zhe’er to be someone who appreciates tea," Gongsun Mo felt gratified, realizing his gifts were appreciated, and proudly introduced, "This tea is called Shanyang Small Spirit Species. I unintentionally discovered its wild spirit tea seeds deep in Dragon Ridge Mountain during my youth. After decades of careful cultivation, now it can stably produce over a pound each year, even beloved by the two family ancestors. I’ll allocate you one liang each year."
When mentioning allocating a liang, Gongsun Mo’s mouth twitched slightly, clearly feeling some reluctance. Understandably so, for cultivating spirit tea was unlike White Jade Spirit Rice, not like the abundant tea seeds on Earth.
Typically, only a few spirit tea trees could be planted per acre of spirit field, requiring meticulous cultivation and maintenance. The processes of picking, rolling, and fermenting were also very particular.
Therefore, even a liang of spirit tea cost dearly.
"Thank you, Grandfather. Zhe’er humbly accepts." Wang Shouzhe knew Gongsun Mo intended to support him and naturally didn’t refuse.
Currently, in the Wang Family, only Wang Shouzhe was worth Gongsun Mo’s investment, just as Gongsun Mo had once married his daughter to Wang Dingyue as a second wife. If one day, Wang Shouzhe could advance to the Spirit Platform Realm, he would surely remember this kindness.
Moreover, Gongsun Mo and his wife were very fond of Gongsun Hui. And Wang Shouzhe, being Gongsun Hui’s legitimate son, was her future reliance within the Wang Family. So, in consideration of his daughter, Gongsun Mo would find ways to squeeze out resources to support his grandson Wang Shouzhe.
Of course, all this was built on Wang Shouzhe’s decent potential and his harmonious relationship with Gongsun Hui.
If Wang Shouzhe were an ungrateful person with no self-awareness, Gongsun Mo wouldn’t bother with him. If the Wang Family were to completely decline, at worst, he would bring his daughter and granddaughter back to the Gongsun Family.
After exchanging pleasantries, they finally got to the main topic.
After drinking a cup of tea, Gongsun Mo’s expression grew serious: "Zhe’er, after receiving your letter this morning, I initially had some doubts. But after personally inspecting the farm and consulting with the experienced farmers, I confirmed it. As you said, there is indeed a potential honey bee infestation, which could reduce the yield by over sixty percent compared to last year. Zhe’er, on behalf of the Gongsun Family..."
"Grandfather, there’s no need to speak as an outsider," Wang Shouzhe interrupted, "Even if I hadn’t issued a warning, with the speed of the honey bee outbreak these past few days, all families would inevitably notice it within a day or two."
Aphid symptoms weren’t obvious at first, as each year sees some reduction due to aphids. So initially, when aphids appeared, farmers would usually accept it as normal. But once they broke out, the aphid eggs buried in the soil would quickly hatch, catching everyone off guard.
"That’s not true," Gongsun Mo shook his head and said, "The Shanyang Gongsun Family itself has sixteen thousand acres of good fields. This season’s winter wheat harvest is calculated at fifteen Large Copper per acre, totaling two hundred forty thousand Large Copper, equivalent to two thousand four hundred Qian Gold. Now, it’s the early stage of the honey bee outbreak. Even reducing the loss by twenty percent would recover four to five hundred Qian Gold worth of loss. Moreover, I also followed your arrangement, sending clan members and household generals into the mountains to capture the Grasshopper King and the Nine-Star Insect."
Despite being the Insect King, Grasshopper and Nine-Star insects are, in the end, commonplace, not even tier one spiritual insects and generally ignored. In the deep mountains around Shanyang, some can still be found.
While they were speaking, a household general came to report, saying that the first batch of captured Grasshopper Kings and Nine-Star Insects had been delivered back.
"In that case, there’s no time to lose. Please have Grandfather dispatch trusted household generals to accompany us," Wang Shouzhe rose and said, "Disaster relief is as urgent as putting out a fire, leaving no room for delay."
Soon, a maid went to fetch Gongsun Hui and Wang Luojing, and together they rode horses to the largest farm of the Gongsun Family, a huge estate with seven thousand acres of good land.
This shows how the foundation of the Shanyang Gongsun Family far exceeded that of the Ping’an Wang Family.
The tenant farmers at the entire farm were in frantic motion, using traditional plant ash mixed with twice the dosage of insecticide powder in pest control. Such measures had a decent effect. With enough insecticide powder, they seemed able to curb the outbreak.
Unfortunately, the Gongsun Family had only stockpiled a limited amount of insecticide powder, proving inadequate to control the overall situation.
"Fourth Brother~" Wang Luojing spent over an hour taming three Grasshopper Kings and one Nine-Star Insect King, looking very tired. "Because time was too tight, I could only simply tame these Insect Kings to make them follow orders, so let’s have the household generals release the wild Grasshopper and Nine-Star insects."
"Luojing, you’ve worked hard," Wang Shouzhe said with concern, gently patting her head and handing her a spirit fruit he had conveniently brought, "Take this to energize yourself, disaster relief can’t be delayed."
"Don’t worry, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing nodded obediently. After eating the spirit fruit, she regained considerable strength. "As long as the Insect Kings are controlled, the Grasshopper and Nine-Star insects won’t run wild. But getting them to gather other insects on their own and then come back isn’t possible."
Subsequently, Wang Luojing clumsily imitated commands for the Insect Kings and insects to enter the thousands of acres of wheat fields. After the struggle, night had already fallen.
At this point, Gongsun Mo personally came to the scene, bringing with him cooks and a fair amount of spiritual food, preparing dinner on site. They cleared a room in this farmstead, with the Clan Leader, Young Clan Leader, and a clan member named Gongsun Zhong and his wife Wang Liuyu accompanying them.
Wang Liuyu was a member of the Wang Clan. By this time, she should be about forty years old, but due to good maintenance, she looked only slightly over thirty, and her attire and appearance suggested she was living well.
"Shouzhe greets Third Aunt and Third Uncle." Wang Shouzhe first saluted with a hand gesture.
"This, this, Shouzhe, no need for so much formality," Gongsun Zhong, who was rather dark and according to rumors, managed the mines of the Gongsun Family, held a significant position among the direct lineage clan members, but was quite simple, taciturn, and not adept at socializing.
Wang Liuyu also returned the salutation repeatedly, showing great respect for Wang Shouzhe. Although she was of an older generation than Wang Shouzhe, Wang Shouzhe was of the direct lineage and Clan Leader of the Wang Family.
Meanwhile, Wang Luojing leaped into Wang Liuyu’s embrace, sweetly calling out, "Aunt."
Compared to blood relations, Wang Liuyu was indeed the second daughter of the fourth old master Wang Xiaozhi, making her Wang Luojing’s true aunt, naturally leading to affection.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Dream of the Butterfly
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26: Dream of the Butterfly
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Wang Liuyu also embraced Wang Luojing with questions and concern, clearly feeling tender towards this well-behaved niece who lost her father at a young age, and specially gave her a gold note worth ten Qian Gold.
"Auntie, Jing’er cannot accept this. I heard that Cousin Zhuo is currently trying to reach the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm; you should save it for him," Wang Luojing waved her hand repeatedly, refusing to accept it no matter what.
The cultivation resources of young clan members usually come mainly from the family’s supply. In addition, closer blood relatives, such as parents, often try to support the younger generation.
However, Wang Luojing’s father Wang Dingbang died five years ago, so Luojing is at a disadvantage in this aspect.
"Jing’er, when Auntie gives it to you, just take it," Wang Liuyu said with slight annoyance, "Now that your father is gone, won’t I, as your biological aunt, help you out a bit?"
"Luojing, just accept it," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile from the side, "Don’t let down Third Aunt’s good intentions."
He certainly understood; this was after both Wang Luojing and Wang Shouzhe had shown great value. "Grandfather-in-law" Gongsun Mo specifically brought along Third Aunt and her husband to accompany them to further strengthen the closeness and play the family card.
Moreover, Wang Luojing is the future Spirit Insect Master, so when should they draw her in if not now? Wang Shouzhe naturally also welcomed the relationship between the two sides growing closer, as the Gongsun Family’s overall strength was much greater than that of the Ping’an Wang Family.
"Yes, Fourth Brother, thank you, Third Aunt," Wang Luojing obediently accepted it.
Afterwards, the two families sat down happily for a meal.
However, this time, the main focus was not on Wang Shouzhe, but Wang Luojing.
"Luojing," Gongsun Mo personally served her a bowl of White Jade Spirit Rice, adding a large piece of Spirit Horned Yak Meat and a large piece of Spirit Fish Flesh, "You worked too hard today, eat more, don’t be polite."
Wang Luojing felt a bit overwhelmed and weakly looked at Wang Shouzhe.
