The resources of any family are distributed in a unified manner, and as a girl from the main lineage of the family, her training position is not high, and the allotted spiritual food each month is very limited; where would she have such a luxurious way of eating?
She pursed her lips, wanting to eat, but didn’t dare to.
"Go ahead and eat it, don’t let down Grandfather’s intentions," Wang Shouzhe gently stroked her head, "In the future, your brother will work harder to try and ensure a good life for everyone in the family."
"Okay, thank you, Fourth Brother, thank you, Grandfather Gongsun," Wang Luojing obediently picked up her chopsticks and began to eat the White Jade Spirit Rice in big bites, her expression very satisfied.
Seeing how she ate so contentedly, Wang Shouzhe felt a mix of relief and the heavy pressure of being the head of the clan.
"Zhe’er, this time, it’s all thanks to you," Gongsun Mo poured spirit wine and said to Wang Shouzhe, "Our people have assessed that this time, because of your support, we will produce at most twenty percent less than last year, saving us over a thousand Qian Gold in losses."
A thousand Qian Gold is a huge sum for both the Gongsun Family and the Wang Family. What also caught Gongsun Mo’s attention was Wang Shouzhe’s goodwill signals towards the Gongsun Family.
It was precisely because of this that the Gongsun family brought out their utmost sincerity to host Wang Shouzhe and his group, with enough spirit wine and spiritual food. This feast alone must cost at least a dozen Qian Gold.
"Grandfather-in-law is being too polite," Wang Shouzhe took a sip of the spirit wine and said modestly, "Truth be told, our two families were just fortunate, as my younger sister accidentally learned some Insect Control Skill."
The Young Clan Leader Gongsun Qiang, sitting beside him, had a bright look in his eyes: "Speaking of which, Shouzhe, you’re very fortunate; just after becoming the Clan Leader, the family discovered a Spirit Insect Master. I wonder if Luojing is married? Should we consider our Xiao Yan?"
"What?"
Wang Luojing was eating rice and meat when she heard this, her eyes widening in surprise.
"Uncle, Luojing is only twelve," Wang Shouzhe’s tone revealed a hint of dissatisfaction, "Moreover, Cousin is from the direct lineage of the Gongsun family, and our Luojing is only from the main lineage, afraid that they do not match."
"It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter," Gongsun Qiang seemed to brush off Wang Shouzhe’s implied meanings, continuing, "With such a wonderful girl as Luojing, our family doesn’t care about her lineage."
Wang Shouzhe put his hand to his forehead, thinking, you might not mind, but we do.
Fortunately, Gongsun Hui stepped in to deflect the attention: "Brother, don’t be so optimistic. Our Luojing is a Spirit Insect Master with limitless future potential. Just her ability to control the Nine-Star Insect King makes her a prized asset for the entire Changning Guard. Since the Purple Mansion Academy’s Insecticide Powder had such a serious flaw, no family really wants to use it again, do they?"
After a pause, Gongsun Hui continued, "Just considering the Gongsun family’s 16,000 acres of fertile land, using pesticide once a season, twice a year, the annual consumption of Insecticide Powder costs over three hundred Qian Gold. If our Wang Family charged the Gongsun family just two hundred Qian Gold, having a Spirit Insect Master personally remove the insects, would this business not be worth doing?"
Gongsun Hui’s words seemed to awaken everyone.
Even Gongsun Mo involuntarily took a deep breath, looking at Wang Luojing with extraordinary seriousness, as if seeing a gold mine.
The earning potential of a Spirit Insect Master is indeed immense.
Regarding this business, Wang Shouzhe had actually already thought about it. However, relying solely on Luojing as a Spirit Insect Master, the number she could handle in a limited amount of time would inevitably be limited; even at best, she’d only be able to manage five to six thousand acres.
But even so, just by helping various families with pest control, they could earn at least seven or eight hundred Qian Gold a year, and that’s at a friendly discount price.
Let alone, Spirit Insect Masters excel at cultivating spiritual insects; among these insects, there are quite a few economical types, such as spiritual silkworms and spirit bees.
So, Grandmother Gongsun Hui spoke Wang Shouzhe’s intentions, Gongsun Qiang was being overly optimistic. Who would be willing to marry off such a precious asset?
"Shouzhe, you truly are blessed," Gongsun Qiang looked at Wang Shouzhe with eyes filled with envy and jealousy, wishing his clan could also have a Spirit Insect Master.
Unfortunately, Spirit Insect Masters are not easy to come by.
Firstly, the number of those with the Spirit Insect Master talent is extremely scarce; one must have the talent to communicate with insects, a very unusual gift.
Secondly, families generally do not have the means to inherit Spirit Insect Master skills, making it difficult to identify such talent among the clan members.
According to the information possessed by the Gongsun family, throughout the Changning Guard Region, there’s only a mere total of three Spirit Insect Masters. They belong to the Shanyin Liu Family, the Changning Xu Family, and the City Guard Mansion has a Spirit Insect Master as a tributor.
The Gongsun family had slightly more detailed information than the Wang family, due to Shanyang Gongsun’s greater strength within the Spirit Platform race.
Since both the Gongsun and Wang families had mutual goodwill intentions, this dinner truly felt harmonious.
The next day.
Revived and refreshed, Wang Luojing continued taming the newly captured Grasshopper King and Nine-Star Insect King. Having had multiple past experiences, Wang Luojing seemed to make significant progress, taming several Insect Kings in just half an hour.
By afternoon, she had already deployed the Insect Kings in two other farms, and next, the Gongsun family’s clansmen and household generals would continue capturing wild grasshoppers and nine-star insects to replenish the wheat fields.
With the Insect King leading the way, the wild grasshoppers and nine-star insects would not leave.
"Fourth Brother, the taming of those Insect Kings is too shallow," Wang Luojing said somewhat wearily after completing everything, "Within a few days, their wild nature will likely resurface, so in a few days, we’ll have to do this again. Fourth Brother, let’s head to the Yingxiu Lu Family next."
"Luojing, you seem a bit tired," Wang Shouzhe said with concern, "Why not rest for a night before going?"
"Fourth Brother, I’m fine," Wang Luojing shook her head and said, "The signs of a pest outbreak are becoming increasingly apparent. If we wait till tomorrow, the Lu Family will suffer significant losses. Fourth Brother, I understand the relationship with the Yingxiu Lu Family..."
Yes, the relationship.
In fact, purely from a blood relationship perspective, the connection between the Yingxiu Lu Family and Wang Shouzhe is extremely close. This is because his mother, who passed away early due to illness, was a lady of Yingxiu Lu Family and also the sister of the current Lu Family head, Lua Zhengxiong.
Moreover, Lua Zhengxiong’s legitimate wife came from the Wang Family’s sixth-generation main lineage, which means she was Wang Shouzhe’s own aunt, Wang Liuling.
This mutual marrying custom is frequently practiced among noble families. The mutual marriages between the main lineages elevate the intimacy between two families to the peak.
The only exception was that Wang Shouzhe’s biological mother, Lua Mengxue, passed away when he was six, leaving a young son and daughter. In Wang Shouzhe’s memory, memories of his mother remained the strongest, and recalling her remains quite painful nowadays.
Fortunately, his stepmother, Gongsun Hui, treated him extremely well from a young age, as if he were her own, gradually allowing him to accept his stepmother and heal a lot of the emotional scars.
As his memories and feelings became more intertwined, Wang Shouzhe felt himself increasingly merging into this world, as if he had grown up here, while the memories of Earth gradually seemed more like a dream realm.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 27 Family Tradition and Education (Thank you for your support)
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27 Family Tradition and Education (Thank you for your support)
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Then I’ll trouble Luojing." Wang Shouzhe didn’t want to delay any longer and let the Lua Family suffer a loss for nothing.
Moreover, the two uncles of the Lua Family treated him and his sister Wang Luoyi very well. Even if they could only meet once a year or two, the Lua Family would often send household generals to deliver gifts to Wang Shouzhe, Wang Luoyi, and even Gongsun Hui’s daughter Wang Luomiao.
"It’s no trouble, I’ve eaten well these past two days." Wang Luojing smiled lightly, "I have so much energy I can’t use it all." Saying this, she deliberately made a gesture indicating her strength.
"Alright, you skinny little yellow-haired girl, don’t show off in front of me. Let’s hurry up and start our journey." Wang Shouzhe felt a warmth in his heart and laughed, "Later, have a sip of spirit wine and get a good sleep on the carriage."
"Fourth brother, I’ll grow up, you know." Wang Luojing pouted with some displeasure, "Don’t underestimate Jing’Er, fourth brother."
"I don’t underestimate you, I wouldn’t dare." Wang Shouzhe helped her up onto the carriage, "My Luojing is going to be a Great Spirit Insect Master in the future. Maybe your fourth brother will depend on you for protection, how dare I underestimate you."
"That’s settled then. In the future, if anyone bullies fourth brother, I’ll send insects to bite them."
"Alright, alright, whatever you say. Now, go to sleep."
...
The carriage slowly traveled on the flat road.
Wang Shouzhe rode a black steed, escorting the carriage on both sides with several other household generals. There were mainly two routes to Yingxiu Lu Family, one passing through the sunny side of Dragon Ridge Mountain or detouring from the shady side.
Surely, it wasn’t feasible to go towards the Shanyin Liu Family side, so they naturally took the Shanyang route.
This was also one of the main reasons Wang Shouzhe prioritized assisting the Shanyang Gongsun Family in stabilizing the crisis.
Originally, Gongsun Qiang wanted to come along but was rejected by Wang Shouzhe. Firstly, he couldn’t really handle Gongsun Qiang’s low emotional intelligence, and secondly, the Gongsun Family was currently busy with disaster relief and already short on people.
Additionally, Gongsun Hui had voluntarily stayed in Shanyang for a while, saying it was just right to accompany her parents. In reality, she understood her own position and that going to the Lua Family wasn’t very appropriate.
The caravan continued to move forward, entering a dense forest where the road gradually became bumpy and uneven.
Wang Shouzhe frowned slightly, "Wang Zhong, this road isn’t easy to travel on. How much further to Yingxiu?"
"Patriarch, this forest is the border between Shanyang and Yingxiu, spanning a width of seven to eight miles." The household general Wang Zhong, familiar with the route, said, "Once we pass through the forest, we’ll reach the famous Yingxiu Lake. You haven’t been to Yingxiu for several years, and previously you always traveled through the main road on the Shanyin side, which might be why you’re unfamiliar with this one."
"Everyone, forests are usually more dangerous, so stay alert."
With his shout, all the household generals perked up, becoming even more vigilant.
"Wang Zhong, is there anything unusual about this forest?" Wang Shouzhe also became more cautious, "Could there be any rumors of fierce beasts?"
This world wasn’t a game world; if powerful fierce beasts appeared, they could result in casualties for the team.
"Patriarch, at such border places, the Black Tortoise Clans of Shanyang and Yingxiu would take turns patrolling. Any slightly dangerous wild beasts would be cleared out, let alone fierce beasts." Wang Zhong shook his head and said, "However, since we’re household generals escorting, we have regular training to be extra cautious in areas with poor visibility; it’s our duty to prevent any accidents."
The team continued to move uneventfully for a few more miles until they passed a small stream that flowed over the road.
Suddenly!
Wang Zhong’s expression changed, and he raised his hand to halt.
The coachman Wang Laoshu quickly stopped the carriage, and the other household generals drew their weapons with a clang, full of alertness.
Wang Zhong dismounted and walked over to the side of the road by the stream, picking up a small piece of cloth fragment. His face turned solemn as he spoke to the approaching Wang Shouzhe, "Patriarch, this piece of cloth was cut by a sharp blade and has some blood stains on it. There are also some uncleaned blood traces on the stones by the stream."
Indeed, something had happened.
Traveling in the wild, the last thing you want is to encounter unexpected situations. With a serious expression, Wang Shouzhe said, "Wang Zhong, give me your assessment."
"Judging by the fabric, this is fine-grained cotton dyed gray, which is relatively expensive. Ordinary tenant farmers, civilians, hunters, and the like are reluctant to buy such expensive clothes. Even if they gritted their teeth to buy it, it’s usually worn during festive occasions like New Year." Being a household general, Wang Zhong was trained by senior generals since childhood and is quite familiar with this area. "Therefore, this person is highly likely to be a Black Tortoise Practitioner whose status is relatively higher than a commoner. However, his status wouldn’t be too high; people with noble status like the Patriarch usually use even more expensive brocade fabrics."
"That would be household generals or ordinary clan members of the Black Tortoise Clan," Wang Shouzhe nodded, "Or perhaps some traveling merchants."
"Traveling merchants usually travel in groups," Wang Zhong shook his head, "Patriarch, look at these footprints, they should all belong to the same person, and they went deep into the dense forest, um, as if avoiding capture. Therefore, it’s highly likely this person is a fugitive loose cultivator or a traitor of some family. He must have heard our voices and couldn’t hide his tracks in time, so he hurried into the forest."
"Can we catch him?" Wang Shouzhe asked solemnly, "We came from the direction of Shanyang and haven’t heard of any fugitives or traitors, so this person is most likely coming from the direction of Yingxiu. Regardless of the situation, let’s catch him first before we speak."
"Rest assured, Patriarch." Wang Zhong’s eyes flashed coldly, "He’s already injured, and his hurried tracks are hard to conceal, I’ll take two brothers to retrieve him."
"Wang Yong, Wang Wu, you follow," Wang Shouzhe ordered, "Safety first, if it becomes too difficult, seek help immediately."
"Yes, Patriarch."
The three household generals took orders and acted. They slightly distanced themselves from each other and tracked down the footprints in a pinwheel formation. In less than the time it takes to burn a stick of incense, a mournful cry echoed from deep within the forest.
Soon, the three household generals of the Wang Family carried back a man who was tied up like a rice dumpling and returned to the carriage.
"Patriarch, mission accomplished without disgrace," Wang Zhong said, throwing the captive on the ground and cupping his hands, "This thief looks to be around the Fourth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. Judging by his appearance, he seems to be a loose cultivator."
"Mmm mmm, mmm mmm~" the man looked terrified, his mouth stuffed, his body bound, he could only struggle to catch Wang Shouzhe’s attention.
"Listen to what he has to say," Wang Shouzhe instructed.
"Yes, Patriarch," Wang Zhong removed the rag from his mouth.
"This young master, no, sir," the somewhat sleazy-looking middle-aged man immediately began begging for mercy, "I’m just passing through your esteemed land, not committing any offenses. Please, let me go. I still have some Qian Gold and a Profound Martial Technique on me, they can serve as my ransom."
"Whether you committed offenses, what you say doesn’t count," Wang Shouzhe gestured to Wang Zhong.
Wang Zhong quickly searched him; he had a total of 5 Qian Gold, 17 Large Copper, and 56 Coins. There was nothing valuable in his pack, just a worn-out Profound Martial Technique.
"Small Circulation Qi and Blood Transport Method."
Wang Shouzhe glanced at it with a frown. It was a common cultivation method. The Wang Race’s heritage collection has this, used to build a foundation for household servants and generals in early cultivation, and this technique clearly had several errors.
However, it generally matched the status of a destitute loose cultivator. Loose cultivators most focus on improving their cultivation, and whenever they get some money, they buy cultivation resources.
"How did you get injured?" Wang Shouzhe asked, noticing a deep knife wound on his shoulder.
"I encountered bandits," the loose cultivator said honestly, "I fled into the forest in panic and had just started to clean my wound when I ran into you, sir."
"Lies! This area is the border of the Shanyang Gongsun Family and the Yingxiu Lua Family’s influence. Which bandit would dare commit crimes here?" Wang Zhong scolded, "Confess the truth, or I’ll chop off your head."
"I’m wronged, sir, wronged," the loose cultivator screamed miserably, "Those bandits disguise themselves as traveling merchants, usually bullying passing loose cultivators. They wouldn’t dare to target noble families like yours."
"Sounds plausible," Wang Shouzhe remained unmoved, "Take him to Yingxiu and have the Lua investigate the situation. If what you say is true and you’re not a criminal, then everything will be returned to you, and you will be released."
Among the Black Tortoise Clans, every family has its code of conduct, not to mention he only has a few Qian Gold. Even if it were dozens or hundreds of Qian Gold, or more, Wang Shouzhe would not randomly rob or kill him for immediate benefits.
This is a matter of family conduct and education. Doing so would plant a significant hidden danger for the family’s moral conduct. How would those involved household generals and clan members think? Would it foster a mindset of bloodthirst and cruelty? Would their values become distorted?
Would they, when encountering similar situations next time, deem killing, silencing, and robbing justified actions?
A family or a power that acts lawlessly for the sake of interest might be rampant for a while but will never be arrogant for a lifetime.
Any Black Tortoise Clan capable of lasting a hundred years, or even several centuries to a thousand years, will undoubtedly have good family education and conduct, possess a high reputation, and clan members will necessarily adhere to strict behavior standards and principles.
But as Wang Shouzhe finished speaking, the loose cultivator’s face became ashen instantly, and he screamed in agony, "Sir, I was wrong, please don’t take me to Yingxiu. I beg you, I’ve hidden some items, if you let me go, they’re all yours."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 28 Yingxiu Lu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28 Yingxiu Lu Family
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
The reaction of this loose cultivator was indeed somewhat unexpected to Wang Shouzhe, and his face immediately turned gloomy: "It seems that you’ve committed quite a crime in Yingxiu."
"Sir, it’s my fault, I was greedy." The loose cultivator tearfully confessed, "We were a group of traveling merchants who passed by Yingxiu and saw that a wealthy family was getting married. Originally, we just planned to have a cup of wine and leave, but when we discovered their dowry was quite lavish, with over a hundred Qian Gold and two valuable Centennial Ginseng, we were tempted. That night, we snuck into that wealthy merchant’s house to steal..."
With the confession made, Wang Shouzhe’s face grew darker and darker. This group of loose cultivators were truly audacious. To not only steal but also resort to murder and plunder to silence witnesses.
Fortunately, those loose cultivators had internal conflicts due to greed, and ultimately this one laughed until the end. But he was unlucky, trying to treat his wounds in a sparsely populated forest, only to run into Wang Shouzhe’s group.
"Sir, if you swear to spare my life as a dog," the loose cultivator pleaded desperately, "I am willing to reveal the location of the hidden stolen goods and offer it all to you."
This loose cultivator seemed to know well the mannerisms of the Black Tortoise Clans. If Wang Shouzhe swore in front of his Household Generals, he would not break his oath.
Otherwise, if a dignified Patriarch could casually betray his word, how would the Household Generals feel? Could the Patriarch’s words be trusted in the future?
Wang Zhong and the other Household Generals also turned their attention to Wang Shouzhe, with some hope in their eyes. Those stolen goods were valuable, and acquiring them could alleviate the Wang Family’s financial woes.
Wang Shouzhe only pondered briefly before mounting his horse: "Take him and hand him over to the Yingxiu Lua Family for disposal."
"Yes, Patriarch." Wang Zhong only hesitated for a moment before faithfully carrying out his duty, gagging the loose cultivator and throwing him onto the horse despite his calls and struggles.
"Giddy up!"
The carriage driver Wang Laoshu cracked the whip, and the two tired horses slowly pulled the carriage along the rugged, muddy road.
After a small while, Wang Zhong rode up behind Wang Shouzhe and asked in a low voice, "Patriarch, are we really going to give up that stash of stolen goods? If you’re worried about dirtying your hands, let me handle it. Just give me some time, and I’ll ensure he reveals the hiding place."
"Our time is precious; we have no leisure to play a treasure-hunting game with a mere loose cultivator," Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "And Wang Zhong, as members of the Black Tortoise Clan, our vision must be long-term. There are no secrets forever kept; angering the Lua Family would cost us tenfold, a hundredfold of that stolen bounty! Most importantly, if we let greed blind us to steal those goods and release the main culprit, how can we face Ancestor Zhou Xuan, who established our clan with hard work? Or Ancestor Longyan who has defended the clan tirelessly for decades?"
This is a matter of family faith, and for most families, the greatest faith lies in their founding ancestors.
Wang Zhong’s body shook with shame, "I understand, Patriarch. I was blinded by greed."
"Human nature is greedy, yet controlling that greed is critical," Wang Shouzhe calmly responded, "Just like those loose cultivators who let greed drive them to crime, then couldn’t control it and turned on each other. With such lack of self-control, they might escape this time, but can they escape a second, a third time?"
"Patriarch, if those loose cultivators succeeded once and refrained from further crimes, wouldn’t they be fine?" Wang Yong approached on horseback and asked.
"There might be, but they are sure to be few." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "Imagine if they couldn’t resist the first temptation, especially after tasting the second temptation’s sweetness? Such greed is bound to lead to their ruin sooner or later. It’s not that I don’t want those stolen goods, it’s purely that I dare not take them, for fear that I won’t be able to control my greed eventually leading the clan to decline."
The Household Generals fell into thought, looking at Wang Shouzhe with eyes full of respect.
Wang Zhong remarked with emotion, "Patriarch, I have a feeling that our Ping’an Wang Family will surely rise under your leadership."
"Haha, though your flattery is clumsy, it does mean a lot to me as Clan Leader."
"Patriarch, I’m not flattering you, I truly believe this."
"Indeed, indeed, Patriarch, we all believe this." The other Household Generals chimed in with agreement.
Meanwhile.
Inside the carriage, Wang Luojing, who had long awakened and witnessed and heard everything, had eyes gleaming with enlightenment. Being with Fourth Brother always felt safe and secure.
For nothing else, even if just for Fourth Brother, Luojing, you must work hard to share the burden on his shoulders.
...
In less than half an hour.
Wang Shouzhe and his party emerged from the forest, arriving on a wide road.
The first thing that caught the eye was the vast and boundless Yingxiu Lake, with the towering Dragon Ridge Mountain reflecting on the water, turning the lake a deep green. The lake breeze, mixed with water vapor, blew over, bringing a chill in the early summer season.
On the wide lake surface, large fish occasionally leaped out, splashing water everywhere. Among the dense reed beds, various waterfowl were swimming.
Undoubtedly, not only is Yingxiu Lake picturesque, but its natural resources are also quite abundant. Compared to the ceaseless and majestic Anjiang, Yingxiu Lake is more resplendent and graceful.
At this moment, a group of riders galloped from afar and reined in their horses in front of Wang Shouzhe’s party.
"Whoa!"
The leader was a man in his early thirties, dressed in sturdy attire, carrying a strong bow on his back and a Treasure Saber at his waist, exuding an extraordinary aura. Upon seeing Wang Shouzhe, he was momentarily stunned, then burst out laughing, "Zhe’Er, it’s only been a few days, and you’ve become even more valiant. It seems that after becoming the clan leader, your demeanor has changed."
"Uncle, why did you trouble yourself to come in person?" Wang Shouzhe hurriedly cupped his fist.
This man was Lua Zhengjie, the blood brother of Wang Shouzhe’s biological mother, Lua Mengxue, and a pillar among the young and middle-aged generation of the Yingxiu Lu Family. Though just in his early thirties, he had already reached the eighth level of the Qi Refining Realm, with the potential to break through to the Spirit Platform Realm.
Some time ago, he had specifically traveled to Ping’an Town to attend Wang Dingyue’s funeral, so naturally, they had just parted not long ago.
"I wasn’t here just to welcome you," Lua Zhengjie’s cheerful expression grew stern, "Recently, a group of bandits disguised as traveling merchants wiped out a wealthy merchant’s family of seven. We’ve been tracking them and found they escaped towards Shanyang. I’m investigating this matter. Your visit to Yingxiu, I heard from the Household Generals, you can go see your uncle yourself. I don’t have time to accompany you back right now."
"What a coincidence." Wang Shouzhe laughed, "I just came from Shanyang, and on the way, I happened to capture a criminal. Initial interrogation suggests he’s from the same group you mentioned, Uncle."
"What?" Lua Zhengjie was slightly surprised.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe handed the criminal over to Lua Zhengjie and recounted the series of events: "I’ll leave the criminal to you, Uncle, but he’s hidden the stolen goods. I won’t interfere in this matter; have someone handle the interrogation."
"That makes things easier. Lua Yi, the rest is up to you. Try to recover the stolen goods and provide an explanation to the survivors of that merchant family." Lua Zhengjie instructed jubilantly.
The Black Tortoise Clan enjoys various privileges locally but also bears the responsibility to protect the civilians under their jurisdiction.
"Yes, Second Commander." A man with a somewhat sinister and fierce appearance stepped forward, let out a cruel sneer, "The audacity of this thief to commit crimes on our Lu Family’s territory! He’s going to regret falling into my hands; I’ll make sure he’s unable to live or die."
Such fierce words made Wang Shouzhe take an extra look at him.
"Lua Yi is quite adept at interrogation," Lua Zhengjie said with a smile, "You could have a Household General with some talent sent to learn a thing or two."
To this, Wang Shouzhe remained noncommittal.
As far as interrogation goes, Wang Shouzhe’s "knowledge" is quite extensive, exploring a wide variety of ancillary topics. After all, modern detective dramas, spy thrillers... have plenty of similar scenes, and the methods are fairly scientific.
No longer dwelling on this matter, as the task of capturing the fugitives was already complete, Lua Zhengjie personally led Wang Shouzhe back to the main residence of the Yingxiu Lu Family.
Compared to the Shanyang Gongsun Family’s main residence built halfway up the mountain, with a seemingly impregnable stance, the Yingxiu Lu Family’s main residence was built on a peninsula in Yingxiu Lake, surrounded by water on three sides and easy to defend.
By blood relation alone, Wang Shouzhe had deep ties with the Lu Family, and as such, he naturally received a high level of hospitality.
Before even entering the door, a girl in a red dress bolted out, throwing herself into Wang Shouzhe’s arms: "Cousin Shouzhe, Xiaoxiao missed you so much."
Lua Xiaoxiao!
The present Clan Leader Lua Zhengxiong had a daughter late in life, who was most cherished.
But before Wang Shouzhe had time to speak, Wang Luojing, who was hiding behind him, suddenly grabbed his hand, "Fourth Brother, Jing’Er feels a bit uncomfortable."
Uncomfortable?
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback, hurriedly grabbing her small hand with concern: "Luojing, where are you uncomfortable? Could it be from sleeping in the carriage..."
Halfway through his words, he noticed the two girls locked eyes, their mutual hostility unmasked, sparks flying.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 29 Ice Crystal Dew Drink
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29 Ice Crystal Dew Drink
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Who are you?" Lua Xiaoxiao, holding Wang Shouzhe’s arm, glared at Wang Luojing and said, "Let go of my cousin Shouzhe’s hand quickly, girls shouldn’t be so shameless."
In the Changning Guard Region, most of the noble families’ daughters didn’t follow any name generation order, it was more casual. The Ping’an Wang Family, however, had a long history, and Ancestor Zhou Xuan personally set the name generation order for the girls, which had continued on.
"I’m Fourth Brother’s sister, and he’s the most fond of me." Wang Luojing, not backing down at all, held onto Wang Shouzhe’s other side and mocked, "I think you’re the shameless one, throwing yourself into his arms at first sight."
"You’re lying, cousin Shouzhe dotes on me the most." Lua Xiaoxiao said angrily, "He brings me gifts every time he sees me."
"Fourth Brother treats me the best, he just gave me a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive as a gift to play with the day before yesterday, it’s worth over two hundred Qian Gold." Wang Luojing said proudly with her head held high.
"Cousin Shouzhe, I also want a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive." Lua Xiaoxiao felt overshadowed and started to whine to Wang Shouzhe. She was usually pampered and probably didn’t even know what a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee was.
"Uh..." Wang Shouzhe was somewhat speechless, why had the two little girls started fighting over him as soon as they met? Especially Luojing, who was actually a year younger than Lua Xiaoxiao, normally well-behaved, but now vying for favor.
"Shouzhe, did you really buy a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive for the child to play with?" Uncle Lua Zhengjie on the side was also very surprised, "That’s way too extravagant, let’s see how you get past your cousin now."
Two hundred Qian Gold was a huge sum of money whether for the Wang Family or the Lua Family. Like Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai’s Fishing Team, ten ships would go through wind and rain all year to earn about two hundred Qian Gold in profit.
The Fenggu Farm, being one of the pillars of the Wang Family, had two hundred tenant farmers and thousands of acres of farmland, even with such a scale, a year’s profit was only six or seven hundred Qian Gold, and that’s the book profit.
This time coming to the Lua Family, some gifts were prepared, but they were indeed just some small trinkets.
"Uncle, there’s more to this than meets the eye." Wang Shouzhe smiled wryly, "Why don’t you try to persuade cousin? Even if you sold me now, I couldn’t buy a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive."
"I don’t have the ability to persuade her." Lua Zhengjie quickly shook his head, "That girl is the most spoiled, even Ancestor dotes on her, big brother can’t do anything about her. Shouzhe, you’d better fend for yourself."
Even Ancestor dotes on her?
Wang Shouzhe was a bit confused, Ancestor Lua Mingsheng of the Lua Family, he’s from the direct lineage of the Mingsheng generation, already over a hundred years old, right? In terms of bloodline rank, he would be Wang Shouzhe’s great-grandfather.
The ancestors of the major Black Tortoise Clans rarely liked to show their faces. Normally they would be in seclusion, focusing on making further progress, only coming out for major events.
Wang Shouzhe, who was eighteen now, vaguely remembered that the number of times he had seen Ancestor Mingsheng was countable on one hand, and the only time he was summoned was when he was seven years old, tested to have good talent, and was called to be praised and given some resources by Ancestor Mingsheng.
You have to know, Wang Shouzhe’s talent was close to middle grade, yet he only received this kind of treatment. What merit or ability does the little girl Lua Xiaoxiao have to be doted on by the great-grandfather...
But things had come to this point, he couldn’t take out a gift worth two hundred Qian Gold, even if he could he wouldn’t be able to part with it, so he had to brush off Lua Xiaoxiao with a line: "Xiaoxiao, that hive was a bargain cousin stumbled upon..."
"Wow! Cousin Shouzhe doesn’t like me anymore, boo hoo, cousin is bullying me." Hearing she wouldn’t get one, Lua Xiaoxiao immediately felt overshadowed and ran into the room crying.
Meanwhile, Wang Luojing, holding Wang Shouzhe’s arm, wore an expression of triumph over the "bad person," causing Wang Shouzhe to roll his eyes, what a little girl, even jealous over this sort of thing.
But this kind of thing was just a minor episode, which Wang Shouzhe didn’t mind.
Then, under the guidance of Uncle Lua Zhengjie, Wang Shouzhe and Wang Luojing reached the main hall of the Lua’s residence.
At the same time, Clan Leader Lua Zhengxiong of the Lua Family, along with his legitimate wife from the Wang Family, were already waiting there in formal attire.
Lua Zhengxiong was already in his fifties, had a square face and sported three strands of beard, which gave him quite a dignified air.
And his legitimate wife from the Lua Wang Family, was actually Wang Shouzhe’s eldest aunt—Wang Liuling. Though she was already in her fifties in age, with good maintenance and attire, she sat there like a middle-aged beautiful woman.
"Shouzhe brings sister Wang Luojing from home, to see uncle and aunt." Wang Shouzhe stepped forward and bowed according to the etiquette of the younger generation meeting the elders. He had already sent his Household Generals ahead to report, this trip was to pay respects to the elders, not to meet as family clan leader.
"Shouzhe, please rise," Lua Zhengxiong stepped forward to support Wang Shouzhe, looking him up and down, "Haven’t seen you in some time, Shouzhe you’ve grown up so much."
"Zhe’er, Zhe’er," Wang Liuling also stepped forward to hold Wang Shouzhe’s hand affectionately, "You’ve just become clan leader, and you’re already running around so much, it must be hard for you."
Elder Aunt Wang Liuling had personally gone to Wang Family to mourn, having already cried for her younger brother’s death, and with the deceased gone, her concern now was more for her nephew Wang Shouzhe.
"Uncle, aunt, this isn’t really a hardship," Wang Shouzhe said, "Our Wang and Lua Families are blood connected, mutual assistance is a matter of course."
As Wang Shouzhe’s mother was a direct daughter of the Lua Family, he had a deep affection for the Lua Family since childhood. The exchange of direct descendants between the two families in the previous generation also brought their bloodlines exceedingly close.
After a brief exchange, Aunt Wang Liuling took Wang Luojing to the side to chat.
Meanwhile, Lua Zhengxiong sat with Wang Shouzhe on the opposite side to chat, but surprisingly he served not regular spirit tea, but Yingxiu Lu Family’s specialty Ice Crystal Dew Drink.
The Lua Family took advantage of the lake resources of Yingxiu. Not only did they have some achievements in aquatic farming, but they also cordoned off a "Spiritual Water" area, where a submerged spirit plant—Crystal Dew Grass—was specially grown. The Crystal Dew Grass bore a grape-sized spirit fruit, translucent like cicada wings, with juice that, once chilled, made a superb drink.
A sip down, a cool and clear sensation traveled from the throat to the stomach, then spread throughout the body, feeling as if one’s whole body was refreshed similar to the sensation after a Bone Marrow Purify and Fur Cutting process.
Speaking of which, this was Wang Shouzhe’s third time drinking Ice Crystal Dew Drink, as this was a scarce spiritual drink; just one cup could cost several Qian Gold. Even the direct lineage of the Lua Family rarely had the chance to taste it.
The Yingxiu Lu Family wasn’t a particularly strong family, with only one ancestor overseeing it. Yet their Ice Crystal Dew Drink was a significant specialty, primarily supplied to the Purple Mansion Academy, with limited portions shared among some strong families’ direct lineages.
Wang Shouzhe wasn’t sure of its yearly net earnings, but he estimated it wouldn’t be less than eight or nine hundred Qian Gold.
Besides Wang Shouzhe’s cup, Wang Luojing also received one. It was her first time tasting such a fine drink, her eyes went wide.
After the wonderful drink, there was a sumptuous spiritual food feast, leaving the Wang siblings invigorated.
Then naturally, they moved on to the main topic. Collaborating with Lua Family members, Wang Luojing participated in a pest extermination operation. The model was simple, directly borrowing the method from the Shanyang Gongsun Family. Moreover, with only six to seven thousand acres of land, the LUas’ fields were not too hard to handle.
Wang Shouzhe had originally intended to help, but before he could set out, he received a summons from Ancestor Mingsheng, summoning him for a meeting.
Causing Wang Shouzhe’s heart to be uncertain, could it be that Lua Xiaoxiao had run to Ancestor Mingsheng to falsely accuse him, causing Ancestor Mingsheng to have a problem with him?
However, this ridiculous thought just flashed by, as Ancestor Mingsheng was the stabilizing force of the Yingxiu Lua Family; how could he involve himself in the petty issues of youngsters?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 30 Ancestor Mingsheng (Requesting Recommendation Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30 Ancestor Mingsheng (Requesting Recommendation Votes)
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Very soon, Wang Shouzhe, under the guidance of the maid, arrived at the backyard of the Lua Family’s main residence, Ancestor Mingsheng’s secluded place for cultivation.
This area is near the shores of Yingxiu Lake, and the towering and majestic pavilion offers a view of half the lake. The lake breeze, sound of waves, jumping fish, and chirping birds all merge the building into nature.
Standing in front of the pavilion named "Yingxiu Rises with the Bright Moon," Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and said, "Wang Shouzhe of the Ping’an Wang Family requests to see Ancestor Mingsheng."
"Come in."
A gentle voice sounded directly in Wang Shouzhe’s ear.
Following the voice, Wang Shouzhe went up the solid wooden steps to the upper level of the pavilion. Outside the window, an elder in a grey robe sat with his back to Wang Shouzhe, seated in a Master’s chair, fishing with a long fishing line in Yingxiu Lake.
His posture was very casual, but to Wang Shouzhe’s eyes, he was utterly impenetrable, like a high and insurmountable mountain or a deep and unfathomable lake.
Beside him was a twelve or thirteen-year-old girl dressed in red, precisely Wang Shouzhe’s cousin Lua Xiaoxiao. She was glaring at Wang Shouzhe with puffed cheeks, evidently still angry.
"Grandpa Zeng, you see how annoying cousin Shouzhe is." Lua Xiaoxiao pouted, "Why does that Wang family sister have a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive, and I don’t?"
"Uh..." Wang Shouzhe rubbed his nose, feeling helpless. This little girl Xiaoxiao really came to the Ancestor to complain.
"Then tell me how I should teach your cousin a lesson? Last time, you said you liked cousin Shouzhe the most." The elder spoke faintly, "Don’t you like him now?"
"I do, but mother said the Wang Family is not doing well right now and lacks money everywhere." Lua Xiaoxiao tilted her head and said seriously, "I think cousin must be very short on money. How about Grandpa Zeng giving cousin five hundred Qian Gold Notes to buy a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive to give me? Then Xiaoxiao won’t be mad at cousin Shouzhe anymore."
"Why five hundred Qian Gold Notes?" the elder asked in surprise, "Grandpa Zeng remembers ordinary Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hives are only two or three hundred Qian Gold Notes. Could it be that prices have risen so much?"
"Cousin Shouzhe would find it hard to buy a hive too."
Pfft!
This statement almost made Wang Shouzhe spit blood. His cousin’s logic is indeed strong. To get a bee hive, she’s even trying to make Ancestor Mingsheng pay extra. This is unbearable for him, so he coughed twice and said, "Shouzhe greets Ancestor Mingsheng."
Unexpectedly, Ancestor Mingsheng didn’t acknowledge Wang Shouzhe at all but continued talking with Lua Xiaoxiao, "Then if your cousin buys you a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive, will you listen to Grandpa Zeng?"
"I will!" Lua Xiaoxiao nodded firmly.
Ancestor Mingsheng nodded slightly, turned to Wang Shouzhe with a smile, casually threw several gold notes towards him.
Wang Shouzhe hurriedly caught them and looked closely. Shockingly, they were five hundred Qian Gold Notes, instantly leaving him bewildered about what had just happened. Could it be...
"Shouzhe, did you hear?" Ancestor Mingsheng’s face, appearing only in his fifties, showed a hint of jest, "Later, buy a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive for your cousin Xiaoxiao, and the rest can be considered your running fee."
"Ancestor, this..." Wang Shouzhe said with a cold sweat, "This must not be done. If cousin Xiaoxiao truly likes the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive, I’ll find a way to buy one."
"Alright, now, don’t you know what state your Wang Family is in?" Ancestor Mingsheng impatiently waved his hand, "Take these Qian Gold Notes first, prepare more cultivation resources, and discuss the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive when you have the means."
Wang Shouzhe felt a slight warmth in his heart, cupped his hands and said, "Thank you Ancestor for your support." It seemed Ancestor Mingsheng intended to support his great-grandson, so he naturally wasn’t too polite and took the money.
"Thank your cousin Xiaoxiao." Ancestor Mingsheng said with a smile, "If I hadn’t been unable to resist her pestering, I wouldn’t have given these Qian Gold Notes. For the Lua Family, five hundred Qian Gold Notes isn’t a small sum; after various huge expenses, even in a year, they might not save this amount."
"Thank you, cousin Xiaoxiao." Wang Shouzhe also cupped his hands and said.
"Humph." Lua Xiaoxiao turned her head, giving a cute hum, seemingly unwilling to speak to him.
"Xiaoxiao, you must strive hard and don’t let that Spirit Insect Master girl surpass you." Ancestor Mingsheng "instigated" her, "If you successfully learn the Array Master way and become a Tier One Array Master, I guarantee your cousin Shouzhe will admire you."
"Array Master?"
Wang Shouzhe was startled and asked, "Ancestor, could it be that cousin Xiaoxiao has talent for learning arrays?"
"What, the Wang Family producing a Spirit Insect Master is allowed, but not our Lua Family having an Array Master?" Ancestor Mingsheng said with a half-smile.
Wang Shouzhe had a cold sweat on his forehead: "Ancestor, I don’t mean that. I’m just a bit surprised. Congratulations to Ancestor, congratulations to cousin Xiaoxiao."
In his heart, he sighed, thinking that talent can indeed be unpredictable. He vaguely remembered that Lua Xiaoxiao was terrible at learning the "Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art," yet she had talent in arrays...
"Grandpa Zeng, from today onwards, I’ll definitely work hard and not be lazy anymore." Lua Xiaoxiao obediently said, "When I become a Tier One Array Master, I will infuriate that Spirit Insect Master girl and make sure cousin Shouzhe won’t look down on me."
"That’s the spirit; it suits my granddaughter Lua Mingsheng. Come, let’s build a good foundation first, and Grandpa Zeng will take you to become an apprentice." Ancestor Mingsheng was amiable to Lua Xiaoxiao but casually waved to Wang Shouzhe, "Shouzhe, go about your business."
Isn’t this being treated like a tool?
Wang Shouzhe felt speechless silently but was willing to be a tool if it yielded five hundred Qian Gold Notes each time. Besides, the fact that Lua Xiaoxiao has talent in arrays is excellent news since she is his dual-blood cousin, and their blood relations are very close.
Seeing Ancestor Mingsheng was rare, Wang Shouzhe didn’t want to waste this opportunity easily, immediately cupping his hands and asking, "Ancestor, I have several obscure points in my cultivation and hope you can guide me."
"You brat, don’t push it." Ancestor Mingsheng huffed and stared, "Your Ancestor Longyan is knowledgeable. Do you still need my guidance?"
"Seeking a second opinion." Wang Shouzhe said with a foolish grin, "Having multiple verifications is advantageous for my path on the Spirit Platform. I see the environment here is excellent, cultivation must progress rapidly..."
He presented an attitude suggesting that if Ancestor Mingsheng didn’t guide him, he wouldn’t leave; as a junior, showing slight insolence to a great-grandfather is entirely acceptable.
"Alright, alright, ask your questions quickly, and leave once done without disturbing my cultivation." Ancestor Mingsheng said helplessly.
Wang Shouzhe promptly threw out the prepared questions one by one.
In dealing with the cultivation questions raised by Wang Shouzhe, Ancestor Mingsheng was certainly not perfunctory, thought each through before answering. Unexpectedly, as the questions progressed, Wang Shouzhe’s questions became more tricky, even requiring careful pondering for Ancestor Mingsheng to answer.
The pre-crossing Wang Shouzhe was introverted, focused solely on self-cultivation, sometimes holding many questions without daring to consult Ancestor Longyan. But the Wang Shouzhe now was entirely different; influenced by modern Earth thinking, he accumulated a lot of cultivation questions from various angles.
This highlights one difference between Noble Family Descendants and Loose Cultivators: having family elders to resolve doubts and give guidance.
"You brat, that’s enough; Ancestor also needs to cultivate." After over two hours, even Ancestor Mingsheng felt overwhelmed. Where did this brat find so many strange questions? Continuing would surely lead to unanswerable queries.
If unfamiliar issues arise, he cannot just make things up; potential problems could harm juniors?
Cannot endure it any longer!
Lua Xiaoxiao initially pretended to listen, but as the questioning proceeded, she became more baffled and bored, eventually dozing off beside him.
"Thank you, Ancestor, for resolving my doubts; I am truly enlightened." Wang Shouzhe saw the time was right, stood up, and cupped his hands, "I wish Ancestor early Profound Skill success, ascending to Celestial Human."
These words made Ancestor Mingsheng quite happy. Although he was still trudging towards the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, every cultivator reaching Spirit Platform Realm aspired to advance further.
It’s known that those below Spirit Platform Realm are all mortals, with a lifespan hardly exceeding a century. Upon reaching Spirit Platform Realm, lifespan doubles, reaching a maximum of two hundred years. This is why the Spirit Platform Realm is referred to as an Ancestor: as they live longer, they’ll eventually see their descendants pass away before them, one by one.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 31 "Beekeeping Manual
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31 "Beekeeping Manual
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Especially some Spirit Platform Realm ancestors who know how to maintain health can live to nearly two hundred years. In such cases, they can often witness the birth of their eighth or even ninth generation descendants.
If one can further progress to the Celestial Human Realm, the lifespan can reach up to four hundred years. The entire family would rise along with this, and it could even be described as a situation where everything prospers together.
Thus, Ancestor Mingsheng, in a cheerful mood, pulled out an ancient beast-skin book and tossed it to Wang Shouzhe: "This is the ’Beekeeping Manual.’ Consider it a congratulatory gift for your Wang Family for producing a Spirit Insect Master. It is a note from a loose cultivator of the Spirit Platform Realm, who specialized in controlling Spirit Bee Types, from hundreds of years ago. It records some techniques and key points for nurturing various Spirit Bees. But this is only a copied version, and there are inevitable omissions, so use it as a reference."
Wang Shouzhe was momentarily stunned, then overjoyed and said, "Thank you, Ancestor, for the timely help."
Currently, Luojing has the talent of a Spirit Insect Master, but relying only on the family’s ’Insect Scripture’ is obviously insufficient.
This ’Beekeeping Manual’ undoubtedly focuses on the Spirit Bee section, which would greatly benefit Luojing, who possesses the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee Hive.
"Now that you’ve taken the gift, hurry and get out of here, don’t be a nuisance to this old man," Ancestor Mingsheng impatiently drove him away.
"I bid farewell, farewell." Having gained so much, Wang Shouzhe quickly tucked the ’Beekeeping Manual’ into his arms and left the pavilion of [Yingxiu Rises with the Bright Moon] respectfully.
Ancestor Mingsheng watched Wang Shouzhe’s distant figure with both joy and a hint of loss. The joy was that this descendant, who carries his bloodline, is quite outstanding and has great potential. The loss was that, among the two generations of young men in the Lua Family, none could compare to Shouzhe.
Luckily, there is still Xiaoxiao.
Ancestor Mingsheng lovingly stroked the head of Lua Xiaoxiao, who had already fallen asleep: "This child has awakened the Li Fire Separation Body of our Lua Family’s ancestors. Although a bit diluted, it’s still extraordinary, truly a blessing for our Yingxiu Lua Family."
Every inheritance of the Black Tortoise Clan is not simple. Every ancestor who opened up territories and established a clan was a peerless genius.
...
Having received many benefits and bade farewell to Ancestor Mingsheng, Wang Shouzhe was led by a maid to the guest room—Elegant Guest Residence. This is where the Lua Family hosts distinguished guests. The entire lakeside courtyard is his lodging, with several surrounding side rooms for the accompanying household generals.
The household generals from the Wang Family and Wang Luojing went to help with disaster relief. Wang Shouzhe, finding the rare peace, instructed a Lua Family maid to prepare a bath, soaking comfortably to wash away the fatigue of recent days.
He then ordered not to be disturbed and entered cultivation mode. Both the Shanyang Gongsun Family and the Yingxiu Lua Family served the best spiritual food to entertain Wang Shouzhe and his party, which he had not yet had time to thoroughly digest.
Moreover, he had just consulted Ancestor Mingsheng on many cultivation issues today, which truly enlightened him and brought sudden realization. After entering meditation, he quickly reached a state of cultivation.
He cultivated all the way until the next morning. His inner meridians and acupoints became fatigued, and much of his abundant energy and blood were consumed, but his eyes were filled with brilliance, showing considerable progress, taking a firm step forward toward the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
This delighted Wang Shouzhe greatly. Combining some modern Earth thinking with Ancestor Mingsheng’s guidance, he gained a much clearer understanding of the path of the Qi Refining Realm.
Upon exiting the room, Wang Zhong was already waiting outside, cupping his hands in respect: "Patriarch, your uncle is visiting and, upon hearing you were in closed-door cultivation, did not dare disturb you and is waiting in the lounge."
Wang Shouzhe had Wang Zhong lead the way to the lounge, casually asking, "How was the disaster relief yesterday?"
"Everything went smoothly. The Lua Family prepared a lot upon receiving our letter in advance." Wang Zhong marveled, "Miss Luojing is truly remarkable; in a short time, she managed to control several Nine-Star Insect Kings, suppressing the signs of the insect disaster outbreak."
When Wang Zhong mentioned Luojing’s name, it was clear that his tone carried genuine respect, indicating that Luojing’s performance had earned the deep admiration of the household generals.
Luojing indeed seems to have a natural talent for the path of the Spirit Insect Master, showing progress in a short amount of time.
Thinking this over, Wang Shouzhe entered the lounge of the Elegant Guest Residence, cupping his hands to Lu Zhengjie, "Shouzhe came late, please forgive me, Uncle."
"No worries, no worries." Lu Zhengjie stood up with a cheerful smile, "Shouzhe, our Lua Family greatly benefited from your support this time; the insect disaster was curtailed just as it began to unfold."
If food production plummeted, it would not only be an economic loss but would also trigger a series of chain reactions.
Daqian is based on the Black Tortoise Clan, which enjoys various privileges but must also shoulder the responsibility of protecting the land and the people. The balance of rights and responsibilities obviously exceeds that of rural gentries in ancient Earth.
"Uncle, you are too kind. It is only natural for the Wang and Lua Families to support and assist each other as we share a bloodline." Wang Shouzhe replied modestly with a smile.
After a brief exchange, Lu Zhengjie continued, "The case of the exterminated wealthy merchant family also has a result. That loose cultivator was not much of a hard case; after just two hours of interrogation, he confessed, and all the hidden loot was found. He will be publicly executed soon to serve as a warning to others."
"The wandering of loose cultivators always poses a hidden risk." Wang Shouzhe frowned, "If we can’t control the loose cultivators entering the territory, similar cases will eventually happen."
"This matter is extremely difficult; most loose cultivators wander back and forth under the guise of traveling merchants. Daqian Law does not prohibit loose cultivators from wandering about." Lu Zhengjie frowned, then changed the subject, "By the way, your achievements in this quickly solved case mean the Guardian’s Mansion has decided to award you fifty Qian Gold. Although it isn’t a huge amount, it’s the largest we could obtain."
"Thank you, Uncle, for your mediation." Wang Shouzhe was quite satisfied with the outcome. Fifty Qian Gold is no small sum; some loose cultivators would risk their lives just for that.
After receiving the reward, Wang Shouzhe proposed to leave first.
He left behind two household generals to assist Wang Luojing and entrusted uncle to help protect her in combating the disaster. The insect disaster plaguing the Lua, Gongsun, and Wang Families had only been initially contained; the taming of those wild Insect Kings was insufficient and required further reinforcement. Over the next ten days or so, she would need to travel back and forth between the Lua, Gongsun, and Wang Families.
Concluding his thoughts, Wang Shouzhe entered the lounge at Elegant Guest Residence and bowed to Lua Zhengjie, "Sorry for being late, Uncle."
"No need to apologize, Shouzhe," Lu Zhengjie said with a wide smile, standing up. "It’s thanks to your assistance that our Lua Family was so effectively aided when the insect disaster occurred."
If the food production were to drastically decrease, it would mean much more than just an economic loss.
The power and responsibility of noble families in Daqian are much greater than those of rural gentry, with an obligation to protect the land and the people.
"Maintaining mutual support between the Wang and Lua Families is only right and proper," Wang Shouzhe replied modestly.
After some brief courtesies, Lu Zhengjie added, "It was entirely thanks to your efforts that the case of the exterminated merchant family was swiftly resolved. The Guardian’s Mansion has decided to reward you with fifty Qian Gold for your meritorious service. Although it may not be much, it is the largest reward we have."
Wang Shouzhe was quite satisfied with the result. "Thank you, Uncle, for facilitating this."
After some pleasantries, Wang Shouzhe took his leave of Ancestor Mingsheng and handed over the Beekeeping Manual to Wang Luojing.
With Little Xiaoxiao and the Household Generals who came with him, Wang Shouzhe rode on a magnificent black horse and returned to the Changning Guard. Travel was quick without the burden of goods, and the group reached Changning Guard in just a few hours.
Upon his arrival at Wang’s Villa, Steward Qian had already arrived and was complaining bitterly as soon as he saw Wang Shouzhe, even before the refreshments were served in the lounge.
"Junior Brother Wang," Steward Qian bemoaned without caring about the burning tea, "this time you’ve put us in a tough spot, cleaning out our Insecticide Powder inventory. Was that really necessary?"
"Brother Qian, let’s not play coy and speak frankly," Wang Shouzhe smiled. "You know I’m doing Qiaan’s Trading Company a favor by helping clear out your Insecticide Powder stockpile. Surely you don’t think there’s anything wrong with that?"
"Information advantage, information advantage." Steward Qian mumbled a couple of times, then sighed helplessly, "Junior Brother, I admit, it’s a valid point. But you didn’t put out a single coin and you’re about to make a huge profit out of it."
"Don’t worry, Brother Qian, I have mentioned before that I would give you a great credit, right? I assure you, it’s an opportunity that won’t just redeem your reputation but might even help you advance further," Wang Shouzhe said, completely unfazed.
"Really?" Steward Qian looked at him in disbelief.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Secret Covenant
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: Secret Covenant
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
He stared at Wang Shouzhe for quite a while before speaking, "Younger brother, are you trying to trick me or set me up again? I’ve already reached this point... is there still a chance for me to redeem myself?"
"The cause of the insect plague, the reason why the Insecticide Powder is gradually losing its effectiveness, along with the research directions for the new Insecticide Powder..." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "If these are not enough for Brother Qian to make a comeback, then it’s my mistake in underestimating Brother Qian’s abilities."
"Is this true?" Steward Qiaan suddenly stood up, a powerful aura of a peak Qi Refining Realm Ninth Layer exploded, with a gleam in his eyes, he said, "If there’s indeed such great merit, younger brother Shouzhe, you are truly my brother, Qiaan Xue’an."
What a powerful aura!
Even Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised. This Steward Qiaan, who had always been low-key, actually had such high cultivation. Truly worthy of the Longzuo Qian Family, even a small steward in a branch could have such cultivation.
A glimpse of a part reveals the whole, how strong the Longzuo Qian Family truly is.
"Is Steward Qiaan aiming to use this great merit as an opportunity to strive for the Spirit Platform Realm?" Wang Shouzhe squinted slightly, knowing that the other was not releasing his aura frivolously. It was a way to show Wang Shouzhe the value and potential of Qiaan Xue’an.
"Younger brother understands me." After "displaying" his strength, Qiaan Xue’an immediately reverted to his harmless Maitreya Buddha-like demeanor and said, "To be honest, younger brother, I am an illegitimate child of a direct line in the Qiaan Family. My status and treatment in the family can be imagined, and how difficult my path to this day has been. Without exceptional merit, it’s extremely unlikely to gain family support to strive for the Spirit Platform Realm. If younger brother aids me in this, I’ll be eternally grateful regardless of the outcome."
"Does Brother Qian know why I don’t contribute this merit to the Purple Mansion Academy myself?" Wang Shouzhe smiled, as if testing Qiaan Xue’an’s intelligence.
"The matter of the Insecticide Powder is significant, and your Ping’an Wang Family is too weak." Qiaan Xue’an also smiled, "Even if you contribute your research findings to the Academy, with the high and mighty attitude of the people there, they might not even feel grateful towards your Wang Family. But our Longzuo Qian Family is different. With this information, we have the qualification to negotiate with the Academy, even if we could secure an extra ten percent share in the future profits of the new Insecticide Powder, it would be a colossal amount! Thus, younger brother choosing to give this great merit to me is... what’s the phrase younger brother used?"
"Maximizing benefits." Wang Shouzhe sipped his tea and replied.
"Yes, that’s the phrase." Qiaan Xue’an replied earnestly, "But this matter has a condition, that is, I must show gratitude and reciprocate towards younger brother Shouzhe. We can sign a secret alliance for this. If I violate the alliance, younger brother is free to make the alliance public, leading to my utter disgrace. You know, our Qiaan Family values reputation, and a personal disgrace leads to severe consequences."
This Steward Qiaan is indeed a clear-minded friend.
Wang Shouzhe was somewhat relieved; nowadays, the biggest fear is to offer goodwill to a blind person, or to find out later that the one you supported is ungrateful.
Based on his interactions with Qiaan Xue’an, he realized this is a meticulous person, otherwise, with his illegitimate direct line status, how could he have reached this far?
"Brother Qian, if we sign the secret alliance, we’ll be in the same boat. Are you sure about this?" Wang Shouzhe finally asked.
Qiaan Xue’an pondered slightly, "If it were any other ally, I would certainly need to consider it carefully." He paused, then looked at Wang Shouzhe seriously, "But forming a secret alliance with younger brother Shouzhe is something I desire. Your detailed mind and bold strategies, flipping fortunes with a wave of hand, are what I deeply admire. I firmly believe that standing on the same side with you, younger brother, is my lifelong fortune."
Although the words were a bit exaggerated, Wang Shouzhe could feel his genuine intention, so he promptly decided to draft the secret alliance.
In line with the idea of addressing potential issues upfront, Wang Shouzhe drafted alliance terms that were meticulous and devoid of any apparent loopholes, clearly outlining mutual responsibilities and obligations.
When Qiaan Xue’an finished reading the alliance, he was stunned on the spot, not because the terms were too complex or harsh, but because they were too simple and fair. In his view, his future either ends bleakly or soars dramatically, all depending on Wang Shouzhe.
Even if the conditions were harsher, it would be normal, as he had already prepared himself mentally.
"Younger brother Shouzhe, this alliance..." Qiaan Xue’an frowned slightly, "Should there be more restrictive terms for me?"
"Brother Qian, I’m looking for allies, not collecting subordinates." Wang Shouzhe said leisurely, sipping his tea, "Since we are allies, we should naturally uphold the principles of fairness, justice, mutual respect, and assistance. If one day, brother feels the alliance is meaningless, you can refer to the last clause, compensate your ally with ten thousand Qian Gold, and the alliance is void."
Qiaan Xue’an took a deep breath, signed and stamped the two copies of the contract, then respectfully bowed, "Younger brother Shouzhe, your broad-mindedness is unparalleled in my lifetime. I swear, as long as you do not betray me, I will not betray you, or let the heavens strike me down with lightning."
"Brother, no need for such heavy words. From now on, we are brothers, sharing both glory and loss." Wang Shouzhe was very satisfied with this outcome, putting away the contract, he handed the prepared documents to Qiaan Xue’an, "How to operate forward, I’m sure you understand better than I do."
Qiaan Xue’an focused on the documents, the more he read, the more his expression turned marvelous, "Unbelievable, unbelievable, yet perfectly reasonable. Younger brother Shouzhe, this data is extremely valuable, preventing future ineffectiveness of new Insecticide Powders."
This document was written by Wang Shouzhe himself, using simple and clear language to explain the resistance of the Honey Bees. To eliminate the current resistant Honey Bees, the ancient Insecticide Powder must be adjusted.
As for how to adjust and experiment, Wang Shouzhe gave no suggestions, leaving the Purple Mansion Academy to explore.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe never intended to develop new Insecticide Powders himself, as the stakes involved were too high. This is like levying an insect tax on all fertile lands in Longzuo County; the astronomical interests were enough to crush the Wang Family.
"Good, good, good, with this great merit." Qiaan Xue’an’s eyes shone brightly, "If I, Qiaan, still can’t handle it, truly I’ve lived thirty-eight years in vain."
He solemnly kept the contract, then smiled and said to Wang Shouzhe, "Younger brother Shouzhe, I must admit, without this great merit, I would really resent you. But now, hehe, I can only say, younger brother, well played."
"Just following the momentum." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "How much is your shopkeeper planning to pay to redeem the contract this time?"
"Initially, the shopkeeper’s bottom line was double the contract price. Although ideally, you would back off after taking a thousand Qian Gold." Qiaan Xue’an squinted his eyes, "However, this insect plague is quite severe, estimated to reduce yields by sixty to seventy percent without effective measures, translating to a loss of about ten Large Copper per mu. If a double-dose of Insecticide Powder is used in time, the loss is at most one or two Large Copper."
"According to brother, the noble families’ psychological bottom line for investment in Insecticide Powder is around six Large Copper per mu?" Wang Shouzhe had already calculated and smiled, "Then if Qiaan’s Trading Company repurchases the contract at double price, not only won’t they lose, they will earn?"
"Wrong." Qiaan Xue’an squinted and smiled, "The noble families’ psychological bottom line is at least twelve Large Copper investment, possibly more. They even need to beseech our Qiaan Family to sell to them because the Insecticide Powder supply is far from enough to save all noble families."
"Rather than losing more, they’d choose not to invest, letting grain yield decrease." Wang Shouzhe frowned, slightly puzzled.
"Younger brother should know, Daqian Law prohibits speculative trading of grain prices in good harvest or disaster years, which superficially looks like an excellent policy to stabilize people." Qiaan Xue’an said with a knowing smile, "In disaster years, it actually causes much harm. Merchants won’t act without profit, and if grain prices don’t rise, how many would be willing to sell? Many commoners won’t be able to buy food even if they have money."
"Most noble families have enough stored grain to manage during disasters, but certainly, a significant portion of the commoners will struggle to buy food even with money, as supplies can’t cover everything."
