chapters.title: Chapter 35: Establishing Transportation Lines
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: Establishing Transportation Lines
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Shouzhe, where on earth did you manage to get fifty to sixty thousand dan of grain?" Gongsun Qiang took a deep breath and almost couldn’t believe it.
The Shanyang Gongsun Family is quite powerful, owning about ten to twenty thousand acres of fertile land. But even so, the yield of a season can’t reach fifty to sixty thousand dan! Moreover, the noble family’s land produce must be shared with tenant farmers, taxed annually per acre, and some must be reserved for grain seeds, insecticide powder, and other consumables.
From this, it’s evident how astronomical fifty to sixty thousand dan of grain is. Even in normal circumstances, acquiring that much grain at once is extremely difficult, let alone in today’s world.
"Bought it through connections with friends from the Qiaan’s Trading Company," Wang Shouzhe said, "Uncle, time waits for no one. Let’s head to Money Manor first, and the carriages will follow."
The Gongsun Family’s carriages were specially reinforced to transport minerals. The horses pulling the carriages were stout and full of endurance, Northern heavy draft horses, with four to five horses per carriage, capable of pulling thousands or even tens of thousands of pounds.
Bought it through friends?
Gongsun Qiang’s eyelid twitched violently, thinking, where do you find such friends, can I have a dozen of them? Filled with envy, jealousy, and a bit of disbelief, he first followed Wang Shouzhe to Money Manor.
Money Manor is one of Qiaan’s assets, used to stockpile various bulk goods. Many bulk items number tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of dan, and it’s unnecessary to transport them into Changning Guard City.
As for fears of attack or robbery, that’s just a joke.
Not to mention the formidable armed forces within Money Manor, the prestigious Qiaan Family of Longzhou alone is enough to deter any evil thoughts.
After seeking an audience at the Money Manor gate, Steward Qiaan Xue’an came out after a short while, wearing a face of displeasure towards Wang Shouzhe.
Afterward, he represented the Qiaan Family in making an exchange, both parties drafted a new contract, with Qiaan Family "repurchasing" the insecticide powder from Wang Shouzhe in the contract.
The price was very reasonable: ten thousand Qian Gold in cash and sixty thousand dan of aged grain in stock. With the repurchase of the original five thousand bags of insecticide powder, Qiaan Family could at least sell it for fifteen to twenty thousand Qian Gold, naturally ensuring no loss.
Regarding such "embarrassing" matters, the shopkeeper of Qiaan’s Changning Branch didn’t even want to appear, delegating everything to Qiaan Xue’an. The shopkeeper who hadn’t shown up evidently planned to shift all the blame for the errors onto Steward Qiaan Xue’an.
That’s why Qiaan Xue’an’s face darkened during the process of assisting Wang Shouzhe with the procedures, unwilling to utter a single word from start to finish.
After everything was settled, he threw a large stack of gold notes and a route permit for sixty thousand dan of grain at Wang Shouzhe and left in a huff.
Such a genuine display of acting left Wang Shouzhe astonished, making him sigh; once Qiaan Xue’an successfully ascends to the Spirit Platform Realm, he will surely become a remarkable figure.
Once the procedures were completed, Wang Shouzhe located Gongsun Qiang, who was waiting outside: "Uncle, the procedures for receiving sixty thousand dan of aged grain are complete. Once your people arrive, we can start transporting the grain."
Gongsun Qiang trembled with astonishment, mouth agape, it was real; he actually "bought" a full sixty thousand dan of grain, his nephew is truly incredible.
Soon, Gongsun Qiang’s convoy of twenty carriages approached, accompanied by eighty sturdy mining slaves.
In the mountain-like granary, aged grain is packed in rice bags, with each bag weighing exactly one hundred pounds, equaling one dan. But those mining slaves easily carried three or four bags to load onto the carriage.
"Uncle, how much can one carriage hold?" Wang Shouzhe, having lived two lifetimes, had never seen so much grain. Even though he had some mental preparation, the volume and quantity still far exceeded his imagination.
"Load it up, just load it up to a hundred dan, our carriages are specially reinforced. These Northern heavy draft horses can handle it," Gongsun Qiang’s eyes reddened, never having seen so much grain in his life.
For a powerful family like the Shanyang Gongsun Family, stockpiling twenty thousand dan of grain is sufficient, enough to feed thousands of strong laborers for a year. The tenant farmers, miners, and mining slaves of the Shanyang Gongsun Family, combined with the family members, don’t exceed thousands of people.
A hundred dan? That’s over ten thousand pounds of grain...
Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised; indeed, this is a mystical world, where not only ordinary people’s physical strength is much greater, but even the strength of these Northern heavy draft horses is impressive. Not to mention, these aren’t even Spirit Beast-level warhorses, otherwise, they’d be even stronger.
Those mining slaves were obviously used to heavy work, with every four people assigned one carriage. It only took six to seven trips to load up the carriages. Each special mineral transport carriage was overloaded with grain.
Even so, it was only two thousand dan.
At this pace, it’ll take about thirty trips, won’t it? Never mind, just take it slow, there’s no hope of transporting all this grain in a short time anyway.
Fortunately at this time, Qiaan Xue’an reappeared, still with a stern face, saying: "Our Qiaan’s Trading Company values its reputation above all else, we won’t let our clients suffer. You can rent our heavy-duty freight carriages, including the drivers, for twenty Large Coppers a day, which includes provisions for both drivers and heavy draft horses. Loading and unloading are up to you."
Clearly, Qiaan Xue’an risked it to provide support.
But on the side, Uncle Gongsun Qiang almost spat out old blood; although the price was fair, it undermined his hard work, didn’t it?
Originally, Gongsun Qiang planned to ask thick-skinned for some of the grain his nephew acquired as a favor for helping.
"Thank you, Steward Qiaan," Wang Shouzhe said happily, "Then let’s rent another thirty carriages."
The number of carriages owned by Qiaan’s Trading Company far exceeded that of the Gongsun Family. Additionally, their business operations spanned Longzhou, and the freight capacity of their carriages was, of course, extremely high, not inferior to Gongsun Family’s carriages in any way.
When all fifty carriages were fully loaded, they set off from Money Manor.
Money Manor is only ten li from the Changning Ferry, under normal circumstances, a carriage can reach there in less than an hour. However, given the numerous eyes at Changning Ferry, Wang Shouzhe didn’t want to make a spectacle and attract unnecessary trouble.
After passing the fork in the road, the carriage took the road towards Shanyang; two or three li later, it turned towards Anjiang, reaching the edge of a dense forest. From there, the carriage could no longer proceed. However, through the dense forest, after walking a hundred or so steps, there was a vertical cliff five or six zhang high, with a natural bay two to three zhang wide at the bottom.
At this time, uncle Wang Dinghai, having received a letter from the household generals, was already waiting there with the fleet and had set up a makeshift inclined walkway. The fleet comprised fishing boats and ferryboats, assembling all the usable boats from home.
Though transporting like this was laborious, it was highly concealed.
The route from the carriage, through the forest, to the cliff and onto the boats, required approximately two hundred and fifty steps. Wang Shouzhe positioned the mining slaves and household generals at intervals of three steps, employing a relay method to transport the grain.
Once everyone adjusted to the setup, they discovered the advantages of this simple human transport line: stable, orderly, and gradually increasing in efficiency. The speed of loading the boats ultimately reached one dan every one or two breaths, greatly saving time and effort in round trips.
In just over an hour, they miraculously loaded and unloaded all the grain from fifty carriages. Afterward, the cart convoy returned to Money Manor for the next batch, while Wang Shouzhe followed the fleet across Anjiang to the Fenggu Gate.
Fenggu Farm had more people — as many as two hundred tenant farmer households, providing a hundred and fifty robust laborers with ease. Using the same method, the rice grain was transported through the Fenggu Gate and temporarily stored in Fenggu Farm.
The inland river’s boat resources were insufficient, with only five or six boats available, necessitating slow transport at this final stage.
The successful establishment of a difficult transport line allowed Wang Shouzhe to relax, but also made him acutely aware of his family’s transport shortcomings.
First and foremost, there was an excessive reliance on public docks and a lack of privately developed concealed small docks.
Secondly, there was inconvenience in routing from Anjiang to the inland river due to differing water levels on both sides. The use of a single gate could not remain open for long, risking inner flooding, a problem that needed remedying through the construction of navigable locks.
Moreover, the family had apparent shortcomings in both boat and cart transport. Perhaps, given the current scale of the Wang Family, these were not very evident, but as the family continued to grow and prosper, these weaknesses would severely hinder its development.
It seems the establishment of their own comprehensive transportation channels is an urgent necessity.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 36: The Cohesion of the Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: The Cohesion of the Family
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
However, this kind of project is systematic and grand. It cannot be completed overnight, and no matter how anxious one might be, it can’t be rushed. Wang Shouzhe simply boarded the slightly larger boat on the inner river, standing on the high pile of rice bags, and followed the waterway of Fenggu Farm back to the Wang Family’s Main Residence.
The boats on the inner river are very small, and this largest one is only about six zhang long. It reaches its limit merely by carrying four or five hundred dan of grain, with a carrying capacity far less than river boats. Furthermore, it does not use sail power but relies solely on the boatmen paddling and poling.
Fortunately, the water flow on the inner river is stable. With the combined effort of paddling and poling, the boat can barely move, yet it took more than an hour to traverse the winding twenty-li river channel. Comparing with Earth’s speed, it is only equivalent to more than two kilometers per hour.
The fleet passed through the river mouth and entered Zhuwai Lake.
On the relatively narrow Zhuwai Lake, one can already see the architectural group of the Wang Family’s Main Residence under the steep mountain walls. However, Wang Shouzhe didn’t hurriedly return but continued to observe the terrain of Zhuwai Lake on the boat.
"She" is slightly oval-shaped, about six or seven li long and more than four or five li wide, with a total water area already exceeding ten thousand mu. The lake surface is clean and magnificent, surrounded entirely by mudflats and reed marshes, imparting a primitive beauty to the scenery.
Perhaps the "natives" would feel it is desolate, but to Wang Shouzhe, who is used to big cities and constant human presence, this primitive landscape makes him feel exceptionally comfortable, even improving his state of mind considerably.
If such a large expanse of water is used to breed spirit fish, it would be excellent, Wang Shouzhe pondered quietly.
However, Zhuwai Lake has a significant disadvantage: the lake water is too shallow, generally less than one zhang deep, and there’s too much silt accumulated at the bottom. No chance of breeding spirit fish, even raising ordinary large fish species would find the water level too low.
Besides, in this mystical world, large-scale fish farming is not mainstream. At most, some small fish are caught and thrown into ponds to grow freely.
The reason for this is twofold: firstly, there are many fish in the wild, and even with simple fishing techniques, one can still reap good hauls by going out to fish. Secondly, due to limitations in fishing technology, investing money and manpower in fish farming in wide lakes is also very challenging to harvest, better to wild fish in resource-rich Anjiang.
Take Uncle Wang Dinghai, for example, it takes two months for twenty weavers to barely weave a small trawl net... The difficulty of a large-scale encircling net in a big lake is imaginable.
The greatest difficulty in fish farming lies in managing water quality, density, diseases, scientific feeding, and other technical aspects. A slight mishap in these might lead to mass fish death, causing a total loss.
Yet, this world is vast, with countless Black Tortoise Clans, naturally, some families have already achieved results in the fish farming industry. Like Yingxiu Lu Family, they have already mastered some fish farming technology and developed the industry.
However, the Black Tortoise clans always value production technology, keeping it secret very well. Even in some key industries, family women are not allowed to participate, fearing they might spread the technology upon marriage.
Even with Wang Shouzhe’s relationship with the Lua Family, obtaining their fish farming technology is still impossible.
The isolationism in clan technology has similarly resulted in the backward overall production technology in the Black Tortoise World. Even though Earth’s patent strategy was criticized extensively, it actually triggered a technological storm, where myriad technological inventions blossomed in a short time.
Though that’s the case, Wang Shouzhe thinks it’s better for the Black Tortoise World not to bloom profusely; his greatest advantage now is his "wide experience" and "foresight" beyond this world.
He generally knows many technologies but vaguely knows they exist and their general direction. For instance, the famous monosodium glutamate, an amazing product that changed the human taste system.
Ask Wang Shouzhe to create it, and he couldn’t even do it in ten or eight years.
But if a group of smart people is found to specialize in studying this aspect, engage in similar research, because of the clear direction, with good luck, it might take twenty or thirty years to create.
Even with bad luck, as long as the related technology accumulates continuously, surely in a hundred years it can be done, right?
There are also spinning or weaving devices, like the renowned transmigrator’s must-have — [Jenny Loom], even if Wang Shouzhe is beaten to death, he couldn’t draw a blueprint, but he knows it exists and vaguely understands some principles, find a group of craftsmen to work on it slowly, sooner or later something might be tinkered out.
If this thing is created, it would be far more powerful than Wang Luojing the [Spirit Insect Master].
Of course, these are just concepts for now. Before the clan has adequate strength to sustain, introducing these things would be pure suicidal. Not mentioning others, but the Changning Xu Family, whose primary operation is the textile industry, would turn against the Wang Family in an instant, because the [Jenny Loom] surely touches the Xu Family’s survival base.
Let’s put aside the idle talk.
Wang Shouzhe and his fleet gradually increased their speed in Zhuwai Lake, arriving at the rear dock of Wang Family’s Main Residence less than half an hour later.
This dock and waterway, although seldom used, are often traveled by several farms to carry grains and produce to the family, mostly via this waterway. Although slower by water, the capacity is large, and fewer carts are required; raising horses is more expensive than raising people.
In the rarely visited rear dock of Wang Family’s Main Residence, it was bustling with people at this moment, led by two women. One of whom was precisely Wang Shouzhe’s eldest aunt, Gongsun Hui, while not far behind her stood a young woman Wang Luotong.
Behind them were four Household Generals, three of whom are female Household Generals. It is worth noting that now in the Wang Family’s nine Household Generals, three are female.
When the ship was about to dock, with still seven or eight zhang distance from the pier, Wang Shouzhe lightly tapped with his foot, his body soaring in the air, swooping to the dock like a large bird, landing steadily on the pier within just two breaths.
This was Wang Shouzhe’s current leaping ability, thoroughly crushing Earth’s long jump and high jump champions, yet it wasn’t the realm of some high-martial fantasy where one could soar the sky or shatter mountains with a punch.
"Aunt, why have you returned? Shouldn’t you accompany our grandfather more at your family?" Wang Shouzhe greeted Gongsun Hui with a gesture.
"Earlier, you wrote a letter asking my brother Gongsun Qiang to handle matters for you, I asked Wang Zhong roughly, knowing the main residence also needed someone to assist you." Gongsun Hui said, "Though not knowing the specifics, I thought it better to return to the family soon to help. Prior, you mentioned preparing the rear warehouse, currently it’s only partially done."
"Then thank you, Aunt, the partial preparation is enough for now." Wang Shouzhe gestured profusely, his heart warmed and moved, Aunt Gongsun Hui truly considers the Wang Family wholeheartedly, assisting him diligently in steering the family.
"Fourth Brother." Wang Luotong saluted Wang Shouzhe, a slight spark flickering in her eyes. Earlier, Fourth Brother entrusted some tasks to her through letters.
What does that mean? It signifies Fourth Brother’s esteem for her. She, too, wants to contribute to the family like her sister Wang Luojing, to aid Fourth Brother.
"Thank you for your hard work, Luotong, Ah, did you just break through to Qi Refining Realm Third Layer?" Wang Shouzhe’s eyes slightly narrowed, under Qi Observation Technique, Wang Luotong’s aura was significantly stronger than before, with signs of uncontrollable aura overflow, "Congratulations, congratulations."
"I still have to thank Fourth Brother." Wang Luotong’s cheeks were slightly red with happiness, "If not for the Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill sent from the family treasury as per your order, I couldn’t have broken through so quickly."
"It was also your effort, having honed at Qi Refining Realm Second Layer Peak for a while." Wang Shouzhe praised, "Continue to strive, be a role model for our younger siblings and future generations."
Having understood her situation beforehand, naturally, he wouldn’t watch her slowly hone at Qi Refining Realm Second Layer Peak, thus he allocated a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill from the family treasury for her before departing.
She indeed proved herself, breaking through immediately. At least far surpassing that little brat Wang Zongwei, The twenty-year-old is still dawdling at Qi Refining Realm Second Layer High Stage.
"Hmm, Hmm, Fourth Brother, Luotong will certainly do her best." Wang Luotong joyfully nodded repeatedly. For her, earning Fourth Brother’s recognition is an exceptionally happy matter.
As people conversed, the grain transport ship had already started docking.
Eldest Aunt Gongsun Hui directed the Household Generals and servants, together transporting the grain to the vacated rooms. Even Wang Luotong joined in, taking charge of the main transport efforts alongside several female Household Generals.
She was already at Qi Refining Realm Third Layer, her physical strength and power far exceeded that of ordinary household servants and slaves, carrying four or five bags of rice at once while briskly moving. Eldest Aunt Gongsun Hui initially wanted to stop her but was signaled by Wang Shouzhe to let Luotong contribute.
Moreover, even when the family’s Lu generation Fourth Miss was involved in transporting grain, drenched in fragrant sweat, household soldiers and servants worked even harder, not daring to slack, showing high morale.
The family’s cohesion and centripetal force are built bit by bit in such moments.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Heart-to-Heart Between Mother and Child
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37: Heart-to-Heart Between Mother and Child
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Of course, Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui should not randomly get involved, or else they would bring not a boost to morale, but anxiety and unease among the household soldiers and servants.
The entire transportation route has already been initially established, so Wang Shouzhe no longer participates in it. Such a massive grain transport operation is not something that can be accomplished in a short time.
This is not some game world where you can complete the grain transport task with a few quick mouse clicks.
Moreover, as the head of his family, he should naturally focus on the big picture and not get bogged down in minor details. If he were to personally get involved in every matter from start to finish, what’s the point of having clan members and household generals?
Even his aunt Gongsun Hui was called along with him. The last segment of the transportation line was fully entrusted to Wang Luotong to oversee, as the young women in the family should also take responsibility.
While chatting with Gongsun Hui, they strolled through the vast rear garden and into the backyard of the Wang Family’s Main Residence, eventually making their way to the Young Clan Leader’s courtyard where he grew up.
His close servant Wang Gui was overseeing two household servants in maintaining the courtyard. Upon seeing Wang Shouzhe and Gongsun Hui, he immediately approached to pay his respects: "Greetings, Patriarch, Lady."
Wang Gui was an attendant to Wang Shouzhe, having a clear family background, originally being a descendant of a collateral branch of the Wang Family. Most importantly, he was a young man with a Lower Grade C talent among the collateral branch descendants.
Though he was just a servant, having served the Young Clan Leader from a young age, he was destined to become a trusted confidant to Wang Shouzhe. Once he married and established himself, producing offspring with notable talent could lead to being included in the family’s Direct Vein sequence, with his name entering the clan genealogy.
"Wang Gui, make a pot of Shanyang Small Spirit Species tea for me and my aunt." Wang Shouzhe handed the spirit tea brought with him to Wang Gui.
"Spirit tea?" Wang Gui was slightly taken aback, having served Wang Shouzhe for ten years but had only seen spirit tea twice.
"Zhe’er, you mustn’t. This spirit tea was given to you by your grandfather for your personal use," Gongsun Hui immediately refused, "These are crucial growth years for you, and you need to quickly reach the Eighth Layer, or even the Ninth Layer, of the Qi Refining Realm to match your clan leader status!"
"Aunt, please don’t decline. Weren’t you curious about the source of this batch of old grain? Let’s drink some spirit tea, and I’ll tell you slowly." Wang Shouzhe invited firmly and rebuked Wang Gui, "What are you standing there for? Go make the tea."
"Yes, yes." Wang Gui, suddenly spirited, quickly retreated.
With Wang Shouzhe so resolute, Gongsun Hui found it hard to refuse. They sat across each other at a square table in the side hall of the courtyard. Before long, Wang Gui brought over a pot of spirit tea and some nuts, fruits, and preserved snacks, before bowing and departing.
"Zhe’er, this courtyard no longer fits your status as a clan leader." Gongsun Hui looked around and said, "After I finish the mourning period in the main estate for a year, I’ll move out to make room for you, making it convenient for you to marry Miss Liua."
"Aunt, there’s no need for that." Wang Shouzhe laughed nonchalantly, pouring each of them a cup of tea, "This courtyard is quite good, and I’m used to living here. You and sister Luomiao just stay comfortably and don’t worry about moving."
"How can that be considered unnecessary trouble? You are now the head of the family and should live in the main residence." Gongsun Hui said, "Furthermore, while you might be accustomed to it here, Miss Liua might not be. Once she enters the Wang Family, I’ll have to hand over this account and finance management to her, as per the noble family rules."
Wang Shouzhe shook his head and said: "When Miss Liua marries into the family, she is your daughter-in-law; how can she overstep her bounds like that? Let’s not talk about this now; aunt, have some tea first. Let me slowly recount the gains of this trip; there are many things I need to discuss with you."
To Wang Shouzhe, Aunt Gongsun Hui was mature and composed, and due to her status, her prestige in the family was extremely high. Even the prestige of several clan elders couldn’t compare to hers.
If merely constant cultivation could rejuvenate the family, he wouldn’t mind doing so. However, his vision and goals already far surpassed what those elders and family members could match. As a young clan leader, if he wanted to make substantial improvements in the family, he was bound to encounter resistance from the conservatives.
And Aunt Gongsun Hui should be his most formidable and steadfast ally. After all, she was the legitimate daughter of the Shanyang Gongsun Family!
Gongsun Hui took a sip of spirit tea, her eyes filled with curiosity as the legitimate son of the family, since taking charge, had become increasingly sophisticated, to the extent that even she couldn’t comprehend many of his methods.
Pausing for a moment, Wang Shouzhe eloquently recounted how he managed to acquire substantial funds and grain from Qiaan’s Trading Company. Of course, he concealed his secret alliance with Qiaan Xue’an.
Gongsun Hui’s mouth gradually opened wide, and her eyes widened. This, this was simply unbelievable and audacious. By relying on some foresight about the insect disaster outbreak, he decisively acted and manipulated the Qiaan Family as if playing with them.
Such an operation was beyond Gongsun Hui’s wildest imagination. Moreover, it gave her quite a scare, as Shouzhe had staked the family reputation on securing 4,200 Qian Gold! If his prediction failed, he could have become the first squanderer in the Ping’an Wang Family’s history!
Even though this matter had succeeded, Gongsun Hui’s mind was still agitated and unsettled. Bold, truly bold!
"Aunt, please don’t blame Zhe’er for not consulting you beforehand. This matter had a fleeting opportunity and couldn’t afford the family to deliberate slowly," Wang Shouzhe calmly said while sipping tea, "These funds can be injected into the family accounts, but to the internal elders, we should announce that the funds were borrowed from the Shanyang Gongsun Family and the Yingxiu Lua Family. This is to avoid the old gentlemen from being unable to comprehend the news and causing trouble."
"I understand," Gongsun Hui replied, drinking two cups of spirit tea to steady her mind and dispel chaotic thoughts. She finally realized why her legitimate son wanted her to drink tea and receive the news. The impact of the news was too significant for fear she might not handle it well.
With her mind settled, Gongsun Hui slowly said, "Zhe’er, inviting me to drink spirit tea isn’t just for sharing news, right?"
"Haha, Aunt, your insight is impeccable; it’s hard to hide my little thoughts from you." Wang Shouzhe chuckled, "I just see some flaws in the family’s system, especially in the sequence ranking which is merely based on bloodline, talent, and gender. There’s a lack of competitive mechanisms and an over-reliance on free-range nurturing for the younger generation, among other issues."
Gongsun Hui furrowed her brows and said, "You’re referring to that child, Zongwei, aren’t you? I’ve heard his story, and he’s been brought back by Shouyi’s men. When Shouxin heard about it, he was furious and rushed back from the Silkworm Manor, almost breaking Wang Zongwei’s legs. I heard he’s still locked in the woodshed."
"What do you think about this, Aunt?" Wang Shouzhe asked casually while sipping spirit tea.
After some contemplation, Gongsun Hui pondered, "That child indeed behaved inappropriately. As the clan leader and elder, it’s right for you to discipline him. It’s also acceptable to temporarily revoke his cultivation resources as punishment. However, you must consider the face of Second Elder and Uncle Dingchuan, and your brother Shouxin, who all have been working hard for the family throughout their lives. You can’t forever transfer his due resources to Luotong, can you?"
"Aunt, see, this is exactly why I invited you for tea." Wang Shouzhe smiled confidently, "As you think this way, so will others, right?"
"Are you really going to permanently strip Wang Zongwei of his resources?" Gongsun Hui exclaimed, "Wouldn’t that antagonize your brother Shouxin’s line?"
"It’s not about permanently stripping him. But for him to reclaim his share, nobody, including myself, can decide that." Wang Shouzhe stated calmly.
Gongsun Hui was puzzled, "Even you can’t decide? Then who can?"
As he was about to reply, a middle-aged woman’s voice came from outside: "Fourth Uncle, is Fourth Uncle Shouzhe at home?"
Gongsun Hui’s face subtly changed: "That’s Zongwei’s mother from the Xu Family. She’s a proud and difficult woman to deal with. Shouzhe, you must handle this carefully."
Wang Shouzhe confidently smiled, "Aunt, you’re joking. Xu Family is my sister-in-law, so we’re all family. There’s no need to talk about dealing with anything."
Immediately, he personally went to open the door, a refreshing spring-like smile on his face as he cupped his hands, "Sister-in-law, if you were coming to visit in person, you should have informed me in advance so I could welcome you."
Such a smooth, adaptable demeanor even left Gongsun Hui a bit surprised. This legitimate son of hers is truly remarkable. Not only was her brother Gongsun Qiang far inferior to him, even her late husband Wang Dingyue couldn’t compare.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 38: What Evil Technique Did 4th Brother Use?
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Chapter 38: What Evil Technique Did 4th Brother Use?
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
Standing in front of Wang Shouzhe was a middle-aged woman dressed with exquisite taste. Her hair was adorned with pearl hairpins, her hands with jade bracelets, and she wore high Cloud-Stepping Boots, all wrapped in a luxurious multicolored cloud-pattern silk dress. She appeared as a noblewoman from the city.
Moreover, she had meticulously groomed herself before coming. Her face was powdered and her lips painted a crimson red, making her seem not a day over twenty-seven or eight years old rather than her actual age of forty. This was a testament to her diligent upkeep and being clearly cherished and indulged by her husband, Wang Shouxin.
Yet, there were red threads in her eyes, indicating she had been crying recently.
Remarkably, she held a large bamboo basket covered with red cloth.
Upon seeing how courteous Wang Shouzhe was, Xu Shi’s initial tension and hostility diminished slightly. She respectfully curtsied and greeted, "Xu Shi greets Fourth Uncle."
"Sister-in-law, you are too polite," Wang Shouzhe replied with a sincere smile. "Sister-in-law, please, come into the side hall and rest. My Lady is also here." Saying this, he courteously guided Xu Shi to the side hall.
Xu Shi’s expression tightened, and upon seeing Gongsun Hui, she hastily bowed with respect, "Xu Shi greets Lady Hui." She had always been proud, as a direct lineage daughter of the Changning Xu Family, marrying Wang Shouxin was considered a step down. Yet, no matter her pride, she dared not show airs in front of a legitimate daughter of the Shanyang Gongsun Family.
Especially since Gongsun Shi was the wife of the former Clan Leader, the current Clan Leader’s legitimate mother, and her elder!
"Oh, it’s Shouxin’s family that’s come. What wind blew you here?" Gongsun Hui spoke with a slight authoritative undertone, yet with a full smile, "Come, come, sit down and speak. Just in time to taste the Shanyang Small Spirit Species grown personally by Shouzhe’s grandfather."
She maintained a tone of seniority, using "Shouxin’s family" to emphasize Xu Shi’s identity as Wang Shouxin’s wife, evidently a hint of a warning.
"No, no, no, Lady Hui, how dare I sit?" Xu Shi awkwardly smiled. She had not expected Lady Gongsun to be here; otherwise, she wouldn’t have dared come looking for Wang Shouzhe at this time.
Moreover, the tea they were drinking was Spirit Seed Spirit Tea, which, given her position in the Changning Xu Family, she could never have enjoyed. Marrying into the Ping’an Wang Family made it even more unattainable...
"Fourth Uncle, you are the pillar of the family." Xu Shi put on a slightly fawning smile and handed over the basket in her hand, saying, "Sister-in-law just thought you work so hard in your cultivation, and brought some fresh ingredients to nourish you. I wouldn’t want to disturb your conversation..."
With that, she placed down the basket and prepared to leave.
"Sister-in-law, hold on." Wang Shouzhe said, smiling to stop her, "It’s rare for you to visit my place, have a cup of tea before you go. Besides, it’s been a long time since I’ve seen Brother Shouxin. I heard he’s recently returned to the main house for some business, I’ll have a servant invite him over, and we can have a meal together and catch up."
"This..." Xu Shi was somewhat flattered yet apprehensive, glancing at Gongsun Hui.
"Shouzhe is the Patriarch of the Wang Family, if he asks you to sit, then you should sit," Gongsun Hui’s demeanor softened a bit.
Only then did Xu Shi sit down, though awkwardly. Although she wore luxurious clothes, her attire seemed to lack its splendor compared to the more simply dressed Gongsun Hui.
Wang Shouzhe called in Wang Gui and instructed, "Inform the main kitchen to cook a large piece of boar meat sent by the Fourth Old Master, but don’t let it stew too soft. Also, get a skilled cook to set up a small stove in our courtyard and slice two pounds of Spirit Horned Yak Meat. Oh, and also bring that pot of Spirit Wine, and arrange for fresh fruits and vegetables as you see fit."
"Yes, Patriarch. By the way, the Sixth Master sent a fresh Red-Scaled Eel into the family’s ice cellar, and the precious Spirit Eel Blood has been prepared into blood tofu. It’s said to belong to your private collection since you caught it yourself—only you are allowed to eat it," Wang Gui reminded.
"Heh, ignore it," Wang Shouzhe replied with a smile, "Cut the best part from the middle of the Red-Scaled Eel, along with the blood tofu, and bring them both out. The rest goes to the public storage and is distributed as needed for everyone to taste. After you’ve arranged it all, invite Brother Shouxin over."
"Yes, Patriarch." Wang Gui acknowledged and withdrew.
"Fourth Uncle, this, this is too extravagant... and makes you go through too much trouble." Xu Shi was trembling, whispered, "Make it simpler, simpler."
"Sister-in-law, what are you saying? Wang Shouxin is my brother, you are my sister-in-law. Since we’re all together for a meal, how can we be haphazard?" Wang Shouzhe personally took a teacup and poured Xu Shi a cup of Spirit Tea, "Sister-in-law, try this Shanyang Small Spirit Species, it’s best consumed hot for effect."
Xu Shi trembled as she sipped the tea, and the bitterness and unique flavor of the Spirit Tea struck her heart. Instantly, she felt like crying.
Having lived in the Changning Xu Family for nineteen years and married into the Ping’an Wang Family for twenty-one, she never had the blessing to drink a cup of Spirit Tea. Her first cup in life, unexpectedly, was given by Wang Shouzhe.
Initially, she came here prepared to plead with him. If that didn’t work, she was ready to make a scene, to alarm all the clan members.
For her son, she could overlook everything and was ready to let go of all her dignity.
Yet she never thought that as the prestigious direct lineage of the clan and the patriarch, Wang Shouzhe would treat her with such respect and hospitality as a sister-in-law.
"Fourth Uncle, that, that matter..." Suddenly, Xu Shi felt a bit choked up, wondering if perhaps there was a chance for a turnaround, given Wang Shouzhe’s kindness toward her and her husband.
"Sister-in-law, are you referring to the matter concerning Zongwei?" Wang Shouzhe had no intention of avoiding the issue and said with a smile, "I have considered this matter. Let’s wait until Brother arrives, and we can discuss it as we eat. Sister-in-law, have some snacks to settle your stomach first."
"Yes." Xu Shi quickly swallowed back her words. From Wang Shouzhe’s demeanor, it seemed he wasn’t planning to hold onto the issue, yet her heart was still uneasy.
After a short while, the family cook arrived. After paying respects to Wang Shouzhe, she was about to start a fire in the small kitchen in the courtyard when Wang Shouzhe stopped her: "No need for too much hustle, just slice the fresh ingredients, the Spirit Horned Yak Meat, and the Red-Scaled Eel into thin slices for the plate, the thinner the better. Also, use top-notch charcoal to light a brazier, prepare a clean copper basin with water, and some salt."
The cook, though puzzled, wouldn’t dare disobey the Patriarch’s order and set about as instructed.
"Zhe’Er, what are you up to?" Gongsun Hui questioned curiously, "Why are you lighting a brazier in this heat?"
"Madam, you’ll see shortly." Wang Shouzhe replied with a smile, "Just a little something for the heat, so long as I don’t waste precious Spiritual Food."
Gongsun Hui curbed her curiosity and decided to wait and see, tugging Xu Shi along with her to have a friendly chat. She was impressed that Wang Shouzhe was not using his authority as Clan Leader to arbitrarily impose, which was reassuring.
However, with what she knew about Xu Shi, she doubted that Xu Shi would hold back so casually.
Before long, Wang Shouxin arrived in a hurry, led by Wang Gui. As soon as he stepped inside the room, his expression turned cold with anger and he barked, "Wang Shouxin! What nonsense are you spewing?! Look at Zongwei now; should I just let you beat him to death, or stand by and watch his future be stolen by that, by Wang Luotong?"
"You, you, you... If it weren’t for you spoiling him... I would have... just..."
But all that bluster was clearly not enough to suppress Xu Shi.
"Fourth Uncle, you are the pillar of the family." Xu Shi showed a slightly placating smile and handed over the basket in her hand. "Sister-in-law just thought you work so hard in your cultivation, so I brought some fresh ingredients to help replenish your strength. I won’t disturb your conversation with mother and son..."

chapters.title: Chapter 39: I’ll Listen to You, Uncle Four!
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Chapter 39: I’ll Listen to You, Uncle Four!
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
"Big brother, you should sit down too." Wang Shouzhe stood up and cupped his hands in invitation.
"Fourth brother." Wang Shouxin’s slightly weathered face showed a complex expression, mostly a bit of shame. He opened his mouth as if to speak but stopped and then sat down.
"It’s rare to have a meal with both big brother and sister-in-law." Wang Shouzhe skillfully greeted everyone, "Everyone, try the clear water hot pot."
A high-grade charcoal brazier heated a copper pot of boiling water, with just a sprinkle of salt, de-fishing wine, and ginger; thin slices of Spirit Horned Yak Beef were placed in it, and they were cooked in seconds.
"This?"
Everyone was somewhat doubtful. Could such a simple cooking method produce delicious food? Hopefully, it wouldn’t waste the spiritual food.
However, when the thin slices of meat entered their mouths, they felt refreshing, chewy, tender, and smooth, with a surge of fiery qi and blood energy spreading throughout their bodies.
"The best ingredients should be prepared with the simplest cooking methods." Wang Shouzhe slowly poured spirit wine for everyone and said unhurriedly, "Only in this way can one taste the most original flavor of the food. Big brother, you started working at the Silkworm Manor at the age of eighteen, and now it has been twenty-five years. For all these years of dedicated, diligent work for the family, I, your fourth brother, toast to you."
Even at the age of forty-three, Wang Shouxin had few experiences such as eating spirit meat while drinking spirit wine. Especially Wang Shouzhe’s words brought warmth to his heart, prompting him to quickly raise his wine cup and say, "It should be so, it should be so."
After both finished their drinks, Wang Shouzhe solemnly toasted to the Xu Family matron, "Sister-in-law, you have been married into our Wang Family for twenty-one years, giving birth to two sons and two daughters for our eighth generation of the Ping’an Wang Family, truly a meritorious achievement. I, Shouzhe, toast to you."
The Xu Family matron’s heart suddenly ached; yes, who truly knew the hardships? But except for Shouzhe mentioning it, no one else had ever praised her so. She immediately raised her wine cup and, with a slight choking, replied, "Thank you, fourth uncle, for your understanding."
This spirit wine, it was truly sweet, making her feel light.
"Madam, you married my father in your prime, not only working hard to manage the family business but also treating my sister and me as your own, taking care of us with all your heart." Wang Shouzhe toasted a third cup, saying, "This kindness and virtue, Shouzhe will always remember."
Gongsun Hui paused, her nose faintly tingling with a slight soreness, and she glared with her apricot eyes, pretending to be annoyed, "Luoyi is my legitimate daughter; you are my legitimate son. Taking care of you is my duty, so why say such things for no reason?"
Despite her words, she happily drank this cup of spirit wine, feeling that Shouzhe’s gratitude meant the hardships over the years were not in vain.
With these words, everyone gradually relaxed, and after three rounds of drinks, they had drunk more than half the pot of spirit wine. Spirit wine was most intoxicating, giving everyone a slight drunkenness.
"Fourth uncle." The Xu Family matron, gaining courage, said, "I also know that Zongwei deserves punishment. However, could you spare him this time for the sake of your sister-in-law and big brother? Don’t worry, your sister-in-law will surely discipline him well."
As soon as these words were spoken, even Wang Shouxin paused, his eyes showing a hint of expectation. Although he yearned to punish that brat severely, he was still his son after all.
Isn’t it natural for parents to hope their children become successful?
"Sister-in-law, big brother, we are family." Wang Shouzhe put down his wine cup and said seriously, "Zongwei is my nephew and the future hope of our young generation in the Ping’an Wang Family. You hope for your son to succeed; how could I, as a fourth uncle, wish for my nephew to fail?"
"Yes, yes, fourth uncle is right." The Xu Family matron smiled broadly, "Whatever you dictate regarding his discipline, we will abide by."
"It’s simple. Henceforth, young people in the family under thirty years of age will be judged by their virtues and achievements." Wang Shouzhe revealed his ultimate purpose, "I will implement a sequence system from first to fifth, whereby each sequence receives different family salaries and resources. I will also establish standards, conducting an evaluation each year."
"What?"
Even Gongsun Hui was a bit surprised at this.
In the family, sequences are indeed set for the younger generation, but they are usually based on bloodline, potential, and age, and once set, they typically don’t change.
"Not only that, I will also introduce a comprehensive merit system for the entire clan. As long as one contributes to the family, one can continuously earn contribution points. With contribution points, one can exchange them for various cultivation resources from the family, including spirit tea, spirit wine, cultivation techniques, and anything within the family’s Treasure Vault." Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "As long as you have ability, you can acquire more cultivation resources."
Wang Shouzhe’s setup, to put it plainly, comes from the settings in novels and games, avoiding the situation where the entire family eats from a communal pot. While many clan members are willing to bear hardships now, this is ultimately not a long-term solution.
Because when everyone is poor, it’s fine; everyone works with a shared determination. But once the family becomes wealthy, people’s hearts will change.
"But, but this..." Xu Family opened her mouth wide and said, "How, how does this relate to Zongwei’s matter?"
"Sister-in-law, you’re being muddled." Wang Shouzhe said, "Is Zongwei’s talent bad? It’s not very good, but not bad either, right? But why is he still only at the second level of the Qi Refining Realm at twenty, not even able to surpass some of the younger brothers and sisters? That’s because he’s been spoiled since childhood, receiving pampering from Second Grandfather, Eldest Uncle, as well as sister-in-law and big brother. This made him lack a sense of competition, unwilling to endure hardships, and gradually developed various bad habits."
"Then, is there still hope for Zongwei?" Xu Family weakly asked, truthfully, she was very disappointed with her son’s behavior. But no matter how disappointed, he’s still her son.
"Yes!" Wang Shouzhe said seriously, "That is by stripping him of all resources, letting him rely on his own hands to strive for cultivation resources, knowing shame to then be courageous. He should use his own efforts to climb to the family’s top tier, to reclaim the cultivation resources that were taken from him. Only when he grows and progresses through his own bit-by-bit effort, will he mature."
"Fourth Brother is right." Wang Shouxin slapped the table, strongly agreeing at this moment, "That brat’s conditions are too good; how can he grow up without experiencing some hardship?"
"But if Zongwei still doesn’t work hard..." Xu Family hesitated, "Wouldn’t he miss the best time to cultivate then?"
"Haha, if he’s still unwilling to work hard in such circumstances." Wang Shouzhe sneered, "Sister-in-law, can you still expect him to achieve something in this lifetime? Don’t worry, although our Wang Family is a bit poor, we can still support a loafer. Sister-in-law, you don’t only have this one son; look at Zongchang, isn’t he quite good? I recall that he’s only thirteen this year but already at the second level of the Qi Refining Realm. If such potential is well nurtured, he’ll surely be the pillar of our Wang Family in the future."
At the mention of Wang Zongchang, both Xu Family and Wang Shouxin showed a look of comfort. No matter what, this younger son is still quite promising, much stronger than his brother.
"Shouzhe, you’re right." Wang Shouxin seemed to have also made up his mind, "Then let’s give that brat one last chance. If it still doesn’t work, then let him fend for himself, I, Wang Shouxin, will just consider that I never had this son."
Xu Family was somewhat anxious and was just about to say something when Wang Shouzhe comforted her, "Sister-in-law, don’t be anxious. How could big brother and I harm Zongwei? If it really doesn’t work, then I’ll handle it. I truly don’t believe we can’t straighten that kid out."
These words calmed Xu Family’s anxiety, and she gratefully said to Wang Shouzhe, "Fourth Uncle, we’ll listen to you for everything." Unknowingly, her eyes showed much admiration and trust towards Wang Shouzhe.
Since the matter was settled, everyone stopped this topic. Wang Shouzhe and Wang Shouxin, the two brothers, exchanged drinks and only talked about brotherly feelings, finishing off a pot of spirit wine completely.
After the feast ended, Wang Shouxin, who was quite drunk, returned with Xu Family’s support.
Having witnessed all these, Gongsun Hui felt both satisfied and emotional looking at Wang Shouzhe. If Zongwei’s issue wasn’t handled well, it could very well create a rift between the brothers.
But not only did he manage it remarkably well, he also got Xu Family and Wang Shouxin on the same boat. Just imagine, if even the least promising Wang Zongwei has to go the sequence route, what reason do others have to oppose?
"Elder Aunt, regarding the family’s merit point system, it will be hard for Elder Aunt to manage and compile the records." Wang Shouzhe thought that Gongsun Hui was the best candidate for this task.
Subsequently, they began discussing various aspects of the merit point system.
Meanwhile.
Wang Shouxin also returned home with Xu Family’s support, and Xu Family, somewhat tipsy, with a glowing face, said: "Shouxin, I see Fourth Uncle is really not a simple character."
"Of course, you should see whose brother he is." Wang Shouxin said smugly, "If he didn’t have to take on family responsibilities, Fourth Brother might already be a student at the Purple Mansion Academy." Today’s various events with Wang Shouzhe made him feel exceptionally proud, giving him the feeling of being able to hold his head high in front of Xu Family.
"Look at you boasting... what are you doing, you old thing?" Xu Family got halfway through her sentence before being embraced by Wang Shouxin, her eyebrows raising, and her temper flaring up.
"Didn’t Fourth Brother praise you as a great contributor?" Wang Shouxin picked up Xu Family and headed towards the bedroom, "We as a couple can’t let Fourth Brother down; we need to have more children to contribute more to the family."
"Wang Shouxin, you dog, you think I’m... ah~"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 40 Obsession with the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40 Obsession with the Golden Finger
Editor:
Atlas Studios
...
The next five or six days passed quietly and peacefully.
Regarding the grain transport line, Gongsun Qiang and Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai were the first to complete their tasks. As a reward, Wang Shouzhe promised Gongsun Qiang that the last batch of old grain could be transported back to the Gongsun Family. Of course, there would be a charge, selling it at a flat rate to the Gongsun Family.
As a result, that "cheap big brother-in-law" was quite a "relentless person," arranging for overloaded carts and mining slaves to carry on their shoulders, bringing back a full three thousand dan. The next day, he couldn’t wait to send over two hundred Qian Gold for the grain purchase, afraid that Wang Shouzhe might change his mind.
No wonder he was ruthless, as the disaster in Changning Guard was becoming more intense. Those able to hire Spirit Insect Masters or have means to purchase large amounts of Insecticide Powder at a high price were Black Tortoise Clans that could remain stable.
But most lower-rank noble families were not so fortunate, and the fields were plagued by insect disasters. They could only rely on large amounts of plant ash liquid to kill pests, but against the increasing number of Honey Bees, it was of limited effect, and a large-scale reduction in yields was inevitable.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe heard worse news, and this disaster could very well spread beyond Longzuo County. Therefore, holding on to grain at this point would be even more "valuable."
At the same time, Wang Shouzhe was not idle.
Daily cultivation was necessary, and recently, due to good food consumption, his qi and blood were abundant. He could clearly feel his cultivation was steadily moving forward, heading towards the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Of course, the cultivation path was not easy, as it was a process of gradual physical transformation and strengthening. It required slow, meticulous effort to progress,day by day
He also wished he could be like the protagonists in those mystical world novels, casually taking pills and effortlessly breaking through realms, or taking a sword to kill a chicken or slaughter a dog to make experience points soar.
But in his world, these were all pipe dreams. No matter whose cultivation realm it was, it was achieved through meticulous, sustained cultivation.
Apart from cultivating, Wang Shouzhe was also working on his system panel.
Since he didn’t have a system with him when crossing worlds, he had to create some sort of rudimentary system panel himself.
Firstly, there was the family expenses.
Before he figured out the panel, Wang Shouzhe was quite unclear about family expenses, but after comparing with his aunt-in-law’s accounting book, he was truly amazed at how extensive a family’s expenses were.
Just consider the tributes and resources Wang Shouzhe enjoyed as the Clan Leader.
Allocation of ordinary supplies each year:
Refined rice 300 jin (24 Large Copper), refined flour 150 jin (15 Large Copper), various vegetables 200 jin (8 Large Copper), fruits and melons 400 jin (48 Large Copper), preserves 20 jin (20 Large Copper), pig meat 250 jin (75 Large Copper), ordinary beef and mutton 150 jin (60 Large Copper), 100 chickens and ducks (60 Large Copper), 30 geese (45 Large Copper), eggs 100 jin (20 Large Copper), lard 20 jin (8 Large Copper), refined soybean oil 20 jin (12 Large Copper), superior soy sauce 10 jin (20 Large Copper), superior refined salt 5 jin (20 Large Copper), snowflake salt 1 jin (10 Large Copper), snowflake sugar 10 jin (20 Large Copper), seasoning spices 1 jin (10 Large Copper), incense 5 jin (25 Large Copper), refined charcoal 500 jin (15 Large Copper), fuel wood depreciation 30 dan (6 Large Copper), clothing and bedding depreciation (100 Large Copper), other living material depreciation (20 Large Copper)
Just the ordinary supplies portion for Wang Shouzhe alone adds up to a whopping 6 Qian Gold 51 Large Copper annually. He glanced at the list and felt it was quite indulgent, but upon reflection, he did indeed have a large appetite.
As he was about to reach the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, his food intake was far beyond that of ordinary people. Moreover, cultivation wasn’t just about meditation and qi refining; it also required training in Black Tortoise Combat Technique, body technique, swordsmanship, string control, and riding skill, which also consumed significant physical energy.
These ordinary foods could just barely satisfy his current needs. Aunt-in-law Gongsun Hui would often divert some of her tributes to Wang Shouzhe.
Of course, this was just a small part; the major portion was the annual allocation of cultivation resources for Wang Shouzhe.
Spirit Rice Type 60 jin (12 Qian Gold), Spirit Fish Type 60 jin (20 Qian Gold), Spirit Meat Type 60 jin (20 Qian Gold), Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill 12 pills (120 Qian Gold).
A full 172 Qian Gold in cultivation resources were provided just for him each year. Moreover, as his cultivation realm increased, this portion would continue to rise. Otherwise, it would simply not keep up with his consumption.
This is also why Wang Shouzhe, at such a young age, was about to reach the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, not solely because his cultivation talent was exceptional, but because the clan piled resources on him.
Considering that the clan’s Spirit Fish Type was produced by the Fishing Team, averaging only about 400 jin annually, Wang Shouzhe alone would consume 60 jin.
As for Spirit Meat Type, the sources were quite varied, generally through hunting or purchasing, as the Wang Family lacked the financial power and capability to raise Spiritual-Horned Yaks. In hunting, the clan would organize an autumn-winter hunt every year after autumn harvest, primarily to train clan children’s skills while supplementing some meat.
However, because they didn’t dare delve deep into the Outer Domain wastelands, rarely could they hunt Fierce Beasts. At least, the Wang Family hadn’t successfully hunted a Fierce Beast during the autumn-winter hunts for five years. Hence, the main provision of spirit meat types for the Wang Family was mostly acquired externally, incurring substantial expenses.
In addition, now as the Clan Leader, Wang Shouzhe had a monthly allowance of 5 Qian Gold, totaling 60 Qian Gold each year. This private money he could use freely, as there were many areas where a Clan Leader would need personal funds.
Thus, just Wang Shouzhe’s direct annual expenditure would amount to around 240 Qian Gold. This doesn’t include the depreciation expense for house repairs, carriage and horse maintenance costs, and expenses for assigned servants, as those were part of other family spending items.
So when the account was calculated, it was a staggering figure.
Once he marries a proper wife, the cultivation resources certainly cannot be given as much, perhaps about a third of it. However, the food and maintenance of the Clan Leader’s wife would follow the level of the Clan Leader, resulting in another hundred Qian Gold or more in expenses.
In addition, the other expenses within the clan are also quite astonishing.
All bloodline members of the clan, including Wang Shouzhe, have an average annual expenditure of about 1800 Qian Gold. Meanwhile, the expenses and treatment for the nine Household Generals and their families together amount to nearly 350 Qian Gold.
Furthermore, there are seven minors or young Household Generals under cultivation, and the resource expenses for this group are about 80 Qian Gold. Additionally, there are over a hundred household servants, divided into several levels, with an annual total expenditure of about 170 Qian Gold.
Just the personnel within the main residence of the clan consume a total of 2400 Qian Gold each year. Of course, this 2400 Qian Gold is not entirely spent in Qian Gold; a significant portion consists of resource provisioning, measured in Qian Gold only as a yardstick.
For instance, the White Jade Spirit Rice produced from the Spirit Field of the clan’s Xingsheng Farm is accounted for in the farm income when it enters the clan, and when allocated to someone in the form of resources, its value is ultimately expressed in Qian Gold.
Similarly, part of the live fish, fresh fish, and Spirit Fish produced by Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai’s Fishing Team is recorded as income upon entering the clan, while the clan also records it as an expenditure.
Of course, this type of accounting only involves material transactions; there is no actual Qian Gold being transferred. Therefore, the so-called profit of the Fishing Team is usually a paper profit, not actual money earned back in Qian Gold. This portion of the profit has already turned into a resource supply for the clan.
However, for a large Black Tortoise Clan, the huge material expenses are obviously unavoidable. In fact, because the Ping’an Wang Family is so poor, their overall expenses are already considered low, and Ancestor Longyan, along with those clan elders in the Xiao generation, are already trying to cut down on spending as much as possible.
Fortunately, there are still three main pillars among the clan industries.
The Fenggu Farm, purely based on ordinary agriculture, is currently the industry with the lowest recorded income; others like Xingsheng Farm boast a greater output due to its 20-acre Spirit Field.
Besides, the Xinmao Silk Farm mainly produces cocoons and supplies them steadily in the long term to the Changning Xu Family. Most of its overall earnings come in Qian Gold.
The other two clan industries, the Ping’an Wang’s Fish Stall and the Fishing Team, are managed by the younger generation, and their previous annual earnings have been far less than the three major pillar industries.
However, this year, after Wang Shouzhe’s several maneuvers, the Fishing Team and Wang’s Fish Stall are bound to take off, and surpassing the earnings of the pillar industries is not surprising.
Moreover, this year, as the largest grain farm, Fenggu Farm will also usher in a glorious moment due to the impending insect disaster.
More importantly, strategically seizing some intelligence during the insect disaster, Wang Shouzhe made a bold move that yielded a pure profit of over ten thousand Qian Gold, enough to bring about a qualitative change for the financially constrained Wang Family.
Thinking of that large stack of Daqian Gold Notes and the food piled high in the backyard, Wang Shouzhe felt a surge of enthusiasm!
The Ping’an Wang Family is certainly bound for a meteoric rise!
Gathering his thoughts, Wang Shouzhe redirected his attention to the self-built earth system interface.
First, the main interface.
[Family Name]: Longzuo Changning Ping’an Wang Family
[Family Grade]: Ninth Grade
[Family Prestige]: [Village Reputation (75) Remarkable][County Reputation (21) Slightly Known][County Reputation (00) Obscure]
[Family Industries]: 5 items (click to view details)
[Family Members]: [Clan (35)][Outmarriage (10)](click to view details)
[Clan Relatives]: 6 (click to view details)
[House Generals]: [Adult (9)][Minor (7)](click to view details)
[House Servants]: [Adult (112)][Minor (32)](click to view details)
[Income and Expense List]: (click to view details)
After finishing this, even Wang Shouzhe felt he had played too many games and read too many system novels in his past life. If he didn’t create a ’system interface’, he’d feel uncomfortable.
However, this system is still relatively rudimentary, made up of sheets of paper panels, and many templates still need to be gradually added.
"Click to view details." Wang Shouzhe pretended to click on the family industries item, then jumped to the [Family Industries] detail page.
In reality, he merely pulled out the small notebook for tracking the family industries... still self-bound with perforated lines...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Paying Respects! Ancestor Longyan (Request for recommendation votes on Monday)
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41: Paying Respects! Ancestor Longyan (Request for recommendation votes on Monday)
...
***[Clan Industry]***
[Fishing Team]
[Changning Fish Stall]
[Fenggu Farm]
[Xingsheng Farm]
[Xinmao Silk Farm]
In total, there are five items, each followed by (click to view details). Naturally, Wang Shouzhe clicked on the Fishing Team.
The page "jumped" to the Fishing Team details page.
***[Fishing Team]***
Small fishing boats: 9
Medium fishing boats: 1
Sailors and fishermen: 46
Clan responsible person: Wang Dinghai
Average annual revenue over the past five years: 606 Qian Gold
Average annual expenditure over the past five years: 385 Qian Gold
Average annual net profit over the past five years: 221 Qian Gold
Average annual spirit fish catch over the past five years: 400 pounds
...
Improvement direction: Develop various fishing tools for mixed fishing operations
...
This year’s target:
Net profit target: 1000 Qian Gold
Spirit fish target: 1000 pounds
This is the simple panel of the Fishing Team, recording financial data before Wang Shouzhe took office, as well as the direction for improvement and this year’s profit targets.
According to Wang Shouzhe’s estimate, this target is very easy to achieve. After all, it is currently the peak season, and this year, due to the pest disaster leading to food shortages, the price of fish meat, as a partial substitute for staple food, will inevitably rise.
For the Fishing Team and Fish Stall industries, Wang Shouzhe’s total profit target is 2000 Qian Gold.
However, the only issue is that with the increased catch by the Fishing Team, it is highly likely to gradually disrupt the ecological balance, although it won’t pose a significant problem within a few years.
However, this is ultimately not a long-term plan.
For a Black Tortoise Clan, long-term and stable sources of income are the true pillar industries. Short-term enormous profits can only serve as a supplement to the clan’s industries.
Just like an industry such as [Fenggu Farm], it is a true heritage industry that can continuously provide resources for a Black Tortoise Clan over centuries.
This point is extremely important.
In the Black Tortoise World, there is no shortage of windfalls; getting lucky and coming across a treasure, or benefiting from a senior’s legacy, or encountering two High-Tier Ferocious Beasts perishing together, and other miracles, these will make you wealthy overnight.
But what about after getting rich overnight? No matter how many resources you have, they will eventually be exhausted, only heritage can remain evergreen.
Take Wang Shouzhe himself as an example: now eighteen years old, at the Sixth Layer High Stage of Qi Refining Realm, he currently consumes nearly 200 Qian Gold in resources annually. According to the clan’s estimate, he can reach the Peak of Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm in about twenty years, and by that time, he will only be thirty-eight, still at the prime of his life.
Even if these 200 Qian Gold resources remain unchanged, it would still require 4000 Qian Gold over the course of twenty years.
Of course, it’s impossible for things to remain unchanged; as he reaches the Seventh Layer, Eighth Layer of Qi Refining Realm, the resources consumed each year will increase rapidly. To cultivate from his current stage to the Peak of Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm, it will consume at least over 8000 Qian Gold in resources.
Where do these resources come from? They are squeezed out bit by bit from the output of the clan’s various industries every year. Those clan assets that can produce long-term and continuous benefits are the true family heritage.
Similarly, this is also why, given the current situation of the Wang Race, there is no strength to cultivate a second Wang Shouzhe. Otherwise, even if the talent is slightly inferior, as long as enough resources are invested, a young expert can still be created.
In fact, if one or two times the resources were additionally invested in Wang Shouzhe, or resources were invested regardless of cost, he wouldn’t need twenty years to reach the Peak of Qi Refining Realm. Perhaps it would take only fifteen years, or even ten years or less.
This is also the reason why Loose Cultivators find it difficult to achieve significant accomplishments; they have no roots or foundations. They might get lucky and obtain some resources, but if unlucky, they might even go hungry.
Loose Cultivators who can cultivate to the Spirit Platform Realm either have talent beyond measure and luck, or their luck is extraordinarily high to the extreme.
Therefore, even though the over ten thousand Qian Gold resources of Wang Shouzhe seem a lot, it is only equivalent to the total expenditure over several years under the current tight circumstances for the clan. Without careful planning, it would at best be a flash in the pan for the Wang Family, lacking lasting strength.
Watching the "simplistic system panel" he created, Wang Shouzhe’s mind was also rapidly turning; how to spend money wisely has been something he’s been contemplating these past few days.
What does the clan lack most now? Of course, it lacks a Spirit Platform Realm expert. In this way, they could replace Ancestor Longyan’s position and long-term act as the clan’s shield. After all, Ancestor Longyan’s injuries have never fully healed, and the situation is worsening.
But is more than ten thousand Qian Gold in resources enough to support someone to reach the Spirit Platform Realm? Naturally, it is far from being enough. If a Spirit Platform Realm expert were so affordable, Ping’an Wang Family’s overall financial resources would have easily solved the problem long ago.
In fact, all the ancestors in the Black Tortoise Clans with the Spirit Platform Realm would become too numerous. Therefore, this option can already be crossed out, no need to consider it.
Use all this money to expand the clan’s industries...
Wang Shouzhe has also carefully pondered over this question, but how many clan industries can more than ten thousand Qian Gold develop? One must know that some industries known as pillar clan industries are famous for their large scale, long development cycles, and relatively low return on investment.
Take the Wang’s Fenggu Farm for example, how much effort and funding from previous generations have been poured into it? But how much profit does it normally yield each year? In good years, making a pure profit of seven or eight hundred Qian Gold is already quite good.
In the long term, increasing investment in pillar industries is an inevitable trend. But distant water cannot put out a nearby fire, so Wang Shouzhe temporarily circled this idea and decided to wait and see.
Or perhaps, purchase a large number of cultivation resources for himself and supply those clan members with potential?
Wang Shouzhe naturally also considered this point.
However, there is an increasingly tight marginal effect in this, can Wang Shouzhe reach the Spirit Platform Realm after consuming Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills every day for several years?
Obviously not... not to mention the Spirit Platform Realm, even reaching the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm is uncertain.
Even if he could aggressively consume resources to cultivate to the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm in just a few years, what then? Can it solve the fundamental issues of the clan’s survival?
If even someone with his talent, among the best in the clan’s youth, cannot do it, what about other clan members?
Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan attempted to reach the Spirit Platform Realm years ago but failed. Although his state has declined with age, he’s currently stalled at the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm, and no longer at his peak. If he were given ample resources and confidence, there would be a chance to return to the peak of Qi Refining and attempt the Spirit Platform Realm again. This is the quickest way Wang Shouzhe can think of to add an ancestor in the Spirit Platform Realm to the clan.
But this resource is still far from sufficient compared to gathering all the resources necessary to attempt the Spirit Platform Realm. Moreover, adjusting Wang Xiaohan’s mental and physical state to be capable of attempting the Spirit Platform Realm is not something that can be achieved overnight.
After much consideration, Wang Shouzhe thought that if this money could somehow be used to heal Ancestor Longyan’s injuries or extend her life, it might be the most urgent matter to address.
But it is apparent that merely relying on this sum of money to completely cure Ancestor Longyan is impossible. If it were possible to heal her with just more than ten thousand Qian Gold, the clan would have long done so at any cost.
Therefore, even if she could truly be healed, the cost would surely far exceed that of supporting one or even several Spirit Platform Realm experts.
Maybe with a large investment of money, at best, her injuries could be alleviated or her life prolong somewhat.
Let’s list it as an option to be considered later, Wang Shouzhe thought deeply with a furrowed brow.
Truly envious are those transmigrators with genuine golden finger systems, who can solve all difficulties with their golden fingers. They can go about their days carefree and laugh, overpowering all obstacles effortlessly.
Unlike him, even with a bit of money, he’s still thinking long and hard about where to best utilize it. From cultivating from the sixth layer high stage of the Qi Refining Realm to the seventh layer, advancing just a stage in this small realm, it takes a few months of time to slowly cultivate and hone, and that’s because of his relatively rich resources, which hastens the process.
But upon careful thought, it is quite apparent that this world is very much real, and the path to becoming a strong individual has always required building step by step.
While he was lost in thought, Miss Xia He was sent over by Elder Gongsun Hui, saying that Ancestor Longyan had summoned him for a meeting.
Ancestor Longyan summoning?
Wang Shouzhe’s mind blanked for a moment before he immediately composed his Essence, Qi, and Spirit. Ancestor had often secluded herself in recent years, rarely summoning descendants of the clan. She hadn’t even appeared at Wang Dingyue’s funeral, showing that her physical condition was not very good.
Even Wang Shouzhe, the most favored among the seventh generation, hadn’t seen the ancestor for more than a year. Usually, it was Elder Gongsun Hui who took care of her.
"Thank you, Miss Xia He." Wang Shouzhe was quite polite to Xia He.
Xia He quickly bowed slightly: "No need to be polite, Patriarch. If you have nothing pressing to attend to, please come with me to see Ancestor."
She was Gongsun Hui’s companion, raised from the age of nine, and now she was nineteen. Although she had no cultivation talent, she was intelligent and resourceful, literate and proficient in the Nine Chapters of Mathematics.
Much of the accounts for Elder Gongsun Hui were calculated and organized by her help.
Afterwards.
Wang Shouzhe followed Xia He all the way to the secluded courtyard where Ancestor Longyan resided. It was situated near Zhuwei Lake. In a short while, Wang Shouzhe arrived at the courtyard known as [Longyan Residence].
To avoid disturbing Ancestor Longyan’s dedicated practice, this vicinity was deemed a clan forbidden area, where nobody was to trespass without her summoning.
Gongsun Hui was already waiting at the entrance of Longyan Residence. Upon meeting, she said in a bright voice: "Ancestor, Shouzhe has arrived."
"Shouzhe, come in."
A calm voice gently sounded at the doorway.
"Yes, Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe took a deep breath, calming his mind slightly before pushing the door open and stepping into Longyan Residence.
This was a quaint courtyard, sparsely decorated and devoid of any luxury. Simple, ordinary flowers and plants grew in the courtyard, swaying gently in the breeze.
In the pavilion, a slender woman stood leaning against a railing, gazing at the garden scenery. Her back was to Wang Shouzhe, with a cascade of white hair casually draping over her shoulders.
On seeing the snow-white hair, Wang Shouzhe’s heart inexplicably ached. This was from a deep memory of his predecessor; when Wang Shouzhe was a child, he clearly remembered that Ancestor Longyan’s hair was only half white.
In just a span of ten years, it had turned completely white.
Wang Shouzhe felt a lump in his throat, stepped forward, and bowed in respect: "Shouzhe pays his respects to Ancestor."
