chapters.title: Chapter 42: The Ancestor Plans to Travel
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42: The Ancestor Plans to Travel
...
Facing Ancestor Longyan feels completely different from seeing Ancestor Ming Sheng. Although Ancestor Ming Sheng appears somewhat old, he exudes the energy of a man in his prime.
But Ancestor Longyan is not only gaunt, she also seems to carry a hint of desolation. No wonder, Ancestor Longyan’s condition has been deteriorating in recent years; she’s significantly reduced her consumption of spiritual food to save and supply the younger members of the family.
As a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, her physical functions are far superior to those of Qi Refining Realm cultivators. However, according to the law of conservation of cosmic energy, the source of energy does not arise out of thin air; the more powerful the body, the greater the consumption.
For Ancestors in the Spirit Platform Realm, ordinary food has a very low efficiency in converting to vital energy. Therefore, Spirit Platform Realm Ancestors typically need to supplement with spiritual food for a long time to maintain strong physical functions, even to strengthen themselves.
However, with Wang Xiaohan’s failure to break through to the Spirit Platform Realm, the family’s resources have become increasingly strained, prompting Ancestor Longyan to gradually reduce her spiritual food consumption. Now, she consumes only 80 pounds of spirit rice, 100 pounds of spirit fish and spirit meat, and 2 Solid Essence Pills a year.
In total, the spiritual food costs only 36 Qian Gold, and the 2 Solid Essence Pills merely 60 Qian Gold.
A dignified Spirit Platform Realm Ancestor consumes less than 100 Qian Gold worth of resources per year! This is probably just enough to maintain her meditative state...
In fact, she’s not the only one doing this.
The clan elders in the family also receive only enough spiritual food and resources to maintain their bodies, and their cultivation has stagnated for many years. They’ve given up their chance for younger, more promising members of the family.
"Shouzhe, are you feeling sad?" Ancestor Longyan did not look back, her voice carried a touch of ethereality and grace, without the hoarse quality typical of aged women.
"I’m just feeling a bit sad for Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe spoke honestly.
In truth, Ancestor Longyan is only a hundred and fifteen years old, a few years older than Lua Family’s Ancestor Ming Sheng, and far from reaching the Spirit Platform Realm’s limit.
Back then, Ancestor Longyan ascended to the Spirit Platform Realm at thirty and reached the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm at sixty, maintaining her youthful and peak physical condition.
She was so spirited and her life’s goal was aimed at reaching the higher Celestial Human Realm!
But unfortunately.
The beast disaster in the Changlong Calendar year 3095 brutally pulled the Ping’an Wang Family from its heights to the mud and broke Ancestor Longyan’s wings.
"The rising and falling tides, the blooming and wilting flowers, are the most common things in the world." Ancestor Longyan spoke calmly, slowly turning around, "I’ve already heard from Hui about your recent experiences, well done."
Though she appeared somewhat gaunt, dressed in simple cotton clothes and cloth shoes, there was a kind of ethereal immortal aura, her star eyes were like a hundred-foot cold pond, completely inscrutable.
The only regret Wang Shouzhe had was that Ancestor Longyan wore a veil on her face, obscuring her appearance.
But the veil was not new today; ever since Wang Shouzhe could remember, she had always been dressed like this, never having seen Ancestor Longyan’s true face.
"Thank you for the praise, Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands in respect, "As long as Ancestor doesn’t blame my rashness, that’s enough." After a pause, he asked with slight curiosity, "Did Ancestor summon Shouzhe for any instructions?"
He felt a bit uneasy inside, fearing that Ancestor Longyan might disagree with his implementation of the competitive ranking system, given that the older generation emphasizes family unity and love. They might be concerned that competition could lead to conflicts between siblings and affect familial relationships.
"Shouzhe, you are the Clan Leader." Ancestor Longyan stated serenely, "I wouldn’t presume to direct you."
"So this time, Ancestor..." Wang Shouzhe felt puzzled, as Ancestor Longyan wasn’t one to call him over for idle chat or casual compliments.
"I need you to arrange, and accompany me on a trip to the Hundred Islands Guard." Ancestor Longyan said.
Hundred Islands City?
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback, only recalling after a while that it was a Guardian City near the East Sea. His slow reaction was understandable, as he’d never left the Changning Guard since childhood, let alone thought of traveling so far.
Moreover, since that great disaster, Ancestor Longyan hadn’t left the vicinity of Changning Guard.
Suppressing his curiosity, Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands, saying: "Shouzhe will take your orders. Please, Ancestor, wait a couple of days while I make the arrangements." Regardless of Ancestor Longyan’s intentions, Wang Shouzhe could not refuse her request.
Receiving orders from Ancestor Longyan, Wang Shouzhe returned to his courtyard, took out a county map to study, planning the travel route.
For Ancestor Longyan’s journey, the first priority was secrecy.
Now is the time when the insect disaster is at its most severe, with the Liu Family and Zhao Family overwhelmed, but even so, vigilance cannot be relaxed.
Secondly, it was crucial to consider Ancestor Longyan’s physical condition. Avoiding discomfort and ensuring her comfort was a priority, and someone would need to accompany her throughout the journey. The choice of who would personally attend to her required careful deliberation.
In a short while, he had devised the route and plan for this journey.
"Wang Gui." Wang Shouzhe summoned the servant inside, "Go invite my fourth aunt from the Xu Family and Wang Lici over."
Wang Gui was puzzled: "Fourth aunt from the Xu Family? Which Xu Family?"
"You rascal, of course, it’s from my fourth uncle’s family. Can’t you remember even the few dozen members of our household and relatives?" Wang Shouzhe frowned, nearly kicking him.
"Perhaps the Patriarch wishes to see Lady Rou." Wang Gui hurriedly nodded and bowed out, "I’ll go right away."
But it’s no wonder Wang Gui was confused. For one, there were more than one Xu Family member in the house. Secondly, Wang Shouzhe’s fourth aunt Xu Zhirou was always quiet, and after Uncle Wang Dingbang passed away five years ago, she became even more secluded.
However, Wang Shouzhe held a deep impression of fourth aunt Xu Zhirou. She hailed from the direct vein of the Golden Sand Xu Family, and during the time when Wang Shouzhe’s mother passed away, it was Xu Zhirou who took care of him.
Even after aunt Gongsun Hui remarried into the family, Xu Zhirou continued to help care for him for quite some time. After all, Gongsun Hui was a delicate young lady back then, and it was fourth aunt Xu Zhirou who taught her step by step.
In his memories, Xu Zhirou was gentle and meticulous, yet very skillful. She excelled in cooking and making little trinkets that amused him.
In those bewildered and saddened days, it was fourth aunt who helped him through the most difficult times. Unfortunately, later fourth aunt became pregnant with his fifth sister Wang Luojing, and went back to nurture her pregnancy six months later.
After that, Wang Shouzhe lived under aunt Gongsun Hui’s care until he moved into the Young Clan Leader’s courtyard to live independently at fourteen.
Choosing fourth aunt from the Xu Family, Wang Shouzhe valued her gentle meticulousness; an elder needed an experienced woman to tend to them during travels, and after consideration, fourth aunt was very suitable.
Putting aside distractions for now, Wang Shouzhe continued to refine the travel plan.
Before long, fourth aunt Xu Zhirou and Wang Lici were brought to his side hall by the servant Wang Gui.
The last time Wang Shouzhe saw fourth aunt was during his father’s funeral, where she was naturally busy managing various tasks as one of the household’s female relatives. However, Wang Shouzhe was too dazed then to speak much with her.
Looking more closely now, he saw Xu Zhirou was dressed in a simply colored fine-grain cotton dress, without any extra ornaments, plain and clean. The only difference from his memory was that she had slightly aged into a middle-aged woman.
No wonder, having borne three children and with her fourth uncle passing away five years ago, managing those children’s affairs surely kept her busy.
"Xu Family greets the Patriarch." Xu Zhirou bowed slightly.
Beside her, Wang Lici also hurriedly bowed and said, "Lici greets fourth uncle."
"Fourth aunt, no need for formality, you can still call me Shouzhe as before." Wang Shouzhe quickly returned the bow to Xu Zhirou, "Come, let’s sit and chat." He then smiled and gestured to Wang Lici to sit as well, "Big girl, you too, have a seat."
After thanking him, both sat down.
Wang Gui bustled around, serving tea and fruit before withdrawing.
Wang Shouzhe first chatted causally with Xu Zhirou before shifting his attention to Wang Lici, seeing her nibbling at a piece of candied fruit, he laughed and said, "Big girl, what have you been busy with lately?"
Wang Lici quickly swallowed the half piece of candied fruit and replied nervously, "Replying to fourth uncle, I haven’t been busy with much, just reading and cultivating daily."
This girl was the daughter of elder brother Wang Shouxin, sixteen years old, and the eldest among the eighth-generation girls of the Lizi lineage, hence the Shouzhe generation likes to call her big girl.
"Hmm, sounds like hard work. Good, very good." Wang Shouzhe was pleased inside; at least among the girls in the family, one knows to work hard in studies. He smiled and said, "Then fourth uncle will test your studies, and if you pass, there’ll be a reward."
"What?"
Wang Lici’s pretty, slightly plump face turned pale, and her legs began to tremble. Fourth uncle was ten times scarier than her father Wang Shouxin—just look at her older brother Wang Zongwei’s terribly miserable outcome.
Her heart was filled with regret, eyes moistening. If she’d known she’d be summoned by fourth uncle for a test today, she would have frantically studied hard the past few days.
But who could have foreseen this happening?
Her mind was buzzing...
Indeed.
Disaster from the sky!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Legend! Jiaolong Gang
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43: Legend! Jiaolong Gang
...
Wang Shouzhe’s face was almost turning black. This big girl was so nervous that she looked like this, surely she hadn’t been diligent in her studies or training usually, yet she still had the nerve and courage to claim to read and practice every day in front of him?
"Shouzhe, don’t scare the big girl anymore. Look, she’s so frightened that she’s crying," said Xu Zhirou, gently wrapping her arms around her with a smile. "Big girl, don’t be afraid; your fourth uncle is just teasing you. Think about it, if he really wanted to test you on your studies, why would he call just you alone?"
So, that’s how it was.
Wang Lici patted her chest, immediately relaxing. She was really scared to death, so she quickly ate a piece of preserved fruit to calm her nerves. She immediately picked up a piece of fruit and happily ate it.
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe’s face turned even darker. The quick transformation from surviving a disaster to a foodie was astonishing, wasn’t she a bit too carefree?
What’s there to even test with her like this?
Originally, he thought of finding two female clan members from home to accompany Ancestor Longyan on her journey, one should be older and more mature, and the other younger with more energy and stamina.
Wang Shouzhe was quite satisfied with his fourth aunt Xu’s involvement, but Wang Lici, this big girl...
He had a headache!
Among the younger female clan members, there was his elder sister Wang Luoyi, his fourth younger sister Wang Luotong, and his eldest niece Wang Lici. As the journey would pass through East Port, and since his sister Wang Luoyi was already betrothed to the Young Master Chen of the East Port Chen Family, it wasn’t appropriate to have her appear publicly in East Port at this time.
Meanwhile, Luotong was busy with the final transportation line for grain. Once she completed her task, Wang Shouzhe also wanted her to follow their aunt Gongsun Hui to handle subsequent matters for some experience.
Therefore, he wasn’t going to interrupt Wang Luotong’s original plans.
After pondering over and over, the only suitable and unoccupied candidate was Wang Lici. Seeing her in this clumsy heroic state, he felt an urge to replace her with a clever and agile maid.
But this thought only flashed by quickly. Since the girl refused to study or practice properly, he might as well bring her along to teach her properly and put some pressure on her.
Moreover, the trend in the family now of girls not studying properly was widespread, Luotong, Luojing, and others were the same. Presumably, other little girls weren’t much better. The boys were slightly better, as the elders applied more pressure on them.
This bad family trend surely needed to be rectified later on.
With this thought, Wang Shouzhe returned to the main topic, saying, "Fourth Aunt. I’ve called you over today because you need to take a trip that will last around ten days. Please prepare and we will depart the day after tomorrow at the hour of Chen. Is that okay with you, Fourth Aunt?"
Xu Zhirou, though having some doubts, stood up and nodded, "No problem, I’ll leave it all to you, Shouzhe."
Wang Lici’s little head was filled with curiosity, excitement, and confusion. They were going on a trip? Was Fourth Uncle taking her to play at Changning Guard? In her mind, Changning Guard was already quite far, and she hadn’t been there more than twice her whole life.
Time passed in a blur over the two days.
At dawn, just as the sky was getting light.
A four or five-zhang long black awning boat set off from the dock in the Wang Family’s Main Residence backyard, heading into Zhuwei Lake and then towards Fenggu Farm.
This was the route arranged by Wang Shouzhe. As Ancestor Longyan was traveling, he naturally intended to keep things secretive. If they traveled by carriage to Dingpu Ferry to board a boat, it would certainly be too conspicuous.
It was better to follow the grain transport route, crossing Fenggu Gate to board a large boat; after all, that was their own territory.
Those accompanying Ancestor Longyan on this trip were not many; it was just Wang Shouzhe along with Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, two Household Generals, as well as Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou and the big girl Wang Lici, including the Ancestor, making a total of six people.
Wang Zhong and Wang Yong were responsible for navigating the boat outside. Though not professionals, controlling such a medium-sized black awning boat was quite simple with the methods of a Black Tortoise Practitioner, and the combined effort of sculling and rowing made for quite a brisk speed.
Inside the black awning boat.
Wang Lici’s eyes were wide open, clutching her bundle tightly with both hands, barely daring to breathe. Fourth Uncle didn’t notify her in advance that they were accompanying Ancestor Longyan on this trip.
This was the family’s Ancestor, an existence more frightening than Fourth Uncle.
The surprise that Fourth Uncle gave was too big to digest easily.
"Ancestor, the itinerary and arrangements are like this. Fourth Aunt and Lici will be responsible for taking care of your daily needs," Wang Shouzhe respectfully explained all the arrangements for the trip to Ancestor Longyan.
"I trust you, Shouzhe, in handling things," Ancestor Longyan was quite satisfied with Wang Shouzhe’s meticulous plans, and then said to Xu Zhirou, "Zhirou, this trip will require some effort on your part."
Xu Zhirou humbly said, "Serving the Ancestor is both my duty and honor."
Afterward, Ancestor Longyan turned to look at Wang Lici, her eyes unexpectedly softening a bit: "Child, it’s been two years since I last summoned you. In the blink of an eye, you’ve grown into a big girl. How is your academic work going recently?"
Ancestor Longyan was generally very kind to the younger generation in the family. Especially because Ancestor Longyan was the third-generation granddaughter descended from Ancestor Zhou Xuan, while Wang Lici was already the family’s eighth-generation descendant.
"What?" Wang Lici was momentarily stunned, being asked about her studies again?
Fortunately, having the prior experience of Fourth Uncle testing her academic work, she was prepared this time.
Wang Lici’s eyes twinkled as she quickly said, "I’ve been quite diligent recently. Let me recite an article for Ancestor..." With that, she eagerly began to recite a piece—"Ascending to Celestial Mist to View the Vault of Heaven," written by a powerful Celestial Human Realm master and literary sage a thousand years ago. Its language was ornate and grand, earning the admiration of later generations.
Literature, in any civilization, is an extremely important layer, playing a role in cultivating sentiment and enhancing cultural depth. If humanity only knows fighting and killing, without nurturing the mind and body, pursuing only strength and slaughter throughout life, then how are they different from the Wilderness Ferocious Beasts?
Wang Shouzhe listened to her fluent recitation, with some expression and emotion, finding it amusingly helpless. This so-called recent diligence was probably just cramming in these last two days, right? She could probably recite just this one piece fluently?
However, he didn’t expose her, seeing that the Ancestor seemed quite gratified and offered her some words of praise and encouragement.
The covered black boat meandered its way to Fenggu Farm, not stopping even upon arriving, passing through directly to reach the Fenggu Gate. Everyone disembarked from the boat and crossed the gate, where a medium-sized river boat was already waiting.
This medium-sized sailboat, even if empty, could securely carry horse carts. Who knows where Wang Dinghai got it from.
"Shouzhe, as per your instructions," Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai approached, "the cabin has been slightly modified, and a temporary resting space has been set up. What mysterious plans do you have... hmm?"
Wang Dinghai suddenly noticed Ancestor Longyan behind Wang Shouzhe, and his eyes nearly bulged out. Was this a joke? The Ancestor had actually ventured out...
Frightened into a cold sweat, just as he was about to pay his respects, Wang Shouzhe stopped him, "Hold off, Sixth Uncle. Just steer us to East Port properly."
"Yes, yes, I will navigate diligently." Wang Dinghai, looking pale, hurriedly invited Wang Shouzhe and the others into the temporary rest area in the cabin before going out to steer the boat.
The Ancestor’s outing must be a significant event.
But no matter the importance of the event, it could not supersede Ancestor Longyan’s safety. Thus, under his control and command, the ship slowly left the deep water area outside Fenggu Gate, steadily reaching the heart of Anjiang River.
As they reached the river’s center, the wind and waves gradually intensified, the sails opened systematically, capturing the wind as the tightly woven sailcloth bulged outward, increasing the ship’s speed bit by bit.
On Earth, the speed of ships is measured in knots.
However, in the Daqian Kingdom of this world, it is still calculated by how many li per hour. Today’s southeast wind, with swift eastern-flowing waters, had the speed unknowingly reaching fifty to sixty li per hour.
It sounds fast, but that’s roughly the equivalent of a speed of only ten-plus kilometers per hour, about two to three times the walking speed of an average person.
Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai, seasoned in making a living on Anjiang River, handled the ship as smoothly as flowing clouds and water. Wang Shouzhe and the others felt little discomfort from the motion in the cabin’s rest area.
However, Wang Shouzhe, energetic and strong, got bored staying inside the cabin. After excusing himself with the Ancestor, he went to the deck to enjoy the scenery, noticing Wang Dinghai at the helm, and immediately went to take a look.
"Sixth Uncle, this boat seems quite good. Looks like a merchant ship. Where did you borrow it from?" Wang Shouzhe examined the ship, noting that the crew aboard were clearly not from the Wang family’s fishing fleet.
Wang Dinghai, while steering, replied, "You instructed me to find a decent boat, so I borrowed one from a friend at the Jiaolong Trading Company’s Changning Branch. That old fellow owed me a favor. Last time, the fleet under his command ran into an accident in our territory, and Sixth Uncle took the risk to save him."
Jiaolong Trading Company?
Wang Shouzhe had naturally heard of this firm. Their way of doing business involved traveling along the entirety of Anjiang River, from the most western Great Wilderness County to Longzuo County, spanning several counties, with branches in every city along the river.
This was a trading company with overall strength no less than Qiaan’s Trading Company, though they strictly stick to riverside trading and do not conflict with local powers of the counties, maintaining non-interference with each other.
"Shouzhe, you better not get any ideas about running a river-based business." Wang Dinghai gravely warned, "Jiaolong Trading Company isn’t to be messed with. You must know they were once called the Jiaolong Gang, a gang secretly supported by several powerful families. In recent decades, their business has grown so large that they’ve rebranded as a trading company. They’ve signed treaties of non-aggression with local families everywhere."
Oh dear! Turns out it’s an underworld organization turned legitimate trading company. No wonder they’re dominant over the strategic waterway of Anjiang River.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t know whether to find it funny or tragic; on Earth, when reading fantasy novels, things like the Jiaolong Gang and Angry Dragon Association were low-tier forces, merely places for protagonists to gain early experience.
How did they become an untouchable behemoth when it came to his turn!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 44: In-Law Factions (Seeking Recommendations)
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: In-Law Factions (Seeking Recommendations)
...
However, upon closer consideration, it seems quite reasonable. If Jiaolong Trading Company wasn’t powerful enough, how could it take over all the business along the entire Anjiang?
The annual revenue must be an astronomical figure.
With such immense revenue, attracting or nurturing talent becomes a matter of course.
This is the so-called rule: the stronger you are, the wealthier you become, and the wealthier you become, the stronger you are. This principle is universally applicable in any world.
The speed of the ship sailing downstream was fast, and while Wang Shouzhe chatted casually with Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai, they quickly left the exclusive Wang Family’s water domain. To the left of the river was a large chaotic stone beach, and to the right were steep cliffs.
The next stretch of water was the domain of the Ping’an Zhao Family. As Wang Shouzhe saw it, it was like an economically exclusive zone divided by various forces through long-term competition.
After traveling more than ten miles downstream, the right bank was the Shanyang Region, the old stronghold of the Gongsun Family. Compared to the small Ping’an Town region, where three noble families squeezed together, Shanyang Town had only two families, with the Shanyang Gongsun Family being considerably stronger than the Shanyang Cao Family.
The Black Tortoise Clan’s marriages are meticulous. They ensure the bloodlines continue while also possessing the means for alliances and diplomacy. Typically, families from the same region do not intermarry.
Just like the Wang Family, the Liu Family, and the Zhao Family in Ping’an Town, they do not intermarry. This is an implicit understanding, signifying that two tigers can’t live on one mountain. Eventually, they are bound to swallow each other.
Similarly, when marrying outside, it’s forbidden to choose two families within the same region for marriage. For example, since the Wang Family and the Shanyang Gongsun Family are in a marriage alliance, the Wang Family absolutely cannot intermarry with Shanyang. That would be a grave taboo. As a return, the Shanyang Gongsun Family naturally will not intermarry with the Ping’an Zhao or Liu Families.
Thus, throughout the Changning Guard Region, with dozens of noble families large and small, it may seem complex, but in reality, it divides into only five or six marriage alliances.
Wang Shouzhe admired the fleeting scenery along the way while sorting through some thoughts. The family’s future development and marriage alliances are factors that cannot be ignored.
Take the Changning Xu Family, for example. Currently, the Changning Xu Family has three members in the Spirit Platform Realm, with the most powerful ancestor reaching the late Spirit Platform Realm, comparable to the Wang Family at its peak.
However, as marriage allies, both parties still maintain direct line marriages. Xinmao Silk Farm’s main business of mulberry planting and silkworm raising also relies on the Xu Family for survival. Not to mention anything else, just the fact that the price of buying cocoons is twenty percent higher than that of others shows that the Changning Xu Family still harbors affection for the Wang Family.
If one day Wang Shouzhe achieves the Spirit Platform Realm, how can he not remember the sentiments of the Gongsun Family, Lua Family, and others? Anyone might face downfall at some point; even the Wang Family, strong as they once were, fell into decline suddenly, didn’t they?
"Shouzhe, look, that’s the Zhao Family’s fishing fleet." Wang Dinghai suddenly spoke.
Wang Shouzhe glanced across the river and noticed a fishing fleet several miles away working on the river, with two of the ships being medium-sized fishing vessels. More than a dozen fishing boats spread out, appearing quite grand. Evidently, their fishing fleet was slightly superior in scale to the Wang Family’s.
It’s no surprise, given that of the three noble families in the small Ping’an Town region, the Wang Family is currently the weakest. Firstly, the Wang Family has always been plagued with misfortunes, and secondly, they owe it to Zhao and Liu’s joint pressure strategy.
However, the Zhao and Liu Families both know that once the Wang Family collapses, Ping’an Town becomes the battlefield between them. The lack of intermarriage between the Zhao and Liu Families indicates their mutual understanding.
"Ha, they still use the outdated fleet netting fishing technique." Wang Dinghai steered the rudder, a sneer appearing at the corner of his mouth, feeling a surge of superiority.
It’s no wonder, since Wang Shouzhe taught the fixed net-launched technique. Wang Dinghai has already discreetly erected 30 fixed net-launching platforms at various hidden locations along both banks. Near those platforms, simple thatched huts have been built to allow two fishermen to take turns working and resting.
Moreover, using the seesaw principle, the fixed net-launching platforms make fishing extraordinarily simple and convenient. Even an ordinary teenager can easily master it without much effort.
Nighttime fishing on the river can be dangerous. Unless absolutely necessary, fishing boats usually head out at dawn and return before nightfall. The net-launching platforms, however, can conduct non-lit fishing operations at night, and are much safer along the shore than on the river.
The fishing pattern is that fish tend to move closer to the shore at dusk because the shore offers more opportunities for food, and the night gives them a sense of security.
During the fish season, a single fixed net-launching platform might capture one to two thousand pounds of fish overnight with great luck, and even with less luck, it could catch four to five hundred pounds.
Across thirty net-launching fishing points, they’re averaging daily catches of twenty thousand pounds over the past few days! That’s a full two hundred dan of various fish harvests...
Thus, to maintain secrecy, Wang Dinghai has already halted daytime operations of the net-launching platforms. The nets are dismantled, and the frameworks flattened and covered with grass. By the time dusk arrives, they are rapidly assembled to fish throughout the night under the cover of darkness.
After all, the daytime fish harvests are much less compared to nighttime, so it’s better to increase the level of secrecy.
As for the daytime, to cover their tracks, the fishing fleet still needed to go out if there was nothing else. But during the fishing season, catching just a few dozen tans a day gradually made Wang Dinghai lose interest, and he was pondering how to get more bamboo rafts.
When Wang Dinghai reported this softly to Wang Shouzhe, Shouzhe’s heart was filled with emotion. The natural resources of this world were indeed too abundant. Even those famous Western countries with rich natural water resources couldn’t compare to this world.
"Uncle Six, try to pay attention to conserving resources as much as possible," Wang Shouzhe said with a mix of relief and some concern. "In the future, just release the small fish of the same species back."
"How can that be? These are all money, you know. We get more than a dozen tans each day." Wang Dinghai’s eyes widened. "Besides, if our family doesn’t catch them, other families will." After a pause, he couldn’t stand Wang Shouzhe’s gaze and said awkwardly, "If you really have opinions, Shouzhe, we can have the boatmen gather the small fish and throw them all into the Fengshui River, treating it as our own family’s breeding. At most, I’ll add a few more bamboo rafts to catch more big fish."
"That works too," Wang Shouzhe acknowledged, knowing the mindset of the older generation in the family. They had been too poor; making extra money wherever possible mattered to them. As for the advanced thought of protecting natural resources, it couldn’t be changed overnight.
With the ship’s fast pace, they swiftly passed by the Zhao family’s fishing boats at a distance of two miles, gradually leaving them behind.
From Fenggu Gate to East Port, there were about one hundred and twenty li of waterway. With favorable winds and currents, they would reach there in just two and a half hours.
Here, the river broadened, forming a large horn-shaped opening, and the water flow slowed. To the left of the big river horn lay the endlessly extending Liping Mountain Range.
The Liping Mountain Range and the region behind were a highly dangerous area, one of the Outer Domain wildernesses unclaimed by settlers. The deeper you go, the fiercer the beasts become, even a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor might fall if they rashly charge in.
On the right side of the big river was a vast plain area. From Wang Shouzhe’s study of the map and the field observation, he judged it to be a substantial alluvial plain.
This expansive fertile land was the famous East Sea Guard region in Longzuo County.
East Port Town was the furthest eastern segment extending from the Changning Guard Region and bordered the East Sea Guard region.
East Port had a very favorable geographical position, with a natural deep-water bay that was a haven for ships. Over time, it became a prosperous port with developed freight and concentrated trade.
The Liu family’s in-laws—the East Port Chen Family, was one of the noble families here.
The Chen Family was a family primarily in the shipping business. Since its establishment, it had been under a century, making it a relatively young family. Its entrepreneurial ancestor had long passed, giving the impression of a weak foundation, but in reality, the family now had two Spirit Platform Realm ancestors.
The older ancestor was just over a century old, while the younger one was only seventy-something.
In addition, the current clan leader of the Chen Family, Chen Dewei, had reached the peak of the Qi Refining Realm at just forty-two years old. He was doing the final polishing work and gathering resources, and it would take half a year to two years for him to attempt breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm.
Once successfully advanced, Clan Leader Chen Dewei would make the East Port Chen Family a family of three Spirit Platforms, solidifying the clan’s foundation even more.
Producing a Spirit Platform Realm every thirty years!
It showed the Chen Family’s considerable financial resources and fortune were not ordinary.
Wang Shouzhe gazed at the vigorous East Port buildings afar, feeling somewhat emotional. In contrast, Ping’an Wang Family’s previous fortune seemed rather lackluster.
Fortunately, they now had him, Wang Shouzhe.
Suddenly!
A ship sailed out from the inner bay port, its unique feature being the huge family flag it hoisted, depicting a golden bird flying over the sea.
On the lookout tower, a signalman waved a flag.
"Shouzhe," Wang Dinghai said happily, "that’s a ship from the East Port Chen Family. They’re inquiring via flag signals if we are guests from the Wang Family. They must have sent someone to greet us."
"Yes." Wang Shouzhe nodded. Earlier, household generals were sent to notify the Chen Family of the journey, and them coming out to welcome us was standard courtesy between the two families.
Wang Shouzhe guessed it might be the Young Clan Leader Chen Fangjie, as that fellow was soon to become Wang Shouzhe’s brother-in-law...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 45 East Port Chen Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45 East Port Chen Family
...
Unless Chen Fangjie is not at East Port, if he does not come to greet us, it would be a complete disregard of the Wang Family.
Given the deep kinship between the two families, such a disrespectful thing would certainly not happen.
Sure enough, after Wang Dinghai responded with flag signals, the ship on the other side quickly approached. Standing at the bow was a young man in a strong outfit, appearing heroic and handsome.
With Wang Shouzhe’s vision, he recognized the young man from afar. It was none other than the Young Clan Leader of the East Port Chen Family, Chen Fangjie. Last year, after his engagement to Wang Shouzhe’s elder sister Wang Luoyi, he had come to visit the Wang Family.
When Wang Dingyue passed away, he also came on behalf of the Chen Family to offer condolences. However, because they had not yet officially married, he could not observe mourning rites.
Chen Fangjie obviously also saw Wang Shouzhe, and a smile appeared on his face. He kicked off from the ship’s railing, leaping like an arrow from a bow, and after a mid-air roll, landed steadily on the deck.
Smiling, he clasped his hands together in salute to Wang Shouzhe, and complained, "Shouzhe, if you were coming to East Port, you should have informed me a few days earlier, so I could send a ship to bring you over."
"Greetings, Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe returned the salute, "The decision was made too hastily, please forgive me, Brother Chen."
Indeed, this Chen Fangjie was to be his future brother-in-law. However, until they were officially married, he could not address him casually.
As they spoke, Wang Shouzhe quietly observed him. Compared to the previous year, Chen Fangjie, now a year older, exuded even more vigor. Even Wang Shouzhe’s own strength could not clearly see through his cultivation.
Clearly, at such a young age, Chen Fangjie had already reached the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, and not just at the initial entry. This already made him an exceptional young talent, seeming outwardly to match Wang Shouzhe closely.
However, Wang Shouzhe remained calm and confident internally. Overall, Chen Fangjie’s level was at most comparable to what Wang Shouzhe had before his transmigration. As for the current Wang Shouzhe, he was confident that by the time he reached Chen Fangjie’s age, his cultivation would far surpass his.
At the same time, Chen Fangjie was also secretly appraising Wang Shouzhe, internally surprised. Previously, he had thought Wang Shouzhe’s talent was excellent and his cultivation diligent, but his overall demeanor still needed refinement.
Yet, in such a short time, he found that Wang Shouzhe’s bearing and poise had transformed tremendously. More astonishingly, Wang Shouzhe’s aura subtly exerted pressure on him, as if nearing a breakthrough to the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Eighteen years old and already at the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm!
In the entire Changning Guard Region, this was already exceptionally rare. Back when he was the same age, he only reached the seventh layer at nineteen. It seems this future brother-in-law is anything but simple.
With this thought, Chen Fangjie’s affinity towards him grew stronger. "Shouzhe, why such formality between us? After we meet my father, I’ll take you on a good tour around Chen Port to unwind."
"Brother Chen, under normal circumstances, I wouldn’t decline." Wang Shouzhe laughed, "But after visiting Uncle, I must rush to the Hundred Islands Guard."
Although he held the title of Clan Leader, the Chen Family’s Clan Leader, Chen Dewei, was his sister’s future father-in-law, considered an elder, and it was only right to pay him a visit when passing through.
"Hundred Islands Guard." Chen Fangjie’s expression turned slightly serious, "You mentioned this in the letter you sent earlier, but Shouzhe, I must remind you, the Hundred Islands Guard is a remote offshore city, where Longzuo County’s influence is weak, and it’s a mix of various people, unlike the orderly Changning Guard."
"Brother Chen, I’m aware," Wang Shouzhe replied solemly, "However, I do need the Chen Family’s assistance in planning the route for this journey."
Traveling further along the Anjiang, exiting the estuary leads directly into the East Sea Region.
The boat borrowed by Uncle Wang Dinghai navigated the Anjiang without issue, but entering the sea would be vastly different. A sea vessel needs not only to be large and stable but also to have excellent storm resistance and experienced seamen for navigation.
In short, navigating the vast, enigmatic sea is not easy, especially in such a mystical world.
"It’s not really troublesome," Chen Fangjie hesitated slightly, "As you might already know, our Chen Family’s merchant ships travel to the Hundred Islands Guard once a month, transporting mostly goods. Besides the crew quarters, there are a dozen cabins reserved for passengers. The overall conditions are rather basic. If you insist on going, I can make room for a few slots, and we could depart this afternoon, reaching the Hundred Islands Guard by the morning after tomorrow, but our ship can only stay there for five days."
A sea voyage requires a significant investment, and the costs are high. The routes, tides, and weather all need careful calculation and assessment.
Wang Shouzhe, of course, would not be rude enough to request a separate voyage exclusively for himself and immediately expressed complete acceptance, and asked Chen Fangjie to arrange for three cabins.
Since the itinerary was confirmed, Chen Fangjie naturally agreed without further ado.
Subsequently, guided by the reception boat, Uncle Wang Dinghai’s ship docked, while Ancestor Longyan and others remained on board for the time being. Wang Shouzhe accompanied Chen Fangjie to pay a visit to the Chen Family’s current Clan Leader, Chen Dewei, following proper rituals.
Chen Dewei welcomed Wang Shouzhe with the appropriate etiquette and expressed gratitude for the Wang Family’s advance notice about the honey bee pest outbreak. Though the Chen Family didn’t primarily rely on agriculture, with only two small farms totaling three or four thousand acres, the early warning helped minimize their overall losses.
Meanwhile, Chen Fangjie swiftly made arrangements for Wang Shouzhe’s sea journey and introduced a few Chen Family members who would be traveling with him, instructing them to take good care of Wang Shouzhe and his party.
Since Wang Shouzhe declined the offer to be escorted onto the ship, Chen Fangjie handed him a small booklet before departure, containing information and intelligence about the various forces at the Hundred Islands Guard.
Not long after, at East Port Deepwater Port, Wang Shouzhe and his group quietly boarded a sea vessel named "Junyao." The ship was named after the Chen Family’s Ancestor Junyao, to deter any unscrupulous thoughts.
After boarding, a Chen Family member named Chen Fanghua courteously led them to their cabins.
Chen Fanghua, the clan cousin of Young Clan Leader Chen Fangjie, was only twenty-five but had already reached the high stage of the fifth layer in the Qi Refining Realm, making him an elite among the Chen Family’s younger generation.
The three cabins were connected, with one reserved as a high-class room for esteemed guests.
The ability to allocate a high-class room in such haste showed just how much Chen Fangjie valued Wang Shouzhe, handling matters diligently.
"Thank you, Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe said, cupping his hands to Chen Fanghua, "Please take care of us along the way."
"Not at all, not at all," Chen Fanghua replied promptly, "You are the esteemed guests of the Young Clan Leader, hence guests of our Chen Family. Please feel free to ask me for anything you need."
He then took his leave, as preparations for the ship’s departure were reaching their busiest time.
To avoid drawing too much attention, Wang Shouzhe asked Chen Fangjie to keep his identity confidential, so the Chen Family members on board only knew him as the esteemed guest of the Young Clan Leader.
Once they were alone.
Wang Shouzhe respectfully addressed Ancestor Longyan, "Ancestor, I apologize for having you travel on a merchant ship. Chartering a ship would not only be costly, but it wouldn’t be as straightforward and simple."
"It’s no bother. Shouzhe, your arrangements are well thought out," Ancestor Longyan replied calmly, without joy or sorrow, "For the journey to the Hundred Islands Guard, it’s best to go quietly and return swiftly."
"Fourth Aunt, please look after Ancestor and ensure she gets some rest," Wang Shouzhe requested of Xu Zhirou, "This trip will take over twenty hours, so please don’t let Ancestor get too tired."
"Rest assured, Shouzhe, I will take good care of Ancestor," Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou responded solemnly, then helped Ancestor Longyan into the high-class room.
The high-class room was divided into inner and outer sections to allow distinguished guests and their accompanists to rest separately.
Just as Wang Lici was about to cheerfully follow them inside, Wang Shouzhe called her back. "Big Girl, come with me—I have a few things to discuss with you."
"Yes, Fourth Uncle."
Wang Lici’s heart trembled—had she done something wrong again? She immediately followed Wang Shouzhe despondently into the adjacent room.
Wang Shouzhe, seeing her expression, flicked her forehead good-naturedly. "What kind of expression is that? I’m your Fourth Uncle, not some demon ready to eat you."
Wang Lici quickly changed her expression, mustering a slightly guilty but ingratiating dry smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Hundred Islands Golden Sand
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Chapter 46: Hundred Islands Golden Sand
...
Such a provoking expression made the corners of Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitch twice. He took a few deep breaths to stabilize his emotions before waving his hand and saying, "Alright, alright, you didn’t do anything wrong, sit down and let’s talk."
Wang Lici immediately found a chair and sat down, barely perching on it, putting on an obedient look, ready to listen to her fourth uncle’s teachings.
"I can see that Ancestor really likes you." Wang Shouzhe said, "While on the ship, talk to Ancestor more, keep her happy."
Oh, is that all? As long as I’m not getting scolded, that’s good.
Wang Lici relaxed from her tense state and repeatedly nodded in agreement. She shifted her seat slightly towards the back of the chair to sit properly, habitually pulling out a piece of candied fruit to calm her nerves, and then complacently started eating it.
Such a carefree demeanor made Wang Shouzhe’s eyelids twitch uncontrollably.
With that, he nonchalantly pulled out two books from his arms and tossed them to her: "This is the ’Selected Poems of Longzuo’ and ’Cuiju Mountain Hermit’s Pen Talk,’ books your fourth uncle just bought at East Port. They say they have quite a bit of literary depth."
He paused and added, "This morning I heard you reciting the famous piece ’Ascending to Celestial Mist to View the Vault of Heaven’ with much emotion and rhythm, it seems you’re quite good at literature. Why not quickly get familiar with these two books, and recite them to Ancestor to relieve her boredom. Ancestor loves hardworking children, I’m sure she’ll be very happy."
"Huh?"
Wang Lici widened her eyes, momentarily forgetting to chew the candied fruit in her mouth, her slightly chubby face full of shock. Fourth, Fourth Uncle... Are you the devil?
"Hmm, your look of surprise and delight makes your fourth uncle very pleased." Wang Shouzhe said kindly, "Do you like it?"
Tears rolled down Wang Lici’s cheeks, but she could only hold back her grievance and forced a ’joyful’ smile, chokingly saying, "Th-thank you, Fourth Uncle, I like it very much..."
"Lici, seeing you so moved to tears, shows that your fourth uncle’s good intentions didn’t go to waste." Wang Shouzhe patted her head apologetically, "I admit, it’s partly my fault for the rushed journey, only managing to buy two books. Later, when we reach the Hundred Islands Guard, I’ll be sure to buy you several more. Who knows, maybe our family will produce a literary giant someday."
Wang Lici felt utterly defeated, feeling like the colors of life had drifted far away, leaving only a gray haze before her.
Fortunately, there was still candied fruit.
The sweet taste in her mouth seemed to be the only bright spot, a source of hope, in her otherwise gray future.
"By the way." Wang Shouzhe frowned again, "Candied treats are fine to have occasionally, but too much can harm your teeth and lead to weight gain, just look at your round face. Hand them over, your fourth uncle will keep them for you."
Boom!
This statement struck Wang Lici like lightning, releasing an uncontrollable gush of tears. She reluctantly pulled out one bag of candied fruit.
"Is that all?"
Then she pulled out another bag.
"Hehe~"
And another bag.
After taking out a total of five bags, Wang Lici clutched the two books and, bursting into tears, said, "No more, there really isn’t. Fourth Uncle, it’s getting late, I, I’ll go read now..."
Then she dashed away as if escaping from a sea of knives and flames.
Only after she ran out, did Wang Shouzhe chuckle, feeling fully satisfied, brewing a pot of tea to enjoy. Little girl, is there any way your fourth uncle can’t handle you?
Teaching a wayward niece was just a small episode.
After taking a short break to clear his mind, Wang Shouzhe took out the small booklet given to him by his future brother-in-law Chen Fangjie and began to read slowly. Although the Wang Family had heard of the Hundred Islands Guard, there wasn’t much related intelligence documented within the clan, and the information was relatively outdated.
The East Port Chen Family had more contact with the Hundred Islands Guard, so their intelligence was naturally more detailed. This small booklet recorded information about the forces, families, situation, and characters to avoid provoking within the Hundred Islands Guard.
The more Wang Shouzhe read the booklet, the more surprised he became; the forces of the Hundred Islands Guard were indeed much more intricate than those of the Changning Guard, starting with the dozens of large and small noble families.
Some of those families were relatively weak, occupying just one island alone. Others were powerful, spanning several or even dozens of islands.
The main island is called Golden Sand Island. It is said that a thousand years ago, this island was rich in gold sand, which sparked bloody competitions among some Black Tortoise Clans. The Daqian Government Office dispatched experts to strongly suppress the conflict, and stability was only achieved after the establishment of the Hundred Islands Guard. After several hundred years, the gold sand had been completely mined, and some remaining Black Tortoise Clans fragmented the Hundred Islands, gradually leading to the current situation.
Due to the complex and remote geography of the Hundred Islands Guard, and the depletion of gold sand, the Daqian Government Office’s control power here has gradually weakened. Therefore, there are often some Loose Cultivators wanted for crimes, expelled descendants of Noble Families, or some pirates and bandits seeking to launder their identities who venture into the Hundred Islands Guard.
Fortunately, the East Port Chen Family has been operating on the main island of Golden Sand in the Hundred Islands Guard for many years, with extensive connections and a solid foundation. With the Chen Family’s protection, ordinary people do not dare to easily provoke them.
As long as you don’t recklessly cause trouble, the safety issue isn’t very significant. Otherwise, Chen Fangjie definitely wouldn’t dare let Wang Shouzhe go to the Hundred Islands Guard. If something major happened, how could Chen Fangjie bear the consequences?
Although the Hundred Islands Guard is chaotic, it has also given rise to some unique industries not found elsewhere.
For example, the black market!
The Golden Sand Black Market is one of the two industries owned by Celestial Human Families in the Hundred Islands Guard, with a history of two hundred years. In the black market, all identities can be disguised and hidden. As long as you have money, you can buy whatever you want in the most secret way, or secretly sell your items or even contraband and stolen goods!
The black market doesn’t care about who you are or where your money and items come from. They only maintain order, reputation, and take commissions.
The fundamental reason a black market can survive is because of its order and reputation.
Since people who visit the black market are often very sensitive to exposing their identities and origins, any little sign of trouble would make them hesitant. It can be seen that for the Golden Sand Black Market to stand for two hundred years and grow in scale, it must highly value reputation and order.
Upon seeing this news about the black market.
Wang Shouzhe felt a vague suspicion in his heart. Ancestor Longyan was likely heading for the black market, and using his wisdom, Wang Shouzhe mostly deduced her intentions for this trip.
His brow immediately furrowed, as this was something he did not want to see. After getting off the ship, he’d need to talk with Ancestor Longyan, as some things simply didn’t need to reach that point.
However, she is the Ancestor after all, and once she has made up her mind to do something, she probably has thought it over for a long time. How could he persuade her otherwise?
Wang Shouzhe’s expression grew heavier as his fingers tapped the table in rapid thought.
Time passed little by little.
More than twenty hours flashed by, and the gigantic merchant ship docked at the deep-water port of Golden Sand Island in the Hundred Islands Guard.
Wang Shouzhe and his party disembarked from the Junyao, inhaling the strong scent of the sea breeze. Speaking of which, the Junyao merchant ship was quite stable at sea, making the journey to the Hundred Islands Guard safely and without incident.
At this time, a Chen Family member, Chen Fanghua, came forward, respectfully cupping his hands and saying, "Young Master Wang, as per the Young Clan Leader’s instructions before departure, I am here to arrange accommodations and a guide for you and your party."
Wang Shouzhe chuckled inwardly, guessing that his future brother-in-law was worried he would wander around the island and face danger, so he specially arranged for family members to even organize his accommodations and itinerary.
"In that case, I trouble Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe said. Unfamiliar with Golden Sand Island, it was best to have someone arranging matters for him. Moreover, it was important to accept Chen Fangjie’s future brother-in-law’s thoughtful gesture.
Knowing that "Young Master Wang" had female companions, Chen Fanghua specially arranged for a carriage, and Ancestor Longyan, the fourth aunt, and the Big Girl all got on. Wang Shouzhe, along with Household Generals Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, were assigned three fine horses.
Afterwards, Chen Fanghua led a Household General, guiding Wang Shouzhe’s party toward the inner city of Golden Sand Island.
As they walked, Chen Fanghua chatted with Wang Shouzhe about the local customs of Golden Sand Island, for example, how despite being the largest island in the Hundred Islands Guard, because the land had many rocks and other impurities, very few arable lands could be developed.
"So, half of the cargo we shipped consisted of grain products and various meats and poultry, as well as some daily necessities. These ordinary items actually bring decent profits in the Hundred Islands Guard," Chen Fanghua openly shared these well-known business facts, clearly wanting to get closer to Wang Shouzhe.
"Isn’t it against Daqian Law to speculate on grain?" Wang Shouzhe asked curiously.
"Young Master Wang, the Daqian Law doesn’t hold much sway in the Hundred Islands Guard." Chen Fanghua replied with a smile. "Moreover, we’re not speculating on grain; we’re bartering goods. Although the Hundred Islands Guard’s grain yield is low, it has an abundance of sea treasures and lime. Transporting these inland can still yield a small profit."
Wang Shouzhe also knew that in such times, sea trade was bound to be very profitable, but it was also very challenging and risky. Building a merchant ship was not only expensive but also required deep expertise.
Furthermore, training maritime shipbuilders and professional seafarers was also incredibly difficult. Even the slightest mistake could lead to the loss of a ship, resulting in a complete loss.
Thus, for ordinary families to cross over into the sea trading sector was almost impossible. It’s no wonder that the East Port Chen Family had grown stronger over a mere century.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Turn the Tables! Ancestor Longyan
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47: Turn the Tables! Ancestor Longyan
...
"What is Lihui?" Wang Shouzhe set aside his thoughts on sea merchants and asked curiously.
"Lihui is a building material made from oysters, shells, and such, processed through kiln burning and other methods," replied Chen Fanghua. "When mixed with river sand in the right proportions, it can bond bricks and stones effectively, making them as hard as a single piece. It’s often used in noble families or government office city walls. Because its production is limited, it’s not cheap. It’s normal for you, Young Master Wang, to be unfamiliar with such basic building materials, considering your noble background."
"I see," Wang Shouzhe expressed his realization, delighted, "It’s true that traveling ten thousand miles is better than reading ten thousand books; I have gained much knowledge."
It sounded like a variant of cement? Wang Shouzhe pondered slightly, wondering why he hadn’t thought of cement before. If it could be developed, even if not sold externally for now, it would greatly benefit the family’s infrastructure.
However, when it comes to producing cement, Wang Shouzhe only had a vague idea. But as long as there is a general direction and willingness to invest manpower and funds, it’s only a matter of time before it’s developed.
Moreover, concrete-structured buildings are very sturdy, whether for constructing houses or creating hydraulic facilities, enhancing the overall safety of the family.
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe incorporated the cement industry into future research plans.
"Young Master Wang, the Hundred Islands Guard is best known for its sea delicacies," Chen Fanghua introduced, "fresh sea treasures are very difficult to store and transport, so most that are transported inland are dried and preserved. It’s best to enjoy sea treasures while they’re fresh. Today, I will arrange for Young Master Wang to sample some..."
"Thank you for your kindness, Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe declined, "It’s just that the journey at sea was tiring, and my family members are already a bit fatigued. How about we rest for a few days, and then I’ll host a banquet to thank Brother Chen?"
He and Ancestor Longyan didn’t travel far to the Hundred Islands Guard just to eat some delicious sea treasures. Moreover, Wang Shouzhe had a lot to discuss with Ancestor Longyan.
"Then let’s follow Young Master Wang’s wishes. But the Young Clan Leader has ordered us to entertain the esteemed guests well, so please don’t make it difficult for me; allow our Chen Family to host," Chen Fanghua said with a smile.
Then they chatted as they walked.
Soon, they entered Golden Sand City within the Hundred Islands Guard. The city stood on the island, using locally sourced rocks, very rugged. Wang Shouzhe paid particular attention, noting that a greyish white lime material filled the gaps between the rocks, which should be the Lihui mentioned by Chen Fanghua.
Even the main city wall used Lihui, demonstrating that the bond strength of the Lihui mixed with sand is very high. But who knows how it compares to cement concrete?
This question could only be answered once Wang Shouzhe "develops" cement; let’s set it aside for now.
Entering Golden Sand City, the group temporarily stayed at a premium inn. With Chen Fanghua, the "Local Bully," in charge, they smoothly arranged a large compound for Wang Shouzhe’s group to stay.
The compound had seven or eight rooms, and the environment was elegant, enough for everyone.
Wang Shouzhe and the others went to their rooms to rest. He also took a bath first. After resting for more than half an hour, he went to visit Ancestor Longyan next door.
Standing at her door, he knocked softly and called, "Ancestor, Shouzhe seeks an audience."
A moment later, Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou opened the door and said, "Shouzhe, Ancestor invites you in."
"Fourth Aunt, Big Girl. You’ve had a tiring journey too; please rest first. I have matters to discuss with Ancestor," Wang Shouzhe said after entering the room.
"Yes, Shouzhe." Xu Zhirou gave a brief bow, then led the still confused Wang Lici away, closing the door behind them.
After they left, Wang Shouzhe walked steadily to Ancestor Longyan, bowing and greeting, "Shouzhe greets Ancestor, sorry to disturb your peace."
Ancestor Longyan’s eyes were calm as a still water, glancing at Wang Shouzhe, and said indifferently, "Shouzhe, you seem serious and solemn. Are you here to persuade me not to sell the spiritual artifact?"
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but smile bitterly. Ancestor Longyan was indeed straightforward. But he had already weighed the matter in his heart, so he stated seriously, "Having reviewed the Hundred Islands Guard intelligence data, I found there’s a famous black market on Golden Sand Island and cautiously guessed Ancestor’s purpose for this trip. However, Shouzhe has some doubts; is Ancestor intending to sell the Longyan Sword, or the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield?"
Ancestor Longyan’s gaze remained unfazed as she replied, "The Turtle Scale Treasure Shield is useless to me."
Wang Shouzhe’s body trembled, his heart bitter beyond measure; it was indeed the worst of his numerous guesses. Ancestor spoke that the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield was useless, which meant the Longyan Sword still had use.
The Treasure Shield defends, the Spirit Sword attacks; without a doubt, she abandoned defense in favor of attack.
"Shouzhe dares to speculate on Ancestor’s intentions, if incorrect, I ask Ancestor to correct," Wang Shouzhe pondered, "Ancestor wishes to sell the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield to provide resources for Shouzhe to ascend the Spirit Platform Realm. Someday, once Shouzhe ascends the Spirit Platform Realm, Ancestor will strike, taking either the Ancestor Spirit Platform of the Zhao Family or the Liu Family to secure the family’s future!"
By the end, Wang Shouzhe’s voice was somewhat trembling.
Ancestor Longyan remained silent for a moment, her ethereal gaze still unstirred, and only after a considerable pause did she slowly shake her head, "Shouzhe guessed wrong."
Guessed wrong?
Wang Shouzhe’s heart relaxed instead, joy creeping onto his brows; luckily Ancestor Longyan had some sense...
Unexpectedly, Ancestor Longyan calmly said, "If I wait until then, I fear I shall be powerless to act further."
"Ancestor..." Wang Shouzhe’s expression changed, wanting to speak but was stopped by Ancestor Longyan, who said, "Shouzhe, I know you care for me, but I know my own injuries, can’t hold on..."
The pain in her brows flashed and disappeared, returning to a tranquil state, her voice ethereal and elusive, "I, Wang Longyan, am not one to linger in weakness until incapable of killing before dying slowly. Rather, with some strength left, I’d rather shine brightly like fireworks. I shall take those two thieves of the Zhao Family and Liu Family together, Shouzhe, you can rest assured."
Rest assured?
Rest assured my soul!
Wang Shouzhe’s heart trembled, truly wanting to curse. Ancestor Longyan’s plan was too crazy, must be stopped, he took a deep breath and said, "Ancestor, even if you succeed, the conventional forces of Zhao Family and Liu Family are stronger than our Wang Family!"
"There is the Liua Family," Ancestor Longyan calmly said.
Liua Family... right, Wang Shouzhe remembered, Miss Liua was his fiancée. So that’s it, Ancestor Longyan personally went to the Liua Family to propose, finding a way to make this marriage happen, had already drawn up this plan. If the two are married, the Liua Family will certainly not sit idly by against Liu Family and Zhao Family remnants.
"Then so be it," Wang Shouzhe said solemnly, "On my wedding night is the best opportunity to act. First, Zhao Family and Liu Family would never expect Ancestor to suddenly act on my wedding night. Second, at that time our Wang Family will have guests gathering, Liu Family and Zhao Family dare not retaliate."
Ancestor Longyan’s frail body quivered slightly, then she slowly shook her head, "This plan is ominous for you, not beneficial to your reputation, don’t mention it again."
Wang Shouzhe laughed, "If Ancestor can sacrifice life for the family, what do I, Shouzhe, as a mere junior, have to fear?"
"You are still young, the family’s greatest hope for the future," Ancestor Longyan said lightly, "when I die in battle, the Longyan Sword will be passed to you. You must take my body to the Purple Mansion Academy and give it to my master, Binglan Ascendant, saying that I, Wang Longyan, lived willfully for half my life, failing my master’s grace, hoping to return to the sect after death."
She called Wang Shouzhe to Hundred Islands Guard with her, not intending to truly hide from him, after all, this matter requires his cooperation.
"I understand," Wang Shouzhe solemnly cupped his hands.
"You, no longer persuade?" Ancestor Longyan found it somewhat strange, according to her original conception, with Shouzhe’s filial nature, he would surely plead arduously, she had already prepared to suppress with an Ancestor’s authority.
"If no other variables arise, Ancestor’s plan is the only plan to allow Wang Family to quickly turn the tables," Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "Ancestor’s injuries are clearly reaching an uncontrollable stage, with Ancestor’s proud and unparalleled nature, how could you endure lying in bed suffering and dying in misery? Dying gloriously and splendidly in battle, not only can relieve the family’s predicament but also let the world remember your unparalleled charm, is naturally the best choice."
"Indeed, I, Wang Longyan, loathe dithering and nagging the most in this life," in Ancestor Longyan’s eyes as calm as still water, a fervor flashed, "Shouzhe, your understanding is the thing that gratifies me the most."
"Ancestor, my premise is, if no other variables, your plan is the best choice," Wang Shouzhe said with a relaxed smile, "I also have a plan, the ultimate goal is—for me, Wang Shouzhe, to ascend the Spirit Platform Realm as the pillar of the family, while Ancestor Longyan you settle your own matters, since you feel remorse for your master, then go and apologize to your master yourself."
"What?" Even with Ancestor Longyan’s control over her state of mind, she was shocked beyond measure, her eyes revealing a look of disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 Ancestor Longyan’s Injuries
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48 Ancestor Longyan’s Injuries
...
However, Ancestor Longyan, after all, has lived for over a century and has experienced highs and lows.
In just a few breaths, she adjusted her emotions, her gaze becoming calm: "Shouzhe, I admit you are excellent, able to use the insect disaster to profit greatly from it. But this little bit of money is undoubtedly a drop in the bucket if you want to heal my injuries."
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe was not disappointed, but rather delighted: "Hearing Ancestor’s tone, is there still a chance to treat your injuries?"
"It’s difficult, as difficult as ascending to heaven." Ancestor Longyan said calmly, "Even if the Wang Race were to bankrupt itself, it would still be far from enough. Therefore, Shouzhe, you should not entertain such notions. It’s best to keep your money to accelerate your sprint to the peak of the Qi Refining Realm."
There is naturally difficulty, otherwise the Wang Race could not have ignored Ancestor’s injuries, the cost would inevitably be beyond what selling land and assets could afford.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression was serious, retreating to advance: "So, Ancestor, could you please detail the difficulties so that I can give up entirely on this matter."
"Very well, if I don’t make it clear to you, you might not give up." Ancestor Longyan’s eyes softened considerably, she could see that Shouzhe genuinely cared for her, his ancestor. She said gently, "Back then, the Spirit Platform Realm who conspired with the Zhao Family and the Liu Family wasn’t simple. That person possessed pure Yin Sha Power, likely associated with the Yin Sha Sect in the Land of the Far West. I guess he committed something and was hiding from assassination, thus concealing his identity, pretending to be a loose cultivator and mixing in with the Liu and Zhao Families."
"Yin Sha Sect?" With Wang Shouzhe’s knowledge, he naturally hadn’t heard of this name.
"It’s an evil sect, its overall strength not weaker than the Purple Mansion Academy." Ancestor Longyan’s star eyes grew a bit more solemn, "Others only know the Zhao Family and Liu Family have wolfish ambitions, but when I fought them, I discovered this person might be the mastermind behind them. Thus, during the fierce battle, despite the danger, I relied on higher cultivation and two Spirit Treasures to forcibly kill him on the spot. Little did I expect the disciple of Yin Sha Sect was indeed formidable, his final counterattack cost me dearly."
Even though this battle of life and death happened fifty years ago, Ancestor Longyan still vividly recalled it.
And Wang Shouzhe was also secretly shocked, realizing this mystical world was far larger and more complex than he imagined, fully believing Ancestor Longyan only revealed a corner of it.
"At that time, the Shield Seal of the Turtle Scale Armor Shield was already broken, I endured his full-force Yin Sha Palm." Ancestor Longyan’s eyes grew slightly cold, "This palm was extremely sinister, heavily injuring my internal organs, and the Yin Sha Power further eroded my five viscera and lungs. No matter how I expel it, it clings on like maggot, unable to disperse, leading to my difficult-to-heal injuries."
Wang Shouzhe shivered inwardly, previously underestimating this mystical world. In reality, this world was so dangerous, and battles were not like those fantasy novels where protagonists had myriad secret techniques and numerous lives to waste, willing to "fight to the death" over mere words, life and death fights become "a daily occurrence," and more exaggeratedly, becoming a part of daily life.
Indeed, it’s laughably absurd.
Any battle has the possibility of unexpected occurrences, fifty years ago that deadly battle was an unexpected life cost for that mysterious Yin Sha Sect.
And for Ancestor Longyan, it was a lifetime of pain and torment.
Moreover, it left the Liu and Zhao Family ancestors with a huge psychological shadow, to this day they dare not overly press the Ping’an Wang Family, fearing Ancestor might, in a fit of anger, take one of them with her, disregarding her own life!
Every decision concerning battle must be cautious, considering potential accidents and whether one can bear them!
Back then, Ancestor Longyan had no choice but to fight, if she didn’t, the Wang Race would be finished.
"Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe took a deep breath and said, "Let’s talk about the treatment." After hearing about that battle, Wang Shouzhe was even more determined to help Ancestor Longyan, no matter how great the cost.
"My injuries have two huge problems." Ancestor Longyan said, "One, the Yin Poison that has been eroding for fifty years within me has grown increasingly sinister and difficult, and under the circumstances of its growth over my decline, I’ve gradually been unable to suppress it. Two, my five viscera and lungs are severely damaged, and because of the entanglement with the Yin Poison, they have never healed, worsened over time.
She paused then added: "To dispel such severe Yin Poison, one must rely on a Tier Three Pill, the Fire Yang Pill, to suppress and remove it."
"If it’s a Tier Three Pill, although they’re relatively rare, it might be possible to acquire them, right?" Wang Shouzhe frowned deeply, feeling it wouldn’t be that simple.
Usually, the price of Tier One Pills is tens or twenties of Qian Gold, Tier Two Pills are several dozen to over a hundred Qian Gold, Tier Three Pills range from several hundred to a thousand Qian Gold.
"Fire Yang Pill is a common Tier Three Pill, produced by many Alchemy Masters, not considered hard to find, about 300 Qian Gold to buy one." Ancestor Longyan’s eyes carried a hint of helplessness, "However, I need to take one each month, slowly suppressing and refining the Yin Poison. Moreover, the medicine must be taken long-term, if the Yin Poison can be completely eradicated within ten years it would be fortunate."
One pill per month? Wouldn’t that amount to 3600 Qian Gold a year?
Even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but gasp. In fact, before Wang Shouzhe traversed, the family’s entire industrial profitability couldn’t reach this number!
And this profitability could only barely sustain the entire family’s expenses, unable to even retain any surplus.
In fact, any family’s account yields are not small, but heritage expenditures are all very large. Even a relatively flourishing family like the Shanyang Gongsun Family typically, after deducting huge family expenses, rarely yields more than 1000 Qian Gold.
"Not only that, to counteract the Yin Sha Power, I must maintain good physical condition, spiritual food must be abundantly supplied each month, and I must also take Peiyuan Pill long-term to strengthen myself." Ancestor Longyan said, "This cost is at least 600 Qian Gold per year."
"Additionally, in the second year, I must acquire Tier Three Healing Saint Medicine, Creation Pill, to repair my damaged five viscera and lungs, the Creation Pill is much harder to obtain than the Fire Yang Pill, priced at 1000 Qian Gold each, amounting to 12,000 Qian Gold a year." Ancestor Longyan said calmly, "If fortunate, I might recover mostly after ten years and eleven, if miscalculated, it needs extending further by two to three years."
After detailing all this, Ancestor Longyan’s gaze actually became somewhat relieved, she understood her tribe’s feelings for her, in the past, how the young generation longed to help treat her?
Simply unaffordable, forcing treatment would bankrupt the Wang Race and still not heal. Forget the Wang Race, even the Shanyang Gongsun Family, Shanyin Liu Family faced with such an issue, likely cannot afford it.
Maybe the Changning Xu Family could barely afford it, but the whole treatment process would inevitably lead to severe damage to their family resources.
Back then, she saw the despair and helplessness in her tribe’s eyes, as well as their agony. If not for Shouzhe insisting, she truly didn’t want him to experience this too.
"What you’re saying is, Ancestor’s injuries don’t require huge resources right away, but can be periodically invested for gradual treatment." Wang Shouzhe calculated rapidly with bright eyes, "First year’s full investment would be about 4100 Qian Gold, with additional 12,000 Qian Gold costs starting from the second year! The total treatment cost is approximately more than ten thousand Qian Gold. Good, good, good!
"Good, good, good!?" Ancestor Longyan’s eyes were somewhat puzzled, the situation was dire, the burden enough to make one despair and helpless, yet Shouzhe was cheering?
"Please don’t misunderstand, Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe calmed his emotions and said, "The reason I’m saying ’good’ is because the actual situation is simpler than I estimated."
Yet inside, he felt a bit sentimental, regardless of which world, illness was unaffordable. On Earth, so many decent families were depleted because of a family member’s serious illness.
Unexpectedly, the mystical world was the same!
"Simple?" Ancestor Longyan’s figure trembled slightly, shouldn’t there be hopelessness?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Venting Anger for the Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49: Venting Anger for the Ancestor
...
What Wang Shouzhe mentioned as simple was relatively simple, which was much easier than suddenly coming up with hundreds of thousands of Qian Gold.
In fact, even asking him to earn an extra ten or twenty thousand Qian Gold in the next year wasn’t an easy task. It required careful planning and strategy. But the Ancestor had to be saved; he didn’t want to see the Ancestor, who had protected the family for half of her life, die tragically.
Moreover, Ancestor Longyan was a powerhouse in battle. Once she regained her strength, how could the ancestors of the Liu Family and Zhao Family possibly compete with her?
Thinking of this.
Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and said, "Please rest assured, Ancestor. Leave this matter to me."
This time he had planned on buying some things at the Hundred Islands Guard. For this reason, he carried plenty of Qian Gold Tickets, with a full thousand of them. Safety was not a concern, as traveling with the Ancestor ensured great security.
Should a situation arise where even the Ancestor couldn’t handle it, then so be it.
"Shouzhe..." Ancestor Longyan had her doubts. In her view, Wang Shouzhe profiting greatly was due to the circumstances and his luck. Such opportunities wouldn’t always be present.
"Ancestor, hold off on your plans for now. Let me prove myself in a year, and give yourself a chance to turn things around," Wang Shouzhe said confidently. With his insight and mindset as a Transmigrator, he wouldn’t earn money slowly.
A year later, the Ancestor would fully understand.
Faced with Wang Shouzhe’s strong confidence, Ancestor Longyan finally nodded slowly, agreeing: "However, the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield is useless to me. Selling it will help you gather some resources."
Wang Shouzhe did not oppose this decision. It was the Ancestor’s spiritual artifact, and she had the right to decide its use. Besides, Wang Shouzhe believed that in the future he could afford spiritual artifacts, and could even buy a better one for the Ancestor.
Having convinced the Ancestor, he temporarily withdrew.
Everyone rested for the night.
Early the next morning, Wang Shouzhe invited Chen Fanghua over and asked him to lead everyone on a tour of Golden Sand City. It was a chance to relax, and Wang Shouzhe could also assess the overall market of the Hundred Islands Guard. Even gaining some knowledge would be beneficial.
Chen Fanghua was very familiar with Golden Sand City and had good eloquence. As he led everyone on a leisurely tour, he introduced the local customs from time to time, which broadened Wang Shouzhe’s horizons. In a good mood, he bought some dried fish snacks for Wang Lici to eat.
The girl, once she had something to eat, forgot all her worries and looked at Wang Shouzhe with immense gratitude.
"Young Master Wang, through here is the street for Loose Cultivators," Chen Fanghua introduced, "Most cities will have a designated street where Loose Cultivators can set up stalls. It allows the city to earn some booth fees and prevents Loose Cultivators from setting up booths haphazardly."
Wang Shouzhe understood; places like Changning Guard had similar setups. He had even stumbled upon a honeycomb there. Yet finding a bargain among Loose Cultivator stalls was a rare event; it was more likely to be deceived or pay a high price for something of little value.
The so-called Heavenly and Earthly Treasures and Divine Skill Manuals were all greatly exaggerated, each more impressive than the last. Wang Shouzhe was just browsing casually, extending his knowledge. With his current insight, finding a genuine bargain was nearly impossible.
However, there were noticeably more Loose Cultivators here on Golden Sand Island than in Changning Guard City, and their strength was generally higher. Along the way, Wang Shouzhe had already encountered three or four whose aura he couldn’t perceive, clearly indicating they had a cultivation higher than his. It seemed the opportunities around Golden Sand Island were more abundant than those at Changning Guard, attracting more capable Loose Cultivators to try their luck.
If someone stronger than him didn’t burst out with their aura, Wang Shouzhe found it difficult to see through them.
Suddenly!
Ancestor Longyan, who had been silent all along, stopped in her tracks. Her gaze swept over a stall managed by a Loose Cultivator, her brow slightly furrowed, and her body seemed to tremble uncontrollably.
Not understanding the situation, Wang Shouzhe stepped across and stood between Ancestor Longyan and the Loose Cultivator, diverting the latter’s attention. With a cheerful demeanor, he said, "These pearls of yours aren’t bad. How much for all of them?"
A major customer!
The Loose Cultivator’s attention was immediately drawn to Wang Shouzhe. He quickly introduced, "These pearls, rich in Spiritual Qi, are Spiritual Material Pearls that I harvested myself from sea clams. They’re prime materials for Tier Two Spirit Pill ’Beauty Pill.’ There are thirteen in total, and I’ll offer them for thirty Qian Gold."
Seeing Wang Shouzhe’s outstanding attire and the Household Generals accompanying him, the Loose Cultivator dared not show disrespect.
"10 Qian Gold," Wang Shouzhe began to haggle. The vendor was firm on the price, and the two started wrangling over the cost. Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe was left puzzled. The Ancestor, usually so composed, showed such a significant change in emotions, indicating she encountered a major event.
Could it be she discovered a great bargain opportunity at this stall?
While covering for her, Wang Shouzhe awaited Ancestor Longyan’s instruction or action.
