Ancestor Longyan, after all, wasn’t an ordinary person and quickly regained her composure. Her lips moved slightly under the veil as she conveyed her intentions to Wang Shouzhe.
The message she conveyed, even with Wang Shouzhe’s mindset as a transmigrator, made him slightly stunned. However, he controlled his emotional changes and continued to haggle over the price while pondering how to proceed.
Bargaining is a very normal thing. For loose cultivators, involving ten Qian Gold is already a substantial sum.
Soon, Wang Shouzhe settled on a strategy, got up, and said displeasedly, "Forget it, this young master will check out other places." Then, despite the stall owner’s attempts to retain him, Wang Shouzhe led everyone out of the loose cultivator street.
"Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands, "My eldest niece and fourth aunt are a bit tired, could you please take them to the restaurant ahead to eat something good? Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, please go and protect Miss Lici and Lady Zhirou."
"Yes." The two household generals responded in unison.
Chen Fanghua was astute and realized at once that he was being sent away, perhaps they had discovered something they didn’t want him to see. He immediately returned the gesture and said, "Young Master Wang, rest assured, I will definitely take good care of both lady and madam."
Xu Zhirou’s eyes welled up slightly, but eventually, she said nothing. Instead, it was Wang Lici, who, hearing about going to eat something delicious, drooled with delight and suddenly felt a surge of goodwill towards Wang Shouzhe, thinking, woo woo~ Lici misunderstood fourth uncle, after all, fourth uncle still loves me...
After everyone left, only Wang Shouzhe and Ancestor Longyan remained. Once they moved to a secluded place, Wang Shouzhe’s face turned extremely serious, and he said in a low voice, "Ancestor, can you be sure about this matter?"
"There’s no mistake." Ancestor Longyan’s voice was cold and carried an indescribable hatred, "I’ve been tortured by this evil poison day and night for fifty years, and not a trace of Yin Fiend Qi can escape my detection."
Wang Shouzhe was startled, his heart now certain. He immediately said in a low voice, "Ancestor, the forces in the Land of the Far West, their tentacles have gradually appeared in our Changning Guard. I fear the matter isn’t so simple. Perhaps there is a greater power behind them... If we want revenge, I’m afraid..."
Currently, the Wang Family is too weak. Regardless of what the other side is plotting, once involved, it will inevitably be a situation of fragmentation.
Ancestor Longyan deeply loved the family and naturally calmed down, with her eyes revealing a thick sense of helplessness, the overall strength is too weak, even incapable of seeking revenge.
"Please endure for a while, Ancestor, until your injuries heal, the strength of our Wang Family will also grow significantly stronger." Wang Shouzhe said solemnly, "We will take our time seeking this revenge! However, it’s feasible to give the Ancestor some relief now."
Originally, Ancestor Longyan was a bit disappointed, but upon hearing this, her eyes lit up and she said in a low voice, "Shouzhe, what are you planning to do?"
...
By dusk, the sky was getting dark. The vendors on the loose cultivator street began to pack their stalls one after another. The loose cultivator selling sea pearls was also about to close up, as it was normal for things not to sell for several days.
At this time, a rough-looking man in his thirties or forties, with a scruffy beard, appeared in front of the stall, and in a commanding manner, said, "I want all these pearls."
While paying, he "accidentally" exposed a small stack of gold notes, and the golden brilliance of those notes was highly seductive. It was clear each note was a large 100 Qian Gold bill, and just at a glance, the total couldn’t be less than over a thousand Qian Gold.
The loose cultivator was taken aback, and his eyes were filled with greed. For the Black Tortoise Clan with an established foundation, over a thousand Qian Gold is already a massive sum, let alone for a loose cultivator.
The ensuing storyline progressed naturally. The loose cultivator, eyeing the rough man, enthusiastically invited him for food and drink. A few drinks down, he had already learned about the rough man’s general "background," having "made some money" elsewhere before recently arriving at the Hundred Islands Guard to lay low.
After a feast of wining and dining, the two became so close that it seemed as though they had sworn brotherhood. After eating and drinking their fill, the rough man suggested if there was a place to "have some fun." The loose cultivator assured him he’d find a good place, and after settling the bill, he led the rough man through the streets and alleys.
Ultimately, in a remote and secluded alley corner, the "loose cultivator" revealed his sinister fangs. At the peak of the Qi Refining Realm Seventh Layer, he even brought along a partner at the Qi Refining Realm Sixth Layer just to deal with a lowly Fourth Layer.
This way, it was naturally foolproof.
Unfortunately, the mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.
As they grinned greedily and attacked the drunken "rough man," a misty sword light suddenly appeared in a stealthy ambush, instantly cutting down the two men.
Those two fellows never expected there would be a Spirit Platform Realm expert using a Spiritual Artifact to ambush them. They had no time to react before they were slain. Seeing this left the rough man sweating profusely and trembling slightly.
"Ancestor, are you alright?" Wang Shouzhe hurried over from a bit further away, supporting the slightly disturbed-breathing Ancestor Longyan, asking with concern. His cultivation was half a notch weaker than that of the loose cultivator, so he didn’t dare be too close for fear of being discovered.
However, he was also secretly shocked that Ancestor Spirit Platform could use such an ambush method to deal with the Qi Refining Realm, which truly meant certain death for the Qi Refining Realm if unexpected.
"I’m fine. I’m doing well." Within a breath or two, Ancestor Longyan temporarily suppressed the backlash from the evil poison within, and her eyes slightly reddened, clearly relieved.
"Wang Zhong, quickly collect the spoils of war." Wang Shouzhe ordered Wang Zhong as they swiftly gathered the spoils of war, and then, along with the Ancestor, the three quickly disappeared into the dark alley.
Within a very short time, only two corpses were left in that dark alley.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 50 Longyan’s Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50 Longyan’s Decision
...
In just a moment.
In the side hall of the inn courtyard where Wang Shouzhe and his group stayed, Wang Zhong, who quickly changed his attire on the way, placed the collected spoils and the Qian Gold used as bait on the table, his voice slightly trembling as he said, "Patriarch, thankfully, I did not fail the mission."
Evidently, today’s event was overly thrilling and dangerous for the household general, Wang Zhong.
"Wang Zhong, you did well." Wang Shouzhe praised, then solemnly added, "However, you must remember to keep this matter confidential. It was this group of Ghost Realm bandits’ accomplices that injured Ancestor Longyan back then. We are exacting revenge and washing away the shame."
He was extremely satisfied with Wang Zhong’s overall execution of the mission. Among the two household generals he brought along, Wang Yong had better talent and strength, but for such a difficult task, Wang Zhong was the smarter and more composed choice.
Wang Zhong had grown up listening to legends of Ancestor Longyan and her contributions to the family, and he admired her greatly. His eyes immediately showed hatred: "These bandits are not worth keeping alive. Rest assured, Patriarch, this matter will die with me."
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe waved his hand grandly, rewarding him with 20 Qian Gold. Wang Zhong left in surprise and gratitude.
Once only Wang Shouzhe and Ancestor Longyan were left, Wang Shouzhe placed another batch of spoils on the table and began to examine them carefully.
Speaking of this operation, it was somewhat hasty and reckless for Wang Shouzhe, but it had to be done regardless. After all, it was a matter of venting Ancestor Longyan’s anger. She had been tormented by Yin Poison for a full fifty years. Who could imagine the suffering?
As for capturing that "loose cultivator" and interrogating about the mastermind behind the scenes, Wang Shouzhe had naturally considered it. However, the operation was too difficult, and the risk was excessively high, easily bringing disastrous consequences to the family. Moreover, even if they found out anything, what then? This "loose cultivator" was clearly a minor character, with the real culprit likely at the Spirit Platform Realm.
Such matters, if mishandled, would lead to the destruction of both family and home and could not be entangled with.
Ancestor Longyan expressed understanding as well. Being able to eliminate one of their claws was already enough to dissipate much of her anger, leaving her contented. Given her deep feelings for the family, she did not want Wang Shouzhe to overextend himself in taking risks.
"These are all common items: scattered Qian Gold, pearls, a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill, and assorted odds and ends. There’s no correspondence or identity seals." As Wang Shouzhe sorted through the spoils, he took out anything of value. Beyond the miscellaneous items, the most notable ones were an ancient thread-bound book and an item resembling a jade gourd.
The thread-bound book had no name. Upon opening it, it was found to be a manual on refining the Power of Heaven and Earth’s Yin Sha into one’s body and gradually transforming one’s profound qi into Yin Sha Attribute Profound Qi.
Besides, this book also recorded a unique secret technique, which was how to hide the Yin Sha aura within, making it appear to others as if one were an ordinary Black Tortoise Practitioner.
It goes to show that Ancestor Longyan’s sensitivity to Yin Sha Evil Qi was indeed keen, far surpassing those ordinary Spirit Platform Realm ancestors.
Yet upon seeing this book, Wang Shouzhe was momentarily stunned, his heart beat faster, giving rise to a thought, although this thought ultimately...
"Shouzhe, your expression shifts, hesitant, is there something you’ve discovered?" Ancestor Longyan, after slight adjustment, opened her captivating eyes and spoke.
Though she only killed two minor figures in the Qi Refining Realm, to prevent unexpected incidents, she both ambushed and fought with all her strength. It was still a bit uncomfortable for her.
"Ancestor, take a look at this book." Wang Shouzhe respectfully handed the book to the ancestor.
Initially, Ancestor Longyan looked at it calmly, but then her eyes also shifted in expression for a moment. After a while, she closed the book and contemplated, clearly moved greatly by this matter.
And Wang Shouzhe did not disturb her but stood quietly to the side, patiently waiting.
After another good while, Ancestor Longyan slowly opened her eyes, looking at Wang Shouzhe, and asked, "Shouzhe, what do you think?" With each performance, her regard for Wang Shouzhe grew, so in such a crucial matter, she wanted to hear his opinion.
After some consideration, Wang Shouzhe replied, "Before we make a decision, let’s first sort out the situation. This book, initially judged, should be a manual from the Yin Sha Sect given to some temporarily recruited outer disciples to refine Yin Sha Evil Qi and transform it into Yin Sha Profound Qi. It’s mostly a cultivation technique used to groom outer minions and doesn’t count as the Yin Sha Sect’s core cultivation method."
Ancestor Longyan nodded repeatedly in agreement. Indeed, if it were the Yin Sha Sect’s core cultivation method, it wouldn’t be so easily exposed.
Pausing for a moment, Wang Shouzhe continued, "But with such a rudimentary refining method, how confident is the ancestor?"
Ancestor Longyan steadied herself and said, "This Yin Sha refining method, although initial tier and meant for nurturing outer sect loose cultivators, still ultimately belongs to the Yin Sha Sect’s non-mainstream lineage and is no child’s play. For ordinary loose cultivators, without a deep understanding of Yin Sha Power, converting would not be too swift. But I... could do it quickly!"
Wang Shouzhe understood.
For fifty whole years, Ancestor Longyan had been tormented by Yin Poison, battling it day and night. The Yin Poison had spread throughout her organs and even her entire body.
Her understanding of Yin Poison surpassed not just those outer sect disciples of the Yin Sha Sect but even their inner sect disciples and core disciples.
"Ancestor’s hesitation means there are downsides." Wang Shouzhe contemplated aloud, "If the ancestor transforms into Yin Sha Power, the cultivation realm might be difficult to advance further."
"Indeed so." Ancestor Longyan agreed, "This secret technique is ultimately not the core cultivation method of the Yin Sha Sect. It cannot possibly support my journey on the Path of Celestial Human. If it were only that, I would still be satisfied to recover to the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm. However, in doing so, I’d be completely betraying my school and disappointing my master’s kindness. Moreover, when taking action, I’d have to conceal myself to avoid being mistaken for a Yin Sha Sect spy."
These are indeed various disadvantages, especially considering Ancestor Longyan actually has a strong sense of belonging to the Purple Mansion Academy. She joined the academy at eighteen, and by sixty, she was already at the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm. Her master, Canglan Ascendant, even bestowed a Spiritual Artifact, the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, upon her. This shows the academy’s cultivation and expectations of her.
If not for the incident fifty years ago, with Ancestor Longyan’s talent and potential, she might already be an important figure in Purple Mansion Academy by now.
"Since it’s like that, then let’s not cultivate this technique." After pondering for a moment, Wang Shouzhe suggested, "Besides, we already have a solution. As long as the ancestor’s injuries recover, with time, advancing further might not be impossible."
"No, I still want to cultivate the Yin Sha Power." After a moment of hesitation, Ancestor Longyan ultimately made up her mind, "The previous solution was too lengthy and consumed enormous amounts. If I convert the Yin Sha Power within me to my own use, it could save vast resources."
There was another consideration she didn’t voice, not wanting Wang Shouzhe to bear such a significant burden. Even if he could manage it, it would be better to allocate those resources within the family.
"Master, oh master, Longyan is being willful once more. Your grace, Longyan can only repay in the next life." In Ancestor Longyan’s eyes, there flitted a poignant remorse.
"Alas!"
Wang Shouzhe sighed slightly inside. With his comprehension of Ancestor Longyan, once she decided on something, even if Ancestor Zhou Xuan were reborn, persuading her might be in vain.
However, with Wang Shouzhe’s mindset of a transmigrator, whether it be Yin Sha Profound Qi or Purple Mansion Profound Qi, it is merely a form of power. Power itself holds neither good nor evil; it ultimately depends on the user’s mindset.
"This Jade Gourd Bottle." Ancestor Longyan picked up the item and, after a brief examination, commented, "This should be a container for storing Yin Sha Evil Qi. It still contains some Yin Sha Power, which could be quite useful for me. Shouzhe, I’ll go ponder the Yin Sha Transformation Technique and the method of concealing Yin Sha aura. You should go back and rest well."
After saying that, she left Wang Shouzhe behind and returned to her room.
Wang Shouzhe was slightly taken aback. Indeed, his Ancestor Longyan was a heroine among women. Once she set her mind to something, she would immediately get to work without hesitation.
He silently collected the Gold Notes and other assorted spoils, his thoughts drifting. Despite the various downsides to Ancestor Longyan’s choice, the advantages were also quite apparent.
Firstly, it could save a substantial amount of resources. Secondly, recovering in this manner would undoubtedly be much faster than the original plan. Once her long-standing affliction is cured, it could very well spell the end for the Zhao and Liu families.
This was likely one of the crucial reasons for Ancestor Longyan’s decision; she was eager to exact revenge and wash away the shame.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Celestial Human Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51: Celestial Human Family
...
A night passed.
The next day, Golden Sand City was not in an uproar over the death of two loose cultivators. Perhaps some high-ranking government officials would investigate for a while, but they wouldn’t expend too much effort on it. The Hundred Islands Guard was already more chaotic than other places, and the death of two loose cultivators was not a big deal.
As for the mastermind behind the "Yin Sha Outer Sect" disciple, they would probably be uncertain for a while, but they wouldn’t dare to investigate openly. After all, the Hundred Islands Guard was still within the territory of Longzuo County, and they wouldn’t allow the Yin Sha Sect to cause trouble.
Wang Shouzhe and his team naturally acted as if nothing had happened and weren’t the least bit interested in the conspiracy behind it.
The small Wang Family, for now, still found it more prudent to focus on their own survival.
Black market transactions were often held every few days.
Today was the opening day of the black market.
In the evening, Wang Shouzhe asked Chen Fanghua to arrange a carriage for him and Ancestor Longyan to go to the black market. This time, no one else went with them, just the two of them.
The black market was located at the east end of Golden Sand City, near the seashore, where ordinary people weren’t even allowed to enter. Only Black Tortoise Practitioners at the Fourth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm or higher were qualified to enter, and most could only stay in the main hall.
Today, Wang Shouzhe and Ancestor Longyan had thoroughly disguised themselves. He disguised as a rough-looking man, while Ancestor Longyan was covered in a gray robe, revealing only a pair of eyes.
The two got off the carriage and walked straight to the entrance of the black market.
Ancestor Longyan released a slight Spirit Platform Realm aura, and the doorman respectfully invited them into the black market, and invited them to a private room on the second floor, without even asking about their background. Instead, when the ancestor mentioned selling a spiritual artifact, it immediately drew attention, and they said they would invite the steward to appraise it.
This was the style of the black market, allowing customers to disguise themselves, ensuring their privacy.
Such practices made the reputation of this black market in Golden Sand City grow increasingly famous. Many families from nearby Guardian Cities might find ways to participate in the black market transactions.
Soon after, a maid entered and respectfully left after offering fruits and tea.
After a short while, a voice sounded outside the private room: "I am a black market steward, surname Zhong."
Ancestor Longyan gave Wang Shouzhe a look.
Wang Shouzhe understood immediately, went to open the door, and invited the steward in. He had read the information earlier; this black market was a joint venture of the Zhong Family and the Ouyang Family, one of the two Celestial Human Bloodline Families of the Hundred Islands Guard.
The person was dressed in a black robe, wearing an expressionless mask. Since his surname was Zhong, he must be a member of the Zhong Family.
"Steward Zhong, the family ancestor invites you." Wang Shouzhe, playing the role of the rough-looking man, saluted the man.
After entering, Steward Zhong courteously saluted the gray-robed Ancestor Longyan: "Thank you, fellow Daoist, for trusting our black market. Our black market has a two-hundred-year heritage and is most concerned with reputation. Fellow Daoist, you need not worry while trading in our market. If you wish to sell any spiritual artifact, please present it for viewing."
These words were spoken with integrity, representing the foundation on which the black market stands. Any market cherishes its reputation greatly. A two-hundred-year reputation is not easy to establish.
Ancestor Longyan wasted no words, and with a flip of her hand, a palm-sized object appeared. It looked like a turtle shell, with densely packed scales layered on top of it, and inscribed with some mysterious and complicated runes.
"It is this item, how do you appraise it?" Her voice was low and hoarse, deliberately masking her original voice.
"This item?" Steward Zhong took a closer look, his eyes changing instantly, speaking in a low stern voice, "It’s the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, fellow Daoist, where did you get this?" A powerful Spirit Platform Realm aura emanated from him.
Wang Shouzhe’s heart skipped a beat. What was wrong with this black market? One moment they were praising their reputation, the next moment they were questioning the origin of this item. He immediately stood in front of Steward Zhong, ignoring the Spirit Platform Realm pressure, and said coldly, "Is Elder Zhong intending to break the rules of the black market?"
These words made Steward Zhong quickly calm down, though he remained somewhat solemn: "I was being reckless, this Turtle Scale Treasure Shield is a relic of an important person from my sect. If you are willing to reveal its origin, I am willing to increase the purchase price by ten percent, no, twenty percent."
"Oh?"
Wang Shouzhe frowned slightly. The Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, as a defensive spiritual artifact, generally had a higher value than offensive ones, likely reaching tens of thousands of Qian Gold! Increasing the price by ten percent would equal several thousand Qian Gold.
This Steward Zhong was so concerned about this treasure? And his words...
"We’re not selling it; we’re leaving." Ancestor Longyan quickly put the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield away with a flip of her hand, her voice low.
"Wait!"
Steward Zhong unexpectedly blocked the doorway and then stared at Ancestor Longyan with a look of disbelief, whispering, "Senior Sister, is that you, Senior Sister Longyan? You, you, you’re still alive."
Senior Sister?
Wang Shouzhe gasped. This Steward Zhong was actually Ancestor Longyan’s junior? He was also from Purple Mansion Academy... Could it be that there was once... He started letting his imagination run wild.
"Who are you?" Ancestor Longyan halted her movements, her gaze flashing with a hint of severity, "How do you recognize me, and why do you know the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield?"
"I, I’m Zhong Xingwang." Steward Zhong hurriedly cupped his hands and said, "Senior Sister Longyan, do you remember me?"
As he spoke, he took off the mask on his face, revealing an ordinary old face, slightly aged.
"Zhong Xingwang?" Ancestor Longyan pondered for a moment, a hint of confusion in her eyes, "I don’t recognize you, perhaps I’ve forgotten."
Steward Zhong didn’t mind, just smiled foolishly and cupped his hands, "It’s normal for Senior Sister Longyan not to remember me. Back then, Senior Sister Longyan reached the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm at sixty and was a legendary figure in the Academy. And I, Zhong Xingwang, got into the Academy by using my family’s connections and was just a humble follower, only able to look up to Senior Sister’s magnificence."
As he spoke, his face and eyes unconsciously showed admiration, reverence, and even a bit of fear.
Hearing this.
Wang Shouzhe finally understood that all his previous imaginings were wrong. This Steward Zhong and Ancestor Longyan had nothing like a mutual admiration relationship, but rather a relationship of a loser and a goddess...
His own Ancestor couldn’t even remember his name...
And judging by his appearance, he was already somewhat old and worn. And he called Ancestor Longyan "Senior Sister" and got into Purple Mansion Academy through connections, must have only advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm at a much older age.
It was normal for him not to know Ancestor Longyan’s family background, as casually promoting one’s family or inquiring about others’ family situations was strictly prohibited in Purple Mansion Academy.
Unless the relationship was exceptionally good, everyone was merely one of the many students, without too much distinction of family status, which was the domineering aspect of Purple Mansion Academy.
"Why are you blocking me, what do you intend to do?" Ancestor Longyan spoke with a cold voice, "Are you intending to break the black market’s rules?"
"Don’t dare, don’t dare." Steward Zhong hurriedly waved his hand and said, "Breaking market rules would get me beaten to death by the Ancestors. It’s just that everyone said Senior Sister had already died in the Outer Domain, leaving me heartbroken for years. So when I saw Senior Sister Longyan, I got a bit excited for a moment, hoping Senior Sister would not blame me."
Saying so, he repeatedly cupped his hands, pleading for Ancestor Longyan’s forgiveness.
"Then step aside." Ancestor Longyan said coldly.
"Step aside, step aside... No, no, no." The dignified Spirit Platform Realm Steward Zhong was actually flustering, "I plead with Senior Sister Longyan to give me a chance to make amends. Why does Senior Sister want to sell the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield? I recall that was a Spiritual Artifact bestowed upon you by Binglan Ascendant!"
"Short of money." Ancestor Longyan said coldly.
"Short of money, you should’ve said earlier." Steward Zhong sighed in relief, then showed a flattery and pleasing expression, "Xingwang, as a direct lineage of the Zhong Family, has saved up a little in personal funds, and I’ve also accumulated some connections. How much does Senior Sister Longyan need? I might be able to gather some for you."
Zhong direct lineage?
The Zhong Family is a high and mighty Celestial Human Bloodline Family under the Hundred Islands Guard, how could a direct lineage fall to such a state? Even needing connections to get into the Academy. And his demeanor, like a dog licking without any discernment, going on a desperate licking spree.
Wang Shouzhe was speechless, Elder Zhong, oh Elder Zhong, chasing a goddess isn’t done this way. Haven’t you heard, "A licking dog ends up with nothing"?
Sure enough, the cold aura surrounding Ancestor Longyan gradually filled the air, her anger rising uncontrollably, saying with a cold sneer, "Zhong, are you planning to buy me, Wang Longyan?"
Steward Zhong’s legs suddenly went weak, panicking, "Senior Sister Longyan, don’t misunderstand, I just wish to repay kindness, repay kindness. Don’t you remember? During one of the Academy’s trial missions, you helped me once, although you don’t remember it..."
Done!
Wang Shouzhe shook his head in his heart. In front of his inner goddess, if even the legs can’t stand straight, how can the backbone be straight?
With this demeanor, there’s probably not even a slim chance left. Even with such an old fellow’s talent, let alone Ancestor Longyan, even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t admire it.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 52: [Celestial Spirit Pill]
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: [Celestial Spirit Pill]
...
The conversation between the two was something Wang Shouzhe could no longer listen to. He immediately took a step forward to stand in front of his ancestor, cupping his hands toward Steward Zhong and saying, "Elder Zhong, we are here to do business, so we ask Elder to proceed according to the rules."
With that, Wang Shouzhe handed the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield over to Steward Zhong for appraisal.
"Yes, yes. Business is about following the rules." Steward Zhong was obviously a little absent-minded, appraising the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield while probing Wang Shouzhe, "Young man, what is your relation to Senior Sister Longyan?"
"Replying to Elder, my name is Wang Shouzhe, I am the Clan Leader of the small clan in Ping’an Town of Changning Guard, and Ancestor Longyan is my Ancestral Grandmother." Wang Shouzhe did not hide this fact but instead replied politely. The ancestor could be unkind to him, but Wang Shouzhe as a junior could not afford to do so.
Moreover, it was evident that Steward Zhong had already recognized Ancestor Longyan. In the Academy, he did not dare to inquire recklessly due to the rules, and later thought that Ancestor Longyan had passed away, so naturally, he couldn’t go around probing.
Now, with the status and influence of the Zhong Family, it wouldn’t be difficult to find out. Even though Ancestor Longyan was quite low-key, her fame and influence outside were relatively small.
Upon hearing that they both carried the surname Wang and that she was his Ancestral Grandmother, Steward Zhong suddenly let out a strange, rippling laugh, as if he were in the midst of a beautiful dream.
"Why are you laughing?" In Ancestor Longyan’s eyes above the veil, cold light flickered.
Steward Zhong’s laugh abruptly stopped, and he quickly lowered his head, pretentiously continuing to appraise, "This defensive spiritual artifact, Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, was personally refined by the Binglan Ascendant of Purple Mansion Academy, naturally of superior quality. However, it appears this spirit artifact has been damaged before, not repaired in time, requiring at least a ten percent deduction..."
Before he could finish speaking, he suddenly felt a chill on his back, realizing it was Ancestor Longyan’s gaze coldly smiling at him. He felt a shiver for no reason and quickly changed his tune, "Such minor damage, Steward Zhong can have an Artifact Refining Master repair it. No need for deduction, no need for deduction. The final appraisal of this spirit treasure should be around thirty-one, no, thirty-two thousand Qian Gold. Is the esteemed guest looking to consign it or do you wish for us to take it directly?"
Hearing the implication in his words, Wang Shouzhe also estimated the price. Ancestor Longyan’s Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, due to previous damage, should be realistically appraised at around twenty-seven to twenty-eight thousand Qian Gold. If consigned, it would hardly exceed thirty thousand Qian Gold.
Moreover, as the black market host, they would need to charge a five percent venue fee, which means a fee of fifteen hundred Qian Gold.
Just as he was about to speak, Ancestor Longyan said coldly, "Purchase it at thirty thousand. With your Zhong Family’s Artifact Refining Master’s repair, there’s still some profit to be made. Consider it as me, Wang Longyan, owing you a favor."
"Senior Sister Longyan, I can..." Upon hearing that there was a favor from the Goddess, Steward Zhong was just about to further express his willingness.
"No need!" Ancestor Longyan interrupted him coldly, "If I, Wang Longyan, wasn’t truly helpless, I would never owe anyone a favor. If you pay the loss out of your own pocket, then the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield will not be sold."
"Yes, yes, Senior Sister Longyan, as you say." Steward Zhong nodded repeatedly without dignity, feeling regret in his heart. Although doing so would cost him personally, having Senior Sister Longyan owe more favors was something he dreamed of.
The parties agreed that the Golden Sand Black Market would purchase the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield for thirty thousand Qian Gold.
Steward Zhong, having a rare chance to get things done for the Goddess in his heart, immediately scurried off to handle the paperwork. With his direct lineage position in the Zhong Family and Spirit Platform Realm cultivation, this matter was already a foregone conclusion.
Taking advantage of this gap, Wang Shouzhe and Ancestor Longyan began to discuss how to use the money.
Ancestor Longyan initially intended to buy a Tier Five Spirit Pill, the Celestial Spirit Pill, for Wang Shouzhe, and then preserve it carefully. This pill is a highly sought-after, rare spirit pill, the best auxiliary spirit pill for those at the peak of the Qi Refining Realm to break through to the Spirit Platform Realm, significantly increasing the success rate.
This spirit pill is also one of the spirit pills that all major Black Tortoise clans dream of obtaining. With it, it would be possible to add a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor to the clan.
However, it is a Tier Five pill, extremely difficult to refine, requiring many expensive Heavenly and Earthly Treasures. Each time it appears, it is sold in auction form, with the price often reaching between thirty-two and thirty-five thousand Qian Gold, much more expensive than typical spirit artifacts.
For most clans, this is an astronomical figure. Even those with successful industries might take several decades of accumulation to afford it.
And even with a Celestial Spirit Pill, there’s no guarantee the clan will certainly produce a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor.
Just like the Sixth Granduncle Wang Xiaohan, who had high hopes placed in him, once used a Celestial Spirit Pill to break through to the Spirit Platform Realm and failed, resulting in him being dejected and feeling guilty for letting down the clan.
It’s understandable for Wang Xiaohan to have such thoughts. The resources to cultivate him to the peak of the Qi Refining Realm, along with that Celestial Spirit Pill, were all amassed by the clan selling off many family assets in Changning Guard, so the failure to break through caused tremendous loss to the clan.
However, Wang Shouzhe rejected Ancestor Longyan’s proposal, as he had no immediate need for it, and such funds stagnating would not be beneficial. Instead, he suggested purchasing a Tier Three Spirit Pill, the Creation Pill, to heal her severely damaged five visceral organs.
Her injuries had been dragged out for too long, and each year of delay risked causing irreparable outcomes. With her now capable of refining Yin Poison, it was the optimal time to treat her injuries.
"Ancestor," Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "Putting everything else aside, restoring your injuries as soon as possible is most advantageous for the clan. Without your protection, no matter how well my Wang Race develops, it would still be seen by others as an easy target."
Ancestor Longyan pondered for a moment and finally agreed. Shouzhe’s suggestion was the most appropriate for the current situation. The previous plan to purchase the Celestial Spirit Pill was due to the fear that after her death, the Wang Race would be unable to obtain it. Now, with the threat of death removed, the situation naturally changed.
Quickly, Wang Shouzhe used the pen, ink, and paper in the private room to discuss and prepare a list with Ancestor Longyan.
Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill, 300 pieces; Tier Two Pill Peiyuan Pill, 100 pieces; Tier Three Pill Creation Pill, 20 pieces; Spirit Stone, 10 pieces; Small Five Elements Array Banner, one set.
Total cost is approximately thirty thousand Qian Gold.
Among them, the Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill is specifically stored and used in conjunction with clan contribution points. Especially for the younger generation of the clan, it is the best time for cultivation. If they miss this age, later resources will be hard to compensate.
Wang Shouzhe never wants to see those younger siblings having to spend several extra months honing their realm due to the lack of a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill, ultimately falling behind others in cultivation.
As for the Peiyuan Pill, it is prepared for Wang Shouzhe, Ancestor Longyan, and Old Master Wang Xiaohan. Especially Wang Xiaohan, who became depressed after failing to reach Spirit Platform Realm, focusing solely on the clan industry Xingsheng Farm, which is certainly a huge waste.
It is still timely, and with the resources like Peiyuan Pills, he can gradually return to the peak of Qi Refining Realm and prepare to strike for Spirit Platform Realm. Having only one Spirit Platform Realm ancestor in the clan often results in unmanageable situations, which is certainly a loss.
Wang Shouzhe himself also wants to speed up his cultivation progress, using Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill for regular cultivation and relying on Peiyuan Pill to break through at crucial moments.
After all, according to the original plan, he was prepared to reach the peak of Qi Refining Realm by nearly forty before attempting to enter Spirit Platform Realm.
Too slow!
With Wang Shouzhe’s mindset as a transmigrator, how could he endure such snail-paced progress? Even if it means being extravagant and wasting some resources, he must quickly strike for Spirit Platform Realm.
As for the Small Five Elements Array, it is naturally a gift for Lua Xiaoxiao. Spending Ancestor Mingsheng’s five hundred Qian Gold on the Purple Crystal Spirit Beehive was wasteful; however, Lua Xiaoxiao has a talent for being an Array Master, thus this basic array is suitable for her learning.
When Steward Zhong returned to the private room and saw the list Wang Shouzhe provided, he was startled. Could it be that the Wang Family is a large Black Tortoise Clan, needing such a vast amount of resources?
"Elder Zhong, does your market have any concealing breath-type treasures for sale? The price shouldn’t be too high, ideally under a thousand gold." Wang Shouzhe inquired.
Steward Zhong pondered slightly and said, "There’s a Little Spirit Treasure—Concealing Breath Jade Pendant, but it can only hide non-explosive states of Qi Refining Realm cultivation and can’t fool a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator. The price isn’t too high, just about a thousand Qian Gold."
"Sufficient for use." Wang Shouzhe was slightly pleased, "Include it in the list."
He planned to explode his cultivation speed soon. He definitely doesn’t want his cultivation state exposed to miscellaneous people all the time.
"The esteemed guest requires quite a few items." Steward Zhong appeared troubled, "I need one to two days to gather everything."
"No problem, let’s sign an agreement between us."
Wang Shouzhe quickly let Steward Zhong experience the mood of Steward Qiaan back then. This purchase agreement was meticulous, accounting for all imaginable loopholes.
With Steward Zhong handling things, Wang Shouzhe and others no longer needed to wait here and returned to the inn overnight.
He sat cross-legged on the bed, meditated, and after several hours slowly opened his eyes, marking noticeably significant progress.
At this point, Wang Shouzhe’s heart finally calmed down.
This Hundred Islands Guard journey truly stirred up waves and was quite tumultuous. First discovered Yin Sha Sect’s outer disciple, then Ancestor Longyan encountered a former academy junior.
Any mishandling could result in severe crises.
Fortunately, both matters turned crisis into safety, turning disadvantages into advantages. Especially with Yin Sha Sect’s Yin Sha Transformation Technique for outer disciples, it was useless to others but extremely fitting for the ancestor.
However, despite the benefits, Wang Shouzhe decided to remain low-key after returning and secretly develop his strength.
This mystical world is too dangerous; reckless wandering could lead to losing one’s life.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Foodie Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53: Foodie Talent
...
In the following two days.
Wang Shouzhe and Ancestor Longyan plan not to go anywhere, just stay in the inn’s courtyard to cultivate.
Ancestor Longyan has been tormented by the Yin Poison for fifty years and has long been fed up with this state. The technique was very simple, even ordinary loose cultivators could understand it. After a brief contemplation, she began to try transforming.
Wang Shouzhe was afraid of unexpected incidents, so he accompanied her and could get insights from the Ancestor on his cultivation doubts. Ancestor Longyan, after advancing to the Spirit Platform Realm at the Purple Mansion Academy, apprenticed under Binglan Ascendant and cultivated to the Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm at a young age. Both her talent and insight are incomparable to Ancestor Ming Sheng from the Lua Family.
A casual pointer caused Wang Shouzhe to have an epiphany, with thoughts streaming forth.
The big girl from home, Wang Lici, was too young and couldn’t stay put. Wang Shouzhe simply arranged household generals to accompany her out for a stroll and gave her ten Qian Gold as pocket money, to reward her for her diligence and careful service to the Ancestor lately.
At noon.
Wang Lici ran crying into Wang Shouzhe’s room, her chubby, round face full of grievance: "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I was tricked by an evil loose cultivator. Boo hoo, ten Qian Gold and I got this worthless stone, there’s nothing good inside."
While speaking, she took out a fist-sized stone, which she had found a way to cut open, revealing a white inside.
Wang Shouzhe felt a sting in his heart; ten Qian Gold is no small amount. But since he gave it to her, it was her money. Still, to waste it like this, Wang Shouzhe felt a bit weary.
Could it be that Brother Shouxin just excels in raising wastrels? One loves gambling, the other loves eating!
What could possibly be edible in a stone? This intelligence is really worrying.
"Huh, wait." Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched suddenly, and he took the stone she had cut in half.
The outer skin of the stone was green and very pleasing to the eye. Clearly, this is the most common gambling stone from loose cultivator stalls! Some very powerful families, like the Celestial Human Families, or major powers, might have control over Spirit Stone Ore.
In Spirit Stone Ore, there are lots of scraps, and occasionally, Spirit Stones can be extracted from those scraps. But to pursue greater profits, those scraps are sold as gambling stones.
Initially, it was loose cultivators who gambled on them, and later, it became an industry chain. Loose cultivators transported these gambling stones to various places to set up stalls, letting people try their luck.
Everyone knows that nine out of ten bets lose.
But some people defy the odds, like buying a stone for ten Qian Gold and gambling out a Spirit Stone worth hundreds or thousands of Qian Gold, thereby getting rich overnight.
Various legends have made the gambling stone industry thrive, and families with Spirit Ore are happy to maximize profits.
However, these gambling stones, Wang Shouzhe usually wouldn’t even look at them. He has no Golden Pupil or Heavenly Discernment Gaze. The odds of losing far exceed winning. Better to honestly farm, earning money step by step.
But this big girl’s gambling stone... inside it’s all white, even Wang Shouzhe could feel the abundant spiritual energy within, a cool sensation flowing into his body when he held it.
He certainly knew it was a Spirit Stone, but couldn’t quite judge the quantity, since Wang Shouzhe had only seen a Spirit Stone once or twice in his life.
Therefore.
Wang Shouzhe grabbed the still sobbing Wang Lici and went to find Ancestor Longyan to take a look.
Even with Ancestor Longyan’s extensive experience, after examining the stone for a while, she was slightly surprised and after a brief assessment said: "Indeed it’s a Spirit Stone, seems like about three to four could be cut and polished."
Three to four?
Wang Shouzhe’s expression froze, as on this shopping list, he had bravely squeezed ten Spirit Stones in, worth a thousand Qian Gold. His original plan was to use one or two to try cultivating and see the effect.
The rest of the Spirit Stones were mostly intended for Xingsheng Farm, to combine with the Spirit Gathering Array and see if more Spirit Fields could be developed. From what he knew, there is a Spiritual Spring at Xingsheng Farm, enough to support about sixty acres.
However, currently, there are only twenty acres of Spirit Fields at Xingsheng Farm, as the family had faced calamity and finances were tight. Originally, the plan was to wait for Sixth Uncle Wang Xiaohan to reach the Spirit Platform Realm, stabilizing the family’s situation, and then slowly develop the rest.
But Wang Xiaohan failed to reach the Spirit Platform, which also stalled the Spirit Field development plan.
Now, Wang Shouzhe must develop the Spirit Fields, otherwise, it would limit the cultivation progress and development of the family members. They couldn’t always rely on purchasing Spirit Rice from outside, could they?
The purchase of ten Spirit Stones was a decision Wang Shouzhe made through gritted teeth.
Unexpectedly, this troublemaker Wang Lici gambled three or four out with just ten Qian Gold!
"Big girl, do you know that gambling stone is wrong?" Wang Shouzhe’s voice was a bit stern. Even though winning was momentarily profitable, this habit shouldn’t be encouraged. Otherwise, if the big girl gets hooked, no amount of money would be enough.
"Huh?"
Wang Lici was scared pale, trembling as she said, "Fourth Uncle, what do you mean by gambling stone? I just thought the stone had something delicious inside, like really tasty things, that evil loose cultivator also said there’s definitely good stuff inside. Who knew, he tricked me~ boo hoo, my money, gone, could have bought lots and lots of dried fish, octopus, squid..."
Since arriving at Hundred Islands Guard, Wang Lici became obsessed with tasty dried fish, finding it even better than candied fruits. As for Spirit Stone, she hadn’t seen or heard of them.
"Glutton! What could possibly be delicious in a stone!? What goes on in your mind all day?" Wang Shouzhe facepalmed, both amused and frustrated.
"Alright, alright, don’t cry." Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou hurried to mediate, hugging Wang Lici for comfort, persuading Wang Shouzhe, "Shouzhe, the big girl is still young. She doesn’t usually go out, doesn’t know about these things."
"Boo hoo~ Fourth Auntie, that evil loose cultivator, somehow tricked me into believing there’s delicious stuff inside, but when I cut it open, it’s all inedible garbage." Wang Lici was heartbroken and furious.
Garbage?
Wang Shouzhe facepalmed, feeling faint. If Spirit Stones are garbage, then are there any treasures in the world? But Wang Lici probably truly doesn’t know what a Spirit Stone is, she grew up in the family. The Wang Family was too poor, and Spirit Stones were far too few.
At this point, Wang Shouzhe was convinced the big girl wasn’t fabricating lies.
She didn’t have the intelligence!
"Shouzhe, if the big girl can truly sense something delicious inside." Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou looked expectantly, saying, "Doesn’t it mean..."
Wang Shouzhe certainly considered this point, but he still didn’t quite understand, so he looked to Ancestor Longyan.
Ancestor Longyan frowned slightly, puzzled: "From what I know, even Celestial Human Realm cultivators must use secret techniques to see through gambling stones, and the cost and commotion are definitely not small. However, I’ve heard of some remarkable people possessing unique pupil techniques who can see through gambling stones. But such individuals are extremely rare, and using pupil techniques causes noticeable changes in the eyes, making it easy to expose. But Lici... I haven’t heard of something like this.
After a pause, the Ancestor continued: "Shouzhe, the world is far beyond your imagination. What I’ve seen and heard is merely a drop in the ocean. Perhaps, this girl Lici has a talent in spiritual sense."
What talent in spiritual sense? Wang Shouzhe was a bit skeptical. Even if this girl has some talent, it’s probably a gluttonous talent.
A test will prove it.
Wang Shouzhe took out thirty Qian Gold and gave it to Wang Lici, saying: "Go and buy three more stones, remember, choose the ones that feel like they have something delicious inside."
Then Wang Lici stopped crying, looking at Wang Shouzhe with innocent eyes like he was an idiot, Fourth Uncle, have you been angered into stupidity? One bad experience wasn’t enough lessons?
"Haha."
Wang Shouzhe’s face twitched, smirked, "Big girl. I forgot to tell you, Fourth Uncle just bought two books..."
Before he finished speaking.
Wang Lici tightly clutched the thirty Qian Gold ticket, ran like the wind.
The speed and reaction were so quick that even Wang Shouzhe was struck dumb. He wasn’t sure if the big girl had a talent in spiritual sense, but he was convinced she definitely has a talent in speed.
However, worried she might suffer losses, he hurriedly sent Wang Zhong and Wang Yong after her.
"Shouzhe, you really are..." Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou chuckled.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Wang Shouzhe Feels Very Comforted
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: Wang Shouzhe Feels Very Comforted
...
Actually, Wang Shouzhe approached this matter with a "let’s see" mentality.
Being addicted to gambling stones is definitely wrong, but if Wang Lici indeed possesses some mysterious and inexplicable talent, then using that talent to exploit opportunities might just provide an unexpected financial resource for the family.
It does resemble those "Golden Pupil" novels from my previous life.
The Wang Family is too poor, so poor that Ancestor Longyan had to sell her personal spiritual artifact, the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, just to gather some resources. Especially that Tier Three Spirit Pill [Creation Pill], it’s incredibly expensive, a full thousand Qian Gold per pill.
It seems the alchemist is the most lucrative profession in this world.
But to achieve anything in alchemy requires extremely high talent. Moreover, nurturing an alchemist demands an astronomical initial investment, and a single mishap could bankrupt the family.
However, if a family wishes to develop greatly, nurturing alchemists is inevitable.
Let’s put this aside for now.
Wang Shouzhe and Ancestor Longyan re-entered the cultivation mode.
By evening, when Wang Shouzhe emerged from meditation, Wang Lici and the household generals had returned, and this time they didn’t bring back three gambling stones, but rather a stone the size of a football.
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, the other small stones didn’t have anything delicious, only this big one has something tasty." Wang Lici handed over a large stone as if taking credit.
What a muddled way to say things.
"Patriarch." Wang Zhong explained from the side, "We accompanied Miss Lici for half the day, and Miss Lici only chose this one. After bargaining, it cost 45 Qian Gold, and Wang Yong and I pitched in 15 Qian Gold."
"Thank you all for your efforts." Wang Shouzhe returned the supplementary Qian Gold to the household generals and instructed Wang Zhong to cut it open.
This time, Wang Zhong used a file and slowly ground along the surface to avoid wasting even a bit of spirit stone.
Wang Shouzhe watched from the side, feeling nervous, as this unimpressive stone cost a full 45 Qian Gold. If the gamble collapses, everything will be lost.
Soon, Wang Zhong had filed through two to three centimeters of surface, revealing a white crystal jade-like material inside, and he immediately exclaimed with joy, "Congratulations, Patriarch, congratulations, there’s a big increase."
It’s actually...
Even with Wang Shouzhe’s temperament, he couldn’t help but feel excited, feeling light all over. One must admit, gambling has a strong stimulation, making it hard to stop after becoming addicted.
Looks like after going back this time, I must strengthen family discipline again; gambling habits must not affect the younger generation of the family.
But the Big Girl’s talent is really terrifying, she has completely transcended the word "gamble," purely relying on her foodie talent, she accurately determined this stone contained spirit stones.
This is a completely different concept from gambling; it’s essentially picking up money.
Even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but say... really great.
Half a quarter-hour later.
Wang Zhong had filed away all the stone surface and was left holding a large piece of spirit stone, which, if properly cut, would yield about ten standard spirit stones.
Everyone was stunned, and Ancestor Longyan was also quite surprised.
With explanations from the household generals, Wang Lici understood that although spirit stones can’t be eaten, they’re good things and can be exchanged for many delicious treats. She immediately felt very happy, eagerly looking at Wang Shouzhe, as if hoping her Fourth Uncle would reward her somehow.
At that instant, Wang Shouzhe felt baffled, and his gaze towards Wang Lici became quite peculiar.
He found it very odd that his carefree and gluttonous niece managed to achieve this. Could it be that forcing her to study stimulated the awakening of some unique potential?
This possibility can’t be entirely ruled out.
Considering the family’s development, Wang Shouzhe’s gaze towards Wang Lici grew more kindly.
The familiar gaze, the familiar smile.
Wang Lici suddenly felt like she was struck by lightning, sensing the coming of doomsday. Living like this, what meaning is there in life?
Tears started flowing involuntarily.
"Alright, alright, I’m just teasing you." Wang Shouzhe chuckled, pinching her chubby cheek, "This time you’ve made great contributions to the family. So, tell me, what do you want to eat? Fourth Uncle will treat."
Really!?
Wang Lici suddenly came back to life, her eyes sparkling, drooling: "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle. I want to eat steamed giant lobster, the kind that weighs ten pounds. And abalone, as big as a sea bowl, I want to eat five in one go. And shark fin..."
"Oh, I see. But let’s talk about your studies first." Wang Shouzhe smiled more warmly.
"No, Fourth Uncle, if there are no giant lobsters, small lobsters will do, five pounds, no, two pounds will be fine. As for abalone, just the size of a fist..."
In the end, Wang Shouzhe still took her to enjoy a sumptuous feast, entirely to her satisfaction.
In this world, many plants and animals tend to grow larger, and non-spiritual species aren’t very expensive. The Hundred Islands Guard lacks many things, but sea treasures are not one of them; they’re still affordable.
Wang Lici naturally ate to her heart’s content and, after getting off the carriage, supported herself against the wall all the way back to her room, filled with gratitude toward Wang Shouzhe.
Hehe~ Truly simple to a terrifying degree.
Things proceeded smoothly afterward. Steward Zhong delivered the resources on the list as agreed, with a total value of 31,300 Qian Gold. Due to the large one-time purchase, Steward Zhong used his authority to waive the 300 Qian Gold odd amount, so Wang Shouzhe’s total expenditure was 31,000 Qian Gold.
Among those resources, the most significant investment was for 20 Creation Pills, costing a staggering 24,000 Qian Gold. This shows how the expenses for Spirit Platform Realm cultivators far exceed those at the Qi Refining Realm. For poorer families, Spirit Platform Realm cultivators can’t even afford to get injured.
However, for a Black Tortoise Clan, if there are no Spirit Platform Realm cultivators overseeing things, they are just a juicy target in the eyes of others.
To express gratitude to Zhong Xingwang, Steward Zhong, Wang Shouzhe treated him to a meal. Although Ancestor Longyan didn’t attend, which somewhat disappointed the Steward, he was accustomed to the aloofness of his goddess-like senior sister, and soon started chatting eagerly with Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe, true to his nature as a transmigrator, often amazed Steward Zhong with his broad perspectives and unique insights, especially after a few cups of spirit wine, leading them to call each other brothers.
This made Wang Shouzhe break out in a cold sweat; Steward Zhong truly lacked the demeanor and poise of a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor. Not to mention compared to Ancestor Zhou Xuan or Ancestor Longyan, even his poise was far inferior to Ancestor Ming Sheng.
However, thinking about it carefully, it’s normal. Zhong Xingwang was born into a Celestial Human Family, where the number of Spirit Platform Realm cultivators must be numerous, and he doesn’t have to bear the burden of the family’s rise or fall.
Moreover, he himself is not exceptionally talented or self-confident, otherwise, he wouldn’t have needed backdoor access to enter the Purple Mansion Academy.
How could someone like this win the favor of the proud, confident, and slightly headstrong Ancestor Longyan?
But even if she doesn’t think much of him, Wang Shouzhe had to find a way to befriend Steward Zhong because of their senior-junior relationship with Ancestor Longyan. The Celestial Human Family is too formidable, a comprehensive strength that far surpasses a small family like the Wang Family, and having such a connection would be useful in the future.
In the following days, everything was calm.
The Big Girl once again scoured the Independent Practitioner Market for all gambling stones, but only brought back two, yielding six spirit stones, and found no more gambling stones that intrigued her.
This illustrates how deceptive the actual gambling stone market can be. To hope to make a fortune from this is almost dreaming.
Wang Shouzhe and his group discreetly boarded the Junyao merchant ship to return to East Port. At this time, Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai was already waiting as arranged, with his ship.
Since Chen Fangjie was out on business, after briefly thanking the Chen Family Clan Leader Chen Dewei, Wang Shouzhe took his leave.
Some personal luggage was transferred to Wang Dinghai’s ship, consisting mostly of locally sourced sea treasures purchased from the Hundred Islands Guard, including a bag of Lihui on which Wang Shouzhe had high hopes. It’s worth noting that Lihui’s price is quite high, not much cheaper than grain per load.
Of course, Wang Shouzhe, who truly adored his big niece, didn’t forget to buy some unique and classic books exclusive to the Hundred Islands Guard, already envisioning Wang Lici’s delighted and chirpy expression.
The greatest achievement of this trip was finding a solution to Ancestor Longyan’s injury. In recent days, Ancestor Longyan had fully mastered the technique to refine evil Qi and had begun gradually refining the evil Qi within her.
Wang Shouzhe could even see a hint of fervor and urgency in Ancestor Longyan’s once lethargic gaze. He thought to himself, the ancestor would give the two old rival ancestors from Zhao and Liu Families a huge surprise.
Thinking this made Wang Shouzhe’s mood significantly better.
Returning from East Port to Ping’an Town required timing the tide. In this world, a large satellite hangs in the sky, causing tides to rise and fall. When the tide gradually rises, the flow from Anjiang becomes more stable.
At this time, they needed both sails and manpower to row.
As the rowers’ calls echoed, Wang Shouzhe was eager to return home.
However, this time, an unexpected turbulence occurred during the return.
While meditating in the cabin, the boat had only traveled for a little over half an hour when suddenly, with a "clang," it seemed to hit something, causing the entire ship to shake.
At that moment.
A loud, mixed-emotion shout from outside came from Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai: "Shouzhe, come out and assist! There’s a fierce beast, a Tier Two aquatic ferocious beast!"
Tier Two aquatic ferocious beast!?
Wang Shouzhe was momentarily stunned, but instead of panic, he was delighted. This was a windfall of spiritual food. The old and young back home, dozens of clan members, were all eagerly waiting.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Casualties and Gains
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55: Casualties and Gains
...
Wang Shouzhe immediately picked up his strong bow and sword, and rushed out swiftly.
He arrived on the deck.
Wang Dinghai held a fishing and hunting short spear with barbs and ropes, directing the crew to quickly beat the water surface with long bamboo poles. Household Generals Wang Zhong and Wang Yong also drew their strong bows, ready to shoot at any time.
"Shouzhe, you came just in time." Wang Dinghai’s expression was grave, but he couldn’t hide his joy, "It’s a lone East Sea Arrow Banner, probably washed into the freshwater by the tide, not too hard to deal with. Aim for its vital spots when it surfaces."
Overall, the difficulty of dealing with aquatic ferocious beasts is no less than that of terrestrial ones. They are often powerful and fierce underwater, frequently ramming and shattering boats.
With more than a decade of experience as an "old fisherman," Wang Dinghai naturally had his own set of techniques for dealing with aquatic ferocious beasts. The sound of bamboo poles hitting the water can disturb the beast’s judgment, making it hesitant to attack the boat, while also provoking its anger.
Except for a few species, most fish, even the ferocious ones, generally have lower intelligence compared to terrestrial ferocious beasts.
Just as Wang Dinghai finished speaking, a large splash suddenly erupted four or five zhang away from the left side of the ship. A nearly two-zhang long aquatic monster leaped out of the water, charging fiercely toward the ship.
With Wang Shouzhe’s dynamic vision, he could only make out the long sword-like front spikes of the aquatic ferocious beast and its dorsal fin resembling a triangular flag, somewhat reminiscent of a sailfish from Earth.
But in terms of both size and ferocity, it far surpassed a sailfish.
"Zheng! Zheng! Zheng!"
The sound of three bowstrings echoed almost simultaneously as sharp arrows struck the beast in succession. The difference was that Wang Zhong’s and Wang Yong’s arrows penetrated three or four inches into its body, while Wang Shouzhe’s arrow embedded over a foot deep.
The difference didn’t stem from the bows and arrows but from the higher-quality profound qi Wang Shouzhe infused onto his arrow.
"Beast, how daring!"
As the fiercest among the old fishermen, Wang Dinghai’s entire body swelled, his profound qi bursting to its utmost. His fishing and hunting short spear, specialized for slaying large fish, was launched with a fierce throw, "Puff," piercing over two feet into the beast’s side abdomen.
At this point, the beast’s front spike struck a crew member, sending him falling into the water, its tail sweeping another two crew members down as well.
"Boom!"
Amid the loud splash, the beast with the crew member plummeted into the water.
However, it carried Wang Dinghai’s fishing and hunting short spear with a special thick rope tied to its tail end.
Before it swam ten zhang away, the rope tightened with a sudden "creak" sound. This medium-sized merchant ship was pulled to one side, the bow swung by the immense drag.
This was the human technique for dealing with large aquatic ferocious beasts aboard ships. Clearly, the East Sea Arrow Banner had made a fatal mistake. This error would naturally lead to its demise.
The tugging of the fishing short spear and barbs caused it to thrash in pain, desperately trying to break free but unable to do so. The more it struggled, the worse its injuries became, and the special rope wound tighter around it.
To add to its doom was the long-range assault from Wang Shouzhe and others with their strong bows.
Nevertheless, Wang Shouzhe and the others spent an entire quiver of arrows before the East Sea Arrow Banner gradually ceased struggling, turning belly up. The crew worked together to slowly drag it back.
By this time, the crew member pinned to death by its front spike had long been cast off, swept away by the tide, and his whereabouts unknown. Of the crew members who fell into the water, only one was rescued, while another was likely swept away by an underwater current, irretrievable.
Although they had killed a Tier Two aquatic ferocious beast, losing two human lives cast a shadow over Wang Shouzhe’s face.
The crew’s morale was low as well, given that the dead were companions they lived with day and night.
"Shouzhe, the battle with a Tier Two aquatic ferocious beast today was already quite favorable; it was a great victory." Wang Dinghai came over to pat Wang Shouzhe’s shoulder, offering words of comfort, "Even among blood relations and household generals, death in battle isn’t impossible."
Wang Shouzhe understood that although Tier Two ferocious beasts and the High Tier of the Qi Refining Realm were both Level 1, ferocious beasts were generally stronger than beings of the same realm.
Moreover, this world ultimately differed from Earth; humanity had always been contending with ferocious beasts for survival territory. Since humans survived on land, terrestrial ferocious beasts in human habitats had long been eradicated, making it relatively safer.
However, one could never estimate how many people would die during such eradications and pioneering.
Yet the situation in water was different.
Humans do not live underwater. Like Anjiang’s great river, it has a wilderness source and numerous tributaries, some of which lead to undeveloped dangerous water marshes, where aquatic ferocious beasts thrive.
It is due to these extensive water networks that aquatic ferocious beasts continue to appear within the bounds of human settlements. Otherwise, humans would have long eradicated the aquatic ferocious beasts within their territory by persistent hunting.
This East Sea Arrow Banner is clearly a sea-dwelling fierce beast, unlucky enough to be swept into the freshwater river by the tides. Moreover, it lacks experience in dealing with humans. The vast ocean contains countless terrifying and fierce species that humans have yet to fully comprehend.
Therefore, merchant ships typically need to be large and extremely sturdy, and equipped with siege equipment and other weapons. The walls on Golden Sand Island are not merely decorative to prevent humans from wandering in...
Sea-dwelling beasts, likewise, cannot be underestimated.
Briefly gaining composure, Wang Shouzhe said, "Uncle, provide the necessary compensations and rewards."
"Naturally, we’ll follow traditional high standards. Each deceased crew member will receive 30 Qian Gold, totaling 60 Qian Gold. I’ll handle these personally." Wang Dinghai, accustomed to such events, showed little emotion. "An additional hush fee and reward of 2 Qian Gold for each of the other twenty crew members, totaling 40 Qian Gold, bringing our expenses to 100 Qian Gold."
Qian Gold as an expenditure is substantial, and crew compensations are typically high.
Wang Shouzhe paid out the 100 Qian Gold without hesitation, directly giving Wang Dinghai the amount for him to manage.
The surviving crew members, upon hearing they’d receive 2 Qian Gold each, immediately felt encouraged, greatly boosting morale. Despite the risks of their work, crew earnings were decent, but the pure gain of 2 Qian Gold was considered a windfall.
Joyfully, they aided Wang Zhong and Wang Yong in gradually dragging the fierce beast’s corpse onto the deck.
"We must set sail quickly. Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, drag the prey into the cabin and expedite clearing the deck; it’s unwise to linger here." Wang Dinghai immediately issued another order and explained to Wang Shouzhe, "This region is not our hunting ground but belongs to East Port’s Zuo Family. It’s best to leave shortly to avoid complications."
Unquestionably, Wang Dinghai, accustomed to living on water, made a wise decision.
More than a minute after setting sail, they encountered the Zuo Family’s fishing fleet at a distance. As the tides rose, it was the ideal time for fishing in these waters.
They saw a passing medium-sized merchant ship and were busy seizing the golden time for fishing, showing no intention of inquiry. In Anjiang, merchant ships and passenger boats frequently come and go.
Then, they smoothly passed the Zuo Family’s territorial waters without incident.
"Congratulations, Patriarch." Wang Zhong and Wang Yong, temporarily processing the East Sea Arrow Banner, joyously reported, "This Arrow Banner weighs over a thousand pounds, and after removing inedible parts, it still has over seven hundred pounds, quite profitable."
Tier Two fierce beast meat is several times more expensive than Tier One and offers better benefits for replenishing vitality and blood. These pure meat portions alone are worth hundreds of Qian Gold.
The skin of the Arrow Banner is also very useful; specially tanned, it can create some high-end water armor, enhancing a Black Tortoise Practitioner’s Water Escape Technique and defense.
All edible parts, even fish guts and liver, will be consumed.
Unedible bones and spines, on the other hand, can be dried and ground into Spirit Fish Bone Powder for spirit field fertilization.
In short, not a single part of such a valuable and rare spirit fish will be wasted.
Furthermore, the fish maw of the spirit fish is exceedingly costly. Specially processed and sun-dried, it becomes the renowned Spirit Fish Jelly.
This is the most precious part of the spirit fish, known for preventing postpartum hemorrhage and providing warm support to replenish blood and energy after childbirth.
Of course, only female members of the Black Tortoise Clan consume such precious items postpartum; ordinary families’ women are not privileged.
"Remember to note in the ledger when the fish jelly is placed in the clan treasury; when my sister gets married, it will be part of her dowry." Wang Shouzhe thoughtfully instructed.
"Naturally," Wang Zhong agreed with a smile, "The Spirit Fish Jelly from the Red-tailed Spirit Eel hunted by the Patriarch earlier is also kept, assuredly to be part of Miss Luoyi’s dowry."
Wang Luoyi, being the legitimate daughter of the Wang Family, will naturally have the finest Spirit Fish Jelly in her dowry upon marriage.
In addition, Wang Shouzhe need not worry about providing this for Miss Liua.
For when Miss Liua, the legitimate daughter, marries Wang Shouzhe, she similarly will not lack high-quality Spirit Fish Jelly in her dowry as part of the family’s heartfelt wish for the daughter to recover well postpartum.
The customs and traditions of the Black Tortoise Clan permeate every aspect of life.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 56: If I Become the Cyan Emperor in the Future, I Will Make Your Face Bloom with Peach Flowers
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56: If I Become the Cyan Emperor in the Future, I Will Make Your Face Bloom with Peach Flowers
...
"Wang Zhong, Wang Yong, you two did well too." Wang Shouzhe was also quite satisfied with these two Household Generals. Their combat skills were strong, and they were capable.
Consequently, he rewarded each of them with ten Qian Gold.
The two Household Generals were overjoyed and immediately knelt to thank him, saying, "Thank you, Patriarch, for the reward."
In this period, working under the Patriarch had indeed been profitable, filling them with motivation.
They were among the top tier of Household Generals and enjoyed substantial annual benefits. Their living standards were equivalent to about two Qian Gold a year, plus they received cultivation resources valued at twenty Qian Gold annually and an additional allowance of twelve Qian Gold.
Compared to ordinary civilians, their income was remarkably high.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe’s reward of ten Qian Gold was a considerable sum. Especially for Wang Zhong, who had recently drawn out an outer disciple of the Yin Sha Sect as bait, completing his task exceptionally well, and had been additionally rewarded with twenty Qian Gold, truly gaining a fortune.
"Work well and also cultivate well," Wang Shouzhe encouraged them before returning to the cabin to rest.
Being generous with them was also a form of support. While Household Generals’ benefits weren’t low, the resources they enjoyed couldn’t compare to those of bloodline clan members. Both were in their thirties, reaching the Fourth or Fifth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm was not easy.
Afterward, the journey continued without incident.
At Fenggu Gate, they took a small boat through the inland river towards the main residence. The journey to and fro took about ten days or so, quite smoothly.
On the black canopy boat.
Wang Shouzhe saw the massive changes at Fenggu Farm. Thousands of acres of wheat had been harvested, and the drying field was piled with threshed wheat, resembling small hills.
It was a bountiful harvest.
The tenant farmers busy with work were filled with satisfied smiles. This harvest year would make their lives much better.
Most of the world’s farms operated on a minimum share model for tenant farmers. The larger the grain production, the more profit they shared. Besides keeping some for themselves, the excess could be exchanged for Large Copper to save up.
Once enough money was saved, it could be used to send their children to Ping’an Town to learn a skill. Once the children became skilled and self-sufficient, they could start a family and establish a career.
If more money was saved, they could buy ten or twenty acres of good farmland. Then, build a house beside the farmland, thus becoming independent farmers.
However, transitioning from a tenant farmer family to an independent farmer family was not an easy feat. It often took one generation, or even two generations of effort and hard work to accumulate.
In this world, some tenant farmer households gradually became independent farmers. At the same time, independent farmer families might experience a decline and become tenants of different farms. It’s a natural cycle, like the ebb and flow of tides, or the waxing and waning of the moon.
Similarly, this world also witnessed the decline and collapse of some noble families, alongside the rise and prosperity of others.
In the eyes of these tenant farmers, the Ping’an Wang Family was like the heavens.
But at that moment, Wang Shouzhe had a sudden insight that the Wang Family and those tenant farmer families, or independent farmer families, weren’t fundamentally different. Everyone desired to improve and strengthen their family or clan through effort and accumulation.
The black canopy boat passed through Fenggu Farm, following the winding and twisting river towards the main residence, passing several villages along the way. These villages had anywhere from thirty to three hundred households and were mostly settlements of independent farmers, with a few small farms scattered about.
Originally, Ancestor Zhou Xuan took the Pioneer Order southward to open up land, accompanied by over a hundred Wang Family collateral branches, along with his small family. However, these collateral families had long separated from the Wang Family’s main lineage, and the bloodline passed down from the ancestor had become so thin that it was hard to produce cultivators of notable talent.
Nevertheless, these Wang Family collateral branches had settled down and thrived in Ping’an Town along with Ancestor Zhou Xuan. Now, the number of Wang Family collateral branches in the Ping’an Town generation alone had exceeded a thousand.
Due to the large population base, in the recent generation, two young individuals with cultivation talent had emerged. One was Wang Gui, Wang Shouzhe’s servant, and the other, Wang Xiaoyu, who served Wang Luoyi.
In this Black Tortoise World, bloodline inheritance was of utmost importance. Direct lineage would not marry collateral branches, as it would dilute the Black Tortoise Bloodline in their descendants, risking offspring with no Black Tortoise Talent.
If so, a tragedy is bound to occur.
Because such an offspring simply could not marry a wife with an excellent bloodline. No family would marry their Black Tortoise Talent daughter to a wastrel with no significant Black Tortoise Talent.
Likewise, no family’s direct lineage son would marry a girl with no bloodline talent.
Ultimately, that offspring most likely could only marry collateral branches, starting another cycle of tragedy, likely producing more offspring without bloodline talent. In such a case, the offspring wouldn’t even make it into the family register and would be considered collateral.
This is why bloodlines were so highly valued in the Black Tortoise World. Direct lineage, direct veins, and collateral branches all stayed within their respective lines; intermarriage was absolutely forbidden.
For noble families, collateral branches were merely collateral, not even considered true clan members. Normally, ordinary collateral members couldn’t even enter the main family’s gate.
However, under the Wang Family’s care, these collateral branches were living quite comfortably and prosperously. Some trusted positions in the clan industry were also reserved for outstanding talents among collateral members.
Additionally, some steward positions, including Chief Stewards in the Wang Family’s main residence, were often filled by excellent collateral talents from the Wang Family.
This kind of system was not unique to the Wang Family; the world itself was organized this way.
Wang Shouzhe had neither the power nor the intent to change this; you couldn’t expect a direct lineage to marry another family’s direct lineage daughter or collateral, could you? Not to mention the question of family honor, it wouldn’t be fair to his own descendants.
Miss Liua was a direct lineage, and so was he. Both of their bloodline qualities weren’t bad.
Their descendants, therefore, would naturally have decent bloodlines and, with some luck, could even produce an offspring with Middle Grade Talent, which would be a blessing for both the Wang and Liua families.
In the Wang Family’s territory, the farms and fields received some degree of care from Wang Luojing’s spiritual insects. Although still affected by disasters, the reduction in harvest wasn’t too severe, ensuring no major problems for the year, much to Wang Shouzhe’s relief.
Lost in thought, Wang Shouzhe’s boat entered Zhuwei Lake and subsequently sailed into the backyard moat of the Wang Family’s main residence. By then, there were no more transport boats at the backyard pier, indicating that Wang Luotong had successfully completed her task.
First, Ancestor Zhou Xuan was escorted back to the Longyan Residence. Meanwhile, Wang Luojing, looking weightless with joy, seemed like she was about to escape from the clutches of disaster and embrace a sense of survival.
Fourth Uncle, O Fourth Uncle, Lici has been so well-behaved and obedient. Surely, Uncle, you’ll spare me at least half of that cart of delicious food, right?
"Wang Luoci, you’ve done well, too." Wang Shouzhe affectionately pinched her round cheek and took out a few books from his pocket. "Fourth Uncle is giving you these books. You mustn’t slack off. Emergencies can happen at any time."
"What, what, what?"
Fourth Uncle, oh Fourth Uncle.
Hmph!
When I become the Cyan Emperor one day, your face will be full of peach blossoms!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 57 Accelerating the Sprint to Spirit Platform Realm (Monday Seeking Recommendations)
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57 Accelerating the Sprint to Spirit Platform Realm (Monday Seeking Recommendations)
...
Even though she was thinking these things in her heart, her expression showed a face of tears of joy and she said: "Fourth Uncle, you treat me so well."
"Our Lici is still very well-behaved. As long as you work hard, Fourth Uncle will have other rewards for you," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, gently rubbing her head, "Like those tasty little dried fish."
Hmph! Even if I, Wang Lici, am just a girl, a girl still has dignity. Don’t think that some little dried fish can buy me off...
But when the words reached her mouth, they turned into bright eyes and watering lips as she said, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, how much is the reward?"
"The sea treasures snacks brought back this trip are for you to handle," Wang Shouzhe said generously.
"Wuwuwu~ Fourth Uncle, you are so good to me."
