Wang Lici was so excited that tears started flowing, looking tearfully at Wang Shouzhe, feeling she shouldn’t have muttered slander against Fourth Uncle in her heart, nor should she have hit him so hard that his face was covered in flowers. Where could she find such a good Fourth Uncle?
"Hmm, Fourth Uncle believes you can handle it well, you must distribute them fairly to everyone," Wang Shouzhe added, "These snacks, everyone in our family under twenty gets a share. You’ve learned Nine Chapters of Mathematics and bookkeeping, right? Remember who received them, everyone has to sign their name on the account book."
Even! Distribution!
She even has to deliver these precious snacks to each household with her own hands, how cruel, how ruthless!
Fourth Uncle, you’ve gone too far, I’m going to fight with you...
Unfortunately, after Wang Shouzhe gave his instructions, he had already disappeared in front of her.
Leaving the girl holding a few books, lost in the wind.
...
Wang Shouzhe returned to his own courtyard, without handling any affairs, and took a short rest. This time, going back and forth to Hundred Islands Guard, both his body and spirit were somewhat fatigued.
Fortunately, the danger has passed. As long as Ancestor Longyan’s health improves, Ping’an Wang Family will truly have a foundation to stand on.
A night passed without words.
The next day, Wang Shouzhe met with his elder aunt Gongsun Hui for reporting and inventory. In short, the large family cannot have chaotic accounts, or else various undesirable problems will arise.
All these surprising matters and harvests, Gongsun Hui was shocked while doing accounts. Why does Shouzhe always bring unexpected surprises with him every time he returns?
"Aunt, I should be unchallenged in the first sequence," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "In terms of resources, I’m prepared to be a bit extravagant. Monthly spiritual food supply should be double what it was before, Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill increased from 1 to 3 per month, and each month I also need 1 Peiyuan Pill, as well as temporarily using a piece of Spirit Stone."
This way, in terms of resource consumption, Wang Shouzhe has reached an extremely extravagant level. Just spiritual rice every month is fifteen catties, spiritual fish and spiritual flesh each fifteen catties.
Plus elixirs and other consumables, not counting the Spirit Stones, the cultivation resources for a year will be as high as eight to nine hundred Qian Gold.
Normally, after advancing to the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, the annual cultivation resource budget is at most a little over two hundred Qian Gold, now it’s directly more than four times upwards! Four to five times the resources won’t make Wang Shouzhe’s cultivation speed reach four to five times.
There is a principle of diminishing marginal returns here, at most it can be faster than before by more than a double, adding Spirit Stones can make it a little faster, definitely not reaching three times faster than before.
In ordinary Black Tortoise families, even when nurturing the legitimate son of the first sequence aiming for the Spirit Platform Realm, it would never be so extravagant.
Such a request even made Gongsun Hui widen her eyes in surprise: "In theory, with your merits, applying for so many cultivation resources is reasonable. I’m just afraid those clan elders who are used to frugality might have some opinions. But it’s not a big deal, with Ancestor Longyan backing you, no one will gossip."
The family is everyone’s family, not just his, Wang Shouzhe, alone. Other family elders naturally have the right to express their opinions.
However, Wang Shouzhe does not care. With his abilities, this family will gradually enter a transformation phase. Besides, if we start implementing a contribution system, in terms of contributions, Ancestor Longyan is first, and he is second.
Even, he believes that his future contributions will exceed that of Ancestor Longyan.
Taking so many resources is not because he is selfish, but rather he truly doesn’t want to wait until middle age before having a chance to impact Spirit Platform. The most crucial is, this mystical world is too dangerous, with his current cultivation running around recklessly, sooner or later, there will be issues.
Therefore, it’s still safer to hide within the family, speeding up the cultivation progress to Spirit Platform Realm to have some self-preservation ability.
Once this matter was settled, Wang Shouzhe asked again: "Aunt, how is the insect disaster situation?"
He was gone from Changning Guard for ten days, so is behind in intelligence. The situation at Hundred Islands Guard is different; the cultivated land there is very little, possibly due to geographical isolation, they have not suffered from the disaster.
However, the imminent grain shortage is inevitable. Even Hundred Islands Guard will be impacted by the shortage.
"The situation is very bad." Gongsun Hui said with a serious expression, "Aside from a limited number of families, most families have suffered some level of reduced grain production. But the most severely affected are the free cultivators within the family territories of each town and clan. They have very poor disaster resistance, generally reducing production by around seventy percent."
Wang Shouzhe furrowed his brows slightly: "A seventy percent reduction is indeed a heavy loss, but with stored grains plus new grains, it should not be difficult for free cultivators to last until the next rice season matures, right? Not likely to be worse off than tenant farmers?"
"You might not be aware of this," Gongsun Hui explained, "Let me first talk about tenant farmers, tenant farmer families range from one to six or seven people. We will calculate by taking a common tenant farmer with a household of three, two labor forces, they ought to be able to cultivate twenty acres of land, with the normal year’s rice and wheat total value around 600 Large Coppers. With insecticide powder requiring about 40 Large Coppers, oxen, farm tools, and grain seeds depreciation about 20 Large Coppers, the noble family’s own good fields adopting the four-tax system per acre, including tax from the town, guard, county, and nation each 1 tax, twenty acres of good fields need 80 Large Coppers in taxes. Thus, approximately 460 Large Coppers remain, shared with the landlord under a three-to-seven split, meaning this tenant farmer household can obtain a benefit of 138 Large Coppers."
"A household of three tenant farmers yearly sums up to slightly more than one Qian Gold, after deducting daily expenses, there isn’t much left," Wang Shouzhe touched his nose, slightly surprised internally. Previously also calculated field income, but didn’t carefully calculate tenant farmers’ earnings."
"Tenant farmers’ risk resistance is stronger primarily because they have the backing of Black Tortoise clans above them," Gongsun Hui replied, "To stabilize tenant farmers’ operations, the landlords guarantee a minimum return, even if the yield is zero, there will still be a benefit of 60 Large Coppers, ensuring they continue farming with peace of mind."
Of course, these benefits refer not purely to Qian Gold but rather to distributed materials and Qian Gold combined, generating a resultant account paper value.
"In addition, tenants often raise a small number of chickens, ducks, geese, etc., and plant some fruits and vegetables around their houses, all supplied to our family throughout the year, yielding a net benefit of twenty to thirty Large Coppers," Gongsun Hui patiently explained, "During farming downtime, we organize tenant farmers for pioneering, river dredging, constructing houses, reinforcing river banks, etc., these also result in twenty Large Coppers. Hence, a regular tenant farmer household of three members can earn one hundred eighty to ninety Large Coppers yearly, even during disaster years, they can surpass a hundred Large Coppers."
Wang Shouzhe nodded in acknowledgment; it seems tenant farmers’ lives remain quite stable, thanks to having the landlord’s protection, even tightening their belts during disaster years allows them to get by. Encountering a prosperous year, living frugally, could even save a sum of Large Coppers.
"But free cultivators are different," Gongsun Hui stated, "Taking free cultivators with twenty acres, like the aforementioned tenant farmer households, if this season reduced production by seventy percent, this season will only generate a benefit of 90 Large Coppers, deducting 10 Large Coppers for oxen rental and seeds, investing 20 Large Coppers in insecticide powder, the tax follows a five-tax system, noble family, town, guard, county, nation each 1 tax, presently collecting summer tax, twenty acres require paying a tax of 50 Large Coppers. How much will they have left?"
Previously mentioned, local Black Tortoise clans hold the duty of securing civilians and territories; when encountering bandits, fierce beasts, and adverse incidents, the clans must eliminate and handle, while also assisting the local Guardian’s Mansion in tax collection. Therefore, the good fields within the territorial range have noble clans extracting 1 tax.
However, the Wang family’s territorial scope is small, aside from privately owned farms comprising about six hundred tenant farmers households, the territorial range consists of slightly over one thousand households, with managed civilian good fields totaling less than twenty thousand acres, the annually collected taxes combine to a hundred or so Qian Gold, with significant consumption, barely enough for survival.
"Thus, those free cultivators are virtually equivalent to having no yield this season?" Wang Shouzhe slightly furrowed his brows and asked, "Is it still necessary to collect taxes under such circumstances?"
"Tax is the nation’s foundation; town, guard, county, nation all rely on taxation for sustenance. Field tax is the largest tax category; without this part, various levels of institutions would struggle to sustain," Gongsun Hui explained, "Perhaps the national tax for Longzhou County will be waived this summer, but ultimately, a portion of households not well-managed will face considerable difficulties, and during such times, some Black Tortoise clans often commence strategies for land annexation."
"Like Zhao Family and Liu Family, their disaster and losses this time are severe, their eyes seem red. Various signs indicate they intend to annex some land in chaos," Gongsun Hui sneered, "A wolf remains a wolf, even clad in a noble family’s skin, cannot escape its greedy nature."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 58: The Unremarkable Household General Wang Mei
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: The Unremarkable Household General Wang Mei
...
This pest disaster, if we talk about the ones suffering most severely, naturally it is those low-ranking Black Tortoise Clan families who have no means to resist the disaster.
For example, the Zhao Family and the Liu Family.
A rough calculation makes it clear that based on the previous example, if twenty acres of land have a seventy percent reduction in yield, there will only be 90 large copper coins in revenue. Tenant farmers will take away a guaranteed base of 30 copper coins, and then there are 40 copper coins in taxes, 10 copper coins in depreciation for plowing oxen, farming tools, and seeds, and 20 copper coins for the insecticide powder. Just these costs alone make the Zhao and Liu families not only earn nothing this season but also have to incur a deficit of 10 large copper coins per twenty acres.
In the case of the Liu Family, their farms add up to over ten thousand acres of fertile land, so they won’t earn a single coin and will have to incur a deficit of 50 Qian Gold.
This Qian Gold doesn’t even include expenses like the Agricultural and Sericulture Chief Steward, with the total deficit exceeding a hundred Qian Gold altogether.
It may not seem like much to lose a hundred Qian Gold, but in reality, this wave will cause them to lose a fortune. Because in normal years, these ten thousand acres could bring them a pure profit of eight to nine hundred Qian Gold per season. Now, with the loss and the gain, it’s a pure profit loss of over a thousand Qian Gold.
Under normal circumstances, a noble family like the Liu Family has enormous annual expenses, and managing to save five to six hundred Qian Gold a year is a testament to their capability. Just the loss of this thousand Qian Gold has already swallowed up two years’ worth of savings.
"There’s another fatal piece of news that you probably don’t know, Shouzhe." Gongsun Hui continued, "Changning Guard Government Office has ordered all noble families that this year’s summer tax cannot be paid in Qian Gold but must be paid in grain."
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe took a deep breath; this was pushing the lower-tier Black Tortoise Clan families to their limits. In past years, they could pay in grain or money, as long as the equivalent value was paid.
However, this year all noble families are already short of grain, so paying in grain would only worsen the situation for the lower-tier Black Tortoise Clan families. But this doesn’t apply to the Wang Family or some of their marriage allies because they preserved their production this time, and they can afford to pay the grain tax.
The ones truly impacted are noble families like the Ping’an Liu Family and the Zhao Family. They have little grain left, and paying the grain tax would deplete their reserves. If cornered, they would naturally pass the pressure onto the lower-class civilians and even tenant farmers.
"The government’s order is understandable." Wang Shouzhe said seriously, "In terms of the overall lack of grain in the Changning Guard Region, if the government doesn’t use this order to gather grain from the noble families, there is a high possibility of chaos erupting within the Guardian City."
"Is Shouzhe intentionally planning to watch the show involving the Zhao and Liu families this time?" Gongsun Hui asked, "The land annexation will inevitably lead to chaos, and the Zhao and Liu families may be playing with fire with significant risks involved."
"No!"
Wang Shouzhe’s gaze was extremely cold, "The land of Ping’an was initially cleared and developed by Ancestor Zhou Xuan, who spent centuries building the foundation. How could I just watch it be destroyed by two wolves? Want to take advantage of the chaos to play land annexation? Not without asking me, Wang Shouzhe, first! This time, I aim to strike at the Zhao and Liu families and let them witness Wang Shouzhe’s skills."
"Shouzhe, you truly have great spirit and courage; I haven’t misjudged you." Gongsun Hui’s eyes sparkled, "No matter your decision this time, your mother supports you wholeheartedly. At this critical moment, I will certainly find a way to invite Ancestor Mang to visit our Wang Family."
"Ancestor Mang?"
Wang Shouzhe’s face lit up with joy, "Aunt can actually invite Ancestor Mang?"
In the circles of noble families, ancestral-level figures generally do not meddle in the disputes of other noble families, lest it trigger larger-scale factional conflicts.
Gongsun Hui smiled, "Have you forgotten? Our Wang Family’s fourth-generation eldest legitimate daughter, Wang Lingdie, was married to the Gongsun Family as the Lady of the House. Ancestor Mang is her biological legitimate son, with half of his bloodline coming from our Wang Family, so he is naturally close to us. Moreover, don’t forget, Ancestor Mang is my grandfather. When I returned to my natal home some time ago, I also visited him. He is very regretful about the battle of Ancestor Longyan back then, only regretting that he was only at the Ninth Layer in the Qi Refining Realm and heard the news too late."
After a pause, Gongsun Hui added, "Ancestor Mang heard about your accomplishments from your maternal grandfather, and he speaks highly of you and wants to seize the opportunity to meet you. I believe just inviting him as a guest this time, given his temperament, he should not refuse."
"Great, great, great! This makes it even more secure." Wang Shouzhe was overjoyed, initially worrying that with Ancestor Longyan’s health not yet fully recovered, it was uncertain if she could deter the opposition.
If Ancestor Mang is willing to come and stay for a while, how would the two ancestors of the Liu and Zhao families dare to act recklessly?
After discussing further with Gongsun Hui, Wang Shouzhe took his leave.
Simultaneously striking at both the Zhao and Liu families is a monumental task that requires careful calculation and planning. Otherwise, if not careful, it could have disastrous consequences.
Intelligence!
It has always been fundamental in battles between two forces.
Wang Shouzhe summoned Wang Zhong over, whose strength was not very strong, only at the Fourth Layer High Tier in the Qi Refining Realm. But recently, it was gradually discovered that he had a relatively steady personality, handled matters appropriately, and was quite resourceful.
"Greetings, Patriarch." Wang Zhong saluted upon entering.
"No need for formalities." Wang Shouzhe said, "Before you have had a good reunion with your family, I need you to handle some tasks. My apologies."
"Serving the Patriarch is no hardship at all." Wang Zhong’s essence, Qi, and spirit were very high; his eyes lit up at the prospect of handling matters.
This was not merely because the Patriarch was generous but because every time the Patriarch took action, he turned the tide, and the Wang Family showed signs of great prosperity under his leadership. The relationship between a Household General and their noble family is mutually beneficial.
Wang Shouzhe smiled and explained what needed to be done.
Wang Zhong pondered seriously for a while and said, "Patriarch, intelligence work is not my specialty. I would recommend a Household General for this task—Wang Mei. She is only twenty-three years old, yet her cultivation has reached the Third Layer in the Qi Refining Realm. However, she is meticulous, observant, and highly skilled at disguising and infiltrating to collect clues."
Wang Shouzhe neither approved nor disapproved, but he sent someone to summon Wang Mei, wanting to personally evaluate her.
Soon, Household General Wang Mei arrived, bowing respectfully and with unease, "Greetings, Patriarch."
Wang Shouzhe took a look at her. This girl’s appearance was unremarkable, so plain that it seemed one would forget what she looked like as soon as they turned away. However, her figure was quite good, curvy and shapely, and her legs were long and strong, indicating good power potential.
Curiously, he said, "No need for formalities. Wang Zhong said you are skilled in disguise and infiltration, with a meticulous mind. Can you elaborate on this?"
"Reporting to the Patriarch," Wang Mei said steadily, "I am indeed skilled in disguise and infiltration."
"Oh~ You are quite confident," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Can you give me a demonstration?"
Wang Mei agreed but mentioned she needed to make some preparations.
Wang Shouzhe was intrigued and let her prepare thoroughly. After she left, Wang Shouzhe settled his mind, beginning to deliberate on this plan.
This time, the plan was not something profound; it was just a minor commercial ambush. This kind of event occurs constantly on Earth.
However, Wang Shouzhe planned meticulously because this divinely granted opportunity could not be missed.
One step at a time, the plan started to take shape...
"Greetings, Patriarch." A deep male voice rang out.
"No need..." Wang Shouzhe turned around abruptly, only to see an unfamiliar male Household General standing with cupped hands; though not tall, he was dignified, with fair skin and quite handsome, having the aura of a literate general.
"Who are you?" Wang Shouzhe did not recall having such a Household General and frowned immediately.
"Patriarch, I am Wang Mei." The male Household General changed to a female voice, sending shockwaves through Wang Shouzhe, causing goosebumps as he exclaimed, "This skill of yours is indeed unique, interesting, interesting."
Hearing the Patriarch’s praise, Wang Mei was elated and said, "Please wait, Patriarch; I will make another change."
An hour passed.
When Wang Mei appeared once more, Wang Shouzhe was stunned, and so were Wang Zhong and Wang Gui.
Before them now stood a graceful young woman, draped in a thin veil, with lotus shoes on her feet, holding an antique floral umbrella in her hand. Every step she took was graceful and enticing, with a faint fragrance filling the air.
Most astonishingly, her face had transformed into one of beauty, with red lips and fair cheeks, her long hair elegantly poised, looking like a true beauty.
She curtsied gracefully, her voice as soft as a wellspring, "Meimei greets the Patriarch."
"Gulp." The servant Wang Gui on the side couldn’t help but swallow, staring intently.
Wang Shouzhe, well-versed in experience, quickly came to his senses. Inwardly, he was amazed; her makeup skills had reached an exquisite level. It was on par with the monstrous makeup techniques seen in apps from his previous life.
This Wang Mei was comparable to those makeup wizards, invigorating Wang Shouzhe’s spirit. Ping’an Town, when all was said and done, was rural. How could the children of noble families like the Liu and Zhao have witnessed such a scene?
Perhaps, with Wang Mei’s subtle tactics, intelligence would soon flood in.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Great Demon King Wang Shouzhe
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: Great Demon King Wang Shouzhe
...
This woman holds immense nurturing potential.
Moreover, though she is only twenty-three years old, she has already reached the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. Such cultivation, while not as advanced as the bloodline disciples of the family, is not far behind. Hence, her talent is not lacking, and she must also be working extremely hard.
Beside her, Wang Zhong was also taken aback for quite a while before he returned to his senses, smiling wryly, "Wang Mei, I’ve seen you use makeup techniques before, but never as impressive as this. Truly remarkable."
"Uncle Zhong, it’s just that since I was young and had a plain appearance, I gradually came to enjoy makeup, entertaining myself behind closed doors." Wang Mei’s voice was melodious and nimble, her expressive eyes glancing briefly at Wang Zhong, "These minor skills aren’t worthy of the spotlight."
Wang Zhong’s heart pounded like a drum, his breath quickening, as he turned away, "Wang Mei, please don’t speak to me like that anymore, I already have a wife and children."
Were he not so familiar with Wang Mei, as a man in his thirties or forties, he might have fallen for her charms at this moment.
Wang Shouzhe watched and chuckled inwardly; would he have taken the bait if not for his family commitments?
"Alright, then this task shall be entrusted to Wang Mei." Wang Shouzhe coughed lightly and said solemnly, "Wang Zhong, you are usually calm and steady, and you will oversee this intelligence operation. You can requisition family members as necessary, and you must ensure Wang Mei’s safety, avoiding excessive risk to complete the task."
"Wang Zhong accepts the order," Wang Zhong replied seriously, bowing with utmost respect and seriousness.
"Wang Mei," Wang Shouzhe continued, "Your makeup technique may seem minor, but if used well, it will become a significant asset. However, your style is overpowered by makeup fragrances, and your demeanor often leans too much towards delicate affectation. Against the inexperienced younger generation, that’s fine, but it may not suffice against those sly old foxes of the world."
Afterward, Wang Shouzhe casually shared some theories from past insights, sharing them with Wang Mei. Techniques like how to present oneself as an elegantly cultivated lady, or how to appear profound and unfathomable through careless gestures.
Things like feigned indifference while truly engaging, or the appearance of closeness masking actual distance!
In Wang Shouzhe’s previous life, there was an abundance of such things, even dedicated courses for nurturing elegant young women, and infamously various PUA trainings and practices.
By sheer exposure, his understanding of the theoretical knowledge was far more advanced and comprehensive than Wang Mei’s.
Wang Mei’s eyes brightened more and more, as the patriarch opened a new world for her, revealing vast opportunities awaiting her pursuit.
However, Wang Zhong and Wang Gui found it increasingly unsettling, their bodies trembling.
If Wang Mei could truly achieve as the patriarch envisioned, would there be any refuge left for men in this world? Wouldn’t her targets be at her mercy, one by one?
"Remember this well, you cannot let the target achieve success in the end," Wang Shouzhe admonished, "First, as a Wang Family General, I don’t wish for you to make such a sacrifice. Second, for men, what they cannot have is most beautiful, leading to boundless imagination and the potential for future utility."
"Wang Mei will remember the patriarch’s teachings," Wang Mei was convinced, feeling warmth in how the patriarch protected her, reflecting his profound understanding of human nature and his far-sighted strategy.
After receiving their tasks, Wang Zhong and Wang Mei departed.
"Wang Gui, go fetch Wang Yong, Wang Wu, and Wang An," Wang Shouzhe instructed again.
Unexpectedly, Wang Gui, who was usually eager to serve, stood in a daze, seemingly caught up in Wang Mei’s allure. Annoyed, Wang Shouzhe kicked him over, "Can’t you show some promise?"
"Patriarch, I was wrong," Wang Gui immediately snapped out of it, hurriedly apologizing, then hesitated with a hint of expectancy, "Patriarch, do you think there’s a chance for me and Mei Mei? Our statuses should be fairly compatible..."
"Heh~" Wang Shouzhe gave him a look, "Wake up. I can tell that Wang Mei isn’t a woman content to stay at home as a wife and mother. Her ambitions exceed what you imagine, and you won’t be able to control her. If you’re genuinely looking to settle down, I’ll scout for branches of families with ancestral bloodline connections for you. Now get to work."
"Yes, Patriarch." Wang Gui hurriedly scrambled out.
Taking this opportunity, Wang Shouzhe brewed a pot of spirit tea for himself, sipping slowly to calm and focus. Among the household generals, someone like Wang Mei, with such extraordinary talent, emerged.
However, if it weren’t for Wang Shouzhe taking the reins, and if the more traditional Wang Dingyue were still patriarch, Wang Mei’s exceptional talent might never see the light of day, possibly never being recognized.
But having discovered such a precious talent, Wang Shouzhe could not let it go to waste. Using it against the younger disciples of the Liu Family and Zhao Family was merely an initial practice for Wang Mei.
Once this matter is settled, creating a secretive organization centered around Wang Mei is imperative, building a comprehensive intelligence agency under Wang Shouzhe’s control.
But such plans are premature, reliant on her performance this time.
For now, set it aside.
Soon after, Wang Yong and several other household generals reported in, receiving their respective orders and setting off to handle their assigned tasks.
And so, Wang Shouzhe found himself momentarily unoccupied.
As the head of a family, he naturally couldn’t, nor needed to, manage everything personally. Micromanaging would only undermine their ability to handle affairs, and leave him with insufficient time and energy.
At this juncture.
A voice came from outside the door, "Is the patriarch available? I’m Wang Xiaoyu, the maid from Miss Luoyi’s room."
"Come in." Wang Shouzhe said.
At the entrance of the side hall, a young maid of about eighteen or nineteen walked in. She was quite pretty, much more so than Wang Mei. However, compared to Wang Mei’s allure after using an evil technique, she was not on the same level at all.
One has to admit, the Makeup Technique, one of the three great evil arts, is truly terrifying.
Wang Xiaoyu dared not look up at Wang Shouzhe. She respectfully said, "Xiaoyu pays respects to the Patriarch. Miss Luoyi said it has been some days since she last saw the Patriarch and has specially sent Xiaoyu to ask if the Patriarch has time to dine together."
Wang Luoyi.
That was Wang Shouzhe’s full-blooded elder sister. In his memory, the two siblings had a deep bond, relying on each other after losing their mother at a young age.
Immediately, a sense of longing surged in his heart, and he nodded, saying, "Go back and inform my sister that I’ll make slight preparations and head over."
Wang Xiaoyu accepted the order and withdrew.
Meanwhile, with the help of the servant Wang Gui, Wang Shouzhe washed his face, tidied his clothes, and looked at himself in the large copper mirror. Hmm, his appearance seemed quite heroic and outstanding, full of vitality yet not lacking in reserve, a very good look indeed.
If he had this look and demeanor on Earth, Wang Shouzhe reckoned he could live off his face alone.
Wang Shouzhe took some Spirit Tea, the sea treasures brought back by the Hundred Islands Guard, and a few gold pearls infused with Spiritual Qi. With the gifts prepared and carried by Wang Gui, he then leisurely strolled over.
Back then, Ancestor Zhou Xuan, for long-term considerations, had planned and built the main residence very large. Sister Wang Luoyi’s courtyard was more secluded, and it took nearly a quarter of an hour to walk there.
In this main residence, there were many kinds of vegetation everywhere, lush and verdant. Especially since some ancient species and trees were planted at the time, now over a hundred years have passed, and they have grown into towering trees, with canopies stretching to provide shade. Walking under the sun not only does not scorch but gives a sense of coolness.
This fully embodies the saying "the descendants enjoy the shade of trees planted by their ancestors."
The closer the main residence is to the mountains, the quieter it becomes. This place was mostly for daughters and younger family members to live, except for the very young ones who would live with their parents, the rest would move out to live independently.
Besides the courtyards, there were also small ponds, rockeries, flower beds, pavilions, corridors, and more, with quite an elegant scenery.
Wang Shouzhe was strolling along, enjoying this rare peace when suddenly.
A burst of noise came from ahead.
"Wang Shou Lian, if you lose, you’ll see what happens!" A somewhat bossy little girl’s voice sounded.
"Go, Fifth Brother! I support you. Losing to Sixth Brother would be too embarrassing." Another familiar girl’s voice, alright, it was Wang Luojing’s voice.
At the same time.
The sounds of punching and kicking, and the clash of Qi Force were heard.
Were Fifth and Sixth engaged in a spar?
Among the male Shou generation of the Ping’an Wang Family, from the oldest Wang Shouxin to the youngest Wang Shouye, there were seven in total. Wang Shouzhe was only ranked fourth, with three younger brothers behind him.
The ones sparring now were Fifth Brother Wang Shouyong and Sixth Brother Wang Shou Lian.
Such is the way of Noble Families. The longer the family history, the greater the age gaps within the same generation.
Wang Shouzhe smiled and decided not to join the commotion, lest the few of them become restrained.
Just as he was about to slip away quietly, he suddenly heard Big Girl Wang Lici’s voice: "Wang Shouyong, Wang Shou Lian, haven’t you eaten? Your blows are so weak, what kind of men are you?"
"Big Girl, stop causing trouble from the sidelines." Wang Shouyong called out, "If you’re so good, why don’t you come up?"
"Yeah, Big Girl, you have to call us uncle!" Wang Shou Lian chimed in while fighting, "Our generation is higher than yours."
"Sigh, what good is a higher generation? I gave you my fish snacks for nothing, and they didn’t increase your strength at all." Wang Lici sighed deeply, "Sigh, with how you are, how can you beat Uncle Four, that Great Demon King?"
Uncle Four...
Great Demon King?
Wang Shouzhe touched his nose in bewilderment. When did he get this nickname?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 60: The Younger Brother and Sister Are Energetic
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: The Younger Brother and Sister Are Energetic
...
"Big girl, maybe we should just drop it." Wang Shouyong’s voice rang out, clearly a bit shaky. "Fourth Brother is really strong, even Big Brother might not be able to beat him."
"Drop it? Wang Shouyong, when you were munching on my little fish snacks, why didn’t you say drop it?" Wang Lici said with an air of maturity. "You ate my things, so now you belong to me. I’m warning you, if you don’t listen, I’ll tell Fourth Uncle about our alliance."
"Wang Lici, you’re going too far. When you gave me the fish snacks, you didn’t mention dealing with Fourth Brother." Another male cousin, Wang Shou Lian, said with a voice almost in tears. "Fourth Brother almost got into the Purple Mansion Academy, who can beat him?"
"Idiot, I’m not asking you to fight him one-on-one." Wang Lici said disdainfully. "We should trap the Great Demon King with a plan, and swarm him with a sack over his head, so he won’t even know who hit him."
Wang Shouzhe found it both funny and exasperating, as this group of little brats seemed to be plotting to beat him up.
Especially Big Girl Wang Lici, who in his presence behaved like a gentle little bunny. But the moment he turned his back, she rallied a group of little rascals to turn the tables on him.
The change in behavior was so quick, it caught him off guard. This Big Girl’s nickname was truly well-earned.
"Wang Luojing, are you acting all sneaky because you’re planning to sell us out?" Another voice with the bossiness of a little girl piped up. "Big Girl said that Fourth Brother prepared a bunch of books for us to read, and if we don’t finish them, he’ll get all stern and scold us. You may like reading, but I don’t."
Wang Shouzhe recognized the voice as that of Wang Luqiu from Third Uncle’s family, who was only eleven this year. He had heard from Luojing that this girl had already reached the second level of the Qi Refining Realm and had exceptional talent. Wang Shouzhe had intended to find time to encourage her, but hadn’t had the chance.
"Wang Luqiu, I don’t want to read either, but I don’t think your plan can deal with Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing said. "Fourth Brother is much stronger than you."
"Luojing, don’t you keep bugs?" Wang Luqiu said again. "You could have the bugs sting him."
"No, no." Wang Luojing shook her head hurriedly.
Wang Shouzhe’s face started to darken. What kind of siblings are these, to think about harming their older brother just to avoid reading?
Thankfully, Wang Luojing was somewhat rational and had a lot of respect for Fourth Brother, which brought Wang Shouzhe some relief.
"If we are going to deal with Fourth Brother, we need to hatch the second batch of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees." Wang Luojing was plotting over there. "Also, attacking head-on has no chance of success. Luqiu, you can pretend to sprain your ankle in front of Fourth Brother, then I’ll use the opportunity to release the Purple Crystal Spirit Bees. You’re still young, Fourth Brother will definitely protect you first... then Fifth Brother and Sixth Brother can storm in with the sack in the chaos..."
Cold sweat!
Slipped down Wang Shouzhe’s temple.
What kind of sinister thoughts were these? So cunning and ruthless. I’m your brother after all... especially you, Wang Luojing! That Purple Crystal Spirit Beehive was bought by me for you!
Wait a minute, she managed to keep the Purple Crystal Spirit Bees alive? Truly a little demon.
This group of younger siblings and nieces are really not behaving themselves. In front of him, they’re all obedient and well-behaved little darlings. Yet once he turned his back, he truly underestimated them.
However, Ruotong was right, never underestimate Wang Luojing. That girl has been quick-witted and mischievous since she was little, how could she possibly be a truly harmless and obedient girl?
"Luojing, you always have the best ideas." Big Girl Wang Lici praised her. "I’ll reward you with a pack of dried octopus, and tell you about the vast sea, the majestic Golden Sand Island City, and the stories of how I roam triumphantly through Golden Sand Island City."
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched. Well, Wang Lici, I asked you to distribute snacks fairly. Yet you took it upon yourself to use these snacks as resources to conspire against me.
Triumphantly roaming indeed, what capabilities does a brat like you have? With your intelligence, you’d probably get rubbed on the ground by Wang Luojing.
"But there’s something to be said first." Wang Luojing said. "We’ll just get Fourth Brother to agree not to force us to read, and make sure not to hit Fourth Brother’s face. Fourth Brother is so handsome, it would be a shame if his face got swollen."
Really couldn’t listen any longer.
Wang Shouzhe walked out with a smile: "Luojing, I never thought you would actually cherish your Fourth Brother so much, it makes me feel so warm inside."
"Gah?"
A group of little troublemakers plotting on how to deal with the Great Demon King suddenly froze in shock on the spot. Was this some kind of joke? They were plotting well, but the Great Demon King overheard it all, and caught them red-handed.
It’s over, it’s over.
The most terrified amongst them were undoubtedly Wang Luojing and Wang Lici.
One was the mastermind, the other the planner, neither were particularly good elements.
"Hello Fourth Uncle, goodbye Fourth Uncle." Wang Lici’s knees went weak, and her neck shrank as she prepared to dash away.
Wang Luojing’s little face turned pale, and she quietly slipped behind Wang Shouyong. Of the three girls, only the eleven-year-old Wang Luqiu glared at Wang Shouzhe, surprised at his sudden appearance, but also seemed somewhat defiant.
As for Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian, the two boys seemed to have the least courage, bowing their heads and trembling. According to Wang Family’s rules, boys were disciplined more strictly. Wang Shouzhe was not only their older brother but also the head of the direct lineage family. If they dared to show disrespect, they deserved to be taught a lesson.
"Stop right there."
Wang Shouzhe said with a grin, "Wang Lici, Wang Luojing. You better think it through; you can run away as a monk, but you can’t run away from the temple."
The two girls, one big and one small, glanced at each other and then obediently returned to stand before Wang Shouzhe, behaving like little quails.
"Fourth Brother, I won’t dare to do it again."
"Fourth Uncle~ wuu wuu, I was just joking with you."
Wang Shouzhe ignored them and instead turned his gaze to Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian, smiling faintly as he said, "Shouyong, Shou Lian. You two have a lot to say about Fourth Brother, don’t you?"
The two younger brothers were frightened, immediately waving their hands eagerly: "No, no, we usually admire Fourth Brother the most." And this was the truth; among the Shou Generation, Wang Shouzhe was like a star, shining brightly, and they had always held him in high regard.
"Then why did you try to put Fourth Brother in a sack this time? Were you instigated by someone?" When Wang Shouzhe said this, he was somewhat amused; the thought of putting someone in a sack was rather creative of them.
"No, no one instigated us." The two of them shook their heads fervently, clearly frightened, yet they still said, "It was all our idea. If Fourth Brother wants to punish us, we will accept it."
This was more like it, at least showing some responsibility as men of the Wang Family. Just as he was about to speak, Wang Luqiu, who had been glaring at him, put her hands on her hips and said, "Fourth Brother, you’re bullying us."
The little girl, though tiny, was full of vigor.
"Luqiu ah," Wang Shouzhe chuckled, "tell me, how is Fourth Brother bullying you?"
"I don’t want to read those books; just looking at them gives me a headache," Wang Luqiu said, looking distressed, "Fourth Brother, can you not make me read anymore?"
"If you don’t want to read, that’s fine." Wang Shouzhe nodded.
"Really?" Wang Luqiu said, eyes wide with surprise and joy, "Fourth Brother, you’re the best."
"Don’t be too happy yet. If you don’t want to read, there’s a condition." Wang Shouzhe smiled as he looked at the four younger ones present, plus one big niece, "If I were to use my status as your elder brother or the Clan Leader to force you all to do your studies properly, I’m afraid you’d all comply outwardly but not sincerely. So why don’t we make an agreement? Every year, you can team up to challenge me once, openly or secretly. If you win, I’ll let you be. But if you lose, no skipping studies for the year."
"Okay, it’s a deal." Wang Luqiu’s eyes lit up, "On behalf of everyone, I accept."
Then, the others looked at her with soulful eyes, saying, "Who asked you to accept on behalf of us? If Fourth Brother weren’t prepared and we schemed well, there might be some hope. But now he’s obviously on guard, how do we challenge him?"
"Show some spirit, don’t be so dejected," said Wang Luqiu, "Losing just means studying hard and practicing properly. Just win it back next year."
Such boldness earned Wang Shouzhe’s attention.
This little girl had quite the spirited courage. No wonder she had already reached the Qi Refining Realm’s second level at such a young age.
If she maintained this momentum, with the family’s current financial resources, she could become an outstanding woman, even if not as formidable as Ancestor Longyan.
Their encounter this trip, albeit slightly surprising to Wang Shouzhe, also made him feel that his sisters were rather lively.
But the two younger brothers lacked strong will and resolution, a bit too rigid, and needed some serious honing.
If a family wants to develop, it cannot rely on Wang Shouzhe alone. The more outstanding talents and a continuous flow of rising stars will truly elevate the family’s prosperity.
"Haha, let me teach you a lesson first." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "In the future, if you plan on plotting anything, be sure to find a secluded and safe place."
"Fourth Brother, I was wrong." Wang Luojing, teary-eyed and aggrieved, approached, "You’ve been so good to me, yet I did this because I dislike reading... wuu wuu~"
"Alright, alright, I’m not mad at you." Wang Shouzhe also felt a pang of sympathy for Luojing; with her father’s early death and leaving behind orphans and a widow, even with the family’s care, she still lacked paternal love.
"Can Fourth Brother forgive me?" Wang Luojing asked hopefully, her eyes filled with anticipation.
"What’s there to forgive? I never blamed you," Wang Shouzhe comforted her by patting her head. "In fact, it’s quite normal for you to be so energetic, have your own unique thoughts, and even be a bit rebellious. Fourth Brother doesn’t mind, as you weren’t seriously trying to harm me."
Could it be that easy? Wang Lici was astonished and quickly scrambled over, her chubby face pulling into a reluctant apology, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I’m a bit rebellious too, surely you haven’t blamed me either, right?"
"Scram!"
Wang Shouzhe gave her a stern look, causing Wang Lici to back away in fear, clutching her chest as her heart pounded with fright and frustration. Why could Wang Luojing get away with acting spoiled?
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing murmured, throwing herself into Wang Shouzhe’s arms, "Anyway, Luojing swears, I will definitely protect Fourth Brother for life."
"Hehe~ Luojing, your words touch Fourth Brother deeply, and I believe you." Wang Shouzhe laughed, "Except, while clinging, can you not throw weird bugs into my lap? Your little honey trap won’t work on me."
As he spoke, he flicked his finger, sending a foot-long red-headed centipede flying before it could do any harm, where it thrashed for a moment on the ground before meeting its end.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 61: "Ancestor Luoqiu
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61: "Ancestor Luoqiu
...
The entire audience of younger siblings were dumbfounded.
Especially Wang Lici, who blinked in amazement. Could there really be such a tactic?
One moment everything was fine, the next they started fighting?
However, Wang Shouzhe admired Luojing’s thought process. It was difficult for others to imagine taking action right after a conspiracy was exposed. The more unexpected the timing, the higher the chance of success.
Unfortunately, she underestimated Wang Shouzhe in the end.
"Luojing, let Fourth Brother teach you a lesson." Wang Shouzhe said with a smiling squint, "Next time you ambush, keep your breathing steady, and don’t get nervous. Your performance was fine, except your breathing was too tense and your heartbeat too fast, and the way you threw the centipede was a bit rough. But purely from a tactical awareness standpoint, it’s commendable and worth praising."
This Mystical World is very dangerous, where a single battle can decide life and death, and possibly affect the rise and fall of a family. Wang Shouzhe hoped to avoid fighting, but if it was unavoidable, he wanted his side to be the survivors.
"Little Hong!" Wang Luojing suddenly started to tear up, "Waa, Fourth Brother, you’re so mean, Little Hong was hard for me to catch."
Uh...
Seemed like he was a bit heavy-handed. It wasn’t easy for Luojing to tame a venomous centipede.
As Wang Shouzhe was about to comfort her with a few words,
his right arm suddenly felt a pain, and a numbing sensation rushed through his whole body. His heart immediately sank—he had fallen into a trap! With a flick of his wrist, a tiny colored spider, the size of a thumb, flew out.
"Luojing! You..." Wang Shouzhe gasped. He never expected that the red-headed centipede was merely a distraction.
"Fourth Brother, let Jing’er teach you a lesson." Wang Luojing hopped back, keeping two zhang away from Wang Shouzhe before giggling, "First, never underestimate any Spirit Insect Master. Their tactics can be bizarre and unpredictable. Not all venomous creatures are big; I’ve heard of some so small you can’t even see them."
"Second, never underestimate any little girl. Their harmless, innocent appearance is just the best protection. If Fourth Brother is out walking in the future, be careful of everyone, especially obedient-looking little girls."
This remark made Wang Shouzhe’s old face turn red. He took a deep breath and said, "Your Fourth Brother has learned the lesson and will be cautious in the future. Eh, what kind of spider was that? It’s quite venomous... Hand over the antidote to Fourth Brother first."
He sighed in his heart, remembering how Luotong and Shounuo said not to underestimate this girl Luojing; she was indeed cunning. He didn’t take it seriously before, but now he’s truly tasted her prowess.
Tsk tsk, this girl will definitely be trouble when she grows up. No, she already is trouble now.
"Antidote? What’s that?" Wang Luojing feigned innocence with a naive look.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression froze, almost coughing up blood. Luojing, are you kidding me? Carrying around a venomous insect without an antidote?
Aren’t you afraid of being bitten?
The key point being, you still dared to set it on your brother...
"Luqiu, Fifth Brother, Sixth Brother, Big Girl, why are you just standing there? Hurry and act! Don’t give Fourth Brother time to expel the poison with Profound Qi." Wang Luojing shouted crisply, "Otherwise, you’re all stuck in Clan Academy for a year."
She obviously knew that this level of toxin couldn’t truly harm Fourth Brother.
"Great Demon King Fourth Brother, take my punch." Sixth Sister Wang Luqiu came to her senses. She was only eleven but her eyes blazed brightly. She stepped forward and launched the Wang’s Basic Boxing toward Wang Shouzhe, looking quite impressive, surpassing many boys in practice.
Such solid fundamentals in body technique and boxing delighted Wang Shouzhe instead of alarming him, as Fifth Sister Wang Luojing was no simple person to lay a trap he fell into.
And this Sixth Sister Wang Luqiu was equally remarkable, mastering battle techniques so skillfully. Unlike other girls who only focused on improving their Realm Cultivation, neglecting body techniques, combat skills, swordsmanship, or even archery and riding.
He truly underestimated Wang Luqiu.
At the same time, Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian also charged at Wang Shouzhe: "Fourth Brother, forgive us, we were forced into this."
Even Wang Lici joined in, shouting as she attacked Wang Shouzhe: "Take down the Great Demon King." Unfortunately, although her cultivation wasn’t bad, her body technique and boxing form were too flimsy, clearly neglected in practice.
"Well, well, your courage truly surprises me." Wang Shouzhe laughed instead, "But alas, you’ve all underestimated me. Let me show you what a true Great Demon King is."
"Boom!"
As he spoke, Wang Shouzhe flipped his hand, releasing a surge of Profound Qi. Wang Shouyong, who had reached the high stage of the second level of the Qi Refining Realm, was sent flying.
When it comes to solid fundamentals, even among the older generation, few could compete with Wang Shouzhe.
As a legitimate son with extraordinary talent, having a large amount of resources invested, he was nurtured to become a future ancestral level figure. How could he just be a high-realm empty shell?
In the midst of his younger siblings’ attack, his body moved with his heart, like a willow catkin in the wind, elusive and naturally graceful.
"Our family’s Middle-Grade Xuanwu Body Technique—Willow Catkin Body Technique." Wang Luojing, who was watching, was extraordinarily surprised. Fourth Brother hid too deeply, even practicing the Willow Catkin Body Technique to such an extent.
What shocked her even more was Wang Shouzhe’s resistance to toxins. Her speckled little spider, while not of Spirit Insect Level, could bite down and knock over even a two to three hundred jin pig, paralyzing it.
But Fourth Brother seemed unaffected; Fourth Brother was too terrifying, truly a Great Demon King level, leaving everyone powerless.
We lost!
This group of younger siblings, plus one big niece, were all defeated. They laid on the ground groaning, sprawling in all directions. The girls were slightly better off, not hit in the face.
Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian, being fourteen or fifteen-year-old family boys, naturally received extra attention from Wang Shouzhe, getting beaten black and blue.
"Hehe~ Since we have an agreement, then we’d better accept our loss willingly." With hands behind his back, Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "This whole year, study hard for me. I believe the descendants of the Wang Family are all people of promise and responsibility."
As soon as these words came out, everyone made a bitter melon face; well, the coming days will be hard.
"Hmph." Wang Luqiu, being the youngest, still had plenty of courage, "Study is study, but this year I’ll definitely train hard and come back next year."
"Commendable courage, I welcome you all to continue next year. Luqiu, you seem the most energetic, remember this well and supervise everyone." Wang Shouzhe lightly smiled, hands behind his back as he elegantly left.
After he left.
The younger siblings, plus one big niece, finally got up from the ground, exchanging looks. Wasn’t that Great Demon King Wang Shouzhe too difficult to deal with?
"Revitalize yourselves, everyone." Wang Luqiu said, "No matter how strong Fourth Brother is, he is still a person; we are five. Each of us advance one level this year, next year will be different."
Advance one level each, you say so lightly. Everyone rolled their eyes at Wang Luqiu, as if it were easy for everyone to be like you, a Little Demon. At only eleven, you are already at the second layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
"Anyway, I don’t care, whoever drags us down I’ll beat them." Wang Luqiu said dominantly, "I’ll set some targets for everyone. Wang Luojing, next year you should at least advance to the second-layer high stage and strive to become a true Tier-One Spirit Insect Master, mastering two kinds of spiritual insects including the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee. By then your combat power, even against the fourth layer, will have an advantage."
Wang Luojing’s eyes lit up, that was indeed true. If it came to that, even that twenty-year-old brother Wang Shounuo could be beaten. Heard he recently finally broke through to the fourth layer of the Qi Refining Realm, might as well find him later to spar.
"Wang Shouyong, you are now at the second-layer high stage, isn’t it shameful to be at that realm at fifteen? And your basic skills are not solid enough." Wang Luqiu pointed and criticized, "I’m not asking much, next year reach the third-layer middle stage of the Qi Refining Realm and solidify your basics. Or else don’t blame me for beating you every time I see you."
Isn’t that asking for a lot? Wang Shouyong was about to cry, as a brother, getting belittled by Sixth Sister was so embarrassing. But Luqiu is so formidable, not even having an advantage fighting her now. If I don’t try harder, I fear I’ll be beaten by Sixth Sister every day.
"Wang Shou Lian, why are you cowering? Where’s the demeanor of a Wang Family man?" Wang Luqiu yanked up Wang Shou Lian, who was a head taller than her, "You are my own brother... we all came from the same parents, and you’re already fourteen, how are you only at the second layer of the Qi Refining Realm? Ah, it’s all because I, as a sister, haven’t pushed you enough usual."
Wang Shou Lian was about to cry too, fourteen years old and at the second layer isn’t fast, but it’s not slow either, right? My dear sister, didn’t you see our big nephew Wang Zongwei, who is twenty, is only at the second-layer high stage.
With such a Little Demon-like sister, Wang Shou Lian felt a lot of pressure.
"I don’t care, come next year, if you haven’t reached the third layer of the Qi Refining Realm, see how I’ll deal with you." Wang Luqiu forcefully assigned him a task, "Also, remember to come to me every day to practice body technique and battle technique."
Third layer of the Qi Refining Realm... that’s a bit too much pressure! But he had no choice but to agree, he couldn’t even complain anywhere when beaten by sister.
"What about me, what about me." Wang Lici said, "Next year should I also aim for the third-layer middle stage?"
"You?" Wang Luqiu scrutinized her, then helplessly shook her head, "Eat too much, no strength in hands and feet, even reaching the third layer of the Qi Refining Realm is useless. Forget it, forget it, next year just cheer on from the side, and do some logistics support."
So infuriating.
Wang Lici pouted, clearly, I am the Big Girl.
Humph, Wang Luqiu, I’ll remember you! Thirty years in the east of the river, thirty years in the west. I will go find Ancestor for some special training, determined to regain my title as the Big Girl.
In the end, Wang Luqiu, with hands behind her back, mimicked Wang Shouzhe’s way of walking, saying: "As for me, Wang Luqiu, being a once-in-a-century girl genius, the weight of the family’s rise on my shoulders is very heavy. So, let’s set a small goal first, train to the third-layer high stage next year."
What?
Wang Luqiu, are you crazy, is that still a small goal? Are you aiming for the stars? Twelve years old reaching third-layer high stage, are you setting yourself against the Great Demon King Fourth Brother?
"Hehe, I heard some rumors, the family sequence path is about to begin." Wang Luqiu, with little hands behind her back and an immature face, looked up at the sky, "I, Wang Luqiu, a lonely girl genius, carrying the hope and destiny of the family’s rise, am destined to become a goddess like Ancestor Longyan. By that time, even the Great Demon King Wang Shouzhe will have to respectfully call me Ancestor Luoqiu. Wahahaha~"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 62 True Iron Straight Man Wang Shouzhe
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62 True Iron Straight Man Wang Shouzhe
...
Uh...
Wang Shouzhe actually didn’t go far, secretly watching and listening from a distance. He still cares a lot about this group of younger brothers and sisters in the family.
At first, he listened and nodded frequently. With Wang Luqiu around, these younger siblings all felt a huge pressure. If this pressure turns into motivation, it’s a good thing.
But when he heard that unruly girl speaking such nonsense, even saying she would suppress him, Wang Shouzhe.
Hehe~~ Wang Luqiu, oh Wang Luqiu, Fourth Brother will surely give you some real pressure later, so you can feel what care from an elder brother means.
But then again, Wang Shouzhe does feel some pressure. He must cultivate well to avoid losing to them next year, otherwise, it would be quite embarrassing.
With a large investment of resources in the family’s new generation, coupled with Wang Luqiu, the "Catfish Spirit" stirring things up, these little brats won’t grow slowly.
However, Wang Shouzhe is ultimately very gratified. For a family to be strong, can it rely solely on him? An endless lineage of excellent descendants is the true foundation of a family.
The younger generation of the Wang Family is in their prime growth period.
It’s just that the family was too poor before, just supporting him as a direct lineage to charge through the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm was already very difficult. The thirty-year-long sprint process consumed nearly ten thousand Qian Gold in cultivation materials, and the higher you cultivate, the more resources you need.
Other younger siblings, even the children of the eighth generation, no matter how talented, cannot be cultivated like him. The family can no longer afford a second Wang Shouzhe.
Therefore, the younger generation, before the age of twelve, could still have a bit more resources, but after that, the resources would become increasingly scarce. The boys had a bit more than the girls, but only slightly more.
Now these children rely on their elders saving resources to barely cultivate. Take Third Brother Wang Shounuo, for example, it took him until the age of twenty to painstakingly reach the Peak of Qi Refining Third Layer, relying on squeezing his younger sister’s Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill to push forward.
Second Brother Wang Shouyi is already thirty-three years old and only at the Fifth Layer of Qi Refining Realm. Why? Admittedly, there’s the reason of mediocre talent, but the biggest original sin is the lack of resources.
Wang Shouzhe remembers Steward Zhong Xingwang, his talent is naturally far inferior to Wang Shouzhe’s and even ranks at the lower middle in the Wang Family. Yet, he is now a dignified Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator!
Why is this?
Because he is from the direct lineage of a Celestial Human Family, as long as you are not a bloodless waste, you can reach the Spirit Platform Realm by piling up resources.
In other words, if Wang Shouzhe had extremely vast and endless resources, each of these younger siblings could charge up to the Spirit Platform Realm.
If they enjoyed the same resources as Wang Shouzhe did before, by his age, they might not nearly reach the Qi Refining Seventh Layer, but at least the Fifth Layer or barely the Sixth Layer would be attainable.
Wang Shouzhe’s life was originally well planned. He was supposed to impact the Spirit Platform Realm at about thirty-eight to forty years old. For his less talented younger siblings, fifty or sixty years old was almost reasonable, right?
Of course, because of the slow overall cultivation due to poorer talents, the longer the sprint period, the more resources would be consumed exponentially. Therefore, the vast majority of families always prefer to cultivate descendants with good talents for the Spirit Platform road.
But enough of the idle talk for now.
After putting a "special care" label on Wang Luqiu secretly, Wang Shouzhe walked dozens of feet and took a few turns to a pondside, only then did he call Wang Gui over.
Taking off his outerwear, he tore a corner off his inner shirt sleeve, revealing a prominently swollen area on his arm.
That little multicolored spider’s venom was indeed not weak. It’s estimated that a Black Tortoise Practitioner only at the second or third layer of Qi Refining Realm might be out of action for a while after taking a bite.
"Patriarch!"
Wang Gui was startled, "I’ll go get a doctor."
"No need, this little bit of venom was already controlled." Wang Shouzhe remained calm and composed, cutting open the wound slightly, he used Profound Qi to force out the controlled venom completely.
Luckily, the battle was resolved quickly earlier, otherwise, if it dragged into a stalemate, he might not have been able to control the venom.
This was just the venom from an ordinary poisonous insect, not something like a Fierce Insect. Otherwise, even Wang Shouzhe might not be able to handle it.
This lesson also taught him never to underestimate anyone. In the future, effort must be put into guarding against poison, as there are countless bizarre poisonous insects in this world.
After Wang Gui helped him wash off the blood stains, he put his clothes back on.
Only then did he arrive at the courtyard entrance where Wang Luoyi lived.
Wang Xiaoyu had been waiting here for a long time and ushered Wang Shouzhe inside.
At this moment, Wang Luoyi also walked out from the main hall. Upon seeing her younger brother, she immediately beamed, "Shouzhe, you’re finally here. Sister Miaomiao is starving to death waiting for you."
Wang Luoyi is twenty years old this year, and she and Wang Shouzhe are siblings with the same father and mother, naturally growing up to be a lovely goddess-like figure. Moreover, her temperament is serene and natural, her demeanor graceful, bearing the aura of a direct lineage eldest daughter.
It’s just that she’s not very diligent in cultivation, and with no shortage of resources, she’s only at the peak of the fourth layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
But it’s no wonder; most girls in noble families aren’t serious about cultivation, unless they’re aiming for the Spirit Platform Realm. Otherwise, even those of direct lineage rarely achieve much.
Like Aunt Gongsun Hui, who married Father Wang Dingyue at nineteen, and was only at the middle stage of the fourth layer of the Qi Refining Realm. Even now at thirty, she’s only at the sixth layer, and her combat abilities are not to be mentioned!
Neither the Gongsun Family nor the Wang Family can afford to support Gongsun Hui to hit the Spirit Platform Realm, and similarly, the Wang Family and the East Port Chen Family don’t have the resources to support Wang Luoyi to reach it.
Unless Wang Luoyi’s talent is outstanding enough for the family to cultivate her at all costs, and then she’d be on the path similar to Ancestor Longyan’s Spirit Platform Road.
"Shouzhe greets sister. I just met Shouyong, Luojing, Luqiu on the road and chatted with them for a while." Wang Shouzhe bowed politely and said with a smile, "Sorry to keep you waiting, let’s go and see sister Miaomiao."
At the same time, Wang Gui handed over the gift to Wang Xiaoyu and then accompanied her to the side hall to eat and wait.
"Oh, why bring gifts to sister?" Wang Luoyi muttered softly, "You might as well save some money; you’re short on resources for your cultivation. Here, I’ve saved fifty Qian Gold, take it and use it." She didn’t deal much with family finances and didn’t realize the current significant money and resource infusion into the Wang Family.
"Sister, keep this money for yourself." Wang Shouzhe said seriously, "Besides, sister, you should also work a bit harder in cultivation. With the Chen Family’s rising momentum, Chen Fangjie has a good chance of achieving the Spirit Platform Realm in the future."
On hearing Chen Fangjie’s name, Wang Luoyi slightly reddened, lightly muttered, "Why are you bringing him up for no reason?" After a pause, she said helplessly, "Even if I work hard in cultivation, I can’t follow the Spirit Platform Road."
"That’s not certain; the future is still long, sister should seize the present moment." Wang Shouzhe said, "Maybe one day, the situation will change."
"Alright, I’ll listen to you." Seeing him serious, Wang Luoyi agreed. She then linked arms with Wang Shouzhe, "Come, let’s eat, don’t keep Aunt and sister waiting."
"Okay." Wang Shouzhe didn’t speak any further and went to the inner hall with her, knowing that Wang Luoyi’s gentle exterior hid a very strong will.
If she promised you, she’d find a way to accomplish it.
In the inner hall, a little girl with braids, dressed cutely at eight or nine years old, skipped and jumped over: "Brother, Brother. Why are you only coming now? Miaomiao’s tummy is empty with hunger." She said, rubbing her little tummy in grievance.
"Oh dear, my little princess Miaomiao’s tummy has gone flat, that’s a disaster." Wang Shouzhe smiled and picked her up with one hand, "Brother will do a magic trick to apologize, watch carefully, don’t blink."
As he spoke, Wang Shouzhe’s right hand flew over, and suddenly, a packet of dried sea fish appeared. These little snacks tasted nice; the girls at home seemed to like them, so Miaomiao would surely get hooked too.
"Wow, dried fish." Wang Luomiao was immediately disappointed, "I have a whole bunch of these."
Beside was Wang Luoyi, who covered her mouth and laughed lightly, "Shouzhe, this trick isn’t going to work, Lici already brought over plenty of these dried fish; I have them too."
Hehe~
Wang Shouzhe rubbed his nose awkwardly; Wang Lici wasn’t hoarding dried fish resources to engage in diplomacy, was she? Right, she wouldn’t dare offend Luomiao and Luoyi, after all, they were the Great Demon King’s fourth uncle’s dear sister and dear cousin.
Well, that big girl really... has decent survival instincts.
Hmm, hmm, the time spent with her lessons hasn’t been wasted, must continue diligently next time.
"Oh come on, pleasing sister requires some thought, Miaomiao is already eight years old." Watching him embarrassed, Wang Luoyi found it amusing and couldn’t stop laughing.
"Exactly, exactly, Miaomiao is already eight, not a four or five-year-old little girl." Wang Luomiao flashed her bright eyes and teased, "Brother, can you be a bit more attentive?"
"Well then, I’ll perform a martial arts technique for you." Wang Shouzhe said helplessly, "You little girl, getting harder and harder to please."
"Pa"
Wang Luomiao slapped her forehead, showing a hopeless expression and looked at Wang Shouzhe disdainfully, "Brother, which girl would like watching martial arts performances? You’re so bad at pleasing girls, it’ll be tough once Sister-in-law Ruolan arrives, you know. Luckily, ancestors arranged a marriage for you early. Alas~~"
Saying this, she shook her head and sighed deeply, with a look of disappointment at his failures.
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched, the little girl’s tone made it sound like if the family didn’t arrange a marriage, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t be able to get a wife?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Luomiao! Come on, let’s hurt each other a bit
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63: Luomiao! Come on, let’s hurt each other a bit
...
Off to the side, Wang Luoyi and Gongsun Hui were enjoying the spectacle, grinning broadly. It was a rare occasion to see Wang Shouzhe being rendered helpless and at a loss for words; it was quite entertaining.
"Alright, alright, I won’t argue with you today. Let’s eat," Wang Luomiao waved her hand with a sigh and took a seat at the table. "When we have time, I’ll teach you a thing or two. Wooing girls, you know, is a profound skill. Wang Shouzhe, take your time figuring it out."
"Auntie, where did she learn all this?" Wang Shouzhe asked weakly as he sat at the dining table.
Gongsun Hui gave him a sideways glance and chuckled, "That’s what you get for not putting your heart into wooing your sister."
"Learn the lesson, learn the lesson, and upgrade my skills in wooing sisters when I get the chance," Wang Shouzhe wiped his cold sweat. These little girls really couldn’t be underestimated as each of them were quite astute. Lua Xiaoxiao, Wang Luojing, Wang Luqiu, Wang Lici, and even the little Wang Luomiao were all quite formidable.
The younger brothers probably wouldn’t be too foolish either, though in front of an older brother from the direct lineage, they’re certainly too restrained to speak. I bet they’re even more scared to act out, or they’d face even greater reprimands.
The Wang Family’s strictness towards male members was far from lenient like it was with the girls.
"Let’s eat first, before Miaomiao’s belly gets too hungry," Wang Luoyi said with a smile, instructing Wang Xiaoyu to start serving the dishes, having somehow procured some spirit wine, albeit not the White Jade Spirit Rice Wine, but a fine brew made from a blue spirit fruit.
Spirit fruit was even more rare than White Jade Spirit Rice, with benefits for rejuvenating the body, nourishing the skin, and enhancing beauty, much favored by the women of the Black Tortoise Clan.
The dishes weren’t too complicated, mostly consisting of fresh vegetables from local farms, tasting light and refreshing, quite appetizing. To cater to Wang Shouzhe’s need for replenishing his blood and energy, a large bowl of braised meat and some other meat dishes were specially prepared.
"Huh? This isn’t Spirit Horned Yak Meat," Wang Shouzhe was a bit surprised upon seeing the bowl of meat.
The Changning Guard Region held two powerful Celestial Human families, among which the Changning Huangfu Family owned a massive pasture. They not only raised common cattle, horses, pigs, and sheep but also bred the famous Spirit Horned Yak.
Most of the families sourced their primary meats from the Huangfu Family. Especially the Spirit Horned Yak, nearly the main source of spirit meat for major families.
With this pasture, the Celestial Human Family Huangfu amassed great wealth, not to mention their other extensive businesses beyond animal husbandry. Thus, any Celestial Human family is never simple, having a comprehensive strength that is utterly astonishing.
"This is the meat of a wild Tier Two top-level fierce beast, the Iron-backed Wild Boar." Wang Luoyi said, "The vitality and energy it contains far exceed that of the domesticated Spirit Horned Yak. You’ve been working hard lately, and this will help replenish your energy and blood."
Oh my, a Tier Two top-level fierce beast, equivalent to the peak of the human Qi Refining Realm. Normally, a human at the peak of the Qi Refining Realm would find it difficult to defeat a wild beast of the same level in a one-on-one fight.
Or you could say it’s almost impossible to solo it; if you lose, you lose your life, and if you win, you’d probably end up half-dead yourself.
Land beasts are often adept at wild combat, with a terrifying brute force. That Iron-backed Wild Boar is akin to a rampaging tank on Earth, with thick skin and tough flesh, making it extremely hard to deal with.
To hunt such fierce beasts, humans not only need martial power but also strategies and traps, just as the Wang Family fleet needs strategy and skill to battle spirit fish on the river.
"Sister, you’ve got both spirit fruit wine and Tier Two top-level fierce beast meat," Wang Shouzhe asked with slight surprise, "Where did all this come from? Did sister have a windfall?"
Wang Luoyi’s face flushed slightly as she whispered, "These were sent by Chen Fangjie through his household generals for us to try. They said their fleet discovered a lone Iron-backed Wild Boar in the nearby wilds across the river. Ancestor Junyao of the Chen Family decisively led a group to strike, hunting down that Iron-backed Wild Boar."
A lone Iron-backed Wild Boar?
Wang Shouzhe looked envious; this was a great item for boosting energy and blood. That Iron-backed Wild Boar was much more valuable than the East Sea Arrow Banner Fish he had caught. Although the fierce fish was Tier Two as well, it hadn’t reached the top of Tier Two.
However, if a Tier Two top-level fierce beast really appeared in the vicinity, it would definitely be a disaster for the Wang Family. Without their ancestor being able to strike at will, hunting it would probably cost them greatly.
Envious that others have an ancestor to lead them in a hunt.
Fortunately, their own Ancestor Longyan was now converting the Yin Sha Evil Qi and receiving active treatment. Once her injuries healed, her comprehensive combat power probably wouldn’t be something Ancestor Junyao could match.
"Clang, clang, clang, clang."
The sound of two crisp knocks on a bowl interrupted Wang Shouzhe’s thoughts.
"Wang Shouzhe, my dear brother," Wang Luomiao said while knocking on the bowl, "Listen, listen to how Chen Fangjie acts. They’re not even married yet, but he’s already delivering gifts to please his future wife. I tell you, feelings need to be nurtured before marriage. Don’t ignore our Sister-in-law Ruolan."
Wang Shouzhe was at a loss whether to laugh or cry, gently pinching her cheek, "What do you little girls understand? The Liua Family is much stronger than ours, what do they not have? And, don’t knock on the bowl while eating." Chen Fangjie sending gifts to his sister, and the little lass took it and threw it all on him.
"Miaomiao, your brother is right, don’t knock the bowl. But Shouzhe, Miaomiao’s words do have a point," Gongsun Hui deliberated, "Though you’re not married yet, keeping in touch with Miss Liua privately is somewhat against the norms. However, Ruolan will eventually be part of our Wang family, so it’s good to show some care beforehand. Zhe’er, didn’t you just catch a Tier Two Spirit Fish? Pick the best parts and have a female household general send it over."
"Yes, Aunt," Wang Shouzhe agreed, though he felt it was unnecessary, but went along with her suggestion anyway.
"Better write a letter yourself and put it inside," Wang Luomiao’s eyes lit up as she suggested from the side, "to also express your feelings to Sister-in-law Ruolan."
"Stop talking nonsense. Also, she’s not married yet, don’t call her sister-in-law randomly," Wang Shouzhe gave her a gentle flick on the forehead, "What ridiculous idle stories have you been reading lately? Let me tell you, at your age, you should quietly nurture your body, build a solid foundation, do serious schoolwork, and learn basic arithmetic."
Wang Shouzhe knew well that young girls in the family loved to read miscellaneous romantic books, while the boys preferred action and adventure tales.
Such books circulated in secret among the siblings of different families. Although Wang Luomiao was only eight, children of the Black Tortoise Clan were enlightened early, and clever ones like her knew quite a lot of characters by the age of eight.
"Wow~" Suddenly, Wang Luomiao burst into tears, "Mother, brother is bullying me."
"Your brother is right to reprimand you," Gongsun Hui said sternly, "At your age, you shouldn’t be reading such nonsensical things. Hand them over to your mother when you return home. Also, this family custom needs to be rectified."
"Mother, I was wrong." Wang Luomiao pleaded for forgiveness and secretly glared at Wang Shouzhe, grinding her little teeth in anger.
"Aunt, nowadays, these little girls are very clever, don’t underestimate them. Miaomiao is smart and cunning, she must have hidden them well," Wang Shouzhe advised solemnly, "Check under the mattress, on the beams, under the desk, search every secret corner. Also, don’t overlook the maid’s room who takes care of her!"
"Zhe’er makes a good point," Gongsun Hui agreed gravely.
"Wah!"
Being hit where it hurts, Wang Luomiao burst into tears, "Evil brother, bad brother, always bullying people. No wonder Big Sister calls you a big villain, a terrifying demon king."
Hehehe~
Big Sister has really worked tirelessly to spread his notoriety. Along with her dried fish, his "infamy" reached every corner.
Scene change, Wang Shouzhe drank the fine spirit fruit wine and ate spiritual flesh, calmly saying, "If Aunt wants to rectify this wind, you must curtail the source, cut off the channels of distribution. Also, prepare some renowned masterpieces passed down through the ages, and let the children of the family soak up the immortal works of the ancients. I think the ancient classic ’Records of the Eastern Celestial Pavilion’ is quite good, with its elegant and extraordinary language and the mighty spirit of swallowing mountains and rivers. Perfect for Luomiao sister to recite and copy, accumulating culture is best."
"Huh?" Wang Luomiao stopped crying, her eyes widened in disbelief, what nonsense? She had never even heard of that ridiculous book... Wang Shouzhe, you’re taking revenge, revenge!
"This?" Gongsun Hui hesitated, "This classic is indeed good, but its archaic language is too dense, even I struggle reading it. I’m afraid your Luomiao sister can’t handle it?"
"Woohoo, mother is the best, knows how to pity me," Wang Luomiao laughed joyfully, no interest at all in the ’Records of the Eastern Celestial Pavilion’ with its dense arcane language.
The latest circulating booklet ’Overbearing Senior Brother and Charming Junior Sister’ was so captivating, with its gripping and poignant plot.
"No worries. Luomiao sister has been smart since childhood, unlike ordinary girls," Wang Shouzhe smiled indifferently and looked at his sister "indulgently," "At first, copying and reciting might be difficult. But as the saying goes, with diligence and repetition, a bar of iron is ground to a needle. If once doesn’t work, try twice, and if not twice then a hundred times. Keep copying and you’ll grasp it deeply."
"What the heck?"
Copy a hundred times? What does he mean by copying will lead to understanding?
Wang Luomiao shivered, looking at her gentle and beautiful mother. Her panicked heart settled down, yes, yes, I’m so obedient, and Mother loves me so much, surely she won’t...
"Zhe’er’s words are very sensible. Your Luomiao sister is precocious but lacks patience in her studies, often stops after a superficial taste," Gongsun Hui said with grave seriousness, "She needs diligent polishing to understand that constant effort leads to success."
"Wow~" Wang Luomiao cried, crying so sorrowfully, so desolately.
At the side, Wang Luoyi glanced at Wang Luomiao and then at Wang Shouzhe, who wore a face of "affection" for Luomiao sister, and couldn’t help but shiver internally.
Now she understood why whenever Big Sister mentioned Fourth Uncle, her face would turn deathly pale and she’d tremble all over, unable to stand.
At this moment, she was immensely glad that she was Wang Shouzhe’s elder sister and not his younger sister or niece, otherwise, wouldn’t she also be ensnared in darkness and fear?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Family Cultivation Technique Heritage (Seeking Recommendation)
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: Family Cultivation Technique Heritage (Seeking Recommendation)
...
The eldest lady, Gongsun Hui, comes from a noble family background, so she certainly wouldn’t spoil Wang Luomiao without principle.
She left her to sulk by herself.
Then she happily shared a meal with Wang Luoyi and Wang Shouzhe, enjoying a pleasant and harmonious atmosphere of laughter and joy.
"Eldest sister-in-law, this is the pork belly of the Iron-backed Wild Boar, simmered to perfection, tender but not greasy, soft but not mushy, melting in the mouth. Please have a taste." Wang Shouzhe placed a good piece of meat on Gongsun Hui’s plate with the public chopsticks, vividly describing the flavor.
"Gulp." Wang Luomiao, who was sulking on the side, swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
"Sister, did you cook this stir-fried inner tenderloin yourself?" Wang Shouzhe praised as he ate, "The control of the heat is truly refined, fresh and delicious, as if tasting a celestial delicacy."
