"Just eat, where do you get so much to say?" Wang Luoyi rolled her eyes at him, then glanced sympathetically at Wang Luomiao, whose mouth was about to drool.
"Brother, Miaomiao wants to eat too." Wang Luomiao finally couldn’t hold back and pounced towards the dining table, crying out.
Unfortunately, her little head was stopped by Wang Shouzhe with a single finger, who smiled and said, "Call me good brother, or there’s nothing for you to eat."
"Good brother." Wang Luomiao finally couldn’t resist the temptation of the food and completely surrendered.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe chuckle, pick her up, and place her on the chair, serving her meat and vegetables. The little girl, incredibly hungry, ate ravenously, enjoying the meal thoroughly.
After the meal with drinks and contentment, the family had some tea and chatted for a while.
In the evening, as Wang Shouzhe was about to leave, the servant Wang Gui was carrying a large pile of things, including meat, clothes, shoes, socks, and so on.
Wang Luoyi usually enjoyed leisure, not stepping out the door lately, so with nothing better to do, she had been sewing quite a few clothes for him. Wang Shouzhe accepted them with appreciation while urging Wang Luoyi once again to cultivate diligently.
He even advised Gongsun Hui to cultivate well, not to delay her cultivation.
That night.
Wang Shouzhe sat cross-legged in his room, entering cultivation mode.
Daily cultivation of the "Profound Origin Technique" was an essential task, and the path to the Spirit Platform was always walked step by step, allowing no slacking.
However, today’s cultivation was different from usual.
Usually, the Profound Origin Technique was used to circulate energy throughout, refining the body’s blood and Qi, strengthening the physique and the Profound Qi, and at most, consuming one Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill a month to aid in cultivation. But this time, Wang Shouzhe held a Spirit Stone in his hand.
The Spirit Stone in his palm was slightly cold, and he could feel the mysterious and profound energy contained within it.
He channeled his Profound Qi, making contact with the Spirit Stone.
Suddenly.
The energy within the Spirit Stone was activated, emitting a faint light. Wang Shouzhe quickly absorbed the energy into his body.
"Hiss! It’s intense!"
The energy provided a strong stimulation to the body, making him tremble all over for several seconds. Not wanting to waste it, he endured the peculiar feeling and started circulating the energy throughout.
With each complete circulation, the blood and Qi within his body surged and boiled, as if undergoing a Bone Marrow Purify and cleansing, while the Profound Qi generated from the Qi Sea swelled and purified incrementally.
After more than two hours, four complete circulations.
Wang Shouzhe’s internal meridians and acupoints were swollen and painful, so he slowly retracted the cultivation technique, daring not to continue. The swelling pain of his internal meridians and acupoints indicated he had reached his limit.
If he forcibly continued cultivation, it would not only be unbeneficial but also harmful to his body. It’s necessary to take a break, allowing his body functions to gradually recover before proceeding with the next cultivation session.
Therefore, inner cultivation can only adhere to a rhythm of once per day. Using Wang Shouzhe’s understanding as a transmigrator, it’s like the body needs to cool down and recover, needing to supplement with meat to nourish the blood and Qi, without overexploitation.
However, the result of this cultivation was quite satisfying for Wang Shouzhe, with most of the blood and Qi in his body consumed, the newly generated Profound Qi in the Qi Sea becoming increasingly rich and pure.
It should be known that his diet had been too good recently, leaving his blood and Qi vigorous and abundant. Even with persistent daily cultivation, he couldn’t completely consume the blood and Qi.
Yet today’s cultivation gave him a faint sense of blood and Qi deficiency.
This should be due to the assistance of Spirit Stone energy in cultivation. Wang Shouzhe glanced at the Spirit Stone, which had dimmed slightly, feeling grateful for the substantial help the Spirit Stone’s energy provided, both replenishing part of the blood and Qi and working with the Profound Qi to enhance stimulation to his internal acupoints, achieving body strengthening.
At this rate, it won’t take long to reach the peak of the sixth layer of the Qi Refining Realm and attempt to break through to the seventh layer.
Unfortunately, despite great progress, this cultivation method is extremely extravagant.
A single Spirit Stone is worth over a hundred Qian Gold; how long can it last him? Currently, it’s impossible to estimate, but it’s believed that long-term use of Spirit Stones for cultivation will undoubtedly be a massive expense.
However...
Wang Shouzhe thought of his eldest niece, Wang Lici. Recently, under his tireless "encouragement," she not only started to show ambition but also awakened a peculiar foodie talent.
Upon thinking this, he couldn’t help but smile with relief.
Bathe and sleep.
At the break of dawn the next day, Wang Shouzhe got up to practice body techniques, combat skills, swordsmanship, string control, and other skills. Previously, as the Young Clan Leader, there was a small training ground not far from his courtyard. Here, he spent his entire childhood.
His achievements at a young age were not merely due to his bloodline talent or the status of being the Young Clan Leader. His foundation in body techniques, combat skills, swordsmanship, and string control were all refined. Even the Wang Family’s secret, the middle-grade body technique "Willow Catkin Body Technique," and the middle-grade swordsmanship "Wang Family’s Profound Origin Sword" had reached a level of minor achievement.
This was due to the urging and guidance of his strict father, Wang Dingyue, and his own hard work.
All these cultivation techniques, body techniques, combat skills, etc., of the family were brought out by Ancestor Zhou Xuan when he went south with the Pioneer Order, with the approval of the Longzhou Wang Family.
The heritage of cultivation techniques and combat skills is extremely important foundational capital for a family. For instance, the main cultivation technique of the Wang Family, the "Profound Origin Technique," has the "Qi Refining Chapter" and the "Spirit Platform Chapter," which are sufficient for clan members to reach the end of the Spirit Platform path and embark on the Path of Celestial Human.
However, the inheritance of such techniques is always extremely strict. First, clan members are not allowed to disseminate them externally. Second, if someone is found secretly learning the inheritance, it becomes a major issue.
Married women are also not allowed to pass the cultivation techniques to their husband’s family, and any sensible husband’s family would never make such a request, and would even prevent such things from happening.
Otherwise, at best, there would be casualties involved in the case. At worst, the good kinship relations would be completely severed, turning both parties into mortal enemies.
And the family that secretly learns others’ cultivation techniques and combat skills would lose its reputation and may no longer have a place to stand. Which family would dare to marry into a family that doesn’t respect the rules? No family would want its secret techniques to become someone else’s due to marriage.
Ancestor Zhou Xuan originated from the Longzhou Wang Family, and the Longzhou Wang Family, a millennium ago, had ancestors that branched off from the Daqian Wang Family. Therefore, although the Wang Family’s Profound Origin Technique is only a middle-grade technique, it is considered a decent technique within the Changning Guard Region.
At most, one-third of the families have their core inherited cultivation technique reaching the middle grade.
Furthermore, Ancestor Longyan initially cultivated the "Wang Family’s Profound Origin Technique." When she finally advanced to the Spirit Platform after reaching the Purple Mansion Academy, she was accepted as a disciple by Binglan Ascendant and started to retrain with the upper-grade technique "Profound Ice Technique." The Profound Qi cultivated by the Wang Family’s Profound Origin Technique is harmonious and balanced, making it less difficult to retrain with other techniques.
However, even for someone as willful and forceful as Ancestor Longyan, she would never dare to impart the "Profound Ice Technique" to the family. Doing so would not only be unbeneficial to the family but would rather put the family in a deadly situation.
With the means of the Purple Mansion Academy, they could wipe out the Ping’an Wang Family in no time, and no one would dare utter a word.
Let’s set aside the discussion of cultivation technique inheritance for now.
Recently, Wang Shouzhe has been busy with clan affairs. Although he hasn’t neglected his sitting meditation and cultivation, he has indeed fallen behind in body techniques, combat skills, etc. Merely cultivating the realm without practicing body techniques and combat skills is just an empty shell at most.
Not to mention a clan pillar like Wang Shouzhe who intends to follow the path of the Spirit Platform; even every male clan member must diligently practice body techniques and combat skills.
Previously, the family’s requirements for girls in this regard were a bit less stringent, which is why someone like Wang Lici, who is a lazy foodie, even with the cultivation level of the second high stage in the Qi Refining Realm, is merely an empty shell, only able to bully commoners.
However, Wang Luqiu gave him a lot of pressure and motivation. The girl’s middle school-like demeanor is indeed intimidating, spending a significant amount of time on cultivation every day.
In the future, in case she really unexpectedly turns the tables, where would Wang Shouzhe’s dignity be? Seeing how she ridicules her brother Wang Shou Lian, one can tell the result won’t be good.
Let’s fight!
Wang Shouzhe began practicing vigorously, sweating profusely.
His personal servant, Wang Gui, also trained alongside him, inexplicably more motivated than before, full of fight.
...
Meanwhile.
On the largest training field in the main residence, a group of young boys and girls was also sweating and spending their youthful energy.
Wang Luqiu’s young yet somewhat domineering voice rang out: "Wang Luojing, why are you daintily slacking off? Is being a Spirit Insect Master really that remarkable? If you don’t train hard in combat skills and body techniques, when my Unrivaled Dominating Body gets close, I will suppress you in no time."
"Wang Shouyong, Wang Shou Lian, the family’s sequence is about to open, the future Emperor Road faintly visible. If you don’t fight, how can you compete with the various Celestial Pride contenders for that sliver of heavenly opportunity!"
"I, Wang Luqiu, will definitely sweep through my peers, shedding the blood of the Celestial Pride, and surpassing the present age."
Sister!
Wang Shou Lian was in tears, full of regret, thinking he should not have given those legendary story hand-copied manuscripts circulated among boys to Wang Luqiu to read.
How has she become so middle school-like? Always mentioning "suppressing Celestial Pride" and "sweeping across the age."
Our family is just a rural Ninth Grade Lower-Rank Noble Family.
Must life goals be set so high?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Saving the Distressed Young Lady
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65: Saving the Distressed Young Lady
...
A few days later.
The Changning Guard Region had already encountered quite a bit of chaos.
Every one or two days, Wang Shouzhe would receive a letter from Wang Shouyi, recounting the events happening within the Changning Guard. The City Guard Mansion had reached agreements with two Celestial Human Families and several top Spirit Platform Families, including the Xu Family from Changning, as well as Qiaan’s Trading Company and other forces, to open granaries for disaster relief within the city.
However, the Guardian City, with its large population of over a hundred thousand, consumed an astronomical amount of grain daily.
Several audacious merchants had the nerve to hoard goods, selling grain to the city’s citizens at five or six times the usual price. As a result, they were caught red-handed by the City Guard Mansion, not only executed and displayed to the public, but the grain they tried to stockpile was also confiscated and nationalized by the City Guard Mansion.
Moreover, there were rumors because the disaster had spread beyond Longzuo County, making it difficult to allocate grain from outside the county to alleviate the famine in the short term, resulting in a grain shortage even in the vast county city.
It was said that Longzuo-State County City was a major city with a population exceeding one million. The occurrence of a grain shortage there was certainly a monumental event, also indicating the degree to which the overall situation in Longzuo County had deteriorated.
Now rumors and news were circulating everywhere, some saying that the Purple Mansion Academy couldn’t procure grain from outside. Others claimed that the county city had ordered the City Guard under its command to requisition grain to ensure the county city’s grain supply.
The biggest rumor even mentioned that the Emperor Changlong’s lifespan was nearing its end, and the Daqian Empire was doomed. The current insect disaster was a sign of this. Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat, realizing that in chaotic times, all sorts of idle characters emerge.
However, those daring to say the Emperor Changlong was about to die were quickly rooted out by the City Guard Mansion, placed on the city’s gates, and subjected to death by a thousand cuts.
In Wang Shouyi’s letters, he could only discreetly express his concerns, while Wang Shouzhe still heard the gossip from the messenger Household Generals.
To sum it up in one word.
Chaos!
And amidst this chaos, the Ping’an Wang Family could only outwardly remain compliant. Taxes had to be collected, and grain had to be delivered, not a single load less to the Guardian’s Mansion. In fact, even if the Wang Family wanted to deliver one less load, it was impossible.
Even though Third Uncle Wang Ding Race served as Deputy Garrison Commander in the Guardian’s Mansion, in such a critical situation, he absolutely dared not have any private inclinations. This was because people had long been sent from the City Guard Mansion to supervise the grain collection process, and at this moment, who would dare to play favoritism?
This summer’s tax required the Wang Family to deliver a significant amount of grain.
One load after another was loaded onto carts, transported to Dingpu Ferry, weighed under the supervision of the City Guard Mansion’s envoy, and finally loaded onto grain boats.
The three major farms together had a registered total of 7,650 acres of fertile land, taxed at a four-tax rate per acre, requiring a total of 3,060 loads of wheat for the single-season field tax. Luckily, this time the overall harvest was good, aside from the honey bee infestation issue. This season, with abundant early rain and good mid-to-late sunshine, was quite favorable for wheat filling and maturing.
Consequently, the total wheat harvest from the three major farms reached over 26,000 loads, with an average yield of about three and a half loads per acre, barely qualifying as a bumper crop.
After deducting the summer tax, the previously invested Insecticide Powder tax, the cost of seeds and plow oxen, and the tenant farmers’ share, there was still an additional net profit of fourteen or fifteen thousand loads left. Of course, the actual amount of grain was much more than this number.
This was because previous expenditures on Insecticide Powder, among others, were paid with Qian Gold, and there would be no further purchases of that blasted Insecticide Powder. This was merely the income from one season.
By the way, the Fourth Old Master had been persuaded earlier to stockpile a batch of Insecticide Powder. It was sold at three times the price when demand was high, earning quite a fortune.
This made the Fourth Old Master Wang Xiaozhi incredibly proud, boasting to everyone about how his exceptional foresight earned the family a "big sum of money," achieving great merit.
Aside from the summer tax on the family farm’s wheat fields, taxes on other industries within the farms were paid before the year-end. Since they were not producing grain crops, they did not need to settle with grain.
Additionally, there was the delegated tax collection within Wang Family’s sphere of influence.
Because the Wang Family’s sphere of influence was small, the registered fertile land among the commoners under its jurisdiction was only 16,000 acres, taxed at a five-tax rate, but the Wang Family considered the independent farmers’ hardships within its jurisdiction, which, though less than the outside world, were still significant.
Thus, they decided to collect only four taxes of grain, with the noble family’s one tax offset by large copper coins. This time, the Wang Family earnestly collected 6,400 loads of grain, all loaded onto carts and transported to Dingpu Ferry, then shipped off one large boat after another.
Under the protection of his Household Generals, Wang Shouzhe stood at the bustling, fervent Dingpu Ferry, filled with countless emotions. These days, the Black Tortoise Clans and free citizens toil hard in farming, but their yield truly pales in comparison to tax extraction.
This grain was likely, as rumors suggested, partly transported to Guardian City and partly to "relieve" higher-level state and county individuals. Bear in mind, their living conditions were far superior to those in Ping’an Town.
One might say it’s a form of irony.
What’s more, such continuous shipping of grain would further exacerbate the grain shortage in Ping’an Town. Especially for many who had invested their savings in buying farmland, spent a fortune sending their offspring to study, or recently underwent costly weddings or funerals, this crisis would be particularly difficult to endure.
In theory, self-sufficient farming families are not financially disadvantaged, but their consumption levels are significantly higher than those of tenant farmers. The costs of oil, salt, soy sauce, vinegar, food, clothing, shelter, transportation, weddings, and funerals are also much higher.
Moreover, most self-sufficient farmers, if they have any savings, will try to expand their land, build houses, and educate their children in reading and the arts. This exhausts their funds, and most do not have much in savings.
There are usually no issues in normal times, but unexpectedly, this insect disaster came so fierce and sudden.
However, even so.
Except for a few self-sufficient farmers, most of them find ways to persevere until the next harvest, and once they’ve made it through, they can breathe a little easier. But among them, some can’t withstand people making trouble.
Whenever there are natural disasters and man-made calamities, there are always some insatiable wealthy individuals. They take this opportunity to engage in consolidation and devour the people’s fat and blood to grow themselves stronger.
Wang Shouzhe glanced from afar at the convoy of Liu Family and Zhao Family continuously coming to pay taxes, his eyes narrowed slightly. Previously, it was only based on the style of the two families, Liu Family and Zhao Family, the Jackal Wolf Race, and some rumors, to estimate their actions.
However, as intelligence work progressed, some solid information gradually reached Wang Shouzhe. He could almost be certain that the opposing side would indeed make a significant move.
...
Ping’an Liu Family.
In the main hall of the Liu Family’s main residence, the patriarch of the Liu Family, Liu Shengye, was listening to several groups of clansmen reporting on events, which also included the relatively outstanding young Liu Yongzhou.
His brows furrowed: "What’s going on with the Changning Sun Family? They clearly promised to lend us fifteen thousand dan of wheat, and after the autumn harvest, we would return thirty thousand dan of rice. Why aren’t they fulfilling it now? Just like that, isn’t earning double for nothing enough?"
"The Changning Sun Family said they managed to safeguard some of their yield only by rushing to buy insecticide powder." An older clansman in his fifties replied, "They said the Sun Family’s losses were too great."
"How much do they need?" Liu Shengye’s face was somewhat gloomy, the losses this time for the Liu Family were severe, if they can’t make up for it, it would heavily deplete their primordial qi.
The clansman’s face was also grim: "The Sun Family said they won’t ask us to repay the grain double, but said that speculating on grain prices is illegal. It would be better to barter, they want to exchange for fifteen hundred mu of fertile land."
Fifteen hundred mu of fertile land?
Liu Shengye’s complexion turned green and then white, almost fainting from anger: "Have they gone mad, exchanging fifteen thousand dan of grain for fifteen hundred mu of land?" Their Liu Family, accumulating from the time of their ancestors until today, had only just over ten thousand mu of fertile land.
This would cost them one-seventh of their land assets at once, how ruthless, it’s a multiple times windfall of profit.
"Patriarch, why not just drop it?" The clansman helplessly suggested, "According to our original plan, we were only aiming to consolidate about two thousand mu of fertile land. With the Sun Family doing this, aren’t we taking the blame and making someone else a wedding dress?"
"Dropping it is not an option, this time our Liu Family’s losses are too great." Liu Shengye’s eyes revealed viciousness, "Then this time, let’s go big or go home, target three thousand mu to incorporate. Even if we end up mortgaging loans or bartering, we will still profit greatly."
His elder brother Liu Shenghao was at a critical moment in advancing the Spirit Platform, with some resources still lacking. Once he reaches the Spirit Platform Realm, they would have two in the Spirit Platform Realm, then they could compete with the Sun Family.
Liu Shengye has always been adept at economic maneuvering, and never takes a loss. The family has been arduously accumulating wealth for the last fifty years, precisely to cultivate a second Ancestor Spirit Platform in the family.
"Patriarch, such a large move might cause public resentment, right?" Another clansman worriedly suggested, "Moreover, the Wang Family due to a Spirit Insect Master, was mostly unaffected by the disaster. They likely have surplus grain on hand. Might they take the opportunity..."
"They wouldn’t dare!" Liu Shengye confidently declared, "Our Liu Family and the Zhao Family are working together, how dare the feeble Wang Family move a muscle? What’s more, I have already heard that the Wang Family has transported their surplus grain to East Port in exchange for a high return of cultivation resources. That’s a wise move, holding onto surplus grain until the next season will surely not be as sought after."
"And how can the patriarch be sure of this?" A clansman curiously asked, "According to this trend, not every family needs double doses of insecticide powder."
"This patriarch has received the news that the Purple Mansion Academy has begun improving the next generation of insecticide powder. Additionally, as an apology, the next season’s insecticide powder will be distributed to each affected family at a loss, at only ten percent of the cost."
This news is relatively confidential, but in this council chamber, surrounded by key figures of the Liu Family, there’s naturally no fear of leaks.
"Since that’s the case, this opportunity should not be missed." The clansmen all expressed in unison, "It’s just that the Sun Family is too black-hearted."
Having remained silent, Liu Yongzhou suddenly cupped his hands and said: "Patriarch, uncles, Yongzhou actually has a method that might allow us to not cooperate with the Sun Family. Sometime back, my fishing boat rescued a noble young lady in distress by the river..."
At the mention of this noble young lady, an irrepressible flame flickered in Liu Yongzhou’s eyes, passionate, obsessive, almost frenzied...
...
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Hidden Danger of Floating Thunder
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66: Hidden Danger of Floating Thunder
...
In Liu Yongzhou’s eyes, that Miss Zhong was the most perfect lady he had ever seen. She was gentle and charming, yet her words and gestures carried an elusive ethereal celestial aura.
Although she never revealed which Black Tortoise Clan she came from, she must be from a very noble family; her demeanor was a dead giveaway.
Their Liu Family’s legitimate daughter, in normal times, didn’t seem too bad, and already two noble families had come to propose marriage. But compared to Miss Zhong Luoxian, she was like a country bumpkin from a tenant farmer’s family raising chickens and ducks.
Luoxian.
What a beautiful and immortally charming name. She truly seemed like a fairy who accidentally fell from the celestial palace to the mortal world.
Even when she ate spirit fish, she only casually tasted the soft and tender parts like the belly and cheeks, savoring just the freshness.
Things he usually regarded as treasures, like his White Jade Spirit Rice Wine, he wouldn’t dare to present. Her eyes conveyed a faint disdain and condescension that he still vividly remembered.
The only thing that made him very angry and regretful was why he was drinking on the ship with that damn Zhao Dingtian from the Zhao Family that day. Were it not for that, he would have been the sole rescuer of the distressed Miss Zhong.
That damn Zhao Dingtian, Luoxian doesn’t like you at all, yet you still dare to pester her every day.
But soon he and Luoxian wouldn’t have many more days to be together. Zhong Luoxian’s household generals had already found her and were preparing to take her back.
However, he also got a piece of news; it seemed Miss Zhong’s family was also short on grain and was purchasing from a large family from the East Sea Guard. It seemed the relationship between the two parties was quite close, and the additional conditions were not high.
"Yoongzhou, tell me about the situation," Liu Shengye interrupted his idle thoughts with a slight frown.
Liu Yongzhou calmed his emotions and relayed the general situation.
"Could it be a scam?" An older clan member raised doubts, "There are not that many distressed ladies in the world."
"Third Uncle!" Liu Yongzhou said with some annoyance, "Don’t slander Miss Zhong without reason. I only happened to hear about this; Miss Zhong herself never brought it up. I was just thinking that the Sun Family is black-hearted and wondered if I could ask Miss Zhong for help to see if she could also help procure a batch."
Zhong Family? Near the Changning Guard, there aren’t any noble families with the surname Zhong. Could they be from somewhere else...?
"Yoongzhou, even if they’re willing to sell, we don’t have that much Qian gold to buy," Liu Shengye said with some difficulty, "I wonder if it’s possible to buy on credit and repay double after the autumn harvest."
"Patriarch, why can’t our family come up with even a thousand or two Qian gold? I can’t handle this." Now it was Liu Yongzhou’s turn to feel embarrassed. To impress Luoxian, he usually acted like a wealthy noble descendant, but to ask for credit, especially from the goddess in his heart, how could he open his mouth?
"This..." Liu Shengye hesitated, unwilling to speak.
Liu Yongzhou thought briefly and exclaimed with surprise, "Could it be Uncle..."
His uncle, Liu Shenghao, was the first in line on the Spirit Platform path that the Liu Family had been cultivating, and considerable financial and material resources had been devoted to this.
Fortunately, the Liu Family’s overall conditions were stronger than the Wang Family’s. When nurturing the Spirit Platform Realm line, they didn’t excessively squeeze other clan members’ resources. Therefore, Liu Yongzhou could stand out, being considered excellent among the younger generation.
If his uncle advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, the family would certainly expand its territory, and as an outstanding junior of the Yoong generation, wouldn’t he also have opportunities?
He was overjoyed.
Liu Shengye said seriously, "Since you’ve guessed, as you’re a core member of the Yoong generation, I won’t hide it from you, but you must keep it a secret. Indeed, your uncle is already making final preparations, the crucial Celestial Spirit Pill has been procured, and only two auxiliary spirit pills are missing to ensure no mistakes. If you make a great contribution... you’ll understand naturally."
"Very well," Liu Yongzhou suddenly became invigorated. "Even if this matter is a bit difficult, I’m willing to give it a try."
The family was experiencing some resource strain because it was about to produce an ancestor. This was quite normal and wouldn’t cause much embarrassment.
Moreover, once the family gained another Spirit Platform Ancestor, it would thrive greatly, and with increased family resources, according to the patriarch’s words, the next cultivation target might well be him, Liu Yongzhou.
When a family prospers, it’s like accumulating interest, accelerating development continuously. Conversely, when a family declines, it naturally becomes increasingly unfortunate, with difficulties and obstacles everywhere.
In Liu Yongzhou’s view, the Liu Family was on an upward trajectory, while the Wang Family was the kind that was getting deeper into a quagmire, unable to extricate itself.
He was confident that after making a great contribution this time, his future achievements would be immeasurable.
...
Two days later.
In a side hall of the Wang Family’s Main Residence, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but chuckle when he finished listening to some news and put down the secret letter in his hand. Then he clasped his hands to the visitor and said, "Brother Chen, you’ve worked hard on this matter."
"Clan Leader Wang," the man hurriedly returned the salute repeatedly, his expression slightly apologetic, "During the last trip to the Hundred Islands Guard, I didn’t know your identity and was neglectful; please forgive me."
This person was Chen Fanghua, an elite clan member of the Chen Family, responsible for hosting and guiding during that trip to the Hundred Islands Guard. With rich sea experience and social finesse, he was an exceptionally talented individual.
This time, apart from Household General Wang Mei, no other household generals were used to counter the Liu and Zhao families.
Fortunately, the plan required the strength borrowed from the Chen Family, so after much thought, Wang Shouzhe wrote to Chen Fangjie asking for support, promising a share of the benefits upon successful completion.
With Chen Fangjie’s personality, he naturally wouldn’t refuse cooperation with Wang Shouzhe.
Even if things were ultimately exposed, it didn’t matter. Given the East Port Chen Family’s momentum and unique, relatively distant geographical location, he felt no fear of offending the Zhao and Liu families.
Once Chen Fanghua arrived, Wang Zhong arranged for him to be part of the plan. He and another relatively obscure Chen family member pretended to be Zhong Luoxian’s household generals, coming to find the distressed lady.
The plan was successfully implemented, and both Liu Yongzhou of the Liu Family and Zhao Dingtian of the Zhao Family, those "close friends," had both taken the bait. The interception plan had entered its second phase.
"No need to be so polite, Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile. "During the Hundred Islands Guard trip, thanks to Brother Chen’s care, it should have been me apologizing for concealing my identity. Let’s not mention this anymore. In this plan, Brother Chen must pay attention to safety. If anything seems off, better to stop the plan than have any safety issues."
"The plan is excellent, and the part we are involved in is very simple, so it cannot go wrong," Chen Fanghua said admiringly. "Clan Leader Wang is truly formidable, obtaining such a fairy-like ally. Fortunately, I’ve already married and know she’s with you; otherwise, I might have fallen under her spell."
Fairy? Hehe~
Wang Shouzhe chuckled to himself. If Chen Fanghua witnessed her true face, that would be the real shock.
Hmm?
Something’s not right; Wang Shouzhe tried hard to recall what Wang Mei looked like but couldn’t quite remember. His mouth twitched slightly; indeed, the average household general Wang Mei’s true face was so unremarkable it had no presence, even less so than a random passerby.
After Chen Fanghua left.
Wang Shouzhe reopened the secret letter Wang Mei wrote to him. The lacquer seal had been opened earlier, but the earlier received news was so startling that he temporarily put it down.
He now carefully reread it, furrowing his brows tightly, thinking the situation wasn’t good.
The Spirit Platform path line of Liu Shenghao from the Liu Family wasn’t really a secret. However, the man had always been low-key, often overlooked. Moreover, he had recently revealed that he had just reached the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
But suddenly, he had secretly reached the peak of the ninth layer and was already making final arrangements, having acquired a Celestial Spirit Pill.
The Wang Family originally estimated it would be at least five years before Liu Shenghao would begin taking the final step.
This Liu Family had stood independently for only fifty years and had grown increasingly potent. While satisfying family development, they could still quickly save up for a Celestial Spirit Pill. They were more formidable than anticipated.
Liu Family’s Patriarch Liu Shengye had average talent and strength, but his earning ability was impressive.
Wang Mei’s intelligence was likely accurate, extracted during Liu Yongzhou’s drunken confession.
This was a common issue among many men; in front of a goddess they admired but felt inferior to, they always found ways to raise their worth in her eyes, emboldening themselves.
The Liu Family might soon have an additional Spirit Platform Realm Ancestor. What about the Zhao Family?
The Zhao Family had always been more low-key than the Liu Family. Perhaps, their Spirit Platform path sequence had reached its final stage as well.
Wang Shouzhe, with a grave expression, tapped on the table, thinking deeply for quite some time before writing a secret letter with instructions, sealing it with lacquer, and having it secretly delivered to Wang Mei.
This matter is no small concern. If not handled correctly, it could very well lead to the downfall of the Wang Family. However, if managed well, it could serve a fatal blow to the enemies.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 67: 100-Year Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 67: 100-Year Plan
...
As the Clan Leader, Wang Shouzhe usually only needed to manage the overall strategy and naturally did not need to participate in every step of the plan.
Thus, during this time, he stayed in the main residence, spending his days cultivating or "teasing" some younger siblings.
With abundant resources, his cultivation progress was rapid, and he had already reached the peak of the Sixth Layer. In just a few days of polishing, he could attempt to break through to the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
However, today, he needed to take some action.
After arranging things through Wang Gui, he first summoned one of the family’s children.
Not long after.
A gentle woman in her early thirties, with an attractive appearance, led a ten-year-old boy into Wang Shouzhe’s side hall.
"Greetings, Patriarch." The woman bowed slightly. The boy, however, seemed somewhat fearful and hid behind his mother.
"No need for formalities, Sixth Aunt, just call me Shouzhe." Wang Shouzhe returned the bow and invited her to sit, saying, "Please, have a seat."
This Chen Family member was the wife of his Sixth Uncle, Wang Dinghai, and a direct lineage daughter of the East Port Chen Family.
In the sixth generation, intermarriage between the Wang Family and Chen Family was very frequent. Two members from the Ding Generation married daughters of the East Port Chen Family. Also, two aunts of the Lu Generation married into the East Port Chen Family.
Now, both families have even started intermarriages among their direct lineages, so the relationship is very close.
After the servant Wang Gui served tea, fruit, and candied snacks, he withdrew to the side.
Then Wang Shouzhe began to chat with Chen Family, exchanging pleasantries, before focusing his attention on the boy and smilingly asked, "Shouye, how have your studies been lately?"
This boy, the youngest male in the seventh generation Shou Generation, was named Wang Shouye. He was only ten years old, ranking as the seventh child.
Why currently? That’s because the sixth-generation members of the Ding Generation like Third Uncle Wang Ding Race and Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai are still young and vigorous. It’s possible that they might have more children.
It’s not without precedent, just like First Uncle Wang Dingchuan, who fathered Wang Shouyong, the fifth of the Shou Generation, at the age of fifty, truly vigorous at an advanced age.
Of course, the credit goes to First Aunt, who gave birth in her forties and was particularly fertile.
But let’s not digress.
Wang Shouye was visibly shy and very respectful of Wang Shouzhe, who, upon hearing this, was so scared that his face paled, clutching the Chen Family member’s clothes tightly, "Fourth, Fourth Brother. It’s, it’s okay."
"Shouzhe, don’t blame him. The child has always been shy." The Chen Family member explained somewhat awkwardly, "But he has been quite diligent lately..."
As she spoke, she sneakily glanced at Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe understood. The seventh child must have heard about the recent reputation of the Examining Great Demon King, fearing that he would be singled out for an examination by Fourth Brother someday, so he started working hard early.
That’s a good thing.
Wang Shouzhe sipped his tea, increasingly pleased with the reputation of the Examining Demon King. It was like a Damocles sword, constantly hanging over the heads of his younger siblings and the next generation.
Alright, then we’ll just go with the flow and carry out an examination.
Wang Shouzhe started examining Wang Shouye, from basic literature to basic arithmetic, all the way to understanding of Body Technique and Combat Skills.
At first, Wang Shouye was terrified, answering in a stammering manner, but under Wang Shouzhe’s encouragement, he started answering fluently, showing that his fundamentals were quite solid and he had indeed been studying diligently lately.
"Not bad, not bad." Wang Shouzhe smiled, full of praise, "Shouye is doing quite well. This is your reward." Wang Shouzhe directly gave a reward of ten Qian Gold, to honor the first child to successfully pass his examination.
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Shouye’s small face flushed with excitement, and his eyes and speech became considerably more confident.
Recently, the pressure from the Great Demon King had made the younger generation and the youth everyone apprehensive, and rewarding outstanding ones at this time would surely provoke some envy.
Wang Shouzhe believed that the carrot-and-stick policy would make the younger family members increasingly excellent.
Wang Shouye’s good performance made the Chen Family member very gratified and joyful. What mother doesn’t hope for her son to become a dragon?
After the examination, Wang Shouzhe proceeded to the main topic, saying, "Sixth Aunt, I’ll have Shouye accompany me to Xingsheng Farm to pay respects to Sixth Grandpa later." The implication, of course, was that she should not go along.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t oppose Chen Family going together, but he felt that Shouye, as a male in the family, seemed overly reliant on his mother.
Take Wang Luqiu, for instance, though only a year older than Shouye, she had already started to confront the heavens, confront the earth, and even confront the air, shouting every day about slaying gods and exterminating Buddhas, taking on the heavy responsibility of the family’s rise alone.
Though Wang Shouzhe couldn’t understand what slaying gods and exterminating Buddhas had to do with the family’s rise... Furthermore, her so-called [Lonely Girl] bearing the family’s fate... Such a strong atmosphere of a middle-schooler girl also made him want to give her a thump, treating the whole family as if they were all pig teammates?
But that didn’t prevent Wang Shouzhe from appreciating Wang Luqiu’s energetic and ambitious spirit.
Therefore, Wang Shouzhe had to let the seventh child leave his mother’s embrace early and quickly become a little man.
"Everything listens to Shouzhe." Sixth Aunt Chen Family, though somewhat pained for the seventh child, still complied.
Soon after.
Wang Shouzhe took Wang Shouye, heading through the backyard waterway to Xingsheng Farm. He was increasingly fond of taking water routes now, serene and natural, with a wide view, aligning with nature and allowing ample time to plan the family’s grand strategy.
For instance, along the waterway to Xingsheng Farm, on both sides were low-lying wetlands. At this season, it’s overgrown with reeds. Some farmers from nearby villages took the opportunity to come and harvest the reeds, treading through the mud.
Reeds, although not valuable, have numerous uses. For instance, once dried, they can be used as roofing for some rustic houses or woven into reed mats to make the upcoming summer a bit cooler. At the very least, they can be dried and used as firewood.
However, reed fluff is not very useful. Although it looks like cotton, it does not have the warmth of cotton. If on Earth, reeds could be used to make paper, among other uses.
Some of the information buried in his brain was touched, appearing vaguely.
Wait a moment?
Cotton, papermaking?
Cotton crops had long been planted in the Daqian Kingdom, with some noble families relying on large-scale cotton plantations as their industry. If Wang Shouzhe wanted to get involved, it wouldn’t be easy.
But what about papermaking?
In this world, there is of course paper. Books and letters use paper everywhere. The quality of paper is widespread, but the decent ones are controlled by a select few noble families who possess the papermaking technology.
After searching his memory, he couldn’t recall any noble families within the Changning Guard having papermaking technology.
Wang Shouzhe considered the information, touching upon this scene, and was quite interested in the vast marshlands on both sides.
Generations before, when the ancestors developed the Fenggu Farm, they sought areas that were low cost to reclaim into arable land: places with flat terrain, fertile soil, and strong expandability, to keep the development costs relatively low.
These two marshland areas on both sides, however, have various disadvantages, such as being situated at a low altitude. Once it rains, these areas easily flood, but when rain is absent, they become the life vein of the land.
To transform them into farmland, large-scale landfilling is required, raising the entire terrain. Even the Ancestors, back then, couldn’t easily tackle the scope required for transforming the Fenggu Farm.
Of course, back then, thanks to First Uncle, who fathered the fifth of the Shou Generation, Wang Shouyong, at the age of fifty, still strong and vigorous.
Remembering back, at the time of the first uncle Wang Dingchuan, Shouye was born when his aunt was over forty. Not only was she able to conceive at such an advanced age, but she was also incredibly fertile.
The side talk aside.
Consequently, Wang Shouzhe often pondered, whenever he passed by those swaths of wasteland, about how to develop the area.
If filling up the marshland was to be carried out, these areas would lose their water storage capacity come the rainy season. Nonetheless, if the total volume of water remained unchanged, the water level of Zhuwei Lake and other bodies of water could overflow, leading to potential water disasters.
The optimal solution would be to carry out large-scale landfilling of the wetlands, gradually transforming it into fertile land that can continue to expand, thus reducing the overall cost of reclamation.
Moreover, by deepening the water level of Zhuwei Lake, large-scale projects could enhance its water storage capacity, which could assist in mitigating floods when rain is abundant.
A few times when passing by these two large abandoned lands, Wang Shouzhe kept thinking about how to develop this area.
Ever since settlement safety was established fairly securely in Ping’an Town, it has been challenging to find large areas of land that could be more easily developed into fertile land. So, if the project of filling the wetlands is carried out properly, these areas could gradually be turned into productive farmland, aiding the growth of the Wang Family.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe had already begun to include the plan for reclaiming the marshlands into future plans. He could rely more on young ones to possibly realize this grand ambition.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Rise! Salted Fish Elder
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68: Rise! Salted Fish Elder
...
By doing a bit of calculation, it becomes clear that Zhuwei Lake isn’t a particularly large lake, but it does cover an area of about ten thousand mu. Dredging it to an average depth of one meter would amount to six to seven million cubic meters of silt...
In this world, Wang Shouzhe has indeed seen dredging ships.
They’re manually operated using dredging rakes to dig silt onto the ship. One dredging ship can hold about ten cubic meters of silt.
The silt that is usually cleaned out contains adequate organic matter. When mixed and composted with other fertilizers, it becomes a good agricultural fertilizer that can replenish the fertility of farmland.
After all, during this era, the silt from riverbeds and lake bottoms doesn’t accumulate heavy metal pollution.
But the problem is, six to seven million cubic meters translates to six to seven hundred thousand ships! If ten dredging ships work year-round, with each ship clearing three ships and filling three ships a day, it would take over twenty thousand days, requiring six to seven decades of labor without rest!
Moreover, the silt significantly shrinks upon drying. The marshland itself mostly consists of mud, estimating that at most it could fill only two to three thousand mu of good farmland. The entire project is estimated to cost more than ten thousand Qian Gold.
Spending such extensive manpower, resources, energy, and time to open up just one mu of land for three to four Qian Gold seems somewhat unwise.
Clearing Zhuwei Lake to an additional depth of two meters would not only double the cost but also make dredging increasingly difficult. You might as well purchase good farmland, which only costs two to three Qian Gold per acre.
Yet, the calculation isn’t that simple. As Zhuwei Lake undergoes extensive dredging and the water storage increases, it can support the farming of larger fish, potentially even allowing for the introduction of Spirit Fish. From a long-term family perspective, relying solely on wild fishing isn’t a sustainable plan, as the income source is unstable.
If they could industrially farm economic fish species or even Spirit Fish species, that would be the correct foundational industry for the family. Although the investment is huge and time-consuming, once successfully constructed, it would provide the family with a constant source of wealth.
Moreover, the Government Office encourages the Black Tortoise Clan to reclaim land by offering a ten-year tax exemption on newly developed fields, which amounts to considerable savings.
Of course, given Wang Shouzhe’s personality, even if he were to undertake this massive dredging and land reclamation project, he would not spend six to seven decades to do so. By that time, even his great-grandchildren would have been born...
This plan has been brewing in his mind for quite some time.
Originally, he planned to start small-scale implementation next year, gradually expanding the project’s scale, aiming to dredge Zhuwei Lake by two meters within ten years, and fill the marshland to create four to five thousand mu of good farmland, turning it into the family’s next large-scale farm, with ten thousand mu of aquaculture and several thousand mu of good farmland.
The annual output value would certainly not be low, and the total expenditure should be controllable within thirty thousand Qian Gold.
But now, there are some changes in the plan!
Standing on the awning boat, Wang Shouzhe stood with hands behind his back, surveying the wilds on both banks. He seemed to have the demeanor of overseeing a vast territory, nurturing the family’s millennia legacy.
The Seventh male of the Shou Generation, Wang Shouye, sat inside the cabin, his originally anxious heart gradually calming as he looked at his fourth brother standing so tall and majestic, and a feeling of admiration and reverence welled up within him.
I, Wang Shouye.
In the future, I must become a man as steadfast and resolute as the Fourth Brother.
...
The awning boat docked at the small pier of Xingsheng Farm. Under the trepid guidance of the Wang Family’s collateral management at the farm, Wang Shouzhe and Wang Shouye went all the way to find Wang Xiaohan.
At this time, Wang Xiaohan was tending to the precious twenty mu of Spirit Field, carefully removing weeds from the Spirit Field. Those weeds were pulled out as soon as they sprouted, preventing them from having extra opportunities to absorb nutrients and Spiritual Qi.
Even if it’s just one mu of Spirit Field, if meticulously cultivated, even producing an additional half yield is a significant resource.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t disturb him, opting instead to wait patiently.
This Xingsheng Farm was the second farm opened by Ancestor Zhou Xuan. It boasted two thousand mu of good farmland, a small livestock farm, and a small orchard and vegetable garden. Most importantly, Xingsheng Farm cultivated twenty mu of Spirit Field.
This land was embraced by a small tributary of the Liping Mountain Range. The original land had many fragmented and loose stones, theoretically not a very suitable area for development.
However, Ancestor Zhou Xuan chose this place to cultivate farmland, even going as far as to dig through canals to bring in a water source to develop the farm. This was because, within the narrow mountain crevices, there was a gushing Spiritual Spring.
The presence of a Spiritual Spring indicated the existence of a small Spirit Vein.
By constructing a Spirit Gathering Array around the Spirit Vein, the Spiritual Qi from the vein can be condensed and prevent dispersion, converging and nourishing the land. With the Spiritual Spring irrigating the land and various agricultural techniques used to enrich the soil, one can gradually open up Spirit Fields suitable for planting various Spiritual Objects.
Having one’s own Spirit Field allows for the production of one’s own Spirit Rice, marking a Black Tortoise Race as truly having its own foundation.
Therefore, Ancestor Zhou Xuan named this farm "Xingsheng Farm," naturally hoping that the family would prosper.
This pool of Spiritual Spring, along with the small Spirit Vein, can support a maximum of around sixty acres of Spirit Field. However, back then, the Wang Family was relatively unfamiliar with the technology for growing Spirit Rice. To avoid unwarranted depletion of the Spirit Vein, a Spirit Gathering Array was temporarily built, and twenty acres of Spirit Field were opened.
The plan was to wait until the Wang Family had matured in the technology for growing Spirit Rice, and then to open up the remaining forty acres of Spirit Field. Unexpectedly, before the plan could be implemented, the Wang Family faced a great calamity.
Afterwards, the family was in a state of fear, and resources were scarce.
Investing in the Spirit Field was also a large investment with slow returns. Everyone’s mind was set on first nurturing an Ancestor Spirit Platform, and then slowly saving money to develop the Spirit Field, accumulating the family’s foundation.
Unexpectedly, the first candidate for cultivation, the eldest legitimate son, second uncle Wang Dingtian, whether it was due to the psychological trauma from a major catastrophe at the age of five, or because of the pressure exerted by the elders, or perhaps his own anxiety, at the age of twenty, he fell into a state of madness and died.
It is important to know that the Wang Family’s "Profound Origin Technique" is known for its balance and harmony. Even if we count from a thousand years ago in the Longzuo Wang Family, practitioners who fell into madness are exceedingly rare.
In the family’s grief, attention was shifted to the second legitimate son Wang Dingyue and the sixth Wang Xiaohan. The elders, having learned from experience, did not exert too much pressure on Wang Dingyue, but nurtured him methodically.
More pressure actually focused on the gifted direct vein member Wang Xiaohan. However, when he took the path to Spirit Platform, it was already relatively late. It wasn’t until nearly twenty years ago that Wang Xiaohan secretly took the Celestial Spirit Pill, exchanged for many family assets sold off.
The upgrade failed!
Subsequently, Wang Dingyue died in the Outer Domain.
This matter is quite bizarre. Originally, Wang Shouzhe thought the family had really run out of resources and could not afford to buy Celestial Spirit Pill for Wang Dingyue. But lately, upon careful thought, Wang Shouzhe realized that there is something amiss.
Ancestor Longyan could sell the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, her personal Spirit Treasure, to gather resources, so why did she not buy it for his father Wang Dingyue?
Furthermore, after the former Patriarch died, Ancestor Longyan did not show up. Is she afraid of revealing something suspicious? It’s quite possible that during this period, she took forceful action.
If the Ancestor acted, then who did she act with? Did she accompany his father Wang Dingyue to the Outer Domain?
If the conjecture holds true, why did Ancestor and his father Wang Dingyue go to the Outer Domain at such a critical moment? Was it truly just to procure resources for seeking opportunity?
Certainly not.
Wang Shouzhe has reason to believe that Ancestor and the clan elders have a significant secret kept from him. Moreover, that secret should be very important to the Wang Family! Perhaps, the Outer Domain holds an opportunity to ascend to Spirit Platform Realm, and it was just that his father Wang Dingyue failed?
The more he thinks about it, the more it makes sense, otherwise Ancestor Longyan would definitely choose to sell the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield to buy Celestial Spirit Pill for his father Wang Dingyue, rather than taking risks together in the Outer Domain.
If given the chance, he wonders if he can extract some information from Ancestor’s mouth.
While Wang Shouzhe was deep in thought, the sixth granduncle finished dealing with the weeds and walked out from the forest field, seeing Wang Shouzhe and Wang Shouye guarding outside, he couldn’t help but relax his brows and smile, saying, "Shouzhe, why have you come? Have you been waiting long? Why not call me earlier?"
Although Wang Shouzhe couldn’t discern his cultivation, he could sense a somber and aged aura in his mental state. Clearly, he hadn’t recovered from the failure of investing a lot to ascend to the Spirit Platform Realm. He was only sixty-five years old but felt older than the fourth granduncle Wang Xiaozhi, just like a real old farmer.
"Hello, sixth granduncle." Wang Shouzhe bowed.
"Grandfather." Wang Shouye rushed up.
"Oh, oh, you little rascal, why have you followed your fourth brother to see grandfather?" Wang Xiaohan picked up Wang Shouye, teased him a bit, and then had a member of the collateral line take him aside to play.
Afterwards, Wang Xiaohan invited Wang Shouzhe to drink a cup of regular tea in front of his secluded hut, saying, "Shouzhe, have you come this time still to persuade me to pursue the Spirit Platform path again?"
Previously, Wang Shouzhe had sent Household Generals with Peiyuan Pill and Spirit Stone and wrote a letter outlining his intentions. However, Wang Xiaohan refused, saying that his ambition had aged, and he only wished to have a grass hut in front of the Spirit Field for the rest of his days.
This laid-back attitude, Wang Shouzhe did not blame him.
He sipped the ordinary tea, looked around, glanced at his simple hut, and smiled saying, "No, Shouzhe is just here to bid farewell to the sixth granduncle, and to take one last look at the Spirit Field left by Ancestor Zhou Xuan. After all, Shouzhe is nothing more than a dying man."
"What?"
Wang Xiaohan almost crushed the cup, burst out in anger and surprise, "Wang Shouzhe, what nonsense are you talking?"
An astonishing aura erupted from him.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 69: The Family Foundation Passed Down by the Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: The Family Foundation Passed Down by the Ancestor
...
His burst of momentum was quite extraordinary, even more intense than what I had seen from Steward Qian some time ago.
Clearly, Wang Xiaohan is a man with deep foundations and accumulations.
However, because of his past failures, his will was too depressed, and he merely planned to tend to the twenty acres of Spirit Field until his old age.
"Hehe~" Wang Shouzhe ignored his momentum and rage, calmly saying, "Liu Shenghao of the Liu Family and Zhao Daoyuan of the Zhao Family. These two names must not be unfamiliar to you, Sixth Grandfather?"
In shock and awe, Wang Xiaohan gradually retracted his momentum, returning to an appearance of an old farmer, with a solemn expression, "Both are taking the path of the Spirit Platform. There are rumors that in less than five years, they will each attempt to challenge the Spirit Platform Realm, which poses the greatest threat to our family.
"But Shouzhe, you need not worry too much. Once you marry Miss Liua and have children, the Liua Family, with their three Spirit Platform Ancestors, will definitely find ways to protect us. All the family needs is for you to hold on until reaching the Spirit Platform, and we can firmly establish ourselves."
The three Spirit Platform Ancestors of the Liua Family share deep blood ties with the Wang Family, especially Liua Xuanfu, who has developed at Purple Mansion Academy for many years, her strength likely having reached an unfathomable depth.
Furthermore, she is a cousin to Ancestor Longyan.
Heh, no wonder he’s content being a salted fish.
Wang Shouzhe analyzed that Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan’s attitude of self-blame and ostrich-like avoidance was due to his failure to break through, afraid to shoulder any responsibilities again. These types are also common in modern Earth society, like entrepreneurs who collapse after a major blow to their confidence.
To deal with such people, the best method is to cut off all their hopes and eliminate the last straw of psychological solace.
Wang Shouzhe smiled playfully while toying with an unadorned teacup, "What a pity, what a pity, I have confirmed news. The Zhao Family and Liu Family have secretly prepared the Celestial Spirit Pills. Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan are polishing their skills for the final stages and could strike for the Spirit Platform Realm at any time. If either of them succeeds, there will be no place for our Wang Family."
"If I were the Patriarch of the Liu Family or the Zhao Family, once the family had two Spirit Platform Realm Ancestors, I would surely conceal this matter first, seeking an opportunity to secretly and daringly strike to kill Wang Shouzhe during mourning." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "I am merely engaged with Miss Liua. Even if the Liua Family feels humiliated and enraged, they are unlikely to avenge me."
He knew all too well that both the Liu Family and Zhao Family viewed him, Wang Shouzhe, as a thorn in their side. They dared not act now, as the time wasn’t ripe, or they couldn’t bear Ancestor Longyan’s backlash.
If one family had two Spirit Platform Realm Ancestors working in unison, why would they fear the crazy retaliation of Ancestor Longyan, who had one foot in the grave?
Of course, they would prefer to wait for Ancestor Longyan to falter on her own, posing less risk that way.
But who knows how long their patience can last?
Once a second Ancestor appears in the family, spirits will be lifted, and ambition will inevitably stir.
"How could it be, how could it be? How could they act so quickly?" Wang Xiaohan’s face was full of shock and despair. In his eyes, Wang Shouzhe was already the family’s last hope.
If he died, the Wang Family would truly be finished.
"As long as they’re willing to invest resources, accelerating the cultivation process is perfectly normal," Wang Shouzhe said lightly while sipping tea, "If I were the Patriarch of the Liu Family or Zhao Family, I would make the same choice. Using smoke bombs to confuse the opponent while desperately pushing forward in secret is merely a common tactical measure."
"So ruthless, so ruthless." Wang Xiaohan trembled all over but his gaze gradually became determined, and he suddenly stood up, "Our only option now is to sell the family treasure and exchange it for another Celestial Spirit Pill. Your Sixth Grandfather will risk his life to challenge the Spirit Platform again, hoping Ancestor Zhou Xuan will protect us. I, Wang Xiaohan, will either succeed in retracing the Spirit Platform path or die trying!"
His posture was upright, as though he could prop up the sky and stand firm, dispelling all decay and despondency, fearless of success or failure. This sixty-five-year-old man stood up once more, just like before, taking on all burdens.
Family treasure?
Wang Shouzhe asked with slight confusion, "Does Sixth Grandfather mean to sell the Cosmic Palace Sword? It’s the only relic of Ancestor Zhou Xuan, currently enshrined in the ancestral hall. If it’s sold, regardless of success or failure, the soul of the family would be drawn out."
"Of course not. The Cosmic Palace Sword is a symbol of our foundation; how could it be sold?" At this moment, Wang Xiaohan exuded a fierce aura, repressed for nearly twenty years under regret and endurance.
But at this moment of life and death for the family, the sharpness he once thought had been worn away emerged again, causing even Wang Shouzhe’s heart to feel faintly apprehensive. As expected of Sixth Grandfather, who had previously challenged the Spirit Platform Realm.
"Our Ping’an Wang Family, after all, is the foundation created personally by Ancestor Zhou Xuan with his own hands and feet." Wang Xiaohan spoke confidently, his hands behind his back, "Though we are now in decline and in hiding, our deep-rooted foundation is still not something those traitorous families of servant origin like the Liu Family and Zhao Family can compare to."
Wang Xiaohan, having lived through the rebellion incident back in the day, naturally harbored deep-seated hatred for the Liu Family and Zhao Family, despite them being vassal families and not servants.
So, our family has hidden depths?
This made Wang Shouzhe even more convinced that his father, Wang Dingyue, going to the Outer Domain to seek opportunities and dying there was merely a public excuse. It seemed even he, the son, was kept in the dark, and most likely, his mother was also unaware.
"Shouzhe, don’t blame me. Originally, I planned to show you these things after you came to Xingsheng Farm someday." Wang Xiaohan said apologetically, "But you’ve been so busy lately, there hasn’t been a chance."
Wang Shouzhe didn’t mind it much; as a junior in the family before, he couldn’t have known everything. Moreover, the more family secrets and hidden resources, the better. He wouldn’t mind having ten or so ace cards unknown to him.
This way, the pressure on him as the Clan Leader would reduce significantly, and being a carefree person might not be a bad thing.
Wang Xiaohan led him around twenty acres of Spirit Field, through the clear, flowing Spiritual Spring, and by the mountain stream, he opened a secret door camouflaged as a rock.
Upon entering, they found the sides lined with rock walls like blades, and only a narrow path leading to the end.
Following Wang Xiaohan through the narrow path, the view suddenly opened up. It was a hidden place akin to a Grotto Heaven Blessed Land, with bright sunshine streaming through the cave above, illuminating this secluded inner cave.
The interior wasn’t very large, barely a few thousand square meters, roughly the size of two acres. Yet, the family had specially constructed a Spirit Gathering Array here, and within it were two acres of Spirit Field shrouded in mist.
These two acres of Spirit Field, judging by the richness of the spiritual qi gathered, far exceeded the twenty acres of Spirit Field outside. Moreover, what was planted here wasn’t the traditional White Jade Spirit Rice.
But instead, it was a cluster of precious Spiritual Medicines!!!
"These two acres of Spirit Field are all Middle-Grade Spirit Fields?" Even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but be slightly surprised.
"That’s right." Wang Xiaohan said with a hint of pride, "Back when Ancestor Zhou Xuan developed Xingsheng Farm, he discovered this hidden, independent mountain ravine. It just happened to be the starting point of a small Spirit Vein, and a small Spiritual Acupoint gathered here. Then he personally, along with several clan members, expanded and excavated this place, spending a fortune on laying soil and building the array, channeling the Spiritual Spring, and it took considerable effort to develop two acres of Spirit Field. After long-term nourishment by a dedicated Spirit Gathering Array and meticulous management, it gradually turned into two acres of Middle-Grade Spirit Field."
Spiritual Medicines mostly grow in Spirit Veins and Spiritual Acupoints, gradually forming the essence of plants and trees after prolonged nourishment by spiritual qi. The more abundant the spiritual qi, the higher the chances of the growth of Spiritual Medicines.
In all, Wang Shouzhe had lived so long, yet had never encountered Spiritual Medicines in the wild.
"Shouzhe, look, this patch is all ten-year-old Purple-leafed Heshou, planted ten years ago. This one is twenty-year-old, thirty-year-old, and fifty-year-old." Grandpa Wang Xiaohan pointed at the acre of Spirit Field divided into five grids from small to large, each grid planted with Purple-leafed Heshou of different ages.
The grid area occupied by older Purple-leafed Heshou was larger.
Wang Shouzhe knew that Purple-leafed Heshou was a common root-type Spiritual Medicine that was relatively easy to cultivate. Once it matured to fifty years, it could be used in alchemy.
The famous and highly sought-after Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill used fifty-year-old Purple-leafed Heshou as its main ingredient.
A fifty-year-old Purple-leafed Heshou weighed approximately one jin and could be refined into five to ten Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills with other auxiliary materials. Those who produced less than five were considered immature alchemists, while those who produced more than ten were often Alchemy Masters.
However, crafting Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills yielded slim profits, so rarely did Alchemy Masters ever bother to refine Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills out of sheer boredom.
Thus, selling fifty-year-old Purple-leafed Heshou, valued at around fifty Qian Gold, was usually more profitable for alchemists, who would break even at six pills and start profiting from the seventh.
"By rotating this acre, every ten years our family will have a batch of fifty-year-old Purple-leafed Heshou maturing." Wang Xiaohan said proudly, "Every ten years, we can harvest an average of eighty mature Purple-leafed Heshou."
Eighty plants?
Wang Shouzhe was secretly astonished. Wouldn’t that be around four thousand Qian Gold? That’s quite a substantial income.
And this is just the yield from one acre of Middle-Grade Spirit Field.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 70: 9-Leaved Spirit Ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70: 9-Leaved Spirit Ginseng
...
However, four thousand Qian Gold sounds like a lot, but that is the production of a full ten years.
Moreover, the consumption is extraordinarily large.
Just the Spirit Gathering Array alone needs to have its spirit stones replaced every five years, requiring five spirit stones each time, which averages out to the usage of one spirit stone per year.
Additionally, the fertility of the spirit field is a huge problem. A spirit field without fertility is like a human body lacking various vitamins, which can easily lead to stunted or even dead spiritual medicine.
The best source of fertility is the fermentation of spiritually linked things such as straw left from harvesting spirit rice, remaining purple leaves from purple-leafed Heshou, and remnants of spirit fish and spiritual flesh.
Of course, the main source of fertility is still the manure from domesticated spirit beasts.
For example, the Huangfu Family raises quite a number of Spiritual-Horned Yaks, and the manure they produce in a year is considerable. Besides using it on their own spirit fields, they sell the surplus to reduce the cost of raising spirit beasts.
Spirit Horned Yak meat is expensive, and rightly so, as the breeding costs are exorbitant. They must use the spirit fields to grow a large amount of spirit grass and occasionally have to buy residue from spirit bean oil extraction or rice bran left from threshing spirit rice!
Even Celestial Human Families must be frugal to ensure a continuous flow of profit.
Similarly, the maintenance of spirit fields is extremely troublesome. Spiritual Qi gathering, replacement and maintenance of spirit stones in the Spirit Gathering Array, creation and maintenance of the irrigation system of the spiritual spring, fertility supplementation of the spirit fields, and pest and disease control—all these have very high costs.
However, if the spirit fields are well-maintained, they not only have a high output value but are also the foundation of a family.
Wang Shouzhe set aside distractions and said, "These trades of purple-leafed Heshou aren’t recorded in the family account books, right?"
He had carefully studied the family account books and found no entries for the income and expenditure of those two acres of spirit fields.
"Rest assured about that, Shouzhe." Wang Xiaohan hurriedly explained, "The income and expenditure of these two acres of middle-grade spirit fields are all recorded personally by me, and the other elders and the clan leader can check the accounts at any time. When we return to the thatched cottage, I’ll show you."
"Part of the output is used to offset the costs of the two acres of middle-grade spirit fields. Some are exchanged for Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills and portions of spirit beast blood and flesh, gradually converted into family account books and inventory as repayments from other families, transforming into the family’s long-term consumption."
Wang Shouzhe suddenly remembered that indeed the family account books recorded some obscure income, like debts from other families to the Wang Family from decades ago being repaid in batches, etc.
At that time, it seemed inexplicable, but now it makes sense that it was the output from this hidden spirit field. The purpose should be to make those two acres of middle-grade spirit fields more concealed.
"Naturally, I trust you, Sixth Grandpa." Wang Shouzhe waved his hand and smiled, "However, Sixth Grandpa must also train the successor for the spirit field cultivation and care as soon as possible. Otherwise, having an ancestor at the Spirit Platform Realm farming every day is not feasible."
"A successor naturally needs to be trained early, but..." Wang Xiaohan furrowed his brows slightly, "Right now, only Zongwei has just become an adult in the family!"
Wang Zongwei!
For a family like the Wang Race, which prides itself on its honor and strictness towards men, to have such a character emerge. Though he seemed more honest after recently getting beaten.
But considering Wang Xiaohan’s character, he surely wouldn’t trust a gambler?
No matter how he appears to have changed, it doesn’t help. The spirit fields in the family are crucial assets; what if that scoundrel sells them off?
"There’s no rush, select a few from the younger generation and see who has talent," Wang Shouzhe said, "Shouyong, Shoulian, and Shouye can also be tried. Managing spirit fields isn’t something that happens in a mere ten or eight years."
Letting Wang Zongwei manage the spirit fields—Wang Xiaohan wouldn’t allow it, and even Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t agree.
Wang Xiaohan opened his mouth, initially wanting to ask what if he couldn’t advance to the Spirit Platform Realm.
But on second thought, if he couldn’t advance, the family might be in jeopardy...
At that time, they’d have to find other ways to protect the family and Shouzhe. But many family assets, including these spirit fields, might be lost. Thinking too much about it now is futile.
"Shouzhe, most of the proceeds from the purple-leafed Heshou are invested into this acre of middle-grade spirit field," Wang Xiaohan said, pointing to another middle-grade spirit field.
This other spirit field is also divided into multiple sections of various sizes. The smallest section is only a few dozen square meters, while the largest takes up a third of the space, about two hundred square meters.
Only one spiritual medicine is planted there. Its large leaves are greedily absorbing the sunshine and spiritual energy within the spirit field.
It was previously mentioned that Wang Shouzhe had learned the Fierce Beast Atlas and Spirit Medicine Atlas as part of his studies since childhood. He immediately recognized it as a Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng, and seeing its large leaves, he realized this ginseng was quite old.
Usually, a century-old ginseng is worth several dozen Qian Gold.
But the Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng is of spirit grade. Even a century-old one is worth over a thousand Qian Gold, as it’s a material for many Tier Three spiritual medicines.
The Healing Holy Medicine Creation Pill consumed by Ancestor Longyan requires a two hundred-year-old Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng, making its price extraordinarily high, but its healing and stamina-restorative effects are also exceptionally powerful!
Even for an ordinary person at death’s door, a single Creation Pill can drag them back from the brink. However, it’s difficult for even wealthy ordinary people to purchase a Creation Pill.
Wang Shouzhe’s heart trembled more and more as he looked at the Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng; there was something wrong with it.
"This Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng was already close to five hundred years old when Ancestor discovered it in the Outer Domain," Wang Xiaohan explained, "so Ancestor decided to plant it in the Spirit Field to cultivate it."
Five hundred years old?
Wang Shouzhe was truly astonished by the family’s foundation; indeed, it was a family treasure. He vaguely understood that one of the main ingredients of the legendary ’Celestial Spirit Pill’ was the Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng aged five hundred years.
The value of this item was likely to exceed fifty thousand Qian Gold? Indeed, if an ancestor in the lineage was formidable, the foundation of the family’s heritage was something other ordinary families couldn’t compare to.
"It’s just a pity that the Middle-Grade Spirit Field is too little of a benefit to it," Wang Xiaohan said helplessly, "Currently, its growth is very slow. It’s been here for seventy years and hasn’t transformed into a five hundred-year-old spiritual medicine."
Uh...
Seventy years ago it was nearly five hundred years old, and seventy years later it still hasn’t transformed; indeed, that’s quite slow. Wang Shouzhe found himself speechless, as the value of high-tier spiritual medicine is extraordinary, yet it’s truly something ordinary families can’t afford to cultivate.
Looking at it occupying more than three fields, if these seventy years had been used to plant Purple-leafed Heshou, the net profit should be at least several thousand Qian Gold, yet it has only grown a little bit.
The age of spiritual medicine is not simply determined by how many years it is planted. If the same spiritual medicine is planted in Lower-Grade and Upper-Grade Spirit Fields, can they be the same?
What is called Centennial Spiritual Medicine is because the spiritual medicine undergoes transformation at that stage, significantly advancing its essence of life and medicinal properties to the next stage.
It’s somewhat akin to humans transitioning from the Qi Refining Realm to the Spirit Platform Realm.
The value escalates significantly.
However, the higher the age of the spiritual medicine, the more difficult it becomes to cultivate because its need for spiritual energy and nutrition becomes greater. A barren spirit field simply lacks the ability to sufficiently nourish its growth.
In some excellent spirit fields, the growth speed of spiritual medicine is notably faster. However, in terms of planting and cultivating layout, it is best not to let it grow at a speed that exceeds the normal age speed.
For example, enhancing the concentration of spiritual energy and fertility, using fifty years to accelerate to produce a centennial spiritual medicine.
Such spiritual medicine in the market is called ’Rapid-growth Pill’; both its practical medicinal properties and value are greatly reduced.
The growth of spiritual medicine involves factors such as spiritual energy and fertility, while the actual years of growth are equally important. Some experienced spiritual medicine merchants, Pill Workshop Chief Stewards, alchemists, and other professionals can discern with a glance whether it is a rapid-growth pill.
"According to my estimation, in seventy years of planting, its age should have increased by about seven years. But if it accelerates, I estimate in another twenty years it will transform into a five-hundred-year-old spiritual medicine." Wang Xiaohan said excitedly yet regretfully, "It’s just a pity our family doesn’t have an Upper-Grade Spirit Field, otherwise it should be able to grow normally."
Upper-Grade Spirit Field?
Wang Shouzhe glanced at Wang Xiaohan, thinking how daring you are for a sixth elder.
Our family finds it hard enough to handle a Middle-Grade Spirit Field, yet you dare dream of an Upper-Grade Spirit Field?
"Shouzhe, this item was originally left for you to use as a precaution once it matures." Wang Xiaohan said with difficulty, "Moreover, the family has invested too many resources and effort into it. Selling it now before it transforms incurs a loss. If it weren’t for the family being in a crisis, I would absolutely not sell it to exchange for a Celestial Spirit Pill. Ultimately, it is the Sixth Grandfather who let you down."
"Selling it now is indeed too costly," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "However, Sixth Grandfather, don’t act rashly just yet. Let me think of a way to solve the problem of the Celestial Spirit Pill."
"What?"
Wang Xiaohan was astounded, "Shouzhe, where would you get so much money to buy a Celestial Spirit Pill?"
