A Ninth Grade Lower-Rank Clan, using decades to gradually accumulate wealth to exchange for a Celestial Spirit Pill, was already extremely difficult.
Families able to achieve this level can mostly perpetuate the lineage, continuing endlessly.
Loose Cultivators, unless they encounter great opportunities, couldn’t buy a Celestial Spirit Pill in a lifetime. Furthermore, major academies and sects are cautious towards rootless and foundationless Loose Cultivators.
Even if the person’s talent far surpasses a genius like Wang Shouzhe, academies would still consider and investigate cautiously, choosing not to accept if there’s any doubt.
Lack of background means one could make up an origin, leading to potential future issues; who knows if they’re spies for hostile forces or carrying great unresolved hatred?
It’s also because resources are hard to earn that Wang Xiaohan was so shocked.
"Sixth Grandfather, you should first use the Peiyuan Pill to properly adjust your health, quickly recover your state to prepare for the sprint to the Spirit Platform Realm," Wang Shouzhe did not answer directly, "I am merely attempting to try a bit. If luck is good, hehe~"
In Wang Shouzhe’s view, the Liu Family and Zhao Family achieved what they have today by seizing the results that the Wang Race ancestors fought for with their lives. Since he knew they had accumulated decades of wealth ’fruits.’
With his personality, wouldn’t he try to figure out a way to have a go?
Even if he couldn’t win, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t want them to easily digest the wealth fruits.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 71: The Ancestor’s Injury Greatly Improves
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: The Ancestor’s Injury Greatly Improves
...
Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan was somewhat suspicious and uncertain, but in the end, he still respected Wang Shouzhe’s decision.
He is the Clan Leader now, the head of the family. If he strongly opposes selling the immature Five Hundred-Year Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng, then naturally no one would dare to sell it.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe also took an interest in the remaining six or seven portions of the Middle-Grade Spirit Field.
It was also planted with the Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng, ranging from low to high maturity, the least mature being ten years old, and the most mature astonishingly reaching seventy years.
"The Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng is not sold externally by us but is instead used to slowly accumulate the family’s foundation," Wang Xiaohan explained, "Thus, although these two acres of Middle-Grade Spirit Field yield considerable value, at least half of the profit is reinvested into increasing the cultivation of the Nine-leaf Spirit Ginseng."
"Indeed." Wang Shouzhe nodded in praise, "If a family wishes to continue thriving over the long term, it cannot rely on quick profits alone, but rather on long-term investments and returns. As such, the family’s foundation will gradually become robust, allowing us to rise with good harvests, and sustain during downturns or crises."
These two acres of Middle-Grade Spirit Field are secretly operated outside the clan’s assets, which theoretically violates the taboos of the Black Tortoise Race.
However, it’s not a clan member operating a private property. Broadly speaking, it is still part of the clan’s assets, while accumulating this foundation, it also occasionally bleeds a wave of support to the family.
Clan members operating private properties for personal gain have always been one of the greatest taboos of the Black Tortoise Race. Such practices inevitably lead to disunity, constant internal strife, and eventually the family’s collapse.
If a certain clan member truly wishes to independently develop his or her business, they can separate from the family to establish their own lineage elsewhere, with the family’s agreement on conditions.
This is known as a branching off.
At that time, that branch will be recorded as a subsidiary bloodline of the Ping’an Wang Family.
For example, the Golden Sand Xu Family is the branch of the Changning Xu Family. Though both bear the Xu name, they split into two independent entities more than a hundred years ago.
The Ping’an Wang Family is also a branch of the Longzuo Wang Family, with the family tree records in the Longzuo Wang Family’s ancestral hall inevitably including records of Ancestor Zhou Xuan passing on this lineage.
However, how many descendants survive, who they are, naturally won’t be recorded in the family tree, at most some chronicles will record the prominent figures that emerged from here.
Anyway, enough idle talk.
After visiting the family’s secret foundation, Wang Shouzhe was in high spirits, feeling more confident because of these foundations.
Wang Xiaohan also took Wang Shouzhe around Xingsheng Farm to further understand it, greatly enhancing his knowledge of the farm.
After achieving his goal, Wang Shouzhe, having eaten dinner, took a boat back home with The Seventh, Wang Shouye.
Along the way, in the boat covered with dark bamboo.
Wang Shouzhe took out pen and paper, sometimes pondering, sometimes noting down things. Beside him, Wang Shouye showed curiosity, "Fourth Brother, what are you writing?"
"System panel."
"Oh." Wang Shouye had no idea what a system panel was, but he inexplicably thought his Fourth Brother was amazing, his admiration and respect reaching new heights.
Indeed, Wang Shouzhe was absolutely not going to give up gradually establishing and updating his system panel.
The dark bamboo boat gently rocked along, returning to residence.
After encouraging and advising Wang Shouye with a few words, Wang Shouzhe had the servant Wang Gui escort him back. Carrying a cloth bag full of fresh fruits, he made his way to [Longyan Residence].
Outside Longyan Residence, Wang Shouzhe found Big Girl Wang Lici peeking around. His face became stern, "Big Girl, what are you doing sneaking around?"
"Ah? Fourth Uncle..."
Wang Lici was scared stiff, confessing honestly, "I-I’m looking for Ancestor."
"Nonsense." Wang Shouzhe frowned and reprimanded, "Longyan Residence is a forbidden area. Without Ancestor’s summons, how dare you disrupt Ancestor’s concentration?"
"I, I..." Wang Lici was terrified, her round face turning pale, tears welling up, "Fourth, Fourth Uncle. I was just trying to seek Ancestor’s guidance, guidance on Body Technique Combat Techniques."
"Body Technique Combat Techniques?" Wang Shouzhe suspiciously assessed her, "Are you sure you’re not here to ask Ancestor for food?"
"Fourth, Fourth Uncle. How can you say this about me." Wang Lici, brimming with grievances, weakly retorted, "Don’t you have aspirations? I, I also want to become stronger."
When he heard this.
A hint of warmth softened Wang Shouzhe’s stern expression, as he tenderly rubbed her head, "It turns out my Little Lici is indeed ambitious, it was a misunderstanding by Fourth Uncle. Fourth Uncle apologizes to you."
Humph, so angry, I don’t want to talk to you.
Wang Lici turned away, puffing her cheeks, tears in her eyes, looking pitifully aggrieved.
"By the way, I just went to Xingsheng Farm," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "I picked some fresh sweet melons, this year’s weather is good, the melons are juicy and sweet. Would you like one?"
Saying this, he pulled out a vibrant, green sweet melon from the bag.
"Want, want, want." Wang Lici’s eyes immediately lit up, grabbing the melon and wiping it before munching loudly, her eyes narrowing in satisfaction while praising, "This melon is so sweet and delicious, thank you Fourth Uncle."
"Lici, being ambitious is a good thing. However, Ancestor’s health is poor, it’s best not to disturb her without reason." Wang Shouzhe said with relief, "Given your current realm level, Fourth Uncle’s guidance is sufficient. Starting tomorrow, meet me at my training ground at 5:00 AM, Fourth Uncle will train with you. Slow down eating, here, have another melon."
Wang Lici listened to the first part earnestly, but the latter part made her tremble, practically giving up on the melon, her voice trembling while weakly saying, "Fourth, Fourth Uncle. Isn’t 5:00 AM a bit too early?"
"Not early, now that summer is here, dawn arrives early at 5:00 AM." Wang Shouzhe slightly frowned and said, "That time is perfect for training Battle Techniques and Body Techniques. Are you having difficulties?"
"I, I mean. Is there a way without training, where every day I just eat and drink, and still become strong with some Black Tortoise Combat Skills?" Wang Lici blinked with curiosity, "Why not, Fourth Uncle, ask Ancestor for me?"
Heh heh!
Wang Shouzhe’s face twitched uncontrollably; so this was Big Girl’s ambition? He actually believed her!
Wang Shouzhe, oh Wang Shouzhe, you’re still too young after all.
At once, he quietly grabbed her melon, stuffed it back into the cloth bag, and walked toward Longyan Residence without looking back.
"Hey, Fourth Uncle, that’s my melon. How can you just take it?" Wang Lici chased after him, "Fourth Uncle, the world is so big and full of wonders. Maybe there’s such a Black Tortoise Combat Technique out there."
Wang Shouzhe sneered twice. Are you accusing me of being ignorant?
"Come inside, don’t make a fuss out here."
At this moment, Ancestor Longyan’s voice came from inside Longyan Residence.
Wang Shouzhe responded and pushed the door open to enter. Wang Lici, however, trotted in after him, shrinking back when she caught Fourth Uncle’s unfriendly gaze and said, "Ancestor said everyone should come in." She particularly emphasized the word "everyone."
"Heh heh~" Wang Shouzhe gave her a glare before proceeding to pay respects to Ancestor Longyan.
By this time, Ancestor Longyan had already moved to the pavilion, waiting for the two of them.
"Shouzhe pays respects to Ancestor." While giving his salute, Wang Shouzhe noticed that Ancestor Longyan’s aura seemed greatly improved, even the white hair draped over her shoulders appeared to have an invisible gloss, prompting him to exclaim joyfully, "Congratulations Ancestor on your great health."
His heart was stirred as well; the better the Ancestor’s health, the safer the Wang Family would be, and the burden on his mind could ease considerably.
"Lici pays respects to Ancestor, congratulations Ancestor on your great health." Wang Lici rushed forward to pay her respects, even parroting Wang Shouzhe’s congratulatory words, which made Wang Shouzhe twitch at the corner of his eye.
However, Ancestor Longyan seemed rather receptive to her. In such good health, her mood was also pleasant, and she gestured for Wang Lici to come over: "Child, why haven’t you come to see Ancestor recently?"
This scene left Wang Shouzhe slightly bewildered. During the trip to the Hundred Islands Guard, what charm had this girl used on Ancestor? Ancestor seemed quite fond of her.
Then, Wang Lici began to attend diligently to Ancestor, rubbing her shoulders and arms while replying, "Fourth Uncle said Longyan Residence is off-limits to the family, and told Lici not to disturb Ancestor’s meditation. Boo hoo~ Ancestor, Lici misses you dearly, I’ve lost my appetite these days, just look how thin I’ve become."
Heh heh.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned unkind. This bothersome girl dared to put on a victim act right in front of him?
"She does seem a bit thinner." Ancestor Longyan gave her a glance and then said to Wang Shouzhe, "Shouzhe, if Big Girl wants to come in the future, just let her."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lici, who had been hiding behind Ancestor, gave Wang Shouzhe a triumphant look.
"Ancestor," Wang Shouzhe said, "I’m just afraid she’ll be too noisy and disturb your cultivation."
"It’s fine." Ancestor Longyan, perhaps due to her improved health, seemed to have an open mind, "Lici is gentle and clever, very attentive. With her company, I can recover even faster."
Alright then.
Wang Shouzhe admitted that Wang Lici was quite skilled at currying favor. He immediately said, "If Ancestor likes it, that’s wonderful. These fruits are freshly picked from the farm; please try them."
"Fourth Uncle, you’ve worked hard. I should handle these small tasks." Wang Lici rushed forward, took the cloth bag, enthusiastically washed two melons, and naturally gave one to Ancestor, "Ancestor, please enjoy the melon. I’ve tried it, it’s very crisp and sweet."
Then she happily munched away, delighting in her meal.
Wang Shouzhe was truly impressed by his niece’s thick-skinned nature.
Seeing her enjoy the melon so much, Ancestor Longyan slightly turned aside, lifted a corner of her veil, and took a couple of bites as well, saying, "This year, the summer came with less rain, making the melons sweeter than usual."
Seeing Ancestor in such good spirits, Wang Shouzhe also felt relieved. Recently, Ancestor’s nourishment with spiritual food was ample for healing, making her once emaciated figure more robust, shooing away the cold and withering aura.
It was clear that her health was improving, and she was filled with hope for herself and the family’s future.
This also signified that the Wang Family’s fifty years of misfortune were about to end. What followed would be the reckoning and rise.
Wang Shouzhe’s mood also improved significantly.
But before all that, he must first manage the future of the promising younger member, Wang Lici, of the Wang Family.
This child had ambition, loved gourmet food, was filled with enthusiasm and a colorful imagination for life, and knew how to endear herself to her elders.
Such an outstanding child.
Surely, having her accompany Sixth Grandpa in planting the Spirit Field would be most suitable.
Besides, this child loved reading and possessed a spiritual quality, so she mustn’t miss out on any new classics or ancient works. Although the Wang Family was poor, its members couldn’t be deprived of education.
Imagining Big Girl working tirelessly in the fields during the day and reading by lantern light in the grass hut at night, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but smile with gratification and satisfaction.
The family’s hope for rising ultimately rested on these excellent descendants.
We as elders must support them during these crucial moments of their development.
"?"
While indulging in her third melon, Wang Lici sensed that something was off, her back felt a chill.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Brother-in-law and Brother-in-law
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72: Brother-in-law and Brother-in-law
...
Then.
He found an excuse to temporarily send Wang Lici away and detailed the recent plans to be executed, highlighting the parts that required the Ancestor’s cooperation.
Inside the pavilion.
Ancestor Longyan’s snow-white hair gently danced in the wind, her eyes like stars shone with a mesmerizing light, her words plain yet carrying an undertone of slaughter: "Shouzhe’s plan is very good, but why is it that I am only arranged as the backup? The Yin Poison within me has been mostly refined, and when it’s time to act, I no longer need to worry about backlash in the short term."
"Even if this plan lures in an old fiend, I, Wang Longyan, can slay it at some cost. If it lures two old fiends, there’s no fear as well."
Wang Shouzhe rubbed his forehead; everything about Ancestor Longyan was fine except her excessively fierce nature.
The battles between these two families are akin to playing cards; who throws in their trump card right from the start?
He had arranged Ancestor Longyan into the plan merely as a precaution, to be used as a last resort. As her condition was rapidly improving, how could he let her take such risks anymore?
This kind of thinking is unacceptable.
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe respectfully clasped his hands, saying, "Ancestor, the conflict between the Black Tortoise Clans is not about individual bravery or cruelty, nor is it like marching into battle. Because those participating are all our relatives, household generals, or close friends. A single mistake could lead to irreparable loss."
Ancestor Longyan’s delicate body shivered, calming her down slightly, she apologetically said, "Shouzhe, you are right. I, Wang Longyan, have been willful and pampered half my life, committing many errors, and causing much irreparable past. It’s necessary to calm down and deeply reflect on my inadequacies."
"Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe quickly said, "Your great contributions and sacrifices for the family are unquestionable, and we juniors have always kept them in our hearts. It’s just that times have changed; our Wang family is in the dark while the Liu and Zhao families are in the open. What we need to do is protect ourselves while taking a big chunk out of them. It’s like taking some interest before collecting the debt."
"In terms of strategy, I am not as good as Shouzhe." Ancestor Longyan’s eyes flickered, "I will fully rely on your arrangements."
Upon receiving Ancestor Longyan’s approval, Wang Shouzhe also felt a burden lifted from his heart. In reality, he did not need Ancestor Longyan to be involved in this plan. As he said, what he feared most was the occurrence of unforeseen circumstances.
Ancestor Longyan’s role was meant to be a last resort card, to be used only if necessary, especially since her body is just beginning to recover.
"In that case." Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands and took his leave, "I respectfully ask Ancestor to rest well, and when it’s time to act, I will notify Ancestor again."
After saying this, Wang Shouzhe took his leave.
Before leaving, he didn’t forget to pull along Wang Lici, who was eating, to prevent her from disturbing the Ancestor’s rest.
...
More than an hour later.
At the pier in the backyard, a small boat slowly departed. Wang Lici, holding a bundle, was bewildered in the wind. Apart from her change of clothes in that bundle, there was also a large pile of ancient texts and classics carefully selected by her fourth uncle.
Just like that, she’s been arranged?
"Big Girl." Wang Shouzhe waved tearful goodbyes from the shore, "While contributing to the family at Xingsheng Farm, make sure to listen to Grandfather Six. Among all the younger siblings and the younger generation at home, it’s you that Fourth Uncle dotes on and values the most. This good task, your brother Wang Zongwei might not get in his next life."
"Many, many thanks for Fourth Uncle’s high regard." Wang Lici’s tears streamed like a fountain, "I’m truly grateful to you."
"No need for thanks, everything is understood without words." Wang Shouzhe was also filled with emotions, feeling like sending off a daughter in marriage, having the impulse to wipe away tears, "Wang Ju, Wang Bamboo. You both must take good care of Miss Lici along the way, do not slack off in the slightest."
"Yes, Patriarch."
The two female household generals responded solemnly in unison, then they simultaneously fixed their gaze on Wang Lici. Apparently, their real task wasn’t to take care of her, but to "escort" her.
The boat gradually drifted away.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe stop waving goodbye, walking back briskly and cheerfully.
Actually, arranging her like this was his intent to temper her personality. This unruly child was used to idleness and even dared to fantasize about acquiring a Black Tortoise Combat Technique that required no cultivation, just eating and drinking all day to become very powerful?
Is there such a Black Tortoise Combat Technique or cultivation method, give Wang Shouzhe a dozen!?
Your wild imagination is even larger than mine as a transmigrator.
Unrealistic!
How long to grind her down? Three months is too long, half a month too short. Then let’s make it a month, by then she should be tempered enough. Then I’ll keep her by my side to teach and guide her well.
Lici, oh Lici, don’t blame your fourth uncle for being ruthless.
As the saying goes, a treasure sword comes out from honing, plum blossom fragrance comes from the bitter cold. Without effort, how can there be reward?
Accompanying him, Wang Gui was even more cautious. He really feared inadvertently offending the patriarch and being sent to dig mines.
Originally, Wang Shouzhe thought about taking Wang Lici for a walk around Guardian City to collect some spirit stones for use. But now, Changning Guard was indeed too chaotic, he preferred not to take that risk for the time being.
Wang Shouzhe had just returned to the courtyard.
The doorward came hastily to report, saying Gongsun Zhong from the Gongsun Family, along with Wang Liuyu from the Liu generation, had come home to visit, and they came after receiving a letter from the patriarch.
Upon hearing they had arrived.
Wang Shouzhe’s mood lifted; this meant that there was progress in the matter he had entrusted to Gongsun Zhong to investigate. He immediately asked the doorward to lead the way to the courtyard for entertaining distinguished guests.
Right now, it is evening, and the crowd is enjoying the cool breeze.
"Third Aunt, Third Uncle," Wang Shouzhe greeted with cupped hands as he entered.
Gongsun Zhong and Wang Liuyu hurriedly returned the salute. Although they were of higher seniority, Wang Shouzhe was the Clan Leader of the Wang Family.
"Luotong and Luojing are here too," Wang Shouzhe smiled and greeted his two sisters, and then respectfully saluted Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou, "Shouzhe greets Fourth Aunt."
Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou had taken care of him and Wang Luoyi for a period, a kindness forever remembered.
"No need to be so polite, Shouzhe," Xu Zhirou hurriedly returned the respectful salute.
Their presence here was entirely normal, given that Wang Liuyu and Luojing’s late father, Wang Dingbang, were full siblings, naturally making the relationship between the families special.
What followed was some hosting and dining.
The evening.
Wang Shouzhe met alone with Gongsun Zhong, who had the household servants deliver some items to his courtyard.
There were baskets of stones, some iron ore powder, white gypsum, and a variety of other miscellaneous items.
"Shouzhe, I brought everything you described in your letter. Not sure if they’re right, so I brought a lot of miscellaneous items," said Gongsun Zhong, whose dark skin gave away his honest and straightforward nature.
Since the age of eighteen, he had been working in the Gongsun Family’s mines and was very familiar with various mineral stones. If Wang Shouzhe wanted to make cement, he couldn’t avoid involving the Gongsun Family.
To be frank, there was no need to avoid it. Given the strength of the Ping’an Wang Family, attempting to monopolize the benefits of cement posed too great a risk. In his plan, the cement industry, if successfully developed, should at least involve the Gongsun Family and the East Port Chen Family together.
Of course, the premise was successful research and development.
"Thank you, Third Uncle. How much in total?" Wang Shouzhe expressed his gratitude, "So I can settle the accounts with you."
"It’s all worthless waste, not even ten cartloads in total," Gongsun Zhong hurriedly waved his hand, "My second uncle also instructed me not to take any money."
"Thank you, Third Uncle, and also thank Grandfather," Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands in thanks, without making any fuss over it.
After a short chat, the taciturn Gongsun Zhong took his leave.
Regarding the research and development of cement, Wang Shouzhe already had some ideas. Recently, he had been trying to recall, roughly determining some directions. It’s not very different from lime; it involves burning limestone with various other things and then mixing with gypsum and grinding it into powder.
Most of the raw materials are very cheap, with the only slightly valuable one being iron powder, though its content should be low.
Wang Shouzhe naturally would not personally conduct the research on cement. Instead, he had previously sought out a family of kiln workers from a collateral line of the Wang Family, a small family that had been building kilns and making bricks for generations.
It is said that their ancestor was also a kiln worker and had followed Ancestor Zhou Xuan southward due to that skill. Many of the bricks in this main residence were made by that collateral family.
"Wang Gui," Wang Shouzhe handed the written "Cement Research Guide" to Wang Gui for handling, "These are compiled clues about [Iron Cement] from ancient texts, with properties similar to lime. Beyond that, I don’t know much. Tomorrow morning, you will deliver this information and those ten cartloads of research materials to Wang, yes, Wang Jingyuan."
"Yes, Patriarch," Wang Gui followed the instruction and collected the materials.
Wang Shouzhe naturally attached great importance to the area of cement, hoping for a successful breakthrough, but he was ultimately an amateur. It was better to provide the ideas to professionals; the kiln workers, having dealt with bricks and tiles all their lives, are familiar with lime and even some homemade adhesives.
These professionals are experienced and not without intelligence. Often, what they lack is merely a flash of inspiration.
As for whether the development succeeds immediately or not, it doesn’t matter; take it slow, and eventually it will work out.
Similarly, in the area of papermaking, Wang Shouzhe also only wrote a "Paper Research Guide," then found some smart and reliable collateral family carpenters and, after providing some research funds, let them handle it themselves.
Having a large collateral population has this advantage; you can always find some talents across various fields.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe’s current greater focus needed to be on the grand plan of countering the Liu Family and the Zhao Family.
...
Night.
It was already late.
Outside the Anjiang Dingpu Ferry, a medium-sized, luxuriously designed tower ship floated on the wave-stirred river. This ship was clearly not a transport vessel but one specifically for the travel of those of noble status.
The tower of this ship was exquisitely built, made entirely of expensive materials and colors, exuding an aura of luxury and sophistication.
The main hall of the tower was even more lavishly decorated, as if a noble family descendant had moved their expensive living room and bedroom onto the ship. Those antique flower vases looked incredibly precious; aren’t they afraid that a gust of wind could shatter them?
Such magnificence was evident.
However, at this moment, two very young and gallant men were facing each other in this hall. Beside them stood a stunningly beautiful, otherworldly woman, standing obediently with her hands down, both fearful and deferentially.
Her captivating eyes darted furtively from one man to the other.
In her quiet heart, she decided with secret pleasure that the Patriarch was more handsome.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 73 Shouzhe! Don’t act recklessly
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73 Shouzhe! Don’t act recklessly
...
Two young and handsome men, each with the demeanor of a noble young master, were staring wide-eyed at each other, neither expecting the other to be here.
"Shouzhe, didn’t you say you weren’t going to be involved in this mission planning phase?" The slightly older handsome man, Chen Fangjie, the Young Clan Leader of the Chen Family, said awkwardly.
"I was worried, so I came to take a look. But you, Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe touched his nose, suppressing the urge to hit someone, "why are you here? Could it be..."
"Misunderstanding, a real misunderstanding." Chen Fangjie was sweating profusely and quickly explained, "First, we needed someone to play the role of a noble young master from a powerful family in Shouzhe’s plan. I couldn’t find a suitable candidate and thought the challenge was interesting, so I took on the role myself. Second, alright, I’ll be honest. I heard from Fanghua that Miss Luoxian is as beautiful as a celestial immortal, like an exiled immortal descending to the mortal world. I was curious, so I joined this mission to broaden my horizons."
"Hehe~ Let me ask first, before deciding." Wang Shouzhe believed him mostly, observing Chen’s expressions and words, then turned to Wang Mei, "Wang Mei, tell the truth, did this young master act disrespectfully towards you?"
"Reporting to the Patriarch," Wang Mei said seriously, "when this young master first saw me, he seemed mesmerized for about three seconds before turning away and dared not look again. Aside from that, he did nothing disrespectful."
Upon hearing this, Chen Fangjie finally breathed a sigh of relief, proving his innocence. Otherwise, one wouldn’t know what future brother-in-law Wang Shouzhe might have done.
However, he was soon stunned and said in surprise, "Wang Mei? Could this be Miss Luoxian’s real name? She’s actually Shouzhe’s subordinate, possibly a Wang Family General?"
"Hehe, so what if she’s my Wang Family General?" Wang Shouzhe half-smilingly retorted, "What, does the ’brother-in-law’ wish for my Wang Family to send a general as dowry?"
"Absolutely not, absolutely not." Chen Fangjie was shocked, breaking into a cold sweat, and hurriedly said with hands clasped, "Please don’t misunderstand, I, Chen Fangjie, can swear by the heavens, my heart for Luoyi is as clear as day and earth. I won’t have divided loyalties or waver like the wind."
A solemn oath from Young Clan Leader is no trivial matter, showing how urgent the situation was for him.
Seeing he had pressed enough, Wang Shouzhe laughed and cupped his hands, saying, "I naturally trust Brother Chen’s character. Please, have a seat. Wang Mei, serve the tea."
Wang Shouzhe sat down first, displaying an air of host-like demeanor.
Chen Fangjie wiped a non-existent bead of sweat from his forehead, thanked Shouzhe, and returned the gesture.
He then seated himself opposite Wang Shouzhe. Only then did he feel something amiss – wasn’t he supposed to be the host of this boat? How did the roles reverse so easily?
Wang Mei, graceful as a descending celestial, akin to a noble daughter from a celestial human family, obediently brewed tea, her movements elegant and tranquil, exuding a unique charm.
"Patriarch, please enjoy the tea. Young Master Chen, please enjoy the tea."
Their dialogue had already indicated to her that the slightly older young master present was indeed the Chen Family’s Young Clan Leader, and the future husband of Miss Luoyi.
He was quite handsome, with extraordinary presence, but he still fell short compared to the Patriarch. As she poured the tea, she silently made that assessment.
"Shouzhe, when did you acquire such a remarkable general?" Chen Fangjie asked, finally calming down after sipping some tea, but unable to curb his curiosity, "Excelling in both looks and demeanor, I can’t even see through her cultivation. I mean no offense, it’s just quite unbelievable."
Not seeing through the cultivation was intentional, otherwise the Little Spirit Jade Pendant – the Concealing Breath Pendant, bought by Wang Shouzhe for a thousand Qian Gold, would’ve been a waste.
Originally, Wang Shouzhe intended to use it to conceal his own cultivation. But it served far better when used by Wang Mei. Everything else could be disguised, but the aura of cultivation wasn’t easy to fake.
Just imagine, how could a noble lady from a prestigious family only possess a third-layer Qi Refining Realm cultivation?
"Brother Chen," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "have you heard curiosity killed the cat? Perhaps you should ask my sister?"
"I wouldn’t dare, absolutely wouldn’t dare." At that moment, despite his curiosity, Chen Fangjie couldn’t ask Wang Luoyi. Even with incredible bravery, he dared not.
"Brother Chen, your vessel is not bad." Wang Shouzhe glanced around, smiling, "This boat is luxurious and high-end, oh, there’s even a bedroom over there. Tsk tsk, Brother Chen, you lead quite the carefree life."
"Please, Shouzhe, stop teasing." Chen Fangjie helplessly smiled, "If I dared to craft such a luxury houseboat for my own use, my father would’ve broken my legs long ago." He realized for the first time how sharp his future brother-in-law’s words were, often hiding a knife in them. "This boat is borrowed from the Little Master of the Tantai Family of the King of Eastern Sea."
"The one from East Sea Guard, known as the Tantai Family of the King of the Eastern Sea?" Wang Shouzhe was intrigued, "Brother Chen, you have quite extensive connections, being able to associate with even the young master of the Tantai Family."
Compared to the remote Hundred Islands Guard, the neighboring East Sea Guard often interacted with the Changning Guard. One of the most famous families in East Sea Guard was the Tantai Family of the King of the Eastern Sea, said to have a fleet that dominated the East Sea with unparalleled might.
Although East Port Chen Family was doing well, it could not compare in scale and strength with the King of the Eastern Sea.
Chen Fangjie composed himself and thoughtfully said, "I met that young master during a joint operation to eliminate a group of pirates."
"That young master from the Tantai Family is exceptionally talented, greatly favored by the ancestors of the Tantai Family. However, he is ultimately the second legitimate son in the direct lineage. As per the Black Tortoise Clan’s rules, the eldest is always prioritized over the younger."
"Yet this young master, being talented and ambitious, doesn’t want to live his life as just another steward of a family estate. Thus, he’s generous, making wide connections, and establishing an extensive network. He will likely form his own branch family in the future. This vessel is merely one of his rides on the Inner River, unused at the time, so I borrowed it."
As Chen Fangjie spoke softly, some of the causes and effects became clearer.
The East Port Chen Family, overall, is much smaller than the Eastern Sea Tantai Family. However, a future prospect of having three Spirit Platforms is already faintly becoming apparent, and as the Young Clan Leader of the Chen Family, Chen Fangjie’s personal character, talent, and abilities are excellent, with unlimited future prospects.
Having had the experience of fighting together and with both parties meeting their needs, naturally comes collusion, no, collaboration, no, it counts as intimate association.
"Brother Chen, is your plan this time directly impersonating Young Master Tantai?" Wang Shouzhe raised an eyebrow, smiling, and said, "Do you need to play it so big? I was merely writing a letter to Brother Chen earlier to find a clan member to impersonate a seller from a certain power in the East Sea. It’s just a matter of selling a wave of grains, why such a fuss?"
"Since Shouzhe, you wrote such a formal letter asking me to handle matters, how dare I neglect?" Chen Fangjie said with a smile, "Now that this phase of the plan has been entrusted to me, I have my own considerations on how to execute it and do it better. You shouldn’t thank me too much, just speak well of me in front of Luoyi after things are done. Also, during my wedding, have mercy while drinking."
"Moreover, it seems Luoxian is supposed to impersonate Miss Zhong from the Hundred Islands Guard, isn’t she? To have the qualification to conduct major trades with the Zhong Family, it would most likely be a formidable noble family. Additionally, the identity of the King of the Eastern Sea would make the plan proceed more smoothly."
Wang Shouzhe touched his chin, musing for a moment, "Would impersonating the King of the Eastern Sea descendants pose any risk?"
"It’s merely conducting a transaction in line with Daqian Law with two nouveau riche lower-rank noble families, what risk could there be?" Chen Fangjie said confidently, with an imposing attitude, "Not to mention, Tantai Heyu wouldn’t know. Even if they knew, they would just laugh it off. Would the Liu Family or the Zhao Family actually dare to seek verification from the Celestial Human Family? But Shouzhe, you utilized the situation so skillfully, laying such a delicate trap to bury the Zhao Family and Liu Family together, this foolish brother is greatly impressed."
This is one of the reasons why Chen Fangjie placed such emphasis and effort after receiving Wang Shouzhe’s letters. Yet he couldn’t figure out, where did Wang Shouzhe get so much grain?
All evidence suggests that this future brother-in-law is probably not someone who can be measured lightly, and the Ping’an Wang Family under his leadership is very likely to prosper.
Chen Fangjie naturally is happy to see the Wang Family’s prosperity. With the depth of the alliance between them, they are undoubtedly natural allies.
"That’s only because the Liu Family and Zhao Family themselves are unrighteous, giving me an opportunity to exploit. In this, Shouzhe must thank Brother Chen personally for his support." Wang Shouzhe toasted with tea instead of wine.
"Mutual support, mutual support." Chen Fangjie returned the courtesy and said with a smile, "Next year around this time, you’ll have to start calling me differently, we’ll be all one family, Shouzhe don’t be too polite."
"Then I won’t be polite, I’ll have Brother Chen step out, I have some confidential matters to discuss with Household General Wang Mei." Wang Shouzhe lifted his hand holding the tea, looking like he was issuing a guest expulsion order.
Huh?
Really so unceremonious, considering this is a borrowed ship.
However, as the carefully nurtured Young Clan Leader of the Chen Family, he is ultimately a person of patience and grace, reluctantly clasped his hands and said: "This foolish brother happens to feel somewhat uneasy internally, I’ll go catch some air, Shouzhe please go ahead."
With that, Chen Fangjie left the pavilion and went to the foredeck.
Even in summer, the night wind in Anjiang is still somewhat chilly.
Chen Fangjie occasionally glanced towards the pavilion, secretly becoming suspicious. Shouzhe coming here in the middle of the night to discuss confidential matters with Wang Mei, and even specially asked him to step out.
Could it be??
Chen Fangjie’s heart skipped a beat, no way, right?
A voice inside said, why not, that Wang Mei with such exceptional elegance, resembling an exiled immortal, her every word and slight frown makes one inadvertently feel that she has extraordinary origins.
Such a brilliantly beautiful woman, her aura so deeply concealed, is not one that could be nurtured by an ordinary family, how could she be a Wang Family General?
To think Wang Shouzhe,
even fabricated a mediocre general’s name —— Wang Mei! Isn’t that intentionally hiding something?
Meeting secretly in the middle of the night?
Alright.
I understand.
The night wind disheveled Chen Fangjie’s hairstyle somewhat.
Shouzhe, oh Shouzhe, don’t act rashly.
If Miss Liua came to know, it would be a major issue.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 74: East Sea King’s Tantai Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: East Sea King’s Tantai Family
...
For the descendants of the Black Tortoise Clan, who boast a long lineage, everything must be done with measured restraint.
Especially before marriage, utmost attention must be paid to appearance and reputation, among other factors. Otherwise, it could significantly affect marriage prospects, to the extent that a downgrade in marriage could occur.
No Black Tortoise Clan would marry their daughter to a notorious wastrel. In particular, legitimate sons and daughters must pay attention to these details, which often concern the reputation and face of both noble families.
Thus, the legitimate sons of noble families have only servants attending to them from a young age, rather than a host of maidservants.
The idea of taking concubines before marriage is almost unheard of. Every noble family cares about their reputation; how can they marry a legitimate daughter to someone who already has concubines?
Moreover, in families like the Spirit Platform Family, resources are usually scarce, and they are always intent on elevating the family to greater heights.
It’s rare for a clan leader to take concubines as well; high-bloodline women cannot become concubines, and having children with a low-bloodline concubine would diminish descendants’ status.
Besides, children born to concubines are illegitimate, which puts them in a very awkward position. With the Spirit Platform Family’s financial and resource prowess, why invest heavily in an illegitimate child?
However, in the Celestial Human Family, because they control more resources and have greater family wealth, they also need more talent to manage various family industries. Thus, the culture of taking concubines gains popularity gradually.
Standing at the ship’s bow, Chen Fangjie was blown into disarray by the cold wind.
He was somewhat envious of Wang Shouzhe’s romantic luck yet worried for him. Could this Miss Zhong Luoxian really be an authentic legitimate daughter of the Zhong Family?
Indeed, it’s not entirely impossible.
Before, Shouzhe secretly visited the Hundred Islands Guard, and subsequently, someone from the Zhong Family personally came to deliver items. Later, he even dined with the Zhong Family’s Spirit Platform Realm member.
Could it be that Shouzhe really has some intricate relationship with the Celestial Human Family—Zhong Family?
But with Shouzhe’s status, it’s doubtful that he could reach the level of a Zhong Family legitimate daughter. Could he be planning... to cross the Rubicon first?
But what about Miss Liua?
Such an act that humiliates the family door, how could the powerful Liua Family just let it slide?
Could it be that with Shouzhe’s wit, he has already pacified Miss Liua in secret?
Shouzhe, Shouzhe, you’re playing too big this time.
Your unwise brother, with his frail constitution, and being from a small household like the Chen Family, cannot help you this time. You’ll have to rely on yourself for good fortune.
Chen Fangjie stood at the bow, mulling over the clandestine meeting between Miss Zhong and Wang Shouzhe in the inner chamber of the ship’s tower while he could only endure the cold wind and worry for him, which was indeed very miserable.
Alas!
This future brother-in-law might not be an easy one to handle.
Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe did not know that his future brother-in-law, while buffeted by cold wind, had already imagined an elaborate love triangle drama. Otherwise, he might have kicked this future brother-in-law into the river to clear his mind.
...
"Wang Mei, is the plan for the next major undertaking clear?" Wang Shouzhe asked calmly, sipping his hot tea. "If there’s anything unclear, you can ask. This time, you may need to take some risks."
Whether to take risks or not depends on the potential gains. When it concerns some enormous benefits, and also when there’s a chance to strike at the enemy, taking risks is inevitable.
"Patriarch."
Wang Mei’s "Star Eyes" were slightly shimmering with light as she softly said, "For the patriarch, even sacrificing my life is worth it."
The voice was alluring yet ethereal, extremely pleasant to hear, causing one’s heart to involuntarily soften.
"Pfft!"
Wang Shouzhe almost spit out a mouthful of tea, staring as he said, "Speak properly."
"Well... forgive me, Patriarch. I’ve gotten used to this tone these days. What I mean is, to deal with the Liu Family and the Zhao Family, I wouldn’t hesitate to sacrifice my life." Wang Mei smiled awkwardly, swiftly returning to her naturally somewhat ordinary tone, her voice tinged with resentment.
She was a household general of family heritage; her Grandpa Zeng had died in that fierce battle back then, how could she not hate?
Upon hearing her real voice, Wang Shouzhe found it bland and tasteless, furrowing his brows as he said, "Use the fake voice again."
"Yes, Patriarch, I’ll always listen to you." Wang Mei obediently switched back to her coquettish, captivating voice that resonated within the heart, and after entering the state, she also momentarily gave him a charming sidelong glance.
"Hiss!"
Wang Shouzhe held his forehead, that voice was too bewitching, he couldn’t take it. Immediately, he waved his hand helplessly, saying, "Enough, enough, let’s use the real voice again."
"..." Wang Mei blinked innocently, wondering why the patriarch wanted her one way at one moment, and then another the next.
This taste truly was elusive.
...
In the early morning.
The sky had not yet brightened.
A boat set sail from Dingpu Ferry, its passengers included the Patriarch Liu, Liu Shengye, the family’s promising young generation Liu Yongzhou, and several other core family members.
"Patriarch." A middle-aged clan member exclaimed excitedly, "I never expected this. After a careful investigation, we found something surprising. Among the nearby Guardian Cities, there are three noble families with the surname Zhong, and the one most fitting to Miss Luoxian of the Zhong Family should be the Celestial Guard Family of Hundred Islands."
Liu Shengye’s expression was also very serious, with a trace of uncontrollable delight: "Miss Zhong’s identity is noble. It makes sense that she wouldn’t want to reveal her identity after falling into such circumstances. I implore everyone to remain composed and not bring disgrace to our Liu Family."
"Yes, Patriarch." Everyone responded in unison.
Only Liu Yongzhou stood straight as a javelin at the bow of the ship, with a faint hint of fervor occasionally flashing in his eyes.
Celestial Human Family.
Luoxian is, no, as expected, she is a young lady of the Celestial Human Family.
No wonder she continuously avoided questions about her family background. It must be that only a Celestial Human Family could nurture such an extraordinary Immortal Noble Lady, emitting an aura of inaccessibility with every move and word.
What stirred his heart the most was that Luoxian seemed to display a slightly different attitude towards him, as if she wanted to be closer, yet had deep reservations.
Seeing her occasionally furrow her brows with a seemingly worried expression, Liu Yongzhou’s heart broke.
Indeed, the enormous gap between their noble families was the barrier between them.
With that thought, Liu Yongzhou’s fervent heart cooled a bit.
Yet, another thought emerged in his mind: His uncle, Liu Shenghao, was about to ascend to the Ancestor Spirit Platform. Their family’s resources would undoubtedly increase significantly. As for Liu Yongzhou, he was already slated to be the next to embark on the Path to the Spirit Platform.
Given his status, even if there was still a significant gap with Luoxian, it was no longer an insurmountable barrier. If the whole clan supported his pursuit of the Spirit Platform, and Luoxian had affection for him, they might indeed succeed.
His heart grew more fervent, filled with hope for the future.
The ship traveled a short distance.
The Liu Family caught sight of a luxurious medium-sized tower ship coming into view.
"That is..." The members of the Liu Family were all taken aback. The meeting with the grain seller arranged by Miss Zhong was not expected to be on such a luxurious and exquisite tower ship.
"Hmm?" Liu Shengye peered intently, his pupils shrinking, "Although this ship doesn’t bear a family banner, based on the emblem at the ship’s bow, it should be from the Tantai Family of the King of the Eastern Sea.
The Tantai Family?
The East Sea Guard is adjacent to the Changning Guard, unlike the remote Hundred Islands Guard. The King of the Eastern Sea is a well-known name among the Celestial Human Families, heard by the surrounding guards.
"This tower ship is extraordinarily luxurious, and its owner is likely an important figure of the Tantai Family." Liu Shengye advised with caution and respect, "Let’s steer clear of it, to avoid inadvertently courting disaster."
However, Liu Yongzhou had a hunch—could it be...
Sure enough, a graceful silhouette in a celestial gown floated out from the tower ship.
"It’s Miss Zhong Luoxian." Liu Yongzhou exclaimed excitedly, "It turns out the seller she found is from the Tantai Family of the King of the Eastern Sea; truly befitting of the legitimate daughter of the Zhong Family."
The members of the Liu Family, too, were all thrilled. Having the opportunity to connect with the family of the King of the Eastern Sea was a coveted chance.
The ships docked together.
Following the guidance of the other ship’s crew, the members of the Liu Family boarded the tower ship, becoming exceedingly cautious at the sight of its opulence. The cost of this tower ship was likely no less than three to four thousand Qian Gold.
The total income of the sizable Liu Family could reach such a number, but their expenses were also immense, leaving them with only five to six hundred Qian Gold a year.
"Young Master Liu." Zhong Luoxian first set her eyes on Liu Yongzhou, appearing somewhat joyful at the sight of him before quickly restraining herself and calming down. Bowing slightly to the members of the Liu Family with a melodious, ethereal voice, she said, "Luoxian greets the elders of the Liu Family."
Patriarch Liu Shengye quickly led the group in returning the courtesy. Though Miss Zhong was addressing them as a junior, they dared not act superior? The legitimate daughter nurtured by a Celestial Human Family indeed, what an approachable demeanor.
Liu Shengye felt thoroughly optimistic about the ultimate purpose of this visit.
After a brief exchange, Zhong Luoxian guided them into the tower ship to meet the grain seller for this transaction.
As the members of the Liu Family entered, they were even more astonished by the lavish interior decoration and layout. They had underestimated the ship’s cost; the various ornaments alone probably exceeded a thousand Qian Gold.
Inside a hall, a handsome young man donned in a silk robe and adorned with a jade crown lounged lazily on a couch. His entire demeanor showcased what it meant to possess a noble status.
The brocade robe was made of Ice Spirit Silk, with a slight shimmering of icy white light, appearing exceptionally extraordinary. Ice Spirit Silk has always been an incredibly luxurious and expensive material.
Wearing it offers a refreshing coolness in the scorching summer without any sweat, and prolonged wear nourishes the skin, providing whitening and beautifying effects.
Most importantly, Ice Spirit Silk is extremely dense and resilient, making it resistant to cuts by ordinary swords and providing some defense and fire-resistance.
Descendants of noble families have long considered Ice Spirit Silk as a highly coveted luxury. The Spirit Insect Masters of the Changning Xu Family reportedly secretively raised some Ice Spirit Silkworms, earning a significant fortune. Yet despite this, few in the Xu Family could afford an Ice Spirit Silkworm Robe.
The price is exorbitant.
Even an undergarment would cost over one hundred Qian Gold. This young nobleman’s entire silk robe ensemble likely cost several hundred Qian Gold. Even the jade crown on his head shimmered with splendor, clearly a treasure of significant value.
The household general standing behind him also exuded an impressive aura, appearing remarkable.
"Zhong Luoxian." The noble young man, half-lifting his eyelids to sweep a glance at the Liu Family members, lazily and disdainfully said with a slight frown, "You wrote to our Tantai Family just to deal with this lower-rank noble family?"
"?"
A surge of anger flared within Liu Yongzhou’s heart. Who was this scoundrel who dared to speak to Miss Luoxian in such a manner?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 75: "Upgraded Version of ’High Rewards for Offspring,’ Take a Look
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: "Upgraded Version of ’High Rewards for Offspring,’ Take a Look
This seemingly lofty noble young master is naturally none other than Wang Shouzhe’s future brother-in-law, Chen Fangjie. The ’unremarkable’ household general standing behind him is actually Wang Shouzhe himself in disguise.
Of course, both had already put on makeup, applied personally by Wang Mei. Although it wasn’t to the point of being unrecognizable, unless someone was very familiar with them, they definitely wouldn’t be recognized.
When Chen Fangjie first heard about this plan, he thought it was quite amusing.
There aren’t many occasions where one can please their future in-law’s relatives in such an interesting manner. Moreover, Wang Shouzhe inviting the Chen Family to participate in this plan was not something that could go unrewarded for their efforts.
Therefore, to play the role of a young master with his eyes high above, Chen Fangjie even brought out a robe custom-made for him by his family to hold up appearances before and after the wedding.
Wang Shouzhe, playing the household general, was also quite speechless about this. This future brother-in-law seemed very serious on the surface, quite having the demeanor of a noble Young Clan Leader, yet at his core, he was still a bit—reservedly flamboyant.
This half-reclining lazy posture, with half-opened and half-closed eyes, radiating a disdainful and contemptuous look, was indeed very well-portrayed.
The faces of the Liu Family members had turned pale.
Liu Yongzhou, a talented young man of the Liu Family, had his face flushed red, showing a look of readiness to explode with indignation.
"Ahem." Patriarch Liu Shengye of the Liu Family, after all, was an old fox who could keep his calm, smiling broadly as he cupped his hands, "This young master must be the illustrious Young Master Tantai of the East Sea King’s Tantai Family, indeed worthy of the Tantai name, truly majestic and unparalleled."
As he spoke, he also gave Liu Yongzhou a look, signaling him to endure small annoyances to achieve big plans.
"Tantai Heyu, this transaction, I was not originally looking for you; you insisted on getting involved," Zhong Luoxian’s tone was cold with a hint of displeasure, "The Liu Family has saved my life, please respect that."
"Yes, yes, since they are Miss Luoxian’s benefactors, I shall show them some courtesy," Chen Fangjie slightly straightened his body, glanced sideways, and said, "Speak, how much grain do you wish to borrow?"
Liu Shengye’s heart was pleased, and he promptly cupped his hands, "Our Liu Family needs to borrow ten thousand dan of grain to quell the disaster in our jurisdiction. We are willing, after the next harvest season, to return twenty thousand dan of grain to your noble family."
"Ten thousand dan?" A smirk appeared at the corner of Chen Fangjie’s mouth, showing a half-smile, half-not expression. He didn’t respond to Liu Shengye, but looked at Zhong Luoxian and said, "Luoxian, it’s not Tantai Heyu belittling people. For such a trivial matter, you actually seek to use our Tantai Family’s favor?"
"Zhong Luoxian" seemed to have quite an opinion on Tantai Heyu, but merely said coldly, "This transaction is indeed but a small amount to you. However, it’s intended for the Liu Family to aid the disaster victims, hoping Heyu will be accommodating."
Liu Yongzhou’s heart skipped a beat. Luoxian was actually pleading with that detestable Tantai Heyu for him. He felt humiliated and enraged, thinking, isn’t this guy looking down on small business? He immediately said, "Twenty thousand dan, our Liu Family needs twenty thousand dan."
As soon as these words were spoken, Liu Shengye almost lost his footing. This time, it’s to be said that the Liu Family has an approximate shortage of fifteen thousand dan. By mixing some sand with the rice, over ten thousand dan could also address the situation somehow.
Yet unexpectedly, for the sake of face, Liu Yongzhou directly mentioned twenty thousand dan.
"Really uninteresting," Chen Fangjie didn’t even blink, as if reluctantly agreeing, "But, considering Luoxian’s face, a mere business of twenty thousand dan of grain, just do it."
"Worthy indeed of the East Sea King’s Tantai Family, truly magnificent, then lend twenty thousand dan," Liu Shengye, at this moment, could only accept this number, otherwise, he feared this temperamental Young Master Tantai might leave in anger.
"For twenty thousand dan of old grain, billed at 5 Large Copper per dan, that would be 1000 Qian Gold," Chen Fangjie stated indifferently, "Our Tantai Family firmly supports the Daqian Law, resolutely refusing to speculate on grain prices. Therefore, our contract must stipulate that this transaction is a Qian Gold borrowing transaction, we lend your family 2000 Qian Gold, to be repaid within five months, only needing to pay an additional 1000 in interest. Additionally, your family must mortgage more than 3000 Qian Gold worth of property. If the loan is not repaid after the period, the collateral belongs to us."
What?
The entire Liu Family’s face changed, those terms were quite harsh! Even compared to the Sun Family, they were only slightly better, but ultimately still limited in generosity.
Moreover, needing property as collateral made everyone particularly wary. All eyes were on Liu Shengye.
Liu Shengye’s expression was also quite solemn and serious. After careful consideration in his heart, he cupped his hands and said, "Young Master Tantai, could the clan’s property collateral be waived? Our Ping’an Liu Family is willing to use our reputation as a pledge."
"Reputation?" Chen Fangjie sneered, "To me, the reputation of these lower-rank noble families is worth less than half a wen. Could it be that you’re planning to default, which is why you won’t use your clan’s property as collateral? Hmph, this Young Master doesn’t have time for such idle games with you."
Seeing the Liu Family seemingly quite troubled, Zhong Luoxian glanced at Liu Yongzhou and slightly bit her lips, her voice containing a trace of pleading, "Tantai Heyu, I also know that grain is hard to come by right now. But could you consider that the Liu Family is trying to aid disaster victims and offer some more concessions?"
In an instant, Liu Yongzhou’s heart trembled.
Luoxian, Luoxian actually pleaded with that high-headed Tantai Heyu for him.
Chen Fangjie, however, laughed heartily, "Since Luoxian has asked, I’ll waive 500 Qian Gold in interest for this Young Master. But the Liu Family’s property collateral must become a transfer. After clearing the loan and interest, it will be returned."
The reduction of 500 Qian Gold immediately brought joy to the faces of the Liu Family, truly a substantial concession. Yet upon hearing the property must transfer ownership... everyone’s hearts still skipped a beat.
"The property to be transferred should ideally be a manor type," Chen Fangjie squinted, his gaze falling on Zhong Luoxian, "Luoxian has been in a bad mood lately. Since she wants to travel and relax outside, she should at least have a place to stay temporarily, let it be named under Luoxian’s for now."
"Young Master Tantai is so straightforward, then Liu Shengye won’t be pretentious," Liu Shengye’s eyes lit up, smilingly cupping his hands, "Since business is business, let us exchange the grain for the manor’s transfer documents. Before this, Miss Luoxian can first move in to her new residence."
Under the name of the Liu Family, there is an estate that has been developed for over ten years, with picturesque scenery. It includes comfortable villa-style buildings, 800 acres of fertile fields, and a lotus pond of about 200 acres, with room for further development in the surrounding areas.
The total value of this estate, even if slightly less than three thousand Qian Gold, isn’t too far off.
The only concern for Liu Shengye is that after transferring the ownership of the estate, he might not get the food reserves. And he doesn’t have the power to seek trouble with the King of the Eastern Sea.
"Cash and goods cleared, that is indeed the right way," Chen Fangjie agreed, then impatiently waved his hand, saying, "Alright, all of you withdraw. This transaction will be entirely handled by Luoxian."
His attitude was so casual, it was as if this transaction involving two or three thousand Qian Gold was too trivial to mention.
Withdrawal?
The Liu Family had never before felt such disdain. However, the arrogance of such a person naturally stems from their capital. If it weren’t for Miss Zhong’s mediation, how could such a figure even be approached?
The older members of the Liu Family didn’t mind, but Liu Yongzhou’s face flushed, as if a fire was stifled in his heart.
As Liu Shengye led his family out of the attic, a mocking laughter echoed from inside, belonging to "Tantai Heyu": "Luoxian, I know you don’t like this Young Master, and that’s why you ran away from home in protest. What a pity, what a pity. When I return, I’ll ask the ancestor to arrange the marriage, who can refuse?"
"You!" Zhong Luoxian’s voice was restrained and angry, "Luoxian is merely an ordinary person, why must you entangle me so endlessly?"
"The more I can’t have something, the more this Young Master desires it. Zhong Luoxian, you can’t escape from my grasp." That voice grew increasingly arrogant, "But consider it my kindness to you, letting you enjoy the last moments of freedom."
The people of the Liu Family had little reaction to those words. For a Celestial Human Family descendant, talking about love and grudges had nothing to do with them.
However, no one noticed that Liu Yongzhou’s eyes had started to redden, his entire body trembling, never in his life having felt such humiliation and heartbreak.
He understood, finally realized that Luoxian wanted to be close to him but seemed to have enormous concerns. He originally thought it was just a status gap between noble families, not expecting such an obstacle to exist.
But he was, after all, just a direct descendant of a Ninth-Grade Lower-Rank Noble Family, with no power to change any of this.
No matter how furious, in the eyes of that high-society Young Master, it’s nothing but a joke.
The Liu Family’s boat drifted farther, and Liu Yongzhou’s heart seemed to sink along with it. The pained expression flashed from Luoxian’s eyes couldn’t be erased from his mind.
...
Meanwhile, inside the cabin of the boat.
Chen Fangjie was in a good mood, sipping tea with slight excitement: "Shouzhe, how did your foolish brother do just now, did I look like a second-generation ancestor of the Celestial Human Family?"
Wang Shouzhe looked him up and down: "Is this your true nature? As the Clan Leader, do I have the right to cancel this marriage arrangement for my sister?"
"Pfft!" Chen Fangjie spit out tea, hastily saying, "Wrongfully accused, most unjustly wronged. I was just acting as you told me, by all means, don’t misunderstand. I, Chen Fangjie, am a handsome man, a piece of uncarved jade, pure in nature."
"Alright, Brother Chen, keep this piece of jade for my sister to slowly refine," Wang Shouzhe said, "Quickly adjust your mood, we have guests to receive in the afternoon."
Receive guests?
Chen Fangjie’s cheeks twitched slightly, the term made him grit his teeth.
Yet this future brother-in-law is no simple character, the more he gets along with him, the more unfathomable he seems.
Likewise, Wang Mei grew more satisfied with the Patriarch by the day.
Her ancestors for generations were Wang Family Generals, naturally loyal to the family. But this loyalty was only towards the family. No matter who became the Patriarch, she would work diligently.
But Patriarch Shouzhe was different; calm demeanor, wisdom overflowing, perceptive of human nature, exceptionally considerate, and most importantly, incredibly handsome and valiant.
Encountering such a perfect Patriarch, my luck as Wang Mei is indeed very good.
If the Patriarch were to require company at night... what then?
What role should Meimei play then? Hehehe~~ the more she thought about it, the happier she became.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Cultivation Breakthrough and the Brother-in-law Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: Cultivation Breakthrough and the Brother-in-law Arrives
...
After two nearly identical plays, Chen Fangjie felt exhausted and somewhat bored.
On the other hand, Wang Mei seemed to enjoy it, becoming even more energized, evidently fond of these days, proving to be quite a talent.
Wang Shouzhe never expected that this seemingly average household general, Wang Mei, would start coveting his body at any chance.
The matter was settled here.
Overall, Wang Shouzhe was quite satisfied with the completion of the second phase of the task. Not only did he sell forty thousand bushels of Chen grain at a high price, but he also planted a deadly seed in the hearts of Liu Yongzhou and Zhao Dingtian, serving the third plan to unfold later.
Then, according to the original plan, the East Port Chen Family deployed two large merchant ships, deliberately removing the markings. The Wang Family also transported the grain to Fenggu Farm in advance, utilizing a lot of manpower to transfer the grain onto the large merchant ships overnight.
Although this transshipment back and forth seemed like a waste of manpower and resources, in such special times, an extra bit of caution translates to extra safety.
The most crucial aspect for a Black Tortoise Clan that can be inherited for generations is not windfall profits, but one word.
Stability!
Achieving stability is extremely difficult, but ultimately, it boils down to two major directions: the ability to avoid risks and the ability to withstand risks.
If the Wang Family were not currently beset by internal and external troubles, Wang Shouzhe would really not want to clash with the Liu Family and Zhao Family so quickly. He would prefer to manage the big picture, lay long-term plans, and eventually crush them with a grand momentum.
However, given the current situation, he can only find a way to achieve the optimal solution.
Time passed day by day.
One day.
As usual, Wang Shouzhe was cultivating, and when he went to the Martial Arts Arena at 5:00 AM, there was an uncontrollable brilliance in his eyes, and his aura had become sharper.
"Patriarch, have you broken through?" The servant Wang Gui felt the powerful aura and exclaimed with joy.
"Just broke through to the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm." Wang Shouzhe, while calm, couldn’t help but feel a bit of joy. Some time ago, he had already reached the peak of the sixth layer, and after some time of consolidation, he felt something last night and directly ingested a [Peiyuan Pill], clenching a Spirit Stone to sprint.
Due to deep accumulation, coupled with resources and luck, he succeeded in one go.
From today onwards, he, Wang Shouzhe, is now in the late stage of the Qi Refining Realm.
Eighteen years old, seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm!
Looking at the entire Changning Guard, it was a very commendable achievement. Thinking back, Ancestor Longyan also achieved this accomplishment at eighteen, only slightly earlier by half a year.
Having just broken through, both the quality and quantity of the Profound Qi, as well as the physical quality, had a significant improvement.
In the days to come, he needed to cultivate well and stabilize and familiarize himself with the new power level as soon as possible. However, reaching the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm would not be a trivial endeavor, nor something achievable in a short time.
In the martial arts arena, Wang Shouzhe practiced the Black Tortoise Combat Technique, body technique, swordsmanship, and String Control. He could clearly feel that he had become significantly stronger than before, perhaps not capable of fighting two of his previous self, yet he felt he could manage against two ordinary sixth-layer Qi Refining Realm practitioners. Assuming they were ordinary...
After training until the sun was quite scorching, with his muscles and bones aching all over, Wang Shouzhe finally went back to take a bath.
Afterwards, he brewed a small pot of Shanyang Small Spirit Species in the side hall, calming his mind, and began handling some miscellaneous affairs.
"Patriarch, these are intelligence reports regarding the Liu Family and Zhao Family in recent days." Wang Gui presented some letters and intelligence.
As Wang Shouzhe went through the intelligence, his brows gradually furrowed. By the end, he slammed his hand on the table with a loud "bang," his eyes icy cold: "The Jackal Wolf Race is indeed the Jackal Wolf Race; even when donning human skin, they can’t hide their innate greed and cruelty."
Though Wang Shouzhe had anticipated that once the Liu Family and Zhao Family began implementing a merger strategy, their methods would likely not be gentle. However, he hadn’t expected their tactics to be so cruel and greedy.
Take the Liu Family, for instance. Under their influence, there are about two thousand or so families, with a total of three to four million mu of good farmland. During this locust plague, these self-sufficient farmers were hit very hard, and some poorly managed households had empty grain reserves after paying their taxes.
However, among these farmers, there were quite a few middle-class farmers and even wealthy farmers.
With substantial family assets, they habitually hoarded some grain. Therefore, overall, although the self-sufficient farmers in the area still faced grain shortages, by borrowing from each other and enduring the hardships, they could barely get through the disaster year.
But once the Liu Family intervened, they first targeted the heads of some grain-hoarding middle-class farmers. Because they dared to privately lend grain to others and even dared to set up contracts for repayment of twice the borrowed grain after the autumn harvest.
In the end, that group of middle-class farmers had to sacrifice part of their land to gain the "understanding" of the Liu Family.
That was not all; some wealthy households, seeing their fellow villagers suffering, voluntarily assisted relatives in need without charging any interest.
This undoubtedly touched on the fundamental interests of the Liu Family. They secretly recruited some rogue cultivators and scoundrels to cause havoc at the homes of wealthy families doing charity, demanding "relief," forcing those wealthy individuals to retreat and protect themselves.
There was also a particularly stubborn wealthy family that continued to secretly help others. As a result, a group of rogue cultivators took advantage of the night to sneak in, and the entire household, all ten-plus people, met a tragic end.
The Liu Family has only one goal: to make those families with depleted resources mortgage their land to exchange for their old grain. Intelligence shows that, so far, not many small landowners have taken this step.
However, as time goes by, the artificially-induced "famine" becomes increasingly severe. Eventually, some can’t hold out any longer and will trade their land for those "skyrocketing" old grains.
Amid this insect disaster, to prevent the consequences of large numbers of refugees, regions are typically locked down, making it difficult for civilians to roam. This has conveniently facilitated the Liu Family’s plans.
The Liu Family doesn’t want "much," just aiming to annex one-tenth of the land in their jurisdiction. If done with ruthlessness, they will surely succeed in two months.
Of course, as a noble family, the Liu Family will not violate Daqian Law on the surface.
They will engage in trades like "Tantai Heyu" with the Liu Family, under the guise of Qian Gold mortgage lending, ensuring no crimes appear on paper.
This is what they call finding ways around policies. Noble families in rural areas, in particular, appear like local emperors to commoners. Once they disregard shame, they can truly do as they please.
At this moment, Wang Shouzhe felt a pang of regret for selling the old grain to the Liu and Zhao Families.
However, the thought quickly disappeared, knowing that even if he hadn’t acted, the Liu and Zhao Families would acquire grain from elsewhere and execute the same plan. Instead, he would just be funding their unscrupulous friends, further losing control of the situation.
"The people’s grievances have risen. Notify Wang Zhong to cast the net and start the ambush plan. Also, find out the whereabouts of the group of rogue cultivators responsible for the massacre," Wang Shouzhe ordered with a grim expression and sent the secret order through his household generals.
While prolonging the situation would accumulate more public resentment, striking at the height of such resentment would benefit Wang Family’s future plans more. At the same time, though, it might cause more tragedies for common families.
After finishing this matter, he drank a few cups of Yangshan Small Spirit Species to calm his emotions.
"Patriarch, do not forget that today the second young master of the Liua Family will visit," Wang Gui reminded carefully, observing the situation.
The Liua Family’s second young master?
With this reminder, Wang Shouzhe recalled the letter he received a few days ago from the Liua Family, stating that their Clan Leader’s second legitimate son, Liua Yuanrui, was expected to arrive at Dingpu Ferry at noon today for a visit.
Wang Shouzhe and the Liua family’s Miss Liua, Liua Ruolan, were already engaged. As per custom, the Wang Family needed to send someone of corresponding status to greet him. This reception task typically fell to the clan leader’s legitimate son.
However, Wang Shouzhe had not yet married, and since Liua Yuanrui was his future brother-in-law, he had to go to greet him personally.
He prepared the carriage, some fruit, and summoned two household generals.
The group set off toward Dingpu Ferry, and the carriage passed by the outskirts of Zhuwei Lake.
At this time, the Zhuwei Lakefront had transformed. Over a hundred young and strong tenant farmers from the Wang Family were dispatched here to clear the reeds on the outskirts of Zhuwei Lake, level the land, and build greenhouses.
Leading this project was the third in the Shou Generation—Wang Shounuo. The sun-tanned, tall, and robust young man was initially organizing the young and strong to unload some timber and stone materials. Upon seeing Wang Shouzhe’s carriage, he greeted him from afar and continued to work.
The construction of these sheds and such was to serve the next phase of the plan. Seeing the third was busy, they naturally did not disturb him.
The carriage continued to sway and proceeded all the way to Dingpu Ferry.
At this ferry, the Wang Family also had some storefronts and ferry businesses. However, they were mostly managed by the Wang Family’s branch, consisting of hard labor with little profit.
Wang Shouzhe went straight to the deepwater pier and waited less than a quarter of an hour when he saw a ferryboat approach. Once docked, Liua Yuanrui’s group disembarked first without hesitation.
From a distance, Wang Shouzhe approached with a smiling face: "Yuan Rui, your grand arrival is an honor to us. I apologize for not welcoming you sooner; forgive my rudeness."
Liua Yuanrui, not yet sixteen this year, had a youthful face, but dressed in a vibrant and well-dressed manner, he exuded the charm of a heroic young man.
He also smiled, came forward in quick steps, and reciprocated the courtesy: "Yuan Rui greets Brother Shouzhe. I must apologize for my impulsive visit and ask for Brother Shouzhe’s understanding." His demeanor was elegant and made others feel comfortable, like being enveloped in the warmth of spring.
The noble family descendants, especially those of direct lineage, received elite education from a young age. Their conduct and etiquette were strictly enforced. While rowdy, vengeful, and provocative family members were not unheard of, they were very rare. At least in public, they would display elegance and good upbringing.
As the two exchanged pleasantries,
a lively girl’s voice came from behind Liua Yuanrui: "Brother-in-law, you’re even more handsome than I imagined."
Brother-in-law?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 77: The Sister-in-Law Is Here Too?
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 77: The Sister-in-Law Is Here Too?
...
Only then did Wang Shouzhe notice a girl of about thirteen or fourteen not far away.
She was at an age when youth began to bloom, with two small braids, an oval face, and was quite beautiful and neat, her large, clear eyes blinking with great interest as she observed Wang Shouzhe.
"You must be Sister Ruolei, right?" Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands in greeting.
He knew that the Liua family’s direct lineage was quite prosperous in this generation, with the current Clan Leader, Liua Gaowang, having two sons and two daughters. His fiancée, Liua Ruolan, was the eldest legitimate daughter, and she had a younger legitimate sister, Liua Ruolei, beneath her.
He hadn’t expected that Liua Ruolei would also come along on this trip.
Well, not long ago, he had just experienced the thrill of being a brother-in-law in front of Chen Fangjie, allowing Chen Fangjie to fully taste the sensation of walking on thin ice.
Now, it was his turn to be anxious as both his future brother-in-law and sister-in-law had arrived.
"Ruolei greets Brother Shouzhe." Liua Ruolei hurriedly returned the salute, her demeanor proper, already showing some traces of a future accomplished lady.
The term brother-in-law was still more of a playful title for now. As long as Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan were not yet married, he couldn’t change the form of address casually.
During the exchange of greetings and small talk, the Liua family’s Household Generals drove the carriage and sturdy horses off the ferry.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe welcome them out of Dingpu Ferry.
"Brother, let’s ride with Brother Shouzhe in his carriage. It would be a great opportunity to hear him talk about the customs and culture of Ping’an Town." Liua Ruolei tugged at Liua Yuanrui’s sleeve, suggesting.
Clearly, Liua Ruolei was very interested in her future brother-in-law, Wang Shouzhe, and wished to interact with him more.
Liua Yuanrui, though under sixteen, still had a somewhat youthful appearance but was quite experienced in handling affairs. He shook his head with a bitter smile and said to Wang Shouzhe, "Brother Shouzhe, please don’t mind. Our Ruolei has been pampered since childhood."
"It’s no problem at all. Sister Ruolei is lively and charming, very lovable. Yuanrui, if you’re not bothered, please join Sister Ruolei in my carriage." Wang Shouzhe replied with a smile, "It’s perfect, as we, brothers, haven’t seen each other in some time. Let’s catch up."
"That would be wonderful. I can also take this opportunity to learn from Brother Shouzhe."
Afterwards, the three of them shared a carriage and headed back to the Wang Family’s Main Residence. The Household Generals from both the Liua and Wang families rode alongside, guarding them.
Along the way, the three of them chatted idly about the scenery outside while enjoying melon and fruits.
Liua Yuanrui was quite talkative as well, discussing topics ranging from the current pest disaster to disaster relief, and the potential long-term effects that might arise. Through this, it was evident that he had a solid understanding of various subjects.
Although there were a few minor ideas with which Wang Shouzhe disagreed, it did not affect his positive impression of his future brother-in-law. The Liua family’s upbringing was indeed remarkable, incomparable to that of families like the Liu or Zhao Family.
In Liua Yuanrui’s heart, however, he was rather surprised. He had interacted with Wang Shouzhe before, at a time when his character was introverted and he was not good at conversation. It was only his prowess in cultivation that had impressed him.
It was due to this that Liua Yuanrui had some dissatisfaction with the engagement deep down. He always felt that with the abilities and talents Wang Shouzhe had displayed, even he was surpassed. How could he be worthy of his sister, Liua Ruolan?
However, the engagement was decided by their Ancestor, and as a younger member of the family, Liua Yuanrui had no say in the matter, even if he was displeased.
But to his surprise, in just a couple of years since they last met, this future brother-in-law had undergone a dramatic transformation. His words and actions were mature and steady, his demeanor calm and confident, seemingly exuding immense self-assurance.
