When discussing certain current affair topics, his thoughts were quick, and his logic clear. Often, with just a few words, he could grasp the essence and get to the core of the issues. Even listening to him, Liua Yuanrui felt enlightened, as if a weight had been lifted off his chest.
"Brother Shouzhe’s insights are truly admirable," Liua Yuanrui said eloquently. "However, regarding what was mentioned earlier about not liberalizing grain prices, I find it hard to agree. From this pest disaster, one can already see the drawbacks of this national policy. If merchants have no profit to gain, why would they go through great lengths to transport grain from afar to sell? In my view, half of this disaster seems to be a natural calamity, for which the Purple Mansion Academy should take responsibility, and half is due to the error in the national policy. I believe that sooner or later, there will be changes in the national policies regarding grain prices."
"Changes in grain price policies are possible, but even if they happen, they will only be minor adjustments," Wang Shouzhe shook his head and said. "Yuanrui, you only see the advantages of liberalizing grain prices, such as rapidly mobilizing grain during disaster years to quell the situation, but you overlook the greed of human nature. Once grain price fluctuations are completely open, large predators will inevitably enter the market, monopolize grain production, and manipulate grain price fluctuations. At that time, small noble families like ours, countless self-farming peasants, and thousands of other civilians will be at their mercy, unable to control their life or death."
"Natural disasters don’t happen every year, but human-made disasters can occur at any moment." Wang Shouzhe’s expression was extremely serious. "When considering national policies, one cannot only focus on certain flaws. Moreover, even in disaster years, opening up grain prices would be a massive catastrophe. Greedy merchants would unscrupulously empty the pockets of civilians, even going as far as forcing them to sell their land, homes, and even their children."
"This..." Liua Yuanrui seemed skeptical but didn’t want to dwell on the topic, so he changed the subject, "Brother Shouzhe, is that stretch of water ahead Zhuwei Lake? It’s my first time visiting Ping’an Town, so you must take me for a boat trip on the lake."
Liua Ruolei had remained silent, but as she watched the conversation between her brother and Wang Shouzhe, she could sense that Brother Shouzhe was more confident and composed, calm, and dignified. Most of what he said was likely correct.
It seems that Brother Shouzhe is even more outstanding than the rumors suggest.
However, she was quite interested in Zhuwei Lake as well: "I also want to go play at Zhuwei Lake."
Upon hearing that the siblings both wanted to go to Zhuwei Lake, Wang Shouzhe remembered that the Liu Family’s direct lineage had a different kind of affection for Zhuwei Lake.
The second legitimate daughter of the Wang Family’s second generation—Wang Zhuwei—was married into the Liu Family’s direct lineage and bore two sons and one daughter. The current direct lineage is all of her descendants.
Her esteemed position in the Liu Family was largely due to the fact that the three living Spirit Platform Realm ancestors of the Liu Family were all related to her—one was her son, another her grandson.
And there’s another daughter, who is even more remarkable.
That is Liua Xuanfu, one of the Double Beauties of Changning, who is renowned alongside Ancestor Longyan.
It was widely speculated that Liua Xuanfu, who was developing smoothly in the Purple Mansion Academy, must have already reached the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm. The rapid development of the Liu Family over the years was inseparably connected with the secret patronage and support from Liua Xuanfu.
Therefore, Grandma Zhuwei, in the Liu Family, lived a life of prosperity and wealth. Sadly, in the year Ancestor Zhou Xuan died in battle, indeed the year Changlong Year 3095, upon hearing the news, Grandma Wang Zhuwei was overwhelmed with grief and ultimately passed away, joining Ancestor Zhou Xuan. She was eighty-seven years old.
Let’s set aside the gossip for now.
As the carriage advanced, they saw the bustling construction site by Zhuwei Lake.
Liua Yuanrui was intrigued once again: "Brother Shouzhe, with so many work sheds set up, are you planning to build a villa by the lake?"
Wang Shouzhe chuckled, building a villa was certainly not possible. Although the Wang Family’s financial situation had eased recently, plunging money into villa construction without reason was like having one’s head caught in a door.
"Our Wang Family plans to dredge and fill the earth." Wang Shouzhe roughly explained the plan, such a massive project couldn’t be kept secret, nor was there any need to hide it.
After listening, Liua Yuanrui was stunned on the spot. He quickly calculated in his mind, and his expression was filled with shock: "Brother Shouzhe, are you joking? Such an enormous project, the total cost must be no less than thirty thousand Qian Gold, and the manpower and resources involved are extremely substantial, you you you..."
No wonder, such a gigantic project was comparable to the grand feats of expansion undertaken by each family’s ancestors. While some Black Tortoise Clans would organize tenant farmers or households during farm lulls to perform works like river dredging and land leveling to expand farm estate scope.
However, that is ultimately a small endeavor, with limited scale, it’s a good year if a farmhouse could expand by tens or hundreds of acres.
"Would such a grand matter be a jest?" Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned somewhat solemn.
Liua Yuanrui’s body shook, his expression became complicated. Though he presented himself humbly and politely, inherently there was a not insignificant sense of superiority, he had come with a bit of the mindset of criticizing a future brother-in-law as a younger brother.
The Liu Family was very powerful, and Liua Yuanrui himself was also exceptionally talented, having been praised many times by the ancestors in his family. He always thought that his sister, Liua Ruolan, would eventually marry beneath her into Wang Shouzhe.
Unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe inadvertently crushed his pride bit by bit. In terms of personal talent, vision, conduct, and realm of thinking, he couldn’t help but feel slightly inferior.
Yet, the strong prestige of the Liu Family was his source of pride.
Unexpectedly, now the Wang Family has launched such a huge expansion plan, involving over a thousand people and costing tens of thousands of Qian Gold. Such a project, even the Liu Family doesn’t dare initiate lightly.
"Brother Shouzhe is merely two or three years older than me." Liua Yuanrui’s heart was filled with admiration and a bit of bitterness. At such a young age, the ’future brother-in-law’ has begun inheriting the family business, wielding actual power, initiating grand expansion projects, and laying the foundation for the family’s hundred years.
Compared to him, Liua Yuanrui was on a completely different level.
Not to mention Liua Yuanrui, even his brother, the current Young Clan Leader of the Liu Family, Liua Yuanhui, would likely find it hard to compare.
"Brother Shouzhe is so impressive." Liua Ruolei also spoke joyfully, eyes shining, "He’s indeed much stronger than my little brother, who only talks strategy on paper."
Liua Yuanrui’s face turned black; although Brother Shouzhe was indeed extraordinary, Ruolei, was there a need to disparage her brother so?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 78 Don’t Disturb This Young Lady’s Efforts to Rise Up for Her Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78 Don’t Disturb This Young Lady’s Efforts to Rise Up for Her Family
...
"Though that’s the case, this development project involves tens of thousands of Qian Gold." Liua Yuanrui calmed himself, still somewhat doubtful, "I heard that in recent years Wang Family..."
The Wang Family has been deteriorating over the years, where do they get such funds?
"Yuan Rui, do not worry." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "Your humble brother has already made arrangements for this."
Liua Yuanrui’s expression froze; is this a matter of worrying? I’m just curious... However, he ultimately knew the etiquette and refrained from further questions.
Wang Shouzhe, of course, was very clear that his marriage contract with Miss Liua was a morale booster for the Wang Family, as they can rely on the strong Liua Family.
Even the clan elders had such expectations.
However, for the Liua Family, their dignified Eldest Legitimate Daughter to marry into a declining family like Wang’s certainly sparked some grievances and emotions. Yet, since this marriage was arranged by the ancients from both sides, the younger generations naturally shouldn’t oppose it.
As such, Wang Shouzhe was pretty indifferent towards this marriage, neither exhilarated nor prideful. The Wang Family cannot become actually strong just by climbing high branches and hugging thick legs.
Although he knew well that the juniors of the Liua Family would surely harbor some complaints, he understood fully. After all, on the surface, the disparity between the Wang and Liua Families was vast; he himself would feel annoyed by such a match.
"Oh? Brother Shouzhe, so many people are coming over there." Liua Ruolei, with her sharp eyes, saw a crowd approaching from the far side through the carriage window.
Moreover, behind that crowd, smaller groups were also coming over.
"Those are our civilians from Ping’an Town." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "I suppose they’ve heard of our Wang Family’s labor recruitment and have come to respond."
"So many people responding?" Liua Yuanrui was stunned, "Brother Shouzhe, at what high wage did your Wang Family set? Stop the carriage, I want to take a look."
His curiosity was piqued; such a large project like dredging and filling earth was costly, and if the wages were increased, how could the Wang Family bear the cost?
Since Liua Yuanrui wanted to see, Wang Shouzhe naturally didn’t stop him and instructed Wang Laoshu to stop the carriage. The other household generals also halted and formed a guard around the carriage.
Such an imposing presence naturally intimidated the civilians, keeping them at a distance and prompting them to gather at the work sheds.
"Everyone, don’t crowd, come register one by one." Two big boys around fourteen or fifteen, still a bit childish in appearance, maintained order, "Our Wang Family offers work relief with good pay, as long as you’re willing to work, we ensure your entire family will have food."
"Come, come, come here to register. Our Wang Family offers full board." Two little girls each moved a desk and chair to start registering the applicants, "The monthly wage for young and strong laborers aged sixteen to forty is half a load of aged rice, while healthy women receive 20 pounds of aged rice, and youths aged twelve to sixteen get 20 pounds a month."
The two little girls clearly spoke and worked swiftly to register everyone. Finding explaining individually too tedious, they simply had a clever, collateral boy repeat it a hundred times.
As for erecting an advertisement board, most tenant farmers and self-sufficient farmers basically couldn’t read.
These young people were naturally Wang Shouzhe’s siblings. For such a major family affair, Wang Shouzhe didn’t want them idle; it would help train them.
Whether it’s initiating a major project or work relief events, all contribute to shaping their family honor and proper worldview.
"You, name, birthplace, any household documents?" Even Wang Luqiu, who would "slay gods and extinct Buddhas" in the future, was earnestly registering every applicant.
Her gaze was sharp and stern, seemingly scrutinizing every applicant, determined not to let a single ill-intentioned person slip through.
"I am Ouyang Gousheng, a resident of Liuazigou Village in Ping’an Town." A sallow young man nervously handed over his household documents.
"You are only fifteen? You qualify as half a worker, monthly calculated at 20 pounds of aged rice." Wang Luqiu said.
"Ah, miss!" Ouyang Gousheng pleaded disappointedly, "Look at me, I’m strong and used to hard labor. Can’t I be considered for half a load? My mother hasn’t had a grain of rice for two days."
"No, rules are rules." Though young, Wang Luqiu was principled, "However, we’re providing full board. I can even advance you 20 pounds of aged rice to ensure your mother doesn’t starve."
"Thank you, thank you, miss." Ouyang Gousheng thanked profusely, tears of joy falling.
"Take these two bamboo tokens to claim 20 pounds of aged rice." Wang Luqiu handed him two tokens, "Remember, you start work today, and collect your grain after work. Also, don’t let this lady down, work hard, and if your performance is good, I’ll credit you fully."
"Yes, I absolutely won’t slack off." Ouyang Gousheng cherished the two bamboo tokens like two lives.
"Hold this work badge, there’s a porridge shed over there, and with the work badge, you can get free porridge." After registering the work badge, Wang Luqiu sternly waved him off, "Go, don’t delay this lady’s work. Next one, name, birthplace, age!"
Ouyang Gousheng, holding the work badge and two rice tokens, left with endless gratitude.
Wang Luqiu worked briskly, never idling, often handling someone in just a few tries.
"Wang Luojing, what are you dawdling for? Do your work with a bit of heart." Seeing this, Wang Luqiu almost got furious; she had already handled five while Wang Luojing was still tangled with the second applicant.
Unable to bear it any longer, she approached and gave a glance at a fair-skinned young man, took a look at his household document: "A scholar?"
"I am indeed." The young man slightly nodded, with some arrogance.
"Can you even do this kind of work?" Wang Luqiu asked suspiciously.
"I’m a scholar, how could I do such menial labor?" the young man said. "I’ve read extensively, so I can supervise. I only need a monthly wage of ten bushels of grain."
In these times, the literacy rate among common folk is low.
Therefore, scholars still have good prospects. Government offices, noble family businesses, and the like all need knowledgeable individuals to serve as the backbone.
"Our family doesn’t need a supervisor." Wang Luqiu replied coldly. "You can leave now."
"You, you, you, how dare you look down on scholars? Little girl, let me tell you, reading helps you understand the world... You are still so young... Ah~"
Before the scholar could finish his sentence, he was sent flying, landing face-first in the mud.
"He’s even more long-winded than Wang Shouzhe." Wang Luqiu snorted, "Someone, come here."
"Sister, I’m here." Wang Shou Lian trotted over eagerly, acting sycophantishly.
"Kick this guy out and put him on the Wang Family blacklist, never to be hired." Wang Luqiu ordered with authority, then went back to handle the recruitment registration.
Watching her stern and serious face, some interviewees who were hoping to fish in troubled waters quietly left the queue.
Not far away, Wang Shouzhe and the others were already approaching.
Seeing this scene, Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched slightly. This unruly brat Luqiu, she really does have quite the presence. Someone who didn’t know might truly think this little lady was the head of the family.
Liua Yuanrui, who came along, was dumbfounded watching all this: "Brother Shouzhe, isn’t half a bushel of rice per month for one strong laborer a bit too little?"
And that little girl was very fierce, she seemed to hold a grudge against scholars, and Liua Yuanrui himself considered himself a scholar... It felt a bit dangerous.
"Yuanrui, whether it’s too little or not, you can ask those queuing up to apply." Wang Shouzhe said.
Liua Yuanrui didn’t hem or haw, he went up and asked several people, and they all said it was enough. They all thanked the Wang Family for stepping up at this critical time to give everyone a meal to eat. Many of them secretly complained about the Liu and Zhao Families.
When Liua Yuanrui returned, his face was rather unsightly: "The Liu and Zhao Families are truly nouveau riche families that seized power. How utterly heartless they are. Thank goodness, Brother Shouzhe took action, coming up with the idea of work-for-relief."
"Brother, you didn’t quite agree with Brother Shouzhe’s idea before." Beside him, his little sister-in-law Liua Ruolei added fuel to the fire, "Now with the national policy in the forefront, there are still noble families using the food shortage issue to engage in large-scale land grabs. If grain prices are completely deregulated, the life and death of countless commoners will be in the hands of some top noble families. They have ways to manipulate grain price fluctuations.
"Also, don’t disdain how little Brother Shouzhe is offering. Right now, everyone is short on grain, and Brother Shouzhe can already provide work-for-relief, which is quite commendable."
Liua Yuanrui’s face reddened, casting an unhappy glance at Liua Ruolei. This pesky sister, why are you always undermining your brother? Before you came, weren’t you saying you needed to train your future brother-in-law first for your sister?
Before he could scold his sister, he saw Liua Ruolei had already walked over to Wang Luqiu.
She quietly appeared next to Wang Luqiu, curiously asking, "Little sister, what’s your name?"
"Little sister, your..." Wang Luqiu was about to explode, but seeing it was a refined pretty young lady, she immediately toned down a bit, though still impatiently, she said, "I’m Wang Luqiu. Whose child are you? Go, go, play elsewhere, don’t interrupt my effort for the family’s rise."
"I’m Liua Ruolei, ah, your handwriting is really ugly." Liua Ruolei chuckled, "Why don’t you ask the questions, and I’ll handle the registration, that’ll be faster." With that, she volunteered to help.
Wang Luqiu nearly fainted with anger, dare she say her handwriting is ugly?
Hmph, the vast Ping’an Wang Family, even Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t dare...
Then she saw the young lady’s handwriting, uh... it was indeed pretty, so she quickly swallowed her words.
Then she thought about it, this name Liua Ruolei sounded very familiar. Immediately, her eyes widened in surprise: "Are you the famous Miss of the Liua Family?"
"Exactly." Liua Ruolei responded with a sweet smile. She didn’t expect her name to be quite widespread. She promptly accelerated her speed in registering the applicants.
"But you look so young, how can you have children with Wang Shou— I mean, my fourth brother?"
"Ah?" Liua Ruolei blushed from embarrassment, stamping her foot, what part of me is small?
No, that’s not the main point...
The main point is, what part of me is small?
Ugh, that’s not what’s important either...
What’s the main point again?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Return Gift from Fiancée (Seeking Recommendation Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: Return Gift from Fiancée (Seeking Recommendation Votes)
...
As Liua Ruolei was feeling utterly confused, Wang Shouzhe walked over with a dark face and grabbed Wang Luqiu’s ear: "Wang Luqiu, do you have ears on your forehead? This is Sister Liua Ruolei, not Sister Liua Ruolan!"
"Ouch, ouch, Brother Shouzhe, let go. This is too embarrassing, I, Wang Luqiu, am a future grand Empress... Hmph, don’t blame me when I turn things around..." Before Wang Luqiu could finish her boast, she was already in tears from the pain and could only beg for mercy, "Brother Shouzhe, I was wrong."
Upon hearing her submit and beg for mercy, Wang Shouzhe finally let her go, mocking her incessantly: "The future Empress Luqiu, suppressed so easily?"
"Hmph." Wang Luqiu rubbed her reddened ear and said with a huff, "Any unparalleled genius’s growth journey is always filled with hardships and thorns, and inevitably some sinister little..."
Seeing Wang Shouzhe’s expression was off, Wang Luqiu quickly changed her tune and said sincerely, "Of course, there’s also the indispensable like Brother Shouzhe, who shows utmost care and concern for the protagonist, a spirit guide on the lonely road to emperorship."
Wang Shouzhe was utterly speechless, this girl had read too many cheesy blood-pumping novels, you as the protagonist?
"Big Sis, I was wrong, I shouldn’t have called you small." Wang Luqiu sincerely apologized, then energetically threw herself into working hard for the rise of the family, "Wang Shouyong, what are you doing? Can’t even maintain order properly? If you can’t handle the scene, let Miss here do it."
"Wang Shou... Third Brother, your construction shed needs to go up faster, a lot of recruits will have nowhere to sleep tonight."
"Wang Luotong, could you lead the team to cook porridge any slower? If you keep this up, you’ll only be sent off to marry."
"Brother Shouzhe, move aside. Do whatever you’re supposed to be doing, don’t stand in the way."
Wang Shouzhe was quite speechless, this troublesome girl’s personality indeed had a pretty "sincere" side, anyone she could beat, she called by name, anyone she couldn’t beat, she called Third Brother, Fourth Brother, etc.
"Ruolei, ah." Wang Shouzhe apologized clasped-handedly, "I’ll apologize on Luqiu’s behalf to you again, she’s just got a lively personality, but she doesn’t mean any harm."
"Brother Shouzhe, it’s okay, it’s okay, well, Luqiu sister is quite adorable." Liua Ruolei recovered from her embarrassment.
"Brother Shouzhe, your sister is too..." Liua Yuanrui was also incredibly moved.
"Absolutely not." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly interrupted and denied, smiling as he said, "Luqiu’s just a bit more lively, she’s the exception. My sister Luojing is actually very sensible and obedient, gentle and well-behaved. Luojing, come here and say hello..."
Just as he finished the sentence.
A scream was heard from the crowd.
A big man covered in venomous ants was desperately rolling and shrieking on the ground: "It hurts, it’s killing me, young lady spare me, I was wrong, I shouldn’t have incited... Ah!"
"Brother Shouzhe, I’ve caught a spy." Wang Luojing casually threw out two fist-sized spiders and three centipedes, which quickly crawled onto the man’s body, "This guy is a Black Tortoise Practitioner, judging by his appearance, probably a loose cultivator. He dared to incite refugees, intending to rob food from our family. Hmph, you’re a bad thing, I’ll let the bugs sting you to death."
The man’s screams were so painful, the surroundings fell into a chilling silence.
Wang Shouzhe’s smile froze on the spot, do these sisters have to be like this? This is ruining things...
If that causes others to rethink marriage proposals and he can’t get a wife, what then?
Liua Yuanrui was sweating profusely, sweat trickling down his face, and started looking at Wang Shouzhe with a suspicious gaze, this, this is the gentle, obedient sister?
Are you sure these sisters are all very tame and not a pack of wolves and tigers?
He instinctively retreated a bit, coming over to Ping’an Wang Family for diplomatic duties with some psychological superiority.
Now thinking back, it seems like Ping’an Town might be quite dangerous, it was too hasty to come here!
This place is uninhabitable.
"Brother Shouzhe." Liua Yuanrui slightly timorously saluted him, "The engineering project has been visited completely, indeed a grand effort. However, the time’s not early, it’s time to pay respects to Lady Gongsun and Ancestor Longyan."
"Little brother, please greet Lady and Ancestor for me, I’m not on the diplomatic list anyway, I’ll just stay here and help out." Liua Ruolei was quite interested in Luqiu and Luojing, voluntarily staying back to assist, "Also, Brother Shouzhe. I see a lot of people are already very hungry, could they drink some porridge first, then enlist?"
After all, she was a pampered young lady, unaccustomed to the hardships of the world.
"Sister Ruolei is right." Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands, "It’s my oversight, I’ll have Luotong arrange it right now. And, if you want to stay here to help, that’s fine, I’ll tell the Household Generals to look after you a bit more."
"Brother Shouzhe, I’m not just some frail little girl unable to even bind a chicken." Liua Ruolei lightly smiled, then joined Wang Luqiu and continued to work.
Wang Shouzhe, after giving some instructions to Wang Luotong, returned to the carriage with Liua Yuanrui, and headed towards the main estate.
In the carriage.
"Brother Shouzhe, your sister is truly lively." Liua Yuanrui still felt somewhat uneasy. As the second legitimate son, he wasn’t particularly fond of cultivation, nor did he have the opportunity to pursue the path of the Spirit Platform.
Therefore, he usually prided himself as a scholar and valued decorum. Yet unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe’s sisters were fiercer, one after another.
"Hehe, Yuanrui, it seems that Sister Ruolei has concealed her aura?" Wang Shouzhe diverted the topic, saying, "I cannot discern her cultivation level."
There are two possibilities when one cannot discern cultivation: either the cultivation level is significantly higher, or some method has been used to conceal the aura.
"Well..." Liua Yuanrui hesitated for a moment, but eventually spoke, "Brother Shouzhe is like one of our own. Indeed, our Ruolei has a decent cultivation talent and has been favored by Ancestor Xuanfu since she was young. To avoid exposing her cultivation progress, the ancestor provided her with a treasure that can conceal her aura. In a couple of years, the ancestor will take her to the academy."
Though Wang Shouzhe had some suspicions, he was still somewhat shocked and envious when it was confirmed in his heart: "Congratulations, Yuanrui, the fortune of your Liua family is indeed not bad."
Being so favored by Ancestor Xuanfu, Liua Ruolei must possess talent and potential not inferior to those of her ancestors. With the resources of the academy and the family’s support, without any accidents, she is bound to achieve the Spirit Platform Realm.
Pursuing the path of the academy is a dream cherished by many lower-tier noble families. The academy has a broader stage and more resources compared to the family. The development of family offspring will also become immeasurable in the future.
However, the academy’s strict control over its elite disciples means they can contribute to the family to some extent, but ultimately, they belong to the academy. The academy does not spend a vast amount of resources and teaching effort to train talent for the noble families to contribute.
This is also why Ancestor Longyan chose to return and guard the family for the long term, relinquishing her status as an elite disciple.
Moreover, Ancestor Longyan’s action was almost equivalent to betraying the academy. The academy turned a blind eye and did not pursue the matter, which was already very kind, likely due to her teacher’s mediation.
Even though the Purple Mansion Academy is strict, most noble families, upon the emergence of a genius in the family, will find ways to send them to the Purple Mansion Academy. This allows the family to establish a presence within the academy, earning respect and consideration from other families both openly and secretly.
No one can predict how far a family descendant can develop in the future. Should they achieve the Celestial Human Realm, the entire family would bask in glory, at the very least securing the family’s prosperity for hundreds of years.
In this process, it’s not impossible for the family to gradually rise to be a Celestial Human Family.
As far as Wang Shouzhe knew, any Celestial Human Family is bound to have someone in the academy, and often not just one.
Let’s put aside idle talk for now.
Wang Shouzhe and Liua Yuanrui arrived at the main residence, and according to etiquette, he went to pay respects to Lady Gongsun.
Even though the Shanyin Liu Family and the Shanyang Gongsun Family had issues due to the mineral resources of the same mountain range, etiquette could not be ignored, especially since Gongsun Hui was now the lady of the Wang Family.
Gongsun Hui was dressed in elegant formal attire and received Liua Yuanrui in the main hall of the main residence.
After some pleasantries, Liua Yuanrui expressed his wish to visit Ancestor Longyan.
"No rush, Yuanrui." Gongsun Hui smiled and said, "We have to wait for one more person, and then we’ll go to Longyan Residence together."
Although Liua Yuanrui was curious, he gracefully subdued his curiosity and chatted with Wang Shouzhe over tea, saying, "Brother Shouzhe, my visit this time serves two purposes. First, to thank you on behalf of my family for dispatching household generals to notify us in advance during the pest disaster. Second, on behalf of my elder sister, to present a return gift to Brother Shouzhe."
With that, Liua Yuanrui took out two gift lists and presented them.
At that time, when Wang Shouzhe noticed signs of a pest disaster, he immediately wrote letters to notify all related families.
If the Liu Family had disregarded this mutual aid and watchfulness, it would show a lack of regard for the Wang Family. Sending an emissary along with a gift of thanks indicates they acknowledged this kindness.
As for Liua Ruolan’s personal return gift, it was due in part to an earlier suggestion from Gongsun Hui. Wang Shouzhe had sent the best parts of the East Sea Arrow Banner he hunted, frozen, for Liua Ruolan to taste.
Liua Ruolan’s return gift was a type of Spirit Tea called Cloud Mist Spirit Species, amounting to a full three liang.
This return gift of Cloud Mist Spirit Species made Wang Shouzhe feel a bit gratified and also fostered some goodwill towards Liua Ruolan.
Her choice of this return gift, being an elegant Spirit Tea, was precisely one of the scarce resources needed by those like Wang Shouzhe who walked the path of the Spirit Platform. Its value matched that of the Spirit Fish he sent, neither too much nor too little.
Such a return gift left one feeling comforted, and it was clear she had put considerable thought into it.
Even without saying a word, one could feel her gratitude and expectations for his future.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 80 Ancestor Mang Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80 Ancestor Mang Arrives
...
It must be admitted that women often have much finer thoughts in this regard than men.
Although Wang Shouzhe could not be described as an unfeeling man, he ultimately had fewer thoughts in this area. Without the reminders from his eldest aunt Gongsun Hui and his sister Luomiao, he might not have thought of sending some gifts.
Fortunately, through this silent interaction with Liua Ruolan, he roughly understood the meaning Liua Ruolan was trying to convey.
"Yuan Rui, go back and tell your sister that I understand her meaning," Wang Shouzhe said solemnly.
Ah?
Liua Yuanrui looked puzzled, his sister’s meaning? What did his sister mean? Could it be that there is some hidden secret in this return gift?
Although he was quite talented, he was still young.
Moreover, boys generally don’t pay as much attention to these matters as girls do.
Putting this topic aside for a moment, Wang Shouzhe chatted idly with Liua Yuanrui again.
Eldest aunt Gongsun Hui, however, excused herself for the time being.
A little over half an hour later.
Outside the main hall, Gongsun Hui’s voice came in: "Shouzhe, your great-grandfather is here, come out and greet him."
Great-grandfather?
Wang Shouzhe was slightly stunned, then suddenly realized, and immediately greeted him with a joyful expression. Liua Yuanrui was also slightly curious and followed out.
Outside the main hall of the main residence.
There stood a tall man in a grey robe, who appeared to be a middle-aged man. But just standing there casually, he exuded an imposing aura like a lofty mountain, unfathomable.
And eldest aunt Gongsun Hui stood obediently by his side, like a well-behaved little girl.
"Shouzhe pays respects to Ancestor Mang." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly stepped forward to salute.
"Shouzhe, no need for formalities."
This man in the grey robe was, of course, one of the two ancestors of the Gongsun Family—Gongsun Mang. Inside and outside the family, he was respectfully addressed as Ancestor Mang.
At this time, Ancestor Mang was also sizing up Wang Shouzhe, revealing a pleased and satisfied smile: "Not bad, not bad. Shouzhe, at a young age, you have achieved the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, which is quite remarkable."
Of course, what pleased him most about Wang Shouzhe was not his cultivation progress but this young man’s way of handling matters, his style, and some of his skillful strategies.
"Ancestor Mang overpraises me," Wang Shouzhe replied respectfully and humbly, "I have only achieved what I have today because of the resources my family has poured into me. Ancestor, your esteemed presence is much appreciated. Why did you not notify us in advance so that I, Wang Shouzhe, could welcome you properly? Otherwise, it seems it is our Wang Family that has been too discourteous."
"I came this time to handle a confidential matter, so there is no need for a grand reception. So what of politeness or impoliteness?" Ancestor Mang laughed heartily, "I have heard from Hui’er about your plans and thoughts. You have done well, those wolf-like people ought to be harshly taught."
Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands and said, "I thank Ancestor Mang for your support. Please, Ancestor, move to the main hall so that I may entertain you properly."
"There’s no need for that now." Ancestor Mang laughed and waved his hand, then turned his gaze to Liua Yuanrui and smiled gently, "This child bears the aura of the Liua Family’s cultivation technique, the Primordial Water Heart Technique. Could he be a child of the Liua Family?"
Wang Shouzhe said, "Ancestor, this is Liua Yuanrui, the younger brother of my fiancée Liua Ruolan."
Liua Yuanrui felt a chill run through him and snapped back from his initial shock. He hurried forward to pay his respects: "Liua Yuanrui pays respects to Ancestor Mang."
The Gongsun Family and the Liua Family were not on good terms, but it was merely a level of disharmony. They were not enemies like fire and water. Moreover, it didn’t mean that a junior could be rude or inattentive when meeting someone else’s ancestral-level elder.
"So this is a child from the Yuanzhi generation of the Liua Family. I met your elder brother Yuanzhi a while ago; that child indeed has the potential of the Spirit Platform. Considering the financial resources of the Liua Family today, they can indeed cultivate him. However, you, young man, your aura is unstable, and your whole body is slack. You must dedicate yourself more to cultivation in the future. Whether you can walk the Spirit Platform path in the future is uncertain, so don’t give up lightly." Ancestor Mang advised with a demeanor of a senior, offering a few pointers.
"Yes, I will definitely strive, senior." Liua Yuanrui was sweating on his forehead. One shouldn’t casually retort when an ancestor speaks, even if he is from another family.
After all the pleasantries.
Eldest aunt Gongsun Hui respectfully saluted Ancestor Mang: "Grandfather, I have already communicated with Ancestor Longyan earlier. The elder has been waiting for a while; shall we proceed now?"
At the mention of Ancestor Longyan, even Ancestor Mang’s expression became serious, with a hint of respect in his eyes, he said: "Hui’er, lead the way. I haven’t seen the esteemed grand-aunt in a long time."
Ancestor Mang’s mother was Wang Lingdie, the eldest daughter of the fourth generation of the Wang Family. Hence, Ancestor Longyan was truly his great-aunt.
Gongsun Hui led the way in front, followed by Ancestor Mang.
And the two juniors, Wang Shouzhe and Liua Yuanrui, naturally followed closely behind.
After notifying Ancestor Longyan, they proceeded into the Longyan Residence.
Ancestor Longyan was already waiting in the courtyard. Her white hair draped over her shoulders, wearing a veil, with simple attire, she seemed so ethereal, completely untouched by the world’s smoke and fire, like a true exiled immortal descending to the mortal realm.
Wang Mei, disguised as Zhong Luoxian, was as different in temperament from the elder as heaven is from mud.
Ancestor Mang took the lead in paying respects, bowing and saying, "Gongsun Mang, pays respects to Ancestor Longyan."
"Mang’er." Ancestor Longyan’s eyes deep as the starry sky, flickered with a trace of nostalgia, "Every time I see you, I can’t help but think of the past. I remember when your mother was young, she always looked forward to my return from the Academy, hoping there would be rare tasty snacks. Time, like a white colt passing through the crevice, changes everything in the blink of an eye."
Listening to Ancestor Longyan’s lament, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but smile inwardly, realizing that Ancestor Mang’s mother, Ancestor Grandmother Lingdie, was also a foodie in her childhood.
No wonder Ancestor Longyan is so fond of that troublesome girl Wang Lici, seeing the shadow of her niece’s childhood in her.
"Grandmother, my mother lived a peaceful life, without difficulty or worries. Please do not be saddened, Ancestor," Ancestor Mang comforted.
In truth, only Ancestor Mang knew that his mother Wang Lingdie lived to eighty but suffered from heartache for the last twenty years without cure.
It was because her maternal family suffered misfortune, and she grieved for her ancestors, especially her Aunt Longyan and Brother Qiong Yuan. No matter how good the elixir, it could heal the body but not the heart.
He remembered clearly, twenty-five years ago, before she passed away, his mother Wang Lingdie held his hand and instructed, Mang’er, if there’s a chance in the future, you must support the Wang Family.
He always remembered those words.
Otherwise, why would Gongsun Hui go and marry Wang Dingyue as a continuation? If it weren’t for Gongsun Mang’s push from behind, Gongsun Mo might not have approved of the continuing marriage, nor would other elders agree.
"Ancestor Longyan, Ancestor Mang." Wang Shouzhe advised, "Let’s all sit down and talk. The past is past, let’s look forward to a beautiful future."
Both ancestral-level figures were not ordinary mortals. Immediately, they retracted their emotions and sat down on the stone benches of the pavilion.
Liua Yuanrui seized the opportunity to step forward for his respects: "Liua Yuanrui, pays respects to Ancestor Longyan."
Ancestor Longyan had once personally visited the Liua Family to arrange a marriage for Wang Shouzhe, naturally familiar with the young generation of the Liua Family. Her voice softened a bit, "This child Yuanrui, possesses the temperament of a scholar. It seems you are prepared to take the path of an official, which also is a way out. But do not let studies delay your cultivation."
With Ancestor Longyan’s keen eyesight, she discerned Liua Yuanrui’s problems instantly.
"Yes, Ancestor." Liua Yuanrui sweated profusely, having been criticized by two ancestors today.
Inwardly promising, upon returning, he must strive harder in cultivation.
Also, he was utterly surprised that Brother Shouzhe had already reached the seventh layer of Qi Refining Realm, on par with his twenty-one-year-old brother Liua Yuanhui.
Such potential explains why the family finally agreed to this marriage.
Suppose under Wang’s circumstances, if Wang Shouzhe had no value for support. Ancestor Longyan would undoubtedly find it difficult to open such a topic with the Liua Family, even if her face was magnanimous.
Gongsun Hui began gracefully serving tea to both ancestors, using the Shanyang Small Spirit Species. It’s unknown when she gathered it from her maternal home, but fresh fruits and other items were also presented.
While Wang Shouzhe and Liua Yuanrui, the two younger ones, stood by obediently, listening to their conversation.
After quite a while, the conversation shifted to Wang Shouzhe.
First was the insect plague incident, then it was unclear how he managed to acquire a large sum of grain from Qiaan’s Trading Company. Subsequently, using the grain sold at high prices to the Zhao Family and Liu Family.
Now, he began targeting Liu Family and Zhao Family’s merger plan.
One step connected to another, trapping the Liu Family and Zhao Family in a predicament with no way out. They purchased costly old grain, intending to capitalize on the situation for substantial profit.
However, Wang Shouzhe utilized the large project of clearing silt and filling land, employing labor instead of pay, saving on wages and rescuing self-farming peasants from famine, thus shattering Liu Family and Zhao Family’s plans.
They failed to gain benefits while damaging their reputation, getting stuck with a bulk of overpriced old grain. After such an incident, Wang Family’s reputation among Ping’an Town’s civilians would utterly overshadow Liu Family and Zhao Family.
Ancestor Mang praised Wang Shouzhe endlessly.
While Liua Yuanrui stood wide-eyed, increasingly shocked, Brother Shouzhe, this prospective brother-in-law, was formidable, indeed. The series of dazzling operations, digging pits for others, also harvested enormous benefits for Wang Family.
Even both ancestors were there to hear his instructions, assisting him in handling follow-up matters.
Ancestor Longyan, at this time, glanced at Wang Shouzhe with deep meaning. Mentioning these affairs in front of Liua Yuanrui inevitably meant he would relay them back to the Liua Family.
It also served to quell some idle gossip within the Liua Family.
But Ancestor Longyan knew undisclosed secrets, and Wang Shouzhe could only publicize certain achievements to this extent.
His latter plan was not only fiercer but must not be leaked externally whatsoever. This concerned Wang Family’s grand rise in the future!
Wang Longyan understood clearly, in that Changning Guard City, some families were very reluctant to see Wang Family rise.
In an instant!
Her eyes flashed with a slight cold light.
Now that she’s slowly recovering from her injuries, the future will be Wang Longyan’s time to reclaim past debts.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Stepping Stones on the Emperor Road (Seeking Recommendation Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: Stepping Stones on the Emperor Road (Seeking Recommendation Votes)
...
A few days later.
Over ten thousand acres of Zhuwei Lake had over a hundred ships working on it.
These ships, including transport ships and dredging ships, were all suitable for use on calm inland rivers. To gather these ships, Wang Shouzhe had used quite a bit of his connections.
Especially from the East Port Chen Family, where waterways crisscrossed inland, with numerous small boats and many shipbuilding workshops.
Chen Fangjie, the future brother-in-law, was quite helpful. Thanks to his influence, from purchasing small used boats to ordering dredging ships, he spared no effort in helping, even taking charge of transportation.
With the future brother-in-law being so considerate, Wang Shouzhe naturally wouldn’t be stingy. Using the excuse of the previous help, Wang Shouzhe directly offered five thousand dan of newly harvested wheat, which, once processed by the mill, would make excellent flour.
The bran sifted out was usually used to feed livestock in past years, but this year it was also in high demand.
In previous years, these five thousand dan of new wheat were quite valuable, but this season was different. Because the new wheat yield was extremely low, its value was incomparable to that of past years.
In collaborating with Wang Shouzhe, the East Port Chen Family also secretly gained a substantial profit.
It’s worth noting that many noble family descendants were accustomed to eating fine rice and flour, making demands that were much higher, far more difficult to satisfy than commoners.
In short, both parties were overjoyed.
With the rapid assembly of inland river ships, Wang Shouzhe’s "century project" was quickly unfolding.
Previously, the family would annually dredge some waterways during winter, using the dredged silt to fill farmland. However, that mode of work involved five people per ship.
One person steered the ship, and four others dredged with rakes. The ship would then travel to the destination to unload the silt, before returning to dredge again...
This seemed fine on the surface, but in reality, this work mode was extremely inefficient. Small-scale dredging in winter was mainly done during agricultural downtime, so lower efficiency was tolerable.
However, under a grand project, every bit of manpower saved accumulated to a significant saving over time.
Under Wang Shouzhe’s direction, the dredging workers were all strong laborers, forming groups of five. Once a group boarded an empty ship, they quickly loaded it with dredging rakes, then switched to another empty ship to continue dredging.
The ship steers were slightly older and didn’t need to participate in dredging; they only had to steer back and forth. Upon arrival at the destination, one group was responsible for unloading, another for filling the soil.
Once emptied, the unloaders would restock the ship with empty wicker baskets. The steers would immediately return the ship to start the next operation.
After some trials and adjustments, a streamlined assembly operation gradually formed.
The rakes used by the dredging workers were heavy, with iron strips all around, especially at the sharp, polished edges. The center was a densely woven rattan space, requiring considerable strength.
However, each rake could lift fifty to sixty kilograms of silt, filling a large wicker basket in a few swings. Smaller boats could only carry about ten to twenty wicker baskets.
Larger ships, specifically designed for dredging plus inland river transport, could carry over a hundred wicker baskets at once. The largest ship could hold over three hundred wicker baskets.
A group of five dredging workers, including rest intervals, could dig and load about eighty baskets per hour on average. Therefore, slightly larger boats required several groups of people to work together, with one group of dredgers finishing up.
Additionally, there were weaker women, children, and elders, who would be responsible for weaving wicker baskets, cooking, cleaning, or flattening the ground in the silt areas, among other supporting roles.
Overall, the dredging and soil-filling work commenced very smoothly.
There were currently eighty groups of dredging workers, totaling four hundred people, with a hundred and fifty ship workers, fifty silt unloaders, and eighty soil fillers, along with slightly less than a hundred other supporting workers.
The total number of people involved in the project reached nearly eight hundred.
Even so, the daily dredging and soil-filling only amounted to approximately three to four thousand cubic meters, roughly equivalent to one two-thousandth of the phase one project.
With the current manpower and resources, working like this every day would still take about six years to complete the first phase of the project. This timeframe didn’t even take into account the rainy season, winter, and other adverse weather conditions when work couldn’t proceed.
Nevertheless, pioneering and developing family property was never an easy task.
The ancestors of the Wang Family had also expended an unknown amount of effort and time to gradually bring Ping’an Town to its current state. To conquer nature was never an easy feat for humankind.
Wang Shouzhe’s awning boat quietly rowed in Zhuwei Lake, observing the bustling project in the distance.
"Brother Shouzhe," Liua Yuanrui commented with great emotion, "It is only at this time that I truly understand the difficulties our ancestors faced in establishing the family foundation. Each piece of clan industry contains the lifelong dedication of the ancestors."
"That’s right. Thinking back to when Ancestor Zhou Xuan ventured south, the entire Ping’an Town region was a barbaric wilderness beset by fierce beasts," Wang Shouzhe also expressed his sentiments. "At that time, the ancestors had it much tougher than we do."
Wang Shouzhe stood at the bow of the ship, gazing at the vastness of Zhuwei Lake. Although it seemed like an enormous project, the actual construction area occupied only a small part: "The scale of construction must continue to expand, as many people in the Ping’an Town area still go hungry."
Among the current eight hundred people, many were tenant farmers of the Wang Family, or the Wang Family’s collateral descendants who came to participate in the construction and management. Only about four to five hundred people were recruited from outside.
To truly quell the famine, merely recruiting a large workforce would not suffice. The workforce must be expanded, and dredging ships increased. At least, the entire workforce should reach around two to three thousand people.
Carrying out such a large project under such limited productivity was not easy, and progress was slow even with the deployment of large amounts of manpower and resources.
But for basic projects like dredging and land filling, besides winding up assembly line construction, there are no great methods. He does not have the ability to manufacture large excavators.
After satisfying Liu Yuanrui’s interest in lake cruising, the black canopy boat returned to the main residence.
At this moment, Wang Zhong sent someone to report. The loose cultivator who previously killed a wealthy farmer had been located. It was at a secluded warehouse not far from Dingpu Ferry.
Wang Shouzhe’s gaze sharpened, revealing a hint of murderous intent.
He did not discriminate against loose cultivators; many of them have a hard life. However, what he hated most were those who recklessly committed crimes, then left with a flippant attitude.
...
Time passes.
A secluded warehouse was used by a noble family specifically for storing salted fish and smoked fish.
Recently, the sales of smoked fish and the like had been extremely good, and stocks were depleted, yet the smell of fish remained pungent.
A few fierce-looking loose cultivators sat scattered with low morale.
"Boss, is there still no news from the Liu Family?" A man in his thirties said anxiously, "It’s just arranging a boat to cross the river, is it that difficult?"
"The Wang Family seems to be up to something. They’ve let Deputy Garrison Commander Wang Ding Race block Dingpu Ferry, and even posted troops at some wild ferry points, obviously targeting us." A scarred middle-aged loose cultivator in his forties said with a cold face, "Everyone hold on a bit longer, and we’ll get through this situation."
"Boss, I heard the Wang Family and Liu Family got into a conflict." Another loose cultivator said worriedly, "Do you think the Liu Family will kill us to silence us?"
"They wouldn’t dare!" The scarred loose cultivator sneered, "We’ve done shady things for the Liu Family more than once. I’ve kept all sorts of evidence. If anything happens to us, someone will send the evidence to Deputy Garrison Commander Wang Ding Race. Given the relationship between Wang Family and Liu Family, they surely won’t let it go easily."
Loose cultivators roam the world, going wherever there’s benefit, often being used by some noble family as a tool, hearing many stories of being crossed and murdered after crossing the river.
Hence, loose cultivators are no fools; they can do things for money, but it’s almost impossible to cleanly eat them up afterward. Those who survive to their old age are all savvy, and the dangers they’ve experienced in their lives are unimaginable for noble family descendants.
"Smart, boss, smart. Once we catch a breather, we must carve a piece of meat from the Liu Family."
The other loose cultivators also let out a sigh of relief, and all started praising the boss while railing against the Liu Family.
It’s okay to hold on a bit, just get through the storm. The people of the Wang Family are just putting on a show, raising their prestige; it’s not like it’s your wealthy farmer who died.
At this moment.
"Clap! Clap! Clap!"
The sound of applause rang out, and at the same time, a young man’s voice came from outside: "Listen closely, this is how these loose cultivators conduct themselves. Learn from them, always leave yourself a way out. It’s an excellent philosophy of survival."
"Yes, Fourth Brother." Two boys answered earnestly.
"Stop rambling, just get on with it!"
"Luqiu, Fourth Brother makes a lot of sense. No matter how strong you are, there’s always someone stronger in this world."
The faces of those loose cultivators turned very ugly.
The leader of the scarred loose cultivators remained somewhat composed: "Since you’ve come prepared, let’s have a talk."
While speaking.
Wang Shouzhe led two brothers and two sisters into the warehouse together.
He didn’t directly respond to the loose cultivators but continued talking to his siblings: "You must remember that if you don’t want people to know, don’t do it in the first place. Our Ancestor Zhou Xuan of the Wang Family opened Ping’an Town in the south, slaying Demon Beasts and opening new territories, providing Wang Family descendants and countless civilians a place to live. We descendants may not rival the Ancestor’s achievements, but we must protect our home, uphold our bottom line, and not bring shame to the Ancestor."
"You must remember that family’s like Liu Family and Zhao Family disregard the law and have no bottom line." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "They may run rampant for a time, but they won’t be arrogant forever. Sooner or later, their clansmen will bring an existential disaster to their whole family."
"Yes, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing nodded solemnly.
Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian were also somewhat excited, their faces a bit flushed. Our Wang Family is a rightful noble family handed down by Ancestor Zhou Xuan, totally different from those jackal wolf families like Liu Family and Zhao Family.
"I am Wang Luqiu, and you don’t need to remember my name." Wang Luqiu’s gaze exploded with a fierce and valiant spirit, "I carry the hopes of Ancestor from heaven, determined to bear the heavy responsibility of the Wang Family’s rise. You little villains are stepping stones on my Emperor Road, leveling up monsters!"
"Boom!"
Wang Luqiu rushed into the loose cultivators like a cannonball.
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched.
Can this little aunt calm down for a bit? I haven’t finished imparting family honor and proper values yet!
What a hot temper this girl has!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Defeating Monsters! Dropping Equipment
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82: Defeating Monsters! Dropping Equipment
...
But don’t say.
That girl Wang Luqiu is really quite extraordinary. Her movements are very clean and swift, direct and straightforward, taking on hits with toughness. It’s clear that she’s very diligent in the cultivation of basic body technique and basic fist technique.
Every punch and every move appears as if they’ve been honed a thousand times, even the simplest moves are wielded with the stance of a little rampaging dragon.
However, that group of Loose Cultivators is not easy to deal with; each one is a desperado.
So, Wang Shouzhe immediately waved his hand to let Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian join the battle team. The two of them are fourteen and fifteen years old, respectively, and have been training very hard lately under the supervision of Wang Luqiu, the Catfish Spirit.
With long swords in hand, they entered the battlefield, and both their body technique and swordsmanship have improved significantly, appearing quite impressive.
Loose Cultivator cultivation is not easy, yet they are ruthless and experienced. However, Noble Family disciples have significant advantages too, with a deep family heritage and more systematic training.
On the whole, Noble Family descendants are still stronger.
In addition, Wang Luojing was not willing to be outdone.
She took out a strangely styled flute and gently began to play it. The flute’s pitch was very high, sounding extremely harsh to the ears.
Suddenly!
"Buzz buzz buzz."
A swarm of bees flew into the warehouse. Although called bees, they were quite different from the bees on Earth. Each of them was about the size of a pinky finger, with a slight black hue over their bodies, slightly larger than hornets. Among them, the largest one was the size of a little girl’s fist.
[Purple Crystal Spirit Bee]!
Anything with the spirit character naturally doesn’t belong to the ordinary bee category.
A relatively common Spirit Bee is the famous Tiger-headed Spirit Bee, but the Tiger-headed Spirit Bee belongs to the group Tier One Fierce Insect category. No matter how well they are cultivated, even with the Queen Bee, their overall combat strength barely reaches Tier Two.
However, if a Purple Crystal Spirit Bee grows to its fullest, it can achieve group-level Tier Two combat strength. If the Queen Bee advances to Tier Three! Then overall combat power becomes extremely explosive. Even Spirit Platform Realm ancestors would prefer to avoid them.
But Wang Luojing’s bee swarm is too small right now, barely achieving the combat power of Tier One Fierce Insects, only good enough to deal with small fry from the early-stage Qi Refining Realm.
"Buzz buzz buzz." The Purple Crystal Spirit Bee swarm targeted a fierce Loose Cultivator at the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. That Loose Cultivator’s strength wasn’t weak, with a fierce and robust aura from horizontal refining, otherwise, he wouldn’t be a desperado.
Unfortunately, he had no experience dealing with a Spirit Insect Master, and wielded a battle saber slashing repeatedly. The cold saber light swallowed and spat unpredictably under the urging of Profound Qi, with extraordinary power. Such slashes were hard to deal with for the Spirit Bee type species.
After a few slashes, he had used up quite a bit of stamina and Profound Qi, only managing to kill two or three bees. In turn, he was stung five or six times by the Purple Crystal Spirit Bee. The paralytic poison immediately slowed his movements.
The Loose Cultivator secretly thought to himself that this wouldn’t end well, and if it continued, he would surely die. In a fit of rage, he roared: "Wretched wench, how dare you!" His entire body lunged at Wang Luojing like a fierce tiger.
Unfortunately, Wang Luojing was no longer what she used to be. Relying on controlling the Insect King for rescue, she had been well treated wherever she went. The small benefits and gifts from various families, both overtly and covertly, were not few.
Coupled with the family’s resources starting to lean towards her, it can be said that she was gradually developing into a little rich lady.
With her own efforts and ample resources, she quickly advanced from the high stage of the First Layer of Qi Refining Realm to the Second Layer. She performed the Liu Family’s basic body technique, moving as flexibly as a little swallow, constantly widening the distance from the Loose Cultivator.
The Liu Family’s basic body technique sounds like something low-end.
But in reality, this technique, gradually summarized and refined by countless Liu Family ancestors, serves as a good foundation and is quite effective, stronger than the body techniques of most loosely trained Loose Cultivators.
Lately, Wang Luojing has been practicing a lot with Wang Luqiu. Although she frequently got charged and struck by Wang Luqiu, causing her to be beaten up, over time, she gradually discovered the strategies a Spirit Insect Master should have, deciding to strengthen her body technique.
"Not bad." Wang Shouzhe paid attention to every segment of the battlefield. Luojing’s tactics were very correct. As a Spirit Insect Master, she must leverage her advantages and not let people get in her face, which is the most basic requirement.
"Ah!"
Suddenly, that Loose Cultivator chasing Wang Luojing cried out miserably, convulsing as he fell to the ground, foam coming out of his mouth.
Wang Shouzhe observed closely and found a two-foot-long centipede lying in wait on the road, biting the Loose Cultivator’s leg.
"What’s this?" Wang Shouzhe took a light, shocked breath, recognizing the species of the centipede. It seemed to be the Iron Wire Centipede among the Fierce Insects. This type of centipede is extremely venomous and fierce, capable of growing up to ten feet long and able to rival Tier Two Fierce Beasts.
When did Luojing, that girl, hide such a trump card?
Luckily, it’s still a juvenile. Otherwise, once it matures, even Wang Shouzhe would find it challenging to deal with. However, fully grown Iron Wire Centipedes are not that easy to control. With Luojing’s current power, she couldn’t possibly handle it.
The most commendable part is her courage and wisdom in battle, using venomous insects to plot against her enemies. This made Wang Shouzhe quite pleased.
At this time, Wang Luojing, who had dealt with a Loose Cultivator.
Her face was already somewhat pale, obviously quite exhausted, but her spirits were very high: "Wang Luqiu, I’ve already dealt with one, can you do it? If you’re having trouble, sister can come and help you!"
Luojing had always been overshadowed by Luqiu, even being half a pace slower in cultivation realm. Now that she finally took the lead, she couldn’t help but boast.
Wang Luqiu was fighting against a Loose Cultivator at the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, about forty years old, sleazy in appearance but very experienced in combat. Moreover, he kept maneuvering, conserving energy and Profound Qi, not engaging in direct confrontations with Wang Luqiu, but always looking for chances to escape.
"No need!" Wang Luqiu gritted her teeth and replied, immediately roaring, "You nameless peon, take a punch from your little aunt!"
Her Profound Qi erupted, a flush swept across her little face, dashing around like a mini-tyrannosaurus, every punch and kick causing the air to explode with a boom.
She liked to use her fists and feet, rather than weapons, often saying, "My fists and feet are the best weapons."
Usually, she often beat Wang Shouyong, who was in the third layer of the Qi Refining Realm. Although it was not easy, it was never as strenuous as today. This Loose Cultivator was as slippery as a mouse, and with Wang Luojing’s taunting, her temper flared up relentlessly.
"You stupid guy, I’ve got you now."
"Using the same escape move twice in front of your grandaunt? How dare you?"
Suddenly.
She grabbed the Loose Cultivator’s arm and viciously threw him.
"Boom!" That sleazy Loose Cultivator was hurled right into the warehouse brick wall, leaving a big hole.
Before the Loose Cultivator had a chance to get up, she pounced on him with howls, punching furiously while cursing, "You ugly thing, daring to use tricky body techniques against your grandaunt. Peh, who do you think you are, Wang Shouzhe?"
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Each punch was explosively powerful.
Wang Shouzhe frowned continuously; this tomboy’s strength was a bit excessive, wasn’t it? Could this muscle and bones be developed solely from the Wang Family’s Basic Body Tempering Technique?
And the Wang Family’s "Profound Origin Technique" is famous for being moderate and peaceful, where did such terrifying explosive power come from? Looks like, later on, he might need to examine what’s wrong with the girl’s body.
However, despite her cursing, why does she keep mentioning his name, Wang Shouzhe?
"I surrender, I surrender, grandaunt, please don’t hit me anymore," the slippery Loose Cultivator cried out miserably.
Wang Shouzhe also intervened, saying, "Luqiu, that’s enough, don’t kill him; he still has his uses."
"Hmph, I’ll show Fourth Brother some face," at this critical moment, Wang Luqiu was quite obedient and stopped immediately.
Then she grabbed the half-dead slippery Loose Cultivator and started scavenging him. Such actions left even Wang Shouzhe stunned.
Also, can you really call him Fourth Brother?
"Luqiu, what are you doing? That Loose Cultivator is so filthy and covered in blood," Wang Luojing, shocked, hurriedly said.
"Filthy? I’m scavenging for loot! And you, drop the act; don’t you also sneak around looking at your little secret notes?" Wang Luqiu said without raising her head, "Sigh~ these days, cultivation is too resource-intensive. Our family is too poor, we have no choice but to fight wild monsters, get resources and equipment, to barely support cultivation."
"Cough, cough!"
The slippery Loose Cultivator coughed up blood in pain but insisted, "Young lady, I’m not a wild monster."
"Idiot."
"Pa!" Without hesitation, Wang Luqiu punched him into unconsciousness and continued scavenging, "Of course, humanoid monsters are still a type of monster. Oh, Gold Notes! Hahaha~ I’m rich!"
She laughed happily.
No wonder, she scavenged a few Gold Notes, ten Qian each, totaling fifty Qian Gold from the humanoid monster, no, Loose Cultivator. And some scattered Qian Gold, Large Copper, Coins, and some miscellaneous materials, roughly worth another ten Qian Gold.
And the short sword that was looted, seemed also to be made of high-quality refined steel, different from ordinary weapons, worth about seven or eight Qian Gold.
Most remarkably, Wang Luqiu scavenged a Body Technique Manual "Chasing Wind," although it is still of the Lower Grade category, it’s stronger than ordinary Body Techniques, where this Loose Cultivator got it from is a mystery.
Such luck left Wang Shouzhe quite surprised. But thinking about it, these Loose Cultivators often help the Liu Family with some shady dealings, so having some resources is normal.
That being the case.
Wang Luojing also couldn’t sit still, and went to scavenge her own loot. Her opponent belonged to the Horizontal Refining Faction, whose strength wasn’t weak either.
Unfortunately, he ran into Wang Luojing, a Tier One Spirit Insect Master, and quite a tactical one at that, causing him to fall in panic and carelessness.
Here, Wang Luojing also scavenged a considerable amount of resources from him, and her eyebrows beamed with joy; this girl too was a little money grubber.
After examining the spoils, she picked up a quaint book and said, "Luqiu, this ’Body Refining Technique,’ although not as systematic as our Wang Family’s ’Basic Body Tempering Technique,’ it has its unique insights. I’ll trade it for your ’Chasing Wind.’"
"No, no, this ’Body Refining Technique,’ I can only use it for some reference, the gains are limited. If you want to trade, make up the difference of twenty Qian Gold."
"I’ll make up for you twenty Qian Gold, but your garbage short sword must be thrown in too."
"You miser! My short sword is made of high-quality refined steel, a divine weapon with hair-splitting sharpness, unmatched."
Wang Shouzhe’s cheek twitched uncertainly, what’s the trend with secret notes in the family now? And what is that strong third-rate online game vibe in these two tomboys’ conversations?
Feels like there’s a huge generation gap with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Wang Shouzhe’s True Strength (Thanks for the Support)
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: Wang Shouzhe’s True Strength (Thanks for the Support)
...
The two girls were full of gains and had already begun trading with each other for what they needed.
On the contrary, the two older boys in the family were still entangled with their respective opponents. Their opponents were only at the high stage of the second layer of the Qi Refining Realm, but they were very skilled at coordinating in joint attacks.
Forcing the two brothers to also team up in battle. They were evenly matched, fighting intensely.
In addition, the scar-faced bandit leader hadn’t moved all this time.
Among the group of bandits, his cultivation was the highest, looking like it was almost at the fifth layer of the Qi Refining Realm. As a loose cultivator, reaching such a level in his forties was indeed not easy.
They, unlike family disciples and household generals, did not receive substantial support every year. If things went well, there would also be additional rewards.
The sources of cultivation resources for loose cultivators were often very unstable, with most resources requiring them to risk their lives to obtain.
Some might say, since loose cultivators are so poor, why not join a noble family to become household generals? This is naturally a path for loose cultivators, but noble families are very strict about recruiting household generals, the basics being a clean background, clear provenance, and no issues with character.
Even so, most noble families are not willing to recruit wild loose cultivators as household generals, preferring to cultivate their own people from a young age.
If noble families have to use loose cultivators, it’s mostly to hire them at high prices to act as cannon fodder or to do some shady business.
The reason the scar-faced loose cultivator hadn’t moved was that he was being watched by Wang Shouzhe all the time.
The youth who looked only eighteen or nineteen gave him a feeling of being completely unfathomable and profound. It was very clear that the opponent’s strength far exceeded his.
Such a terrifying sense of oppression had only been felt from experts in the late stage of the Qi Refining Realm.
A young expert at the late stage of the Qi Refining Realm like this must be a legitimate son meticulously cultivated by the family with all resources, destined to walk the path of the Spirit Platform in the future.
And those who reached such a level in Ping’an Town were only that one from the rumors.
He had tried to escape several times, but he was always within Wang Shouzhe’s line of sight. He knew that if he moved, he would be met with the opponent’s thunderous strike.
By this time, he could no longer hold back and swallowed hard, saying, "You must be Wang Shouzhe, the Clan Leader of the Ping’an Wang Family, right? I am Scarface Lao Wu. Since I’ve run into you, I’ll admit defeat." Of course, the name wasn’t his real one — in the world of loose cultivators, there were plenty of names like that.
"Heh~" Wang Shouzhe didn’t reply, merely continued to focus on the fight between Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian. As for Scarface Lao Wu, unable to discern Wang Shouzhe’s pattern, he could only stay put obediently.
As for the two male family members of the Wang clan, their previous performance was just so-so. Under the pressure of their elders, their cultivation was passable. But since the family was too poor, most resources were inclined towards Wang Shouzhe.
Therefore, they merely stopped at getting by on the path of cultivation and never aspired to walk the path of the Spirit Platform.
Until Wang Luqiu, the catfish spirit, stirred things up, which "triggered" their desperate cultivation. They had made some progress but their opponents were also very seasoned, and the two sides were just about evenly matched.
On this mission to exterminate bandits, Wang Shouzhe had come with a plan to kill two birds with one stone: not only to eliminate the bandits but also to hone his younger siblings and instill in them a correct worldview.
Yet, they couldn’t break the stalemate.
Wang Luoqiu began her taunting again: "Wang Shouyong, Wang Shou Lian, can you get any more useless? Luojing and I will split them, one each." Her eyes were full of excitement, clearly hoping to make a gain and fatten her small purse.
The two boys flushed, gritted their teeth, and began fighting desperately. Finally, after a few risky moves, they managed to take down the two loose cultivators. Such a performance could only be considered passable.
Wang’s "Profound Origin Technique" was a middle-grade cultivation technique, and the various basic body technique combat techniques at home were also good things, with a solid foundation. Against these often incomplete lower-grade technique loose cultivators, they should have had a relative advantage.
Yet unexpectedly, with similar cultivation realms, they still had to exchange injuries to barely take down their opponents.
Though they were indeed embarrassed, having been ridiculed too much by their younger sister recently, Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian had grown thicker skins and quickly learned from the two girls to gather their spoils.
"Not bad, overall there is some honing effect." Wang Shouzhe recognized this to some degree and praised, "Shouyong, Shou Lian, you were very brave in battle, and you’ve made good progress. Although you’re injured, well, a man has to weather some storms to see rainbows. Go bandage yourselves up."
He had been watching closely; had his younger brothers been in great danger, he would have intervened immediately.
"Yes, Fourth Brother." Both boys dutifully withdrew to the side to bandage their wounds, their faces flushed with excitement, feeling both the joy of defeating strong enemies and the happiness of being praised by their fourth brother.
The family’s elders had far stricter rules for the boys than for the girls, making their characters generally more composed. And the girls, in their view, were destined to be married off eventually, so they just needed to be adequate.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe was their most revered and admired brother; receiving his praise was a first and delighted them greatly.
"Not bad, you’ve shown some manliness, enough to make this young lady look at you with new eyes. It seems my special training for you hasn’t been in vain." Even the previously biting Wang Luqiu, along with Wang Luojing, whose face was slightly pale, went up to help their two brothers apply some golden sore medicine and bandage them up.
Being sharp-tongued was one thing, but in the end, they were bound by blood as family. How could they not feel heartache over injuries?
At this moment, Wang Shouzhe finally turned his gaze to the scar-faced loose cultivator, his tone calm, "Surrender, you have no chance."
Scarface Lao Wu’s face turned ashen, large beads of sweat continually dripping down: "Lord... Lord Wang. I was wrong; I shouldn’t have been deceived by the Liu Family and Zhao Family into doing things not fit for pigs or dogs. As long as you let me go, I’ll hand over all the evidence, ensuring the Liu Family and Zhao Family get nothing out of it."
He knew quite well that the feud between the Wang Family and the Zhao and Liu families was significant.
"Sounds tempting," Wang Shouzhe said coldly, "but if I agree, how can I face my conscience? There’s only one road for you, surrender and confess, and I’ll grant you a dignified death afterward."
"You... if you don’t agree, don’t think you can get the evidence." Scar-Faced Five threatened savagely, "You’ll lose an excellent opportunity to deal with the Liu and Zhao families."
"Doesn’t matter, if it can be interrogated out, fine, if not, so be it." Wang Shouzhe said with a breezy demeanor, "Your little evidence is dispensable and cannot topple the Liu and Zhao families anyway."
"You!" Scar-Faced Five grew increasingly fierce, like a cornered beast, "Alright then, you forced me, I’ll fight you to the death!" The only path to survival was blocked by Wang Shouzhe, he determinedly took out a pill and swallowed it.
In an instant.
His face turned bright red, his eyes filled with a fierce glare, the Profound Qi swirled around him, even making his body seem larger.
"Fourth Brother, be careful, that’s a Frenzy Pill, they say it can allow you to battle across levels." Wang Luojing exclaimed anxiously, taking out an Insect Flute.
Even Wang Luqiu’s expression changed: "So despicable, actually swallowing a Frenzy Pill. Fourth Brother, let’s team up to fight him."
"No need. This person is too dangerous, you can’t handle him, back off a bit." Wang Shouzhe casually drew his sword and leisurely walked toward the Loose Cultivator, "Today was meant to hone our skills anyway, remember this—never underestimate any enemy, they may have some hidden means of survival."
"Yes, Fourth Brother." "Yes, Fourth Brother." "Wang, Fourth Brother, be careful."
Wang Luqiu could see the danger of the man, growing worried for Wang Shouzhe.
"Roar!"
That scar-faced Loose Cultivator’s eyes filled with a brutal bloody aura, wielding a large saber, he fiercely chopped at Wang Shouzhe, Qi Force surging, the saber blade carrying a domineering sharpness as if it would cleave the warehouse.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression didn’t change in the slightest, casually pointing his sword, striking the side of the saber like lightning.
"Clang!"
A sound of metal clashing rang out, the saber’s ferocious style was completely dismantled, the blade unable to withstand the force, swinging back, the muscular scar-faced Loose Cultivator seemed as if he was hit by a punch, stumbling backward several steps.
"Impossible!" A trace of remaining sanity left the scar-faced Loose Cultivator terrified. He was confident that this move, even if it couldn’t injure someone, could at least push them back.
"Alas!"
Wang Shouzhe sighed softly, "You underestimated the foundation of our Wang Family and underestimated me, Wang Shouzhe, too much. Just one Frenzy Pill and you think you can fight me to the death? Haha~"
With a faint laugh, Wang Shouzhe’s body floated like smoke as he charged at him, incredibly fast yet elusive and unpredictable.
A sword swung out.
The thick white Sword Aura transformed into a bolt of lightning, cleaving toward the Loose Cultivator’s head.
"’Willow Catkin Body Technique’"
"’Wang’s Profound Origin Swordsmanship’"
Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu almost shouted at the same time, these were all family inherited essences of the Wang Family, Middle-grade Body Technique, Middle-grade Sword Technique.
Previously, they had seen Wang Shouzhe’s Willow Catkin Body Technique, elusive and unpredictable, one adversary after another being knocked around, unable to even touch his coat hem. Yet it was their first time witnessing the family’s inherited mastery, the ’Profound Yuan Sword Technique’.
"Clang!"
The scar-faced Loose Cultivator barely blocked it, spewing blood as he retreated. But before he could catch his breath, a more powerful second sword followed closely.
Block again...
The third sword!
"Clang!" With a sound of bell and drum resonating, the scar-faced Loose Cultivator’s saber shattered into two pieces, the impact sending him flying back, spewing blood as he fell to the ground, unable to rise again.
"Ugh!"
The four younger siblings saw Wang Shouzhe fighting for real for the first time, all shocked and awed on the spot, followed by faces flushing with excitement, Fourth Brother was truly formidable, indeed formidable!
"This is the power of our Wang’s Profound Origin Technique, combined with the Profound Yuan Sword Technique." Wang Shouzhe gracefully landed, as if he had done something trivial, smiling as he explained to them, "The initial power is ordinary, but as the Profound Origin Technique is cultivated to greater depths, its power becomes more profound. Train well in the Profound Origin Technique, it becomes more powerful towards the later stages."
"Yes, Fourth Brother."
Even Wang Luqiu had a flushed face this time, nodding excitedly, filled with admiration for Wang Shouzhe.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Ancestor’s Domineering Presence!
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: Ancestor’s Domineering Presence!
...
"Fourth Brother, let me help you gather the spoils." Wang Luqiu swiftly pounced forward, searching with increasing proficiency, "We’ve struck it rich, this guy was quite loaded."
She pulled out a stack of gold notes, at least a dozen, along with some scattered Qian gold and large copper. This person alone had over 120 Qian golds. In his travel bag, there were also some odds and ends typically found with loose cultivators, healing medicines, some strange little fragments, ceramic jars, and even two Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills, plus a few manuals.
