However, for the Noble Families, manuals from loose cultivators are mostly common goods, and rarely of high quality. His saber technique and body technique manuals held little value, at most serving as reference material.
"Sigh, Fourth Brother, you’re too violent." Wang Luqiu lamented as she picked up the broken saber, "A fine steel great saber should be worth at least a dozen Qian golds. Now it’s worth barely two or three."
Despite her complaints, the little girl deftly packed away all the spoils.
At this moment, a middle-aged man’s voice came from outside the warehouse door: "Shouzhe, is everything settled? We’re coming in."
While speaking, a middle-aged general with a dignified appearance and steady presence, fully armed, led a dozen or so soldiers clad in armor, wielding spears and with long sabers at their waists, into the room.
"Third Uncle, thank you for your help this time." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands toward the middle-aged general, "Otherwise, this group of bandits might really have escaped from Ping’an Town."
This man was one of the core figures of the Wang Family’s sixth generation, Wang Shouzhe’s Third Uncle, Wang Ding Race. He was a family member specialized in pursuing an official martial career, possessing extraordinary strength, reaching the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm in his early forties.
"Shouzhe, no need to thank me." Wang Ding Race cupped his hands and smiled, "Furthermore, capturing criminals is precisely the duty of our Ping’an Guard Office. I’ll take these men away first and interrogate them overnight. Perhaps we can extract some interesting information from them."
"Thank you, Third Uncle." As Wang Shouzhe spoke, he took out a bag containing dozens of Qian gold and handed it to Wang Ding Race, "Third Uncle, your brothers have been working hard lately. Please thank them on my behalf."
"Alright, I’ll accept it on behalf of those little rascals. Being a soldier isn’t easy." Wang Ding Race didn’t refuse and smiled at the soldiers behind him, "What are you all standing there for? Hurry and thank Clan Leader Wang."
"Thank you, Clan Leader Wang." The soldiers quickly expressed their gratitude, showing appreciation towards Wang Ding Race. In these times, having a considerate superior isn’t easy.
That bag of Qian gold looked heavy, and the brothers would all get a substantial share.
Wang Shouzhe and Wang Ding Race shared a knowing smile.
This was the reciprocal support system between the family and the official martial branch members. When a family member holds real power in the government, they tend to look after the family in various ways. The family, in turn, would be a strong backing for the official martial member, supporting them within their capacity.
The strength of Noble Families is significant, but the control of the government is not weak. At least in every place, the government is the actual administrative body, holding the legitimate authority.
Moreover, these soldiers are no simpletons. They are not family slaves or household servants but bona fide Black Tortoise cultivators.
Among them are Noble Family descendants, collateral line descendants, and some loose cultivators with clear backgrounds. Even more are those from generations of official martial family heritage.
Within the Noble Family descendants, there are two kinds. One kind is the ones without a path and seeking a way out in the official martial system. The other is like Wang Ding Race, selected by the family for potential descendants, specifically to develop in that system, extending the family’s influence.
Therefore, after extensive training, these soldiers generally have superior combat capability compared to loose cultivators. Loose cultivators are typically apprehensive of soldiers and dare not provoke them under normal circumstances.
Under Wang Ding Race’s signal, the soldiers, fierce like wolves and tigers, bound the loose cultivators lying all over the ground, tying them up in five-flower binding style, taking them all away.
Before leaving, Wang Ding Race’s gaze fell on Wang Luqiu, his stern eyes carried a hint of doting: "Qiu’Er, when you’re out working with Fourth Brother, be sure to behave and don’t get temperamental."
"Got it, Daddy." Wang Luqiu responded obediently, blinking her innocent eyes. The girl played the part of a docile young lady well in front of her father.
Subsequently, Wang Ding Race turned his attention to Wang Shou Lian, his expression even more severe but merely snorted without more words and left with everyone.
This made Wang Shou Lian shiver, cold sweat seeping on his forehead. His father’s authority had long taken root in his heart.
"Shou Lian." Wang Shouzhe patted his shoulder and said, "It’s okay, you did well this time."
Some elders in the Wang Family, perhaps due to high pressure, have very high expectations and requirements for themselves and the male members. At times, too much strictness and harshness can make them somewhat timid and lacking in confidence.
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Shou Lian breathed a sigh of relief, his expression regaining some vigor, "I will definitely strive to earn Father’s approval."
After comforting his brother.
"Alright, this little trial ends here." Wang Shouzhe put away his smile, his gaze gradually becoming sharp. Let’s sum up the gains and losses of this mission.
"Firstly, you all fought bravely, which is commendable. However, some people disobeyed orders, acted on their own, with no sense of team collaboration." Wang Shouzhe looked directly at Wang Luqiu without reservation, "I’ll deduct 30 family merit points from you."
The family’s merit system already has a preliminary version and has begun to be implemented. Of course, it will take years of testing and continuous adjustments before it is truly perfected.
"What?" Wang Luqiu jumped up, "30 points? Wang Shouzhe, your brain..."
"Insulting the Clan Leader, minus 5 points." Wang Shouzhe took out a small notebook and began to record.
"..."
Wang Luqiu was almost in tears. The family had begun to implement the path of sequence and the merit system, which she wholeheartedly supported. According to the current rules, merit isn’t cheap, with each point equivalent to a Qian Gold. Losing 35 points all at once was almost heart-breaking for her.
Fortunately, she had just defeated a humanoid monster, so she could recover some value. This wave was not a loss.
"Everyone, organize the spoils of war, centralize management, and hand them over to the family warehouse." Wang Shouzhe said, "For family team tasks, spoils need to be processed uniformly. After entering the family warehouse, they are converted to merit points for everyone. Wang Luqiu attempted to privatize equipment, minus 10 points. Wang Luojing, Wang Shouyong, and Wang Shou Lian followed blindly, minus 5 points each."
"What?" Wang Luqiu’s anger surged up, and she was on the verge of tears from grievance, "Wang, no, Fourth Brother. The equipment I found, why can’t I take it?"
"Team battles have rules." Wang Shouzhe began to lecture her, "Do you think you fought that Loose Cultivator alone? Certainly not... The early reconnaissance by household generals, the blockade by your father leading troops, these are all invisible merits. Moreover, without my defense and the teamwork of other allies, do you think you could single-handedly defeat a group of Loose Cultivators?"
"Fourth Brother makes sense, huh, I was wrong." Wang Luojing obediently acknowledged.
"Fourth Brother, I was wrong too, can’t we not punish?" Wang Luqiu was on the verge of tears, feeling her little purse quickly deflating.
"Not punishing is out of the question." Wang Shouzhe said sternly, "However, after the punishment, let’s discuss rewards. This mission has 100 merit points, with the spoils being converted into 315 merit points, totaling 415 merit points. With my role as the main force of the team and my contributions, it is appropriate to calculate 205 points for me. The remaining 215 points, Luqiu gets 60 points, Luojing gets 55 points, Shouyong and Shou Lian get 50 points each..."
Wang Shouzhe explained the rules of team battles to his younger siblings and how each earned their merit, so everything was clear and explicit.
While they each had their own joys and worries.
At the Liu Family main residence.
In a secluded and tranquil attic.
The Liu Family’s Patriarch, Liu Shengye, was seriously bowing and saying, "Ancestor, this is how things have transpired. The Wang Family went too far this time, using low wages for disaster relief, this move is practically killing us. If we don’t act, the family not only will suffer greatly but will also see a significant drop in prestige."
After he finished speaking.
An elder with white whiskers, tall, sturdy, and vigorous, pondered for a moment, his eyes a bit wary, "How is Wang Longyan?"
This dignified-looking elder, like a retired old sage, was the Liu Family’s ancestor, Liu Zhide—Ancestor Zhide.
"Reporting to the Ancestor, Wang Longyan has been hiding in her lair. However, based on various previous signs, it is most likely that her lifespan is short." Liu Shengye replied respectfully.
"If her lifespan is short, how dare the Wang Family provoke my Liu Family and the Zhao Family at this time?" Ancestor Zhide said calmly, "Could it be that their young clan leader has gone mad?"
Immediately, sweat appeared on Liu Shengye’s forehead and he exclaimed, "Could it mean that the Ancestor thinks Wang Longyan’s injuries have healed?" If so, it would be troublesome for both the Liu Family and the Zhao Family.
Ancestor Zhide thought for a bit and shook his head slowly, "I know her injuries very well, healing them is as difficult as ascending to heaven."
"Then why..." Liu Shengye was also puzzled, "Could it be that the Wang Family is deliberately luring the ancestor out to give Wang Longyan a chance to perish together with us? Unfortunately, the Wang Family hasn’t recruited household generals and servants for the past fifty years, they’ve been severely reclusive, and Wang Longyan has always been hiding. We have no way of arranging spies to find out the true condition of Wang Longyan’s injuries."
"Is she trying to stage a desperate counterattack before she dies?" Ancestor Zhide chuckled coldly with interest, "Wang Longyan is impulsive and reckless, she might indeed do it. It’s a pity she still thinks I’m the same Liu Zhide as fifty years ago?"
"Ancestor, could it be that you have?" Liu Shengye looked delighted.
"It’s just that there’s been some progress in cultivation, barely entering the Third Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm, why be so surprised?" Ancestor Zhide said indifferently, "However, if I add that Defensive Spiritual Artifact, the Purple Gold Alms Bowl, I can contend with her even at her peak, not to mention when she’s only half alive."
All along, Ancestor Zhide was most worried about Wang Longyan’s desperate counterattack before dying, seeking mutual destruction with him. How could he not have any precautions for this?
"Then what do you mean, Ancestor..."
"I originally didn’t want to take risks and waited for Wang Longyan to perish naturally. Unfortunately, they now want to destroy the foundation of our Liu Family, seeking their own path to destruction. I’ll write a letter to Brother Bo Jun, my long-time friend and brother, it’s time to join forces once again." Ancestor Zhide said faintly with a flash of cold in his eyes, "No matter what intentions the Wang Family harbors, they must be suppressed."
"Ancestor, you’re so domineering!" Liu Shengye exclaimed excitedly.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 85: The Ancestor’s Bloodline (Seeking Recommendations)
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85: The Ancestor’s Bloodline (Seeking Recommendations)
...
Two days later.
Before dawn.
Wang Shouzhe opened his eyes on the bed, naturally sensing the slow progress of his cultivation. After reaching the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, the difficulty of cultivation increased significantly.
If not for his current abundance of spiritual food, occasional consumption of Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills, and the aid of Spirit Stones in cultivation, he might not even perceive any progress.
However, the path of cultivation and advancement is inherently about perseverance. It is a long process of grinding, as persistent as dripping water that wears down stone.
If one could advance casually just by taking pills, the world would long be overflowing with unparalleled experts. Noble families wouldn’t have to exhaust all efforts to cultivate a Spirit Platform Ancestor.
The Black Tortoise Clan, despite its family wealth and ancestral inheritance, finds cultivation so difficult, let alone those wandering cultivators.
Recently, Wang Shouzhe also read several small pamphlets circulating within the family.
One such pamphlet was specifically about loose cultivators, where the loose cultivator had endless fortuitous encounters, even picking up an ancient sacred beast cub while walking on the road, or inheriting an upper-grade cultivation technique by accidentally falling off a cliff. Then they went around massively face-slapping legitimate sons of various noble families, with countless direct lineage young ladies swooning over them, refusing to marry anyone but them.
It was indeed too absurd, likely written by a loose cultivator for self-indulgent fantasies.
The path of the loose cultivator is often ten times more difficult than that of the noble family descendants.
Even if some loose cultivators occasionally achieve great results and have excellent conditions, end up marrying into a noble family, they can mostly only marry a relatively outstanding woman from a collateral line, with only a rare few managing to marry someone from the direct lineage.
A direct lineage noble girl? That’s something not even worth dreaming about.
It’s not that there aren’t loose cultivators with extremely good luck, experiencing a bloodline mutation, possessing tremendous inherent talent, or advancing to the peak of life due to fortuitous encounters, but those are always rare events in the realm of probabilities. All else being equal, noble family descendants are bound to go higher and farther.
Moreover, if a loose cultivator truly reaches the pinnacle of life, the next step is inevitably to establish a family, ensuring that their descendants do not have to retrace the path of a loose cultivator.
As Wang Shouzhe’s past life on Earth put it, the class status of this world is essentially solidified, and moving upward even one step is extremely difficult.
Let’s set aside these distracting thoughts for now.
With the servant Wang Gui attending to him, Wang Shouzhe washed and had breakfast.
Nowadays, his breakfast has essentially become a standard of White Jade Spirit Rice porridge and some Spirit Fish cured meat.
Breakfast is the foundation of the day, and eating these delicious spiritual foods invigorates one’s mind. Soon enough, one can feel the blood and qi, depleted from cultivation, begin to gradually recover.
After a brief rest and digestion, Wang Shouzhe proceeds with his daily Black Tortoise cultivation.
As a Black Tortoise Practitioner determined to walk the path of the Spirit Platform, practicing Black Tortoise Combat Technique is essential; otherwise, exhausting resources to arduously cultivate to an ancestral level would result in being merely a hollow shell, and would that not be a laughing stock?
The practice of Black Tortoise Combat Technique, too, has no shortcuts. Daily diligence is required, following the path of steady improvement. This is another advantage that noble family descendants have over loose cultivators—they do not have to constantly roam and endure the elements, allowing them to cultivate steadfastly.
After finishing cultivation, he washes up before visiting Ancestor Longyan.
At this time, Longyan Residence is much livelier than usual. Not only has Ancestor Mang come to visit early, but even the Liua brothers and sisters are here.
Everyone greets each other formally.
"Grand-aunt," Ancestor Mang said respectfully, "Thanks to your guidance two days ago, the bottleneck that troubled me for years seems to have loosened. It probably won’t be long before I can break through to the third layer."
His heart was filled with emotion. He, Gongsun Mang, was naturally considered a person of decent talent, achieving the Spirit Platform Realm in his forties. At that time, full of youthful exuberance, he aspired to reach the Celestial Human Realm within his lifetime.
However, thirty or forty years have passed, and his cultivation has been stuck at the peak of the second layer of the Spirit Platform Realm for eight years. At such a slow rate of advancement, not to mention reaching the Celestial Human Realm, even reaching the late stage of the Spirit Platform depends on luck.
"Mang’er, you needn’t be so modest. Your talents are not poor; with a few more years of diligent effort, you can probably break through smoothly," Ancestor Longyan replied calmly, "For us lower-tier noble families, reaching the Spirit Platform Realm is most difficult due to two points: scarcity of resources and lack of guidance from predecessors, making every step particularly tough."
"Grand-aunt speaks truly. I once thought that once reaching the Spirit Platform Realm, the path would be smooth. Yet, the path to the Celestial Human Realm feels as insurmountable as a heavenly chasm. If I were to consume resources freely for cultivation, the Gongsun family’s half of the resources would probably have to be dedicated to me alone. If it truly comes to that, what would happen to the children and grandchildren?" Ancestor Mang lamented, "But upon careful thought, it’s only natural. Becoming a Celestial Human Family is not achieved so easily. Among the dozen or so families of our Changning Guard, there are only two Celestial Human Families."
The younger generation like Wang Shouzhe listened to the elders’ chat naturally without interrupting.
However, Wang Shouzhe began to calculate in his mind. The Ancestor mentioned that the Path of Celestial Human is difficult, one of the difficulties being the lack of cultivation resources.
Indeed, raising one Ancestor at home is already difficult enough, let alone saving money to raise the next generation of Ancestors.
The most important thing is that even maintaining the status of a Spirit Platform Ancestor is a huge expenditure of resources. And if the Ancestor wants to take the Path of Celestial Human, well, that would require a massive amount of resources being poured in.
Just raising one Ancestor is strenuous, what kind of enormous expenditure would it be to raise two Ancestors or even host an entire family with three Spirit Platforms?
Therefore, with each additional Spirit Platform Realm in the family, it constitutes a greater expense. It’s necessary to expand the family estate, increase the scale of industries, and seize more resources.
This is what they call being able to charge into the Spirit Platform but unable to sustain it. Thus, most families cultivating Spirit Platform Realm do so at a measured tempo, as they cannot afford to have more family Patriarchs in the Spirit Platform Realm, nor can they sever the inheritance of the Spirit Platform Realm.
Such is the reality for most lower-tier noble families.
However, when it comes to resources.
For Wang Shouzhe, it is actually a relatively easy problem to solve. If the entire Ping’an Town is brought under his command, even three Spirit Platform Ancestors could be easily sustained.
"Shouzhe." After Ancestor Mang sighed, he turned his attention to Wang Shouzhe, "Regarding the matter of that girl you asked about a few days ago..." As he spoke, he hesitated and glanced at the Liua Brothers and Sisters.
"Ancestor Mang, please feel free to speak." Wang Shouzhe smiled and said, "Both Yuan Rui and Ruolei are one of our own, there are no secrets here that cannot be shared."
This was, of course, a gesture of goodwill from Wang Shouzhe; if it were truly about the Wang Family’s most core secrets, how could they be casually let known? However, in the future, Liua Ruolan is to become the Lady of the Wang Family, so the establishment of some intimate ally relationships between the two families in advance is only natural.
With just a casual word, both Liua Yuanrui and Liua Ruolei found Wang Shouzhe even more pleasing, each assuring that whatever secret they heard would never be leaked.
Especially Liua Ruolei, before she came, she kept saying that she wanted to teach her future brother-in-law on behalf of her sister. Yet unexpectedly, she had already defected upon arrival. These days, she has been treated so well by the Wang Family with good food and fun, she doesn’t even want to go home anymore.
"If what I say is incorrect, I ask the young lady to correct me." Ancestor Mang said, organizing his thoughts, "Since I tread the path of Horizontal Refinement and Tempering Body, I have a considerable understanding of war body type bloodlines. However, regardless of the bloodline, they all ultimately trace back to the Ancestors. I refer to Ancestors not as the Spirit Platform Ancestors of each family, but to the true founding Ancestors, those who once stood at the pinnacle of humanity."
"It is said that in ancient times, those human Ancestors possessed various miraculous and powerful war body bloodlines, some with immense strength, others with indestructible vajra bodies, immortal and undying, or even the ability to incinerate lakes and boil seas with a wave of a hand. These progenitors passed down their bloodlines through generations, creating an intricate mixture, leading to the emergence of more bloodlines. Over countless years, the bloodlines of our progenitors have almost completely disappeared. Only a fortunate few, due to luck or opportunity, can awaken a portion of the ancestral bloodline."
"Of course, upon reaching the Spirit Platform Realm and further enhancing bodily functions, part of the ancestral bloodline will inevitably awaken." Ancestor Mang continued, "Like myself, after reaching the Spirit Platform, a faint Geng Metal Bloodline emerged. But your young lady is different. She was born with Middle Grade Talent. What is Middle Grade? Naturally, it’s having already developed a bloodline, thereby being called Middle Grade. I remember Ancestor Longyan awakened the Primordial Water Bloodline."
"Yes, in my youth, it was the Primordial Water Bloodline, which evolved into the Profound Ice Bloodline upon reaching the Spirit Platform Realm, much thicker compared to when it was the Primordial Water Bloodline." Ancestor Longyan added nonchalantly, "The Primordial Water Bloodline should be the main bloodline of the Liua Family. Cultivating the ’Primordial Water Heart Technique’ makes it easier to awaken the Primordial Water Bloodline upon breaking through the Spirit Platform. My mother was the Liua Family’s direct daughter, so it’s normal for me to awaken a trace of the Primordial Water Bloodline."
After speaking, Ancestor Longyan turned her gaze towards Liua Ruolei, with a slight smile and satisfaction in her eyes.
Wang Shouzhe’s mind was stirred, and he too looked towards Liua Ruolei. This future sister-in-law must be concealing some sort of thin bloodline awakening with some essence-suppressing artifact, most likely a trace of Primordial Water Bloodline.
The conversation between the Ancestors gave Wang Shouzhe a greater understanding of the bloodline awakening in the Black Tortoise Clan.
It’s just a pity he, Wang Shouzhe, has not yet awakened any ancestral bloodline. Must he wait until ascending to the Spirit Platform to rely on body function metamorphosis and randomly trigger some ancient bloodline?
Reluctant as he was, just as he was about to inquire further.
Knock knock.
The voice of household general Wang Wu came from outside: "Patriarch, I dare to disturb you."
"Whenever, feel free to say." Wang Shouzhe had already a guessed few things in mind. If it wasn’t the occurrence of what he’d anticipated, Wang Wu wouldn’t have dared to disturb him at Longyan Residence.
"There’s intelligence from the front lines." Wang Wu reported from outside, "Liu Family and Zhao Family’s elites have all moved out, surrounding two Ancestors, and are coming grandly towards our Wang Family."
As expected!
Wang Shouzhe’s eyes narrowed. His series of strategies, especially the relief work in exchange for labor, had already dug into the survival foundation of the Liu and Zhao Races.
Those two old things couldn’t sit still any longer.
Meanwhile, Liua Yuanrui and Liua Ruolei’s faces turned pale, suddenly becoming extremely tense.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Expressing Gratitude for the Wang Family’s Generosity
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: Expressing Gratitude for the Wang Family’s Generosity
...
"Brother Shouzhe, it seems your plan has pushed the Liu and Zhao Clans into a corner," Liua Yuanrui’s face was extremely serious. "With both patriarchs coming together, they probably mean no good. We must prepare early."
"I was careless, never thought the Liu and Zhao Clans would be so reckless. Unable to annex land, they dare to come and cause trouble," Liua Ruolei was equally tense and regretted, saying, "Had I known, I would have sent a letter to invite our family’s patriarch as a guest. If Ancestor Mang were here too, we wouldn’t be afraid of them."
After spending some time together, in her heart, she had truly accepted Wang Shouzhe as her future brother-in-law, considering him one of her own.
Between the Liua and Wang Clans, after this marriage alliance, relations are bound to return to the intimate state they were a hundred years ago.
"No worries, with Ancestor Mang here to oversee, they won’t gain any advantage in this troublemaking," Wang Shouzhe said with a calm smile.
Liua Ruolei only saw the surface of public works substituting for charity, as if it were merely Wang Shouzhe thwarting the opponent’s land annexation plan, a deed that delighted people.
She didn’t know how much resources and hope the Liu and Zhao Clans had invested in this annexation plan. Not to mention, the estates mortgaged for loans alone, their combined value approaching six thousand Qian Gold, couldn’t be recovered lightly.
At that time, after ’Zhong Luoxian’ and ’Tantai Heyu’ entertained the Liu Family, they also ’entertained’ the Zhao Family, applying the same performance to both families and completing two sets of plans.
In Wang Shouzhe’s words, after painstakingly writing a script, how could it be used just once?
"With Ancestor Mang overseeing..." Liua Ruolei’s expression turned somewhat intriguing, "Brother Shouzhe, did you perhaps foresee they would come to cause trouble?"
Liua Yuanrui also had a sudden realization, "No wonder. With Brother Shouzhe’s capability to plan the full public works undertaking, how could he not anticipate the Liu and Zhao Clans causing trouble? Remarkable, remarkable. I wondered why Ancestor Mang quietly came to oversee; we siblings worried for nothing."
"How could that be? Shouzhe still appreciates Brother Yuanrui and Sister Ruolei’s concern," Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands in salute.
The Liua siblings hurriedly returned the salute with respect.
"The Liu and Zhao Clans are still a ways off; they have no right for me to receive them," Wang Shouzhe laughed mockingly, turning his gaze back to Ancestor Mang. "Ancestor Mang, regarding the ancestral bloodline awakening, I’d like to ask further. Earlier, you mentioned middle-grade talent relates to bloodline awakening. But is it that middle-grade talent comes first, or bloodline awakening?"
"Every practitioner whose talent has reached the lower grade level already manifests part of their ancestor’s Black Tortoise Bloodline. The difference from lower grade C to lower grade A is merely the degree of Black Tortoise Bloodline talent," Ancestor Mang patiently explained. "If unique divine techniques appear in the bloodline, then Black Tortoise talent must have reached the middle grade. Even if it wasn’t originally, after awakening such a unique bloodline, Black Tortoise talent will evolve to middle grade."
"Your family’s little girl, named Luqiu, right? She probably awakened some ancestral war body type bloodline. Yet in human history, there are many war body type bloodlines with various mutations. Currently, the girl’s war body bloodline is very thin, making it hard to distinguish what type of war body she has. Once she reaches the Spirit Platform Realm, as her body transforms and her bloodline strengthens further, the type of war body will become clearer."
"I understand, once the bloodline mutates, it will inevitably enhance Black Tortoise Bloodline talent," Wang Shouzhe nodded in realization, feeling both happy for his family and Luqiu, while also regretful about why he himself hadn’t undergone a bloodline mutation or awakened some ancient ancestral gene.
Indeed, what Ancestor Mang referred to as bloodline, in Wang Shouzhe’s understanding, is gene inheritance. Awakening the bloodline, he comprehended as the activation of some latent, dormant, recessive genes in the body.
The sour feeling made Wang Shouzhe feel as if his heart was pierced by a knife.
"Actually, in your family, not only the girl named Luqiu, but also the young Spirit Insect Master girl must have awakened an ancient type of bloodline; otherwise, she couldn’t possibly communicate spiritually with the Insect Race." Ancestor Mang added, "Therefore, that girl’s future potential shouldn’t be underestimated."
Uh...
Wang Shouzhe felt like his heart was stabbed by a knife once again.
Wait.
Apart from Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing, it’s likely even the mischievous girl Wang Lici isn’t anything simple. The patriarch once mentioned she might have awakened some kind of spiritual sense type talent.
Alright, Wang Shouzhe’s heart was stabbed for the third time.
No!
The situation seems somewhat unusual.
Wang Shouzhe’s brow furrowed deeply. Logically speaking, a ninth-grade lower-rank noble family already has relatively diluted bloodlines. It’s very fortunate to occasionally have one with a special bloodline.
Yet now, the young generation of the Wang Family has three in one go!
Could it be that the ancestral genes were so strong, manifesting concentratedly in this generation?
That probably isn’t right either, as Wang Lici, Wang Luqiu, and Wang Luojing, though all sisters or nieces, share only clan blood, with different parents and even different grandfather and great-grandfather.
Moreover, among the young generation in the family, there are many males too. If it were due to the ancestor, why would the blood manifest only in a few girls?

chapters.title: Chapter 87
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 86: Expressing Gratitude for the Wang Family’s Generosity_2
There must be some kind of connection among them, a connection that belongs only to the three of them.
Cheat sheets? Dried fish? It’s unlikely to be those.
Wang Shouzhe fell into deep thought, with too few clues at present, it’s difficult to deduce anything. Once this matter passe, he’ll gather the three girls for questioning, to see if he can find any common points.
If he can find a connection, maybe Wang Shouzhe can benefit from it as well.
...
Meanwhile.
A large contingent of people was marching grandly toward the Wang Family’s Main Residence.
There were elite clansmen and household generals with overwhelming presences. But most notably, were the two carriages.
The two carriages were luxuriously built, with dragon and phoenix carvings on the compartments exuding magnificence. Even the horses pulling them were each four high-quality black steeds without a single mark of impurity.
Steeds are expensive, and raising them incurs further costs; not only do they need to eat well, but they also require specialized servants to manage them.
Most importantly, steeds are more suitable for riding than for pulling carriages. Wang Shouzhe, in fact, owned a black steed specifically for riding.
Indeed, these two carriages were the vehicles of the ancestors of the Liu and Zhao Clans. Unlike Ancestor Longyan, who stays hidden from the world, Liu and Zhao’s ancestors appear once a year in a parade to bolster family prestige.
For ordinary people, the Liu and Zhao Clans’ actions might seem overwhelmingly impressive, full of status.
However, in the eyes of slightly older noble families with richer cultural backgrounds, this is undoubtedly seen as the compensatory behavior of former upstarts. Outwardly, they might not say anything, but secretly they would surely be contemptuous.
It makes sense, given that the origins of these two ancestors weren’t impressive. It’s rumored one was a side branch from a large family in the Commandery of Longzuo, while the other was a loose cultivator for quite some time, succeeding in reaching the Spirit Platform Realm by luck or other opportunities.
Yet, even after painstakingly reaching the Spirit Platform Realm, there’s no living space for them in the core area of noble family-packed Longzhou County.
They were unwilling to still depend on noble families or certain forces for survival after such difficult advancements to the Spirit Platform Realm.
Back then, they followed Ancestor Zhou Xuan south, expanding human living space, intending to become a follower family, hoping to establish a family to help their descendants escape humble beginnings.
This is not incorrect, as many loose cultivators or those of lower origins with Spirit Platform accomplishments have similar thoughts and plans.
Their mistake was in betrayal. Especially after Ancestor Zhou Xuan granted them the promised territory, they still chose to betray!
In the distance, some curious commoners followed at a distance. People are naturally curious and enjoy excitement, wanting to see what’s happening today.
The Liu and Zhao Clans didn’t drive away the onlookers but instead sent spies to secretly fan the flames. This attracted more people to follow the excitement, including some traveling merchants, loose cultivators, scholars, and various other miscellaneous figures.
Clearly, they intended for the "commoners" of Ping’an Town to know who truly owns Ping’an Town. The public support generated by the Wang Family’s disaster relief efforts is no match against absolute power. They also sought to spread the reputation of "suppressing the Wang Family" through others’ voices.
Patriarch Liu of the Liu Family, Liu Shengye.
Patriarch Zhao of the Zhao Family, Zhao Jinxian.
Each rode a tall horse, arriving spiritedly at the Wang Family’s Main Residence gate, surrounded by household forces and clansmen.
When Ancestor Zhou Xuan chose the location for the main residence, he must have chosen the best spot. With the scenic Zhuwei Lake to the left and the Liping Mountain peaks embracing the right, the residence sits on elevated land, boasting excellent feng shui and momentum, and is also a position easy to defend and hard to attack.
To enter the main residence, there’s only one road besides taking the water route to the rear garden. Along this road, some arrow towers and defensive facilities were built and checkpoints can be set up at any time to construct lines of defense.
However, currently, the Wang Family made no resistance against the Liu and Zhao Clans, allowing them to reach the Wang Family’s main gate unimpeded.
Under the towering courtyard walls of the main residence lies a plaza paved with bluestone.
Liu Shengye stopped his horse and looked up slightly at the Wang Family’s gate. The words "Ping’an Wang Family" were inscribed above, unable to suppress a sneer: "Brother Jinxian, what virtue or ability does the Wang Family have, to occupy this prime feng shui real estate?"
Zhao Jinxian halted by his side, his tall and robust stature indicating a greater martial prowess than Liu Shengye, and he replied calmly: "As the saying goes, the feng shui wheel constantly turns. If the Wang Family had kept to their corner quietly, out of respect for our ancestors’ relationships, we might have shown them some consideration. But now, daring to jump out and oppose us, heh, that’s truly courting death. Brother Shengye, how do you plan to proceed today, I’ll follow your lead."
"How to proceed? Haha. We’ll naturally adhere to the etiquette of making a formal visit, so no rumors spread about us being upstarts with no manners." Liu Shengye squinted, waved his hand, and said, "Someone, call the door, present the visiting card."
The younger generation of the Liu Family, Liu Yongzhou, immediately dismounted from a Yellow Steed and walked forward with strides like a dragon and tiger, pulling out the visiting card and declaring loudly.
"Ancestor Zhide of the Ping’an Liu Family, along with Patriarch Liu Shengye and their clansmen, have come to express gratitude for the Wang Family’s grace."
The outstanding representative of the Zhao Family’s young generation, Zhao Dingtian, was equally undaunted, stepping forward to declare:
"Elder Bo Jun of the Ping’an Zhao Family, together with Patriarch Zhao Jinxian and their clansmen, have come to thank the Wang Family for their generosity."
The two young elites, their profound qi thick and voices full of momentum, echoed for a long time without dissipating.
Though they claimed to thank the Wang Family’s grace, their intent to hold them accountable was visible to all.
...
At the rear of the Liu and Zhao Clans’ contingent, more and more onlookers gathered. Among them were wealthy commoners, middle-class farmers, merchants, loose cultivators, and so forth.
When such domineering knocks sounded.
The onlookers erupted into commotion, among them, some who psychologically sided with the Liu and Zhao Clans cheered, their faces flushed with excitement.
Meanwhile, many who directly or indirectly received the Wang Family’s benevolence appeared worried.
Especially as the Wang Family recently launched a major project to dredge and fill, providing disaster relief through work-based assistance that saved many common families, a reputation for benevolence widely spread among the commoners of the Ping’an Town area, making many commoners mentally favor the Wang Family, and they worried on their behalf.
The total population of Ping’an Town is merely twenty thousand.
When significant events occur, word swiftly spreads throughout Ping’an Town. The commoners living and thriving here knew well that the Wang Family was increasingly in decline, with fears that their ancestral pillars might not hold.
However, most of the crowd remained merely spectators without allegiance, having been provocatively drawn to the spectacle. They harbored no goodwill toward either family.
As the Liu and Zhao Clans’ knocks reverberated provocatively, coupled with some malevolent agitators hidden among the crowd, some spectators began to shout.
"Ping’an Wang Family, stop being cowards."
"Ping’an Wang Family, do you have the guts to own up?" "Wang Shouzhe, do you dare come out?" "Wang Longyan, won’t you come out to greet Zhide and Elder Bo Jun?"
Many who supported the Wang Family glared angrily at them.
But of what use was it?
Suddenly!
The gate of the Wang Family opened.
With two household generals in attendance, a tall, handsome young man in a sturdy outfit stepped out, his expression calm and unreadable. Walking with each step as steady as a rock.
He looked around imperiously from his elevated position, frowning slightly.
"The main residence of the Wang Family is a place of significance; who is causing such a disturbance here?"
He did not shout it.
His words seemed to be spoken in an ordinary tone but spread outward like an invisible wave.
Even those standing dozens of feet away felt its force reverberate, leaving them momentarily speechless and the scene fell silent enough to hear a pin drop.
Immediately!
All the clamor and noise ceased abruptly, the scene was still and quiet enough to hear a pin drop.
...
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 88
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 87: Never Refuse Anyone, Please Enlighten Me! (Seeking Recommendations)
...
Among the closest to the center were two notable figures: one from the Liu Family, Liu Yongzhou, and one from the Zhao Family, Zhao Dingtian.
Suddenly, their hearts were gripped with panic, and they involuntarily took two steps back. But as soon as they did this, they were immediately overtaken by a sense of embarrassment and anger, their faces turning red with shame.
Following Wang Shouzhe out were the Liua Brothers and Sisters. They feared that Wang Shouzhe might suffer a loss and had intended to come and support him, but they did not expect to witness this scene.
"Brother Shouzhe, you truly are something else," murmured Liua Ruolei softly.
On the other hand, Liua Yuanrui, after a moment’s daze, showed a helpless bitter smile on his face; Brother Shouzhe, oh Brother Shouzhe, you never cease to surprise me.
The Clan Leaders of the Liu and Zhao Clans, who originally had an air of amiable confidence, found their expressions frozen on the spot.
The grand morale conjured by both clans’ people was utterly shattered by just a single sentence from him.
Sufficient time passed for a few breaths.
It was only then that Liu Shengye recovered from the shock. He shot a fierce glare at the somewhat humiliating Liu Yongzhou and then said to Wang Shouzhe with a sarcastic tone, "Dear nephew Shouzhe, since we parted at Dingpu Ferry, you’ve become more and more impressive. Is it that you no longer acknowledge even your elder uncle visiting the door? Your Ping’an Wang Family, with such scholarly heritage, does it not even understand the slightest decorum?"
Since the momentum was broken, Liu Shengye, known for his eloquence, was ready to turn the tables.
Wang Shouzhe glanced left and right before finally resting his puzzled gaze on Liu Shengye: "Oh, isn’t this the Patriarch Liu? My apologies, my apologies, I, Wang Shouzhe, a stalwart man, am not accustomed to acknowledging a jackal as my elder uncle."
"You..." Liu Shengye’s face flushed red. Originally, he came here full of confidence to accuse them, feeling superior. Under the public eye, he intended to showcase the Liu Family’s might and to exhibit the superficial manners of a traditional noble family.
Yet unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe directly tore off the facade.
"Fine, fine, fine," Liu Shengye laughed in his anger, saying, "I never thought that the esteemed Ping’an Wang Family, even before vanishing, would already lose the demeanor and grace of a noble family."
"Liu Shengye, are you joking?" Wang Shouzhe said with an inexplicable look, "The demeanor and grace of a noble family are meant for people. In this world, who talks about manners to a beast?"
To "cooperate" with the propaganda strategy of the Liu and Zhao Clans, every word Wang Shouzhe uttered was laced with some Profound Qi, ensuring that those on the outskirts, the onlookers, could all hear clearly.
As expected, the surrounding crowd burst into laughter. Among them were many onlookers who had no particular stance, purely there for the spectacle.
Hearing Wang Shouzhe’s domineering words, they all laughed loudly.
In this situation, with hundreds or even thousands of onlookers, the Liu and Zhao Races had no way to handle them.
"You..." Liu Shengye’s old face turned crimson, almost spitting blood. His muddled old eyes showed a fierce glint, "You little bastard of the Wang Family, now that you want to tear off the facade, don’t blame me for being ruthless today."
"Haha~~ It seems as though your aggressive visit to our Wang Family’s doorstep today was to bow your head and greet me politely," Wang Shouzhe’s expression gradually turned solemn as he spoke loudly, "Liu Shengye, listen to me."
"Three thousand years of Great Qian Prosperity. Our Wang Family Ancestor Zhou Xuan bore the Pioneer Order southward, slaying demon beasts and clearing the wildlands, paving the way for humanity, establishing a haven for the ancestors, for which he rendered great service."
Hearing this, many onlookers adopted serious expressions. Most of them were locals, maintaining respect for Ancestor Zhou Xuan who helped establish Ping’an Town.
"In the year 3095 of Prosperity, a Tier Five demon beast stirred a beast tide. Our Ancestor Zhou Xuan personally went to the front lines, refusing to retreat, determined to protect tens of thousands of citizens in Ping’an Town. In that battle, our Wang Family suffered heavy losses, with clansmen and Household Generals dead and wounded. Our Ancestors, Zhou Xuan and Qiong Yuan, both fell in battle against the beast tide. At that time, where were Liu Zhide, Ancestor of the Liu Family, and Zhao Bojun, Ancestor of the Zhao Family? Haha, not only did they feign death, but they also let two beast tides in, causing our Wang Family’s defense line to completely collapse."
The emotions of the onlookers gradually turned to anger. Such hidden matters were, of course, not something the Liu and Zhao Clans wanted to spread. If this were true, the Liu and Zhao Clans would be utterly despicable and shameless.
"Slander, you’re spouting baseless lies," Liu Shengye roared, "Wang Shouzhe, without evidence, don’t talk nonsense." Should this matter truly spread, the reputation damage to the Liu and Zhao Clans would be immense.
Even the younger generations of the Liu and Zhao Clans felt a bit dubious. However, they considered such words, coming from rival forces, to be mostly false.
"Whether slander or not, you and I know well," Wang Shouzhe said with a cold laugh, speaking loudly, "If you have opinions, let’s talk about the present. In this pest disaster, how many outrageous deeds have your Liu and Zhao Clans committed in an attempt to seize civilian lands? How many civilian families have suffered because of you? If not for our Wang Family’s relief effort through work-for-relief, who knows how many self-cultivating farmers would have lost their land and ended up as serf tenants? Will you still say this is baseless?
"Liu Shengye, before you ask others to respect you, you must first be a human, not a beast."
As soon as Wang Shouzhe finished speaking, a group of self-cultivating farmers shouted, "It’s true, everything Clan Leader Wang said is true."
More and more people began to shout: "It’s true, the Zhao and Liu Clans are heartless, not only do they not provide disaster relief, but they even seize the opportunity to annex and plunder everyone’s land."
The cries of the farmer and civilian voices gathered, echoing in the sky, as they finally found a channel to express their anger within.
Many traveling merchants and passersby who had just arrived in Ping’an Town were quite surprised, all filled with disbelief. Could it be? The Liu and Zhao Clans are so shameless, couldn’t they cover their shame a little when annexing land?
To make a fuss at the Wang Family’s door over such matters?
In an instant, even the momentum of the Liu and Zhao clansmen and their household generals was suppressed.
Especially Clan Leaders Liu Shengye and Zhao Jinxian, they were so enraged that they nearly spit blood.
Originally, in their plans and imaginations, the two clans would come together to suppress the Wang Family. Even if the Wang Family didn’t beg for mercy on the spot, they would at least be trembling in fear, not daring to confront them directly.
Their bigger purpose was to provoke Wang Longyan to appear, so that the two Ancestors could personally, under the guise of sparring, suppress her. Killing her on the spot wasn’t possible, after all, the Daqian Law stands in the way. But if they could injure her further, hastening her to an early grave, that would be the right path.
Without Wang Longyan, the mere Wang Family is nothing more than a sick tiger without claws or teeth, left to be molded at their will, isn’t it?
But to their surprise, Wang Shouzhe was so audacious. Does he not fear completely angering the Liu and Zhao Clans, not even giving them a chance to survive?
Just as Liu Shengye was about to retaliate verbally, he heard some instructions from the ancestors in his ear.
His face immediately darkened, and he stepped forward, viciously saying, "Wang Shouzhe, you’re just a junior here spouting nonsense, has Wang Longyan died? Let her come out immediately to explain the matters of commercial sniping, otherwise don’t blame our Liu and Zhao Clans for being rude."
What’s the use of these mere commoners even if they scream louder?
Could it be, they’re daring to take up scythes and charge at a noble family? Once the Wang Family is completely suppressed, won’t each of these commoners obediently fall in line?
"Haha, truly those with big fists have strong confidence." Wang Shouzhe laughed lightly and casually, "With your family of wolves and traitors, what qualification do you have to request an audience with Ancestor Longyan? How about this, and don’t say the Ping’an Wang Family lacks grace. I’ll give you a chance: if anyone under forty in your two clans can defeat me, Wang Shouzhe, I’ll invite Ancestor Longyan out."
"Clang!"
"I, Wang Shouzhe! Currently eighteen years old, welcome any opponent under forty." Wang Shouzhe drew out his fine steel longsword, assumed a battle stance, and shouted aloud.
"Please enlighten me!"
He stood on the steps, his expression neither angry nor joyous, looking down at the Liu and Zhao Clans as if they were nothing!
Unfortunately, no elite from the Liu and Zhao Clans dared to meet his gaze.
With just one person and one sword, he once again completely suppressed the momentum of the Liu and Zhao Clans.
"Brother Shouzhe..." Liua Ruolei’s eyes flickered, muttering incessantly, "Truly a hero, a true champion. Boohoo, elder sister is so fortunate."
Liua Yuanrui, who always thought highly of himself, looked somewhat pale, inwardly complaining, Brother Shouzhe, oh Brother Shouzhe, haven’t you set the bar a bit too high for the younger generation?
This puts the young legitimate sons such as himself in a tough spot.
Even his eldest legitimate brother Liua Yuanhui probably couldn’t achieve this, could he?
At this very moment.
A little girl with braided pigtails jumped out from behind Wang Shouzhe. She skittered over to Wang Shouzhe’s side, also gazing down at the Liu and Zhao Clans.
"Before challenging fourth brother, you’ll have to defeat me first."
"I, Wang Luqiu! Currently eleven years old!" Wang Luqiu’s immature yet proud voice echoed across the square, "Welcoming any Black Tortoise Practitioner under sixteen, please enlighten me!"
Before Wang Shouzhe could speak.
Wang Luojing also walked over slowly, saying calmly as she walked, "I, Wang Luojing! Currently twelve years old."
"Welcoming any Black Tortoise Practitioner under sixteen, please enlighten me!"
Wang Shouzhe’s heart warmed. His two sisters stepping forward to fight was not part of the plan; this feeling of standing shoulder to shoulder with family, of having someone protect you and share the burdens of the family together, was truly wonderful!
The scene was silent, all eyes lifted to gaze at the three young members of the Wang Family. Such boldness, truly such boldness.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 89
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 88 This, Is Family!
...
"I, Wang Shouyong, am willing to shoulder this burden with Fourth Brother."
"I, Wang Shou Lian, am willing to act as Fourth Brother’s support."
The younger generation of the Wang Clan members emerged one by one from the main residence. Their faces were tender, yet each showed a courage that defies life and death, charging unfalteringly forward.
Shouyong, Shou Lian.
Perhaps they are not as dazzlingly talented as Luqiu and Luojing for the moment, but they dare to stand up at this critical juncture and stand shoulder to shoulder with Wang Shouzhe, together bearing the life-and-death crisis of the family.
With such courage and sense of responsibility, their future achievements will not be lacking.
This event was not yet over.
People from the family all stood up one by one, even Wang Shounuo and Wang Luotong, who were working at the distant Zhuwei Lake, had returned to stand by Wang Shouzhe.
"Shouzhe, I will bear this with you." Wang Shouzhe’s sister Wang Luoyi also stood by his side, with an immensely determined look in her eyes.
"Brother~ Miaomiao will help you beat up the bad guys." Wang Luomiao also stood up, saying with a very tender voice, "I, Wang Luomiao, am now eight years old, under ten, none are refused, please give me your guidance!"
Although saying under ten sounded not very imposing, it was also very much in line with the actual situation. She was still at the stage of warming and nourishing her body’s meridians, certainly unable to fight real Black Tortoise Practitioners.
"I, Wang Zongwei, though without prospects, fearlessly battle to the death." A twenty-year-old young man hobbled forward with the aid of a cane, "Fourth Uncle, let me atone for my sins."
Wang Shouzhe looked at Wang Zongwei, and indeed looked at him with newfound respect.
"My name is Wang Shouye, and I am ten years old! You bunch of bad people, one day, you will remember my name." This was the son of Sixth Uncle Dinghai, quite young, yet full of vigor.
"My name is Wang Zongchang, thirteen years old this year! Second tier of the Qi Refining Realm, unafraid of peers, please give me your guidance!" This is the second son of Brother Shouxin, only thirteen, but his cultivation has nearly caught up with that of his brother Wang Zongwei.
"My name is Wang Liwan, nine years old this year, just started cultivating, unafraid of peers, please give me your guidance." This is the second daughter of Brother Shouxin, a well-behaved and obedient child, who surprisingly also stood up.
"My name is Wang Zongsheng, seven years old this year. Just you all wait!" This is the son of Brother Shouyi, just tested with a Grade B Lower Grade talent.
Finally, a milky voice of a little girl rang out.
"My name is Wang Luolan, and I’m five years old! I won’t let you bully my Fourth Brother." This is the youngest daughter of Sixth Uncle Dinghai, the youngest girl of the Lu generation, ranked eighth, and her talent has not been tested yet.
One by one, the clan members, even young children, stood up fearlessly.
Following them, some of the family elders and womenfolk all stood behind Wang Shouzhe. Household servants and family slaves all appeared. They, although afraid, still stood unwaveringly behind Wang Shouzhe.
It was as if invisible threads connected everyone, forming an invisible rope that unified them into one entity.
Ping’an Wang Family!
The Ancestor Zhou Xuan once held the Pioneer Order, marched south, fought monsters and demons, expanded territories, and laid the foundation of the family.
The glory of the ancestor is etched in everyone’s heart, this is what faith is.
Why can a Noble Family unite as one?
Because it has roots!
This is the true foundation and heritage of a family.
The foundation of the family, the glory of the ancestors, the fusion of bloodlines, mutual protection, and inheritance from elders all bring the clan members together.
While warming Wang Shouzhe’s heart, it also brought immense shock to those present. The Wang Clan members could be so united and spirited at critical moments?
What strength is this?
Especially the people of the Liu and Zhao Clans were shocked. Compared to the unity within the Wang Clan, their clan members seemed to lack such cohesion, instead filled with overt and covert struggles and mutual scheming.
Why?
Why is this so?
The gathering onlookers, whose numbers subtly approached a thousand, stood in silence, as an indescribable emotion seemed to take root in their hearts.
"Alas! This is the true Black Tortoise Clan, this is truly a noble family." murmured a loose cultivator, eyes filled with endless yearning.
"If I’m not mistaken, once the Wang Clan endures this crisis, they might soar to the sky," said an elder with a head full of white-blond hair.
"But currently, the Liu and Zhao Clans are stronger," someone expressed concern, "after all, in this world, strength is the true reason."
Some discussions gradually arose.
But this time, nearly all public opinion swung in one direction, standing on the side of the Wang Clan.
Even those with ulterior motives dared not to stir chaos, fearing that they might be overwhelmed and beaten to death by the angry crowd.
...
"Liu Shengye, Zhao Jinxian," Wang Shouzhe said solemnly, sword in hand, "this is where we Ping’an Wang Clan differ from you traitorous families. You might rely on sinister tactics to be arrogant for a moment, but you will never be rampant for a lifetime. As I said, to meet Ancestor Longyan, you must first pass through me."
"No, Fourth Brother, let me." Wang Luqiu stepped forward, blocking the way, "how can it be that the commander steps up first in the beginning?"
"Let me handle it." A hint of fierceness appeared in Wang Luojing’s eyes, "These people bullied Fourth Brother with such momentum, I will make them pay."
Wang Shouzhe truly felt gratified, as the joint siege by the Liu and Zhao Clans actually made the Wang Clan members more united.
"Good, very good. It seems Wang Longyan is determined to stay hidden. Sending you youngsters to cause trouble here, so audacious." Liu Shengye, once a sly old fox, no longer had a pacifying smile, his face filled with ruthlessness, "If so, I’ll beat you arrogant younglings down, let’s see how long Wang Longyan can hold out. Liu Yonghao!"
"Father, I’m here." A youth in gorgeous clothing, about fifteen or sixteen years old, stepped forward. His appearance was decent, yet there was an indescribably flippant look between his brows, like a frivolous libertine.
"Didn’t those two little girls say under sixteen, none are refused? It seems they’re the unworldly genius girls of the Ping’an Wang Clan," Liu Shengye sneered, "aren’t you under sixteen? You should go and learn from them, have a spar."
Liu Yonghao glanced at Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing from afar, laughed impudently: "As you wish, Father."
Then, he swaggered forward, sizing up the two girls, snorting disdainfully: "At such a young age, you already have the second-layer strength of the Qi Refining Realm, quite decent. But this Young Clan Leader is already at the Third-Layer Middle Stage, not to mention bullying you, you’d better regret it while you can."
As soon as these words were spoken, the onlookers couldn’t hold back any longer.
"Does the Liu Family have no shame? A legitimate son of fifteen or sixteen, actually having the face to step up."
"Aren’t those two little girls only eleven or twelve? Even if their Qi Refining talent is good, their combat strength can’t be that strong."
Especially some traveling merchants and loose cultivators, who began to jeer and discuss incessantly. Normally, they wouldn’t dare oppose the Liu Family. But now, hidden among the crowd, they felt like they had a natural shield.
"Fight, why not?" Wang Luqiu saw that someone indeed stepped forward and was so excited she was trembling a bit. "Wang Luojing, this one is mine, don’t compete with me."
When it comes to being warlike, no one in the Wang Clan could match the Little Overlord Wang Luqiu.
"No, normally I let you," Wang Luojing insisted, her voice calm, "but this time I must be the vanguard for our Fourth Brother."
"Yield.""I won’t yield!"
"Rock-paper-scissors then.""Fine."
Scissors-paper-rock! A draw. Again.
...
The playful smile on Liu Yonghao’s face gradually froze, replaced by out-of-control anger. In his eyes, these two little girls were the type he could crush easily, even if it were one against two, he felt it would be easy.
But unexpectedly, the two girls from the Wang Clan started arguing over who would fight him, deciding it with a rock-paper-scissors game.
The uproarious laughter around him made Liu Yonghao feel like a slighted clown, his expression becoming increasingly fierce.
Suddenly!
An excited voice chirped up, "Wang Luojing, you lost, he’s mine." Then, she swaggered step by step toward the center of the square.
Wang Luojing had a look of regret, muttering to herself, she really shouldn’t have chosen scissors just now.
But regretting now was useless.
Wang Luqiu was already facing off against Liu Yonghao in the square at the entrance, her bright eyes unapologetically scrutinizing him from top to bottom, "Liu Family’s legitimate son?"
"Hmph, that’s right." Liu Yonghao was seething with anger, "Little girl, if you obediently kneel and beg for forgiveness, I can spare you once. Otherwise, I’ll break your legs."
"Idiot!"
Wang Luqiu sneered, full of disdain, "With just you, are you fit to be a legitimate son? Less talk, Wang Luqiu of the Wang Clan, let’s see what you’ve got."
In her view, being a legitimate son required someone extraordinary like Wang Shou, no, like her Fourth Brother.
After speaking, she assumed a combat stance. Her small stature was impressively poised.
"Fine, fine, then don’t blame me for being rude." Liu Yonghao laughed in anger, also assuming a combat stance, "Liu Yonghao of the Liu Family, let’s see what you’ve got." He still managed to save a bit of face by not using a weapon.
Both sides began scrutinizing each other, looking for weaknesses. Wang Luqiu was warlike, but not foolish; on the contrary, she was quite clever.
"Fourth Brother, that bad guy is almost sixteen." The just five-year-old Wang Luolan blinked and said, "Will Sixth Sister win?"
"Oh, you little ancestor, why are you out here too?" Wang Shouzhe affectionately picked her up, pinching her chubby cheek with a smile, "Don’t worry, just watch as your Sixth Sister beats him up."
No sooner had Wang Shouzhe finished speaking.
Over there, Wang Luqiu moved, kicking off with such ferocity as if she were a small predator from the wild Outer Domain, her speed leaving a trail of afterimages.
In a breath, she was in front of her opponent, throwing a straightforward punch.
When she moved, it was startling.
"How is it possible!" Liu Yonghao’s face turned pale; he could only barely block the move.
"Boom!"
Liu Yonghao felt as if his arms had been smashed by a hammer, the powerful impact forced him to take several steps back.
Before he could recover, Wang Luqiu was already upon him, her fists and feet, elbows and knees, raining down like a violent storm.
The legitimate son of the Liu Family could only defend himself, constantly retreating.
Ultimately, his defenses were breached.
"Boom!"
Wang Luqiu closed in, delivering a straightforward Mountain-Shaking Elbow to his chest. Liu Yonghao was sent flying like he had been hit by a horse carriage, landing on the ground, coughing up blood and unable to get up.
It was very clear that several ribs in his chest had been broken.
At that moment, Wang Luqiu lowered her stance from the Mountain-Shaking Elbow, mimicking Wang Shouzhe by placing her hands behind her back, her eyes full of dissatisfaction, her pretty little face questioning sharply.
"So weak. Seems like just an empty post, really boring."
"Is this the best the Liu Family can produce as a legitimate son?"
"Ah, so disappointing."
"Can’t someone tougher come out? This lady hasn’t even warmed up yet!"
Each of her honest words was like a sharp knife, mercilessly stabbing into the hearts of the Liu Family members.
Some thin-skinned Liu Clan members wished they could find a hole to crawl into.
Meanwhile, they also began to grow dissatisfied with Liu Yonghao.
They were all legitimate sons, why was there such a big gap compared to Wang Shouzhe?
"Long live Sixth Sister, Sixth Sister is invincible!" Young Wang Luolan excitedly screamed in Wang Shouzhe’s arms.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 90
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 89: Ferocity! Wang Luojing (First update: 5,000-word long Chapter, please subscribe, please vote for monthly tickets)
...
With the youngest girl of the Wang Family—Wang Luolan’s babyish scream, the Wang Family members couldn’t help but cheer.
How many years has it been.
The Liu and Zhao Clans have always been aggressive, while the Wang Family could only endure everywhere, being squeezed little by little for survival. Any resistance would invite combined bullying from the Liu and Zhao Clans.
But today, finally, there’s a day to hold one’s head high.
Wang Luqiu, at just eleven years old, faced off against and brought down the legitimate son of the young generation of the Liu Family.
Especially the older generation of the Wang Family, who felt like they had cleared the clouds and seen the sky, feeling suddenly enlightened and relieved, as years of oppression seemed completely released with Wang Luqiu’s exhilarating blow.
Winning so cleanly and swiftly, even Wang Shouzhe, who was holding Wang Luolan with one arm, couldn’t help but nod secretly. Luqiu, this girl, is truly gifted in combat, having improved a lot compared to the days of battling loose cultivators, her moves more neat and her Profound Qi bursts perfectly timed.
However, Wang Shouzhe is also quite aware that this is partly because Liu Yonghao’s basic skills are somewhat average, not quite matching those desperadoes among loose cultivators.
Outside, more and more onlookers followed with cheers and noise. Most of them were originally standing on the side of the Wang Family, and since the Liu Family used the strong to bully the weak and got beaten instead, such an outcome was naturally welcomed.
Compared to the Wang Family’s cheers and joy.
The faces of the Liu Family members were already gloomy, about to rain, failing to suppress and getting beaten instead, they lost face completely.
Some clan members went forward, supporting Young Clan Leader Liu Yonghao back, even their movements were sullen.
Zhao Family’s Clan Leader Zhao Jinxian glanced at Liu Shengye, slightly frowning, said: "Brother Liu, don’t just focus on making money. You need to put more effort into educating the younger generation. Yonghao’s basic skills are somewhat lacking."
Zhao Jinxian, who is skillful in Black Tortoise Combat Technique, has never held Liu Shengye, who is proficient in scheming and calculating, in high esteem.
In his opinion, for a Black Tortoise Noble Family, at the end of the day, they need to be strong themselves.
Being strong allows one to suppress all opposing voices. Being strong, naturally more resources will come.
Liu Shengye’s face twitched, with a strange tone said: "Could it be, Brother Jinxian, that you’re also considering sending your legitimate son to fight that girl? Your legitimate son is only fourteen years old, his cultivation barely reaching the third layer of the Qi Refining Realm, he might not necessarily be that girl’s match, right?"
"No matter what, we have to get back at this." Zhao Jinxian stroked his beard and said, "Look, that girl has already gone back after the fight."
Upon a closer look, it was indeed so.
Only to see Wang Luqiu mimicking Wang Shouzhe’s movements, strolling back unhurriedly, looking as if the younger generation of the Liu Zhao Clans were all trash, not worth her effort.
Liu Shengye’s eyes lit up: "Brother Zhao means..."
"My son, Zhao Dingteng, has been diligently practicing Black Tortoise Combat Technique since childhood, but can only slightly surpass that Wang Luqiu, there’s no guarantee of winning if he fights." Zhao Jinxian calculated calmly, "Among the younger generation, we can’t afford to lose. Dingteng!"
From behind him, a boy with a sturdy build stepped forward, speaking in a muffled voice: "Yes, father."
"You go challenge that other girl with the wild remarks."
"This... I’d like to fight the one from earlier, she was strong and interesting."
"Listen to me. We can’t afford further losses."
"Alright." The robust youth Zhao Dingteng reluctantly, immediately walked to the square, shouted towards the Wang Family, "That girl, come down, let’s spar."
With that said, he pointed in the direction of Wang Luojing.
"Me?" Wang Luojing was slightly bewildered?
"Yes, I’m talking about you." Zhao Dingteng’s voice buzzed, "Originally, I wanted to fight that little tigress from earlier, but father says we can’t afford further losses, so I’m left with you."
The scene fell silent.
A few seconds later, the surroundings erupted in laughter. This boy, does he have to be so honest?
Even Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched slightly, it was rumored that this generation’s legitimate son of the Zhao Family, Zhao Dingteng, was not good at socializing and was more into cultivation. But unexpectedly, he was this simple-minded.
However, this boy’s voice was strong and resonant, with a robust and sturdy physique, walking steadily and firmly, clearly with decent basic skills.
Seeing this opponent, Wang Luqiu immediately became eager, full of interest: "No problem, no problem, let’s fight, I’ll go easy on you." For the chance to fight, she didn’t even mind being called a little tigress.
But before she could finish speaking, she was pulled back by Wang Luojing: "Go, go, go, you’ve fought one match already, it’s my turn now."
Saying this, before Wang Luqiu could react, Wang Luojing quickly ran down the steps, walked to the square, and said to Zhao Dingteng: "Wang Family’s Luojing, please instruct me."
Wang Luqiu, seeing this, pouted, regrettably said: "I should have known there would be someone who doesn’t know their own limits coming out to challenge, I shouldn’t have come back."
Wang Shouzhe secretly chuckled on the side, who told you to show off? Winning is fine, but you insisted on putting on a show, and if you must put on a show, you had to mimic how Wang Shouzhe walks, and if you must imitate, you exaggerated on purpose.
"Sixth sister is already very awesome." Wang Luolan said admiringly, "When Luolan grows up, I want to be just as awesome as sixth sister."
This praise made Wang Luqiu smile widely, as she put her hands behind her back and raised her head, speaking with a commanding tone: "It’s just okay. Luolan, let me tell you, as they say, there’s always a mountain beyond a mountain, and people above people. On the invincible emperor road, there will certainly be bumps and setbacks, as long as you persevere..."

chapters.title: Chapter 91
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 89: Brutalization! Wang Luojing (First update, 5,000-word Chapter, asking for subscriptions and monthly tickets)_2
"Alright, don’t set a bad example for Xiao Ba," Wang Shouzhe interrupted, not waiting for her to argue back, he quickly added, "This time, your performance on the battlefield was pretty good, so I’ll give you 50 merit points."
There are actually merit points? Wang Luqiu narrowed her eyes, and her dimples appeared as she smiled happily, but she still haggled, "Only 50 points? That was a legitimate son, isn’t that worth a bit more?"
The emphasis on the words ’legitimate son’ indicated their value. After all, Wang Shouzhe himself was a legitimate son too.
"That was just subpar, not even as good as the loose cultivator you took down before. It’s like I’m sponsoring you. If you don’t want it, fine."
"I’ll take it, I’ll take it, 50 is 50," Wang Luqiu said helplessly, "And how much is the one Luojing took down worth?"
"That Zhao Dingteng is a solid guy, not a simple character," Wang Shouzhe said, his expression slightly serious, "Depending on his actual performance in battle, he’s expected to be worth at least 100 merit points."
A hundred points?
Wang Luqiu’s vision went black, and she swayed, regretting deeply. Had she known, losing the guessing game would’ve been so much better?
No will to live.
...
"Zhao Dingteng from the Zhao Family," Zhao Dingteng said with a silly smile, "Miss, what weapon do you use?"
"?" Wang Luojing was puzzled, "I’m not good with weapons."
"In that case, I won’t hold back," Zhao Dingteng said as he gestured with his hand. Immediately, a household general came forward carrying his weapons, which were two eight-sided hammers!
The onlookers immediately began to jeer, saying how the young lady wasn’t even using a weapon and yet this big guy, as tall as a mighty man, was using two large hammers? Wasn’t that bullying?
Where’s their sense of shame?
Even Liu Yonghao previously was better, at least he knew to fight hand-to-hand.
Unfortunately, those taunting words had no effect on Zhao Dingteng, who continued to grin foolishly, holding his two heavy hammers, "Miss, please grant me your guidance."
Wang Luojing broke out in a cold sweat.
Is this guy really dumb or just pretending? It felt like underneath that silly exterior, there was a touch of cunning.
Better be careful.
If she slipped up, Wang Luqiu would have a good laugh.
"Please grant me your guidance," Wang Luojing also struck a pose, drawing out a fine steel short sword, which she had exchanged for with her merit points.
As soon as she finished speaking, Zhao Dingteng let out a roar, swinging the heavy eight-sided hammer, charging forward like a wild ox. As the hammer came down, it seemed as if the air would explode.
The fight started right away, no hesitation.
Everyone immediately became tense. Zhao Dingteng seemed extremely powerful. If that hammer even grazed Luojing, she would either die or suffer serious injuries.
Fortunately, Wang Luojing was well-prepared. Having become accustomed to Luqiu’s face-to-face assault tactics, she lightly sprang backward like a fleeting bird.
"Boom!"
Zhao Dingteng’s hammer strike missed, shattering a large pit in the bluestone ground and sending debris flying.
Wang Shouzhe’s gaze sharpened, as expected, Zhao Dingteng was not simple. Even if it wasn’t a bloodline mutation, he was at least exceptionally gifted.
This strength was likely more than enough to surpass the yet-to-develop Wang Luqiu.
"This..." Wang Luqiu was equally surprised, "This guy has such great strength, is he a monster?" She imagined herself in the midst of it and felt it would be tough to fight, with a higher chance of losing. Of course, the result wasn’t guaranteed, as combat wasn’t just about strength.
Wang Shouzhe glared at her. Compared to you, that guy is the real monster, no? You’re only eleven and haven’t even developed yet.
Nonetheless, Wang Shouzhe was somewhat relieved. With Luojing’s capability, dealing with the Zhao kid was even more advantageous. Although that kid was strong, he was slower than Wang Luqiu by a slight margin.
There’s the massive weight and those two hammers, after all.
Though that was Wang Shouzhe’s judgment, it didn’t mean others saw it the same way.
On the battlefield, Zhao Dingteng seemed to dominate, controlling the battle, charging about forcefully. Meanwhile, Wang Luojing could only dodge, narrowly avoiding attacks and seeming rather flustered.
It appeared as though Zhao Dingteng only needed to push a little harder to defeat Wang Luojing.
But he didn’t know Wang Luojing was holding back. Her speed and agility slightly exceeded Wang Luqiu’s. This approach was just leading him by the nose, exhausting his stamina and profound qi.
The strategy was very sound, even Wang Shouzhe quietly approved, nodding. Luojing’s strength wasn’t only about her talent, but also her strategic mind during combat, setting the stage from the very beginning.
Suddenly!
A sudden change occurred.
As Wang Luojing sidestepped again, "clumsily" dodging Zhao Dingteng’s attack, Zhao Dingteng suddenly grinned, letting out a loud shout. In an instant, his speed, which had already been at its "limit," surged another ten to twenty percent, dashing forth with a blur, swinging a hammer towards Wang Luojing.
Holding back!
Many didn’t expect that the seemingly foolish Zhao Dingteng was so sly, controlling his speed from the start and bursting with full speed at the crucial moment to decide the battle.
Not good!
The faces of the Wang family changed dramatically.
Meanwhile, the Liu and Zhao Clans were all smiles.
Victory!
If this girl took the hammer hit, she’d be either dead or seriously injured. How would the Wang family dare to flaunt anymore?
At this critical juncture.
Wang Luojing’s expression showed no change, her small hand shook, and the fine steel short sword was thrown toward Zhao Dingteng’s face.
Forced to retreat, it seemed like Wang Luojing had narrowly escaped. But without a weapon, what chance did Wang Luojing have against Zhao Dingteng? It was only a matter of time before she lost. Thus, he surged again with full speed to attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 92
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 89: Ferocity! Wang Luojing (First update: 5,000-word long Chapter, please subscribe, please vote for monthly tickets)_3
"Hehe!"
Wang Luojing chuckled lightly, her body technique also quickened a bit, continuing to lead Zhao Dingteng by the nose. Compared to her earlier awkwardness, she now glided like a butterfly and was as light as a sparrow, subtly touching the threshold and essence of the Willow Catkin Body Technique.
This girl! She was hiding her skills too!? Her body technique is so outstanding? The joy on the faces of the Liu and Zhao Clans froze instantly, fearing it might end in a draw if this continued.
They didn’t know that Wang Luojing had to excel in body technique, or else she would have been beaten to death by Luqiu. The two little girls were always competing against each other, neither willing to submit to the other.
"Since you’ve revealed your trump card, don’t blame me for being impolite." Wang Luojing flipped her small hand, revealing a strangely-shaped flute, which she played while retreating.
The high-pitched sound was extremely piercing.
But to the sensory system of the Purple Crystal Spirit Bees, it was a very clear command.
"Buzz buzz buzz!"
A swarm of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees flew onto the battlefield, circling Zhao Dingteng, seeking an opportunity to strike.
As for Zhao Dingteng, he was suddenly flustered, swinging his Eight-sided Hammer repeatedly, yet unable to hit the Purple Crystal Spirit Bees at all.
"Spirit Insect Master!"
Zhao Jinxian and others exclaimed with a drastic change in their expressions. Everyone had heard that the Wang Family had a Spirit Insect Master. But because of Wang Family and allies’ confidentiality, people only knew that the Wang Family was hiding a Spirit Insect Master.
No one would have thought that the Spirit Insect Master was a little girl, and coincidentally, it was this little girl who was battling Zhao Dingteng!
"Not good, Dingteng is at a disadvantage against the Spirit Bees." Zhao Jinxian looked extremely grim.
It’s no surprise.
Zhao Dingteng’s fighting style was open and forceful, mainly relying on strength to overpower. Encountering a fast opponent already put him at a disadvantage. Now that he’s faced with a fast Spirit Insect Master, how could he possibly win when he can’t even get close?
Using the Eight-Sided Hammer to hit Spirit Bees?
This was a complete slamming counter.
"Dingteng, surrender." Zhao Jinxian sighed.
Zhao Dingteng was naturally extremely aggrieved. Swinging the hammer couldn’t even touch a Spirit Bee, it truly was impossible to fight. Just as he was about to surrender.
Suddenly.
Over ten Purple Crystal Spirit Bees fearlessly charged in, Zhao Dingteng hurriedly swung his hammer, barely managing to kill a few. The remaining Spirit Bees violently drove towards his face, or more precisely, his mouth.
"Ah!"
Zhao Dingteng screamed in pain, but that cry stopped abruptly after two or three breaths. That was because his mouth and cheeks had become numb and swollen, like a pig’s head, unable to produce any sound.
"If you think you can just surrender?" Wang Luojing sneered, "Did you even ask for my permission?"
With a casual flick, several centipedes and scorpions crawled rapidly towards Zhao Dingteng. At the same time, the frequency of her flute playing became even more urgent, as if urging the rhythm of the Spirit Bee and poison insect attack.
The Liu and Zhao Clans all gasped in shock, this girl was truly malicious, using such a vicious method to prevent Zhao Dingteng from surrendering, was she going for the kill?
"Girl, you are bold!" The Zhao Clan members shouted angrily.
