"Fair duel, how dare you interfere." The Wang Clan members also shouted angrily, all rushing forward. If the Zhao Family dared to act rashly, they wouldn’t let it go either.
Even Wang Shouzhe took the lead, his long sword sharp and cold, and if a conflict arose, it would be the weapon to reap heads.
Today, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t mind a real showdown, especially when the opponent had lost the moral high ground.
The Black Tortoise World naturally has its own laws, even unwritten rules.
In a fair duel, the side conceding can surrender, which is naturally one of the unwritten rules.
However, the same goes for those who interfere with a fair duel. Interfering in the competition is essentially against the unwritten rules. The consequence of breaking the rules is simple, that is, losing all honor and face.
Even if the interferer is killed, the Daqian Law would turn a blind eye.
The Zhao Family members hesitated a bit in their actions, faced with the Wang Family’s obstruction.
And Zhao Jinxian, called out in devastation and helplessness, "Ancestor!"
Zhao Dingteng was already rolling around on the ground, despite his robust physique, after all, he was only at the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. With all sorts of toxins, how could he bear it?
The scariest part was, Zhao Dingteng couldn’t even scream or surrender.
All the spectators felt chilled to the bone, even those watching from the sidelines were chilled into silence.
That seemingly delicate and pretty little girl was truly terrifying and ruthless.
Especially Liu Yonghao, with his ribs broken earlier, seeing this scene felt unbelievably fortunate, lucky that the girl had lost the drinking game earlier. Otherwise, the one rolling on the ground, ravaged by poison insects, would have been him, wouldn’t it?
At this moment.
A terrifying and towering force erupted from the previously dormant carriage of the Liu and Zhao Clans.
With Zhao Jinxian’s shout, Elder Bo Jun couldn’t sit still, and the Zhao Family members all breathed a sigh of relief.
"Junior of the Wang Family, how dare you."
With an angry shout, an old man in gorgeous clothing flew up from nowhere, heading straight for the battlefield, his gaze as sharp and fierce as an eagle, he swooped down towards Wang Luojing from afar.
"Such a vile heart at such a young age, I cannot let you remain!"
Elder Bo Jun’s mentality was simple, regardless of the situation today with Wang Longyan, eliminating a Spirit Insect Master was naturally more beneficial than detrimental. Although doing so lacked the demeanor befitting an elder, and would garner criticism, there might even be repercussions under the Daqian Law.
However, as a dignified elder, if he accidentally disables a young girl in the Second Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, he’s not exactly killing her.
Would the Guardian’s Mansion arrest him for execution?
Sometimes, an elder indifferent to face could indeed be hard to handle.
But today, Elder Bo Jun was destined to be disappointed.
Almost simultaneously with Elder Bo Jun’s eruption, a domineering presence surged from behind Wang Shouzhe, a majestic figure charging towards Elder Bo Jun.
He punched towards Elder Bo Jun, and that punch contained an incredibly terrifying explosive force, the golden Qi Force condensed without dissipating, seeming to want to shatter the invisible space.
At the same time, a taunting shout echoed.
"Zhao Bojun, as a dignified elder, do you not care about face, did you ask for my consent?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 93
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 90: Reaping Reputation! Reaping Desperately (Asking for Monthly Votes)
...
That punch.
Directly collided with Elder Bo Jun’s claw.
"Boom!"
Two forces clashed, sending shockwaves in all directions.
Elder Bo Jun’s body flipped backward in mid-air for over ten zhang before he barely managed to regain his balance. A flush of redness on his face flashed and disappeared, indicating he had suffered some loss. Then, like a floating feather, he slowly descended to the ground. His face was filled with extreme rage: "It’s you, Gongsun Mang!"
The Zhao Family’s main territory was directly across from the Shanyang Gongsun Family, and he had crossed paths with Gongsun Mang twice before, so they were not entirely unfamiliar with each other.
After Gongsun Mang’s successful strike, he too landed heavily, his feet creating a pit in the bluestone ground.
He lifted the hood of his gray robe, sneering coldly: "Zhao Bojun, you disregarded the rules of engagement and struck at a twelve-year-old child. When this spreads, your reputation will surely be ruined."
"You..." Elder Bo Jun was so infuriated he nearly spat out a mouthful of blood, "Gongsun Mang, don’t falsely accuse me! I only acted out of concern to stop that girl from killing my great-great-grandson."
Gongsun Mang had merely wanted to provoke him with a remark. Since the matter was not accomplished, he naturally couldn’t do anything to a dignified elder. But to take the opportunity to kick someone when they are down and diminish the Zhao Family’s prestige was something he wouldn’t miss. He immediately said loudly, "Right and wrong will be judged by the public consensus. Over a thousand people witnessed everything today, and they will naturally spread news of your family’s actions."
Elder Bo Jun took a deep breath and said in a deep voice, "Our grievances with the Wang Family are not for discussion at this time. But it is not your place, as someone from Shanyang, to interfere, is it? Or are you preparing to provoke a clan war through marriage ties?"
Gongsun Mang laughed heartily and said, "Zhao Bojun, don’t accuse me of such grand intentions. I merely happened to come by to visit my great-grandson Wang Shouzhe. I just happened to see your Liu and Zhao Clans charging in and coincidentally couldn’t stand by while you, a dignified elder, bullied a twelve-year-old girl. If you want a duel, I’m ready to accompany you to the end."
Elder Bo Jun was somewhat uncertain.
Logically speaking, their coming to the Wang Family to make trouble and exert pressure was a temporarily arranged action, and Gongsun Mang would not have had time to rush over even if he got word.
Unless.
Had Gongsun Mang really come here just by chance?
However, he knew this was not the time to argue with Gongsun Mang. Seeing his own great-great-grandson still writhing on the ground, he immediately yelled in anger, "You impudent Wang family brat, since Zhao Dingteng has already lost, why do you still drive poisonous insects to torment him?"
Just as Wang Luojing was about to speak, Wang Shouzhe stepped in front of her, speaking calmly and gracefully: "In a duel, it’s inevitable that both sides suffer some damage. Furthermore, Zhao Dingteng, with his robust physique and indomitable will, has never admitted defeat in the battle. Naturally, it can be assumed that he is still in combat with my younger sister, possibly preparing for a counterattack in the next moment. It is reasonable and appropriate for my sister to continue her moves to ensure victory."
"Fine, fine, fine. A junior like you dares to speak so boldly in front of an elder. Is this the kind of ’teaching’ the Wang Family has?" Elder Bo Jun was enraged.
"I apologize, but I, Wang Shouzhe, am the Clan Leader of the Wang Family, and not some junior of yours to be scolded at will." Wang Shouzhe stated calmly and collectedly, "As for impertinence, the Liu and Zhao Clans’ leaders Liu Shengye and Zhao Jinxian constantly mentioning Wang Longyan, isn’t that rather arrogant and overbearing? The fact that I didn’t address you directly as ’Zhao Bojun’ shows much restraint."
Elder Bo Jun trembled with rage: "Wang Shouzhe, does that mean you have no intention of letting my great-great-grandson go?"
"As the duel continues, it’s not up to me." Wang Shouzhe turned and said, "Luojing, keep battling with Zhao Dingteng well. Don’t let them tarnish the Wang Family’s reputation. Besides, Zhao Dingteng appears to have a significant talent, resilient willpower, and possibly possesses a certain bloodline war body. Be extra careful not to let him turn the tables."
"Yes, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing responded sweetly, then with a serious and determined face, continued to play the insect flute, commanding various poisonous insects and spirit bees to attack Zhao Dingteng.
The brother and sister spoke so earnestly and in tune as they spun blatant lies. Old Ancestor Mang couldn’t help but feel a slight twitch in his heart, realizing that Gongsun Hui and Wang Longyan may not have exaggerated Wang Shouzhe’s capabilities in their accounts.
Judging from the current scenario, their words may have been conservative regarding Wang Shouzhe. Immediately, he reminded, "It’s just a duel, be careful not to cause any fatalities." As soon as he said that, Ancestor Mang felt that his realm of speaking falsehoods had reached a new level.
"Yes, Ancestor Mang." Wang Luojing replied respectfully during a pause.
Not far away, the siblings Liua Yuanrui and Liua Ruolei both swallowed hard. Their Brother Shouzhe, who usually seemed gentle and elegant, a refined gentleman.
Yet when he became ruthless, he was truly terrifying. Zhao Dingteng was indeed in a pitiful state.
"Junior, such audacity you show." Elder Bo Jun chuckled angrily, "Gongsun Mang, since today you choose to protect these juniors, don’t blame us for getting physical with you as well. Brother Zhide, aren’t you planning to take action in such circumstances?"
As his words fell.
From another carriage, the curtain of the sedan opened, and an elderly man with simple clothing and white beard slowly emerged. He did not exhibit the Spirit Platform Realm’s ability to fly mid-air, but walked slowly.
Yet with every step, he seemed to cover several zhang, as if the ground shrunk beneath his feet.
His complexion was rosy, and his white hair fluttered. His garments drifted with the wind, as if a revered land immortal was approaching. In a few breaths, he stood before everyone.
Liu Family’s Ancestor, Liu Zhide.
"Liu Zhide, greets Ancestor Mang." Ancestor Zhide bowed slightly.
"Gongsun Mang, greets Ancestor Zhide." Naturally, since the other party was polite, Gongsun Mang wouldn’t lose the noble family’s manners and returned the greeting.
Ancestor Zhide nodded, slowly and steadily saying, "Since Ancestor Mang is coincidentally here, I understand the protective instincts for your grandsons, but there’s indeed some misunderstanding regarding our Liu and Zhao Clans."
"Though we, the Liu and Zhao Clans, have had misunderstandings with the Wang Family, ultimately we are families sheltered by Ancestor Zhou Xuan, considered a lineage united as one. We should ideally support and watch over each other, yet unfortunately have reached today’s situation." Ancestor Zhide stated calmly, "How about this? As long as Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe promises never to interfere in matters within our territories and dismisses those recruited laborers, we can let this matter pass."
Ancestor Mang’s eyes turned to Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe stepped forward, straightened his demeanor, and said loudly, "Our Ping’an Wang Family, unlike the Liu and Zhao Clans, do not share the same ancestors. Additionally, this region of Ping’an was preserved as a human habitat by Ancestor Zhou Xuan and several Wang family forebears who risked their lives."
"As descendants, if we stand by idly while others desecrate our ancestors’ legacy without taking action, wouldn’t that make us unworthy descendants, disgracing our forebears?"
These words, spoken with clarity and reason, resonated with the Wang Clan Members and most bystanders.
Wang Shouzhe’s face was serious as he said, "I have a suggestion — why don’t our Wang Family, Liu Family, and Zhao Family join forces? Together, we can provide disaster relief and assist the innocent civilians in overcoming this difficult situation. Here, on behalf of the twenty thousand citizens of Ping’an Town, I, Wang Shouzhe, thank Ancestors Zhide and Bo Jun."
After saying that, Wang Shouzhe rose to his full height, cupped his hands in a respectful gesture, and bowed deeply.
"Well said, the Wang Family is a clan of benevolence and righteousness." "Truly worthy descendants of Ancestor Zhou Xuan."
"For the sake of twenty thousand civilians, Clan Leader Wang actually set aside past grievances and performed such a great ceremony for the other side. What great virtue and benevolence." "If the Liu and Zhao Clans could return to the right path, that would indeed be a great merit."
The onlookers were deeply moved by Wang Shouzhe’s words, and each spoke of their vision of a "bright future" without hesitation.
Each of the Wang Clan members exchanged glances, wondering if the patriarch truly intended to cooperate with the Liu and Zhao Clans on disaster relief. It did not seem to fit his character.
Only Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide could truly feel how uncomfortable and disgusted Wang Shouzhe’s words and ceremony made them.
This young man strikes at the heart.
You, a mere junior, how dare you represent the twenty thousand citizens of Ping’an Town? What do you take yourself for?
If they refuse to participate in disaster relief in front of everyone, their prestige will surely plummet. If they agree, wouldn’t they become mere tools in that young man’s hands? They would do all the hard work, yet everything accomplished would be under the leadership of the Wang Family. Was this using them as a vassal family?
Advancing was impossible, retreating wasn’t an option either.
Watching Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide was like swallowing a handful of flies, utterly disgusted, which was precisely what they felt.
The more disgusted they were, the more Wang Shouzhe felt an extreme sense of satisfaction.
Gaining reputation!
I stand on the moral high ground, using the mantle of twenty thousand citizens to suppress you. Whether they accept it or not, Wang Shouzhe’s goal was already achieved.
Having come to the Wang Family’s main residence to cause trouble today, they had to be prepared to play the role of "reputation monsters" psychologically.
From start to finish, Wang Shouzhe was using them to harvest reputation, and it was wave after wave.
Once caught, how could he easily let go? He would exhaust every method to relentlessly harvest their reputation, from the inside out.
At this moment, had it not been for the occasion, Wang Shouzhe might have wanted to pull out that little notebook system of his, to massively adjust the personal and family reputation values upward.
At least the [Town Reputation] column was about to explode, maxing out at 100 points.
Elder Bo Jun and Ancestor Zhide exchanged glances, both seeing the regret in each other’s eyes.
Had they known that the matter of land annexation would be used by the Wang Family’s Wang Shouzhe to make an issue of — and make a big issue at that, endlessly — they would surely not have taken that step.
But things have come to this, and there is no regret pill to take.
Thus, the only option was to let fists do the talking. This time, as long as the Wang Family could be thoroughly suppressed, who in Ping’an Town would dare discuss the shortcomings of the Liu and Zhao Clans?
Ancestor Bo Jun and Ancestor Zhide’s gazes gradually became sharper, one on either side surrounding Ancestor Mang. Although they did not wish to battle Ancestor Mang, since he was already blocking the path of the Liu and Zhao Clans and refused to retreat, they had no choice but to suppress him first.
"Zhao Bojun requests guidance from Ancestor Mang."
"Liu Zhide requests guidance from Ancestor Mang."
The crowd was stunned, the onlookers were also amazed. Two revered elders, shamelessly joining forces to spar against one elder in the public eye.
Indeed, a shameless person is invincible.
"Hehe~ Gongsun Mang offers his guidance." Ancestor Mang’s expression was serious, but at this time, he had no choice but to assume a battle stance.
Suddenly!
"Buzz!"
A gentle hum of a sword reverberated, as if echoing, lingering in human ears.
At the same time, a hazy light flashed swiftly from afar, slashing towards Ancestor Zhide like a wandering dragon.
Ancestor Zhide was taken aback, and hurriedly retreated, narrowly avoiding the sudden blow of the sword.
"Swish!"
The hazy sword aura flickered, a strand of white whiskers fluttering open in the wind, and then it returned, hovering like a spiritual object before Ancestor Mang.
The sword, light as smoke, emanated an ethereal beauty, both real and illusory.
"Longyan Sword!"
Ancestor Zhide and Ancestor Bo Jun both changed their expressions dramatically, filled with extreme fear. The scene from years before surged into their minds!
Simultaneously, a light, ethereal, icy female voice echoed.
"Liu Zhide, Zhao Bojun. Where do you find the courage to suppress me, Wang Longyan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 94
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 91 Powerful! Ancestor Longyan (Seeking Subscription and Monthly Tickets)
...
As the words echoed.
A graceful woman approached from afar, ascending through the air, and gently descended to the ground. Her long white hair cascaded over her shoulders, and the star-like eyes beneath her veil were as deep as ice, betraying no emotion as they swept over Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun.
She dressed in a simple, unadorned manner, yet she exuded an ethereal aura, devoid of any worldly presence.
An elegant hand reached out.
The suspended Longyan Sword emitted a light hum, "hum~~~", and moved into her palm as if it were a living being.
"Wang Longyan!"
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun’s pupils constricted, and they involuntarily stepped back, their eyes flashing with shock and fear. The terrifying memory of Wang Longyan remained fresh and vivid in their minds, even after all these years.
It was her!
With a single sword, she could overwhelm a city, enchanting like a dream, noble as a goddess descending from the nine heavens.
It was her!
In a one-against-three unfavorable situation, she boldly killed the powerful allies they relied upon.
Fifty years had passed, and aside from her hair turning white, she had hardly changed. Her gaze had become more profound, her aura more reserved, yet more enigmatic and unfathomable.
The members of the Liu and Zhao clans, along with the household generals, were all filled with nervous fear, slowly retreating. However, despite their fear, many still cast curious glances at Wang Longyan.
This name was filled with mystery in their two clans as well. Single-handedly supporting the Wang Race to this day, even the ancestors feared her greatly.
Compared to the declining morale of the Liu and Zhao clans.
The Wang Clan’s members were thrilled and excited to the extreme. Ancestor Longyan had emerged; let’s see if the Liu and Zhao clans dare to be arrogant now!
Only Wang Shouzhe remained calm and composed throughout, as if everything was already within his grasp.
But Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, who had lived for over a hundred years, quickly regained their composure from shock and fear.
Zhao Bojun took a deep breath, his eyes gradually growing solemn, "Wang Longyan, don’t you fear that forcing the use of profound energy to fight will cause your injuries to backfire and take your life?"
Indeed.
Everyone in Ping’an Town knew that Ancestor Longyan of the Wang clan had been gravely injured and never fully recovered, barely holding on. Recently, rumors spread that Ancestor Longyan’s days were numbered.
Could it be that she was merely enduring by force now?
The people of the Liu and Zhao clans could not help but breathe a sigh of relief, their fallen spirits gradually reviving, focusing their gaze on their two ancestors.
Feeling the hopeful gaze of his clansmen, Liu Zhide knew he couldn’t falter at this moment.
Immediately, he straightened his body, hands behind his back, projecting a calm and composed demeanor, "Wang Longyan, I admit you are extraordinary. But over the years, your injuries, whether or not they’ve worn you down is another matter. Just speak of the past fifty years, during which we’ve diligently cultivated day and night, our strength is no longer what it used to be..."
"Try it."
Ancestor Longyan didn’t waste words with him, swiftly moving forward as she lifted her hand, and the Longyan Sword, with a soft hum, targeted Liu Zhide.
This sword seemed ordinary, yet the moment it was unleashed, the surrounding air temperature plummeted dozens of degrees. Moisture condensed into beautifully dancing frost, rapidly gathering around the Longyan Sword, forming a frost storm of several meters in radius, enveloping Liu Zhide within.
Liu Zhide’s pupils shrank, exclaiming, "Profound Ice Sword Technique." He then retreated in a panic.
The Upper Grade Sword Technique, Profound Ice Sword Technique, was a supreme skill from the lineage of the Binglan Ascendant of the Purple Mansion Academy, requiring the cultivation method Profound Ice Technique to be employed.
It was said that when perfected, a single strike could shroud everything within a hundred meters in ice and frost, annihilating all life.
However, Liu Zhide retreated too late; the frost storm already made his entire body numb and sluggish, slowing his reactions by several beats. The deadly Longyan Sword, elusive as ever, streaked toward his chest.
Before the sword reached, the Profound Ice Sword Qi had arrived.
Liu Zhide felt a faint pain in his chest and hurriedly reversed his palm, revealing a dark golden alms bowl in his palm.
Spiritual Artifact Purple Gold Alms Bowl!
Liu Zhide held the bowl with one hand and forcefully urged his profound energy.
"Hum!~~"
The Purple Gold Alms Bowl emitted a high-frequency resonance, thick and deep like a morning bell or evening drum. It floated up, radiating a golden light, and in the blink of an eye, it formed a semi-circular shield.
The entire incident seemed complex, yet it transpired in an instant.
The Longyan Sword, engulfed in its frost storm, collided head-on with the golden light shield from the Purple Gold Alms Bowl.
"Clang!"
The fierce collision sounded, and frost flowers danced in the air. The golden light shield rippled with waves of vibrations, yet stood firm like a lone peak against the tempest.
Only Liu Zhide, connected to the Purple Gold Alms Bowl, bore a portion of the impact, his complexion paling slightly.
But at least, he survived!
"Oh, is it the Purple Gold Alms Bowl from the Prajna Temple?"
One sword had not achieved full success.
Ancestor Longyan uttered a light "hmm," slightly surprised. But she quickly dismissed the thought and coldly said, "So it’s just an imitation artifact of Spiritual Artifact level. I suppose the real Purple Gold Alms Bowl wouldn’t fall into your hands."
The spiritual artifacts in this world are diverse. Ancestor Longyan herself once had two spiritual artifacts, the Longyan Sword and the Turtle Scale Armor Shield. However, these two artifacts were original creations by an Artifact Refining Master, utilizing the properties of the materials.
Moreover, many Artifact Refining Masters in the world often imitate some famous and powerful magical treasures. Although their power and effectiveness fall far short of actual magical treasures, they are better suited for Spirit Platform Realm cultivators.
This Purple Gold Alms Bowl is evidently an imitation.
"That’s right." Liu Zhide held the Purple Gold Alms Bowl with a proud expression on his face, "This Purple Gold Alms Bowl of mine is a defensive spiritual artifact. I wonder how it compares to your Wang Longyan’s Turtle Scale Armor Shield?"
He was proud and naturally had the right to be. A spiritual artifact is easily worth tens of thousands of Qian Gold. Some Ninth-Grade Lower-Rank Noble Families simply cannot afford it. Even some stronger families, over a prolonged period, consider it good fortune to accumulate even one spiritual artifact.
Ancestor Longyan had two spiritual artifacts because the "Longyan Sword" was crafted during the Wang Family’s most prosperous period.
At the time, Ancestor Zhou Xuan was already a late-stage Spirit Platform Realm powerhouse. During his expansion efforts, he made considerable money and accumulated many precious resources. He personally returned to Longzuo County City and commissioned an Artifact Refining Master to forge two spiritual artifacts.
One "Cosmic Palace Sword" is now enshrined in the ancestral hall, the focal point of faith for the Wang Race. The "Longyan Sword" is the main battle spiritual artifact of Ancestor Longyan.
The Turtle Scale Armor Shield was bestowed by her master, Binglan Ascendant, when accepting her as a core disciple. Even the incredibly wealthy Purple Mansion Academy would not randomly bestow spiritual artifacts to disciples, highlighting how greatly Ancestor Longyan was valued by Binglan Ascendant, likely believing she had the potential to ascend to the Celestial Human Realm.
Even during the Wang Family’s prime, only two spiritual artifacts were forged. For a Ninth-Grade Race like the Liu Family, far inferior to the Wang Family of yore, saving up for a spiritual artifact was naturally no easy task.
With the appearance of the Purple Gold Alms Bowl.
Even Zhao Bojun and Ancestor Mang showed eyes filled with envy and jealousy—they did not possess spiritual artifacts.
Rumor had it that the Gongsun Family did possess a spiritual artifact, but it was considered the family’s foundational treasure, unavailable for Ancestor Mang’s casual use.
At that moment, Patriarch Liu, Liu Shengye, proudly boasted to Patriarch Zhao, Zhao Jinxian: "Brother Jinxian, who said making money is useless?"
Obviously, even if the Purple Gold Alms Bowl wasn’t solely accumulated by Liu Shengye, at least he played a significant role in it.
Even Wang Shouzhe had a newfound respect for him from afar, acknowledging Liu Shengye’s not-so-ordinary talent for amassing wealth.
"Hmph!" Zhao Jinxian snorted in discontent and envy, turning his attention to his son. Fortunately, after Ancestor Longyan appeared, that ruthless girl restrained herself a bit and no longer tormented Zhao Dingteng.
With Zhao Dingteng’s robust physique, suffering a little and enduring would pass.
While the people of the Liu Family and Liu Zhide were basking in pride.
Ancestor Longyan calmly stated, "How effective is the defense? Only a test will tell."
Immediately, she advanced again, thrusting a sword once more.
This thrust was entirely different from the first.
In the moment of action, it was like celestial thunder bursting, torrential rain raging, transforming into countless sword auras enveloping Liu Zhide, all while snow drifted in the sky.
Ancestor Longyan, too, seemed to transform into a goddess cloaked in ice and snow, her garments fluttering, surrounded by a whirlwind of frost at her sides.
Again?
The smile on Liu Zhide’s face vanished abruptly as he hurriedly brandished the "Purple Gold Alms Bowl" once more, forming a golden shield for defense.
"Clang, clang, clang..."
The sword auras, as dense as a torrent of rain, bombarded the golden shield, sending sprays of frost and a cascade of golden water droplets.
Holding the Purple Gold Alms Bowl, Liu Zhide could not withstand the relentless impacts, retreating incessantly, able only to barely defend himself, appearing disheveled and panicked, as he shouted frantically, "Brother Bo Jun, aren’t you going to lend a hand?"
He knew if Wang Longyan continued her assault, once the Purple Gold Alms Bowl’s defense was broken, what would fend off the Longyan Sword?
Zhao Bojun was equally terrified; if Wang Longyan’s injuries had truly healed, failing to suppress her now meant endless trouble later.
Just as Zhao Bojun moved, preparing to join forces.
Ancestor Mang stepped in and blocked him, laughing heartily, "Brother Bo Jun, weren’t you going to spar with me? Come, come, let us get well acquainted."
With that said.
Ancestor Mang’s aura surged powerfully, even his body growing larger. A straightforward punch launched forward, unstoppable and relentless, displaying absolute force with the momentum of tearing through everything in its path.
"Gongsun Mang, how dare you!"
Zhao Bojun bellowed in anger, forced into battle with Gongsun Mang.
Boom, boom, boom!
The Qi force exploded wildly, rocks flying everywhere.
These four ancestral-level figures split into two battlefield pairings, locked in combat. But Zhao Bojun and Ancestor Mang’s fight seemed somewhat evenly matched.
Meanwhile, between Ancestor Longyan and Liu Zhide, it was purely a one-sided domination.
When Spirit Platform Realm cultivators engage in full combat, the aftermath is vast and quite hazardous. Consequently, Wang Shouzhe urged everyone to stay far away since their battle wasn’t something the younger generations could meddle in.
The two grand battles left Wang Shouzhe’s heart quaking with emotion, his eyes filled with longing. Spirit Platform Realm cultivators were truly mighty,
and little wonder why, if a family had an ancestral figure of the Spirit Platform Realm, it could continue prosperously. Without such protection, how could one withstand the oppression of others?

chapters.title: Chapter 95
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 92: Catching a Big Fish (Request for Monthly and Recommendation Tickets)
...
Not only Wang Shouzhe.
The other young members of the family, each with sparkling eyes, were watching the battlefield with fascination.
Ancestral-level Spirit Platform Realm battles are rarely seen. Everyone could only imagine their combat abilities and destructive power.
Today is a feast that has a positive impact on the younger generation aspiring to walk the Spirit Platform path.
Just like Wang Luqiu, this girl who always boasts about walking the Emperor Road, at this moment, her pretty face is filled with shock and disbelief, seemingly a bit disheartened, which makes Wang Shouzhe feel a bit distressed.
"Girl, it’s okay." Wang Shouzhe patted her head, soothingly said, "You’re still young. As long as you want to walk the Emperor... no, the Spirit Platform road, your fourth brother will always support you, even though this road is full of hardships and challenges..."
But unexpectedly.
Wang Luqiu glanced back at Wang Shouzhe: "Old, no, Wang Shouzhe, can you not be so naive? The path of the strong is inherently without smooth roads. I’m just thinking about when I can punch and smash a mountain. Thinking about it, it might still take one to two hundred years, just feeling a bit sentimental."
Wang Shouzhe was immediately speechless, you’re still thinking about tearing spaceship yourself? He couldn’t be bothered to pay her any more attention.
Suddenly!
The battlefield changed again.
Under Ancestor Longyan’s relentless offensive, Liu Zhide’s turtle shell was finally shattered, and he was sent flying, screaming like a frightened ghost: "Lei Yangqiu, do you really want to watch me be killed with eyes wide open?"
Upon hearing this.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression immediately became serious, it has come.
When Liu Zhide finally called out that name, Wang Shouzhe had actually anticipated it, but when it truly happened, his face turned as dark as water, and some of the issues he had been contemplating surfaced.
As Liu Zhide’s plea for help rang out.
From afar, a loud shout came: "Stop!" That voice was like a thunderclap, exploding throughout the field.
At the same time.
A man wearing military officer armor slowly walked onto the square from where the crowd had parted way, looking quite dignified and stern: "Esteemed ancestors, spar as you may. But please control yourselves a bit, if lives are lost, do not blame this Garrison Commander for turning cold and ruthless."
Ping’an Town Garrison Commander - Lei Yangqiu.
Among the two Celestial Human families of Changning Guard, one is the Celestial Human Family Huangfu. The other one is the Celestial Human Family Lei.
Indeed.
Wang Shouzhe sighed slightly in his heart, but immediately accepted the fact. Because this matter had long been within his calculations.
Fifty years ago, during that great war, although there were records in the clan’s chronicles, many parts were vague. The Tier Five Ferocious Beast invasion led to a beast disaster, and Ancestor Zhou Xuan had done his best to resist.
Changning Guard was supposed to respond quickly, but unfortunately, they were late.
And the ancestors of the Liu Zhao clans feigned death to escape, releasing two paths of beasts, leading directly to the collapse of Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s lines of defense. Was it really just their desire to rebel?
Such fringe vassal clans, not even considered Ninth-Grade Races, daring to handle it this way, if they didn’t have someone supporting them from behind, they probably wouldn’t have the guts.
Throughout the Changning Guard Region, who has the capability to support them? The families with the ability to manipulate the clouds and rain can be counted on one’s fingers.
Judging by the theory of who benefits is who is behind the scenes, Wang Shouzhe deduced in secret that the greatest possibility could indeed be the Changning Lei Family.
There are two reasons, one is that Changning Lei Family entirely has the capability, two is that afterward, the Garrison Commander of Ping’an Town had always been assumed by the Lei Family or families close to them.
However, their ultimate motive was something Wang Shouzhe couldn’t fully determine. There was also another doubt, if the Lei Family was truly the mastermind then why didn’t they take action themselves? Or eliminate them entirely?
Instead, they allowed the Wang Race to survive, albeit barely, until today?
Many doubts can’t be resolved, but today, Wang Shouzhe took advantage of an opportunity he had designed, firstly to adamantly damage the reputation of the Liu and Zhao Clans, laying the groundwork for the next step of the plan. Secondly, to probe into the bottom line of the Garrison Commander, as intended.
The Garrison Commander stands as the extension and coverage representative of the Daqian Kingdom’s forces. If he steps in to stop the battle and anyone continues fighting to the death, they will surely bear the consequences of a great responsibility pinned on them.
All four Ancestral-level figures ceased their attacks on the spot but still confronted each other.
At this critical moment, Wang Shouzhe quickly rushed forward to hold onto Wang Longyan’s arm, filled with anxiety and concern: "Ancestor, are you okay? Did your injuries backfire on you?"
Meanwhile, he lightly pinched Ancestor Longyan’s arm, as a reminder not to forget about his prior instructions.
Why are you just standing there doing nothing?
Ancestor Longyan is generally excellent, just too straightforward.
Ancestor Longyan was momentarily stunned, only then recalling Shouzhe’s prior instructions. Immediately, her delicate body swayed, her graceful jade-like hands touched her forehead, and she was unable to control the backlash of the "Yin Sha Evil Qi" within her.
"Poof!"
A mouthful of fresh blood sprayed onto her veil, dyeing it blood red, looking so tragically miserable.
As for this act, Wang Shouzhe could only give her seven points, as the spitting of blood was too abrupt, without any warning. Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe was well-prepared and immediately cried out in a heartbroken tone, "Ancestor, I’ve repeatedly reminded you, why don’t you listen? If it continues like this, what would happen?"
"Ancestor, are you alright?" "Ancestor!"
The members of the Wang Family also rushed over, each one filled with anxiety. Ancestor Longyan was the family’s stabilizing force; if something really happened to her, how would they manage?
"Luojing, Luqiu, quickly help the ancestor back to rest; I’ll handle things here." Wang Shouzhe played the role of clan leader, swiftly arranging all matters.
During this time, Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide were also utterly shocked. Wang Longyan was just vibrant and ferocious in battle; how did she lose control of her injuries in the blink of an eye?
Even the Garrison Commander, who had just come out to stop the fight, fearing Liu Zhide would be killed by Wang Longyan on the spot, was somewhat bewildered at how things had turned so dramatically upon his appearance.
"Wang Shouzhe greets the Garrison Commander." Wang Shouzhe, with a face full of gratitude, saluted Thunder Guardian Envoy Lei Yangqiu, saying, "Shouzhe, on behalf of the Wang Family, thanks Lei Guardian for upholding justice and preventing our Wang Family’s annihilation."
Lei Yangqiu’s lips twitched at this statement, almost unable to reply. He coughed twice sternly, "Clan Leader Wang, how is the injury of your family’s Ancestor Longyan?"
"Alas, to report to Thunder Guardian," Wang Shouzhe deeply sighed, looking mournful and filled with indignation, "The Ancestor’s injuries showed signs of recovery, but unexpectedly, the Liu and Zhao Clans, upon hearing about it, seized the opportunity to create trouble, wanting to suppress our Wang Family. The Ancestor was forced to use her sect’s secret technique to temporarily suppress the injuries to withstand the formidable enemies. If it hadn’t been for Thunder Guardian’s timely arrival to stop the Liu and Zhao Clans’ violence, who knows what would have happened to the Ancestor today..."
Speaking of this, Wang Shouzhe shivered all over, seemingly fearful in retrospect. He immediately saluted Lei Yangqiu again, sincerely saying, "Thunder Guardian’s great kindness to our Wang Family, Shouzhe will remember it in his heart and will surely repay it in the future."
With these words, Liu Zhide felt incredibly wronged; this young man truly knew how to distort the facts. Clearly, it was Wang Longyan who was vibrant and smashed his Purple Gold Alms Bowl, so how did it turn into Liu Zhide committing violence?
No, from his understanding of Wang Longyan’s injuries, healing them was as hard as ascending to heaven. Even selling the entire Wang Family wouldn’t be enough to cure them.
Could it be!?
Liu Zhide trembled all over; Wang Longyan really used some secret technique from the Purple Mansion Academy, merely temporarily suppressing her injuries? An extremely frustrated feeling surged straight to Liu Zhide’s brain.
If this were true, all he had to do was persist a little longer, and Wang Longyan would’ve collapsed on her own? No wonder she was going all out from the beginning. She feared there wasn’t enough time.
Regret!
Why didn’t he persist a little longer? In the end, bringing Lei Yangqiu out only helped save Wang Longyan.
At the same time.
Zhao Bojun and Lei Yangqiu also realized this point, then they both stared fiercely at Liu Zhide; the excellent opportunity to let Wang Longyan collapse from her injuries by the guise of sparring was just missed.
Nevertheless, Lei Yangqiu, as the Garrison Commander, still wore a solemn expression, "Clan Leaders and Ancestor, according to Daqian Law, private fights between the noble families are strictly prohibited. With that strength, why not go to the Outer Domain and kill some fierce beasts, contributing to the Human Race. Disperse!"
He decisively settled today’s matters with a single statement.
Before leaving, he looked at Liu Zhide with slight dissatisfaction; causing such commotion not only disgraced the two clans but eventually let Wang Longyan manage to escape.
Today, it was an utter defeat.
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, filled with regret, also felt somewhat ashamed. This place could no longer be stayed in; it was better to leave soon.
Just as they were preparing to leave shamefacedly.
Wang Shouzhe suddenly called out, "Hold on! Today’s matter is not over yet."
All eyes gathered on him.
Lei Yangqiu frowned slightly, dissatisfied, "Clan Leader Wang, is there anything else? I, as the Garrison Commander, have said, disperse and end it here."
"To report to the Garrison Commander," Wang Shouzhe saluted calmly, "The junior has a few heinous clan extermination murder cases to report, so it’s better to resolve them in one go while everyone is here."
Clan extermination murder cases?
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun felt a sudden thud in their hearts. Something was wrong today; it felt like they’d fallen into one trap after another.
Before everyone could react, Wang Shouzhe waved his hand and shouted loudly, "Third Uncle, present the evidence."
Wang Shouzhe’s third uncle, Wang Ding Race, the Deputy Garrison Commander of Ping’an Town, then led a group of officers and soldiers to walk over slowly from afar. He solemnly saluted, "To report to the Garrison Commander, this subordinate has cracked several heinous clan extermination cases. Now, with both witness and material evidence complete, I request the Garrison Commander’s approval for this subordinate to execute the criminals."
Looking at Lei Yangqiu, Liu Zhide, Zhao Bojun and others’ faces.
Wang Shouzhe sneered continuously, daring to cause trouble at my Wang Family, do you think you can come and go as you please? This was a well-planned scheme; how could he not let Liu and Zhao Clans shed some skin?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 96
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 93: Can’t even be a bad person well, what’s the use of keeping them?
...
After Wang Ding Race finished speaking.
He presented all the evidence to Thunder Guardian Envoy Lei Yangqiu and said, "All those witnesses have been fully controlled by my subordinates. If you have any doubts, you may summon them for further questioning." Then he respectfully stood aside.
Thunder Guardian Envoy Lei Yangqiu, born from the direct lineage of the Celestial Human Lei Family. He has always shown outstanding talent and was groomed as an elite.
Since his promotion to the Spirit Ascension Platform, he was assigned by the family to guard Ping’an Town, and it’s been more than ten years now. Naturally, he is well-informed and experienced.
At this point, he couldn’t be more aware that he had fallen into a trap.
However, as Thunder Guardian Envoy, Lei Yangqiu had a duty to perform. He reviewed the evidence and Wang Ding Race’s closing statement. The chain of evidence was complete, and the statement was clear and thorough, with no loopholes, revealing the "painstaking effort" of Deputy Garrison Commander Wang Ding Race in handling the case.
Lei Yangqiu put away the evidence and statements, with a hint of "kindness" in his gaze: "Brother Ding Race, you are a talent, not inferior in talent and skill to this Guardian Envoy."
Wang Ding Race cupped his hands in salute: "Sir, your praise is overwhelming, Ding Race dares not accept it."
"It’s just a pity that you come from a declining minor family, and the support you can receive is truly limited." Lei Yangqiu said with his hands behind his back, "Forty-five years old, eighth level in the Qi Refining Realm, truly a shame. If you were born in my Lei Family, you would have been given focused nurturing, and the path to the Spirit Platform would have been possible."
Wang Ding Race was silent, expressionless, and did not reply.
"Brother Ding Race, do you really want to oppose me for such a family?" Lei Yangqiu’s gaze became stern as he scrutinized Wang Ding Race, "Do you know the consequences?"
Even under such pressure, Wang Ding Race remained as steady as a mountain and solemnly said with cupped hands, "Thunder Guardian Envoy Sir, I am the Deputy Garrison Commander of Ping’an Town, having received the immense favor of Emperor Changlong of the Daqian Kingdom. Naturally, I must devote myself to my duty, guarding and pacifying the region. The evidence in this case is conclusive. I request the sir to order the interrogation of the suspects, to administer the national law on the spot, and to serve as a warning to others."
"Good, good, good! Brother Ding Race is truly devoted to the nation, a model for us officials and warriors." Lei Yangqiu laughed in anger, "I will take this dossier, and after returning to the Guardian’s Mansion, I will soon summon the suspects for interrogation."
After speaking, he prepared to leave with a wave of his sleeve.
"Sir, please wait." Wang Shouzhe called out.
Lei Yangqiu stopped, glaring unkindly at Wang Shouzhe: "Clan Leader Wang, what advice do you have?"
"I dare not presume to advise." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands in salute, "Although the Ping’an Wang Family is a minor clan, it is also an officially recorded Black Tortoise Noble Family of the Daqian Kingdom."
"According to the Daqian Law, our Black Tortoise Noble Family has the responsibility to protect and assist the local government and supervise it. Especially since this case involves the bloodline members of the Liu and Zhao Clans. Therefore, it’s more prudent for you, sir, to interrogate and make a decision in public to prevent the spreading of rumors among the thousands of people in Ping’an Town and to protect your reputation as an official."
"Public interrogation, public interrogation."
Among the onlookers, some began to stir up sentiments, "These cases of family extermination involve the exalted Black Tortoise Families. Who can guarantee that the Guardian Envoy won’t abuse power for favoritism?"
"Yes, yes, the Liu and Zhao Clans have far-reaching influence. As long as they’re given time, they will surely eliminate evidence and reverse the situation."
"If that’s true, won’t those who died unjustly never have their day of vindication?"
"Alas, young man, you’re still too young. You don’t understand the dangers of the world, the treachery of people’s hearts. Hasn’t this kind of thing happened less often before? Who’s seen the Liu or Zhao Clans lose a single strand of hair?"
A wave of momentum was stirred up, with some among them naturally being those Wang Shouzhe had already arranged to be there.
The Zhao and Liu Clans had also placed some people among the masses previously, but when it came to manipulating public opinion to fan the flames, who could match Wang Shouzhe’s "well-rounded experience"?
In a past life online, he had seen countless similar tactics and techniques. The methods of the Liu and Zhao Clans to incite and stir were mere child’s play.
"Everyone rest assured, Thunder Guardian Envoy will definitely give us an explanation."
"Everyone should trust the Guardian Envoy sir. After all, he is a noble from the Celestial Human Family."
Public opinion was boiling!
Lei Yangqiu was already being driven forward. He glowered at Wang Shouzhe with eyes like sinking water, and murmured, "Clan Leader Wang, though you’re young, you’re indeed skilled. Is it really appropriate to be so confrontational?"
"What is the sir saying?" Wang Shouzhe glanced at the Liu and Zhao Clans, then solemnly said, "As the Clan Leader of a Noble Family, and with Ping’an being the place protected by my family’s ancestor’s life, the oversight of this case is both my duty and my responsibility. Of course, Ping’an Town ultimately looks to you, sir, as the leader. If you truly have any scruples, you can choose to handle it back at the mansion."
Scruples? Handle it back at the mansion?
Lei Yangqiu wanted to murder someone at this moment. The situation had been pushed to this extent by Wang Shouzhe, and if he insisted on going back to the mansion to deal with it, based on the skills Wang Shouzhe had displayed so far, it was likely that the matter would be made a big fuss over.
If things escalated, he, Lei Yangqiu, would likely lose his position as Guardian Envoy. The family would blame and even shelve him. If he couldn’t manage such a small place, how could he be entrusted with greater responsibilities?
Being born into a Celestial Human Family had its advantages and its disadvantages. The disadvantage was the many competitors. Such a vast Celestial Human Family lacked neither resources to nurture someone to the Spirit Ascension Platform nor talents on the path to the Spirit Platform.
With this thought, Lei Yangqiu’s face immediately turned solemn, and in a righteous and stern manner, he criticized Wang Shouzhe, "Clan Leader Wang, what are you saying? As this Guardian Envoy has received the favor of the King to guard this corner, my clothing and salary come from the support of countless people, and I should naturally seek justice for the people."
Whether it is the Daqian Kingdom or the Black Tortoise Clan, although both are lofty, they ultimately place great importance on the local order and stability. To them, commoner tenant farmers, though of low status, even ant-like, are recognized as the fundamental basis of the Black Tortoise Clan and the state’s establishment.
Without millions of people, where would the Black Tortoise Clan’s abundant resources come from?
If there was real public outrage, and it could not be suppressed, neither the Black Tortoise Clan nor the local Garrison Commander would benefit.
"Ding Race."
Lei Yangqiu was also a decisive individual and immediately got into action.
"Subordinate at your command." Wang Ding Race solemnly cupped his hands.
"Since this case involves Liu Family member Liu Shengze and Zhao Family member Zhao Jinda, according to the law, you originally have no authority to arrest and interrogate Shi Clan Members of the direct vein." Lei Yangqiu said sternly, "I now authorize you, given the substantial evidence, to immediately arrest these two and bring them to justice."
Many Deputy Garrison Commanders are often from local noble families.
The Daqian Kingdom, to prevent noble families from using public power to meddle in internal disputes among noble families, requires that in cases involving Shi Clan Members, only with a complete chain of evidence and a direct order from the Garrison Commander can arrests be made.
"Subordinate respectfully follows the command of the lord." Wang Ding Race respectfully accepted the order and immediately led a group of fierce soldiers into the ranks of the Liu and Zhao Clans, capturing Liu Shengze and Zhao Jinda.
"Father." "Father!"
The young elites Liu Yongzhou and Zhao Dingtian rushed forward anxiously.
"How bold!" Wang Ding Race’s expression turned cold, and with a "clang," he drew his sword. "You dare to obstruct the Guardian’s Mansion from executing Daqian Law? If you don’t retreat immediately, I, as the Deputy Garrison Commander, will not spare you."
Clan Leaders Liu Shengye and Zhao Jinxian hurried out to stop them, "Yongzhou, Dingtian, quickly step back."
Their faces were also dark as water, begrudging Wang Shouzhe deeply.
But now that Wang Ding Race held the "Imperial Sword," who dared to interfere? Who could bear the consequences of such serious accusations?
Thus, the two clan leaders could only turn their gaze to their ancestors. At this moment, only the ancestors could speak on behalf of the family.
The ancestors of the Liu and Zhao Clans, Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, glanced at each other, each feeling the difficulty of today’s situation.
Moreover, at this moment, they realized that from beginning to end, it seemed as if the Wang Family had been leading them by the nose, every step falling into the other’s calculations.
But if they didn’t save important clan members, wouldn’t the family morale collapse?
Immediately, Liu Zhide, with no other options, stepped forth and cupped his hands to Lei Yangqiu, saying, "Yangqiu, my younger brother, as everyone knows, the Wang Family has longstanding grievances with our Liu and Zhao Clans. The Wang Family bringing up this case now is likely targeted. How about..."
"The evidence in this case is conclusive, there’s no need for a retrial." Lei Yangqiu interrupted directly, "Ancestor Zhide, Ancestor Bojun. Although I’ve been associated with you two for many years, I cannot condone this for personal favor. Let me remind you, as members of the Black Tortoise Clan, while it is inevitable to have a few unworthy descendants, it is still due to your lack of discipline."
While saying so outwardly, Lei Yangqiu cursed inwardly, you two old relics still dare to ask him to condone favoritism now? The Wang Family had calculated every step completely, leaving no loopholes in the evidence. These people were already nailed down.
Moreover, Lei Yangqiu was well aware that these things were indeed done by them, with no injustice involved.
He, Lei Yangqiu, was put on the spot today, not because Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun were too incompetent?
They couldn’t even manage a disturbance properly, instead being led by the nose back and forth, having their face slapped repeatedly, losing all prestige and dignity.
Ultimately, they even dragged him, Lei Yangqiu, into this, being caught red-handed by Wang Shouzhe, who wouldn’t let go. Where could he voice the grievances of his heart?
Even with the pleas of the two ancestors being ineffective, the members of the Liu and Zhao Clans were immediately filled with rage and lamentation.
The two clan leaders exchanged glances, signaling the household generals to temporarily control Zhao Dingtian and Liu Yongzhou, preventing them from acting impulsively. Otherwise, giving Wang Family more leverage would cause even bigger troubles.
Seeing the other side self-restrict, Wang Ding Race naturally had no excuse to exploit the situation and, adhering to impartial law enforcement, brought the two key clan members before Lei Yangqiu.
"Zhao Jinda, Liu Shengze, with such conclusive evidence, if you don’t have the ability to overturn it, this Garrison Commander suggests that you at least preserve a bit of dignity for your family."
Lei Yangqiu glanced at them coldly, having judged them with death in his heart.
Meanwhile, he was somewhat annoyed. Truly useless people, can’t even do a bad deed well, what use are they?
The Wang Family, however... that seemingly gentle young man... for a moment, Lei Yangqiu grew deeply apprehensive of Wang Shouzhe.
This youngster is terrifying!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 97
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 94: Wang Shouzhe Who Discards the Donkey After Using It (4,000-word Chapter)
...
Liu Shengze, Zhao Jinda.
They were all elite members of the family, their power was around the fifth and sixth layers of the Qi Refining Realm, though they were each in charge of a business enterprise, running it quite successfully.
They belonged to the type of people who could be considered important figures wherever they went.
On this visit to the Wang Family to stir up trouble and suppress Wang Longyan, they came with high spirits, imagining the benefits they would gain if they subdued the Wang Family once again.
Yet they did not expect, upon arriving at the Wang Family’s entrance, to be met with blow after painful blow, until even their ancestor was nearly killed, barely surviving by seeking help in a sorry state.
Such a great humiliation was not even the end...
At this moment, Liu Shengze and Zhao Jinda were bound up like prisoners, in a wretched state, with no trace of nobility, their eyes filled only with intense fear and despair.
They wanted to argue in their defense but had no way to start, simply because the crimes listed against them were genuine and undeniable.
Perhaps the only direction they could take in their defense was that all these actions were done for the family’s sake, not out of personal desire. However, to do so would undoubtedly drag the family down with them, involving their descendants as well.
They understood all too well the Garrison Commander’s suggestion to save some face for the family. They knew to some extent about the family’s relationship with Lei Yangqiu. Once they completely offended Lei Yangqiu, the family would have a hard time surviving.
After a fierce internal struggle, they finally made up their minds.
"Patriarch!" Liu Shengze cried miserably, "Take care of Yongzhou. Wang Shouzhe, Wang Ding Race, you will die a terrible death."
With that, he roused his Profound Qi and shattered his heart, the intense spasm of the heart before death causing a spurt of blood, dying on the spot.
And Zhao Jinda also let out a miserable laugh: "Wang Family, you will not be arrogant forever. My son, take care of your mother, your brothers, and your sisters."
Saying this, he imitated Liu Shengze and committed suicide, leaving some face for the family.
Such "tragic sacrifices" caused profound grief among the Liu and Zhao clans’ members, with many bursting into tears. Their hatred for Wang Shouzhe, Wang Ding Race, and even the entire Wang Family grew intense. Wang Shouzhe, today’s events won’t end with you.
Especially the two sons, Liu Yongzhou and Zhao Dingtian, who howled and cried on the spot, the family generals and clansmen had to forcefully take them away.
Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide, the two ancestors, stared like eagles at Wang Shouzhe. Their dignity was completely lost, with their descendants dying like that, how could they be reconciled?
Even some women in the Wang Family couldn’t bear to watch, covering their children’s eyes. Yet the Wang Family members would never truly sympathize with their enemies, given the irreconcilable enmity between the Liu Zhao clans and the Wang Family due to their past doings.
"They can also be considered as two men." Lei Yangqiu said with slight emotion, turning to Wang Shouzhe with a sarcastic tone, "Clan Leader Wang, are you satisfied with such an outcome?"
Of course, he was not happy. All of this was just Wang Shouzhe’s coercion, forcing him to act against the Liu Zhao clans.
In doing so, the previously obedient Liu Zhao clans and his Lei Family were likely to develop irreparable rifts.
Meanwhile,
The onlookers seemed to let out a sigh of relief, applauding Lei Yangqiu.
They commented how the Thunder Guardian Envoy was still enforcing the law impartially, that they never expected the Thunder Guardian Envoy to arrest the Liu Zhao nobles for the death of some common folk. Such remarks were about the Celestial Human Families.
Those comments reaching the Spirit Platform Realm Lei Yangqiu’s ears somewhat restored his dignity. Although this matter was indeed vexing, at least he gained some reputation from it.
"Not satisfied." Wang Shouzhe replied loudly with a serious face.
This answer directly caught everyone off guard. Even Ancestor Mang nearby and the Liua Brothers and Sisters watching felt their hearts skip a beat, thinking it was bad, fearing it might completely provoke Lei Yangqiu.
The onlookers’ discussion also came to an abrupt stop, their faces filled with bewilderment, thinking the Thunder Guardian Envoy seemed to have done a good job. So why was Clan Leader Wang still not satisfied?
Some members of the Liu Zhao clans couldn’t help but feel secretly delighted, Wang Shouzhe, oh Wang Shouzhe, you are courting death. You are handing the opportunity for a counterattack to the aggrieved Thunder Guardian Envoy on a silver platter.
"What?" The hint of pride in Lei Yangqiu’s heart suddenly froze, and his anger surged uncontrollably, laughing angrily, "Alright, alright, alright, please Clan Leader Wang point it out, I will ensure you are satisfied today."
Originally he had planned, after this affair, to find a way to properly deal with Wang Shouzhe, then find an excuse to have the Wang Family cause some trouble afterwards. In any case, today’s incident where Wang Shouzhe toyed with him in the palm of his hand had to be paid back tenfold, hundredfold.
Unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe directly handed him the leverage. If he didn’t clarify things, Lei Yangqiu could trouble him on the spot.
"First, the Garrison Commander addressed them as two men, with a hint of respect in his words." Wang Shouzhe said in a deep voice, "Although there was no trial, the charges show that these two are the masterminds behind numerous massacres, with blood on their hands and monstrous crimes. The Commander unexpectedly expressed respect and admiration for such brutal beasts, which clearly shows an inherent approval of their actions. This leads me to vaguely worry, whether a person with such views and virtue is fitting to govern Ping’an Town."

chapters.title: Chapter 98
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 94: Wang Shouzhe the Grindstone-Killer (4000-large Chapter)_2
"You..." Lei Yangqiu’s face changed dramatically, and a surge of anger erupted in his chest, "Wang Shouzhe, how dare you make false accusations."
"Accusations indeed, but whether they’re false or not remains to be discerned," Wang Shouzhe said calmly. "The second point is not dissatisfaction but my deep questioning of your morality and professionalism as a Garrison Commander. You know, as a Noble Family, we have the right to oversee the conduct and laws governing you, the Garrison Commander."
"As a Garrison Commander, you should abide by the laws of the Daqian Kingdom and handle cases impartially. Just look at what you have done?"
"You... where have I not handled matters impartially?" Lei Yangqiu was furious, but there was a vague sense of unease in his heart.
Wang Shouzhe, full of righteous indignation, said aloud, "The laws of the Daqian Kingdom have their procedures for handling cases. First, you used coercive means to directly suppress the self-defense of two unjudged suspects."
"Secondly, without any questioning, without hearing them recount whether their offenses corresponded with the investigation, and without interrogating whether they had accomplices or instigators behind the scenes, or whether there were other hidden aspects to the case, or even whether there were unsolved old cases, you decided in one word, pronouncing them to be unforgivable criminals. I would like to see how your case report is written. Such professionalism in governing is something I, Wang, cannot agree with."
"Thirdly, rushing to a verdict without interrogation is procedurally inappropriate. I had not thought that you would imply and subtly threaten the suspects not yet convicted to commit suicide. There are only two explanations: first, you fear that during interrogation, more accomplices might be implicated; or second, you’re impatient with this matter and just want to wrap it up hastily. Whichever it is, I feel greatly afraid."
"Today, you hastily dealt with the bloodline members of the Liu and Zhao Clans. Tomorrow, you could just as arbitrarily convict the members of our Wang Family. I am truly terrified."
"You..." Lei Yangqiu’s face turned red, and he staggered back a few steps under Wang Shouzhe’s words, eyes wide in anger, "Wang Shouzhe, how dare you make such slanderous accusations!"
A massive aura of pressure enveloped Wang Shouzhe.
"Such authority you wield, my Lord," Wang Shouzhe faced the pressure fearlessly. Most of the Spirit Platform Realm’s pressure is psychological intimidation over those lower in the hierarchy. With some Divine Thought Power imbued in it, Wang Shouzhe, at the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, was yet unaffected.
Ancestor Mang saw Lei Yangqiu using Spirit Platform Realm pressure and initially intended to shield Wang Shouzhe, but he saw that Wang was undisturbed by it and could only admire him in amazement, growing even more respectful of this great-grandson.
One had to admit, what this great-grandson said had a lot of sense. Lei Yangqiu’s conduct clearly did not meet the Daqian Kingdom’s demands for a Garrison Commander.
He vaguely felt that with his great-grandson’s methods, Lei Yangqiu might face some bad luck. His great-grandson was not one for idle words.
Ancestor Mang even felt a bit of sympathy for Lei Yangqiu. This fellow, an upright cultivator of the Spirit Platform Realm, was first forced by Shouzhe to act against the Liu and Zhao Clans, using him as a tool to kill.
Then, once used, Shouzhe promptly discarded him like dirty tissue after going to the bathroom, treating him with disdain.
Ancestor Mang was not alone in feeling this way.
The Wang Clan members and the Liua Brothers and Sisters all felt that Wang Shouzhe’s words made sense — Lei Yangqiu was either incapable of serving as a Garrison Commander or was deeply colluding with the Liu and Zhao Clans.
Either way, his tenure as Garrison Commander of Ping’an Town was a disaster.
For the thousands of spectators, at first, they thought Thunder Guardian was handling things impartially and was a good Garrison Commander. But after listening to the Clan Leader Wang’s analysis, they broke out in cold sweat, filled with dread.
Yes, is such a Garrison Commander, disregarding state laws, functioning on whims, and carelessly deciding cases really fit for the role? Today, he can arbitrarily deal with the Liu and Zhao Clans, tomorrow he can do the same to the Wang Family, the day after, nothing stops him from turning his blades to the local commoners.
A Garrison Commander should keep a locality calm and peaceful.
Now everyone was afraid — who wouldn’t be scared of a Garrison Commander without regard to law?
With malicious individuals steering public opinion, the discussions among the commoners became increasingly louder and more fervent, all feeling that Thunder Guardian had serious problems.
The sounds of discussion reached Lei Yangqiu’s ears, sinking his heart bit by bit as public sentiment boiled over.
Even the Liu and Zhao Clans’ members, including Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, two old ancestors, sneered at his predicament, with an attitude relishing in his misfortune rather than sympathetic.
Lei Yangqiu, oh Lei Yangqiu, did you ever imagine this scene as you were dealing with us earlier?
Seeing that the time was ripe, Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands, sneeringly said, "I’ve felt the might of Thunder Guardian’s authority. But this Changning Guard isn’t something your Celestial Human Lei Family can dominate alone."
"As for this matter, I will record the entirety clearly, make several copies, and send one to the Lord of the City Chief’s Mansion, one to the Purple Mansion Academy, and one to the Longzuo County Prince’s Mansion. Right or wrong, let the authorities judge. I refuse to believe there’s nowhere in the Daqian Kingdom’s great authority to plead for the people’s sake. If not, I’ll go to the Capital City."
"Well said, Brother Shouzhe. I also think Lord Thunder Guardian is not fit to occupy this seat," Liua Ruolei excitedly stepped forward, "I’ll entrust the Purple Mansion Academy letter to Ancestor Xuanfu for delivery to the Academy."
"Thank you, Sister Ruolei, for speaking out righteously," Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands in gratitude, "But our Wang Family also has some connections with the Academy to handle this."
"Could it be... Bing?" Liua Ruolei said with surprise and joy, "Has her honorable self forgiven Ancestral Grandmother?"
"Cannot say, cannot say," Wang Shouzhe teased, half revealing half concealing about the Binglan Ascendant, but dared not lie outright. If news reached Binglan Ascendant’s ears, it would be extremely troublesome.
Better to leave some room for everyone to imagine for themselves.
Sure enough, Liua Ruolei smiled and said, "Since Brother Shouzhe already has plans, I won’t interfere. With her there, the Academy will surely respond."
Lei Yangqiu was truly stunned, suddenly felt a chill in his heart.
With Wang Shouzhe’s piece of speech, there was no one left to side with him. If news reached the City Chief’s higher authorities and they sent an Inspector down to take a quick look, no one would speak well of him.
Moreover, some of Wang Shouzhe’s words were not without foundation; how could he withstand an investigation?
As Wang Shouzhe said, this Changning Guard was not something solely dominated by the Lei Family. Putting him in this position already took considerable effort from the family. If it reached the family, he would be the first to bear the consequences.
Wang Shouzhe’s ability to turn clouds and cover rain with just a flip was terrifying!
Immediately, he hastily retracted his aura, putting on a friendly face, and saluted to Wang Shouzhe, "Junior Brother Wang, could you spare me a moment?"
Wang Shouzhe returned the courtesy and politely refused, "Lord Garrison Commander, you jest. There are no ties between us, if there’s something to say, please speak it directly."
Lei Yangqiu was furious inside, but today the leverage was firmly held, and his future depended entirely on Wang Shouzhe’s disposition.
He couldn’t care less about face now, he cupped his hands with a foolish smile and said, "Clan Leader Wang, what do you think would be the right course for me to take? Rest assured, I can swear I won’t make things difficult for your Wang Family in the future."
"Lord Garrison Commander, my Wang Family stands upright with no law-breaking deeds, no need for you to swear," Wang Shouzhe respectfully responded, "At this point, I can only offer you one piece of advice."
"What?" Lei Yangqiu felt a chill run down his spine.
"I suggest you leave some face for your family," Wang Shouzhe said, then turned and left with a flick of his sleeve.
What?
Wasn’t this what he said to Liu Shengze and Zhao Jinda just now?
"Wang Shouzhe, you..." Lei Yangqiu’s heart was overcome with anger, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 99
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 95: Lei Yangqiu Completely Suppressed (Seeking Votes)
...
A dignified Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator was actually so angered that he spat blood.
Though not unheard of, it was still extremely rare.
Lei Yangqiu stared intently at Wang Shouzhe’s retreating figure, wanting to lose his temper but too afraid to do so. It was just because that brat had a firm grip on his Achilles’ heel.
Forget it, forget it, I’ll just endure Wang Shouzhe for now.
He was extremely angry, but had no way to vent it on the Wang Family, so he could only glare fiercely at the Liu and Zhao Clans.
The Liu and Zhao Clans similarly had strong objections to Lei Yangqiu, after all, two of their clan members had essentially died because of him. More importantly, in order to save himself, Lei Yangqiu had driven their clan members to death.
Yet in the end, he was slapped in the face to this degree and even had to shamelessly beg the Wang Family.
The scene was utterly silent.
The Wang Family members all looked at Wang Shouzhe with complex expressions. None of them could have predicted that today’s series of events would develop to such an extent.
Among Liu, Zhao, and Lei Yangqiu, the Garrison Commander of the Celestial Human Family, who was easy to provoke? Yet they were all suppressed one by one by Wang Shouzhe’s moves.
Even Ancestor Mang decided he couldn’t underestimate Wang Shouzhe anymore, and couldn’t help but ask, "Shouzhe, how do we handle things from here on out?"
As soon as he spoke, Liu, Zhao, and Lei Yangqiu all turned their eyes to Wang Shouzhe, wondering what other tricks he might have up his sleeve.
These successive pitfalls had already broken people’s legs from jumping.
"How to handle it?" Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Naturally, each return to their own homes, unless Ancestor Mang plans to keep them for dinner?" In a good mood, he made a joke.
Actually, if it were up to Wang Shouzhe’s disposition, he would have loved nothing more than to utterly deal with the Liu and Zhao Clans and Lei Yangqiu.
But, in truth, such a thing was absolutely impossible.
Ancestor Mang was indeed formidable in combat, but he’s ultimately not the real ancestor of the Wang Family. That he could support the Wang Family to such a degree, Wang Shouzhe was already immensely grateful. To make him risk his life alongside them, he couldn’t bring himself to ask that.
Moreover, Daqian after all has its Daqian Law.
Wang Shouzhe’s head wasn’t thick enough to blatantly defy Daqian Law without consequence. Private matters are private, while public matters remain public.
Today’s ability to suppress Lei Yangqiu was just Wang Shouzhe borrowing the power of Daqian Law.
The clan members and Household Generals of the Liu and Zhao Clans, upon hearing this, inexplicably breathed a sigh of relief. Retreat then, although they’ve lost some troops and faces, ultimately they still get to go home, right?
But before they could turn to leave.
Wang Shouzhe frowned and called out, "Wait."
The people of the Liu and Zhao Clans shuddered uncontrollably, wondering if another disaster was about to befall them. Every time Wang Shouzhe said wait, or hold on, it was never good news.
"First, although Zhao Jinda and Liu Shengze are dead, compensation for the survivors cannot be avoided." Wang Shouzhe said with a serious face.
Lei Yangqiu’s eyes immediately brightened, feeling he had a chance to perform, and stepped forward, saying, "Clan Leader Wang’s words are quite reasonable, this matter shall be overseen by me, the Garrison Commander, with total compensation set at five hundred, no, one thousand Qian Gold."
Lei Yangqiu was under immense pressure; given his current situation, if Wang Shouzhe was truly determined to deal with him, he might not die, but he’d be skinned alive, and his family wouldn’t easily let him go.
Maybe later, the Lei Race would retaliate against Wang Shouzhe in a punitive manner, but by then, it would no longer be Lei Yangqiu’s concern, as he would already be finished.
Upon hearing the compensation was a thousand Qian Gold, the clan leaders of the Liu and Zhao Clans turned black-faced, as that would mean their respective clans worked for nothing for a year. But they never bothered to think, just how many households have they obliterated?
Wang Shouzhe was indifferent to this and continued, "The Liu and Zhao Clans’ previous troublemaking damaged many bluestone slabs on our square..."
"Clan Leader Wang’s words are equally reasonable." Lei Yangqiu continued flattering, "I see at least several hundred bluestone slabs broken, and calculating at five hundred slabs, each slab valued at one Qian Gold, that totals five hundred Qian Gold. This debt, I will be responsible for collecting, pay up now, now."
Five hundred Qian Gold!
The Liu and Zhao Clans were about to go crazy. If Lei Yangqiu wanted to curry favor with the Wang family to secure his position as Garrison Commander, did he have to cut into them so deep? A Qian Gold per bluestone slab, why not just rob instead?
Even Wang Shouzhe felt that Lei Yangqiu’s extortion was somewhat excessive.
"What kind of looks are those?" Lei Yangqiu said with a serious face, "These bluestone slabs were left by the Wang Family Ancestor Zhouxuan over a hundred years ago. They are historical artifacts that witnessed Ping’an Town’s transition from the Wilderness to its present prosperity. Such historically significant items, a Qian Gold per bluestone slab is already cheap for them."
"Uh..."
Wang Shouzhe was stunned by his rhetoric. This huge square must have at least hundreds of thousands of bluestone slabs, right? At a Qian Gold per piece, this Bluestone Square would be the Wang Family’s most profound ancestral asset.
Well, for the sake of money, Wang Shouzhe decided to let Lei Yangqiu slide for now.
After all, watching him gradually break down with the Liu and Zhao Clans is quite an interesting sight. As for the follow-up, let’s see how he performs by then.
Even though Lei Yangqiu had become shameless, he remained the Garrison Commander of Ping’an Town. Under his "coercion," the Zhao and Liu Clans had no choice but to gather five hundred Qian Gold to compensate Wang Shouzhe.
"Clan Leader Wang, about this..." Lei Yangqiu cautiously offered the compensation money.

chapters.title: Chapter 100
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 95: Lei Yangqiu Completely Suppressed (Seeking Votes) _2
Wang Shouzhe pondered for a moment, then seriously cupped his hands and said, "The settlement and compensation for the families of the deceased can be considered a solace to their spirits in heaven. I’ll trouble Lei Guardian Envoy with this task. If it’s done well, it might not be a small achievement."
He reviewed the case files. Even though they were called extermination cases, the victims were all adult men, leaving a pile of women and children. It wasn’t due to the benevolence of the perpetrators; they deliberately left a tragic group of widows and orphans as a warning.
Lei Yangqiu was taken aback, and for once, Wang Shouzhe truly caught his attention. It seemed he genuinely cared about those women and children.
Regardless of whether he was genuine or not, even if it was fake, if he could consistently act in such a manner, others would perceive it as genuine.
As long as Wang Shouzhe did not fall midway, the Wang Family was likely to rise under his leadership.
Immediately, Lei Yangqiu solemnly cupped his hands and said, "Since Clan Leader Wang has entrusted me, I will do my best to comfort those surviving old and weak women and children."
He paused for a moment and then whispered, "Clan Leader Wang, be cautious of Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide; those two old ones are full of tricks. They won’t dare act openly, but in private, who knows."
Instinctively, Lei Yangqiu tried to do a favor.
"Oh?" Wang Shouzhe squinted and smiled, "Lord Guardian Envoy, after what I did to you today, do you not hold a grudge against me? Or are you pretending to lower my guard to retaliate at any time?"
Up to this point, Wang Shouzhe saw through some patterns.
Among these noble Celestial Human Families, some Spirit Platform Realm cultivators seemed to lack the imposing bearing.
Take the Liu and Zhao Clans, for instance. Even though those two ancestors were enemies of the Wang Family, Wang Shouzhe wished to kill them immediately. However, he had to admit, those two ancestors indeed possessed some gravitas as stabilizing presences for their families.
The Celestial Guard family of Hundred Islands’ Steward Zhong Xingwang and this Lei Yangqiu both seemed to lack the indomitable resilience and pride of ancestral figures.
Upon careful thought, this was not surprising at all.
Cultivators of the Spirit Platform Realm in small noble families are the foundation of their lineage, shouldering the life and death of their entire clan and allowing no room for error. Any decision might bring the family to ruin.
Over time, these Spirit Platform cultivators naturally develop a strong mindset and a self-centered aura.
However, Spirit Platform cultivators in Celestial Human families do not bear the burden of their family’s survival; they focus more on personal achievements or family status and interests.
In their growth environment, they must continually look up to the Celestial Human Ancestors of their family. Such restraint naturally doesn’t breed an aura of dominion.
Let’s set aside idle talk for now.
Upon hearing Wang Shouzhe’s accusation, Lei Yangqiu’s expression turned solemn and he said seriously, "Honestly, saying I don’t hold a grudge is false. However, the Wang and Lei Families have no inherent animosity. If I bear a grudge against Clan Leader Wang because of this, my family might not support it."
No animosity?
Wang Shouzhe squinted his eyes slightly, wondering if his previous assumptions were incorrect, or if Lei Yangqiu was unaware?
Immediately, he said nothing and continued to listen to Lei Yangqiu.
"Additionally, I, Lei Yangqiu, truly have my own shortcomings, but those behind-the-scenes instructions to loose cultivators to kill civilians are genuinely unrelated to me," Lei Yangqiu said, "I, a Garrison Commander from a dignified Celestial Human family with a promising future, would not participate in such heinous acts. The Liu and Zhao families wouldn’t involve me, would they?"
Wang Shouzhe remained expressionless, contemplating Lei Yangqiu’s words.
"Our Lei Family has adhered to our family rules for nearly a thousand years," Lei Yangqiu quickly added when he saw Wang Shouzhe’s slight relaxation, "Of course, during my garrison here, I did have intentions to draw in the Liu and Zhao Families to expand our influence in Ping’an Town, which aligns with our strategic family objectives."
"And I’ll admit, privately, I’ve accepted offerings from Liu and Zhao Families. But I can swear under the name of my family that I have not participated in such evildoings," Lei Yangqiu hurriedly clarified.
Wang Shouzhe pondered for a moment, somewhat believing him, but still coldly sneered, "But your indulgence and turning a blind eye have made the Liu and Zhao Clans more rampant."
"That’s true," Lei Yangqiu admitted straightforwardly, "but I don’t admit knowing about it. To be honest, I was also a bit surprised when I saw the evidence today.
