But first, Clan Leader Wang put me on the spot, clearly using me to stir trouble. Second, bringing in the Liu and Zhao Families was a strategic direction for our Lei Family. Instinctively, I wanted to shelter them and oppose Clan Leader Wang."
"Of course, in my heart, I didn’t think the deaths of some civilians were a big deal..." Lei Yangqiu cautiously said, abruptly pausing when he saw Wang Shouzhe’s displeasure and hastily adding, "This point has been corrected after Clan Leader Wang’s reprimand. I now understand the error in my thinking."
"Although Clan Leader Wang’s rebuke embarrassed and infuriated me, making me want to kill you, in retrospect, it wasn’t without merit," Lei Yangqiu earnestly stated. "If I can do what Clan Leader Wang suggested, maybe I can make some achievements. Then, the family Ancestor might have a different opinion of me."
"And another important point," Lei Yangqiu said with great seriousness, "While our Lei Family aims to have influence in Ping’an Town, it doesn’t mean we have to hang on the Liu and Zhao ropes; drawing in the Wang Family works just the same. After today, I’m convinced that, with the abilities of Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide, they are likely no match for Clan Leader Wang."
Lei Yangqiu went all out, aiming to persuade Wang Shouzhe to let him off.
"An alliance with the Lei Family?" Wang Shouzhe furrowed his brows, pondering deeply.
Lei Yangqiu was about to say this wasn’t an alliance but allegiance. However, he swiftly swallowed his words, realizing Wang Shouzhe likely wasn’t someone who would willingly remain under others.
"Let’s put this matter on hold for now." Wang Shouzhe deliberated before saying, "Lord Guardian Envoy, don’t think you’re out of the woods yet. I’ll send someone to investigate you. If it turns out that you’re merely confused but not evil, today’s matter will be forgotten."
"However, if you’ve committed unforgivable crimes, although I lack the authority to judge you, I suggest you’d better pack up and leave immediately."
Wang Shouzhe’s gaze fixed intently on Lei Yangqiu.
Lei Yangqiu was so startled by his glare that he felt a chill and hurriedly said, "Minor offenses, small corruption and bribery, yes, but no major crimes. These will be rectified in due course."
"Fine, but saying it yourself doesn’t count. Go handle the aftermath for the orphans first." Wang Shouzhe waved his hand, showing a hint of impatience, "Or is Lord Guardian Envoy waiting for the Wang Family to host you for dinner?"
"Of course not, Clan Leader Wang, I’ll take my leave now." Lei Yangqiu tightened his expression and retreated honestly.
It wasn’t until he had walked a fair distance that Lei Yangqiu finally breathed a sigh of relief, feeling as if he had passed a test.
By then, his back was already dripping with sweat. Wang Shouzhe, no, Clan Leader Wang, was terrifying. That ability to effortlessly manipulate life and death through mere words, playing him in the palm of his hand, made him feel utterly powerless to resist.
He himself found something odd and unsettling, getting lost in thought.
At this moment, he felt profound respect for Wang Shouzhe while simultaneously filled with gratitude for being spared.
And simultaneously, he felt deep hatred towards the Liu Zhao Clans that had duped him so terribly.
...
Watching Lei Yangqiu’s departing figure, Wang Shouzhe also couldn’t help but fall into contemplation.
What’s this state of Lei Yangqiu called again? He had seen it on some app before.
Hmm, Stockholm syndrome? It’s pretty similar.
All about having one’s life and death in other’s hands, powerless to resist, receiving a favor, and feeling grateful, even reverent, and subservient to the controller.
Hehe~ now this is getting interesting.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 101
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 96: Brother Shouzhe Is Truly a Divine Being
...
This matter has been resolved.
After paying the compensation, the Liu and Zhao Clans retreated with their tails between their legs, looking like a pack of defeated dogs. This was in stark contrast to their earlier grand entrance when they came to stir up trouble.
Lei Yangqiu was temporarily let off the hook, and having survived this ordeal, he didn’t want to linger.
The onlookers, however, showed no signs of dispersing, still eagerly discussing and sharing their excitement about the events.
Most of the world’s common folk live difficult and monotonous lives, struggling to stay above the subsistence line. Their greatest hope is often just to save up some money gradually year by year, buy some land, or secure a good future for their children, perhaps find a good wife.
This dramatic and suspenseful saga was enough to be etched in their memories for a lifetime.
Madam Gongsun Hui, accompanied by her sisters-in-law and female relatives, directed the household servants to set up a porridge stall and cook some thick salted meat porridge, inviting the common folk to have a meal.
Today, these commoners, even the poor among them, might have seemed like mere onlookers. But in fact, they were the most crucial part of Wang Shouzhe’s plan today.
This meal was a feast in their honor.
In the eyes of many arrogant noble family descendants, commoners are so insignificant and inconspicuous, like ants that can be crushed at will.
Yet, most noble families cannot do without commoners. Without commoners to create wealth for them, how could noble family descendants afford their luxurious lifestyles? How could they buy precious cultivation resources?
Moreover, while individual commoners may be insignificant, their collective strength becomes very formidable once gathered in large numbers. Under the watchful eyes of a thousand commoners, even a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator like Lei Yangqiu, a dignified Garrison Commander, dared not act recklessly.
Wang Shouzhe had learned this well in his previous life; the gathered power of onlookers should never be underestimated. Even the lofty Celestial Human Families need a vast number of commoners to survive.
Some of the young girls and young male servants of the Wang Family also actively participated in cooking and serving porridge, as well as maintaining order.
This included two legitimate daughters, Wang Luoyi and Wang Luomiao.
Even the recently acclaimed Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing were earnestly busy with their tasks, showing no signs of disdain.
This pleased Wang Shouzhe greatly; the children of our family have upright values. They certainly won’t think themselves superior just because they possess martial strength and separate themselves from the common folk.
Wait?
It seems that some odd elements have snuck in.
A burly man with a face like a pig’s head sat on the ground in front of the porridge stall, gulping down meat porridge. As soon as he finished one bowl, he demanded another, consuming more than ten bowls in no time.
This little fellow!
Wang Shouzhe walked over and scrutinized him. He found that the man’s injuries from the Spirit Bee stings had already healed significantly, and his recovery power was truly astonishing.
"Is it tasty?" Wang Shouzhe asked with a slight smile.
"Tasty, very tasty." The boy Zhao Dingteng instinctively responded, then looked up and saw Wang Shouzhe, immediately startled and clutching his bowl, as if afraid Wang Shouzhe would take it away.
This caused the corner of Wang Shouzhe’s mouth to twitch; this kid, he’s afraid in the wrong direction, isn’t he?
What a simple-minded kid, but during a fight, he’s quite cunning. It would be hard to say who would win if he faced Wang Luqiu.
"Alright, alright, eat more, and when you’re full, head home quickly." Waving his hand, Wang Shouzhe, with his bearing, would not concern himself with a fourteen-year-old dimwitted boy.
Though this boy, his appearance hardly suggests he’s a child, after all, he’s only fourteen.
"Clan Leader Wang, it’s Clan Leader Wang."
When the commoners saw Wang Shouzhe approach the porridge stall, they became extremely tense, with awe and admiration in their eyes.
Today’s event not only made the Wang Family famous but even more so the fame of the Wang Family Clan Leader.
"Everyone, help yourselves today, eat your fill," Wang Shouzhe cheerfully invited. "In the future, if you find life unsatisfactory in the territories of the Liu and Zhao Clans, you could move to our Wang Family’s territories. In our territory, at the very least, you can live and work in peace, and should disaster strike, we of the Wang Family will face it together with you."
Wang Shouzhe’s words immediately tempted many people. Compared to the lofty and vindictive Liu and Zhao Clans, the Wang Family seemed to be a genuine noble family.
Under the protection of the Wang Family, it felt as if one could live with more peace of mind.
"Clan Leader Wang, but my family’s fields and house are in the village," said a somewhat ragged self-cultivating farmer. "If we move, we can’t take the fields with us."
Yes, indeed.
Many people echoed his concerns; they wanted to move but faced many practical difficulties, each feeling somewhat disappointed and frustrated.
Among the thousand commoners, there were also those from the Wang Family’s territory.
Upon hearing this, they immediately felt a sense of superiority, a young man about twenty years old said, "Your dilapidated fields and houses, how much are they worth? Only the houses and fields in our Wang Family’s territory are truly valuable."
People outside the Wang territory were not convinced, angrily retorting, "Why aren’t they valuable? They produce grain and house people just the same."
The young man arrogantly replied, "What do you know? Our Wang Family has a Spirit Insect Master. This year, with some care, our family’s fields only saw a fifty percent reduction in yield."

chapters.title: Chapter 102
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 96: Brother Shouzhe is Truly a Divine Person_2
The rest of the "local Wang Family members" all started to respond enthusiastically to the young man, affirming that everything he said was true. On average, each household’s yield reduction was about fifty percent.
A Spirit Insect Master? Only a fifty percent reduction? And just slightly tended to?
The self-sufficient farmers from outside the territory remained silent, thinking that the self-sufficient farmers within the Wang Family’s territory gained an additional twenty percent yield this season compared to them.
If they could also have twenty percent more yield, they would have a significant surplus after paying the grain taxes, avoiding the need to borrow grain everywhere to survive the disaster, and avoiding bullying by the noble families.
For a moment, those "external self-sufficient farmers" looked at the locals with envy.
"Not only that, when our Wang Family collected taxes on behalf of the government, the noble family’s tax could be offset directly with cash. This year, we survived the disaster year easily," the young man said with pride. "Just our family has over twenty loads of surplus grain now."
In the bountiful years of the past, having twenty loads of surplus grain at home did not mean wealth.
But this is a disaster year!
The external self-sufficient farmers’ eyes turned red when they heard this number. How could your family be so wealthy and still want to share gruel with us?
"Not only that, I have a buddy in the Wang Family branch who revealed a top-secret message to me. This year, Wang family wasn’t prepared, but starting the next season, all the farmlands in our Wang Family’s territory can be treated by the Spirit Insect Master, with better pest control effects and costing only half of the Insecticide Powder," the young man said mysteriously.
Half the cost of the Insecticide Powder?
Wouldn’t that mean... every acre could save a large copper a year? If a family has twenty acres of land, just the savings on Insecticide Powder would be twenty large coppers a year, which is quite a few loads of grain!
The external self-sufficient farmers felt completely discouraged, feeling that compared to Wang Family’s self-sufficient farmers, they were several notches low.
"Young man, are you married?" one quick-witted external self-sufficient farmer asked with a smile, "We have two girls at home, one is sixteen, and the other is fourteen. We can have a good chat."
"We also have a daughter, who is just fifteen this year."
A group of external self-sufficient farmers with daughters surrounded the young man like wolves, marketing their daughters, even willing to negotiate the bride price.
The young man was terrified, his face turning bright red.
Previously, the family conditions were ordinary, with no savings, and the built house was insufficient. Every time a matchmaker was sent to propose marriage, upon seeing his conditions, they would either directly shake their heads in rejection.
Or they would simply make unreasonable demands, asking for an enormous bride price.
He was already nineteen and still hadn’t gotten a wife. But now, just by being a self-sufficient farmer within the Wang Family’s territory, those external self-sufficient farmers were eager to marry their daughters to him, with some families even willing to pay extra.
Instantly, the young man felt he had stepped into the pinnacle of his life.
Witnessing this scene, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but smile.
Unexpectedly, the household registration within the Wang Family’s territory began to increase in value. But this was only natural, as the price of farmlands and houses varies across different places.
For example, certain farmlands and houses near the Changning Guard naturally cost much more than those in Ping’an Town. Even if the output and tax payment were the same, living near the Changning Guard, civilians felt more secure.
Moreover, visiting the city occasionally was more convenient for them than for the civilians in Ping’an Town, and the interpersonal relationships were more complex. Many of the moderately wealthy and wealthy farmers from there would send their children to the city for schooling or have their second sons learn a money-making craft.
This is understandable.
A hundred years ago, the area of Ping’an Town was still a wilderness. If those civilians weren’t living tough lives, why would they migrate to a place like Ping’an Town?
However, after this situation, the land and property prices inside Ping’an Town might change.
"Everyone, don’t rush," Wang Shouzhe said aloud, "as you all have heard, our Wang Family is dredging and filling soil to reclaim farmland. Those future farmland areas are fertile lands with silt as fertilizer. Our Wang Family will soon launch a reclamation period land exchange plan and a pre-purchase plan for period land."
A "period land" exchange plan?
What on earth is that? This was a term countless civilians had never heard of before.
"Simply put, it’s about exchanging your current land and houses in the territories of Liu and Zhao Clans for our newly reclaimed lands and houses," Wang Shouzhe squinted his eyes and said, "Of course, because period lands cannot be obtained immediately, requiring about a two-year period, they’re called period lands. However, currently, we only accept internal workers participating in the reclamation project for period land exchange. If anyone plans to migrate to our Wang Family territory, this is the only way for now."
The external self-sufficient farmers fell silent for a moment.
But soon, someone jumped up and said, "Let’s exchange, why not exchange? Damn it, I’ve had enough of those bastards from the Zhao Family all these years."
"Exchange, as long as the Wang Family gives wages so we don’t starve. It’s just two years; let’s exchange."
"I believe in the Wang Family; I believe Clan Leader Wang won’t let us suffer. Let’s exchange."
Voices of agreement to exchange echoed one after another. The self-sufficient farmers were not fools; they naturally had their own sharpness. Although it seemed like a loss on the surface, if things continued, the household registration within the Wang Family territory would become increasingly valuable.
"The detailed exchange plan will be launched soon, so please pay attention to our Wang Family’s announcements," Wang Shouzhe said after piquing their interest, turning around and leaving.
Not far away, the Liua siblings approached again, both of them looking at Wang Shouzhe with peculiar expressions.
"Yuan Rui, Sister Ruolei." Wang Shouzhe felt a bit uneasy under their gazes and cupped his hands, asking, "Why do you look at me like this?"
"Brilliant, truly brilliant," Liua Yuanrui praised twice, giving a thumbs up, cupping his hands, "Brother Shouzhe’s strategy is truly indescribable. Yuan Rui’s admiration for Brother Shouzhe is as continuous as the waters of the Anjiang. It not only benefits ourselves but also defeats the enemy invisibly."
Wang Shouzhe was a bit speechless by his words.
"Big Brother, all I see is self-interest. Where is there an invisible defeat?" Liua Ruolei asked curiously.
"The self-interest part is quite obvious. Brother Shouzhe’s grand project lacks a large workforce, and using the period land exchange method to involve a large number of farmers in the project is a strategy of leverage. Ultimately, those laborers will all become self-sufficient farmers under the Wang Family’s jurisdiction."
"Secondly, the lands exchanged to the Wang Family originally belonged to the territories of the Liu and Zhao Clans. With simple integration and exchange, they can establish private estates in the enemy’s territory, converting that land into Wang Family property."
"What’s most impressive is that now the wave of migration to the Wang Family has formed, and many people yearn to join the Wang Family’s territory. Brother Shouzhe only needs to follow a step-by-step process, and the territories of the Liu and Zhao Clans will progressively shrink, and the number of civilians under their jurisdiction will drastically decrease."
"Under this invisible vicious cycle, the Liu and Zhao Clans will become weaker and weaker, unable to compete with the Wang Family, and eventually, the two words await them: extinction!"
Liua Yuanrui’s explanation made Liua Ruolei’s eyes sparkle as she praised, "Brother Shouzhe is truly a godsend, and my sister is very fortunate."
"Uh..."
Wang Shouzhe scratched his nose, thinking that maybe he hadn’t initially thought as deeply as Liua Yuanrui had imagined. He simply wanted to solve the labor shortage issue and had no intention to concoct a century-long plan.
But his future brother-in-law really had a good mind, and after hearing his explanation, this plan seemed quite decent.
Also, Ruolei, could you not use that gaze and tone to speak with me? It gave Wang Shouzhe a bit of a chill inside.
At this moment.
A sonorous voice broke through: "Hey, everyone, let me ask. Is our Zhao family really that annoying?"
Zhao Dingteng!
Wang Shouzhe glanced at him, noticing that the swollen venomous lumps on his face had mostly cured, rendering him speechless. This fool’s constitution had an incredible recovery power!
Liua Ruolei and Liua Yuanrui also stared at Zhao Dingteng with strange expressions.
You don’t have any clue about your Zhao Family’s infamous reputation, you simple-minded fool?
...
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 96 Why Won’t My Sister-in-law Leave?
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 96 Why Won’t My Sister-in-law Leave?
...
However, Wang Shouzhe knew, this naive boy probably really didn’t have a clue?
Being the legitimate son, and obsessed with cultivation and combat, where would he usually concern himself with the outside world?
And among the members of the Zhao Family, it’s not like they’d have "I am a bad guy" written on their faces every day.
Furthermore, good and bad aren’t absolute adjectives.
From Zhao Family’s point of view, they were only striving for more living space for themselves, though somewhat unscrupulously. The world itself is cruel and full of competition.
Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "Using unscrupulous methods to infringe and annex the interests of innocent people is naturally displeasing."
"Then, aren’t you also using unscrupulous methods to infringe upon our Zhao Family?" Zhao Dingteng, looking naive, pointed at Liua Yuanrui and said, "He said your schemes kill invisibly."
"The Zhao Family is not innocent; it was your Zhao Family that broke the rules first, making us enemies," Wang Shouzhe stated calmly, "Secondly, if it weren’t for your Zhao Family’s deceit and wrongdoing, long-term infringement of innocent people’s interests, and offending too many people, my plan wouldn’t have made any waves. Ultimately, if a Noble Family is morally corrupt, it will eventually be annihilated."
Wang Shouzhe wasn’t afraid of his plan being leaked because it was an upright strategy. The Liu and Zhao Clans had no power to resist. With their reputation, even if they wanted to act righteous, the common people wouldn’t trust them.
"Then... can our two families still be friends?" Zhao Dingteng looked troubled with his naive face, "I don’t want to be a bad person."
"No, we can’t," Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "Once some things start, there’s no turning back. You’ve even freeloaded a meal, now you better hurry home. Your father is currently discussing with your great-grandfather how to get rid of me."
Ah?
Zhao Dingteng looked shocked, you can even figure this out?
Ultimately, Zhao Dingteng left disappointed, seemingly unable to understand why he wanted to be a good person but couldn’t choose so?
After Zhao Dingteng left.
Liua Ruolei sighed and said, "This naive Zhao Hanhan is indeed pitiful, born into a certain family, destined to carry the indelible mark of that family for life."
"That’s why we need to become stronger," Wang Shouzhe said with emotion, "Only true strength can break free from constraints and dominate one’s destiny."
"Break free from constraints and dominate one’s destiny?" Liua Ruolei murmured softly, her eyes slightly flickering.
"Uh..." Wang Shouzhe suddenly had an ominous feeling, this future little sister-in-law is at a rebellious age, instilling her with such a notion would be aiding the enemy, wouldn’t it?
Instantly, Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned serious, and he said solemnly, "Yet, the reason we humans are called a civilized society is because we have a comprehensive community. All of our actions need to be accountable to ourselves and to others. Take myself for example, I want to become strong only because I want to protect those around me, to protect those I care about."
"Hmm~ Thank you, Brother Shouzhe, I understand now." Liua Ruolei immediately beamed with joy.
?
Wang Shouzhe looked puzzled, thanking for what? Understanding what?
At this moment.
Liua Yuanrui suddenly bowed deeply and said, "Brother Shouzhe, we siblings have stayed at the Wang Family for quite some time, it’s time to bid farewell."
Wang Shouzhe’s body stiffened slightly, even Yuanrui could see it?
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe without hesitation also bowed and said, "Since Yuanrui is eager to return, I won’t hold you back."
He was also inwardly apprehensive, if these Liua brothers and sisters stayed any longer, this future little sister-in-law at her rebellious age might stir up some trouble.
"Bidding farewell, why say farewell? Little brother, I haven’t played enough yet." Liua Ruolei looked displeased.
Oh my, my little grandaunt, Liua Yuanrui groaned inwardly and cried out, if you stay any longer, little brother might get into trouble here.
Immediately, Liua Yuanrui’s expression became serious, "Ruolei, you can’t be so willful. Your Brother Shouzhe, as the Clan Leader, has too many matters to attend to."
"It’s okay, Brother Shouzhe can go ahead and be busy." Liua Ruolei said innocently, "I can find my sister Luoyi, sister Luomiao, and Luoqiu and Luojing to play. Let me tell you, sister Luomiao is so much fun, she divulged all of Brother Shouzhe’s embarrassing childhood incidents."
These words once spoken.
Liua Yuanrui shuddered, almost crying.
Sister, oh sister, you like the sisters of the Wang Family so much, are you planning to cling on and not leave? If something really happens, how will I explain it when I return home?
Before you came, didn’t you say clearly, you were intending to properly guide your future brother-in-law on behalf of your sister? How come in a blink you’ve gotten yourself involved instead?
Soon, as Liua Yuanrui anxiously imagined, a drama of enmity and sisterly discord unfolded in his mind.
What to do? What to do?
"Well, Yuanrui is right," Wang Shouzhe also said, "There are a plethora of major issues on my side lately, afraid I really can’t take much care of you."
"Alright then."
Liua Ruolei, although somewhat unwilling, could hear the words of dismissal from Wang Shouzhe and sulkily said, "Once Brother Shouzhe finishes his affairs, you can visit the Liua Family. If my sister isn’t convenient to receive you, I can entertain you on her behalf."
"This... better not," Wang Shouzhe gently refused, "I have not yet married your sister; it would be inappropriate to visit the Liua Family rashly."

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 96: Why Is the Sister-in-Law Clinging and Not Leaving?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 96: Why Is the Sister-in-Law Clinging and Not Leaving?_2
This is an unspoken etiquette among the Black Tortoise Noble Families.
Just like Wang Shouzhe’s future brother-in-law, Chen Fangjie, if he were to hang around the Wang Family’s main residence all day, he would probably be kicked out by Wang Shouzhe after a time or two.
Therefore, even if Chen Fangjie came to help Wang Shouzhe with matters, he wouldn’t step into the Wang Family’s main residence to avoid being seen as an impatient libertine by the Wang Family members.
"Alright then, once Brother Shouzhe and sister are married, there won’t be so many concerns," said Liua Ruolei with a look of regret, "Brother Shouzhe, keep the courtyard I’ve been staying in for me recently. No one else is allowed to stay there."
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat.
This little auntie really plans to settle down at the Wang Family, huh? But there’s no way to refuse her request, so he had to say, "Alright, I’ll give the order later."
Beside them, Liua Yuanrui felt like shedding tears.
How come our Liua Family’s legitimate daughter seems to be getting married off with an added gift?
...
Almost simultaneously, in a hidden manor.
Here, the elders and higher-ups of the Liu and Zhao Clans gathered. The two ancestors sat at the head seat, each with very grim expressions.
They originally went to the Wang Family to cause trouble with great confidence but were met with a disastrous defeat, leaving them embarrassed. More importantly, the reputation of the Liu and Zhao Clans had been utterly ruined by Wang Shouzhe, losing public support and becoming the laughingstock.
"Brother Zhide," said Zhao Clan Ancestor Zhao Bojun with a heavy expression, "With the methods of that Wang brat, there will undoubtedly be more blows to us. At such a life-and-death juncture, our two clans must set aside suspicions and overcome the difficulties together."
"Indeed, that brat is truly formidable," Liu Zhide replied heavily, "but he underestimates the foundation of our two clans. Brother Bojun, I fear your family’s Zhao Daoyuan is close to advancing to the Spirit Platform Realm, right?"
Zhao Bojun’s face stiffened, then he laughed heartily, "I said it, this matter couldn’t be hidden from Brother Zhide. But Brother Zhide, isn’t your Liu Shenghao also close to success?"
Zhao Daoyuan and Liu Shenghao, both talented clansmen, are on the path to the Spirit Platform.
Not every family will always fully support the clan leader at any time. Sometimes, for long-term interests, they will preferentially cultivate some talented direct veins.
Just like how the Wang Family had once focused on cultivating Wang Xiaohan.
"Alright, let’s speak frankly," Liu Zhide said, "Our two clans must spare no expense to purchase those auxiliary materials, letting Daoyuan and Shenghao push towards the Spirit Platform Realm. As long as we gain one more ancestor at the Spirit Platform Realm, even with Gongsun Mang and Wang Longyan protecting them, we can be confident to forcibly eliminate Wang Shouzhe. By then, the Wang clan, dogs without a king, would be nothing to fear. We could handle them at will."
After this incident, their top feared target had already shifted to Wang Shouzhe.
"But before that, we must sign a century-long joint development contract to avoid mutual suspicion."
"It should be so; our two clans will jointly control Ping’an Town. Let’s act quickly, aiming to sprint within a month."
Post-alliance.
The Liu and Zhao Clans seemed utterly silent, lowering their flags without any actions. While the Wang Clan, in contrast, vigorously expanded the Zhuwei Lake project. The three clans entered a brief period of peace.
Yet amidst this, a dangerous undercurrent was brewing.
On this day.
Not far from Dingpu Ferry.
There was a small, elegantly landscaped manor, named "Xia Garden" due to the vast ponds filled with lotus flowers.
This season was when the lotuses were in full bloom. In the ponds covering no less than two hundred acres, there were scenes of various lotuses blooming everywhere.
A winding boardwalk led to the center of the pond, to a stilted bamboo house structure— "Lotus Listening Pavilion."
In this beautiful moment.
Staying at the Lotus Listening Pavilion, feeling the night breeze, watching the bright moonlight, admiring the enchanting lotuses, with incessant frog croaks echoing around, was particularly elegant and tasteful.
Unfortunately, Lotus Listening Pavilion was only habitable during this time of year.
This courtyard, which cost the Liu Clan a significant amount of money and effort, was originally meant to please a noblewoman from the Celestial Human Family Lei.
However, it currently belonged to "Goddess" Zhong Luoxian.
Tonight, the moon was bright and the wind was high.
Two noble young gentlemen in cloud pattern brocade robes were sitting cross-legged on the second floor of the Lotus Listening Pavilion, drinking top-grade spirit tea—"Red Lady," casually chatting about some anecdotes.
And a beautiful, elegantly disposed woman was serving the two gentlemen, her gaze occasionally drifting to one of the younger and more handsome gentlemen.
"Brother Chen, are you bored recently?" said the younger gentleman in the brocade robe, none other than the current Wang Family’s Patriarch Wang Shouzhe, with a hint of impatience in his words, "If there’s nothing going on, stop coming to Ping’an. It doesn’t look good."
Wang Shouzhe was slightly tipsy. He had just sent off the clingy little sister-in-law. Not even two days of peace, and the future brother-in-law came to bother him again. It was not a quiet life.
"Not exactly free," replied the other gentleman, naturally the Young Clan Leader of East Port Chen Family, Chen Fangjie, with a shameless smile, "But your long-plotted grand performance, I’m at least playing a minor villain role in it. If I don’t come to see the end, I’d feel some regret."
"I’ve heard that you, Shouzhe, shone brilliantly at the Wang Family’s main residence, defeating the Liu and Zhao Clans completely, sending them off in disarray," Chen Fangjie said, "I already missed one grand scene, I didn’t want to miss a second. I don’t quite understand why you don’t want me to be part of the finale? Rest assured, I’m just here to watch the fun, not seeking any benefits."
Wang Shouzhe was speechless. His future brother-in-law insisted on joining the play; he couldn’t just chase him away, could he? Fine, fine, if you insist on loving the feeling of ’envy, jealousy, and hate,’ I’ll grant your wish.
Beside them, serving as Wang Mei, no, it’s "Zhong Luoxian," who gently covered her mouth with a smile, her voice soft and tender, "Patriarch, before the main show starts, would you like me to provide some preludes to amuse you both?"
Preludes?
"Cough, cough~" Wang Shouzhe, who was drinking tea, almost choked and coughed to death.
"Zhong Luoxian" and Chen Fangjie both gave Wang Shouzhe a curious look. It’s just a prelude, why react like this?
"Cough, cough~" Wang Shouzhe coughed more violently. Alright, he admitted that his thinking was "advanced" compared to these people. It seemed that his brother-in-law and Wang Mei were still quite innocent.
Suppressing his peculiar emotions, Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "Wang Mei, what kind of prelude have you prepared?"
"Patriarch, please call me Luoxian," she teased, flashing a coquettish glance at Wang Shouzhe, before drawing a Jade Flute, "In these times of idleness, I’ve learned the art of playing the flute. On such a long night with plain drinks, let me play a tune for you to lift your spirits."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 97 Luoxian: Young Master, Please Stay (Seeking Monthly Tickets, Recommendation Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 97 Luoxian: Young Master, Please Stay (Seeking Monthly Tickets, Recommendation Votes)
...
Before Wang Shouzhe could oppose, Chen Fangjie applauded and said, "Good! The flute sound is clear and bright yet maintains a sense of age. It is deep and profound yet doesn’t lose its heroic grandeur, which is very much in tune with our mood for tea tasting and listening to the lotus."
Enough, enough. Let her play the flute then. Wang Shouzhe let her be, considering she was planning to play seriously.
"Then I, Luoxian, will humbly perform." Following this, "Zhong Luoxian" gazed with beautiful eyes like water, raised the jade flute, lightly parted her red lips, and played with her jade-like fingers.
The movements were very elegant and pleasing.
Then...
There was no then.
The flute playing was so unbearable that even someone like Wang Shouzhe, an outsider, felt anxious and wished he could jump into the lotus pond from this second-floor balcony.
As for Chen Fangjie, he had his eyes tightly shut, his face was stiff, and he swayed as if he would collapse. If it weren’t for his decent self-discipline, he might have exploded on the spot.
Humbly perform... indeed, it truly was a humble performance.
After the performance ended, Wang Shouzhe had to drink several cups of Spirit Tea Red Lady to calm the excitement in his heart. He couldn’t help but curiously ask, "Luoxian, what kind of courage and confidence do you possess to dare play the flute in front of me?"
"Ah? Both Young Master Liu and Young Master Zhao praised me for playing well." "Zhong Luoxian" said with a baffled expression, "Could it be there are still shortcomings in my playing?"
Still shortcomings?
Miss Luoxian, you’re being too modest; you’re basically inept.
Wang Shouzhe resisted the urge to splash tea in her face. Liu Yongzhou and Zhao Dingteng, they were truly seeing a goddess in a blind man’s eyes.
"Well... Luoxian, in playing the flute, the focus is on four major elements: breath, fingers, lips, and tongue. Simply put, it’s about controlling the flexibility of the breath, the deftness of the fingers, the movement of the lips, and the agility of the tongue." Chen Fangjie, also pale, seriously advised her, "Each element needs to be practiced repeatedly. It’s not something achieved in a day but requires long-term practice,"
Wang Shouzhe’s cheeks twitched endlessly, though he understood that Chen Fangjie was earnestly explaining the essentials of flute playing. Yet, why did he feel an irresistible urge to kick him into the lotus pond?
Fortunately, at that moment.
A young man’s voice rang out from the distant walkway: "Is Miss Luoxian here? Yongzhou has come by appointment to visit."
This man, approximately in his twenties, looked quite energetic, though his simple attire and slightly red eyes couldn’t hide his sorrow. He was Liu Yongzhou, an elite of the younger generation of the Liu Family in Ping’an.
In the Lotus Listening Pavilion on the second floor.
Chen Fangjie, sipping Spirit Tea Red Lady, said, "I heard this Liu Yongzhou is quite a character, with commendable ability and talent. It’s just a pity he isn’t the legitimate son in his family, making it hard for him to pursue the Spirit Platform."
Heads up: Emotional Outburst Incoming!
Sphere. Shouzhe, it’s not right for us to bully him just when his father has passed away."
"Brother Chen does have the spirit of a hero, but I’m not some treacherous villain either." After adding tea, Wang Shouzhe slowly said, "When Wang Mei chose her target, she did so after careful investigation and selection. This Liu Yongzhou isn’t a good person. When his fishing fleet operates on the river, if they encounter suitable targets, such as lone merchant ships with weak strength..."
"You mean... water bandits?" Chen Fangjie’s expression instantly turned serious and furious, "A noble family descendant acting so heinously." The East Port Chen Family, relying on water routes to make a living, has always despised water bandits and pirates most.
"It’s not that he’s heinous, it’s just that he belongs to the Liu Family, which rose to power by rebellion." Wang Shouzhe said indifferently, "This family’s ethos is all about profit at any means. Moreover, with Liu Shengye being a greedy Patriarch with an endless desire to plunder resources, it was only a matter of time before he headed down this path."
"However, they act very covertly, leaving no survivors or ships behind, making it difficult for others to discover. After all, the Anjiang River stretches for ten thousand miles, fraught with countless risks, and accidents aren’t uncommon. My Sixth Uncle Dinghai only discovered some clues by chance and investigated accordingly. Further investigations showed that Liu Yongzhou’s evil acts go beyond just water banditry, mostly done on behalf of the patriarch Liu Shengye."
"Such a villain deserves no pity," said Chen Fangjie hatefully, "Moreover, the entire Liu Family is rotten to the core. Shouzhe, I shall fully support you in eliminating the Liu Family, as it would be an act of justice."
"Thank you, Brother Chen." Wang Shouzhe raised his cup as a gesture of toast in place of wine.
"Gentlemen, please enjoy your tea and rest here a while." ’Zhong Luoxian’ smiled, "I shall go do some justice on behalf of the heavens and return shortly."
...
Following Wang Mei’s instructions, the maid led Liu Yongzhou to the pavilion by the "Lotus Listening Pavilion." From the angle where Wang Shouzhe and Chen were having tea, they could see the scene inside the pavilion through the thin gauze curtains from above.
Zhong Luoxian waited in advance, displaying an elegant demeanor, increasingly exuding the charm of a refined lady from a noble family.
Liu Yongzhou walked into the pavilion, gracefully performing a noble bow and greeting, "Yongzhou greets Miss Luoxian." There was an indelible sorrow and vengeful qi between his brows.
"Young Master Liu..." Zhong Luoxian sighed deeply, "The past is gone, please accept my condolences. Please have a seat and let’s talk."
With that said, she personally brewed tea to entertain him.
"Thank you, Miss Luoxian." It was his first time drinking the tea brewed by Zhong Luoxian, and Liu Yongzhou was flattered, feeling both honored and terrified, "I wonder, Miss Luoxian, about the purpose of this invitation..."
In such a beautiful landscape, the night was enchanting, and Luoxian invited him over. Could it be... for a moment, the sorrow of losing his father faded significantly for Liu Yongzhou.
"This time, I invited you over to say farewell." Zhong Luoxian’s tone carried a hint of detachment and coldness.
"Ah?" Liu Yongzhou nearly dropped his cup, flustered, "Luoxian is leaving! Why is this? Could it be, Yongzhou was not hospitable enough? Or is it..." his heart tightened, recalling that arrogant and domineering young lord.
"Young Master Liu’s hospitality is naturally excellent. I thank you for sending the Spirit Tea Red Lady. The tea is quite good." The detachment in Zhong Luoxian’s tone grew stronger. "When I return to my family, I will have someone return it double."
"This... this..." Liu Yongzhou panicked all of a sudden and hurriedly stood up, "Luoxian, did I make a mistake? You can point it out, and I will definitely change."
"No, the mistake is mine, not Young Master Liu’s." Pain and disappointment flashed in Zhong Luoxian’s eyes. "I originally thought you were... never mind, it’s all my own naivety to blame."
Liu Yongzhou felt chilled to the bone as he seemed to recall something and quickly explained, "Luoxian, you’ve misunderstood. My father was framed by the Wang Family. That despicable Wang Ding Race, Wang Shouzhe! I, Liu Yongzhou, will never let them off." A deep hatred appeared in his eyes.
"Liu Yongzhou, you have greatly disappointed me." Zhong Luoxian’s words were somewhat intense, as if she was struggling to calm her heart. "I originally thought you were a man of integrity and independence, but it turns out you’re a fool who can’t tell right from wrong. Leave, I don’t want to see you again." She was so agitated that she clutched her chest, her brows furrowed as if in pain.
"Luoxian, I, I..." Liu Yongzhou was in a panic, pleading, "You can beat me or scold me, just don’t get yourself angry. Or perhaps, you could tell me exactly where I went wrong, and I will change, truly."
"Young Master Liu, I can tolerate low social standing as long as he is kind-hearted and has a spirit of perseverance." Zhong Luoxian sighed, "But never mind, the Liu Family surely has its means of survival, which I have no right to interfere with."
Shivers! Coldness! Liu Yongzhou understood; the Liu Family’s infamous reputation had reached Zhong Luoxian’s ears, and she was disdaining it.
Indeed, she was, after all, a noble lady from a Celestial Human Family, willing to overlook differences in social class to associate with him had already been her greatest effort, but now the Liu Family was known for its disrepute and was in disarray.
How could she continue to associate with him despite the obstacles?
"Miss Luoxian, listen to me." Liu Yongzhou quickly said, "Our Liu Family’s downfall is only a temporary lull. We are planning a counterattack, and once we deal with the Wang Family, we will become the true masters of Ping’an Town. As for me, I will walk the path to the Spirit Platform to be worthy of you."
"Liu Yongzhou, you still don’t understand." Zhong Luoxian was utterly disappointed. "If I were seeking power from my husband’s family, there are many Celestial Human Families waiting for me to choose. Is being a Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator so remarkable?"
"I have never despised your family’s poverty. But now I despise your family’s vile and reprehensible nature, doing shameless things for a little profit. Do you think I or the Zhong Family can accept that?" Zhong Luoxian’s eyes were filled with shock and disdain, "And don’t try to put the blame on others; you know exactly what your family is like."
"Ah!"
Liu Yongzhou was struck as if by lightning, and he finally understood the reason. After a long time, he said helplessly, "Luoxian, you’re right. I am not worthy of you. But I cannot choose which family I’m born into. If I could choose, I also wish..."
Zhong Luoxian’s gaze gradually softened, "I know, you are essentially a good person. Yongzhou, can you leave that whirlpool?"
"Leave?" Liu Yongzhou was taken aback but then overjoyed, "Is Luoxian’s meaning... Yes, I can become part of your family."
However, just after his joy, he fell into worry again, "But if I join your family, my status will not be high, and even the Zhong Family may not support me on the road to the Spirit Platform."
Zhong Luoxian’s pretty face blushed slightly, and her eyes softened with a touch of gentleness, "Did you not say last time that your Liu Family intends to support you on the Spirit Platform path? If you can get their support..."
"Luoxian, you are right." Liu Yongzhou nodded repeatedly, "I have contributed so much to the Liu Family, and now if I ask for some compensation, the Patriarch will surely not reject it."
"Mr. Liu, you need to be careful with Liu Shengye. That person is cunning as a fox and not benevolent."
The address of "Mr. Liu" made Liu Yongzhou’s heart melt.
"No worries, he promised me. All right, Luoxian, rest assured, I’ll be careful and probe the situation first."
"Be careful in everything. I’m afraid that Liu Shengye..." Zhong Luoxian bit her lip and said, "For our future, let me give you an idea to test."
"Luoxian, this plan is wonderful. Just wait, there will be news in a few days."
Afterwards, Liu Yongzhou left Xia Garden with a passionate heart. It was the first time in his relationship with Luoxian that he had genuinely discussed marriage. What of becoming a part of her family? Being the spouse from a Celestial Human Family’s noble daughter isn’t bad, after all, and Luoxian is also...
...
The second floor of the Lotus Listening Pavilion.
Chen Fangjie was first shocked at Zhong Luoxian’s progress in acting prowess, but as he listened, he sensed something was wrong.
After people left, Chen Fangjie took a sip of tea and still couldn’t hide his shocked expression: "Shouzhe, you are defying the heavens. What are you planning to take from the Liu Family? Could it be... the Celestial Spirit Pill?"
With his intelligence, considering the scenario like a god, he ultimately couldn’t hide it from him.
Wang Shouzhe, however, leisurely sipped his tea and said, "The Liu Family plotted against my Wang Family’s Ancestor, stealing our ancestral foundation. I’m merely taking a bit of interest first, nothing too surprising. Am I supposed to watch them enjoy the Celestial Spirit Pill and then come after our Wang Family? Even if I can’t get it, I will destroy it."
"Bold actions, incredible." Chen Fangjie said with jealousy, "I’m truly envious."
Ha, I told you not to suffer this, but Wang Shouzhe ignored him. He was just here to give Wang Mei some advice, write a script, and provide some assurance.
An hour later.
On the pathway outside the Lotus Listening Pavilion, the voice of a young man was heard again: "Dingtian is here as agreed, to meet with Miss Luoxian."
This young man was Zhao Dingtian, a noble family descendant of the Zhao Family and a disciple.
"Young Master Zhao, my lady Miss Luoxian invites you." A maid led Zhao Dingtian to the pavilion.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 98: Celestial Spirit Pill! In Hand (4200 Grand - )
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 98: Celestial Spirit Pill! In Hand (4200 Grand Chapter)
...
After the incident at Xia Garden’s Lotus Listening Pavilion, a few more days passed.
During this time, the Liu and Zhao Clans seemed to have fallen into silence, regardless of what actions the Wang Family took, they continued to endure and endure again. As if they had suddenly transformed into two wounded tigers lurking in the shadows, licking their wounds and preparing to deal a fatal blow to the Wang Family when the opportunity arose.
With Wang Shouzhe’s methods, naturally, such a favorable development couldn’t be missed. Wave after wave of propaganda campaigns continued to unfold in the Ping’an Town area.
Using military and public water supply promotion strategies, in a short time, the causes and consequences of the battle at the gates of the Wang Family’s Main Residence that day, and the different behaviors of the three noble families were spread throughout Ping’an Town.
Public opinion wars! Propaganda wars!
Many commoners began to eagerly talk and pass around stories of the Wang Family’s history, the tale of Ancestor Zhou Xuan heading south to establish Ping’an Town, and the heroic sacrifice of Ancestor Zhou Xuan to fend off the Tier Five Demon Beast, Golden-winged Sun-devouring Tiger.
From fifty years ago, many of those who experienced that great disaster firsthand have passed away. Even those who were alive were mostly children at the time or have unclear memories, not understanding the actual circumstances.
Under the vast propaganda offense of the Wang Family, the twenty thousand commoners of Ping’an Town.
Only then did they gradually realize that Ping’an Town was actually developed by Ancestor Zhou Xuan of the Wang Family and his clansmen, who spent nearly a hundred years. The Liu and Zhao Clans were originally two destitute households that couldn’t make it in the Commandery city and came halfway to seek refuge in the Wang Family as laborers.
They came to further understand the circumstances surrounding the disaster fifty years ago. Not only did the Liu and Zhao Clans play dead, but they also let fierce beasts in, causing the deaths of many commoners, even leading to the deaths of Ancestor Zhou Xuan and Ancestor Qiong Yuan.
The Wang Family’s reputation and prestige were rapidly rising. Meanwhile, the evil name of the Liu and Zhao Clans was spreading continuously. When many mentioned the Liu and Zhao Clans, they couldn’t help but spit to show disdain and disgust.
No wonder, in any era, any world, human nature is consistent; everyone admires heroes and despises and abhors insidious villains.
Wang Shouzhe was in the side hall of his courtyard.
He leisurely handled family affairs. After completing his daily cultivation and replenishing with spiritual food, his spirit was exceptionally vigorous.
This is also considered a benefit of cultivation; a consistent daily practice of the Profound Origin Technique not only enhances physical qualities and profound qi but also prolongs life, keeping the body in a peak state for a long time.
"Patriarch, please have some tea." The servant Wang Gui routinely brewed some spirit tea.
Today’s choice was Cloud Mist Spirit Species; the tea was as gentle as water, with a swallow that seemed to permeate even the five viscera and six bowels.
Wang Gui himself was quite fond of this spirit tea.
Of course, Wang Gui dared not and would not secretly take some spirit tea for his own enjoyment. However, being close to the well, he could fully enjoy the leftover tea from the patriarch, which was tasteless yet a pity to discard.
Even though it was leftover tea, it had some effects, so how could it be wasted? Until it was completely devoid of taste, it could be rendered into tea soup and consumed whole...
Different spirit teas have different flavors, but Wang Shouzhe also favored Cloud Mist Spirit Species. While drinking this Cloud Mist Spirit Species, he would always recall his yet-unseen fiancee, Miss Liua.
Unlike the choice of marriage in the direct vein, where there is a wide selection and some autonomy for men and women to pick and choose among various candidates.
The marriages in the legitimate lineage are more related to the family’s future direction, hence nearly impossible to make choices.
Thus, both Wang Shouzhe and Miss Liua passively accepted each other’s existence. However, after a small, silent interaction, Wang Shouzhe developed some affection for her.
As he drank the Cloud Mist Spirit Species, feeling pleasant, he leisurely updated the system panel, specifically the family’s reputation column.
[Clan Prestige]: [Village Reputation (90) Respected Far and Wide][County Reputation (29) Slightly Known][Commandery Reputation (00) Obscure]
The reason the Village Reputation didn’t reach the full score of 100 is naturally in line with the system’s consistent principle; the closer the data gets to completion, the harder it is to rise. Furthermore, the Liu and Zhao Clans haven’t been eradicated; the Wang Family hasn’t reached the level of "one hand covering the sky".
The improvement in County Reputation is naturally even more challenging. To reach the level of "respected far and wide" in County Reputation, at least one Celestial Human Realm ancestor must be within the family. Therefore, this time an addition of 8 points, reaching 29, is the maximum possible.
"Hmm, the improvement is not bad." Wang Shouzhe looked at the updated reputation template, drinking Cloud Mist Spirit Tea, feeling quite satisfied with recent achievements.
As long as he pushes harder to eradicate the Liu and Zhao Clans, the Wang Family could truly dominate within Ping’an Town.
...
Meanwhile.
In Liu Family’s main residence, within a courtyard where clan members reside.
The young talent Liu Yongzhou had an extremely ugly expression as he gulped down alcohol. Recently, too many things had happened, like the rise of the Wang Family and his father’s death.
Everything, everything changed too quickly.
But what surprised him the most was Liu Shengye’s attitude towards him. When he slightly probed, Patriarch Liu Shengye seemed somewhat impatient, full of perfunctory.
Later, he recalled Luoxian’s words. Following her suggestion, he got Liu Yonghao drunk and learned a shocking news from his mouth.
It turns out the person chosen to follow the path of Spirit Platform after Liu Shenghao in the family had already been internally decided to be the legitimate son Liu Yonghao. Meanwhile, he, Liu Yongzhou, was merely a pawn casually used by Liu Shengye on the chessboard.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 98 Celestial Spirit Pill! Obtained ( - 4200)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 98 Celestial Spirit Pill! Obtained (Chapter 4200)_2
"Damn it!" Liu Yongzhou slammed his fist down, shattering the stone table, his eyes bloodshot and vicious. His father had even sacrificed his life for the family. And Liu Yongzhou, he couldn’t even count how many contributions he’d made.
Legitimate son Liu Yonghao! What skills did that brat have? Publicly defeated by an eleven-year-old girl in a few moves. Such a worthless person, how could he be qualified to embark on the Spirit Platform path?
Still, Luoxian was right, this family was filthy and despicable.
Luoxian, thank goodness for Luoxian.
In Liu Yongzhou’s eyes, a strong sense of hope appeared, quickly turning into a resolute look as he murmured angrily, "Liu Shengye, all of this is what the Liu Family owes me and my father. I’m just taking back what’s rightfully mine."
...
Late at night.
The blanket of night covered the land.
In a world without light pollution, the starry sky was magnificent and the moonlight enchanting.
The world was silent, with only a steed galloping on the country road, the urgent sound of hooves seemingly echoing the rider’s eager emotions.
Faster!
Even faster.
Rider Liu Yongzhou couldn’t wait to see her. His heart was filled with a fiery passion, blazing with hope for the future.
After marrying into the family, he would surely train hard, become a Spirit Platform Realm as soon as possible, and not disgrace Luoxian.
With the horse spurred on, he arrived at Xia Garden.
Liu Yongzhou dismounted, didn’t bother to announce himself, vaulted over the wall, heading straight for the Lotus Listening Pavilion.
"Luoxian, I’m here..." Liu Yongzhou’s voice halted abruptly, his pupils contracted and face changed dramatically. The scene before his eyes was...
Inside the lotus pavilion at the Lotus Listening Pavilion.
Two men in gorgeous clothing were leisurely enjoying the moonlight and sipping tea. The goddess in his heart, Zhong Luoxian, was serving them obediently by holding a teapot, pouring tea for them like a maid.
Most terrifyingly, there were large bloodstains on the pavilion floor, and a delicate brocade box was placed on the stone table they were drinking tea at.
"Wang Shouzhe, Tantai Heyu." Liu Yongzhou shouted angrily, his face pale, "What are you doing here? Let go of Miss Luoxian!"
Wang Shouzhe put down the teacup, gently pointed at the brocade box, "Yoongzhou, you’re a bit late. Look, all the summer lotuses in the pond are withered. Also, your brother Zhao Dingtian has gone ahead of you."
"You..."
Liu Yongzhou felt cold all over, shocked and furious, "Wang Shouzhe, what exactly do you want?"
"What do I want? Let me first ask, what have you done?" Wang Shouzhe laughed, pulling out a stack of papers from his pocket, seemingly filled with writing, casually pulling out one, "In the autumn of the 3140th year of Great Qian Prosperity, a traveling merchant was buying goods at too high a price, infringing on the Liu family’s interests. Liu Shengye sent you and your father to cruelly kill him two miles outside Dingpu Ferry and seize his belongings, with a total value of about 300 Qian Gold."
Liu Yongzhou trembled instantly, shouting sharply, "Wang Shouzhe, you’re slandering me. Luoxian, Luoxian, don’t believe him."
Wang Shouzhe ignored him, continued pulling out a paper, "In the summer of Changlong 3142, your fishing team discovered an isolated merchant ship. You used your excellent Water Escape Technique to first pierce the ship’s bottom, causing a shipwreck and pretending to save them. Upon discovering valuable silk on board, you ruthlessly murdered thirteen people and seized the goods. Most appalling, two young women guests were taken away by you, their whereabouts still unknown."
Liu Yongzhou staggered, having kept this secret so hidden, only a few confidants knew. How did Wang Shouzhe find out?
Then, Wang Shouzhe took paper after paper, listing all of Liu Yongzhou’s misdeeds over the years, his face growing colder. In the end, he grew tired of reading and simply slammed the charges onto the table, speaking coldly, "Liu Yongzhou, I’ll give you a chance to explain."
"Luoxian, don’t believe him, it’s all slander. They’re trying to divide us because the Wang Family is our enemy. Luoxian, Luoxian, say something." Liu Yongzhou shouted hysterically.
"I’m sorry." Wang Shouzhe slowly stood up, walking step by step towards Liu Yongzhou, his seemingly calm eyes filled with intense killing intent, "Most of this evidence was helped by Luoxian to investigate and confirm."
"What?" Liu Yongzhou took several steps back in shock and disbelief.
"Patriarch, this is what I should do." ’Zhong Luoxian’ said flatteringly, "It’s my honor to do things for the patriarch."
"Pfft! Zhong Luoxian, you tricked me." Liu Yongzhou flushed, spitting out blood.
He was considered a shrewd person, and at this point, he couldn’t see he had been duped.
Driven by instinct, he retreated hastily, escaping, escaping the scene.
"Clang!"
The sound of a sword rang out, and Wang Shouzhe’s figure soared through the air, graceful and swift, like a hawk in flight.
"Clang! Clang! Clang!"
At the critical moment of crisis, Liu Yongzhou’s potential erupted, drawing the Water-Splitting Needle from his waist and blocking several strikes. Eventually, he couldn’t withstand the continuous and increasingly strong outbursts of the Profound Origin Sword.
"Boom!"
In mid-air, he spewed blood and flew backward, falling towards a pond of withered lotus.
But before he could fall, the white Sword Aura flashed twice more. In the final moment of his life, Liu Yongzhou only felt his head flying, his body caught by Wang Shouzhe and thrown onto the bank.
"Splash!"
His head landed in the pond among the withered lotuses.
It all happened very quickly.
Wang Mei swiftly followed, not bothering the patriarch, searching the body. Then, placing the spoils and a brocade box on the stone table.
"Gulp!" Chen Fangjie, witnessing Wang Shouzhe kill someone for the second time, was still frightened by his clean and swift action.
This future brother-in-law, whether his intelligence or strength, was truly terrifying.
Chen Fangjie felt that even if he tried with all his might, he might not be his match. In the future, as his brother-in-law, he’d have to tread carefully, not daring to make a single misstep.
"Patriarch, it’s been checked. The Celestial Spirit Pill, along with the two auxiliary Spirit Pills, the Body-Protecting Pill and Spirit Blood Pill, are all here." Wang Mei was overjoyed, after plotting for so long, putting so much effort, it was all for this moment.
"Well done, Wang Mei." Wang Shouzhe also let out a sigh of relief, forcibly suppressing his ecstatic mood.
After plotting for so long, having obtained two Celestial Spirit Pills and all the auxiliary materials was enough to put the Wang Family on the express track to prosperity.
Seeing this, Chen Fangjie’s eyelid twitched, swallowing his saliva. These were Celestial Spirit Pills, their East Port Chen Family would have to save many years for one.
But this future brother-in-law managed to get two in one go.
"Do you want it?" Wang Shouzhe first put away one brocade box, then looked at Chen Fangjie with a smile.
"Yes, yes, yes, while our Chen Family doesn’t have the money right now, I can write an IOU, use it as collateral." Chen Fangjie nodded repeatedly, "As long as the price is a bit cheaper."
"Hehe~" Wang Shouzhe then put away another brocade box, "This time, there’s nothing for you."
In an instant, Chen Fangjie’s mindset almost exploded, no wonder Shouzhe didn’t let him join the final act, fearing he couldn’t handle it!
Regret! Shouldn’t have come. As the saying goes, what the eyes don’t see, the heart won’t fret.
Chen Fangjie could only say sourly, "Shouzhe, your plan seems good, but ultimately too risky. With my two more years of experience than you, I’m telling you, especially in these final moments, your layout isn’t appropriate. What if they found out? What if an ancestral-level figure came along? You should’ve told me earlier, I could’ve asked our family ancestor for help, splitting the spoils thirty percent for me!"
"Shouzhe is ultimately too young, remember this next time, it’s better to be safe than sorry. You’re just too stingy. This matter you must..."
Before the words were finished, Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands, speaking solemnly, "Ancestor Longyan, the matter is settled, we can leave."
Long, Ancestor Longyan?
Chen Fangjie chuckled, "Shouzhe, are you teasing me?"
Suddenly, his whole body shuddered, his face changed.
He saw a figure, elegant and serene, silently descending in the night, cold eyes behind a veil glancing at Chen Fangjie coldly, "Your Chen Family’s ancestor, stronger than me?"
"Child Fangjie, pays respect to Ancestor Longyan. Meeting the ancestor unexpectedly, I am immensely excited, overjoyed, it’s like seeing the morning star in the long night. Fangjie wishes the ancestor eternal peace, eternal well-being."
Then, Chen Fangjie, being very clever, truly knelt down, with an expression of extreme reverence, his eyes excited, kowtowing devoutly.
How could he not be devout? Offending her, and even his future wife would be gone~
...
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 99 Impact on Spirit Platform & Lici’s hard work (4100)
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 99 Impact on Spirit Platform & Lici’s hard work (4100)
...
All along, Chen Fangjie felt that he wasn’t the most clever type of person.
He did things by the book, with a certain steadiness and grace, earning praise and affection from the clan elders. Even the two ancestors in the family favored him quite a bit.
But for some reason, ever since he got involved with his future brother-in-law Wang Shouzhe, that innate cleverness seemed to jump out of him.
There was no other way because Shouzhe always set traps for him to fall into. If he didn’t force out some cleverness, he would have long been tricked terribly.
This brat didn’t even give him a heads-up before arranging for Ancestor Longyan to be there.
Ancestor Longyan glanced at him up and down and said calmly, "You have a silver tongue. You’ll need Miss Luoyi to properly discipline you later, stand up."
Chen Fangjie smiled wryly; in his twenty or so years of life, it was his first time being described as having a silver tongue. Shouzhe, oh Shouzhe, you’ve really set me up badly.
However, he got up and continued to speak honestly, "Yes, yes, Ancestor’s critique is right. In the future, whatever Luoyi says, I’ll listen." After all, it’s his own wife, discipline, teaching, whatever works!
"Brother Chen, I’ve got pressing matters on hand. Won’t be able to entertain, you should rest early." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands with a smile and then left Xia Garden together with Ancestor Longyan.
After Wang Shouzhe left, Chen Fangjie felt rather bitter, "Rest? My heart is full of envy and jealousy, how can it calm enough to rest? Forget it, Wang Mei, just arrange a guest room for me anywhere." He had said before that as long as he participated in the finale, the spoils didn’t matter. Then... Shouzhe really didn’t mind.
"Young Clan Leader Chen, this Xia Garden is my property." Wang Mei looked him up and down, "And you are the future husband of Miss Luoyi. Us being alone in one room would not be good for our reputation. Please, make yourself at home."
Make myself at home? Ah?
Chen Fangjie was utterly confused, it’s almost dawn, where do you expect me to make myself at home?
...
Time passed.
The sky was already slightly bright.
A small boat with a black canopy sailed peacefully through the river, gently rippling as it moved towards the family property [Xingsheng Farm].
Liu Yongzhou and Zhao Dingtian were both elites within the clan, having handled countless operations for the family, both overt and covert. In the matter of stealing the Celestial Spirit Pill, they had certainly planned thoroughly, making it unlikely to be discovered in the short term.
Otherwise, even if they got hold of the Celestial Spirit Pill, they wouldn’t have time to elope with Zhong Luoxian.
But Wang Shouzhe was even more cautious. Having finally obtained the [Celestial Spirit Pill], along with auxiliary materials for advancement.
He certainly wouldn’t waste any time, delivering it immediately to Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan.
As long as Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, it would truly be assured. Moreover, there were two sets of advancement materials this time, ensuring an Ancestor Spirit Platform would emerge.
This time with Ancestor Longyan accompanying the journey, it was the utmost safety, and at this moment Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t mind if some blind ancestor stumbled upon them.
No words along the journey.
Upon arriving at [Xingsheng Farm], the sky was already lightening.
After communication.
In no time, Wang Xiaohan hurried to meet them. After a brief greeting, they entered a hidden cave in the Liping Mountain Range beside the farm.
This cave was a secret emergency refuge dug out by the ancestors using a natural cave, with a spring inside and some stored food.
At the bottom of the refuge, there was a secret passage for escape.
Even a cunning hare has three burrows, much less a family that has been running for over a hundred years. Most major family properties, even the main residence, would have some secret storage points, concealed paths, etc., for emergency escape and avoidance.
This refuge made it the safest place for Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan to advance to the Spirit Platform Realm, guarded by Ancestor Longyan at the entrance, she could truly block ten thousand with her presence alone.
"Sixth Grandfather, how is the preparation going?" Wang Shouzhe asked with a bow.
At this moment, Wang Xiaohan, after about a month’s body conditioning, looked very well. With the help of the Peiyuan Pill and a large amount of Spiritual Food, his complexion was rosy and his body was full of vital energy.
"Very good, I’m ready to attempt the breakthrough." Wang Xiaohan said spiritedly, though there was still a hint of uncertainty in his gaze due to a previous failure.
Wang Shouzhe joked, "Sixth Grandfather, you’ve had the experience, you’re not like a bashful young girl on her first bridal sedan. You’ve done this before, it’s familiar. Your Heaven and Earth Two Bridges have been washed and nourished by the Celestial Spirit Pill, you should be more experienced than others, this time you will surely open the Spirit Platform. Besides, I’ve prepared two sets of advancement materials for you; if need be, we can spend another month conditioning and try again."
"You, where did you learn to tease like this, even daring to jest with your Sixth Grandfather." Wang Xiaohan laughed, his mood visibly lightening, "Though you really know how to comfort, Sixth Grandfather’s spirits have lifted."
Actually, everyone knew that to reach the Spirit Platform Realm, the first step was to break open the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges, allowing Profound Qi to enter the Spirit Platform, to open the Spirit Platform, and to concentrate Spiritual Sense. Once the Spirit Platform was opened, human Profound Qi could complete a Grand Circulation, allowing the body’s functions to undergo a fundamental transformation.
The human Spirit Platform is inherently mysterious and fragile; if the first attempt to open it fails, it often leaves some trauma, affecting the second attempt.
Thus, breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm becomes increasingly difficult with each attempt, especially so when attempting a second breakthrough shortly thereafter, often with a lower chance of success.

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 99: Impact on Spirit Platform & Lici’s Hard Work (4100)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 99: Impact on Spirit Platform & Lici’s Hard Work (4100)_2
Fortunately, it has been nearly twenty years since Wang Xiaohan’s last failed breakthrough attempt. Even though the Spirit Platform was damaged and repaired slowly, it should have recovered by now.
Currently, Wang Xiaohan’s greatest problem is still a psychological one.
"Ancestor Longyan," Wang Shouzhe turned and cupped his hands, saying, "I’ll trouble you to serve as a protector here; Shouzhe will wait outside."
Breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm is quite taboo to be disturbed, as there is bound to be a lot of unsettled emotions.
The real world is different from fantasy novels where breakthroughs during battles happen frequently, which is nonsense in reality. If one tries to breakthrough to the Spirit Platform Realm during a fight, they’ll end up dead quicker.
Wang Shouzhe left the secret refuge, and outside, the sky was already bright.
He waited outside for a while but felt too idle. He thought of his niece, Wang Lici, whom he had left to toil at the Xingsheng Farm for almost a month now.
After a month of grinding and hardship, surely this child has developed some patience and understood the law of "no pain, no gain."
Oh well, let’s go check on her and bring her back.
By now, she should have slimmed down quite a bit, right?
To be honest, Wang Shouzhe really liked and loved this niece a lot, and couldn’t bear to let her suffer any more hardship.
Shouzhe already foresaw the scene where Lici’s maid dashes toward him, crying passionately and saying, "Fourth Uncle, I was wrong. I will certainly work hard from now on."
And so on, and so forth.
With this thought, Wang Shouzhe’s steps became lighter and more joyful.
...
Meanwhile.
By the farm’s [Spirit Field], several young men from tenant farmer families were busily at work under a cool shed. They had prepared fresh fruits, grills, charcoal, fresh fish, chicken legs, chicken wings, pork belly, and vegetables.
They swiftly grilled the ingredients, some of which were already smelling delicious and ready to eat.
At this moment.
A young woman ran in, scanning the area with proud and critical eyes before sniffing the smell of grilling and said, "Have the chicken legs and wings been marinated? You all know, the young lady is very picky, and there can’t be any mistakes."
"Miss Wang, everything’s marinated." One young man nodded, bending over courteously, "As instructed, this time we’re using top-quality smokeless fruit charcoal. In the marinade, we are using top-grade snowflake fine salt, along with Shaoxing wine, cumin, chili powder, and other seasonings."
Just then.
A voice outside announced: "Miss Lici has arrived."
Then, the young men and women inside the cool shed straightened up solemnly in a welcoming posture.
Two young men carried in a Master’s Chair, with a girl sitting on it, her face somewhat chubby, holding a large black-and-white cat in her arms.
This girl was none other than Wang Lici, who had been sent here for labor. Smelling the barbecue, she instantly perked up, her eyes scanning the food critically.
"Give me two chicken legs, five wings, and half a pound of pork belly to fill my stomach first," she ordered casually, "and more pork belly for my HuaaHuaa."
"As you wish."
Delicious barbecue was served one by one, and Wang Lici reclined in the Master’s Chair, her left hand holding a chicken leg and her right a wing, eating heartily and delightfully.
Her large cat also gave a howl and pounced into a huge platter, devouring the grilled pork belly voraciously.
Truly, it was a case of "like owner, like pet." This large spotted cat was plump and round, eating fiercely.
"Not bad, not bad, give me five more chicken legs."
"Miss, slow down, nobody’s competing with you," the young woman named Wang advised, massaging her shoulders, "Eating too fast can be stressful."
...
The feasting Wang Lici never suspected that Wang Shouzhe was already standing beside the thatched house, his face as dark as water.
"Hehe~ Wang Shouzhe, ah, Wang Shouzhe, you’re still too young," Wang Shouzhe felt his body trembling, his cheeks twitching violently.
What happened to toiling under the sun, dripping sweat?
What happened to studying diligently by moonlight?
Wang Lici!
Hehe~ To think your fourth uncle cares so much for you. Just when Wang Shouzhe was about to step out and catch her, intending to throw her into the Gongsun Family’s mine shaft for reform.
Suddenly.
A young man stepped forward with a flattering smile, "Miss, why don’t you deal with the Spirit Rats while eating? As you know, our White Jade Spirit Rice is at a critical stage of filling grains—the longer the Spirit Rats wreak havoc, the more the yield decreases."
Spirit Rats?
Wang Shouzhe froze.
Spirit Rats are the number one enemy of Spirit Fields. Unlike ordinary Fierce Beasts, their small size makes them hard to hide. They appear mysteriously wherever there are Spirit Fields, voracious and with a staggering appetite.
In past years, although Wang Family’s Spirit Fields always suffered raids from Spirit Rats resulting in varying degrees of yield reduction. Even with Wang Xiaohan, who was well-experienced and had cultivation at the Peak of Qi Refining Realm, had little solution to this pest.
Despite efforts to capture them, it’s only slightly controlled. Their small size and rapid speed, appearing and disappearing in swarms, and nests hidden and complex, making smoke and water flooding ineffective against them.
Wang Shouzhe was perplexed; could it be that this girl Lici had a solution for Spirit Rats? Relying on her chubby large spotted cat?
"Okay, HuaaHuaa, go," Wang Lici knew Spirit Rice is precious, being part of her family business, she immediately commanded her large cat.
"Growl." The large spotted cat was happily eating and ignored her, growling dissatisfied.
"Hehe, I, Wang Lici, can’t tame you?" Wang Lici sneered said, "If you don’t catch the Spirit Rats, that’s fine. Just pay me back in Qian Gold for everything you’ve eaten. Take away HuaaHuaa’s pork belly."
Someone acted as said and took away the platter.
The poor large spotted cat had no Qian Gold to redeem itself and instantly looked aggrieved, growling, and dashed into the Spirit Field like the wind.
Immediately, the Spirit Rats squeaked and fled everywhere in the Spirit Field.
By this time, Wang Shouzhe was already stunned.
This cat called HuaaHuaa, where was it a cat; it clearly was a juvenile Tiger-like Fierce Beast!
To be well-versed in memorizing the Fierce Beast Atlas is a fundamental skill for disciples of the Wang Family. From memory, Wang Shouzhe could only identify it as one of the common Tiger-like Fierce beasts’ juveniles.
Because most Tiger-like Fierce beast juveniles look very similar, it’s hard to distinguish. But whichever Tiger-like Fierce beast it is, once matured, it would reach at least Tier Three!
A Tier Three Fierce Beast! That’s equivalent to a human Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator.
What kind of person is Wang Lici? Actually raising a juvenile Fierce Beast? Where did she get it? How did she tame it... Also, when did juvenile Fierce beasts start catching Spirit Rats?
Just when Wang Shouzhe was confused.
HuaaHuaa had finished the job, bringing out Spirit Rats that were bitten dead one by one, and lining them up neatly. The largest of the Spirit Rats was nearly a pound, plump and fat.
Unlike ordinary mice, Spirit Rats that only eat Spirit Rice are very clean, tender, and rich in vitality, making them a very delicious, nourishing Spiritual Food.
"Growl!" The juvenile tiger roared fiercely, adorably fierce, indicating to humans to barbecue the Spirit Rat meat.
"Wait!" Wang Lici leisurely walked over and said, "According to loot allocation principles, half for each of us."
Then, she began to split them fairly.
"One for you, one for me." "One for me, one for me, one for you."
Thus, the ten Spirit Rats were divided into two piles, her share having seven. And the share for the little tiger, HuaaHuaa, had only three, all skinny Spirit Rats.
The clueless little tiger scratched its head, feeling something was wrong but couldn’t figure out what. Forget it, forget it, let’s barbecue and eat, growl, growl, humans!
Then, Wang Lici packed her "half" of the loot into a bag, smiling triumphantly: "Fourth Uncle’s advice is indeed right; learning the Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art is useful."
Such shameless words shocked Wang Shouzhe immensely!
This big niece, could she be any more shameless?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 100: Advancement! Ancestor Xiaohan (4000)
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 100: Advancement! Ancestor Xiaohan (4000)
...
"It’s no wonder that Miss Lici is so good at arithmetic. I hear it was taught by the Clan Leader himself."
Wang Shouzhe’s face flushed, he couldn’t afford such a student.
"Not only is Miss Lici good at arithmetic, but she is also highly regarded by the Clan Leader, who has sent her to oversee the major affairs of Xingsheng Farm. It shows how high her status is in the family, doesn’t it?"
Overseeing major affairs? Wang Shouzhe was dumbfounded. When did I appoint her to oversee major affairs? Could it be that I have dementia?
Right, I sent you to suffer hardships, and here you are flaunting your authority.
"The Clan Leader is indeed good at recognizing talents. Our Wang Family is set to prosper."
The tenant farmers’ children, or members of the Wang Family’s branches, began to flatter Wang Lici lavishly, bombarding her with praise.
They made Wang Lici feel ecstatic, as if she was floating in the clouds. Lying on that Master’s Chair, she lay like a puddle of soft mud, with a big chicken leg in her mouth, saying, "I’m flattered, truly flattered. It’s all thanks to Uncle Four’s usual guidance and teachings."
This...
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t bear to listen any longer. Did I usually guide and teach you like this? It’s me, your Uncle Four, who should truly feel ’flattered’!
"By the way, before I set out, Uncle Four repeatedly reminded me, ’Lici, you must study hard and do your homework diligently.’ My expression suddenly turned serious, ’I, Wang Lici, am deeply anticipated and beloved by Uncle Four, and I absolutely cannot be careless with my daily assignments.’
"Miss Lici really is diligent, her future prospects are limitless."
"Miss, which piece are we reading today?" asked a cautious girl from the Wang Family branches.
?
Wang Shouzhe’s steps halted again, and a warm feeling of comfort flowed through his heart. Our family’s big girl, although lazy and carefree, and thick-skinned.
But in the end, she still took his words to heart. Ultimately, she knows that she has to study diligently every day.
"Let’s read the eternal classic ’Clan Leader’s Words’, a famous piece by a wise Clan Leader of a generation. It’s said to be beneficial for managing the family. In the future, this lady is going to take on the great responsibilities of the family, after all."
```
