Wang Shouzhe secretly nodded. This piece is not bad, it contains many wise sayings and it’s a model for managing family ethos. It looks like the big girl still has some ambition.
Then, that girl from the Wang Family branches started reading aloud, "The Clan Leader says, governing a big clan is like cooking small fish... The Clan Leader says: Marry a wise wife, as it’s said, ’The husband is the outline of the wife, and the wife is the outline of the child...’"
Not bad, not bad!
Wang Shouzhe nodded twice, but suddenly felt something was off. Why did the voices sound odd?
Then he peeked and saw that the girl from the Wang Family branches was reading while nodding her head, while the big girl Wang Lici was half-closing her eyes, listening while gnawing on a chicken leg, occasionally pretending to nod her head. And as she listened, she fell asleep holding the chicken leg...
Asleep, she occasionally took a bite of the chicken leg, smiling silly and contentedly. It seemed this life couldn’t be more carefree and leisurely.
Wang Shouzhe stood there, feeling as if a bucket of cold water had been poured over him on a hot summer day, chilling him from head to toe.
Studying diligently!
This is what Wang Lici calls studying diligently!
Is this child still wanted?
Can’t afford to keep her. Send her to the mines.
Wang Shouzhe felt that if he continued to let Wang Lici wander in front of him, it would shorten his lifespan.
He really couldn’t bear to watch anymore.
Wang Shouzhe walked out from beside the thatched cottage with his hands behind his back, heading toward the pavilion.
The girl who was reading had sharp eyes, she seemed to have seen Wang Shouzhe before. Her face changed color immediately, hurriedly approaching to greet him, "Wang Juan greets the Clan Leader."
The other branch members and young people from tenant families were dumbfounded when they heard the Clan Leader had arrived, rushing forward to pay their respects, "Greetings to the Clan Leader."
"All rise." Wang Shouzhe said warmly, "I’m just here to see this child Lici. Oh, why is this child asleep so early in the morning?"
Everyone’s faces turned pale, and they didn’t dare say a word.
Wang Juan’s face turned pale, she spoke in a trembling low voice, "Miss, Miss Lici stayed up too late studying last night. She was also entrusted by the Spirit Field tenant farmers this morning to catch Spirit Rats, she might be too exhausted."
"Your name is Wang Juan, you know me?" Wang Shouzhe asked noncommittally.
"Replying, replying to the Clan Leader." Wang Juan replied honestly, "I saw you before at the Clan Academy."
Clan Academy.
Hmm, it’s the internal school of the Wang Family. Besides the family descendants, the children of Household Generals, and more outstanding branch members are all able to study at the Clan Academy. Alternatively, currently, most of the students at the Clan Academy are branch members, while the direct and lineage members, how many are there in total?
The children of the branch members, once they’ve learned something, many of them will join the various industries of the Wang Family and become the backbone. Those with outstanding abilities, along with age and experience, gradually become stewards, chief stewards, and so forth.
"Hmm, you study well, you must have put in a lot of effort. Do a good job, as the family develops, various aspects all need talent." Wang Shouzhe nodded and praised. For a family to develop, talent is indispensable.
To become a core elite, having culture is essential. You can’t expect someone who barely knows a few characters to take on the role of steward or chief steward, right?
Being praised and remembered by the Clan Leader made Wang Juan’s cheeks flush with excitement. She quickly thanked him again, "Wang Juan will definitely work hard."
Then, Wang Shouzhe strolled over to Wang Lici.
"Awoo~~" Little Brain Axe Hua Hua, who had never seen Wang Shouzhe, instinctively felt from its Fierce Beast sense that this human was very dangerous and guarded Lici in front of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 100 Promotion! Ancestor Xiaohan (4000)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 100 Promotion! Ancestor Xiaohan (4000)_2
It let out a playful roar, but its size wasn’t much bigger than a cat, utterly lacking the aura of a tiger’s roar in the mountains.
This roar, however, woke up Wang Lici. She grabbed the little tiger, HuaaHuaa, by the scruff of its neck and scolded, "HuaaHuaa, how many times have I told you? When this miss is studying hard, don’t howl around. Do you have any idea how disruptive that is?"
The little tiger looked aggrieved and whimpered a few times in defense.
"Oh, you’ve grown up and dare to talk back now. Hehe~ Deduct five, no, ten Qian Gold." Wang Lici took out a small notebook and made a note, "Hmm, HuaaHuaa, you already owe me six hundred Qian Gold. Remember, work hard to pay off your debt."
The little tiger, HuaaHuaa, looked frustrated. How did it owe so much? It couldn’t even count that high, anyway, it was a lot.
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched a couple of times.
Is it really okay to bully a ferocious beast cub like this?
Tiger-like ferocious beasts are very intelligent. Once they reach Tier Three adulthood, they become incredibly smart and lively, comparable to ordinary humans. If tamed by a human Spirit Beast Master, they could even read and write.
It’s said that if a beast reaches Tier Five, it becomes incredibly cunning and clever, capable of many ways to communicate with humans. Rare Tier Five beasts can even speak human language.
So, the ferocious beasts and spirit beasts in this world are not simple creatures, far from mere wild monsters.
Just as Wang Shouzhe was complaining in his mind, Wang Lici’s gaze caught someone out of the corner of her eye—this, this, this... Fourth, Fourth Uncle... Could Lici be dreaming?
Suddenly, she felt as if struck by lightning, her calves trembled, and her chubby face turned pale as she stammered, "F-Fourth Uncle, w-why are you here?"
In front of outsiders, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t embarrass her. He just chuckled and said, "I came to the farm on business and decided to check on you."
He looked around, squinting with a smile, "Not bad, not bad, you’re doing quite well."
"So-so," Wang Lici stammered, wiping the Master’s Chair diligently, "Fourth Uncle, please sit. Lici will report on recent work and studies to you."
Wang Shouzhe sat on the Master’s Chair, hmm? This chair is quite comfortable, ergonomic, but it makes one sleepy. Maybe the side study could use one for napping during tea breaks—a delightful idea.
Lici sure knows how to enjoy life.
"Why are you all standing around? The Clan Leader is here, hurry up and bring the barbecue out." Wang Lici turned around and bossily ordered, "Little Three, go and prepare one, no, two, no, three spirit mice for roasting, and let the Clan Leader have a taste."
When she said three, she gritted her teeth, showing just how much effort she was putting in to flatter the Clan Leader.
Wang Shouzhe did not refuse. At least this girl knew how to show respect to her elders, so he let her do as she pleased.
Let me nap for a bit; I’ve been awake for two days planning the Celestial Spirit Pill. Even with his Qi Refining Realm at the seventh layer, fatigue was setting in.
This Master’s Chair is indeed comfortable.
He closed his eyes and half an hour passed.
When he opened his eyes, much of his exhaustion had faded, and his nose caught a whiff of delicious aromas.
"Fourth Uncle, you’re awake? You’ve been working hard for the family." Wang Lici flattered him, massaging his back and shoulders, acting like a considerate little helper.
She then served the spirit mouse barbecue. Wang Shouzhe seemed interested, tried a piece, and found the flavor quite nice, with tender and smooth meat carrying a fragrance akin to White Jade Spirit Rice.
After finishing one, still unsatisfied, he reached for the second. Yet Wang Lici had also finished one and quickly grabbed the second to eat it.
Wang Shouzhe was dumbfounded, realizing the three roasted spirit mice weren’t solely for him. Moreover, Big Girl, didn’t you just eat too much barbecue?
Under his gaze, Wang Lici stopped, blinking at Wang Shouzhe with curiosity, wondering if one wasn’t enough for him.
Then, she made up her mind, tore off a piece of the [front leg], and handed it to Wang Shouzhe.
Thank you so much!
A million alpacas ran through Wang Shouzhe’s mind.
...
In a hidden sanctuary.
Wang Xiaohan was at the final stage of breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm, his whole body surging with vigor, pores opening as tendrils of white mist enveloped him.
After a long time, the mist gathered and was absorbed back into his body.
He opened his eyes, and a powerful vigor burst forth.
"Success! I, Wang Xiaohan, have succeeded."
In an instant, tears streamed down his face. Twenty years, a whole twenty years.
Ever since he failed his costly attempt to ascend to the Spirit Platform Realm, he felt like a sinner to the family. From then on, he secluded himself at Xingsheng Farm, cultivating White Jade Orchid Spirit Rice for the family.
A long cry shook the cavern with a faint tremor. He felt a tremendous metamorphosis in his body and sensed the miraculous spiritual sense in his Spirit Platform, which had myriad incredible uses.
Moreover, with spiritual sense came the ability to wield spiritual artifacts. A Spirit Platform Realm adept with a spiritual artifact had combat strength far beyond those without.
Quickly, he suppressed his internal joy. He took a devout bath to cleanse the filth following his breakthrough.
Afterward, Wang Xiaohan, dressed in rough hemp garments, walked out of the secret storage cavern.
At this moment.
Ancestor Longyan, Wang Shouzhe, and Wang Lici were already waiting at the entrance.
As Wang Xiaohan stepped into the sunlight, his essence, qi, and spirit were markedly different. His energy was vigorous, his complexion rosy like a newborn, and his eyes sharp as a hawk’s.
Even Wang Shouzhe looked at him, feeling an overwhelming awe.
Success!
Wang Shouzhe was equally overjoyed, his heart buoyant. The Wang Family had declined for many years, barely sustained by the gravely injured Ancestor Longyan.
The entire family had been treading on thin ice, cautious not to offend on one side and wary on the other, living daily with their tails between their legs.
Why?
Because there was no ancestor to take charge at home.
Even when someone bullied you, you were powerless, unable to send the severely injured Ancestor Longyan to win back justice?
Just two words: oppressive frustration!
Even the annual autumn and winter hunts only dared skirt the outer domain’s edges before hastily returning. What could they rely on in case of a fierce beast encounter? Offer their heads?
And not long ago, Chen Fangjie sent some Iron-backed Wild Boar meat, hunted by their own people’s discovery of that Tier Two pinnacle ferocious beast and the intervention of the Chen Family’s ancestor.
Such an opportunity, when given to the Wang Family, had to be abandoned. Without a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor’s intervention, hunting Tier Two pinnacle ferocious beasts was too perilous.
But now, things are different.
Ancestor Longyan would soon refine all the Evil Qi in her body. After using the Creation Pill to gradually repair herself, she would truly return to her peak.
However, Ancestor Longyan must remain the ultimate trump card, not to be used lightly.
Now, with Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan as a conventional Spirit Platform Realm ancestor, the scope for strategic deployments had widened, and the Wang Family would embark on its rapid development path.
"Congratulations Sixth Grandfather! On ascension to the Spirit Platform Realm!" Wang Shouzhe and Wang Lici stepped forward to offer their congratulations, their voices tinged with excitement.
For any Spirit Platform Race family, this was a momentous event.
Even Ancestor Longyan’s deep star-like eyes shimmered with faint tears. How many years had it been, supporting the family by herself?
The family invested vast resources and effort into nurturing a Spirit Platform Realm ascendant, yet it failed repeatedly.
Tormented by the Yin Sha Evil Qi to the point of despair, Ancestor Longyan didn’t even dare to die. For if she perished, the Wang Family would have no Spirit Platform successor, and annihilation would ensue!
Our Wang Family will rise!
Wang Shouzhe’s heart was ablaze with fervor. With Sixth Grandfather’s successful ascension, not only had his sense of security greatly increased.
The death days of the Liu and Zhao Clans were also numbered.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 101: Opportunity! Fire Spiritual Vein and Spirit Fruit
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 101: Opportunity! Fire Spiritual Vein and Spirit Fruit
...
"Many thanks to Ancestor for watching over me." Wang Xiaohan calmed his excited emotions and bowed devoutly to Ancestor Longyan.
"No need for formalities." Ancestor Longyan’s voice also carried a trace of excitement as she remarked, "You should thank Shouzhe more; he worked hard to acquire the Celestial Spirit Pill."
"Of course." Wang Xiaohan turned around and gave a deep bow to Wang Shouzhe, "Shouzhe, in my life, I never dreamed I could advance to the Spirit Platform Realm. Thank you, Shouzhe!"
"Sixth Grandfather, please don’t. You are the elder; how could you make such a salute? Don’t take away Shouzhe’s good fortune." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly supported his arm, smiling as he said, "We, the Wang Family, naturally have to support each other; there’s no need to thank. Moreover, with you becoming Ancestor Xiaohan, the burden on my shoulders is lighter. No longer need to borrow others’ ancestors."
Other families’ ancestors, no matter how close the relationship, are still others’.
Take Ancestor Mang, for example; he is naturally willing to be close to Wang Shouzhe and occasionally help. But we cannot always rely on him, as Ancestor Mang also needs to watch over the Gongsun Family.
"Haha, you always have an interesting way of speaking." Ancestor Xiaohan laughed, "In any case, from now on, Sixth Grandfather is like the sword in your hand; wherever you want to strike, Sixth Grandfather will strike."
At this moment, Wang Lici also rushed over, kneeling down and hugging Wang Xiaohan’s leg: "Lici greets Ancestor Xiaohan, wishing you ever-increasing cultivation, rising to Celestial Human."
"Oh, Lici, you’re really good at flattery. It’s so comfortable." Wang Xiaohan laughed as he ruffled her hair, seeing through her little scheme with one glance, "Could it be you’ve done something to anger your fourth uncle again?"
"No, no, I truly am just happy for Ancestor Xiaohan." Wang Lici said with a straight face, "Fourth Uncle loves me so much; how could I anger him?"
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched. Have you not angered me enough already?
"By the way, Sixth Grandfather," Wang Shouzhe said, "where did that fierce beast little tiger of Lici’s come from?"
"Oh, you’ll have to ask her yourself." Wang Xiaohan laughed, "This girl only stayed on the farm for a couple of days before sneaking into the mountains to play. By the time I found her, she already had that little tiger with her. I’ve been too busy adjusting my health to inquire further."
"Roar, roar." At this time, the little tiger, HuaaHuaa, leapt out, rolling and roaring on the ground, trying to assert its presence, indicating that it was the one being talked about.
"You’ve sneaked into the mountains to play again; do you not value your life? Have you forgotten the last lesson..." Wang Shouzhe scolded with a stern face but hesitated halfway through his words. Why add the word ’again’?
Memories emerged; it seemed the girl had done this before. More than two years ago, she picked some unknown wild fruit in the mountains and shared it with her two younger sisters.
As a result, the three of them had severe vomiting and diarrhea for seven or eight days, nearly losing their lives.
The incident caused quite a stir, and Wang Lici was grounded for three months. Additionally, the family prohibited children from playing in the mountains.
While Wang Shouzhe was pondering, Ancestor Longyan spoke, "Girl, come let me take a look."
Wang Lici, adept at buttering up, immediately ran over when summoned by the ancestor, kowtowing and then cuddling in Ancestor Longyan’s arms, "Ancestor, Lici missed you."
"I also heard about your matters. Your fourth uncle does it for your own good. You should listen to him more." Ancestor Longyan seemed to be in a great mood. Then, she gently grabbed her wrist, letting a tiny strand of profound qi enter her body.
"Hiss, so cold." Wang Lici shivered, her face turning pale.
"Ancestor, this is..." Wang Shouzhe’s heart tightened as well. The ancestor’s profound qi carried a powerful Profound Ice Attribute, and now, having gradually refined the Yin Fiend evil qi, it was tinged with it.
"Don’t worry." Ancestor Longyan said calmly, "Shouzhe, haven’t you noticed? The child’s blood energy is too vigorous."
"Huh?" Only then did Wang Shouzhe carefully observe Wang Lici’s qi and blood, and what he saw also startled him, "Such vigorous blood energy, could it be this mischievous child has been eating spiritual food at every meal?"
Previously, Wang Shouzhe somewhat noticed her blood energy was a bit vigorous, thinking it was because she had been living too comfortably, eating too much daily. However, upon closer inspection, her blood energy was excessively vigorous.
Spiritual food is good, able to quickly replenish qi and blood. But if consumed too much, without time to practice and refine, it can cause irreversible harm to the body’s organs.
Even with Wang Shouzhe’s current cultivation level, he dared not eat spiritual food at every meal; it’s best to eat it once every other day or so.
"Strange, this child’s cultivation realm..." Wang Shouzhe remarked puzzledly, "It seems she’s already at the second-layer peak, and it’s only been a month."
A month ago, this child had not yet reached the middle tier of the second layer. Even with vigorous blood energy and diligent practice every day, the speed should not be this fast. When she was seven or eight, her talent was assessed as Lower Grade C.
Such a rate of cultivation couldn’t even be achieved by Wang Shouzhe at that age, no matter the abundance of resources.
"It’s not because of eating too much spiritual food." Ancestor Longyan’s brow slightly furrowed, "Within her vigorous blood energy, there’s a natural spiritual power from a fire attribute. It seems as though she consumed some high-tier fire-type spirit pill or some kind of fire element Heavenly and Earthly Treasure."

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 101 Opportunity! Fire Spiritual Vein and Spirit Fruit_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 101 Opportunity! Fire Spiritual Vein and Spirit Fruit_2
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback. Both of these things are not something that can be casually consumed. Immediately, he sternly said, "Big girl, what did you eat in the mountains?"
"I, I don’t know, it was just some wild berries." Wang Lici was so frightened that her legs went soft, and she was on the verge of tears. "And also, and also, when Huaahua was found, there was a pretty red fruit tree with a red fruit on it, it looked delicious..."
"And then you just ate it?" Wang Shouzhe felt exhausted. How could this girl be so bold and reckless, eating random wild berries whose names she didn’t even know?
"HuaaHuaa wouldn’t let me eat it, so we fought." Wang Lici weakly said, "I couldn’t beat it, so I traded it half of the fruit with some dried fish. I swear, I only ate half."
Wang Shouzhe secretly sneered, your "half" is probably the usual routine of eating more than half, right?
Beside them, Wang Xiaohan wore a serious expression and said, "The red fruit tree is very pretty, the fruit has a fire attribute, and there was only one fruit. Could it be the legendary Heavenly and Earthly Treasure, the Vermilion Fruit?"
"Most likely." Ancestor Longyan said gravely, "Vermilion Fruit is a High-Grade Heavenly and Earthly Treasure, usually used as the main material to refine a Tier Five Fire Element Spirit Pill. Big girl, quickly enter the Qi Refining state and attempt to break through to the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, I will assist you in controlling the Fire Qi."
"Boo hoo~" Wang Lici realized the gravity of the situation, quickly complied, and sat down to cultivate. Ancestor Longyan used her Profound Ice and a trace of Yin Sha Evil Qi to resolve the excessively vigorous fire spiritual power within her.
Wang Shouzhe and Wang Xiaohan distanced themselves to avoid disturbing them.
Seeing Wang Shouzhe’s solemn expression, Wang Xiaohan comforted, "Shouzhe, you need not worry, with your grandaunt here, that girl can count her misfortune as a blessing."
"Uncle Six, I’m not worried about that." Wang Shouzhe said helplessly, "I’m just afraid that this girl Lici will eat something randomly again. This time, the Ancestor was there to save her. What if there’s a next time and even the Ancestor can’t save her?"
"It shouldn’t come to that." Wang Xiaohan said, "Even though the Vermilion Fruit is a fire attribute spirit fruit, it’s relatively mild. Even without the Ancestor’s intervention, with the Vermilion Fruit’s spiritual power transforming her, as long as she diligently cultivates, it shouldn’t be a problem. It’s just a huge waste of the Vermilion Fruit..."
Wang Xiaohan was also speechless, the Vermilion Fruit is the main material for a Tier Five Spirit Pill. And a single Tier Five Spirit Pill is worth at least ten thousand, possibly tens of thousands! The renowned Celestial Spirit Pill is a type of Tier Five Spirit Pill.
Such an item in the hands of an Alchemy Master is treated as a treasure, yet here it was shared and eaten by a little brat and a small tiger.
Only four words can describe this.
Wasteful!
"Uncle Six." Wang Shouzhe pondered for a moment and said, "The Vermilion Fruit tree, if I remember correctly, is a perennial spirit fruit tree. And spirit fruit trees of this level definitely won’t grow without a treasured land."
"That’s correct, if we can find the place where the Vermilion Fruit tree grows, it could greatly enhance our family’s foundation." Wang Xiaohan had naturally thought of this as well, suppressing his excitement and confusion, "Most likely, there is a rare Fire Spiritual Vein. However, Ancestor Zhou Xuan had inspected the surrounding mountains back then, but didn’t find such a treasure land. I also occasionally go to the mountains, but never discovered this place..."
"The location is most likely very hidden or has another grotto heaven." Wang Shouzhe contemplated aloud, "The big girl is only at the Second Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, her pace is not fast. At most, it’s within a range of twenty to thirty miles."
With that, the two stopped discussing the topic and patiently waited.
Within less than an hour, Ancestor Longyan and Wang Lici finished their cultivation.
Wang Lici, at this moment, was full of vigor, exuding an aura that hadn’t yet subsided.
Evidently, this time, she had broken through to the Third Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Moreover, her body’s blood vitality was still very abundant... Evidently, the potential and effect of the half Vermilion Fruit had yet to be fully digested. It’s no wonder, the Vermilion Fruit is indeed a High-Tier spirit fruit capable of being refined into a Tier Five Spirit Pill.
One must admit, this lazy and thoughtless girl, her fortune is indeed terrifying. It gave Wang Shouzhe the illusion that she was the main character.
Indeed, Ancestor Longyan said, "Big girl, follow me and cultivate well, don’t be negligent, strive to break into the mid-stage of the Qi Refining Realm as soon as possible."
"Yes, Ancestor." Wang Lici knew she had caused trouble, now being particularly well-behaved and obedient.
"Big girl." Wang Shouzhe said, "Do you remember the way to that fruit tree?"
Wang Lici twisted her head and thought carefully for a moment, then shook her head blankly, "I don’t remember. I was just wandering around, then felt like there was something delicious over there, so I went."
As expected!
Even though it was somewhat expected, Wang Shouzhe still had the urge to tug her ears, all she ever thought about was eating.
"Maybe, Huaahua remembers." Wang Lici’s eyes lit up, directing her attention towards the little tiger.
Poor little tiger Huaahua, under everyone’s gaze, wore a blank expression, looking around dazed and at a loss. It seemed to express, I’m just a little brainless cub that just stopped nursing... Please don’t expect too much from me, okay? It’s too much pressure.
"Uncle Six, let’s start searching from the location where we found Lici last time." Wang Shouzhe said rather helplessly; neither the person nor the pet seemed very reliable.
"We can only do that." Wang Xiaohan nodded in agreement.
In the following days.
Wang Shouzhe, holding onto Wang Lici, started searching on the mountain. Wang Xiaohan and Ancestor Longyan also ventured out, combing through every corner nearby.
There’s no other way; this Fire Spiritual Vein must be found. It’s too important for the family, akin to adding a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor in the long run.
Finally, on the fifth day.
Going back to search for the third time, they found an extremely concealed entrance in a hidden small mountain hollow.
After entering the entrance, which was only about two to three zhang wide, everyone immediately felt a wave of heat.
"Yes, I remember now, this is the place." Wang Lici said excitedly, "Just a little further in."
Wang Shouzhe gave her a disapproving look, now you remember, this sense of direction and road-blindness is truly one of a kind.
"Everyone be careful." Ancestor Longyan said calmly, "Typically, treasure lands are often guarded by fierce beasts; there’s a good chance this place is the domain of a guardian beast, possibly HuaaHuaa’s mother."
Panic set in among them as this was said.
Wang Xiaohan was especially anxious. If there really was a Tier Three Ferocious Beast lurking here, it would mean trouble for Xingsheng Farm. But with two ancestors on the journey, even encountering a Tier Three Ferocious Beast was manageable, and they dared to venture forward seeking opportunity.
Having the advantage of two ancestors at home was indeed beneficial.
Otherwise, they could only watch as others seized their chance.
Slowly winding their way in, after merely a hundred yards, a wave of heat hit them, and the dim scene suddenly lit up with a fiery glow. Inside the mountainside, faint red liquid seemed to circulate like a red-colored vein, glistening as the scorching heat closed in.
"Middle-grade Fire Spiritual Vein."
"Vermilion Fruit Spirit Tree!"
The family’s two ancestors couldn’t help but utter in low voices, their faces alight with excitement and joy.
A spiritual treasure land like this, how dazzling a find this is.
Not far off, Wang Shouzhe noticed a pool of lava with fiery waves swirling around it, and within, it seemed like there was a skeleton-like object lying in it.
Ancestor Longyan examined it with her Longyan Sword, and then exhaled a breath of relief, "It’s a nearly decayed skeleton."
Relieved, Wang Shouzhe thought, this is for the best. He feared most that this treasure land would harbor hidden dangers. What if a big tiger returned after they had invested so much into maintaining the place?
Ancestor Xiaohan had just advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, and the family had him and the addition of this treasure land, it was truly a double blessing.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 102: Majestic in All Directions! Young Empress~ (4000)
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 102: Majestic in All Directions! Young Empress~ (4000)
...
"Ancestor, theoretically, the lifespan of Tier Three Fierce Beasts is quite long, with many living over two hundred years." Wang Shouzhe was somewhat skeptical about this matter, "How can you be certain that this is Huaahaa’s mother?"
His biggest fear was that the family would invest heavily in this Fire Element Spirit Vein, only to find that the big tiger wasn’t actually dead. If its lair was discovered occupied, it would undoubtedly be a troublesome situation.
A mature Tier Three tiger-like ferocious beast possesses considerable intelligence and combat power.
"Look at this, Shouzhe. The posture of these tiger bones suggests they were crouched in the Fire Pool, and the left leg bone, ribs have multiple fractures, with two vertebrae in the spine shattered." Ancestor Longyan calmly explained, "One can infer it suffered injuries from battle, failed to recover from its heavy injuries, and when its vitality was about to extinguish, deliberately entered the Fire Pool to incinerate itself."
"Moreover, from its pelvic cavity, we can see that it is a mature female tiger, and the pelvis is in an open state, clearly it recently gave birth shortly before dying." Ancestor Longyan concluded, "And with the Fire Pool’s temperature not being low, if this had happened long ago, the bones wouldn’t remain so intact."
Wang Shouzhe remarked, Ancestor is indeed Ancestor, having gone to the Academy and seen the world, truly knowledgeable and experienced.
"Awooo awooo." The little tiger Huaahaa seemed quite spiritedly aware of this matter too, lying in Wang Lici’s embrace, looking rather dispirited.
"Ancestor, it’s so pitiful. She died right after giving birth to Huaahaa." Wang Lici sighed, "I’ve decided, I must treat Huaahaa well."
"Awooo awooo." Huaahaa’s spirit revived quite a bit, rubbing its head against her a few times.
"How about this, I’ll reduce your debt by two hundred, no, one hundred Qian Gold." Wang Lici generously said, "From today on, you only owe me seven hundred Qian Gold."
Awooo awooo, Huaahaa gratefully and coyly acted spoiled.
Wang Shouzhe, however, felt something was amiss. Uh, wait, wasn’t it just six hundred Qian Gold that Huaahaa owed before!?
Alright then. Wang Shouzhe realized this illiterate little tiger might never pay off Qian Gold in its lifetime.
"Ancestor, Vermilion Fruit is a relatively rare Spirit Seed Spirit Fruit, our family’s Spirit Fruit Atlas doesn’t have any records of it." Wang Shouzhe curiously asked, "I wonder when another Vermilion Fruit will be produced?"
"A mature Vermilion Fruit is worth about twelve to fifteen thousand Qian Gold." Ancestor Longyan said, "In this Middle-Grade Fire Spiritual Vein, which suits its growth, about once every hundred years a Vermilion Fruit can be produced."
It actually costs more than ten thousand!
Wang Shouzhe gazed eerily at Wang Lici, this troublesome girl’s life is indeed lucky, having tasted Heavenly and Earthly Treasures worth over ten thousand while only at Qi Refining Realm second level. This could be exchanged into over a thousand Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills, enough for siblings to nibble on as candies.
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle!" Upon hearing this price, Wang Lici’s legs trembled, directly collapsing into Wang Shouzhe’s embrace, regretting so much that her intestines turned green, her face pale as she whimpered, "Had I known that wretched fruit was so valuable, I wouldn’t have eaten it."
"It’s alright, it’s alright, you ate it." Seeing her like this, Wang Shouzhe felt a bit sympathetic too, soothing her head as he said, "This was your own opportunity, it belongs to you. Besides, didn’t you also add a valuable piece of land and Vermilion Fruit heritage to the family? This time, you made a great contribution to the family."
"That’s good, just now Fourth Uncle’s gaze was so terrifying." Wang Lici recovered, said with relief, "I really feared Fourth Uncle would sell me off."
Wang Shouzhe’s face darkened, this troublesome girl, anyone you sell her to would be a pitfall.
Too lazy to pay her more attention.
Wang Shouzhe pondered, "If relying on the output from this Vermilion Fruit Spirit Tree, it may seem impressive, but combined, it’s only over a hundred Qian Gold a year. This piece of Fire Element feng shui treasure land still needs careful planning to strive for more short-term profits."
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, why not plant another Vermilion Fruit Tree? This fruit is quite tasty." Wang Lici said, taking out a pigeon-egg-sized fruit kernel from her body, it glistening transparently like crimson jade, casually emitting Fire Element Spiritual Power.
"That’s not bad." Wang Shouzhe took the Vermilion Fruit kernel, praised, "You’ve got a head now, even knowing to keep the kernel, if you’re lucky, you can plant another."
Vermilion Fruit Trees of course are not too many, if one could gradually develop to scale production of Vermilion Fruit, then the Wang Family would be prosperous.
"Initially I wanted to crack open the shell to eat the kernel inside, but it wouldn’t crack." Wang Lici honestly replied.
Wang Shouzhe cold sweat, this troublesome girl truly is always thinking about eating. Fortunately, she couldn’t crack it open, otherwise this kernel would be wasted. Presumably, the Vermilion Fruit kernel could also be sold for quite a bit of money.
"Shouzhe, if we want to fully utilize this treasure land, we must build a Spirit Gathering Array." Wang Xiaohan said nearby, "Look at this Fire Element Spirit Vein, its spiritual power is distributed very evenly, scattered and chaotic, dispersing particularly quickly. With the Spirit Gathering Array, the Fire Element Spiritual Power can be gathered together, distributed evenly, and thus develop the Fire Element Spirit Field. Grow some fire-element economic crops, this way it can produce the fastest results."
Unexplored wild spirit veins are mostly so chaotic, many spirit plants are wildgrown, scarce in number and with little output.
Originally, in this world, there were no spirit fields.
Spirit Fields are merely a human invention to fully utilize a spirit vein and maximize its economic benefits. With Spirit Fields, humans bid farewell to the awkward situation of purely gathering Spiritual Objects in the wild.

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 102: Majestic in All Directions! Young Empress~ (4000)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 102: Majestic in All Directions! Young Empress~ (4000)_2
"The two most commonly seen fire element cash crops on the market are called Red Crystal Spirit Rice and Flame Lotus. Their overall economic benefits are roughly the same. The former is most suitable for the daily spiritual food consumption of Black Tortoise Practitioners with fire element bloodlines and can be harvested once a year. The latter ripens every few years and can produce Fire Lotus Seeds, which are in large demand as a fire spiritual medicine," said Wang Xiaohan. "Of course, as an economic crop, it’s better to produce only one kind to make production management and experience accumulation easier."
Wang Xiaohan is a Spirit Plant Elder, and his advice is very practical.
What is a cash crop? It is a crop with the highest input-output ratio.
Moreover, since it’s commonly seen in the market, it must be a crop with a high level of domestication throughout human history and widely planted. It would be much easier to obtain seeds and a complete set of planting techniques.
Just like White Jade Orchid Spirit Rice, which is a Spirit Seed with a very high domestication level. It’s simple to plant, has high yields, and is widely known in the human world. Besides meeting one’s family’s daily consumption needs, surplus produce is also very easy to sell.
In fact, if the Vermilion Fruit is dug up and sold, and all the land is used to plant cash crops, the final economic rate of return would definitely be much higher.
However, the Vermilion Fruit is rare, and once the family completes its development, its usefulness becomes significant. The economic value may be slightly lower, but it’s considered part of the foundation accumulation.
The only problem is the Array Master!
Array Master is a highly sought-after profession. Each family and clan cannot develop without an Array Master. However, most declining families do not have a dedicated Array Master of their own, and have to hire one externally whenever a new array needs constructing.
It is said that Cousin Lua Xiaoxiao has the talent to be an Array Master, but she has just started to get in touch with the arrays and lacks the accumulated experience to be of much use.
Among the allied families, aside from the Changning Xu Family, none have an Array Master.
But Wang Shouzhe does not wish to publicize this fire spiritual vein of middle-grade quality, so he must carefully think through the hiring of an Array Master.
Everyone, filled with excitement and hope, first sealed this treasure land until everything was properly arranged before activating it.
With that matter concluded,
Wang Shouzhe and his party temporarily left Xingsheng Farm.
The Spirit Rats in the Spirit Field were basically cleared out and within a short time couldn’t cause any trouble again. Therefore, Wang Lici and the young tiger must also be brought back to the main residence. After all, after the girl swallowed the Vermilion Fruit, she needed Ancestor Longyan to assist her in her cultivation.
And Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan also temporarily returned to the main residence. He had just been promoted and his foundation was still somewhat unstable, requiring consolidation and guidance from Ancestor Longyan.
Ancestor Longyan has been in the Spirit Platform Realm for over eighty years, with extremely rich experience.
Inside the black canopy boat.
Wang Shouzhe apologized to Wang Xiaohan, saying, "Sixth Grandfather, I truly apologize about the Spirit Platform Banquet."
Someone reaching the Spirit Platform Realm in the family is a big event usually announced to other families, with a Spirit Platform Banquet held. Its excitement would even compare to Wang Shouzhe’s future wedding banquet.
This is an opportunity to raise the family’s prestige and show strength. Moreover, for a Black Tortoise Practitioner, it is the most honorable time in their life, and just receiving gifts could bring a small fortune.
However, Wang Shouzhe has his own considerations and plans, and it is indeed not the right time to hold a Spirit Platform Banquet.
"Haha, Shouzhe, there’s no need to apologize repeatedly. This lifetime is already worth it for your Sixth Grandfather!" Wang Xiaohan laughed heartily, "Let alone postponing it, even if it’s to make Sixth Grandfather the family’s hidden trump card all lifelong, it would be fine. Moreover, Sixth Grandfather particularly admires your pragmatic and non-vain character."
"Of course, that won’t happen," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile. "When it’s appropriate for Sixth Grandfather to make an appearance, I promise to hold a grand Spirit Platform Banquet for him, and there might even be a chance for a Celestial Human Banquet in the future."
"That’s not something I dare indulge in," Wang Xiaohan quickly waved his hands. Just the thought of the Celestial Human Realm felt too distant and uncertain for him. Having the opportunity to advance to the Spirit Platform Realm already filled him with immense satisfaction.
Wang Shouzhe merely smiled, saying nothing more.
As the black canopy boat made its way towards Zhuwei Lake, it passed by the large construction sites on both sides.
The scale of the construction sites was getting larger and larger. Silt-carrying boats moved continuously in the waterways, and along both banks, numerous workers were building sheds, filling earth, and making paths.
Besides the busy silt-carrying boats, there were also some passenger boats traveling the waterways. These passenger boats carried people dressed fairly well, appearing to be quite wealthy.
As soon as they arrived at the temporary docks, a servant in clean attire greeted them, looking quite smart: "Welcome, lords, to the first phase of the construction site of Zhuwei Mansion. I am the welcoming servant, Ouyang Junyan."
Wang Shouzhe’s black canopy boat happened to pass by this scene, and he stopped a moment to take a look. This was, after all, crucial to his grand plan for wealth accumulation.
"Ouyang Junyan?" a chubby young man said, "I recognize you. You’re Gousheng from Liuzigou in our neighboring village. Your family was poor and had nothing to eat when you were little, and you came to our village to beg for food, which got you a beating from me. Ouyang Gousheng, how dare you make up a name and attempt to deceive here."
At these words, a commotion arose around them, and the expression on the faces of those affluent individuals changed.
"Oh, so it’s Zhang Tiedan," Ouyang Junyan’s eyes became stern, and he said sharply, "Zhang Tiedan, watch your words. My new name was personally given to me by Miss Six. I, Junyan, am highly regarded by Miss Six, selling future properties and fields of Zhuwei Mansion here. How could this be deception?"
His aura was imposing.
Causing Zhang Tiedan’s face to change instantly, he said in a low voice, "Miss Six, which Miss Six?"
"Naturally, Sixth Miss of the Wang Family’s Lu Generation, Miss Wang Luqiu! I’m personally chosen as her reception servant," Ouyang Junyan’s eyes were full of pride and arrogance. "If you’re unsatisfied with my name, feel free to leave."
Miss Wang Luqiu!
This name rendered the affluent households silent, looking at each other with awe on their faces. The name of Wang Luqiu of the Wang Family’s Lu Generation echoed throughout Ping’an Town.
At the tender age of eleven, she easily defeated the legitimate son of the Liu Family and claimed she was unbeatable among those under sixteen!
Such a high-profile figure has become an idol for many young people in Ping’an Town. Moreover, she is a lady of the Wang Family’s Lu Generation, and the sixth sister of the current Wang Family Patriarch, Wang Shouzhe.
"Gousheng—no, Junyan, I was wrong." Zhang Tiedan suddenly showed deference, his face filled with flattery, "I always knew from a young age that you, Junyan, were destined to be extraordinary. Now you’ve become Sixth Miss Wang’s confidant, even getting a new name from her. You’ve soared to great heights. Our Zhang Family will buy Zhuwei Mansion."
Ouyang Junyan, however, remained calm and collected, saying flatly, "I wouldn’t dare call myself Sixth Miss’s confidant. As Junyan, I’m just a servant she promoted casually. As for Zhuwei Mansion, it’s not something anyone can buy at will."
"The first phase of our Zhuwei Mansion is located along the Zhuwei Water Dao. On the right, it adjoins the famous Zhuwei Lake, and on the left, it overlooks the Wang Family’s ancestral grand geomantic estate, Xingsheng Farm, while being distantly opposite the main residence of the Wang Family’s millennial legacy," Ouyang Junyan said with increasing pride. "Such a unique geomantic treasure that can be passed down through generations isn’t something any random person can buy. To buy the first phase, one must have purchasing qualifications. Zhang Tiedan, do you think money alone is enough?"
"Yes yes, Junyan is right to reprimand," Zhang Tiedan nodded humbly, his face full of flattery, "Please, in light of us growing up together, do provide some convenience."
"We’ll see. There needs to be qualification reviews," Ouyang Junyan said flatly, "It’s not solely my decision on some matters."
With these words, the wealthy people became even more expectant, each face filled with both reverence and hope. Just as they prepared to approach and establish ties with Ouyang Gousheng—no, Ouyang Junyan—
Suddenly.
A commotion sounded from afar. "Sixth Miss is here; Sixth Miss is inspecting the construction site."
"No onlookers! Get back to work immediately.""Everyone, put in a good performance, let Sixth Miss see the spirit of our Fifth Brigade.""Sixth Miss is here; anyone looking to embarrass me will get it from me."
The foremen of each construction team began roaring one after another.
Such a scene left Wang Shouzhe utterly dumbfounded.
Since when did our Luqiu have such prestige?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 103: Big Profit & Spirit Beast Appears at Zhuwei Lake (4000 Votes Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 103: Big Profit & Spirit Beast Appears at Zhuwei Lake (4000 Votes Requested)
...
As they spoke.
Accompanied by several household servants and a household general, Wang Luqiu approached from afar, inspecting along the way.
She carried herself with hands behind her back, her small figure very straight, walking at a measured pace, steady and powerful, calm and unhurried.
As she looked around, her expression appeared gentle yet stern.
Facing the cheers of the captains and foremen like "Good day, Miss Six" and "Blessings, Miss Six," she nodded slightly with amiability.
It seemed she had emulated Wang Shouzhe’s demeanor quite well. No, her demeanor was more akin to a certain high leader inspecting the grassroots.
Ouyang Junyan felt both excited and apprehensive as Wang Luqiu passed by, and he stepped forward, bowing to greet her: "Good day, Miss Six." He was just a small character, fearing she might not remember his name.
Wang Luqiu paused briefly, and upon seeing Ouyang Junyan, she encouraged him with a slight smile: "Oh, it’s Junyan. Keep up the good work."
"Yes, Miss Six." Ouyang Junyan felt a surge of enthusiasm, his body trembling with energy, as Miss Six not only remembered him but also stopped to encourage him.
A gentleman acts for a confidant’s sake!
I, Ouyang Junyan, will never disappoint Miss Six’s admiration and hopes.
However, Wang Luqiu did not linger but continued to inspect the next section of the construction site. This project was significant, and she needed to consider the bigger picture while attending to every detail.
Watching Wang Luqiu’s retreating figure, Ouyang Junyan deeply bowed: "Take care, Miss Six."
Only after she disappeared from view did Ouyang Junyan lift his head, his face flushed and his heart pounding.
The other wealthy families, from beginning to end, were not acknowledged by Wang Luqiu, as if she completely ignored them.
Yet, none of them had any complaints. Instead, they all excitedly began discussing.
"She is indeed the sixth Miss from the Wang Family’s Lu generation, with an outstanding demeanor, like a phoenix chick descending gracefully, naturally regal."
"Having the fortune to meet Miss Luoqiu is an honor for me, Zhang Tiedan."
"I heard that the sixth Miss is an Empress from the heavens incarnated in the Wang Family, and I suspect the Ping’an Wang Family is going to prosper."
All kinds of discussions seemed to praise Wang Luqiu to the skies.
One scholarly person from a wealthy family shook his head as he recited lines of poetry for proof.
The Empress should be an Immortal in the heavens
Fallen to the mortal world to endure trials
Until one day, a strong wind arose
Ascending again to the Hall of Heaven
...
On the black canopy boat, Wang Shouzhe was stunned, wondering if those people had any shame left. Having only caught a glimpse of Wang Luqiu, they began exaggerating and flattering shamelessly.
Are they scholars? Have they lost all integrity and dignity? Do they know about marketing a persona?
Wang Shouzhe wished he could grab that shameless scholar.
Then, have him compose a poem for himself proving it.
"Haha~ Our Luqiu is well regarded," Wang Xiaohan nodded repeatedly, "Looks like this girl has been quite diligent lately, as all the foremen respect her."
In fact, even Wang Shouzhe agreed that although Luqiu had some eccentricities, her competence in handling affairs was quite commendable.
With these younger siblings growing up to share the burden, it was certainly best for him.
Meanwhile.
Ouyang Junyan, surrounded by the wealthy families, seemed to be stepping onto the peak of his life. However, he adhered to Miss Six’s guidance, remaining neither arrogant nor humble, diligently attending to his duties: "This phase of the project focuses on riverfront properties and irrigating upstream fertile lands. Please take a look at the planning and effect diagrams."
In reality, these marketing strategies were surely crafted by Wang Shouzhe. The source was rather simple, as real estate marketing strategies on Earth had long been commonplace.
The effect diagrams and planning diagrams were basic fundamentals. Spend some money and hire an artist to draw it; make it as attractive, grand, and high-end as possible. In this world, artists mostly double as scholars and are not very expensive.
The most powerful aspect of Earth’s real estate marketing plans was exploiting human nature, using scarcity, frenzied sales, and rush buying tactics to promote properties.
"This courtyard is positioned nicely, very beautiful. Amongst the large farmlands, there’s a share of two hundred acres of fertile land," Zhang Tiedan’s eyes lit up, "Brother Junyan, how are these advance sale properties and land shares being sold?"
"Not for sale." Ouyang Junyan said, "The first five sets are reserved by the Wang Family Patriarch for their own use. You can look at the second row. Though not as good as the first row, you will still be neighbors with Wang Clan Members in the future."
"This set is a bit small, and only carries eighty acres of fertile land share." Zhang Tiedan hesitated.
"What is Zhuwei Mansion? The only place in Ping’an Town, every inch of land is precious." Ouyang Junyan proudly pointed at a freshly filled construction site, "In the future, Zhuwei’s first phase will be the residence of Ping’an’s elite dignitaries and wealthy families. I’ve heard that even wealthy merchants from Changning Guard will come to buy. It will certainly appreciate in value."
"Alright, then this set, how much Qian Gold?" Zhang Tiedan couldn’t resist.
"This set has a good position, an advance payment deal at the special price of only eight hundred and eighty-eight Qian Gold," Ouyang Junyan said casually.
"What?" Zhang Tiedan jumped angrily, "Brother Junyan, are you robbing money? This courtyard should be worth a little over a hundred Qian Gold, and eighty acres of fertile land share at most elsewhere would only be over two hundred Qian Gold. Together it should not exceed three hundred fifty Qian Gold."
"Haha, can fertile land residences elsewhere compare with Zhuwei Mansion?" Ouyang Junyan scoffed, "Who lives here? What kind of status do they have? Besides, what’s the use of several hundred acres in Liu Family territory? Aren’t you worried... Haha~ But Zhuwei Mansion is different. We’re located in the heart of the Wang Family’s domain, with Wang Family General patrolling day and night, truly an everlasting legacy."

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 103: Big Profit & Spirit Beast Appears at Zhuwei Lake (4000 Votes Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 103: Big Profit & Spirit Beast Appears at Zhuwei Lake (4000 Votes Requested)_2
Under the current propaganda battle and public opinion war, the Liu and Zhao Clans have gained a terrible reputation for hiring loose cultivators to kill and seize property. This is also why many wealthy families have been eager to relocate.
A few words, and people were moved beyond measure.
Though expensive, Zhuwei Mansion is extremely prestigious, and living here is a mark of status. Most importantly, as Ouyang Junyan said, it’s safe!
In this day and age, having money and property is not enough; a group of deranged loose cultivators could easily wipe out your entire family. Only under the protection of the Wang Family can one truly live and work in peace.
"Alright, I’ll buy it." Zhang Tiedan was moved and said decisively, "Junyan, give me a discount."
"No, you don’t yet have the qualification to buy a house and land." Ouyang Junyan shook his head.
"What? You need qualifications to buy a house and land?"
"Your Zhang Family has never paid even a single coin of tax to the Wang Family, nor contributed anything. What gives you the right to settle in Zhuwei Mansion?"
"Then how can I acquire the qualification to buy a house?"
"For a family like yours, you need at least five able-bodied men to participate long-term in the dredging and landfilling project, or pay 10 Qian Gold in contribution tax per household member." Ouyang Junyan said proudly, "The threshold for Zhuwei Mansion’s first phase is quite high."
This threshold is indeed high!
However, after confirming that there would be Black Tortoise Practitioner household generals guarding and patrolling for security in the future, Zhang Tiedan gritted his teeth and decided to send five able-bodied men for labor, just to have the right to buy a house.
As for the other wealthy families, they either contribute manpower or money.
Wealthy families with money are astute; they have realized that this prime land of Zhuwei Mansion will likely appreciate in value in the future! Even if they have to sell their properties in the territories of the Liu and Zhao Clans, they are determined to buy a unit in Zhuwei Mansion.
The safety on the other side is too lacking.
In the future, Zhuwei Mansion will have walls, and outsiders will be thoroughly questioned when entering or exiting, with no entry for unauthorized people.
Additionally, Black Tortoise Practitioner household generals will patrol day and night, doubling as bodyguards, providing not only safety but also prestige.
...
Wang Shouzhe’s black canopy boat headed towards the river.
At this time, Wang Xiaohan still hadn’t recovered from his shock: "Eight hundred and eighty-eight Qian Gold, eight hundred and eighty-eight... Shouzhe, did you really sell eighty acres of land and property for such a high price? And people actually bought it!"
What amazed Wang Xiaohan the most was that the land was merely newly filled, with no houses built yet, and people were already scrambling to pay.
"This can’t be blamed on me; it’s mainly because of the terrible reputation of the Liu and Zhao Clans." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "The common wealthy families have already started to move beyond worrying about food and clothing. What they pursue first is an enhancement of status and prestige. Second, is absolute safety. Zhuwei Mansion’s first phase just happens to meet their needs."
"Fourth Uncle, are you really going to have household generals guarding the gate and patrolling?" Wang Lici asked in surprise, "Many Black Tortoise Practitioners look down on civilians."
"With money, ghosts can be made to grind grain. We can hire loose cultivators of good character to be household general bodyguards." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "A bodyguard is only around ten Qian Gold a year. The work has no danger, so many loose cultivators will rush to do it."
"Will the money come from our family?" Wang Xiaohan asked worriedly, "If this goes on long-term, the expenses will be considerable."
"Grandpa Six, there’s a type of expense called property fee..." Wang Shouzhe laughed, "When split among all the owners, it doesn’t amount to much."
Wang Xiaohan: "..."
...
The black canopy boat gradually sailed into Zhuwei Lake.
At this moment, Zhuwei Lake had evidently turned into a large construction site, with a total of several hundred boats participating in the work, and the number was continually increasing.
With such a massive crew involved, the project’s progress accelerated significantly.
Wang Shouzhe stood at the bow, spirited as he watched the scene. The dredging and landfilling major project had evolved to become a strategic project for the Wang Family.
Just then,
a fast boat sped toward Wang Shouzhe, with the third of the Shou generation, Wang Shounuo, standing on the bow.
Originally, Wang Shounuo was the chief director of the entire project. However, he was clearly overshadowed by Wang Luqiu.
"Fourth Brother, Fourth Brother, you’re finally back." Wang Shounuo said delightedly upon seeing Wang Shouzhe, "Quick, quick, come with me, that fierce beast has appeared again."
Wang Shouzhe hurriedly ordered the black canopy boat to follow him and leapt onto Wang Shounuo’s boat, asking suspiciously, "Third Brother, what do you mean by ’the fierce beast has appeared again’?"
"You have no idea." Wang Shounuo said anxiously, "In the few days you were gone, a turtle-like fierce beast appeared in Zhuwei Lake, specifically ramming the dredging boats. I’ve organized personnel several times to drive it away but to no avail. Fortunately, the beast is quite gentle and doesn’t harm people."
"But even so, panic is starting to spread. If this continues, many workers won’t dare to work on the lake anymore."
A turtle-like fierce beast?
Wang Shouzhe’s expression tensed as he said solemnly, "Could it be the legendary one?"
When he was a child, he had heard that a turtle-like fierce beast lived in Zhuwei Lake. It was said to be an indigenous resident of Zhuwei Lake, and since it was quite docile and never harmed anyone, Ancestor Zhou Xuan didn’t eliminate it.
But rumors are just rumors, Wang Shouzhe had never seen it, some clansmen said they’ve seen it, others said they haven’t.
Therefore, when Wang Shouzhe was planning the dredging and landfilling project, he completely overlooked this matter.
Could it be that the massive dredging project angered that turtle beast?
While pondering, Wang Shounuo’s boat quickly reached the incident site. A dredging boat was already capsized, and the boatmen and dredging workers had all fallen into the water.
A gigantic turtle-like fierce beast was lurking on the water’s surface, occasionally using its head to pester the dredging workers.
Luckily, it didn’t have any intent to harm them and seemed only to be venting.
Upon seeing Wang Shounuo’s boat, the turtle paddled rapidly, charging head-on with the apparent intention of ramming and sinking the boat.
Wang Shouzhe’s face turned stern: "You dare."
He drew his sword, soared into the air, and a layer of white light covered the Fine Steel Sword as he struck with the force of thunder. The turtle didn’t flee but curled up on the water’s surface. A water-blue light shield covered its shell.
"Boom!"
The sword struck the light shield, the enormous counterforce made Wang Shouzhe’s profound qi surge wildly, almost causing him to spit blood. The water-blue shield of the turtle merely rippled a few times without breaking.
The turtle head extended again, spraying a water column at Wang Shouzhe.
Tier Two pinnacle!
Wang Shouzhe’s heart tightened, surprised that the turtle had reached such a realm. The water column moved with lightning speed, and just as he intended to dive into the water to evade—
a voice thundered in his ear.
"How dare you! Shouzhe, retreat!"
A powerful force pulled Wang Shouzhe, tossing him back onto the boat.
It was Grandpa Six, Wang Xiaohan, the newly ascended Ancestor Xiaohan of the family. He effortlessly shattered the water column with a punch, lightly tapping the water’s surface with his feet, causing ripples.
Following that, he glided over the waves, his stature imposing, with his coarse hemp garments fluttering like a land immortal. In a breath, he leapt above the turtle, striking down with a powerful blow.
Profound Force surged as the water-blue shield shattered, and Wang Shouzhe was on the verge of spitting blood. Meanwhile, the massive turtle’s water-blue shield was barely disturbed.
Caught up in the spectacle, Wang Shouzhe’s heart raced in awe.
Realizing it was facing a formidable opponent, the turtle quickly submerged, vanishing without a trace.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 104: Capture! Guardian Spirit Beast (4200)
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 104: Capture! Guardian Spirit Beast (4200)
...
Tier Two top-notch, its overall strength is already comparable to the peak of the human Qi Refining Realm.
Moreover, it is an aquatic ferocious beast, with exceptionally strong combat capabilities in water, able to hide and evade at will.
The vast Zhuwei Lake spans over ten thousand acres, with waterways extending in all directions. If this turtle beast sincerely wants to hide, it might be quite challenging to deal with.
"Shouzhe." Wang Xiaohan’s face was somewhat troubled, "If this turtle dares to show itself, Grandmaster Zeng Liu naturally won’t fear it. But if it chooses to hide or engage in guerrilla warfare, not even a Celestial Human Realm expert would be able to catch it. After all, everyone’s spiritual sense has its limits and can’t conduct an extensive search."
"Xiaohan is right." Ancestor Longyan gracefully landed on the small boat, "If we can’t accurately pinpoint its location, it may be difficult to handle."
Wang Shouzhe’s expression gradually turned stern. The dredging and land reclamation project at Zhuwei Lake was part of his grand plan, and if disrupted by a single turtle, it would be a colossal joke.
"Shouzhe, if it really doesn’t work, Grandmaster Zeng Liu can organize some fishermen." Wang Xiaohan suggested, "We pose as dredgers, and when the turtle comes to us, we temporarily trap it with a net and then quickly eliminate it."
This plan was barely feasible, just overly passive, but it was better than having no plan at all.
At this moment.
With a "thud!", Wang Lici jumped up onto the boat, causing it to rock.
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched as he looked at her with an odd expression. Has this girl overeaten?
However, upon closer inspection, she wasn’t that chubby. Her face had a bit of baby fat, and she was just within the range of slightly chubby. The problem must lie with her body technique.
Immediately, he raised an eyebrow and said, "Big Girl, can you practice your body technique properly? Which female Black Tortoise practitioner jumps and lands with such a ’thud’?"
Wang Shouzhe was a bit exasperated.
The Wang Family’s body technique, even in its basic form, emphasizes grace and elegance. The advanced [Willow Catkin Body Technique] is even more graceful and elusive, swaying in the wind like an intangible presence.
Yet in her case, it became "thud!"
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle." Wang Lici said pitifully, "My cultivation has improved too rapidly, and I can’t control my body momentarily. Usually, my body technique is quite light."
Light? I don’t believe you one bit.
And that phrase about your cultivation improving too rapidly—particularly grating to the ears.
"In any case, you should focus your mind on cultivation properly." Wang Shouzhe sternly criticized, "Don’t get complacent because you have a bit of cultivation. A Black Tortoise practitioner is not just about cultivation realm; otherwise, you’d just be an empty shell."
"Yes, Fourth Uncle." Wang Lici said dispiritedly. Then she added, "Lici came to inform Fourth Uncle that she can sense the turtle’s location."
"?"
Wang Shouzhe’s face darkened. Just after calling you an empty shell, you pull this trick on me? This troublesome girl, is she born to go against me?
Wang Lici shrank her neck, looking pitifully at Wang Shouzhe. What did I do to provoke Fourth Uncle?
"Hahaha, don’t mind your Fourth Uncle." Wang Xiaohan was amused and pulled Wang Lici aside, "Come, Big Girl, tell Grandmaster Zeng Liu, where is the turtle? Let Grandmaster make turtle soup for you."
With those words, Wang Lici nearly drooled, her spirits lifted, "Fourth Grandpa, it’s right there, floating half a zhang deep, eavesdropping on us." She pointed to a location several zhang away.
Wang Xiaohan extended his spiritual sense towards that direction, and sure enough, vaguely sensed the turtle. He immediately leaped and punched towards the spot.
"Boom!"
The lake water exploded.
The ferocious turtle beast’s form was revealed, and it was terrified. After taking a punch, it quickly dove deeper. This time, it hid farther away, burrowing itself into the mud.
"Grandmaster Zeng Liu, it’s there, hiding in the mud." Wang Lici again directed the small boat over, pointing to a spot.
This time, before Wang Xiaohan could act, Ancestor Longyan stepped into the air and gracefully wielded her sword.
"Swoosh!"
The sword aura flashed, as if a knife had sliced through the lake surface, parting the water to both sides.
The lakebed, a few zhang deep, was laid bare by the sword, revealing the mud. The turtle’s body was hidden there, with only its head poking out, eyes rolling cluelessly.
Who am I? Where am I? Where has all the surrounding water gone?
But it was ultimately a turtle that had lived a long time. It scrambled through the mud at high speed, within half a breath returning to the water.
"Splash!"
The parted water closed back up, creating waves, and the turtle disappeared.
"That turtle is quite clever." Wang Shouzhe was also surprised, thinking that turtles were usually slow and leisurely. Unexpectedly, when escaping, they’re incredibly agile.
"Oh no, it has fled farther away." Wang Lici said helplessly, "It went in that direction, let’s chase."
Yet even when they caught up this time, neither of the two ancestors acted rashly. The turtle, being in the water, if it truly wanted to escape, they wouldn’t have a great method to catch it.
Moreover, it became more cunning after suffering several times, always moving a bit farther away when people approached.
"Looks like we’ll have to transfer Sixth Uncle Dinghai’s fishing fleet over." Wang Shouzhe thought of a solution, though he wasn’t sure if those nets could truly capture it.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 104: Capture! Guardian Spirit Beast (4200)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 104: Capture! Guardian Spirit Beast (4200)_2
As long as it hits, within a few breaths, the two Ancestors can strike it heavily.
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I have another way to try." Wang Lici said cleverly again.
"?"
Wang Shouzhe stared at her with an unusual expression. How come you usually don’t have so many ideas? Are you here today specifically to oppose Fourth Uncle?
"Okay, go ahead and tell me." Wang Shouzhe ultimately put the bigger picture first.
"Fourth Uncle, I can’t guarantee it." Wang Lici said, "I was thinking, Spirit Beasts and the like, all really love delicious food. If we can lure it to the shore with gourmet food, wouldn’t it be unable to run away?"
Tempting with food?
Wang Shouzhe’s gaze was somewhat skeptical. This girl might think that just because she loves to eat, all species in the world can’t resist the temptation of food?
"Fourth Uncle, HuaaHuaa followed me like this." Wang Lici said earnestly, "It really loves to eat my dried fish snacks."
Though Wang Shouzhe hesitated slightly, he knew he was persuaded by her: "Then let’s try it, after all, there’s nothing to lose."
One must admit, this girl Lici always does things unexpectedly yet strangely successful.
"What do you mean by nothing to lose?" Wang Lici said angrily, "I’m sacrificing my dried fish, and my stock isn’t a lot."
"Alright! Fourth Uncle will reimburse you." Wang Shouzhe said through gritted teeth, "If you truly perform a great feat, I will treat you to a big meal at Hundred Flavors Pavilion in Changning Guard. Order whatever you like, no ceiling."
"Huh?"
Wang Lici’s eyes lit up, feeling her blood boiling, filled with fighting spirit all over, and patted her chest saying, "Fourth Uncle, leave everything to Lici, dealing with small animals is what Lici is best at."
Next, Wang Lici quickly got into the groove and started arranging Wang Shouzhe, as well as the two Ancestors.
"Fourth Uncle, set the ambush point at that remote spot, there’s a forest behind for hiding." Wang Lici rapidly brainstormed, "Besides, didn’t you hunt an East Sea Arrow Banner last time? Have someone cut a piece, that turtle has a big appetite, at least three, no, fifty pounds."
"Do you know a roasting oven? If the house doesn’t have one, go take one from my courtyard, I had several made by the blacksmith for backup."
"Top-grade fruitwood charcoal, various seasonings."
"Ancestors, you must stay far away, hold your breath and concentrate."
...
All kinds of arrangements and commands were quite lively.
Even Wang Shouzhe was a bit shocked, upon hearing there was delicious food, the energy this girl burst out was truly terrifying.
Despite being somewhat hesitant about those fifty pounds of Spirit Fish, ultimately, he agreed.
Then.
Everything was ready.
Wang Lici, a tiger, plus a common boatman started drifting in the lake. She and the little tiger HuaaHuaa were happily enjoying various gourmet foods, especially dried fish snacks, and while eating, some dried fish snacks accidentally fell into the lake.
After more than an hour.
The boat gradually approached the shore, dried fish snacks continued to "fall" incessantly.
"HuaaHuaa, Miss will grill Spirit Fish for you, this is a sea fish, you’ve never eaten it." Wang Lici held HuaaHuaa, went ashore, and started roasting.
Her movements were skillful, her technique exquisite, and in a matter of moments, the aroma of grilled fish spread everywhere.
Even Wang Shouzhe and others hiding in the woods were attracted by the aroma of grilled fish. But Wang Shouzhe still had some doubts; could it really lure the turtle ashore with this method?
The sky gradually darkened.
The charcoal fire in the grill grew ever brighter.
"HuaaHuaa, this piece is mine, don’t snatch!" Wang Lici had already started enjoying the delicious grilled Spirit Fish with the little tiger HuaaHuaa. It seemed she had forgotten the plan.
You take a piece, I take a piece, feasting joyfully.
In less than fifteen minutes, Wang Shouzhe’s fifty pounds of East Sea Arrow Banner Spirit Fish Meat, surprisingly, was eaten one-third by them!
Moreover, they had no intention of stopping, eating with more enthusiasm than anything, and shortly after, half was gone!
Wang Shouzhe’s heart skipped a beat, secretly saying it was bad.
Could it be, he was tricked?
Wang Lici never intended to lure the turtle up; she purely wanted to feast on his Spirit Fish...
Afterwards, at most wipe her mouth, saying that today’s luck was bad, the turtle didn’t take the bait, maybe the turtle doesn’t like fish, etc.
Tomorrow, continue to deal with dozens of pounds of Spirit Horned Yak Meat.
The more Wang Shouzhe thought, the more alarmed he became. This girl Lici has a history full of precedents, how could he believe her so easily?
Until she and the little tiger had eaten two-thirds.
Wang Shouzhe finally slapped his forehead.
Uh... alright, I believe your luck, little lady.
But just at that moment, the surface of the water at the lake’s edge moved slightly, and a gigantic turtle slowly crawled ashore. Its enormous size seemed quite terrifying in the dim light, and it even bared its teeth at Wang Lici and the little tiger.
"Fierce beast!"
Wang Lici exclaimed, picked up the little tiger HuaaHuaa, and ran away without a trace.
Then, the big turtle shook its head proudly, and with heavy footsteps, swaggered over to the grill. It tilted its head, as if contemplating whether the grilled fish was really that tasty?
With a shallow taste, a pound of grilled fish was gone.
Then this big turtle seemed possessed, eating large mouthfuls, probably regretting being overly suspicious and not coming up to eat sooner.
Woo woo~ Master Turtle wasted three hundred years of life.
In the forest, Ancestor Xiaohan flew out and lunged at the big turtle.
The big turtle’s head twitched with a shiver, suddenly realizing it had indeed fallen into a trap.
However, it seemed mentally prepared for this situation, still not forgetting to grab a big chunk of grilled fish and sprint wildly towards the lake.
Its running speed was more than ten times faster than when it crawled ashore. Just seven or eight yards of distance took only a few breaths to cover.
It’s no surprise, this big turtle had lived so long, its intelligence was not low. Having already anticipated the possibility of a trap, it dared to come up and eat, naturally thinking about how to escape.
It seemed to want to show humans that as a fierce beast level turtle, it not only ran swiftly like the wind, but it could also leap.
Using the momentum of its rapid run, when it was just over a yard away from the lake, its strong hind legs suddenly kicked, and its huge and heavy turtle body really took off into the air.
At this moment, it still didn’t forget to blink its eyes and snicker at Wang Xiaohan who was pursuing closely behind, with the big chunk of grilled fish held in its mouth.
As if expressing that without adequate preparation, how would your Master Turtle dare to go up the mountain?
No worries, everything is under Master Turtle’s control.
The enormous turtle formed a pose in midair that wasn’t particularly graceful, heading straight towards the lake headfirst. As long as it got to the lake, the world was vast, and Master Turtle could travel freely.
Humans, thank you for the gourmet feast.
If it weren’t for the big chunk of grilled fish in its mouth, it couldn’t help but want to laugh heartily a few times, expressing its inner joy.
Just as the big turtle was feeling most triumphant.
Suddenly!
A light scoffing voice was heard.
"Haha, you’re too happy too soon." "Profound Ice Sword!"
A hazy figure appeared in the night, she gracefully swung a sword. But this sword wasn’t aimed at the turtle, but at the surface of the lake.
That sword, light as it looked, was enveloped in countless ice crystals and frost.
As soon as the sword fell onto the lake surface.
Instantly, a powerful profound ice chill rapidly spread along the lake surface, actually freezing a meter radius of the lakeside surface into over a foot thick ice sheet. Naturally, because the lakeside surface was quite shallow, she could freeze it so quickly and solidly.
"Clang!" "Crunch!"
The turtle’s big head crashed hard onto the ice surface, breaking through the ice by over a foot, along with the turtle’s head and front shoulder plate.
Then, its head and front shoulder plate got stuck in the ice layer.
Its four legs flailed desperately in the air!
This scene made Wang Shouzhe unable to hold back his laughter.
This big turtle was indeed ridiculously silly and cute. You might as well just run, why insist on jumping into the lake elegantly!
But with Ancestor Longyan blocking the way, even if it hadn’t jumped into the lake, it wouldn’t have escaped.
Wang Xiaohan rushed forward, grabbed one of its paws, and forcefully pulled it back, dragging it to an open space far from the lake.
"Haha~ you’re quite a runner, run some more?"
Wang Xiaohan was quite annoyed with it, directly flipping it over, shell down, limbs up. Originally, the turtle could rely on stretching its head to flip over, but it hit so hard just now that its head and neck were injured.
It could only lie there honestly, facing the sky.
This made Wang Shouzhe involuntarily think of a joke about a sea turtle that never flipped over after a night of fun...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 105: Step by Step! Enhancing Family Heritage
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 105: Step by Step! Enhancing Family Heritage
...
Moreover, this turtle is particularly clever and smart. After realizing it had been captured, it was extremely obedient and behaved well, as if resigned to its fate.
"Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe said, "Can you recognize what species of fierce beast this is? It seems like a Water Origin Spirit Turtle."
Ancestor Longyan examined its shell, the patterns, and shape, then said, "It’s indeed not any rare spirit seed, just a Water Origin Spirit Turtle."
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe was slightly disappointed. Seeing it so lively, he had thought it might be some ancient alien species.
However, thinking further, most fierce beasts in this world are ordinary spirit seeds. Where would there be so many ancient alien species? Wang Shouzhe had also seen Water Origin Spirit Turtles in the Fierce Beast Atlas.
Water Origin Spirit Turtles are generally mild-mannered and prefer calm environments, tolerate extended underwater life, mainly feeding on aquatic fish, and they prefer spirit fish if available.
Their bloodline inheritance includes one or more water element profound skills. From its previous performance, it seemed to have awakened at least two innate profound skills from its bloodline.
In Wang Shouzhe’s understanding, bloodline inheritance is genetic inheritance.
In his world, there is a practice of passing down knowledge, profound skills, and cultivation methods through bloodline genes. How much one can awaken depends on the genes’ strength; the thicker the bloodline, the more complete the inheritance.
Humans also have bloodline inheritance. Abilities awakened through bloodline are called innate abilities, contrasting with those mastered through postnatal learning.
"Shouzhe, this spirit turtle looks pretty good," Wang Xiaohan said with great interest. "It’s smart and clever. Why not tame it and make it our family spirit beast?"
"Ancestor Longyan, what do you think?" Wang Shouzhe asked.
After a brief contemplation, Ancestor Longyan said, "Grandfather didn’t kill it back then, hoping to see if it could be tamed into a family spirit beast as it matured. Turtle spirit beasts have two major benefits: gentle temperament and high loyalty, and their extraordinarily long lifespan."
She paused for a moment, then continued, "But once it becomes a family spirit beast, you are obligated to feed it. Keeping a spirit beast incurs significant annual expenses."
After some thought, Wang Shouzhe said, "Spirit Turtle, I know you can understand me. If you become our family spirit beast, you’ll receive a hundred pounds of spirit fish each year, and if you fight for us, you’ll get extra tributes in spirit fish."
Unexpectedly, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle tilted its head, showing no interest in Wang Shouzhe.
"Uncle, uncle! You can’t treat spirit beasts this way." Wang Lici came running back, holding the little tiger HuaaHuaa. "Let me try."
Okay then.
Wang Shouzhe felt she indeed had a way with animals.
Maybe his tone was too stiff and lacked friendliness. Perhaps Lici should try, since girls are generally more gentle.
Wang Lici circled the Water Origin Spirit Turtle and then fiercely said, "Listen up, turtle. You have two paths. Either obediently become our Wang Family spirit beast and enjoy annual care."
"Or I’ll have Uncle cut you into eight pieces. I’ve never eaten spirit turtle before. This leg braised, this leg steamed, this leg in soup, this leg grilled...this leg is too small? Hmm, stir-fried then..."
Little girl, I only have four legs, how did you count five?
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle was terrified.
It sensed that this human girl wasn’t joking.
She really wanted to eat.
In the face of danger, it hurriedly nodded, indicating willingness to become a family spirit beast, as long as it could often eat that grilled fish.
"No problem with grilled fish, but only if you behave well," Wang Lici threatened coldly. "Be obedient, and you’ll have everything. Don’t listen, hehe...you know."
Understood, understood!
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle nodded quickly.
"Uncle, flip it over." Wang Lici casually instructed.
"?"
Wang Shouzhe raised an eyebrow, but still flipped the Water Origin Spirit Turtle over. This big guy was really heavy, likely weighing over a thousand pounds. He asked, "Big Girl, aren’t you afraid it’ll escape?"
Once its feet touched the ground, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle immediately felt a sense of security, retracting its legs, raising its tail, and relaxing its neck. Hearing the word ’escape,’ its large eyes fixed themselves, as if longing.
"Escape? Haha, I wish it would run. This Zhuwei Lake spans only ten thousand acres—where could it go?" Wang Lici said indifferently. "If it tries to run, killing it for meat wouldn’t be a loss, weighing over a thousand pounds, enough to eat for a long time. And its shell can boil turtle jelly, perfect for summer detoxification and beauty care."
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle quickly retracted its head, wondering how this human girl could be so ruthless at such a young age. Eating the meat wasn’t enough—she wouldn’t even spare the shell.
It then walked step by step toward the shore.
Wang Shouzhe and Wang Xiaohan both looked at Wang Lici. Since they trusted her, they let her take the lead.
Wang Lici waved her hand, signaling them not to worry.
