Sure enough, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle arrived at the shore, didn’t enter the lake, and began sniffing around the ice residue.
It found the dropped grilled spirit fish flesh, picked it up, and leisurely enjoyed it by the shore.
This scene amused Wang Shouzhe. This Water Origin Spirit Turtle had a truly relaxed attitude. Just captured, became a family spirit beast, and it had already thrown away its worries, fully enjoying its turtle life.

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 105: Step by Step! Enhancing Family Heritage_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 105: Step by Step! Enhancing Family Heritage_2
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I think it’s time to seize the opportunity and grill some more delicious food," Wang Lici eagerly suggested from the side, "For example, another fifty pounds of Spirit Horned Yak Meat, let this turtle see the barbecue heritage of our Wang Family. That way, it’ll never want to leave us."
Little Brain Axe Huaahua, listening nearby, had its eyes shining brightly, nodding repeatedly with an adorable dumbfoundedness. Its owner’s thoughts were always so peculiar, yet they made Hu Huanxi.
Grilling heritage, my foot?
This is just you being greedy, wanting to eat, right?
Wait a sec!
This little girl and the little tiger Hua Hua just ate at least thirty pounds, didn’t they? Aren’t you afraid of bursting?
Even Ancestor Longyan couldn’t help but comment, "Lici, although you are still growing, and your cultivation is increasing rapidly, leading to a strong demand for spiritual food. However, overeating in the short term is ultimately not very good."
"Yes, Ancestor," Wang Lici has always been very obedient in the presence of her ancestor, although her mood seemed a bit low.
"Alright then, let’s just grill fifty pounds," Ancestor Longyan said, "You and Hua Hua can eat up to ten pounds."
"Thank you, Ancestor." Wang Lici and the little tiger immediately perked up, got the warehouse token from Wang Shouzhe, and happily went to prepare.
I have it so difficult.
Wang Shouzhe’s head was buzzing. Fifty pounds of Spirit Horned Yak Meat, managing this house wasn’t easy.
"Shouzhe, don’t misunderstand that I am indulging Lici," Ancestor Longyan explained nearby, "This girl’s bloodline is in the Second Layer Awakening stage, and her cultivation is increasing so quickly that her life factor is rapidly updating. Even if the family is relatively poor, she must not be neglected. Besides, thanks to your efforts, Shouzhe, the family’s situation is gradually improving~"
"Second Layer Awakening?" Wang Shouzhe’s expression grew serious, "Ancestor, can you be sure?"
"Of course, I can." Ancestor Longyan couldn’t suppress a trace of joy in her gaze, "I have also undergone Two Layer Awakening, so I’m quite clear about it. However, my second bloodline awakening was achieved when I reached the Spirit Platform Realm. Lici is so young and already has Two Layer Awakening, and with another awakening when reaching Spirit Platform, it will be Bloodline Third Layer Awakening. The ancestral blessings are turning the fortunes of our Wang Family."
Wang Shouzhe’s expression was bewildered, feeling both happy and slightly bitter.
Could he, Wang Shouzhe, one day end up relying on his big niece’s golden leg?
Nonetheless, this is Wang Lici’s own opportunity, Wang Shouzhe, though envious, ultimately felt happy for her.
"Auntie," Wang Xiaohan was a bit shocked nearby, "With Lici’s Two Layer Awakening, if she goes to Purple Mansion Academy, wouldn’t she be able to squeeze into the ranks of direct disciples? Among the younger generation, there may be very few who can match her."
"Xiaohan, Shouzhe," Ancestor Longyan’s gaze turned serious, "Don’t get overly complacent and proud because our Wang Family is showing signs of improvement. After all, we’re not talking about the entire Daqian Kingdom. Even within Longzuo County, the overall strength and foundation are incredibly formidable."
"Back in the day, I entered the Academy as a Middle Grade talent with Bloodline First Awakening, yet I was merely among ordinary students," Ancestor Longyan said. "Due to personal effort and considerable family support, I reached the Spirit Platform Realm before thirty. My bloodline was enhanced to the Profound Ice Bloodline and caught the attention of Canglan Ascendant, who accepted me as an Inner Disciple. Only upon reaching Mid-stage Spirit Platform and showing potential was I accepted as a Core Disciple."
"I have personally seen a Celestial Pride who reached the Spirit Platform Realm at sixteen. Yet even then, this Celestial Pride was not immediately accepted as a direct disciple," Ancestor Longyan warned earnestly, "Therefore, everyone must not be arrogant. Let’s seize this opportunity and develop steadily across the entire clan."
Sixteen reaching Spirit Platform Realm?
Wang Shouzhe was stunned and awed.
The ancestor’s criticism was spot on; the Wang Family is ultimately just a small Ninth Grade lower stream family in a rural area.
Being in such a situation, it inevitably was limited in perspective.
How many noble families of various grades are there above? How many unprecedented geniuses? Those historical large families, any one of their foundations can crush the entire Wang Family.
"However, Shouzhe, do not lose your confidence," Ancestor Longyan encouraged, "Your ability and vision are evident to all. I firmly believe that under your leadership, the family will surely prosper, and one day might break into the ranks of Celestial Human Families, fulfilling Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s long-standing wish."
"Yes, Ancestor," Wang Shouzhe, although slightly introspective, still remained confident, bowed and said, "As the saying goes, ’A thousand-mile building begins from the ground.’ Those towering noble families also spent hundreds, thousands of years accumulating to achieve their present grandeur."
"Shouzhe doesn’t wish for the Wang Family to soar in one day; he simply wants to steadily, step by step, build a solid foundation. By continuously accumulating the family’s heritage and treasures, one day we’ll be able to overlook the multitude," Wang Shouzhe said calmly.
"Well said."
Both Ancestor Longyan and Xiaohan praised Wang Shouzhe highly.
This world always lacks opportunities and individuals or families rising rapidly in a short time.
However, as times change and the sifting occurs, only those families that remain steady and unyielding are the true legacies that endure through the ages.
Conversations continued among the group.
Wang Lici came rushing back with a large bag of Spirit Horned Yak Meat. Her chubby cheeks flushed, either from running too fast or being overly excited.
Little Tiger Hua Hua was even more energetic, running around her in circles and occasionally rolling on the ground, as if complaining that Wang Lici was too slow.
In less than half an hour.
Under Wang Lici’s management, everyone enjoyed the fragrant grilled meat.
"Sixth Grandpa, Lici’s grilling is quite good, eat more," Wang Shouzhe, feeling compassionate towards Wang Xiaohan, urged. Having endured hardships for the family his whole life, he often skimped and saved to spare more food for the juniors.
"Xiaohan indeed should eat more," Ancestor Longyan also advised beside him, "You’ve just advanced to Spirit Platform, your body is still rapidly transforming, eating more spiritual food helps you stabilize your realm."
Thus.
Wang Xiaohan no longer declined, eating the grilled meat heartily, never in his life had he eaten spiritual flesh so freely, truly moved to tears.
However, Wang Shouzhe was the family head.
He knew well that the current prosperity of the family depended heavily on resources.
Increased emergence of elders and accelerated growth of juniors depended on resources.
Current resource consumption is no longer the tight situation the Wang Family faced back then.
Skimping was not a strategy for family development; it would only lead to a vicious circle.
Creating multiple sources of income and expanding family revenues is the correct way for a family to enter a virtuous cycle.
"Ancestor, Sixth Grandpa," Wang Shouzhe said, "It’s late summer already, and in a month and a half, it’ll be Wang Family’s traditional autumn and winter hunting season. This year the situation is favorable for us; we must seize the chance to hunt some fierce beasts to replenish the Spiritual Food Storage."
"Without a doubt," Wang Xiaohan laughed heartily, "In previous years, our family had no choice but to wander around the outskirts of the Outer Domain briefly then return, but this year is different, time to show those fierce beasts what our Wang Family is capable of."
"Sixth Grandpa should focus on consolidating your realm these days, waiting to shine during the autumn and winter hunt," Wang Shouzhe seemed to speak with a double meaning, smiling.
"Good!" Wang Xiaohan was a bit excited, "It’s time for these old bones of mine to add more bricks and tiles to the family’s rise."
But Ancestor Longyan said nothing, instead, she looked at Wang Shouzhe meaningfully.
Through her prolonged interaction with Shouzhe, having witnessed his abilities to change fortunes time and again, she knew that this autumn and winter hunt would not be simple.
However, Ancestor Longyan was never good at scheming, naturally letting Shouzhe handle everything.
Wang Shouzhe, eating the delicious grilled meat Lici handed over, watched this beautiful family scene, his mind already settled.
The upcoming autumn and winter hunt will surely be the turning point for Wang Family, overturning fifty years of misfortune and paving the way for a resurgence.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 106: Taking Lici to Scrounge for Food! No Upper Limit
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 106: Taking Lici to Scrounge for Food! No Upper Limit
...
Several days later.
Liu Family’s main residence.
Recently, it has been like a hellish nightmare for the Liu Family, with one misfortune after another coming in quick succession.
Now, within the Liu Family, there is a sense of panic.
All major enterprises have withdrawn, whether it be the middle-level chief stewards or the lower-level helpers and tenant farmers, morale is extremely low, and even basic daily work is not completed well.
It is no wonder that rumors are spreading outside, claiming the rise of the Wang Family, with the downfall of the Liu and Zhao Clans imminent.
Yet, the Liu and Zhao Clans seem to be possessed, not taking any action or countering, as if they have already accepted this situation.
Only the true core family members of the Liu and Zhao Clans know their real plans.
A secluded courtyard slowly opens.
A simply dressed middle-aged man walks out, his physique sturdy and his walking style robust like a dragon and tiger, radiating strong fierce energy.
He is Liu Shenghao, the Spirit Platform Realm successor the Liu Family has meticulously trained for dozens of years.
The Patriarch, Liu Shengye, who has been waiting here, smiled happily and approached with a cupped fist salute, "Brother, have you mastered the breakthrough to the Spirit Platform Realm? If the polishing is not thorough, perhaps it’s better to wait longer; our Liu Family can still endure."
"Shengye, you’ve worked hard." Liu Shenghao’s eyes were filled with powerful confidence, "Decades honing a sword, I am greatly assured of advancing to the Spirit Platform Realm. Bring me the Celestial Spirit Pill and the auxiliary Spirit Pills. Today shall be the day I ascend to the Spirit Platform Realm."
"Good, good, good." Patriarch Liu Shengye was moved, almost shedding tears. Recently, it’s been too tough for the Liu Family. Not only did the civilians within their territory rush to work on the Wang Family’s Zhuwei Lake project,
But even some wealthy households didn’t hesitate to sell off ancestral holdings to purchase futures in the Wang Family’s Zhuwei Mansion estate, all hoping for gains despite potential losses.
Under strong public and promotional warfare, everyone views the Liu and Zhao Clans as vicious floods and beasts, desperately avoiding them.
In this, the Liu and Zhao Clans are completely powerless to counterattack.
"As long as Brother reaches the Spirit Platform Realm," Liu Shengye excitedly smirked, "Several strong Spirit Platform Realm warriors among us will seize the moment and secretly kill that hateful Wang Shouzhe. All adversity will utterly, completely turn around."
In the eyes of the Liu and Zhao Clans, Wang Shouzhe has become the number one enemy, replacing Wang Longyan.
Once Wang Shouzhe is eliminated, the so-called rise of the Wang Family will be nothing more than a groundless aerial castle doomed to collapse.
Even those who betrayed the Liu and Zhao Clans will eventually face retribution.
Liu Shengye led Liu Shenghao all the way to the Patriarch’s courtyard, smiling and saying, "The Celestial Spirit Pill is hidden within the mechanism secret chamber of my bedroom; aside from the Ancestor, Yoonghao, and a few close ones, no one knows its location. Let me retrieve it for Brother~"
He entered the bedroom, activated a mechanism, and a wall slowly opened. He walked into the secret chamber, retrieved a brocade box from the hidden cabinet, and then handed it to Liu Shenghao saying, "Brother, the family’s hope rests entirely on you."
"Rest assured, Shengye." Liu Shenghao, slightly excited, accepted the long-desired brocade box, opened it and saw indeed there were several jade bottles inside.
He opened one jade bottle, intending to sniff the aroma of the Celestial Spirit Pill, when suddenly his expression drastically changed: "This, what is this?" He poured it out, only to find a lump of flour.
"Bam!"
Liu Shenghao inwardly exclaimed that things were not good and hurriedly opened the auxiliary Spirit Pills bottles one after another, unsurprisingly, they were all replaced with flour balls. He roared, "Shengye, what’s going on?"
Liu Shengye, having lived his entire life, never felt so flustered before.
He sweated profusely, body trembling: "Impossible, impossible! Only a few people know about this secret chamber. Is it possible that Yoonghao did this? Someone, bring Yoonghao here."
Before long.
Liu Yonghao knelt in the courtyard, having been beaten until he spat blood, and said miserably, "Father, I didn’t take it, I really didn’t take it."
"Oh yes, I remember now. Fifth Brother Yoongzhou invited me for flowers, no, for drinks, that day I drank too much and didn’t know what I said. Could it be..."
"Yoongzhou?" Liu Shengye looked confused, "Yoongzhou is doing well, why would he want the Celestial Spirit Pill? No, it’s been a while since I saw Yoongzhou."
"Yoongzhou said he was going to breakthrough to the Sixth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm and would strive for the family’s rise, so he went into seclusion."
With such pulls involved.
The Liu Family discovered Liu Yongzhou is indeed missing; the so-called seclusion was purely a blinding technique.
At this point, the Liu Family finally realized there’s an issue with Liu Yongzhou. His problem is likely connected to Zhong Luoxian of the Zhong Family.
The Liu Family members rushed to "Xia Garden," only to find the gates tightly shut, long deserted, with Zhong Luoxian nowhere to be found.
In the Liu Family’s main residence.
A group of elders, even Ancestor Liu Zhide, all gathered together.
"Could it be that Yoongzhou was bewitched by Zhong Luoxian, stole the Celestial Spirit Pill, and betrayed the family to join the Zhong Family?"
"Alas, day prevention, night prevention, internal traitors are hard to guard against. Yoongzhou nephew is muddled!"
"Even if Zhong Family is a Celestial Human Family, they should not conduct such despicable acts, right? We should go to Changning Guard City Mansion to report them, demand they hand over the traitor Liu Yongzhou."
"The Zhong Family’s powerful influence, and being the Celestial Human Families’ Hundred Islands Guard, how would they pay attention to us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 106: Taking Lici to Scrounge Food! No Upper Limit_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 106: Taking Lici to Scrounge Food! No Upper Limit_2
Just as everyone was trying to say something to salvage the situation.
A household general hurriedly came back to report: "I was ordered to go to the Hundred Islands Guard to investigate and came back to report. After a lot of effort, I finally found out. It turns out that among the direct descendants of the Zhong Family, there is no one named Zhong Luoxian. Patriarch, we must be careful, this might be a scam."
He went to the Hundred Islands Guard to investigate this news, and it wasn’t easy, as many families have good protection for their children. That household general didn’t know that a major incident had occurred at home.
"What!?"
Liu Shengye’s face turned ashen, and he spat out blood from his mouth.
If Zhong Luoxian were truly the daughter of the Zhong Family, there would be a glimmer of hope of recovering the Celestial Spirit Pill.
Now...
The elders of the Liu Family were all in mourning and panic.
What to do next, what to do?
Under such a massive blow.
Even Ancestor Liu Zhide’s figure wavered, struggling to keep his footing.
...
Just when the Liu Family was in utter despair.
Changning Guard, with its towering and majestic city walls.
A seemingly ordinary carriage slowly entered Changning Guard after paying some entry tax.
A few people were sitting inside the carriage.
One of them, a girl with a somewhat chubby baby face, couldn’t suppress her curiosity. She secretly lifted a corner of the carriage curtain to peek outside.
This young girl was, of course, Wang Lici, the eighth-generation eldest miss of the Wang Family.
A young girl’s nature is curious and lively. Since she was little, opportunities to visit the city were few and far between.
Wang Shouzhe naturally wouldn’t scold Wang Lici for this; he continued to close his eyes and rest, looking like an old monk in meditation.
Facing Wang Shouzhe was Ancestor Longyan, dressed in plain white. She also had her eyes closed, in a semi-meditative state.
But her spiritual sense always hung outside the carriage, constantly on alert for any adverse situations. Shouzhe was too crucial for the future of the Wang Family and couldn’t afford any mishaps.
"Ancestor, relax a bit, staying on high alert all the time is too exhausting," Wang Shouzhe said calmly. "Though the Liu and Zhao families hate me to the core, the chance of launching an attack on me in broad daylight is low."
Despite saying this, Wang Shouzhe recently avoided going out as much as possible. Even when like this, he brazenly requested Ancestor Longyan to accompany him for protection.
Yes, he was quite afraid of dying.
He wasn’t afraid of anything else, just afraid that the Liu or Zhao family ancestors would suddenly lose their minds due to age and do something insane and detrimental.
Understanding the enemy with leniency, Wang Shouzhe preferred to think of his enemies in the worst possible terms.
Previously, it was the Liu and Zhao families fearing that the Wang Family would act recklessly and go down together with them. But now, the situation had completely flipped, and Wang Shouzhe worried that the other party might lose their sanity.
"Hmm~" After entering the city, Ancestor Longyan could relax a bit.
Even if the Liu and Zhao family’s ancestors went crazy, they wouldn’t dare attack another family’s clan leader within the city.
Moreover, on this trip, both the route and other aspects were extremely discreet.
Additionally, everyone applied simple disguises, personally handled by the household general Wang Mei. With her skillful touch, although their appearances didn’t change much, even those who knew them might not recognize them at first glance.
Particularly Ancestor Longyan, her white hair was dyed black, cascading over her shoulders like a waterfall, paired with her white attire and veil, resembling an ethereal fairy.
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle." Wang Lici pursed her lips and said eagerly, "They’re selling roasted duck over there, how about we buy a few to fill our stomachs?"
Having switched from water to land travel, wobbling around for half a day, she was naturally very hungry.
Moreover, she had prepared in advance for today’s city visit. As for what preparation, well, everyone understands, hehe~
"Lici, those who travel a hundred steps reach ninety. Are you going to give up at the last moment?" Wang Shouzhe said with a half-smile, "Hundred Flavors Inn is ranked among the top three in Changning Guard."
"Gulp." Wang Lici swallowed heavily, strengthened her resolve, and dropped the curtain firmly, then snuggled against Wang Shouzhe, acting coquettishly, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, how about we eat first before doing our business?"
At this very moment.
The voice of the carriage driver, Wang Yong, came in: "Young Master, not far ahead is our Wang’s Fish Stall, shall we inspect it?"
Wang Lici’s eyes blazed with anger, and she felt like she could kill.
Was this intentionally going against Miss Lici?
Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe feared her getting sick from hunger, so he immediately told Wang Yong to go directly to [Hundred Flavors Inn].
"Fourth Uncle is the best." Wang Lici immediately perked up.
Hundred Flavors Inn.
The carriage stopped in the backyard.
Guided by attendants, Wang Shouzhe and the others discreetly entered a luxurious private room.
"Wow, Fourth Uncle is truly generous." Wang Lici smiled sweeter than honey, having heard that the minimum spending in a private room at the Hundred Flavors Inn wasn’t cheap.
Unexpectedly.
In the lavish private room, a middle-aged fat man was already waiting.
After motioning for the attendants to leave, he greeted Wang Shouzhe with a gleeful salute, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, long time no see! I heard your Wang Family has been quite prominent lately. Eh, why are you dressed like this? I almost didn’t recognize you."
"Brother Qian." Wang Shouzhe smilingly returned the gesture, "It’s all thanks to the care of Brother Qian that the Wang Family is where it is today. It’s just that Shouzhe has made too many enemies recently, so I prioritize safety when going out."
This middle-aged plump man was naturally Wang Shouzhe’s ally, Steward Qian, Qian Xue’an. No, now to be precise, he was already Deputy Shopkeeper Qian.
"Congratulations to Brother Qian on being promoted to shopkeeper, overseeing a region."
The reason for Wang Shouzhe’s visit was the invitation from Qian Xue’an’s letter. His affairs, although having some twists, ultimately achieved the desired outcome.
With the support of the family, he not only successfully advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm but also gained the opportunity to head a region in Changning Guard. However, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t detect any aura of a Spirit Platform Realm expert from him.
"Deputy Shopkeeper, Deputy Shopkeeper, only by passing this stage can I truly become a shopkeeper," Qian Xue’an replied amiably, smiling more joyfully, "You and I are brothers, there’s no need for empty words. Who are these two ladies?"
"This is my eldest niece, Wang Lici," Wang Shouzhe introduced with a smile, "She came to the city to broaden her horizons."
"Ah, so it’s Eldest Niece, Younger Brother Shouzhe’s niece is as good as my niece," Qian Xue’an produced a twenty Qian Gold ticket, "Eldest Niece, take this to buy some food."
"No..." Wang Shouzhe started to protest, "Brother Qian just advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm and managed to secure a shopkeeper position, funds must be tight."
"Shouzhe knows me, but this little gift I can still afford," Qian Xue’an laughed, "Besides, this is a cushy job."
Indeed, he saw Wang Shouzhe as a life-and-death brother, speaking without any reservations.
"Then Lici thanks Uncle Qian," Wang Shouzhe smiled, seeing as they were ironclad allies, the future held promise.
Subsequently, Qian Xue’an took out another twenty Qian Gold, smilingly addressing Ancestor Longyan, "This must be your sister, Miss Luoyi? Wearing a veil because it’s close to the wedding date? Miss Luoyi indeed possesses extraordinary poise, like a phoenix among people. Just a small token to show my respect."
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat.
He knew Ancestor Longyan’s temperament was always firm and abhorred flattery. Agitating her might lead to her drawing her sword, which wouldn’t be good.
Just as he was about to speak, Ancestor Longyan extended her delicate hand, took the twenty Qian Gold ticket, and calmly said, "Thank you."
What was going on?
Wang Shouzhe was a bit dumbfounded, was Ancestor actually posing as a junior to accept a meeting gift?
Afterward, Qian Xue’an hooked his arm around Wang Shouzhe’s and took a seat, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I owe my current status to you. We must have a good drink today."
"Brother Qian, Shouzhe is bringing his family, so let me treat," Wang Shouzhe hesitated, considering Wang Lici made him somewhat anxious.
"Younger brother, what are you talking about? Your family is naturally Brother Qian’s family."
"No, no, it’s just that my niece has quite an appetite..."
"Haha~ Younger brother, are you afraid she’ll eat me out of house and home?" Qian Xue’an laughed heartily, saying to Wang Lici with grandiose, "Lici, precious niece, eat as much and whatever you like today, no limits!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 107: Exposed! Turns out I’m a wealthy 8th-generation heir
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 107: Exposed! Turns out I’m a wealthy 8th-generation heir
...
Qiaan Xue’an’s grand words left Wang Shouzhe stunned.
Meanwhile, Wang Lici naturally laughed until her eyes became slits, sweetly saying, "Thank you, Uncle Qian, you’re truly a good person."
"Ahem!"
Wang Shouzhe hurriedly stopped him, "Brother Qiaan, since you’re hosting, it’s not right to let the guest order the food, is it?"
"No worries, we’re like family, don’t bother with these formalities, let the big niece order. Consider today’s meal a celebration from your humble brother." Qiaan Xue’an had just advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm and became the Deputy Shopkeeper of Qiaan’s Trading Company’s Changning Guard Branch, with prospects of becoming a full manager in the future, so he was at his most ambitious and exuberant.
Wang Shouzhe knew that if he continued to persuade, it would hurt Qiaan Xue’an’s pride.
Immediately, he winked repeatedly at Wang Lici, hinting that she should take it easy today. Worst case, Uncle will take her for another meal tomorrow.
Fortunately, even as greedy as Wang Lici was, after Wang Shouzhe’s hint, she understood she couldn’t act recklessly. Otherwise, she feared her uncle wouldn’t spare her when they got back.
She hesitated and timidly ordered two dishes she heard were good but never tried, which together only cost dozens of Large Copper.
"Big niece, are you looking down on Uncle Qian? Cancel, cancel, today we won’t eat anything other than Spiritual Food." Qiaan Xue’an insisted on throwing money about.
Since Uncle Qian insisted multiple times, Wang Lici finally "braced herself" and ordered five or six Spiritual Foods. They were all Spirit Fish and Spirit Meat she hadn’t tried, plus a platter of Spirit Fruits worth several Qian Gold.
Qiaan Xue’an frowned slightly.
Is that it?
Even combined, it’s only two to three dozen Qian Gold.
Then, Qiaan Xue’an waved his big hand, grabbed the exquisite menu, and ordered another five or six signature dishes from the Hundred Flavors Inn and two types of Spirit Wine.
One was a Fire Element Spirit Wine called Red Flame Mist, made from Red Crystal Spirit Rice and Spiritual Spring, it burns like a fiery steam when swallowed, most suitable for men.
The other was Ice Crystal Dew Fruit Wine, brewed from the famous Water Element Crystal Dew Grass, with low alcohol content, more like an iced beverage, suitable for women.
Crystal Dew Grass includes "grass" in its name, but it’s actually a Water Element Spirit Fruit, which needs to grow in the Spirit Fields with a Water Element Spiritual Vein.
Wang Shouzhe’s maternal family, the Yingxiu Lu Family, produces small quantities of Crystal Dew Grass and makes quite a profit from it.
By the end of this meal, it would likely cost seventy to eighty Qian Gold.
On Earth, that would be comparable to a million-coin luxury bill.
It showed how ambitious and exuberant Qiaan Xue’an was.
But his feelings were understandable. The position of Deputy Shopkeeper of the Changning Branch of Qiaan’s Trading Company was far from an ordinary person’s reach.
The Clan Leaders of some minor families had a hard time even qualifying to have him entertain them.
Only when each family’s ancestor made an appearance would he also appear, reluctantly taking the time to meet them.
"Brother Shouzhe, big niece Lici, Miss Luoyi." Qiaan Xue’an raised his glass, "I, Qian, toast to the Ping’an Wang Family’s suppression of enemies and their awe-inspiring presence in Changning."
"Thank you, Brother Qian."
Everyone drank the fine wine and started eating.
It had to be admitted, the cuisine at the Hundred Flavors Inn was top-notch within the Changning Guard area.
Not only did Wang Shouzhe praise it highly, but even the usually reserved Ancestor Longyan could not help but frequently pick up her chopsticks, showing how finely crafted these meticulously prepared dishes were.
As for Wang Lici, she was eating so much that her eyes were nearly popping out.
She had eaten a lot of Spiritual Food recently, but she had never had such a diverse array of meticulously cooked dishes.
The chefs and cooks of the Wang Race did not possess such culinary skills.
Delicious, just too delicious.
"Brother Qian, I, Shouzhe, toast with borrowed flowers, wishing you a bright future and step-by-step promotions."
"Thank you, Shouzhe, for your auspicious words."
The two men exchanged several more drinks, their cups filled to the brim.
With some tipsiness, Qiaan Xue’an lamented, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, as a mere Direct Lineage Son, it’s been no easy road to where I am today. On my return this time, I’m tasked with taking over this Deputy Shopkeeper position, and it’s not easy."
"Oh, the fallout from the Insecticide Powder hasn’t been resolved? Are the various noble families collaborating to cause trouble?" Wang Shouzhe actually had heard something about this matter.
The current Wang Family was no longer as disconnected as before.
"Indeed, especially the Huangfu and Lei Celestial Human Families, who are particularly aggressive," Qiaan Xue’an frowned, "They actually led the way in demanding our Qiaan Family compensate for last season’s losses, or else they will stop using the Insecticide Powder, and might as well hire Spirit Insect Masters. Other noble families started watching this development. It’s laughable, considering this Insecticide Powder is a creation from the Purple Mansion Academy and our Qiaan Family is merely the distributor."
"Isn’t your Qiaan Family unafraid of the Huangfu and Lei Families?" Wang Shouzhe hesitated slightly.
"Naturally, we do not fear them, but as the saying goes, even a strong dragon cannot crush a local snake. Our Qiaan Family is here in Changning Guard to do business, and business thrives on harmony. If we cannot get through this obstacle, I’m afraid I’ll never have the chance to become a full manager," Qiaan Xue’an said with a self-deprecating smile.
Wang Shouzhe understood.
This time, Qiaan Xue’an invited him over with this hope in mind, wishing Wang Shouzhe could help by offering some advice. After all, Wang Shouzhe’s capabilities had long convinced Qiaan Xue’an.
"Brother Qian, you’re too close to the issue, unable to see the forest for the trees," Wang Shouzhe pondered, "The Academy selling the new Insecticide Powder at a low price not only to reclaim its reputation, but more importantly, to compensate the ordinary civilians for their losses, as more civilians than not suffered from it, whereas even the less fortunate families could still endure."
"So Shouzhe suggests... bypassing the noble families?" Qiaan Xue’an’s eyes lit up slightly. Indeed, the noble families were formidable, but the majority of Insecticide Powder’s sales depended on ordinary civilians.

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 107: Exposed! Turns Out I’m a Rich 8th Generation_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 107: Exposed! Turns Out I’m a Rich 8th Generation_2
"Just bypass some of them, targeting the most obstinate noble families," Wang Shouzhe advised, "Your merchant guild thrives on harmony, you should secretly provide benefits and unite the majority of the noble families."
"Brother Qian, you could carefully analyze all the macro data. How much fertile land does our Changning Guard have, and how many Spirit Insect Masters can we rely on to eliminate pests?" Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Even if our Wang Family has one Spirit Insect Master, they can currently only oversee a few thousand acres per season, at most up to ten thousand acres in the future. Ultimately, the grand trend depends on the Insecticide Powder."
"Indeed." Qiaan Xue’an’s eyes lit up as he slapped his thigh, saying, "I was truly obstructed by a single leaf. Even if a Celestial Human Family goes elsewhere to hire Spirit Insect Masters, so-called places also need Spirit Insect Masters... under the overarching macro data, the Insecticide Powder is still irreplaceable. Thus, I feel bolstered."
"Elder Brother could invite someone proficient in the Nine Chapters of Mathematics to prepare a detailed and illustrated macro data table, so that over ninety percent of the noble families won’t dare to follow blindly."
"Brilliant, truly brilliant." Qiaan Xue’an praised repeatedly, "The issue that has troubled me for so long was solved by just a few words from Younger Brother, indeed worthy of Brother Shouzhe, the Wang Family will surely flourish."
"Elder Brother was merely blinded by being in the game and intimidated by the Celestial Human Family for a moment," Wang Shouzhe shifted the topic, "Could Elder Brother give me some insight into whether the Insecticide Powder is abundant or scarce in the grand scheme?"
"Naturally, it’s scarce," Qiaan Xue’an said, "Even with the might of the Purple Mansion Academy, hastily improving new Insecticide Powder and mass production is no easy feat. How could there be any surplus?"
"According to the Academy’s compensation plan, it’s purchased at thirty percent of the original price, right? Then, for the Ping’an Wang Family’s two hundred thousand acres of fertile land, the original price is 2000 Qian Gold, the discounted price is 600 Qian Gold, and I’ll buy them."
Two hundred thousand acres?
Ancestor Longyan gave Wang Shouzhe an unusual look; since when did the Ping’an Wang Family have so much fertile land?
Even if you add up all the fertile land in Ping’an Town, it wouldn’t be half that number, right?
"Huh?"
Wang Lici, who was happily eating, was also somewhat puzzled. Did Fourth Uncle’s Nine Chapters of Mathematics go to waste, or did I, Miss Lici, suddenly become immensely wealthy from generations of poverty?
"Haha, Younger Brother’s Nine Chapters of Mathematics went to waste, too much drinking perhaps; how could the Ping’an Wang Family have twenty thousand acres of fertile land?" Qiaan Xue’an laughed while shaking his head.
Exactly, exactly, Wang Lici nodded repeatedly; Fourth Uncle drank too much Red Flame Mist, his brain is muddled, he doesn’t even know how much fertile land Ping’an Town has.
"Your Ping’an Wang Family clearly has thirty thousand acres of fertile land," Qiaan Xue’an corrected seriously, "Calculating at thirty percent, your Wang Family has to pay 900 Qian Gold."
"What?" Wang Lici’s eyes widened in surprise, is Fatty Qian, no, Uncle Qian’s Nine Chapters even worse?
"Yes, yes." Wang Shouzhe slapped his forehead upon the realization and said, "Brother Qian, you see how forgetful I am, it indeed is thirty thousand acres. Then let’s settle this. Come, Elder Brother, let me toast you."
The two once again clinked glasses.
And then, Wang Lici was in disbelief. Thirty thousand acres, the family holds thirty thousand acres of fertile land.
Wow~! The elders have been lying all along, they’ve been deceiving Lici about the family’s poverty, that good things must be used sparingly.
Now, everything is exposed!!!
Turns out the elders wanted to temper her, train her, to make her successful.
Now the truth is revealed.
I, Miss Lici, truly am a super-rich eighth generation! So, so happy.
Eat, eat, eat~ no need to worry about money anymore.
Eat heartily.
Even Ancestor Longyan was left somewhat speechless at the side, those two, Shouzhe and that Fatty Qian, are blatantly fleecing the Purple Mansion Academy, and doing so extensively...
What a blow to the pride of a former Purple Mansion Academy core disciple?
However, the Wang family is so poor, a little fleece is a little fleece. Look at our family’s child, Big Girl Lici, she’s been starved like this.
"Hmm?"
Ancestor Longyan’s brows twitched slightly.
The dishes on the table had been completely cleared out.
As Qiaan Xue’an was about to take some food, seeing the empty plate, he was stunned on the spot, then glanced at Wang Lici, his mouth twitched slightly: "Lici, my dear niece, have you had enough to eat?"
Wang Lici was about to say she wasn’t full, but seeing Fourth Uncle’s glance, she swallowed and nodded: "Yes, I’m full." She said this, but every action and expression showed, not full!
"Good, good, being able to eat is a blessing, this child has good fortune." Qiaan Xue’an called in a servant and waved to order seven or eight more dishes. He then resumed talking with Wang Shouzhe.
"Brother Shouzhe, the Red Crystal Spirit Rice seeds you mentioned, or the Flame Lotus Seeds, they are easy to find, yet also not," Qiaan Xue’an frowned slightly, "But what I can find are mostly common varieties, while some high-yield quality varieties are improved over generations, which the nobles won’t release. I’m afraid my face isn’t that influential."
"Normal grain seeds will do, the Wang Family doesn’t dare to hope for exotic species," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Additionally, we need an Array Master, but they must be found from a few Guards away."
Qiaan Xue’an glanced peculiarly at Wang Shouzhe, and after a while, he finally sighed, "Brother Shouzhe has good luck."
"Not at all, since I’m asking you, I won’t hide it," Wang Shouzhe replied with a smile, "Just a small Fire Element Middle Grade Spiritual Vein."
"That’s already quite good, as most Ninth-Grade Races have no small Middle Grade Spiritual Veins," Qiaan Xue’an pondered, "Since Younger Brother doesn’t wish to publicize...fine, I’ll think of a way, see if I can find someone with connections to hire an Array Master from elsewhere. If there are any excess outputs in the future, my Qiaan Family can also help with sales."
"Thanks so much, Brother Qian, here’s to you."
"You’re welcome, between brothers we support each other."
They continued to clink their glasses.
Then, when Qiaan Xue’an felt the alcohol taking effect, he instinctively reached for some food to ease the drink.
"Huh? Gone?"
Trying again~ it was gone again.
"Ah, Lici dear niece, are you full yet?" Qiaan Xue’an was struck with an inexplicable feeling of trepidation.
"Yes, full, full." Wang Lici licked her lips, still somewhat unsatisfied.
"Someone, bring more dishes, I, Qian, am hosting, how can I let my guests not eat their fill?"
After a quarter of an hour.
"Someone, bring more dishes!"
Another quarter passed.
"Brother Qian, that’s enough, enough!"
"Bring more, bring substantial dishes! Today, we must let my dear niece eat her fill!"
And so it repeated.
...
Night had fallen.
"Brother Shouzhe, today... farewell then. Your Wang Family, raising such a child is no easy task..." Qiaan Xue’an walked away with a look of indescribable complexity.
"Thanks for the banquet, Brother Qian, take care..." Wang Shouzhe also felt somewhat at a loss for words.
...
After Qiaan Xue’an left.
Wang Shouzhe helped Wang Lici onto the carriage; this girl could barely walk.
"Four, Fourth Uncle. It’s not my fault...I kept saying I was full, but I couldn’t resist Uncle Qian’s enthusiasm."
"Heh." Wang Shouzhe chuckled coldly, not wanting to deal with her, "Wang Yong, to the villa."
"Yes, Master."
Wang Yong drove the carriage towards the villa.
Not even halfway there, Wang Lici peeked out from the sedan’s curtain, excitedly saying, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, the city is indeed lively, they’re still serving late-night snacks, let’s check it out..."
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched, is this child unmanageable now?
...
Qiaan Xue’an staggered back to his estate and dropped himself into the Master’s Chair in the study, still feeling shaken.
Three hundred thirty-plus Qian Gold!
A single meal cost over three hundred thirty Qian Gold, something he couldn’t have dreamed of. What the family gives him for a year of support totals only five hundred Qian Gold.
Just thinking of dear niece Lici’s lip-licking, unsatisfied look made his heart tremble.
Enough, enough!
Think of ways to earn some extra, or life can’t go on.
But embezzling just after becoming Deputy Shopkeeper... is not good, right?
Suddenly.
He remembered the promotion gift Shouzhe gave him before leaving, which seemed rather hefty.
He opened it and found it was filled with radiant spirit stones, five in total!
Qiaan Xue’an’s tears nearly fell instantly.
Truly worthy of Brother Shouzhe, so generous! Recognizing this brother, Qiaan Xue’an, was truly worth it.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 108: Advancement to Tier 3! Water Origin Spirit Turtle
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 108: Advancement to Tier 3! Water Origin Spirit Turtle
...
The next day!
Just as Wang Shouzhe quietly came, he quietly left.
Apart from stirring Qiaan Xue’an’s heart, he didn’t leave any trace or ripple in Changning Guard.
Moreover, what Wang Shouzhe took away were thirteen spirit stones acquired at a "bargain" of sixty Qian Gold. Excluding the five given to Qiaan Xue’an, he gained eight extra spirit stones.
One must admit, although Lici’s maid has an enormous appetite, her ability to make money is first-rate.
After a round in the gambling stone circle, she not only recouped all her expenses, but also gained a considerable extra income. To know, a single spirit stone normally costs up to a hundred Qian Gold.
Unfortunately, the gambling stone markets in every city are too small.
Once plundered, this industry will inevitably languish for a while before recovering its Primordial Qi.
Once Liu and Zhao Clans are eliminated and the situation is relatively safe. Wang Shouzhe plans to take Wang Lici on a tour around Longzhou and the surrounding areas, plundering each Guardian City to enrich the clan’s treasury.
The carriage swayed leisurely for almost an hour.
Upon reaching a secret dock, Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai was already waiting with a brand new boat to receive them.
Everyone boarded the ship.
The new ship slowly ventured onto the river, with the sails unfurled, riding the waves.
Ancestor Longyan and Lici were resting in the cabin.
While Wang Shouzhe accompanied Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai, engaging in idle chatter and jesting, "Sixth Uncle, you seem to be glowing recently, filled with vitality, it appears you’re doing quite well."
"Absolutely." Wang Dinghai laughed, "It’s all thanks to Shouzhe’s blessings; you improved my fishing methods. In the past two to three months, our catch has been more than ten times that of previous years, with profits soaring. And coincidentally, the clan has implemented the Merit Points system, and my points are quite substantial."
"This month, I caught a rather rare spirit fish, a Tier Two Golden Spirit Carp, measuring eight feet long, rotund and sturdy, with golden scales that are exceptionally beautiful. Weighed up, it was nearly four hundred pounds."
Wang Dinghai was brimming with excitement, "You know, the Golden Spirit Carp possesses a hint of Dragon Bloodline, making it more valuable than other spirit fish."
"Congratulations, Sixth Uncle." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "How is the Liu and Zhao Clans’ fishing fleet doing?"
"Long gone into decline, not showing much enthusiasm." Wang Dinghai said, "Especially in the past half month, we haven’t seen their fleet deploy. They must be suppressed by our Wang Family, the whole clan lacking morale."
Wang Dinghai was unaware that his rivals, Liu Yongzhou and Zhao Dingtian, had already perished at Wang Shouzhe’s hands.
He was also unaware that his father, Wang Xiaohan, had already ascended as Ancestor Xiaohan.
"Did Sixth Uncle take the opportunity to expand the territory?" Wang Shouzhe inquired.
Wang Dinghai laughed heartily, "Your Sixth Uncle isn’t foolish. Since our Wang Family is thriving, naturally, we must suppress them. Haven’t you seen the recent family ledger? I’ve acquired over twenty fishing boats, hired more than a hundred people from side branches and villagers, trained them as boatmen and fishermen, and already claimed over a hundred miles of the river surface! Regardless of the harvest, securing the territory comes first."
Of course, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t scrutinize the ledger every day, and whether it’s Sixth Uncle managing the fishing industry or Second Brother Wang Shouyi at the fish stall, they are mature adults.
Giving guidance at crucial times is fine, but constantly monitoring their development is just stirring up trouble. Moreover, it fosters reliance and reduces their initiative.
Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai handled this exceptionally well. Expand when needed, seize when warranted. Now, with Liu and Zhao Clans in decline, it’s the optimal time for the clan industry to expand.
As the saying goes, history is penned by the victors, and territories are won.
Give it another decade or two, and who will remember these waters once belonged to the Liu and Zhao Clans? Travelers and locals will naturally regard it as the Wang Family’s fishing territory.
"Shouzhe, the trawl technique you proposed is also highly effective. Currently, two fishing boats are sharing a small trawl net, and the catch is overflowing the holds." Wang Dinghai laughed, thinking of the full fish holds, "If it weren’t for the Ancestor accompanying us, I’d take you to see it, the scene is quite grand..."
Just then.
Suddenly!
A small boat sped towards them, and on the bow, a young man was jumping and shouting, "Master Hai, Master Hai, there’s trouble. That Aquatic Ferocious Beast has acted up again, it’s torn through our trawl net."
Wang Shouzhe recognized the young man, seemingly named Wang Goudan, a member of the Wang Family’s side branch, who had been hanging around Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai since childhood.
"What?"
Wang Dinghai’s smile froze, "The cursed thing, I thought it was just passing by."
"Sixth Uncle, what’s happening?" Wang Shouzhe asked.
Wang Dinghai replied with a serious expression, "It’s about an incident three days ago. Our fixed moving zheng net, during the night netting, caught a Tier Three Ferocious Beast, a Crocodile Flood Dragon. Naturally, it easily tore through the net. According to the rules, our men abandoned the net right away and escaped without casualties."
"Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon? Has it appeared before?" Wang Shouzhe immediately recalled this Ferocious Beast from the Fierce Beast Atlas in his memory.
This beast resembles a crocodile from Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 108: Advancement to Tier 3! Water Origin Spirit Turtle_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 108: Advancement to Tier 3! Water Origin Spirit Turtle_2
This thing has tough skin and thick flesh, and it’s an amphibious ferocious beast, very difficult to provoke. It’s said that during Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s pioneering days in Ping’an Town, he once had to go through great effort to slay two Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragons.
"This Crocodile Flood Dragon has appeared before." Wang Dinghai explained with an unpleasant expression, "It roams up and down the Anjiang every year, covering a range of hundreds of miles of water. Whenever any family’s fishing team encounters it, they fearfully try to avoid it, and occasionally, there are casualties among people and livestock along the shore."
"Hmm? No family has gone to deal with it?" Wang Shouzhe frowned deeply.
"Of course, there have been attempts, but all have failed." Wang Dinghai said, "That thing is extremely cunning and very difficult to deal with in the water. Even ancestral level figures dare not jump into Anjiang to fight it. Moreover, it’s very ill-tempered; whoever dares to provoke it will find their fishing disrupted by its relentless harassment."
Indeed, a Tier Three ferocious beast is different. In terms of combat power and intelligence, it is far beyond Tier Two.
Although the Crocodile Flood Dragon is not as smart as terrestrial ferocious beasts like tigers, it is more troublesome than ordinary aquatic ferocious beasts and holds grudges in particular.
It’s simply a Plague God.
As for seeking celestial realm cultivators to deal with it, that’s even less feasible. There are only three celestial realm cultivators in the Changning Guard.
Two are ancestors of celestial human families, and the other is the Mansion Master of the City Chief’s Mansion, all of whom are people of extraordinary status and position.
Having them get into the water to deal with a Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon, putting aside the potential dangers, the Crocodile Flood Dragon is extremely cunning, appearing and disappearing without a trace, and can completely engage you in guerrilla warfare underwater.
When you come, it leaves; when you leave, it might come back in a month or two.
Therefore, aquatic ferocious beasts, especially grudge-holding ones, are the hardest to provoke.
"This is a big trouble." Wang Dinghai said with worry, "Now it’s the end of the fishing season, and I was planning to accumulate more resources for the family during this period. With that Plague God watching us, at least the latter half of this year won’t be easy."
Wang Shouzhe was also somewhat troubled.
Lately, family expenses have sharply increased, and Qian Gold and various resources are being consumed rapidly.
Already in a somewhat financially strained state, if the two main cash flows of the fishing team and the fish stall stop operating, it would be a fatal blow to the family’s rise and development.
The two ancestors need resources, right? We can’t have them subsist on the minimum resources anymore, can we?
The young progenies of the family with exceptional potential, and a group of young people, are also at the most critical stages of their growth. Cutting off anyone’s resources would be burying their future.
As the first in line, Wang Shouzhe’s consumption is naturally also significant, but he can’t stop his own resources, right?
If he misses this most critical period for growth, who knows how long it will take to reach the Spirit Platform Realm.
"Sixth Uncle, can you guarantee that after we lie low for half a year, it won’t come back next year?" Wang Shouzhe’s eyes already had a hint of fierceness.
"Naturally, I can’t guarantee it." Wang Dinghai said helplessly, "Even if it leaves, it might just wander back one day. I estimate that this several hundred-mile section of Anjiang is its territory."
"Then it truly is a Plague God." Wang Shouzhe deliberated and finally made a decision, "It must be eliminated. Otherwise, our family’s rise will be ended by it."
Eliminated?
Wang Dinghai was flabbergasted.
When did our Wang Family become so formidable?
Even saying the Tier Three aquatic ferocious beast Crocodile Flood Dragon can be eliminated?
"Sixth Uncle, be careful these days, and so should the brothers." Wang Shouzhe advised, "In a few days, I will find a way to eliminate it."
Though unclear about the details, Wang Dinghai still chose to believe in his nephew, who repeatedly created miracles.
...
A few days later, in Anjiang.
A Tier Three Water Origin Spirit Turtle is swimming freely in the wide and turbulent Anjiang, feeling a sense of enjoyment like a dragon returning to the sea.
This large body of water is much better than a small place like Zhuwei Lake.
It surfaced, spouting water, in utter contentment.
"Play is play, but don’t forget the main task." On the ship, Wang Shouzhe, with his hands clasped behind his back, said calmly to the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, "You are bound by blood to me, and a strand of your divine soul is in my hands. With a single thought, I can annihilate your form and spirit."
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle, having attained Tier Three, with a body drastically expanded by another large circle, shivered upon hearing Wang Shouzhe’s words.
This young man is too excessive. Clearly, Master Turtle had already agreed to become the Wang Family’s Spirit Beast, yet he took its essence blood and used an ancient evil technique for refinement. This evil technique, allowing him to annihilate its divine soul with a single thought, was terrifying.
Immediately, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle showed a flattering grin to Wang Shouzhe, expressing that as long as the Patriarch ordered it, Master Turtle, oops, Little Turtle, would do anything.
"Follow under the ship and conceal yourself." Wang Shouzhe instructed, "Prepare to ambush that Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon at any moment."
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle obediently dove down, hiding in the shadow of the ship.
In Wang Shouzhe’s view, to deal with aquatic ferocious beasts, the best choice is an aquatic ferocious beast.
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle naturally became his greatest assistance. However, a Tier Two top-level Water Origin Spirit Turtle could in no way be a match for a Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon; forcing it into battle would be sending it to its death.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe had the idea of using the last [Celestial Spirit Pill].
This Celestial Spirit Pill was an extra gain, accumulated over decades after the Zhao Family usurped the Wang Family’s foundation.
Wang Shouzhe had thought through and considered its use.

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 108: Advancement to Tier 3! Water Origin Spirit Turtle_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 108: Advancement to Tier 3! Water Origin Spirit Turtle_3
If he lets it lie dormant for many years, waiting until he cultivates to the Qi Refining Realm Peak to use it, wouldn’t this resource worth tens of thousands of Qian Gold be wasted in dormancy? But if he sells it, there’s a chance it might lose some value.
After all, people have official channels to buy the Celestial Spirit Pill, so why would they risk buying yours at the same price?
He had also considered using it for the Tier Two top-level Water Origin Spirit Turtle.
But the Water Origin Spirit Turtle had not yet matured, and its relationship with the family was not close. Once it is easily promoted to Tier Three, there is still a certain probability of it escaping or betraying.
However, the Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon Plague God has already forced Wang Shouzhe to bet on the Water Origin Spirit Turtle.
Therefore, before taking action, Wang Shouzhe first used the Ancient Secret Technique "Blood Sacrifice Contract" with the Water Origin Spirit Turtle.
As for where Wang Shouzhe got this Blood Sacrifice Contract technique, it was naturally something he made up.
Anyway, having read many fantasy novels in his previous life, he just crafted a random ceremonial process. Adding some poison, making it taste bitter, it was made quite convincingly and seemed legitimate.
Regardless of whether others believe it or not, this Water Origin Spirit Turtle believed it.
It now worships Wang Shouzhe like a deity, fearing that if it displeases him, it would turn to ash.
...
On the ship, the fishermen were casting nets to catch fish as if continuing their fishing operation. All other fishing methods were temporarily halted, and on the river surface stretching over a hundred miles, only this ship was still fishing.
Two days later.
Just when everyone thought the Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon had already left.
Suddenly, Wang Lici whispered, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I sense something delicious coming, on the left, twenty to thirty zhang away."
She could sense Fierce Beasts and even considered them as delicacies...
This is a kind of bloodline talent that even Ancestor Longyan couldn’t understand.
Wang Shouzhe made a gesture with his hand, and many fishermen became alert. As Wang Lici continuously reported the distance, until it was about to reach the ship’s side, Wang Shouzhe waved his hand.
Suddenly, seven or eight zhang of fishing nets were cast out, forming an overturned sea bowl shape, dropping towards the water. With so many fishing nets, maybe one would catch it, perhaps not all, but at least part of it could entangle it.
"I hit it, hit it."
Wang Goudan yelled in surprise and joy, then he fastened the specially thickened wrist rope to the base of the mast. The other two fishermen also struck parts of the Crocodile Flood Dragon’s body, each making the same move as Wang Goudan.
Thereupon, Wang Xiaohan, Wang Dinghai, and Wang Shouzhe all threw the Fishing and Hunting Spears fiercely towards the direction where the rope was taut.
"Boom Boom Boom!"
The fishing spears plunged into the water, with the Spirit Platform Realm’s Wang Xiaohan’s strike hitting the Crocodile Flood Dragon caught in the net, the long rope stretched tight. The undercurrent beneath the water rolled, a gush of red blood surged up.
Relying on this strength alone, it is impossible to hold the Crocodile Flood Dragon. In two or three moves, it could tear the net, break the rope, and then escape to scheme revenge.
Alas, beneath the boat was also hidden a Tier Three Water Origin Spirit Turtle.
Without waiting for Wang Shouzhe to command, it rushed forward with a howl, biting through net, skin, and flesh, getting entangled with it, then desperately dragging it towards the surface.
When they were vaguely about to surface, Ancestor Longyan had already leapt up, plummeting towards the water.
At the same time,
The Longyan Sword emitted a soul-stirring hum.
Wang Shouzhe’s heart settled, that Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon was doomed.
Thanks to it for gifting the family with a fortune.
And as for Wang Lici, the human radar, she was already starting to drool.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 109 - Achievement! 1 Gate 3 Spirit Platforms
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: 109 Chapter Achievement! 1 Gate 3 Spirit Platforms
...
Even though the Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon was extremely ferocious and cunning.
After being struck by Ancestor Longyan, it still desperately dived deeper into Anjiang. However, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, also an incredibly powerful fierce beast, was both amphibious on water and land.
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle didn’t fight it head-on, instead, it entangled with it, refusing to let it escape.
Not long after, the Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon met its demise, buried under the coordinated attack of two Spirit Platform Realm experts and a Tier Three Spirit Turtle.
Three against one, radar scanning for position, and additionally, the boatmen cast their nets.
With such a luxurious lineup, the Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon truly died a worthy death.
The boatmen jumped into Anjiang, bound its body, and then used a winch to slowly hoist it up. When its body was hung on the side of the ship, the entire ship tilted significantly to one side.
It shows the weight of this fierce Crocodile Flood Dragon!
It was about three and a half zhang long, covered in armor, with rough skin and thick flesh, sharp teeth and claws, extremely fierce. Externally it resembled a crocodile yet also had similarities to a flood dragon, possibly weighing seven to eight thousand jin!
This fierce beast was far superior to Earth’s crocodiles in terms of size, strength, or the special abilities in its bloodline, none of which crocodiles could match.
It could easily sink a merchant ship and then kill everyone on board.
If it weren’t for Wang Lici’s "radar function" enabling them to plan against it with unsuspected intents, along with all the elite members deployed, it wouldn’t have been easy to take it down.
If the first ambush had let it escape, it would have been exceedingly difficult to plan against it again later on.
The Plague God that had run rampant in the water for many years was slain.
Over a dozen boatmen and fishermen shouted with excitement. Never again would they fear encountering the Crocodile Flood Dragon Plague God while fishing in Anjiang.
Moreover, the host family is now so strong that even if similar fierce beasts appear again, everyone would not be afraid.
However, such a fierce beast cannot be disassembled by ordinary people. Its skin was so thick, it was already one of the best materials for making leather armor, common blades couldn’t easily penetrate its defense.
Only Ancestor Xiaohan, Wang Xiaohan, could step in to skin and disassemble it.
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle beside them also watched this scene unfold, humans truly treated fierce beasts cruelly. Forget it, forget it, it must remain obedient and not follow in the footsteps of this Crocodile Flood Dragon brother.
After some hustle and bustle.
The spoils of war were transported one by one into the Wang Family’s warehouse, those needing freezing were frozen. The leather was tanned for processing, later to be crafted into leather armor by the Leather Armor Master.
Some sharp teeth and claws were also materials, which the Weapon Master could forge into daggers, short blades, or arrowheads and such.
Although these weapons and equipment couldn’t reach the Spiritual Artifact Level, they had their own merits.
The remaining bones could be ground into powder to enrich the Spirit Field.
After everything was settled.
Wang Shouzhe called up Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai and said, "Sixth Uncle, currently our Wang Family’s high-end combat power should not be advertised externally."
"I understand, I understand." Wang Dinghai was elated, "Sixth Uncle will definitely keep those little brats quiet."
Ancestor Longyan’s injuries had greatly improved, seemingly able to take action multiple times. Moreover, his father Wang Xiaohan had actually broken through to the Spirit Platform Realm.
And the family even acquired a Tier Three Water Origin Spirit Turtle.
The family’s strength had greatly increased.
In a sense, the family had now become a three Spirit Platform entity.
Secure!
Comfortable!
"Just that isn’t enough, this matter is of great importance; before we can completely defeat the Liu and Zhao Clans, we absolutely cannot reveal our trump card." Wang Shouzhe tapped his fingers on the table, frowning and musing, "As a precaution against any leaks, we need to send away those boatmen and fishermen."
Send away?
Wang Dinghai’s body trembled, he stared at Wang Shouzhe in shock, "Shouzhe, you, you, you, you’re not planning to..."
"Sixth Uncle, where is your mind going? I mean, send them a bit farther to stay a while, lest anyone spill secrets while drinking too much. This matter concerns the turning point of the family’s destiny, the more cautious, the fewer mistakes." Wang Shouzhe deliberated, "Send them all to East Port. Brother Chen’s work is quite reliable, let’s have him arrange it. Sixth Uncle, why don’t you go personally, and hand-deliver a letter to Young Clan Leader Chen, telling him I have a profitable venture to discuss with him."
"Shouzhe thought this through very thoroughly." Wang Dinghai breathed a sigh of relief, cupping his hands together, "Since that’s the case, Sixth Uncle will make a trip."
Thankfully, Shouzhe wasn’t planning to silence them; otherwise, he wouldn’t know what to do.
"By the way, cut a piece of the Crocodile Flood Dragon’s tail for Young Clan Leader Chen, as a return gift for my sister," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Though they’re not married yet, we can’t just eat their Iron-backed Wild Boar meat without returning the favor, or we’d be underestimated."
Earlier, there really wasn’t anything good to give back, but Wang Shouzhe remembered this matter. At the same time, it was also a hint to the Chen Family.
Our Wang Family can even slay a Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast.
Wang Shouzhe could already foresee Chen Fangjie’s shocked expression.
...
After handling the matter of the Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon.
Wang Shouzhe entered a reclusive and secluded state, each day spent in cultivation, drinking tea, and casually managing some affairs.
Then he would go to the lakeside to build rapport with the Water Origin Spirit Turtle.
Spirit Beasts, like humans, require relationship building.
However, in one aspect, they’re not quite the same; humans’ emotions can be overly complex, quick to come and quick to go.
Whereas the emotions of Spirit Beasts are relatively purer; once it truly acknowledges you as a partner, it remains steadfast, rarely betraying.
Of course, this process isn’t simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 109 - Achievement! 1 Gate 3 Spirit Platforms_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: 109 Chapter Achievement! 1 Gate 3 Spirit Platforms_2
Fortunately, between Wang Shouzhe and the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, due to the link established by the "Ancient Bloodline Contract Secret Technique," they have already experienced "bloodline fusion" and have achieved a preliminary level of "trust."
Every day, they bask in the sun together, eat some Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon meat, and occasionally enjoy grilled Spirit Fish, dried fish, and Spirit Wine.
Then, he would narrate tales from history about masters and spirit beasts who protect each other, portraying steadfast loyalty, inspiring stories of courage and conviction.
Occasionally, there would be tales of spirit beasts that betrayed their masters, ending up in very miserable situations.
Similar stories have been heard frequently on Earth.
Wang Shouzhe, always adept and articulate, could recount them without repetition for a whole month, effectively guiding the Water Origin Spirit Turtle to establish the correct worldview as a spirit beast.
One human and one turtle, their relationship rapidly moved into a "warming up" state.
...
On this day.
Household General Wang Zhong came to report that Zhong Xingwang of the Zhong Family had come secretly for a visit.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe warmly greeted Zhong Xingwang in the main hall. During their last drinking session in the Hundred Islands Guard, they had started addressing each other as brothers.
After some brief chatter over Spirit Tea, they both felt much more at ease.
"Younger Brother Shouzhe." Zhong Xingwang took out a jade bottle from his bosom, "You wrote to me some time ago requesting help to find a ’Spirit Awakening Pill.’ Coincidentally, someone is consigning one for sale, so I brought it to you promptly."
"Brother Zhong." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hand in gratitude, "Such a small matter, why did you bother coming personally?"
The [Spirit Awakening Pill] is merely a Tier Three Spirit Pill, but due to its low sales, very few alchemists would focus on crafting it. The fewer the craftsmen, the rarer it becomes, and the price increases.
The current market price is about eight hundred Qian Gold per pill, and it is notably hard to find.
To most people, this pill is practically useless, offering only minor talent enhancement for a hefty price, making it cost-ineffective.
For many Ninth Grade Lower-Rank Clans, accumulating eight hundred Qian Gold in a year, after accounting for all expenses, can be quite a challenge.
However, Wang Shouzhe’s talent was originally Lower Grade A, and he ranked very high within Grade A, just a step away from Middle Grade Talent.
If he could transform to Middle Grade Talent through this pill, then it would be well worth it.
"It’s no trouble; I am merely idling away my time in the clan industry." Zhong Xingwang laughed heartily, "With nothing much to do, I decided to drop by and see you."
See me?
What’s there to see about me?
Wang Shouzhe chuckled inwardly, knowing Zhong Xingwang surely came because of Ancestor Longyan. However, he knew very well that with Ancestor Longyan’s character and vision, she would never pay attention to Zhong Xingwang.
After taking the Spirit Awakening Pill, Wang Shouzhe asked and determined that Zhong Xingwang had bought it for seven hundred Qian Gold. Yet, Wang Shouzhe still offered him eight hundred Qian Gold Notes. Surely, he couldn’t let a Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator make a trip for nothing?
Zhong Xingwang declined repeatedly but couldn’t win against Wang Shouzhe’s insistence, finally accepting the eight hundred Qian Gold. Feeling uneasy, he hesitantly asked, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, uh, do you happen to know how my senior is doing lately?"
"Brother Zhong," Wang Shouzhe solemnly replied, "Our family’s ancestor is healthy and fine, but she has been in seclusion recently."
In reality, these days the ancestor has been with Wang Lici, helping her absorb the residual spiritual energy from the Vermilion Fruit. Also, she needed to guide Sixth Uncle Wang Xiaohan, aid him in stabilizing his realm quickly, and impart insights on the Spirit Platform Realm.
Though quite busy, she’s not truly in seclusion.
Before meeting Zhong Xingwang, Wang Shouzhe had gone to Ancestor Longyan to inquire about her intentions.
Clearly, the ancestor didn’t want to meet him, letting Wang Shouzhe handle the reception.
"Oh really?" Zhong Xingwang was slightly disappointed but said, "Since Senior Sister is in seclusion, I’ll stay and wait for a few days. Younger Brother Shouzhe, could you arrange a guest room for me?"
Uh...
Wang Shouzhe hadn’t expected Zhong Xingwang to be so persistent.
Yet, with this request, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t easily refuse. Quickly, he had servant Wang Gui arrange for Zhong Xingwang to stay in guest quarters, assigning two clever servants to assist him.
After arranging Zhong Xingwang’s stay.
Wang Shouzhe returned to his residence, intending to bathe and attempt using the costly [Spirit Awakening Pill].
Unexpectedly, just as he lay in the wooden tub to relax.
Wang Lici burst in fiercely: "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I remembered, I remembered."
"..." Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat, reminding her, "I’m bathing."
"I know, I’m not blind. Fourth Uncle, you go ahead and bathe." Wang Lici sat down on a chair beside the tub, excitedly saying, "Fourth Uncle, I’ve thought of that thing."
"Get out!"
"..."
...
Outside the room.
Wang Lici urged anxiously, "Fourth Uncle, can you hurry up; it’s hard to remember the location."
"Fourth Uncle, if you don’t come out soon, I’ll forget."
"Never mind, take your time. Meanwhile, I’ll have a hotpot... Fourth Uncle, the clear broth hotpot you made the other day was quite nice."
Before she finished her sentence, Wang Shouzhe had already dressed and walked out, wearing a scowl, and staring at her fiercely.
"Fourth Uncle, you’re already done?" Wang Lici seemed slightly disappointed.
"If I delayed any longer, you’d probably have set up the hotpot table." Wang Shouzhe said casually while tidying his attire, "Lici, you’re a grown woman now. Didn’t Big Brother and Sister-in-law teach you... about male-female interactions? How can girls simply barge in when a man is taking a bath?"
"They did, and the clan academy’s old scholar keeps nagging about it." Wang Lici laughed heartlessly, "But Fourth Uncle isn’t a man."
"?" Wang Shouzhe’s look could kill.
"No, I mean, Fourth Uncle is family... Plus, Fourth Uncle’s figure isn’t bad; I don’t mind seeing you bathe."
Thank you for the compliment, but I do mind!
"Ahem!" Wang Shouzhe said seriously, "Lici, even with family, you should respect male-female propriety. Next time, don’t just barge in when I’m bathing."
Oh, okay! Wang Lici replied indifferently.
Knowing that Wang Shouzhe understands this girl has no worries, filled with thoughts only of eating, he didn’t dwell on the matter, "By the way, what did you remember that was so startling?"
"Oh, if you hadn’t reminded me, I’d have forgotten." Wang Lici glanced around his room, finding nothing good to eat, so she took out a preserved melon from her stash, crunching on it, "Fourth Uncle, didn’t you ask me before, what was it I found once with Luoqiu and Luojing? Did they eat something there?"
With delight, Wang Shouzhe said, "What, did you remember?"
"It was autumn, and many wild fruit trees on the mountain were fruiting." Wang Lici recounted, "I brought back some wild fruits and half a bottle of spring water. I thought, I’m the eldest sister, I should give the children at home something to eat. But Shouyong and Shou Lian were too scared to eat. Only Luojing and Luoqiu were eating cheerfully."
Giving the children at home something to eat? You truly are considerate.
"Do you still recall any special fruits among those wild ones?" Wang Shouzhe asked, "Like peculiar shapes or something distinct like the Vermilion Fruit."
"No, just some regular wild fruits." Wang Lici pondered thoughtfully, "Those wild fruits, I used to pick and eat them each year; nothing special. Oh, that bottle of water... I collected it from inside a cavern, it was sticky, resembling transparent milk."
Sticky? Like transparent milk?
Wang Shouzhe felt his face darken, you called that spring water?
However, his heart skipped a beat, and he exclaimed, "Could it be Stone Marrow?"
Stone Marrow, the name sounds mundane.
Yet this item is far from ordinary. It’s revered as the Essence of the Earth Veins, occasionally forming and concentrating within the mountains as High-Grade Heavenly and Earthly Treasures.
Its greatest function is to be combined with other Heavenly and Earthly Treasures to craft a Tier Six Spirit Pill— [Bone Marrow Purify Pill].
The human body’s blood production comes from the bone marrow, the root of bloodline. Yet, the Bone Marrow Purify Pill can awaken latent potential within the marrow, completely enhancing bloodline talent, activating ancient latent bloodlines within.
This item is extraordinary, unlike the "Spirit Awakening Pill" considered insignificant; its price and rarity are beyond the reach of Spirit Platform Families.
Even the Celestial Human Families, in pursuit of a [Bone Marrow Purify Pill], would suffer substantial stress.
Realizing this, Wang Shouzhe was overjoyed.
His ordinary talent finally had a chance of salvation!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 110: Awakening! Wang Shouzhe’s Bloodline Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 110: Awakening! Wang Shouzhe’s Bloodline Talent
...
In fact, Wang Shouzhe’s talent, compared to other Ninth-Grade Noble Family members, is already considered not bad.
But with such talent, reaching the Spirit Platform Realm and living almost two hundred years is basically the end of the line.
If he wants to go further, even if he uses resources to push himself, the chances are still small with his current talent and potential. Of course, it doesn’t mean he won’t advance at all, just that the chances of breaking through to Celestial Human are small.
"Lici, take your Fourth Uncle to have a look," Wang Shouzhe suppressed his excitement, "You should still remember the place, right? After all, you’re familiar with the family back mountain."
"Vaguely remember, haven’t been up the mountain in a couple of years," Wang Lici said nonchalantly, "Fourth Uncle, this season, a lot of wild mountain fruits aren’t ripe yet, they’re bitter and astringent and not tasty."
Who’s after those wild mountain fruits? Your Fourth Uncle is looking for Stone Marrow!
His eyelids twitched, what exactly is going through your mind?
Forget it, forget it, take her and slowly search.
Afterwards, he grabbed Wang Lici and then looked for Ancestor Longyan and Ancestor Xiaohan.
Upon hearing that there might be Stone Marrow in the back mountain, they were also quite shocked. This thing is priceless, even if the entire Wang Family industry is sold, it wouldn’t be enough to exchange for a Bone Marrow Purify Pill.
The four of them headed up the mountain.
The Wang Family’s Main Residence is near a branch of Liuan Mountain.
Although it’s just a branch, it’s still magnificent and vast, with peaks piled up. The terrain is very steep, making it difficult for ordinary Fierce Beasts to cross, serving as a natural barrier for the Wang Family’s Main Residence.
When Ancestor Zhou Xuan chose this place to establish the main residence, he first saw the ease of defense and difficulty of attack, and second, that it had excellent feng shui with its proximity to mountains and water.
Of course, Ancestor Zhou Xuan had cleared the surrounding Fierce Beasts several times, so it’s generally considered safe.
Considering Wang Lici was young, she couldn’t possibly have crossed those steep mountain ravines at that time.
Thus, the search range was significantly reduced.
After searching for two days.
Wang Lici suddenly remembered: "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, it’s there. Follow the small creek down the valley, and ahead there’s a small waterfall. The cave is behind the waterfall."
Everyone followed her words, and sure enough, they found a hidden cave behind a small waterfall.
Being prepared, Wang Shouzhe lit a few torches and followed the winding cave path. Soon, the scenery suddenly opened up, and they entered a spacious cave.
Above, many stalactites hung down, with some liquid dripping from them.
"Fourth Uncle, don’t pay attention to these plain mountain spring waters, they’re not tasty," Wang Lici said, leading the group further. They came to a seemingly ordinary stalactite.
"Fourth Uncle, look, it’s this one. The mountain spring water it drips is delicious," Wang Lici said excitedly.
"?" Wang Shouzhe scrutinized it and honestly couldn’t tell what was special about this stalactite. But it was hanging quite high, about three feet above the ground.
Furthermore, the stone directly beneath it had been eroded to form a fist-sized depression, and the area was crystalline and translucent, looking almost like jade.
In that groove lay a semi-transparent, milky white liquid that faintly glimmered with starlight.
"It truly is Stone Marrow, quite beautiful," Ancestor Longyan said with slight excitement, "I’ve only seen it in academy atlases, never in reality."
"Only one drop?"
Wang Shouzhe’s heart sank, and then he looked up at the stalactite tip, noticing it also seemed somewhat crystalline, like something was about to drip out.
Ancestor Longyan took out a Jade Bottle, reverently collected the single drop of Stone Marrow, and handed it to Wang Shouzhe, saying, "Shouzhe, the Stone Marrow is the essence of Earth Vein, even a single drop is extraordinarily valuable. Keep this drop for yourself, it should help you break through your bloodline."
"Wang Lici, why is there only one drop?" Wang Shouzhe asked speechlessly.
Wang Lici blinked, gently touched Wang Shouzhe’s forehead, and said, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, aren’t you being silly? Because I already took away the others, and shared them with Luqiu and Luojing."
"This drop must have dripped later. Last time I saw that there was still half a drop hanging above, but it was too high to lick. I suppose this drop is yours, Fourth Uncle."
Wang Shouzhe slapped his forehead, feeling grateful that she was considerate enough to leave one drop. His heart ached, "Lici, when you took it last time, how big was the bottle?"
"Not big, but the groove was full," Wang Lici said carelessly, "It was too little, each of us only got a couple of sips, and it was gone."
The groove was full? Only two sips per person and it was gone?
Wang Shouzhe felt like he shouldn’t have asked, asking only made him more upset.
"Oh, my Lici truly is blessed," Ancestor Xiaohan commented from the side, "No matter where she goes, she finds good things to eat, even Stone Marrow can be eaten by the mouthful. No wonder the young women in our family are so impressive."
That hurt, Ancestor.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe stared at the stalactite and asked, "Ancestor, if we cut open this rock, could there be more Stone Marrow inside?"
