"Shouzhe, don’t exhaust the resources," Ancestor Longyan said, "There might be more drops inside, but ultimately it would destroy this treasure spot. The emergence of Stone Marrow is the essence of Earth Vein gradually brewing, and no one knows where it might appear in the future."
Wang Shouzhe was only joking, how could they casually destroy the family foundation?

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 110 Awakening! Wang Shouzhe’s Bloodline Talent_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 110 Awakening! Wang Shouzhe’s Bloodline Talent_2
Moreover, there are some things he is quite open-minded about. Everyone has their own opportunities, and since this is Lici and the others’ opportunity, he’s envious but not jealous. After all, with a few exceptional sisters, he can also bask in their reflected glory.
See, he managed to benefit from Lici a little and got a drop, which in turn added a new foundation to the family.
Subsequently, the two Ancestors discussed sealing this cave, planning to inspect it every few years to see how long it takes to accumulate a drop of Stone Marrow.
This item is indeed an exceptionally valuable Heavenly and Earthly Treasure; even if it takes twenty years to produce a drop, it’s worth it.
After returning home,
Wang Shouzhe rejected all matters and locked himself in his room.
After sincerely bathing, he began to attempt a breakthrough in his bloodline. Naturally, he did not immediately use the Stone Marrow. The Stone Marrow is quite valuable; it’s best to accumulate a bit and use it to craft Bone Marrow Purify Pill, which has effects far superior to direct consumption.
He opened the jade bottle, swallowed a [Spirit Awakening Pill], and then sat in meditation for Qi refining.
An hour later, Wang Shouzhe ended his session.
His face was somewhat disappointed. This Spirit Awakening Pill did cause a slight heat sensation throughout his body, as if there was a feeling of transformation.
But ultimately, he didn’t evolve from lower grade to middle grade, and his bloodline didn’t change at all.
Indeed, the Spirit Awakening Pill is just that, unable to push even someone like him, who is on the verge of stepping into the middle grade. No wonder it’s considered a rather chicken-ribs type spirit pill.
Of course, this doesn’t mean it has no effect at all. Even slight improvements in talent, over prolonged cultivation and resource consumption, can yield slight efficiency gains, making it worthwhile.
Especially for someone like Wang Shouzhe, who consumes resources heavily and accelerates cultivation. Maybe over decades, these slight improvements might save up eight hundred Qian Gold altogether.
"It seems I can only place my hopes on this drop of Stone Marrow now." Wang Shouzhe took out the jade bottle.
The effect of swallowing it raw is, of course, not as good as crafting pills, but merely a drop of Stone Marrow isn’t enough to craft anything substantial.
Yet, this one drop of Stone Marrow should surpass that Spirit Awakening Pill by a considerable margin.
After a brief consideration, Wang Shouzhe swallowed the drop of Stone Marrow. It felt slightly cool upon entry but transformed into the purest energy and entered his body.
He dared not delay and immediately entered a cultivation state again.
The whole person seemed to enter a state of tranquility.
A quarter-hour passed.
An hour passed.
Mists rose from his body, and his skin appeared red and heated.
No one knows how much time passed before he slowly opened his eyes, and a touch of unusual color appeared in his distinctly black and white eyes. Black dirt appeared outside the pores of his skin.
His face lit up with joy; this was a sign after bone marrow purification and fur cutting.
This grime wasn’t from expelling toxins and impurities from the body but was dead cells expelled through metabolism.
Usually, this process is relatively slow. After bone marrow purification, a large number of cellular changes occur, causing this phenomenon.
He was in a great mood, thinking he must have broken through his bloodline, and his cultivation had also made progress.
He instructed the servant Wang Gui to boil water, and after taking a bath, he felt refreshed. Looking into the copper mirror, he felt he appeared a bit more handsome.
He was originally only half a step ahead of Chen Fangjie, now he’s a cut ahead.
However, what kind of bloodline has been awakened is difficult for Wang Shouzhe to determine; it requires detailed experiments to conclude.
After all, with generations of ancestors intermarrying and generations of descendants reproducing, contemporary human bloodlines are incredibly intricate.
Even if the first ancestor was like the Flame Emperor, by the time it’s passed to Wang Shouzhe’s generation, it’s not surprising to awaken a different ancestral ice element bloodline.
"Come, fire." Wang Shouzhe first prepared a piece of paper, then attempted to ignite it with his Profound Qi; unexpectedly, the paper didn’t catch fire but silently turned into fragments.
It seems it isn’t a fire attribute bloodline physique.
Wang Shouzhe was a bit disappointed.
Fire attribute bloodlines have quite an advantage in battles, with high explosive power and damage, also making it easier to become an artifact refiner, alchemist, or other side professions.
Moreover, he noticed his Profound Qi originally had a very pure hue after cultivating the Profound Origin Technique. However, now it faintly carried a tinge of green.
Could it be?
Like the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, does he have a water element bloodline physique? This is also an excellent physique, as the water element balances offense and defense and provides strong Water Escape Technique capabilities, useful for underwater treasure hunts.
Immediately, he instructed the servant to bring a basin of water. Placing his hand in the water, he circulated his Profound Qi. The water in the basin spun and splashed under the impact of Profound Qi, yet showed no signs of control.
Too bad~~ it’s not a water element bloodline physique.
Thus, he began testing one by one.
His strength and explosive power didn’t have any notable increase, nor was there the thrilling sensation during the small cosmic explosion.
Hmm~ it almost rules out all War Body type bloodlines.
That’s fine, too; no need to compete for the vanguard position with Wang Luqiu. And being a Clan Leader, charging in battle at the forefront is not a good idea.
Earth element?
Quickly ruled out, which is good because Ancestor Xiaohan seems to have awakened an earth element bloodline.
Thunder element? Ice element? Wind element?
These belong to three major Abnormal Attribute Systems. Their advantage is high combat power, but the downside is future cultivation techniques are hard to find.
Ancestor Longyan possessed an ice element bloodline; now she’s at the second layer level of ice element, with quite explosive combat power.
After testing, Wang Shouzhe found he had nothing to do with those three Abnormal Attribute bloodlines.
The slightly green Profound Qi.
Could it be wood element?
He found a potted plant, which was an unusually shaped aged pine with vigorous, ancient strength.
This object would be quite valuable on Earth, but here in the Black Tortoise World, it was not well taken care of and had begun to wither.
Wang Shouzhe grasped the pine’s branch, and it seemed to be covered with a layer of vibrant green light, the withered roots and stems filled with new life, the withered portions gradually replaced with a flourishing vitality, exuding great energy.
"The withered tree comes back to life!"
Wang Shouzhe exclaimed with joy. This is the manifestation of bone marrow purify and fur cutting.
Wang Shouzhe was in a great mood. He believed he had finally broken through his bloodline barrier, gaining a true bloodline talent.
He ordered the servant Wang Gui to prepare water, took a bath, and felt thoroughly refreshed. Looking in the copper mirror, he thought he seemed to look a bit more handsome.
He had been slightly ahead of Chen Fangjie, but now he was leaving him behind.
But what kind of bloodline has truly awakened, Wang Shouzhe himself couldn’t discern easily, it would need a series of experiments to determine roughly.
After all, as generations of ancestors intermarried and descendants reproduced, the bloodlines of present-day humans are extremely complex.
Even if the first ancestor was an existence like the Flame Emperor, it’s not surprising that by the time it passed down to Wang Shouzhe’s generation, another ancestor’s ice element bloodline might awaken.
"Come Fire." Wang Shouzhe first prepared a piece of paper, then tried to set it on fire with Profound Qi, only to find the paper didn’t ignite but quietly crumbled to pieces instead.
It doesn’t seem to be a fire attribute bloodline.
Wang Shouzhe was slightly disappointed.
Bloodlines of the fire attribute possess considerable advantage in combat, having strong explosive and damaging power, and they make it relatively easy to double as an artifact refiner, alchemist, and other side professions.
Moreover, observing his Profound Qi, which used to be quite pure in color from practicing the Profound Origin Technique, now it faintly had a tint of green.
Could it be?
Like the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, is it a water element bloodline? Of course, that’s also a good constitution, given that the water element is excellent in both offense and defense, along with the strong Water Escape Technique and convenience for underwater treasure hunting.
Immediately, he ordered the servant to bring a basin of water and, placing his hand into the water, he attempted to control it with his bloodline talent. The basin of water remained undisturbed; it did not respond to his control.
Alas~~ it was not a water element bloodline.
He continued testing his bloodline talent in small increments.
For instance, in situations like bringing an unbloomed flowerpot to life with a single touch, where any inexperienced person would find it natural.
He tried holding a conifer, firm and ancient, which was withered from lack of care, yet again, due to Wang Shouzhe’s busy life.
As he held the branch, the pine seemed to glow with a layer of life-filled green light, the dead trunk appeared to be revitalized, and the wither was gradually replaced with abundant vitality.
"Rebirth of the withered tree!"
Wang Shouzhe exclaimed with joy; this was the manifestation following Bone Marrow Purify and Fur Cutting.
This was not about toxins and impurities being expelled, but about dead cells being shed through metabolism from the skin.
Normally, this process is relatively slow. But after Bone Marrow Purify and Fur Cutting, there is a massive cell replacement, leading to such anomalies.
His mood was excellent, feeling that he had definitely broken through his bloodline and gained progress in his cultivation as well.
He instructed the servant Wang Gui to heat water, then took a bath, leaving him completely refreshed. Looking in the copper mirror, he felt as if he had somehow grown more handsome again.
He used to only be half a step ahead of Chen Fangjie, now he had left him far behind.
However, Wang Shouzhe himself found it difficult to detect which bloodline had awakened and needed to experiment one by one to ascertain.
After all, generations of ancestral intermarriage, the proliferation of generation after generation, have led to a very complex bloodline in modern-day humans.
Even if the first ancestor was an entity like the Flame Emperor, by the time it reached Wang Shouzhe’s generation, awakening some other ancestor’s ice element bloodline would be no surprise.
"Come fire." Wang Shouzhe first prepared a piece of paper, then attempted to ignite it using his Profound Qi. To his dismay, the paper didn’t catch fire but instead silently crumbled into pieces.
It seems I do not possess a fire attribute bloodline physique.
Wang Shouzhe felt slightly disappointed.
Bloodlines of the fire attribute have considerable advantages in battles, with high explosive and destructive power, and they relatively easily double as Artifact Refiners, Alchemists, and other side professions.
Moreover, looking at his Profound Qi, which was originally quite pure in color after cultivating the Profound Origin Technique, it now had a faint tinge of green.
Could it possibly be?
Like the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, is it a water element bloodline physique? This, of course, is also a good physique, as water elements offer both offense and defense, with strong Water Escape Technique abilities, making underwater treasure hunts much more convenient.
Immediately, he had the servant bring a basin of water, placed his hand into it, and tried to wield the power again. However, the water remained unmoved without any sign of control.
Unfortunately~~ it wasn’t a water element bloodline physique either.
Then, he tested one ability after another from his bloodline talents.
For instance, with a potted flower that hadn’t bloomed yet, he placed his hand over it, and it seemed as though a layer of life-filled green light enveloped it, and its withered roots became revitalized by life itself, transforming the withered into a vibrant vitality.
"A withered tree meets spring again!"
Wang Shouzhe exclaimed with joy, as he realized this was the manifestation of Bone Marrow Purify and Fur Cutting’s results.
This process did not involve expelling toxins or impurities from the body, but was about dead cells being shed through metabolic processes and expelled through the skin.
Typically, this process is relatively slow. But after Bone Marrow Purify and Fur Cutting, a large amount of cell turnover occurs, causing this anomaly.
He was in a great mood, feeling that he had probably broken through his bloodline barriers, and his cultivation had improved as well.
He instructed the servant Wang Gui to heat water for a bath, and after washing, he felt completely refreshed. Looking at himself in the copper mirror, he felt as though he might have grown a bit more handsome again.
Originally, he was just ahead of Chen Fangjie by a smidge, now he had left him behind.
However, what exactly did he awaken? Even Wang Shouzhe found it hard to determine this. He needed to experiment with each one to figure it out.
After all, after generations of ancestral marriages and generations of descendants, contemporary human bloodlines became incredibly complex.
Even if the first ancestor was an existence like the Flame Emperor, it wasn’t surprising for another ancestor’s ice element bloodline to awaken in Wang Shouzhe’s generation.
"Fire, come." Wang Shouzhe first prepared a piece of paper and attempted to ignite it with his Profound Qi, but the paper didn’t blaze and silently crumbled into pieces.
It appears this is not some fire attribute bloodline physique.
Wang Shouzhe was slightly disappointed.
Bloodlines of fire attribute possess considerable advantages in combat, with strong explosive power and damage, also making it easier to take on side professions such as an artifact refiner or alchemist.
Furthermore, he looked at his Profound Qi, which he had cultivated using the Profound Origin Technique; its color was quite pure. However, at that moment, it carried a tinge of green.
Could it be?
Could it be a water element-like the Water Origin Spirit Turtle? That would be a good physique too, as water elements offer both strong offense and defense, with powerful Water Escape Technique abilities, making underwater treasure hunting much easier.
Immediately, he had the servant bring a basin of water and tried to control it. However, it remained unaltered without any sign of control.
Unfortunate~~ it’s not a water element bloodline physique.
He proceeded to test further.
For instance, by holding a potted plant wither, the plant seems to be covered in a layer of vivid green life light, the withered roots receiving a gloss as if infused with life, the branches drawing out fresh green leaves, the withering gradually replaced by vibrant vitality.
"A withered tree reborn in spring!"
Wang Shouzhe felt excited for the first time, experiencing his bloodline abilities. The sensation was natural, as if it came very fluently, like a natural part of him.
This ability to control plant vitality seemed innately fused into his bloodline, becoming a natural instinct.
No wonder, Ci’Er herself didn’t even know she had a bloodline talent, just feeling it all as a matter of course.
And Wang Luojing unknowingly walked the path of a Spirit Insect Master, for that was her bloodline’s innate talent.-
Wang Luqiu, too, with her passion and love for battle, where she gets fired up every time she fights. That’s her innate War Body bloodline, subtly influencing her to do so.
What’s called a bloodline talent?
Naturally, it’s the abilities passed down by ancestors through genetic bloodlines, and once activated, you use them as easily as eating or drinking water without the need to learn.
This is talent.
Ever since Wang Shouzhe transmigrated to this day, it’s his first time feeling so excited.
I, Wang Shouzhe, have finally broken free from the shackles of lower grade talent and have acquired my bloodline talent.
Being a transmigrator, to not have a golden finger, no system, no talent, was genuinely humiliating.
Then he experimented with other capabilities of his bloodline talent.
For example, he made an unopened flower bloom instantly, filling the pot beautifully.
The wood element is primarily about life recovery.
In his excitement, he thought of this.
Immediately, he asked the servant Wang Gui to come and cut a small wound on his arm with a sword.
Then, under Wang Gui’s panicked and shocked gaze, he invoked his bloodline talent. The wound on his arm healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, leaving no scars, making it even whiter and more tender than before.
Impressive!
Wang Shouzhe was somewhat astonished. If this were on Earth, wouldn’t it make him far superior to a doctor? Who would need surgeries or cosmetic surgeons?
With a single hand, he would surely amass great wealth, with no shortage of girlfriends.
Such a powerful and distinctive bloodline talent, Wang Shouzhe was quite satisfied. Undoubtedly, this bloodline talent greatly increased his survival chances.
Even if his sisters get injured in future battles, he could easily help heal them.
Wait!?
Wang Shouzhe suddenly felt something was a bit off?
After pondering for a while, he suddenly realized.
Oh my %#￥#...
Isn’t this a support role!?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 111: Shocking! Shouzhe’s Talent Is Not Simple (5000-word - Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 111: Shocking! Shouzhe’s Talent Is Not Simple (5000-word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes)
...
For a moment, Wang Shouzhe didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
This bloodline awakening—coming and going. He had long awaited this bloodline talent, but in the end, it turned out to be a support role.
Could it be that he would rely on a few sisters and ancestors to hold the front line while he, Wang Shouzhe, supports from the back?
However, upon careful consideration, this might not necessarily be a bad thing.
As the clan leader, he is the foundation of the clan, the central soul.
Whether on the battlefield or in other situations, his fall would be a fatal blow to the family.
The wood bloodline talent seems not to have explosive power in combat, but it certainly possesses the most tenacious life force. Even if you can’t take them down immediately, it’s the kind that can eventually outlast you.
Moreover, the potential it holds is also incredibly vast. Any bloodline talent naturally has its strengths and weaknesses, it’s most important to see how it is used.
Additionally, the wood bloodline talent is quite beneficial for longevity. The Spirit Platform Realm has a limit at two hundred years, but most Spirit Platform Realm cultivators do not live to two hundred.
But with the wood bloodline talent, the body’s conditioning is relatively good. As long as nothing unexpected happens midway, living up to the limit is not a big problem, and surpassing it is quite possible.
For enemies of the same age and realm, it is highly possible to laugh last by relying on a longer lifespan...
There is also another very important point.
Through the process of accelerating the growth of several plants, he discovered that after the bloodline awakening, his affinity and understanding of plants were rapidly strengthening.
This is extremely beneficial for the family’s future development.
Take the current rice seeds commonly used by the family, for example. The yield per season is about three bushels. But in Wang Shouzhe’s memory, the yield per acre on Earth far exceeds this number.
If he could cultivate higher quality rice seeds, wheat seeds... it wouldn’t take much. If the yield per acre increased by one bushel, the family’s productivity would suddenly skyrocket.
Moreover, there are spirit seed plants, etc.
The plants currently used by the family for cultivation and production are all ordinary varieties of spirit plants, common goods. If, relying on this bloodline ability, there is a chance to improve varieties, wouldn’t that be something?
The more Wang Shouzhe thought about it, the more he felt the marvel of his awakened bloodline talent. He just had little understanding of bloodline talents. Tomorrow, he still had to ask the ancestor, what exactly is this wood bloodline talent?
...
Almost simultaneously.
Outside Changning Guard City.
In a secret manor, the moon was full.
A gorgeously dressed middle-aged man with an imposing presence was watching the spirit fish in the small lake as they darted around to feed.
From time to time, he would grab a few ice spirit silkworms and throw them down, causing the handsome little predatory spirit fish to scramble for them.
Behind him.
The two ancestors of the Liu and Zhao Clans, Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, stood with their hands at their sides, not daring to take a deep breath, as if they were servants waiting for orders at any moment.
After a long time, the charismatic middle-aged man finished feeding the fish, turned, and sat down to drink tea: "Liu Zhide, Zhao Bojun. Fifty years ago, we made an agreement, and since then we have not met. Why do you two want to break the agreement today?"
"Senior."
Liu Zhide’s cheek twitched slightly, cautiously saying, "We have nowhere else to turn, so we come to seek your help, Senior."
"The matter of that year has been settled." The middle-aged man drank his tea, speaking calmly, "You have also obtained the positions you should have. We owe each other nothing."
"Senior." Zhao Bojun said gravely, "But do not forget, should the Wang Family rise, once they know the truth of that year..."
"Oh?" The middle-aged man smiled faintly, "Elder Bojun, could it be that you are threatening me?"
Zhao Bojun broke out in a cold sweat, hurriedly bowing, "Bojun wouldn’t dare, but our two clans are now at a life-and-death juncture. Please, senior, do not withhold your support."
The middle-aged man drank his tea, half-closing his eyes.
"Senior, the situation is this." Liu Zhide stepped forward cautiously, "Currently, the arrogance of the Wang Family is mainly because of that new clan leader, Wang Shouzhe. If he can be eliminated, the rise of the Wang Family will certainly be curtailed."
Seeing the middle-aged man did not object.
Liu Zhide added, "But that Wang Shouzhe is very cunning, doing things unexpectedly, with many trump cards in hand. Moreover, he hasn’t been stepping out lately, making it difficult for us to find an opportunity."
"We have now received news that the Wang Family will once again hold the traditional autumn-winter hunting event, which will be our Liu and Zhao Clans’ only chance for a comeback. If we can take out Wang Shouzhe, and even Wang Longyan, and those younger generation members... the Wang Family will be like autumn locusts, not lasting long."
The middle-aged man drank his tea, sneering slightly, "You two dignified ancestors, and yet you cannot deal with a half-disabled Wang Longyan?"
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun exchanged an awkward glance.
Zhao Bojun said helplessly, "The senior may not know, but although that Wang Shouzhe is young, he is as cunning as a fox and afraid of death. Moreover, his high-profile move to participate in the autumn-winter hunt may not be without the idea of luring us out and then eliminating us."
"As the saying goes, plan for the worst, we must estimate that besides Wang Longyan, there is at least one, possibly even two Spirit Platform Realm cultivators by his side."
"Therefore, we need a strong reinforcement that can hold Wang Longyan at bay." Liu Zhide added, "Only if that’s ensured, Bojun and I can hold off the two potential Spirit Platform Realm cultivators that may appear. Our clans’ other elite clansmen will be enough to kill Wang Shouzhe and a bunch of juniors."

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 111: Shocking! Shouzhe’s Talent Is Not Simple (5000-word - Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 111: Shocking! Shouzhe’s Talent Is Not Simple (5000-word Chapter Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
"Two Spirit Platform Realm experts?" The middle-aged man sneered, "Do you hold Wang Shouzhe in such high regard that you invite his clan ancestor to participate in a clan duel, which is a taboo in Daqian? How many in-law ancestors would dare to risk breaking the taboo for him?"
"Last time, Gongsun Mang was already pushing the boundaries. But he wasn’t the one who initiated; it was you who ran into him, and he could use self-defense as an excuse. Besides, conflicts in the Outer Domain are perilous, and no one dares to guarantee they’ll not fall."
"Senior, we know this reasoning," Liu Zhide said helplessly, "As they say, prepare for the worst. In this battle, the Liu and Zhao Clans cannot afford to lose."
"Hmph, prepare for the worst, indeed your preparations are quite wide." The middle-aged man said coldly, "Our clan has always been a law-abiding noble family in Daqian and would never send clansmen to get involved in other families’ conflicts without reason."
What?
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun looked disappointed, with a hint of grief. If they couldn’t find reinforcements here, where else could they look?
"However," the middle-aged man said coolly, "I have a friend at the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm. He’s a loose cultivator with no sect or family ties, and he’s extremely honorable and likes to help the oppressed. As long as he’s paid enough, he’ll do anything."
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun were overjoyed, as if grasping the last straw: "Please, Senior, no matter the cost, we’ll hire him."
"Wang Longyan is very formidable; anything less than ten thousand Qian Gold, he probably won’t agree."
"Ten thousand?"
"If you can’t afford it, then forget it."
"We can afford it, even if we have to mortgage the clan’s possessions!"
...
Early the next morning.
After a night of exploration, Wang Shouzhe eagerly went to Longyan Residence to pay respects to Ancestor Longyan.
Entering Ancestor Longyan’s chamber was, of course, not allowed.
She entertained Wang Shouzhe in a pavilion and noticed a hint of joy on his face. She said, "Shouzhe’s brows carry happiness; it seems you successfully awakened your bloodline. Congratulations."
She wasn’t sure about the effectiveness of the Stone Marrow and couldn’t determine whether that drop of Stone Marrow would help Shouzhe awaken his bloodline.
Thus, seeing Wang Shouzhe’s successful awakening made her genuinely happy for him.
"Ancestor," Wang Shouzhe said with a salute, "I’ve awakened a Wood Bloodline Talent, but I’m not sure which kind within the Wood Element."
Human bloodline talents vary greatly, even within the same element, leading to differences and even fundamental discrepancies.
"Wood Bloodline Talent?" Ancestor Longyan frowned slightly but still praised, "It seems quite alright. In the Academy, there is a Changchun Ascendant with a Wood Bloodline Talent, uh... whose lifespan seems quite long. I also have a senior with a dual Wood Bloodline, who is very... resilient. Shouzhe, show me an example; don’t be discouraged. Awakening a bloodline is better than not having one."
From Ancestor Longyan’s expression, it seemed she wasn’t very impressed with the Wood Bloodline, and her examples sounded rather forced.
Wang Shouzhe’s heart sank a little.
He felt his Wood Talent was quite strong, with a wide array of applications.
Yet, why did Ancestor seem unimpressed?
Immediately, with a nervous heart, he performed a demonstration: starting with a dead branch in the courtyard, reviving it back to life.
Then, taking a withered flower and making it sprout anew, grow buds, and bloom into a fresh flower, all in less than a few breaths.
Following that, he demonstrated his ability to heal and rejuvenate wounds.
After a series of dazzling techniques, he nervously asked Ancestor Longyan, "I haven’t tried it on internal injuries or detoxification, but I feel it should work. Ancestor, what exactly is my Wood Bloodline Talent?"
Unexpectedly, Ancestor Longyan’s body stiffened on the spot. She looked Wang Shouzhe up and down and said in a haunting voice, "You call this a Wood Bloodline Talent? Are you joking with me?"
"Uh... Ancestor, is something wrong?" Wang Shouzhe asked in slight confusion.
"Nothing’s wrong, it’s just different from any Wood Bloodline Talent I’ve seen," Ancestor Longyan said drearily.
"Ancestor, how is it different?"
"Shouzhe, it’s different in every way."
"..." Wang Shouzhe was bewildered; he had never seen a Wood Bloodline Talent before but felt strongly that his was one. Helplessly, he asked, "Ancestor, then what exactly is my bloodline talent?"
After spending some time digesting her shock, Ancestor Longyan said, "The ancient bloodlines of our ancestors were numerous, and over generations, they’ve spawned some mutant bloodline talents. I’m ultimately just a Spirit Platform Realm, with inevitably limited knowledge. I couldn’t identify what your bloodline talent is. For now, let’s consider it a Wood Bloodline Talent."
What does it mean to ’consider it as such’?
Wang Shouzhe felt uneasy about having an uncertain talent. But since Ancestor Longyan couldn’t identify it either, he could only temporarily consider it a Wood Bloodline Talent.
After all, he wasn’t the only one with a similar situation in the family. His niece, Wang Lici’s bloodline talent, also evaded Ancestor’s identification.
However, even if it’s unidentifiable, she will probably still be dubbed as such.
Being dubbed as such is no shame.
Moreover, in the family, the sisters and nieces are all fierce. With Wang Shouzhe’s talent, he could at least ensure their safety.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 111: Shocked! Shouzhe’s Talent Is Not Simple (5000-Word - Asking for Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 111: Shocked! Shouzhe’s Talent Is Not Simple (5000-Word Chapter Asking for Monthly Votes)_3
"By the way, Ancestor," the Young Clan Leader asked curiously, "compared to the Wood Bloodline characteristics you mentioned earlier, whose talent is more impressive?"
Ancestor Longyan said indifferently, "Naturally, your bloodline talent is far more impressive. I’ve never seen a bloodline talent that heals so quickly and can rapidly accelerate plant growth in such a short time."
"Then it seems my bloodline talent is quite extraordinary," the Young Clan Leader felt a small twinge of excitement and immediately asked again, "Ancestor, your Ice Bloodline talent is considered an abnormal attribute, right? How does it compare with yours, superior or inferior?"
Suddenly, Ancestor Longyan did not feel like talking to him anymore. She gave him a cold glare. If she had the Young Clan Leader’s peculiar bloodline talent, why would she have endured the torment of the Yin Sha Evil Qi for five decades?
She would have long ago wiped out the Liu and Zhao Races twice over.
The Young Clan Leader saw that the Ancestor seemed a bit sullen, so he immediately changed the topic, "Ancestor, what about Elder Zhong? How should we handle him? Maybe you could take some time to meet him. Otherwise, it’s not good for him to keep freeloading at our house."
"No meeting," Ancestor Longyan said coldly, "If he likes freeloading, let him be. Remember, our family is poor, don’t pamper him with various delicacies. As long as he doesn’t starve."
The Young Clan Leader broke into a cold sweat; our Ancestor is indeed the cold and magnificent type of goddess.
Perhaps as her injuries gradually healed, and the burdens on her shoulders lightened, the family was flourishing. Ancestor Longyan no longer had the somber demeanor she once did.
She is gradually returning to her original character, becoming more lively and at ease. Just a few days ago, she pretended to be her sister Luoyi and took a meeting gift from Qiaan Xue’an...
It’s likely that Ancestor Longyan was not someone easily bullied when she was the eldest young lady.
Although he had a bit of sympathy for Zhong Xingwang, his own Ancestor was the most important, and sympathy had to be cast aside.
The Young Clan Leader just feared that Zhong Xingwang particularly liked this act, and the colder the goddess, the more he would want to warm her up with his affections. If that were the case, there would be no hope...
...
After taking leave from the Ancestor.
The Young Clan Leader received a report sent by Sixth Uncle Dinghai, of the Chen Family’s Young Clan Leader arriving as agreed.
An hour later.
Anjiang.
Inside a humble boat, the Young Clan Leader and Chen Shaojie drank tea together.
After a few words exchanged.
Chen Shaojie’s face showed slight concern, he sighed and said, "Shouzhe, it’s not that I’m avoiding this matter. The Daqian Law strictly forbids various clans’ ancestors from jointly engaging in life-and-death struggles between families."
"You know, Daqian founded the kingdom on noble families. If Daqian doesn’t strictly prohibit this, it would easily lead to larger-scale conflicts between noble interest groups and kinship groups. What would become of Daqian Kingdom’s order then?"
"Shouzhe, if you don’t mind, I could disguise myself and accompany you through this ordeal."
"Brother Chen, I appreciate your concern," the Young Clan Leader smiled as he poured tea for him and said, "However, Brother Chen, you’ve misunderstood my request. I’m not asking the Chen Family Ancestor to participate directly in family death battles, just to help intercept any potential lawbreakers attempting to participate. This can only be considered upholding justice."
"Shouzhe’s meaning is, Liu and Zhao Clans might seek external support? And our Ancestor’s task is merely to contain external assistance? Without direct involvement in family battles?" Chen Fangjie got excited.
"If that’s the task, I will have our family’s Ancestor agree to it. Our two clans are close kin, how can we just watch while enemy families freely seek outside help to oppress us? If it does come to this, our Chen Family will have a just cause, and not just contain them but also defeat these external reinforcements without remorse."
"A thousand Qian Gold after the task," the Young Clan Leader chuckled, "but it has to be your family’s Ancestor Ruhong, since he with his peak Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm."
"Is it necessary for Ancestor Ruhong to step in?" Chen Fangjie asked sternly, "Is it necessary to be this cautious?"
"Plan for the worst while hoping for the best. Our Wang Family cannot afford to lose," the Young Clan Leader calmly replied.
"Honestly, a thousand Qian Gold is already quite substantial," Chen Fangjie thickened his skin and laughed, "But recently, Shouzhe, you have been making a fortune. Can’t you be more generous to a poor man like your humble brother?"
"It’s just showing up to contain them. I’m only keeping the profits within the family," the Young Clan Leader laughed, "If you’re unwilling, I can go to the Liua Family..."
"Willing, of course willing," Chen Fangjie quickly said, "A thousand is a thousand, don’t go to the Liua Family, they’ve got money now."
Having the Ancestor show up just earns a thousand, he’d certainly be willing to have their Ancestor show up as much as possible.
Especially when asked on the basis of their kinship, not going would be unjust even if no money was given.
Chen Fangjie felt good about getting that free thousand.
He actually knew, the Young Clan Leader was compensating him for not sharing in past earnings.
But thinking about how the Young Clan Leader made two Celestial Spirit Pills last time, his heart felt sour.
He thickened his face again and said, "Shouzhe, you also said, as the saying goes, plan for the worst while hoping for the best. Might they call two reinforcements? Our family’s Ancestor Junyao is also idle lately, he’s Early Stage Spirit Platform Realm, how about eight hundred Qian Gold?"
"Hehe~" the Young Clan Leader smiled and said while drinking tea, "My maternal clan, Yingxiu Lu Family, should reap some benefits as well, right?"
"You’ve also invited the Lu Family? Your plan for the worst, how wide does it extend?" Chen Fangjie gasped, "Be honest, is Ancestor Mang going?"
"Ancestor Mang has helped our family a lot, this lucrative matter can’t go without him," the Young Clan Leader leisurely drank tea and said, "Our Wang Family cannot afford to lose, who knows how many reinforcements Liu and Zhao Clans might muster? They have a precedent, this is merely planning for the worst."
"..." Chen Fangjie was speechless.
Shouzhe, how afraid of death are you? Planning for the worst, this plan is as expansive as the sea. With such a lineup, even if the opposition has reinforcements, they’d likely be too scared to act, right?
He had a feeling, if the Liu and Zhao Clans dared to jump into this pit, they would be thoroughly defeated.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 112: Launch! Autumn Winter Hunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 112: Launch! Autumn Winter Hunt
...
The Daqian Kingdom is founded on the Black Tortoise Clan as its cornerstone, and it has continued to operate for seven or eight thousand years, with its territory becoming increasingly extensive.
Attached to Daqian for survival, there are countless noble families of various sizes.
If not for the relatively strict Daqian Law restraining them in clear and broad directions, and without the implicit rules among the noble families acting as codes of conduct, this world would have long descended into chaos.
After bidding farewell to Chen Fangjie,
Wang Shouzhe returned to the main residence and began a life of the Patriarch, preferring the quietude of home. He absolutely wouldn’t give the Liu and Zhao Clans a chance to employ assassination tactics, among others.
Every day, he would cultivate, tease the turtles, and "lightly bully" the family’s siblings and juniors.
Today, the learning environment among the young in the family is very "intense," each with a strong "aspiration for progress," diligently practicing Black Tortoise Combat Techniques, the Nine Chapters of Mathematics, literary cultivation, and so on, daily.
This fact leaves Wang Shouzhe quite gratified; the Wang Family is destined for greatness.
Besides this,
Wang Shouzhe is deeply engaged in studying and researching his own bloodline talent.
Unlike his bewildered nieces and sisters, Wang Shouzhe, as a mature adult, naturally strives to understand the direction and limits of his abilities.
Firstly, there’s the healing ability.
This is one of Wang Shouzhe’s most valued abilities and serves as the foundation for his existence as a "healer." He needs to understand the capability and capacity of his healing power.
As a result, the Wang family suddenly improved their meals in recent times.
These were chickens, ducks, geese, and rabbits sent in succession from several farms, even multiple wild boars, and an ox suffering from a severe illness.
While testing the levels of his healing ability, it was inevitable that some animals, having been injured too severely, couldn’t be saved from the brink of death and instead contributed to the family’s meals.
But precisely because of this, Wang Shouzhe has now gained a rather comprehensive understanding of his healing ability.
First is the simplicity of treating external injuries, halting bleeding and healing in a very short time, leaving no scars, and even whitening the skin. Such an ability would definitely revolutionize the cosmetic and obstetric surgery industries on Earth.
Next, comes the effective treatment of internal injuries, such as damage to the internal organs, blood stasis within the body, etc.
Previously, healing internal injuries in Black Tortoise practitioners was often difficult, requiring the gradual dissolution of stasis through Profound Qi and the gradual healing of internal injuries with healing elixirs, a typically lengthy process.
Thus, most Black Tortoise practitioners fear internal injuries more than external ones.
Originally, Ancestor Longyan suffered severe internal injuries to her organs, with Yin Sha Evil Qi entangled in her body, persistently hindering and worsening her natural recovery or recovery through elixirs, tormenting her for fifty years.
Only when she refined and incorporated the Yin Sha Evil Qi did her internal injuries begin to improve alongside treatment with a Creation Pill in those days.
Yet this also illustrates the formidable vitality of Spirit Platform Realm Cultivators. With such terrifying injuries worsening endlessly, she managed to endure through it all.
Wang Shouzhe’s healing abilities do prove advantageous to internal injuries, though not as immediately efficacious as with external wounds, requiring the injured’s self-healing capacity to gradually improve.
Even so, such healing abilities are indeed remarkably strong. Even Ancestor Longyan remarked that if the family had such a bloodline talent like Shouzhe early on, would she, Wang Longyan, have ended up like this?
Therefore, after experimenting with healing internal injuries on animals, Wang Shouzhe attempted it on Ancestor Longyan. After all, having such a ready-made template of Spirit Platform Realm internal injuries to experiment with is an incredibly rare opportunity.
Longyan Residence.
In the pavilion, Wang Shouzhe’s palm rested on Ancestor Longyan’s back, with cyan Profound Qi channeling through the acupoints on her back, slowly circulating around her internal organs. The residual traces of Yin Sha Evil Qi were dissolving at a physically observable speed under the wash of cyan Profound Qi.
Despite having the Yin Sha Technique now, even Ancestor Longyan could only slowly dissolve those residual toxins. No one could achieve the speed of Wang Shouzhe.
Meanwhile, the cyan Profound Qi nourished her internal organs, restoring them bit by bit; though the speed was slow, it was rather effective.
After a long while, Wang Shouzhe ceased his treatment, a hint of fatigue in his eyes.
Following the treatment, his Profound Qi was almost exhausted, not much better than after a great battle. He consumed a Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill, slowly refining it into Qi and blood, supplementing every cell in his body.
The acupoints in his body beat rhythmically, invigorating the Qi and blood in his body, transforming bit by bit into cyan Profound Qi, then gradually gathering into his Qi Sea along the meridians.
After more than half an hour, the previously depleted Qi Sea gradually filled again, the fresh Profound Qi seemingly purer and thicker than before!
In Wang Shouzhe’s understanding, Profound Qi does not spontaneously arise, nor can it be directly replenished solely by ingesting food or elixirs. Be it food or elixirs, they only provide nourishment to the Qi and blood, albeit at different nutritional levels.
Outside of maintaining its own operation, some part of the body’s cells would convert surplus Qi and blood nourishment into higher-energy Profound Qi, storing it within the Qi Sea. This process bears a slight resemblance to the principle by which the human body accumulates fat.
Under normal circumstances, once the Qi Sea accumulates full of Profound Qi, the body’s mechanisms will automatically cease the conversion. If the Profound Qi in the Qi Sea is depleted, the body’s mechanisms will automatically cater to convert Qi and blood slowly into Profound Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 112: Begin! Autumn-Winter Hunt_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 112: Begin! Autumn-Winter Hunt_2
Additionally, Black Tortoise Practitioners can rapidly replenish Profound Qi by actively stimulating acupoints to resonate and catalyze the transformation of Profound Qi. Wang Shouzhe’s recent cross-legged meditation, activating his acupoints until they were swollen, was an active transformation of Profound Qi, much faster than passive transformation.
After Wang Shouzhe finished his session and stood up.
Ancestor Longyan had also finished her session, her eyes gently shimmering, and she asked concernedly, "Shouzhe, how do you feel?"
"Strange, I’m just healing the Ancestor, not cultivating on my own." Wang Shouzhe said somewhat puzzled, "But it feels like my cultivation has advanced slightly, faster even than when practicing the ’Profound Origin Technique’."
"The first time might have been an illusion, but the second time probably wasn’t," Ancestor Longyan pondered, "There are thousands of bloodlines in the world, and although my knowledge is limited, your bloodline talent is among the most unique I’ve ever seen. Remember, never reveal it outside, just pretend you have a Wood Bloodline."
The Wood Bloodline is considered quite excellent among the many Wood Element bloodlines.
It has strong recovery power, decent healing ability, and also some catalyzing effects on plants.
But compared to Wang Shouzhe’s kind, it falls short by more than a little.
"By the way, is Zhong Xingwang still around?" Ancestor Longyan suddenly asked.
"He is," Wang Shouzhe replied, "Is the Ancestor planning to see him?"
"No, last time in the black market of the Hundred Islands Guard, I bought twenty ’Creation Pills’, and I have already used three," Ancestor Longyan said. "Since you, Shouzhe, can heal me, the remaining Creation Pills would be wasted. Please call Zhong Xingwang over to dispose of the remaining Creation Pills."
"Our Wang Family’s expenses are too high right now, and we could use the funds."
Wang Shouzhe sweated, "Ancestor, can we not be this realistic?" He promptly said, "Ancestor, let me handle this matter."
"No need, Shouzhe, you’ve been too exhausted lately, take a good rest. That Zhong is living too comfortably at our home, eating and drinking for free every day. Isn’t it a small matter for him to handle this?"
Alright~~ Even Wang Shouzhe knew that if one day Ancestor Longyan were to treat Zhong Xingwang kindly, he probably wouldn’t be used to it.
Wang Shouzhe followed the Ancestor’s instructions and invited Zhong Xingwang over.
At first, he appeared timid and apprehensive.
But upon hearing about the task assigned by Ancestor Longyan, he immediately became as excited as if he were injected with adrenaline, enthusiastically pounding his chest and promising to complete the task perfectly.
Then, taking the seventeen remaining Creation Pills, he left full of glee, walking away happily. Before leaving, he said to Wang Shouzhe, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I’ll be back soon. Senior sister is weak, take good care of her."
"Brother Zhong, to tell you the truth, my Ancestor Longyan is unlikely to fancy you," Wang Shouzhe couldn’t take it anymore and said seriously, "I ask you, brother, to accept reality."
"Younger Brother Shouzhe, what are you babbling about? What kind of person is the senior sister, isn’t it normal for her not to fancy me?" Zhong Xingwang said, "I’ve never expected anything from the senior sister, as long as she can be a bit happier, I’m content."
Such a spineless attitude made Wang Shouzhe unable to feel any sympathy for him.
Brother, you’ll never find a wife like this.
However, since Zhong Xingwang enjoys it and likes it this way freely, Wang Shouzhe had no choice.
...
In the days when Wang Shouzhe stayed home every day to cultivate and study his innate abilities.
Time flew by quickly, and in the blink of an eye, it was the autumn harvest season. This autumn’s harvest was bountiful due to the effective improved Insecticide Powder, benefiting all local noble families.
Particularly, the farms owned by the Wang Family and their territory. The harvest was exceptionally good under the early care of Spirit Insect Master Wang Luojing.
The only unlucky ones were the farms owned by the Liu and Zhao Clans.
The tenant farmers were already panicked, unmotivated to produce. Plus, without a Spirit Insect Master or Insecticide Powder, the output plunged unbearably low.
Why didn’t they have Insecticide Powder?
The reason is simple: the share of Insecticide Powder in the entire Ping’an Town was long claimed by Wang Shouzhe. For the commoners in Liu and Zhao Clans’ territory, Wang Shouzhe distributed Insecticide Powder at a thirty percent discounted price according to the agreement.
But as for the Liu and Zhao Clans’ farms, forget it~~ Even if they went to Qiaan’s Trading Company to appeal, they would be ignored.
Under these circumstances, village after village of commoners organized and went to the Guardian’s Mansion to request a change in jurisdiction. Lei Yangqiu of the Guardian’s Mansion made a show of scolding them and ultimately reassigned them to the Wang Family under the guise of serving the people’s will.
The power of the Liu and Zhao Clans continued to shrink.
If they do not come up with an effective counter-strategy soon, they will naturally be squeezed out of any living space by the Wang Family.
However, at this moment.
The Wang Family’s annual autumn-winter hunt officially began.
This tradition established by Ancestor Zhou Xuan serves as a reminder to the descendants not to forget the hardships of the ancestors’ pioneering and also as encouragement for the descendants to cultivate diligently, holding the hope of the family’s expansion.
This tradition has been imitated by many noble families and has gradually become a reserved event for each family and clan.
It’s just that in recent years, the Wang Family had been declining gradually. They dared not venture deeply into the Outer Domain to hunt fierce beasts, merely lingering around its periphery to hunt some ordinary wild beasts and end it simply.
The Wang Family hadn’t hunted a fierce beast in five years, becoming a laughing stock.
Rumor had it this time, under the leadership of the young Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe, the Wang Family would venture deeply into the Outer Domain to restore their honor.
In the midsection of Liuan Mountain’s outcroppings, there is a natural gorge.
At its narrowest point, it’s only a hundred-some feet wide.
Hence, the ancestors built walls here, establishing a pass to block the migration of fierce beasts.
This pass is the famed Zhouxuan Pass.
Indeed, it is the wall and pass established under the supervision of Ancestor Zhou Xuan, also serving as the boundary between the inhabited Ping’an and the Outer Domain.
The Outer Domain is a collective term.
It refers to regions outside the national borders where humans haven’t cultivated and settled, collectively called the Outer Domain. But to the people of Ping’an Town, the area beyond Zhouxuan Pass is the Outer Domain.
Zhouxuan Pass is known for its grandeur, stretching over a hundred feet long, seven to eight feet wide, and ten feet tall!
It sprawls across the land like a mighty reclining dragon.
The wall is equipped with rectangular stone blocks, forming the outer wall over a foot long, which extends large wooden spikes, iron spikes, stone spikes, etc. This provides a series of defensive barricades stretching across the ground. Additionally, part of the area is designated as quarters for the guards and soldiers manning the wall.
The heavily fortified Zhouxuan Pass stands distinguished, housing defense facilities like watchtowers and crossbow cannons. Outside the walls are various defenses resembling chevaux-de-frise like wooden spikes, iron spikes, stone spikes, etc., extending for a long stretch.
The wall itself provides ample space for storage of essential supplies and serves as living quarters for garrison soldiers and officers alike.
In the days Wang Shouzhe spent training at home, studying the effects of his talents.
Time flew by quickly; in the blink of an eye, it was autumn harvest season. This season, the improved effect of the Insecticide Powder was evident, and there was a bountiful harvest across various regions and noble families.
Especially in the Wang Family’s own farms and territories. With the early care of the Spirit Insect Master Wang Luojing, the harvest was abundantly good.
The only unfortunate ones were the Liu and Zhao Clans’ farms.
Tenant farmers were already anxious and unwilling to produce. Without a Spirit Insect Master or Insecticide Powder, their yield plummeted to unbearable levels.
Why didn’t they have Insecticide Powder?
The answer is simple; Wang Shouzhe had already claimed all shares of Insecticide Powder in Ping’an Town. Although he distributed it within Liu and Zhao Clans’ territories at a thirty percent discounted price to their commoners as per agreement.
But for the Liu and Zhao Clans’ farms, not so lucky~~ Even their complaints to the Qiaan’s Trading Company went unheeded.
Consequently, villagers, one after another, organized themselves and approached the Guardian’s Mansion to request a change in rule to belong under the Wang Family’s jurisdiction. Lei Yangqiu at the Guardian’s Mansion pretended to scold them, but ultimately he changed it under the guise of abiding by the will of the people.
The Liu and Zhao Clans’ power began to shrink step by step.
If they could not come up with an effective strategy to counterattack, they would inevitably find all their living space ruthlessly squeezed out by the Wang Family.
However, just then.
The Wang Family’s annual autumn and winter hunt officially commenced.
This tradition was left by Ancestor Zhou Xuan to remind the descendants of the hardship the forefathers faced while pioneering frontiers and also as a motivation for the younger generation to uphold the family traditions.
This practice has been preserved as a tradition by many other families and clans over the years.
Unfortunately, in recent years, the Wang Family has been gradually declining. They no longer dared to venture into the depths of the Outer Domain. Instead, they ended their hunts close to the borders after merely capturing some wild beasts.
It had been five years since the Wang Family last captured a fierce beast, and they had become the laughingstock.
However, this time, it was different.
The midsection of the outcrop in Liuan Mountain houses a natural gorge.
At its narrowest point, it’s just over a hundred feet wide.
The ancestors once built natural fortifications to remind their descendants of the difficulties of pioneering.
These fortifications were known as the renowned Zhouxuan Pass.
Yes, it was constructed by Ancestor Zhou Xuan himself. This pass was named after him.
It is called Zhouxuan Pass.
It is famous for its strength and length, over a hundred feet long, seven to eight feet wide, and ten feet high!
Bisecting the land below like an impenetrable barrier.
With its outer walls made from large rectangular stones, it forms a barricade of defensive spikes such as wooden, iron, and stone spikes, stretching out for tens of hundreds of feet. Part of this zone is also reserved as quarters for the soldiers tasked with defending the area.
The legendary Zhouxuan Pass, draped over the earth like a guarding behemoth.
With watchtowers, crossbow cannon turrets, and vision posts among its facilities.
The walls are constructed from large rectangular stones, each over a foot in size, forming an impenetrable obstacle.
It provides a formidable defense, ensuring safety from the fierce beasts.
As the members of the Wang Family officially passed through the citadel. Along with townsfolk from the pass, loose cultivators, traveling merchants, and soldiers looked on as they exited into the Outer Domain.
The Wang Clan Members, amidst a mix of solemnity and mourning, weren’t without a hint of hope.
This was because Ancestor Zhou Xuan, Ancestor Qiong Yuan, and many of the family had suffered grievously here, losing their lives. The ill-fate was only compounded by the Liu and Zhao Clans, which once controlled parts of the wall and decided to feign dead, allowing a horde of fierce beasts to breach the fortification! This mishap resulted in a complete breach.
However, this time, there seemed to be a different air.
With some unspoken determination within the Wang Clan that indicated the resolve to restore the former glory of the once prestigious Ping’an Wang Family, known for its Spirit Platform trio.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 113: Face Death! Wang Shouzhe
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 113: Face Death! Wang Shouzhe
...
Outer Domain!
Since ancient times, it has been a region that humans both yearn for and hold in great awe, also a place narrated and talked about by countless people.
Here.
Even an ordinary Loose Cultivator could become suddenly wealthy overnight, lucky enough to acquire a fortune beyond one’s lifetime ability to spend.
Here.
Even a Celestial Human powerhouse might unluckily meet a tragic demise, with no remains left.
In the Outer Domain, there is no absolute safety.
Therefore, upon entering the Outer Domain, Wang Shouzhe immediately ordered everyone to be cautious and donned leather armor made from Tier Three Crocodile Flood Dragon skin.
This leather armor is difficult to cut through with ordinary swords, yet not very heavy, offering a high combat effectiveness cost-performance ratio.
At the same time, four stronger Household Generals took the lead, distributed in a fan shape ahead of the team.
This serves as the vanguard.
The vanguard’s role is to clear the way and detect potential fierce beasts or any enemy presence in advance. Upon observing enemies, they won’t engage in combat but will fire different Whistling Arrows according to the situation, alert the team, and immediately retreat.
This gives the main force team ample preparation and reaction time.
Additionally, there are three weaker Household Generals serving as rear guards, scattered behind and to the sides of the main team to prevent any fierce beast or enemy from attacking from the rear.
They usually remain very vigilant, maintaining a wide field of vision.
If manpower is sufficient, side guards can also be arranged.
However, the Wang Family lacks manpower, and the team is relatively small, so everything is kept simple.
Within the main team, there are ten wagons in total.
These wagons were all replaced by Wang Shouzhe with Northern heavy draft horses, known for their strong endurance and pulling power, and trained to be slightly brave, not panicking in chaos when encountering fierce beasts.
Besides the Ancestor, the wagons carry various supplies.
Such as spare weapons and equipment, consumable arrows, fishing nets, tents, ropes, quilts, clothing, water, ordinary food, White Jade Spirit Rice, oil, pots, bowls, and a considerable amount of various Elixirs, not to mention even smokeless charcoal.
The autumn and winter hunting usually lasts fifteen days to about a month, which means huge consumption figures for human and horse provisions. As the weather cools during this period, various cold-resisting materials are indispensable.
This prompted Wang Shouzhe to reflect that in his previous life, when reading fantasy novels, people used to go out hunting monsters lightly and freely.
But here, when he goes out, hunting wild is akin to shifting houses, even bringing a few baskets of pots and bowls.
As for the Storage Bracelet things, they do exist in this world.
But the lowest level Storage Space Bracelet, only one cubic meter in size, is also at the Spiritual Artifact Level!
The Wang Family being a small household can’t afford such high-end items.
Moreover, a couple of Storage Bracelets are practically useless in team combat.
Led by Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing among the younger generation, including Wang Lici and other girls, it was their first participation in the autumn and winter hunt.
They were particularly excited, seemingly imagining the Outer Domain as a land filled with monsters to fight, ready to make a grand venture.
But alas!
They thought too much.
How vast the Outer Domain is, if it were filled with fierce beasts, would humans still be able to survive?
Let alone fierce beasts, even the territory occupied by ordinary carnivorous beasts is quite large. Plus, this is the outermost outer area of the Outer Domain, already swept by humans countless times, making it hard to find even a pack of jackals.
Yet even so, the team progressed very cautiously.
As it’s always said, anything could happen in the Outer Domain.
Perhaps while walking, a Tier Four or even Tier Five fierce beast might suddenly appear. Of course, the probability of this is extremely low.
"Shouzhe!" Wang Shouxin, equally fully armed, rode over on his horse. He is already over forty years old, having been to the Outer Domain countless times, considered an expert in the terrain.
He held a map and said to Wang Shouzhe, "According to the plan we made before departure, we need to reach the hill campsite before Early Afternoon. Currently, the team is progressing a bit slow."
Early Afternoon is roughly around 3:00 PM, implying Wang Shouxin meant they need to reach the campsite by 3:00 PM.
The team needs to settle while it’s still daylight; otherwise, if the camp isn’t set up by nightfall, it would not only be dangerous but also lower morale, etc.
Indeed, humans may not have habitats in the Outer Domain.
But ancestors naturally explored and established simple stronghold campsites in favorable terrains. With generations of operations and reinforcement, those strongholds have somewhat defensive capabilities.
Moreover, no family would rush to the Outer Domain like headless flies. Action routes, battle plans, and required supplies all require precise calculation and repeated discussion.
"Order the entire team to accelerate." Wang Shouzhe commanded to speed up.
The overall pace of the team slightly quickened. Yet the road ahead would become increasingly difficult.
The previously traversed paths would grow wild grass over time, or sprout a heap of plants, and might even be washed away by floodwaters, making simple routes impassable.
Encountering obstructive stones or plants, there is a need to clear them.
Coming to the Outer Domain in late autumn and early winter indeed embodies ancestral generations’ accumulative wisdom. From spring to early summer, prolonged rainy seasons might cause mountain floods and various dangers.

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 113: Facing Death! Wang Shouzhe_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 113: Facing Death! Wang Shouzhe_2
Even if there’s no flash flood, the mountainous terrain is winding, and the dirt paths are muddy. Once it rains too much, even the roads become difficult to walk.
And summer is too hot; neither wild beasts nor fierce beasts like to move much. Humans traveling and hunting in such temperatures and environments is also very unsuitable.
As for winter, not only is food scarce, with prey hiding for the season, but phenomena like heavy snow sealing the mountains are more likely to occur.
After autumn, the climate is dry, and vine plants wither. Some wild gourds and seeds of plants have already borne fruit.
The abundance of mature food attracts many animals to eat, store fat, and even stockpile food for entering winter mode. And some wild beasts and fierce beasts also become active in hunting, storing energy to last through the winter.
Therefore, only this season is most suitable for entering the Outer Domain for hunting.
They wobbled along the road without stopping. The journey was bumpy, difficult, and even dull.
Occasionally, someone’s horse might get its hoof stuck and needed to be replaced with a spare horse. Luckily, Wang Shouzhe quietly treated the hoof, preventing a situation where there would be no horse available later.
They traveled for several hours, and the road became increasingly difficult.
There was even a scene where they had to work together to pry away a seven or eight-ton boulder blocking the road.
Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing, who were originally eager to deal with fierce beasts, began to lose their energy.
It sounds so enticing when the fourth brother tells it, Luqiu, Luojing, the fourth brother took you to the Outer Domain to hunt fierce beasts and have some meat.
And yet?
After walking half a day, they didn’t see a single beast. Only some small animals and birds that ran away at the sight of people faster than Wang Luqiu, escaping at lightning speed.
"Luqiu, the road to becoming an Empress starts with every step," Wang Shouzhe consoled, "Maybe as we keep walking, a Fifth-Tier Fierce Beast might blindly crash to death at the foot of the mountain?"
"Fourth brother, you can save those words for coaxing Luomiao when we return," Wang Luqiu rolled her eyes and shouted at Wang Lici, "Little niece, aren’t you especially good at finding tasty food? Why haven’t you said a word all day?"
"Wang Luqiu, I am the big sister! You need to be patient!" Wang Lici’s strength was rapidly increasing, and with Ancestor Longyan’s assistance, she was quickly moving towards the Fourth Layer of Qi Refining Realm.
However, Wang Luqiu also wasn’t to be underestimated. She was keen on all tasks that could increase Merit Points and performed them well. With resources supporting her, her cultivation soared, climbing from the Initial Tier of Qi Refining Realm’s Second Layer to nearly high-tier in less than half a year.
Just as the two girls, full of energy but nowhere to vent, were about to have a scrap first, Wang Shouzhe flicked his fingers and gave them each a thump in the air: "Quiet, or else Contribution Points will be deducted, and even food rations will be cut."
Once threatened, the two instantly became extremely obedient.
Everyone has their weaknesses, and Wang Shouzhe easily controlled them.
After that, the journey remained calm. The team arrived at the planned hillside base in early afternoon.
It was a very simple base, with rows of large wooden stakes forming a basic fence. However, the base was well-situated, with no obstructions around, offering a wide view, and a clear stream nearby for water replenishment.
Some of the older clan members, Wang Shouxin, Wang Shouyi, and even elder Wang Dinghai and Wang Ding Race, started expertly clearing the camp with the Household Generals.
Wang Shouzhe, Wang Shounuo, Wang Zongwei, Shouyong, Shoulian and other young members also joined the labor, learning how to set up camp alongside their elders and brothers. Even Wang Luotong joined the construction team, and several young girls began participating, learning camp-building knowledge.
Weeds were cleared, the ground swept and leveled, nearby firewood gathered, broken fences reinforced, tents pitched and strengthened, water collected; each task proceeded methodically.
Even the tent placement and who stayed where were quite rule-oriented.
These works and teachings were passed down through generations; even Wang Shouzhe learned alongside. In the Outer Domain, survival techniques for such environments were essential.
As dusk fell, a large bonfire and several small ones were lit, leading to the start of cooking, bringing a cheerful atmosphere.
Followed by night-time rotations for keeping watch.
The night passed in silence until dawn.
At this time, the camp was disassembled, tents packed up, and all living supplies bundled for departure. Only once the sky brightened at early daybreak, was the camp tidied and tasks completed.
Then they continued, steadily and according to their plan and map, moving towards their next base.
In such a manner, after three full days.
The group finally reached the real edge of the Outer Domain, where fierce beasts began to gradually appear.
In previous years, the Wang Family mostly stopped here and didn’t venture deeper into the Outer Domain. Instead, they settled at the base, sweeping and hunting nearby large beasts or several ferocious beasts before heading home.
They had no choice; if they ventured deeper without an ancestor to protect them, encountering formidable beasts could likely result in casualties.
The following day.
In a seemingly inconspicuous tent, a group of people dressed as coachmen gathered. Yet among them, anyone thrown out could terrify others to death.
Wang Shouzhe leisurely sat amongst them.
A slim man, wrapped in a tattered sheepskin coat and wearing a felt hat, curled up like a down-and-out old man, gently complained: "Shouzhe, could your intel be wrong? I see the Liu and Zhao clans have long been scared to death by you; how dare they make a move?"
Wang Shouzhe confidently smiled and cupped his hands towards him, saying, "Ancestor Ming Sheng, be at ease. Though I’m not ten percent certain, I’m nine-percent sure. I’ve been at home for a long while, already stirring their fire to the extreme. Now that I’ve finally found an opportunity, they will inevitably strike."
"Shouzhe is right; their action is inevitable. Missing this chance means the Liu and Zhao Clans will never regain power," said another sturdy man driving a carriage, "If they don’t appear, isn’t it better? In this way, Ancestor Ming Sheng, you just stroll around, and a thousand Qian Gold goes into the account, isn’t it wonderful?"
"Gongsun Mang, I’m helping my great-grandson not for money. He is the legitimate blood kin of my Lua Family’s legitimate daughter Lua Mengxue," Ancestor Ming Sheng retorted.
The phrase ’legitimate blood kin’ he emphasized heavily, seeming to underscore something.
Gongsun Mang chuckled, "That may be so, but now Shouzhe is the legitimate son of my granddaughter Gongsun Hui, also my direct great-grandson."
There truly wasn’t any conflict between Lua and Gongsun Families, but regarding Wang Shouzhe, both Ancestors had shown emotional stake and seemed to be at odds. Recently when discussed, neither was willing to concede.
Blame Wang Shouzhe for being too outstanding, causing both Ancestors to vie over the title of great-grandfather.
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat; he miscalculated. He shouldn’t have put Ancestor Mang and Ancestor Ming Sheng together; however, who could’ve thought they’d be competitive over him?
"Lua Mingsheng, Gongsun Mang, please be quiet," another elder dressed even more "professionally" said, "Don’t disturb my meditative rest."
At this remark, both became sincere.
There was no choice; this Ruhong Ancestor was at the pinnacle of Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, so naturally, they complied.
At this moment, another elder timidly suggested, "Younger brother Shouzhe, my body technique is not bad. Why not let me scout for intel?"
This was certainly elder Zhong Xingwang.
After selling Elixirs, he scampered back, having heard the Wang Family would hunt in autumn and winter; he refused to leave, staying until today.
Wang Shouzhe was about to reply.
Suddenly!
Ruhong Ancestor opened his eyes and calmly said, "They’re here, Shouzhe, you go confront them. All outside support is covered by us."
Almost simultaneously.
Not far from the camp, came the sound of a somewhat maniacal laugh: "Wang Shouzhe, you are surrounded, come out to meet your end!"
It was Liu Shengye’s voice; how could he not be furious?
The substantial prospects and bright future of the Liu and Zhao clans were all ruined by Wang Shouzhe.
"Uh... All esteemed Ancestors, rest a while." Wang Shouzhe lightly chuckled, "Shouzhe will go out to meet his end first."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 114: Domineering! Ruhong Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 114: Domineering! Ruhong Ancestor
...
Listening to him speak was amusing.
All the ancestors laughed, although they were cautious about directly engaging due to Daqian Law, they were quite fearful.
However, if they truly saw Shouzhe in danger, they would still step in to rescue him.
Especially Ancestor Ming Sheng and Ancestor Mang, who considered Wang Shouzhe their blood descendant, how could they ignore and do nothing?
In fact, given their feelings towards Wang Shouzhe now, even if Wang Shouzhe really wanted them to engage in a family feud, as long as there was a slight chance of winning and hope, after weighing and considering, they would likely take the risk to participate.
"Shouzhe, I’ll go with you." Another young "driver" who had been silent stood up and said, "I am sort of half a person of the Wang Family, and at such a crucial moment, I naturally should stand with you."
This young driver, although disguised to look ordinary, revealed a tall and imposing stature upon standing, and was none other than Wang Shouzhe’s future brother-in-law, Chen Fangjie.
If he wasn’t aware of the matter, it would be one thing, but now that he knows there will be a big battle for the Wang Family, if he doesn’t participate, will he have a good outcome after marrying Luoyi?
Wang Shouzhe certainly wouldn’t refuse his desire to show off.
The two of them exited the tent.
At this time, the Wang clan members were not panicking. After all, aside from a few children, the others were mentally prepared.
Under the organization of several elder brothers and elders, everyone orderly arranged themselves in a battle formation.
And several little girls, as well as Shouyong and Shou Lian, although not aware of the sudden change, also obediently listened, being placed in the middle of the group.
Meanwhile.
The key figures of the Liu and Zhao clans, the clan leaders, elite clan members, and even two Spirit Platform Realm individuals Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan, were already standing in front of a simple fence.
But in the Liu and Zhao clans’ ranks, the most noticeable were the four elders at the back of the team.
Among them, two were quite familiar to Wang Shouzhe, the ancestors of the Liu and Zhao clans, Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun.
The other two among them were shrouded in gray robes, just standing there without displaying any aura.
However, Wang Shouzhe knew these must be two Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, brought in as external reinforcements by the Liu and Zhao clans.
Four Spirit Platform Realm cultivators in total.
No wonder Patriarch Liu, Liu Shengye felt so confident, outright challenging Wang Shouzhe to come out and face death.
At this moment, Liu Shengye, looking around with extraordinary style, sweeping away the gloom of the past few months. He wanted to repay the favor granted by the Wang Family, one by one.
Especially towards Wang Shouzhe, he couldn’t wait to see him in a state of panic and extreme regret.
"Oh, isn’t this Uncle Liu?" Wang Shouzhe walked to the front of the team, smilingly saying, "Weren’t you recently confined at home contemplating your actions? How long has it been, already can’t hold back from jumping out?"
"You..." Liu Shengye’s face stiffened, laughing in anger, "Wang Shouzhe, at your young age, your tongue is quite sharp. If you hid in the main residence every day and refused to come out, I indeed have no way to deal with you."
"But who would think, you kid, so unaware of danger, dare to organize some autumn-winter hunt, really assume our Liu and Zhao clans are dead?"
"Brother Liu, don’t waste words with this kid." Patriarch Zhao, Zhao Jinxian sneered, "Better have Wang Longyan come out and speak."
"Exactly, no matter how strong this kid is, he’s ultimately just a junior." Liu Shengye sneered, "Wang Longyan, come..."
Buzz!
A light sword hum sounded.
Only a vague sword light could be seen, drifting lightly, seeming slow but truly swift, slashing towards Liu Shengye.
"Oh no." Liu Zhide’s expression changed dramatically, raising his hand, the Purple Gold Alms Bowl transformed into a purple light and shot out, spinning around and forming a purple shield blocking in front of Liu Shengye.
"Clang!"
The sword aura clashed with the shield, causing ripples of shockwaves, each spiritual artifact retreating.
Even though Liu Shengye was saved, he still broke out in cold sweat, as he was not used to combat.
Liu Zhide sprang forward, holding the Purple Gold Alms Bowl, shouted with angry eyes, "Wang Longyan, you dare to launch a sneak attack on a junior, do you have any shame left as a senior?"
As for Ancestor Longyan, she gently held the Longyan Sword with delicate hands, the star eyes on her veil flashing cold light, evidently her killing intent had not subsided.
The ancestor wasn’t good at verbal attacks.
But Wang Shouzhe was, how could he stand seeing his own ancestor losing out, immediately sneering, "You traitorous Liu clan bandit, trampling civilians, dare to speak of shame?"
"You... such a junior, how bold, dare to insult a Spirit Platform ancestor." Liu Zhide was infuriated, shouted angrily, "You know nothing of family teachings and rules, how can you be the patriarch?"
"Haha~" Wang Shouzhe chuckled, "Family teachings and rules are for people. No matter how long a dog lives, it’s still just an old dog. Can I, the dignified patriarch of the Wang Family, really bow and salute to an old dog, respectfully calling you Ancestor Zhide?"
After speaking, he genuinely mockingly bowed to Liu Zhide.
Since Liu Zhide advanced to Spirit Platform Realm, he had never been so publicly humiliated, his face alternated between red and white from anger.
"Well said, Shouzhe."
"Fourth brother is impressive, scold that shameless old dog to death."
Wang clan members all cheered for Wang Shouzhe.
Even the elders and Ancestor Longyan felt a sense of exhilaration and relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 114: Dominance! Ruhong Ancestor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 114: Dominance! Ruhong Ancestor_2
No wonder.
If it weren’t for Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, those two traitorous old dogs seeking glory, playing dead at the most critical moment while defending Zhouxuan Pass.
Leading to the breach of two sections of the city walls, allowing numerous fierce beasts in.
Ancestors Zhou Xuan and Qiong Yuan of the Wang Family, how would they have perished in such a manner? How would the Wang Family have fallen to such a state in the past fifty years?
Calling them old dogs is already being polite.
"Good, good, good." Liu Zhide laughed in extreme anger, "Just a reckless youngster who doesn’t know his place, I, Liu Zhide, will let you enjoy a brief moment of verbal triumph."
Immediately, he turned and cupped his hands, saying, "Brother Li, according to our previous agreement, you’ll personally deal with Wang Longyan. Once the deed is done, the other half of the payment will be sealed immediately without delay."
The man in the middle of the team, shrouded in a gray robe, sneered coldly, "I am most reliable when it comes to money and disaster relief. But I doubt you would dare to delay the payment."
With that, he walked leisurely towards Wang Longyan with his hands behind his back, "Wang Longyan, I heard you’re from the Purple Mansion Academy. Hehe, I’ve always hated you so-called prodigies... one by one, looking down upon the world and seeing Loose Cultivators as nothing. Let me teach you a thing or two."
With that, a powerful and domineering aura emanated from him, stronger than any ordinary ancestor.
At the same time, his withered old hand flipped, and a short knife about two feet long appeared in his hand. The knife was entirely jet black, with swirling black mist, emitting a terrifying force.
Demon Artifact?
Ancestor Longyan’s eyes narrowed slightly, she laughed coldly, "Since when did Changning Guard harbor a Demon Cultivator?"
