"Hehe, power is neither good nor evil, only strong and weak." The old man sneered, "I came from the humble origins of a Loose Cultivator and naturally take whatever opportunity comes my way. Unlike you Purple Mansion Academy students who have the luxury to choose."
In Longzuo County, the Purple Mansion Academy is often seen as the Black Tortoise Sacred Land, thus its style and cultivation techniques lean towards the righteous path, influencing the overall righteous orientation of Longzuo County.
Other counties have their own Academy Sacred Lands, making the Daqian Kingdom predominantly oriented towards the righteous path.
Demon Cultivators in the Daqian Kingdom aren’t instantly hunted, but they do face vigilance and exclusion. Establishing a Noble Family within the Daqian Kingdom requires special permission from the Commander.
However, outside the Daqian Kingdom, things are not always like this.
In some places, good and evil coexist, while in others, the Demon Dao runs rampant, anything could happen.
Not even Wang Shouzhe could imagine how the civilians in such places survive.
Let’s not dwell on that for now.
Ancestor Longyan knew this was a formidable opponent.
But she was too lazy to waste words with the old Demon Cultivator, instead, she gently lifted her jade palm, the Longyan Sword then flickered with radiance, hovering lightly above her palm.
Meanwhile.
Delighted expressions appeared on the faces of the Liu and Zhao Clans.
As long as someone can hold back the strongest Wang Longyan, the Wang Family members will merely be autumn grasshoppers, unable to jump for long.
It was time for them to settle scores with the Wang Family after months of humiliation.
Suddenly!
"Ancestor Longyan, let me deal with this Demon Cultivator according to our agreement."
A calm and serene voice arose.
No one saw any change, but a figure in an old cotton coat suddenly appeared before everyone.
Although wearing tattered clothes, just standing there, he was as steady as a mountain, inspiring respect and admiration unconsciously.
His gaze stayed on the Demon Cultivator, "No matter who you are, from where you come, you have violated the laws of the Daqian Kingdom, daring to intrude into others’ clan struggles. I, Chen Ruhong, am a marriage ally of the Wang Family, and I cannot sit idly by with such injustice."
Chen Ruhong!
Ancestor Ruhong?
The faces of the Liu Clan instantly turned ugly; they never expected the Wang Family would invite Ancestor Ruhong.
Despite Ancestor Ruhong not being renowned in Changning Guard.
It’s solely because the East Port Chen Family is far from the central area and usually active in the East Sea, causing people to overlook his strength and story.
Before forty, Ancestor Ruhong was unremarkable, merely a candidate for family Spirit Platform route, in charge of leading an overseas merchant ship.
However, at forty, Ancestor Ruhong’s ship wrecked overseas, presumed dead by his family, but he miraculously returned a year later, displaying astonishing potential.
Following this.
Ancestors Ruhong attained the Spirit Platform at forty-five, mid-stage Spirit Platform at seventy-five, and now hovering at the peak of mid-stage Spirit Platform.
Many suspect he underwent a Second Layer bloodline awakening.
Such cultivation speed and talent, even at the Purple Mansion Academy, he’d compete for a place among the core disciples.
With Ancestor Ruhong’s power, the East Port Chen Family, formed less than a century ago, has risen rapidly.
Furthermore, the current Chen Family Clan Leader Chen Dewei is on the verge of ascending to the Spirit Platform Realm.
If successful, the East Port Chen Family would form a three Spirit Platform layout, qualifying for the Daqian Government’s Eighth-Grade Noble Family recognition!
In such a short time, very few within Changning Guard could rise to an Eighth-Grade Noble Family. Moreover, Ancestor Ruhong exhibits abundant potential, possibly reaching late stage Spirit Platform in a decade, and afterward, glimpsing hope to become a Celestial Human.
Such a figure.
Surely frightens and shakes the Liu and Zhao Clans.
Both Liu and Zhao Ancestors, Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun exchanged glances, seeing fear in each other’s eyes.
Although predicted Wang Shouzhe’s slyness would invite one or two ancestors along, aimed likely to lure them.
Yet, surprising, the Wang Family could invite the East Port Chen Family’s pillar—Chen Ruhong.
Then, Liu Zhide declared loudly, "Ancestor Ruhong, you have a grand future as a Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator, possibly becoming a Celestial Human. Why struggle with another of your level for a half-crippled Wang Family? Don’t forget the plight of Wang Longyan these decades."
"The relations between you and the Chen Family aren’t just Noble Young Clan Leader and Wang Family’s daughter having a marriage contract, right? If you withdraw, we Liu Clan have a daughter too, with a dowry of a manor worth over ten thousand!"
In an attempt to drive a wedge between Chen Ruhong, Liu Zhide even went to lengths, offering a ten thousand-worth manor without hesitation.
Unexpectedly, before Ancestor Ruhong spoke, a young coachman beside Wang Shouzhe jumped in anger, cursing, "Liu Zhide, you are indeed a shameless old thief. That Liu Clan daughter of yours, resembling a country hen, can’t match even one toe of Luoyi. Offering her to this Young Clan Leader is an insult."
Chen Fangjie!
Not only the Liu and Zhao Clans, but even Wang Family members didn’t expect Chen Fangjie to disguise as a coachman, participating in the Wang Family’s autumn and winter hunt.
"Good scolding, Brother-in-law.""Brother-in-law, it’s lucky Luoyi sister can marry you.""Brother-in-law, you have such momentum."’He
A multitude of Wang Family juniors began praising Chen Fangjie under Wang Shouzhe’s gaze.
This round of praise made Chen Fangjie feel exuberant. The hardships of recent days as a coachman weren’t in vain.
Today’s performance, once Luoyi hears, will undoubtedly earn praise.
"Does Brother Chen mean that if the Liu Clan daughter were more beautiful, it could be considered?" Wang Shouzhe chuckled.
Immediately, Chen Fangjie felt a cold bucket of water poured over him, the feeling of buoyancy vanished, hurriedly supplementing, "Let alone the Liu Clan daughter’s lowly temperament, even if a goddess descended, I, Chen Fangjie, remain wholly devoted to Luoyi."
In panic, even "wholly devoted" emerged.
Chen Fangjie couldn’t help but wipe cold sweat from his forehead, needing to be careful when dealing with this future brother-in-law, avoiding traps set by him.
Liu Zhide and others wore dark expressions.
In such a dire situation, could these juniors laugh so brazenly, thinking Chen Ruhong couldn’t counter them?
Zhao Clan Ancestor Zhao Bojun laughed angrily, "Alright, alright, you Chen Family wish to be buried with Wang Family, then we’ll fulfill it. Brother Zhide, let’s join forces to kill Wang Longyan. For the rest, kill!"
"Leave no one alive!"
With the word "kill!"
Zhao Bojun and Liu Zhide flew into the air, joining forces to attack Ancestor Longyan.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 115: Suppression! Liu and Zhao Clans
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 115: Suppression! Liu and Zhao Clans
...
Though the two of them didn’t possess the formidable combat prowess of Ancestor Longyan, they were still qualified Spirit Platform Realm Cultivators, and having lived long enough, their combat experience among the ancestors was quite rich.
They attacked from left and right, joining forces to besiege and entirely block Ancestor Longyan’s escape route.
Their strategy was simple and direct.
Their worst outcome would be to hold back Wang Longyan, after which the remaining Wang Clan members would lose their protection. Meanwhile, the Liu Family had two Qi Refining Realm experts at their peak, more than enough to slaughter the Wang Clan’s younger generation.
Ancestor Longyan’s eyes were calm and unperturbed, as if she had not even considered Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun worth her notice. Her jade hand lifted lightly, and the Longyan Sword turned into a hazy glow that blocked the two men’s attacks outside of the sword aura.
Facing two foes alone, she was completely unfazed.
With the two ancestors making their move.
Everyone from the Liu and Zhao Clans was thrilled, their eyes filled with cruel killing intent. As soon as the ancestors managed to suppress Wang Longyan and free themselves, they would attack the Wang Clan members.
"Ancestor Ruhong." The demon cultivator with the surname Li was rather wary of Ancestor Ruhong, speaking to him lightly, "We are both merely here to lend a helping hand. Why fight to the death? If we are not careful and suffer severe injuries, wouldn’t that end our Path of Celestial Human? How about we exchange pieces and take each other out?"
But in his heart, he sneered, planning to settle the score with Chen Ruhong after the Wang Clan’s downfall. It was said the East Port Chen Family possessed an ancestral spiritual artifact, the Water Dragon Spear, a remarkably powerful weapon that displayed even greater effectiveness in water battles.
To this, Ancestor Ruhong made no comment, merely half-closing his eyes while a thread of spiritual sense firmly locked onto him, adopting a stance of non-action as long as the enemy did not move.
...
"Shouzhe, the current situation is surprisingly seventy to eighty percent similar to what you had foreseen earlier. Truly, you predicted their every move." At the side, Chen Fangjie took the opportunity to praise Wang Shouzhe, while showcasing himself, "What move are you planning next? I guess someone in your Wang Family has advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, most likely Ancestor Xiaohan. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have been able to slay the Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast."
He sighed internally, observing how this brother-in-law of his was gaining more power and had a tendency to set traps for people. It was necessary to maintain good relations; otherwise, with just a word, Chen Fangjie’s future could become quite difficult.
Wang Shouzhe gave him a calm glance, "You were part of the plan the whole time, so why speak so smugly about something so obvious? It makes you seem unintelligent, causing me to involuntarily doubt whether this might affect my future nephew’s prospects."
Chen Fangjie felt utterly aggrieved, thinking, wasn’t I just playing along with you to flatter you? Was this really necessary, really necessary?
However, Chen Fangjie was indeed right in his guess.
At this moment, he was naturally going to play the card of Ancestor Xiaohan.
After sparing no effort, he had kept Sixth Grandfather hidden, not even holding a Spirit Ascension Platform ceremony for him, all for this very day.
Just as Wang Shouzhe was about to make his move.
Suddenly.
A roar of anger erupted in the camp, and an old man, also dressed as a coachman, leaped into the air: "Old Thief Liu, Old Dog Zhao. The two of you teaming up to bully a weak woman, do you take Zhong Xingwang for nonexistent?"
The old man soared into the sky, his entire body enveloped in profound qi, launching a fierce punch towards Zhao Bojun: "Come, come, let me Zhong teach you some manners."
Zhao Bojun was immediately filled with fear and quickly turned to block.
"Boom!"
Elder Bojun was punched back four to five zhang and only then could he steady himself, his expression one of shock and anger, "Who are you to dare interfere in our Ping’an Family’s struggle?"
At the same time.
Liu Zhide dared not engage Ancestor Longyan alone; with a feint, he quickly retreated, standing side by side with Zhao Bojun, his expression equally outraged.
Indeed!
That Wang Shouzhe was up to no good, actually inviting two Spirit Platform Realm cultivators to assist them.
"Hmph!"
Zhong Xingwang, after fending off the formidable foe with one strike, took a few steps in mid-air, standing more than a zhang away from Ancestor Longyan, arms crossed and posture tall, he declared loudly, "Hundred Islands Guard Zhong Family, Zhong Xingwang!"
In that moment, he felt he had reached the peak of his life.
Being able to fight side by side with his senior sister, and to lend a hand in her moments of crisis, such a feeling was truly wonderful to the extreme. Especially the subtle glance she threw his way, it was utterly captivating and unforgettable.
Yet he himself didn’t even think, was only gutsy enough to stand more than a zhang away?
What talk of fighting side by side!
Dare to come any closer?
Of course not, because his legs would turn to jelly!
Despite Zhong Xingwang’s inner theatrics, he was indeed a bona fide Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
In the eyes of others, he naturally appeared mighty and imposing, full of extraordinary grace.
"Celestial Human Zhong Family!"
At present, the term belonged to the category of taboo words among the high ranks of the Liu and Zhao Clans. Their resentment towards it was no less than towards Wang Shouzhe.
Liu Zhide roared in rage, "How can your Celestial Human Zhong Family openly collude with the Wang Family? Why, why is this happening?"
Collude?
Facing such accusations, Zhong Xingwang, instead of being angry, felt even more delight, his heart growing even lighter, and he replied with an air of pride and arrogance: "Collude, indeed. I have colluded with the Wang Family, and deeply so. If you disagree, come and fight." Collude? Heh heh heh, I love this word.
However, Ancestor Longyan’s gaze sharpened, glaring in his direction.
Zhong Xingwang shuddered all over, his body weakening instantly. He hurriedly corrected his somewhat perverted demeanor, assuming a more solemn and serious expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 115: Suppression! Liu and Zhao Clans_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 115: Suppression! Liu and Zhao Clans_2
His heart became more and more refreshed, thinking that the goddess-like demeanor of Senior Sister was becoming more formidable. Just one glare was enough to almost scatter his spirit.
Though Zhong Xingwang in the Zhong Family, even if of the direct lineage, his combat sequence wasn’t high and typically lacked authority. However, a Celestial Human Family indeed comes from a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, and once they engage seriously, they won’t be too weak.
Such arrogance and wanton disregard.
Made Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun’s faces as red as pig liver; their hearts doubtful and uncertain. Could it be that Zhong Luoxian’s layout was a joint effort between the Celestial Human Zhong Family and Wang Family?
Or was this mere coincidence?
But at this moment, they couldn’t afford to keep pondering.
Because that Zhong Xingwang had already started rubbing his fists excitedly, saying, "Senior Sister Longyan, you and I, let’s join forces to hit the fallen dog hard."
"Brother Liang, what are you still standing there for? Hurry and lend us a hand," Liu Zhide shouted, "Do you really want our Liu and Zhao Clans’ efforts to go to waste?"
The so-called Brother Liang was naturally another man shrouded in a grey robe.
Liu Zhide, for the sake of caution, meticulously sought help again, paying a great cost to bring in assistance.
The man’s body paused slightly, but ultimately he still walked forward and said to Zhong Xingwang, "If Brother Zhong’s hands are itching, why don’t you and I go aside and spar a bit, and refrain from intervening in other family feuds."
"Who do you think you are, calling me brother?" Zhong Xingwang was ultimately a noble family descendant from a Celestial Human Family, only fawning over Senior Sister Longyan. He dismisses such lower-tier families.
"Brother Zhong, that man named Liang is most likely Ancestor Haofeng of the Westpeace Liang Family," Wang Shouzhe spoke, "Trouble Brother Zhong to intervene a bit."
After a brief conversation, Wang Shouzhe surmised the man’s identity: the Westpeace Liang Family, presently a family deeply allied with the Liu Family, being the maternal family clan of the Liu Shengye.
Who knows what benefits Liu Shengye had promised or how he managed to rope the ancestor in.
The Lianged dare to meddle in these muddy waters, probably thinking that the Liu and Zhao Clans had victory assured.
When this person appeared, Wang Shouzhe originally intended for Ancestor Mang or Ancestor Ming Sheng to intervene.
Since Zhong Xingwang stepped forth early, trying to show off in front of Ancestor Longyan, then let him handle this opponent.
"This?"
Zhong Xingwang had finally seized the chance to fight alongside the goddess, feeling a bit reluctant to go restrain an old man.
At this moment, Ancestor Longyan faintly said, "Listen to Shouzhe, go."
"Senior Sister~" Zhong Xingwang hesitantly wanted to say something.
"Direct involvement in other’s family feuds isn’t good if it spreads," Ancestor Longyan eventually softened her tone towards him.
Although she disdained Zhong Xingwang, he did ultimately stand up to help the Wang Family at a critical moment. This favor couldn’t be ignored, and she somewhat viewed him in a new light.
"Senior Sister!"
At that instant, Zhong Xingwang felt his bones melting; Senior Sister actually voiced concern for him. Was she worried about him?
Ohhh~
If he could, he’d love to roar on the spot to express his joy.
This is the stuff of dreams.
"Senior Sister, I’m fine. For you..." Zhong Xingwang’s eyes sparkled, choking with emotion, "Don’t say they’ll hold me accountable, even if..."
Ancestor Longyan’s brow twitched, thinking that a little kindness was enough to make him float.
She immediately retorted coldly, "If you don’t go, then scram."
"Yes, yes, Senior Sister, I’m off~" Zhong Xingwang’s legs trembled instinctively, but soon he snapped out of it, "No, no, I’m off, I’m off."
Then, he dashed up to Liang Haofeng of the Liang Family, arrogantly saying, "Liang, since Senior Sister Longyan assigned you to me, let’s go aside and settle it. Don’t delay Senior Sister from settling scores with her enemy."
Hearing this, Liang Haofeng felt a chill.
Could the Wang Family have hidden tricks?
As of now, Liang Haofeng was a bit panicked. He’d come to support because Liu Shengye is his external direct lineage bloodline; also, Liu Shengye assured him of certain victory.
He wouldn’t even need Ancestor Haofeng to act, just to share the spoils
But unexpectedly, the situation seemed complicated. On the contrary, the Wang Family appeared calm, as if they had aces up their sleeves.
However, at this point, he couldn’t retreat. He cupped his hand to Zhong Xingwang, "Since Brother Zhong has the interest, let’s spar aside and hold back a bit. We’re both just assistance, no need to fight to the death."
"Who wants to spar with you? I want to kill you for Senior Sister."
"Boom!"
Zhong Xingwang unleashed a powerful aura.
The two exited the camp and began fierce combat just outside.
...
Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun’s faces were already ashen, and they could see that the situation was almost at its worst.
Without a doubt.
Wang Longyan, who could send Zhong Xingwang away, must have another reinforcement, and it was highly likely someone from within the Wang Family.
They both instinctively thought of that Celestial Spirit Pill!
Could it be...
"Clap clap clap!" Wang Shouzhe’s clapping interrupted their thoughts, "I didn’t expect today’s drama to have so many twists and turns. Old thief Zhide, old thief Bojun, have you finished showing all your cards?"
"Today, it’s time for our two clans to settle our accounts. Ancestor Longyan, please hold off these two old thieves.
"Sixth Grandfather, it’s your turn to take the stage, go and kill the two Qi Refining Realm peak Spirit Platform Seeds, Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan, and extinguish their hopes."
Wang Shouzhe commanded from the center, wielding power decisively.
One by one, the high and mighty ancestral figures became cards in his hand.
Since the Liu and Zhao Clans’ cards were fully revealed and thoroughly understood, it was naturally time to push forward directly with full strength.
Ancestor Longyan’s Longyan Sword hummed softly, and she transformed into a figure akin to an Evil God, with sword momentum enveloping Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun.
To take on two opponents, defeating them would likely require paying a hefty price.
But merely to restrain them, Ancestor Longyan felt she could hold on indefinitely.
At the same time.
Among the household generals, a seemingly ordinary general rose up, exuding a majestic aura as he stepped into the air toward the people of the Liu and Zhao Clans: "Liu Family, Zhao Family. Today is the day for our Wang Family to settle accounts with you."
Wang Family!
Ancestor Xiaohan!
He threw a punch, with a faint earthy yellow Profound Qi condensing into the shape of a fist, imbued with the weight of earth. Clearly, during this time, under Ancestor Longyan’s careful guidance, he had completely stabilized his realm.
Overall, his combat power might be slightly inferior to veteran Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, but dealing with two Qi Refining Realm peaks not yet ascended to the Spirit Platform was naturally a matter of ease.
Such overwhelming fist pressure.
Plunged Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan into despair; they could only barely defend, without any strength to counterattack. But how many moves could they withstand like this?
Ten moves, or eight?
Without reaching the Spirit Platform, how can one contend with the Spirit Platform?
"Wang Xiaohan, how dare you!"
Held back by Ancestor Longyan, both Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun roared in indescribable grief and rage. If the two Spirit Platform Realm Seeds of the family were killed, what hope would the family have?
At such a critical moment.
They exchanged a glance, each showing a hint of determination in their eyes.
Joining forces, they fought desperately to temporarily repel Wang Longyan, and each took out a pill and swallowed it, their aura suddenly bursting forth, climbing rapidly, as if an unparalleled powerhouse had arrived.
Frenzy Pill?
Wang Shouzhe raised his eyebrows slightly, but then immediately dismissed this idea. The Frenzy Pill was merely a Tier Two Pill, effective only for Qi Refining Realm use, and its effectiveness diminished the further along one progressed.
The pill capable of enhancing Spirit Platform Realm cultivators so significantly must be some kind of "Tier Four Pill," haha, in order to win, the Liu and Zhao Clans seem quite desperate.
Such a pill was not only expensive but after the burst, would surely leave endless troubles.
"Bojun, I’ll hold off Wang Longyan." Liu Zhide’s voice was almost uncontrollably frenzied, "You go kill Wang Xiaohan."
"Shenghao, Daoyuan, you go kill Wang Shouzhe and the younger ones."
Liu Zhide was extremely formidable, almost losing control of his emotions yet still able to arrange tactics.
"Wang Family! We’ll fight you!"
All the people of the Liu and Zhao Clans, both terrified and frenzied, understood that this was their last hand of cards and opportunity.
For the survival of the family, they had no choice but to fight!
Fight! Fight! Fight!
Fury ignited, blood burned.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 116 Zhou Xuan! Longyan! Twin Swords Resound
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 116 Zhou Xuan! Longyan! Twin Swords Resound
...
"Wang Longyan!"
Liu Zhide’s entire being surged with Profound Qi, his old face bulging with veins, looking ferocious and terrifying, he howled madly.
As if only by relying on such howls, could he expel the endless fear Wang Longyan brought him.
His spiritual sense nearly merged with the Purple Gold Alms Bowl, suspending it in midair above his head, Profound Qi following the trajectory of his spiritual sense, crazily pouring into the Purple Gold Alms Bowl.
"Buzz!~~~"
The Purple Gold Alms Bowl spun and trembled, emitting a deep resonant sound of bells and drums, causing hearts to quiver.
Simultaneously, a thick purple light cascaded down like a Celestial Maiden scattering flowers, enveloping his body, coalescing into a thick purple eggshell-like protective shield.
"I’ll annihilate your entire clan!"
Liu Zhide roared and howled, pouring all his life’s strength into a punch aimed at Wang Longyan. His fist was charged with purple light, like a blazing purple flame set to destroy everything.
The momentum of the punch was overwhelming, like a mountain collapsing or an earth-shattering force, the air exploded with a deafening bang.
The power of the fist, with all his life’s effort, turned out to be of such might.
Even Ancestor Longyan’s expression became serious, having to admit that Liu Zhide, coming from a loose cultivator background, reaching this level step by step, was certainly not a simple character.
Had he been born into the Black Tortoise Clan, his achievements would likely have gone far beyond this.
But what kind of character was she, Wang Longyan? Naturally awakened with the First-Layer Primordial Water Bloodline, accomplished Spirit Platform before thirty, awakened Abnormal Attribute Profound Ice Bloodline. In the Academy, she competed fiercely with the geniuses of all Longzhou County, a mere sixty years old and already at the Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm.
She even alarmed Master Binglan Ascendant, who took her as a core disciple and gifted her a Defensive Spiritual Artifact Turtle Scale Armor Shield, showing the high hopes for her future.
This journey is not something that can be described by just two words: hard work.
How proud was her heart.
Immediately, in the heat of battle, she wanted to use everything she had learned in her life to counter Liu, the old thief’s punch.
Yet, at that moment, she remembered Shouzhe’s earnest exhortation before departing.
Ancestor, this battle concerns the fate of the Wang Family’s turning point, even laying the foundation for millennia. Ancestor, please do not act impulsively, nor follow your temperament.
Yes, do not follow one’s temperament.
Immediately, she put away the thought of breaking the force with force, proving her combat power. Shouzhe had said, her task was to hold the enemy while ensuring she remained unharmed.
Sword momentum retracts!
The Longyan Sword emitted a light, delicate sound, like a bell in the wind, crisp and pleasant. The surrounding air suddenly decreased by tens of degrees, the invisible moisture in the air forming countless cold and piercing frost.
As the sword momentum stirred, thousands of frosts violently rotated, forming a highly dense frost storm, blocking Liu Zhide’s powerful fist momentum.
"Profound Ice Sword Technique—Defense!"
Meanwhile, she continually retreated, avoiding its edge.
Facing Liu Zhide, this mortal enemy whom she hated deeply, every move used to be a killing blow.
Yet this was the first time Ancestor Longyan had adopted a defensive stance!
Liu Zhide’s punch slammed into the dense frost storm, as if his full-strength punch struck an endless wad of cotton, the feeling of the punch’s power being void caused recoil, making his internal organs shake, nearly spitting blood.
The most unbearable part for him was being in the frost storm, where the rapidly dropping temperature made his body stiff, his movements slow by several beats, he had boundless strength but couldn’t exert it.
He never dreamt that the impulsive and unparalleled Wang Longyan would choose not to clash head-on with him.
"Damn it! Wang Longyan, you..." Liu Zhide’s emotions were excessively agitated, spitting a mouthful of blood.
Seeing the strategy succeed, Ancestor Longyan naturally continued to apply the Misty Traceless body technique, constantly engaging Liu Zhide in a battle of wits, never giving him a chance to fight hard.
And Liu Zhide could only charge wildly like a wild ox, yet couldn’t even touch Ancestor Longyan’s sleeve.
Meanwhile.
In other places on the battlefield, different changes were occurring.
Similarly having taken an apparent High-Tier Frenzy Pill, Zhao Bojun’s strength also surged dramatically, each step he took made the land in the encampment tremble, targeting Ancestor Xiaohan.
Ancestor Xiaohan had just ascended to the Spirit Platform Realm, naturally having some temporary disparity with veteran Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, not to mention Zhao Bojun was now drug-fueled, fighting with desperation.
Immediately!
Wang Shouzhe commanded quietly from the center, "Sixth Grandfather, retreat."
Wang Xiaohan obediently followed the command, immediately abandoning Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan, two Spirit Platform Realm seeds, retreating swiftly towards Wang Shouzhe’s direction. Even though in just a few moves, he could kill one of them.
Two Spirit Platform Realm seeds escaped with their lives, feeling a sense of survival after a disaster, their backs were drenched. They exchanged glances, understanding the truth of how being below the Spirit Platform Realm is ultimately futile.
Before ascending to Spirit Platform Realm, Wang Xiaohan’s strength was at most on par with them. Now facing two opponents, he crushed them both.
"Wang Xiaohan, where are you escaping to."
After taking the drug, Zhao Bojun seemed transformed into a berserk beast, his destructive power increased by more than a notch. Seeing Wang Xiaohan fleeing, his speed increased yet again, leaving behind a trail of afterimages.
He clawed towards Wang Xiaohan’s back, a fierce wind swirling.
Meanwhile.
In the tent, the two hidden trump cards, Ancestor Mang and Ancestor Ming Sheng, were instinctively tense, wanting to go out and help.
But before they moved, they remembered Shouzhe’s previous instructions. This battle is of great importance, everyone hopes to obey his command.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 116 Zhou Xuan! Longyan! Twin Swords Resound_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 116 Zhou Xuan! Longyan! Twin Swords Resound_2
Since Shouzhe has not given the order, it means he has other plans.
Immediately, they restrained their actions. They were curious about what other trump card Shouzhe could have. This great-grandson had become increasingly inscrutable to them.
At a critical moment.
Wang Shouzhe drew the sword from his waist with a "clang" and threw it forward: "Sixth Grandpa, catch the sword."
The sword spun twice in the air before landing in Wang Xiaohan’s hand. Holding the treasure sword, he instantly seemed like a changed man, his courage bolstered, and he swung the sword back at Zhao Bojun.
That sword strike splendidly released a heavy, earth-colored sword aura, which swept towards Zhao Bojun like a half-moon arc, domineering and fierce.
"The Cosmic Palace Sword!"
Zhao Bojun’s face turned drastically as he shouted, not daring to confront it, hurriedly sidestepping in a panicked escape.
The impression of the Cosmic Palace Sword was deeply ingrained in him; back in the hands of Ancestor Zhou Xuan, it was like a God of Slaughter’s sword, having slain countless fierce beasts.
Even that Tier Five "Sun-Devouring Golden-Winged Tiger" had once been struck by it and thus injured.
With this sword drawn, Zhao Bojun dared not withstand it directly.
"Swish!"
The sword aura flashed by, cutting a seventy or eighty-foot-long gully in the hard soil of the camp.
"Zhao Bojun, where are you running to?"
Wang Xiaohan, holding the "Cosmic Palace Sword," seemed like Ancestor Zhou Xuan was possessing him, chasing after Zhao Bojun with sword flashes like dragons, full of might.
Back then, when the Wang family was at its peak, relying on expansion responsibilities, Ancestor Zhou Xuan made a fortune. He also spent much effort collecting materials and personally went to Longzuo County to invite an Artifact Refining Master to forge two spiritual artifacts.
One was named [Cosmic Palace], a treasure sword for the clan. Another named [Longyan] was gifted to his granddaughter Wang Longyan to assist her in competing for a place in the Academy, taking a step further.
Since Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s demise, no one in the clan has been qualified to wield the Cosmic Palace Sword. As it bears the clan’s hopes and faith, it was enshrined in the ancestral hall, silently waiting for the next Sword Master.
In this decisive battle, Wang Shouzhe brought the spiritual artifact sword without hesitation as a trump card.
With the Cosmic Palace Sword witnessing the destruction of the once enemy clans, Liu and Zhao, it’s both opportune and a way to console Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s spirit in heaven, why not?
Meanwhile, inside the tent.
Ancestor Lua Mingsheng and Ancestor Mang exchanged a glance.
Indeed, Shouzhe lived up to his name, commanding and strategizing centrally, firmly grasping the Liu Zhao clans. Regardless of how many trump cards the opposing side had, they were taken one by one, as though everything was under control.
This great-grandson is truly extraordinary.
Now, he has yet to even reach the Spirit Platform Realm and already possesses such remarkable bearing. All the clan ancestors followed his command and direction with proper pacing and much organization.
What will it be like when he attains the Spirit Platform Realm?
He truly is a great-grandson of mine, Gongsun Mang/Lua Mingsheng...
Suddenly~
The two contented ancestors suddenly thought of each other’s presence, once again glaring at each other, finding one another increasingly displeasing.
"Wang Xiaohan, do you think you can kill Zhao Bojun, who just entered the Spirit Platform, with just a treasure sword?" Zhao Bojun was extremely agitated, not daring to confront the powerful Cosmic Palace Sword head-on and could only keep dodging outside.
"Hehe." Holding the Cosmic Palace Sword, Wang Xiaohan exuded a majestic aura, "No problem, let’s take our time. I want to see how long your medicinal effects can last."
Zhao Bojun wailed inwardly, initially thinking of quickly killing Wang Xiaohan, then assisting Liu Zhide in jointly killing or at least severely wounding Wang Longyan.
But unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe turned the unfavorable situation around with just a [Cosmic Palace Sword].
Meanwhile.
Outside the camp.
The grey-robed Demon Cultivator, confronting Ruhong Ancestor, appeared somewhat hesitant.
However, Ruhong Ancestor didn’t even open his eyes, speaking calmly, "What, regretting getting involved in this mess? Thinking about escaping?"
The grey-robed Demon Cultivator’s gaze sharpened, and he coldly chuckled, "It’s just that the situation is slightly perilous, once the Wang clan’s trump cards are exhausted, they will either die or be half-crippled."
As the grey-robed Demon Cultivator finished speaking.
Patriarch Liu, Liu Shengye, roared: "Everyone, the turning point of the two clans’ destiny has arrived. The ancestors have already exerted their efforts. In this battle, our victory is certain. The target is Wang Shouzhe; everyone, charge!"
With Liu Shengye’s furious shout.
A few elite household generals of the Liu Zhao clans, family elders, two patriarchs, and the two Spirit Platform Realm seeds, Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan, all charged towards Wang Shouzhe’s direction.
Especially Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan, who were already at the peak of the Qi Refining Realm, their combat power nowhere near the Spirit Platform Realm, but still incomparable to ordinary Qi Refining cultivators.
The two raced ahead, eyes gleaming with ferocity. Since the Wang clan had played all their cards, they wouldn’t balk at overwhelming them with strength.
This is a life-or-death clan war, the hatred and conflicts between the sides have long been irreconcilable.
Everyone on the clan war battlefield is an enemy.
"Shouzhe!" Wang Shouxin, at the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, drew his sword, stepping in front of Wang Shouzhe, his face resolute, "You take the children and retreat first."
At the same time.
Wang Shouyi and Wang Shounuo also drew their swords and stood at the forefront. Although they were only at the fourth and fifth layers of Qi Refining, they still exuded the boldness of the Wang clan.
Two elders of the Ding Generation exchanged a glance, laughing heartily, each drawing their weapons and stepping to the front. The Ding Generation had suffered heavy losses, with only three remaining alive, and the eldest, Wang Dingchuan, who was already sixty-five, stayed back to guard the family.
"Ding Generation, take the front line!"
"Shou Generation, take the second line!";
"Shouzhe and Fang Jie, take the children and retreat!"
With elders of the Ding Generation and the Shou Generation uncles, brothers, all taking their positions at the front lines, not a single one was afraid, their eyes filled with the burning determination to fight the enemy to the death.
And the household generals, too, drew their weapons, standing at the flanks of the first and second rows.
The Wang family had been cowed long enough over these fifty years!
It was time to show the Wang clan’s fiery spirit. The descendants of Ancestor Zhou Xuan were no cowards.
"Why retreat! They are just a bunch of weaklings."
Wang Luqiu, with his hands behind his back, sneered, "I will deal with one of the fourth-layer generals."
"Me too." Wang Luojing was not to be outdone, a resolute and fierce look in her eyes, "Today, this young lady is going to kill!"
Even Wang Lici was unwilling to back down, patting her chest, saying: "I’m the big sister, I’ll take care of one at the fifth layer."
Her bold words elicited skeptical glances from Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu, questioning her capability.
Similarly, Wang Shouyong and Wang Shou Lian, the two younger brothers, along with the fourth sister Wang Luotong, also expressed their determination for a fight to the death.
The Wang family united as one at that moment.
No one would retreat, and no one was afraid of death.
Meanwhile, Chen Fangjie and Wang Shouzhe exchanged glances, both seeing calmness in each other. There was no choice because two ancestors were still lurking in the tent, making calmness unavoidable.
Everything happened quickly.
Liu Shenghao and Zhao Daoyuan were already soaring through the air like falcons, heading towards the Wang family members with the posture of tigers among sheep.
Just as the two ancestors were heartily anxious, wondering why Shouzhe hadn’t ordered an action, just about to intervene.
Suddenly!
A plain-looking carriage parked in the middle suddenly exploded open.
Suddenly!
"Boom!" It burst open.
A gigantic, ferocious-looking turtle beast stretched its body from the slightly cramped carriage cabin, shattering it.
At the same time.
It happened to see a figure flying across, and its turtle head instinctively pecked swiftly, "Owu," it caught that figure with its mouth.
"Ah~"
The one caught was Liu Shenghao, who screamed in agony under the bone-crushing pain and terror.
The battlefield fell into sudden silence!
Only Liu Shenghao’s lingering screams filled the air.
"This is... a Tier Three Ferocious Beast!" Standing beside Wang Shouzhe, Chen Fangjie’s face changed drastically, involuntarily stepping back a couple of steps.
Other ancestors were also dumbfounded.
How was it possible that the Wang family had reared a Tier Three Spirit Beast?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 117 Killing! Punishing the Heart! Liu Zhao Collapses (Seeking Monthly Tickets and Recommendation Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 117 Killing! Punishing the Heart! Liu Zhao Collapses (Seeking Monthly Tickets and Recommendation Tickets)
...
Tier Three Ferocious Beasts, no, if they are domesticated, they are called Spirit Beasts.
Generally, the conditions for wanting to domesticate a Spirit Beast are very stringent. Especially wanting to domesticate a Tier Three Spirit Beast, the difficulty is even greater.
Once Spirit Beasts reach Tier Three, their intelligence will have a significant increase, and they are not easily subdued. Families with Clan Guardian Spirit Beasts mostly raise them from the spirit beast’s infancy, which is beneficial for fostering affection.
However, most Ninth Grade, even Eighth Grade families barely have enough for their own diet, clothing, and cultivation resources.
How could they possibly invest resources into spirit beasts?
The resource expenditure to domesticate a spirit beast is usually higher than for family members.
"A Tier Three Spirit Beast, huh."
Inside the tent, Ancestor Ming Sheng and Ancestor Mang looked at each other, unable to fathom that the Wang Family secretly domesticated a Tier Three Spirit Beast.
Could it be that this Tier Three Spirit Beast is a trump card left for the Wang Family by Ancestor Zhou Xuan?
They were suspicious.
Unfortunately, they only guessed half right.
This Water Origin Spirit Turtle was indeed left by Ancestor Zhou Xuan, but it wasn’t subdued, merely free-ranged in Zhuwei Lake. It was eventually subdued by Wang Shouzhe and others.
Of course, if not for the Water Origin Spirit Turtle living next to the Wang Family for over a hundred years and already familiar with humans and the Wang Family, it might not have been that easy to subdue.
Likewise, had it advanced to Tier Three on its own, it might not have been subdued and it could have brought disaster to the Wang Family.
It can only be considered a fortuitous coincidence that the Wang Family gained a Tier Three Clan Guardian Spirit Beast.
And the appearance of this Tier Three Spirit Beast, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle, immediately put an end to the charge of the Liu and Zhao Clans.
The clan members of the Liu and Zhao Clans, led by Liu Shengye and Zhao Jinxian, were all stunned on the spot as the turtle, massive in size and ferocious in aura, grabbed Liu Shenghao and swung him around.
A Spirit Platform Seed of Peak of Ninth Layer Qi Refining Realm was tossed around like a toy, screaming continuously.
Apart from a few, most of the Wang Family didn’t know they had a Tier Three guardian spirit turtle. Once they saw the battlefield clearly, they couldn’t help but cheer.
"Shou, Shouzhe." Chen Fangjie was astonished and incredulous, "Your clan has a Tier Three Spirit Beast guarding?"
"Spirit Turtle, do not eat people." Wang Shouzhe instructed briefly, then turned to Chen Fangjie, saying, "Just a small Tier Three Spirit Beast, Brother Chen, do not be overly surprised."
To be honest, Wang Shouzhe had a good impression of Chen Fangjie. After all, he was willing to risk danger to be with the Wang Family through this pivotal battle concerning the clan’s fate.
Clan wars are brutal and dangerous; there’s no concept of certain victory. Wang Shouzhe was merely doing his best; as for the final outcome, no one is a deity and cannot ascertain it.
But currently, the overall results are quite good.
Upon hearing Wang Shouzhe’s instruction, the Water Origin Spirit Turtle obediently flung Liu Shenghao aside.
"Bang," Liu Shenghao hit a carriage heavily, but being at the peak of Qi Refining Realm as a Black Tortoise Practitioner, his life force was tenacious, and he managed to stagger back to his camp, covered in blood.
Tier Three Ferocious Beast is terrifying!
He, Liu Shenghao, survived.
"Thud!"
Before he could run far, a massive foot stomped down, crushing his head and spinal cord together.
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle’s logic was simple: its master only said not to eat people, not not to kill them.
A Spirit Platform Realm Seed carefully nurtured by the family for over thirty years was killed without even a chance to scream.
"Brother!"
Liu Shengye cried out in anguish, and the rest of the Liu Family members were also deeply grieved.
But such is the nature of life and death clan warfare.
Today, indeed.
It’s a situation of either you die or I perish.
"Water Origin Spirit Turtle, charge into the battlefield, kill the strongest one." Wang Shouzhe unhesitatingly ordered the spirit turtle to charge.
It howled immediately, a deep blue shield formed around it, and it charged into the battlefield like an ancient war elephant. Its speed was already not slow, and after advancing to Tier Three, it was akin to a rampaging tank.
Zhao Daoyuan was initially quick to react, retreating upon seeing the unfavorable situation, but before he could even rejoice, he was targeted by the Water Origin Spirit Turtle. He quickly retreated, only to be hit from a distance by a water jet, sent flying by the powerful impact.
Meanwhile, the clan members of the Liu and Zhao Clans were scattered, their morale plunged, panic-stricken, and even began to flee in all directions.
"All clansmen, household generals, start pushing and charging!" Wang Shouzhe commanded from the center, "Each choose a suitable opponent, strive for Contribution Points just today, leave no enemy alive!"
The order to attack had two purposes: with the Liu and Zhao Clans’ formation scattered by the spirit turtle, they were bound to scatter in all directions. Some might die in the Outer Domain, but some would escape.
The result of today’s battlefield, Wang Shouzhe didn’t want to publicize. His sole purpose was to annihilate the enemy.
The second purpose was to have every family member participate in the battle.
In this way, everyone would have a greater sense of belonging to the family, unite as one, and understand the truth that the family’s growth cannot be achieved without everyone’s contribution.
Wang Shouzhe did not want to cultivate a group of parasites who would be helpless without the Ancestor. He hoped each of them would become competent on their own.

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 117 Killing! Punishing the Heart! Liu Zhao Collapses (Seeking Monthly Tickets and Recommendation Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 117 Killing! Punishing the Heart! Liu Zhao Collapses (Seeking Monthly Tickets and Recommendation Tickets)_2
Participating collectively in this pivotal battle for the family’s destiny will greatly enhance their sense of honor, participation, dedication, and so on!
As for being afraid of casualties among the juniors.
Haha, now that the Liu and Zhao Clans are in chaos. Moreover, with Wang Shouzhe overseeing like a big nanny, the probability of something going wrong is relatively low.
As soon as Wang Shouzhe gave the order to charge.
The most zealous for contribution points, Wang Luqiu, howled and charged forward. Just as she had predicted before the battle, she chose an enemy household general in the Qi Refining Realm Fourth Layer as her opponent.
That household general tried repeatedly to escape but was blocked by Wang Luqiu with every punch and kick, fueling his anger. How dare such a little girl persist like this?
Subsequently, the household general got entangled with Wang Luqiu, and both sides exchanged moves, appearing quite skillful.
Especially Wang Luqiu, three months ago, she struggled heavily when facing someone in the Qi Refining Realm Third Layer. Now, against a Fourth Layer household general, whether in terms of moves, strength, or even skill and experience, she did not fall behind.
Such astounding progress even caught the eye of Wang Shouzhe. This child, Luqiu, besides her bloodline awakening, she is very determined and trains diligently on regular days.
As long as she is well nurtured, she will surely be a pillar of the family in the future.
Wang Shouzhe then looked at Wang Luojing.
Eh?
Where did that girl go?
"Buzz!"
A swarm of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees suddenly flew out from somewhere, numbering no less than a hundred or two.
Due to the Purple Crystal Spirit Bees’ large size, such a massive swarm was an overwhelming sight, even a Qi Refining Realm Fourth or Fifth Layer practitioner would find it daunting.
But it was quite evident that the girl had big ambitions this time.
The bee swarm’s target was surprisingly Liu Shengye, the Patriarch of the Liu Family.
This person was in the Qi Refining Realm Seventh Layer, even if he was just a figurehead, he was not someone Luojing, who hadn’t reached the Third Layer, could compare with. If faced directly, Wang Luojing would definitely be at a disadvantage.
Thus, Wang Luojing was very smart, hiding behind a carriage and playing the insect flute, more than ten zhang away from Liu Shengye.
"Damn, it’s that little Spirit Insect Master girl." Liu Shengye’s fat quivered, terrified, and he slapped his thick palms continuously, unleashing wave after wave of Profound Qi Palm Force.
The current Purple Crystal Spirit Bees hadn’t evolved yet, only considered a colony of Tier One Fierce Insects. Naturally, they could not withstand the shredding of the Profound Palm Wind, with each strike killing several bees, Purple Crystal Spirit Bees fell in large numbers.
This was the Qi Refining Realm Seventh Layer, even a figurehead was a Seventh Layer.
Wang Shouzhe estimated that the little girl, Luojing, would be heartbroken. It was not easy for her to nurture each Purple Crystal Spirit Bee, each carried her painstaking effort.
However, Wang Shouzhe would not casually assist unless she was in life-threatening danger.
Since she chose to take a big risk for great merit, she had to pay the price.
A Spirit Insect Master isn’t invincible, and neither is a bee swarm. With just her hundred or two Spirit Bees, Wang Shouzhe could easily wipe them all out.
Experiencing a setback now will be more valuable than anything.
Afterward, he turned his attention to other members. He stayed off the battlefield to look after the clan members.
Wang Zongwei!
That kid has grown a lot recently and finally trained to the Qi Refining Realm Third Layer. He managed to hold his own with Wang Luotong, fighting a Qi Refining Realm Fourth Layer household general.
Suddenly!
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched, witnessing an extremely bizarre scene on the battlefield.
Already a Qi Refining Realm Fourth Layer cultivator, Wang Lici had somehow put on a heavy suit of iron armor, weighing no less than three hundred jin, covering her entire body.
That’s not even exaggerating, she also wielded an iron shield in her left hand and held a tremendously heavy big iron hammer in her right.
Walking along, clanging and banging!
It was as if the earth trembled with each step.
Like an iron-clad war general.
Meanwhile, a considerably grown little tiger bounced alongside her.
Just as she boasted before the battle, she chose a Zhao Clan household general in the Qi Refining Realm Fifth Layer, requiring no skills, just blocking and hammering, blocking and hammering.
Having awakened double bloodlines, both her physique and strength had reached a terrifying level. However, her biggest issue is the lack of patience for diligent cultivation of the Black Tortoise Combat Technique and body technique.
This combat style could minimize the impact of body techniques and profound skills.
No matter how the enemy tried to maneuver around her, it was useless. Her little tiger HuaaHuaa wasn’t easily outsmarted, being both fast and aggressive, running like the wind.
With a moment of delay, the iron-clad warrior Wang Lici would swing her heavy hammer in.
The Qi Refining Fifth Layer opponent was harassed endlessly, unable to inflict damage, and unable to outrun the tiger. Even defending was futile, as the hammer smashed their steel saber.
Moreover, there was an annoying little tiger entangling and biting occasionally, causing additional harassment.
"Bang!"
The household general was finally hit in the chest by Wang Lici’s hammer, spitting blood as he was sent flying, landing and convulsing before dying.
Before dying, his eyes remained open, dying a death full of grievance.
"Wahaha! This is the most suitable combat style for me, Miss Lici," Wang Lici laughed triumphantly. "This young lady is now invincible in the world; who can contend with me? Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, I’ll let you know, the big sister will always be your big sister."
Wang Shouzhe wiped a drop of cold sweat, unable to continue watching.
The combat style was quite innovative, but the lines were overly embarrassing.
The emergence of the Tier Three Spirit Beast caused drastic changes on the battlefield.
Not to mention the complete reversal of circumstances in the main camp, other auxiliary battlefields where the other ancestors were also saw various changes.
As the saying goes, a single move can affect the entire outcome.
With Liu Zhide engaging Ancestor Longyan, he was already filled with rage when Liu Shenghao died, and the continuous gruesome deaths of fellow clansmen left him roaring like a mad beast.
Several attempts were made to escape Wang Longyan and save the people on the main battlefield in the camp, but he was tightly held back by Wang Longyan.
"Ancestor Longyan, don’t confront Old Thief Liu head-on," Wang Shouzhe’s voice resounded, "Entangle him until the medicine wears off, and don’t give him a chance to disengage."
"As for you, Sixth Grandpa, as long as you hold on, holding on means winning," Wang Shouzhe continued commanding on the battlefield, "Today will certainly mark the end of the Liu and Zhao Clans."
At the same time.
Inside the tent, Ancestor Ming Sheng and Ancestor Mang exchanged glances, feeling unlikely to have a chance to participate. Winning without entering the fray is undoubtedly a great thing.
But in the face of such a victorious situation today, them being just surplus cards felt somewhat awkward.
"Ah, I understand now." Ancestor Mang said, "Shouzhe invited us solely as a precaution."
"Indeed, Shouzhe only wanted us to handle external reinforcements, and for the life-and-death battle between Wang and the Liu and Zhao Clans, he already held the winning hand and didn’t want us to intervene," Ancestor Ming Sheng also sighed, "Although this is a form of protection for us, it feels uncomfortable taking the money for nothing."
At this moment.
On the battlefield, unable to break free from Ancestor Longyan’s entanglement, Liu Zhide roared in despair, "Wang Shouzhe, don’t get cocky there. Old man admits to being a move behind. If, if I had one more chance~~"
Those remaining from the Liu and Zhao Clans were filled with remorse. Yes, just one move short, just one move short. If only there was one more trump card, just enough to gain one more trump card...
"One move short?" Wang Shouzhe laughed disdainfully, "Don’t say I let you die with a grievance, unconvinced in death. Ancestor Mang, Ancestor Ming Sheng, you’ve been idle long enough, come out and say hello to everyone."
"Hahaha~ Didn’t expect we’d still get a chance to appear."
Ancestor Mang and Ancestor Ming Sheng finally heard their cue, immediately flying out from the tent to land on the battlefield.
The remnants of the Liu and Zhao Clans were struck as if by lightning, their hearts turning to ash, with any remaining morale vanishing without a trace.
This wasn’t just a single move behind!
How many moves behind was this?
"Old Thief Liu, Old Thief Zhao, I, Wang Shouzhe, give you a chance to destroy my Wang Clan," Wang Shouzhe sneered, "but unfortunately, you couldn’t seize it."
"And let me tell you another interesting piece of news."
"Luoxian!" "She is my person."
"Pfft!"
At this point, Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun both spat out a mouthful of blood.
Their faces were ashen!
The remnants of the Liu and Zhao Clans were in great lamentation, filled with sorrow.
This brat Wang Shouzhe, not only wants to kill but also crush their spirits.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 118: Fire Crow! Water Dragon! Ancestor Each Shows Off Their Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 118: Fire Crow! Water Dragon! Ancestor Each Shows Off Their Power
...
"Aow~~"
Liu Zhide, this Spirit Platform Realm cultivator of loose cultivator origin, was now roaring like a madman and a wild beast, "Why, why? The dignified Celestial Human Zhong Family, why would you conspire with them to betray us? Zhong Luoxian, Wang Shouzhe, Zhong Xingwang, Wang Longyan! You disgrace the noble family descendants, despicable and shameless, shameless!"
His voice was mournful and tragic, full of endless anger, resentment, and even regret, resonating back and forth in the sky above the camp.
It was as if singing a dirge for the imminent fall of the noble Liu and Zhao Clans.
"Conspire again?"
Zhong Xingwang was suppressing the Liang Family’s Liang Haofeng, feeling more exhilarated than ever.
As a descendant of the Celestial Human, possessing relatively poor talent, he had barely reached the Spirit Platform Realm and usually didn’t need to act. This rare opportunity to single out a rural ancestor of the same level was naturally a chance to impress his senior sister.
Upon hearing that the Wang Family had achieved a great victory, he was certainly happy for his senior sister and younger brother Shouzhe.
However, he didn’t expect that the old thief Liu Zhide would claim that the Zhong Family conspired with the Wang Family to betray the Liu and Zhao Clans?
Of course, there was collusion, but how could it be termed as betrayal? And who was Zhong Luoxian anyway? Could it be that his performance was so astonishing that it frightened them?
Couldn’t understand, never mind.
The word "conspire" made Zhong Xingwang feel excited yet trembled. It reminded him that he must strengthen and deepen his collusion with the Wang Family, so he could wander in front of his senior sister from time to time to show his presence.
If he could earn a cold and charming glance from his senior sister, hear her scold, "Get lost!" with a mock accusation, the feeling would blend ecstasy and delight.
Comfortable! Cozy!
While Zhong Xingwang indulged in his fantasies, feeling at ease.
Elsewhere on the battlefield, significant changes were occurring.
Foremost among them was a demon cultivator named Li, whose pupils shrank sharply, and his body tensed up.
The Liu and Zhao Clans had come with immense momentum, seemingly certain of their victory over the Wang Family. Unexpectedly, the situation collapsed in such a short time.
If not now, then when?
Just as he intended to make a move.
Suddenly.
Ancestor Ruhong, who had been half-closing his eyes, slowly opened them, his face with a faint smile, "Thinking of leaving only now, might be a bit too late?"
"What do you intend?" The demon cultivator named Li narrowed his eyes, his voice rasping with a cold laugh, "Ancestor Ruhong, do you wish to stop me from leaving?"
With that, the two-foot-long demon blade in his hand flickered with black energy mist, its form ever-changing as if a ferocious and vicious soul were sealed within, roaring madly, waiting to devour someone.
It was like the low growl of a beast facing its enemy, warning and intimidating the opponent.
"Whether you stay or not, it’s not up to me." Ancestor Ruhong said placidly, "The decision lies with the sufferer Wang Family."
Sufferer?
Li’s demon cultivator was a mix of shock, anger, and incredulity. The Wang Family hadn’t suffered a scratch; they were basking in glory, so what suffering was there to speak of?
At this moment.
Wang Shouzhe’s voice rang out, "Ancestor Ruhong is correct. You, demon cultivator, dared to plot against my Wang Family. Despite not succeeding, such sin is unforgivable. You think you can come as you please, leave as you wish, treating our Wang Family as what?"
"Ancestor Mang, Ancestor Mingsheng, I trouble you both."
"Hahaha! Didn’t expect a chance to make a move today, certainly won’t take Shouzhe’s favor in vain."
Gongsun Mang and Lua Mingsheng, the two ancestors, exchanged a glance, and with great understanding, stepped into the air, taking positions to block the direction from which the demon cultivator named Li could escape.
Together with Ancestor Ruhong, the three formed a triangular formation to encircle the demon cultivator, sealing off his escape route.
The demon cultivator named Li had terror written in his eyes, retreating two steps in remorseful anger, "Wang Family junior, since your Wang Family has already won, why make things difficult for me, when I haven’t raised a hand."
"Ridiculous." Wang Shouzhe scoffed with a loud cold laugh, "Since you accepted the invitation from the Liu and Zhao Clans to oppose my Wang Family, you must be ready to fall."
"Alright, alright, alright!" The demon cultivator named Li laughed furiously, "This old man has been in the Spirit Platform Realm for seventy years and is being threatened by a mere Qi Refining Realm brat for the first time. Chen Ruhong, Lua Mingsheng, Gongsun Mang, do you really think I am to be trifled with?"
"Facing three at once, yet daring to boast." Wang Shouzhe laughed coldly, "Three ancestors, should this person escape easily, he would pose a threat to any family. Moreover, as a loose cultivator, he surely carries all his possessions, such a chance must not be missed."
The first part of Wang Shouzhe’s words made the three ancestors sharpen their eyes, revealing killing intent. However, the latter half brightened their eyes. Indeed, this demon cultivator, being a loose cultivator, is unlike family cultivators.
The biggest trait of a loose cultivator is distrust in others, trusting only oneself. Most valuables would likely be carried nearby.
"Shouzhe is right; this person cannot be left alive." Ancestor Ruhong’s eyes flashed with a severe tone, "All of you have families and businesses. Should this demon cultivator escape today, secretly targeting us, could anyone withstand it? Kill!"
Ancestor Ruhong was the first to act, his legs springing him into the air like a Great Peng.
At the same time, a transparent long spear appeared in his hand.
Though the spear was just about a foot long, its shape miniature, as Ancestor Ruhong infused it with Water Element Profound Qi, it rapidly expanded, turning into an over ten-feet-long spear in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 118: Fire Crow! Water Dragon! Ancestor Each Shows Their Might_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 118: Fire Crow! Water Dragon! Ancestor Each Shows Their Might_2
Ancestor Ruhong held a crystalline spear, exuding an awe-inspiring presence, as he thrust it downward with great force.
Strands of Primordial Water Profound Energy gathered at the spear’s tip.
"Buzz!"
The spear tip quivered intensely.
The highly condensed energy burst forth like a ferocious dragon, lunging vehemently at the demon cultivator with the surname Li.
"Water Dragon Spear!"
The demon cultivator with the surname Li looked utterly terrified and cried out in shock.
This was the ancestral spiritual artifact of the East Port Chen Family, the Water Dragon Spear, with extraordinary power, especially formidable in aquatic battles, able to sweep up waves for attacks.
However, that didn’t mean it lacked power on land.
The demon cultivator hastily activated the demon artifact short blade in his hand, infusing it with demonical profound energy, causing it to tremble violently and emit an eerily sharp howling, akin to the bloodthirsty screams of evil spirits and vengeful ghosts.
It seemed to chill to the soul, inducing an involuntary shudder.
Meanwhile.
The swirling demonic qi brewed to its peak in an instant.
"Slash!"
He suddenly swung the blade, unleashing a highly condensed, pitch-black demonic qi sword aura that cut towards the Water Dragon.
"Boom!"
The demonic sword aura harshly collided with the Water Dragon, sending black and white energies scattering everywhere, violently shaking the air, splitting sound waves, and forming a clear shockwave ripple in the sky.
Ancestor Ruhong’s eyes narrowed slightly, and he shouted, "Everyone be careful, this demon blade has a malicious effect that can influence the Divine Soul, don’t be caught off guard."
Upon hearing this.
Both Ancestor Mang and Ancestor Ming Sheng grew more cautious.
Ancestor Ming Sheng was the first to act, waving a hand to produce a crimson foldable fan.
"Whoosh!"
The crimson fan opened, and a surge of scorching fire qi rose swiftly.
He soared through the air with graceful ease, gently shaking the fan. If not for his worn sheepskin coat, he could have been mistaken for a scholarly sage gliding towards them.
In mere moments, Ancestor Ming Sheng ascended into the sky, and with a flick of the fan.
"Fire come!"
Suddenly.
His crimson fan ignited, its flames elegantly dancing.
The flames transformed in the blink of an eye into the shape of a firebird, vividly real, crying clearly as it spread its wings and flew rapidly towards the demon cultivator, leaving trails of fire that seemed to ignite even the air.
"Hoo!"
The Fire Crow soared above the demon cultivator, spewing flames as it dove.
The demon cultivator dodged repeatedly, then swung his blade to slice the Fire Crow into two.
"Boom!"
The explosion of the Fire Crow’s flames mixed with shock waves threw the demon cultivator into embarrassment, igniting many parts of his robes, even blowing off his hood, revealing an old, withered, unsightly face.
But Ancestor Ming Sheng had no intention of stopping, continuing to wield the fan, releasing more Fire Crows. Ultimately, five Fire Crows flew in the sky, singing as they circled the demon cultivator, spewing flames.
Having suffered once, the demon cultivator dared not explode the flames at close range and could only flee in distress, enraged.
"Good! Truly worthy of the Lu Family’s ancestral artifact, the Li Fire Fan." Ancestor Ruhong couldn’t help but praise.
[Li Fire Fan]
The Yingxiu Lu Family’s clan’s spiritual artifact, a treasure passed down from the first Ancestor of the Lu Family.
This was the profound heritage of some ancient noble families.
Despite the Lu Family currently having only one Spirit Platform Realm Ancestor, their ancestors also prospered, leaving such clan spiritual artifacts for future generations is quite normal.
If this spiritual artifact were used in the Withered Forest, it wouldn’t be surprising even to set an entire mountain ablaze.
Ancestor Mang could only smile bitterly, his eyes envious, as Ancestor Ming Sheng’s strength was comparatively weaker. Yet, with the Li Fire Fan in hand, Ancestor Mang knew he couldn’t compete.
Spiritual artifacts, oh spiritual artifacts!
At this moment, he dreamed of having a spiritual artifact.
The Gongsun Family naturally had an ancestral spiritual artifact, but with two ancestors in the family, it never came to Ancestor Mang’s turn to use it.
No spiritual artifact? So be it.
Ancestor Mang thought that his War Body was unparalleled. He could rely solely on his physical body and fists to exhibit the prestige of an ancestor.
Immediately, he roared loudly.
A faint golden light emanated from his body, and he threw himself into the battlefield, each punch and kick imbued with golden profound qi, strong and fierce, like a Vajra from the Buddhist Sect descending upon the scene.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
The demon cultivator repeatedly blocked but was continuously forced back by the punches. With a withered appearance, his physical strength was naturally inferior to Ancestor Mang with his Geng Metal War Body. In a pure contest of strength, he was hardly a match for Ancestor Mang.
Moreover, Ancestor Mang was quite talented, originally struggling at the peak of the Spirit Platform Realm’s second layer for many years.
Two to three months ago, under the careful guidance of Ancestor Longyan, Ancestor Mang’s bottleneck loosened, and after returning home, he broke through to the third layer of the Spirit Platform Realm in less than a month, greatly enhancing his cultivation and strength.
The three ancestors displayed strange techniques and profound skills, surrounding the demon cultivator and attacking jointly.
Despite the demon cultivator’s desperate counterattacks and repeated attempts to break out, he was repeatedly thwarted and found himself trapped in a bitter struggle.
If not for the three ancestors being cautious of his desperate counterattacks, taking a careful strategy to slowly exhaust him, the demon cultivator might not have lasted many rounds.
No matter how the demon cultivator screamed, pleaded for mercy, or tried to sow discord, the three ancestors remained unmoved, continuously wearing him down with their techniques.
Wang Shouzhe observed this and realized that the battle was decided; the demon cultivator would not be able to stir up any trouble.
However, what Wang Shouzhe did not anticipate was that among the ancestors, it was Ancestor Xiaohan, his sixth granduncle, who first achieved merit.
His opponent was Zhao Bojun.
Zhao Bojun’s strength was only at the mid-second layer of the Spirit Platform Realm.
Though he relied on consuming a pill similar to a Frenzy Pill, which stimulated his potential and temporarily boosted his battle power significantly, such a pill surely had terrible side effects. Moreover, during its effect, he became more irritable and difficult to control.
The successive failures of the Liu and Zhao Clans, coupled with Wang Shouzhe’s heart-piercing words, had already left him on the verge of an emotional breakdown. At this moment, his youngest grandson of the Dao generation, Zhao Daoyuan, who he had been proud of as a promising Spirit Platform Seed, was chased to him by a Tier Three Water Element Spirit Turtle, seeking his rescue, which he was powerless to provide, helplessly watching as the fierce turtle crushed him to death.
Instantly, he spiraled into madness, recklessly charging at the Spirit Turtle.
Ancestor Xiaohan seized the moment, wielding the Cosmic Palace Sword to cut Zhao Bojun in two at the waist.
"Ancestor Zhou Xuan, Ancestor Qiong Yuan, my ancestors of the Wang Family," triumphantly roared Ancestor Xiaohan to the sky, "Did you see? Shouzhe avenged you, and Xiaohan avenged you. The Cosmic Palace Sword has fulfilled its mission, quenching itself with the old thief Zhao Bojun’s blood!"
Saying this, he decapitated Zhao Bojun’s remaining half-body as it continued to crawl.
And thus!
Zhao Bojun’s eyes remained wide open, seemingly filled with resentment.
But he could do nothing even if he was resentful; with his head severed, there was no coming back to life. The sole purpose of this head was to be preserved and taken back, becoming an offering in the ancestral hall as a tribute to the forefathers.
Zhao Bojun’s death plunged the already demoralized remnants of the Liu and Zhao Clans into utter despair, leaving them without hope of survival.
Meanwhile, the disciples of the Wang Family were all making achievements, routing the remnants of the Liu and Zhao Clans completely.
"Ah~" Liu Shengye screamed miserably, "Bitch, you actually poisoned the Spirit Bees."
His eyes appeared to have been invaded by the toxin, continually bleeding tears. At the same time, the remaining hundreds of Spirit Bees attacked him, stinging him relentlessly.
Liu Shengye fell to the ground, rolling in pain and howling, his appearance unimaginably miserable.
"Hiss?"
Wang Shouzhe inhaled sharply. Earlier, he had remarked that Wang Luojing was reckless. Little did he know, she had actually poisoned the Spirit Bees. As Liu Shengye swatted down one Spirit Bee after another, the toxin dispersed, eventually blinding his eyes.
Only at the end did Wang Luojing emerge from hiding, calmly severed Liu Shengye’s tendons with a short blade and coldly said.
"Fat pig, this is what you get for daring to insult my fourth brother and oppose him."
Then, she ran to Wang Shouzhe with a sweet smile, saying, "Fourth Brother, that pig-headed Liu Shengye dared to insult you. I’ll sprinkle some honey on his wounds later and let the ants bite him to vent your anger."
What?
Even Wang Shouzhe felt a slight chill; among his younger sisters and nieces, Luojing might indeed be the scariest in the future!
This girl’s character was somewhat extreme and ruthless at her core, and she certainly needed to be taught and guided properly.
Nevertheless, whatever happens, she is Wang Shouzhe’s fifth sister. No matter what, he will always protect his sister.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 119: Great Victory! Great Harvest!
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 119: Great Victory! Great Harvest!
...
"Luojing, well done." Wang Shouzhe smiled and encouraged, patting her head, and said indulgently, "Your tactics were very ingenious and quite insightful."
"Thanks for the praise, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing smiled happily, her eyes narrowing to slits, her pretty face slightly flushed, clearly caring a lot about Fourth Brother’s praise.
"However..." Wang Shouzhe hesitated slightly.
Wang Luojing suddenly became a bit nervous: "Fourth Brother, did I do something wrong?"
"Nothing wrong," Wang Shouzhe said, "It’s just that you’re still young, so let adults handle things like tormenting the enemy."
Wang Shouzhe had no sympathy for Liu Shengye.
Under his leadership of the Liu Family, they committed numerous heinous acts, even being executed by slow slicing wouldn’t be excessive.
However, Wang Shouzhe was reluctant to let Wang Luojing do it. This fifth sister had a rather extreme and radical personality, and Wang Shouzhe feared that she might not be able to turn back if she continued down this path.
"Hmm, thanks for the concern, Fourth Brother, but Luojing can handle it too." Wang Luojing said indifferently, "That fat pig dared to insult Fourth Brother, Luojing won’t spare him."
Wang Shouzhe also knew that Wang Luojing was sensitive and unlike Wang Lici, who was carefree, so he stopped the conversation here. He planned to guide her slowly over time to gradually improve her personality.
"Luojing," Wang Shouzhe said, "from now on, come find me at early morning for training, so I can properly instruct you."
"Really? I can train profound skills with Fourth Brother?" Wang Luojing was overjoyed.
Not far away, Wang Shounuo, who was cleaning up the battlefield, watched this scene with a face full of jealousy, thinking that clearly he was Luojing’s actual eldest brother.
Why did Luojing seem closer to Shouzhe? It made it look like Shouzhe was her real brother.
Poor him, the real elder brother, almost reduced to being a live target for Luojing to experiment with various fierce insects.
Just at this moment.
Wang Lici, clad in heavy armor, sneaked past, seeming to avoid something.
"Wang Lici, stop right there." Wang Shouzhe’s face turned stern.
Wang Lici’s legs turned weak, and she turned back with a forced smile: "Fourth, Fourth Uncle! I, I didn’t do anything wrong, did I?" She thought she had carefully avoided Fourth Uncle and still got caught.
"After this autumn and winter hunt concludes. Every early morning, you will roll to my martial arts arena," Wang Shouzhe said harshly, "Otherwise, I’ll stop your spiritual food."
"Ah?" Wang Lici almost collapsed on the ground, thinking: Fourth Uncle, why be so cruel?
Alas!
Seeing her so disappointing, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but sigh.
The girls at home were all quite challenging.
One was a highly sensitive and ruthless extreme problem girl, one was a careless and brainless glutton, and the other a young girl with a firm and passionate heart on the Emperor’s Road.
He thought that with time, he would slowly discipline them, and Wang Shouzhe didn’t believe that having dealt with the Liu and Zhao clans, he wouldn’t be able to manage these three?
However, at the moment, there were still many remnants unsettled, so Wang Shouzhe couldn’t focus his attention on them.
"Sixth Grandpa, quickly go and help Ancestor Longyan kill the old thief of the Liu Family," Wang Shouzhe instructed, though he understood that with Ancestor Longyan against Liu Zhide, she already had the battle under control.
But if it’s even more secure, wouldn’t that be more comforting? He didn’t want any enemy jumping up during the garbage time of battle’s end and potentially harming his own people.
"Haha, got it, Shouzhe." At this moment, Wang Xiaohan was in high spirits, carrying the Cosmic Palace Sword to assist Ancestor Longyan.
Originally, Ancestor Longyan, given her character, would prefer to deal with Liu Zhide herself. But she also understood Shouzhe was seeking stability and concern. So, she didn’t refuse and coordinated carefully with Wang Xiaohan to prevent Liu Zhide from counterattacking, defeating him two against one to gain absolute advantage, and brutally killing him.
"Swipe!"
With the gentle hum of the Longyan Sword, Liu Zhide’s head flew off. She grabbed Liu Zhide’s head, her fragrant shoulders trembling with excitement, as if suppressing sobs.
Fifty years!
Ever since the betrayal of Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun fifty years ago, which led to the tragic deaths of her grandfather Zhou Xuan and nephew Qiong Yuan.
The Wang Family has been in decline ever since.
And she, Wang Longyan, had to drag a shattered body, endure immense pressure, and protect the Wang Family for fifty years.
The bitterness and hardship involved, perhaps no one could truly understand.
Even though the Wang Family had achieved decisive victory today, her heart still couldn’t completely settle.
Until this moment, when her delicate hand grasped Liu Zhide’s head, did she finally feel a sense of reality.
The nightmare haunting her for fifty years.
Was over!
The grudge of so many family members was finally avenged.
Wang Shouzhe walked over, took the head from her hand, and handed it to Wang Shouxin behind him.
He knew very well that his own feelings of hatred couldn’t measure up to Ancestor Longyan’s. But he could somewhat understand the feeling of not being able to fully release decades of repression.
Among many juniors, the ancestor naturally favored and trusted Wang Shouzhe the most. However, he, as a man, couldn’t just hug the ancestor for comfort. Immediately, he gestured to his few girls to act.
Then, Wang Lici, the most attentive, wearing a full set of heavy armor, clanged up, ready to act cute and roll around. After all, she was thick-skinned and best at these tricks.

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 119: Great Victory! Great Harvest!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 119: Great Victory! Great Harvest!_2
Unexpectedly, Ancestor Longyan was startled. What kind of ghostly thing was that?
She instinctively dodged aside.
Then!
Wang Lici leapt at nothing, and with a "thud," fell flat on her face.
"Ancestor, that’s Lici," Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched. Is there any hope for the intelligence of this fool? Could she take off her heavy armor before acting coy?
"Ah! Lici?" Even Ancestor Longyan’s eyes flickered a bit.
"Ancestor."
Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu both took the opportunity to snuggle into Ancestor Longyan’s arms, and even the older Wang Luotong came over to cuddle Ancestor Longyan’s arm.
The group of energetic young juniors naturally allowed Ancestor Longyan’s emotions to be swiftly released. After all, the children represent the family’s future and hope, symbolizing the rising sun.
With the fall of Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun, the remaining forces of the Liu and Zhao clans naturally had no power to resist and were all slaughtered on the spot.
As Shouzhe had said before, not one of the Liu and Zhao clans attending today will survive.
Even Liu Shengye, Wang Shouzhe did not torment him meaninglessly, but ordered a Household General to dispatch him with one blow.
Torturing the enemy, making them die in agony, is merely a way to vent emotions.
Afterward, it was a matter of cleaning the battlefield and dealing with the last two enemy reinforcements.
The Demon Cultivator needs no elaboration.
With a steady consumption tactic from the three Ancestors, the Demon Cultivator was near collapse. Just to avoid any desperate counter-attacks, the three Ancestors fought very conservatively.
Until Ancestor Longyan, after a slight adjustment, joined the battlefield.
In a four-against-one scenario, the once formidable Demon Cultivator was slain on the spot in desperation and despair, unable even to wound one opponent, let alone take someone down with him.
This is the advantage of many against few—it can bully you into doubting your own life.
Furthermore, each Ancestor is a long-lived wise man, very cautious about preserving life. When holding an absolute advantage, why easily give him the chance to drag someone down?
Once the enemy was desperate, they immediately adopted a defensive stance and retreated, while allies would actively support each other.
This crafty old fox strategy truly disgusted the enemy to the extreme.
But when the enemy is disgusted, that’s when we are happy.
To prevent that Demon Cultivator from playing dead, as advised by Wang Shouzhe, his head and limbs had to be severed. Then, after carefully collecting the spoils, Ancestor Ming Sheng burned his body to ashes.
This is no exaggeration.
