It stems from the respect and caution for the various strange methods of Demon Cultivators—who knows what peculiar Secret Techniques they might have?
After dealing with the Demon Cultivator.
Only Ancestor Liang Haofeng of Westpeace Liang Family remained, holding on hard, facing Zhong Xingwang whose combat experience wasn’t particularly strong, but after all, he was a disciple of the Celestial Human Family and once a student of Purple Mansion Academy.
Ultimately, he had seen much and knew many methods.
Liang Haofeng remained at a disadvantage, being suppressed and attacked, and he even suspected that this Zhong Xingwang was insane.
Clearly, everyone was just here to lend support, yet he seemed excited, like he had taken stimulants, fighting as if avenging a father, constantly trying to trade injury for injury.
This made Liang Haofeng almost cry in grievance, deeply regretting getting involved in such a messy situation. Why did he end up crossing paths with such an unreasonable old Zhong fool? What’s the benefit of getting hurt?
"I surrender, Clan Leader Wang, I surrender," after repeatedly failing to escape, Liang Haofeng could only shout out, "I am willing to swear, I am willing to pay ransom."
Actually, he had no choice but to surrender.
Ancestor Longyan and Ancestor Xiaohan of the Wang Family had surrounded him. The other ancestors also eyed him with hostility.
"Brother Zhong, you’ve worked hard, for now, stop your hand," Wang Shouzhe said.
"Don’t mind me, Shouzhe, watch your brother beat him to death," Zhong Xingwang was still in high spirits, wanting to show off in front of Senior Sister Longyan.
Ancestor Longyan raised an eyebrow slightly, angrily saying, "Shouzhe said to stop, didn’t you hear?"
Zhong Xingwang shivered all over, hurriedly stopped and withdrew to Wang Shouzhe’s side, chuckling awkwardly, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, forgive me, it’s been a long time since I fought, and my hands got itchy." He secretly glanced at Ancestor Longyan’s reaction after speaking.
Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and said, "Brother Zhong, for hosting justice in the clan war for my Wang family, I am already deeply grateful, how could I blame you?"
After speaking, Wang Shouzhe turned his attention to Liang Haofeng, frowning slightly.
Seeing his expression, Liang Haofeng panicked, casting a pleading glance at Ancestor Ming Sheng.
Ancestor Ming Sheng sighed and said, "Ancestor Haofeng, why did you do this? Knowing well that the Liu and Zhao clans were already a mess."
"Alas, I have nothing to argue now," Liang Haofeng smiled bitterly, "The Spirit Platform Seed in my family is about to breach the Spirit Platform Realm, but the resources accumulated by the clan are insufficient. Ah, I made a foolish decision."
Then, Ancestor Ming Sheng turned to Wang Shouzhe and said, "Shouzhe, since you called to stop, you must be hesitating whether to take Liang Haofeng’s life. But this Liang Haofeng has cooperated with me several times in the past, and we have some acquaintance. I shamelessly ask Shouzhe a favor, let him pay his life with money."
Wang Shouzhe quickly cupped his hands and saluted, "Ancestor, please do not make Shouzhe feel unworthy of your nativity. Even if you did not speak, Shouzhe intended the same."
"However, we cannot let him off lightly. He must write several confessions of guilt for us Ancestors to keep. If he dares to seek revenge or leak today’s events, we will ensure the Westpeace Liang Family pays the price," Ancestor Mang added on the side.
"Alright," Wang Shouzhe nodded, "In that case, Ancestor Haofeng, please hand over the reward. These are the funds obtained by the Liu and Zhao clans as collateral to Qiaan’s Trading Company." Wang Shouzhe said, "Shouzhe must redeem Ping’an Town industries from the Qiaan Family."
In fact.
As soon as the Liu and Zhao clans mortgaged their industries to Qiaan’s Trading Company, Wang Shouzhe had received information from Qiaan Xue’an and had a general grasp of the Liu and Zhao clans’ cards.
"Of course, naturally," Liang Haofeng honestly took out a stack of Gold Notes, "I only received the reward after entering the Outer Domain, it’s three thousand Qian Gold. After it’s done, there would be two thousand more."
"Five thousand Qian Gold?" Wang Shouzhe sneered, "Quite a huge sum from the Liu and Zhao clans, much more generous than me."
"Shouzhe, you can’t say it like that," Ancestor Mang defended, "It’s clear to everyone that the Liu and Zhao clans were doomed. They must have begged everywhere for help, and only by using heavy gold could they tempt the cash-strapped Liang Haofeng to take such a risk. They were fighting desperately for survival, whereas we were just collecting money for free. The significance is different."
"Indeed, indeed, Shouzhe, don’t confuse the two," Ancestor Ming Sheng and Ancestor Ruhong also laughed as they persuaded.
"Shouzhe, these are the Gold Notes found on Liu Shengye and Zhao Jinxian," Wang Shouxin also brought a stack of Gold Notes, totaling seven thousand Qian Gold.
Meanwhile, Wang Xiaohan also presented Qian Gold found on the Demon Cultivator, "Shouzhe, this Li-named Demon Cultivator has over seven thousand Qian Gold, five thousand of which is reward money."
"Dear Ancestors, the reward money is a pawn for Ping’an’s industries, so Shouzhe unashamedly takes it," Wang Shouzhe smiled.
"Shouzhe, this time we merely came to lend support, and having already taken the reward, theoretically, the spoils belong to your Wang family." Although the three Ancestors were tempted by the substantial wealth, they adhered to the rules.
They were, after all, the hired side—how could they take both the reward and the spoils? They never dreamed there would be so much to gain, naturally making them a bit restless.
"The three Ancestors jest," Wang Shouzhe said, "The Demon Cultivator was killed by everyone’s joint effort. The most valuable thing on him is that magic blade. Brother Zhong, could you appraise it?"
"That’s my forte," Zhong Xingwang, as a Black Market Steward who usually specializes in appraisals, immediately showcased his skills, "This magic blade is slightly damaged and needs some repair. If the Black Market were to purchase it, the price would be around twenty-five thousand Qian Gold. Selling it after repairing would take some time, reaching between twenty-eight to twenty-nine thousand Qian Gold. The rest of the miscellaneous little items are worth three to four thousand Qian Gold."
Though expectations were set, the total spoils being several tens of thousands of Qian Gold made everyone breathless.
They just heard Shouzhe suggesting that he intended to share with everyone.
Immediately, the three Ancestors looked at Wang Shouzhe as if they were gazing at the God of Wealth.
It seemed with just a call from Wang Shouzhe saying, let’s attack someone.
The three Ancestors would inevitably rush forward without hesitation.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 120: Return! The End of the Autumn and Winter Hunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 120: Return! The End of the Autumn and Winter Hunt
...
"Clan Leader Wang, let’s allocate this Demon Blade and those miscellaneous items to you three," Wang Shouzhe said, cupping his hands. "Please, don’t decline. The Wang Family’s fortunes changed today without any loss of personnel but yielded great gains, thanks to the awe-inspiring presence of you three Ancestors."
Ancestor Ruhong and the others exchanged glances, feeling that Shouzhe certainly knows how to deal with people.
Next, Ancestor Ruhong from the Chen Family spoke up: "Since Shouzhe cares for our allied families, we shall not decline. However, the spoils from the demon cultivator should be divided into four, with each of our four families receiving a share."
Just as Wang Shouzhe was about to speak.
Ancestor Mang said, "Enough, Shouzhe, don’t say any more. This matter benefits our three families, and if your Wang Family doesn’t take a share, we can’t show our faces."
Ancestor Ming Sheng also chimed in agreement.
"In that case, we will transfer the Wang Family’s share to Brother Zhong," Wang Shouzhe decided after a brief moment of thought.
Being the Clan Leader and the responsible commander of this campaign, he naturally decides on post-war matters, including the distribution of spoils.
Zhong Xingwang was stunned and hurriedly declined: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I don’t need it. I was just here to lend a hand."
"You must take it," Wang Shouzhe stated seriously. "None of this ’not taking’ business will work, lest you seem overly close to the Wang Family or overly sentimental, causing the other ancestors who received spoils discomfiture."
"There must be clear, unambiguous sharing of spoils and interests. What is owed must be taken without shying away."
So many families and allies have become estranged and finally broken apart due to spoils disputes, thus this matter must be handled clearly and plainly.
Ancestor Longyan cast a disdainful glance at Zhong Xingwang: "Since Shouzhe wants you to take it, just take it. Why all this coyness?"
"Yes, yes, the senior sister is correct, Younger Brother Shouzhe is correct," Zhong Xingwang cowed, hurriedly cupping his hands to Wang Shouzhe. "I will listen to you."
With that, the three Ancestors, including Ruhong, finally sighed in relief.
As Shouzhe said, if Zhong Xingwang didn’t want his share, how could they show their faces?
Besides, they were not like Zhong Xingwang, who lived without want— they had children and grandchildren, a whole family to support.
"Hiring an Artifact Refining Master for repairs is expected to cost one thousand to one thousand five hundred Qian Gold. If consigned for sale, since this is a demon artifact that’s hard to sell, getting it sold within one or two years would be fortunate." Zhong Xingwang, who has long overseen the black market, is exceptionally clear on pricing and market demand.
The three Ancestors hesitated before deciding to repair and consign it, given the price difference of at least two to three thousand Qian Gold. Split four ways, each could still claim several hundred Qian Gold.
This is a substantial sum for a Ninth-Grade Noble Family; never mind a year, they could easily wait two years.
Take the weakest Yingxiu Lu Family, for instance. After deducting the family’s considerable expenses, storing up five to six hundred Qian Gold in a year is commendable.
The other two families, though wealthier, face even greater expenditure.
Overall, for any Ninth-Grade, let alone Eighth-Grade family, several hundred Qian Gold is not a trifling sum.
Once settled.
The Ancestors even warmed to Zhong Xingwang, as they had shared the spoils as allies.
Everyone’s expression was filled with joy, completely content with the expedition, especially with Wang Shouzhe. Not only was his command precise and the battle magnificently fought, but he also handled the spoil distribution meticulously and thoughtfully.
On the side, Chen Fangjie was equally filled with admiration; Shouzhe’s techniques indeed left him in awe. Even the ancestors were managed by him effortlessly.
However, the ancestors’ reactions were quite exaggerated. Was it worth grinning so widely over each earning eight to nine thousand Qian Gold? Surely this lacks ancestral dignity.
If they knew Shouzhe secured two Celestial Spirit Pills and accompanying materials recently, they’d be wide-eyed with shock?
Of course, he dared not disclose this, needing to maintain strict secrecy, even before his own Ding Ancestor. Otherwise, if word reached Shouzhe, he’d likely have the stuffing knocked out of him.
Unknowingly, Chen Fangjie, the future brother-in-law, was filled with reverence for Wang Shouzhe, the future brother-in-law. His actions were so grand; even the ancestors listened to his direction.
Apart from Chen Fangjie, Liang Haofeng from the Westpeace Liang Family was likewise astonished. This new clan leader, Wang Shouzhe, is far more formidable than the rumors suggest. Several ancestors seemed to yield to his opinion at every turn.
Besides this, the lively profit distribution scene among Ancestor Ruhong and others also captivated Liang Haofeng, who was but a prisoner facing slaughter at any time.
Such are the consequences of taking the wrong side.
Had he known earlier about Wang Shouzhe’s prowess, he’d never have dared enter this turbulent water.
"Ancestor Haofeng," upon completing some spoil allocations, Wang Shouzhe finally turned his attention to Liang Haofeng, greeting politely with a cupped hand, "Would it not be proper for you to consider the cost you’ll pay to preserve your life?"
"Clan Leader Wang, please," Liang Haofeng’s heart was filled with anguish, and he dared not assume airs, adopting a humble posture, "indeed I, Liang Haofeng, was blinded by foolishness, and having erred, I must bear punishment. But our Liang Family is merely a Ninth-Grade Lower-Rank Noble Family, with limited assets."

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 120: Return! Autumn and Winter Hunt Ends_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 120: Return! Autumn and Winter Hunt Ends_2
"Ancestor Haofeng, you’re too modest. Aren’t we all in the Ninth Grade Lower Stream?" Wang Shouzhe sneered with a faint smile, "It’s not easy for any family to survive."
"In that case, we have a large courtyard in the Changning Guard, along with five bustling street shops, totaling a value of over ten thousand Qian Gold." Liang Haofeng, knowing that Wang Shouzhe was not easy to deceive, gritted his teeth and said ruefully, "All transferred to the Wang Family."
His heart bled. Liang Family’s ancestors had painstakingly accumulated some family assets over generations, and this time their plan backfired, causing great losses instead.
"Hehe~ Ten thousand Qian Gold in assets?" Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned serious, "Ancestor Haofeng, do you take the Wang Family for a beggar to be dismissed so easily?"
"Huh?" Liang Haofeng did not expect Wang Shouzhe to have such a large appetite. In his eyes, assets worth over ten thousand Qian Gold were mere trifles? His face flushed red, realizing that he would have to make a painful decision today, he resolutely said, "We, the Liang Family, bought an early estate in the outskirts of Changning Guard, with over two thousand acres of orchards and a small lake. But as you know, estates near Changning Guard are long-term investments, betting on a rising future. Therefore, the annual actual output is quite low, currently valued at ten thousand."
The Wang Family once had industries in Changning Guard City, as well as many properties outside the city. But for the family’s survival, and when Ancestor Xiaohan attempted to reach the Spirit Platform Realm, they sold them all.
Changning Guard City and its surrounding areas are the core of the Changning Region. The prices and output ratios of industries there are usually high price and low yield.
However, the core area has potential for development and is safer, so many families are willing to invest in the long term.
"Twenty thousand?" Wang Shouzhe hesitated slightly, "This price is somewhat sincere. However, Ancestor Haofeng, you are the only ancestor in your family, right? If you fall here and there is no Spirit Platform successor in your family..."
At these words, Liang Haofeng’s brow twitched with anger: "Clan Leader Wang, you’re too greedy. If you keep pressing, you might as well kill me, Liang Haofeng. If I sell the family assets, my grandson will have enough resources to attempt the Spirit Platform. You should show some reasoning, shouldn’t you?"
"Greedy? Reasoning." Wang Shouzhe sneered coldly, "Today, if it weren’t for my capability, the Wang Family would have been annihilated by you. Where would I seek justice for the Wang Family then? Don’t say I’m now giving you a chance to save your life and leave your family some opportunity. You participated in the action against the Wang Family’s extermination; it would be entirely justifiable for me to destroy your entire family! Liang Haofeng, don’t fail to seize the opportunity I give you."
Extermination!
Lian Haofeng shivered all over, fear flickering in his eyes. Would Wang Shouzhe actually do it? If he were provoked, it was likely he could, and he had the ability to do it.
Beside them, Ancestor Mingsheng also chimed in support: "Shouzhe’s words are true. You were part of the action to exterminate a family. Since you failed, you must bear the consequences."
Simultaneously, Ancestor Mang and Ancestor Ruhong also expressed their stance, insisting they wouldn’t stand idly by if Shouzhe wanted to justifiably retaliate against the Liang Family.
Under such circumstances, Liang Haofeng immediately cowered, smiling bitterly at Wang Shouzhe: "Clan Leader Wang, name your price. I hope you show my Liang Family a way out."
He understood that if he died here, even if Wang Shouzhe only made the slightest move against the Liang Family without a Spirit Platform Ancestor, the Liang Family would most likely be done for.
"Forty thousand!" Wang Shouzhe maintained his calm demeanor, "Isn’t your Liang Family a bit short of funds to purchase the Celestial Spirit Pill? It indicates you’re adept at management, with a considerable amount of savings. Liang Haofeng, don’t sulk; consider it as if your family’s Spirit Platform Seed failed in its breakthrough attempt."
Forty thousand!
Liang Haofeng, nearly collapsing, spat out a mouthful of blood; Wang Shouzhe’s demands were ruthless!
Even Ancestors like Ruhong couldn’t help but twitch their eyelids; Shouzhe’s ruthlessness was truly terrifying. This forty thousand in compensation really strained the Westpeace Liang Family.
But it was also justified; if the Liu and Zhao Clans had succeeded, the Wang Family would have suffered a great disaster.
No wonder Shouzhe was determined to cripple the Liang Family.
After a long time.
Liang Haofeng, as if drained of his Essence, Qi, and Spirit, seemed to age more than a decade, lamenting, "I accept the defeat in this matter."
Then came a series of contractual issues.
With Wang Shouzhe’s skills in contract matters, and the witnessing of the three Ancestors, there wasn’t a flaw to be found in any of the contracts, be it for the transfer of family assets or debt contracts.
Once the matter was settled.
The three Ancestors, including Ruhong, looked at Wang Shouzhe with new eyes. This young man, not only adept at winning hearts, was also ruthless to his enemies; he truly had limitless prospects!
Forty thousand Qian Gold in compensation!
How many years must a Ninth-Grade Race laboriously save to amass such fortune?
They also coveted this money, but knew it was Wang Family’s life-or-death gamble that earned it, so they had no intention of touching it.
"Three Ancestors, although matters here are settled." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and said, "I still feel that among our bloodline families, we should deepen our cooperation."
Deepen cooperation?
The three Ancestors, including Ruhong, fell into deep thought.
"Shouzhe means that we should share both glory and loss?" Ancestor Ruhong asked in confusion.
"That’s just one aspect. After all, our families’ foundations are too shallow compared to the Celestial Human Families." Wang Shouzhe advised, "If we can unite more closely, we can accomplish more and reap more benefits."

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 120: Return! Autumn and Winter Hunt Ends_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 120: Return! Autumn and Winter Hunt Ends_3
Ancestor Mang pondered, "Shouzhe’s idea is very good. From what I know, the closer it gets to the Guardian Cities of Longzuo County, the more united the families become. The reason is twofold. First, the history of those Guardian Cities is even longer, and the relationships between the families are more intimate. Secondly, among some families by marriage, there must be someone who can act as a central figure to reconcile all contradictions. Just looking at this second point, Shouzhe seems very qualified."
Ancestor Mingsheng said, "Ancestor Mang missed a point. All families inevitably have their own interests and are unwilling to let their clan industries leak out. For the families to unite, there must be a common industry and a mutual benefit sharing. Otherwise, what is called a deep alliance is merely an illusion, shattering at the slightest touch."
Ancestor Ruhong pondered slightly and said, "Both of you Ancestors are right, but Shouzhe’s consideration is also correct. After this, we should sit down and have a good discussion. Let’s retreat for now, so we don’t delay Shouzhe and their continued autumn-winter hunt."
"In that case, Shouzhe will not see off the distinguished Ancestors." Wang Shouzhe smilingly cupped his hands in a fist.
After the three ancestors escorted Liang Haofeng away.
The Wang Race still stayed in the camp for an extra day. The cleaning of the battlefield, the categorization of the spoils, the burning of bodies, all these follow-up tasks were very tedious.
However, despite the Wang Family members’ hard work, they were all very excited and even held a small celebration at night.
Afterwards, they embarked on the true journey of the autumn-winter hunt.
Time passed quickly.
Another more than half a month went by.
Ping’an Town had entered early winter.
A few days ago, a light first snow fell, making the weather much colder all of a sudden.
Zhouxuan Pass.
This time of year was always the most lively period.
Apart from some Black Tortoise Clans who would choose to go outside Zhouxuan Pass for the autumn-winter hunt, there were also many loose cultivators who traveled from afar, pooling money to buy supplies, and venturing into the Outer Domain together.
Some loose cultivators would never return.
Yet some would reap considerable gains, enough to cultivate peacefully for one or two years. Some exceptionally lucky loose cultivators would become wealthy enough to not need to leave home for ten years.
Thus, within the Weng City of Zhouxuan Pass, many traveling merchants and representatives of some commercial firms would gather.
They came to purchase the outputs from the Outer Domain, anything worth some money, like spiritual medicines, fierce beast flesh, ores, high-tier fierce beast spirit bones, fur, spirit wood, and so on!
Some loose cultivators, when returning fully loaded, would choose to sell part of their miscellaneous items, both to lighten the load and to facilitate distribution.
However, the Black Tortoise Clans mostly had their own channels for handling such items and would rarely sell to traveling merchants at low prices.
On the city wall.
A pair of young girls and boys were straining their eyes, gazing toward the Outer Domain.
The girl’s lips pursed, "Brother Shouzhe is really something, saying he’d be back in half a month; it’s been almost twenty days now! Not even a shadow in sight."
The girl, with bright eyes and white teeth, and a tall, graceful figure, was a rare young beauty. She was Liu Ruolei, Wang Shouzhe’s future sister-in-law.
"Ruolei," another slightly older youth said, "Brother Shouzhe must have been delayed for a couple of days. Don’t worry, we must trust him." This youth was none other than Liu Yuanrui, Wang Shouzhe’s future brother-in-law.
Before Wang Shouzhe left, he naturally couldn’t ignore the main residence.
With his tendency to overestimate his enemies, he was naturally worried that his home base might be raided in his absence. Therefore, he contacted Liu Yuanrui and Ruolei, and through them, invited the Liua Family’s third Ancestor—Ancestor Zhi Sheng to come and oversee.
Ancestor Zhi Sheng had deep ties with the Wang Race; his grandmother was none other than the Wang Race’s legitimate daughter, Wang Zhuwei.
Therefore, Ancestor Zhi Sheng almost didn’t hesitate and agreed to the matter.
Just when Liu Ruolei and Liu Yuanrui had been standing guard for half a day without seeing Wang Shouzhe.
Two more groups of youngsters came up the city wall. They were the youngest generation from the Liu and Zhao Clans, also coming to Zhouxuan Pass every day to wait for their family.
Leading them was Liu Yonghao, who once had his ribs broken by Wang Luqiu, and the naive Zhao Dingteng.
Although Liu Yonghao didn’t dare to directly provoke Liu Ruolei and the others, he still couldn’t help but mutter nonsense to himself. Saying how the Wang Race must be doomed this time, possibly ending up in a fierce beast’s stomach.
Despite his words, those young men and women were equally full of worry.
The dangers of the Outer Domain, no one could guarantee that their clan elders who went out would return safely.
Just as Liu Ruolei was sulking, preparing to argue.
Suddenly!
A Liu clan youth shouted, "A convoy, there’s a convoy. Seventeen or eighteen horse-drawn carriages, such a big team, it must be our Liu and Zhao Clans returning."
"It must be our Liu and Zhao convoy. I heard the Wang Race only sent out ten carriages."
"Oh no." Liu Ruolei’s heart tightened. She vaguely heard Ancestor Zhi Sheng hint that the Wang Race and the Liu Zhao Clans would likely resolve some conflicts during this autumn-winter hunt.
If the Liu Zhao Clans returned fully loaded, wouldn’t that mean Brother Shouzhe and the others...?
Some traveling merchants, garrison soldiers, representatives of the Shang Family, and various others, upon hearing of a large convoy returning, all ran up the city wall to see the excitement.
A convoy of such a scale must belong to a clan.
This time, only six or seven Black Tortoise Clans had left Zhouxuan Pass. Among them, three had already returned.
The convoy slowly approached.
An experienced garrison soldier said, "It’s most likely the Liu and Zhao Clans’ convoy. They took fourteen carriages out, probably picked up three on the way. Eh, the carriage at the forefront seems to have a huge python head on top of the carriage box."
"Goodness! What a big python head, with horns growing on top. Could it be about to transform into a Jiao?"
"Not quite transforming into a Jiao," someone said, "but judging from the python head, it’s likely a Mountain-Swallowing Python at the peak of Tier Three."
"Hahaha!" Liu Yonghao laughed heartily, brimming with confidence, "This must be the Mountain-Swallowing Python we Liu Clan hunted."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 121: Feast! Returning Fully Loaded with Prey (Requesting Recommendation Votes and Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 121: Feast! Returning Fully Loaded with Prey (Requesting Recommendation Votes and Monthly Votes)
...
As soon as these words were spoken, all eyes focused on Liu Yonghao, filled with skepticism and envy.
"Liu Yonghao, what makes you think this Mountain-Swallowing Python was hunted by your family?" Liua Ruolei criticized angrily, "From such a distance, can you really recognize your own people?"
"Miss Ruolei has a point." Some traveling merchants chimed in, "The distance is too great; only by comparing the snake head with the carriage can we barely tell it’s the head of the Mountain-Swallowing Python. What basis do you have to assert it was slain by the Liu Family?"
These words naturally sparked a slew of gossip, ridiculing Liu Yonghao’s boastful claims.
Though Liu Yonghao is the legitimate son of the Liu Family, his reputation is poor due to being soundly defeated by an eleven-year-old girl at the Wang Family’s doorstep a few months ago!
"You know nothing." Liu Yonghao shouted in anger, face flushed, "Even at a distance, you can see two horizontal rods sticking out of the carriage top. These were modifications made by my father himself to the carriage, specifically to carry more goods. This is something no other family has done before."
Upon hearing this, those with keen eyesight indeed spotted the horizontal bars on the carriage and exclaimed in surprise: "Just as Young Master Liu said, it must be the Liu Family’s carriage."
"Haha!"
The youths of the Liu and Zhao Clans cheered loudly, as their families were often close allies or, in their words, "intertwined branches."
Since the leading carriage belonged to the Liu Family.
Such a large caravan was surely a joint convoy of the Liu and Zhao Clans.
They had waited so long, finally seeing their family caravan return.
"Young Master Liu, your family is going to prosper." Some well-traveled merchants began to flatter, "The head alone of that Peak Tier Three Mountain-Swallowing Python is worth a fortune."
The flesh and blood of a Tier Three Fierce Beast are very expensive, often fetching around a pound per Qian Gold. Moreover, most Tier Three Fierce Beasts are quite large, sometimes weighing thousands of pounds or more.
The Mountain-Swallowing Python ranks among the longer and heavier Fierce Beasts.
A Peak Tier Three Heaven-Devouring Python could weigh at least five or six thousand pounds, with its price higher than ordinary Tier Three.
Besides the flesh, many materials from the Mountain-Swallowing Python are quite valuable, such as the giant python gallbladder, which makes excellent material for Tier Three Pills, and python skin, ideal for crafting premium Leather Armor.
Apart from flesh, the most expensive might be the horn, inadequate for crafting Spiritual Artifacts but usable for manufacturing some Divine Weapons fit for the Qi Refining Realm.
Though not quite Spiritual Artifact-level, tools effective for the Qi Refining Realm are often called Little Spirit Treasures. Wang Shouzhe’s Concealing Breath Jade Pendant is considered a rather ordinary Little Spirit Treasure.
Thus, a Peak Tier Three Mountain-Swallowing Python could be worth tens of thousands of Qian Gold.
It sounds very valuable.
Yet ordinary Ancestors facing such a Fierce Python would be lucky merely to escape alive, let alone hunt it.
A string of flatteries engulfed Liu Yonghao, as the traveling merchants sought to curry favor, hoping for discounts on what might be considered leftovers.
Strange?
Liu Yonghao relished this praise yet felt something amiss. As Young Clan Leader, he knew his father’s mission in the Outer Domain was mainly aimed at the Wang Family, not hunting.
Could it be that things went too smoothly, and the Ancestors and their allies got carried away, bagging extra prey for additional profit?
The more he pondered, the more plausible it seemed, filling Liu Yonghao with excitement and unease.
The excitement among the young of the Liu and Zhao Clans grew.
Liua Ruolei grew more worried, her face pale.
"Ruolei, everything’s fine." Liua Yuanrui comforted, "Brother Shouzhe is a fortunate man, probably just delayed on the road."
Meanwhile.
People gathered increasingly on the city wall, drawn by the news for the spectacle.
Meanwhile.
Another carriage arrived within Weng City, from which emerged Gongsun Hui, Wang Luoyi, and Wang Luomiao of the Wang Family.
They had been coming daily to see if they could meet Wang Shouzhe and his party. Upon leaving their car, they heard the bustling discussions and headed swiftly to the city wall.
"Lady Gongsun, Luoyi, Miaomiao," Liua Ruolei greeted with a troubled expression, "They say it’s the caravan of the Liu and Zhao Clans."
"Ruolei, trust in Shouzhe." Gongsun Hui, familiar with the family’s affairs and Shouzhe’s capabilities, expressed calm assurance.
"It’s snowing, it’s snowing."
Someone called out.
Sure enough, the sky was starting to fill with specks of snow, which fluttered as the wind blew, obscuring the view, making the caravan’s shape more indistinct.
The faces of those from the Wang Family grew serious.
This snow seemed heavy; if Shouzhe and the others were further delayed, they might face complications from a snow-blocked route.
In contrast, pride swelled among the youths of the Liu and Zhao Clans, giving rise to various rumors and gossip.
Suddenly!
Someone shouted: "The Garrison Commander is coming for inspection."
Lei Yangqiu, the Garrison Commander!?
He was a prominent figure in Ping’an Town, a prestigious member of the Celestial Human Family, far above the young of the Liu and Zhao Clans in status.

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 121: Feast! Returning Fully Loaded with Prey (Requesting Recommendation Votes and Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 121: Feast! Returning Fully Loaded with Prey (Requesting Recommendation Votes and Monthly Votes)_2
He ascended the city wall with a majestic stride, and the surroundings instantly fell silent. All eyes were on Lei Yangqiu, who was surrounded by a group of soldiers, with awe and reverence.
Lei Yangqiu held the responsibility of guarding and pacifying the region, and Zhouxuan Pass was his jurisdiction, the most crucial line of defense.
"Lady Gongsun." As soon as Lei Yangqiu saw Gongsun Hui, he stepped forward to greet her with a cupped fist salute, while also smiling and waving to Luoyi, Luomiao, Ruolei, and others.
Gongsun Hui quickly led the younger generation in returning the salute.
Everyone was waiting on the city wall for the convoy to approach. After a while, the convoy finally arrived outside the city gate. The wind and snow were intensifying, making it hard to see clearly, but it seemed that many of the carriages in the large convoy were carrying prey. Judging from their shapes and auras, most of them appeared to be fierce beasts.
It seemed to proclaim the hunter’s triumphant return.
There was naturally a batch of knights in the convoy, but in the windy and snowy weather, everyone covered their necks and most of their faces with scarves.
"Alright." Liu Yonghao quietly accepted a bribe from a representative of the Shang Family without showing any hint, and said, "I’ll take you to see my father, but I can’t guarantee success."
"Haha, as long as Young Clan Leader Liu makes the introductions, that’s enough." The merchant representative laughed.
The other merchant representatives and traveling merchants also crowded forward, trying to find ways to connect with Liu Yonghao. Judging from some of the spoils revealed by the convoy, it seemed the Liu Family was going to prosper this time.
"The Ping’an Wang Family’s autumn and winter hunting team has returned. Request the city gate official to lower the drawbridge and open the city gate." In the convoy, a knight rode forward and said loudly.
"The Wang Family?"
The lively atmosphere on the scene seemed to suddenly freeze.
Earlier, Liu Yonghao had spoken with certainty, making everyone believe that this was the convoy of the Liu and Zhao Clans. How did the Ping’an Wang Family suddenly appear?
The city gate official was also confused and shouted, "Aren’t you the Liu Family convoy? Why are you saying it’s the Wang Family?"
"What nonsense?" The knight outside the city gate removed the scarf covering his face, revealing the dignified face of a middle-aged man, "I am Wang Ding Race of the Ping’an Wang Family. Quickly lower the drawbridge and open the city gate."
Wang Ding Race!
He was the Deputy Garrison Commander of Ping’an Town, a position of considerable prestige. Many city guards and the city gate official recognized him.
"Indeed, it’s Lord Vice Guardian Envoy Wang."
"Quickly open the city gate! Open the city gate!"
As the winch creaked, the city gate slowly opened, and the drawbridge gradually lowered, spanning the moat.
"It’s Third Uncle, it really is Third Uncle." Wang Luoyi grabbed Liu Ruolei’s hand excitedly and said, "Ruolei, they got it wrong, this is our Wang Family’s convoy."
Liu Ruolei’s delicate face blushed slightly as she secretly spat, not admitting she belonged to the Wang Family, although her expression remained excited and joyful: "What about Brother Shouzhe? They’re all wrapped up tightly, so we can’t tell who’s who."
"Look, that’s Brother, the one riding the black horse." Wang Luomiao climbed onto her mother’s body, pointing at a knight, "I recognize that horse, it’s called Black Wind, such a terrible name."
"Liu Yonghao, didn’t you say this was the Liu Family convoy?"
"Yes, you said it with such certainty, we all believed you."
"Impossible... impossible!" Liu Yonghao’s expression froze, his eyes dazed and incredulous, "How can it be the Wang Family? Those carriages, so many of them, clearly belong to our Liu Family. Did they return together or something?"
This suggestion quickly quieted everyone around them, as it wasn’t an impossible possibility.
As the city gate opened, the city gate official called out, "Vice Guardian Envoy Wang, did the Liu and Zhao Clans join your Wang Family in forming a convoy?"
"Impossible." Wang Ding Race said loudly, "We have never gotten along with the Liu and Zhao Clans. We naturally travel separately."
As soon as he said this.
The city wall erupted in an uproar.
Especially the traveling merchants and merchant representatives, who all surrounded Liu Yonghao, questioning his claims. This was clearly the Wang Family convoy, but he insisted it was the Liu Family convoy. What was his motive, was he trying to swindle them?
"Impossible, impossible." Liu Yonghao rushed to the battlements, shouting, "Those carriages are clearly our Liu Family carriages. Look, the carriages bear our Liu Family’s mark. Wang Ding Race, why are our Liu Family carriages in your convoy?"
This indeed drew a lot of attention, as the Liu Family’s mark was quite obvious.
For a moment, everyone was engaged in spirited discussion.
"Hmph! What’s so strange about this," Wang Ding Race said loudly, "On our journey, we came across abandoned carriages at a camp and decided to use them. In the Outer Domain, such occurrences are quite common."
This was true as well.
The Outer Domain was treacherous, and anything could happen.
Some teams hunting fierce beasts ended up being hunted by the beasts themselves. It’s not unusual for leftover supplies to be picked up by other teams, such situations have happened countless times.
"You’re lying, you clearly stole our Liu Family’s carriages, stole our prey." Liu Yonghao yelled in a mix of anger and despair.
Just as Wang Ding Race was about to speak again.
Wang Shouzhe drove his horse forward and said calmly, "Third Uncle, there’s no point arguing with a child, let’s proceed into the pass."
Wang Ding Race laughed heartily, "Shouzhe is right." Immediately, he waved his hand and said, "The Clan Leader has issued the order, move into the pass."
"Move into the pass!"
With the command given.
The large convoy once again began to move slowly, with the leading carriage first crossing the drawbridge, followed by the rest entering the city gate, the passageway, and then into Weng City. One carriage after another followed suit.
At this moment.
Everyone finally believed that this was not a convoy of the Liu and Zhao Clans, as there wasn’t a single person from either clan present.
The traveling merchants and merchant representatives were furious. They surrounded Liu Yonghao and demanded their bribes back.
Then, they swarmed over to Wang Luoyi and Gongsun Hui’s side.
"Lady Gongsun, do you remember me? I’m Little Liuzi from Li’s Shop."
"Miss Luoyi, this rouge from Celestial South County perfectly complements your noble aura and stunning beauty."
"Miss Luomiao, just a little trinket as a token of respect, could you please introduce me to your brother?"
Still young at only eight, Wang Luomiao’s eyes widened, realizing there were such maneuvers? So even I, Miss Luomiao, have become someone of importance?
She happily accepted all the bribes, laughing so hard her small mouth couldn’t close, revealing a few gaps where her baby teeth had fallen out.
"Miaomiao, you can’t accept people’s things." Gongsun Hui said sternly, "This will put your brother in a difficult position, return them all."
"Ugh~" Poor Wang Luomiao, she hadn’t even had time to warm the gifts, but she had to return them all one by one.
Though Gongsun Hui usually had a gentle temperament, she was strict when it came to discipline. Young as she was, Wang Luomiao had already received many spankings.
"Look, look, in that carriage, there’s a big tiger head with a white forehead and a golden body." The crowd moved towards Weng City as someone called out, "Isn’t that an adult Tier Three Tiger-like Ferocious Beast — a White-forehead Golden Tiger?"
"First the Mountain-Swallowing Python, now a White-forehead Golden Tiger, goodness, did the Wang Family hunt down two Tier Three Ferocious Beasts?"
"Look at those carriages, they’re carrying the renowned Tier Two top-level ferocious beasts, Ironback Boars."
"With so many Tier Three beasts, what’s a Tier Two?"
"No, no, look... there are many of them!"
The crowd focused their gaze, indeed, there were many of them. Three to four carriages were packed with Ironback Boars of various sizes. The biggest one exuded a powerful aura, weighing around one or two thousand pounds.
In addition, there were twenty to thirty juvenile Ironback Boars tied up and loaded onto the carriages, grunting and squealing.
The crowd gasped in shock!
Was the Wang Family planning to breed Ironback Boars, considering they captured so many young ones?
"There’s a huge turtle at the back of the convoy..." "Isn’t that a Tier Three Water Elemental Turtle, and it’s still alive! Several ferocious beast preys are piled on its back."
The return of the Wang Family convoy seemed to trigger a grand feast.
The onlookers marveled, shocked, and found it hard to believe.
While the members of the Liu Family were pushed aside, unnoticed.
Liu Yonghao collapsed to the ground, stripped of everything, muttering to himself in disbelief, this can’t be happening!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 122: Achievement! A Single Hand Covers Heaven (Nearly 6000)
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 122: Achievement! A Single Hand Covers Heaven (Nearly 6000)
...
With the Wang Family’s fleet of vehicles, one after another entered Weng City.
The sounds of watching and commotion grew louder, especially for some traveling merchants and loose cultivators who had come from afar. While being shocked by the scene before them, they would also spread the Wang Family’s prestigious name.
A noble family must have deterrence, so as to inspire awe and prevent others from casually harboring ill intentions. Firstly, it reduces various unnecessary troubles, and secondly, the bigger the name, the easier it is to gain benefits.
Yet, at the same time, while a noble family maintains deterrence, it must also keep people uncertain about its true depth and strength.
To put it simply, it should both establish its power, making people feel that the Wang Family is very formidable, yet also maintain mystery so that people cannot determine just how formidable it truly is.
The subtleties and mysteries within this must be carefully considered and managed.
It is precisely for this reason that, under Wang Shouzhe’s arrangement, the Mountain-Swallowing Python’s head was placed atop the first carriage. And the head of the White-forehead Golden Tiger was "unintentionally," half-revealed from the cabin.
The Water Origin Spirit Turtle carried a large number of prey, leisurely stepping into Weng City, elevating the spectators’ shock to an extreme level.
Beyond the shock, there was awe for the Wang Family. Even Tier Three Ferocious Beasts can be captured, the Wang Family’s rise is inevitable.
This is called street parade display, laying the foundation for the Wang Family’s future to dominate Ping’an Town.
What to showcase, what not to showcase, and how to showcase it, were all results of the Wang Family members’ careful discussions and considerations, not random acts.
Surrounding people involuntarily praised the Wang Family, while the topic naturally shifted to Wang Shouzhe, speaking of him as the young Clan Leader, promisingly talented, with limitless future prospects.
"Brother!"
Wang Luomiao broke free from her mother’s hand, rushed over excitedly, her little face flushed with pride and admiration for her elder brother.
Those traveling merchants, loose cultivators, representatives of merchant families, and garrison soldiers blocking the way, all actively made way.
That was the Wang Family’s little legitimate daughter—Wang Luomiao, the half-sister of clan leader Wang Shouzhe, with a very noble identity.
She pattered with yet-to-grow short legs, rushed over.
Suddenly, Wang Shouzhe stretched out his arm and scooped her up onto the horse, riding together out of inner Weng City, laughingly asked: "You little one, just a month or so unnoticed and you’ve become even cuter?"
"Brother, your mouth has become sweeter." Wang Luomiao said happily with a giggle, "Not in vain did I write to Sister-in-law Ruolan to praise you well."
"Uh... You even wrote to Miss Ruolan?" Wang Shouzhe said with a laugh and tears, "With your scribble-like characters, is it presentable? Does it not instantly expose our Wang Family’s lack of cultural foundation?"
"Wang Shouzhe, you you you, you’re too bullying, I’ll fight you." Wang Luomiao was furious, flailing her arms and legs, "I even helped to humor Sister-in-law, you wooden-headed stubborn thing. Humph humph humph, I originally wanted to show you Sister-in-law’s reply, now hmph, I won’t show you even if you beg."
"I didn’t want to read your girls’ private conversations anyway."
"You you you, next time I write to Sister Ruolan, I’ll say you’re a big bad big bad."
"Fine by me, if I can’t marry a wife, I’ll just trade you, the legitimate daughter, for a bride."
Chasing closely behind, Gongsun Hui listened to this scene, somewhat finding it ridiculous yet somewhat comforted.
Every time Shouzhe and Luomiao meet, they must go through this routine, and Shouzhe still quite enjoys it.
And Luomiao, every time being so angry she nearly dies, yet later throws herself back into her brother’s embrace.
The relationship between Shouzhe and Luomiao is truly very good.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe dismounted, thanked Gongsun Hui, Liua Ruolei, and Liua Yuanrui. Then he followed the fleet of vehicles, grandly toward the Wang Family’s Main Residence.
Many people followed to watch the excitement, and the crowd grew larger and larger.
The previously bustling Zhouxuan Pass Weng City, in a blink of an eye, became deserted, leaving only the Liu and Zhao Clans and some soldiers unable to leave due to guarding duties, appearing desolate.
The Ping’an Town garrison commander, Lei Yangqiu, watching this scene, looked at the increasingly heavier snow, and couldn’t help but sigh.
"Ping’an Town has completely changed its weather."
The youths of the Liu and Zhao Clans, their expressions collapsed thoroughly. Many whose hearts were fragile and unable to withstand the pressure, directly collapsed onto the ground, crying.
...
The Wang Family’s fleet, slowly moved along.
The original journey of no more than an hour and a half was dragged into two and a half hours.
Behind the fleet, there followed as many as three to four thousand people, looking down from above, it was indeed a vast crowd.
The Wang Family’s Main Residence had already been notified, the remaining clan members, household servants, and maids, awaited outside the gate. For fear of insufficient manpower, many had been specially summoned from side branches for transport.
"Shouzhe." Wang Shouxin approached, his face flushed with excitement.
The Wang Family had been declining for fifty years, and he, Wang Shouxin, had lived for forty-three years, never seen the Wang Family so glorious.
Immediately, he carefully advised: "Some strong noble families, after autumn and winter hunting returns, if they have a bountiful harvest that attracts spectators, they will take out a small portion of prey, ordinary ones will do. Then cook meat on the spot and distribute it to those impoverished people who don’t have meat all year round."
"At the same time, some strong noble families also take out half or a whole fierce beast to sell at lower prices to local minor families, to gather people’s hearts and enhance prestige, this tradition is called ’Celebration Banquet’."

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 122: Achievement! A Single Hand Covers Heaven (Nearly 6000)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 122: Achievement! A Single Hand Covers Heaven (Nearly 6000)_2
Of course, during Wang Shouxin’s forty-three years of life, the Wang Family did not have the power or status to host a "Celebration Banquet."
Every time during the autumn and winter hunts, the Wang Family mostly went quietly and returned dejectedly.
However, when Ancestor Zhou Xuan was alive and there was a bountiful harvest, a Celebration Banquet would be held.
As soon as these words were spoken.
Several older clan members exhibited a strong look of anticipation in their eyes. The Wang Family had been down for fifty years, and now that they had finally turned the tide, they also wanted to elevate the family’s sense of honor and increase their prestige in the territory.
"Alright." Wang Shouzhe pondered for a moment and said, "I remember there are five or six ordinary wild oxen and wild boars left, so we’ll take one of each, and the rest will be preserved and stored. In addition, some of the stocked breeding meat in the family warehouse will also be used for the Celebration Banquet, while also clearing some space in the warehouse."
"Oh, and set up a few porridge stalls to serve porridge on the side, since there might not be enough meat for everyone."
"As for selling fierce beast meat at low prices, use that Tier-One Green Hoof Wild Ox. It’s at least three thousand pounds—more than enough. Warn those insignificant families that if they dare to sell low-priced spiritual flesh to traveling merchants, the Wang Family will not be lenient."
The family’s food warehouse is not small, but the harvest this time was so astonishing that there might not be enough room in the icehouse warehouse.
And given the amount, with just the Wang Family members, they could eat well for two years.
"Alright." Wang Shouxin was ecstatic and led the crowd to carry out the plans as agreed.
When the local people and some insignificant Black Tortoise Clans found out that the Wang Family was preparing to host a Celebration Banquet with an abundance of shocking ingredients, the place was immediately abuzz with excitement.
In the past decades, the Liu and Zhao Clans had alternated hosting Celebration Banquets. However, their scale was very small, probably not even a tenth of this Wang Family banquet. It was just for show, to declare that they were the "top noble family" in Ping’an Town.
Hosting a Celebration Banquet naturally didn’t require Wang Shouzhe, the clan leader, to make an appearance. It was enough for several elder brothers, along with family women, younger brothers, and sisters to manage it.
At this time, Wang Shouzhe, along with Liua Ruolei and Liua Yuanrui, returned to the main residence, and the first thing they did was to visit Ancestor Zhi Sheng.
Accompanying them, of course, were Ancestor Longyan and Ancestor Xiaohan.
This was proper etiquette, as Ancestor Zhi Sheng had come to help defend the Wang Family’s main residence without hesitation after receiving the letter.
This favor was invaluable.
After mutual greetings and courtesy, Ancestor Zhi Sheng, having completed his duty, took his leave.
Naturally, Wang Shouzhe would not let Ancestor Zhi Sheng work for nothing. Subsequently, a cartload of spiritual meat and spirit rice would be directly sent to the Shanyin Liu Family’s residence.
After all matters were handled.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe completely settle down and relax, as if he had suddenly laid down all burdens.
Afterward, he enjoyed a nice long bath and instructed Wang Gui to refuse all visitors and not to think about anything, lying in bed for a whole day and night.
During this period, dealing with the Liu and Zhao Clans had indeed been exhausting, most importantly mentally, without room for the slightest mistake.
But now, finally, he could really relax.
...
The Wang Family’s Celebration Banquet was held in a very lively manner, as if it had already become the most bustling celebration in all of Ping’an Town.
Almost everyone was eagerly talking about it, and every conversation topic turned to the Ping’an Wang Family.
Meanwhile, the other two noble families in Ping’an Town, the Ping’an Liu and Ping’an Zhao Clans, seemed to have been forgotten in the corner, no longer mentioned by anyone.
It was as if, in the vast Ping’an Town, there was only one Black Tortoise Clan—Ping’an Wang Family.
At this moment.
A carriage from the Daqian Government Office unobtrusively stopped at the entrance of the Wang Family’s main residence.
The first to step down from the carriage was a middle-aged man in a Garrison Commander’s uniform, imposing and distinguished. This was naturally Garrison Commander Lei Yangqiu.
Then, two elders in their seventies or eighties, trembling slightly, stepped out of the carriage.
The plaza at the entrance of the Wang Family was still bustling. There were people lining up to drink porridge and eat meat, as well as local insignificant Black Tortoise Clans bringing accumulated Qian Gold to purchase low-priced spiritual meat.
No sensible person would want to miss such an opportunity.
Nonetheless, the Wang Family always conducted matters clearly. Each household had their number of people on record, how much was purchased; it was all allocated.
And for the local residents partaking in the porridge and meat of the Celebration Banquet, they must present local residency proof and register, so they wouldn’t partake more than once.
If anyone dared to act recklessly, the Wang Family’s methods would not be soft.
But even with such strictness, there were still many people lining up after three days and nights.
"Tsk tsk, the Wang Family indeed shows promising prospects." Garrison Commander Lei Yangqiu praised with a smile, then addressed Wang Luqiu, who was distributing meat, "Little sister Luqiu, do you remember me?"
Wang Luqiu looked up at him, continued registering and quickly distributing meat and porridge, and said nonchalantly, "I remember; you were the one scolded to tears by my fourth brother, right? Something with the surname Lei..."
Lei Yangqiu’s face turned a shade of embarrassment, suddenly feeling mentally drenched; when was he ever scolded to tears?
But it wouldn’t be appropriate to argue with a little girl, so he forced a laugh, "Well, the past is best left unmentioned. By the way, is your fourth brother around? I wish to see him; Miss Luqiu, could you help pass the word?"
"Can’t you see I’m busy?" Wang Luqiu replied impatiently, then beckoned to a servant, "Junyan, go inform Wang Gui to send a message to my fourth brother, someone with the surname Lei is looking for him. That’s right, it’s the Garrison Commander."
"Yes, Miss Six." Ouyang Junyan shrank his neck and hurried off to carry out the task.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 122: Achievement! A Single Hand Covers Heaven (Nearly 6000)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 122: Achievement! A Single Hand Covers Heaven (Nearly 6000)_3
In his heart, he couldn’t help but sigh, following Miss Six guarantees presence and respect, even a dignified Guardian Envoy has to wait.
Very soon!
...
Inside the main hall of the Wang Family.
Wang Shouzhe and Lei Yangqiu sat face to face sipping tea, occasionally engaging in small talk.
Lei Yangqiu continuously let out hearty laughter and agreed with Wang Shouzhe’s points, as if a subordinate facing his superior.
As for the two old men in their seventies or eighties, they stood trembling, heads bowed, hands clasped at their waists, as if awaiting a verdict from fate.
These two elders were naturally the clan elders of the Liu and Zhao Clans.
After three rounds of tea.
Lei Yangqiu cautiously asked, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, as the Ping’an Guardian Envoy, there are things I cannot ignore even if I wish to, especially with so many eyes staring down at me. I just want to ask, how do you plan to deal with the remnants of the Liu and Zhao Clans?"
"Deal with them?" Wang Shouzhe leisurely sipped his tea and said, "Lei Guardian Envoy, you must be joking. Our Wang Family is a traditional noble family that abides by the laws, we have no authority to deal with other noble families."
Lei Yangqiu, aware that Wang Shouzhe was not easy to provoke, had mentally prepared himself and immediately said, "Younger Brother, let’s not beat around the bush. It’s no secret even to a fool, the matters between your Wang Family and the Liu and Zhao Clans in the Outer Domain, but since it’s a fait accompli, no one will pursue it."
"However, some matters on the surface still need to be handled properly, to avoid any blame coming down from above, which I can’t afford to bear."
"Don’t speak nonsense, Lei Guardian Envoy, about matters between Outer Domain and Inner Domain!" Wang Shouzhe, sipping his tea, glanced at the two elders and stated firmly, "I’ll say it again, our Wang Family is a law-abiding noble family, we never engage in illegal activities."
The two elders immediately shivered, trembling all over.
Inwardly, Lei Yangqiu mused, indeed. Given Wang Shouzhe’s abilities, he probably managed to eliminate them all while staying within the bounds of the law. Naturally, there’s no need to risk engaging in illegal activities.
Lei Yangqiu was somewhat frustrated by Wang Shouzhe’s impenetrable stance: "How about this, I propose a solution, you listen first, Younger Brother Shouzhe."
Wang Shouzhe made no comment.
"Here’s the situation. Situations similar to those between your three families are not unprecedented in our Daqian Kingdom, not even in Longzuo County or Changning Guard. The usual traditional practice is that if one side ultimately withdraws in a noble family conflict and retreats to another place, the other family should not pursue them further." Lei Yangqiu carefully said.
"Currently, what remains of the Liu and Zhao Clans are mostly the elderly, women, children, and some young males. I suggest, following historical precedents, all of their assets could be bought out by the Wang Family at half price. Then all remaining Liu and Zhao members take this money and retreat to another county, purchase some land to sustain themselves, and swear never to set foot in Longzuo County again."
After speaking, Lei Yangqiu cautiously observed Wang Shouzhe’s expression.
As expected, Wang Shouzhe remained silent, continuing to drink his tea, appearing indifferent and unconcerned.
Lei Yangqiu felt somewhat helpless, but he, as the Guardian Envoy, had a responsibility to get involved in this messy affair.
He immediately continued persuading: "Clan Leader Wang, look, at most they are just some weak elderly, women, and children. Even if they settle in another county, they would be nothing more than a small, insignificant family. In this lifetime, the chance of rising to Ninth-Grade Noble Family status is absolutely impossible."
"In a hundred years or more, no one will remember their Wang Family!"
"If Clan Leader Wang wishes to completely eradicate them, the news would tarnish your family’s reputation if it spreads."
"Hehe~" Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Lei Guardian Envoy, your words consistently paint me as a villain, that cannot be the case. Although I am reluctant to part with old neighbors, if the Liu and Zhao Clans wish to relocate, they can leave anytime. No one is stopping them."
This Wang Shouzhe was truly difficult to converse with, making Lei Yangqiu feel utterly exhausted.
If he weren’t in charge of guarding Ping’an, and hadn’t received many benefits from the Liu and Zhao Clans, at this point he truly wouldn’t want to wade into this troubled water.
Given the current situation, do they dare to indiscriminately sell off clan assets and flee without Wang Shouzhe’s approval?
This large family, with so many people, aren’t they afraid that as they flee, they might run into "bandits and water bandits" and end up with no bodies left?
"Thirty percent. I’ll decide for them, after all, they are the ones at fault first. Sell the assets to your Wang Family at thirty percent." Lei Yangqiu said, "Clan Leader Wang, give me a straightforward answer, if yes, then yes; if not, I’ll leave immediately and no longer involve myself in your family’s affairs. In the future, even if blamed from above, I won’t bother to intervene."
After a moment’s hesitation, Wang Shouzhe felt he had already suppressed them enough, and then calmly said, "Since Lei Guardian Envoy is mediating on behalf, I ought to give you some face."
Lei Yangqiu breathed a sigh of relief, truly grateful for the favor. Before he could speak, Wang Shouzhe added, "However, I too have two conditions."
"Younger Brother Shouzhe, speak your terms, I will try to mediate." Lei Yangqiu said solemnly.
"First, I must decide to which county they will migrate, and I will keep a close watch on that county’s situation." Wang Shouzhe said.
Lei Yangqiu agreed without hesitation, "No problem, but Clan Leader Wang, do provide them a path for survival, do not send them to a county where they can’t make a living."
"Then let the Liu Clan move to Lingbei County, and the Zhao Clan to Southern Desert County, just a distance of a few thousand to ten thousand miles." Wang Shouzhe randomly assigned a location and said, "Second, the young males aged between twelve and sixty must stay behind temporarily. To work in servitude under my Wang Family for five years, as a means to atone for their ancestors’ crimes."
The color drained from Lei Yangqiu’s face, secretly lamenting Wang Shouzhe’s ruthlessness.
Without these young men, it would be even harder for the Liu and Zhao Clans to establish themselves in a distant and unfamiliar county, likely to be targeted and humiliated by local families.
And after five years of servitude, how much zeal would those young men have left? How could they still harbor any ambition?
It’s over!
The Liu and Zhao Clans are essentially doomed, at most becoming an ordinary Black Tortoise Race family, let alone after a hundred years, even after seventy to eighty years, no one would remember the Wang Family, nor remember Ping’an Town.
The two clan elders in their seventies or eighties looked exceedingly forlorn.
Wang Shouzhe’s plan effectively extinguished their chances of a resurgence. He intended to ensure the Liu and Zhao Clans would never rise again.
However, if they did not agree, not a single member of the Liu and Zhao Clans could leave Ping’an Town alive.
"Enough, the Liu and Zhao Clans already owe their slim chances of survival to Clan Leader Wang." Lei Yangqiu concluded, "Let everything proceed according to Clan Leader Wang’s plans."
He, Lei Yangqiu, felt justified toward the deceased Liu Zhide and Zhao Bojun. He couldn’t antagonize the promising Wang Shouzhe for the sake of two dead ancestors, could he?
"Yes, Lord Lei." The two clan elders, although filled with grief, had no power over their fate at this point. Simultaneously, they bowed to Wang Shouzhe, "Thank you, Clan Leader Wang, for granting a path to life."
"In that case, I won’t keep Lei Guardian Envoy for a meal." Wang Shouzhe raised his tea to send them off.
Lei Yangqiu led the two remaining clan elders, clasping his hands in thanks: "Thank you, Clan Leader Wang, farewell, farewell."
As they reached the main hall’s exit, Wang Shouzhe called out one last time: "Lei Guardian Envoy, before you leave, make sure to confiscate their Ninth-Grade Family Seal. Some families, despite the chance, can never truly rise."
Lei Yangqiu paused, hurriedly nodding, "Indeed, indeed, everything follows Clan Leader Wang’s wisdom."
After Lei Yangqiu boarded the carriage, watching as the Wang Family’s gates receded into the distance, he couldn’t help but deeply sigh.
"After today, the Wang Family’s dominance in Ping’an Town is assured."
What Lei Yangqiu didn’t know was that after their departure.
Wang Shouzhe nonchalantly took out a small system booklet, making changes to the prestige column earnestly.
[Clan Prestige]: [Village Reputation (100) Single-Handed Control]
...

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 123: Wedding Procession! Fire Stepping on White Clouds (Seeking Recommendations and Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 123: Wedding Procession! Fire Stepping on White Clouds (Seeking Recommendations and Monthly Tickets)
...
Time flies by.
It has been ten months since the Liu and Zhao Clans have fallen and completely exited the stage.
In these ten months, many joyous events have occurred in the Wang Family. The Spirit Platform banquet for Sixth Grandfather Wang Xiaohan was a lively affair. After that, it was the wedding of my sister Wang Luoyi and Chen Fangjie.
In just a few days, it will be my grand wedding.
The Wang Family is thriving, with continuous celebrations.
It is also the season of autumn harvest.
At Fenggu Farm.
In the thousands of acres of fertile land, the rice plants, now in the middle to late stage of filling, sway like ocean waves in the wind, quite spectacular.
The tenant farmers are busy in the fields, carefully tending to the rice plants, fertilizing where needed, and identifying the barnyard grass that looks similar, sneaking among the crops.
Barnyard grass resembles rice very much and is often considered an ancestor of rice. Through generations, ancestors have selectively bred barnyard grass to create today’s rice. They grow wildly and are hard to eliminate, competing with rice for precious nutrients.
If not thoroughly dealt with, it would inevitably affect the rice’s filling process.
The tenant farmers work very hard, but this year, despite their hard labor, they all show expressions of joy.
Because this year, somehow the landlord has brought in a new variety of rice. It was said that half of Fenggu Farm’s land would be planted with this new rice.
Initially, the tenant farmers grumbled in private, fearing the new rice variety wouldn’t adapt to this land, leading to poor harvests and affecting their share.
Fortunately, the landlord promised a minimum allocation based on last year’s average profit for households planting the new rice. If there is a plentiful harvest, there would be additional distribution.
After planting this season.
As the filling stage progressed, the tenant farmers increasingly discovered the strong points of the new rice—its sturdy upright posture and larger, more abundant ears compared to ordinary varieties.
Many of the tenants are experienced farmers and realized that if things continued this way, each field might yield an extra picul of rice this year, with possibly better quality.
The price of new rice is already slightly higher, and even at the original price, every twenty acres could yield one extra Qian Gold in profit! This profit does not include taxes, fertilizers, oxen, or labor; it’s pure extra gain.
On average, each household of tenant farmers could gain thirty Large Coppers! If wheat also had a good variety, could it not mean an extra sixty Large Coppers each year?
How could the tenant farmers not be delighted?
This extra profit could be saved for future bridal money for their children. Or send the children to learn a craft, with which they wouldn’t have to toil in farming, earn more, and even find it easier to marry.
Many tenant farmers are envisioning the future, thinking they could save enough Qian Gold to buy enough farmland for their descendants to become independent farmers.
With this thought, they are even more motivated.
...
Meanwhile.
At the head of the field, the spirited Fourth Grandfather Wang Xiaozhi excitedly said, "Shouzhe, the Wang Family No. 9 rice variety you developed truly is high quality. If all our farms plant Wang Family No. 9, we’ll earn quite a bit more this year."
Now, the Wang Family has ample meat supplies, and even Wang Xiaozhi and the clan elders, who once lived frugally, are ordered to supplement their diet with Spiritual Food and even use Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills while maintaining diligent practice.
Therefore, Wang Xiaozhi looks good this year, appearing much younger. Although he has no hopes of reaching the Spirit Platform Realm in this life, at least he can live many more healthy years.
Wang Shouzhe doesn’t want these clan elders, who have worked hard for the family all their lives, nurturing generations of children, to end up unable to move by the age of eighty, with bleak old age.
"Fourth Grandfather, let’s plant in another field next year and observe for another season. If there are no issues, we can fully switch to Wang Family No. 9." Wang Shouzhe is very satisfied with his meticulously developed Wang Family No. 9.
The reason he could develop a rice variety stems from his mysterious and profound bloodline ability. When he discovered he could rejuvenate dead wood and make flowers bloom instantly, he thought about catalyzing Spiritual Medicine or Spirit Valley.
Unfortunately, after some research, he found he had oversimplified his thoughts.
Rejuvenating dead wood and instant blooming is only applicable to ordinary plants.
Moreover, without proper nutrient supplementation, rapid catalysis can deplete their life potential, causing them to wither quickly.
For those Spirit Valleys and Spirit Plants, while there is some catalytic effect,
only when hastily catalyzing a White Jade Spirit Rice ear, the produced grain husks are empty.
With normal planting and enhanced nutrition, it requires over ten days of work from Wang Shouzhe to mature and bear White Jade Spirit Rice ears fully.
And only one plant, the cost-effectiveness is extremely low.
As for catalyzing ginseng and similar Spiritual Medicine, it goes without saying that after painstaking catalysis for over ten days, at most, one could add a year’s maturity to the ginseng. Its catalysis effect is rather lackluster.
However, Wang Shouzhe estimates that it’s because his mysterious bloodline level is too low and too thin. If one day, the mysterious bloodline awakens to the extreme, perhaps it could instantly catalyze a hundred-year-old ginseng.
But with the current situation, catalyzing Spirit Seeds is genuinely too tiring and not cost-effective.
Finally, after much deliberation, he decided instead of catalyzing Spirit Seeds, it would be better to improve ordinary rice and wheat seeds first. Thus, he built a laboratory and began small-scale catalytic experiments on rice seeds.
His bloodline ability holds too much advantage over ordinary plants.

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 123: Wedding Procession! Fire Stepping on White Clouds (Seeking Recommendations and Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 123: Wedding Procession! Fire Stepping on White Clouds (Seeking Recommendations and Monthly Tickets)_2
About one fen of greenhouse experimental field, as long as the nutrition inside the experimental field keeps up. He only needs a few days to let this experimental field’s rice reach maturity and harvest.
Therefore, he decided to use his new ability on cultivating rice.
The initial rice seeds, conversely, came from the Liu and Zhao Clans, from that drastically reduced production farm. The rice that could survive such a level of reduced production must be the part with relatively excellent insect resistance and disease resistance.
Starting from this basis, it will be much simpler.
Then, he cultivated a new variety of rice generation by generation, utilizing his previous life’s scarce and scattered knowledge of agronomy and breeding little by little.
It took him half a year to create fifteen rice varieties, each having its own advantages.
But in the end, he chose the "ordinary in yield" Wang Family No. 9, which was not particularly standout in insect and disease resistance, to be the variety for large-scale experimentation.
The reason is quite simple, this variety’s genetic mutation has one major feature, which is that once the seeds are soaked in low concentration salt water, the offspring cannot be reproduced.
Simply put, only the Wang Family can cultivate the first generation as the original seed; the seeds soaked in low concentration salt water, once planted for offspring seeds, that grain can only be eaten and not used as grain seeds.
This can effectively prevent the leakage of good seeds.
According to Wang Shouzhe, many long-established or powerful families have been cultivating their own good seeds for generations, whether with high yield or high quality.
These good seeds are cherished, only used on their own farms, and when selling externally, they are hulled. Because once sold as seed grain, the entire variety would spread out.
And Wang Shouzhe’s Wang Family No. 9 has no such concerns.
In Wang Shouzhe’s contemplation.
Wang Xiaozhi said, "Shouzhe, I know you are concerned about this mass production. But you should hurry back; in a few days, it will be your wedding, the whole family is busy with your wedding matters, you should not run to the farmland anymore."
"I was just taking a look, I’m going back now, going back." Wang Shouzhe smiled, taking his leave.
In fact, he also knew that the Wang Race had been preparing for his wedding for a long time. The wedding attire and so on were made half a year in advance.
There’s also his second brother Wang Shouyi, who had already commissioned various merchants more than half a year ago to purchase some high-end ingredients from Longzuo County and even the surrounding areas.
The rest of the family also had been busy for a good while.
Moreover, at this time, many daughters who had married out brought their children back to the Wang Family’s Main Residence, both to celebrate and help.
On the carriage back, Wang Shouzhe exhaled a turbid breath. He couldn’t help but be filled with emotions, unconsciously, he was getting married!
What fascinated him the most was that up to now, he and the bride had never met each other.
Both did not know what the other looked like.
Moreover, until now, they only had two or three times of little exchanges from a distance.
This was even more exaggerated than those online relationships Wang Shouzhe had on Earth.
But in this world, such marriages between legitimate sons and daughters of noble families are very normal.
Chen Fangjie and his sister Wang Luoyi came to the Wang Family’s Main Residence only once before they got married, not daring to visit the main residence afterward, fearing that they would break the rules and be killed by Wang Shouzhe.
"Hehe~ But this kind of arranged marriage is quite good." Wang Shouzhe smiled, on Earth, marriage and dating could talk for many years, how troublesome!
...
A few more days passed.
Gold Autumn October.
The sky is high and the air is fresh.
This is a season of harvest and also a suitable season for marriages.
For Changning Guard’s Shanyin Town, it is also a very important season.
Because in Shanyin Town, the Luoyi who holds an overpowering position, today, their legitimate daughter is marrying.
To celebrate this joyous event, the Liua Family has announced that the family tax for all arable land within their jurisdiction will be exempted once this autumn harvest.
What a grand gesture!
One must know, the arable land within Liua Family’s jurisdiction requiring the noble family tax amounts to over seventy thousand acres, just the reduced noble tax amounts to over seven hundred Qian Gold.
This is a great affair for most ordinary self-cultivating farmers, paying less than a dozen Ten Large Coppers in tax during the autumn harvest season allows them to have a bountiful year.
And thus, the overall financial power of the Shanyin Liua Family can be seen; the loss of merely over seven hundred Qian Gold is insignificant, genuinely beyond what ordinary noble families can compare.
At the entrance to Shanyin Town’s power range, stands a gate tower outpost, on top of the gate tower is a stone plaque inscribed with the words Shanyin.
This is a defense line and checkpoint, where a Liua Family member and a team of household soldiers and servants are stationed round the clock, anyone entering Shanyin Town, especially those loose cultivators and traveling merchants, will be interrogated and registered.
This is also what makes Shanyin different from the other towns, it can prevent most transient criminals and also make those intending to commit crimes fearful.
Thus, the crime rate within Shanyin has always been the lowest among all Changning Guard’s towns, with a stable and orderly life.
At the same time, on the wide open space beside the gate tower, there had long been Liua Family members waiting, with sunshades erected and a prepared drum and suona ensemble.
7:00 AM.
A large number of Shanyin civilians had already gathered near the gate tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - 123: Wedding Procession! Fire Stepping on White Clouds (Seeking Recommendations and Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 123: Wedding Procession! Fire Stepping on White Clouds (Seeking Recommendations and Monthly Tickets)_3
There are farmers, small business owners, artisans, as well as some Black Tortoise Practitioners from lesser-known families, traveling merchants, and even quite a few loose cultivators of various ages, both men and women.
They were engaged in lively discussions, occasionally glancing outside the gate tower, seemingly looking forward to something.
"I heard the groom is the Young Clan Leader of the Ping’an Wang Family? I wonder what he looks like and if he’s worthy of our Miss Ruolan."
"Brother, where did you get this outdated news? The groom has long been the Clan Leader of the Wang Family."
"Clan Leader? Then he must be quite old. Our Miss Ruolan, is she going to be a second wife?"
"How could it be remarriage!? Our Miss Ruolan is the legitimate eldest daughter of the distinguished Liua Family, her status is extremely noble. I heard the groom is only nineteen, right in the prime of his youth, and is just a year older than Miss Ruolan."
"In terms of age and status, it’s barely acceptable. But isn’t the Ping’an Wang Family just a small family in that remote corner south of the Anjiang River?"
"That’s right, Ping’an Town was developed just over a hundred years ago, and they say there are still fierce beasts that haven’t been completely eradicated within the jurisdiction."
"Oh~~ Does that mean our Miss Ruolan will suffer if she marries into such a poor and wild place? Isn’t it dangerous where there are fierce beasts?"
In this world, many commoners are born and die in the same place.
To have a chance to visit a Guardian City and gain some knowledge would already be considered quite successful in life.
Ping’an Town and Shanyin Town are separated by mountains and water, so ordinary people only hear bits of information through hearsay, without really being well-informed.
However, some traveling loose cultivators and merchants who roamed around the world started speaking up for Ping’an Town, saying, "Ping’an Town is developing quite rapidly under the Wang Family’s leadership. Although it’s currently not as good as Shanyin, it holds great potential for future development. As for the appearance of fierce beasts within its borders, it does happen occasionally, but since it’s close to the Outer Domain, it’s unavoidable."
"Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe is a remarkable young man and is highly regarded in Ping’an Town, worthy of your Miss Liua."
With the defense from the loose cultivators and merchants, some Shanyin townsfolk finally gained some impression of Ping’an Town and Wang Shouzhe.
However, many people still held prejudices.
"Occasional fierce beasts, still means there are fierce beasts. Miss Ruolan marrying to such a wild place is too much hardship."
"Wang Shouzhe? Such a common name. I hope he is handsome and brave, with at least seventy or eighty percent of Young Clan Leader Yuanhui’s qualities."
"How could he compare to Young Master Yuanhui? If the groom has even half of Young Master Yuanhui’s qualities, that would be good enough."
Various discussions continued without end.
Suddenly.
A few clever young lads rushed back from afar, faces flushed with excitement, shouting, "They’re here, they’re here, Ping’an Wang Family’s wedding procession is here, the groom is here."
In an instant.
Everyone fell silent, stretching their necks to peer outside the gate.
After a while, at the corner of the road, the wedding procession slowly appeared.
