Leading the procession was a young man dressed in wedding attire, with a large red flower adorning his chest.
He wore a Zanying Purple Jade Crown on his head, a tight-fitting vermillion wedding robe embroidered with dragon patterns and themed with a phoenix motif, signifying a harmonious marriage and united efforts in building their family.
At his waist hung a Ten Thousand Treasures Golden Pouch, indicating the wealth of the groom’s family and the promise of a worry-free life for the bride, with the pouch meant to be handed over to the bride for future financial management.
On his right side were a Jade Sword and a small, slender Purple Gold Bow, symbolizing the groom’s family’s strong martial power capable of protecting the wife and children.
He wore Cloud-Stepping Boots, signifying the groom’s aspirations to rise steadily and further develop the family.
These outfits carry significant meaning in this world.
This is the standard attire for a family clan leader or a family heir groom. Direct veins or second legitimate sons are not allowed to wear such wedding clothes.
"Oh, the groom’s stature is dignified, and he is as handsome as jade," praised a scholar, "He rides steadily, with poised demeanor, excellent, excellent."
"The groom’s wedding robe, from a distance, seems to emit a faint red glow and golden light. Could it be... the legendary Golden Fire Dual Spirit Silk Robe?" exclaimed a well-informed loose cultivator.
"Brother, what is a Golden Fire Dual Spirit Silk Robe? Isn’t it just a wedding robe? What’s special about it?"
"Ha, there are many types of Spiritual Silkworms, such as Ice Spirit Silkworms, Fire Spirit Silkworms, and Golden Spirit Silkworms, among others. However, any Spiritual Silkworm Silk Clothing is extremely expensive, and an ordinary noble young lady would treasure even a single Spiritual Silkworm Silk Handkerchief," explained the loose cultivator eloquently.
"For men’s wedding attire, the most suitable is a Dual Spirit Silk Robe primarily made from Fire Spirit Silkworm Silk, with Golden Spirit Silkworm Silk as a supplement. These two types of spirit silks have an inherent reddish or golden hue, making them the most prestigious for wedding robes."
"However, the wedding robe requires a lot of materials and intricate craftsmanship, making it even more expensive. I reckon that groom’s robe costs no less than two thousand Qian Gold!"
"Two thousand?"
Both commoners and loose cultivators were stunned.
That’s a sky-high price!
The key point is that a man’s wedding robe is worn only once in a lifetime... A single wear costing two thousand Qian Gold is exceedingly extravagant!
"In the Longzuo County Town, I’ve seen such wedding robes, used by a Celestial Human Family’s Young Clan Leader during their marriage," the loose cultivator boasted of his knowledge.
A groom who can afford such a wedding robe must not be from an ordinary family?
Almost everyone immediately looked at the groom with newfound respect.
"Hey, hey, don’t just look at the wedding robe, take a look at the horse the groom is riding!" another well-informed loose cultivator shouted.
With his reminder.
Only then did everyone notice that the groom’s horse was no ordinary steed.
The horse had a single horn on its head, its whole body was fiery red, with cloud-like white hooves, strong and graceful, full of spirit.
Its steps were light, as if stepping on clouds and flying.
"This is... the legendary Ten Thousand Gold Spirit Beast Steed."
"Fire Stepping on White Clouds!"
Indeed it is.
A thousand-gold robe, a ten-thousand-gold horse, the groom comes to marry the noble lady!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 124: Celebration! Splendor! Phoenixes Sing Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 124: Celebration! Splendor! Phoenixes Sing Together
...
Ten Thousand Gold Steed—Fire Stepping on White Clouds.
Most people might not hear about such a valuable steed worth tens of thousands in their life, let alone see it with their own eyes.
But in that instant, the crowd of no less than a thousand spectators erupted in excitement.
This is the specification for the Young Clan Leader of a Celestial Human Family marrying a bride. It truly is quite impressive. It seems Miss Ruolan’s husband’s family is extraordinary.
No matter how you look at that groom, he seems increasingly pleasing to the eye, as if he is shining, and his whole being is glowing.
Meanwhile.
The wedding party led by Wang Shouzhe slowly approached the archway.
Behind Wang Shouzhe, at the forefront on horseback, was a group of family members dressed in luxurious, festive attire, each riding high-headed horses.
Aside from Wang Shouzhe, the most conspicuous figure was Chen Fangjie, the Young Clan Leader of the Chen Family.
Chen Fangjie had indeed been enjoying a great year.
First, his father Chen Dewei accumulated strength quietly and broke through to the Spirit Platform Realm, and then he married Wang Luoyi, the Eldest Legitimate Daughter of the Wang Family, which left him ambitious and satisfied.
For Shouzhe’s wedding this time, being Wang’s legitimate brother-in-law, Chen Fangjie naturally came to assist.
This important role in protecting the wedding procession was, of course, his duty.
However, the attire Shouzhe wore was far too splendid, surpassing the glamour of when he got married.
Comparisons such as this are the most feared.
"Third brother-in-law."
As Chen Fangjie rode his high-headed horse, mulling over his thoughts, Wang Shounuo, the third eldest of the Shou Generation, squeezed his legs to the horse’s belly and kept pace with him, expressing with a sigh: "Two months ago, when I attended your wedding with Luoyi, I thought you were the handsomest, most radiant groom I had ever seen. Now compared to Shouzhe, sigh~"
Chen Fangjie’s face turned dark; Wang Shounuo, this is really rubbing salt into the wound!
Wasn’t my Ice Silk Wedding Robe eye-catching at that time? Okay, it couldn’t compare to Shouzhe’s attire. But it was summer back then; wearing Golden Fire Double Spirit Silk Robe would have been too hot, wouldn’t it?
Chen Fangjie silently complained in his heart, but outwardly he smiled and said: "Shounuo, aren’t you already twenty-one? Quite an age now, why haven’t you set an engagement yet? Oh, right, I heard from our Chen Family sisters that you recently attended the Pan-Noble Direct Vein Unmarried Youth Mid-Autumn Gathering?"
Now, it was Wang Shounuo’s turn for his face to darken; third brother-in-law, this is a knife in the back! That so-called Mid-Autumn Gathering was purely a large-scale flaunting event. Poor him, having never gone through such a thing before, resulted in a...
Nevertheless, those direct vein ladies were quite interested in Wang Shouzhe, pulling him aside to ask questions all about Shouzhe.
In the end, he had no choice but to put on a cheery face and say: "I just went to observe and learn; lately family business has kept me busy, no time for romance. Unlike you, third brother-in-law, so glamorous, riding a thousand-gold mare to marry my sister Luoyi."
Chen Fangjie once again darkened his face, internally grumbling nonstop; what’s wrong with a thousand-gold mare? A thousand-gold mare is already considered high-end, isn’t it? Besides, my steed, the exotic horse, is worth three thousand Qian Gold.
Do you think the whole world is filled with extravagance like Wang Shouzhe?
After that, the two of them began laughing cheerfully together. You stab me, I stab you, joyously exchanging jabs while their hearts bled quietly inside.
At the front, Wang Shouzhe, who had grown in overall health and capabilities over the past year, probably due to the nurturing of his bloodline and improved Cultivation Realm, turned around and said: "Third brother, brother-in-law, enough now, lift up the wedding gift box."
"Shouyong, Shou Lian, bring the wedding gift box." Wang Shounuo promptly called out.
Then, Wang Shouyong, the fifth, and Wang Shou Lian, the sixth, obediently dismounted, quickly returned to the carriage, each carrying a big box in front of Wang Shouzhe and opened the boxes.
Inside revealed a whole crate, packed with shiny little coins.
And a full box of malt candy, each piece wrapped in oil paper, neatly stacked.
A year had passed, and Shouyong and Shou Lian, both family boys, had grown quite a lot. Not only had their cultivation progressed rapidly, but their builds had also become more robust, like two young adults.
Seeing the Wang Family wedding procession bring out the wedding gift boxes, the onlookers became excited and swarmed forward.
The Wang Family indeed showed their generosity, even preparing two wedding gift boxes.
Following the tradition, Wang Shouzhe dismounted, grasped a handful of coins and malt candy with both hands, and bowed to the gathered spectators of Shanyin: "I am Wang Shouzhe, Clan Leader of the Wang Family, coming to your esteemed Shanyin to marry the esteemed daughter of the Liua Family. I thank all the villagers for your presence."
After saying this, he scattered the coins and malt candy, causing the crowd of Shanyin to scramble for them.
Especially, the malt candy was quite expensive, requiring about three to four coins to buy a small piece. For most ordinary families, malt candy was a luxury.
"The Wang Family is generous, even tossing malt candy, we support the Clan Leader marrying our Miss Ruolan."
"Miss Ruolan and Clan Leader Wang are truly a perfect match."
"Wish Clan Leader Wang and Miss Ruolan to have children soon."
The villagers expressed various auspicious words. Wherever the praises were loudest, Wang Shouzhe tossed more, instantly enlivening the atmosphere.
Soon after, Wang Shounuo, Chen Fangjie, and the brothers joined the group, accelerating the tossing, making the scene incredibly lively and spectacular.
This is one of the cultural features of this Black Tortoise World.
No matter which family is marrying off a daughter, they always wish for it to be grand and lively. The livelier it is, the more it signifies a solemn wedding and a blissful future life.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 124: Celebration! Splendor! Phoenixes Sing Together_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 124: Celebration! Splendor! Phoenixes Sing Together_2
Wang Shouzhe’s bustling activities here also brought more prestige to the Liua Family.
Malt candy was a rare treat, and not only children but also adults were scrambling for it. However, everyone was neighbors, so the order was maintained, and there was no chaotic grabbing.
Suddenly.
A little girl, around seven or eight years old, failed to get her desired malt candy several times, and sat down on the ground crying loudly.
Wang Shouzhe immediately flew over, helped the little girl up, and stuffed her with a handful of malt candy.
The little girl was overjoyed and wept with happiness, bowing to Wang Shouzhe and saying, "Thank you, bridegroom brother. I wish you and the bride sister to have children soon, and have many children, all as handsome as you."
Such auspicious words, they sounded really pleasant.
Wang Shouzhe loved to hear it, and immediately gave her another handful.
Afterward, he found himself surrounded.
Fortunately, Shounuo and the others came over carrying boxes to rescue him.
This round of excitement lasted a full quarter of an hour.
At this point, the Liua Family members, who had been waiting by the side specifically to welcome Wang Shouzhe, came out to stop and end this segment: "That’s enough, don’t delay the bridegroom’s auspicious moment."
The authority of the Liua Family was high. The villagers immediately left contentedly, making way.
The Liua Family member came forward, smiling and cupping his hands to Wang Shouzhe: "I am the seventh of the senior generation in the Liua Family, Liua Gaoyun. Shouzhe has worked hard all the way here. Please come into the cool pavilion first and have a cup of sweet tea to rest for a while."
"So it’s Uncle Seven." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly and respectfully saluted, saying, "I am deeply humbled that Uncle Seven came to receive me in person."
The other juniors also came forward to pay their respects.
At the same time, the three elder members accompanying the wedding procession, Gongsun Qiang of the Shanyang Gongsun Family, Lua Zhengjie of the Yingxiu Lu Family, and Wang Ding Race of the Ping’an Wang Family, all stepped forward to greet Liua Gaoyun.
The first two were Wang Shouzhe’s uncles, while Wang Ding Race was the third uncle. Both the maternal and paternal families were well-represented with elders present.
Simultaneously, Wang Ding Race stepped forward to present red envelopes to Liua Gaoyun and his party who came to greet them, the one given to Liua Gaoyun being a large red envelope of twenty Qian Gold.
The band specifically prepared by the Liua Family started playing cheerful and festive music, creating a lively atmosphere.
After everyone had a sip of sweet tea and had rested briefly.
Uncle Lua Zhengjie came out and said, "Brother Liua, it’s about time, please lead the way, Brother Liua."
After picking up the bride, they need to return to the Wang Family, and time along the way was tight.
Having received a substantial red envelope, Liua Gaoyun naturally did not make things difficult, and immediately shouted, "Lead the bridegroom in."
Then, the Liua Family members took the lead in opening the way, and the wedding procession followed behind. Around them and further behind, more and more onlookers gathered to watch, making the scene very lively and spectacular.
When they were less than five miles from the main Liua residence, the path became a wide and solid bluestone road.
At this time, the onlookers increasingly stirred up the atmosphere, and the band in the back began to play.
They were about to approach the main entrance of the Liua Family, and there should have been some entertainment to liven things up, otherwise, it was not according to protocol.
Within the procession, Gongsun Qiang and Lua Zhengjie exchanged a glance, knowing it was their cue to step up.
At this stage of entering the gate with the bridegroom, it was usually the mother’s side uncle who would show up to support the nephew.
But Wang Shouzhe was a bit unique, having two maternal families.
Months before the wedding, both maternal families had already started competing over this segment.
The origin, of course, stemmed from the two ancestors initially sparring with each other.
Ancestor Ming Sheng and Ancestor Mang would often engage in verbal battles, both openly and discreetly, over who was truly Shouzhe’s maternal family.
Nowadays, one side claimed blood ties, while the other claimed righteousness.
Naturally, neither side was willing to concede.
And so, the scene continued here.
"Play the festive music." Lua Zhengjie, who had been personally briefed by Ancestor Ming Sheng before coming, started the carefully prepared drum and percussion band.
Immediately, the sound of drums and cymbals rang out, creating a lively atmosphere.
The onlookers all cheered.
"Is that it?"
Having also been briefed by Ancestor Mang, Gongsun Qiang showed a disdainful expression, "Brother Lua, you’re working for your nephew, can you show a bit more care."
Saying this, Gongsun Qiang clapped his hands.
Afterward, a small troupe that had been at the back of the convoy sprang into action; they were an acrobatic team, dressed up elaborately, flipping and dancing, even performing fire-breathing acts occasionally.
It was quite lively, and it immediately drew the attention of the audience. Even many collateral members of the Liua Family started to gather around, watching and cheering.
"This acrobatic troupe I invited from Longzuo County," Gongsun Qiang said proudly, "Many noble families in Longzuo County hire their troupe for weddings. Our ancestor said that Shouzhe is our Gongsun Family’s legitimate grandson. On the day of the grand wedding, we must make it as grand as possible and spare no detail."
Within the procession, Wang Shouzhe looked helpless. These two uncles had been bickering all the way here, neither willing to back down. But he couldn’t intervene in such matters, and besides, at a wedding, liveliness and challenges were quite normal.
Who could have anticipated!
Wang Shouzhe’s younger uncle, Lua Zhengjie, smirked, "Is that it?"
Then, he solemnly took a red fan out from a jade box, and as soon as it appeared, a wave of heat swept out.
"Li Fire Fan?"
Wang Shouzhe was stunned, no way! Just to gain prestige, the Lua Family even brought out the Li Fire Fan. That thing is a Spiritual Artifact, a killing weapon on the battlefield!
Lua Zhengjie, with a serious expression, said, "To make this scene happen, the ancestor allowed me to use this fan, after infusing it with the energy of five Fire Spirit Stones, and spending a month training it."
With that said, he waved the fan.
Suddenly!
The Li Fire Fan burst into a bright blaze, and amidst the roaring flames, a magnificent phantom of a Fire Phoenix soared into the sky, flying gracefully, its flames bright and visually stunning.
Following that, another phantom of a Fire Phoenix soared out of the Li Fire Fan, playing and frolicking with the Fire Phoenix, like a pair of celestial lovers.
"Bravo!"
The crowd erupted into cheers; such a wedding scene was unheard of and unseen. Even the direct members of the Liua Family were drawn out of the main residence to watch the spectacle.
Wow!
Even with their broad experience, they had never seen anyone use a Spiritual Artifact for fireworks at a wedding~~
This Wang Family’s wedding procession really knew how to orchestrate events.
However, the livelier the procession, the more face it gave to the Liua Family.
This indicated that the marriage partner took this union very seriously and was making efforts sincerely.
If the procession came casually without any preparations and left hurriedly, it would embarrass the Liua Family and imply a lack of regard for their legitimate daughter.
When Chen Fangjie came to pick up his bride two months ago, it was naturally also a very lively affair at this stage. However, the scale of that event paled in comparison to the one orchestrated by Lua Zhengjie. Using a Spiritual Artifact filled with five Fire Spirit Stones just to create a grand display of fireworks was quite something.
The direct members of the Liua Family also beamed proudly; the Wang Family spared no effort.
Meanwhile, in the wedding party, Lua Zhengjie was quite elated, knowingly provoking, as he looked at Gongsun Qiang, saying, "My dear brother, it seems as if your status as an adopted grandson doesn’t hold the same weight as ours. We of the Lua Family are true dual blood relatives to Shouzhe."
Everyone present was stunned; given the situation, does the Gongsun Family have an ace up their sleeve? Expectantly, the onlookers and Liua members eagerly watched.

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 125: Brother-in-law! Brother-in-law’s wife’s brother! When will the cycle of revenge end?
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 125: Brother-in-law! Brother-in-law’s wife’s brother! When will the cycle of revenge end?
...
Wang Shouzhe was also taken aback, surprised that Gongsun Qiang, who seemed not entirely reliable in emotional intelligence, would have such a hidden card?
It was only then that he remembered.
It seemed that before Gongsun Qiang came, he had brought two carriages alone, and no one knew what was loaded in those carriages?
Could it be... inside those carriages...
Just when everyone was full of suspicion.
Suddenly.
The doors of the last two carriages in the procession were opened, and from each emerged a massive object.
"Boom!" "Boom!"
Accompanied by two loud crashes, the stone pavement shattered.
What appeared before everyone’s eyes were two giant statue-like figures.
They stood more than ten feet tall, broad, and portly, their whole bodies seemingly cast from some kind of dark crystal stone, exuding an aura of endless power.
"What is this?"
Some direct descendants of the Shanyin Liu Family among the onlookers changed their expressions drastically, "Are these the two Inkstone Puppets of the Shanyang Gongsun Family?"
The Liu Family was not unfamiliar with these two puppets.
The Shanyin Liu Family and the Shanyang Gongsun Family were separated by only a ridge. To be precise, they shared the same ridge.
With shared jurisdiction over this territory, conflicts were bound to arise.
Conflicts between the two families due to mineral resources were not a one-time or two-time occurrence, leaving some lingering resentment.
These two Inkstone Puppets usually stayed in the Gongsun Family’s mines for mountain opening and mining, but when conflicts arose, they would occasionally appear in brawls.
Their power was immense, and they seemed impervious to blades and spears. Except for the intervention of the Liu Family’s Ancestor, no one could suppress these two Inkstone Puppets.
After suffering several losses, the Liu Family had begun to consider acquiring their own puppets to guard the disputed mines.
They had found a seller through Ancestor Xuanfu’s connections.
Unexpectedly, Gongsun Qiang had brazenly brought these two Inkstone Puppets to the Liu Family’s territory, truly daring beyond belief.
Wang Shouzhe was also dumbfounded.
Oh dear uncle, aren’t you just organizing a wedding? Do you really need to go as far as staging a raid?
The most astonishing thing was that the chests of the two Inkstone Puppets each had a drum hanging from them. The drums were specially-made giant battlefield drums, around ten feet in diameter and weighing over a thousand pounds, which even ordinary Black Tortoise Practitioners would struggle to lift.
Yet, when hung on the two puppets, they stayed perfectly stable without any signs of strain.
Gongsun Qiang took out a Small Array Disc. The disc was entirely made of inkstone, engraved with many peculiar runes.
With one palm pressed against the disc, Profound Qi continuously surged into it.
Strange events began to unfold.
The two Inkstone Puppets suddenly moved.
"Boom!"
Their sledgehammer-like fists pounded the giant drums fiercely, causing the war drums to erupt in an earth-shattering roar, making one’s eardrums tremble and heart race.
"Boom!"
"Boom boom!"
As their fists thundered continuously on the giant drums, the rhythm of the drumbeats quickened, and an upbeat welcoming bridal drum melody was spontaneously performed by them.
Even the heavy footsteps of the Inkstone Puppets seemed to blend with the drum music, making the atmosphere more joyous, and the tune more rousing.
The scene was as shockingly grand as it could get.
Wang Shouzhe was stunned.
Oh, uncle, your mind is truly extraordinary.
The faces of the Liu Family members also grew very peculiar. They stared in disbelief at this scene, wondering whether Gongsun Qiang was here to celebrate his nephew’s wedding or to cause trouble?
At this moment, they were at a loss for how to handle the situation.
The common folks, on the other hand, were not burdened with such concerns. Initially shocked, they soon became exceptionally excited. Cheers erupted one after another, their volume echoing like a tidal wave across the sky.
Gongsun Qiang, seeing this, grew more and more exhilarated.
He continued to control the Small Array Disc in his hand, speeding up the rhythm of the Inkstone Puppets’ drumming, making the drum music even more powerful, the rhythm even livelier.
Even though the scene was impressive, the Inkstone Puppets were so heavy that every step left behind a series of craters in the stone pavement, turning the blue stone road in front of the Liu Family’s gate into a disaster zone.
The expressions on the faces of the Liu Family members became even more odd and suspicious.
It was clear Gongsun Qiang was using the wedding celebration as a pretext to cause trouble, to damage their Liu Family’s property.
Yet, they had no evidence.
"Nephew, isn’t this a great trick? I put these two Inkstone Puppets on hold for two whole months to train and coax them into this performance." Gongsun Qiang grinned at Wang Shouzhe, full of pride, "Doesn’t the sound of the war drum, ’Phoenix Seeking its Mate,’ sound great? I really upped the ante for you, didn’t I?"
Wang Shouzhe’s face darkened, oh uncle, thank you indeed.
Looking at the expressions on the Liu Family members’ faces, had today not been a day of great joy, they might have skinned and beat you thoroughly, then chased you out of Shanyin Town.
Meanwhile, Lua Zhengjie stood there, helplessly, and admitted, "Gongsun Qiang, you’ve won!"
"I concede!"
Although the scenario was somewhat bizarre, the actual effect was quite good. The emotions of all the onlooking townsfolk were ignited, they danced happily along with the strong rhythm of the drum beats.
Consequently, even the Liu Family couldn’t find any faults and allowed Gongsun Qiang to continue his antics. After all, he was technically the groom’s legitimate uncle, assisting with the wedding proceedings.
With the two Inkstone Puppets leading the way, and the Fire Phoenix and Fire Phoenixy performing a resonant dance above, the Wang Family’s wedding procession, surrounded by the excited townsfolk, merrily proceeded to the entrance of the Liu Family’s main residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 125 Brother-in-law! Brother-in-law’s Brother! When Will the Cycle of Vengeance End_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 125 Brother-in-law! Brother-in-law’s Brother! When Will the Cycle of Vengeance End_2
The two uncles finally withdrew their divine techniques, the Fire Phoenix and Fire Phoenixy in the sky disappeared, and the Inkstone Puppet in front also treaded heavily back to the carriage.
"The Wang Family’s groom, Wang Shouzhe, has arrived."
The main gate of the Liua family’s main residence was already wide open. As Liua Gaoyun announced loudly, several key family members of the Liua family immediately came out of the residence to greet the Wang Family’s wedding party according to the customs, leading them through the main gate.
The accompanying family members and attendants were all entertained by Liua family members, except for Wang Shouzhe who was invited into the main hall.
The main hall of Liua’s residence was already grand in layout, and today it was decorated in a splendid manner. The large red character for happiness and silk flowers symbolizing joy were everywhere, creating a joyful and festive scene.
The Liua Clan Leader, Liua Gaowang, and the mother-in-law, Xu, were both dressed in solemn formal attire reserved for significant occasions, sitting righteously while waiting for Wang Shouzhe to come and pay respects.
Wang Shouzhe straightened his demeanor, immediately adjusted his clothing, and respectfully stepped forward to greet, "Shouzhe pays respects to Father-in-law, Mother-in-law."
Father-in-law Liua Gaowang coughed, and instantly a personal steward stepped respectfully forward to help Wang Shouzhe up.
"Good, good, good~" Mother-in-law Xu carefully examined Wang Shouzhe, becoming more satisfied the longer she looked, "Shouzhe is indeed as handsome and charming as the rumors say. Come, come, sit down, have some tea and pastries."
Wang Shouzhe sat down as instructed, keeping his back straight without any hint of negligence.
After having some tea and pastries, and exchanging a few pleasantries, this part of the ceremony was considered complete.
Mother-in-law Xu said, "Shouzhe, the auspicious time is almost here. Ruolan is waiting for you in the backyard, you should go ahead."
"Yes. I shall take my leave now."
Wang Shouzhe stood up, paid his respects, then respectfully exited the main hall, leading a group of young companions towards the courtyard.
Liua Family’s main residence, the courtyard.
The layout here was square, with flower gardens, trees, and a large hard stone ground area that could serve as a martial arts arena.
At the same time, the courtyard also had connecting corridors linking various doors and courtyards.
If one wanted to go to the backyard to fetch the bride without climbing over the wall, this was the place to go through.
It was precisely in this "strategic location" that the Liua family’s young generation with the character ’Yuan’, and even some with the character ’Wan’, had gathered here for a long time, each one excitedly rubbing their hands in anticipation.
The leader was Liua Yuanrui, the second legitimate son of the Yuan generation. Among the young people under eighteen, he was the one with the highest status and prestige.
Today, Liua Yuanrui had changed from his usual elegant attire to a more luxurious and festive outfit. He gathered his hands in his sleeves, gazing sternly across the crowd, "Did you all understand what I just instructed?"
"Understood!" The unmarried and spirited young people of the Liua family responded loudly and energetically.
"Our slogan is..."
"Brother-in-law, brother-in-law, my sister is the boss." "Patriarch, patriarch, don’t show off." "For big and small matters, the wife decides." "If you dare disagree, consult the aunts and uncles."
The sound was resonant and the momentum was formidable, making the air tremble faintly.
"Oh, Yuan Rui, you’re making quite the ruckus here." Just then, Wang Shouzhe and a group of young brothers walked into the courtyard, and upon seeing this scene, he understood they had entered the next phase of fetching the bride.
Liua Yuanrui also greeted with a full smile, clasping his hands in a graceful manner, "Brother-in-law, you’ve finally arrived. Yuan Rui has been waiting here for quite some time."
Wang Shouzhe glanced at the groups of young people from eight or nine to seventeen or eighteen years old, each eyeing him with a "predatory look," instantly giving him a bit of goosebumps, with a hint of guilt, "Yuan Rui, we have been friends for a long time, our relationship is as close as real brothers. You know of my character. Why not skip these outdated formalities?"
Liua Yuanrui hadn’t spoken yet.
Brother-in-law Chen Fangjie chuckled and said, "Shouzhe, I remember two months ago, when I went to your house to fetch the bride. I asked you the same thing, and what did you say to me then?"
"Uh... alright." Wang Shouzhe replied honestly and helplessly, "I said at the time, it’s a wedding, it’s once in a lifetime, it should be lively and ceremonial. When you grow old, you’ll have more memories."
"Thanks to Shouzhe’s care, the memories of my wedding are unforgettable and forever etched in my heart," Chen Fangjie said, becoming slightly emotional, "During that phase of the wedding, Shouzhe, he, he too, too..."
Even now, recalling those memories makes him tear up. Marrying a wife isn’t easy.
"Brother-in-law, you rushed to help with the wedding this time." Wang Shouzhe suddenly realized, "You’ve been waiting for me here, truly the retribution of Heavenly Dao."
"Oh not, oh not," Chen Fangjie, having spent more time with Wang Shouzhe, had developed a rather thick skin, "I simply did not want Shouzhe’s wedding to have any regrets."
Liua Yuanrui also grinned, "Brother-in-law’s words always inspire deep reflection for Yuan Rui. Since that’s the case, let’s not waste your precious time and start the ceremony immediately."
"Yuan Rui, you are a scholar, be civil." Wang Shouzhe realized he couldn’t avoid this stage, so he clasped his hands while also threatening slightly, "You are sixteen years old this year, you’ll have to marry eventually as well."
"Naturally, naturally, I am a scholar and have a brotherly bond with you, I certainly wouldn’t make it difficult for you." Liua Yuanrui politely gave a salute, then asked, "Brother-in-law, are you ready?"
"I am ready." Wang Shouzhe took a deep breath to stabilize himself.
"Ahem!" Liua Yuanrui suddenly became energetic, eloquently saying, "In our Black Tortoise Clan, the most important thing is the character ’Martial’. Without martial power, how can you protect your family? Brother-in-law, do I make sense?" Liua Yuanrui smiled and looked at Wang Shouzhe.
"You make sense." Wang Shouzhe nodded.
He had to admit this point.
"However, today is the joyful day of Brother-in-law and sister’s wedding; it’s inappropriate to brandish weapons. How about this, Brother-in-law, show a little strength today, and you’ll pass the test." Liua Yuanrui said politely.
"It’s that simple?"
Wang Shouzhe became suspicious.
"It’s that simple," Liua Yuanrui smiled and nodded, "You are my real brother-in-law, how could I, as a little brother-in-law, make things difficult for you?"
As he spoke, he raised his hands and gently clapped his palms together.
Suddenly.
A deep voice came from the corridor behind them: "I am here, Yuan Rui."
With the words, a series of "boom boom boom" heavy footsteps followed.
A nine-foot-tall giant, carrying a large stone ball on his shoulder, strode over. His physique was extremely sturdy, covered with muscle knots, and his face was full of a bearded grin, resembling a fierce god-like general on a battlefield.
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched, sensing something was amiss.
The giant dropped the large stone ball with a "bang." The heavy bluestone ground was immediately dented with a pit.
Liua Yuanrui smirked towards Wang Shouzhe, cupping his hands, "Brother-in-law ~ our relationship as close as real brothers prevents me from making things hard for you. If you can lift this stone ball over your head, you’ve passed, and we young brothers and sisters will acknowledge your ability to protect sister."
"This..." A drop of cold sweat appeared on Wang Shouzhe’s forehead, his expression skeptical, "Yuan Rui, this is not right, is it? This phase seems to be for unmarried peers or younger generation, what is this uncle doing here?"
Liua Yuanrui chuckled, "Brother-in-law, this is our Yuan generation younger brother."
He turned to the giant, "Come, Yuanqiang, tell brother-in-law how old you are."
The giant scratched his head and smiled simply at Wang Shouzhe, "Brother-in-law, my name is Liua Yuanqiang, and I am eighteen years old."
Eighteen years old!
Wang Shouzhe was stunned.
It took him a good while to recover, then he coughed awkwardly, "This Yuanqiang brother looks... quite, quite mature, doesn’t he?"
Liua Yuanrui, still smiling like a weasel that stole the mother hen, replied, "Brother-in-law, Yuanqiang has been cultivating the Horizontal Refining Technique since childhood, practicing so much that he looks more mature."
Mature! You call this mature?!
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched, silently critiquing in his heart. This rascal Yuan Rui, a scholar’s shamelessness exceeds even that of a Black Tortoise Practitioner.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 126 Mighty! Brother-in-law’s Dominance (5,000-word - requesting votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 126 Mighty! Brother-in-law’s Dominance (5,000-word Chapter requesting votes)
...
The crowd’s attention was all on Wang Shouzhe; nobody noticed a pretty young maid of sixteen or seventeen quietly appearing in the corner on the other side of the corridor.
Upon glimpsing this scene, the little maid immediately sprinted back at high speed, her face filled with gravity.
Shulan Courtyard.
Today is the bride’s day of joy.
Early in the morning, Shulan Courtyard had been cleaned multiple times, and even the green bricks on the corridors were washed with clean water, looking bright and new. All the lanterns under the corridors were replaced with red ones, and even the trees in the courtyard were hung with delicate red lanterns, creating an atmosphere full of festivity at a glance.
In the boudoir, the bride Liua Ruolan sat gracefully at the dressing table, surrounded by several graceful middle-aged women attentively helping her with her coiffure and makeup.
Because it was the grand occasion of marriage, and to prevent the rouge and powder from staining the wedding dress, the makeup needed to be finished first, and the hair styled, before putting on the wedding attire.
At this moment, only half of Liua Ruolan’s makeup was done, yet even so, her eyes were pure and bright as water, clear and transparent, but still retaining wisdom and liveliness. She wasn’t the kind of unparalleled celestial beauty rarely seen, yet she was considered extremely attractive. Just sitting there, she exuded the warm and reserved aura of a noble family’s daughter, with a subtle hint of elegance that ordinary girls from common families didn’t possess.
This elegance wasn’t cultivated from pampering but nurtured bit by bit from the solid foundation and strong strength of a prosperous clan, which is challenging for outsiders to emulate.
However, perhaps too nervous today, her delicate body was somewhat tense, and her long eyelashes trembled involuntarily.
"Miss Ruolan, every girl has to go through this one day. Besides, I’ve heard that the new groom is talented and handsome, with exceptional character—he’s such a desirable husband."
The experienced beautician comforted her softly.
"Hmm, thank you, Sixth Aunt." She nodded slightly in gratitude, her eyes revealing a trace of anticipation and shyness.
The beautician was skillful; in no time, she styled her hair elegantly.
Her lips were also coated with bright red lipstick, the vibrant color contrasting her fair and delicate skin, making her even more stunning and captivating, like a blooming peony.
Liua Ruolei watched her sister’s radiant beauty from the side, slightly envious: "Sister, you look so beautiful today, like a goddess from the heavens. Brother-in-law is so fortunate to marry you; it’s the greatest blessing."
Hearing Liua Ruolei’s words, the beautician nearby covered her mouth with a giggle, teasingly adding: "If Ruolei is envious, I can help you find some suitable unmarried desirable husband from somewhere."
The speaking beautician was named Wang Liuzi, the fourth in the Liu generation of the Wang family’s womenfolk, married into a distinguished direct line of the Liua family.
Had she married into another family, she would have returned to the Wang family recently to assist.
Having her accompany Liua Ruolan now, instead, emphasized their closeness.
Liua Ruolei blushed and quickly changed the subject: "Yuan Rui has been gearing up since early morning, saying he wants to assert himself for you, sister. I wonder how it’s going now?"
Just as she spoke, a pretty maid suddenly rushed in from the door.
Her expression was slightly anxious, and as soon as she entered, she exclaimed urgently, "Miss, it’s not good. Young Master Yuan Rui is too much."
"Sister still..."
Liua Ruolei hadn’t finished her sentence; upon hearing this, her expression tightened suddenly, quickly asking, "Qiao’Er, what happened?"
"Young Master Yuan Rui brought Young Master Yuanqiang, saying he wants the new groom to lift such a big, heavy stone ball." As she spoke, Qiao’Er gestured with her hands, indicating the stone ball used in Young Master Yuanqiang’s practice, weighing a good two thousand pounds, even Young Master Yuanhui finds it very challenging to lift."
Qiao’Er said worriedly, "The new groom is so handsome, what if he gets hurt?"
The middle-aged beautician nearby giggled discreetly: "Qiao’Er, your Miss Ruolan hasn’t even married yet, and you’re already worried about the new groom. Aren’t you embarrassed~"
"Don’t worry, Yuan Rui is a scholar and knows the rules; he won’t act recklessly." Another accompanying middle-aged beautician also laughed, "The new groom is here to pick up the bride. If we don’t curb his vigor now, won’t our Ruolan suffer when she marries? Yuan Rui is just being considerate of his sister."
"But these are just conventional customs. If one wants a harmonious marriage and a prosperous family, they must be virtuous and meticulous, always considering for their husband to earn respect, rather than constantly relying on the maternal family for support."
Liua Ruolan’s eyes moved slightly, but she still couldn’t rest assured, but said softly and melodiously, "Ruolei, go check for me, don’t let Yuan Rui and those kids go too far, just make sure it’s lively."
"Yes, sister. I’ll go now."
Lia Ruolei couldn’t sit still either, worried about her brother-in-law, bid farewell, and immediately dashed away.
...
Meanwhile, in the courtyard.
"Yuan Rui, if I can’t pass this hurdle, what should be done?" Wang Shouzhe, knowing Yuan Rui and his group were just playing around, naturally wasn’t bothered, smiling as he cooperated and asked.
Lia Yuanrui kept his hands in his sleeves calmly, smiling gently, "Brother-in-law, you know, just admit defeat, and all the hurdles will be over."
Wang Shouzhe knew, this was the custom among the Black Tortoise Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 126 Mighty! Brother-in-law’s Dominance (5,000-word - requesting votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 126 Mighty! Brother-in-law’s Dominance (5,000-word Chapter requesting votes)_2
The brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law will give the brother-in-law a hard time before the sister gets married, which is called standing up for the sister. It’s to make sure the brother-in-law won’t let the sister be wronged in the husband’s family.
Of course, it’s just a traditional custom. Nowadays, it’s become a part of the wedding process, mainly to create an atmosphere and have fun.
"Yuan Rui, you’ll have to marry a wife someday too, so don’t blame me for participating in the wedding then," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "You know my tricks, so why don’t we just call it quits to avoid endless retaliations?"
Unexpectedly, Yuan Rui said nonchalantly, "I don’t mind. I’m a scholar, what’s wrong with admitting defeat? Anyway, I’ll rely on my wife to protect me then."
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat, indeed shamelessness is invincible.
In a past life, author Old Ao once said, when you decide to break the pot and fall, you’ll find the world suddenly becomes clear.
It seems there’s some truth to it.
"Brother-in-law, if it doesn’t work, just admit defeat."
"Yes, yes, my sister will cover for you in the future."
The brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law all started heckling.
Chen Fangjie also laughed gleefully from the side.
Looking back two months ago, Wang Shouzhe treated him just like this, that’s what they call the tables have turned. At the time, he couldn’t withstand those tricks and had to admit defeat on the spot.
"Well... as for my own wife, admitting defeat is nothing." Wang Shouzhe, not thin-skinned, continued smilingly, "Just that, I still want to try; if it doesn’t work, then I’ll admit defeat."
"Brother-in-law is bold, brother-in-law is awesome."
Cheers came from the brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law around. Each of them was watching eagerly, wanting to see how the brother-in-law would lift the stone ball.
"Shouzhe, be careful not to strain your back. It would be bad if it affects the wedding night." Chen Fangjie gloated on the side, chuckling "hehe."
Really an old married man, the thickness of his skin is not on the same level as these young guys and girls.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t bother with him, bent down and patted the large stone ball, and said to Liua Yuanqiang, "Yuanqiang, this big stone ball of yours is probably one or two thousand pounds, right?"
Liua Yuanqiang chuckled foolishly, "Brother-in-law, this stone ball of mine is two thousand pounds now."
"Goodness, your Horizontal Training isn’t shallow." Wang Shouzhe praised.
But it still felt strange to have this burly man calling him brother-in-law, an indescribable weirdness.
"Fourth Brother, be careful."
Wang Shouyong and Wang Shoulian on the side expressed concern.
After all, they are real brothers, and at critical moments, they are reliable and considerate to their elder brother.
"Don’t worry, I’m just trying it out."
Wang Shouzhe casually reassured them, then placed his hand on the stone ball, slightly pushed it, feeling for the grip.
Suddenly.
He pressed, twisted, and lifted with both hands, and the huge stone ball was forcibly pulled up by him, easily being lifted above his head.
How could this be possible?
Liua Yuanrui, Chen Fangjie, and others’ smiles instantly froze on their faces.
The scene before them stunned them all, even the burly giant Liua Yuanqiang looked amazed, dumbfounded, in a state of disbelief.
This stone ball is two thousand pounds, and even he struggles to lift it.
"Brother-in-law, you’re amazing, amazing, I’m impressed, I’m impressed."
The burly giant has a straightforward personality, and after reacting, his face was full of admiration.
The other brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law, after a brief daze, also cheered: "Brother-in-law, well done! Truly strong, a good man!"
The Black Tortoise World is just so simple. If you’re strong, it’s easy to win others over.
"Yuan Rui, is this considered passing? Am I qualified to protect your sister?"
Wang Shouzhe smiled at Liua Yuanrui, looking as calm as ever.
He was holding the stone ball, still seeming to have some energy left.
Nobody knew, but with the awakening of Wang Shouzhe’s bloodline, his physical fitness was improving day by day. Coupled with his daily strength training and constant practice, he was quite confident in terms of strength.
Yuan Rui’s challenge was basically serving him on a silver platter.
It took Liua Yuanrui quite an effort to snap out of the shock, shaking his head with a wry smile: "It’s Yuan Rui who underestimated his brother-in-law. Brother-in-law’s strength is impressive, and protecting my sister is no problem now."
"Hehe~"
Wang Shouzhe chuckled, suddenly shouting at Liua Yuanqiang: "Big guy, catch it!"
With that, he gave his arm a twist, the stone ball spun and flew towards the burly Liua Yuanqiang not far away.
Liua Yuanqiang hurriedly caught it with both hands.
The stone ball kept spinning on his hands, shaking him back several steps, almost slipping out of his grip.
Luckily, luckily~ fortunately I reacted fast, or I’d have made a fool of myself. Liua Yuanqiang was secretly shocked, just about to put the stone ball down.
Before he could act, Wang Shouzhe approached, grabbed his waist with both hands, and lifted him up.
In an instant, Liua Yuanqiang felt himself lift off the ground.
Then, he quickly descended, settling halfway in the air.
He was a bit dumbfounded, not knowing what happened. His head was buzzing, feeling a bit light-headed.
All around there was an uproar, although he didn’t know, others could see clearly.
It turned out that after Wang Shouzhe threw him into the air, he grabbed his legs with both hands and lifted him like King lifting the cauldron.

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 126 Mighty! Brother-in-law’s Dominance (5,000-word - requesting votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 126 Mighty! Brother-in-law’s Dominance (5,000-word Chapter requesting votes)_3
The little brothers and sisters-in-law were left utterly stunned.
Is brother-in-law really that formidable?
With such terrifying strength, forget about Yuanqiang—even if Yuanhui, the eldest son of the direct lineage, were here, he’d be far inferior.
Just like that.
Liua Yuanrui completely surrendered, with a wry smile saying, "Brother-in-law, please let Yuanqiang down. He’s still young, don’t scare him."
"Okay, fine."
The words "he’s still young" gave Wang Shouzhe a shiver all over, almost causing him to lose strength.
With a gentle release, Wang Shouzhe lightly placed the burly Liua Yuanqiang back onto the ground.
Casually, he tucked a red envelope into Yuanqiang’s arms and patted him on the shoulder, "Yuanqiang, go have fun."
"Thank you, brother-in-law."
Liua Yuanqiang happily hugged his stone ball and trotted off joyfully, soon disappearing from sight.
After this episode, the way everyone looked at Wang Shouzhe had changed, with a hint of reverence and admiration.
Meanwhile.
The young maid Qiao’Er, who was standing at the end of the verandah, was also blushing with excitement, immediately turning around and running back to the courtyard.
"Miss, Miss! The new brother-in-law is amazing! Such great strength, even Young Master Yuanqiang can’t compare." She said excitedly, vividly recounting the earlier events to Liua Ruolan.
Fourth Aunt Wang Liuzi joyfully said, "He is indeed a prodigy of our Wang Family, my nephew Shouzhe is truly extraordinary."
"The new brother-in-law’s strength is unexpectedly immense?" The two middle-aged ladies were also slightly shocked, then chuckled ambiguously, "Our Ruolan sure is blessed."
At this moment, the clever bride Liua Ruolan looked a bit bewildered, her beautiful face in a daze.
It’s certainly good for a man to be strong, but how does that relate to blessings? Completely puzzled, she was deep in thought.
At this moment, after reporting back, the young maid Qiao’Er had sprinted out again to continue observing the proceedings at the front.
Meanwhile, in the middle courtyard.
Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands, "Yuan Rui, is it about time I fetch your sister?"
By now, Liua Yuanrui had recovered from his shock and continued with a smiling, courteous gesture, "Brother-in-law, I do want to let you pass, but you have to see if the brothers and sisters agree."
Saying this, he turned to glance at the younger brothers and sisters behind him.
The younger brothers and sisters immediately perked up, shouting in unison, "We don’t agree, it’s not exciting enough! Brother-in-law, do it again!"
"Alright~ If Yuan Rui has more tricks, just bring them on. I’ll do whatever I can, and if I can’t, I’ll admit defeat."
Wang Shouzhe knew that what he had just done probably wouldn’t be enough to handle this pack of wolf-like little brats and girls.
"Brother-in-law is bold!" Liua Yuanrui laughed, cupping his hands, "Then I will be impolite."
"Our Black Tortoise Clan has always opened up lands. Why? People live for food. If Third Sister is marrying into your Wang Family, there should be food. Brother-in-law, isn’t that so?"
"That’s the reason." Wang Shouzhe nodded in agreement.
"So how do you get meat to eat? Naturally, by hunting. Our Black Tortoise ancestors fed their families through hunting, and hunting emphasizes archery. In that case, brother-in-law, show us your archery skills."
Wang Shouzhe did very much want to say, meat can also be obtained by farming, but to cooperate with Liua Yuanrui’s enthusiasm, he had to swallow the words.
"Alright then, Yuan Rui, get a bow and arrow for me." Wang Shouzhe was quite confident in his archery. Originally, his archery was excellent, and after the bloodline awakening, he improved by leaps and bounds.
This point, he himself couldn’t quite understand, even the Ancestor was somewhat puzzled. However, compared to the explosive War Body types, his power still fell short, and his archery didn’t reach the heights of certain natural sharpshooter bloodlines.
In summary, he’s very strong in all aspects, but not the absolute best in any.
Unexpectedly, Liua Yuanrui laughed again, "What’s the point of displaying archery alone? I’ve already set up an opponent for brother-in-law."
Saying this, he clapped his hands twice.
As the applause faded, a slender shadow responded, rolling in from outside the courtyard wall.
He continuously stepped in mid-air, his body technique was extraordinary, landing in front of Wang Shouzhe within two or three breaths.
Wang Shouzhe examined him carefully, seeing his slim yet refined physique, although his features appeared somewhat sly and old-looking. With arrows hanging at his waist and a bow slung over his back, he was clearly a skilled archer and hunter.
Only, this person seemed too mature in appearance, probably looking about thirty or forty years old.
Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised and hesitated, "Yuan Rui, could this be another brother?"
Liua Yuanrui shook his head, "No, it’s not."
He leisurely gazed at the newcomer, "Brother Yuanshan, introduce yourself to your brother-in-law."
The lean man nodded, respectfully cupping his hands towards Wang Shouzhe, "Hello, brother-in-law. I’m Liua Yuanshan, forty years old, unmarried."
The words "unmarried" were emphasized as if to express his eligibility to participate in this game.
"Um... this..."
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat.
This brother is quite honest, but being unmarried at forty doesn’t seem like something to brag about, does it?
"Brother-in-law, are you despising me?" Liua Yuanshan looked at Wang Shouzhe with a faint sadness.
"How could I?" Wang Shouzhe laughed, "Brother Yuanshan joining the game adds color to my wedding, it’s most welcome."
"If that’s the case, let’s start the next game." Liua Yuanrui chuckled, "Brother-in-law, please look over there, there are large copper coins hanging."
He said, gesturing to the other side of the courtyard, indicating to Wang Shouzhe to look over.
Wang Shouzhe looked, but saw nothing.
He suspiciously glanced at Liua Yuanrui, "Where?"
"Look further."
Liua Yuanrui continued to smile broadly.
Wang Shouzhe looked again but still saw nothing.
"Further."
As if anticipating Wang Shouzhe’s reaction, Liua Yuanrui calmly added.
Wang Shouzhe followed his direction, looking further and further, eventually spotting large copper coins hanging on a tree over ten zhang away.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t speak, but Chen Fangjie beside him gasped, "Yuan Rui, do you need to make it this tough? You’ve got to give your brother-in-law some face."
Though he said this aloud, in private, he gave a thumbs-up: well done.
Liua Yuanrui returned a triumphant look to him, it was Brother Chen who wrote to advise them well.
Thereafter, both shared a knowing, conspiratorial smile, as if they were already assured of victory.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 127: The Phoenix Falls to a Treasure Land, Awakening the Hidden Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 127: The Phoenix Falls to a Treasure Land, Awakening the Hidden Dragon
...
At this moment, Liua Ruolei pushed through the crowd and gave Liua Yuanrui a hard pinch: "Brother~ just give in a little, you don’t really want to embarrass Brother-in-law, right? Be careful or sister will deal with you later."
"Oh, my dear sister. I’m just standing up for sister, aren’t I? This is a traditional thing among noble families, and our Liua Family is well-known, we can’t lose this custom." This pinch completely deflated Liua Yuanrui’s smug mood.
"I don’t care, it’s sister’s wish anyway." Liua Ruolei snorted cutely, "If you don’t listen, I’ll go inform sister right now."
Liua Yuanrui couldn’t help but shiver; he knew full well his sister Liua Ruolan’s temperament. Don’t be fooled by her graceful, gentle, and virtuous appearance, if you really anger her, it’s a serious matter.
If it came to that point, not to mention Liua Yuanrui, even if his father Liua Gaowang came to persuade her, it would be of no use, he would be finished.
Liua Yuanrui was quite helpless, and simply said alright alright, I’ll lower the difficulty for Brother-in-law.
"Brother-in-law, you just need to shoot down those three Large Copper coins from within half the distance, that’s five zhang, with consecutive arrows to win."
"That’s more like it." Liua Ruolei said with slight satisfaction, "Sister said, this kind of outdated custom is not good."
"Ruolei, I’m also an elder brother, don’t just say ’sister said’ all day." Liua Yuanrui protested slightly with a glare, "If you’re so capable, persuade those in-laws when I get married later."
"Hmph, like I care about your well-being." Liua Ruolei rolled her eyes slightly, "Anyway, don’t bully Brother-in-law."
With Liua Ruolei issuing the decree, the rest of the brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law trembled all over and immediately changed their stance. They felt that, hmm, reducing by half was about right, otherwise, it would be too much bullying of Brother-in-law.
Liua Yuanshan, though his cultivation and other aspects were mediocre, he was the top archery expert among the Yuan generation.
Moreover, he was already forty years old.
Brother-in-law is only nineteen, how could he compare?
The brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law all began to change their tune quickly, shifting to sympathizing with Brother-in-law’s position.
Such a rapid change in wind direction left Wang Shouzhe somewhat apprehensive, as his wife whom he hadn’t met seemed quite formidable.
Just by having Ruolei pass on a message, those fierce-looking kids were all behaving?
Could his wife be a tigress?
"Hey hey, Brother-in-law, what are you thinking?" Liua Yuanshan urged, "Are we still competing? Don’t worry, for Little Sister Ruolan’s sake, I will make sure you lose without any resistance, cleanly and neatly."
Wang Shouzhe was speechless, this face-saving gesture was really special.
No wonder at forty, he still hadn’t married a wife. Serves him right!
But while he was grumbling in his heart, he politely cupped his hands and said: "Brother Yuanshan, please."
The Liua Family was large and prosperous, and there were too many people in the Yuan generation, Wang Shouzhe didn’t even know what rank this one held.
Liua Yuanshan didn’t hesitate, and after a cheeky smile, he unfastened his bow and arrow.
Right from ten zhang away, he took aim and shot arrows.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh~ Three arrows almost simultaneously shot out with a sound.
The arrows were as fast as lightning, so fast that even the ordinary person’s vision could barely track them.
"Ding ding ding!"
With three consecutive loud bangs.
Three Large Coppers were almost simultaneously shot, shattering on impact. The arrows continued forward, embedding themselves firmly half a foot into a tree.
"Good, good archery!"
The surrounding sisters-in-law and brothers-in-law cheered loudly.
Obviously, they were all very satisfied with Liua Yuanshan’s archery, looking sharp and impressive, truly worthy of Brother Yuanshan, with such archery skills he could dominate most of the Qi Refining Realm.
But how could Brother Yuanshan, who was so good at archery, not find a wife? Sigh~~
At the same time.
Liua Yuanshan himself was also slightly proud, glancing at Wang Shouzhe with a look.
Just as he boasted before shooting, he wanted to make Wang Shouzhe lose cleanly and neatly, without any resistance.
"Brother-in-law." Liua Yuanrui calmly chuckled, "As long as you can do the same as Brother Yuanshan within that half distance, you pass. If you can’t, then just admit defeat, I’ve already given Brother-in-law enough face."
Is this giving face to Brother-in-law? You’re just afraid of being beaten by sister, aren’t you? Wang Shouzhe secretly pondered a sentence about him.
Then, he calmly and brightly smiled: "Hmm, I’ll still stick to the same words, giving in to the wife is no big deal. But I want to give it a try. As for that half distance, no need to yield, otherwise it would truly be admitting defeat."
"Okay, Brother-in-law is bold, then bring Brother-in-law the bow and arrow."
On Liua Yuanrui’s command, someone quickly brought over a strong bow.
Wang Shouzhe tested the feel, although the bow was a bit soft, making it ineffective against stronger fierce beasts, it was still usable for the competition at hand.
"Brother-in-law, you can do it." Liua Ruolei cheered from the side, "Stay steady, shoot well, just hitting one is enough."
As soon as Liua Ruolei spoke, the other brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law also joined in, shouting: "Brother-in-law, take your time, no rush. Brother Yuanshan has been single for forty years, he had plenty of time to practice his speed, you’re still young, it’s different."
Liua Yuanshan’s heart skipped a beat, Little Sister Ruolei’s words were quite hurtful. Also, what does being single have to do with practicing speed? He was confused, feeling that something was off.
At that moment, Wang Shouzhe stood under the gaze of everyone.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 127: Phoenix Lands on Treasure Ground, Rising Hidden Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 127: Phoenix Lands on Treasure Ground, Rising Hidden Dragon_2
Open the bow and shoot arrows.
Using the Continuous Arrow Technique as well.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh, three arrows were fired in succession.
As soon as Wang Shouzhe released the arrows, the Liua Ruolei’s side erupted in cheers.
No matter the outcome, at least brother-in-law’s posture is much more graceful than that of Liua Yuanshan.
The main thing is that when someone looks good, any posture looks good.
As for whether brother-in-law’s archery skills are outstanding, she doesn’t care. After all, brother-in-law is the clan leader, in hunting and such, naturally there are people who will rush out in front.
"Thunk! Thunk! Thunk!"
The three arrows almost simultaneously embedded into the tree, the arrows were strong and powerful, the shafts buried more than halfway deep.
Everyone fell silent in astonishment.
No way!
Brother-in-law didn’t even hit a single piece of Large Copper?
Although no one held much hope for brother-in-law’s archery skills, as a direct lineage Clan Leader, is it really alright for the archery to be so mediocre?
Suddenly.
"Ding ding ding!"
Three crisp sounds.
Three pieces of Large Copper almost simultaneously fell onto the bluestone ground, producing a series of crisp sounds.
What is going on? What exactly happened? The younger brothers- and sisters-in-law were all bewildered.
Only Liua Yuanshan widened his eyes, looking shocked at the scene.
A few breaths later, he reluctantly smiled and cupped his hands to Wang Shouzhe, saying, "Brother-in-law, I concede. Indeed, there are always people better than oneself, and mountains beyond mountains."
Even Chen Fangjie, who was grinningly watching the excitement on the side, was full of amazement. Shouzhe’s archery skills were truly astounding.
His three arrows actually severed the threads hanging the Large Copper pieces.
Wry smile!
Having never seen archery before, he thought Shouzhe’s skills were just average.
Shouzhe indeed is Shouzhe, truly incomparable.
"After all, he’s still my brother-in-law, a bit more impressive isn’t a loss," Chen Fangjie could only comfort himself this way.
With Liua Yuanshan explaining it on the side.
Those in the dark, the younger brothers- and sisters-in-law finally realized, surprised at brother-in-law’s archery being so superb.
"Brother-in-law deserves to be called brother-in-law, such a sharpshooter." Liua Ruolei cheered happily,
triggering Liua Yuanrui to be amused and annoyed.
I lost so miserably trying to back you, and you are laughing so happily?
Truly she is siding with outsiders, a girl cannot be kept when grown?
Wait a minute, cannot be kept?
Sister, oh sister, this is your brother-in-law, you must not have thoughts you shouldn’t have.
At the same time.
Once this scene ended.
The little maid, Qiao’Er, again dashed back to the backyard.
Her pretty face full of excitement, vividly described Wang Shouzhe’s heroic performance to everyone: "The new groom is so amazing, his archery is even better than Young Master Yuanhui." This young girl always pulled Liua Yuanhui out for comparison, not even caring about Young Clan Leader Yuanhui’s feelings.
The women inside the room all showed expressions of astonishment, all said that Wang Shouzhe was wise and resourceful, yet nobody expected his personal martial power to be so heroic.
Even Wang Liuzi was extremely surprised, her nephew truly gives people pleasant surprises.
The bride Liua Ruolan’s eyes.
Also showed slight joy and shyness, it was merely a family arranged marriage with no room for choice. But as her understanding of Wang Shouzhe grew deeper, her affection also grew.
What girl wouldn’t like her husband to be an outstanding man?
Beside her, Wang Liuzi covered her mouth with a playful laugh, somewhat proudly saying, "This time, Yuanrui is really out of options. Ruolan, let’s quickly prepare. My nephew is about to come in for the bridal escort."
Earlier, many Liua Family members had considerable opinions on the marriage, with much gossip in private. Wang Liuzi, being born of the Wang Family, was caught in the middle, hearing much of the rumors, even arguing with others many times.
But with the rise of the Wang Family, the idle chatter became much less. Now her nephew shows such great prowess, exuding awe among the Liua Family peers, allowing her, as an aunt, to feel full pride, able to straighten her back among the sisters-in-law and sisters of the Liua Family.
The reputation of being Wang Shouzhe’s fourth aunt, who dares to disdain her?
"Not at all." The little maid, Qiao’Er, pouted and said, "Young Master Yuanrui is very cunning, he has set up three stages."
"Having competed in archery and strength, is there yet another move Yuanrui has?" Wang Liuzi couldn’t help but ask curiously.
"This time Young Master Yuanrui said he would go himself."
"Go himself?"
Wang Liuzi laughed so hard she was about to shed tears, covering her mouth, "Considering Yuanrui’s Black Tortoise Combat Technique, how can he compete with Shouzhe? Isn’t this seeking abuse?"
Suddenly.
Wang Liuzi’s laughter abruptly stopped.
She realized something wasn’t right, her pretty face tensed, "Is Yuanrui going to challenge Shouzhe with that? This time Shouzhe might face defeat."
Meanwhile, in the atrium.
Wang Shouzhe was also astonished to hear Liua Yuanrui say, "Yuanrui, what did you say? You want to compete with me in poetry writing!"
He expressed great shock, a scholar of the Black Tortoise World actually wants to compete in poetry with a transmigrator from Earth?
This, this, this...what to do?
"Brother-in-law, I concede your Black Tortoise Combat Technique is impressive. But as a Black Tortoise Clan, passing down through generations, mere martial power isn’t enough. Otherwise, how are we different from the Outer Domain fierce beasts? Cultural heritage is also a treasure of humanity." Liua Yuanrui said earnestly.
Wang Shouzhe thought this sounded very familiar. Upon deeper reflection, it turned out to be his original words of encouragement to Wang Lici and Wang Luqiu, urging them to pursue education and cultural growth.
"Alright, I admit what you said makes sense. So please, Yuanrui, lay down the challenge," Wang Shouzhe said helplessly, "This is the final stage, right? We still need to hurry back to Ping’an today."

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 127: Phoenix Lands on Treasure Ground, Rising Hidden Dragon_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 127: Phoenix Lands on Treasure Ground, Rising Hidden Dragon_3
"Naturally, if my brother-in-law passes this last challenge, he can smoothly marry my sister," said Liua Yuanrui with an air of calm confidence, chuckling, "Of course, even if he fails, he can still marry my sister by admitting defeat."
"That’s fine, but like I said, admitting defeat doesn’t matter to me; I just want to give it a try," Wang Shouzhe replied with equal composure.
This was the third time Wang Shouzhe had said this sentence.
The first two times he ’gave it a try,’ he actually succeeded.
Could it be that a miracle would happen again this third time? The watching brothers- and sisters-in-law cheered enthusiastically, urging, "Brother-in-law, go for it! Take down Yuan Rui!"
Liua Yuanrui’s face darkened. Whose side are you siblings on anyway?
Nevertheless, Liua Yuanrui harbored full confidence in this final challenge. After all, isn’t poetry what scholars excel at?
If even this he could be outdone by his brother-in-law, then why study books at all?
"Brother-in-law, are you ready?" Liua Yuanrui asked with unshakeable confidence.
Wang Shouzhe smiled and said, "Yuan Rui, please give the topic, let’s not waste time."
Liua Yuanrui glanced around, smiling lightly, "Since today’s my sister’s wedding, naturally the topic should be her. Each of us will compose a poem, and let’s see who can praise her better."
The surrounding crowd cheered enthusiastically. This topic was fitting and could test the brother-in-law’s literary skill. Even if he couldn’t surpass Yuan Rui, as long as he did decently, he would be considered to have passed.
Wang Shouzhe pondered briefly and said, "Then please go ahead, Yuan Rui. Let me learn from you first."
Liua Yuanrui didn’t refuse, cleared his throat in a performative manner, thought for a moment, and then began to recite with a flourish.
...
The proud maiden in her boudoir hidden
Matchmakers brightened the doorstep stone.
Today she marries a Wang Family youth,
The phoenix alights, the hidden dragon’s growth.
...
Upon hearing the poem, the crowd erupted in overwhelming applause.
Even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but nod quietly, acknowledging that Yuan Rui, indeed a scholar, showed some skill.
Rather than directly proclaiming how wonderful his sister was, the poem elevated her through subtle backdrop.
Especially the last line, "The phoenix alights, the hidden dragon’s growth," instantly elevated the entire poem!
It praised his sister, while also extolling the Wang Family and Wang Shouzhe, with pleasant imagery of a treasured land and a hidden dragon.
Overall, the poem still mainly praised his sister, suggesting that by marrying Wang Shouzhe, she would significantly aid his future success—a daughter of prosperity.
Also telling Wang Shouzhe, it was a blessing to marry Ruolan.
The entire poem was quite flavorful and very fitting for the occasion.
"Brother-in-law, it’s your turn. No rush, take your time; we have all the time in the world," Liua Yuanrui said with a voice full of confident assurance.
No wonder, he had been working on this poem for three months, waiting for this very day. How could he not be confident?
"Alright, let me think for a moment."
Faced with such a fine poem, Wang Shouzhe dared not take it lightly.
Meanwhile.
Naturally, the poem was quickly conveyed to the back courtyard by the maidservant Qiao’Er.
After Liua Ruolan tasted a few lines of the poem, she personally transcribed it on paper, recounting each word carefully, her gaze hinting at relief, "Yuan Rui does care for his sister after all."
"Yuan Rui’s studies have not gone to waste," the middle-aged women around praised one after another.
Wang Liuzi suddenly grew worried, feeling a sense of trouble as Yuan Rui’s poem was extraordinarily good. Her nephew Shouzhe might be overshadowed!
"Seventh Aunt, it’s okay," Liua Ruolan gently held Wang Liuzi’s hand, reassuring her, "These three challenges are just for the young ones to enjoy. I... um, I..."
At this, her face flushed a delicate pink, full of shyness. In any case, she wouldn’t hold any prejudice even if he failed to write a good poem.
Oh well!
I’ll write one to support him a bit.
But Yuan Rui’s poem was excellent, and in a hurry, it would be hard to surpass, at most it might just help him save face.
With that thought, Liua Ruolan’s delicate jade-like hand took up the pen to write a poem.
"Qiao’Er, slip this to him secretly, don’t let anyone see."
The maidservant Qiao’Er was dumbstruck for a moment.
Miss, how am I supposed to secretly slip it to him in such a crowd?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 128: Marrying the Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 128: Marrying the Beauty
...
Alright!
Little maid Qiao’Er also felt helpless; you are the mistress, what you say goes.
Let me think of a way to figure out how to slip this poem to the new groom in front of everyone.
Meanwhile, in the courtyard.
Wang Shouzhe sat leisurely on the stone bench, pondering deeply.
To be honest, Yuan Rui’s poem put a lot of pressure on him.
Logically speaking, as a transmigrator, his mind is full of ancient poems. He could easily pull out a famous masterpiece that would effortlessly outshine Liua Yuanrui’s poem.
However, ultimately, this is his own wedding, and he still wants to try composing a poem himself. Even if it’s not very good, it’s still his own creation. Using someone else’s poems to deceive his wife just feels lacking.
Liua Yuanrui and the others didn’t rush him, they just watched him with smiles as he pondered hard. He knows that composing a poem isn’t easy, especially creating a good one requires careful thought.
Just at that moment.
Little maid Qiao’Er rushed out from the backyard, squeezed through the crowd, and collided heavily with Wang Shouzhe.
"Ah, sorry new groom, I walked too fast, did I hurt you?"
Just as Wang Shouzhe was dumbfounded, the girl cleverly slipped a piece of paper into his hand with a wink, suggesting him to understand.
And then she sprinted away.
This girl really came and went like the wind.
It left Wang Shouzhe a bit amused and helpless, feeling like the one behind couldn’t hold it in any longer and sent a little maid to deliver a poem to him.
Isn’t this cheating?
Alright, alright, how can a wife’s assistance to her husband be considered cheating?
This is called love!
Thinking of this, Wang Shouzhe felt a little touched, warm in his heart.
But Liua Yuanrui was stunned.
Wasn’t that the maid Qiao’Er from his sister’s side?
Rushing so recklessly into brother-in-law’s arms and slipping a piece of paper, did they think everyone was blind?
Isn’t this blatant cheating?
In an instant, Liua Yuanrui felt a wave of tears. I tried so hard to support my sister, how come one by one, they are all undermining it?
Even if it’s cheating, the technique is so clumsy and blatant, he feels utterly embarrassed.
Couldn’t the cheating technique be a little more clever, giving him a bit of face?
Qiao’Er’s technique was indeed clumsy.
The other brothers and sisters also saw this scene. But they all pretended to be deaf and dumb, acting like they hadn’t seen anything.
This clearly demonstrated the one in the backyard was helping the future brother-in-law cheat, under years of accumulated might, who dared to speak up?
Liua Yuanrui also helplessly said: "Brother-in-law almost ready, should we start?"
He thought since it’s his sister’s poem, no matter what, he had to cheer to support, otherwise, if his sister got angry, the consequences would be unimaginable.
His brothers and sisters also pretended: "Yes, brother-in-law should be ready, let’s start."
But Wang Shouzhe shook his head, saying, no, no, I haven’t finished thinking.
This made Liua Yuanrui roll his eyes.
How long do you plan to pretend? Clearly my sister already helped you cheat, yet you say you aren’t ready.
Fine, you perform then, since sister personally got involved.
Moments later, Wang Shouzhe finally stood up and said: "I’ve thought about it, Yuanrui’s poem is excellent. Brother-in-law can only attempt to show off, excuse me, excuse me."
"Alright, brother-in-law, let’s hear it."
The brothers and sisters began to cheer, eagerly anticipating. Everyone knew Wang Shouzhe’s poem was made by the sister in the backyard, no matter what, all they had to do was enthusiastically cheer.
Wang Shouzhe walked with his hands behind his back in the courtyard, after a few steps he recited the first line: "Divine Lady in the Immortal Palace cares for All Living Beings, wielding spear guarding all night at the celestial front."
"?"
Upon hearing, everyone’s mind instantly conjured up an image, as if talking about a Goddess in her Celestial Palace, worrying about All Living Beings, handling Mortal World affairs, an Immortal General guarding in front of the palace, accompanying her through the endless night.
Before they could savor it, Wang Shouzhe recited the second line: "Time revolves a thousand hundred times, finally gaining the paired branches in the Mortal World."
The brothers and sisters began to understand. This is telling a story, elder sister is the Goddess worried for the All Living Beings, brother-in-law is the silently guarding Celestial General, ultimately the Goddess perhaps went to save All Living Beings descending to the Mortal World, yet fatefully met brother-in-law to join together.
Sounds not bad, sister is elevated pretty high.
Then they began cheering loudly, this is the poem composed by the sister, and it seemed quite flavorful.
"No!" Liua Yuanrui was shocked, "This isn’t sister’s work. Sister wouldn’t possibly compare herself to a Goddess, and brother-in-law to a palace guard."
"Is that right?" The brothers and sisters realized, but they also said back, brother-in-law’s poem still tastes good, though perhaps missing something.
"Pretty good, brother-in-law showing such caliber, it’s considered having both literary and martial prowess."
"Indeed, though slightly inferior to Yuanrui’s poem, yet elevated sister very high." The Liua Family spares no effort in nurturing culture, everyone possesses some appreciation ability.
"Passed, passed." Liua Ruolei directly rejoiced, "Everyone step aside, don’t delay brother-in-law welcoming the bride."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 128: Marrying the Beautiful Lady_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 128: Marrying the Beautiful Lady_2
Even Chen Fangjie couldn’t help but admire, "I didn’t expect Shouzhe to have such a talent for poetry, even better than me by half a notch."
Suddenly!
Liua Yuanrui looked serious and stopped everyone, saying, "Everyone, hold on."
"Huh?" All eyes turned to Liua Yuanrui. Yuan Rui, are you serious? Brother-in-law’s poem is already quite good; you still want to make it difficult for him?
Liua Ruolei glared at him fiercely and disapprovingly, "Yuan Rui, don’t be too much."
"Don’t misunderstand, don’t misunderstand." Liua Yuanrui quickly raised his hands in surrender, "Brother-in-law’s poem is indeed nice, but I feel it’s lacking something. Brother-in-law, is there possibly a second half to this poem?"
The second half?
Everyone was taken aback. Yuan Rui seemed to have a point; the poem seemed incomplete, leaving a lingering mood.
Everyone looked questioningly at Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe wasn’t shy and continued to recite the second half of the poem: "Fearing my lovely wife flies with the wind, I deceived her saying the Celestial Palace is cold."
"?"
Everyone was stunned, drawn into the mindset of the brother-in-law. Imagine, a Palace Guard waiting patiently for countless years, finally marrying the Divine Lady in the Mortal World – naturally a great thing.
But he’s also worried that one day his beloved wife will ascend and leave him, so he resorted to deceiving her, saying the Celestial Palace is undesirable. This anxious and fearful feeling is fully displayed.
"Good, what a well-crafted line fearing my lovely wife flies with the wind, deceived saying Celestial Palace is cold," Liua Yuanrui applauded repeatedly.
The others joined in the applause.
Then, Wang Shouzhe recited the long-stewed final line: "Holding hands with children tearfully awaiting, praying to share the pillow for ten thousand lifetimes!"
As soon as this line was spoken,
everyone was stunned, with visions of brother-in-law Wang Shouzhe holding the hands of his children, tearfully watching the Divine Lady sister about to ascend, very reluctant to part. Even employing the as-yet-unborn children as a tactic – isn’t that shameless?
The last line was even more shameless, praying to share the pillow for ten thousand lifetimes.
This means marrying him for this lifetime isn’t enough; she has to marry him for ten thousand lifetimes? How shameless.
Indeed, there’s a poem as evidence:
The Divine Lady’s Immortal Palace pities All the Living Beings
Holding the spear in the Palace, guarding the long night
Time cycles a thousand times
Finally, the Mortal World connects the branch of love
Fearing my lovely wife flies with the wind
Deceived saying Celestial Palace is cold
Holding hands with children tearfully awaiting
Praying to share the pillow for ten thousand lifetimes
...
Everyone fell silent; this poem isn’t exactly a world-shattering masterpiece. But today’s theme is, after all, praising their sister Ruolan more eloquently.
Undoubtedly, Liua Yuanrui’s poem was very praiseworthy and lofty.
But Brother-in-law’s poem...
This is no longer praising.
It’s groveling.
Yet they are, after all, husband and wife, and his groveling skills are so masterful, so smooth and natural. This brother-in-law is truly a rare talent in the world of silver tongues.
"Alas~" Chen Fangjie sighed with hands behind his back, looking up, "I used to think my own groveling skills were unmatched. But compared to Shouzhe, it’s like the difference between clouds and mud. I acknowledge defeat! I bow in admiration!"
"Boo hoo~" Liua Yuanshan began to cry, sobbing grievously.
"Brother Yuanshan, why are you crying?"
"I understand now."
