```
"Brother Yuanshan, what have you realized?"
"I understand why I can’t get a wife."
"Brother Yuanshan, since you’ve realized it, there’s still hope. Keep it up."
"There’s no hope for me," Liua Yuanshan cried, tears flying as he ran away, shouting forlornly, "Because in this lifetime, I’ll never be able to create such shameless and ridiculously saccharine Y poems D words... boo hoo~" His figure, along with his crying, gradually faded until it disappeared.
Watching his retreating figure, everyone couldn’t help but reflect, Brother Yuanshan, not being able to get a wife isn’t just because you can’t compose Y poems.
Then everyone acknowledged Brother-in-law Wang Shouzhe; they could never match such groveling skills in poetry.
Even some of the sisters-in-law started getting out paper and pens, blushing deeply as they copied the poem. Although the poem wasn’t about them, savoring it every night was certainly wonderful.
Holding hands with children tearfully awaiting, praying to share the pillow for ten thousand lifetimes.
Brother-in-law is so naughty, hehe~
Even Liua Yuanrui gave a deep bow to Wang Shouzhe, "Brother-in-law, I am convinced."
"Hehe~ My pleasure, my pleasure. Yuan Rui, you’re still young," Wang Shouzhe, not thin-skinned, patted his shoulder earnestly, "When you grow up, your skills will certainly match mine."
"Hey, where’s Ruolei? She was quite spirited earlier; how come she’s suddenly gone? I still wanted her to lead the way."
"Forget it! Hand out the red envelopes."
Immediately, a whole box of red envelopes was brought in, distributed to the brothers- and sisters-in-law, nieces and nephews, and various younger generations.
"Brothers, come with me to welcome the bride." With a wave, Wang Shouzhe’s Wang Family brothers responded thunderously, and a spirited group headed toward the back courtyard.
Three checkpoints had been passed, and so elegantly. Naturally, there would be no further obstruction with so many red envelopes distributed.
...
As Wang Shouzhe and his group headed for the back courtyard,
the maid Qiao’Er had already reported the poem back, her speed truly incredible, coming and going like the wind.
Along with her was Liua Ruolei, who huffily remarked, "Brother-in-law is too much, wanting not only to marry sister for this lifetime but also to cling to her in every lifetime, such greed knows no bounds."
With this remark, everyone in the room looked straight at her.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 128: Marrying the Beauty Back_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 128: Marrying the Beauty Back_3
Hmm?
Isn’t such a confession a good thing? Why is Ruolei so indignant?
Liua Ruolei realized she misspoke and hurriedly shut her mouth, but in her heart, she was still puffed up with anger. Such a beautiful poem, why couldn’t it be for her?
Qiao’Er, however, excitedly said, "This new young master’s poem is truly excellent, it’s almost making me cry."
At this time, Liua Ruolan had already copied the poem onto paper and read it twice carefully, blushing increasingly as she read.
She softly "tsk"ed and commented, "It is indeed somewhat frivolous."
However, even as she said this, her eyes were full of bashful joy, her cheeks were slightly flushed and warm, and she murmured in her heart, "Holding hands with tearful eyes, praying for a lifetime of shared sleep, how shameless!"
It was evident that Wang Shouzhe’s poem had truly touched her heart.
Between husband and wife, a little frivolity is fine.
They were talking inside the room.
A call came from outside: "Miss, get ready, the new young master is here."
At this moment, Liua Ruolan had put on her red wedding attire, and several aunts quickly placed the red veil on her head and had her sit on the bed.
"Please invite the new young master to enter the bridal chamber and take the bride."
Wang Shouzhe entered the bridal chamber as instructed.
The middle-aged women examined Wang Shouzhe curiously and couldn’t help but praise, "The new young master is truly handsome and elegant."
The bride, with the red veil covering her, slightly trembled but managed to resist peeking.
Wang Shouzhe, brimming with happiness, greeted each of the aunts and offered them red envelopes.
Particularly to his fourth aunt Wang Liuzi, he sneakily gave a large red envelope.
Fourth Aunt Wang Liuzi was delighted and immediately said, "Shouzhe, aren’t you going to quickly present the Ten Thousand Treasures Golden Pouch?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe hurriedly untied the Ten Thousand Treasures Golden Pouch from his waist, walked quickly to the bride, handed it to Liua Ruolan, and softly said, "Ruolan, the auspicious time has come, please return with me to the Wang Family."
The Ten Thousand Treasures Golden Pouch contained various small items made of gold or jade, such as grains, fruits, fish, meat, and even a small pure gold abacus, symbolizing the entrustment of his future finances to her.
Liua Ruolan, with the red veil still covering her, held the Ten Thousand Treasures Golden Pouch, her heart filled with shyness and nervousness, gently nodded, and whispered, "Mm."
Wang Shouzhe was overjoyed and called out, "Yuan Rui, aren’t you coming in quickly?"
At this time, Liua Yuanrui walked into the bridal chamber, grinning and clasping his hands, saying, "Congratulations, brother-in-law, for finally winning the beauty."
"Thank you, Yuan Rui, for going easy on me. To marry Ruolan is indeed my great fortune," said Wang Shouzhe as he took out a large red envelope, "Yuan Rui, I’ll be depending on you next."
According to tradition, an unmarried young brother-in-law is supposed to carry the bride to the sedan chair.
Liua Yuanrui, without hesitation, took the large red envelope and patted his chest, saying, "No problem, leave it to me. Although I seem frail, I have been training diligently lately."
Having said that, he picked up Liua Ruolan and proceeded to walk out of the bridal chamber.
He hadn’t taken more than a few steps when Liua Yuanrui mumbled quietly, "Hmm, has sister become a lot lighter recently? It must be to spare me the effort. I remember during the last practice..."
But before he could finish, there was a sudden "ouch," and he cried out in pain, quickly pleading for forgiveness, "Sister, I was wrong."
Then, holding his sister, he ran swiftly outside.
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat; this lad really knew how to court disaster. Naturally, he pretended he hadn’t heard a thing, dutifully following along step by step.
Later, they bade farewell to the bride’s father and mother in the main hall.
Only then did Yuan Rui carry the bride out through the Liua Family gate.
After a series of ceremonial steps, the bride was seated in a grand sedan chair carried by eight bearers.
And Wang Shouzhe rode at the very front on his precious horse.
"Lift the sedan," Gongsun Qiang called out, and the procession began to move slowly, departing Shanyin amidst the cheers of the people, headed toward Ping’an.
The returning procession was more than twice as large as the one that had arrived.
The escorting party, led by members of the Liua Family, was equally magnificent. One carriage after another followed the procession, all part of the Liua Family’s dowry.
Judging by the scale of the dowry, it truly showcased the Liua Family’s immense wealth.
Wang Shouzhe, in luxurious and ornate wedding robes, rode his Fire Stepping on White Clouds at the head of the procession, feeling completely elated.
Having lived twice, it’s the first time he’s getting married.
From today on, he would be stepping into a brand-new life.
One of life’s four great joys, the wedding night, was slowly unfolding before him.
Indeed, as the saying goes, in the spring breeze of success, one should enjoy life to the fullest.
The wedding night—I’m ready!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 129: Wedding Night (End of Volume 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 129: Wedding Night (End of Volume 1)
...
Just as Wang Shouzhe’s wedding procession was making its return.
The main residence of the Ping’an Wang Family.
It was also in the midst of its busiest time. The entire family was fully mobilized, with each person handling their own tasks.
Some of the women, like the eldest sister-in-law and fourth aunt, were in charge of the kitchen, as well as the placement of dishes and tables. Even Wang Luqiu, Wang Lici, Wang Luojing, and others were involved in the work, each with their own responsibilities.
However, Wang Lici originally wanted to manage the kitchen or ingredients, but was unanimously vetoed by everyone.
Instead, she was put in charge of the open banquet at the square, which catered to ordinary people not eligible to enter the main residence for the wedding feast and most side branches.
This time, the Wang Family would hold a three-day and three-night open banquet, welcoming all who came, marking a display of extraordinary generosity.
Guests of higher status would be arranged at the open seats in the Wang Family’s courtyard, which were the main seats.
Even more esteemed guests, such as the Clan Leader, Shopkeeper Qian, Thunder Guardian Envoy, and various clan Ancestors, would be personally entertained by Ancestor Xiaohan.
Their banquets were arranged in elegant halls.
As for Ancestor Longyan, she had always disliked socializing, so she was only arranged to appear during Shouzhe’s wedding ceremony.
Guests from various paths arrived at the Wang Family one after another.
The male members of the family each took on the responsibility of hospitality, full of joy and happiness. Shouzhe’s marriage was indeed a monumental event.
It also represented the thriving progress and continuation of the family.
Today’s Wang Family was no longer the Wang Family of the past.
A family with three Spirit Platforms.
In Ping’an Town, they covered the sky with one hand. Such a family already showed signs of rising and renewal.
Then, Wang Shouzhe’s wedding procession and the Liua Family’s escort party simultaneously arrived at Ping’an Wang Family.
What followed naturally were a series of very lively ceremonies, with the couple performing the traditional wedding rituals in the central hall.
Gongsun Hui, already dressed in splendid attire, sat in the main seat with a face full of joy. She was the legitimate mother, and also a widow, and today her status was the highest.
With Shouzhe’s marriage, she was naturally overjoyed and quietly wiped away tears of happiness. Over the years, she had remarried into the Wang Family and raised Shouzhe and Luola, which had not been easy.
Being a stepmother naturally made it much more difficult than being an ordinary mother,
Then came the ceremony of the wedding vows. This ceremony was naturally a very lively segment, with relatives and friends all offering their blessings.
Afterwards, the bride was first escorted into the bridal chamber.
As the groom and the head of the family, Wang Shouzhe still needed to entertain the guests outside.
Some close family clans came not only with their clan leaders and relatives but even the ancestors quietly arrived to personally congratulate Wang Shouzhe.
This kind of honor was not typical for the marriage of a usual family heir.
These marriage allies, Wang Shouzhe naturally could not neglect.
And so the lively festivities continued until the evening.
...
After a day of entertaining, even Wang Shouzhe, who was nearly at the eighth level of the Qi Refining Realm, was a bit overwhelmed.
But fortunately, everything had finally concluded.
After attending to the guests, with a slight hint of tipsiness, Wang Shouzhe walked back to his courtyard with light and joyful steps.
In the master bedroom.
The room was festively decorated with lanterns and colorful banners, red candles flickering brightly.
The bride, Liua Ruolan, sat obediently on the bed, patiently awaiting her husband’s return.
The bed was covered with red bedding, scattered with dates, lotus seeds, Qian gold, and more than a dozen dazzling spirit stones.
"Thank you for your hard work, wife." Wang Shouzhe suppressed his excitement and stepped forward to deeply bow.
"Husband." Liua Ruolan’s voice was slightly shy as she softly replied.
Next would be the uncovering of the red veil and the wedding wine rituals.
These had all been prepared in advance, placed on a low table by the bed.
With Liua Ruolan’s consent, Wang Shouzhe picked up the Jade Ruyi and said, "Wife, I apologize for my offense."
Then he gently lifted her red veil.
What met his eyes was a youthful and beautiful face.
She was adorned in a phoenix crown and red robe, with a lovely oval face, wide forehead like Qian, crescent eyebrows, and apricot eyes filled with shyness and spring-like emotion.
She tightly clasped her hands, lowering her head, not daring to look at Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe was stunned for several breaths, unable to look away.
To tell the truth, this was his first time seeing Liua Ruolan.
As a transmigrator, it was his first time marrying a bride, especially such a great beauty, giving him an illusionary and unreal feeling.
"Husband!" Liua Ruolan’s delicate body trembled slightly, as if worried about something, she weakly asked, "Could it be that I am not attractive?"
"Attractive, attractive. My wife, you are too attractive." Wang Shouzhe nodded repeatedly, "Wife, you are like a Divine Lady from the heavens. Marrying you feels so unreal, I fear you may float away on a breeze."
These words reminded Liua Ruolan of his earlier frivolous poem, causing her to quickly bury her hesitant forehead into her collar.
"My wife’s makeup is stunning, only the rouge and powder should not stay on your face for too long."
Wang Shouzhe, being a transmigrator, knew it was not good for a lady to keep her makeup overnight. He was in no rush to drink the wedding wine and immediately fetched a copper basin of warm water and a towel to help her remove the phoenix crown and robe.
"Husband, how can there be reason for a man to assist a woman in removing her makeup?" Liua Ruolan was moved by Wang Shouzhe’s attentiveness but felt a bit scared, "Perhaps call Qiao’Er from the side room to help."
"No worries, in the privacy of our room, why worry about such formalities?"
Wang Shouzhe did not want anyone else to disturb them and personally helped her with makeup removal. In no time, she appeared natural and unadorned before him, her skin delicate and tender, with a shy, radiant face like a freshly bloomed flower.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 129: Wedding Night (End of Volume 1)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 129: Wedding Night (End of Volume 1)_2
Compared to her heavy makeup earlier, she now had less of that majestic aura but exuded more youthful vibrance and the essence of collagen.
"Wife, you’re truly a beauty."
Liua Ruolan blushed slightly with shyness, having been secretly observing Wang Shouzhe all along. She shyly muttered in a mosquito-like voice, "Husband also looks quite handsome and extraordinary."
It was very obvious; she was quite satisfied with Wang Shouzhe’s appearance.
Even though it was an arranged marriage, with no choice in the matter.
But if the husband turned out to be a handsome and spirited young man, naturally, she’d be happier. Besides, this husband was gentle and considerate too.
Beside the bed, there was a small table with some exquisite pastries and a little brazier warming a pot of wine.
Wang Shouzhe knew she probably hadn’t eaten all day, so he quickly picked up a plate of pastries and said with concern, "You must be hungry, dear. Would you like something to eat?"
Liua Ruolan gently nodded and replied, "Yes," thanking her husband.
Then, she delicately picked up a piece of pastry, slightly turned her graceful body, and covered her mouth with her hand, chewing gracefully and reservedly.
After all, she was a lady from a prominent family, Wang Shouzhe silently marveled.
Unlike his own family member Wang Lici, who ate like a bandit. Eating with her at the same table, if you weren’t quick, you’d starve.
Just as he thought of Wang Lici, suddenly!
There was a commotion outside the courtyard.
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, are you there?"
It turned out to be Wang Lici’s voice, and then she was pounding on the door. "Fourth Uncle, why did you lock the door?"
Wang Shouzhe broke out in a cold sweat, thinking of something at just the wrong time.
Didn’t this big niece know it was his wedding night?
If he didn’t lock the door, he’d be welcoming uninvited people barging in.
Liua Ruolan’s almond-shaped eyes opened wide, appearing somewhat puzzled.
"My dear, don’t mind it. That is the Big Girl Wang Lici, who’s always boisterous and careless," Wang Shouzhe said helplessly, "She’s one of the Little Demon Kings of Chaos in our family."
"I’ve heard about this child," Liua Ruolan hid her mouth and chuckled softly, "It’s no big deal. Which family doesn’t have a few Little Demon Kings?" Speaking of which, there were quite a few quirky ones among the young ones in the Liua Family too.
Wang Shouzhe knew Wang Lici’s character well; if he didn’t open the door, it would be trouble.
She might even pry open the door and storm in.
After obtaining Liua Ruolan’s consent, Wang Shouzhe went to open the door. Before he could scold them with a stern face,
he saw Wang Lici complain, "Fourth Uncle, what are you dawdling about?"
Saying this, she had already picked up a large wooden basin and stormed into the bridal chamber.
A whole group of people followed behind her in a rowdy procession.
Several younger sisters, Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, surprisingly even the younger ones Wang Luomiao and Wang Luolan followed in.
Additionally, there was the second niece Wang Liwan, nephew Wang Zongchang, and the youngest brother Wang Shouye.
This sight left Wang Shouzhe dumbfounded, wondering what on earth was going on. Were they planning a rebellion?
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle! Why do you have that expression? I just saw that Fourth Aunt hasn’t eaten for a while, so I specifically brought her some food. And you, Fourth Uncle, busy drinking, haven’t eaten much either."
Wang Lici pouted, looking as if her good intentions were taken as trash.
"And what about all of you?" Wang Shouzhe looked at the others.
"We’re here to see sister-in-law," Wang Luqiu was quite straightforward, "We didn’t see her face because of the red veil during the day." This girl, apart from her Emperor Road, had few things left she was curious or concerned about.
Wang Shouzhe saw Liua Ruolan smiling at the corners of her mouth, not appearing to mind. So, he said to Wang Lici, "Why do you still stand there? Quickly serve your aunt the food you’ve brought!"
Then the young ones from the Wang Family began their respective tasks, those who needed to offer greetings did so, and those setting up a hotpot stand went ahead, creating a lively atmosphere.
Liua Ruolan, in her dignified manner, took out prepared red envelopes and handed them out one by one.
"Fourth Aunt, this is the clear soup hotpot my Fourth Uncle loves. I especially prepared this late-night snack for you today."
Wang Lici skillfully aimed to curry favor. She had already noticed keenly who in the house would be the one to please in the future.
Only newlywed, she hurried over to show her solicitousness, trying to ingratiate the Fourth Aunt.
The girls were quite efficient.
Very soon, a table was set up with clear soup hotpot, the copper pot in the center bubbling with hot water.
Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan accompanied the younger ones around the table, cheerfully enjoying the clear soup hotpot.
Even though having hotpot was a fun affair, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t shake off a slight unease, thinking, right, this was supposed to be his wedding night! Surely, these kids weren’t here to ruin the moment?
Liua Ruolan, however, had never tried clear soup hotpot. In front of the children, she was generous and unpretentious, seemingly enjoying herself quite a lot.
Moreover, her anxiety seemed to ease quite a bit.
Gradually, the brothers and sisters grew more familiar with her. Especially Wang Luomiao, who often wrote to her previously, making them quite well-acquainted.
A meal of hotpot was shared happily among everyone.
Wang Shouzhe observed quietly, noticing that Ruolan had almost finished eating, setting her chopsticks down.
So he coughed lightly, "It’s getting late. You all go ahead and do your own things." He made the gesture to begin ushering them out.
Joking aside, a night of springtime was worth thousands in gold, especially when it was the first bridal chamber in two lifetimes. Surely, they couldn’t have hotpot till dawn?
"Fourth Uncle, are you kicking us out after crossing the bridge? I haven’t had my fill yet," Wang Lici said, aggrieved.
"When have you ever not eaten your fill? Take some home and eat slowly."
Without mercy, Wang Shouzhe chased all the young ones out and quickly locked the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 129: Wedding Night (End of Volume 1)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 129: Wedding Night (End of Volume 1)_3
Only then did he breathe a sigh of relief, saying to Liua Ruolan, "My dear, time is getting on; we should drink the wedding wine."
"Yes, my husband." Liua Ruolan nodded bashfully. She naturally understood the meaning.
But Wang Shouzhe hadn’t even brought the wedding wine yet.
Outside, the noise started again, only to hear Wang Lici’s loud voice shouting, "The moon is nice tonight; let’s eat in the courtyard."
Then a group of brothers and sisters started eating hotpot and singing in the courtyard, creating quite the commotion.
Wang Shouzhe opened the door with a scowl and went out.
He realized these rascals were definitely in cahoots, deliberately trying to mess things up for him.
How could he go about his wedding night like this?
Even if he had a thick skin, Ruolan wouldn’t be able to handle it.
"Hey? Fourth Uncle, aren’t you full yet?" Wang Lici blinked with innocent starry eyes.
Wang Shouzhe let out a cold laugh, thinking they could stay in his courtyard, causing trouble until their plans succeeded?
This courtyard had been personally maintained by Wang Shouzhe for a year.
With a press of his hand on the porch, a surge of rich azure profound Qi was injected into it.
Suddenly, those quiet vines hidden in the shadows of his courtyard seemed to receive some kind of command.
They came to life.
The roots of the vines grew wildly, like sinister tentacles dancing enchantingly in the courtyard.
Wang Luomiao, Wang Shouye, and the other little troublemakers were terrified, surrendering first and screaming as they fled the courtyard.
Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and Wang Lici were rather bold.
Facing the attack of the sinister vines, they even resisted.
Unfortunately, they underestimated Wang Shouzhe. The vine array in his courtyard was painstakingly researched.
He collected many basic vines, improving them over and over again, ultimately forming the current vine array.
One could say, as long as in his courtyard, even a Qi Refining Mirror Ninth Layer Peak cultivator would have to submit.
Under Wang Shouzhe’s profound Qi control, the rapidly growing vines quickly bound Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and Wang Lici into a bundle, dragging them out of the courtyard.
The world suddenly became serene.
Only Liua Ruolan stood at the door of the bridal chamber, looking at Wang Shouzhe with a surprised expression.
"My dear, do not worry, it’s just my innate bloodline talent," Wang Shouzhe explained with a smile, flipping his hand to reveal several flower seeds.
These flower seeds were also recently cultivated with care by him.
The biggest feature is the large size of the seeds, containing a lot of energy.
As his mighty azure profound Qi was injected, those flower seeds started to grow in his hand.
From sprouting, to growing leaves, to blooming flowers, it was all completed in just a dozen breaths.
In an instant, the flowers bloomed.
In his palm, a handful of splendid flowers appeared, stunningly beautiful.
Liua Ruolan’s eyes were filled with surprise; her husband’s skills were much more formidable than she imagined.
She didn’t expect her husband to have such a strong bloodline talent hidden.
But she was still very happy; the stronger her husband is, the happier she naturally is.
Wang Shouzhe presented the flowers and took her hand, leading her back to the bed.
With a touch on the wooden bed, the purple sandalwood bed unexpectedly grew into tender branches and leaves like an old tree flourishing anew.
Then, those flower seeds he had placed beside the bed also quickly grew. Before long, his bed turned into a vibrant little flower garden.
Such "romantic and beautiful" scenery delighted Liua Ruolan greatly, relaxing her mood quite a bit.
"My dear, it’s time to drink the wedding wine."
Wang Shouzhe picked up the pot of wedding wine which had been kept warm continuously.
"Alright, I’ll listen to my husband." Liua Ruolan nodded lightly with a flushed face.
The wedding wine; it’s the Earth’s so-called wedding toast.
It’s a kind of ritual, capable of allowing the newlyweds to relax through the power of alcohol.
Three successive glasses down.
Liua Ruolan, unable to handle alcohol, her beautiful face became slightly flushed, her eyes grew hazy and full of spring warmth.
With her face full of bashfulness, her pearly teeth lightly biting her lip, she seemed to have made up her mind, fetching a box from beneath the bedding and handing it to Wang Shouzhe with her eyes closed.
"My dear, what is this?" Wang Shouzhe was a bit puzzled.
"You, you look for yourself." Liua Ruolan bashfully closed her eyes, her delicate body trembling nonstop.
Wang Shouzhe opened the exquisite box to find a booklet inside.
Turning over the pages, he suddenly exclaimed, "This is..."
He was momentarily astonished; it turned out to be an H-themed pictorial book.
Some of the little characters were depicted quite vividly and accompanied by explanatory text, making it quite clear at a glance.
He could hardly believe it was something given by Liua Ruolan: "My dear, what is this supposed to mean? Could it be for enhancing the wedding night atmosphere?"
These words caused Liua Ruolan’s face to flush red; she lightly scolded, "Fool."
This item was secretly handed to her by an aunt before her marriage, and instructed her thoroughly, teaching a lot to her ears.
At that time, she was utterly shocked to find out that wedding nights involved such mortifying couple rituals?
At the same time, her aunt instructed her.
After drinking the wedding wine, hand this booklet to the groom.
Seeing her so bashful, Wang Shouzhe suddenly realized, indeed, this wasn’t Earth!
People here marry rather young, and having very little information on this, they are generally clueless before marriage.
Many are altogether clueless by the time they get married.
Unlike on Earth, where almost everyone is a seasoned expert.
On the wedding night, both the husband and wife are well-experienced.
Evidently, Liua Ruolan feared he knew nothing at all, hence presenting this booklet.
"My dear, rest assured, I won’t need this, leave it to me," Wang Shouzhe already a bit tipsy today, immediately tossed the crude booklet aside.
Kidding, having been taught by many teachers in his previous life, and having had two girlfriends, why would he need such a basic guide?
Hmm?
Upon hearing this, Liua Ruolan’s starry eyes widened in surprise, seeming a bit skeptical, looking at Wang Shouzhe.
As if asking where her husband learned these things?
Because until yesterday, she was completely clueless regarding this, wholly innocent and unaware.
According to her auntie, generally, the male doesn’t understand this; the family doesn’t educate them.
The wedding night usually requires the woman to teach everything.
But Wang Shouzhe’s seasoned rogue-like demeanor really frightened Liua Ruolan a bit.
Okay.
Wang Shouzhe realized he misspoke.
Hurriedly laughing awkwardly, he said, "My dear, don’t misunderstand, I’ve just seen a little on ancient texts, just know a bit, need my dear to teach me well." This line made Wang Shouzhe feel his face burning, as before the pure Ruolan, he seemed...
Liua Ruolan genuinely believed this, though she felt something was amiss, unable to pinpoint what.
With her knowledge, she certainly couldn’t conceive that her husband appeared as a handsome youth but his soul was a seasoned expert.
"Husband, extinguish the candles first." Liua Ruolan’s face was burning hot, nervously tense, but her Auntie said a girl must go through this.
One must honor the couple’s ritual to conceive children.
Feeling slightly excited, Wang Shouzhe turned and embraced her, placing her on the bed.
"Husband, I’m scared, be gentle with me." Liua Ruolan was extraordinarily nervous.
"My dear, I don’t know either, you must teach me." Wang Shouzhe said shamelessly.
"But, but I don’t really know either."
"Then let’s not blow out the candles." Wang Shouzhe took the opportunity to suggest, then picked up the booklet he had scorned earlier, saying seriously, "We’ll research as a couple, progress together, and grow slowly."
With a casual wave, a curtain of vines and flowers slowly closed.
"Husband!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 1: 8th-Rank Noble Family (New Edition, Monday Request for Recommendation Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 1: 8th-Rank Noble Family (New Edition, Monday Request for Recommendation Tickets)
...
Year 3153 of the Great Qianlong Chang’s reign – Spring, February 17.
It’s been almost eight years since Wang Shouzhe crossed over.
This is a season of spring warmth and blooming flowers, when everything revives.
Dingpu Ferry.
A large ferry boat slowly docked at the Deepwater Port District.
As soon as the connecting bridge was laid flat, people orderly disembarked. They held a card in hand, passing through the checkpoint one by one.
The card was no bigger than a child’s palm yet finely crafted, resembling neither gold nor jade, exhibiting a faint purple hue under the sunlight.
Inside the card, a piece of card paper seemed embedded, listing place of origin, name, age, and simple physical characteristics.
As long as the cardholder passed through the checkpoint, the fully armed gatekeepers would slightly inspect and then smile as they allowed passage: "Welcome home."
And the passerby would return with thanks: "Thank you for your protection."
However, those without a card needed to go through another checkpoint. That checkpoint was more crowded, with gatekeepers’ faces stern, scrutinizing each passerby, requiring them to provide a Daqian Government-issued travel pass. Without a pass, they would be immediately deported.
Even those with a pass would be questioned by personnel about their background, purpose, and how long they intended to stay in Ping’an Town, etc. The interrogation was extremely strict, and if anything seemed off, they would be immediately deported.
After passing the interrogation, they were issued a thick paper card, warning them not to stay in Ping’an Town for more than a month, and were charged a handling fee of one Large Copper.
They could opt out, but then would have to return to where they came from, paying themselves for the next ferry ride back.
On the ferry, a few people dressed as traveling merchants formed a small caravan. As they had horse carts with them, they were arranged to disembark last.
At this time, a young traveling merchant in his twenties looked at this scene from afar and said: "Big brother, what is that faint purple card?" Clearly, it was his first time coming to Ping’an Town for business.
Loaded on this group of merchant carts were goods like refined salt, rough salt, rough iron, rough copper, and other supplies, all bestsellers in Ping’an Town. Especially refined salt and rough iron, which were bought at high prices by blacksmiths’ shops and general stores almost immediately after disembarking.
And from Ping’an Town, they would purchase items like snow sugar, rough cotton fabric, brocade patterned cotton fabric, and ordinary porcelain, all with relatively high prices. After a tough journey, they’d earn quite a lot.
"The purple card, huh." A forty-to-fifty-year-old older traveling merchant said with envy, "This is the identity card for local residents of Ping’an Town. Now Ping’an Town is not like before; outsiders wishing to migrate to Ping’an Town must purchase at least twenty acres of land and a house at once to be issued an identity card. With the identity card, they can freely enter and exit Ping’an Town."
"Wow, I’ve heard the land and house prices in Ping’an Town are very high now." The young traveling merchant said with envy. "Is it possible that even those lowly tenant farmers are also issued identity cards?"
"Watch your words." The older traveling merchant hurriedly stopped him.
But it was too late.
Several rugged men dressed in fine cotton cloth nearby glared at them: "What’s wrong with our tenant farmers, and where are we lowly?"
The older traveling merchant hastily apologized on behalf of the young man: "Sorry, sorry everyone, the young don’t know better. He didn’t know the current esteemed status of the Ping’an Wang Family tenant farmers."
The high status originates from considerable income and the Wang Family’s attention to them.
Currently, the average annual income of Wang Family tenant farmers has exceeded the average income of independent farmers in Ping’an Town by thirty percent. The only explanation for such an inverted result is that the Wang Family’s estate income has become very high, benefiting the tenant farmers in turn.
It’s known that independent farmers in Ping’an Town earn much more than independent farmers elsewhere because they cultivate the Wang Family’s Number Nine Seeds and enjoy the Spirit Insect Master’s discounted pest control rate.
Therefore, the high income of Wang Family tenant farmers exceeds many people’s imagination.
Those few Wang Family tenant farmers didn’t bother to argue, casually continuing their conversation: "I heard the daughter of Old Zhang’s Family married an independent farmer? I remember that girl worked at Silkworm Manor, right? Really don’t know what they were thinking, letting the daughter marry down like that."
"Does the family have fifty acres of good land? Is the boy also an apprentice blacksmith? If that’s the case, it’s rather a decent match."
"Lao Liu, I heard your family rented a storefront in the second phase of Zhuwei Mansion? Did you invest all the family’s years of savings?"
"Yes, correct, my third son has some talent in sewing and will graduate in two years. Opening a tailor shop, he can at least support himself. Our Lao Liu Family can’t be farming generation after generation, right?"
"What’s wrong with farming? Now, becoming a Wang Family tenant farmer is not easy, requiring identity verification, skill assessment, and a few years of work from the outer estates first..."
"That’s true, but having a tailor shop with a skill yields a good income, and the storefront was a good investment."
These tenant farmers talked about income and investment openly.
This scared the young traveling merchant, thinking these aren’t tenant farmers. Their confidence and tone felt like wealthy farmers from elsewhere.
And they even disdain marrying independent farmers?
"Is that Zhuwei Mansion’s storefront really expensive?" The young traveling merchant asked weakly.
"It’s alright, just over a hundred Qian Gold." Lao Liu said, "Put all the family’s years of savings into it, and borrowed quite a bit of debt too."
"That expensive?" The young traveling merchant was shocked: "That amount can buy over thirty acres of land in other towns; the Wang Family’s shop prices are too steep!"

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 1: 8th Rank Noble Family (New - Week 1, Requesting Recommendation Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 1: 8th Rank Noble Family (New Chapter Week 1, Requesting Recommendation Tickets)_2
"Young man, if you don’t understand, don’t speak carelessly," Tenant Farmer Liu reprimanded. "The Zhuwei Mansion is a place where every inch of land is worth gold, with real estate prices climbing each year. Many wealthy people from Changning come to buy properties and estates in Zhuwei Mansion for secondary homes. Leaving aside things like feng shui, just consider the Tier Three Guardian Spirit Beast that guards one side of Zhuwei Lake, which alone justifies the value of the land here."
Tier Three Guardian Spirit Beast?
The young traveling merchant was shocked, but his curiosity got the better of him, leading him to converse with Tenant Farmer Liu. The more he talked, the more astonished he became; Ping’an Town was far more powerful and prosperous than he had imagined.
"Did you see that young gentleman in fine patterned clothing?" Tenant Farmer Liu pointed to a young man inspecting the wharf, where soldiers saluted as he passed.
"Is that... some direct descendant of the Wang Family?"
"He is indeed a Wang Family young master, but from the collateral branch."
"Good heavens, even the collateral branch carries such presence; the Ping’an Wang Family is truly remarkable."
"Naturally, our Ping’an Wang Family is an Eighth-Grade Noble Family. The wife of our Clan Leader also comes from the Eighth-Grade Shanyin Liu Family, a strong alliance; how could it be simple?"
The young traveling merchant was instantly filled with awe. An Eighth-Grade Noble Family has at least one lineage of Spirit Platforms. Together, these families must house at least six Spirit Platform Realm cultivators; their power is evidently formidable.
On the ferry, travelers, loose cultivators, and merchants were passing through checkpoints methodically, each handling inspections and paperwork as required.
Suddenly.
An unexpected incident disrupted the orderly scene.
From afar on the dock, a stalwart Black Tortoise Practitioner hurriedly dashed toward a ferry about to leave port. No soldier who tried to stop him was a match, each being knocked away with fists and kicks.
"Goodness, that’s a master, likely already at the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm."
The crowd began to murmur, stunned and surprised. To have reached such a realm as a loose cultivator was remarkably rare. His combat abilities seemed formidable.
Suddenly!
"You dare run after harming people in my Ping’an Town?"
A shout resounded from behind him, a youth intercepting him with even greater speed. Not only was his speed swift, but his movements were also like a willow catkin dancing in the wind — unpredictable, elegant, and graceful.
With the soldiers entangling and blocking him.
Within seconds, the youth had engaged the middle-aged loose cultivator Black Tortoise Practitioner. His sword momentum was like a rainbow, large and expansive, sword aura flashing with a heavy white glow.
This elegant and graceful youth was displaying the Wang Family’s secret — the Middle-Grade Body Technique [Willow Catkin Body Technique], and the Middle-Grade Swordsmanship [Wang Family’s Profound Origin Sword].
As he executed the techniques seamlessly, it was evident he had reached a level of minor achievement.
"Wang Shouyong!"
The middle-aged loose cultivator roared angrily, "I merely injured someone while eating, yet you pursued me for dozens of miles; do you truly think I’m made of clay?"
He drew a steel saber, and his saber stance was fiercely aggressive — clearly, he wasn’t easily provoked.
Among loose cultivators, whether in Black Tortoise Combat Techniques or cultivation, this individual was no weakling.
The two engaged in a fierce fight, evenly matched in their combat.
Some of the weaker soldiers or guardians dared not approach and intervene.
"That’s the Wang Family’s fifth young master of the Shou Generation, Wang Shouyong!" Many recognized the youth’s identity, cheering, "Fifth young master, go on; apprehend that loose cultivator."
"Oh my goodness," the young traveling merchant was taken aback, "This fifth young master seems barely twenty years old, right? At the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, with such solid cultivation techniques, he might reach the peak of the Qi Refining Realm by his forties, with hopes of achieving the Spirit Platform Realm in this lifetime."
"Of course, our Wang Family young masters and misses are all top-notch."
Encouraged by the crowd, Wang Shouyong fought increasingly courageously, gradually gaining the upper hand.
The Wang Family’s Profound Origin Technique, being a Middle-Grade Cultivation Heart Technique, grows increasingly powerful and thick with profound qi as cultivation progresses. This provides extraordinary endurance during prolonged battles.
The loose cultivator found himself unable to withstand any longer.
Suddenly, he pulled out some red sand from his bosom and scattered it while shouting, "Taste my Poisonous Sand."
Wang Shouyong felt alarmed, quickly retreating, his sword momentum so airtight that it completely blocked the sand. Unfortunately, he had been fooled; the sand was ordinary red-sanded pebbles.
The loose cultivator had already seized the chance to escape again, rushing towards the ferry now five or six yards away from port.
"Darn!" Wang Shouyong thought to himself, realizing the impending trouble. Catching up to the ferry only in time to fight risked harming innocents.
"Hahaha!" The loose cultivator laughed maniacally, "Dare you chase me onto the ferry? Once I escape, I’ll never return to Ping’an Town in this lifetime..."
Yet, his words abruptly stopped, and even his sprint came to a sudden halt.
His expression showed shock and fear, cold sweat sliding from his forehead.
Standing between him and the ferry was an eighteen or nineteen-year-old young maiden in goose-yellow attire.
She stood with her hands clasped behind her back, halting all the loose cultivator’s movements with her very presence.
Her expression remained calm, entirely disregarding the loose cultivator with her gaze. An invisible pressure subdued the loose cultivator’s legs, rendering them weak.
"Wang, Wang... Wang Luqiu!" The loose cultivator’s eyes were filled with terror and despair.
"Miss Six, it’s Miss Six is here!"
Among the crowd, someone instantly shouted excitedly, "That loose cultivator is unlucky enough to run into Miss Six. Rumor says Miss Six has already broken into the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm!"
"That’s old news. Miss Six was already in the eighth layer before last year’s New Year."
"Goodness, wasn’t Miss Six only eighteen last year? Her cultivation speed is terrifying!"
"Miss Six’s cultivation speed is fast, and her Black Tortoise Combat Techniques are formidable. Rumor has it she possesses frightening powers to fight beyond her level."
With everyone’s murmurs, the loose cultivator’s heart sunk to rock bottom.
He had mixed in Ping’an Town for over a year, and naturally, the name of Wang Family’s Lu Generation Miss Six was already renowned in his ears.
But unwilling to submit, he swung his steel saber, aiming resolutely at her: "Wang Luqiu, move aside if you don’t want to die!" Refusing to believe, refusing to believe that this young lady’s practical combat prowess could be too formidable.
He believed himself a strong warrior who had slain fierce beasts in the Outer Domain, naturally confident in his Black Tortoise Combat Techniques!
"Sigh~ fool."
Wang Luqiu shook her head, softly sighing, stepping forward gracefully.
That step, as if shrinking the ground to an inch, swiftly brought her right in front of him, her light punch landing on his chest.
"Boom!"
The loose cultivator seemed to be directly struck by a giant fierce beast, flying backward five or six yards before crashing heavily to the ground. His chest was depressingly caved in, coughing blood endlessly, his body shaking uncontrollably, unable to rise.
The watching crowd gasped, the silence palpable. They all knew Miss Six Wang Luqiu was formidable, never expecting her to be this extraordinary.
One punch!
It merely took one punch to completely solve the menacing loose cultivator.
At that moment, the handsome youth Wang Shouyong approached, embarrassedly saying, "Thank you, Luqiu Sister, for your help. Had this thief escaped to the ferry, it would have been troublesome."
"Wang Shouyong, fooled by such insignificant Ghost Realm tricks?" Wang Luqiu clasped her hands behind her back, her delicate brows slightly furrowing with dissatisfaction, "You disappointed Fourth Brother’s expectations of you; go seek him for punishment."
"Yes, I’ll imprison the person, then go to seek forgiveness from Fourth Brother," Wang Shouyong replied honestly, looking despondent.
"Hmph." After a cold snort, Wang Luqiu paid him no further heed, walking away with her hands behind her back.
Knowing Luqiu’s temperament well, Wang Shouyong dared not delay, immediately capturing the man and escorting him to the Guardian’s Mansion prison.
Then he hurried back to the Wang Family’s Main Residence, quickly arriving outside his Fourth Brother’s courtyard.
Once outside the courtyard, he was again filled with fear and shame, hesitantly pacing.
Yet before he could pause, a gentle yet authoritative voice resonated from inside the courtyard: "Old Five, how long do you plan to procrastinate outside my courtyard? Come in."
Wang Shouyong trembled, straightened up immediately, reverently and solemnly saluting, "Yes, Fourth Brother."
Then he entered, his mind filled with emotion, feeling that his Fourth Brother’s cultivation strength had become more and more inscrutable.
It seemed the more he pursued, the more unfathomable Fourth Brother became.
Standing outside the courtyard, he was noticed.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 2: My Wife Is a Hidden Big Shot
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 2: My Wife Is a Hidden Big Shot
...
Just turned twenty-three, already at the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm!
The basic skills are all very solid, and the family’s ultimate techniques, the Willow Catkin Body Technique and the Profound Yuan Sword Technique, have both been cultivated to a minor achievement.
Most legitimate inheritors from carefully nurtured Ninth-Grade Races aren’t even as good as him.
This shows the effort and struggle of Wang Shouyong.
Unfortunately, there are too many formidable geniuses in the family, making Wang Shouyong feel that the harder he tried, the greater the gap grew, leaving him with a sense of powerlessness.
With a nervous heart, he walked into the courtyard of his fourth brother, Wang Shouzhe.
As he saw, the courtyard was filled with flowers and plants, everywhere was teeming with life, with various exotic flowers and rare plants vying for attention.
To observe such a phenomenon in early spring is extremely rare.
A youth aged twenty-five or twenty-six was lying on a master’s chair enjoying the sun, looking at ease, telling stories to children.
Two children were surrounding him.
The older one was a girl, about six or seven years old, crafted like a delicate jade sculpture, very adorable.
The younger one was a boy, around four years old.
He sat beside on a stool, with his little posture sitting straight, blinking his eyes, with his mouth wide open, looking utterly amazed by the story.
Seeing the fourth brother engaged in storytelling with the kids, Wang Shouyong chose not to interrupt and stood by waiting.
"Papa, this Zhu Bajie is really too gluttonous, just like our big sister who can eat so much." The pretty little girl leaned into Wang Shouzhe’s embrace, saying with a laugh.
"You shouldn’t say that about your Sister Lici." Wang Shouzhe tapped her forehead lightly, smiling as he said, "Otherwise, she won’t bring you any treats in the future."
Speaking of which, Wang Lici was indeed quite fond of these two kids. She would always excitedly share any goodies she found with her younger siblings.
This was indeed a rare trait for the food-loving Wang Lici, even Wang Shouzhe himself did not enjoy such treatment.
However, due to Wang Lici’s history of almost overfeeding a child, Wang Shouzhe had ordered his children to always show their Mother or him whatever Sister Lici gave them to eat before indulging.
"Got it, Papa, I still really like Sister Lici." The little girl apologized, then coyly added, "Papa, I want to hear the story of Sister Chang’e; I don’t like Zhu Bajie."
Then, the little boy, sitting upright on the stool, also quickly chimed in, "Papa, I don’t like Zhu Bajie either, I want to hear the story of Sun Wukong."
And so, Wang Shouzhe affectionately patted his daughter’s head and said, "Alright, alright, then Papa will tell you the story of Sister Chang’e."
The little boy, accustomed to being overlooked, helplessly thought to himself, he should bring his good snacks to his sister, so that she could tell Papa she loves Sun Wukong stories, and then Papa would tell more about Sun Wukong.
At this moment,
a beautiful and elegant woman in her twenties walked out from the house, casting a playful glare at Wang Shouzhe, "Wang Shouzhe, what kind of nonsense stories are you telling the kids again?"
"You’ve got them thinking all sorts of supernatural things all day and not focusing on their studies. Enough of this, your fifth brother is waiting to speak with you."
This brilliant and charming woman is naturally now the wife of the Wang Family’s Clan Leader, Lady Liu, Liua Ruolan.
"Alas, today’s fun time ends here. Liyao darling, go back to the room with your mother to read and write a little. Papa will come to accompany you after talking with your Fifth Uncle." Wang Shouzhe gently comforted his daughter with a smile.
Then, the daughter and son obediently got to their feet.
Then they formally bowed to Wang Shouyong, "Liyao, Zong’an, greet Fifth Uncle."
Wang Shouyong also greeted his niece and nephew with a cheerful smile and then took out some trinkets, saying they were rare finds in town and were gifts for them.
Wang Liyao and Wang Zong’an were overjoyed, thanking their Fifth Uncle gladly.
Subsequently, Wang Shouyong formally greeted Liua Ruolan, "Shouyong greets Fourth Sister-in-law."
Liua Ruolan returned the greeting, "Greetings Fifth Uncle, I’ve asked Qiao’Er to serve the tea. Since I will be taking the children to study, I won’t interrupt you brothers catching up."
"Please go ahead, Sister-in-law." Wang Shouyong bowed his hands.
Following that, Liua Ruolan gracefully returned the salute, taking the two children away.
Wang Shouzhe hosted Wang Shouyong in the pavilion of the courtyard.
At this time, Liua Qiao’Er, under the young lady’s instructions, had brewed a pot of Spirit Tea and presented it.
"This is the new batch of Cloud Mist Spirit Tea that your Sister-in-law brought back from her maternal home not long ago, try it, Shouyong." Wang Shouzhe sat down with a smile.
Cloud Mist Spirit Tea grows in the Spirit Field of the Liua Family’s Cloud Mist Cave, and it is harvested in the winter.
Every time Liua Ruolan visits her maternal home, she brings back quite a bit for Wang Shouzhe.
"Thank you, Fourth Brother."
The two sat down, enjoying tea while chatting.
After a few words, Wang Shouyong blushed slightly and apologized, "Fourth Brother, I have encountered an issue..."
Before he finished speaking, Wang Shouzhe gestured with his hand, smiling as he said, "I already know about it."
Wang Shouyong’s heart trembled slightly, knowing that his fourth brother had a secret intelligence department. It was said that this intelligence network’s reach had nearly covered Ping’an Town entirely.
Originally he thought it might be an exaggeration, but now it seems the actual situation could be even more remarkable than the rumors suggest. The recent events at the Dingpu Ferry had already reached his fourth brother’s ears.
Wang Shouyong even heard that this intelligence organization is continuously expanding outward. As for how powerful it truly is, Wang Shouyong naturally had no idea.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 2: My Wife Is a Hidden Big Shot_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 2: My Wife Is a Hidden Big Shot_2
"Fourth Brother, this issue was mishandled by me. I was too careless, nearly letting that thief cause trouble. I am ashamed for failing to live up to your years of nurturing, and I ask for your punishment." Wang Shouyong said with guilt.
Wang Shouzhe did not answer directly but said, "By the way, your wedding with your fiancée from the East Port Chen Family is approaching, isn’t it?"
Wang Shouyong’s face flushed slightly and he said, "Yes, the wedding is set for May."
"Alright, Fourth Brother will prepare a great gift for you then." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile.
Wang Shouyong immediately cupped his hands in thanks, "Thank you, Fourth Brother."
Then, Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "In our family, we have always implemented the merit system: mistakes must be punished, and merits must be rewarded."
"I have two pieces of intelligence here about spies infiltrated by some ill-intentioned families. Deal with them, and consider it a way to atone for your past mistakes."
"Thank you, Fourth Brother." Wang Shouyong gratefully took the intelligence. It was Fourth Brother taking care of him, giving him a chance to redeem himself and further train him.
With Fourth Brother’s skills, he had many ways to discreetly get rid of the exposed spies.
"Shouyong, you need to work hard. You are the pillar of our Wang Family’s future." Wang Shouzhe encouraged him.
When it came to being a pillar...
Wang Shouyong sighed and said, "Fourth Brother, without even comparing me to you, I’m still far behind Sister Luoqiu and Sister Luojing. In the future, they will be the real pillars of the family." Talking about this made him lose confidence.
"Shouyong, do not belittle yourself. I’ve seen the years of effort both you and Shou Lian have put in." Wang Shouzhe poured him tea personally and said with a smile, "As for Luoqiu and the others, they are indeed phoenix chicks among people. But do you think our Ping’an Town can nurture a True Phoenix?"
"Fourth Brother, you mean..." Wang Shouyong said solemnly.
"This world is vast, and our small Ping’an Town is just an inconspicuous corner." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "How can we bind their wings with ropes and lock them in a cage? No matter how far they fly in future, as their brothers, we will be their support and backing."
Wang Shouyong took a deep breath, his expression serious, "Fourth Brother, I understand. I will certainly work hard to help you protect our family together."
Indeed, if a family has pioneers, there must also be ones who maintain. Shouyong and Shou Lian have good natures and are bound to take up the responsibility of protecting the family.
After the two brothers chatted for a while, Wang Shouyong left confidently, having understood his position, he became no longer confused.
...
After Shouyong left, Wang Shouzhe sat alone in the courtyard, drinking tea slowly, his emotions a bit stirred.
Eight years have passed, and in a blink of an eye, he has been in this world for eight years.
Taking a crisis-ridden, dilapidated small family, step by step out of danger to today’s situation was truly not easy.
But hardship aside, the harvest was substantial.
Not only is the family prospering, but Ping’an Town managed by him is becoming more fortified, almost becoming private territory. He also gained a gentle, virtuous wife with outstanding capability, along with a pair of beloved children.
In addition, his greatest gain is the enhancement of his cultivation power. After a bloodline awakening, his bloodline talent took a leap, not only becoming stronger in combat but also accelerating in cultivation speed.
The family originally set a twenty-year cultivation plan for him, which he completed in just eight years.
His cultivation is now at the Peak of the Qi Refining Realm, just a step away from the Spirit Platform Realm.
He needs only another two or three months to achieve perfection.
But now in front of him, there is a huge dilemma.
Whether to directly use the Celestial Spirit Pill to advance to the Spirit Platform Realm or to further refine his bloodline before hitting the Spirit Platform Realm.
His bloodline awakened once, and if he directly advances to the Spirit Platform Realm, he can awaken his bloodline for the second time.
This scenario and outcome are quite similar to Ancestor Longyan’s at that time.
But it’s quite far from Lici’s circumstances.
Wang Lici has long since undergone a second awakening, and once she advances to the Spirit Platform Realm, she would achieve a third bloodline awakening.
She truly has boundless prospects.
Wang Shouzhe was naturally envious of this.
Therefore, over these years, he has been accumulating wealth, constantly inquiring about where there might be Heavenly and Earthly Treasures to let him awaken his bloodline again.
Unfortunately, despite consuming many Heavenly and Earthly Treasures and Spirit Pills to improve bloodline talent.
It feels like there has been some improvement.
But the second awakening still seems a long way off.
Could it be that he really can only enter the Spirit Platform Realm first before slowly finding a way for the third awakening? But this makes it even harder.
As the saying goes, once you fall behind, you fall behind at every step.
Just as he frowned slightly, Liua Ruolan brought in some snacks and said, "My husband, are you still hesitating about the second bloodline awakening?"
"Let it be, do your best and listen to the destiny. If it’s not in my fate, it can’t be forced." Wang Shouzhe said carefreely, "Moreover, even if I’m not strong enough in the future, I still have my wife to protect me."
Protector!
Indeed.
When marrying Liua Ruolan, Wang Shouzhe always thought she was just an ordinary legitimate daughter.
He always overlooked one thing, which is he never saw through her cultivation, only vaguely feeling that his lovely wife Liua Ruolan seemed to wear a Breath Concealing Little Spirit Treasure.
Such oversight was quite normal.
Because Wang Shouzhe never imagined the Liua Family would spare no expense to marry a legitimate daughter with a very high level of bloodline awakening to him, Wang Shouzhe.
Not to mention marrying him, even Celestial Human Families seeking marriage wouldn’t marry such a high level bloodline legitimate daughter.
"Ruolan, I’ve always been puzzled. With your bloodline talent, you should soar at the Academy, competing with various Celestial Prides. Why did the Liua Family agree to marry you to me? Was it because you secretly fell in love with me and adamantly insisted on marrying?"
This wasn’t the first time Wang Shouzhe asked this.
"Hehe, Husband, don’t overthink. It was Ancestor Xuanfu’s wish to arrange the marriage, although part of it was my unwillingness to attend the Academy. Otherwise, if I wasn’t willing to marry, Ancestor Xuanfu would not force it." Liua Ruolan replied the same way as before, then frowned slightly, "Maybe it was for Ancestor Longyan’s sake. But it’s fine like this, the Academy is quite exhausting, with high pressure and fierce competition."
Wang Shouzhe shook his head, denying it, "That can’t be. You’ve said yourself, back then, Ancestor Xuanfu obtained an Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species accidentally, a treasure beyond comparison, so even she didn’t dare to boast about it. It was later used on Mother-in-law to give rise to the exceptionally talented you."
This matter Wang Shouzhe already knew, Ancestor Xuanfu back then was already at the Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm, who, while exploring ancient sites beyond with her Master, stumbled upon an Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species by luck.
"Ancestor Xuanfu must have had deep expectations for you, how could she marry you off just for minor face reasons?" Wang Shouzhe contemplated this for a long time but could not understand it. More likely, Ancestor Longyan’s face might have influenced this. However, Liua Ruolan also denied it frankly, "No, it’s not that. I also didn’t want to go to the Academy. If I was unwilling to marry, Ancestor Xuanfu wouldn’t have forced me."
Wang Shouzhe wondered, "Why did you hide it from me back then, Ruolan?"
Wang Shouzhe was filled with emotion at this thought.
When he married Liua Ruolan, they once had a minor emotional argument over some rare "posture".
His masculine pride burst out, and he was slightly forceful.
The result was tragic.
He almost suffered brutal domestic violence, but Ancestor Longyan intervened and spared him from having his young wife become a widow.
He then understood why Ruolei, Yuan Rui, and those brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law had always been afraid of Liua Ruolan.
From then on, Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan have lived a harmonious and respectful happy married life. Never again having any "quarrels"!
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 3: My Daughter Has the Bearing of a Great Emperor (Seeking Recommendation Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 3: My Daughter Has the Bearing of a Great Emperor (Seeking Recommendation Votes)
...
This has its benefits, establishing a good atmosphere for the family.
Even the Clan Leader and his wife are so loving and respectful to each other, living in harmony.
Other couples naturally follow their example.
The most helpless thing for Wang Shouzhe is that every time he advances and becomes stronger, Liu Ruolan always advances a step before him, and he still can’t beat her!
Isn’t Wang Shouzhe still a few months away from completely refining his Qi Refining Realm?
And Liu Ruolan, taking care of the children, doesn’t seem to exert much effort, yet she completed it ahead of him.
Maybe this is one of the reasons why Wang Shouzhe wants a second bloodline enhancement.
At least he can ensure that in case he accidentally uses too much strength, his wife won’t become a widow.
"Husband, I made this bowl of lotus seed porridge just for you, you should drink it first. Actually, I didn’t mean to hide it from you, it’s just that you never asked," Liu Ruolan said innocently, "Moreover, didn’t you also conceal your bloodline back then? On our wedding night, your vines really gave me a shock."
Liu Ruolan is quite easy-going when she is not provoked.
This one benefit makes Wang Shouzhe quite pleased.
Hence, Wang Shouzhe happily finished the lotus seed porridge. Even though the porridge was supposed to be sweet, his wife accidentally added refined salt instead, and quite a bit at that.
He still smiled and said, my wife has good culinary skills.
"Thank you, husband, for the compliment. By the way, husband, Ruotong came to report that the Spirit Testing Platform you commissioned the Array Master to purchase and oversee construction at the Academy has been completed. See if you have time in the next couple of days to inspect it. Coincidentally, our Liyao has also reached the age for talent testing."
"If Liyao has Black Tortoise Talent, we should start nurturing her meridians and prepare for cultivation," Liu Ruolan gently reminded, truly being a supportive wife.
When it comes to the beloved daughter, Wang Shouzhe’s expression becomes animated: "My treasure daughter Wang Shouzhe, she is surely extraordinarily gifted."
The Spirit Testing Platform was built by Wang Shouzhe at great expense, the array platform and labor alone costing no less than several thousands Qian Gold.
Normally, families wishing to test a child’s talent must go to the official Spirit Testing Platform at the Changning Guard Government Office.
That platform is open to the public, even commoners can apply. However, testing each person costs ten Qian Gold, and it’s opened for collective use after applying, not available at whim.
Nowadays the Wang Family isn’t incapable of affording this testing money.
It’s just that the family bloodlines are quite eclectic, and Wang Shouzhe doesn’t want the various peculiar bloodlines to stir up a commotion.
Most ordinary families, either can’t afford to build a Spirit Testing Platform or would celebrate finding a child with a decent talent by spreading the news all around, thus leaving Wang Shouzhe without such concerns.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe has additional thoughts regarding the Spirit Testing Platform.
Thus, building a Spirit Testing Platform at home is a necessity. Even if it costs social capital and over ten thousand Qian Gold, it’s worth it.
With this in mind, Wang Shouzhe said: "Then let’s go tomorrow, and inform the siblings to retest their talents together."
Wang Shouzhe last tested his talent at seven years old, and he doesn’t know how his talent is after his bloodline concentration changed.
After finalizing the matter.
Wang Shouzhe glanced left and right, seeing no one around, he said softly: "Wife, since your {Profound Water True Technique} has reached the peak of Qi Refining Realm, it’s been a long time since we’ve sparred."
Liu Ruolan’s pretty face blushed slightly, her apricot eyes showing a hint of spring, and she said with a blushing face: "Husband, your {Eternal Spring True Technique} is also nearing completion. I haven’t experienced your prowess in a while either."
"It’s just that the children are still studying in the study... I’m afraid it might be inconvenient," she said with a shy, red face and some concern.
Wang Shouzhe smiled and said: "No worries, we can go to the Water Moon Celestial Pavilion."
Water Moon Celestial Pavilion.
That’s a small villa that Wang Shouzhe built these years on an island in the center of Zhuwei Lake, after expanding the land.
It’s like a private secret hideaway for the couple.
The primary purpose of its construction was to temporarily escape from the mischievous children, offering the couple a chance to enjoy the moon and lake together, feeling comfortable, and perhaps sparring the Black Tortoise Combat Technique if they were in the mood.
No other meaning, just the literal.
Liu Ruolan’s beautiful eyes moved slightly, clearly quite tempted. She hesitated briefly and then said softly, "Hmm, I’ll follow husband’s arrangements."
Thus.
After giving a few instructions to Qiao’Er, the couple disappeared.
An hour later.
The two kids studying hard in the study.
Suddenly.
They realized it’s been a while since they saw father and mother.
Wang Liyao pouted: "Father clearly promised to come and tell the story of Chang’e, why hasn’t he come yet?"
"Mother also said she would check our homework, but she hasn’t come either." Wang Zong’an rolled his eyes and said, "Could they have gone to practice the Black Tortoise Combat Technique again?"
"Most likely, father and mother have been quite diligent in their training lately."
Beside them, Qiao’Er had a drop of cold sweat.
...
Next day, the backyard of Wang Family’s Main Residence.
An empty and uninhabited courtyard was put to use to build a Spirit Testing Platform.
That Spirit Testing Platform, shaped like an Eight Trigrams, is carved from white jade stone and adorned with many intricate and mysterious runes on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 3: My Daughter Has the Bearing of a Great Emperor (Seeking Recommendation Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 3: My Daughter Has the Bearing of a Great Emperor (Seeking Recommendation Votes)_2
At five locations, each stands a pillar carved with various Array Master runes, and in the middle of the Array Platform rests a crystal ball.
This Spirit Testing Platform is uniformly manufactured and sold by the Purple Mansion Academy, the Array Master merely procures and supervises the construction.
Its primary driving force is the Spirit Stone, which needs to be placed on each of the five pillars.
Every activation and deactivation consumes considerable extra energy.
Therefore, once the Spirit Testing Platform is activated, it will not be closed, continuously depleting the energy of the Spirit Stones. This is why all families and clans concentrate the testing candidates to register for testing at the same time.
Even so, the energy consumption of the Spirit Stone is formidable. Five Spirit Stones can only support testing for around a hundred people. On average, it costs five Qian Gold per person in pure cost.
But the official price is ten Qian Gold per person. After deducting the long-term maintenance of the Spirit Testing Platform and other expenses, the officials barely make a small profit.
Today.
Some of the younger siblings of the Wang Family gathered in front of the Spirit Testing Platform.
Meanwhile, in the courtyard’s empty rooms, some little boys and girls were gathered.
They are suitable-aged children that the Wang Family has gleaned from side branches, household servants, tenant farmers, and other channels. Moreover, they are carefully selected to appear somewhat spiritually endowed.
This was mainly done not to waste Spirit Stones, and on the chance to discover one or two children with Black Tortoise Talent.
From a probability standpoint, side branches yield the highest chances as their bloodlines are closest to the Black Tortoise Practitioner.
As for ordinary families, it purely depends on luck.
Who knows for how many generations their ancestors have not produced a Black Tortoise Practitioner? Or, even if there were Black Tortoise Bloodlines, they were missed due to inability to test.
According to Wang Shouzhe’s knowledge, the Purple Mansion Academy conducted a similar test.
For children from ordinary families, if not pre-selected based on intelligence and other criteria, on average, it takes three hundred to find one child with Black Tortoise Bloodline.
What a terrifying expense!
If rigorously screened first, eliminating eighty percent who seem inept, physically weak, or lacking intelligence, side branches can be slightly more lenient, thus increasing the chance to one in two hundred.
Of course, such screening may inadvertently discard those with talent, but it is the optimal strategy for controlling costs.
Therefore, most Noble Families are unlikely to invest money and resources here.
Most families barely sustain their own bloodline members, why would they be willing to seek out lost pearls of the bloodline from the common people?
But Wang Shouzhe is somewhat different.
Perhaps once bitten by a snake and now fearful, he holds some prejudice against most Loose Cultivators.
To strengthen the family, apart from expanding their own bloodline members, one must consider the enhancement of Household Generals.
If some children with bloodline talent are unearthed among the common folk, they would be more malleable, with a stronger sense of identity and dependence on the Wang Family.
Perhaps short-term it seems like a losing endeavor.
But it involves a hundred-year plan, perhaps further, making it highly strategic. Even if only one is found each year, accumulated over time, the Wang Family would grow stronger, and the children born to those bloodline Household Generals are likely to be decent in talent too.
Ordinary Black Tortoise Race families would already struggle to nurture their own bloodline, let alone go this far.
So this time, only eight or ninety children were gathered mainly to test the Spirit Testing Platform. Wang Shouzhe was prepared for the possibility that not even one Black Tortoise Bloodline might be found.
Under the guidance of the Array Master.
The Wang Clan Members activated the Spirit Testing Platform, and the transparent crystal ball in the middle slowly floated.
First, a normal child was arranged to test. The child placed a hand on the crystal ball, and a light enveloped the child, followed by the crystal ball emitting a weak red glow.
Those with testing experience know this signifies failure, the bloodline concentration is extremely low, far from reaching Lower Grade Talent, making it difficult to cultivate Profound Qi.
The second child went up, this time slightly brighter, but still far from Lower Grade Talent.
Well, ten Qian Gold was just thrown away in that time.
Wang Shouzhe almost suspected if there was a problem with the Spirit Testing Platform, so he sent Wang Shouyong up to try. Remember, he is of Lower Grade C Talent and has consumed some elixirs that mildly improve talent over the years.
Upon testing, the crystal ball immediately brightened, the red light more intense. The scale showed it was still Lower Grade C, but already approaching Grade B.
Seems like the Spirit Testing Platform is alright.
Wang Shouzhe let the clan members accompany the Array Master to rest and drink Spirit Tea, then began testing his own family members.
First was Wang Luotong, hmm~ slightly above Lower Grade B, might hit Grade A after consuming Stone Marrow.
The rest of the clan members went up one by one; the testing was quite lively. But apart from Wang Luomiao at Lower Grade A, the rest were mostly Grade B at most.
Finally, it was Wang Luojing’s turn. She went up, tested, and the crystal ball burst into a brilliant red glow, with mysterious starry specks swirling amid the red light, seemingly a special bloodline talent.
Middle Grade A!
Wang Shouzhe inhaled sharply, although he knew the result, he was still astonished. How much Stone Marrow did this girl consume back then?
Next, Wang Luqiu went up, also Middle Grade A. But the red light in her had golden star specks swirling, clearly her War Body Bloodline.
Usually, at Middle Grade, bloodline phenomena appear.
Then Wang Shouzhe went up for fun, the result indicated slightly above Middle Grade C! Similarly, green star specks swirled amid the light. To reach Grade C, obviously it wasn’t solely relying on that one Stone Marrow back then.
Over the years, Wang Shouzhe consumed numerous resources for the goal of awakening the second-layer bloodline. The result should be a modest improvement, moving slightly up the grade, still far from awakening the second-layer bloodline.
Still, it’s a smidgen stronger than Ancestor Longyan back then. The second-layer bloodline requires Upper Grade Talent for awakening. Such talent in the whole of Longzuo County is rare and celestial pride-like.
Nowadays Wang Shouzhe has seen more and can understand the situation. Generally, if the bloodline concentration in the Qi Refining Realm can reach Middle Grade, reaching Spirit Platform Realm is almost certain.
Upon promotion to Spirit Platform Realm and awakened a first-layer bloodline, one qualifies to aim for the Celestial Human Realm, albeit merely a matter of probability.
If two-layer awakening occurs at Qi Refining Realm, awakening the third-layer with Spirit Platform Realm ensures reaching Celestial Human Realm, and in the future, has a certain chance to aim for Purple Mansion Realm, potentially nurturing Nascent Soul there.
Such talent in the Purple Mansion Academy receives the highest level of nurturing, typically treated as Purple Mansion Seed, cultivated as direct disciples.
Indeed, Wang Lici went up to try... Upper Grade D!
Clearly, when she shared Jade Marrow with Luqiu and Luojing back then, she must have eaten and got more.
Otherwise, it would be very difficult for her to mix into two-layer awakening with just one Vermilion Fruit!
Wang Lici began to brag, donning an I’m the eldest sister attitude, which made Wang Shouzhe want to teach her a lesson.
Unfortunately, this girl possesses a divine talent, but is extremely lazy in cultivation, barely reaching Qi Refining Realm peak even now.
"Let Liyao try," Liua Ruolan said, blinking, "It’s said that the Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species has significant influence on the next generation, but only limited to the first child. Look at how much Yuan Rui and Ruolei are weaker than me."
Unfortunately, her brother Liua Yuanhui didn’t get the chance for the Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species... but this was Wang Shouzhe’s fortune!
Wang Shouzhe instantly grew energetic, carried his precious daughter on stage, and taught her to test.
Then, bright red light dazzled Wang Shouzhe’s eyes, the intensely bright red light was interwoven with a highly dense blue Water Element Power. Evidently, she had a Water Origin Element bloodline physique.
Wang Shouzhe was stunned!
After several breaths, he burst into wild laughter, his laughter so carefree and joyful.
"Daddy, why are you laughing?" His precious daughter Wang Liyao asked adorably clueless. She was young, not understanding what this meant.
"I laugh because..."
My daughter has the grandeur of an emperor!
...
```

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 4: Longyan Advances to Spirit Platform Realm Stage 4
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 4: Longyan Advances to Spirit Platform Realm Stage 4
...
"Haha!"
Wang Shouzhe was extremely excited, feeling his whole body ablaze with passion.
This was his precious daughter, and her bloodline talent was so rich.
Born with an Upper Grade B, and her Water Origin Bloodline was so dense, it seemed she was born with a Water Origin Spirit Body.
It’s truly unimaginable how high her growth potential might be in the future!
Beside him, Liua Ruolan also smiled joyfully, her eyes curved into arcs. Their daughter’s high talent was certainly a delight for both husband and wife, a masterpiece they accomplished together.
Wang Lici then skipped over to join the fun and said, "Indeed, she’s my sister. Truly, she has the presence of a Great Emperor."
Wang Shouzhe pushed her aside, giving her a side glance, what’s it got to do with you? He protected his daughter closely, fearing that his niece might lead her astray. What if she ends up lazy like her?
Holding Wang Liyao after stepping off the Spirit Testing Platform, Wang Shouzhe said to Liua Ruolan, "My dear, you should test yourself as well, so that your husband can witness how formidable your bloodline talent is."
Actually, he just wanted to see how much they differ, as he had been hungry for certain positions for a long time. On the premise that safety couldn’t be ensured, mentioning them was out of the question.
"I don’t need to test," said Liua Ruolan indifferently, smiling enchantingly, "As long as my husband and children protect me, that’s enough."
Wang Shouzhe felt slightly disappointed but couldn’t force her.
He thought that Ruolan’s bloodline awakening level should be similar to Luqiu and Luojing, maybe only to the extent of Lici. Compared to his precious daughter Liyao, she might be a notch lower.
Because there was still a lot of spirit stone energy left in the Spirit Testing Platform, Wang Shouzhe ordered others to bring the remaining children from the room to test them one by one.
Unfortunately, luck didn’t spill over, among seventy or eighty children, only one was found to have a Lower Grade D bloodline talent, but this was as expected and counted as good luck.
This child would naturally be taken in as a seed for a household general by the Wang Family, starting the cultivation process. The other children wouldn’t be left out either, they would enter the school set up by the Wang Family to learn some culture. The outstanding ones could stay and futurely enter different systems of the Wang Family.
After all, selecting these children carefully took quite some effort from the Wang Family.
Afterwards, the young people of the Wang Family dispersed. Everyone returned to their own tasks, except for Lici, who was very busy.
With no one else around.
However, since the Spirit Testing Platform seemed to have a little energy left, Wang Shouzhe somewhat reluctantly proposed, "My dear, try again, don’t waste the spirit stones."
"Alright, since my husband insists so much." After a slight hesitation, Liua Ruolan went up to test.
Then.
Wang Shouzhe regretted this suggestion.
He silently left holding his daughter.
At the same time, he was even more determined to enhance his own bloodline talent.
...
The days went by peacefully and uneventfully.
On this day.
Inside Longyan Residence.
Ancestor Longyan sat cross-legged in the secret chamber.
Her eyes were closed tightly, operating the Upper Grade Technique "Profound Ice True Technique" in the Spirit Platform Chapter.
All around her delicate figure floated peculiar ice and snowflakes, swirling around her in constant rotation, a truly magnificent and beautiful sight.
Suddenly!
The scene changed abruptly.
The snowflakes instantly coalesced into more than a dozen icy blades, violently traversing back and forth, whistling with piercing sounds.
The most terrifying thing was.
