The icy blades were not only extremely cold but seemed to mixed with some yin fiend energy, adding a significant amount of sinister cold energy to the secret chamber.
If an ordinary Black Tortoise Practitioner entered such an ice array,
fear not that they would be sliced apart, they would fall seriously ill due to the constant infiltration of yin fiend into their body.
After a long time, Ancestor Longyan finally withdrew her profound skills. The yin fiend icy blades vanished into thin air with just a wave of her hand.
She opened her star-like deep eyes, and couldn’t help but flash a trace of joy, her cultivation breaking through another layer again.
Her long seclusion had not been in vain.
When she walked out of the secret chamber,
found Wang Shouzhe waiting in the outer yard.
Wang Shouzhe greeted her with a smile, "Just now, I felt the ancestor’s aura surge greatly all at once, Shouzhe congratulates Ancestor on achieving great success in her profound skill."
Ancestor Longyan replied calmly, "Barely broke through to the late stage."
She spoke thus yet couldn’t restrain the slight joy in her eyes.
Since nearly sixty years ago, after that great disaster, her cultivation had not progressed an inch.
Moreover, she suffered the torment of yin fiend poisonous qi day and night, her organs and body continued to deteriorate day by day.
Despite all this, she persevered bitterly to protect the family.
The turnaround appeared when she absorbed and refined all the yin fiend energy.
By relying on the Creation Pill and Wang Shouzhe’s occasional treatment for her internal injuries, over years her body function not only fully recovered but became far stronger than before.
It’s no wonder that the yin fiend energy is so vicious? She suffered torment for fifty years, always fighting against it.
This in turn made her meridians, body, and every life factor unusually resilient.
It’s also unknown what talent Shouzhe possesses?
Helping her treat long-term, the aide he provided was not small, definitely not a simple Wood Bloodline Talent.
Due to various reasons, her cultivation has been progressing very swiftly in recent years.
"Shouzhe, all of this is thanks to you." Thinking so, Ancestor Longyan felt full of emotion, never having imagined before she would reach such a day.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 4: Longyan Advances to Spirit Platform Realm Late Stage 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 4: Longyan Advances to Spirit Platform Realm Late Stage 2
"Ancestor, please don’t say that," Wang Shouzhe said with a serious expression, "If it weren’t for Ancestor’s decades of unwavering support for the family, our Wang Family would have long been extinct. We, the younger generation, wouldn’t even exist."
For Ancestor Longyan to reach the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm so swiftly.
Wang Shouzhe felt very gratified, his heart full of a sense of achievement and security.
With a late-stage Spirit Platform expert in charge, as long as a Celestial Human Realm expert doesn’t attack us, we’re as stable as Mount Tai.
Looking over the entire Changning Guard, there are only three Celestial Human Realm experts.
Moreover, they rarely go out without major affairs, mostly staying at home.
They wouldn’t easily intervene, fearing one careless move might lead to their demise, dragging down the family with them. Celestial Human Realm cultivators are strong, but the weight on their shoulders is heavier, and naturally, they are more cautious about their lives.
Some words are better left unsaid; it is about family mutual support.
Ancestor Longyan did not continue to speak further but asked with concern, "Shouzhe, how is your situation after switching to the Eternal Spring True Technique these past two years? Does it fit your bloodline?"
Upon mentioning this, Wang Shouzhe responded, "Reporting to Ancestor, after switching, it feels very good. It has made my Profound Qi much richer and purer, and my control over plants has become stronger and more fluent. It’s indeed worthy of being an Upper Grade Technique."
Ancestor Longyan then relaxed his brows and said, "It seems that even if your talent isn’t Wood Element, it’s greatly related to the Wood Bloodline. Before you’ve found a truly suitable technique, this Eternal Spring True Technique is quite fitting for you."
Indeed, Wang Shouzhe is currently practicing the Eternal Spring True Technique, the secret heart method of Changchun Ascendant at the Purple Mansion Academy.
But he only has the Qi Refining Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique.
The technique for the Spirit Platform Chapter requires reaching the Spirit Platform Realm. After passing the assessment at the Purple Mansion Academy, one can be granted the subsequent Chapters.
Do not underestimate this mere Qi Refining Chapter.
Such an Upper Grade Technique’s Qi Refining Chapter wouldn’t easily be taught by the Purple Mansion Academy to outsiders.
This was obtained after Ancestor Xuanfu fought for his status as an outer disciple of the Academy.
The so-called outer disciples are a recruitment strategy by the Academy for outstanding young people with potential but, due to various reasons, cannot join the Academy.
In Wang Shouzhe’s understanding, formal Academy students are like full-time undergraduate students, whereas outer disciples like Wang Shouzhe are like distance learners.
The Academy recognizes you as a student and allows you to apply for certain techniques as circumstances warrant. However, it also won’t provide you with resources for cultivation.
If you don’t understand something in cultivation, you can write to the Academy, but whether you’ll get a reply is uncertain.
Of course, even being an outer disciple of the Academy isn’t an opportunity for everyone. You need to have a clean and reputable background with someone vouching for you.
Having a clean and reputable background means you can’t be a loose cultivator or from some unremarkable Black Tortoise Clan, etc., and even several generations of your ancestors must be checked before the Academy can trust you.
Moreover, outer disciples need some status; they can’t be collateral branch disciples, and even direct vein disciple assessments are stricter.
Wang Shouzhe is the clan leader of an Eighth-Grade Noble Family, with numerous generations traceable back to Ancestor of the Daqian Wang Family. His background is very clean and reputable.
Simultaneously, he awakened a first layer "Wood Bloodline" talent and had passed the Academy’s student preliminary selection.
Plus, Academy core disciple Liua Xuanfu vouched for him, thus he smoothly acquired the status of an Academy outer disciple and was authorized to learn the Qi Refining Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique.
However, his Eternal Spring True Technique can only be practiced by himself. If he dares to disclose or teach it, he would face the Academy’s ban, even implicating the entire family.
Moreover, there is a conditional restriction; once the Academy needs your assistance in summoning you, you cannot refuse and must comply to help.
Of course, such summons are only effective during national life-and-death crises or when facing significant external threats; ordinarily, the Academy wouldn’t need you.
Like Wang Shouzhe, his wife Liua Ruolan has the same treatment.
However, Liua Ruolan practices the Profound Water True Technique, also an Upper Grade Technique inheritance from the Academy.
Let’s put aside idle chatter.
After confirming Wang Shouzhe’s technique had no issues, Ancestor Longyan asked, "Shouzhe, are you here at Longyan Residence for any important matter?"
Lately, Ancestor Longyan had been in seclusion, attempting to break through to the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, so clan members usually wouldn’t disturb him.
Wang Shouzhe coming at this time must be for an important matter.
"Ancestor, Liua Family’s Ancestor Xuanfu has returned from the Academy," Wang Shouzhe said softly, "Ruolan is currently accompanying her, she probably has important matters to discuss with you."
Liua Xuanfu and Wang Longyan, in their youth, were collectively called the Changning Double Beauties.
Their fame was unmatched at the time.
The two were also competing against each other at the Academy, each having thoughts and actions to not fall behind the other.
Overall, Ancestor Longyan was always a bit more formidable.
But their relationship remained very close.
Only after Ancestor Longyan experienced a significant upheaval did she stay with the Wang Family for fifty years, never to leave Changning.
Gradually, the two became estranged.
In truth, Ancestor Longyan didn’t want to see Ancestor Xuanfu, as her condition couldn’t be cured, so why watch Ancestor Xuanfu’s thriving demeanor and add to the distress?
Until later, she sought a marriage proposal for Wang Shouzhe, hoping to secure the family’s future.
Only then did she muster the resolve to visit Ancestor Xuanfu while she returned to the Liua Family.
No one knows what they discussed back then, but ultimately Ancestor Xuanfu agreed to the marriage.
Wang Shouzhe previously thought it was nothing, perhaps Ancestor Xuanfu remembered old affections, but now believes there must be a hidden cause.
Now he and his wife Liua Ruolan both stepped into the peak of the Qi Refining Realm, and Ancestor Xuanfu returned from the Academy, the hidden secrets from back then are likely to be unveiled.
Ancestor Longyan silently pondered before saying faintly, "It is indeed time to return. Shouzhe, please invite Ancestor Xuanfu and Ruolan here."
"Yes, Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe complied.
Soon after.
Ancestor Longyan, Ancestor Xuanfu, Liua Ruolan, and Wang Shouzhe met in the Longyan Residence.
At this moment.
Wang Shouzhe finally had the chance to discreetly look at the famous Ancestor Xuanfu.
He saw her dressed in a water blue palace attire, with a veil on her face, making it impossible to see her age or appearance, but she seemed to have beauty preservation techniques, as her figure looked quite good.
In contrast to Ancestor Longyan’s aura, which subtly carried a sharp blade-like edge.
Ancestor Xuanfu’s temperament was more gentle like water, making people feel vast like the seas, evidently having cultivated the Profound Water True Technique to a very high level.
"Congratulations, Cousin Longyan, you have accumulated over time and finally reached the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm." Ancestor Xuanfu’s gaze was serene like water, resembling Ruolan in this aspect.
Ancestor Longyan replied faintly, "Compared to Cousin Xuanfu, I’m still far behind, it’s not worth mentioning."
"Cousin, you’ve endured a great ordeal to finally find peace and prosperity, and your future is promising. Perhaps you will step into the Celestial Human Realm even before me. If Binglan Ascendant hears of this, they will surely be gratified. I’m wondering, Cousin, do you have intentions to return to the Academy? I could lend a hand in some matters." Ancestor Xuanfu suggested.
Ancestor Longyan, however, furrowed her brows slightly with some displeasure, "No need for you to meddle in the matters between me and my Master."
It’s evident that the emotions between Ancestor Longyan and Ancestor Xuanfu, these cousins, are quite complex.
It’s no wonder, as Ancestor Longyan once overshadowed Ancestor Xuanfu, and now their cultivation levels have reversed. With Ancestor Longyan’s pride, there must be a hidden dissatisfaction within.
"Let’s discuss the matter at hand," Ancestor Longyan clearly did not want to dwell on it, she then turned to Wang Shouzhe and said, "Shouzhe, previously I did not reveal this matter to you. Firstly, it was to prevent distraction, and secondly, it is of no benefit.
Wang Shouzhe adjusted his posture to listen carefully, he understood Ancestor Longyan was about to disclose that secret.
"This is the greatest secret of our Ping’an Wang Family," Ancestor Longyan’s eyes looked slightly lost, as if recalling past events, "Shouzhe, do you know why Ancestor Zhou Xuan came to open up Ping’an Town back then?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 5 "Cowardly and Fearful" Wang Shouzhe
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 5 "Cowardly and Fearful" Wang Shouzhe
...
Wang Shouzhe’s mind stirred as he spoke, "Could there be some hidden truth in this?"
"Longzuo County was originally a pioneer county, with many directions for expansion. Ancestor Zhou Xuan chose this particular place to pioneer and establish the family for his own reasons."
"Back in the day, Ancestor Zhou Xuan was merely a direct lineage member of the Longzuo Wang Family. The Longzuo Wang Family was struggling at the time, declining continuously, even transitioning celestial humans was extremely difficult, and there weren’t many resources to nurture family members."
"Yet, Ancestor Zhou Xuan was born with an awakened bloodline, qualified to break through to the Celestial Human Realm. Hence, he was unwilling to spend his life being mediocre."
"Therefore, Ancestor Zhou Xuan ventured out seeking opportunities and discovered an extremely hidden location belonging to the Divine Martial Dynasty relic from the Middle Ages in the Outer Domain. Relying on the blessing of this relic, Ancestor Zhou Xuan successfully ascended to the Spirit Platform Realm."
"However, when Ancestor Zhou Xuan discovered the relic, he did not obtain the greatest opportunity within it. Because of this, he held the Pioneer Order, established the Ping’an Wang Family in this area, hoping his descendants could gradually control the relic and derive endless benefits from it. Presently, this relic is merely about a thousand miles away from our Ping’an."
As Ancestor Longyan explained gently, the reason why Ancestor Zhou Xuan headed south in the beginning became clear to everyone.
"So, there’s such a secret." Wang Shouzhe realized suddenly. Abruptly, his heart wavered, his expression changing slightly as he said, "Back then, about my father..."
In those years, the former patriarch Wang Dingyue perished while seeking opportunities in the Outer Domain, a matter Wang Shouzhe had always found suspicious. After all, the family still had some surplus funds at that time, and with a bit of effort, it was still possible to buy a Celestial Spirit Pill at a loss.
"Alas, speaking of which, it’s all my fault." Ancestor Longyan’s eyes flashed with a hint of bitterness. "Yes, back then when Ding Yue reached the peak of the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm, I discussed this matter with him. Opportunities were hard to come by, and both Qiong Yuan’s nephew and I had once explored that relic and gained benefits from it."
"Unexpectedly, fortune was so unfavorable, he encountered a Tier Four Ferocious Beast midway. Even though I did my utmost to protect him, I couldn’t save his life." Speaking of this, Ancestor Longyan’s gaze dimmed with guilt, evidently distressed over Wang Dingyue’s death.
"Ancestor, what’s past is past. Besides, your condition wasn’t well at that time, which also worsened your injury," Wang Shouzhe consoled softly, "However, Ancestor, what kind of relic is it exactly? How can one benefit from it? And what dangers does it hold?"
Wang Shouzhe asked a series of questions, expressing his bewilderment.
In his view, no matter how good ancient relics might be, one needs to be alive to enjoy them.
If it’s merely for a small Celestial Spirit Pill, it seems unworthy to venture into the Outer Domain. He would rather take his time farming, using time to accumulate strength for a grand breakthrough.
With the current financial strength of the Wang Family, buying a Celestial Spirit Pill wouldn’t severely injure their Primordial Qi anymore.
If things aren’t made clear or sufficient preparations aren’t in place, without a high level of certainty, he would absolutely refuse to venture deep into the Outer Domain for adventure.
"That relic is a trial land opened to outsiders by the Divine Martial Dynasty with the intention of recruiting promising young talents for the dynasty. It’s inherently non-dangerous, even if one fails the trial, there’s no risk to life."
"Back then, when Ancestor Zhou Xuan was at the peak of the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm, he passed the first trial, obtaining something known as a consolation prize... a stored Celestial Spirit Pill."
"Uh..."
Wang Shouzhe wiped a drop of cold sweat. What kind of relic is it? To call a Celestial Spirit Pill a consolation prize...
No wonder back in the day, the former patriarch Wang Dingyue was eager to venture into the Outer Domain.
Given the Wang Family’s condition at the time, if procuring a Celestial Spirit Pill was possible, it was worth risking life for.
"The difficulty of the first trial isn’t too great but isn’t too small either," Ancestor Longyan introduced. "The Gatekeeper is a demon puppet at the peak of the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm. If you can defeat it within the rules, you pass. If your Black Tortoise Combat Technique is well-mastered, you could manage to pass this trial."
"As for the Celestial Spirit Pill, I heard the Divine Martial Dynasty was extremely powerful, at its peak holding a territory unknown for hundreds of thousands of miles. A mere Celestial Spirit Pill was nothing. If one could pass the second trial, the rewards are rich."
Ancestor Longyan continued, "The second trial involves simultaneously battling two demon puppets at the peak of the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm! Once passed, you can obtain an elixir that improves bloodline aptitude."
"An elixir to improve bloodline aptitude?" Wang Shouzhe’s eyes brightened at this; what he lacked the most now was precisely this, rather than the Celestial Spirit Pill, which could be obtained more easily.
"I remember back then, I barely managed to pass the second trial, obtaining the bloodline improvement elixir and a Celestial Spirit Pill," Ancestor Longyan continued, "Unfortunately, my initial bloodline talent wasn’t very high, just around Middle Grade D. After consuming that elixir, it only reached around Middle Grade A, and did not awaken the Second Layer bloodline."
"But even so, when I ascended to the Spirit Platform Realm, my Primordial Water Bloodline transformed into a Profound Ice Bloodline. Also, in terms of talent, I was much stronger than ordinary Second Layer bloodline bearers."
As Ancestor Longyan continued to narrate.
Wang Shouzhe finally understood, no wonder Ancestor Longyan’s combat power was so formidable.
Moreover, after she ascended to the Spirit Platform Realm, she surged forward with unstoppable momentum, always placing Ancestor Xuanfu under her.
If it weren’t for that unexpected event back then, Ancestor Longyan might have already reached the Celestial Human Realm by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 5 "Cowardly and Fearful" Wang Shouzhe_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 5 "Cowardly and Fearful" Wang Shouzhe_2
Moreover, it’s well known that the Profound Ice Bloodline is one of the three abnormal attribute bloodlines, and its destructive power is much stronger than the purely Primordial Water Bloodline. But it also has a drawback, in terms of self-recovery power, it’s not as good as the Primordial Water Bloodline.
Although Ancestor Xuanfu had heard of this from Ancestor Longyan last time, there was still some emotional turmoil in her eyes. When Ancestor Longyan broke through to the Spirit Platform Realm, it was her most glorious thirty years, leaving Ancestor Xuanfu far behind.
To the extent that she even had some doubts about life back then. Now hearing her bring it up again, she felt a pang of sourness in her heart.
"Ancestor, the second trial was two Peak of Ninth Layer Qi Refining Realm, is the third one possibly three?" Wang Shouzhe said, slightly teasingly.
"That’s right, the third trial is indeed so, which is why I only got through the second trial." Ancestor Longyan said rather helplessly, "Those demon puppets are extremely difficult, I struggled desperately to get past two of them."
Wang Shouzhe was somewhat speechless, that trial designer really went the brainless route. Could there be a fourth trial with four of them? He chuckled indeed~
However, upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe was already tempted.
But if he wants to beat two same-level strong opponents, the difficulty is likely daunting. Three? Let’s not even mention it, with his current strength, it’s simply impossible!
At this point.
Liua Ruolan blinked and said: "Ancestor Xuanfu, did you sell me to the Wang Family for this secret?"
Ancestor Xuanfu coughed twice, with a slightly embarrassed look: "Ruolan, don’t misunderstand, I’m purely thinking of you."
"Your talent is already extremely high. The more so, you mustn’t miss such opportunities. Not to mention the Spirit Pill of the second trial, which must have some effect for you. But the key is winning the third trial! From what the relic expresses, once you pass the three trials, you can become a disciple of the Divine Martial Dynasty and go to practice there."
Wang Shouzhe frowned and said: "Isn’t the Divine Martial Dynasty long extinct for over ten thousand years?"
Ancestor Xuanfu shook her head and said: "Although the Divine Martial Dynasty has perished, its relics still exist in various places. And the famous core area of the Divine Martial Dynasty remains a mystery."
"Even the Purple Mansion Academy values the relics of the Divine Martial Dynasty greatly, hence such opportunities should not be missed. Moreover, the Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species I obtained back then came from a relic of the Divine Martial Dynasty. If we can find the core area..."
Ah, so Ancestor Xuanfu’s ambition is quite grand.
Wang Shouzhe nodded silently, but pondered: "There’s another question, why didn’t sixth grandfather Wang Xiaohan go for the relic trial back then?"
Ancestor Longyan explained: "This Divine Martial trial is not for everyone. One must be below the Spirit Platform Realm and not over forty years of age. Back then, Xiaohan had already missed the age. And your father Wang Dingyue barely qualified."
Alright, it seems like the Divine Martial Dynasty’s requirements are quite high. Those slightly lacking don’t even get the chance to try.
"Can one participate in the trial without being at the Peak of Ninth Layer?"
"Should be possible. The problem is if you’re not at the Peak of Ninth Layer, it’s hard to win against the Ninth Layer’s Demon Puppets, you’d be going for nothing."
"Can we go back after winning two trials and try again in a few years?"
"This... according to the Trial Artifact Spirit, if you come next time, you have to start again, and the rewards aren’t repeated."
As Wang Shouzhe raised one question after another, he continuously refreshed Ancestor Longyan’s worldview.
Besides, Ancestor Xuanfu gradually became impatient: "Hey, Shouzhe. Are you done with your questions? Let’s get ready, we’re setting off in the next couple of days."
"Wait! Ancestor Xuanfu, are you just going like this?" Wang Shouzhe was somewhat bewildered, "This seems a bit too rushed."
"Shouzhe, you’re not ready yet?" Ancestor Xuanfu said with a puzzled expression.
Are you kidding me, what do you mean not ready?
I haven’t even started preparing yet?
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat, this Ancestor Xuanfu was a bit hasty indeed, then he raised a skeptical discussion: "Ancestor Xuanfu’s plan won’t be just the four of us going, right?"
"No, there’s also Liua Yuanhui." Ancestor Xuanfu said calmly, "Don’t worry, even if we encounter a Tier Four Ferocious Beast, just the two of us, Longyan and I, would be enough."
That tone, seems a bit too confident.
Wang Shouzhe stroked his chin and pondered: "A Tier Four Ferocious Beast is fine, but what if we run into two Tier Four Ferocious Beasts? What if we encounter a Tier Five Ferocious Beast? Does Ancestor Xuanfu have a strategic plan for this?"
Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyelids twitched, and she said in annoyance: "Where in the world are there so many Tier Five Ferocious Beasts? According to Longyan, it’s just over a thousand miles from here."
"It’s already quite deep into the Outer Domain, so we need to be fully prepared," Wang Shouzhe said.
"And what do you mean by fully prepared...?" Ancestor Xuanfu felt an ominous foreboding arise.
"At the very least, when we encounter a Tier Five Ferocious Beast, I won’t say we have to kill it, but at least we should be able to intimidate it."
"Plus, my Bloodline Talent isn’t enough yet, barely beating the second trial, absolutely can’t beat the third trial."
"Once you break through to the Spirit Platform Realm there’s no way to participate anymore, life only has this one chance. So I plan to gather some Heavenly and Earthly Treasures to enhance the bloodline, as well as items that can intimidate Tier Five Ferocious Beasts."
"How long do you have to prepare for this?" Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyelids were jumping, trying to suppress the urge to hit someone.
"Anyway, there’s no rush, we’ll prepare slowly. If I don’t have full confidence, I’m not going to take the risk. Oh, and dear wife, you’re not allowed to go either."
"Opportunities and such, you need to be alive to compete for them. Most Heavenly and Earthly Treasures can be bought with money, if not, we’ll farm slowly and accumulate wealth slowly. Then buy, buy, buy!"
Liua Ruolan nodded obediently and said: "Yes, dear husband, I listen to you."
Ancestor Xuanfu was nearly dizzy, she stared blankly at Ancestor Longyan and said: "Is your family boy really this cowardly? We’re working hard to seek opportunities for the younger ones. Those Celestial Prides, which one doesn’t fight to the death for opportunities?"
Ancestor Longyan was also somewhat embarrassed, her great-great nephew indeed doesn’t have that imposing bravado to advance forward without fear like a Celestial Pride.
"Well... my Shouzhe, he’s not cowardly, but rather prepares for the worst in everything."
"However, I think Shouzhe is right; it was precisely my lack of thoughtfulness that cost Ding Yue’s life. Shouzhe, you decide on this matter, we’ll set off once you’re ready."
"Boy, if you don’t want to go, that’s fine." Ancestor Xuanfu was quite agitated, "I can take Ruolan and Yuanhui myself."
"Ancestor, if my husband says we can’t go, I certainly can’t go. I’m a daughter-in-law of the Wang Family..." Unexpectedly, Liua Ruolan directly shook her head and said, "Moreover, my husband is right, it’s always good to have more preparation, we must also think about the children."
"My dear wife, you’re so obedient."
"Dear husband is truly good, always thinking of the family in everything."
"Being able to marry you is the greatest fortune of my life."
"Being able to marry dear husband is the greatest blessing of my life as Liua Ruolan."
The husband and wife sung in harmony, not forgetting to throw a wave of dog food.
Both ancestors have been single for over a hundred years, hearing this, they turned their heads aside.
This is too mushy...
Then, Ancestor Xuanfu helplessly said to Wang Shouzhe: "Alright, you go prepare. But make it quick..."
"Ancestor, give me the map first, I can plan the route in advance." Wang Shouzhe got to the point; facing such adventurous Outer Domain dungeon affairs, he wouldn’t let others dictate the pace.
Following suit, Ancestor Longyan handed an old map to Wang Shouzhe.
And then Wang Shouzhe began his preparations.
A month later, Ancestor Xuanfu asked if he was ready yet?
Wang Shouzhe calmly said he was not ready.
Was still not ready by the second month.
By the third month, when Ancestor Xuanfu came to ask again, she was shocked to find Wang Shouzhe had already gone shopping.
"Ancestor, husband said he found a channel through friends to buy something that can kill Tier Five Ferocious Beasts. Also, there are clues for the bloodline evolution Spirit Pill and Bone Marrow Purify Pill." Liua Ruolan calmly said, holding the two little ones, "And husband said if there’s no Storage Ring, my change of clothes and daily necessities, as well as favorite snacks can’t be taken, so he’s planning to buy me a Storage Ring as well."
Each sentence stunned Ancestor Xuanfu into silence, each situation left her dumbfounded... even a ’buy on the side’ Storage Ring!
I can’t even bear to buy a Storage Ring...
Going out but with daily necessities? Is this a trip outing?
Wang Shouzhe this boy, how can he be so outrageously wealthy?
For a moment, Ancestor Xuanfu felt sourness in her heart.
She, as a core disciple of the Academy, how did she suddenly become a pauper?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 6 Overwhelming Power! Celestial Human Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 6 Overwhelming Power! Celestial Human Family
...
East Sea.
The vast sea, with its billowing waves.
A giant sailing ship is cutting through the waves with the wind. This ship has a heavy wooden structure, with the sides and key areas clad in a layer of riveted iron sheets, making it exceptionally solid.
It is about thirty zhang long and more than eight zhang wide, a giant transport sea vessel.
Large bed crossbows are installed at the bow, sides, and stern of the ship. The crossbow arrows are more than a zhang long, with a fierce glint, exuding might. Once these crossbow arrows are fired, even a Tier Three Ferocious Beast would sense danger.
The ship is loaded with a large quantity of goods, including some precious glass products, paper, and snow sugar, among others. However, the bulk of the cargo consists of a material known as foreign cement.
Foreign cement is a building material. Some Black Tortoise Clans, whenever involved in significant constructions like houses, sluices, city walls, and so on, would use a building material known as lime mortar.
Lime mortar is a high-quality adhesive for construction. The only issue is that it is too expensive. Typically, a dan of lime mortar costs as much as an ordinary dan of grain.
This price is indeed unaffordable for ordinary families, and even the Black Tortoise Race would only use such materials on important structures.
Foreign cement is a building material not inferior to lime mortar, with the price of a dan being only two large coppers, much cheaper than lime mortar. Upon entering the market, it became extremely popular, with various Black Tortoise Clans switching to using foreign cement.
Even some ordinary civilian families would grittingly choose to use foreign cement when building houses, as it makes the houses more solid, sturdy, and durable.
This giant ocean-going sailing vessel is loaded with as much as a hundred thousand dan of foreign cement, with a total value reaching two thousand Qian Gold. Yet even so, these hundred thousand dan of foreign cement are merely a drop in the bucket.
Once it arrives at the East Sea Guard, it will be quickly snatched up.
East Port Chen Family owns as many as five ships like this. Every three months, they supply the East Sea Guard with five hundred thousand dan of foreign cement, as well as glass products, snow sugar, and more.
This single trade run exceeds a total value of thirty thousand Qian Gold.
At the bow stood a handsome young man with his hands behind his back, gazing at the sea while listening to someone reporting next to him. With the waves’ undulation, he stood as steady as on flat ground.
Surrounding him were two elderly men with extraordinary demeanor and a man in his thirties.
That man also had an extraordinary bearing, dressed in fine clothing with a long cloak, and had a handsome face with two small mustaches. He smiled and said, "Shouzhe, this is roughly the situation regarding the foreign cement trade. The biggest issue right now is insufficient production. Otherwise, we could certainly transport foreign cement to even more distant counties."
Foreign cement is a basic construction material with a very wide market application and it will be consumed completely no matter how much there is. That handsome young man is Wang Shouzhe. The other man is brother-in-law Chen Fangjie.
"Regarding production, I will notify the Gongsun Family and Liua Family to organize manpower for extracting raw materials." Wang Shouzhe stated calmly, "Your most important task is to keep it a secret; you must not let anyone know the origin of the foreign cement is from our Changning."
"Don’t worry, Shouzhe, the names foreign cement and foreign glass are well thought out, and others only know that our East Port Chen Family brought them from overseas." Chen Fangjie confidently said, "Our East Port Chen Family has over a century of overseas trade experience, with our own exclusive maritime routes, and we will not be exposed."
Wang Shouzhe nodded. Over these years, the East Port Chen Family has done very well in this area.
This is because everyone is currently too weak, fearing to attract others’ covetous attention on this industry, leading to such an inferior strategy being adopted.
The main purpose of his trip to the East Sea Guard this time is not merely to inspect the industry. He also heard about the Hundred Treasures Pavilion auction in the East Sea Guard, where a Bone Marrow Purify Pill is available, which drew him to travel thousands of miles to the East Sea Guard.
"Shouzhe, the funds you want to mobilize are already prepared. This time I’ve prepared a hundred thousand Qian Gold for you." Chen Fangjie stated proudly, "Our Ruhong Ancestor said that as long as Shouzhe needs money, even if we have to mortgage industries to obtain loans, we should gather the funds. If it’s not enough, I’ll find another way."
"That’s about it." Wang Shouzhe stated calmly.
This time, he himself carried three hundred thousand Qian Gold, which is the maximum liquid funds that Ping’an Wang Family can draw. Any more might affect the operation of various industries.
To prevent accidents, he asked East Port Chen Family, Gongsun Family, Liua Family, and Lua Family to prepare some backup funds. After all, the items to be purchased this time are all quite expensive, and with a definitive ambition towards them, it’s always good to prepare more funds.
Including the backup funds prepared by the allies, the total has reached seventy thousand Qian Gold. With this terrifying amount of funds, even a Celestial Human Family daring to compete with him would be knocked down.
Yes, this is the strength of the Wang Family and its allies now. Everyone cooperates in industries, each responsible for their own part. And Wang Shouzhe is the most crucial figure among them.
This has been a long-standing plan of Wang Shouzhe. Relying solely on the Wang Family is too weak, and any disturbance would be a risk. It is better to share interests among allies, develop together, and survive in a group.
As a result, not only has the Wang Family grown rapidly, but even the allies have become increasingly powerful.
A while ago, both Gongsun Qiang from the Gongsun Family and Lua Zhengjie succeeded in advancing to the Spirit Platform Realm, adding two War Generals to the alliance. These two new forces will not stay within the family but will join the alliance’s industries, safeguarding the alliance’s industries.

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 6 Overwhelming Power! Celestial Human Family_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 6 Overwhelming Power! Celestial Human Family_2
It is believed that the interest alliance with Wang Shouzhe at its core will become increasingly united and powerful, able to contend even with Celestial Human Families.
As the sailboat continued on its journey, it docked at the deepwater harbor of the East Sea Guard.
On the dock, a gorgeously dressed young man in his thirties was waiting, followed by several attendants.
Upon seeing Chen Fangjie, he greeted him with a smile, "Brother Fang Jie, it’s been a long time."
Then he turned his gaze to Wang Shouzhe, and his eyes flashed in surprise. He never expected such a young nobleman to already be at the peak of the Qi Refining Realm.
Moreover, the two elder guards beside him were extraordinary, their auras profound and lengthy, even he, who had just advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, found them unfathomable.
Immediately, he revealed a warm smile, "This must be Young Master Wang from Lingbei, right? I am Tantai Heyu, just call me Heyu."
"I am Wang Ziteng, nice to meet Brother Tantai." Wang Shouzhe greeted elegantly, exuding the demeanor of a noble family young master.
After brief exchanges.
Tantai Heyu led the group into the best restaurant of the East Sea Guard.
What naturally followed was a round of enthusiastic hospitality.
The details will not be elaborated further.
Several days later.
East Sea Guard, Hundred Treasures Pavilion.
With Tantai Heyu’s arrangements, Wang Shouzhe’s group was naturally seated in one of the best private rooms, waiting for the upcoming auction.
Meanwhile, various wealthy patrons were arriving in droves.
This auction had many rare items, attracting many noble families from nearby cities around the East Sea Guard, though most could only sit in second-tier private rooms.
Only two groups piqued Wang Shouzhe’s interest.
One group, led by a middle-aged gorgeously dressed man, exuded a grand aura, accompanied by two Spirit Platform Realm cultivators.
The leader of the other group was a charming woman, equally imposing, surrounded by numerous guards.
When these two groups met outside the private room, tension immediately flared up.
The charming woman first sneered, "Oh, isn’t this Liu Kangping, the patriarch of Chuyun Liu Family? Are you here for the Bone Marrow Purify Pill too? I advise you to give up. Your useless son is better off being replaced with a new one."
The Chuyun Liu Family was a renowned Celestial Human Family in the Chuyun Guard, with a long history and formidable strength.
The middle-aged man Liu Kangping’s face turned cold, "So it’s Lady Bilian with your big mouth. Which family’s pretty boy have you taken a fancy to this time? Spending on a Bone Marrow Purify Pill to win someone over?"
Lady Bilian chuckled, "I want to, and as long as I’m here, it won’t be your useless son’s turn."
Liu Kangping retorted with a cold smile, "Then let’s watch and see, I hope Lady Bilian has enough money ready."
After exchanging a couple of barbs, both groups returned to their private rooms.
They hadn’t concealed their words, so Wang Shouzhe heard everything clearly. Evidently, these two groups were his strongest competitors.
However, he had been waiting for news about the Bone Marrow Purify Pill for years and was determined to succeed, undeterred even by the Celestial Human Families. Moreover, with the enhancement of his bloodline from the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, he was confident in winning the second round, ensuring no loss.
The Bone Marrow Purify Pill was exceedingly expensive, and even a Celestial Human Family found it challenging to purchase one easily. A casual purchase could severely injure their primordial qi.
The auction quickly began.
One by one, Heavenly and Earthly Treasures were presented, each fetching from hundreds to thousands of Qian Gold, quickly being snapped up.
This time, the East Sea Guard’s Hundred Treasures Pavilion brought out quite a number of good items to establish their name.
Neither Wang Shouzhe nor the other two groups had made a bid.
An hour later.
The auctioneer started bidding for the Bone Marrow Purify Pill.
"The Bone Marrow Purify Pill is a sixth-grade spirit pill, starting at ten thousand Qian Gold."
"Twelve thousand Qian Gold." Without waiting for the auctioneer to finish, Liu Kangping immediately raised the bid.
"Thirteen thousand." Lady Bilian was obviously also determined to win, with ample funds prepared.
The two quickly raised it to fifteen thousand with their back-and-forth bidding.
At this point, their bids became more cautious, increasing slowly by a few thousand.
Under normal circumstances, a Bone Marrow Purify Pill would fetch around twenty thousand, but why not try to get it cheaper if possible? What if the other party hadn’t prepared enough Qian Gold?
Even for a Celestial Human Family, raising twenty thousand Qian Gold at once was no easy task.
"Twenty thousand."
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t bear their slow bidding any longer and directly raised it to twenty thousand.
What?
Neither group expected a third competitor for the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, their faces darkened, but the bidding voice came from the best private room.
The Hundred Treasures Pavilion had rules; without being from a Celestial Human Family, one could not sit in the best private rooms.
This made them wary.
"Which family’s friend are you from?" Liu Kangping asked, "Why not do me a favor and stop here, I’ll bid twenty thousand and one thousand."
"Ha ha, Liu Kangping, you have some nerve, I bid twenty-one thousand." Lady Bilian also said, "I am determined to get this pill, the two of you should back off."
"Twenty-five thousand." Wang Shouzhe couldn’t be bothered with slow bidding, "It’s just fair competition, feel free to continue bidding."
With this, Liu Kangping and Lady Bilian’s faces changed dramatically.
Which Celestial Human Family’s young master was this extravagant? This price left them hesitant. Though the Bone Marrow Purify Pill was precious, it rarely reached such heights.
Nobody’s money came with the wind; this amount could buy many Celestial Spirit Pills!
Moreover, what if this is a setup? If one bids higher and the other party suddenly withdraws, it would be a trap.
They still had some money, but continuing would hurt their primordial qi.
Liu Kangping left the Hundred Treasures Pavilion with a cold face, unable to cause trouble despite being a member of a Celestial Human Family.
Lady Bilian, on the other hand, smiled, "This young master is so generous, which family might you be from? Might I have the honor of a meeting?"
Wang Shouzhe knew of Lady Bilian’s bad reputation and naturally didn’t want to engage with her. What if word reached his wife, and he got beaten?
Wang Shouzhe immediately sneered, "We are fated not to meet, Madam."
"Hmph." Lady Bilian snorted coldly, "Unappreciative." She too left angrily.
Very naturally, the Bone Marrow Purify Pill fell into Wang Shouzhe’s hands! With the Bone Marrow Purify Pill in hand, he couldn’t help but sigh; after being in this world for eight years, he finally had a chance to come up against the Celestial Human Families and come out on top.
He had to admit, it felt pretty good.
After obtaining the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, Wang Shouzhe immediately went for the next item.
...
Three months later.
By the end of August, the weather in the Outer Domain was gradually cooling.
A Primordial Water Spirit Turtle, larger than a small car and weighing several tons, was briskly running along a dirt path, full of energy even under its hefty load.
No choice, its owner’s generosity was overwhelming.
This time, the mission rewards were extremely generous, with Spirit Flesh Spirit Fish offered without restraint.
Following the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle, Ancestor Xuanfu looked on with a peculiar expression.
Six months!
Wang Shouzhe had prepared for a full six months.
Was he going to the Outer Domain or the Demon Realm?
And what all did he prepare? A sedan-like structure woven from vines, securely tied on the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle’s back, forming a mobile house inside which was covered with soft goose down cushions and had a small table set up.
The table was filled with snacks and refreshments.
Her cherished grandniece, whom she had pinned great hopes on, was lazily lying on the cushions, occasionally munching on a piece of fruit, appearing entirely at ease.
"My dear, it’s hard on you to travel to the Outer Domain this time." Wang Shouzhe said apologetically, "Time was short, and I couldn’t prepare sufficiently, the conditions are too basic, truly wronging you."
"No worries, no worries, it’s worth any toil to accompany husband on a quest." Liua Ruolan, while pinching a snack, placed it in Wang Shouzhe’s mouth, "Husband, you’ve toiled preparing for the journey lately." The term "quest" was something she picked up from Wang Shouzhe.
The two showered each other with affection, showing love unabashedly.
Causing Ancestor Xuanfu’s anger to rise steadily, she had painstakingly obtained an Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species, aiming to cultivate an unparalleled celestial pride.
Now this precious pride was turned sweetly fragile by that pesky junior Wang Shouzhe?
Most irritatingly, dogs were fed all this affection right along the journey.
For her – still single at over one hundred twenty – it was a tough pill to swallow.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 7: Great Opportunity! The Legacy of Ancestor Wang
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 7: Great Opportunity! The Legacy of Ancestor Wang
...
This time, quite a few people are going on the Outer Domain trip.
Among the younger generation,
there are Chen Fangjie, Liua Yuanhui, Gongsun Yan, Lua Xiaoxiao, Wang Luoyi, and Liua Ruolei.
There are also Wang Shouyong, Wang Shou Lian, Wang Luotong, and Wang Shounuo.
And we have the little Celestial Prides of the Wang Family, Wang Luqiu, Wang Lici, and Wang Luojing.
Almost the whole family came along.
Many of the family’s elders are here as well, Ancestor Ruhong, Ancestor Ming Sheng, Ancestor Mang, Ancestor Longyan, Ancestor Xuanfu, a total of five Spirit Platform Realm Cultivators.
Such a luxurious lineup caused Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyelids to twitch, she deliberately lagged behind and said to Ancestor Longyan, "Cousin, what is going on here? We clearly agreed at the beginning that this relic would be shared by our two families, so why are there so many people now?"
Ancestor Longyan said calmly, "I indeed said that."
"But now all the big and small matters at home are being decided by Shouzhe. Why don’t you ask him?"
Ancestor Xuanfu’s brow twitched, "Cousin, you can’t burn bridges like this. For this relic, I even married Ruolan to your family."
The Gongsun Family, East Port Chen Family, Yingxiu Lu Family. They didn’t even pay any price and just joined this feast.
Ancestor Longyan helplessly called Wang Shouzhe down to let him explain to Ancestor Xuanfu.
"Ancestor Xuanfu, we are all relatives. It’s only right to share good things together, why bear grudges?" Wang Shouzhe said with composure.
Why bear grudges?
Ancestor Xuanfu felt a bit aggrieved, and said quietly, "Sharing good things, why wasn’t this mentioned earlier? Only after Ruolan married did the sharing begin."
"Perhaps, Ruolan and I were destined in a previous life." Wang Shouzhe said.
What the heck, destined in a previous life!
Ancestor Xuanfu’s mouth twitched, it was probably due to the two kids this young lad and Ruolan already had that made her want to hit him.
Unfortunately, the deed is done, and regrets are useless. Besides, she also heard that the collaboration between the Liua Family and the Wang Family had brought quite a lot of profit.
Even his brothers and nephews, the two ancestors, were full of praise for Wang Shouzhe.
So be it, there’s no use overthinking, it’s damaging to the spirit.
Ancestor Xuanfu reluctantly waved Wang Shouzhe away, asking him to keep his distance to avoid the urge to hit him when she saw him.
Hence, Wang Shouzhe returned to the turtle carriage, continuing to display affection with his wife as if no one else was around.
Until Wang Luoyi, who was also in the carriage, couldn’t stand it anymore and drove Wang Shouzhe off.
Only then did the team move forward peacefully and calmly.
Wang Shouzhe had already studied the map repeatedly and compared it with the map the Wang Family had established in the Outer Domain over the past eight years to find the safest and easiest route.
The group traveled lightly and swiftly.
Each day’s journey was much faster than the hunting teams. For the thousand or so miles, they only stopped for four nights.
As for the turtle carriage, it could only be taken by Wang Luoyi and Liua Ruolan. Even if Wang Lici was envious, she was ordered to travel on foot using her body technique.
Even for a delicate cousin like Lua Xiaoxiao, Wang Shouzhe was quite strict.
Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe accompanied everyone on foot, preventing the sisters from rebelling.
The Black Tortoise Clan typically wouldn’t hunt so far into the Outer Domain. Therefore, the first two nights could still be spent at camps, but later on, it was all in uninhabited wilderness, and they had to set up camps themselves.
Due to good route planning and a bit of luck.
The journey was free of danger, not encountering any Tier Five Ferocious Beasts, not even a Tier Four Ferocious Beast.
At most, they encountered a Tier Three pig-like Ferocious Beast.
It was unlucky for that Tier Three Ferocious Beast.
The group of ancestors swarmed it, and the result was undeniably a heap of spiritual flesh accumulated for everyone.
All present were Black Tortoise elites, and the ancestors had great appetites, so if they indulged in eating, this Tier Three Ferocious Beast would only last seven or eight days.
However, the calmer the better, Wang Shouzhe was only preparing for contingencies, and not encountering a Tier Five Ferocious Beast was normal, encountering one would be strange. But if unprepared, should anything unexpected occur, Wang Shouzhe could not bear the consequences.
Smoothly, they arrived at the destination, which was ordinary and quite hidden.
If not for Ancestor Longyan, who came here nearly a century ago.
Without a guide, it would be extremely difficult to find this place. Because one must weave through a narrow canyon gorge, twisting and turning, to enter an unremarkable gorge.
Back then, Ancestor Zhou Xuan was being chased by a Tier Three Ferocious Beast and accidentally stumbled upon this place in panic.
This is what you call opportunity.
If this place were easy to find, it wouldn’t have gone to Ancestor Zhou Xuan.
Unfortunately, Ancestor Zhou Xuan didn’t succeed in using this opportunity to promote to the Celestial Human Realm.
All the effort in planning only benefited the descendants.
This is what they call planting trees for others to enjoy the shade.
Furthermore, this relic is not directly exposed in the canyon, but rather buried in the mountainside adjacent to the canyon, accessible through concealed natural crevices.
As they say, times change, and so does the land.
Over ten thousand years, everything has changed.
Most of this relic has collapsed, with many structures having merged into the mountain, leaving only a central area resembling an arena.
"Welcome to the thirty-seventh Divine Martial Army Recruitment Point."

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 7: Great Opportunity! The Legacy of Ancestor Wang_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 7: Great Opportunity! The Legacy of Ancestor Wang_2
As everyone stepped into the relic, a sweet yet somewhat monotonous voice came from the air.
Divine Martial Army Recruitment Point?
Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised, this didn’t quite match what Ancestor had mentioned.
Everyone’s gaze was on Ancestor Longyan; she was the only one who had been here, so naturally, everyone awaited her move.
"Hello Artifact Spirit, my name is Wang Longyan." Ancestor Longyan took out a black token.
"Elite Militia Wang Longyan, welcome. It appears your Civilian Soldier Token has no accolades. Please continue to strive and contribute to the Divine Martial Dynasty."
Elite Militia Wang Longyan.
All eyes were on Ancestor Longyan. Our distinguished Ancestor Longyan was considered merely an elite militia by the Artifact Spirit.
Ancestor Longyan was slightly embarrassed.
"Cousin Longyan, didn’t you say this relic was for selecting Divine Martial disciples?" Ancestor Xuanfu asked doubtfully.
Ancestor Longyan glared at her slightly displeased: "Isn’t it the same? Legend says the Divine Martial Army is the core force of the Divine Martial Dynasty; they don’t bother with the disciple thing. Anyway, as long as you pass, you’ll receive all the rewards."
Her tone seemed a bit indignant. Clearly, she hadn’t expected the Artifact Spirit to directly reveal her elite militia identity.
Wang Shouzhe also chuckled secretly,
but at the same time felt a profound dread, as the Divine Martial Dynasty, which was destroyed ten thousand years ago, seemed truly terrifying.
Someone like Ancestor Longyan of the Purple Mansion Academy’s Core Disciple was considered just an elite militia?
It shows how formidable the Divine Martial Dynasty was at its peak?
"Alright, everyone, let’s not mind these details," Wang Shouzhe stepped in to help Ancestor Longyan, "Ancestor, anything we should pay attention to during the trial?"
"Nothing particular to note. Simply tell the Artifact Spirit that you’re ready for the test, and if you think you can’t win, you can surrender." Ancestor Longyan replied.
Wang Shouzhe pondered briefly, scanned the group before targeting someone with his gaze: "Alright then, Brother-in-law, you’re the eldest, you go first."
Chen Fangjie was somewhat shocked: "I get it, you brought me to participate in the trial just so I could scout ahead, didn’t you?"
"Brother-in-law, you’re almost thirty and have barely reached the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm. Since you might not succeed, it’s better for you to test the waters first so I can plan the strategy." Wang Shouzhe said mercilessly, "If you don’t go, do you expect my sister to scout instead?"
Without waiting for Chen Fangjie to respond.
Ancestor Ruhong gave him a smack: "You brat, Shouzhe is being kind by including you. What’s wrong with you? Try it out, there’s always another chance if you fail this time. And you wouldn’t have reached this realm so quickly without Shouzhe’s help in making money?"
Kidding, who is Shouzhe?
The God of Wealth of the East Port Chen Family, whose income has significantly increased over the years.
Whether Ancestor Ruhong could earn the resources needed for advancing to the Celestial Human Realm one day depended entirely on Shouzhe’s backing.
Chen Fangjie was full of bitterness.
Since when did being almost thirty and reaching the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm become worthless and worthy of scorn?
Remember Ancestor Ruhong once said, Fang Jie, you’re quite talented, truly worthy of being our Chen Family descendant.
Now suddenly, I’m the brat deemed unworthy.
It’s not that Chen Fangjie isn’t trying, but that the era changes too quickly.
Fine, compared to Shouzhe and those little prodigies.
He really can only... scout ahead.
Then Chen Fangjie shouted, "Artifact Spirit, I am Chen Fangjie, and I will take the trial."
"Civilian, your name doesn’t matter. Continue after clearing the first test." The Artifact Spirit said.
Chen Fangjie broke into a cold sweat; I’m the Young Clan Leader of the East Port Chen Family, Ninth Layer in Qi Refining Realm, now turned into a civilian. Before he could complain,
there was a space fluctuation at the center of the trial ground.
His opponent appeared, a nearly two-meter tall, sturdy creature covered in scale armor, with barbed tail — a fearsome demon.
Its cold eyes on Chen Fangjie made his body shiver in horror.
Such demons were only seen in ancient texts.
"Don’t be afraid, Fang Jie! It’s just a demon puppet," Ancestor Longyan encouraged, "Its combat power is similar to various family’s Ninth Layer Qi Refining Realm peak level Spirit Platform Seeds, not particularly difficult to handle."
Chen Fangjie almost passed out, Ancestor Longyan, you say this lightly, this also called not particularly difficult?
Before he could react, the demon puppet seemed to know Chen Fangjie was the trial taker, it quickly lunged at him, leaving a trace of a shadow in its speed.
Its claw struck, leaving multiple claw shadows in the air, with a sharp whistle piercing through.
Chen Fangjie hurriedly retreated, wielding a silver spear as he engaged with the demon puppet. Unfortunately, the power disparity was large, he managed to withstand only twenty moves before being swatted away by the puppet’s claw; he urgently declared surrender.
Upon his words, the demon puppet’s actions halted immediately.
And Chen Fangjie, soaked in sweat and his hands trembling, murmured how can this be called not particularly difficult to handle?
Wang Luoyi rushed to help Chen Fangjie aside, her eyes filled with concern. The two were quite close after all. Chen Fangjie did treat his wife well.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 7: Great Opportunity! The Legacy of Ancestor Wang_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 7: Great Opportunity! The Legacy of Ancestor Wang_3
With her brother-in-law’s failure, Wang Shouzhe’s expression also became solemn.
This demon puppet’s combat power is even stronger than he imagined.
Indeed, as Ancestor Longyan said, it’s almost as strong as some Spirit Platform Seeds at their peak.
Even all the ancestors exchanged glances, realizing the trial’s difficulty was greater than expected.
Only Wang Luqiu’s eyes shone brightly, as if she had encountered a favored opponent, somewhat invigorated.
"Fang Jie," Ancestor Ruhong said, "Even if you’ve reached the peak of the Qi Refining Realm, you must hone your Black Tortoise Combat Technique well to have a chance at winning."
"Yes, Ancestor." Chen Fangjie, greatly embarrassed, resolved to dedicate himself to improving his Black Tortoise Combat Technique.
Next was Wang Shounuo, who, at twenty-eight years old, had worked hard for the family’s benefit over the years and received many advantages, reaching the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm through diligent cultivation.
Of course, he went up merely to observe the atmosphere, unable to withstand even the puppet’s fourth move.
Subsequently, Wang Luotong, Wang Shou Lian, Wang Shouyong, Gongsun Yan, and Lua Xiaoxiao all tried as well, similarly just experiencing the atmosphere.
Only Lua Xiaoxiao stood out a bit; she used a small Five Elements Array Disc to hold off the demon puppet for twenty to thirty moves. After all, at just nineteen years old, she had awakened the Li Fire Bloodline once and reached the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, which was quite commendable.
Older sister Wang Luoyi, though also having benefited from many of the Chen Family’s resources and reaching the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, was ultimately just an empty framework. Wang Shouzhe decided not to let her participate, planning to buy a Celestial Spirit Pill later, as the Chen Family was currently quite affluent.
Following that was Liua Ruolei, who had awakened the Primordial Water Bloodline once, with talent likely akin to Ancestor Xuanfu’s in her youth. Now at twenty-two, she was no longer the little girl she once was.
Having been in the Purple Mansion Academy for four years, her cultivation was in the middle of the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm, evidently a focus of Ancestor Xuanfu’s training.
Remarkably, she went up and fought the demon puppet evenly.
Unfortunately, after one incense stick of time, she was carelessly ambushed by the demon puppet and lost the battle, prompting Ancestor Xuanfu to pull her aside and reprimand her. Clearly, with more combat experience, she could have won.
A dejected Liua Ruolei was gently reassured by Liua Ruolan, who said, "It’s okay, it’s normal for young girls to lose, you can try again next time."
This statement caused Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyebrow to twitch, wondering what kind of Enchanting Soup had been fed to this child with such an Innate Dao Embryo, resulting in this state, and if there was any hope for rescue.
Wang Shouzhe felt speechless. Was it his fault even when he didn’t speak?
"Hmph," Wang Luqiu slowly stepped forward, "Quite interesting, worthy of being a stepping stone on my Emperor Road."
This girl, already nineteen, still brimming with energy, with an unchanged heart for the Emperor Road.
As Wang Luqiu entered the stage, Wang Shouzhe immediately grew serious.
Previously, it was normal for them not to win, but for sister Luqiu, he held high expectations. Even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t gauge her actual combat power now.
"Luqiu, go for it!" Even Liua Ruolan smiled to cheer her on.
"Don’t worry, Fourth Sister-in-law, they’re just minor cannon fodder." Wang Luqiu, clad in a goose-yellow Black Tortoise Martial Attire, calmly stepped onto the trial ground, "I, Wang Luqiu, request to proceed directly to the second stage."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 8: Little Celestial Pride! Showing Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 8: Little Celestial Pride! Showing Off
...
A drop of cold sweat fell from Wang Shouzhe’s brow, "Luqiu, do you have to be so reckless? You actually want to start directly from the second level!!"
Skipping a level, what if we miss out on a wave of rewards?
Just as he was about to stop her.
The Artifact Spirit spoke up: "Commoner, your request has been denied. Please proceed with the trials as per the Recruitment Point requirements."
Thankfully, this Artifact Spirit is quite rational, handling matters strictly according to the rules.
A trace of boredom flashed in Wang Luqiu’s eyes as she turned her neck and stretched her muscles, "Since that’s the case, let’s get started quickly."
In the center of the Trial Ground, after a ripple in space.
The Demon Puppet appeared once again, its momentum still as terrifying, its appearance still as hideous.
Before it could make any moves.
Wang Luqiu was the first to step forward and kill towards the Demon Puppet.
Her movements were fierce and direct, without any embellishments, as if she were a humanoid tyrannosaurus entering hunting mode.
With a "boom", a single punch.
The Demon Puppet, caught off guard, hastily blocked, but was knocked back three to four meters, stumbling almost unable to stand still.
"Luqiu is amazing."
The younger generation from the various families watching were all shocked.
The Demon Puppet that gave them immense pressure, seemingly invincible, appeared much "weaker" in Wang Luqiu’s hands.
Throughout the process, it was only able to parry, being forced to continuously retreat or dodge awkwardly.
This scene looked as if the Demon Puppet was the one being beaten by those they resembled earlier.
However, now it’s Wang Luqiu overpowering the Demon Puppet.
Her assault was as continuous as raging waves, each blow stronger than the last.
Twenty moves, just twenty moves.
A Demon Puppet that appeared powerful and invincible was struck in the chest by Wang Luqiu’s elbow, blown two to three zhang away and crashed to the ground, with its chest cracked open, struggling but unable to get back up.
"Like an ant." Wang Luqiu smirked, looking as if she wasn’t fully satisfied.
"Good! Well done, Luqiu."
Peers cheered excitedly.
Even the Ancestors looked surprised, thinking this child Luqiu was too terrifying. When they were her age, they were nowhere near her capability.
Even Ancestor Longyan couldn’t help nodding, saying, "This child is much more formidable than I was at her age."
Ancestor Ruhong also said, "Congratulations, Ancestor Longyan, this child’s Path of Celestial Human has appeared."
His eyes were filled with indescribable envy. If only the East Port Chen Family could produce such a child.
Then gazing at Chen Fangjie, he sighed...
Upon witnessing Luqiu’s exceptional performance, even Ancestor Xuanfu couldn’t resist pulling Liua Ruolei aside, fervently admonishing her. Your sister, that unparalleled Celestial Pride, has been spoiled by that brat Wang Shouzhe.
The future of the Liua Family rests solely on your shoulders, you must live up to it. Then, she glared fiercely at Wang Shouzhe from afar.
Meanwhile, on the Trial Platform.
"Congratulations on passing the trial. What is your name?"
"Wang Luqiu."
"Very well, Wang Luqiu. For passing the first level, you can receive a consolation prize, provided you accept the identity of a militia member of the Divine Martial Dynasty."
"I accept." Wang Luqiu may be a bit adolescent, but she’s not foolish. The reward is a Celestial Spirit Pill.
"Militia member Wang Luqiu, on behalf of the Divine Martial Dynasty, and the Divine Martial Army, I grant you the identity of a militia member, and award you a Basic Breakthrough Pill."
Once the Artifact Spirit’s words were finished.
After another slight spatial ripple, two items appeared in front of Wang Luqiu. A delicate jade bottle, and a black token.
Wang Luqiu reached out to take the rewards, then opened the bottle to show Wang Shouzhe, "Fourth Brother, take a look, is this the Celestial Spirit Pill? Why does the Artifact Spirit call it the ’Basic Breakthrough Pill’?"
Wang Shouzhe took a careful look, his mood excited, "It is indeed the Celestial Spirit Pill!" It seems that during the Divine Martial Dynasty period, such things as the Celestial Spirit Pill weren’t rare.
Though he never doubted Ancestor Longyan’s experiences, only upon obtaining this item did Wang Shouzhe truly breathe a sigh of relief. It seems the relic hasn’t deteriorated over the hundreds of years.
The Wang Family is quite wealthy now, but being gifted a Celestial Spirit Pill worth tens of thousands is naturally pleasant.
The other ancestors and juniors were also thrilled, seeing that although the Demon Puppet was difficult to fight, it was not unbeatably so, and the rewards were so generous.
For some Ninth-Grade Lower-Rank Noble Families, accumulating a Celestial Spirit Pill often takes decades.
Their eyes suddenly burned with eagerness.
At this time, the Artifact Spirit said: "Militia member Wang Luqiu, do you wish to continue to the second level?"
Just as Wang Luqiu was about to respond to the Artifact Spirit, Wang Shouzhe grabbed her, "Luqiu, you’ve just finished fighting. Rest for a while first."
Wang Luqiu looked puzzled, "Fourth Brother, I’m not tired, it was just a warm-up."
Wang Shouzhe glared at her, "I say you’re tired, so you’re tired."
Wang Luqiu helplessly rolled her eyes, alright, I can’t beat you, so whether I’m tired or not is up to you.
Then Wang Shouzhe cautiously asked the Artifact Spirit: "Before starting the second level, can she rest?"
"You may rest and receive treatment, but it must not exceed one day," the Artifact Spirit answered honestly, "otherwise, you will need to wait a year to start again."
"Can others trial while she rests?"
"No, unless she voluntarily exits the trial, or doesn’t challenge the next level within a day."
"Okay, we’ll let Luqiu rest first." Wang Shouzhe pulled Wang Luqiu aside, "Rest well, replenish all the Profound Qi you used up, don’t proceed to the second level with even a sliver missing. Otherwise, I’ll deduct your Contribution Points."

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 8: Little Celestial Pride! Showing Off_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 8: Little Celestial Pride! Showing Off_2
Don’t be fooled by how easily she passed the first trial. One-on-one and one-on-two are completely different concepts.
Wang Luqiu reluctantly complied with Wang Shouzhe’s request.
She sat cross-legged and gradually started to recover her Profound Qi. In less than two quarters of an hour, she stood up. Artifact Spirit, I want to start the second trial.
"As you wish, Militia Wang Luqiu."
As soon as the words fell, after a spatial fluctuation, two Demon Puppets appeared simultaneously.
Soon after, the sound of clashing filled the air as they began to fight.
As expected, those two Demon Puppets coordinated extremely well, giving even Wang Luqiu a hard time, forcing her to abandon her strategy of frontal assault.
She began to move around consistently, engaging in a war of attrition.
Don’t be deceived by Wang Luqiu’s appearance; she’s actually quite clever in combat and never sticks to one pattern.
But even so, the battle grew increasingly challenging. There truly is a significant difference between one-on-one and facing two opponents.
Moreover, the demon claws were exceptionally sharp, leaving a wound with the slightest touch. Gradually, Wang Luqiu began to struggle, continually falling into a disadvantageous position.
Only then did everyone understand.
Why even with Ancestor Longyan’s talent, she had to risk her life to pass the second trial back then.
Moreover, Ancestor Longyan was already at the Peak of the Qi Refining Realm back then!
And Wang Luqiu is only at the mid-stage of the eighth layer of the Qi Refining Realm now.
She had already performed excellently, and once she reaches the Peak of the Qi Refining Realm, she should be able to defeat these two Demon Puppets more easily.
But at that moment.
Wang Luqiu let out a furious roar, "I, Wang Luqiu, will not be defeated by merely two pieces of cannon fodder!"
A hint of red light flashed in her eyes, and her entire aura changed in an instant.
No longer dodging.
She activated her War Body and returned to her frontal assault mode of combat.
Each move was filled with tremendous explosiveness, and she began trading blows with the Demon Puppets, wound for wound.
"Luqiu, there are more opportunities later; don’t do this,"
The peers called out anxiously.
"I, Wang Luqiu, will dominate this world." With a loud roar, she ignored the claws piercing her abdomen, explosively smashing the head of one Demon Puppet. The remaining Demon Puppet barely withstood five moves before being torn to pieces by her.
"Crack!"
Wang Luqiu stomped on the head of the Demon Puppet, her eyes filled with an aura of conquest.
"Militia Wang Luqiu, congratulations on passing the second trial. Here is your reward, [Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid], and an Elite Militia Token. Do you wish to start the third trial?"
Wang Luqiu reached out to take the reward, her eyes brimming with raging blood and an intense desire to battle.
"Artifact Spirit, prepare..."
Before she could finish speaking, Wang Shouzhe rushed up: "Artifact Spirit, she is injured and needs rest."
"Wang Shouzhe, let go of me."
"Wang Luqiu, shut up." Wang Shouzhe glared, forcibly pulling her off the stage.
Seeing her Fourth Brother truly angry, Wang Luqiu did not dare to oppose him and relented.
She knew her Fourth Brother’s temper; usually, he was playful and light-hearted.
But once he got serious, Wang Luqiu shivered from the bottom of her heart.
This girl’s injuries were already severe, with more than a dozen wounds on her body, not to mention the claw mark on her abdomen, which was quite deadly, injuring her abdominal cavity. Continuing to push herself could be life-threatening.
He moved her to a secluded place, and Wang Shouzhe channeled Profound Qi to heal her.
In a short while, he managed to stabilize her injuries.
Some non-lethal wounds also healed one by one. Only the fatal abdominal wound would take several days to fully recover.
It was thanks to Wang Shouzhe’s strong Milk Power; otherwise, even with Healing Medicine, she would have to be bedridden for at least a month.
"Wang Luqiu, your trial ends here for now. Once your injuries heal, take the Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid," Wang Shouzhe said. Although the name is basic, the item is genuinely valuable.
At the same time, Wang Shouzhe examined the so-called [Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid]. It was liquid in form, its fragrance pleasing, very different from the scent of Stone Marrow.
He breathed a sigh of relief, believing this treasure had no relation to Stone Marrow, thus no issue of resistance to the medicine.
Wang Lici, Wang Luqiu, and Wang Luojing had all consumed large amounts of Stone Marrow. If this substance were refined from Stone Marrow, its effects would be significantly reduced or even null.
Wang Shouzhe himself had taken the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, with Stone Marrow as the main ingredient, facing the same problem.
This was one of his main concerns. After all, Wang Shouzhe had spent 250,000 coins on a Bone Marrow Purify Pill.
After consuming it, his talent had indeed improved vastly.
But it only reached the appearance of Middle Grade A, similar to Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing, without a second Bloodline Awakening.
If the reward was another Bone Marrow Purify Pill, it would be challenging for him to break through to Upper Grade Bloodline Talent and achieve Second Layer Bloodline Awakening.
While Wang Shouzhe pondered.
"Fourth Brother, you should use this Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid first," Wang Luqiu said nonchalantly.
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback, quickly shaking his head, "No, this is your hard-earned reward from risking your life; Fourth Brother can’t covet your treasure." It’s the family’s greatest taboo to seize another’s resources, which can lead to divisiveness.
"Fourth Brother, are you stupid?" Wang Luqiu rolled her eyes, "If your bloodline talent were a bit stronger, you’d easily pass the second trial. Then, take the reward and return it to me, wouldn’t that be the solution?"

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 8: Little Celestial Pride! Showing Off_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 8: Little Celestial Pride! Showing Off_3
"Uh, that’s true." Wang Shouzhe hadn’t thought of that tactic before, but now that he was reminded, he realized it was a good strategy. Without any pretense, he accepted the Improvement Liquid.
Then, in an annoyed manner, he kicked Wang Luqiu: "You’re done here, get lost and rest on the side. Next time, don’t push yourself so hard."
Wang Luqiu glared at him, but knowing she couldn’t beat her fourth brother, she dusted herself off and obediently went to rest on the side.
With Wang Luqiu’s withdrawal,
Liua Yuanhui was the next to step up and challenge.
Liua Yuanhui was a Spirit Platform Seed meticulously cultivated by the Liua Family’s direct lineage. Even though he was only thirty years old, he had already reached the peak of the Qi Refining Realm. His Black Tortoise Combat Techniques were equally refined.
After observing for so long, he had a thorough understanding of the Demon Puppets and approached with a very serious expression.
He then proceeded to challenge.
He fought with the Demon Puppet to a stalemate, almost evenly matched. Fortunately, his willpower was very strong, and he practiced the Liua Family’s Middle-Grade Technique, the Primordial Water Technique.
His endurance and recovery power were both commendable.
He tangled with the Demon Puppet for a full half-hour, suffering many minor injuries before finally piercing its chest with a sword, arduously achieving victory.
Dragging himself down with claw wounds on half his body, his face was full of a bitter taste.
If, in normal circumstances, he had defeated a peer of similar strength, he would have been complacent and proud. But with Wang Luqiu’s exemplary performance before him, his own seemed merely ordinary.
As for the second trial, he didn’t even bother considering it and directly gave up.
It was a wise choice. Otherwise, facing two on one, he probably wouldn’t last more than a dozen moves.
Still, earning a Celestial Spirit Pill was extremely fortunate, and Ancestor Xuanfu patted him on the shoulder in encouragement.
His peers also offered countless congratulations, after all, being the second to pass and obtaining a Celestial Spirit Pill was something everyone envied greatly.
Then, Wang Shouzhe pulled him aside and helped treat his injuries.
Liua Yuanhui gratefully bowed and said, "Shouzhe, thank you. Your Wood Bloodline is truly unique."
"Between us, there’s no need for such formalities," Wang Shouzhe smiled and said, "Fortunately, these are superficial wounds. Even without my help, you’ll recover in seven or eight days."
At the same time,
another young member of the family stood up and walked towards the center of the Trial Platform.
It was Wang Luojing.
She wore a long navy blue dress embroidered with many intricate patterns, which, upon closer inspection, were all in the form of insects.
Additionally, she carried a peculiar large box on her back.
Her expression was calm, and there was no trace of fear in her eyes.
Over the years, she had spent half her time in the Changning Guard.
Because after the Changning Guard’s Tributor Spirit Insect Master heard about Wang Luojing, he personally came and insisted on taking her as a disciple, promising to teach her everything he knew. Such a good opportunity, Wang Shouzhe naturally wouldn’t refuse.
Seeing Wang Luojing step onto the platform,
Wang Shouzhe was moved and said, "Luqiu, let me discuss this with you. Let’s use this bottle of Talent Enhancement Liquid on Luojing first. This way, Luojing can handle the second trial more easily." He had great expectations for Wang Luojing as well.
Wang Luqiu shrugged, "Since I’ve given it to you, four brother can decide for himself."
However, upon hearing this suggestion, Wang Ruojing immediately shook her head and said, "No need, thank you for your kind offer, fourth brother. However, if Luqiu sister can do it, then as her older sister, I can do it too." Her calm eyes held a trace of stubbornness.
With these words, Wang Shouzhe didn’t insist further.
He knew his fifth sister Wang Luojing’s personality well. Though she appeared soft and gentle on the outside, she was inherently stubborn.
Moreover, she had always competed with Wang Luqiu since childhood and certainly didn’t want to lose to her.
"Luojing! Be careful," Wang Shouzhe solemnly reminded her, "If you can’t persist, you can give up. There will be another chance next time."
"Fourth brother, don’t underestimate me," Wang Luojing replied with a sweet smile towards Wang Shouzhe. Then, step by step, she walked to the center of the Trial Platform, her expression gradually turning serene and cold: "Artifact Spirit, I wish to undergo the trial."
A cold and murderous aura spread out, making the younger spectators shiver involuntarily, each gaining a little more respect for Wang Luojing.
Only Wang Luqiu, who was resting, pursed her lips and muttered, "Of all things not to learn, she chose to imitate Wang Shouzhe’s pretentious demeanor."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 9 Fierce! Red Bull Fire Toad
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 9 Fierce! Red Bull Fire Toad
...
Unexpectedly, Wang Luqiu said it quite loudly, and Wang Shouzhe heard it.
Immediately, he gave her a displeased glare, as if she didn’t usually learn from him herself.
Both the fifth and sixth sisters were quite a handful.
However, Luojing was in the middle of a trial, so Wang Shouzhe’s attention shifted to her.
Another new Demon Puppet appeared, chillingly charging at Wang Luojing.
Wang Luojing’s expression remained indifferent as she put down the box on her back. Without any entanglement, she lightly tapped her feet and flew gracefully like a butterfly, her skirt fluttering beautifully in the air.
At some point, an insect flute appeared in her hand, which she gently played while pressed horizontally against her jade-like lips, producing a high-frequency sound that was extremely harsh to human ears.
From the box she placed on the ground, came a buzzing sound, and a swarm of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees surged out.
Each of them was the size of a date, exhibiting a purple crystalline glow on their bodies, with their stingers clearly visible.
A swarm of two to three hundred Purple Crystal Bees, like a cloud obscuring the sun, enveloped the Demon Puppet.
This was a Tier Two Purple Crystal Spirit Bee, vastly different in appearance from the Tiger-headed Spirit Bee.
Moreover, within that swarm of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees, there was an especially large one about the size of a fist, the Queen Bee. With the Queen Bee directing them, the swarm’s combat power was incomparable.
Such a swarm had an overall power reaching the peak of Tier Two.
Even someone at the peak of the Qi Refining Realm would not dare to confront them head-on, likely opting to detour instead.
The Demon Puppet, although named a puppet, was ultimately made from demon blood and flesh, with a body structure virtually identical to that of wild demons.
The bee swarm entangled it, their venomous stingers constantly stabbing into its body.
The Demon Puppet’s combat strategy was not adept at eliminating the bee swarm, only managing to kill a few Purple Crystal Spirit Bees with its powerful swinging claws.
Despite the Demon Puppet’s seemingly strong resistance to toxins, it couldn’t withstand the copious numbers of bees, with the venom gradually accumulating within it.
