Its speed grew increasingly sluggish, and in battles against Spirit Insect Masters, once slowed down, it was nearly a foregone conclusion.
With the advantage gained, Wang Luojing calmly maneuvered with her body technique, resolutely avoiding close combat with the Demon Puppet.
Eventually, after the sacrifice of dozens of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees,
The Demon Puppet couldn’t even touch her skirt before collapsing with a thunderous crash, unable to rise again.
The ease with which she won this battle left everyone exchanging surprised glances. Truly, her fighting power as a Spirit Insect Master was terrifying.
Moreover, a Spirit Insect Master’s combat posed almost no danger, as there was no need for close-quarter fighting.
One only needed to maintain distance and let the spiritual insects handle the enemies.
This unique fighting style naturally aroused both envy and admiration among the onlookers. While congratulating Wang Luojing on her victory, they began to chatter excitedly.
Ancestor Ruhong frowned and said, "A Spirit Insect Master is a rare dual occupation, both in life and combat, and there are hardly any in the entire Changning Guard."
"Don’t start having wild ideas; besides, a Spirit Insect Master’s combat ability is built over time, naturally different from other Black Tortoise Practitioners."
What Ancestor Ruhong said made a lot of sense.
Raising top-tier Purple Crystal Spirit Bees was clearly a significant challenge for Wang Luojing, and losing dozens of them must have caused her some heartache.
Nevertheless, the final reward was exceptionally generous.
The Artifact Spirit said, "Congratulations on passing the trial, what is your name?"
"Wang Luojing."
"Very good, Wang Luojing. For passing the first level, you can receive a consolation prize, provided you accept the identity of a civilian soldier of the Divine Martial Dynasty."
Naturally, Wang Luojing had no reason to refuse.
Soon, she received a Celestial Spirit Pill along with a Civilian Soldier Token.
Then she obediently rested and regained her Profound Qi, waiting until both her energy and spirit were restored before starting the second battle.
However, in the second battle, with two Demon Puppets joining forces, the situation became entirely different.
They could execute flanking and encirclement tactics.
Instantly, Wang Luojing found herself in constant peril, repeatedly dodging danger, and unable to concentrate on commanding the Spirit Bees.
"This is big trouble." Wang Shouzhe’s expression was a bit grave; even if it was the same strategy, facing different numbers of enemies made for a vastly different scenario.
Rip!
A demon claw tore Wang Luojing’s skirt, leaving a bleeding gash on her waist.
"Luojing, enough." Wang Shouzhe shouted, "When you reach the peak of the Qi Refining Realm, you’ll definitely be able to defeat them."
He could heal, but no matter how good a healer he was, he couldn’t bring back the dead.
Persistently engaging in an unwinnable fight could lead to instant death.
Unexpectedly, the injured Wang Luojing’s eyes flashed with a chilling anger: "Damn you, Demon Puppets, making my fourth brother worry, you all deserve to die!"
An ominous aura began to emanate from her, with a mysterious tint enveloping her eyes.
Not good, Wang Shouzhe felt a jolt in his heart and was about to intervene when.
A deep, resounding "croak~" was heard.
It was the call of some kind of toad, the sound deep and booming, like a Wild Ox roaring in the wilderness.
In Wang Luojing’s delicate palm, there appeared a crimson toad the size of her palm, which, though small, exuded a fearsome aura of fiery intimidation.
"This is..." Ancestor Xuanfu’s expression shifted slightly, "Red Bull Fire Toad!? From where did this little girl get it?"
Red Bull Fire Toad?
Wang Shouzhe was a bit bewildered, clearly unfamiliar with the name, but soon Wang Luojing showed him the might of the Red Bull Fire Toad.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 9 Fierce! Red Bull Fire Toad_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 9 Fierce! Red Bull Fire Toad_2
Wang Luojing opened her mouth and spat out a mouthful of essence blood, which dyed the Red Bull Fire Toad red. It immediately let out a more excited "croak" and roared even more fervently.
In almost the blink of an eye, the Red Bull Fire Toad expanded against the wind, transforming into a giant toad the size of a small calf. It emitted Fire Qi from its body, and in its huge, swollen eyes, a fervent and excited glow radiated.
"Luojing." Wang Shouzhe’s expression changed slightly. Just as he was about to make a move, he was stopped by Ancestor Xuanfu, "Be careful not to go over. That girl used the Essence Blood Technique to connect her mind with the Red Bull Fire Toad, and the most taboo thing would be to disturb her. Moreover, she’s emotionally unstable right now, very dangerous."
"Damn demon, die." Wang Luojing scolded, a terrifying aura appearing in her eyes, and a strand of her long hair stood up.
"Croak!"
The Red Bull Fire Toad let out a roar and spewed a flame from its mouth. This flame was different from ordinary fire, having a scarlet, enchanting hue, forming a fire dragon with its eerie nature.
The enchanting flame landed on the Demon Puppet, instantly setting it ablaze.
Sizzle sizzle!
The Demon Puppet rolled on the ground but couldn’t extinguish the flame. In just seven or eight breaths, it was burned into a pile of blackened bones.
The terrifying fire caused Wang Shouzhe to take a cold breath.
"This is the Fire Poison Red Flame." Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyes filled with dread, "Once it touches even a bit, it’s extremely hard to extinguish. Moreover, with fire poison attacking the heart, it is one of the renowned evil flames. Longyan cousin, where did this girl get such a terrifying evil creature as the Red Bull Fire Toad! And she even refined it as her Lifebound Gu! Is she courting death?"
Ancestor Longyan’s expression was also extremely grave, "This is probably the work of Luojing’s master. Seven or eight years ago, Zhou Changfeng came to visit, saying he wanted to take Luojing as a disciple, promising to teach her everything he knows. Therefore, Shouzhe and I both agreed."
"Zhou Changfeng? The Loose Cultivator Spirit Insect Master that has long been a Tributor at the Changning Government Office?" Ancestor Xuanfu said angrily, "He’s got some nerve, actually cultivating the Dao of Witchcraft and Gu. We’ll have to settle that account with him later."
Ancestor Longyan slightly frowned but didn’t say much, instead cautiously watching the battlefield. She instructed, "Shouzhe, once the battle ends, immediately go and take care of Luojing."
"Yes, Ancestor."
Wang Shouzhe responded, actually not needing Ancestor Longyan’s instructions, he was already prepared to enter the battlefield at any time to rescue Wang Luojing.
With the appearance of the Red Bull Fire Toad, the battle had already become one-sided. Another Demon Puppet also couldn’t resist the Fire Poison Red Flame and was burned into a pile of bones.
Meanwhile,
Wang Luojing’s face turned incredibly pale, and she fell backward with her eyes closed. In an instant, the Red Bull Fire Toad transformed to the size of a palm and jumped into Wang Luojing’s embrace.
Wang Shouzhe quickly rushed forward, held Luojing in his arms, and cyan Profound Qi surged madly into her body. Thanks to his strong Milk Power, Wang Luojing slightly recovered. She opened her weakened eyes and said, "Fourth Brother, Luojing won’t embarrass you."
"You silly girl." Wang Shouzhe scolded angrily, "You don’t even take care of yourself like this. I’ve told you before, we can come back again."
"Fourth Brother, Luojing doesn’t want to drag you down." After saying this, she closed her eyes and dared not look at Wang Shouzhe again.
Wang Shouzhe still wanted to scold a few more words, but seeing her little face so pale and utterly exhausted, he naturally withheld his words. Moreover, he knew that Luojing had always been very determined since she was a child, and simple lecturing wouldn’t work on her.
He carefully carried Luojing back and treated her meticulously.
Meanwhile, he found a moment to ask Ancestor Xuanfu, "Ancestor, is the Dao of Witchcraft and Gu a Forbidden Technique?"
"It’s not exactly a Forbidden Technique either." Ancestor Xuanfu said solemnly, "But the Academy doesn’t encourage cultivating such an evil technique. Anyone who cultivates the Dao of Witchcraft and Gu needs to report to the Academy. That Zhou Changfeng, being just a Loose Cultivator, who knows where he got the Witchcraft and Gu Secret Manual from, and even has a Red Bull Fire Toad, this matter needs to be clarified."
"Since it’s not a Forbidden Technique, that’s a relief." Wang Shouzhe breathed a sigh of relief.
"Shouzhe, you need to talk to this girl later." Ancestor Longyan’s gaze also showed some annoyance, "That Red Bull Fire Toad is already quite powerful, far exceeding the level of Spiritual Sense she currently possesses. It’s extremely dangerous for her to forcibly drive it using essence blood."
Ancestor Longyan also felt somewhat helpless. Though Luojing appeared to respect her as an Ancestor, she actually listened only to her Fourth Brother Wang Shouzhe.
"Yes, Ancestor." Wang Shouzhe replied honestly, "If her cultivation isn’t sufficient next time, and she dares to drive the Red Bull Fire Toad again, I’ll spank her."
He knew Wang Luojing was pretending to be unconscious, she could hear this. Using such words to warn her was more effective than direct scolding.
Sure enough, her small body trembled, and her face turned red.
Fortunately, Wang Shouzhe had sufficient Milk Power, and in no time, Wang Luojing recovered considerably, but she shouldn’t even think about participating in the next battle.
Nevertheless, the Artifact Spirit still offered a bottle of Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid and an Elite Militia Token.
"Wang Luojing, you’re so childish." At this moment, Wang Luqiu came over and mocked, "Do you think you can defeat me with that Red Bull Fire Toad?"
"Hmph." Wang Luojing, having somewhat recovered, sneered coldly, "If Fourth Brother hadn’t forbidden me, I’d definitely show you its power."
Seeing them starting to argue, Wang Shouzhe immediately interrupted, "Shut up, both of you."
These two sisters were really a handful, always giving him a headache.
Wang Luojing didn’t continue to entangle with Wang Luqiu and instead gave her bottle of Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid to Wang Shouzhe, saying, "Fourth Brother, you should use my bottle instead."
Uh...
Only then did Wang Shouzhe realize why Luojing fought so fiercely. Her little scheme was that she didn’t want Wang Shouzhe to use Wang Luqiu’s bottle.
This made him break into a cold sweat. This crafty girl, she had such deep schemes.
Wang Luqiu raised an eyebrow, crossed her arms, and sneered, "Naive ghost."
"Reckless girl." Wang Luojing calmly replied.
"Alright, alright, both of you take a break." At this time, Wang Lici stood up, assuming the posture of the eldest sister, "Winning two rounds is quite impressive, you haven’t let down the teachings of Miss Lici."
Then Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing simultaneously gave her a side-eye. This Big Girl had quite a talent, but in terms of actual combat power... passing the second stage would be a big question mark.
Then Wang Lici ignored them, but instead, walked swaggeringly onto the Trial Platform with her hands behind her back.
As Wang Lici appeared, everyone’s gaze was drawn to her.
Only to see her standing there, posing like an unparalleled expert, she then whistled.
Instantly, a large tiger with a plump figure came running towards her, whether it was because it was too fat or the heavy burden on its back was too much.
Always feeling like the tiger was panting as it ran.
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but twitch at the corners of his mouth. When he first met this little tiger, it was quite agile, running like a wind, and very adept at catching Spirit Rats.
But as it grew up, it became more plump. If this continues, Wang Shouzhe started to doubt whether it could still hunt.
"HuaaHuaa, thank you for your hard work." Wang Lici patted the tiger’s head, "Considering you’ve been carrying equipment for me all the way, I’ll reduce your debt by five hundred Qian Gold."
HuaaHuaa happily rubbed its tiger head against Wang Lici, completely unaware of how much Qian Gold it actually owed.
Wang Lici removed a large package from its back, which contained her full set of equipment. A meticulously crafted full-body battle armor, a giant hammer, and a heavy shield.
Fully armored, Wang Lici was transformed into a heavily armored warrior, and said to the Artifact Spirit, "I, Wang Lici, commence the trial."
Unexpectedly.
The Artifact Spirit replied, "Civilian, your name is meaningless. Your wish is granted, the trial has commenced. Also, please have that unrelated tiger leave the Trial Ground."
"What?" Wang Lici exclaimed in surprise, "Why? Luojing’s insects and that big toad can be used, why can’t my war pet?"
But before the Artifact Spirit could respond, with a spatial fluctuation, the Demon Puppet charged at her.
Meanwhile, the large tiger, HuaaHuaa, was wrapped in an invisible energy and was thrown off the Trial Platform, the tiger’s face was full of bewilderment.
Poor Wang Lici, facing the ferocious Demon Puppet alone, almost burst into tears.
How long has it been since Miss Lici had a one-on-one fight?
"Artifact Spirit! I... &&$#$"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 10: Warrior! Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 10: Warrior! Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact
...
Wang Lici was filled with melancholy.
In the past few years, every time she fought, she merely donned heavy armor and took the stage as a formality. The main combat unit was still the big tiger, HuaaHuaa.
But who could have thought that the Artifact Spirit would actually teleport HuaaHuaa out?
How could she handle this?
Yet, she had no time to think too much, because that fierce Demon Puppet had already lunged at her. Its sharp claws swung at her viciously, seemingly carrying the force of a thousand pounds, emitting a sharp whistling through the air.
At this moment, Wang Lici was terrified.
She hastily raised her Heavy Shield, frantically infusing Profound Qi into the shield to enhance its defensive capabilities.
"Clang!" A loud crash.
Something strange occurred.
Wang Lici’s body didn’t budge an inch, but instead, the Demon Puppet had two of its claws broken off by the shock.
"Roar!"
The Demon Puppet seemed furious, letting out a roar before charging at Wang Lici fiercely.
Its height of over two meters and weight of more than three hundred pounds slammed heavily onto the Heavy Shield.
"Boom!"
Who would have thought.
Wang Lici’s body merely swayed slightly.
Instead, the Demon Puppet was pushed back a few steps by the counter-shock force.
"Huh? This thing’s body is that weak?"
The eyes under Wang Lici’s helmet were full of confusion. Watching Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu struggle so hard against it earlier, she thought this Demon Puppet was supposed to be formidable?
Maybe there’s a mistake here, better test it again.
Then she wielded her shield and charged forward fiercely.
"Thud!" A loud bang.
The Demon Puppet was actually knocked flying, crashing to the ground.
"Hahaha." Wang Lici laughed wildly, "Turns out your Miss Lici is this powerful. You lowly Demon chicken, how dare you fight with your Miss Lici. Come on, come, get up, let’s fight three hundred more rounds."
The Demon Puppet let out a low growl, actually got up, and started wrestling with Wang Lici.
Unfortunately, its strength was much inferior to Wang Lici’s, and in a few moves, it was slapped away. Wang Lici seemed to be having fun, tossing her hammer and Heavy Shield aside, and started wrestling barehanded with the Demon Puppet in her heavy armor.
Bang bang bang.
The pitiful Demon Puppet was smashed to the ground again and again, miserably resembling a rag doll.
This bizarre scene left everyone dumbfounded.
Is this girl’s strength too terrifying?
Even Wang Shouzhe was somewhat moved; he had always known Lici was strong, but he hadn’t expected her to have grown to this extent. He couldn’t help but feel some sympathy for the poor Demon Puppet.
After playing for a while, Wang Lici seemed to lose interest. Then she lifted the Demon Puppet high, slamming it headfirst onto the ground with force.
"Thud!"
The Demon Puppet’s head, along with its neck and shoulders, collided with the hard ground of the training yard, and was instantly smashed to smithereens, naturally losing its life.
Then.
Wang Lici stood like an unparalleled master, hands clasped behind her back, gazing up at the sky at a forty-five-degree angle.
She shook her head and sighed, "Sigh, being invincible in the world is truly lonely."
Invincible! Invincible, my foot.
Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched slightly. If it weren’t for the relatives present, he really would have wanted to grab her by the ear and teach her a good lesson.
I don’t know why, but she always gives off this natural vibe of needing a spanking.
Subsequently.
Very naturally. The Artifact Spirit gave the corresponding rewards and bestowed her with the title of militia member.
"I’ve been exercising for so long, I’m so hungry." Wang Lici wasn’t interested in those Celestial Spirit Pills at all and rubbed her belly, muttering to herself
Then, she beckoned, and the big tiger HuaaHuaa trotted over obediently.
She pulled out several large pieces of pre-roasted meat from the tiger’s saddlebag, weighing a hundred or two hundred pounds altogether. Judging them, she picked the smallest piece to share with HuaaHuaa.
Just like that, the person and the tiger started munching away as if nobody else were present.
That scene was as awkward as it could get.
Such astonishing performance.
Several Ancestors looked at each other in dismay, this seemingly naive Big Girl was just too fierce, wasn’t she?
Those roasted meats were the flesh of Tier Three Ferocious Beasts, rich in energy. Can she digest that much?
Even if the Ancestors ate to their fill, their appetite would be far less than hers!
No wonder that girl’s strength is so immense.
"Husband, our Lici really is full of energy." Liua Ruolan laughed, covering her mouth, "Her strength has grown by quite a bit, even more than yours, husband."
Purely in terms of strength, Wang Shouzhe might indeed be inferior to her.
This prompted Wang Shouzhe to grumble inwardly, I’m a human, she’s a monster in a girl’s skin, can it be the same?
"Wang Lici, have you eaten enough?" Wang Shouzhe said from offstage, "If you have the time, get on with the next round quickly."
This Big Girl simply didn’t require rest, she seemed to have inexhaustible strength and energy.
"Fourth Uncle, I’m a girl, fighting is exhausting, let me eat first." She munched on the roast meat with large bites, while still complaining to the Artifact Spirit, "Artifact Spirit, tell me, why can’t my HuaaHuaa go on? Wang Luojing’s insects, even the big toad can go on, isn’t this too unfair?"
"Militia member Wang Lici. There is no contract between you and this tiger-type Spirit Beast, nor is there a sign of bloodline ritual refining, therefore it cannot be determined as your pet. However, militia member Wang Luojing is a Spirit Insect Master, and those Spiritual Insects are combat weapons she nurtures and rituals, while the big toad is her Lifebound Spirit Gu, so it can be judged capable of going on stage."

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 10 Warrior! Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 10 Warrior! Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact_2
Hearing this, Wang Shouzhe understood.
The Trial Ground has its rules. You can’t just grab a spirit beast, claim it’s your war pet, and pretend to be a Spirit Pet Master.
This rule prevents Wang Shouzhe from having the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle assist in battle.
"Forget it, forget it. Anyway, I’m already undefeated in the world. It doesn’t matter if HuaaHuaa doesn’t help me." After the previous battle, Wang Lici was brimming with confidence.
It’s the first time she realized that she was so powerful.
"Let’s see Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu, those two little girls, who is the real big boss." While speaking, Wang Lici gobbled up the roasted meat, wiped her mouth, and said, "Artifact Spirit, start the next round."
"Militia Wang Lici, as you wish." Said the Artifact Spirit.
After another wave of spatial fluctuation, two Demon Puppets appeared simultaneously.
This time, Wang Lici was full of confidence, no longer avoiding the fight, but actively engaging and trading blows with those Demon Puppets.
Her heavy shield and warhammer were swung with great vigor. Even facing two, she didn’t fall behind.
Wang Lici’s bravery and strength won her praise from the elders, as this girl truly has unlimited potential.
The only small problem is that her Black Tortoise Tortoise Combat Techniques seem quite poor.
Her moves were instinctive, forming no system, purely relying on her frightening strength and Profound Qi to overpower.
Furthermore, her heavy armor, specially made by a blacksmith, possibly weighs several hundred pounds, with crucial areas being particularly thick. When infused with Profound Qi, its defense becomes exceptionally strong.
The poor Demon Puppets couldn’t even break her defense.
Seeing this started making Wang Shouzhe wonder if he had been wrong all these years?
Could it be that Lici’s style and cultivation method are the true way?
But in the blink of an eye, this thought was thrown out of his mind. Wang Lici is a prodigy, a humanoid monster in a cute guise. Such combat mode is inimitable.
Following this, the battle was without suspense.
She smashed the two Demon Puppets to pieces with her warhammer, breezed through the second round, claimed her rewards, and earned the title of Elite Militia.
With this, Wang Lici began to boast even more: "Wahaha, I, Lici the lady, am the true undefeated ruler. Wang Luojing, Wang Luqiu, do you concede?"
Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu turned their heads, refusing to look at her. You’re several years older, already at the peak of Qi Refining Realm, what’s there to brag about?
After receiving her rewards, Wang Lici clutched her stomach saying: "HuaaHuaa, my tummy is starving, hurry and bring me something to eat."
Then, amidst everyone’s stunned gaze, she pulled out a bunch of roasted meat and a fat tiger, and started munching away.
Even Ancestor Xuanfu’s beautiful eyes widened, this girl can really eat. Elder Sister Longyan, raising this child in your family isn’t easy.
Wang Shouzhe also watched with his heart racing, thinking silently that as Lici his niece ages and cultivates, she’s getting increasingly able to eat.
Isn’t this like a bottomless pit?
It’s becoming challenging to sustain.
Then Wang Shouzhe glanced at Ancestor Xuanfu, pondering, having heard the Purple Mansion Academy not only provides resource subsidies but also full board for core disciples?
Looking back, can I find a chance to send Lici to the Academy later?
This idea seems promising, the more Wang Shouzhe thought about it, the more it felt right.
Yes, it’s decided.
Suddenly, Ancestor Xuanfu started feeling uneasy, an ominous premonition arose.
Meanwhile, after being satiated, Wang Lici began the third round.
Indeed, as Ancestor Longyan mentioned, the third round had three Demon Puppets. When it comes to any species, once the quantity increases, it leads to qualitative changes.
The three Demon Puppets obviously posed some pressure on Wang Lici. They maneuvered like a wolf pack, executing various tactics.
Their sharp claws scraped across Wang Lici’s battle armor leaving deep marks.
Such sneaky tactics stirred up Wang Lici’s fireiness.
"You think I’m a sick cat when Lici the lady doesn’t unleash her fury?"
While a Demon Puppet tried a sneak attack from behind, she hurled her warhammer fiercely backward.
The warhammer spun and whistled away.
"Boom!"
The warhammer hit the Demon Puppet’s chest, killing it instantly!
Then Wang Lici tossed the heavy shield from her hand. The shield spun horizontally like a card, sending sharp cries through the air.
"Slash!"
A Demon Puppet couldn’t dodge in time, getting sliced in half.
Hence, there’s no suspense left in the battle.
Wang Lici once again won the fight effortlessly.
Incredible!
She’s the first among the young ones undergoing trials to clear three rounds.
All kinds of admiration and worship from the younger generation aside, even the elders gave heaps of praise.
The Wang Family has indeed produced a rare talent.
Ascending to the Spirit Platform Realm, it’s a certainty for this child, limitless future potential.
Only Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu exchanged glances, their gazes fervently fixated on Wang Lici, as if igniting determination.
In their hearts, they were proud Little Celestial Prides, not easily yielding.
Plus, they’re confident that once they reach the peak of the Qi Refining Realm, they’ll also clear three rounds easily.
Meanwhile.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 10 Warrior! Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 10 Warrior! Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact_3
The artifact spirit said, "Elite militia Wang Lici, congratulations on passing the third stage. You are rewarded with a standard weapon, and your status is upgraded to warrior."
This announcement garnered great concern from Ancestor Longyan and Wang Shouzhe. "Warrior" and "standard weapon" were terms they had never heard before.
The artifact spirit added, "Since the primary weapon detected for Warrior Wang Lici is a warhammer, would you like to choose the warhammer weapon?"
"Hammer, I want the hammer. It’s thrilling to use one," Wang Lici said without hesitation. The truth was, she couldn’t handle other weapons.
Without a hammer, was she supposed to embroider with a sword?
The artifact spirit continued without further ado.
After a spatial wave, "clang!"
A warhammer suddenly appeared out of thin air and struck the ground with a heavy thud.
The hard ground of the trial platform now had a pit due to the impact.
The warhammer appeared ordinary, its body dark, emitting a rich lustrous spirit light, exuding an aura seemingly full of spiritual essence.
The ancestors’ expressions changed, "Is this..."
"An Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact!!"
Judging from the intense spirit light, it was undoubtedly an Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact.
The ancestors were simultaneously astounded and enviously jealous.
Some smaller family ancestors might not possess even one spiritual artifact.
Even if they did, most owned lower-grade ones, while few had those at middle-grade spiritual artifact level.
The Wang Family currently possesses three spiritual artifacts.
Among them, the Cosmic Palace Sword is a middle-grade spiritual artifact, while the Longyan Sword and the Purple Gold Alms Bowl are merely lower-grade spiritual artifacts.
The sudden appearance of an Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact was exceedingly shocking and enviable.
More importantly, the artifact spirit claimed it was merely a standard weapon.
This revealed the astounding strength of the Divine Martial Dynasty at its peak!
Wang Lici, full of joy, reached for the warhammer, "This hammer looks fierce, I like it. Wait, why is it so heavy?"
With both hands gripping the hammer handle, she exerted a great amount of strength just to barely lift it, starting to stagger as she moved.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Wang Lici’s strength was evident to all; within the Qi Refining Realm, few could rival her. With her power, picking up objects weighing three thousand kilograms should be rather easy.
How heavy was this warhammer? Five thousand kilograms, or perhaps six?
Seeing her struggle, Liua Ruolan, unable to bear it, went over and said, "Lici, with your current strength, I doubt you can wield this hammer. Let me keep it safe for you for now."
"Thank you, Fourth Aunt," Wang Lici responded obediently.
Liua Ruolan then simply waved her hand and stored the warhammer in the storage ring.
Under such circumstances, the utility of the storage ring became apparent. Limited only by volume, it was unaffected by weight constraints.
The ancestors looked at the storage ring with envious eyes; though everyone had prospered alongside Shouzhe, currently purchasing a storage ring remained too extravagant.
"Lici, take a break and then quickly try the fourth stage," Liua Ruolan said. "This trial game is quite interesting; I’m eager to have a go myself."
Originally lacking interest in the trial, Liua Ruolan came to assist her husband, but now she found it quite engaging.
"Yes, Fourth Auntie," Wang Lici responded sweetly. She knew well who was truly in charge at home.
After eating and resting for a while, Wang Lici prepared her gear and told the artifact spirit that she wanted to proceed to the next stage.
"Warrior Wang Lici, as you wish."
A spatial wave ensued, revealing a terrifying demon puppet over ten feet tall.
It was much larger than the previous demon puppets, its entire body armored like real armor, emitting a dark glow. Its eyes were cold and ruthless.
Upon its appearance, a powerful oppressive aura enveloped the whole area.
All the Qi Refining Realm juniors present turned pale, feeling as if faced with a formidable fierce beast.
Wang Shouzhe’s pupils contracted, wasn’t there supposed to be four demon puppets in the fourth stage?
Is this one perhaps a Spirit Platform Realm demon puppet?
Which Qi Refining Realm fighter could ever take it down?
Wang Lici, caught off guard, stared at the huge demon puppet, dumbfounded.
Tears threatened to fall. Was the artifact spirit teasing Miss Lici?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 11: Shouzhe! 2nd Bloodline Awakening (Requesting Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 11: Shouzhe! 2nd Bloodline Awakening (Requesting Monthly Ticket)
...
Almost immediately, Wang Lici wanted to surrender. She was done with this, it was just too much.
A Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet.
Just hearing the name made Wang Lici’s legs tremble, leaving her whole body weak.
That Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet’s gaze was filled with cruel malice, sizing up Wang Lici, step by step closing in on her as if toying with its prey.
Its intelligence was evidently far superior to a Qi Refining Realm Demon Puppet, retaining much more wisdom.
"I, I, I, I surrender..." Wang Lici was about to voice her surrender when Wang Shouzhe shouted from below, "Lici, you are not allowed to surrender. No matter what, try and test its capability first."
What the heck, test its capability!
Tears flowed down Wang Lici’s face, and she felt like swearing, what’s there to test with a Spirit Platform Realm demon?
Either way, she couldn’t win.
Fourth Uncle, don’t just say things easily, if you’re so capable, then you go ahead. This thing is on the same level as the various Ancestors.
For a long time, living under Ancestors’ protection, Wang Lici had a natural reverence for the Spirit Platform Realm, and she was already eighty percent scared even before the fight.
"One year." Wang Shouzhe shouted, "As long as you fight, whether you win or lose, for one year you can eat whatever you like, anything you love."
"Really." Wang Lici suddenly perked up, gaining a bit of courage, "Then I’ll give it a try."
As soon as she spoke.
The Demon Puppet rushed towards Wang Lici with a swoosh, its speed exploding.
Such speed, Wang Shouzhe’s pupils contracted; he estimated that the Demon Puppet’s speed was at least thirty to forty percent faster than his. If encountered in the wild, escape wouldn’t be possible.
Its claws were even more robust and sharp, sweeping at Wang Lici with the wind howling, as if even iron could be shredded.
However, Wang Lici, after all, was a Second Layer Bloodline Awakening, barely raising her shield to block.
"Clang!" A loud noise rang out.
Wang Lici staggered back three or four steps, four claw marks appeared on the heavy shield, each about an inch deep, almost piercing through the shield.
The power wasn’t small either.
Wang Shouzhe caught every detail, his mind spinning rapidly, assessing the Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet’s strength.
"Eh? The strength doesn’t seem very strong." Wang Lici was vaguely surprised, originally thinking she would be sent flying by that hit. Instantly, her spirit lifted, swinging her heavy hammer back at the Demon Puppet.
"Clang clang clang."
In less than ten moves, she was struck by the Demon Puppet and sent flying, her heavy armor now adorned with several claw marks, blood starting to seep out.
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I can’t hold on." Wang Lici cried pitifully, "This big guy is too fierce."
"Hang in there, you can do it." Wang Shouzhe said, "Without my permission, you surrender, I will confiscate all your Spiritual Food, and arrange for Shouyong and Shou Lian to eat in front of you every day."
"For a year."
Too cruel!
Wang Lici could hardly believe that scene, it would be the end of days. Not even for a year, she couldn’t last a single day.
"If you can injure it, I’ll take you to the Commandery, and you can choose whatever delicious food you want." Wang Shouzhe gave a stick then a carrot approach.
Commandery?
Wang Lici suddenly became enthusiastic upon hearing how prosperous the place was, with all sorts of tasty food she hadn’t tried yet.
She knew Fourth Uncle would never lie to her.
Then Wang Lici was filled with images of delicious foods from the Commandery, wielding her heavy hammer, charging at the Demon Puppet.
Miss Lici is going to fight to the death with you!
Her strength seemed to grow by a third.
"Clang clang." She engaged in a hard-fought battle with the Demon Puppet.
Wang Shouzhe continued estimating the Demon Puppet’s strength. The longer the time dragged on, the clearer his understanding became.
Not particularly strong.
About the same as Ancestor Xiaohan who had just been promoted to the Spirit Platform Realm and stabilized for a while.
But even so, it wasn’t something that ordinary Qi Refining Realm could deal with. Typically, three to four Peak Qi Refining Realm were not a match for Spirit Platform Realm.
However, since the Artifact Spirit presented a Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet, it showed that they weren’t invincible, at least some Qi Refining Realm could confront it.
Even if none are successful this time, it can accumulate experience for those who come later.
"Swish swish swish."
The Demon Puppet, its claws flying, seemed like a butchering hand, tearing apart Wang Lici’s heavy armor, little by little. More wounds appeared on Wang Lici, looking very miserable.
It seemed to be toying with its prey.
His assessment almost complete, Wang Shouzhe was about to call a halt, worried that Lici might be in danger.
Suddenly.
Wang Lici got angry: "Damn demon, what’s wrong with letting this miss hit you once?"
Fourth Uncle said, to injure it to go to the Commandery for delicious food.
"Miss Lici is about to go berserk."
"Going berserk!"
Huh? Wang Shouzhe paused, wondering, could Lici be hiding her strength?
But Wang Lici’s rampage didn’t happen; she was slammed by the Demon Puppet, sent flying in a heavy strike. Her armor completely scattered, revealing a body covered in blood.
"Damn it. Clearly Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu, those two girls, become very powerful when they go berserk." Wang Lici grumbled, "I, Lici, am the big sister here. How dare you, stupid demon, underestimate this miss."
As she spoke, the Demon Puppet once again closed in to attack her.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 11: Shouzhe! 2nd Bloodline Awakening (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 11: Shouzhe! 2nd Bloodline Awakening (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
"Lici, forget it, quickly admit defeat." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly shouted, "Fourth Uncle will take you to eat something delicious."
"Ah!" Wang Lici roared angrily, "How dare you underestimate me? I’m going to eat you."
At this moment, Wang Lici was already enveloped in anger.
A heart-palpitating and powerful aura began to seep from her body, as if a terrifying giant beast was about to emerge.
"Roar~"
With an ear-splitting roar, an invisible energy gathered behind Wang Lici, forming a terrifying giant beast over ten feet tall. It had a ferocious appearance, a massive mouth, and a huge belly, seemingly capable of devouring everything.
However, due to the thin energy, this terrifying giant beast was only faintly visible. Even so, the movements of the demon puppet halted, and its cold eyes showed a hint of fear.
It was evident that its intelligence hadn’t been completely erased, retaining many instincts.
"A Dharma Illusion?" Ancestor Ruhong exclaimed, "Even many Celestial Human Realm cultivators can’t manifest a Dharma Illusion, right?"
"How unusual." Ancestor Xuanfu said, "It’s normal for some celestial prides with particularly rich bloodline talent to manifest a Dharma Illusion in the Qi Refining Realm; it’s mainly related to bloodline density."
Ancestor Longyan also said, "In the Academy, there are two direct disciples who are said to have manifested a Dharma Illusion in the Qi Refining Realm. But I didn’t think Lici could also achieve this."
As soon as these words were spoken, all the ancestors were envious, as this indicated Wang Lici had the potential to become a direct disciple in the Academy. However, not every direct disciple can manifest a Dharma Illusion in the Qi Refining Realm, right?
This child’s Path of Celestial Human is probably smooth.
"Forgive my ignorance, what is the child’s Dharma Illusion?" Ancestor Ruhong said, "Please, Sister Xuanfu, enlighten me."
Sister Xuanfu?
Wang Shouzhe was slightly startled, well, only then did he remember that Ancestor Ruhong looked older because he entered the Spirit Platform Realm later; in reality, he was more than ten years younger than Ancestor Xuanfu.
Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyes burned with anger as she glared fiercely at Ancestor Ruhong. You old man, doing this on purpose to annoy me?
But who told her that she was indeed older than him?
Ancestor Xuanfu said coldly, "There are countless bloodlines in the world, each with various mutations, how could I know them all? But it seems like some kind of devouring talent."
They weren’t particularly concerned about the Spirit Platform Realm demon puppet, as after all, it was just a newly entered Spirit Platform demon, anyone could defeat it.
As everyone was talking.
Wang Lici had already charged up and was fiercely battling with the demon puppet, making a huge ruckus.
She even managed to beat the demon puppet quite miserably.
However, this momentum didn’t last long. As her bloodline energy was continuously exhausted, the exotic beast Dharma Illusion behind her gradually dimmed, barely able to be maintained.
"Still, ultimately just a Qi Refining Realm." Ancestor Ruhong said wistfully, "It’s not easy to manifest a Dharma Illusion, defeating a Spirit Platform Realm is really difficult."
As Wang Lici’s Dharma Illusion dimmed and eventually collapsed, she finally conceded and regained some logic. Seeing the situation wasn’t favorable, she quickly shouted, "I surrender."
With her surrender, even if unwilling, the demon puppet had to stop its actions, glaring at Wang Lici resentfully as its body gradually faded away.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe had long rushed forward, embracing Wang Lici.
Cyan Profound Qi surged madly into her body to heal her.
"Fourth Uncle, I injured it, you saw that, right?" Wang Lici said weakly.
"I saw, I saw, your performance this time was excellent." Wang Shouzhe quickly replied, "Fourth Uncle promised you something, and I absolutely won’t go back on my word. Once this is over, Fourth Uncle will take you to Longzuo County to eat delicious food."
"Hehehe." Wang Lici’s mind was filled with delicacies and laughed out a "pig sound." She had never tasted the things from the commandery, just thinking about it made it seem delicious.
When Wang Shouzhe carried her back.
Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and a group of younger ones gathered around her, showing great concern. Especially Luojing, Luqiu, I told her, "Your performance this time was impressive."
"But we’re not going to lose to you, once we reach the peak of Qi Refining Realm, we’ll defeat that demon puppet."
They seemed to have found their target to strive for.
"Husband, it’s my turn now, isn’t it?" Liua Ruolan said after comforting Wang Lici.
"It’s already late, the visibility isn’t great." Wang Shouzhe said, "Let’s rest overnight and come back tomorrow."
With Wang Shouzhe’s arrangements, everyone set up camp in the canyon.
That night.
Wang Shouzhe took Luojing’s bottle of Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid and entered a state of seclusion. Last time, he spent two hundred fifty thousand silver to purchase a Bone Marrow Purify Pill. With that pill, he reached Middle Grade A talent but ultimately couldn’t achieve a Second Layer Bloodline Awakening.
This was also his last attempt in the Qi Refining Realm.
He swallowed the Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid, a bitter taste spread to his lungs, but soon a cool essence spread throughout his body.
Not daring to delay further, he quickly entered a state of cultivation.
Two hours later, when he opened his eyes, he showed a joyful expression with many black impurities seeping from his pores, evidently a sign of his bloodline evolution.
He seemed able to clearly feel his bloodline filled with powerful energy.
Second Layer Bloodline Awakening.
This almost made him feel like crying.
Eight years, it’s been eight whole years for this moment.
He couldn’t know how much money he had spent, how many connections and paths he had gone through, and finally achieved Second Layer Bloodline Awakening.
Moreover, he now knew he likely had reached Upper Grade talent, though most likely only Upper Grade D, but already similar to Wang Lici.
He wasn’t like the big girl, Lici, who squandered her talent; he was more diligent than anyone, not even delaying cultivation after marriage.
"From today onwards, I can also be considered a celestial pride." Wang Shouzhe was thrilled in his heart, "Even if I were to attend the Academy, I could compete for the status of a direct disciple."
Of course, the idea of him going for schooling was impossible, it simply meant he had reached that level.
Thinking back, even though he passed the Academy’s initial selection, whether he’d be accepted later was uncertain. Now, directly reaching Upper Grade D meant he could compete with Longzuo County’s top celestial prides.
Moreover, he was convinced, with his skills, he would eventually suppress all celestial prides, one by one.
"Congratulations, Husband, on your Second Layer Bloodline Awakening." Liua Ruolan came over with a smile, "From now on, you step into the ranks of celestial pride."
Seeing Liua Ruolan, Wang Shouzhe felt like a bucket of cold water was poured over him, the heat and excitement disappeared without a trace. He had only barely achieved Second Layer Bloodline Awakening, similar to Wang Lici.
Compared to his wife Liua Ruolan, the gap was still wide.
Wash up and sleep, there’s a dungeon to tackle tomorrow.
...
The following day!
Morning light just rising
As if, heralding the arrival of a beautiful day.
Everyone gathered again.
Among all the young ones, only Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan had not yet faced the trial.
Just as Wang Shouzhe was about to step forward, Liua Ruolan grabbed him: "Husband, as the head of the clan, you should go last, I’ll go first."
"Alright, wife, be careful, it’s alright if you can’t win." Wang Shouzhe said dotingly, "Don’t get hurt, I’ll be worried."
Ancestor Xuanfu glared at Wang Shouzhe, what do you mean it’s alright if you can’t win? Even that big girl Lici passed three rounds.
"Yes, husband, I’ll listen to you." Liua Ruolan replied obediently, holding a sword as she walked to the Trial Platform, whispering to the artifact spirit, "I want to take the trial."
The way she looked like a model daughter-in-law of nobility, gentle and dignified, not a trace of absolute celestial pride aura?
Today, it almost seemed like this wasn’t a trial, but an autumn stroll with her husband.
That demeanor made Ancestor Xuanfu sigh internally. Finally obtained an Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species.
In the end, it turned out like this...
"As you wish, civilian."
With the artifact spirit’s voice falling, a ferocious-looking demon puppet appeared, fiercely and menacingly charging toward Liua Ruolan.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 12: The Lady... Got Angry
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 12: The Lady... Got Angry
...
But at this moment, neither the Liua Family nor the Wang Family was truly worried about Liua Ruolan.
With Liua Ruolan’s strength, dealing with this small Demon Puppet was as easy as a breeze.
As expected.
Facing the fierce momentum of the Demon Puppet.
Liua Ruolan executed the swordsmanship supporting the Profound Water True Technique—[Profound Water Sword Technique].
This swordsmanship, appearing soft and light, drew streaks of water-blue light as the sword aura danced, looking very appealing. In reality, it was profound and mysterious, seemingly gentle but hiding deadly killing moves.
Often, when you least expect it, a fatal blow erupts in an instant.
As expected, after just a dozen moves.
The Profound Water Sword Technique suddenly erupted, pulling out a stream of water-blue light. Amidst the gorgeous sword aura, the head of the Demon Puppet flew off.
Even in death, the Demon Puppet seemed not to realize why its head suddenly relocated.
"My darling, what excellent swordsmanship." Wang Shouzhe cheered loudly from below the platform.
His other siblings and nieces also joined in the applause one after another, as if Liua Ruolan was a revered Sword God.
It seemed these children were quite clear-headed, knowing exactly who was at the top of the food chain in the family.
Only Ancestor Xuanfu furrowed her brow repeatedly, constantly sighing in her heart.
With her great-great-niece’s talent as a Celestial Pride, dealing with this small Demon Puppet should have taken at most three moves. Yet, she dragged it out for over a dozen moves.
Truly spoiled by that brat, she lacked the unmatched aura of a true Celestial Pride.
Feeling discontent, Ancestor Xuanfu glared viciously at Wang Shouzhe.
Unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe paid her no mind and went straight up to the Trial Platform, expressing concern for his wife: "Ruolan, you’ve worked too hard, are you tired? Have some Ice Crystal Water first, and take a break."
Then, Wang Shouzhe courteously massaged her shoulders and arms, as if Liua Ruolan was truly exhausted.
"Not hard at all, I’m just happy to do something for my husband." Liua Ruolan sweetly smiled, seemingly quite enjoying it.
They rested for a whole incense stick of time. Only then did Liua Ruolan begin the second battle.
This battle, too, was naturally without any risk.
The only issue was that two incense sticks later, she slowly ground down the two Demon Ghosts.
As Wang Shouzhe advised her before the match.
Liua Ruolan persistently followed her husband’s advice, preferring to fight slowly and making sure not to get injured, lest her husband be heartbroken.
A welcoming roar of praise naturally ensued. Titles like "Invincible Fourth Sister-in-law, Mighty Fourth Aunt" filled the air.
Wang Shouzhe naturally didn’t miss the chance to demonstrate loyalty.
He ran up again, wiping off the nonexistent fragrant sweat, fanning her, showing great concern.
"Husband, should we use the reward of [Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid] for An’an?" Liua Ruolan proposed gently, "I estimate that child’s talent isn’t too great, perhaps just a tad better than my older brother, barely reaching the level of Middle Grade D."
The couple showcased their affection publicly.
But Liua Yuanhui was sweating all over.
My dear sister, how could you say that about your older brother?
I, Liua Yuanhui, am at least a Lower Grade A talent, which is considered quite good among Noble Family disciples.
Yet, he could not refute, since compared to his Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species sister, his talent was insignificant.
For Liua Ruolan’s proposal, Wang Shouzhe shook his head: "An’an is still young and will have his own opportunities in the future. Besides, the Wang Family is becoming stronger; basic resources will not be lacking for him. If he wants to advance further, he can strive and fight for it himself."
"Dear, you have never taken any Talent Enhancement Medicine before. This Bloodline Improvement Liquid might not elevate you to a higher level but it can pave the way for your further progress. Moreover, only by becoming stronger can we provide a better haven for the children."
This Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid should have some effect on Ruolan.
"Husband, what you say makes sense, I’ll listen to you." Liua Ruolan said gracefully.
Her husband pampered her greatly, but once he made serious requests, they were mostly reasonable, and she would comply.
Of course, for those less serious demands, they needed to be carefully considered...
Afterward, Liua Ruolan began her third match.
The difficulty of this third match could not be compared—facing three at once, even Liua Ruolan struggled.
Only by exchanging injuries for injuries and fighting to the death could she hope to quickly end the battle. Yet Liua Ruolan staunchly adhered to her husband’s wishes, resolutely adopting a conservative approach, preferring to take it slow and steady.
As a result, this battle dragged on endlessly.
Fortunately, [Profound Water True Technique] is an advanced version of the Primordial Water Technique.
This cultivation technique excels at dragging out the pace and employing grinding tactics, where the longer it stretches, the weaker the enemy becomes.
Therefore, despite the prolonged battle, Liua Ruolan gradually gained control of the situation.
Half an hour later, the first Demon Puppet perished.
Only then did she gain a decisive advantage, quickly eliminating them one by one. Those watching were nearly put to sleep by this passionless battle.
"Mighty wife, formidable wife."
Only Wang Shouzhe continued to cheer, rushing forward with a tide of praise.
At this point, the Artifact Spirit said, "Congratulations on passing the third trial, Elite Militia Liua Ruolan. You will be rewarded with a Standard Weapon and be granted the title of Warrior. Since it’s detected that you use long sword-type weapons, do you choose a long sword-type Standard Weapon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 12: The Lady... Got Angry_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 12: The Lady... Got Angry_2
As Liu Ruolan looked at Wang Shouzhe, Wang Shouzhe understood her intentions and stopped her, saying, "My dear, just choose a spiritual artifact for your use. Our family still has the Cosmic Palace Sword."
The Cosmic Palace Sword is a middle-grade spiritual artifact passed down from the ancestors, a symbol of the family, and naturally meant for his use.
Besides, sword-type weapons are the most common; many people in this world use swords, and their value as a heritage is also the highest.
Liu Ruolan obediently nodded and said, "Artifact spirit, I choose the long sword type."
Suddenly, after a wave of space fluctuations.
A long sword-type spiritual artifact appeared gracefully in front of Liu Ruolan.
It appeared semi-transparent, as if between the tangible and intangible, its entire body radiating with brilliant colors, like autumn water, emitting strong and vibrant primordial water energy.
It looked like a long sword forged from spiritual water.
This is naturally another upper-grade spiritual artifact!!
Upon seeing such a beautiful sword, Liu Ruolan was somewhat unable to take her eyes off it.
She tentatively touched the sword hilt that seemed crafted from transparent crystal, and a refreshing, cool feeling immediately swept over her. She vaguely felt the faint joy emanating from this upper-grade spiritual artifact.
It’s no surprise, as Liu Ruolan’s bloodline is nearly a primordial water spirit body, with an affinity for primordial water that surpasses ordinary people. And this upper-grade spiritual artifact, it’s purely of the primordial water attribute.
Though far from reaching the level of choosing its master, it already has some instinctive consciousness. Encountering such a master naturally pleases it.
When Liu Ruolan grasped the hilt, it transformed as if a living entity, like soft water, wrapping around her arm, making it seem as though she wore a semi-transparent bracelet on her white wrist.
Liu Ruolan seemed to have gained her beloved toy, constantly experimenting, with a movement of her thoughts, it transformed into a spiritual artifact long sword. Another thought, and it changed into a semi-transparent bracelet.
The flowing spirit light of the beautiful bracelet also became plain under her control, becoming less noticeable.
Hmm! It has the function of hiding its spirit light, which is nice. As my husband once said, it’s good to keep a few cards hidden.
"My dear, you’re truly remarkable, able to control a spiritual artifact even before reaching the Spirit Platform Realm." Wang Shouzhe praised without reserve.
Liu Ruolan laughed gently, "I can barely manage, as the truly powerful effects of the spiritual artifact cannot be fully unleashed before reaching the Spirit Platform Mirror."
"But even so, my dear, you’re much stronger than the ordinary Qi Refining Realm." Wang Shouzhe was not stingy with praise for his wife, seizing every opportunity to flatter her.
She laughed joyfully, clearly very satisfied with this upper-grade spiritual artifact, "Husband, your literary talent is outstanding, would you name my spirit sword, please?"
"It seems like a pool of autumn water, rippling like a robe of rosy clouds, and waves are vast and far-reaching." Wang Shouzhe mused, "Then, let’s call it Yi Bo."
Yi Bo?
Liu Ruolan breaking into a cold sweat. If this spiritual artifact develops a sentient sword spirit in the future, would it go mad with such a name?
"Just joking, let’s call it ’Qiushui’." Wang Shouzhe laughed.
"Qiushui, rippling with autumn waves and rosy clouds." Liu Ruolan smiled even sweeter, "Thank you, husband."
In the distance, Chen Fangjie had a speechless expression; Shouzhe definitely surpassed him, with his extraordinary skill in flattering, truly profound.
It seems Chen Fangjie needs to study well and slowly comprehend the true intent within.
The other ancestor from the Spirit Platform Realm was also envious; the Wang Family truly harvested plentifully this time.
Yet, everyone is relatives and united allies with common interests. The stronger the Wang Family becomes, the more advantageous it is for everyone.
"After passing three challenges, my dear must be tired; how about taking a good rest? It’s my turn to perform next." Wang Shouzhe said.
"No, I still want to try the fourth challenge." Liu Ruolan insisted, but then softly said, "Don’t worry husband, I just want to experience the atmosphere. If I really cannot win, I will concede."
Wang Shouzhe hesitated slightly, but seeing her serious expression, he said, "Then, my dear, take care."
After resting for another hour.
Liu Ruolan, fully recharged and in high spirits, was finally allowed to proceed by Wang Shouzhe.
"Artifact spirit, I want to challenge the fourth level."
"As you wish, Warrior Liu Ruolan."
With his words ending, the Spirit Platform Realm demon puppet appeared again, identified as the same one.
Because from the scars on its body, though healed, it was obvious that Wang Lici’s heavy hammer had caused the dents.
The demon puppet snarled sinisterly.
Like a wild ox, it charged fiercely towards Liu Ruolan, even causing cracks in the ground as it stomped.
This time, it learned its lesson and decided to attack strong right away, no longer toying with its prey.
Liu Ruolan waved her jade hand, gently gripping the Qiushui Sword.
Even though spiritual artifacts generally require reaching the Spirit Platform Realm to use.
But clearly, Liu Ruolan could already harness part of its power, much more effective than an ordinary long sword.
With a casual swing, the Qiushui Sword released a pure force of primordial water, morphing into a primordial water barrier.
"Boom!"
The primordial water barrier slightly blocked the demon puppet, but it was smashed to bits. It encroached, sweeping its ferocious claws at Liu Ruolan.
She hurriedly blocked, her graceful figure constantly drifting backward, her demeanor no longer composed.
Within merely ten breaths, Liu Ruolan already showed signs of defeat.
Spirit Platform Realm, after all, is Spirit Platform Mirror. There is an insurmountable chasm between it and the Qi Refining Realm. Even with the Qiushui Sword’s assistance, it was not its match.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 12: The Lady... Got Angry_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 12: The Lady... Got Angry_3
Wang Shouzhe watched from below the platform with his heart pounding, hurriedly shouting, "Wife, if it’s not working, just surrender."
Ancestor Xuanfu also let out a gentle sigh. If only Ruolan, this child, had been diligently cultivating all this time, working hard and progressing bravely, she might not have been so battered even if she couldn’t defeat it.
Ultimately, that brat spoiled her too much. The world is likely to lose a peerless Celestial Pride.
Suddenly, Liua Ruolei’s eyes flashed as if she had an idea, and she immediately shouted, "Sister, you must become strong! Just think, if you have an accident, brother-in-law can marry a new bride!"
"Huh!?" Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat. What kind of talk is this from Ruolei? How could she curse her sister and slander her brother-in-law like this?
But as soon as these words came out.
On the Trial Platform, Liua Ruolan’s delicate body shuddered, and an intangible, yet familiar, killing intent seemed to be brewing.
This made Wang Shouzhe think, not good, and just as he was about to stop her, it was too late.
Only to hear Liua Ruolei continue to shout, "Sister, think carefully. At that time, the new bride with brother-in-law will share your bed every day, eat your family’s food, drink your family’s wine, use your family’s things, and when in a bad mood, she might even hit your children. Can you put up with that?"
"Wang Shouzhe." In the trial ground, a cold, charming voice rose, "Dare you!"
A tangible killing aura erupted from her, as if an invisible, suffocating force began spreading in all directions.
"This is big trouble." Wang Shouzhe felt his scalp tingle, here it comes again, this familiar sensation has returned.
Ruolei, how could you be so ruthless?
Brother-in-law, how did he ever wrong you!
Meanwhile.
That Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet seemed to sense some sort of threat. It howled wildly.
Waving its massive claws, it threatened to tear Liua Ruolan into pieces.
At this moment, Liua Ruolan had completely changed appearance. Her gentle, clear eyes turned into an icy blue, with nothing left but endless indifference.
Like a high and mighty monarch, overlooking the humble all living beings.
Facing the Demon Puppet’s threat, she merely glanced indifferently, and that Demon Puppet seemed to be enveloped by an endless chill, even its movements slowed a bit.
"Noisy."
She casually swung her sword, and a water-blue Sword Aura burst forth, transforming into endless killing intent as it slashed toward the Demon Puppet.
"Swish!"
The Sword Aura flashed.
A hideous wound appeared on the chest of the Demon Puppet that dodged hastily, with devil blood gushing out, and the scale armor of its sturdy, ink-steel-like body seemed to be made of paper under that Sword Aura.
"Hmm? It actually dodged? Hmph, just a small ant."
Liua Ruolan said coldly, immediately swinging the rapid Qiushui Sword back towards the Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet.
The Demon Puppet roared furiously yet couldn’t resist, retreating step by step.
The situation instantly turned around.
Seeing his wife unleash great power.
Wang Shouzhe was not pleased but instead alarmed. He inhaled sharply, glaring at Liua Ruolei from afar with displeasure.
Ruolei, oh Ruolei, your brother-in-law has treated you well.
You are pushing your brother-in-law into the fire pit, don’t you know about your sister...
The memory of that night is something Wang Shouzhe could never forget. If Ancestor hadn’t intervened, his wife might have become a widow.
It was from then on, for these eight years, he was always cautious.
Just afraid another Liua Ruolan would appear.
All the ancestors were puzzled and uncertain about what was happening. How could the gentle and well-behaved Mrs. Wang suddenly become so fierce?
The younger generation of the Wang Family all had their expressions change drastically, equally uneasy and somewhat fearful.
That night didn’t just disturb Ancestor Longyan!
The absolute authority of Fourth Aunt and Fourth Sister-in-law among the younger siblings and nieces wasn’t gained without reason or a mere title.
Even Ancestor Longyan had a trace of complex and unfathomable emotion in her eyes. Eight years ago, she barely managed to mediate with her strong power.
But now... Ruolan is no longer what she used to be.
Shouzhe, oh Shouzhe, you might have to rely on your good fortune this time.
Only Ancestor Xuanfu, after a moment of being stunned, was delightfully surprised and said, "Good, very good, this is indeed our Liua Family’s peerless Celestial Pride, my Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species was not in vain at all!"
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelid twitched, and you’re cheering for this?
Ancestor Xuanfu, when my wife loses her temper, could you go and take the hit, please?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 13: Wife! Unparalleled Dominance
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 13: Wife! Unparalleled Dominance
...
"Brother-in-law, why do you look so delighted?" Liua Ruolei giggled from the side, "Now you can be at ease, right? Sister is sure to defeat that monster."
Ha... I’m at ease, my ass.
This brat, you’re really acting like it’s their funeral, not ours.
Wang Shouzhe chuckled to himself. It’s been eight years, did you think your brother-in-law wasn’t prepared at all?
Haha, little girl, just wait for it.
Now that it’s come to this, more complaints are useless, let’s just handle the matter well.
Though the situation is critical, at least after Liua Ruolan erupted. That demon puppet probably really isn’t her match.
Despite that demon puppet’s incessant roars and fierce resistance, it still couldn’t withstand Liua Ruolan’s endless and lethal sword aura.
Its scale armor, radiating a dark black glow, was sliced open one sword after another, with demon blood splattering. In just a moment, its body was covered in sword marks, a mess of black blood and flesh.
Liua Ruolan, she’s really going to execute that demon puppet in the most brutal way.
All the ancestors and younger generations alike were all stunned silent by this scene. This Mrs. Wang, when she goes berserk, it’s as if she becomes a different person. No, to be precise, she actually becomes a different person.
It’s just a pity that the trial takers can surrender, but as for the demon puppet, it has no rights whatsoever, even wanting to surrender is impossible, only able to watch itself being torn apart alive!
An incense stick of time later, when that demon puppet fell with a thud, there wasn’t a piece intact on its body, it had been sliced to bits.
In some way, it was also a form of liberation.
And Liua Ruolan’s eyes were still cold as ever, her anger seemingly nowhere near dissipated.
"Congratulations to Warrior Liua Ruolan, for winning the victory. According to the rules, you may choose one reward from Spirit Seed, Spirit Egg, Spirit Soldiers, and Spirit Treasure. And you are granted the title of Lord Elite Soldier. Please proceed to the Divine Martial Army Headquarters soon to report and attend training, to make outstanding contributions for the Divine Martial Dynasty."
"Annoying, shut up."
Liua Ruolan coldly said, right now she had no time to care about the rewards.
Unexpectedly, the artifact spirit obediently replied: "Yes, Lord Elite Soldier Liua Ruolan, the Artifact Spirit is at your service anytime."
Evidently, once a trial taker gains the status of an elite soldier, even the artifact spirit treats her with great respect, as if not daring to defy her.
This shows that the status of an elite soldier is indeed valuable in the Divine Martial Dynasty.
But clearly, now is not the time to discuss this.
Liua Ruolan turned around, looking far into the distance at Wang Shouzhe, an invisible killing intent enveloped him as her voice apathetically called out: "Wang Shouzhe, come over here."
Then everyone’s gaze was focused on Wang Shouzhe.
Although younger sisters and nieces had some sympathy for him, they dared not intervene right now. The scene from eight years ago, although they were still young, had already left a deep impression.
Since then, nobody in the Wang Family dared to provoke Liua Ruolan.
"Ahem!"
Wang Shouzhe had already been preparing for this moment earlier. Instantly, he straightened up, walked over with his head held high, showing no sign of fear in his demeanor.
He knew that the more guilty he appeared now, the easier it would be to trigger Liua Ruolan’s emotions.
Then, as usual, he smiled and said: "My dear wife is powerful, my dear wife is domineering, this battle must have been hard on you."
As before, he continued to fawn, massaging her shoulders and tapping her back, "Are you tired, my dear wife? Rest for a bit. Have a bottle of Ice Crystal Dew Drink to quench your thirst."
As if nothing had happened, and his wife hadn’t undergone any change.
But secretly, his heart was in his throat, always keeping an eye on his wife’s every move, and the subtle changes. So that if anything went wrong, he could immediately escape.
When his hand pressed onto her fragrant shoulders, he clearly felt her delicate body suddenly stiffen, with an instinctive sign of avoidance.
That invisible killing intent suddenly thickened significantly.
But in the end, she didn’t avoid, instead very unnaturally, allowing Wang Shouzhe to tap here and pinch there, her delicate body trembling slightly, as if struggling to restrain some emotion.
Suddenly!
Wang Shouzhe let out a sigh of relief inwardly, some of his thoughts were confirmed.
Thinking back to when that incident happened, Wang Shouzhe naturally found a way, secretly went to the Liua Family, and gathered with father-in-law, mother-in-law, brother-in-law, and sister-in-law to discuss it.
Then father-in-law Liua Gaowang gave a "fair" suggestion: "Shouzhe, Ruolan’s situation is quite special, you need to tolerate more, and let her have her way in everything."
Beyond that, there were no more constructive opinions.
Moreover, they all concurred that there seemed to be two spirits inside Liua Ruolan’s body.
This left Wang Shouzhe torn between laughter and tears, his wife’s gentle and elegant exterior seemed to hide a bit of wildness at her core.
But after all, Wang Shouzhe is a transmigrator.
Compared to them, he naturally had more insight, suspecting that his wife likely had dual personalities. The other one didn’t usually appear unless provoked.
Modern psychology has already conducted extensive research and analysis on dual or multiple personalities, with all sorts of cases accounted for.
So his wife’s situation wasn’t particularly rare either.
It’s no wonder that the Liua Family’s brothers- and sisters-in-law, and even father- and mother-in-law, were so utterly compliant with Liua Ruolan, never daring to offend her.
Later on, Wang Shouzhe discreetly tested his wife without leaving any traces, only to find that she has a memory discontinuity of what happened that night.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 13: Wife! Unparalleled Dominance_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 13: Wife! Unparalleled Dominance_2
From this, we can infer that when the other personality appears, dear wife isn’t aware of it, it’s unconscious.
However, Wang Shouzhe still hasn’t been able to conduct another test.
Which is whether the other personality knows about the happenings between him and Liua Ruolan? Does she know she is already Wang Shouzhe’s wife?
No wonder the test couldn’t be conducted.
Surely, he wouldn’t risk his life to provoke her again, right?
Since the other personality reappeared today, Wang Shouzhe naturally wanted to take this opportunity to probe her. After all, for the long haul future with the wife, without figuring out her other personality’s pattern, life would be like walking through a minefield, constantly on edge.
Liua Ruolan’s reaction, naturally made Wang Shouzhe secretly delighted.
Thus, it can be seen that this hidden personality at least has some level of awareness.
She has a relatively clear understanding of her own identity and is also very clear about her relationship with Wang Shouzhe. Hence, despite her internal aversion to contact with him, she ultimately endured it.
After all, this is something Wang Shouzhe often does to her, a pinch here and a tap there.
Soon, her delicate body gradually relaxed, clearly she had begun to adapt to Wang Shouzhe’s not overly excessive actions.
Of course, it is limited to actions that are "not overly excessive".
If he dared to cross the line, the consequences would probably be unimaginable.
A moment later.
"Liua Ruolan" turned around coldly and said, "Wang Shouzhe, I hear you’re waiting for me to die, to marry a new bride? Also preparing to allow the new bride to hit my baby?"
She even knows the baby is hers?
Wang Shouzhe was thrilled instead of shocked; this meant her awareness of her own identity was very, very clear.
That means the memory of this personality has a lot in common with the wife.
Wang Shouzhe thought to himself, this makes things much easier.
He immediately straightened his face and exclaimed injustice, "Heavens and earth, the wife is wronged. My heart for the wife is as vast as the Lu’an Mountain Range, like the water of the Anjiang, endlessly flowing."
"Dear precious wife, think back yourself, you and I, as husband and wife, are so loving, an exemplar and model for the family. As a husband, how could I do such a beastly thing?"
Sure enough, "Liua Ruolan" frowned, thought carefully, and indeed, it seemed that way.
Husband Wang Shouzhe took her out on a quest, and tirelessly attended to her every need.
’Then why did Ruolei say that?’ "Liua Ruolan" pondered in doubt, "Could it be..."
"Ah~~wife, to be honest. As a husband, I am so handsome and talented, gentle and meticulous, and quite capable of making money. Passively attracting some young ladies and misses, though I am quite annoyed, there is no choice."
"It’s natural for young girls to be secretly jealous of the feelings between us as a couple." Wang Shouzhe grumbled helplessly, "In the end, it is to be blamed on me as a husband, who asked me to be too excellent."
"Oh no!" Liua Ruolei was originally enjoying the spectacle; at this moment, her heart ’thumped’ in alarm, realizing it was bad news. Brother-in-law started shifting the blame onto her.
"Are you saying?" "Liua Ruolan" raised her eyebrows, coldly glancing at Liua Ruolei.
"Sister, it’s untrue, please don’t believe brother-in-law." Seeing the trouble was upon her head, she panicked instantly.
"Wife! It’s your own sister, don’t be rash." Wang Shouzhe ’desperately’ advised, "Between sisters, what barrier cannot be overcome? Don’t act impulsively!"
Then.
"Liua Ruolan" pulled Liua Ruolei into a secluded crevice in the rocks where Wang Shouzhe often treated his sisters.
"Sister, I was wrong. I didn’t have any ill intentions towards brother-in-law. Earlier, it was just to motivate you so that you could win against that demon puppet."
"Alright, alright, I was wrong!" Then came bursts of screams from Liua Ruolei inside.
Wang Shouzhe shouted, "Wife, we’re all family, hit softer. Ruolei has been single for years, at the age where thoughts can run wild, having some inappropriate thoughts is completely normal. Just two hits for symbolic purposes should be enough."
This sounded as if it was helping placate, but in truth, it was throwing fuel on the fire.
"Brother-in-law, I’ll remember you; you just wait."
"No, sister. I won’t remember him, isn’t that enough?"
"Sister, hit gently, I was wrong, truly wrong."
The sound of this made Wang Shouzhe secretly pleased, Ruolei, oh Ruolei, who asked you to send a fire towards me? You really thought brother-in-law was a vegetarian?
Since you started this fire.
Then trouble yourself with putting it out; after all, your own sister can’t kill you.
Besides, from his recent understanding, "wife" was already emotionally stable from venting while battling the demon puppet.
After two sticks of incense!
From the hidden place, dear wife Liua Ruolan called out anxiously, "Sister, Ruolei, Ruolei, what happened to you? Husband, husband, hurry over, my sister is hurt, quickly treat her."
Then Wang Shouzhe enthusiastically ran inside: "Wife, do not fear, your husband has arrived."
Then the temporary secluded place,
Wang Shouzhe’s shocked cry came out: "Oh dear Ruolei, why are you so miserable, come, let brother-in-law treat you."
"Wang Shouzhe, I remember you. Wu wu~~~~" Liua Ruolei actually began to cry.
Half an hour passed. Only then did the trio emerge.
Then Liua Ruolei threw herself into Ancestor Xuanfu’s embrace: "Ancestral Grandmother. Let’s quickly return to the Academy, I must practice diligently."
The entire scene made Ancestor Xuanfu shocked and uncertain, evidently, she had been in the Academy for years, yet didn’t realize that her ultimate Celestial Pride actually had "two souls"?
Alright!
The situation suddenly became more complex.
Ancestor Xuanfu felt a headache; it was hard to get an Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species. Secretly groomed a Celestial Pride, and how could it be filled with so much calamity?
Thankfully, the matter is already over.
Thinking of asking Liua Gaowang and the other few boys what on earth happened?
"Wife, you just passed the fourth level, hurry and ask the Artifact Spirit for your prize." Wang Shouzhe suggested opportunistically.
Liua Ruolan looked astonished: "What I passed the fourth level, I remember I clearly...seem unable to beat it, can’t recall..."
"Wife had good luck, at the final moment, that demon puppet had a problem with its mind, fell headlong on the stage, naturally making wife victorious." Wang Shouzhe bluffed.
But in such circumstances, no one would expose him.
"Oh, then it seems our fortunes are quite good." Liua Ruolan said happily.
"That’s right, our wife’s fortune has always been good." Wang Shouzhe smilingly said.
"Elite soldier Liua Ruolan, are you ready to receive your reward?" The Artifact Spirit observed attentively and said.
"What rewards are there?"
"You can receive Spirit Treasure, Spirit Egg, Spirit Species, Spirit Soldiers, etc., all are very nice things." The Artifact Spirit continued, "Wait, it seems the headquarters have not replenished the warehouse for some time, only five final prizes remain."
"Can I pick one?" Liua Ruolan asked.
"Of course, I will introduce them to you." The Artifact Spirit said, "Look, this Spirit Treasure Wine Gourd is good, just by adding in the corresponding Spirit Rice and Spirit Fruit, it can automatically brew a hundred jin of Spirit Wine every month."
A virtual image of the gourd suspended in front of Liua Ruolei, with dense mysterious rune markings.
"This is nice and could add an industry to the family." Liua Ruolan muttered.
"Does the lady want to choose this Spirit Treasure Wine Gourd?"
"No, my husband is quite adept at making money, and he doesn’t particularly enjoy drinking." Liua Ruolan waved to go to the next item.
Wang Shouzhe watched Liua Ruolan selecting Spirit Treasures, truly gentle, elegant, meticulous and harmonious, completely different from her previous fiercely menacing appearance.
Making his heart inevitably emotional, it seems like marrying once but gaining two wives.
Especially thinking about earlier with the other "wife", when massaging the shoulders, despite the body being the same person, the feeling was entirely different.
This filled Wang Shouzhe with deep emotions, complex thoughts, and endless contemplation.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 14 Shouzhe’s Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 14 Shouzhe’s Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species
...
"Sir, take a look at this spirit egg," the artifact spirit said. "This spirit egg belongs to the Five-Tier Spirit Beast, the Li Fire Sparrow. With sacrificial refining techniques, raising it from a young age could potentially evolve it to a Tier Six Spirit Beast level. Of course, this process is highly consuming and will take a very long time."
As it spoke, a scarlet egg-like phantom appeared before Liua Ruolan, burning with a thin layer of flame, evidently not an ordinary item.
When this item appeared, Liua Ruolan visibly grew breathless; this was a treasure.
Not to mention Liua Ruolan, even those ancestors who had seen much were wide-eyed, breathing heavily.
If such a treasure were taken out, even the Celestial Human Families would vie for it.
Yet it was placed right in front of Liua Ruolan for her selection, freely to take as she wished.
If it could grow to Tier Six, would the entire Changning Guard not be invincible?
But it was only a thought.
No matter how good a spirit beast, raising it would certainly be a prolonged process, and the resources consumed would be countless.
Liua Ruolan forcibly suppressed the urge to choose it, waved her hand to see the next one: "This one grows too slowly."
"Sir, then take a look at this puppet spirit soldier." the artifact spirit introduced again, "This is an initial tier Spirit Platform guard spirit soldier, the ideal choice for home defense and travel; essential for assassination."
As it spoke, a spirit soldier phantom appeared before Liua Ruolan. It was about the size of a normal person, indistinguishable from a puppet.
"A Spirit Platform guard spirit soldier?"
Family ancestors began exclaiming again; does this not imply having an Ancestor Spirit Platform at home?
The Daqian Empire naturally also sells Spirit Platform Realm spirit soldiers, but not only are they extremely expensive, they are not within our reach.
Yet the trial rewards are truly not easy to obtain.
One must, at the peak of Qi Refining Realm, fairly slay a Spirit Platform Realm demon spirit! In all of Longzuo County, how many could achieve this?
Liua Ruolan thought, just take this guard spirit soldier, just take this guard spirit soldier.
But she still cast her gaze upon Wang Shouzhe: "Husband, what do you think of this guard spirit soldier?"
"The item is good, but if it breaks, finding someone to repair it will be a troublesome matter." Wang Shouzhe contemplated and said, "Aren’t there five items to choose from? Let’s look at the others."
"Next one, next one." Liua Ruolan was full of expectation too, the rewards for breaking through the fourth trial were honestly excellent.
Everyone wanted one, but unfortunately, only one could be chosen.
"Sir, you must see this Primordial Water Spirit Pearl," the artifact spirit introduced again, "It is the most compatible spirit treasure for you, as your bloodline is nearing the Primordial Water Spirit Body. This Primordial Water Spirit Pearl accelerates your cultivation progress during practice. Furthermore, in battle, it provides you with constant Primordial Water Spiritual Power, amplifying your moves’ power."
Primordial Water Spirit Pearl!
As the artifact spirit’s words fell, a water-blue pearl phantom appeared before Liua Ruolan.
There was no doubt that among the introductions so far, the Primordial Water Spirit Pearl was indeed the most compatible with Liua Ruolan.
However, there was still one last item to see, so she might as well look at it before deciding. Liua Ruolan said again, next one, next one.
She feared she might not be able to resist taking it first, daring not to look more.
