```
The artifact spirit said again: "Then there’s only this last item left. It’s not suitable for you, sir. It’s a spirit seed of the Bloodthirsty Vine, more appropriate for those with the Wood Bloodline. Once successfully planted through a blood rite, you will have a Bloodthirsty Vine! As it grows, it has immeasurable potential. But simultaneously, cultivating a Bloodthirsty Vine is no easy task and demands vast resources."
"Then I’ll have this." Liua Ruolan said without hesitation.
"Sir, are you really sure you want the spirit seed of the Bloodthirsty Vine?" the artifact spirit confirmed repeatedly.
"Ruolan, still choose the Primordial Water Spirit Pearl." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly said, "As for the Bloodthirsty Vine, I’ll strive to obtain it myself."
"I just want the spirit seed of the Bloodthirsty Vine." Liua Ruolan ordered, "After all, this is a freebie from the last trial."
She clearly understood that her ability to break through the last trial was due to luck. Though her husband was exceptional, defeating a Spirit Platform Mirror at the peak of Qi Refining likely had a very low chance.
"As you wish, elite warrior Liua Ruolan." The artifact spirit naturally wouldn’t listen to Wang Shouzhe, clearly Liua Ruolan was the true owner of the treasure.
After a wave of spatial fluctuation.
A fist-sized seed appeared before Liua Ruolan, emitting a faint cyan light.
The seed was full, as if it contained a vigorous power of life.
Wang Shouzhe once planted many vine-type plants for testing, but none were spirit seeds, all were ordinary kinds found everywhere.
Yet this Bloodthirsty Vine spirit seed made him feel extraordinarily unique.
Along with the spirit seed, there appeared a small, jade-like white crystal stone.
The artifact spirit added: "Liua Ruolan, in this low-level jade scroll are stored some elements for planting the Bloodthirsty Vine. Additionally, the Bloodthirsty Vine is inherently ferocious, and falls under an extremely aggressive type of spirit plant. It is best if you wait until reaching Spirit Platform Realm to conduct blood rites for planting."
"Thank you, artifact spirit, you did well." Liua Ruolan said in a good mood, praising the artifact spirit.
"Thank you for your praise, Liua Ruolan."

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 14 Shouzhe’s Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 14 Shouzhe’s Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species_2
The artifact spirit is actually afraid of the Lord Elite Soldier causing trouble. Generally, those who reach the level of Elite Soldier are considered Celestial Pride.
All Celestial Prides have quite a temper. If they flare up, it’s possible to eliminate the artifact spirit. Just like the previous fellow... he definitely had a bad temper.
Afterwards, Liua Ruolan happily put away the low-level jade scroll and the blood vine spirit species, obediently handing them to Wang Shouzhe: "Husband, as long as you protect me, it’s fine."
She looked so obedient and reliant on her husband, like a little woman.
Wang Shouzhe’s heart felt warm and touched, filled with emotion.
"She is a Mrs. Wang who devotes all her energy to herself and to her children."
"Where else can you find a wife as great as this? It would be perfect if she doesn’t suddenly transform and hit me."
"Ruolan, rest assured, I, Wang Shouzhe, will protect you for a lifetime and beyond," Wang Shouzhe said sincerely.
"Husband, you’re really great."
"My wife is truly great."
Liua Ruolei pouted from the side, feeling this was a display of love, torturing single people.
It’s unbearable in the Changning Guard, better to return to the Academy sooner.
"Wife, please rest beside me." Wang Shouzhe had been preparing for this trial for a long time.
Then, Liua Ruolan obediently went back to watch the battle.
Standing in the center of the trial platform, Wang Shouzhe took a deep breath and said, "Artifact spirit, I’m ready to begin the trial."
"As you wish, commoner."
A demon puppet slowly emerged.
When everyone first saw the demon puppet, they felt it was very powerful. But when the Spirit Platform Realm demon puppet appeared, they realized the Qi Refining Realm peak demon puppet wasn’t much, looking rather weak and thin.
Yet in reality, it’s over two meters tall, weighing over three hundred pounds.
The moment the demon puppet appeared, it attacked Wang Shouzhe without saying a word.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t even draw the sword from his waist but scattered a handful of seeds.
Each seed was infused with green profound energy, appearing like strands of spirit light.
The seeds fell to the ground and sprouted spontaneously, growing rapidly into vines. The roots of those vines even sunk into the earth through the gaps of the thick bricks on the trial platform.
These vines were developed by Wang Shouzhe through continuous improvement, unlike the bloodthirsty vine spirit species.
However, their greatest characteristic is their resilience, rapid growth, and low energy requirement.
Employing the Willow Catkin Body Technique, Wang Shouzhe gracefully dodged the demon puppet’s chase around the vines. It felt like Jing Ke’s assassination, with King Qin circling the pillars.
This tactic is very simple, often used in games in a previous life, like circling a tower.
As the vines quickly grew, they soon formed a plant world that increasingly hindered the demon puppet’s movement.
The demon puppet seemed to be getting annoyed, extending its fierce claws and waving them.
"Swish, swish, swish!"
With each swing of its claws, many vines were severed.
Even if the non-spirit seed vines were quite tough, they couldn’t withstand such claw attacks and broke apart.
However, the demon puppet overlooked the sheer number of vines and their terrifying regenerative ability.
It paused only briefly, but its legs were unknowingly entangled by several vines. These vines grew rapidly, coiling upward and around it.
As if trying to wrap the demon puppet into a vine dumpling.
The demon puppet hastily swung its claws rapidly, clearing the vines off its legs.
The vines were constantly severed and torn into segments. However, more vines kept growing and coiling up relentlessly from its feet, legs, and even arms.
The demon puppet’s motions became slower and slower until, within moments, it couldn’t swing its claws anymore.
It was trapped alive in the vine array.
At the same time.
The vines continued to grow without stopping, absorbing the earth’s nutrients, prying open the hard bricks on the ground and exposing the soil.
They became increasingly sturdy and strong, like pythons coiling and squeezing.
The power of plants was fully demonstrated at this moment.
Unknowingly, the demon puppet’s bones started to emit cracking sounds. Black demonic blood seeped from its ears, nose, and throat.
At this point, it had no strength left to struggle, being crushed alive by dozens of vines wrapping around it like giant snakes.
Everyone took a sharp intake of breath.
Shouzhe’s combat method was not only strange but extremely powerful and terrifying.
Especially Ancestor Xuanfu, having seen many with wood bloodlines at the Academy. Most of them clustered under the Changchun Ascendant’s teachings.
The plants they researched were all kinds of oddities, yet they were mostly not adept at combat, preferring plant research.
Using vine-type plants to form a battle array for fighting was not particularly unusual.
But she hadn’t seen vines grow so quickly with such lethal strangling power as Wang Shouzhe’s.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe hadn’t even drawn his sword at this point.
Could Shouzhe also pass the fourth stage? Everyone was both expectant and a bit incredulous.
"Congratulations, you’ve won," said the artifact spirit.
"Husband, you’re mighty, husband, you’re domineering." Now it was Liua Ruolan’s turn to display affection. She stepped forward, wiping sweat, massaging his back, and fanning him, like a dutiful servant.
While enjoying his wife’s attentiveness, Wang Shouzhe conversed with the artifact spirit and put away the Celestial Spirit Pill.
Soon he proceeded to the next stage.
This time, two demon puppets appeared, but Wang Shouzhe noticed the artifact spirit didn’t stop him, and the vines planted during the first round played a role on the battlefield.
Evidently, this was another small test for Wang Shouzhe.
Testing whether the vines planted in the first stage remained effective in the second stage?
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe’s spirits soared.
His mindset differed from the brute force approach of his sister, niece, and wife.
He considered more aspects.
Since the artifact spirit approved this combat method, Wang Shouzhe was naturally unreserved.
He began circling the field, employing body techniques to play hide-and-seek with the two demon puppets.
At the same time, scattering seeds around. Those seeds continued to spread until almost one-third of the trial ground was covered.
Yet he wasn’t in a rush to strangle these two demon puppets. Instead, he expanded the planted area leisurely.
"Artifact spirit, can I take medicine or eat during combat?" Wang Shouzhe asked leisurely.
"You can use healing medicine or spirit pills to replenish profound energy, as long as your condition permits, and you can eat," replied the artifact spirit.
"But you cannot use excitement-inducing or stimulant pills to boost combat power."
Hehe, I understand.
Wang Shouzhe’s confidence was further strengthened.
Then, the vines gradually entangled the two demon puppets.
At this point, Wang Shouzhe’s profound energy was already depleted.
Therefore, he wasn’t in a hurry to strangle the two demon puppets but controlled them with vines, then took out some items from his storage ring and began to eat and drink.
Yes, he bought two storage rings. A couple’s pair, one for each. He even planned to equip every ancestor with one within a few years.
The intertwined vines transformed into tables and chairs.
He patiently took out spirit flesh, spirit fish, a small coal grill, teaware, and other things.
Then he started eating a clear soup hotpot, replenishing his previously consumed qi and blood. Meanwhile, he drank Cloud Mist Spirit Tea to nourish his spirit.
Ancestor Mang, Ancestor Ruhong, and others exchanged glances, finding Shouzhe’s combat style too peculiar. Furthermore, he seemed unbound, able to think of any combat tactics.
Watching this, Wang Lici swallowed hard and quickly said, "Artifact spirit, artifact spirit, can I go up to help eat?"
"Mind your status, warrior," the artifact spirit replied.
"Then, can Liua Ruolan go up to eat?" Wang Shouzhe asked testingly.
"If Lord Elite Soldier Liua Ruolan agrees, she can go up to eat but cannot assist you in combat."
This confirmed the difference in Elite Soldier status, Wang Shouzhe mused secretly.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 15 Victory! A Fruitful Harvest (Requesting Recommendation Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 15 Victory! A Fruitful Harvest (Requesting Recommendation Votes)
...
So Wang Shouzhe invited his wife to the Trial Ground to eat and drink together.
With Liua Ruolan by his side, Wang Shouzhe found this meal particularly delicious.
After they were full and satisfied with tea and food.
Wang Shouzhe began his second round of shenanigans.
He first sat cross-legged and began to digest his Qi and blood, converting it into Profound Qi. Until his energy and Qi and blood were fully restored.
Only then did he start replanting vines. Half an hour later, large parts of the Trial Ground were covered with vines, turning it into a lush green garden.
Besides that, Wang Shouzhe also planted a type of grass whose sap is lethal upon contact with blood, capable of inflicting considerable damage even to strong Qi Refining Realm practitioners.
Of course, for Spirit Platform Realm practitioners, unless injected in large doses over a long period, it would be difficult to kill them with this.
Don’t ask why Wang Shouzhe knows this.
At home, Ancestor Xiaohan and the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle had many bitter stories about this.
Until his Profound Qi was nearly exhausted again.
Wang Shouzhe then resumed eating, drinking, meditating to replenish his Primordial Qi.
This cycle repeated a full ten times.
By this time, the entire Trial Ground was completely covered, without a single exposed stone brick, and two whole days had passed.
At first, the ancestors and juniors were very engrossed, judging and evaluating Wang Shouzhe’s plant array.
And his wife, Liua Ruolan, occasionally joined in to eat and drink with him, saying a few words of encouragement like "Husband, you’re working hard."
Watching until later, everyone went back to sleep.
Liua Ruolan was also exhausted; it was mainly too boring. How could her husband have such patience? In the end, she couldn’t take it anymore and went back to sleep.
This style of combat was unheard of, unseen before.
Only Wang Shounuo was assigned to stay and watch, waiting for the results.
Fortunately, the Artifact Spirit was not truly alive. As long as Wang Shouzhe didn’t break the rules and remain in combat, it didn’t interfere.
Until the third day. The two Demon Puppets, entangled by vines for three full days, faced their ultimate fate.
After Wang Shouzhe completed the array setup, with a move of his Spiritual Sense, the vines around them rapidly grew and wrapped them in a strangling array.
Then they died in such a suffocating, yet silent manner with a strong sense of relief.
"Congratulations, Militia Wang Shouzhe, for passing the second trial." The Artifact Spirit unaffectedly continued with full vitality, "You will receive Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid and be granted the title of Elite Militia."
Stationed at the Trial Ground’s edge, Wang Shounuo finally perked up and said, "Everyone, come quickly, Shouzhe passed the second trial!"
His voice was filled with indescribable excitement. And unsurprisingly so, who wouldn’t be after watching a battle for several days and nights without any result?
Then the ancestors and juniors all ran out from their tents outside the Trial Ground.
This victory was not easily won; Wang Shouzhe fought for more than three days.
Even Liua Ruolan’s ceremonial celebratory cheer was lacking in vigor and full of perfunctory, "Husband mighty, husband domineering~"
Wang Shouzhe didn’t care, as long as he could win, he didn’t mind taking longer. He put away the Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid and returned it to Wang Luojing. This vial would greatly assist Luojing.
Then, Wang Shouzhe looked confidently at his meticulously arranged Vine Poison Array.
This was one of the tactics he had devised long ago.
Fortunately, his bloodline had already achieved Second Layer awakening. The growth speed of vines and poisonous plants, and the setup speed had far exceeded his expectations.
This is why he completed this array in just over three days.
Otherwise, his original estimate was at least seven or eight days.
That’s also why he chose to be the last to take action; otherwise, his siblings and wife might have strangled him.
After everyone congratulated Wang Shouzhe.
Ancestor Longyan arranged for Wang Shounuo to stay on duty, saying that they should call her once Shouzhe wins again. With Shouzhe’s combat style, who knows how long it would be until the next result if they watched by the sidelines?
It would be better to go take a nap or cultivate.
Seeing everyone looking utterly bored, Wang Shouzhe helplessly called out, "My Vine Array is ready, why are you all leaving?"
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe said, "Artifact Spirit, start the third trial."
"As you wish, Elite Militia Wang Shouzhe."
With the fall of the Artifact Spirit’s words.
In the middle of the Trial Platform, three menacing Demon Puppets appeared.
But before they could make any move, the surrounding vines frantically grew and wrapped around them.
Then there was nothing more to it.
This time Wang Shouzhe directly drew his sword and effortlessly chopped off their heads.
The entire battle lasted only about ten breaths of time.
Everyone looked at each other in disbelief. Really? Is this Vine Array actually this powerful?!!
Before anyone could react, Wang Shouzhe had already won the third trial.
In fact, it was quite simple to explain.
When a strong opponent of the same level is entangled and unable to move, how easy is it to harvest their head?
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe’s Vine Array was not prepared just for these three mere Demon Puppets.
"Congratulations, Elite Militia Wang Shouzhe, on passing the third trial. You will receive a Standard Weapon and be granted the title of Warrior." The Artifact Spirit said, "Based on the judgment, the weapon you are using is of the longsword type, do you want to choose a longsword type Standard Weapon?"
"Of course not, I want to choose a defensive type Standard Weapon." Wang Shouzhe replied, "Artifact Spirit, can I choose a general shape within the defensive type?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 15 Victory! A Fruitful Harvest (Requesting Recommendation Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 15 Victory! A Fruitful Harvest (Requesting Recommendation Votes)_2
He is the family heir, and the Cosmic Palace Sword belongs to him, so why would he choose another sword-type spiritual artifact?
Selecting a defensive spiritual artifact is the best strategy.
"As you wish, Warrior Wang Shouzhe." The Artifact Spirit quickly changed its address, "You can choose energy defense, half-energy and half-physical defense, pure physical defense. You can also choose battle armor, shield, or jewelry types."
Clearly, different identities have different treatments, and a warrior’s privileges are far better than a militiaman’s.
Wang Shouzhe pondered slightly and said, "I want a shield type, half-energy and half-physical defense."
He had always been longing for the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield that Ancestor Longyan sold back in the day.
It’s worth mentioning that he had already written to Zhong Xingwang some time ago, asking him to redeem the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield at a premium.
That spiritual artifact was granted by Ancestor Longyan’s master, bearing extraordinary significance to the ancestor.
"As you wish, Warrior Wang Shouzhe."
Then, before Wang Shouzhe, there was a ripple in space, and a shield about the size of a basin floated before him.
It was entirely in a rustic, heavy bronze color, engraved with many enigmatic runes, emitting a lively glow, appearing very exquisite and solid.
Clearly, this was yet another upper-grade spiritual artifact.
Wang Shouzhe acquired the shield and discovered that despite its heavy appearance, it was very lightweight, allowing free movement once fitted on his left arm.
When he infused it with Profound Qi, the shield emitted a cyan glow, and the energy condensed into an energy shield, shaped like a curved umbrella with a diameter of over two meters.
When deployed, it could block all incoming attacks, and its direction could be freely adjusted by rotating his arm.
Wang Shouzhe was greatly satisfied, quickly retracting the umbrella-shaped energy shield.
Qi Refining Realm wielding spiritual artifacts is indeed challenging, and even in such a short while, he felt a large amount of Profound Qi draining.
"Husband, give your shield a name," Liua Ruolan suggested, as her Qiushui Sword had a name, and they couldn’t let the upper-grade spirit shield be without one.
"Seeing you so rustic and heavy yet lively, it’s clear you are an outstanding defensive spirit shield," Wang Shouzhe pondered, "Let’s call you Pot Lid."
"Pot Lid?" A drop of cold sweat appeared on Liua Ruolan’s forehead, her husband’s quirky naming habits hadn’t changed, and she chimed in, "Husband, it might develop intelligence in the future, don’t belittle it."
This, at least, is an upper-grade spiritual artifact; how unsightly is the name Pot Lid?
"Alright, since my wife is not satisfied, I’ll change it." Wang Shouzhe said, "This spirit shield will be the guardian treasure of our family’s legacy. Hopefully, if it develops intelligence, it won’t change its initial intention; let’s call it ’Heart Guard Shield’."
The name was quite decent, and Liua Ruolan agreed.
Then Wang Shouzhe initially intended to start the fourth trial immediately. However, after briefly using the Heart Guard Shield, approximately one-thirtieth of his Profound Qi was consumed.
Given his nature, he’s naturally not in a hurry to start the battle. He rested slightly, meditated to fully restore his Profound Qi.
Only then did he begin the fourth trial.
After a ceremony.
A large demon puppet appeared in the Trial Ground.
As soon as it appeared, the surrounding vines aggressively wrapped around it.
But how could a demon puppet in the Spirit Platform Realm be so easy to deal with?
Its hands moved, claws like blades flipping up and down, slicing the vines into countless segments as they approached.
It carried out its loyal mission to defeat Wang Shouzhe.
Continuously attacking like a demon lawnmower, cutting through the vines. Where it passed, vine wreckage flew everywhere.
A Spirit Platform Realm demon puppet, so ferocious and domineering, was already anticipated by Wang Shouzhe.
The vine array prepared for so long was meant for it.
Wang Shouzhe calmly executed his body technique, weaving through the vines, which seemed alive, making way for him. After he passed, they closed up immediately.
The demon puppet’s speed was very fast, but no matter how fast, it had to clear the vines constantly. Its speed was reduced by seventy to eighty percent compared to its peak.
How could it catch up to Wang Shouzhe?
Moreover, the demon puppet tried various maneuvers, such as low-altitude leaps, to intercept Wang Shouzhe.
But unfortunately, it underestimated Wang Shouzhe’s vines, stretching five to six zhang wide, forming barriers in the air like a demon’s long hair wildly dancing.
Once tangled with the demon puppet, they fiercely pulled it down. The scene was indeed terrifying.
Despite the demon puppet’s continuous roar, it remained helpless against Wang Shouzhe.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe began replanting the severed vines or stimulating them to regrow, playing hide-and-seek with the demon puppet in the vine forest.
Time passed little by little, and the demon puppet grew increasingly irritable.
Despite its immense power, it wasn’t a perpetual motion machine. Depleting most of its power in the vine entanglement, struggling to chase Wang Shouzhe, kept exhausting its strength.
If this continued, its power would eventually be depleted.
Indeed, after an hour, the demon puppet’s speed slowed significantly, and its explosive power became insufficient.
The vines continued to grow endlessly, causing endless hindrances. Its scale armor also started showing some signs of deterioration.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 15 Victory! A Fruitful Harvest (Requesting Recommendation Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 15 Victory! A Fruitful Harvest (Requesting Recommendation Votes)_3
That’s the effect of the Highly Poisonous Grass, which looks inconspicuous and can’t stop the footsteps of the Demon Puppet.
However, the splattered juice has already covered the entire body of the Demon Puppet.
The poison is gradually causing slight damage to the Demon Puppet in a hushed and subtle manner.
In contrast, Wang Shouzhe has always maintained his Profound Qi at a relatively high level without depleting it.
He occasionally consumes a Peiyuan Pill, continuously consuming the body’s blood and gradually converting it into Profound Qi Energy. This process of restoring Profound Qi, although not as quick as meditation recovery, prevails in its continual, slow restoration.
This is destined to be a marathon-like battle.
Two Hours later, only a third of the Vine Array laid down by Wang Shouzhe is left, with most of the others having been swept away by the Demon Puppet, leaving wreckage all over the Trial Ground.
This is still the result after Wang Shouzhe continuously replanted the vines.
This shows how terrifying the Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet is.
But no matter how fearsome it is, its life has reached its end. Ten percent of its strength has been depleted by nine percent. Its entire body is relentlessly deteriorating, constantly harmed by the poison. Its steps are staggered, and its grass-cutting speed has slowed considerably.
Gradually, the speed of vine entanglement has exceeded its ability to slay and cut the grass.
Once such a state is reached, it is ready to face death.
All the Ancestors watching the battle throughout exchanged glances with solemn faces. If they faced a similar Vine Array.
Once deeply entrapped within, the outcome might not be much better.
But humans are always human, unlike the Trial Ground’s Demon Puppet.
When faced with a similar situation, they can completely find another way.
That Demon Puppet was simply drained bit by bit. However, the Ancestors can find a way to break out. Then they can leave without batting an eye, refuse to play, and say, "Not playing with you!"
In fact, this is also the drawback of Wang Shouzhe’s Vine Array.
As the saying goes, good defense, poor offense.
However, if he reaches the Spirit Platform Realm and cultivates the Bloodthirsty Vine, the situation will be different.
Though the Vine Array has many shortcomings, its power was brought to full play in the Trial Ground.
The depleted Demon Puppet gradually got entangled by countless vines, slowly buried within with no more movement.
If it were an average person, they would have already drawn their Sword and quickly slain it.
But Wang Shouzhe remains very patient.
After all, there’s plenty of time since it has been procured and can be ground to death slowly.
Why risk moving forward to slay it?
Thus, another Hour was spent, as Wang Shouzhe smoothly continued replanting vines, adding them to the entanglement army, and finally grinding the Demon Puppet alive.
The entire battle lasted three and a half Hours, and from start to finish, the Demon Puppet didn’t even touch Wang Shouzhe’s sleeve.
"Congratulations Warrior Wang Shouzhe, on winning the final victory," said the Artifact Spirit.
With the sound of the Artifact Spirit, everyone realized that the Spirit Platform Mirror Demon Puppet buried deep in the vines had finally fallen!
At this time.
Liua Ruolan carefully avoided the wreckage of the vines and stepped forward to complete the couple’s ritual: "Mighty Husband, Husband, you’ve worked hard!"
Actually, it’s not quite mighty, and the normal battle wouldn’t have exciting ups and downs, it was all hide and seek and maneuvering play.
To put it in the words of Ancestor Xuanfu, Wang Shouzhe, the man is so greedy for life and fear of death that there’s not a trace of the celestial pride’s relentless demeanor in him.
But what does it matter? Isn’t such a fighting style very safe?
Liua Ruolan felt a sense of safety, having such a cautious husband meant she never needed to worry about him being in danger when abroad, what a good thing?
Then.
The delightful time of harvesting rewards arrived.
Without the Artifact Spirit introducing, Wang Shouzhe directly said, "Artifact Spirit, I want that Primordial Water Spirit Pearl."
Naturally, he gave this Primordial Water Spirit Pearl to Lady Liua Ruolan.
"Husband, you’re really good, always thinking of me," Liua Ruolan said emotionally.
"Lady, you are good too, always thinking of the Husband."
The couple once again began shamelessly showing off their affection.
Below the Trial Ground, Liua Ruolei watched with a melancholy face.
Perhaps it’s better to return to the Academy earlier, staying here longer might not be bearable for her young mind.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 16: Achievement! Shouzhe Steps into the Spirit Platform Mirror
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 16: Achievement! Shouzhe Steps into the Spirit Platform Mirror
...
Why did it feel so off, the way they exchanged treasures between the couple?
Obviously, they could have separately fought for their own treasures, but now it turned into them exchanging between husband and wife.
They even managed to sprinkle a big dose of public display of affection, leaving Liua Ruolei feeling slightly tipsy from it. The whole operation was rather over the top.
Unfortunately, no one seemed to pay any attention to her.
Especially the Wang Family members, who were all very excited. After all, this time, the harvest for the Wang Family was the biggest.
The other families, apart from Liua Yuanhui, only obtained one Celestial Spirit Pill.
But they were not discouraged, because with this trial ground in place, each family would eventually benefit. The focus now was on cultivating the young and talented members of the clan.
Next came the cleanup work.
Although the trial ground was remote, since Ancestor Zhou Xuan had the ability and luck to enter, sooner or later, others would break in.
Hence, Wang Shouzhe suggested properly setting up this canyon and having each family take turns to guard it.
All the ancestors responded in kind, following Wang Shouzhe’s instructions.
They moved stones and dug holes where needed, all without complaint, working enthusiastically. Especially Wang Shouzhe, who expended a significant amount of his Profound Qi to set up a Vine Array throughout the valley.
The entrance was designed with care, making it extremely difficult for outsiders to find the place without someone from inside opening the path.
During this process,
the Wang Family members carefully absorbed the rewards from this time, with Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing both consuming Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid, undergoing a Bone Marrow Purify and a Secondary Bloodline Awakening.
Their natural talent, already at Middle Grade A, advanced to Upper Grade D after the purification. Such a formidable bloodline talent is rare even in Longzuo County, earning them the title of Celestial Pride.
Their future prospects are truly limitless.
Meanwhile, Wang Lici’s gain was even greater, elevating her talent a bit more with the Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid.
Under the protection of the ancestor, she broke through from the peak of the Qi Refining Realm to the Spirit Platform Realm, becoming a very young Spirit Platform Realm cultivator. At twenty-four or five, she is considered exceptional even within the Purple Mansion Academy.
Unfortunately, this girl is naturally lazy and not enthusiastic about cultivating Black Tortoise Combat Skills. Her only praise-worthy trait is her incredibly good fortune, and it’s uncertain how far she will go in the future.
In the path of the Black Tortoise, sometimes fortune is even more important than talent.
It’s also worth mentioning Liua Yuanhui.
With his Lower Grade A talent, reaching the peak of the Qi Refining Realm by thirty shows how much the Liua Family has invested in him.
This time, he acquired a Celestial Spirit Pill and under Ancestor Xuanfu’s protection, he attempted to break through and succeeded in reaching the Spirit Platform Realm. His luck is decent, given that with Lower Grade A talent, breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm is not always successful.
For someone like Wang Lici, who originally had Upper Grade talent, the chance of success in breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm is not guaranteed to be one hundred percent, but the chance of failure is very low. This demonstrates the importance of bloodline talent.
Regardless, Liua Yuanhui’s advancement to the Spirit Platform Realm is a great stroke of luck. With Liua Family now having four visible Spirit Platform members,
Why say visible?
It’s simple, because the Shanyin Liua Family originally had four Spirit Platform Realm ancestors, but Liua Yuanhui and Liua Ruolan’s grandfather—Liua Cunren, had secretly advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm.
To preserve his trump card and act low-key, preventing attention, Ancestor Cunren was hidden away.
This is the way of survival for noble families, especially like the Liua Family, an Eighth-Grade Noble Family with three Spirit Platforms, they tend to hide a trump card secretly.
Now with five Spirit Platform members, if this is revealed, it will surely cause a huge wave, and possibly, Liua Yuanhui might also be secretly hidden away.
This time the Wang Family gained a lot.
The largest beneficiaries were the Shouzhe couple.
In a temporarily carved-out mountain chamber, Wang Shouzhe was in seclusion, absorbing the results of the battle while Ancestor Longyan guarded outside for his protection.
Wang Shouzhe sat cross-legged, his heart filled with emotion, recalling the days of crossing over and living in constant fear as a small Clan Leader.
Today, he was qualified to attempt a breakthrough to the Spirit Platform Realm. The process had been arduous but filled with the joy of harvest.
The Spirit Platform Realm.
In a sense, within this Black Tortoise World, the Spirit Platform Realm is just the beginning,
only having gained some ability to protect oneself.
He calmed his mind, eliminating distractions until he reached a state of emptiness. Only then did he take out the Celestial Spirit Pill and swallow it with a mind free of joy or sorrow.
The Celestial Spirit Pill immediately transformed into waves of robust and tyrannical energy, pounding against his internal organs, causing his handsome face to contort with immense pain.
Wang Shouzhe hurriedly activated the last stage technique of the Qi Refining Chapter of the Wood Element Upper Grade Technique, the "Eternal Spring True Technique," controlling that energy to make it his own.
Cooperating with the warm and pure Eternal Spring True Qi, he entered the breakthrough stage.
The Qi Refining Realm is a process of long accumulation. To break through to the Spirit Platform Realm, one must open the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges for the Grand Circulation of Profound Qi, create the Spirit Platform, and continuously gain spiritual sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 16: Achievement! Shouzhe Steps into the Spirit Platform Mirror_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 16: Achievement! Shouzhe Steps into the Spirit Platform Mirror_2
Spiritual sense, which can colloquially be called spiritual power, would be considered superpowers on Earth.
Some with powerful bloodlines already possess rudimentary spiritual sense in the Qi Refining Realm, such as Wang Shouzhe who had some weak spiritual sense.
As for Wang Luojing, her spiritual sense was already not weak during the Qi Refining Realm.
Having rudimentary spiritual sense is somewhat beneficial in breaking through to the Spirit Platform, offering some shortcuts.
However, the most crucial first step for Wang Shouzhe is to connect the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges.
He mobilized Wood Profound Qi, harnessing the energy of the Celestial Spirit Pill, circulating the Small Circulation cycle repeatedly, causing all acupoints to resonate, with blood and qi boiling and burning within his body, and every cell resonating.
After several Small Circulations, when his body was in optimal condition, he began to break through the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges.
Then he did not experience the sensation of being on the verge of dying or ascending; under the immense energy, the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges only resisted for the time it takes a stick of incense to burn before they crumbled.
From then on, the Profound Qi flowed unimpeded, helping Wang Shouzhe form a Grand Circulation.
How fragile were these Heaven and Earth Two Bridges? Wang Shouzhe silently complained, not needing to use any prepared auxiliary elixirs.
But this was reasonable; he had consumed Heavenly and Earthly Treasures for bloodline improvement and evolution so many times that he had reached Upper Grade D and had entered the ranks for Secondary Bloodline Awakening as a Celestial Pride.
With such exceptional talent, would it not be disgraceful to the title of Celestial Pride if breaking through the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges caused extreme pain?
It was said that in ancient times, some extraordinarily formidable Celestial Prides didn’t even need the Celestial Spirit Pill to breach the Spirit Platform Realm. But such Celestial Prides were truly far from Wang Shouzhe, and whether he could ever encounter one was questionable.
When Wang Shouzhe completed his first Grand Circulation.
Suddenly, all the acupoints in his Grand Circulation resonated simultaneously, driving his qi and blood to a boiling state, with mist rising from his entire body as he entered a profound transformation.
Countless cells were dying, and the newly born cells were becoming very strong, far surpassing those in the Qi Refining Realm.
This was a transformation of life, an evolution of physique.
Crossing from the Qi Refining Realm to the Spirit Platform Realm was an earth-shattering change. It entailed a great leap in life level.
This naturally made sense; otherwise, how could the Spirit Platform Realm have a lifespan of two hundred years?
Wang Shouzhe’s body was evolving rapidly, with dead cells expelled through sweat and pores, forming a layer of black grime. But at this moment, he clearly couldn’t worry about such things; he mustn’t stop now.
Again and again, circulating the Grand Cycle, each time driving his body’s evolution. Meanwhile, his own Profound Qi and the Celestial Spirit Pill’s energy were rapidly depleting.
This is why the Celestial Spirit Pill is necessary for breaking through to the Spirit Platform Realm. Without the vast energy support of the Celestial Spirit Pill, how could a regular Black Tortoise Cultivator have enough energy?
Wang Shouzhe continued until after completing the ninth Grand Cycle, when his body’s evolution and transformation reached its peak. The next step was to slowly cultivate, progressing gradually until stepping into the Celestial Human Realm.
And during this time, there was another extremely important task awaiting Wang Shouzhe—opening the Spirit Platform.
Only after opening the Spirit Platform could he be considered a true Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
The position of the Spirit Platform resides above the eyebrows, within the Yin Tang. It is a very mysterious and mystical place, concerning the existence of one’s spiritual power.
There are even studies and records about this position on Earth, but humans on Earth cannot cultivate Profound Qi and thus find it difficult to actively open the Spirit Platform.
The position of the Spirit Platform needs to be accessed through the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges.
This is why the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges must be connected first before unlocking the Spirit Platform.
Wang Shouzhe circulated Profound Qi, passed through the Heaven and Earth Two Bridges, gradually and imperceptibly infiltrating the Spirit Platform.
Opening the Spirit Platform must not be rushed, as it is the most fragile spot in humans, and any carelessness could injure it, which would be a significant problem.
The Profound Qi slowly filled the Spirit Platform, like the beginning of creation, and the previously chaotic Spirit Platform gradually filled and became clear.
At this moment, Wang Shouzhe’s eyes were closed.
Yet he could miraculously sense everything around him, a perception entirely different from seeing with eyes, and unlike the feeling of exploration with radar. It was as if, where spiritual power shrouded, everything around was immediately reflected in his mind.
He found it difficult to describe this wonderful sensation; for instance, he could sense the ground’s rock with such clarity, even its rough and uneven surface could be felt, as if lightly caressing it with his hands.
But he couldn’t perceive the color of the rock; after all, color is sensed through the eyes capturing light.
This sensation became increasingly clear, reflecting his growing spiritual sense.
Until a feeling of swelling discomfort and slight stinging emitted from the Spirit Platform, prompting him to cease the process.
He knew he had reached his limit, and forcing further development could damage the Spirit Platform, doing more harm than good.
If he wanted to further enhance the Spirit Platform, he would need to continue cultivating to reach the Second-Layer Spirit Platform Stage.
Wang Shouzhe slowly opened his eyes, and the scene before him was exceptionally clear; the training cave he carved out by himself appeared very rough, and his eyes could distinctly see the coarse, uneven places.
It was like a nearsighted person wearing glasses for the first time, suddenly seeing the world in great clarity.
Simultaneously, his ears became highly sensitive; he could even faintly hear the gentle breathing of Ancestor Longyan waiting just outside the door.
Of course, that was because Ancestor Longyan hadn’t deliberately concealed her breath; otherwise, Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t have detected her.
This was the transformation upon entering the Spirit Platform Mirror, resulting in a vast improvement in all aspects of physiognomy, of which vision and hearing were just parts.
This was a leap in life.
Wang Shouzhe felt a surge of excitement within, stood up, and immediately felt his body as light as a feather.
With a casual step forward, it seemed so buoyant that he felt like he might start flying. Compared to the Qi Refining Realm, the Spirit Platform Mirror seemed like the realm of immortals, ready to soar any moment.
No wonder Ancestor Xiaohan in his days after advancing loved to walk on water or glide at low heights, as it was the body’s natural instinct.
With a slight push, Wang Shouzhe’s body gently floated upward. It wasn’t until reaching the top of the cave that he gently descended like a feather.
This experience was akin to being on a low-gravity planet, where his body seemed weightless.
At that moment when Wang Shouzhe was three feet from the ground, the Profound Qi in his body suddenly swelled, and abruptly his descent stopped, hanging effortlessly in mid-air.
Floating, flying—dreams humanity has held since time immemorial.
In this Black Tortoise World, as long as one reaches the Spirit Platform Realm, brief levitation and flight become possible.
This made Wang Shouzhe’s heart surge with excitement as he hovered three zhang, still suspended in the air.
Satisfying.
This feeling, like being free from Earth’s gravity, truly stirred his heart. It was far different from using body technique to jump or even to glide.
This was true flight.
However, countering Earth’s gravity caused Profound Qi to be consumed rapidly, even in such a short spell, Wang Shouzhe could feel the vast depletion of Profound Qi.
Hence, Spirit Platform Realm cultivators would never use flight to travel long distances, as they would have to stop for recovery long before flying a few miles.
After another simple test of strength and speed, Wang Shouzhe naturally found it incomparable to the peak of the Qi Refining Realm.
Such all-encompassing improvements.
At that moment, Wang Shouzhe felt completely safe inside, his heart full of strength, as if he finally had the qualifications to survive well in the Black Tortoise World.
He had worked hard for nearly nine years to reach this point.
Those nine years of hardship had not been in vain.
He immediately felt his heart brimming with a sense of security and strength, his body filled with a newfound lightness.
Just a step forward, and everything felt buoyant, like he could float away. No wonder Ancestor Xiaohan often walked on water or skimmed low across the sky after his own promotion.
With a casual step, as if weightless, Wang Shouzhe floated lightly upwards, gently descending like a feather until he landed at the cave’s roof.
This experience was like being on a distant, weightless planet, effortlessly floating in the air.
As Wang Shouzhe remained suspended three feet above the ground, his internal Profound Qi suddenly swelled. His descent stopped abruptly, an indication of his newfound control.
But to resist the pull of gravity, Profound Qi was consumed rapidly; in just a short flight, Wang Shouzhe went to feel the need to restore energy after extensive consumption.
Such is an across-the-board enhancement.
That realization filled Wang Shouzhe’s heart with a profound sense of security, growing stronger, only then feeling the qualification to live well in the mystical world filled with dangers.
He had worked diligently for nearly nine years to reach this step.
Those nine arduous years were not in vain.
He immediately felt his heart full of a sense of security, strong, only then able, perhaps, this lifetime, to witness the splendor of stepping into the Celestial Human Realm.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 17: Major Enhancement of the Triple Bloodline and Family Heritage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 17: Major Enhancement of the Triple Bloodline and Family Heritage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
...
Of course, this is merely because his inner pride swelled after just being promoted to the Spirit Platform Realm.
He also knows that the Path of Celestial Human is longer and more arduous. Only by steadily moving forward, step by step, can one possibly reach the end.
There are absolutely no shortcuts along this path.
Fortunately, before he was promoted to the Spirit Platform Realm, he had already achieved the awakening of the Second-Tier Bloodline.
Now that he has been promoted to the Spirit Platform Realm, his life level has undergone a leap. According to conventional wisdom, his bloodline should further purify and reach the Triple Bloodline level, moving closer to some ancient ancestor.
Once he had tested his body and gained preliminary understanding,
he began to test the degree of bloodline awakening. He casually took out an ordinary vine seed and placed it in the palm of his hand. Then, he infused it with rich cyan Profound Qi.
Suddenly.
The vine seed sprouted roots and stems in the blink of an eye in his palm and wrapped tightly around his hand.
Then the vine grew wildly, faster and faster. In no time, it had grown into a vine as thick as an arm and nearly six or seven feet long.
The vine appeared to emit a heavy luster amid its dark green hue, exuding a very robust appearance.
"This..."
Wang Shouzhe’s eyes lit up with joy. An ordinary vine seed now seemed different. It was much stronger, more resilient, and grew faster than before.
If that Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppet encountered this level of vine now, it probably wouldn’t be able to "mow the grass" so wildly.
At the same time, the battle duration would be significantly shortened.
This was merely the enhancement in the aspect of rapid plant growth.
If Wang Shouzhe were to invest more time, slowly updating and strengthening the vine seed, its potency would increase by more than a little.
This is one of the advantages of awakening the Triple Bloodline.
The other benefits of the Triple Bloodline require time to adapt and explore slowly. Understanding and analyzing the evolved bloodline can’t be achieved overnight.
Besides, his bloodline ability is quite unique...
If talking purely in terms of combat, the manifested combat strength isn’t particularly strong.
But as long as he is given enough time to continuously improve his battle seeds and fully utilize the terrain and tactics in combat, there is great potential for surmounting levels in battle.
Moreover, what excites him the most is the possibility of improving the Spirit Seeds.
Previously, because the First-Tier Bloodline was too thin, it limited the bloodline’s development in the improvement of spirit seeds.
It merely enhanced rice and wheat seeds, developing seeds with higher yields and fuller grains.
But ordinary rice and wheat seeds, no matter how enhanced, are still just ordinary seeds.
If he can improve the two types of spirit crop seeds at home, the White Jade Spirit Rice and Red Crystal Spirit Rice, into higher-yield spirit seeds, the family’s benefit will be even greater.
However, improving spirit seeds isn’t something that can be done overnight, so Wang Shouzhe temporarily set this thought aside.
Originally, Wang Shouzhe also wanted to take the opportunity to study the Heart Guard Shield and the Bloodthirsty Vine. But after calming down, he smelled an unpleasant odor on himself.
It was the residue left from the leap in his life and evolution of his bloodline. If not dealt with, it would surely smell terrible.
Only then did he call out, "Honey, I’ve completed my promotion."
Not long after, Liua Ruolan, who had been waiting from afar, came running in carrying a large barrel of hot water, about one or two tons heavy.
But Liua Ruolan seemed to bear no effort in carrying that large barrel of hot water.
First, because she is naturally talented, with a high degree of bloodline awakening. Second, she had already stepped into the Spirit Platform Realm before Wang Shouzhe and easily awakened the Triple Bloodline.
Her bloodline level is much higher than Wang Shouzhe’s. Even if she hasn’t reached the Fourth Tier of Bloodline, she isn’t far off.
Indeed, she is one step ahead again.
This made Wang Shouzhe involuntarily suspect whether she was doing it on purpose?
Clearly making sure Wang Shouzhe couldn’t overpower her!
This was so infuriating.
"Congratulations, husband, on stepping into the Spirit Platform Realm and becoming an Ancestor Spirit Platform," Liua Ruolan said gently and generously, unaware of Wang Shouzhe’s thoughts, then with a "clang," she placed the large barrel of hot water on the ground, "Husband, take your time bathing, and I’ll take my leave first."
"Wait a moment," Wang Shouzhe stopped her, "Just now when I was promoted to the Spirit Platform Realm, I accidentally twisted my waist. Ruolan, please help me bathe this time."
"Hmm?" Liua Ruolan’s beautiful eyes widened in surprise, "Are you sure, husband?"
She couldn’t understand why he would twist his waist while promoting to the Spirit Platform Realm?
"I’m sure. Alas~~ I was too excited after the promotion and accidentally twisted my waist while attempting to fly," Wang Shouzhe said seriously, "Honey, we’re an old married couple now. Don’t we even have this basic level of trust?"
"Alright then." Liua Ruolan blushed slightly, hesitated for a moment, but still agreed, biting her lip, "But you mustn’t act rashly. I will be shy."
Since they were married, she hadn’t done such a thing before, her face was all red.
"I won’t act rashly, I won’t," Wang Shouzhe assured, patting his chest.
"Alright, let’s try it." Finally, Liua Ruolan nodded, still blushing.
Then.
Ancestor Longyan, who was outside guarding Wang Shouzhe, quietly left.
During this time, she also pulled away Ancestor Xuanfu, who came to check on the situation, saying that Shouzhe got slightly hurt during the promotion, and Ruolan was helping with the healing.

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 17: Triple Bloodline and Major Enhancement of Family Heritage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 17: Triple Bloodline and Major Enhancement of Family Heritage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
This left Ancestor Xuanfu feeling unsettled and suspicious. How could one be injured while advancing to the Spirit Platform Realm out of the blue?
Could it be an injury to the Spirit Platform?
This is a major issue. No, she needs to take a look.
As a result, she was forcibly dragged away by Ancestor Longyan.
After the time it took for an incense stick to burn, miserable cries emanated from the grotto where Wang Shouzhe was in seclusion: "Ruolan, why did your eyes change color?"
"You said you wouldn’t mess around."
"I didn’t mess around, it’s just that the power surged too quickly, and I couldn’t control my hand speed."
"Hmph! Go die!"
"I was wrong..."
Then, sounds of intense fighting erupted.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Under the intense energy fluctuations, it seemed as if the entire mountain range was trembling.
Amidst this, there were also some bizarre cries that sounded utterly inhumane.
"Something’s wrong." Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyes widened with surprise and prepared to investigate.
Once again, she was held back by Ancestor Longyan: "Don’t get too involved with young people’s affairs."
Meanwhile, she marvelled in her heart at how quickly the world changes, and how adept young people are at playing.
Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyes were filled with doubt. The sounds and scenes seemed way too shocking; is it really alright not to go?
"Maybe we should wait until Shouzhe begs for forgiveness before checking it out?" Ancestor Longyan suggested uncertainly.
"Uh... it seems he’s already begging for forgiveness." Ancestor Xuanfu weakly noted.
"Then let’s wait until he screams for help... before checking it out."
"Uh... it seems he’s already screaming for help."
Subsequently, the two ancestors exchanged glances and rushed in.
Then, they quickly rushed out at the fastest speed.
Their faces were flushed beneath their veils, these young people were way too shameless.
...
What exactly happened that night?
Except for the few involved, who remained tight-lipped, no one else naturally knew.
A dozen days later.
The main force began to withdraw from the canyon.
"Third Brother." Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands in respect to a young man within the vine array, "For this first year, I entrust the guard duty to you. This is a good time for you to hone yourself and strive to reach the Spirit Platform Realm as soon as possible."
"Fourth Brother." Wang Shounuo replied bitterly, "I have to trouble you to take care of my wife and children back home."
He never imagined that coming out for a trial would result in being assigned a year of guard duty — truly the world is unpredictable.
Fortunately, not only are the merit points high this year, but the main force also left him plenty of resources.
If he cultivates with peace of mind, it seemed his cultivation could significantly advance, though it would be rather lonely.
After Wang Shouzhe arranged the covert operations of the trial ground and the selection of the guards,
he didn’t remain idle either.
He leveraged his strong influence and numerous ancestors and engaged in a good harvest around the trial area, gathering a considerable amount of fierce beast meat and various heavenly and earthly treasures.
At the same time.
Wang Shouzhe also secretly began cultivating the Bloodthirsty Vine.
Not long after, once the trial area’s surroundings were cleared out,
he met up with the autumn-winter hunting team led by Wang Family’s Ancestor Xiaohan and returned all the way to Ping’an Town.
Speaking of why Ancestor Xiaohan’s autumn-winter hunting team was present, it was naturally something Wang Shouzhe had planned long ago, conducting the trial along with autumn-winter hunting was certainly more beneficial for the family.
After returning to Ping’an Town,
they distributed the meat that needed to be distributed.
The heavenly and earthly treasures obtained during the sweep were also distributed fairly according to the contributions of each family.
Thus, this trial journey concluded successfully. Each family had gains, making the trip worthwhile.
The only unexpected outcome was that.
Ancestor Xuanfu and the sister-in-law Liua Ruolei, after completing the trial, didn’t return to the Liua Family but instead stayed shamelessly at the Wang Family, freeloading food and lodging. They said since it was already October, they would return to the academy after the New Year.
Especially Ancestor Xuanfu, who said it had been a long time since she celebrated the New Year with her cousin Longyan and thus naturally decided to stay with the Wang Family.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe also started staying at home, peacefully researching his Bloodthirsty Vine, refining and familiarizing himself with the Heart Guard Shield and Cosmic Palace Sword.
And also exploring and adjusting to his bloodline, which had reached the Third Layer.
This time, he started from ordinary seeds for adaptation, ultimately aiming to enhance the Spirit Seed.
Besides these, he spent his days playing with his pair of adorable children. Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, more than half a month went by.
On this day,
while accompanying the children in their studies, Wang Shouzhe received a report from the gatekeeper that Celestial Human Zhong Family’s Zhong Xingwang had come to visit.
Wang Shouzhe held a great amount of respect for Brother Zhong, Zhong Xingwang.
After all, Brother Zhong had helped several times during the family’s crisis.
Even though he remained hopelessly devoted to Ancestor Longyan and found ways to linger at the Wang Family every year, that could not negate his various contributions to the Wang Family.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe personally went out to greet Zhong Xingwang, serving the best tea and snacks without the slightest neglect.
"Younger Brother Shouzhe." Zhong Xingwang said with a smile as he drank Spirit Tea and ate snacks, "I was fortunate not to disgrace my mission. According to your request, I redeemed Sister Longyan’s [Turtle Scale Treasure Shield]. Also, the three [High-Level Breath Concealment Pendants] you tasked me to search for are now in hand."
"Brother Zhong, Shouzhe truly appreciates it." Wang Shouzhe stood up and bowed, saying sincerely, "The favor of Brother Zhong’s assistance will be engraved in my heart. If Brother Zhong needs anything in the future, Shouzhe will not decline."
Zhong Xingwang hurriedly stood up to return the salute and said, "Shouzhe, you’re too polite. You and I are brothers, no need for such formalities."

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 17: Triple Bloodline and Major Enhancement of Family Heritage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 17: Triple Bloodline and Major Enhancement of Family Heritage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
After a brief exchange of pleasantries.
Wang Shouzhe confirmed that the redemption price for the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield was thirty-two thousand Qian Gold. This price was quite fair, evidently Zhong Xingwang had put in some effort.
And the high-level Breath Concealment Pendant, each priced at eleven thousand.
The price can be considered very expensive, but to keep some trump cards for the family, the money has to be spent. After all, this high-level Breath Concealment Pendant can mask and hide the powerful aura of a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
Moreover, high-level Breath Concealment Pendants are not particularly common treasures. Zhong Xingwang managed to find a way and connections to acquire them, which already took considerable effort.
In this way, Wang Shouzhe spent sixty-five thousand Qian Gold again, including an extra three thousand Qian Gold, which was used as a reward for Zhong Xingwang’s hard work.
Thus, Wang Family’s funds became a bit tight. Luckily, there are many sources of income nowadays, so there’s no fear of lacking cash flow.
Besides, Qian Gold if not converted into strength, what use is even more money?
Although this round, Wang Shouzhe spent a lot of money, it was all used to enhance the family’s strength and foundation.
Regarding that three thousand reward, even though Zhong Xingwang repeatedly declined.
However, Wang Shouzhe does things straightforwardly, he will never waste relationships for nothing.
After some entanglement, Zhong Xingwang reluctantly accepted the Qian Gold, and with great emotion said, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, among all the patriarchs I’ve met, you are the most meticulous in your work. Wang Family’s prosperity today is definitely inseparable from your relationship."
"Brother Zhong overrates me, overrates me!" Wang Shouzhe said modestly.
"By the way, uh... how has the senior sister been lately? I haven’t had the chance to pay her my respects and greetings for quite some time," Zhong Xingwang, who is generally well-intentioned, can’t seem to avoid mentioning Ancestor Longyan even after few serious words.
"Ahem," Wang Shouzhe coughed twice, solemnly reminded again, "Brother Zhong, I really need to remind you something. Ancestor Longyan in my family is set on the Path of Celestial Human, perhaps..."
"I understand, I understand. I only have admiration for Senior Sister Longyan, definitely no inappropriate thoughts. It’s only natural for Senior Sister to walk her Path of Celestial Human, I just need to quietly support her from behind," Zhong Xingwang nodded repeatedly in agreement and then changed the topic, saying, "Alright, I’m rather tired from this journey, so I’ll rest now, there’s no need for additional hospitality, Younger Brother Shouzhe."
Afterward, Zhong Xingwang headed familiarly straight to his guest courtyard.
There’s no alternative, he comes to stay for a while every year, so the courtyard has to be kept for him. Fortunately, when Ancestor Zhou Xuan built the main residence back then, he fully considered the subsequent burgeoning population, constructing many courtyards.
Otherwise, it would really not withstand all the people coming over to mooch food, drink, and lodging.
After taking the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield.
Wang Shouzhe immediately went to Longyan Residence, planning to give the ancestor a surprise.
Just happened to encounter Ancestor Xuanfu also visiting Longyan Residence, the two ancestors were drinking Spirit Tea in the courtyard and seemed to be chatting.
This was not surprising.
After Ancestor Xuanfu settled in Wang Family, she would pay visits to Ancestor Longyan every few days.
"Shouzhe, it’s just right that you’re here, I was just talking to my cousin about you," Ancestor Xuanfu seemed in a good mood, "Sit down and join us in conversation."
Although Wang Shouzhe had reached the Spirit Platform Realm now, these two were both ancestor-level, naturally adhering to hierarchy and propriety, he promptly cupped his hands and replied, "As the ancestors wished, I dare not refuse."
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe sat down aside, helped the two ancestors add Spirit Tea, displaying a silent demeanor.
"Shouzhe, both my cousin Longyan and I are of the same mind," Ancestor Xuanfu said, "After the New Year, take Ruolan and join me on a trip to the Academy. First, as you have just advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, you need to acquire the remaining Spirit Platform Chapter’s cultivation technique from the Academy. Secondly... Cousin Longyan hopes to have you pay a visit to Binglan Ascendant."
Academy, Binglan Ascendant? Wang Shouzhe slightly furrowed his brows.
"Of course, the most important thing on this trip is your Wang Family must find a way to make friends with the Academy’s high-levels," Ancestor Xuanfu said, "No matter what, Purple Mansion Academy is the Black Tortoise Sacred Land of our Longzuo County. In a way, the Academy influences at least half of Longzuo County."
Wang Shouzhe thought secretly, Ancestor Xuanfu’s words do make sense.
In the entire Longzuo County, Purple Mansion Academy’s influence is indeed immense.
And by the looks of the two ancestors, they want him, Wang Shouzhe, to go and curry favor with Binglan Ascendant.
But why do the two ancestors believe that Binglan Ascendant would let him curry favor?
Wang Shouzhe fell into contemplation, evidently the complexity of that matter in the past exceeded his imagination.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 18: The Longzuo Wang Family and the Purple Mansion Academy
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 18: The Longzuo Wang Family and the Purple Mansion Academy
...
"Binglan Ascendant has always valued Cousin Longyan greatly," Ancestor Xuanfu said. "Over the past decades, I’ve heard that Binglan Ascendant has mentioned Cousin Longyan several times in front of the core disciples. And each time after mentioning her, she would be in a bad mood for several days. Clearly, she still has a lingering attachment to Cousin Longyan."
"How many direct disciples does Binglan Ascendant have?" Wang Shouzhe pondered as he asked.
"Only one; the Profound Ice lineage has always had very few people," Ancestor Xuanfu replied strangely. "Shouzhe, why are you asking this?"
"Naturally, I’m calculating just how much Binglan Ascendant cares for Ancestor Longyan," Wang Shouzhe said calmly. "Our family ancestor is in the Spirit Platform Realm, with a Profound Ice bloodline around the Second Layer high stage. In the future, reaching the Celestial Human Realm is promising, but eventually becoming a Purple Mansion Realm might still require a good fight."
"Indeed, that’s true," Ancestor Longyan agreed realistically. "Without special opportunities, entering the Purple Mansion Realm in this life would be quite difficult for me."
"Ancestor, among Binglan Ascendant’s disciples, how many have a bloodline equal to yours?" Wang Shouzhe continued to ask.
"When I left, there were only three remaining," Ancestor Longyan said. "Among them, a senior brother and a senior sister have already reached the Celestial Human Realm. However, after reaching the Celestial Human Realm, they awakened an additional layer of bloodline, significantly enhancing their overall strength."
"Then, Ancestor’s position among Binglan Ascendant’s many disciples should rank in the top five in her mind," Wang Shouzhe mused. "There should be considerable importance attached, and losing this disciple is quite regrettable, but it’s still not to the extent of choosing her above all others. Thus, there’s an opportunity to build some connections, though latching onto her for support is quite challenging."
"Unless Ancestor can show greater potential, such as reaching a Third Layer bloodline while in the Spirit Platform Realm."
Ancestor Xuanfu rolled her eyes: "You rascal, do you really think human feelings can be calculated like this? Even finding out an Ascendant’s thoughts is something you dare to guess."
This isn’t just a wild guess, Wang Shouzhe thought to himself.
According to Wang Shouzhe’s understanding and various deductions, Binglan Ascendant indeed values Ancestor Longyan quite a bit and regrets losing this disciple. But it’s indeed not to the extent where she can’t live without her.
This has nothing to do with anything else, it’s merely human nature, As much as even an Ascendant can’t escape it.
Ancestor Xuanfu said, "In any case, that’s generally the situation. After the New Year, we’ll set out for the academy in early spring."
"Ancestor Xuanfu, how many direct disciples and core disciples does Changchun Ascendant have?" Wang Shouzhe asked again.
He is currently nominally under Changchun Ascendant’s tutelage, but only as an outer disciple in name.
"Changchun Ascendant currently has two direct disciples and seventeen or eighteen core disciples," Ancestor Xuanfu said. "Shouzhe, by asking this, are you perhaps trying to compete for a direct disciple’s spot?"
At this point, her eyes lit up a bit.
If Shouzhe is willing to become an official disciple at the Purple Mansion Academy, wouldn’t that mean Ruolan would have to go along too?
To be honest.
Ancestor Xuanfu still hopes that Liu Ruolan has the opportunity to go to Purple Mansion Academy and become an official disciple.
After all, Changning Guard is too small, and Ping’an Town is even more of a backwater among backwaters.
Only by standing on the big platform of the academy, can they have a broader world and better development.
Ancestor Xuanfu immediately said, "Shouzhe, with your current bloodline talent. If you give up the patriarch position and join the academy focusing on cultivation, you can indeed have a chance to compete for a position as a direct disciple under Changchun Ascendant."
Give up the clan leader position?
What a joke!
Wang Shouzhe relies on the family’s power for his future Path of Celestial Human and Purple Mansion path.
Farming is the true path.
With enough financial and material resources, one can change their destiny.
As for the Outer Domain Trial Land left by Ancestor, it indeed is an unexpected delight.
But even without that trial land.
Wang Shouzhe has enough confidence that through continuous farming, he can flourish. It might just take a bit longer.
Of course, if there’s a chance to build connections at Purple Mansion Academy, increasing some backing, it’s definitely something worth considering.
"I’ve grown accustomed to being free and unfettered, so being an outer disciple is already satisfying. These core disciple, direct disciple titles are just too much trouble," Wang Shouzhe said indifferently.
Ancestor Xuanfu was instantly speechless, as this boy’s free and unfettered spirit has led Ruolan astray as well.
Others strive desperately to compete for a core disciple spot, fighting tooth and nail for advancement.
If they gain the status of a direct disciple, it’s like soaring into the sky and rising in a single bound.
To him, these core disciple, direct disciple statuses don’t seem to be worth mentioning.
"In addition, there’s one more thing," Ancestor Xuanfu said. "Cousin Longyan also mentioned to me that at least one person from the Wang Family should join Purple Mansion Academy. This way, as she develops and grows within the academy, she can become a great support for the family."
Wang Shouzhe thought for a moment; this is what most noble families are doing or attempting.
Even Celestial Human families send an outstanding member into the academy to develop. If they grow to the academy’s mid-tier and form mutual support with the family internally and externally, it will ensure quick development and perpetual prosperity for the family.
Take Ancestor Xuanfu as an example: after becoming a core disciple in the academy, she’s been secretly supporting the family ever since. Because of this, the Shanyin Liu Family has rapidly improved its overall strength and foundation in just a few decades.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 18: The Longzuo Wang Family and the Purple Mansion Academy_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 18: The Longzuo Wang Family and the Purple Mansion Academy_2
In fact, even if Ancestor Xuanfu hadn’t mentioned it, Wang Shouzhe was already contemplating this matter in secret.
Yet, until now, he still harbored some hesitation in his heart.
After a brief moment of contemplation, Wang Shouzhe said, "Why don’t we call those kids over and ask them what they think?"
Then Wang Shouzhe sent someone to call over Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and Wang Lici, who were among the more outstanding members of the family.
In the meantime, Wang Shouzhe returned the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield to Ancestor Longyan.
When Ancestor Longyan received the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield, her expression was complex and hard to decipher, filled with emotion. Remembering back when Binglan Ascendant gave her this treasure, it was full of hope for her future.
Then the family catastrophe came, and she had to protect the family with her frail body for fifty long years. Eventually, she had to sell the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield.
Recalling all these experiences now still brought a heartache.
However, Shouzhe quietly redeemed it back without a word...
If her mind weren’t so steadfast, tears would have already flowed down by now.
Luckily, before long.
Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and Wang Lici had arrived one after another. Especially Wang Lici, who naturally clung to Ancestor with coyness as usual.
This diluted much of Ancestor Longyan’s melancholy and reflections.
Then, Wang Shouzhe conveyed the ancestors’ intentions to the three of them.
First, Wang Lici expressed her opinion, her eyes wide and her chubby face full of hope as she said, "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, is there good food at the Academy?"
"Of course." Wang Shouzhe said confidently, "The Purple Mansion Academy is the richest institution in our Longzuo County, they have all sorts of delicious food there."
"Then Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, what exactly is so delicious?" Wang Lici’s eyes were shining, and she began to drool.
"Just how delicious, even Fourth Uncle doesn’t know." Wang Shouzhe said with a yearning look, "It’s all because your Fourth Uncle is too inexperienced. There’s many delicious food that Fourth Uncle has never even heard of, nor can he imagine."
"So amazing!!!"
Wang Lici was taken aback.
So the Purple Mansion Academy is so amazing, with so much delicious food, even Fourth Uncle hasn’t heard of it.
That place is wonderful, it’s practically a heaven on earth.
"Fourth Uncle, I’d like to go to the Purple Mansion Academy." Wang Lici said, her eyes shining brightly, "I’m willing to become the family’s, uh, whatever backing."
There’s no need for any backing or whatever.
Wang Shouzhe thought to himself endlessly, just going to the Purple Mansion Academy to study, no, to eat, would be the greatest help to the family.
Sigh~ You eat too much, at this rate, the family really can’t support you.
Thinking like this in his heart, but Wang Shouzhe said, "Lici, then it’s decided happily. You must study well in the Academy in the future, strive forward every day, and bring glory to the family."
"Fourth Uncle, rest assured." Wang Lici said seriously, patting her chest as it echoed loudly, "I’ll definitely study hard in the Academy, and bring honor to the family and Fourth Uncle."
At this moment, Wang Lici was already in a state of eagerness to go to the Academy, immediately wanting to fly over with wings.
Ancestor Xuanfu on the side, however, watched with a bit of shock and apprehension.
This pair of uncle and niece, speaking seriously as if there was no problem.
Yet, she always felt something wasn’t quite right, but couldn’t pinpoint what wasn’t right.
But speaking back again.
This Wang Lici’s bloodline talent is truly powerful, and going to the Purple Mansion Academy, she’s likely to become a direc disciple of some Ascendant.
Truly stepping up to great heights, the future is limitless.
The remaining two girls were still contemplating in secret, not rushing to express their opinions.
Don’t be fooled by Wang Luqiu’s somewhat immature appearance.
But this child has always been very determined in her will, she knows exactly what path she wants to take. To make her go to the Academy, there must be something that attracts her.
As for Wang Luojing, there’s no need to mention.
This child has been meticulous since childhood, with many thoughts. Many times, even Wang Shouzhe doesn’t know what she’s truly thinking.
Only to see Wang Luojing say after a brief moment of contemplation, "Ancestor Xuanfu, you keep saying how good the Academy is. But when our Wang family faced great calamity back then, we didn’t see the Academy offer any help to our family. Neither did we see those schoolmates come to assist."
"Instead, our Ancestor Longyan had to give up her position as a core disciple at the Academy to return to the family to guard."
"If that’s the case, I don’t want to join the Academy. I’m afraid when Fourth Brother faces danger, the Academy won’t let me return."
Wang Luojing said unhurriedly, clearly showing her main concern was her Fourth Brother.
"Child, you might have some misunderstanding about the Academy." Ancestor Xuanfu explained, "Firstly, the Academy certainly doesn’t encourage students to involve themselves in family disputes on a daily basis. After all, the original intention of the Academy’s establishment and the purpose of nurturing students is to focus on the development and protection of the whole human civilization."
"If every student focused all their energy on family disputes, the whole Longzuo County would be in chaos."
"After all, some powerful families have their bloodline people in the Academy. If these members form factions and actively participate in family disputes, the Academy would be hard to maintain. Therefore, the Academy discourages students from participating in family disputes, especially those of others."
"Secondly, the Academy doesn’t forbid students from giving their family some help within their capability. For example, I have brought significant benefits to the Liua Family over the years. If a disciple’s family encounters a crisis or unfair treatment, they can naturally ask a mentor to mediate."
"It’s just that Wang Family’s calamity back then happened too suddenly. And Longyan, eager to take revenge, returned hurriedly without discussing the matter carefully with her mentor, leading to her going back alone. She also got seriously injured and never returned to the Academy to report."
At this time, Ancestor Longyan said lightly, "What’s the point of discussing back then, could there be room for negotiation?"
Indeed, there was no room for mediation back then.
It was certainly a situation of life and death.
And what the opposition did was so secretive and thorough, that it was hard to investigate even afterward.
"Speaking of which." Wang Shouzhe also contemplated and said, "This matter is very suspicious, according to my longstanding deductions and investigations, it’s highly likely that there is a secret instigator behind the Liu and Zhao Clans. And the biggest suspects are those two Celestial Human Families of Changning Guard."
"Except, there’s one thing I never understood. Why did those Celestial Human Families not annihilate us completely in the end? Why didn’t they continue to strike against us?"
According to Wang Shouzhe’s methods, since deciding to do a bad deed, one wouldn’t just do half and leave it there.
"I happen to know a thing or two about this matter." Ancestor Longyan said, "Back then, after our family suffered a great disaster, Ancestor Zhoubo also traveled south. I estimate that his efforts and support made the hidden instigator harbor some apprehension. And our family was already in decline, so they didn’t continue to pursue us but let the Liu and Zhao Clans slowly squeeze us."
Ancestor Zhoubo?
Wang Shouzhe had indeed heard of him, he was Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s clan brother, from the direct lineage of Longzuo Wang Family. It was said that Ancestor Zhoubo is now in the Celestial Human Realm.
But he hadn’t expected that there was such a hidden story behind the events of the past?
The connection between Longzuo Wang Family and Ping’an Wang Family now is very weak, often going years without communication.
It was only in recent years, when life got a little easier, that Ancestor Longyan mentioned it to Wang Shouzhe, saying that Ping’an Wang Family actually owed a considerable debt to Longzuo Wang Family back then.
During the most difficult times for the family, every year before the New Year, the family would receive some resources sent by Longzuo Wang Family.
There was spirit rice, minor primordial cultivation pills, spiritual flesh, and more. Although the quantities weren’t large, together they were worth a few hundred Qian Gold.
Yet it was indeed a help in times of need, and it continued for more than twenty years.
"Back then Longzuo Wang Family’s situation was also difficult." Ancestor Longyan said, "They were then at the celestial human transition period, resources were scarce, and the family couldn’t afford to cultivate a second celestial human realm person, otherwise Ancestor Zhou Xuan wouldn’t have split off to develop on his own."
Those resources were something Ancestor Zhoubo worked to spare.
"Something doesn’t seem right." Wang Shouzhe frowned and said, "I remember Ancestor Zhoubo was only in the Late Spirit Platform Realm back then. And Longzuo Wang Family itself was in decline, they might not even complete the celestial human transition, the hidden instigator likely wouldn’t give this kind of face."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 19: Unmatched Talent! The True Power of Shouzhe’s Triple Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 19: Unmatched Talent! The True Power of Shouzhe’s Triple Bloodline
...
Ancestor Longyan was slightly taken aback, thinking that Wang Shouzhe’s words made quite a bit of sense.
However, wasn’t it precisely because Ancestor Zhoubo was running around for the Changning Guard in those years that the Wang Family was spared from a devastating blow? How does one explain that?
Truly, it’s something one can’t figure out.
After pondering, Ancestor Longyan said: "Our Ping’an Wang Family has been under the care of the Longzuo Wang Family since the time of the branch-off. After all, so many cultivation techniques of the family were brought out by the Longzuo Wang Family, which is already a favor."
