"And subsequently, when our Ping’an Wang Family fell into hardship, the Longzuo Wang Family also stepped up to express their stance and squeezed out some resources for us."
"Shouzhe, when you go to the Academy this time, you have to pass through the Commandery anyway. Just take this opportunity to visit Ancestor Zhoubo for me, firstly to thank him for his years of favor, and secondly to inquire about what happened back then."
"Ancestor wants me to do this; naturally, there’s no problem." Wang Shouzhe thought for a moment, then cupped his hands and said, "However, it would be best if Ancestor goes with me for the academy visit next year. Binglan Ascendant has shown favor to Ancestor; regardless of whether Ancestor wants to re-enter the sect, this matter ultimately needs to be resolved, and it has to be you personally who shows up."
"This?" Ancestor Longyan was slightly embarrassed.
It’s been sixty years; this issue has always been a hurdle in her heart. She has never dared to face it directly and has a bit of an avoidance mentality.
But Shouzhe’s words were right.
No matter what, she must personally show up to settle it, even if it means facing reprimand from Master, which might, in turn, bring her inner relief.
After thinking it over carefully, Ancestor Longyan finally decided: "Okay, I will go with Shouzhe to the Academy, to see Master and ask for her punishment."
Seeing Ancestor Longyan agree, Wang Shouzhe finally breathed a sigh of relief.
It was evident that Binglan Ascendant was quite a person who cherished old relationships. If Ancestor Longyan did not go, trying to curry favor would undoubtedly be an absurd dream.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe deeply suspected.
With the strength of the Longzuo Wang Family at that time, who even struggled with celestial human transition, it would be hardly sufficient to settle this matter.
Maybe Binglan Ascendant was secretly manipulating from behind?
This is not an impossible scenario.
After all, Ancestor Xuanfu had said so. For decades, Binglan Ascendant repeatedly mentioned Ancestor Longyan. Such attentiveness would not have been consistent with completely ignoring the situation then.
Of course, speculating wildly here is pointless; everything will be clear when they go to Longzuo County and Purple Mansion Academy next year.
After agreeing on this matter, Wang Shouzhe turned to Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing, the two young girls, and asked: "Have you two thought it over?"
Wang Luqiu considered for a moment and said: "Since Ancestor Xuanfu has already mentioned that the Academy will not prohibit disciples from interacting with family, it’s just not allowing disciples to stay at home for long periods. If that’s the case, I have no worries."
"Anyway, I never thought about inheriting the Wang Race, so let Fourth Brother continue leading the family; he manages it quite well."
Perhaps Wang Luqiu was a bit rebellious, but her feelings for the family were very deep. She had aspirations, but she didn’t want to completely break away from the family.
But that latter half of the sentence made Wang Shouzhe break a sweat, as if to say, as if you wanted to inherit the family you have a share, thank you for letting me continue to be the head, and also thank you for saying I’m managing it well.
"Besides, as long as the Academy can let me see a broader world, step onto a bigger stage, I am willing to try. The best would be opportunities to fight every day." Wang Luqiu’s eyes sparkled with excitement and longing.
It was evident that Wang Luqiu was still very curious about Purple Mansion Academy. After all, Purple Mansion Academy’s reputation was too great, and everyone considered entering the Academy a great honor.
But Wang Luojing said, "Fourth Brother, since we’re going to the Academy next spring anyway. At that time, I’ll go and take a look. If it seems promising and the conditions can be negotiated, I wouldn’t mind trying it."
This little girl indeed had big ideas. She hadn’t even entered the Academy yet and wanted to negotiate terms with them.
However, Wang Shouzhe, on the contrary, approved of her approach, thoughtful and deliberate, planning before acting, rather than acting on impulse and preference.
As soon as Wang Luojing finished her statement, Wang Luqiu was immediately displeased. She said, "Then I’ll also take a look next year and evaluate it."
This statement made Ancestor Xuanfu amused and exasperated.
The moves of these Wang Family people, truly, one was more presumptuous than the other.
What kind of place is the Purple Mansion Academy?
It’s the academy where countless young geniuses in Longzuo County are desperate to get into.
Many families go to great lengths to send their children to Purple Mansion Academy. Some powerful families even go as far as using connections and backdoors to get their children in.
Yet here they are.
EITHER THEY COMPLAIN ABOUT BEING TOO TIRED, OR THEY PLAN TO ONLY GO IF THERE’S FOOD, OR THEY SIMPLY WANT TO ASSESS THE ACADEMY AND NEGOTIATE TERMS.
From top to bottom.
It’s probably all thanks to that rascal Wang Shouzhe’s influence.
But there is no choice.
Who let the Wang Family be so impressive now? Every child has extraordinary bloodlines, each one has the demeanor of a direct disciple, a Purple Mansion Seed.
Even if they truly negotiate terms with the Academy, it’s not impossible to do.
Oh well, oh well, let’s just take them to have a look first. Whether it works out in the end isn’t up to her, Liua Xuanfu, to decide.
Things were settled.
Everyone was preparing to leave, and Wang Shouzhe casually tried probing Ancestor Longyan: "Ancestor, Zhong Xingwang, Brother Zhong is here. Would the Ancestor be inclined to meet him?"
Indeed, Ancestor Longyan raised an eyebrow and coldly said, "Let him come if he’s coming; what does it have to do with me? Every year during the New Year, doesn’t he come to our house to mooch a meal? And he never pays for it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 19: Unmatched Talent! The True Power of Shouzhe’s Triple Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 19: Unmatched Talent! The True Power of Shouzhe’s Triple Bloodline
It is clear that our family ancestor still looks down on him.
If not for the old sentiments, Ancestor Longyan would have already taken action to drive him away. The ancestor is very protective of the family’s food and despises those freeloaders.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe no longer spoke much and led three juniors to retreat first.
The trip to Purple Mansion Academy, planned initially for after the New Year, wouldn’t need urgent arrangements now.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe certainly needs to go to the Purple Mansion Academy, not just for the continuation of the "Eternal Spring True Technique" regarding the Spirit Platform Chapter cultivation technique.
The cultivation techniques of the Spirit Platform Chapter are not urgent since just entering the Spirit Platform Realm focuses on stabilizing the realm. There is no rush to advance to the second or third layer.
The main aim is to find a map in Purple Mansion Academy.
Because within the Trial Land, the Shouzhe couple passed through the fourth stage and was instructed by the Artifact Spirit to go to the Divine Martial Dynasty’s Divine Martial Army Headquarters as soon as possible to report for intensive training.
Where is this Divine Martial Army Headquarters?
The couple naturally looked puzzled.
The Artifact Spirit did provide a map, but it was a map from ten thousand years ago.
A map from ten thousand years ago!
Enough for the vast sea to change to mulberry fields, mountains to collapse and rise, river courses to change, and terrain to shift unpredictably.
Finding the location of the Divine Martial Army Headquarters from this map is like finding a needle in a haystack.
Thus, they can only pin their hopes on Purple Mansion Academy since, according to Ancestor Xuanfu, the academy has extensively researched the Divine Martial Dynasty and often excavates its relics.
Perhaps they might have information or the location of the Divine Martial Army Headquarters.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe focused most of his attention on exploring his bloodline talent.
Now is the maturation period for Red Crystal Spirit Rice.
Already late October, the outside is rather cold, so Wang Shouzhe had someone build a small wooden cabin in the Fire Spiritual Vein cave and settled there.
It didn’t take long before the single Liua Ruolan, struggling alone, followed over.
The couple spent rare and peaceful days here, having almost forgotten about the two children, far into the clouds.
Red Crystal Spirit Rice matures once a year.
In this Middle-Grade Fire Spiritual Vein, the family has gradually developed 20 acres of Middle-Grade Fire Element Spirit Field over the years.
After several years of exploration and learning, the family has gradually mastered the essence of cultivating Red Crystal Spirit Rice.
Now, after meticulous cultivation, the yield per acre has reached 300 jin, with a total yield of 6,000 jin. Given the average price of Red Crystal Spirit Rice at 80 Large Copper per jin, that’s 4,800 Qian Gold.
According to Daqian Law, each acre of Middle-Grade Spirit Field requires 20 Qian Gold annually, amounting to only 400 Qian Gold in taxes.
Even after deducting costs like Spirit Seed, Spiritual Fertilizer, labor, and Array Spirit Stone depreciation, the pure profit for the year far surpasses 3,000 Qian Gold.
Don’t be fooled by Wang Shouzhe’s tendency to spend large amounts, often in the tens of thousands, even though investing such sums builds up the family’s foundation and strength.
Glass, cement, paper, they seem to bring considerable profits to the family each year. But these items could one day be copied by other families, potentially cutting off this layer of profit.
However, why are Spirit Vein and Spirit Field considered the true pillars and foundation of the family? Because no matter when, the Spirit Rice produced always holds value, and Red Crystal Spirit Rice, for instance, is often more in demand than supplied, never worrying about sales.
Over 3,000 Qian Gold annually, over a century, that’s more than 300,000, and over a thousand years, it’s over 3 million.
Some families of slightly greater strength often exist for several hundred years, and in Longzuo County, there are even millennial noble families.
What kind of frightening accumulation occurs year after year, century after century?
Therefore, Wang Shouzhe’s development of various secondary industries naturally contributes to explosive family growth. But ultimately, secondary industries must support the main industry, propelling it forward.
Only such foundational pillars ensure a family’s enduring prosperity.
Moreover, this portion of Middle-Grade Fire Spiritual Vein still holds much potential for development, eventually potentially developing 30 acres of Middle-Grade Fire Element Spirit Field, promising even more lucrative future returns.
But this is merely the foundation of a moderately strong ordinary family, and for Wang Shouzhe, it is not enough.
Many powerful families have long been improving their Spirit Seeds, producing higher yield and better quality Spirit Rice. Even if additional annual income per acre increases by 50 Qian Gold, 30 acres alone boosts income by 1,500 Qian Gold yearly.
Over long years, this becomes a significant figure.
But these powerful families do not improve Spirit Seeds overnight. It results from decades, centuries, or even several centuries of gradual improvement.
They do not sell these improved Spirit Seeds, keeping them highly secret, fearing leaks.
They typically shell the sold Spirit Rice or further process it to ensure it cannot be cultivated after acquisition.
Wang Shouzhe, in the last eight years, has devoted much of his attention to common rice and wheat seeds. Today, Wang’s peripheral farms no longer plant ordinary grains; instead, they use high-quality Wang’s No. 9 rice seed and Wang’s No. 7 wheat seed.
Wang’s No. 9 and No. 7 grain seeds cannot be regenerated, but they vastly outperform ordinary grain seeds in yield and disease resistance.
Thus, farmers, even purchasing at a premium, reap final returns two or three times higher than usual.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 19: Unmatched Talent! The True Power of Shouzhe’s Triple Bloodline_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 19: Unmatched Talent! The True Power of Shouzhe’s Triple Bloodline_3
This has already made people flock to it incessantly.
And in the Wang Family’s most core farm, what’s secretly planted now is—the mysterious No. 19 wheat seed, No. 23 rice seed.
These two types of grain seeds can increase the per acre yield for the planter by more than fifty percent in the end.
Such high-quality grain seeds.
Made Wang Shouzhe not dare to sell them in Changning Guard.
Instead, he deeply cooperated with Qiaan Xue’an, the shopkeeper of Qiaan’s Trading Company, and through Qiaan’s Trading Company’s secret channels, transported them to distant and remote cities for sale.
Now, a wave of enthusiasm has already erupted in a few remote cities over there, with grain seed prices soaring step by step.
Therefore, how much money can selling grain crops make?
The most profitable, of course, is selling seeds.
Relying on those core farms secretly producing grain seeds, Wang Shouzhe truly earned a fortune.
And Qiaan Xue’an, the shopkeeper of Qiaan’s Trading Company, not only firmly held the position of shopkeeper in Changning Guard due to the secret cooperation with Wang Shouzhe. Within the family, his status also rose steadily, gaining the ancestor’s attention, becoming one of the family’s core members, and acquiring the sequence qualification for the Path of Celestial Human.
Therefore.
Don’t look at those foreign glass, foreign cement, and paper, as if they earn a lot, but in reality, what makes the Wang Family the most money now is secretly selling grain seeds.
How profitable it is to sell the grains produced in the farmland as grain seeds?
For the above reasons.
Wang Shouzhe set his sights on the Red Crystal Spirit Rice, whether it’s 20 acres or 30 acres of Middle-Grade Spirit Field. Just selling grain, how much money can you make in a year at most?
But if high-yield varieties of Red Crystal Spirit Rice are developed, pure profits can be multiplied by several times. Over 20,000 Qian Gold in pure profit in a year would be a small matter.
Only when it reaches that point will these Middle-Grade Fire Element Spirit Fields truly become one of the Wang Family’s pillars.
This time harvesting Red Crystal Spirit Rice, it was not done casually.
Instead, Wang Shouzhe first ordered people to repeatedly search the twenty acres of Spirit Field, collecting the Red Crystal Spirit Grain that had the strongest plants, the largest ears, and the plumpest grains.
In the end, he selected over a hundred grains of Red Crystal Spirit Grain.
It was through these over a hundred grains of Red Crystal Spirit Grain that Wang Shouzhe began his miraculous journey.
In the deserted Spirit Field.
He planted these Red Crystal Spirit Grains one after another, then exerted his bloodline talent, injecting rich Cyan Profound Qi into the earth and the spirit seeds.
A miraculous thing happened.
The spirit seeds took root and germinated in a very short time, and eventually matured. It took just one day. However, at the same time, his profound qi was exhausted two or three times, and he had to recover it through meditation and Qi Refining.
It truly succeeded.
Wang Shouzhe was overjoyed, the Third Layer Bloodline Awakening had already increased his bloodline concentration by a large margin. Previously difficult-to-activate annual spirit seeds were now easily controlled.
Using his previous experience in improving ordinary grain seeds, Wang Shouzhe quickly catalyzed generation after generation of Red Crystal Spirit Grain, conducting various experiments on them.
Finally, in a certain generation, he successfully created a spirit seed that could not be reproduced a second time after special treatment.
This is the basis for selling grain seeds.
If it’s the kind of seed that can easily be reproduced a second time, no matter how well you cultivate it, if you dare to sell it, it will be imitated in no time.
This is also why those powerful noble families treat their spirit seeds as the lifeblood and protect them.
"Congratulations, husband, for adding another powerful foundation to the family," Liua Ruolan, who had been accompanying Wang Shouzhe, was also happy for him after witnessing his success.
"Hehe~ It’s all thanks to your good fortune," Wang Shouzhe was also very pleased.
To his surprise, the effect of his Third Layer Bloodline was so powerful. It was much stronger than the First-Tier Talent.
In a sense, this is truly an invincible talent. If he only used it to stimulate spirit rice for sale, it would probably wear him out before making much money, but for catalyzing and improving spirit seeds, this talent is second to none.
In addition to Red Crystal Spirit Rice, the family also has White Jade Spirit Rice. It can also be improved and transformed into mass-produced spirit seeds.
Just these two items alone can lead to extremely terrifying annual yields.
Indeed, farming is the true path to dominance.
"Indeed, husband, your bloodline talent is excellent, and it truly makes money," Liua Ruolan sighed with emotion, "Unlike my Primordial Water Bloodline Talent, which isn’t very useful at all."
"Not necessarily," Wang Shouzhe said with a mysterious smile, "The Primordial Water Triple Top Bloodline is almost a Primordial Water Spirit Body, much more useful than you imagine."
"Ah, this!?" Liua Ruolan’s pretty face turned crimson, and she glared at him fiercely.
This husband is great in every way. It’s just that when he occasionally acts like a rascal, it’s really overwhelming for her.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 20: Prosperous! The Rise and Transformation of the Wang Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 20: Prosperous! The Rise and Transformation of the Wang Family
...
Time flew by quickly.
In the blink of an eye, the year had passed.
Early spring.
The small river had thawed, and the tender grass in the fields had begun to peep out slightly.
During the time before the year ended, Wang Shouzhe was busy inside and out, hardly getting a break. Mainly, he took the opportunity to fully utilize his Triple Bloodline Talent.
Red Crystal Spirit Rice, White Jade Spirit Rice.
Both types of spirit rice had entered large-scale production of spirit seeds, thus adding two pillar industries to the Wang Family.
Especially the White Jade Spirit Rice, which can be planted on lower-grade spirit fields, making it the most widely grown spirit rice in the entire Daqian Kingdom.
Many of the Eighth and Ninth-Grade Noble Families own a more or less number of lower-grade spirit fields, and most of these fields are planted with White Jade Spirit Rice.
The White Jade Spirit Rice has a high yield, is easy to maintain, and the planting threshold is relatively low. It is the primary spirit plant choice for the vast majority of lower-grade spirit fields.
Because of this, if the yield of White Jade Spirit Rice can be increased by two to three tenths, the seeds would sell very well, and many families would rush to buy them.
After all, with limited spirit field space at home, who wouldn’t want to increase spirit rice revenue if they could?
However, due to limited time, the Red Crystal Spirit Rice No. 6 and White Jade Spirit Rice No. 5 cultivated by Wang Shouzhe could only increase yields by about three-tenths.
Even so, it was enough to transform the family’s spirit fields from producing spirit rice just for eating into producing spirit seeds.
Don’t underestimate the White Jade Spirit Rice even if it’s relatively cheap, only worth 20 Large Copper per pound, but given the vast number of lower-grade spirit fields owned by the Wang Family, just the Xinsheng Farm alone has 60 acres of lower-grade spirit fields.
Additionally, from the farms merged from the Liu and Zhao Clans, the original 100 acres of spirit fields had been developed to 150 acres.
Therefore, the Wang Family currently owns a total of 210 acres of lower-grade spirit fields.
Planting all with the high-yield White Jade Spirit Rice No. 5 seeds, the annual output reaches nearly 100,000 pounds!!
These 100,000 pounds of White Jade Spirit Rice, even if sold as food, represent a huge income. If sold as spirit seeds, the revenue would at least double or triple.
Thinking of this, Wang Shouzhe felt a secret delight in his heart.
There is nothing more enjoyable than farming.
And nothing more profitable than farming.
Of course, the various secondary products are also yielding good returns currently, especially since they haven’t been imitated by others yet, their benefits shouldn’t be underestimated.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe had left many tricks up his sleeve; what is being sold now might not necessarily be the latest version.
Once someone tries to imitate, he naturally has ways to deal with it.
On this day, a person was sent from the R&D center he had long established to report that another important project—[Mirror]—which Wang Shouzhe greatly valued, seemed to have shown results.
With that news, Wang Shouzhe rushed to the R&D center without delay.
...
At the same time, at Changning Guandu.
It was the only official passage between Changning Guard and Ping’an Town.
If you want to enter or leave Ping’an Town, under normal circumstances you can only take the ferry between Changning Ferry and Dingpu Ferry.
Otherwise, any other means of entry would be considered illegal immigration, and the Ping’an Wang Family certainly doesn’t tolerate such acts.
At noon.
A carriage slowly turned off the main road and entered the Changning Guandu ferry terminal.
The carriage’s cabin was designed in a simple and heavy style, with the symbol of a certain noble family subtly carved into unobtrusive areas, low-key yet not lacking in luxury.
The horses pulling the carriage were surprisingly two pure black strong horses, clearly not ordinary breeds.
Just these two horses were worth over a hundred Qian Gold, and their feed had to be high-quality, costlier than supporting seven or eight people.
It was very apparent, the passengers inside this carriage were either rich or noble, likely dignitaries from a Black Tortoise Clan.
Some traveling merchants and passers-by, upon seeing the carriage, quickly stepped aside.
This is the way ordinary people survive in this world.
The carriage entered the ferry terminal.
From the carriage stepped down an elderly and a younger individual.
The elderly man appeared to be in his sixties or seventies, yet he looked vigorous and spirited. His clothes weren’t luxurious, but exuded an exceptional elegance, brimming with self-confidence.
The young man, roughly in his twenties.
Wearing a Black Tortoise Martial Attire with white floral patterns on the base and black and gold edges, his head adorned with a Jade Crown, and a Treasure Sword at his waist, he appeared as a spirited and imposing young gentleman.
The young man’s eyes scanned the facilities within Changning Guandu and frowned slightly, "Third Grandpa, I didn’t expect this Changning Guard to be so poor! Even the ferry terminal is shabby. Some buildings look like they haven’t been repaired in decades?"
"Shouyue, how many times have I told you? This isn’t like home; you must be careful with your words when out and about," the old man frowned slightly, criticizing in a low voice, "Sometimes, one ill-considered word can invite disaster, leading to regret."
"Third Grandpa, aren’t you being overly cautious?" the young man called Shouyue said indifferently, "In this Changning Guard, only the Huangfu and Lei Families are worth our attention. Other Black Tortoise Clans, at most Eighth Grade, offending them is no big deal."
As he spoke, the young man carried himself with pride and looked around arrogantly.
The old man’s face turned stern, "Wang Shouyue, this time we’re out to handle important matters, also to broaden your horizons and gain some experience. If you can’t control yourself, then return. How many times must I tell you, never to underestimate any local power?"
Wang Shouyue hurriedly put on a sheepish grin, "Third Grandpa, I was wrong." After apologizing, he quickly changed the subject, "Third Grandpa, since we’re going to the East Sea Guard for business, why not head directly there? Why detour to this countryside to visit some relatives?"

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 20: Prosperous! The Rise and Transformation of the Wang Family_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 20: Prosperous! The Rise and Transformation of the Wang Family_2
The elder wore a serious expression and said, "This is all by the decree of Ancestor Zhoubo. If you have any dissatisfaction, you can tell him yourself when you return."
"Since it’s Ancestor Zhoubo’s wish, how dare I speak to his esteemed self," Wang Shouyue hurriedly retracted his words, but couldn’t help being curious, "I’ve never heard that in Ping’an Town of Changning Guard, we still have relatives of the Wang Family? Does Third Grandpa know the inside story?"
"Shouyue, you’re still young, so it’s understandable that you don’t know. The relationship between the Ping’an Wang Family and us has been rather distant for about twenty or thirty years," the elder’s thoughts drifted far away as he spoke, "The founder of the Ping’an Wang Family was named Wang Zhouxuan. Our generation refers to him as Ancestor Zhouxuan. He was the clan brother of Ancestor Zhoubo, and back in our Longzuo Wang Family, he was also a talented and outstanding young hero."
"At that time, our Longzuo Wang Family was in a difficult situation and could only afford to nurture one person to the Celestial Human Realm," the elder spoke with some admiration, "So Ancestor Zhouxuan headed south to expand, establishing the branch of the Ping’an Wang Family. His esteemed self was truly a prodigious talent and a hero. It’s just a pity..."
"In recent years, during the New Year, the two families have resumed correspondence. Therefore, Ancestor Zhoubo instructed me to visit the Ping’an Wang Family while I was out on business."
"Ancestor Zhoubo truly cherishes old ties," Wang Shouyue said curiously, "I noticed, Third Grandpa brought a lot of things, many of which are for the Ping’an Wang Family, right?"
"Just some Spirit Rice, Spiritual Flesh, Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills, and other basic cultivation resources," the elder replied, "The most expensive is a Creation Pill, which is said to be specially for healing his great-niece Wang Longyan by Ancestor Zhoubo. Speaking of the Longyan Ancestor of Ping’an Wang Family, she was also an exceptionally talented individual."
"When I was young, Ancestor Longyan was already a Core Disciple of the Purple Mansion Academy. I heard that when she first entered the academy, she often visited our Longzuo Wang Family, sometimes staying for a while, and even Ancestor Zhoubo was very fond of her," the elder said with a regretful face, "It’s really a pity, later the Ping’an Wang Family encountered trouble... alas..."
Speaking of the past, the elder was also filled with sighs and endless emotions, saying that if it weren’t for the accident in those years, the Ping’an Wang Family might be a dominant force in Changning nowadays.
"No matter what, they’re just a fallen small family now," Wang Shouyue said indifferently, "Ancestor Zhoubo is also generous, this time the resources sent must be worth two thousand Qian Gold, right? Fortunately, our Longzuo Wang Family has made a lot of money these past two years, otherwise, we couldn’t afford to send them."
"We are all part of the Wang Family line, supporting each other is as it should be," the elder said, "Back in the day when our Longzuo Wang Family was struggling, Ancestor Zhouxuan earned quite a bit when expanding in Ping’an Town and also tried to supplement Ancestor Zhoubo’s resources for advancing to the Celestial Human Realm. I think Ancestor Zhoubo wants to support if he can support. After all, the Ping’an Wang Family is not having an easy time now."
"This ferry is too slow?" Wang Shouyue started to lose patience, glancing at the river with no sight of the ferry, and complained slightly, "We need to quickly fulfill Ancestor Zhoubo’s wish and then hurry to the East Sea Guard. I am eager to connect with the rumored Young Master Chen and Young Master Tantai of the Donghai United Trading Company."
"You are too impatient," the elder shook his head repeatedly but his eyes also sparkled slightly when talking about Young Master Chen and Young Master Tantai, speaking in praise, "Two years ago in Chuyun Guard, we managed through connections to get a batch of foreign cement, foreign glass, and foreign paper procurement rights from Young Master Tantai. Then, after opening the trade route and painstakingly transporting them back to Longzuo County, we’ve made quite a bit of money over these two years."
"The intention of the ancestors is to possibly establish a deeper connection with Young Master Tantai," the elder contemplated, "Moreover, I also learned through connections that Young Master Chen seems even more extraordinary. I have inquired that the main shareholder of the Donghai United Trading Company turns out to be a family called the East Port Chen Family, they control the outer sea merchant ships and trade routes, and in the firm, Young Master Chen is the real primary leader."
"Being so heavily relied upon by the family at such a young age must be extraordinary," Wang Shouyue’s face became serious, "I heard Third Grandpa mention before that Young Master Chen seems to be only thirty years old and is already at the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm. Compared to me, a Celestial Human lineage member, he is only slightly inferior, definitely worth making a good acquaintance."
"The East Port Chen Family has three Spirit Platforms, and the most powerful ancestor is said to have hopes of reaching the Celestial Human Realm, with limitless future development. Do not underestimate that Young Master Chen."
"Naturally, I won’t," Wang Shouyue said confidently, "The family sent me alongside Third Grandpa to showcase our Longzuo Wang Family’s strength and foundation, also intending to establish mutual relationships, hoping to secure more foreign goods quota in the future. I, Wang Shouyue, absolutely won’t ruin the family’s grand plan."
The elder was satisfied with this, nodding, mentioning that the family also holds Wang Shouyue in high regard.
Ancestor Zhoubo spared no resources to improve his talent from lower grade A to middle grade D, and even before reaching the Spirit Platform Realm, he had awakened a first-tier bloodline.
He is being groomed as a successor for a celestial transition.
"Shouyue, this is a good point of yours, you usually train diligently," the elder complimented, "It’s a pity that you have to guard the family in the future, otherwise you might have a chance to strive for a core disciple spot in the academy."
Generally, family heirs go to the academy only as outer sect disciples. Once becoming a core disciple, it becomes difficult to return and assume the family leadership.
While they were chatting, the ferry arrived.
And by then, the Changning Ferry had already become crowded with traveling merchants and carts, bustling up and down the ferry.
This surprised the two from Longzuo Wang Family a little. Why were so many traveling merchants, loose cultivators, and ordinary people needing to take the ferry? Is there a big festival to celebrate in Ping’an Town?
However, this was clearly unrelated to them; they were just there to visit relatives, deliver some resources, and present Ancestor Zhoubo’s regards.
After that, they would hurry to East Sea Guard to meet Young Master Tantai and Young Master Chen.
Amidst the bustling ferry crowding, the two from Longzuo Wang Family and their cart finally boarded the ferry, and they all settled down.
With the calls of the crew.
The ferry slowly departed from the shore, soon more than two meters from the bank.
Suddenly.
A young man in blue sprinted towards the quay of Changning Guandu, calling out loudly in a clear voice, "Ferry, wait for me."
The ferry suddenly became noisy.
"Huh, isn’t that the Seventh Young Master?" "It’s truly the Seventh Young Master, boatman, boatman, hurry and stop the boat."
"Seventh Young Master? Could it be the rumored Seventh Young Master."
"Nonsense, in this area, who else could be called the Seventh Young Master besides him?"
The boatman hurriedly shouted, "Crew, crew, stop the boat quickly, wait a moment for the Seventh Young Master."
There was a sudden hustle on the ferry, and the crew promptly turned the bow.
But the ferry had already left the bank, and it still swayed outward for a while before soon being seven or eight zhang from the shore.
Wang Shouyue frowned upon witnessing this. What a grand air of this so-called Seventh Young Master.
Isn’t this delaying his schedule?
Suddenly.
Seeing the young man in the blue outfit reach the quay and lightly tap the ground with his foot, he floated in the air like a willow catkin, drifting eight or nine zhang before landing steadily on the ferry.
Once on the ferry, he gracefully cupped his hands and apologized, "Ladies and gentlemen, sorry, sorry, it was I, Wang Shouye, who delayed the time."
"Willow Catkin Body Technique? Wang Shouye?" Wang Shouyue’s heart trembled, wasn’t this the middle-grade technique of the Longzuo Wang Family, the Willow Catkin Body Technique?
Right, besides the Longzuo Wang Family, the Ping’an Wang Family also has the Willow Catkin Body Technique.
This young man in blue named Wang Shouye truly had superb body technique.
Judging by his youthful appearance, seemingly only eighteen or nineteen, having such proficiency in the Willow Catkin Body Technique. Moreover, his cultivation appeared to be on the verge of reaching the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Such a heroic and extraordinary young man as Wang Shouye indeed looked like a Spirit Platform Seed.
Is he perhaps the direct lineage successor meticulously cultivated by the Ping’an Wang Family?
The elder and Wang Shouyue exchanged glances, both secretly guessing to themselves.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 21 Shocking! Direct Lineage Successors Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 21 Shocking! Direct Lineage Successors Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
...
"My apologies, everyone." Wang Shouye continued to greet the traveling merchants and loose cultivators. He looked cheerful, his smile sincere, saying, "It’s all because of my oversight, delaying everyone’s journey. Please forgive me."
"Seventh Young Master, no need to be so courteous."
"Indeed, indeed, these are just small matters."
"We aren’t in a hurry, there’s nothing much being delayed. It’s the Seventh Young Master’s journey that is important."
Everyone chimed in one after another, all laughingly flattering the Seventh Young Master. Clearly, this Seventh Young Master holds a high status in their eyes.
Yet, Wang Shouye continued to circle around, greeting everyone as much as possible.
Eventually, his gaze fell upon the elder and Wang Shouyue. It was evident he recognized their extraordinary nature, his eyes barely flickered, yet he said nothing more, only smiling as he cupped his hands in salute, "Sorry for keeping you waiting."
He had an extraordinary presence, with a gentle elegance like a noble gentleman, making others feel as if they were bathed in spring wind, increasing their fondness towards him.
Nowadays, the Wang Family is powerful, and having people come to visit is quite normal, Wang Shouye thought to himself.
"No problem, no problem," the elder said with a smile, "The Seventh Young Master’s body technique is quite impressive, full of ease and skill."
"You flatter me, you flatter me," Wang Shouye said honestly, "My body technique is nothing special, compared to my siblings at home, it is indeed lacking."
Although he spoke the truth.
However, the elder and Wang Shouyue’s outward expressions barely changed, but internally they were somewhat skeptical.
Being so young yet having such mastery in body technique, with high cultivation—if not a Spirit Platform Seed of the family, then what is?
Could it be that the fallen Ping’an Wang Family could still muster resources to nurture two Spirit Platform successors?
Thus, they assumed he was just being modest.
Meanwhile.
Those familiar with the Wang Family, the traveling merchants and loose guests and cultivators, began to speak among those unfamiliar about the Wang Family’s Seventh Young Master.
Since childhood, Seventh Young Master Wang Shouye had been learning the art of alchemy at the Xu Family’s Pill Workshop in Changning Guard.
At a young age, he had already become a Tier One Alchemist.
Moreover, the Seventh Young Master was handsome, amiable, and refined, with many remarkable qualities.
This made him quite popular among the younger generation in Changning Guard.
Many noble young ladies had their eyes on him, frequently visiting the Xu Family’s Pill Workshop. They would either pretend to buy medicine or seek medical advice, sometimes even bringing lots of alchemy materials and specifically requesting the Seventh Young Master to help with alchemy, stating there was no need to compensate even if the task was botched.
This indeed gave the person in charge of the Pill Workshop quite a headache, as business overall improved while other employed alchemists began complaining.
Why did everyone seek Wang Shouye for alchemy?
How could Wang Shouye’s modest skills compare to their seasoned expertise?
Could it be that looking handsome and having a good family background made even the elixirs fragrant?
Wang Shouye managed to become a Tier One Alchemist at such a young age because his family was too wealthy, extravagantly allowing him to consume materials, with losses aplenty not being a concern.
This level was completely built upon resources.
As a result of such "rumors" appearing, those few alchemists were ambushed in a dark alley by a group of noble young ladies, who caught them in sacks and beat them up mercilessly.
There were plenty more such strange anecdotes.
Clearly, this Seventh Young Master Wang Shouye had quite the reputation in Changning Guard.
With that being said.
The elder and Wang Shouyue exchanged glances, both somewhat puzzled.
Could it be that the Ping’an Wang Family had fallen so far, allowing the direct lineage successor to go learn alchemy at another’s Pill Workshop?
Generally speaking.
Succession candidates in a family rarely specialize in a craft; they have too many things to learn.
They still need to work hard in cultivation, striving to reach the Spirit Platform Realm as soon as possible. Specializing in secondary trades would delay their cultivation.
Forget it, forget it, no need to ponder much, Ping’an Wang Family surely has its own plans.
The two did not hurry to come forward to connect with Wang Shouye.
Though somewhat astonished by his prowess, they found it quite normal.
After all, no matter how fallen, the Wang Family could grit their teeth and nurture a successor of such calibre.
Especially Wang Shouyue, who is only two to three years older than Wang Shouye, and is currently at the peak of the seventh layer in the Qi Refining Realm. He felt confident that he could sprint toward the Spirit Platform Realm by the time he turns thirty.
With a slightly arrogant mindset, compared to Wang Shouye, the direct lineage successor of Ping’an Wang Family, Wang Shouye seemed rather "unremarkable."
Just then.
A cargo ship was slowly docking, loaded with smoked fish, salted fish, and other goods. The ship brimming with fish was evidently of great value.
The leader of the ship was a lean young man of around twenty-five or twenty-six, and upon seeing Wang Shouye, he exclaimed joyfully, "Young Master, you’ve returned to Ping’an? Not coming back even during the big annual festival. Master Hai would be very pleased to know you’ve returned."
"Ah, it’s Brother Doggy," Wang Shouye called from afar, "How is my father’s health lately? It’s been a while since I’ve seen him." Wang Goudan was from the Wang Family branch, having followed his father since childhood.
"Master Hai is lively," Wang Goudan said with laughter, "Recently eyeing a Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast that invaded our family’s waters, he said he wants to catch it for Young Master to nourish the body."
Wang Shouye couldn’t help but smile: "Father loves fishing the most; he probably cannot give up this hobby." Nowadays, his father, Wang Dinghai, is already in charge of all the fishing fleets and no longer needs to personally handle things.
The two chatted as the ferry slowly left the dock, gradually heading towards the center of the river.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 21 Shocking! Direct Lineage Successors Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 21 Shocking! Direct Lineage Successors Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
This conversation made Wang Shouyue frown unconsciously.
Father fishing? Has the Ping’an Wang Family fallen to such a degree?
A dignified patriarch of the direct lineage, yet he also needs to go down to the river to fish?
Moreover, targeting a Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast! This boast seems somewhat exaggerated.
A Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast is particularly formidable, even more troublesome than a terrestrial beast of the same level. One mistake could lead to a disaster of boats destroyed and people dead.
Everyone knows that not even two or three Ancestor Spirit Platforms would dare to casually deal with a Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast.
Wang Shouyue pondered in his heart, inevitably thinking less of the Ping’an Wang Family.
Thereafter, no more words were exchanged.
The ferry passed through the river on its way and finally arrived at Dingpu Ferry in Ping’an Town.
"Hmm?"
This Ping’an Wang Family’s ferry dock is evidently far different from Changning Guandu. No, to be precise, they are worlds apart.
Changning Guandu is dilapidated and shabby, perfectly matching Wang Shouyue’s imagination of a rural ferry dock. However, this Dingpu Ferry has completely exceeded his expectations.
All around are tall wooden buildings, both tidy and clean, and they even appear somewhat grand and majestic.
The people who guard the ferry and those disembarking are orderly and distinct, unlike the chaos and crowding at Changning Guandu.
The level of order here is rare even within Longzuo County; there is hardly a hint of rustic charm.
The old man and Wang Shouyue looked at each other, both somewhat confused.
"Uncle Three, have you been here before?" Wang Shouyue asked in a low voice.
"I was here once over twenty years ago." The old man also looked puzzled.
Over twenty years ago, this Dingpu Ferry was so desolate; how has it become so bustling in the blink of an eye?
It’s like a bustling small town.
Unable to grasp the situation, they noticed people gradually disembarking from the ferry and realized that entering Ping’an Town required registration.
Listening to various remarks, they felt like they weren’t entering Ping’an Town but rather the Governor’s Mansion.
Just then, Wang Shouye, carrying the Wang Family descendant’s identity token, first passed through the security checkpoint.
Standing eagerly at the checkpoint was a young man in a vigorous outfit, who upon seeing Wang Shouye, came forward and greeted excitedly, "Uncle Seven, after receiving your letter earlier, I’ve been waiting for you here. How come you’re so late, perhaps entangled by those young ladies who admire you?"
The young man appeared sixteen or seventeen years old, tall and robust, with muscles packed like a young bull calf.
"Zongsheng, you youngster are growing stronger, and even daring to joke with Uncle Seven now." Wang Shouye laughed and gave him a playful punch, "Your Second Brother has entrusted me with some Peiyuan Pills for you, all taken away."
This youngster called Wang Zongsheng is the head of the Ping’an Fish Stall and fishery sales—Wang Shouyi’s eldest son. His maternal clan and Wang Shouye are both from the Golden Sand Xu Family, and the two aren’t far apart in age, having been quite close since childhood.
"Uncle Seven, my apologies." Wang Zongsheng quickly feigned repentance and pleaded, "I rely entirely on my father’s supplements to quickly reach the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm and catch up to you, Uncle Seven, please don’t take them away."
The two exchanged banter for a while.
Yet this left the nearby old man and Wang Shouyue both shaken, almost in disbelief.
The boy named Zongsheng should indeed be of the ’Zong’ generation within the Ping’an Wang Family, right?
He looks so young but is already planning to reach the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm?
How could this be possible?
Then focusing his Qi Observation Technique on him, he found the young man truly hadn’t lied; he seemed to have reached the middle stage of the Sixth Layer of Qi Refining Realm.
This is simply unbelievable!
Could it be that this boy is the true heir of the direct lineage?
Especially Wang Shouyue, who was greatly shocked: this boy seems hardly inferior to what he was back then.
This is altogether perplexing.
Subsequently, the old man and Wang Shouyue began to follow others to register, eager to come out and inquire. Which of these two young men is truly the heir of the direct lineage?
Unexpectedly, the registration officer questioned, "You’re called Wang Shouyue? A descendant of the Ping’an Wang Family?"
"I’m named Wang Shouyue, but I’m a direct lineage descendant of Longzuo Wang Family." Wang Shouyue explained earnestly.
Then the officer cautiously asked the old man, "You’re called Wang Xiaozheng, of the Wang Family ’Xiao’ generation?"
"That’s correct." Wang Xiaozheng replied.
The registration officer then shouted, "Chief, chief, come quickly. Someone’s impersonating a descendant of our master’s Wang Family."
Impersonating?
Wang Xiaozheng and Wang Shouyue both froze. When did they impersonate Wang Family descendants?
Before they could speak, a large group of soldiers rushed forward, followed by several Black Tortoise War Generals directing them with solemn expressions.
Impersonating Wang Family descendants is a major taboo; such vile acts haven’t appeared in Ping’an Town for a long time.
Even Wang Shouye and Wang Zongsheng rushed over, ready to act any moment.
The old man Wang Xiaozheng hurriedly shouted, "Don’t misunderstand us, we aren’t impersonating. We are from the Longzuo Wang Family, not the Ping’an Wang Family."
"What Longzuo Wang Family? The Longyou Wang Family?" The leading Black Tortoise War General sternly ordered, "First, surrender, we can talk inside if there’s anything."
Several soldiers surged forward, aiming their long spears and great halberds at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 21 Shocking! Direct Lineage Successors Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 21 Shocking! Direct Lineage Successors Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
"What audacity." Wang Shouyue angrily said, "We are the Longzuo Wang Family, your Ping’an Wang Family is just a branch."
As a direct lineage descendant of a Celestial Human Family and a future successor of the family, how could he have ever been treated with such disrespect?
Just as the situation was about to explode.
Wang Shouye stepped forward to stop them, "Wait." He then looked at the elder and Wang Shouyue with a puzzled expression, "Are you guests of the Longzuo Wang Family?"
Although the younger generation wasn’t familiar with the Longzuo Wang Family, they at least knew that such a family existed.
Just as Wang Shouyue was about to speak, Wang Xiaozheng stopped him and personally addressed Wang Shouye, "Seventh Young Master, surely you are aware of our Longzuo Wang Family. Please have these soldiers stand down to avoid any misunderstandings."
Saying this, Wang Xiaozheng took out a family token and handed it to Wang Shouye.
Wang Shouye couldn’t understand it either.
But being clever, he secretly pondered that whether these two were from the Longzuo Wang Family or not, he could take them back to the main residence.
If they were, then there would be no breach of etiquette.
If not, then they were out of luck, for the family had plenty of strong individuals who could deal with them.
Immediately, Wang Shouye waved off the soldiers and welcomed them according to etiquette, then invited them onto the Wang Family’s carriage, and headed towards the Wang Family’s Main Residence.
Their own accompanying carriage was driven by a coachman following behind.
Almost simultaneously.
A few gray, eagle-like birds flapped and flew out. It was clear that in no time, the Wang Family’s Main Residence would receive this news and make a judgment.
Inside the carriage, the journey was silent.
After more than half an hour, the distinguished elder Wang Xiaozheng, unable to contain his curiosity, asked, "Two young masters, which one of you is the direct lineage successor of the Wang Family?"
Wang Shouye and Wang Zongsheng were both taken aback.
Uh...
Old man, from where did you see that we, uncle and nephew, have the demeanor of a direct lineage?
Both shook their heads, "Neither of us is."
How could that be?
Wang Xiaozheng and Wang Shouyue, shocked, were full of doubts.
Is this a joke? How could such outstanding young men not be the family’s direct lineage successors?
Wang Shouyue, after being stunned, laughed, "Seventh Young Master, perhaps you are the direct lineage successor? It’s evident from your demeanor and temperament."
Wang Shouye, who admired his fourth brother most, quickly shook his head, "How could Shouye compare to Fourth Brother?"
Wang Zongsheng also quickly shook his head, no comparison, no comparison.
"Fourth Brother?" Wang Shouyue was puzzled.
"That’s right. In our Ping’an Wang Family, my fourth brother is the direct lineage successor and this generation’s clan leader." Wang Shouye honestly said, "When you meet my Fourth Brother, you’ll understand."
At the same time, his eyes showed admiration for Fourth Brother, the great figure he would look up to for the rest of his life.
Wang Xiaozheng and Wang Shouyue exchanged glances, both astounded. Could it be that his so-called Fourth Brother was even more excellent than these two young masters?
Impossible?
Especially Wang Shouyue, who couldn’t help but think to himself, perhaps that so-called Fourth Brother only had the direct lineage bloodline, not necessarily more outstanding on his own.
He had no choice but to think this way.
The two young men before him were already exceptional.
If there was an even stronger Fourth Brother, wouldn’t that surpass him, Wang Shouyue?
At this moment, at the front three-way fork, a rapid sound of hooves was heard.
Everyone lifted the carriage curtains to see a group of riders coming from the other end of the fork, pulling a small cart behind them with a massive fierce bird carcass that must have weighed several hundred pounds, presumably a Tier Two fierce beast.
The fierce bird had an arrow piercing through its head, evidently killed with a single shot.
The leading rider was a striking young woman with exceptional presence, riding a black steed.
As the horse’s hooves rose and fell, the red Black Tortoise martial attire on her back fluttered in the wind, exuding an impressive and heroic aura like a female hero.
The female rider, upon spotting this carriage and noticing Wang Shouye and Wang Zongsheng peeking out, immediately rode towards them.
The whip cracked in the air.
"Crack!"
She jokingly teased, "Old Seventh, even during the New Year, you don’t return. Are you so enchanted by those pretty ladies of Changning Guard that you’ve forgotten even your Fourth Sister?"
"Fourth Sister..." Wang Shouye’s face fell; he hurriedly got out of the carriage and, with a wry smile, respectfully greeted, "Why are even you teasing me?"
Upon seeing this spirited woman, Wang Shouyue’s eyes lit up as shock coursed through him.
This beautiful and gallant woman appeared to be no more than twenty-four or twenty-five years old. Her cultivation was unfathomable, beyond even his perception.
Moreover, looking at her horse’s side, where a strong bow and sharp arrow hung, could it be that she personally shot down that Tier Two fierce bird?
In an instant, Wang Shouyue’s mind surged with tumultuous waves, difficult to quell.
What on earth was happening with this Ping’an Wang Family?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 22 Lament! Why is Heaven So Unfair?
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 22 Lament! Why is Heaven So Unfair?
...
Wasn’t it said that the Ping’an Wang Family is just a fallen small family?
How come these young people are each more impressive than the other?
Even the women have such extraordinary presence, looking like Spirit Platform Seeds nailed to the board.
Such a scene, even his Longzuo Wang Family can’t reach, right?
Is he dreaming? Or did some illusion happen...
Can’t figure it out, Wang Shouyue really can’t figure it out.
He saw the spirited woman looking up and down at The Seventh Wang Shouye, and couldn’t help but laugh charmingly: "Who told my Seventh to be so handsome, his ’famous beauty’ has already spread throughout Changning Guard. I heard, several noble families have secretly sent people to propose to our family."
In the Black Tortoise Clan, there is a custom of proposing, but usually it’s still the man proposing to the woman. Only when a young woman falls for a young man will her elders thick-skinnedly go for a backwards proposal.
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouye was speechless, looking rather annoyed. Wives and the like, he doesn’t want them; too troublesome.
At this point, Wang Zongsheng also quickly got off the carriage and respectfully bowed to the spirited woman: "Zongsheng pays respects to Fourth Aunt."
The woman looked Wang Zongsheng up and down, couldn’t help but tease him: "It’s only been a few days since we met, and your muscles have become even more robust. Let me tell you, boys need to be like your Uncle Seven, graceful and elegant, to be welcomed by girls. If you continue growing sideways like this, I’m afraid you’ll end up without a wife."
Wang Zongsheng smiled wryly, wives and the like, what’s the use?
Hurriedly changing the subject, he said: "Fourth Aunt, were you hunting fierce beasts? One shot to kill, truly good archery."
Speaking of this matter.
The woman also showed a bit of pride, but then her expression turned calm: "It was just a fierce bird newly entering Tier Two. It was too stupid, never suffered a setback. It dared to cross mountains and come to our Wang Family to hunt, disturb the civilians, how could it have any way to survive?"
"Even if it was just a Tier Two fierce bird, your single shot to kill was undoubtedly remarkable." Wang Shouyue got off the carriage and bowed with politeness, with Wang Xiaozheng following rapidly.
Seeing outsiders present, the woman immediately became reserved and composed, bowed in return, saying: "And who might this young gentleman be?"
"I am Wang Shouyue, a direct lineage descendant of the Longzuo Wang Family." Wang Shouyue displayed a graceful, genteel demeanor and said, "May I ask the young lady’s name?"
Longzuo Wang Family? Still the Shou Generation!
The woman showed a slight expression of surprise yet remained serious and polite: "So it turns out to be Young Master Wang Shouyue, I am Wang Luotong, greetings to the young master."
"Miss Ruotong is so outstanding and extraordinary, surely she is a direct lineage noble lady of the Wang Family?" Wang Shouyue said somewhat doubtfully, "May I ask, Miss Ruotong, are you a disciple of the Purple Mansion Academy? Under which Ascendant?"
It’s no wonder he would speculate like this.
This young lady named Wang Luotong, whether her demeanor or cultivation, is so exceptional and extraordinary.
If she were an academy disciple, she should be able to contend for the core disciple status.
In comparison to him, a successor carefully nurtured by the Celestial Human Family, she is hardly inferior.
Presumably, at least she would be an outstanding disciple in the academy.
"Purple Mansion Academy?" Wang Luotong chuckled at herself and said, "With my level, I’d be embarrassing myself at the academy; I barely just hang around in the family. Also, I’m not a direct lineage."
"What?"
How could this be possible? Wang Shouyue’s face was full of uncertainty and disbelief.
Such an outstanding young lady, not trained by the academy?
And the most exaggerated thing is, she’s not even a direct lineage.
Not that direct veins can’t produce outstanding women.
Just family resources are limited. Under equal conditions, they are prioritized for direct lineage to ensure better inheritance for the family.
Only when resources are extremely abundant, or when direct lineage is really unfit for nurturing will they focus on training direct vein disciples, to complete the family’s Spirit Platform succession or Celestial Human succession.
Can the Wang Family really possess such financial and material power? Even to lavishly nurture a direct vein woman!
It must be that this young lady’s talent is exceptionally outstanding, the Wang Family had to squeeze out some resources for cultivation. Coupled with her own talent and effort, it led to such achievements.
What a pity, what a pity!
If this young lady could enter the Purple Mansion Academy, her achievements would definitely not stop there.
Such a stunningly talented young lady, born into the Ping’an Wang Family, her talent totally wasted and squandered.
If placed in the Longzuo Wang Family.
The ancestors would definitely find ways to send her to the Purple Mansion Academy.
And quickly allocate resources to support, letting her contend for the core disciple status. Once becoming a core disciple, she could serve as a valuable asset, greatly aiding family development.
Their Longzuo Wang Family had a clan brother who already joined the Purple Mansion Academy and became a core disciple.
Meanwhile Wang Luotong seemed slightly shocked in her heart. This guest from the Longzuo Wang Family is indeed somewhat strange.
After a brief exchange of pleasantries, she fell into a contemplative state.
Occasionally, she would frown, shake her head, sigh, as if expressing emotions, her expressions were surprisingly vivid and odd.
However, she didn’t mind, keeping polite and courteous towards the Longzuo Wang Family.
Since you enjoy contemplating, go ahead, she continued chatting with her brother and nephew.
Perhaps due to the long absence, Wang Luotong and Wang Shouye were very talkative.
The two talked about some strange events and anecdotes.
Especially Wang Shouye, who casually shared some intriguing stories that occurred in Changning Guard with Fourth Sister.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 22: Wail! How Unfair is Heaven_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 22: Wail! How Unfair is Heaven_2
Hearing this, Wang Luotong giggled continuously, saying it was amusing.
The younger Wang Zongsheng also chimed in, finding it quite interesting as well. He mentioned that in two years, he would go to Changning Guard to stay for a while, to help out at the Ping’an Wang’s Fish Stall where his father Wang Shouyi was stationed, and to gain some experience and insight along the way.
Wang Shouyue finally regained his senses.
Listening to those so-called interesting stories, he felt they were quite ordinary and nothing novel. After a sense of superiority arose in his heart, he immediately joined the conversation, discussing various strange and unusual tales from Longzuo County City.
Wang Luotong and a few others listened with exclamations of amazement, finding it very fresh and entertaining. After all, Longzuo County City was too far from Changning Guard, and their news didn’t flow smoothly.
It turned out there were so many fun things in Longzuo County City.
Seeing the three of them looking very interested.
Wang Shouyue grew more enthusiastic in his speech, eloquently saying, "You may not know, but nowadays, the surrounding areas of Longzuo County have begun cultivating a wheat species called ’Wang’s No. 7.’ This wheat species can increase the annual yield by a good forty to fifty percent. The overall additional revenue also exceeds last year’s by thirty percent."
"However, it’s a pity that Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species is hard to come by, and it cannot be reproduced. Our Longzuo Wang Family only managed to obtain a few thousand acres of wheat through friendly connections."
"I wonder which Wang Family developed such a wheat species, truly bringing honor to our family name. Just by those wheat and rice strains, that Wang Family must be making a fortune."
There are numerous Wang Families in the world; in Longzuo County alone, there must be a dozen or twenty. Looking across the entire Daqian Kingdom, the Wang families are even more countless.
Thus, it naturally did not occur to Wang Shouyue that the Ping’an Wang Family was the real owner of the wheat and rice species.
Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species.
Wang Shouye and the other two couldn’t help but exchange glances, showing strange expressions.
At the same time.
Wang Shouyue continued excitedly, "However, soon we can get more Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species and Wang’s No. 9 Rice Species. By then, after discussing with the ancestor, I can spare some for you Ping’an Wang Family, to help you increase the yield of your farms."
This also shows that although this youngster has an unrestrained mouth and a strong sense of superiority, he is not bad at heart.
At once, Wang Shouye felt rather embarrassed and couldn’t bear to let him continue, hurriedly cupping his hands with a dry laugh and saying, "Brother Shouyue, well, that is. Please take a look at the surrounding fields first."
Wang Shouyue glanced around and saw neatly arranged fields. It was clear they were planted with winter wheat this season. Now with winter gone and spring arriving, the wheat seedlings had already emerged, with patches of tender green sprouting everywhere, very pleasing to the eye.
"The planning and organization of Ping’an Town are good, very tidy and aesthetically pleasing," Wang Shouyue said straightforwardly, "But I see villages nearby; these are likely the fields of ordinary citizens, right? What’s so special about them?"
"Ahem." Wang Shouye coughed twice, then patiently explained, "Brother Shouyue, all of these are Wang’s No. 7 Winter Wheat."
"What?" Wang Shouyue was immediately struck as if by lightning, his eyes widening as he looked around, stammering, "This many high-quality fields, all planted with Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species?"
"All of them." Wang Shouye said in a low voice, "All the common folk in Ping’an Town plant Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species, about eighty to ninety thousand acres."
"How can this be?" Wang Shouyue staggered back two steps, seemingly in disbelief, his face reddened, repeatedly protesting, "Aren’t these all common people’s fields? How could they all be planted with Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species?"
"Even if your Ping’an Wang Family managed to get good strains, you would surely only use them on your own estate, right? How could you let commoners benefit!"
After all, we are all relatives, all of the Shou generation.
Wang Shouye, unwilling to let him feel more awkward, softly reminded, "Brother Shouyue, Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species. Something to think about, the key point is — Wang’s."
"Wang’s, Wang’s!" Wang Shouye trembled all over, his face filled with shock, "This, this! Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species was actually cultivated by your Ping’an Wang Family?"
He was speechless.
He just wanted to boast a bit about the advancements in Longzuo County, to satisfy his inner sense of superiority!
What on earth is going on in this world, was he wrong?
Heaven, do you have to torment Wang Shouyue like this!
In an instant, Wang Shouyue’s face flushed hotly, wishing he could find a hole to crawl into.
It was Wang Xiaozheng who, equally shocked, came to de-escalate, saying, "Who would have thought, really didn’t expect it. Our Ping’an Wang Family is so lucky to have cultivated excellent wheat and rice strains, truly a sign of a mighty rise."
The Wang Family naturally responded with modesty, minor achievements, nothing to boast about, nothing to boast about.
In fact, they are all core members of the family. They know well that Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species and Wang’s No. 9 Rice Species were nothing more than the family’s discarded varieties.
Within the strictly guarded core farm.
The mysterious wheat and rice species planted there are truly the terrifying core industry.
Their high yield and quality dare not bear the Wang name, only secretly sold to neighboring counties through some special channels.
Of course, this is something that will absolutely not be disclosed. This is the core secret of the Wang Family, something not even known to in-laws and allies.
"My two guests, let’s get on the carriage. After arriving at the main house, Fourth Brother will give both of you a proper reception." Wang Shouye, being an outstanding family member, naturally didn’t want the guests to feel awkward and uncomfortable, so he shifted the topic.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 22: Wail! How Unfair is Heaven_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 22: Wail! How Unfair is Heaven_3
"Very well, very well." Wang Xiaozheng hastily said, quickly pulling Wang Shouyue to prepare to return to the carriage.
Unexpectedly, when Wang Shouyue regained his composure, he was shocked and felt uneasy in his heart.
Showing off his superiority so confidently, only to end up in such a pitiful state.
He seemed eager to salvage some face.
His mind raced as he said, "Do you know about foreign cement and foreign glass? These are all new products shipped from overseas. Especially foreign cement, which is much more useful than lime. Many Black Tortoise Clans in Longzuo County have already begun using it to pave their ground surfaces. Our own family has even constructed a martial arts arena with foreign cement. The surface is as flat as a mirror, much more practical than bluestone."
Even though foreign cement is much cheaper than lime, using it for constructing surfaces is still extremely luxurious, so it’s no wonder Wang Shouyue felt a bit proud.
"Well..." Wang Shouye looked helpless, patting his forehead and quietly reminded, "Brother Shouyue, just look at the road surface."
Road surface?
Wang Shouyue looked down, and his expression instantly changed from shock to disbelief! His relatively handsome face twisted slightly, and his lips kept trembling.
How could it be?
The entire road was made of poured foreign cement?
Bean-sized beads of sweat trickled continuously from his forehead,
No wonder when they were in the carriage earlier, the road felt particularly smooth and sleek, even more so than bluestone surfaces.
His mind hadn’t initially considered this possibility.
Using foreign cement for martial arts ground surfaces was already extremely luxurious, but using it to build roads...
How wealthy must the Wang Family be?
Within Wang Shouyue’s heart, there was nothing but a mournful cry.
The most crucial point was, his earlier boast had completely turned into a joke, and his face burned with embarrassment.
Wang Xiaozheng stood by, speechless.
Even though the showcase of seed rice and the foreign cement road by the Wang Family was equally shocking to him,
He had long warned Wang Shouyue not to underestimate any of the powerful, and to be cautious in his words and actions when traveling.
Yet this youngster had never taken it to heart.
Well, let him learn a lesson, it would be good for his growth.
After this, Wang Shouyue indeed became much more cautious with his words, observing carefully before asking about anything he didn’t understand.
This journey went on with him observing.
Constantly overturning the worldview of both Wang Xiaozheng and Wang Shouyue.
What about Zhuwei Mansion, what about the commercial plaza, and seeing a Tier Three Aquatic Spirit Beast playfully interacting with a group of children by the lake.
All these things made them feel it was extremely unbelievable.
This journey, upon finally reaching the main residence,
The two guests from the Longzuo Wang Family, especially Wang Shouyue, were completely in shock. He felt as though he was the poor relative from the commandery city visiting his wealthy kin in Ping’an Town.
And Wang Xiaozheng, feeling restless.
The prepared gift worth 2,000 Qian Gold seemed enough at first. But now, it seemed like...it wasn’t enough, what should they do?
Meanwhile,
Having received the news early on, Wang Shouzhe had returned from the research center. He had already communicated with Ancestor Longyan and Ancestor Xiaohan, deciding that he and Ancestor Xiaohan would receive the guests from Longzhou.
Wang Shouzhe, adhering to the proper etiquette, stood waiting outside the front door.
Seeing the two guests get off the carriage, he warmly greeted them, "Ancestor Xiao Zheng and Brother Shouyue, your grand visit is an honor, forgive me for not welcoming you earlier."
Earlier, Wang Luotong had already reported to Wang Shouzhe.
The two from Longzuo Wang Family immediately gathered themselves and looked toward Wang Shouzhe. They had heard quite a few stories about him, and the various changes in Ping’an Town seemed all connected to him.
This filled the two from Longzuo Wang Family with immense curiosity about Wang Shouzhe.
As Wang Shouzhe assessed Wang Shouyue, naturally, Wang Shouyue was evaluating Wang Shouzhe.
Their gazes met.
"Oh?" Wang Shouzhe secretly nodded, not undeserving of being from the Longzuo Wang Family, this young man has some potential.
Only twenty-one or twenty-two years old?
Already reaching the peak of the Qi Refining Realm Seventh Layer. If placed in the Purple Mansion Academy, he’d likely qualify as a core disciple.
Hmm, this young man is pretty good, has development potential.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouyue couldn’t see through Wang Shouzhe’s cultivation level at all, which was only normal given the age factor, having a bit higher cultivation was reasonable.
However, he pondered inwardly, thinking Wang Shouzhe looked about twenty-six or twenty-seven years old?
Appearing four or five years older than him, based on his own standards, it seemed reasonable for him to be around the high stage to the peak of the Qi Refining Realm Eighth Layer.
Since Wang Shouzhe was quite reputable, he guessed broader, a bit higher.
Estimating him to be at the Ninth-Layer Initial Stage. Hmm, approximately, not more than that.
He guessed and speculated, thinking if he gave it his all, he might be able to catch up.
As such, Wang Shouyue regained some confidence.
"Oh? Third Grandfather, what’s wrong with your expression?" Suddenly, seeing Wang Xiaozheng’s shocked face, Wang Shouyue immediately asked nervously, "Third Grandfather, could it be, he’s already at the Ninth-Layer Middle Stage?"
Wang Xiaozheng’s expression shifted from shock to a wry smile, and he said three words.
"Can’t see through!"
Can’t see through!!?
In an instant, Wang Shouyue’s face turned pale, his steps became a bit shaky, and how he was welcomed inside, how they arranged a reception banquet for them, he was in a daze throughout.
His mind was filled with those three words, can’t see through.
Indicating a certain result.
That is, his cultivation level was at least not inferior compared to his own grandfather, who was already in the Spirit Platform Realm.
Oh Heaven, are you bullying me, Wang Shouyue?
"Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle!" Smelling the fragrance of the reception banquet, Wang Lici appeared out of nowhere in the reception hall, sniffing eagerly, she spoke naturally, "I heard you’re entertaining guests, why didn’t you let me join?"
Wang Shouzhe wiped a cold sweat, hadn’t he just tried to send you away? How could you still appear here? He immediately said, "Lici, there’s nothing for you here, I’ll treat you later."
Wang Lici immediately appeared pitiful like an abandoned puppy.
Oh? This young lady looked chubby and a little baby-faced, seemingly not very formidable. Wang Shouyue, whose confidence had plunged to the bottom, suddenly got a spirit lift and persuaded, "Fourth Brother Shouzhe, we’re all family, let’s eat together."
Having someone who seemed not very formidable to accompany could greatly soothe his deeply-impacted heart.
Having a healing effect.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 23: Watch Your Words! Who Doesn’t Have a Few Poor Relatives? (Asking for Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 23: Watch Your Words! Who Doesn’t Have a Few Poor Relatives? (Asking for Monthly Tickets)
...
Since the guests have said so.
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t reject his face and had to show a kindly look and say, "Lici, then thank your Uncle Shouyue."
"Thank you, Uncle Shouyue, you really are a good person." Wang Lici smiled foolishly, then sat down eagerly, looking eager and waiting for the dishes to be served.
Wang Shouyue felt very comforted, the "uncle" was addressed so sweetly.
This simple and naive girl seemed to bring him full positive energy, making his heart, which had suffered trauma, feel a warm current.
Comfortable!
Indeed, spending time with the weak is stress-free and pleasing to the heart.
Wang Xiaozheng, on the other hand, didn’t particularly notice Wang Lici’s cultivation, after all, the girl was still wearing a high-level breath concealment pendant.
As for Wang Shouzhe, he was also wearing a breath concealment pendant, which made Wang Xiaozheng unable to see his cultivation, accidentally intimidating them a bit.
However, Wang Xiaozheng seemed to be at the early stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, evidently giving up on the Path of Celestial Human.
Probably not a match for Wang Shouzhe.
And Wang Xiaozheng, from before entering, had been pondering that the gift initially given on behalf of Ancestor Zhoubo was only worth 2,000 Qian Gold.
The other seven or eight thousand Qian Gold worth of gifts were meant for making connections with local elites such as Young Master Chen and Young Master Tantai.
But now it seems.
Now this 2,000 Qian Gold feels like it’s there to slap faces.
Gritting his teeth.
Wang Xiaozheng, taking advantage of the opportunity to go to the restroom, revised the gift list, and at this time, cheerfully presented it, "Patriarch Shouzhe, this is the resource our Ancestor Zhoubo entrusted me with. It’s not much, please don’t laugh, please don’t laugh."
Wang Shouzhe followed proper etiquette, accepted it with both hands, glanced at the list, and said with a smile, "The Longzuo Wang Family truly lives up to the name of the Celestial Human Family, what generosity. This gift must be worth at least 5,000 Qian Gold, right?"
5,000 Qian Gold?
Wang Shouye, Wang Zongwei, and Wang Luotong, who were also there, were slightly surprised, not expecting the Longzuo Wang Family to be so generous, bringing a gift worth 5,000 Qian Gold.
This far exceeded their expectations.
Wang Shouyue was also surprised, originally said it was 2,000, oh, right, it must be that Third Grandfather saw the situation was not right and immediately added another 3,000.
These additional 3,000 Qian Gold were well added, added marvelously. This displayed the strength of our Longzuo Wang Family.
His severely frustrated self-esteem suddenly came alive, as if feeling a bit proud, and his spirit soared.
Look at the expressions of those young lads and lasses, they all seemed shocked.
Immediately.
With a smile, Wang Shouyue bowed to Wang Shouzhe, "Fourth Brother Shouzhe, our two families are of the same root and branch, naturally we should help each other. This time we came in a hurry, a mere 5,000 Qian Gold resources are really nothing."
"Uh... it does seem like not much." Beside, Wang Lici said truthfully ’mumbled’ as a side comment.
In her view, if she were allowed to eat freely, turning all those 5,000 Qian Gold into Tier Three Spiritual Flesh, she probably wouldn’t be able to eat for many days.
Came all this way just to deliver 5,000 Qian Gold worth of resources.
With that effort, they might as well form a team to the Outer Domain to hunt a Tier Three Ferocious Beast.
Wang Shouyue’s smile suddenly froze on his face...
As soon as Wang Lici finished speaking, she was fiercely glared at by Wang Shouzhe: "If you dare to talk nonsense again, you’ll be banned from spiritual food for half a year."
"Exactly." ’Elder’ Wang Shouye also said to Wang Lici earnestly, "Big Girl, you’re still too young to understand the meaning of ’a light gift but a heavy sentiment’."
Holy "light gift but heavy sentiment"!
The rigid smile on Wang Shouyue’s face twitched a few times, what kind of rebuke is this?
"Alright." As the only "ancestor" accompanying, Ancestor Xiaohan said with a stern face, "What do you junior understand? Even in a Celestial Human Family, not much money can be saved in a year. Don’t talk like you’re well-fed and don’t know what hunger is like for others."
Uh...
What do you mean well-fed and hungry?
Seeing those words.
Even Wang Shouyue, let alone anyone else, felt embarrassed and blushed.
"Alright, alright." Wang Luotong also found it both funny and annoying, secretly thinking what kind of emotional intelligence do these family members have? Immediately, she stepped in to mediate, "Everyone, be mindful of your words, doesn’t every family have one or two poor relatives?"
The two guests from Longzuo were nearly about to crawl under the table.
"..." Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat, this meal shouldn’t have let you accompany. If you continue talking, I reckon they would lose their appetites.
As clan leader, he could only step up and say, "Jokes end here, serve the dishes."
With Wang Shouzhe’s order.
Servants and maids brought up the prepared spiritual food and spirit wine one by one, using some high-quality spiritual flesh and spirit fish. All were produced in Anjiang and Outer Domain, processed with ice fresh treatment, they were quite fresh.
The bowls and plates used were all fine porcelain. However, the wine glasses and some special plates and bowls were habitually made with high-quality glassware by the maids.
"This..." Wang Shouyue’s eyes lit up, picking up a crystal clear glass cup, "This is a top-grade foreign glass cup, top-grade ones aren’t so crystal clear, this must be the legendary top-grade foreign glass cup, Fourth Brother Shouzhe is indeed lavish."
"If Shouyue likes it, I’ll give you a set when you leave, and Ancestor Xiaozheng can also have a set." Wang Shouzhe smiled in a way that was like a warm breeze.
"Fourth Brother Shouzhe is indeed generous, a set like this would sell for at least two to three hundred Qian Gold in the Commandery city." At this point, Wang Shouyue didn’t want to compete for superiority anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 23: Watch Your Words! Who Doesn’t Have a Few Poor Relatives? (Asking for Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 23: Watch Your Words! Who Doesn’t Have a Few Poor Relatives? (Asking for Monthly Tickets)_2
Anyway, he realized that the Ping’an Wang Family was indeed extravagantly generous. Poor relatives were just poor relatives. As long as he was willing to let go of his pride, he discovered the world suddenly brightened up.
Then he and Wang Xiaozheng began to eat heartily. These ingredients were all very fresh and delicious, and both the Spirit Fish and Spiritual Flesh seemed exceptionally fresh, with even the lowest being Tier Two, not lacking in Tier Three Spiritual Flesh main courses.
This made them sigh in awe: just this one meal alone might cost two or three hundred Qian Gold, right?
The current Ping’an Wang Family is indeed not what it used to be, truly magnificent.
But before they could take a few bites, they suddenly found that the dishes on the table were all gone.
But the Wang Family people were also used to it.
