As long as Wang Lici was present, the meal wouldn’t go peacefully.
Then, Wang Shouzhe, who was prepared, calmly waved his hand and said, "Serve the dishes."
The servants and maids began to bring in the second wave of prepared dishes.
And this wave of dishes had even more quantity! More substantial! More hearty!
This once again surprised the Longzuo Wang Family grandfather and grandson. Was the previous table just appetizers?
This hospitality is way too generous, right?
Then, before half an incense stick could burn, Wang Shouzhe, still expressionless, said, "Serve the dishes."
Then the maids and servants began to serve the third wave of dishes.
This wave was even larger in quantity.
The Longzuo Wang Family grandfather and grandson were so astonished they couldn’t speak. Originally, they thought the first wave of dishes was luxurious enough, but didn’t expect a second wave, and then a third wave.
By the end, they served five waves of dishes.
The two of them ate until their bellies were round, never in their lives had they eaten so extravagantly, it was truly an eye-opener.
No wonder.
Earlier, Wang Lici muttered something about five thousand Qian Gold not being much. With the Wang Family’s eating style, five thousand Qian Gold really was nothing.
Given the value of the gifts they sent, they probably couldn’t cover even two meals.
Especially that girl named Wang Lici, who literally ate half of the ingredients and still seemed unsatisfied.
This made Wang Shouyue’s heart race in fear. He originally thought this niece looked quite cute, with an innocent appearance. He was even thinking of making small talk, saying he’d host her if she ever came to the Commandery City.
Fortunately, he quickly took back his words. Otherwise, even if he gave up his entire year’s allowance, it wouldn’t be enough for the girl to have one meal.
He wiped away the cold sweat, grateful in his heart.
After they were full and satisfied.
Wang Shouzhe, as part of the host’s responsibilities, naturally invited them to drink tea and chat.
And so, a few days later.
...
Anjiang.
A medium-sized cargo ship was heading far towards the East Sea.
Longzuo Wang Family’s Wang Shouyue and Spirit Platform Realm Elder Wang Xiaozheng stood at the stern of the ship.
Looking at the Dingpu Ferry gradually receding into the distance, they exchanged glances, their hearts filled with emotions.
This journey to the Ping’an Wang Family, from leaving with full confidence and superiority, to being hit until they were utterly defeated, to accepting Wang Family’s gifts...
This process was truly full of ups and downs, overwhelming them.
Even the Young Master Chen and Young Master Tantai, whom they were proud of getting acquainted with, had a deep connection with the Wang Family.
Especially that Young Master Chen, who turned out to have a kinship connection with the Wang Family, having married Wang Shouzhe’s eldest sister, Wang Luoyi.
After hearing that they were going to visit Young Master Chen, Wang Shouzhe personally wrote them a letter of introduction, asking the East Port Chen Family to take care of them.
This truly felt like trying to grow flowers but they wouldn’t bloom, while unintentionally planting willows that cast shade.
The little favor Ancestor Zhubo did for the Wang Family back then was remembered firmly by them, truly repaying kindness with overwhelming gratitude.
"Shouyue," Wang Xiaozheng said emotionally, "you must learn well from your Fourth Brother Shouzhe."
"Don’t worry, Third Grandfather." Wang Shouyue naturally had no hint of arrogance anymore and sincerely said, "I will definitely hold onto Fourth Brother Shouzhe’s thigh tightly."
"A promising young lad."
...
After sending off the Longzuo Wang Family guests.
Wang Shouzhe also began his long-prepared journey to the Academy.
This journey consisted of dozens of carriages, heading majestically towards Longzuo County City.
The carriages traveled at a steady pace on the smooth official road, moving quite fast.
This journey covers major cities and fortresses such as An Yuan Guard, Langyou Guard, East Mountain Corridor, Dingbian Pass, Langzuo Guard, New City Guard and others, passing through numerous landscapes along the way, with a total distance of over three thousand li.
Even though Wang Shouzhe’s carriage is drawn by the durable Northern Heavy Draft Horse, the daily distance covered is at most one hundred fifty li.
Moreover, every time he passes through a city, he stops for a short while, experiences the local customs, and tastes the local delicacies, purely as if he’s on a leisure trip.
Thus, this journey took a whole month.
The slow pace provoked quite a few grumblings from Ancestor Xuanfu.
Because every time she travels to and from the Academy, she rides light and swift, finishing a single trip in less than ten days.
Yet here he was, taking a whole month to get to Longzuo County, and shopping all the way, showing off his wealth extravagantly.
But since the entire trip was planned by Wang Shouzhe, her opinions were of no use.
In fact, she was often pulled aside by Wang Shouzhe to discuss some of the top core disciples, direct disciples, and ascendants in the Academy.
Wang Shouzhe even teased her, saying, "You’ve been in the Academy for over a hundred years, and yet you don’t even know the preferences of each ascendant or the leadership of the Academy?"
In any case, the caravan traveled safely and arrived at their destination, slowly reaching the front of Longzuo County City.
Longzuo County City.
This is a city name Wang Shouzhe had heard countless times since his transmigration.
Even though he already had an imagined idea of large cities in this mystical world, he was still deeply shocked when he actually saw this gigantic and magnificent city.
It sprawled across the earth like an enormous beast.
The city walls were probably four or five zhang thick and twenty or thirty zhang high, making even the notorious Tier Five Ferocious Beast seem tiny beneath them.
Building such a city undoubtedly had its purpose; it seemed to be designed to defend against not just Tier Five Ferocious Beasts, but even Tier Six and Seven!
No wonder the tiny Changning Guard appeared like a countryside place in the eyes of County City inhabitants.
At the County City gate, there were carriages and various spirit beast-drawn wagons queued to enter. The Northern Heavy Draft Horse was merely decent among regular breeds.
But it was far inferior to a spirit beast.
Just like Wang Shouzhe’s Fire Stepping on White Clouds, which was a famous spirit breed horse. However, Fire Stepping on White Clouds was better suited for riding, not pulling a carriage.
For pulling a carriage, a spirit breed horse called Cyan Scale Heavy Horse or a spirit breed ox called White Elephant Spiritual Ox was more appropriate.
The former allowed for a speedy ride while the latter was specialized for carrying heavy cargo.
Each had its own uses.
These were common spirit breed livestock that ordinary noble families could afford to splurge on.
As for some strange exotic beasts, or Tier Three and Four Spirit Beasts, they weren’t something ordinary families could manage.
Most people had to queue up to enter the County City.
But Wang Shouzhe and his group didn’t have to line up.
Firstly, they had someone from the Celestial Human Family to meet them.
Secondly, Ancestor Xuanfu’s core disciple token from the Academy was enough to enter through the VIP passage.
The group only waited for a moment.
Before long.
A group of people quickly approached Wang Shouzhe and his companions.
Leading them was a middle-aged man, adorned in a fire silk brocade robe, with a purple-gold crown on his head, his fair face bearded, exuding extraordinary elegance.
He quickened his pace, walking with a majestic stride, and greeted with a smile, "Are you the party from the Ping’an Wang Family? I am Wang Xiaorui, the current patriarch of the Longzuo Wang Family, here to welcome the returning wanderer home."
His demeanor was exceptionally cordial.
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but smile. It was impossible for the Longzuo Wang Family to personally come out of the city based on just his letter.
At most, they would have sent a Spirit Platform Realm elder.
The only explanation now was.
The Longzuo Wang Family must have received the report letters from Wang Xiaozheng and Wang Shouyue, and undoubtedly knew of the impressive development of the Ping’an Wang Family.
Indeed, this was the effect Wang Shouzhe had intended to achieve.
To avoid unnecessary unpleasantness caused by underestimating each other.
After all, both families shared a common bloodline, and mutually supporting each other was certainly not a bad thing.
This wasn’t like those mystical novels he read from his previous life, where family members constantly plotted against each other, oftentimes to death, and ending all relations.
Such situations were rare in the Daqian Kingdom.
Most families offered some assistance to each other, and more often than not, turned their efforts outward rather than against each other.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 23: Foundation! The Millennium Noble Wang Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 23: Foundation! The Millennium Noble Wang Family
...
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe also stepped forward, cupped his hands, and said, "I am the Clan Leader of Ping’an Wang Family, Wang Shouzhe, pleased to meet Clan Leader Xiao Rui."
In theory, this Wang Xiaorui is a senior of the Xiao generation.
However, since both parties meet in the capacity of clan leaders, it is natural to adhere to the etiquette between noble families. Furthermore, the blood relation between Clan Leader Xiao Rui and him is relatively distant.
Unlike those close uncles and maternal grandfathers and the like.
Both sides naturally exchanged formal greetings.
Subsequently, Ancestor Longyan, Ancestor Xuanfu, and several Spirit Platform Realm elders on the other side all exchanged greetings with each other.
Especially Ancestor Longyan, being of the Long generation, holds a higher seniority. Among the Spirit Platform Realm elders present, only the elders of the Yu generation are comparable in seniority to Ancestor Longyan.
That elder is called Wang Yuchen, and the Longzuo Wang Family refers to him as Ancestor Yuchen, now over one hundred and fifty years old, significantly older than Ancestor Longyan.
He already looks very aged and probably has only ten to twenty years of lifespan left.
Spirit Platform Realm cultivators enjoy a two-hundred-year lifespan, but not every Spirit Platform Realm can live to two hundred years.
This depends on the age of promotion, any lingering hidden injuries, bloodline and long-term health maintenance factors, etc.
Most Spirit Platform Mirrors live to about one hundred seventy or eighty years and pass away. Living to two hundred or slightly over is considered very long-lived.
Upon seeing Ancestor Longyan, his whole body trembled, his eyes filled with excitement and guilt: "Sister Longyan, it’s been sixty years since we last met. Alas... Brother has let you down; I didn’t offer much help back then."
He sighed deeply, clearly emotional over the events of the past sixty years.
"Brother Yuchen," Ancestor Longyan said calmly, "all this is fate. The help we received from the Longzuo Wang Family back then was already immense. Ancestor Yuchen even accompanied Ancestor Zhubo to run around for us, for which Longyan is immensely grateful."
Ancestor Longyan often stayed with the Longzuo Wang Family during her time at the Academy, naturally fostering a close relationship with Ancestor Yuchen.
On the contrary, Ancestor Xuanfu, although also a granddaughter of Ancestor Zhou Xuan, bears the surname Liu, which makes her slightly less close to the Longzuo Wang Family.
However, she is now a core disciple of the Academy. Naturally, the Longzuo Wang Family also respects her, speaking with an intention to forge closeness.
After the elders exchanged greetings, the juniors stepped forward to respectfully greet them one by one.
Such is the way between noble families.
All these greetings and pleasantries took a good half an hour.
At this time, Wang Xiaorui began to interrupt, saying, "Ancestor Longyan, Clan Leader Shouzhe, this is not the place for conversation; please follow me into the city first."
"In that case, I’ll trouble Clan Leader Xiao Rui," Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands in a salute.
Afterward, the Wang Family members, led by Wang Xiaorui, entered the Longzuo County through the guest gate. About ten carriages passed through the guest passage without even a check.
The Black Tortoise Practitioners guarding the city remained respectful and courteous throughout.
"Soldiers, your hard work is appreciated." Wang Xiaorui slightly cupped his hands. Subsequently, an elder stepped forward and discreetly handed them some compensation.
After the convoy passed.
A newly appointed young soldier asked, "Chief, which family was that? Quite a grand display, with so many Spirit Platform Realm elders."
An older Spirit Platform Realm officer said, "That’s the Longzuo Wang Family, an old Celestial Human family. It’s said to have a history of over a thousand years in our Longzuo County."
"A thousand years?" the young soldier exclaimed, "Wow, that’s almost as long as half of Longzuo County’s history."
"Indeed, the Longzuo Wang Family was once a famous Purple Mansion Family, in its prime," the Spirit Platform Realm officer said, "But unfortunately, after their founding ancestor exhausted his lifespan at eight hundred years old and passed away, they never fulfilled the Purple Mansion succession over the following centuries, leading to their decline."
"In recent decades, the Longzuo Wang Family almost failed the Celestial Human succession. Fortunately, thirty-five years ago, Ancestor Zhubo succeeded in breaching the barrier, allowing the Celestial Human family to continue."
"Now, Ancestor Zhubo is only around two hundred years old, capable of ensuring the Longzuo Wang Family’s security for at least another century. As long as they can complete the Celestial Human succession again, barring any accidents, this family can endure. Therefore, be courteous when you meet them next time."
"Understood, Chief, really envious of these Celestial Human families," the young soldier, clearly born to an ordinary Spirit Platform Family, greatly admired the Celestial Human families.
Amidst the low discussions of the city defense soldiers,
Wang Shouzhe’s group finally entered Longzuo County City.
From the outside, Longzuo County was already a massive entity. It was only from within that one could realize it was an extraordinarily large giant city. The large bluestone road behind the city gate was astonishingly wide, allowing two or three dozen carriages to move side by side.
Moreover, the rules within Longzuo County were very strict. The central path of the main road was reserved only for Celestial Human families or Purple Mansion families. Walking there without the relevant token was a severe crime if caught by the City Defense Army.
On both sides of the road, there were markets, taverns, various shops, and stalls, and further in were the residential quarters.
Those living within Longzuo County City, even commoners, had to possess decent skills to establish themselves amidst the high cost of living in Longzuo County.
Further in, there were the main residences or villas of the Eighth and Ninth Grade Black Tortoise Clans. This area also hosted a large number of businesses, operating various trades and ventures.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 23: Foundation! The Millennium Noble Wang Family_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 23: Foundation! The Millennium Noble Wang Family_2
Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe and his party, a group of young people, watched with relish, as if they had entered a new world.
Only Wang Lici showed no interest in anything else. Instead, she wandered the streets with wide eyes, looking for something delicious.
When she spotted some unique food stalls or taverns, she couldn’t help but swallow secretly.
If not for Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe’s repeated warnings before entering the city, she would have jumped down to devour them all.
"Listen to Uncle Four, listen to Uncle Four, patience in small matters and great plans won’t be disrupted," Wang Lici frantically reminded herself. Uncle Four had promised her that after visiting the Longzuo Wang Family, they would stay in Longzuo County for a few days, and she could eat whatever she wanted, and Uncle Four would cover it.
Everything in Longzuo County City was extremely fresh and new to most members of the Wang Family.
While Wang Shouzhe rode his Fire Stepping on White Clouds alongside Clan Leader Wang Xiao Rui, listening to his eloquent introduction to the various local customs and traditions, he also found it very interesting.
However, he paid more attention to some business opportunities, like the cloth workshops and the Spirit Seed Shops and so on. Almost anything available in the entire Longzuo County could be bought in this county city.
This was a huge economic center, a commercial center, and a political center. Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, rarely seen in remote places, were not everywhere in Longzuo County City, but you could spot one every now and then.
Moreover, the city was lined with shops.
Just the cloth workshops alone, they had passed four or five along the way. Who knows, perhaps the silk sold in a certain cloth workshop came from the Wang Family’s Silkworm Manor’s raw materials, processed by the Changning Xu Family.
In the middle of the avenue, the carriage moved at a brisk pace.
Yet, even so, it took nearly an hour to reach the main residence of the Longzuo Wang Family.
This main residence was grand and imposing, occupying a vast area, with the tallest pavilion several tens of meters high, and the surrounding buildings were also very grand.
They were either the headquarters of some chamber of commerce or a certain Purple Mansion Family.
Even the prefectural government of Longzuo County was not far away.
Therefore, this place belonged to the core area of Longzuo County City, and ordinary civilians couldn’t enter without special passes.
"Clan Leader Shouzhe, how do you find our Wang Family’s main residence?" Clan Leader Wang Xiao Rui remarked with a slight air of pride.
"Truly worthy of being a main residence of a millennia-old noble family," Wang Shouzhe was full of admiration, "That pavilion is the famous Lingyun Tower I’ve long heard of, isn’t it? I heard that Ancestor Hongtian spent the last two hundred years living in Lingyun Tower."
Ancestor Hongtian was the mutual ancestor of the Longzuo Wang Family and the Ping’an Wang Family.
Wang Shouzhe’s repeated use of "our" made Wang Xiao Rui feel much closer, and he sighed, "Ancestor’s building of Lingyun Tower reflected his aspiration to reach the clouds and venture into the void. It’s just a pity that ultimately, Ancestor never took that step. This tower serves as a reminder for future generations to strive courageously for improvement. However, we descendants have somewhat disappointed Ancestor’s expectations. The family fortune is declining, to the point where the succession of Celestial Humans was almost incomplete."
After saying this, he laughed, "Clan Leader Shouzhe, please don’t take these grumbling words to heart. Come, let’s go home together."
With that said, under the guidance of Wang Xiao Rui, everyone stepped into the Wang Family’s main residence.
Truly worthy of being a millennia-old noble family, every grass and tree, every brick and tile, every pavilion and courtyard exuded a rich historical atmosphere, ancient and heavy. Its land area was extensive; as Wang Xiao Rui introduced, there were hundreds of courtyards, and there were two or three thousand rooms for servants and utility rooms.
When the Ping’an Wang Family built their main residence, it was made larger. But compared to the Longzuo main residence, it’s only about a third of its size.
"Clan Leader Shouzhe, I’ve prepared more than ten sets of courtyards. Everyone being members of the Wang Family need not stand on ceremony. After traveling a long way, everyone must be tired, so let’s rest first. By evening, I’ll host a welcoming dinner at Yinglong Pavilion for everyone," Wang Xiao Rui had arranged everything in an orderly manner, "Tomorrow morning, I’ll take everyone to meet Ancestor Zhoubo. Does Clan Leader Shouzhe have any other comments on these arrangements?"
"Clan Leader Xiao Rui’s arrangements are very thorough. In that case, I’ll leave it to you, Clan Leader Xiao Rui." Being at someone else’s place, naturally, you follow their arrangements. Wang Shouzhe naturally wouldn’t overstep his bounds.
Afterward, it was a matter of moving in, washing up, resting, and cleansing the dust from their journey.
By evening, members of the Wang Clan came over to invite Wang Shouzhe and the others to Yinglong Pavilion.
Yinglong Pavilion.
It was a place where the Longzuo Wang Family entertained distinguished guests.
This time, they hosted with top-notch hospitality, offering countless delicious delicacies, some of which even Wang Shouzhe had never seen, and some dishes he’d never even heard of.
Spirit wine and spirit tea were provided abundantly.
It was obvious that a certain foodie’s reputation had already reached the ears of the Longzuo Wang Family.
They even brought out an entire Spiritual-Horned Yak to create a whole yak banquet, half of which went to Wang Lici.
This meal satisfied Wang Lici immensely, and she was elated.
Even though they were mentally prepared, seeing Wang Lici finish half of the Spiritual-Horned Yak, and then eat an entire tub of Purple Jade Crystal Rice, they were still deeply shocked.
This girl’s appetite was indeed remarkable.
The Ping’an Wang Family must have had a hard time raising her.
However, the Wang Family also presented a gift list, containing high-quality spirit rice and spirit meat, including some precious Tier Three spiritual flesh. This gift list was not light, totaling over ten thousand Qian Gold.
Yet it caused Wang Xiao Rui to politely refuse back and forth several times before he reluctantly accepted it.
Afterward, several core elders, Patriarch Wang Xiao Rui, and Wang Shouzhe, along with other key figures, began chatting and discussing various matters over tea.
As the Celestial Human Clan Leader of a noble family, Wang Xiao Rui was well-versed and amiable. He casually spoke of various curious events in Longzuo County, making everyone feel highly entertained, as if they were experiencing it firsthand.
After three cups of tea.
Wang Xiao Rui’s expression became slightly serious, and he cupped his hands slightly towards Wang Shouzhe, "Clan Leader Shouzhe, my grandson Shouyue has already informed me in his letters about your care for him. He has connected with the East Port Chen Family and Young Master Tantai and received a warm reception, securing a large share of foreign trade for the family. On behalf of the Longzuo Wang Family, I sincerely thank you, Clan Leader Shouzhe."
"Clan Leader Xiao Rui, you are too polite." Wang Shouzhe returned the gesture with a smile, "Didn’t the Clan Leader just say that we are of the same family line, we are family? Such a trivial matter is not worth mentioning."
The so-called "foreign goods" were produced by several families united by Wang Shouzhe; it didn’t matter who they were sold to.
Since the Longzuo Wang Family had this need, naturally, they could be supplied preferentially. However, he wouldn’t reveal that he was the mastermind behind it all.
"What seems like a small matter to Clan Leader Shouzhe has great benefits for the Longzuo Wang Family," Wang Xiao Rui remarked with great emotion, "Clan Leader Shouzhe may not know, but competition in Longzuo County City is fierce, and no business is easy to conduct."
"We are barely maintaining the current situation thanks to the businesses and few remaining manors left by our ancestor. Now, with the foreign goods trade, we can greatly relieve our financial difficulties. Clan Leader Shouzhe, there’s one more thing..." Wang Xiao Rui spoke with a bit of difficulty.
"Is the Clan Leader referring to the Wang Family No. 9 Rice Seeds?" Wang Shouzhe smiled and said, "I have already prepared for it. Later, the Qiaan’s Trading Company will bring them over for you to receive. This batch of rice seeds amounts to about ten thousand dan, enough for fifty thousand mu of fertile land. I wonder if it’s sufficient."
Wang Xiao Rui’s spirits lifted, and he said immediately, "Enough, more than enough. We only have about thirty thousand mu of fertile land. Clan Leader Shouzhe, I’ve heard that the price of Wang Family No. 9 Rice Seeds is about eighteen Large Coppers per dan. That combined with transportation costs comes to two thousand Qian Gold. Please accept it and don’t refuse."
After a brief refusal twice, Wang Shouzhe accepted it.
Gifts are gifts, and business is business.
Since Wang Xiao Rui was also a sensible person with clear boundaries, Wang Shouzhe was not averse to further cooperation with him.
Looking around, he said earnestly, "Clan Leader Xiao Rui, since we are family, I’ll be frank. The Longzuo Wang Family has a golden opportunity; why not make good use of it?"
Wang Xiao Rui’s eyes lit up, "Clan Leader Shouzhe, you’ve managed to rise the Ping’an Wang Family in such a short time, surely your vision is remarkable. Please advise me!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 25: Thigh! Target Binglan Ascendant (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 25: Thigh! Target Binglan Ascendant (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
...
Regarding Wang Xiaorui’s inquiry.
Wang Shouzhe naturally didn’t put on airs and instead asked seriously, "Our Longzuo Wang Family’s main residence has several hundred courtyard houses and thousands of side rooms. The annual maintenance costs must not be low."
Upon mentioning this matter, Wang Xiaorui’s face turned sour as he said, "Shouzhe, you are also the clan leader, so you naturally understand the difficulties. Even if we save on maintenance costs, the main residence still requires a thousand or two Qian Gold every year."
"If we were to do major renovations every ten or twenty years, how could we manage without ten or twenty thousand Qian Gold?"
These maintenance costs are indeed much higher than those of the Ping’an Wang Family. But that’s normal; this is the Commandery, and naturally, everything here is more expensive.
"Instead of leaving it vacant and still having to maintain it, why not convert the majority of the main residence into a hotel and operate it externally?" Wang Shouzhe suggested.
"A hotel?" Wang Xiaorui’s expression changed, and he shook his head hastily, "Absolutely not, absolutely not, this is the family main residence passed down by our ancestors. If we operate it publicly, wouldn’t that disgrace our ancestors?"
"I’m merely making a suggestion." Wang Shouzhe responded calmly, "Listen to my analysis first, and then Clan Leader Xiao Rui can make a decision."
"Our Longzuo Wang Family main residence is located at the highest commercial and political center, surrounded by top noble families. It’s said to be a place of elite gatherings and the most valuable area in the entire Longzuo County City."
"In Longzuo County City, even a regular room in an ordinary inn could cost ten or eight Large Coppers a day, right?"
"For a regular courtyard suite, it’s difficult to get one without at least one Qian Gold. If it’s a luxurious top-tier courtyard, staying a night for two or three Qian Gold wouldn’t be surprising, would it?"
"Currently, our Longzuo Wang Family uses at most a hundred courtyard houses. The remaining courtyards could be enclosed with a wall, a side door opened, and managed meticulously. Specifically targeting high-end clientele, such as those Spirit Platform Realm cultivators coming to the Commandery City for business. Allowing them not only to have a place of status but also a luxurious stopping point when negotiating."
"If those two hundred high-end and classically elegant courtyards achieve a 50-60% occupancy rate, it would mean three to four hundred Qian Gold a day, which comes up to a hundred thousand Qian Gold a year."
"Moreover, some of the heavily endowed courtyard halls can be set up as high-end hotels, aimed at customers who naturally are those Spirit Platform and Celestial Human Realm cultivators. Reservations must be made in advance, otherwise, we won’t accommodate. Earning tens of thousands of Qian Gold a year from this area should be easy, right?"
This speech had Wang Xiaorui’s eyes glowing with enthusiasm.
Combining these figures couldn’t it lead to over a hundred thousand? Although there are still many expenses, at least earning tens of thousands should be feasible, right?
As a Celestial Human Family.
All current industries of Longzuo Wang Family, when combined, might not even reach this figure annually.
And a Celestial Human Family has significant expenses, with the Celestial Human Ancestor and various Spirit Platform Realm ancestors to support, and various juniors to nurture. Currently, Longzuo Wang Family, saving seven or eight thousand Qian Gold annually is already quite good.
This money cannot be used recklessly; it must be saved for future Celestial Human transitions.
Wang Xiaorui was already very tempted but still had some doubts and concerns as he said, "Shouzhe, after all, our Longzuo Wang Family is a thousand-year-old noble family. If the main residence is operated like this and it becomes known, it might become a laughingstock."
Wang Shouzhe knew he was burdened by ancestral honor and hesitated because of family pride, so he continued, "There are also the remaining thousands of side rooms, which shouldn’t be underestimated. If rented to those who want a respectable inn while seeking assistance from others, or to wealthy loose cultivators, even at fifteen Large Coppers a day, most would sell."
"With a 50% occupancy rate, this could add up to tens of thousands of Qian Gold as well."
"Of course, the most important thing is to flaunt the thousand-year noble family’s heritage, promoting the fact that our ancestors reached the Purple Mansion Realm, otherwise it won’t justify the price."
The potential annual profit of several tens of thousands.
It would be enough to make most Celestial Human Families envious. Most families don’t have this option! If they did, most would likely engage in it.
"In addition, there’s also Lingyun Tower, which could be opened to the public. That’s where the Ancestor of the Purple Mansion contemplated the Heavenly Dao in his later years. Staying there might one day lead to insights from the legacy left by the ancestor."
"Staying at this location for one night should cost at least two hundred Qian Gold. Anything less would be insulting to the Ancestor of the Purple Mansion."
This series of remarks left Wang Xiaorui deeply moved, with the only hesitation being for the prestige of the thousand-year-old family.
"In my view, if a thousand-year-old family continues to decline, that’s what truly lacks dignity. Saving enough to easily complete the Celestial Human transition and perhaps reviving the ancestor’s peak, now that’s dignity. Ancestors in the heavens would also be gratified."
It wasn’t only Wang Xiaorui; even the elite elders sitting alongside were breathing heavily with anticipation.
This look was very familiar to Wang Shouzhe. Boiled down to three words, "afraid of poverty"!
The elders of the Ping’an Wang Family used to have the same expressions.
At this point, Wang Shouzhe stopped discussing and let them contemplate on their own.
As the two families gradually strengthen ties and foster good relations, if Longzuo Wang Family can grow stronger, that would naturally be excellent.
If they truly manage it carefully, two to three hundred thousand might be out of the question. But tens of thousands, that’s feasible. In this way, Longzuo Wang Family’s economy would certainly see tremendous improvement.
At this point, Wang Xiaorui was already thoroughly tempted.

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 25: Thigh! Target Binglan Ascendant (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 25: Thigh! Target Binglan Ascendant (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
Moreover, if he doesn’t agree, those Spirit Platform Realm elders will most likely not let him go.
After all, over the years, most of the family’s resources have been provided to the direct lineage. Only when the direct lineage completes the Celestial Human transition will many resources gradually tilt towards the collateral lineage.
Your direct lineage has been well-fed, while many of our excellent children from collateral lineage endure hardships daily.
How can we let go of such a lucrative opportunity and give up on pursuing it?
"Shouzhe is indeed the Wealth God Child, with just a bit of guidance, he has shown us a path to great riches." Wang Xiaorui finally made up his mind.
Afterward, Wang Xiaorui began to truly consult Wang Shouzhe for advice.
As for Wang Shouzhe, he casually shared with Wang Xiaorui the high-end hotel management concepts he had roughly learned in his previous life.
Wang Xiaorui listened and nodded repeatedly, as if a new world had opened up for him, his eyes lit up with excitement: "We need to come up with a name that sounds impressive. How about Purple Mansion Palace?
Uh... It’s just one word different from Purple Mansion Academy.
Clan Leader Xiaorui, you’re opening up to a new world of thick-skinnedness quite fast?
Indeed, once people are willing to set aside face, their world becomes suddenly bright.
But this is also good, borrowing the fame of Purple Mansion Academy. In this world, people have a keen sensitivity and reverence for the words Purple Mansion.
And so it went.
Wang Shouzhe was pulled by Wang Xiaorui to chat until late at night before he was allowed to go back to sleep.
The next day.
After having breakfast.
Wang Shouzhe and his group went to visit Ancestor Zhubo.
Ancestor Zhubo resided under Lingyun Tower in Heaven-Watching Pavilion, symbolizing the aspiration to look up to the ancestors and constantly motivate oneself.
He was tall, yet his attire was simple and unadorned.
Having ascended to the Celestial Human Realm at an advanced age, his appearance now was that of a dignified elder.
Even though Wang Shouzhe was already a Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator.
When he looked at Ancestor Zhubo, he still felt that the elder’s depths were unfathomable, like a vast ocean, and as towering as a mountain.
Celestial Human Realm Cultivators enjoy a lifespan of four hundred years.
They have long since transcended ordinary mortal bodies, vastly different from normal humans. Even their every move seems to contain boundless fearful power.
Ancestor Zhubo’s first gaze fell upon Ancestor Longyan.
In his deep eyes, there was a trace of heartache, yet even more, there was comfort.
"Wang Longyan greets Ancestor Zhubo." Ancestor Longyan was the first to step forward and pay her respects.
Afterward, Wang Shouzhe and the others also stepped forward to pay their respects.
After greetings and small talk.
Ancestor Zhubo spoke with the younger generations one by one without any hint of superiority, instead being very approachable.
When faced with any cultivation questions, he patiently answered them one by one.
Two hours later.
After Ancestor Zhubo distributed small gifts to each of the younger generations.
Only Wang Shouzhe, Ancestor Xuanfu, Ancestor Longyan, and Patriarch Longzuo Wang Xiaorui remained in the room.
With the speakers all present, the atmosphere instantly became serious.
It was clear that they were now discussing important matters.
Ancestor Longyan gave Wang Shouzhe a meaningful look.
Wang Shouzhe understood and stepped forward to bow: "Ancestor Zhubo, Shouzhe has a matter to consult you about."
"Back when Ancestor was running here and there to support our Ping’an Wang Family, did you discover who was secretly plotting against our Wang Family?"
Ancestor Zhubo’s expression also became deeply serious: "According to my speculation and inference, the situation most likely involves the hands of a Celestial Human Family behind it. However, it’s hard to say who specifically, as we don’t have evidence."
Ancestor Xuanfu frowned and said: "Shouzhe, when you wiped out the Liu and Zhao Clans, why didn’t you think of capturing a living person to interrogate for information?"
"Ancestor Xuanfu, the Liu and Zhao Clans hated us to the core, the testimony might be hard to distinguish between true and false and could disrupt my own judgment." Wang Shouzhe explained, "It’s okay if Ancestor doesn’t know; I’ve been laying out plans for this for years, and it won’t be long before they reveal themselves. By then, it will be clear who the poisonous serpent is."
Ancestor Zhubo solemnly said: "It is because both sides can coexist peacefully now due in large part to their skillful hiding. Once the other side discovers they have been exposed, could they resort to ruthless measures? Shouzhe, I must remind you, Celestial Human Families are not that easy to deal with."
"Especially, Changning Guard has been a Pioneer Guard for nearly several hundred years, and the Huangfu Family and Lei Family each have their own backing. With just our Longzuo Wang Family, we probably don’t have the strength to confront them."
"This is something that Shouzhe has long considered." Wang Shouzhe solemnly replied, "Ancestor Zhubo, rest assured. Shouzhe won’t act casually unless fully prepared."
Actually, Wang Shouzhe will not act casually; if given a chance to delay indefinitely, he would prefer to continue to develop quietly until he can easily push through the Celestial Human Families before making a move.
However, when is life ever that simple?
Even though Wang Shouzhe has taken various measures, laid out plans, constantly hiding his trump cards, and has remained behind the scenes. But as long as the Wang Family develops, sooner or later the hidden hand will grow impatient.
Rather than passively waiting for the other party to make a move unknown to us, it would be better to cast out bait, let the other party take the initiative to expose themselves so we can grasp the initiative.
Now, the Wang Alliance is not to be underestimated. His greatest concern, in fact, is the backstage support of the so-called Celestial Human Families.
Wang Shouzhe has thoroughly investigated the backings of the Huangfu Family and the Lei Family.
This is also why he absolutely had to head north to the Academy this time; the primary reason being Wang Shouzhe also seeks to latch onto a bigger figure for support.
A local power wanting to truly develop needs some reliable backing, like isolated duckweeds lacking foundation.
"Ancestor Zhubo, I have another question." Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "Forgive Shouzhe for the impudence, when our Longzuo Wang Family was going through the Celestial Human transition, merely relying on our Longzuo Wang Family’s reputation was likely not enough to intimidate the opponents, was it?"
Ancestor Zhubo nodded: "You’re right, at that time I was only a Spirit Platform Realm Late Stage, running to Changning Guard to mediate was certainly not qualified enough. Thus, I first went to the Academy, through connections desperately sought to meet Binglan Ascendant. Though I ultimately could not see Binglan Ascendant, I received a handwritten decree from her!"
"It is with this decree that I and Yuchen rushed around Changning Guard to settle the matter. However, for us to intervene again in Ping’an Town’s matters would be absolutely impossible. Changning Guard’s headquarters would definitely not permit us to interfere freely in local affairs."
As expected!
Wang Shouzhe secretly breathed a sigh of relief; as he had guessed, Binglan Ascendant did not completely ignore Ancestor Longyan’s situation.
This way, the plan to latch onto a bigger figure is a bit more promising.
"This..." Ancestor Longyan’s delicate body trembled with emotion, "Master, Master actually intervened in this matter for me. She, she... Ancestor Zhubo, why didn’t you tell me this back then?"
"Well..." Ancestor Zhubo said helplessly, "This was Binglan Ascendant’s intention, I wouldn’t dare defy it."
Wang Shouzhe understood and comforted: "Ancestor, it’s Binglan Ascendant’s concern for you. She feared that if you knew this matter, it would lead to inner turmoil and add unnecessary worry and guilt."
Upon these words.
Ancestor Longyan couldn’t help but sigh repeatedly.
Subsequently, everyone discussed strengthening ties and future development between the two families.
This was expected; after all, the two families share the same ancestor. Now each has overcome certain difficulties, naturally, collaboration for future planning is necessary.
Today’s Longzuo Wang Family may not be a top Celestial Human Family, but it is a profoundly established old noble family. It brings considerable benefits to the Ping’an Wang Family.
This busy endeavor lasted until the second day.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe have some free time.
Then Wang Shouzhe was immediately grabbed by Wang Lici to fulfill his promise.
In Longzuo County City, whatever Wang Lici wanted to eat, she could have.
Seeing Wang Lici so excited, her eyes shining brightly.
After pondering for a while.
Wang Shouzhe decided to first take Wang Lici to the gambling stone market in the Commandery and reap a big stash; that way they could eat more confidently.
Coming this far, the gambling stone market at each Guardian City is Wang Shouzhe’s recurring agenda. Taking a big haul leaves the market likely unable to recover its Primordial Qi for several years.
Some large gambling stone stalls’ owners will likely end up seriously damaged.
Honestly, without those Spirit Stones.
With Wang Shouzhe’s wealth, he would surely feel a bit uncertain.
Fortunately, this troublesome child is about to go to the Academy to study; the Academy is responsible for the food and lodging of core and direct disciples.
At this thought.
Wang Shouzhe actually felt a sense of ease that comes with removing a heavy burden off his shoulders.
...
(Continuing to request monthly votes)

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 26: Wang Shouzhe! Searching high and low only to find it effortlessly
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 26: Wang Shouzhe! Searching high and low only to find it effortlessly
...
Just as Wang Shouzhe and his group were getting ready to go out shopping.
A man in his thirties came to visit. He had also appeared at the welcoming banquet the night before, and his name was Wang Shouxin.
That’s right.
His name was the same as Wang Shouzhe’s spirit shield.
At the time, the junior members of the Wang Family looked at him with astonished expressions. Because Wang Shouzhe’s upper grade spirit shield was also called the "Heart Guard Shield."
The name wasn’t a big problem, it was just a duplicate.
The issue was that the shield also had a nickname, called "Pot Lid." At the time, Wang Shouzhe had jokingly given it this name, and before long, the nickname "Pot Lid" was spread by the siblings.
As a result, whenever they saw Wang Shouxin, their glances were somewhat subtly peculiar.
Being stared at by his younger brothers and sisters made Wang Shouxin feel uneasy. After checking his own appearance, it seemed like there wasn’t anything wrong with his attire today?
Moreover, these younger siblings had been giving him odd looks since the banquet that evening.
Could it be that they admired him?
Suppressing the joyful distractions in his mind, he gracefully cupped his hands towards Wang Shouzhe: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I have been instructed by the Clan Leader to act as a guide, to show you and the younger ones around Longzuo County City, and in a couple of days, take everyone to the Academy."
This Wang Shouxin was not an ordinary clansman, but one of the outstanding talents of the young generation in the Longzuo Wang Family.
He entered the Academy at the age of eighteen.
Around the age of thirty, he achieved the Spirit Platform Realm with the support of the family and the Academy.
Now at thirty-five, he has garnered significant attention from the Academy, with the potential to be taken in as a core disciple. This was the family brother in the Academy previously mentioned by Wang Shouyue.
Once he grows stronger, he could become a mutual ally to the Longzuo Wang Family, bringing its development to new heights.
Such an exceptional person was naturally recently called back by the Longzuo Wang Family.
The purpose was to host Wang Shouzhe and others, showcasing the foundation of the Longzuo Wang Family, to prevent them from being underestimated by the Ping’an Wang Family.
"Thank you for accompanying us, Brother Shouxin." Wang Shouzhe returned the gesture politely.
Longzuo County City was vast. With the local bully Wang Shouxin accompanying them, everything became convenient and there was no need to wander aimlessly.
Accompanied by Wang Shouxin, everyone joyfully played around in Longzuo County City.
Additionally, Wang Shouxin was mature and steady, cheerful and talkative, sharing the tales and interesting stories of each place they visited, greatly expanding everyone’s knowledge.
Lici’s maid, on the other hand, was fixated on the food stalls, never missing a chance to savor the flavors wherever they went.
"Younger Brother Shouzhe, I heard from your wife that you need to buy a couple of suitable outfits," as everyone continued shopping, Wang Shouxin pointed to a large clothing shop, "This shop is the best in Longzuo County, run by the Celestial Human Family, the Zhous. The Zhou family excels at tailoring, with several master seamstresses within the family."
Wang Shouzhe was familiar with the Zhou family.
He had commissioned his wedding attire through Qiaan’s Trading Company, made at this Zhou’s Clothing Shop.
While the price was steep, the quality was indeed excellent.
Wang Shouzhe understood his wife Liua Ruolan’s intention; she was concerned for her sisters and niece, wanting to buy them some high-quality clothes before they entered the Academy.
"Then, my dear, accompany your sisters on a good shopping trip. For Lici’s clothes, you decide," Wang Shouzhe said. "We passed by the Gambling Stone Workshop earlier, and I heard it’s the largest in Longzuo County. I’ll take Lici there for some fun."
Liua Ruolan naturally understood her husband’s meaning, and gracefully replied, "Husband, go play if you like. I’ll see to things here."
Wang Shouxin slightly furrowed his brow, subtly reminding, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, as they say, nine out of ten bets are losses. Gambling stones mostly result in losses, usually only undertaken by loose cultivators or gamblers looking to take a risk."
Wang Shouzhe praised silently.
The Longzuo Wang Family was indeed a millennium-old noble family; even if it had fallen on hard times, the family discipline was still commendable.
"Thank you, Brother Shouxin, for the reminder. I’ll trouble you to accompany Ruolan and the others here," Wang Shouzhe smiled and said, "I’m just taking Lici to casually buy a couple of pieces and have some fun."
With that, Wang Shouxin naturally agreed to the arrangement.
Soon after, Wang Shouzhe took Wang Lici to the largest Gambling Stone Workshop, and after more than a half hour, he and Wang Lici left the workshop together.
By now, the process was already second nature to the uncle and niece duo.
No wonder Longzuo County City was so well-resourced.
Wang Shouzhe’s face was filled with satisfaction as he patted the storage ring in his hand. Although the gambling stones hadn’t been opened yet, Lici’s maid had never failed before.
She could be called the Golden Eyes of the gambling stone world.
They returned to the clothing shop.
Over an hour later, Liua Ruolan finally completed the shopping task.
Apart from buying a couple of fine Spiritual Silkworm silk clothes for those going to the Academy and her husband, she especially picked out two sets for Ancestor Longyan.
With more than a dozen sets of expensive Spiritual Silkworm silk clothing, the transaction was completed without batting an eye, instantly turning her into a valued customer of Zhou’s Clothing Shop.
Such grandeur made Wang Shouxin’s heart tremble.
It was said that the Ping’an Wang Family was wealthy, but this was too much wealth.
By then, Wang Lici was already impatient: "Fourth Uncle, Fourth Uncle, I’m starving. Didn’t you say you’d take me to the best restaurant to eat?"
"Brother Shouxin, which is the best restaurant in Longzuo County City?" Wang Shouzhe wouldn’t go back on his word once he made a promise.
Wang Shouxin hesitated slightly and said, "The best restaurant in Longzuo County City is undoubtedly the headquarters of the Hundred Flavors Pavilion."

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 26 Wang Shouzhe! No Place to Find After Wearing Out Iron Shoes_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 26 Wang Shouzhe! No Place to Find After Wearing Out Iron Shoes_2
However, the Hundred Flavors Pavilion is already a very expensive restaurant in various cities, and the prices at its headquarters are even more astonishing. This made Wang Shouxin a bit hesitant when speaking.
Before leaving, the Patriarch stuffed him with several thousand Qian Gold, instructing him to treat the Ping’an Wang Family well. With this Qian Gold, it should be enough for a few meals at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
But it couldn’t withstand having a particularly voracious girl among the young ones of the Wang Family; whether the several thousand Qian Gold would be enough for one meal was still a question.
This made him feel somewhat uncertain.
Mentioning the Hundred Flavors Pavilion, Wang Lici’s eyes immediately lit up, her baby-fat face full of excitement: "I’ve eaten at Hundred Flavors Pavilion, the taste is excellent, just this one, just this one."
Wang Shouzhe had made promises earlier, and immediately said, "Alright, let’s go to this one."
Simultaneously, he recalled the scene from nine years ago at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion in Changning Guard. At that time, young Miss Lici was only in the Qi Refining Realm, and she almost ate up Shopkeeper Qiaan’s yearly income.
Who knows how much it would cost once she started eating without restraint this time?
Luckily, although the girl eats a lot, she can also earn a lot. Earlier, that wool shearing in the Gambling Stone Workshop could allow her to eat a few meals and have some surplus.
Once Wang Shouzhe said it like that.
Wang Shouxin also gritted his teeth and said, "Alright, let’s go to the Hundred Flavors Pavilion."
As the host, the Longzuo Wang Family naturally didn’t want to lose face, and could always report back to the Patriarch afterward for reimbursement.
With this thought, he felt more confident.
Actually, he hadn’t even realized that Wang Shouzhe had no intention of letting him foot the bill.
The group, led by Wang Shouxin, stepped into the headquarters of the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
The architecture of the Hundred Flavors Pavilion was naturally in an excellent location, and its grandeur was impressive, with extraordinarily luxurious decoration.
Ordinary independent traveling merchants only dared to look from afar, not having the courage to even enter for the cheapest dish.
The most prominent feature here was one word—[Expensive].
With some confidence, Wang Shouxin lowered his voice and introduced, "This Hundred Flavors Pavilion has a history of several hundred years, originally a major pillar industry of the former Purple Mansion Family Yuwen, spread throughout the entire Longzuo County, generating staggering annual revenues."
"However, the Yuwen Family faced a setback in the succession of the Purple Mansion over a hundred years ago, and their Purple Mansion Seed was stuck at the peak of the Celestial Human Realm, unable to progress. No further breakthroughs could be made for a while, thus making this lucrative business the target of several Purple Mansion Families."
"But the Yuwen Family was ruthless enough, paying a high price to secure a marriage with the Shangguan Family’s direct daughter from the Capital City’s Purple Mansion Family. It was thanks to this daughter that the Hundred Flavors Pavilion regained its footing. That lady was also extremely adept at socializing, expanding the Hundred Flavors Pavilion’s business by several increments in just over a decade."
"However, it’s said that the lady is a husband-killer; not long after getting married, her husband was already dead."
These are peculiar tales and gossip.
But here at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion, Wang Shouxin was very cautious and careful when speaking.
Wang Shouzhe also sighed softly, realizing the Hundred Flavors Pavilion had such a story. Previously, it was only considered a luxurious restaurant, but now it seems without strong power, even the best industry is hard to maintain.
Thinking about it, it’s indeed so.
If there wasn’t a powerful Purple Mansion Family backing it, how could they run such a big business in every corner of Longzuo County?
With excellent disciples from the Purple Mansion Academy, led by Wang Shouxin from an established Celestial Human Family.
At the headquarters of the Hundred Flavors Pavilion, they naturally secured one of the best private rooms.
This private room was located on the second floor, connected by a corridor. Through the newly installed foreign glass window in the room, one could see the grand stage in the middle of the corridor inside the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
The Hundred Flavors Pavilion was not limited to food; it occasionally hosted performances, inviting renowned artists from various counties.
It’s said that this was initiated by that lady, a method to attract popularity.
However, evidently, Wang Lici was not interested in performances.
As soon as she entered the room, she began to busy herself with the menu, ordering liberally; this meal was one she had fought hard for, and she had to get her money’s worth.
The others naturally let her order freely; Wang Lici may not have much other talents, but when it comes to eating, none were as expert as she.
Wang Shouxin’s heart jumped as he watched, calculating whether the few thousand Qian Gold in his pocket could cover the bill.
At this moment.
A group of distinguished guests arrived at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
The shopkeeper personally led the team to welcome them. From the luxurious Cyan Scale Heavy Horse carriage alighted a graceful and charming woman.
Accompanied by her were two young men.
One was very young, just over twenty, with a clean and slightly immature face.
The other was an extraordinary young man in purple; he wore a Jade Crown and a treasure sword at his waist, appearing to be merely twenty-five or twenty-six, but his eyes were deep as cold pools, his aura reserved and undetectable—he was clearly a young and powerful Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator.
Received by the shopkeeper, the trio entered the Hundred Flavors Pavilion and headed toward upstairs private rooms.
The charming woman softly spoke to the purple-clad young man, "Young Master Chi, please look after my younger uncle once he joins the Purple Mansion Academy."
This purple-clad young man was named Chi Junjie, although he came from an eighth-grade family in the Langyou Guard,
he displayed outstanding talent and entered the Purple Mansion Academy early, and due to his excellent performance, is now heavily valued by the Academy, being considered for inclusion in the ranks of Core Disciples.
If he becomes a Core Disciple, the allocation and provision of resources will be vastly different, giving him the chance to aim for the Celestial Human Realm in the future.
Such a character, even though still young, is already impressive.
However, Chi Junjie solemnly saluted the charming woman and said, "Lady Bilian, your praise is too kind. This is something I ought to do. Besides, Younger Brother Yuwen boasts a Grade C Profound Ice Bloodline; such talent will undoubtedly stand out in the Academy soon. Perhaps I will need to rely on Younger Brother Yuwen for assistance in the future."
This woman was none other than Lady Bilian, whom Wang Shouzhe once contested over the Bone Marrow Purify Pill at the East Sea Guard’s Hundred Treasures Pavilion.
Mentioning Yuwen Jianye beside her, Lady Bilian’s enchanting face showed a hint of fondness, "Although Jianye is my younger uncle, he was very close to me since his brother died early. The child has excellent talent and bloodline but is still inexperienced and shy in conduct. With Junjie’s care at the Academy, I am at ease."
However, as soon as she finished, her face darkened slightly, expressing her displeasure, "It’s a pity that I didn’t obtain the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, or Jianye’s bloodline might have advanced to Middle Grade A, securing the title of Little Celestial Pride and even competing for Direct Disciple. That detestable Wang Ziteng..."
Afterwards, she naturally investigated the situation. She learned that the private room was booked by the Eastern Sea King’s great-grandson—Tantai Heyu—and found out the boy’s name was Wang Ziteng, from a strong noble family in Lingbei County.
Her anger wasn’t solely due to the Bone Marrow Purify Pill being snatched. After all, it was a fair auction, and of course, the highest bidder wins.
The indignation and hatred stemmed from her "enthusiastic invitation" for potential friendship being dismissed casually.
That "Wang Ziteng" nonchalantly replied.
"We are destined to not meet!"
That was too dismissive of her.
Lingbei County was remote and far away, even if she was displeased, she couldn’t reach her hands there.
Thus, she could only remain aggrieved till now.
Suddenly! At this moment.
From an upper private room by the corridor came a gentle and pleasing male voice: "Wang Lici, have you ordered enough? Let your fourth aunt order some of her favorites."
"No need, no need, Lici can order." A pleasant female voice said, "She has already ordered quite a few that I love, this Big Girl is just so considerate. Fourth Aunt adores you."
"Thank you, Fourth Aunt, Fourth Aunt is the best."
This was a very normal conversation.
But when it fell into Lady Bilian’s ears, her delicate body trembled heavily, and her eyes sparkled with brilliance.
A mixture of anger and inexplicable excitement surged in her mind.
"Wang Ziteng!!!"
This voice she has dreamt of, dreamt many times, so familiar and "intimate."
This was exactly searching high and low, only to find it effortlessly!
She truly wanted to laugh heartily, hahaha, Wang Ziteng, oh Wang Ziteng.
That you would fall into my hands, wait and see how I deal with you!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 27: Shocked! Someone Paid the Bill
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 27: Shocked! Someone Paid the Bill
...
"Shopkeeper, who are the people in this private room?" Lady Bilian suppressed the anger in her heart, and her tone instead became calm.
This was exactly her strength.
Before she had clear information, she was resolute about not offending those she couldn’t afford to offend. Moreover, she was highly adept in socializing, enjoying befriending various young elites.
The shopkeeper immediately summoned the servant in charge of this private room. After understanding the situation, he replied to Lady Bilian, "Madam, this private room was reserved by Wang Shouxin of the Longzuo Wang Family. It’s an established Celestial Human Family. Wang Shouxin is also an outstanding disciple of the younger generation in the Purple Mansion Academy. It’s said he has the potential to compete for the position of a core disciple."
"Wang Shouxin should be hosting esteemed guests, and it’s said that the order is quite expensive."
Celestial Human Family? Core disciple potential? Hosting esteemed guests?
Lady Bilian’s eyes slightly brightened as she glanced at Young Master Chi, "Does Young Master Chi recognize this Wang Shouxin?"
At the mention of Wang Shouxin’s name, Chi Junjie’s expression became solemn, and with a slight hint of hostility, he said, "Wang Shouxin and I both study under Master Xuan Yao. We are of similar age and talent. However, he is said to come from a Celestial Human Family, receiving more resources from his family, making him slightly more powerful than me."
Although his words showed some discontent towards Wang Shouxin, he answered truthfully.
"So, he’s indeed a young elite." Lady Bilian’s eyes slightly shifted, yet her expression soon turned a bit fierce again, clearly recalling some displeasing matters.
After a brief consideration, she felt that the opponent was one she could provoke, and immediately pushed the door open, her sharp gaze swept across everyone in the room.
Inside the room, there were four women and three men.
Her gaze first swept over the four women.
Hmm?
Immediately, Lady Bilian was slightly taken aback.
Among these four ladies, three were dressed as unmarried maidens, while the other was a beautiful young woman. They were all quite youthful.
Each of them was endowed with natural grace and exceptional temperament, as if phoenixes gathering together.
It was no wonder, Lady Bilian had no idea whatsoever.
All four of them actually possessed upper grade bloodline talent.
The stronger the bloodline, the closer it leaned towards a certain type of perfection, naturally reflected in their appearance.
Of course, it does not mean that everyone who looks good has a strong bloodline. In fact, many good-looking people are merely outwardly appealing while inwardly flawed.
Nevertheless, the purer and stronger a bloodline becomes, it tends to enhance one’s appearance and temperament in a positive direction.
But one cannot judge the strength of a person’s bloodline based solely on their appearance.
Seeing these four treasure-like ladies, Lady Bilian’s already displeased mood turned several degrees worse.
Then she looked at the three men.
Two of the young men were meticulously dressed, full of spirit and extraordinary air, akin to dragons among men.
Especially the younger one.
He was handsome and dashing, his demeanor calm and composed, exuding a natural gravitas.
From his bearing and seating position, it was clear that he was someone accustomed to holding high positions.
As for the sixteen or seventeen-year-old boy, muscular and robust like a young bull, sitting there with a naive and honest expression. This lad could be ignored; he was definitely not Wang Ziteng.
As Lady Bilian was nonchalantly observing the crowd.
Everyone’s gaze also fell on Lady Bilian and her entourage.
Wang Shouzhe slightly furrowed his brows, speaking neither hastily nor slowly, "Have you all entered the wrong private room?"
As soon as his voice rose.
It immediately pricked Lady Bilian, her eyes fixed fiercely on Wang Shouzhe, sneering, "So it’s you, Wang Ziteng."
Wang Ziteng?
The Wang Family were all looking at each other in confusion, this must be a case of mistaken identity, right?
Even Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised, Wang Ziteng? Wasn’t that the name he casually made up to hide his identity while shopping in the East Sea Guard?
Immediately.
He scrutinized Lady Bilian, curiously asking, "This...elder sister, do we know each other?" In a brief instant, he managed to swallow back the words aunt or old lady, and chose a word he deemed more suitable.
Elder sister?
Lady Bilian’s anger couldn’t help but flare up again. She was inherently not someone with a good temper, be it at her maternal or marital family, and even in the business world, she was almost always deferred to.
She had never heard anyone call her with the words elder sister before.
Furthermore, this Wang Ziteng didn’t have the slightest impression of her, how could she, who deemed her charm unparalleled, tolerate it?
"Wang, you did such and such in the East Sea Guard to me," Lady Bilian said with a bitter smile, "I thought you would have fled back to Lingbei County, but I never expected to run into you here."
Did such and such?
Then the gaze of the Wang Family all turned towards Wang Shouzhe, their expressions somewhat complex.
Yet Liua Ruolan remained unfazed, naturally aware of her husband’s temperament. While she couldn’t guarantee he would never stray, she was certain this type was not to his liking.
"Oh~" Wang Shouzhe suddenly recalled, "You are the one, in the Hundred Treasures Pavilion, yes, right, Lady Biluo. It’s you, a pleasure to meet you."
"It’s Lady Bilian," Lady Bilian corrected through gritted teeth.
"Right, right, I remember now," Wang Shouzhe nodded solemnly, "It’s Lady Bilian, a pleasure to meet you."
Then he looked at her quizzically, "Is there something you needed with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 27 Shock! Someone Pays the Bill_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 27 Shock! Someone Pays the Bill_2
"Looking for you for something?" Lady Bilian, with a simmering anger inside her, smiled even more enchantingly, "Last time I invited Young Master Wang for a chat, but to no avail. Since you’ve come to my shop today, as the host, I naturally have to entertain you."
Host?
Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised: "Turns out you are the one from the Yuwen Family..." If it weren’t for Wang Shouxin’s introduction earlier, he really wouldn’t have known that Lady Bilian was the owner of the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
"Indeed, it’s me." Lady Bilian sneered a couple of times and said, "I wonder if I have the qualifications now to invite Young Master Wang for a meal?"
"Thank you for your kindness, madam. But we have no reason or connection, better forget it. I can afford this meal myself." Wang Shouzhe more or less knew that this woman wasn’t reputable and didn’t want anything entangled with her.
Then Liu Ruolan secretly gave her husband a look, seemingly praising him silently, husband is so obedient.
Although Lady Bilian was fuming, she was ultimately born a merchant. Seeing this group all wearing various Spiritual Silkworm Robes, especially that couple, each wearing a Storage Ring, all signs indicated that this Wang Ziteng might have significant background.
Yet her temper wasn’t small.
Even if not wanting to become mortal enemies with the other party, she still needed to vent some anger. Her eyes rolled: "Young Master Wang, if you don’t want to invite me for a meal, that’s fine. But tell me, who did you use my Bone Marrow Purify Pill for back then? At least let me meet the young prodigy worthy of using the Bone Marrow Purify Pill. So that my family’s Yuwen Jianye can see and give up their hopes."
Then her eyes started rolling towards those young people.
Who was the Bone Marrow Purify Pill used for? Of course, it was used for myself.
However, Wang Shouzhe naturally wouldn’t tell her, then he looked at the two young men behind Lady Bilian.
One of them, in his twenties, looked quite extraordinary, this one was likely the Yuwen Jianye she mentioned.
Wang Shouzhe praised: "This young man looks quite nice, full of spiritual energy, madam indeed bore a good son."
Goddamn son!
Lady Bilian’s face turned black, she angrily said: "Wang Ziteng, don’t speak nonsense, this is my brother-in-law."
"Oh, so it’s your brother-in-law." Wang Shouzhe casually replied, "Quite nice, this kid. However, Bone Marrow Purify Pill, the highest bidder wins."
Secretly thought that this kid, besides being somewhat shy, had no major flaws. Under Qi Observation Technique, it was found that despite his young age, he had already reached the eighth layer of Qi Refining Realm.
Clearly, both his bloodline and resources were extraordinary, no wonder they’re anxious to buy him the Bone Marrow Purify Pill.
The Wang Family were not easy to see through. Three Spirit Platform Realm were wearing high-level Breath Concealment Pendants. Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and Wang Zongsheng were wearing regular Concealing Breath Pendants.
Unless one’s cultivation realm surpasses by a large margin or their aura explodes, otherwise it was really difficult to judge their strength.
"Hmph. What you said makes sense, but I still feel unsatisfied." Lady Bilian’s eyes rolled and she said, "How about this, I see the young ones in your family, are they also hoping to join the Academy?"
"Why not let him and my brother-in-law have a duel? As long as someone of similar age can beat him, I’ll waive all your bills today and offer a voucher worth 3000 Qian Gold as a gift. It’s not me treating you, it’s you winning it yourselves."
"Waived the bill?" Wang Shouzhe looked puzzled, reminded, "Madam should know how much our bill is? We haven’t ordered enough dishes, later we’ll add more."
"I don’t care how much your bill is, add or not!! As long as you order on the spot and eat on the spot, without packing to go. No matter how much it amounts to, it’s on me." Lady Bilian looked as if she wasn’t bothered by thousands or even tens of thousands of Qian Gold.
"This..." Wang Shouzhe hesitated, feeling somewhat tempted.
Honestly, this meal wasn’t a small amount.
Before he could make a decision.
Wang Luqiu jumped out and said: "Fourth brother, why are you dilly-dallying, isn’t it just a fight, and we can waive the bill? Where can you find such a good thing? Let’s fight quickly and not delay our meal."
She rolled up her sleeves as if ready to start.
Joking, she was planning to dominate the era and beat the Celestial Pride at the Academy. A guy who hasn’t even entered the Academy, what’s there to be afraid of?
"Sixth aunt, he said anyone of similar age is welcome." Wang Zongsheng stood up and said, "Why don’t I try him first, give me a chance to practice a bit."
Don’t be fooled by his muscular appearance, but he’s actually the son of the businessman Wang Shouyi, having been influenced by his smartness since childhood.
He’s unlike his rough appearance, those who underestimate him will suffer. Even that Nine Chapters of Mathematics he studied since childhood had started to surpass the Shou generation.
At this time, Wang Shouxin hurried and said: "Shou... younger brother. If you don’t want to compete, we can refuse. I don’t believe there’s anyone in Longzuo County City who dares to forcibly coerce someone into fighting?"
His two identities were not insignificant, once serious they were quite influential.
"What’s Ruolan’s opinion?" Wang Shouzhe still looked at Liu Ruolan.
"Husband, since Zongsheng and Luqiu want to play, let them go." Liu Ruolan had little good feeling towards Lady Bilian. Since she was offering her neck for a chop.
She, Liu Ruolan, the money-manager Mrs. Wang, didn’t mind saving some money for the family.
Although the Wang Family was wealthy now, the expenses remained substantial, saving wherever possible.
"Alright, be mindful, don’t go too far." Wang Shouzhe pondered and agreed. After all, these kids would soon study at the Academy. As a brother and uncle, he couldn’t always take care of them.
They also need their own training to truly grow up.
"Aunt, could you bring my weapons out?" Wang Zongsheng respectfully said.
Because of shopping and dining, Liu Ruolan conveniently stored his weapons.
Immediately, she gracefully brushed her hand, and two hefty Eight-sided Hammers appeared in her hand, she gently handed them to Wang Zongsheng and said: "You’re good in everything, just that your weapons are too heavy."
Wang Zongsheng with those two Eight-sided Hammers, didn’t dare to reply to Liu Ruolan.
Secretly thought, Aunt if you get angry, you’ll complain about it being too light. In the family, the highest status naturally belonged to Aunt. She earned that fame.
Then they all went to the center stage of the Hundred Flavors Pavilion, the stage was extremely sturdy and often hosted martial competitions and fights.
Wang Zongsheng was first to jump onto the stage, the two hammers in his hands maneuvered effortlessly, showing great power, even causing the air to explode with a bang.
"Nice!"
This stirred quite a few diners, it looked lively. Seeing Wang Zongsheng’s display, many began cheering.
Those dining at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion headquarters were either rich or noble, their judgment was impressive.
This kid looked only sixteen or seventeen, yet the aura he unleashed was strong, his strength was astonishing.
After some inquiries, it was understood there was a bet.
The Daqian Kingdom has various laws, always prohibiting private fights.
However, if both parties agreed to compete for victory, it was encouraged and promoted. Such competitions often ended when one party conceded and usually included some stakes to add excitement.
"Whose child is this?" A Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, slightly shocked, said, "He’s already at the seventh layer of Qi Refining Realm! Moreover, the strength, he must have awakened some War Body bloodline, right? Much stronger than when I was young."
"Heard he’s related to the Longzuo Wang Family." Someone responded, "It’s the season when the Academy starts recruiting disciples, presumably sending him to the Academy."
"This kid, as long as he maintains momentum, won’t miss being a core disciple at the Academy."
People talked endlessly, these diners weren’t ordinary people, many had great vision.
Thus.
Lady Bilian’s group also showed serious expressions.
Unexpectedly, this simple-looking kid wore the Concealing Breath Pendant, really misjudged.
"Jianye." Lady Bilian solemnly said, "That kid looks tough, if you can’t beat him, let’s forget it."
"Sister-in-law, I can give it a try." Yuwen Jianye said shyly, then he stepped onto the stage.
Suddenly!
In the last few steps, his aura changed.
With each step, the air around him seemed to freeze, frost formed into clusters of snowflakes, swirling around his body.
"Profound Ice Bloodline!"
Many diners whispered in awe.
Lady Bilian also showed pride on her face, this brother-in-law was nurtured by her.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 28: Dominance! The Tone of the Young Empress
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 28: Dominance! The Tone of the Young Empress
...
The Profound Ice Bloodline is one of the three major abnormal attributes, always known for its powerful combat strength.
At the same level, its destructive power is somewhat stronger.
"Qi Refining Realm, Eighth Layer, Profound Ice Bloodline." Some diners were discussing endlessly, "I heard this young man is called Yuwen Jianye, a direct lineage of the Yuwen Family. Truly impressive, they haven’t disgraced their ancestors."
Even Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised: "I didn’t expect this shy young man to have the Profound Ice Bloodline. I’m afraid our Zongsheng may face some trouble."
"Our Zongsheng also has the War Body Bloodline." Liu Ruolan said, "But he is still young and has great potential for growth in the future."
Wang Zongsheng is one of the outstanding males of the young generation in the Wang Family. His talent is not lacking, and along with the rapid family development over the years, the overall resources have increased.
Therefore, my second brother Wang Shouyi has been desperately expanding the fish stall business, earning a lot of money for the family while also gaining a large amount of contribution points. The couple exchanged many Heavenly and Earthly Treasures to improve Wang Zongsheng’s bloodline talent.
The Shouzhe couple also secretly assisted their nephew significantly. After all, the girls in the family were too outstanding, causing an imbalance, and some excellent boys were needed to hold the fort.
As a result, his bloodline has reached Middle Grade D. Compared with Ancestor Longyan when she first entered the Academy, it’s not lacking too much.
Mainly because the child himself is hardworking and willing to progress.
At the same time.
On the arena, Wang Zongsheng instead showed excitement at the sight of a worthy opponent. Holding two eight-sided hammers, he assumed a fighting stance: "Ping’an Wang Family’s Wang Zongsheng, please instruct me."
Over the years, the family has accumulated many cultivation methods and various Black Tortoise Combat Techniques, greatly enriching the Library Pavilion. After all, relying solely on what the ancestors passed down was no longer sufficient.
Thus, many young lads emerged in the family, liking to cultivate peculiar Black Tortoise Combat Techniques.
Wang Zongsheng is a typical example. While cultivating Wang’s Profound Origin Technique, he also cultivates body tempering and refining techniques to further unleash his powerful combat body bloodline with full force.
"Longzuo Yuwen Family’s Yuwen Jianye, please instruct me." Saying this, he drew a delicate long sword with a gleaming ice blade. Obviously, this sword, even if not a Spiritual Artifact, is of excellent quality.
"Roar!"
Wang Zongsheng let out a loud roar and charged forward first. With each step, his foot landed like a Wild Ox stomping the ground.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
It made a sound like heavy drums beating, as if pounding on people’s hearts, instantly giving the sense of a fierce heavy beast charging straight at them.
In almost the blink of an eye, he rushed to Yuwen Jianye’s front, spreading his arms wide and clamping down fiercely, the two heavy hammers whistling as they came crashing together from both sides.
This clamping blow!
If Yuwen Jianye got clamped by it, he might not die but would at least be seriously injured.
But he was ultimately no easy prey, displaying his body technique, his posture agile like a rabbit, swiftly retreating backward.
"Clang!"
The sound of metal clashing rang out, deep and resonant, mingled with profound qi shockwaves spreading outward, making people’s eardrums ache.
Fierce!
Don’t look at Wang Zongsheng’s usually simple and honest appearance, but once he gets into a fight, he becomes as fierce as an unparalleled brave general on the battlefield. Every move exudes immense power, neat and clean, yet carrying terrifying lethality.
"Good."
The knowledgeable diners all cheered. This unheard-of Ping’an Wang Family lad fought so dominantly and fiercely it made people’s blood boil, truly a great seedling.
However, that Yuwen Jianye was also seemingly remarkable, not confronting Wang Zongsheng directly but relying on a more agile and swift body technique to keep moving. Meanwhile, as his long sword danced, the profound ice ability in his bloodline was triggered, making the surrounding air increasingly cold.
Especially on the arena floor, unknowingly, a layer of frost formed. Unlike Ancestor Longyan, who could freeze a river surface of several yards with one sword, under his sword aura, the entire arena gradually turned into an icy world.
Gradually, Wang Zongsheng’s body became increasingly stiff, his movements slower. A thin layer of frost covered his clothes, face, and head, the cold biting, as if to freeze his blood.
"Roar!"
Wang Zongsheng roared again, under the catalysis of his war body, his bloodline boiled up, instantly turning all the frost into white vapor. His movements became rapid and fierce once more.
Clang, clang. His hammers smashed onto the ground.
A good arena was pitted all over by him, with shattered stones flying about. It also forced Yuwen Jianye to dodge embarrassingly.
Lady Bilian scolded angrily: "Is that wild ox boy of yours here for a friendly competition or to wreck the arena? Doesn’t it cost money to repair the arena?"
"If madam worries about the arena costs, I’ll cover them." Wang Shouzhe casually tossed out two thousand Gold Notes, which flew towards Lady Bilian in the air, saying aloud, "Zongsheng, fight well. Even if you tear down the entire Hundred Flavors Pavilion, your Fourth Uncle can afford it."
Wang Shouzhe is also protective of his kin. How could his family’s child be underestimated outside?
Moreover, this statement, filled with unparalleled grandeur, immediately overwhelmed Lady Bilian.
"You..." Lady Bilian was furious with embarrassment, and threw the two Gold Notes back, scolding angrily, "Wang, so what if you have money? We’ll repair our own arena."
By comparison, her momentum was somewhat lacking.
