It was quite apparent that she knew that Wang could afford it. Having lived so long, it was the first time someone threw money at her like this. Usually, it was her throwing money at others.
Many wealthy and influential diners were surprised, looking at Wang Shouzhe. Goodness, which family is this? So grand and generous, even Lady Bilian didn’t dare to challenge him.
"Yes, Fourth Uncle." Wang Zongsheng, feeling supported by his fourth uncle, was instantly revitalized, his blood boiling.
He charged at Yuwen Jianye with a fierce cry once again! The arena was being destroyed by him, torn to pieces.
The diners all praised him, saying that this kid was only at the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, yet so fierce. Imagine what would happen if one day he reached the Spirit Platform Realm. Wouldn’t he demolish the entire arena with a few hammers?
The fight actually lasted for a full two or three quarters of an hour.
Ultimately, Wang Zongsheng was still too young. His cultivation foundation was insufficient, and as he fought, his Profound Qi depleted. On the other hand, Yuwen Jianye, who seemed a bit shy, was also very smart, constantly dodging his sharpened attacks. When he noticed his opponent’s decline, he intensified his counterattacks.
Clang, clang, clang. Sword Aura enveloped Wang Zongsheng, leaving him only with the strength to defend.
After a while, Wang Zongsheng finally couldn’t hold on any longer and conceded defeat.
"Good." Lady Bilian let out a cheer of joy. Although the process was tough, winning in the end was a breath of relief for her. Then she went on stage, feeding her brother-in-law a Peiyuan Pill and helping him wipe off sweat and fan him.
One would wonder if she was raising her brother-in-law like a son?
Keen-eyed diners also showered praise. Whether it was Yuwen Jianye or Wang Zongsheng, both were quite extraordinary, especially since Wang Zongsheng was very young and already Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
The fact that he could fight for so long against Yuwen Jianye, who was at the Eighth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, was already quite outstanding.
"Fourth Uncle, I lost." Wang Zongsheng looked somewhat dejected as he stepped down from the arena. He had fought against Eighth Layer Qi Refining Realm Loose Cultivators before and had easily defeated them numerous times, even winning against Ninth Layer opponents.
But he didn’t expect Yuwen Jianye to be so difficult, making him lose without any room for maneuver.
"You’ve done pretty well already." Wang Shouzhe patted his shoulder and said, "That Yuwen Jianye has extraordinary bloodline, a solid foundation, and exceeds you in age and cultivation. If you were the same age, he might not necessarily be able to beat you."
Wang Shouzhe’s words were not purely for comfort. In his view, Yuwen Jianye’s strength was comparable to that of the demon puppets in the first stage of the Trial Ground, truly not weak.
As for Wang Zongsheng, if he were to tackle the first stage, he would still be lacking quite a bit of seasoning.
"Zongsheng nephew, overall you’re doing fine; it’s just that your body technique is imposing but not fast enough," Wang Luqiu stepped forward and said, "I’m not asking you to be fast all the time, but you at least need to cultivate a body technique with fast explosive moves. When you return to the academy, find one properly. I’ll help you with special training. Your Sixth Aunt knows quite a bit about this eel-like flow."
As she spoke, she glanced inadvertently at Wang Luojing, evidently considering her the big boss of the eel-like flow, and feeling that Yuwen Jianye was still a bit inexperienced.
"Hmph! Zongsheng, don’t listen to her nonsense. Fifth Aunt will do special training with you," Wang Luojing sneered, "Fourth Brother says this is called kite flow."
"Whatever eel-like or kite flow it is. Nephew Zongsheng, listen to your Sixth Aunt: when you encounter such people, there’s only one word, ’smash them in a slap.’"
"Thank you Fifth Aunt, Sixth Aunt, for your guidance," Wang Zongsheng said respectfully, yet in his heart, he was sweating. How was he going to get through academy life if these two aunts were to train him together?
Moreover, these two aunts are no easy opponents, and their methods are way too ruthless.
"Zongsheng is quite fortunate," Liu Ruolan chuckled on the side, "to have two aunts and a cousin accompanying you to school, you’ll definitely be safe from bullying."
"Haha," Wang Zongsheng laughed sheepishly. At least on the surface, he appeared quite fortunate, "Auntie, cousin, and sister-in-law are all good people."
"Alright, alright, no need for flattery,"
Wang Luqiu said somewhat impatiently, "If it weren’t to toughen you up, we would’ve been having our meal already."
With that, she clasped her hands behind her back and walked step by step onto the arena.
She then glanced at Lady Bilian and said indifferently, "Auntie, can you leave the stage now? Don’t delay our spar."
"Little girl, who are you calling auntie?" Lady Bilian was quite riled up, "My family’s Jianye just had a fierce battle, you have to let him recover his Profound Qi, otherwise, wouldn’t your win be unfair?"
"No need, his Profound Qi is sufficient," Wang Luqiu held up three fingers, her expression serene, "Three moves!"
"What do you mean?" Lady Bilian was a bit baffled.
"If after three moves, I still can’t win," Wang Luqiu’s eyes were calm like still water, as if stating a fact, "then consider it his victory."
What?
All the diners were stunned. This little girl was too arrogant.
Wang Shouzhe also covered his forehead in exasperation. This troublesome girl had to put on a show before each battle. She could never change that, could she?
However, her momentum wasn’t bad either. Quite in the style of a young empress.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 29: Scheming! Dominating the Purple Mansion Academy
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 29: Scheming! Dominating the Purple Mansion Academy
...
But Wang Shouzhe had to admit that his sister Luqiu not only had great talent, but her determination was also very firm.
In the entire family, when it came to cultivating, she was the most hardworking. The boasting she did as a child, she has always been moving steadfastly in that direction.
Just for this alone, Wang Shouzhe secretly admired her.
Three moves?
Lady Bilian’s eyes brightened. This little girl sure can boast. However, instead of being angry, she was pleased, and agreed right away, saying, "Alright, then three moves. I want to see how capable you are, little girl!"
If Jianye won two battles in a row, let’s see what Wang Ziteng would have to say then.
"Wait!"
Just at that moment.
A deep voice sounded, and on the side of the arena, an old and a young man appeared.
Among them, the older man carried himself with extraordinary demeanor, walking with hands behind his back like a dragon or a tiger, clearly a person of long-standing authority.
The younger one, though only in his early twenties.
He was quite handsome, but his eyes were evasive and lacked confidence.
The appearance of these two.
Lady Bilian was momentarily stunned but soon chuckled coquettishly: "Oh, I thought who it was, turns out to be Liu Kangping from the Chuyun Liu Family. What, do you want to take your son to the Academy too? But too bad, your son only has a Lower Grade D-level talent. Even if he barely makes it into the Academy, he’ll just be idling away his days without much future."
In fact, any noble family, even celestial human families, would have some direct lineage with poor talent.
They pull some strings and lean on face, and the Academy might accept them as disciples.
Moreover, such people were not few in the Academy, the most typical example was Zhong Xingwang, whom Wang Shouzhe knew, a bottom-level ordinary disciple in the Academy.
However, having a Lower Grade D-level talent was truly too low. If it were any other family, they might give up on this child. As Lady Bilian would say, it would be better to have another one.
Yet, for some reason, Liu Kangping continued to invest significant resources in this child, gradually raising his aptitude and sparing no effort in elevating his cultivation. Even the clan had some resentment toward him because of that.
As a result, his good-for-nothing son’s name was spread across several nearby cities.
"Lower Grade D-level?" A trace of sarcasm appeared in Liu Kangping’s eyes, "My son Yunlang, show Aunt Bilian your current bloodline talent. Lest some people look down on you all day long."
The somewhat unconfident young man, Liu Yunlang, took a deep breath and straightened his expression. Then, he activated his profound qi, and a faint Cyan Wood aura circled around his palm, the vitality of the qi was like the green of early spring, making people feel a sense of warmth.
Wood Bloodline?
Lady Bilian’s eyes froze: "This, how is it possible?"
Some spectators also lit up their eyes, today, it seems they’ve gained a little insight. In this small place, many young talents were gathered.
Although Liu Yunlang relied on the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, the fact that he could acquire one was already a significant achievement.
Most celestial human families could hardly afford the Bone Marrow Purify Pill without harming their primordial qi.
Furthermore, it was well known.
If one awakened a first-tier bloodline under the Spirit Platform Realm first. Upon advancing through the Spirit Platform Realm, their physique evolved, life level leaped, and then they could further enhance their bloodline once more.
With such a level, one could hope to compete for the position of a core disciple, having some qualification to walk the Path of Celestial Human.
"Hahaha, why would it be impossible." Liu Kangping laughed heartily with pride, "Since we parted ways at the East Sea Guard last time, I spared no effort. Managed to obtain from Master Dan Ding his last Bone Marrow Purify Pill."
Lady Bilian was even more shocked: "What? You could actually reach Master Dan Ding’s path?"
Liu Kangping was full of pride and said, "Just because your Yuwen Family has this and that connections? Our Chuyun Liu Family, being an old noble family with a thousand-year history, naturally has our own heritage." His heart was full of joy; his youngest son’s talent always was his concern.
Moreover, he didn’t say one thing.
That was to acquire Master Dan Ding’s last Bone Marrow Purify Pill.
He spent a total of 270,000 Qian Gold, which made his heart ache. He knew if it came to it, he would have fought tooth and nail with Wang Ziteng.
Too bad he didn’t even know, Wang Shouzhe was equally determined to get that Bone Marrow Purify Pill. Never mind 270,000, even if it reached 370,000, he wouldn’t hesitate in the slightest.
Who knew how long he would have to wait for another one if this one were missed.
Moreover, Wang Shouzhe didn’t lose out; by relying on this Bone Marrow Purify Pill, plus the Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid, he not only broke into the second-tier bloodline within the Qi Refining Realm.
He successfully obtained all the rewards of the Trial Ground.
Upon advancing to the Spirit Platform Realm, he even reached the third-tier bloodline. Additionally, he acquired an Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact, along with the Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species, greatly enhancing his combat power.
Counting all the benefits, that Bone Marrow Purify Pill was definitely worth it.
"The Wood Bloodline is indeed impressive." Lady Bilian sneered coldly, "But Liu Kangping, why did you suddenly jump in now?"
"It looks like you young students are having lively sparring." Liu Kangping said, "My son Yunlang also wishes to get closer to his future classmates, and if by any chance he wins two moves against your little nephew, how about waiving one of our meals?"
He didn’t care much about a meal expense as the Clan Leader of an old Celestial Human Family, he just wanted to dampen Lady Bilian’s spirit a bit.
"Fine, after Jianye tidies up this little girl, he can spar with your son. Hopefully his Wood Bloodline resistance properties can hold on a bit longer." Lady Bilian said confidently.
"Aunt, Uncle." Wang Luqiu said helplessly, "You guys find somewhere to chat slowly later, I’m already very hungry. To save time, let’s start eating. How about both the mama’s boy and daddy’s treasure come at me together?"
Although she wasn’t able to eat as much as Wang Lici, she always valued her meals. Only with ample energy could she have the strength to cultivate and fight.
Together?
Both Lady Bilian and Liu Kangping looked at her in unison, this little girl’s tone...
"Alright." Lady Bilian said nonchalantly, "Liu Kangping, let’s have Yunlang and Jianye team up, deal with that girl first, and then spar a bit. They might develop some camaraderie, which could be useful for looking out for each other when they go to the Academy in the future."
At the end of the day, Lady Bilian was just a businesswoman. Upon seeing Liu Yunlang awaken his Wood Bloodline, she suggested Jianye make a connection with him.
Liu Kangping saw this and agreed.
There was no deep-seated hatred between them, so forming some camaraderie under the circumstances wouldn’t be a bad thing.
Then.
Wang Luqiu, Liu Yunlang, and Yuwen Jianye stood facing each other in a triangular formation.
Seeing their positions,
Wang Luqiu shook her head and sighed, "Sigh!"
"Why are you sighing?" Yuwen Jianye asked.
"I’m sighing because if you two cooperated well, you might be able to hold out for twenty moves, but now..." Wang Luqiu shook her head repeatedly, "Five moves!"
"What?"
Yuwen Jianye and Liu Yunlang’s expressions changed together. This tone...
Before they could retort, Wang Luqiu moved.
She also had War Body Bloodline, but her movements were completely different from Wang Zongsheng’s reckless Wild Ox style. With just a casual step forward, she seemed to appear right in front of Liu Yunlang, then lightly threw a punch, simple and unadorned.
It was like children playing around.
Liu Yunlang hurriedly raised his arms, a pale green Profound Qi gathering to block that punch.
Time seemed to pause at that moment.
The next instant.
"Boom!"
Liu Yunlang was like being hit head-on by a cannonball; the blast of energy shattered his defenses, his body flew uncontrollably through the air.
Before he could hit the ground.
Wang Luqiu had already gently leapt up, casually nudging him with her elbow on his chest.
"Bang!"
Liu Yunlang flew six or seven yards like a ball, falling hard to the ground, spitting blood, his eyes filled with incredulity. Who am I? Where am I?
Fortunately, Wang Luqiu spared him; otherwise, this elbow could have cracked several of his ribs!
Her fighting style was just like that—clean, efficient, directly striking at the opponent’s weak points.
Meanwhile.
Yuwen Jianye’s face changed dramatically, getting ready to rush in for rescue. But as soon as he used his agile body technique to dash into the battle zone, he found out that his teammate had already flown out of the arena.
He was left stunned on the spot, what was this? Was he seeing things?
"It’s not a good habit to get distracted during a fight," Wang Luqiu’s voice floated gently by his ear.
In an instant, she was inside his sword defense.
"Oh no." Yuwen Jianye’s heart skipped a beat, and it was too late to retreat. His chest was grabbed by her and ruthlessly flung out.
Then, Yuwen Jianye turned into a bird flying through the sky.
The same thought echoed in his head.
Who am I? Where am I? What happened?
"Bang!"
A few moments later, he crashed hard beneath the stage. Though unhurt, his face turned red.
The crowd was silent.
Even those Spirit Platform Realm spectators were a bit taken aback; this girl was too powerful, wasn’t she?
Although with her Ninth Layer Qi Refining Realm cultivation, defeating those in the Eighth Layer wasn’t unusual, doing it so cleanly as two against one seemed like the fight ended even before it began.
Truly beyond everyone’s expectations.
But Wang Luqiu acted as if she had done something very ordinary, slowly walking off the stage and told Lady Bilian, "Auntie, can we eat now?"
"You, you, you." Lady Bilian’s face turned pale.
This little girl used only three moves from the start to the end.
Could she be a Celestial Pride? No, no, Lady Bilian, born in the Capital City, had seen Celestial Prides in action, and even the average Celestial Pride wasn’t as ruthless as her!
"Let’s eat, let’s eat," Wang Shouzhe said, "Our kids are starving; let’s lead the way."
Everyone followed him back to the private room.
But Wang Luqiu glanced at the two whose faces were flushed,
Yet looked at her with eyes full of admiration, Yuwen Jianye and Liu Yunlang, and comforted them, "You have good talent, just lacking combat acumen. If you go to the Academy, you can spar with me more."
This? Wang Shouzhe slightly, hesitated uncertainly. Is Luqiu planning to recruit some followers to stir things up in the Academy?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 30: Canglan Ascendant! Subduing Others with Strength (Requesting Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 30: Canglan Ascendant! Subduing Others with Strength (Requesting Monthly Votes)
...
"Th-thank you, Miss Luqiu." The two exchanged glances, then became excited.
Undoubtedly, Wang Luqiu had just subdued them. If they could follow her in the Academy, life would surely be much easier.
Then Yuwen Jianye cautiously asked, "Miss Luqiu, can we have a meal with you?"
Wang Luqiu glanced at them, seeing the expectation in their eyes, and nodded, "Since your mom is paying, let’s all eat together."
"It’s sister-in-law!" Lady Bilian corrected through gritted teeth.
But the two young men ignored her reaction.
Instead, they happily followed Wang Luqiu, as if dining with her was their greatest honor.
The three chatted casually.
"Huh? Miss Luqiu, you’re actually a year younger than me?"
After some small talk, they became somewhat familiar. Yuwen Jianye was astonished, "Oh my, how did you cultivate like this? It’s incredible."
"Even if I’m younger, remember to call me senior sister in the future. There’s no special cultivation method, just frequent trips to the Outer Domain to fight fierce beasts." Wang Luqiu often heard Zhong Xingwang call Ancestor Longyan senior sister, and thought the title had some prestige.
"Going to the Outer Domain to fight fierce beasts?" Both Yuwen Jianye and Liu Yunlang were shocked. Are we still kids? And we’re supposed to go to the Outer Domain to fight fierce beasts!!!
This was almost impossible in Celestial Human Families.
"What’s that?" Wang Luqiu said calmly, "When I was eleven, I started life-and-death battles with loose cultivators a tier above me, and competed with wild beasts, hunting fierce beasts. Over the years, I’ve lost count of how many death-row inmates and fierce beasts I’ve defeated."
It couldn’t be helped, as the Ping’an Wang Family was on the edge of the Outer Domain, not a peaceful place. Thus, at a young age, Wang Luqiu had to shoulder the family responsibilities.
As they say, kids from poor families grow up early. Her combat instincts were honed through repeated trials.
She also liked sparring with Wang Shouzhe, and although she lost every time, she always learned many strange tactics from her fourth brother.
"You’re just... too ruthless. Senior sister it is, since you’re amazing." Yuwen Jianye and Liu Yunlang didn’t seem to object. They started calling her senior sister.
"That’s better. I’ll look after you in the Academy in the future. But you momma’s boys and daddy’s darlings need to change your habits, I can’t stand them," Wang Luqiu said.
"It’s sister-in-law..." Lady Bilian defended softly from behind.
"Huh? Aunty... why are you following? We’re having a young people’s gathering." Wang Luqiu looked at her oddly.
Then, Lady Bilian and Liu Kangping were left out, looking at each other blankly.
It felt like the younger generation they had painstakingly nurtured was about to be led astray?
To be precise, they had already been led astray.
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe was speechless. His sixth sister was truly not easy to handle.
Indeed, she was ready to recruit followers. When she enters the Academy, it won’t be peaceful.
The meal was, of course, a joyful one.
Especially for Wang Lici, who felt no worries at all, as Lady Biluo would foot the bill.
...
Several hours later.
Relaxing on the Imperial Concubine’s Couch, sipping Beauty-Enhancing Spirit Bee Honey Spirit Tea, Lady Bilian received the shopkeeper’s bill. Without even looking, she said, "I said to put it on my tab, didn’t I?"
The shopkeeper smiled wryly, "Madam, it’s best to take a look first."
Lady Bilian glanced nonchalantly, "Eating more is no big... pfft!" She spat out half a mouthful of honey tea, eyes bulging, "Are they kidding me? They packed it to go!?"
The shopkeeper shook his head, "We had servants watching, they finished it all on-site."
Lady Bilian rolled her eyes, her mind filled with &*%￥#, sinking into chaos and going blank.
Why did she have to go and provoke Wang Ziteng?
That meal made her heartache, how terrifying!
Looks like she needs to stay away from the Wang Family in the future.
No, staying far isn’t possible.
It seems our Jianye has already pledged allegiance to the little girl as their leader...
Lady Bilian felt like crying but had no tears, losing both in the process.
...
Happy times always pass in a flash.
Several days later.
The days of feasting and drinking in Longzuo County had ended.
With Ancestor Xuanfu returning from scouting ahead, she began leading everyone out of Longzuo County City, heading towards Purple Mansion Academy.
The convoy slowly exited Longzuo County City, heading north, and in just two or three days, they entered the range of Purple Mansion Academy.
Purple Mansion Academy leaned against the towering Purple Mansion Sacred Mountain, over two thousand zhang tall.
The architecture was built along a complex, massive, top-tier spirit vein among several Spirit Peaks.
Many structures were built after shaving off half of the mountains.
The architectural complex was enormous, with staggered high pavilions and lower buildings, covering an area about half the size of Changning Guard.
Wang Shouzhe saw such a vast and complex singular architectural structure for the first time.
Truly worthy of being the Purple Mansion Academy! Truly worthy of being the Black Tortoise Sacred Land within the entire Longzuo County.
Even Wang Shouzhe, the transmigrator, restrained much of his pride, not daring to underestimate the Academy in the slightest.
After half a day’s effort.
They arrived at a large plaza at the foot of the mountain.
This plaza was vast and nearly boundless. More exaggerated was the presence of innumerable people gathered here.
There were noble family descendants with their relatives and caravans, and some groups of loose cultivators.
Yet, they could not easily enter the Purple Mansion Academy.
The Academy was not a tourist attraction you could enter on a whim.
Non-Academy students must hold an invitation or a re-examination notice to enter the Academy. Moreover, they could only stay in designated areas and were not allowed to roam around.
If it weren’t for Wang Dingyue’s mishap back then, forcing Wang Shouzhe to take over the family.
He once held a re-examination notice, ready to enter the Academy for the re-exam.
However, he knew that his talent and strength at the time only gave him a fifty percent chance of passing. If Ancestor Xuanfu backed him, he could possibly slip in.
He would only be an ordinary student.
But even as ordinary students, many were eager to get in.
All for that saying, once you enter the Academy, you will surely become a Spirit Platform.
The Purple Mansion Academy wouldn’t allow those who couldn’t become Spirit Platforms to enter, nor would it allow its students not to achieve Spirit Platform.
And this time, as Wang Shouzhe arrived, the situation was vastly different. Seeing that crowded throng, he felt deeply moved within.
Then, with Ancestor Xuanfu’s care and Wang Shouxin as a core disciple,
Wang Shouzhe and his party easily entered the Academy gates.
They were assigned several guest courtyards to settle down temporarily.
...
Meanwhile
At the rear position of the Purple Mansion Academy, there was a Profound Ice Spirit Peak.
On the platform at the peak, giant gleaming white halls lay atop it, towering over fifteen hundred zhang high, with dense clouds overhead.
Perhaps due to the top-tier Profound Ice Spiritual Vein within the peak, it was perpetually snow-covered, ice-bound across a hundred li. As if enveloping the world’s cold in its entirety.
This was a hell of ice and frost for ordinary people, but for Black Tortoise practitioners cultivating Profound Ice System Techniques, this was a heaven-sent sacred land.
A massive Spirit Gathering Array securely locked the spiritual qi of the Profound Ice Spiritual Vein, entirely contributing to the whole Ice Hall.
At the highest point of the white halls.
There was a loft like an ice crystal, the core location of the entire Profound Ice Hall.
Inside this Profound Ice Attic.
A woman in a white palace gown with a veil stood by the ice-crystal rail.
Her beautiful eyes were as deep as millennia-old ice, gazing down at the base of the mountain.
The thick clouds and heavy snow around her seemed to feel her will, scattering to both sides, revealing the distant scene at the foot of the mountain.
A ray of sunlight even penetrated, casting a golden glow over the entire Ice Hall.
Just by standing there, she seemed to be the embodiment of ice and snow, merging with the entire Profound Ice Attic, even the whole Profound Ice Hall.
This level of cultivation realm.
Had surpassed the mortal body, touching upon those ethereal and mysterious truths between heaven and earth.
Behind her.
Stood a white-clothed young man, handsome and imposing, yet with an aloof demeanor, not daring to interrupt.
After a long while.
The woman in the palace gown withdrew her gaze, and the clouds and snow rolled back inside, isolating the ray of golden sunlight outside.
Her tone was as indifferent as ice, "Longyan, the child, will be arriving at the Academy in the next two days, correct? You’an, go and bring her here."
"Yes, Master." Faang You’an respectfully saluted, hesitating slightly, he said, "Master, Sister Longyan reported she cultivated Yin Sha Evil Qi..."
"I already know about that." The palace-clad woman said flatly, "Is there a problem?"
"This..." Faang You’an’s face showed unease, "Some Ascendants have opinions on recruiting Sister Longyan back into the sect. Saying our Purple Mansion Academy is the righteous way of the world, a model for Black Tortoise. Moreover, the Academy is fundamentally opposed to the Yin Sha Sect, Sister Longyan cultivating Yin Poison, she shouldn’t return to the Academy."
"Do Ascendants have opinions? Is it Changchun or Xuan Yao?" The woman’s gaze did not change, merely said indifferently, "Enough, enough, whoever it is, let them bring their opinions to me."
"I will convince them." She added lightly.
Convince, convince!
Faang You’an broke into a cold sweat, Master was still as domineering as ever, always choosing to [convince by force].
Yet, he felt some sentiment within, Sister Longyan, Sister Longyan. Master treats you so well, do not disappoint the elder.
Of course, Faang You’an also found it odd that though Sister Longyan’s talent was decent.
It shouldn’t warrant such favor from the Master, should it? Perhaps there was some underlying reason?
(Requesting monthly votes)
...

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 31: Everyone Under Changchun Ascendant’s Sect Is Talented
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 31: Everyone Under Changchun Ascendant’s Sect Is Talented
...
The next day.
After a brief rest, Wang Shouzhe and others parted ways today to take separate actions.
Most other directions were led by Ancestor Xuanfu, who grandly guided everyone along.
As for Wang Shouzhe’s side, he was led to the Eternal Spring Valley by Wang Shouxin.
In name, he was considered an outer disciple under Changchun Ascendant, and had only cultivated the Qi Refining Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique. Now that his Spirit Platform Realm was stable, getting the Spirit Platform Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique had become a priority.
Less than half an hour had passed.
Wang Shouxin led him to a spot outside a mountain cove, and upon arrival, he cupped his hands apologetically and said, "Younger Brother Shouzhe, to avoid any misunderstandings, I won’t be escorting you inside. Those under Changchun Zhenren have good tempers; a little inquiry will lead you to the Dao Transmission Hall."
Avoid misunderstandings?
Wang Shouzhe was slightly surprised but didn’t delve into it further, and returned the courtesy, "Thank you, Brother Shouxin."
Then, Wang Shouxin added, "Remember one more thing. At the Academy, regardless of background, Shouzhe, do not disclose your family background casually. Firstly, because the Academy forbids it. Secondly, to prevent family entanglements from any conflicts among students."
Wang Shouzhe had heard about this before. If you wish, you can even change your name. However, changing names is unnecessary and insignificant.
He immediately cupped his hands and said, "Brother Shouxin, I understand."
With that, the two bid farewell.
Wang Shouzhe entered the Eternal Spring Valley, and instantly, his view expanded.
This vast gorge was filled with sunlight that was bright yet not scorching.
Vegetation formed forests, lush and green, with exotic flowers swaying in the fields.
Groups of tamed Spirit Bees flitted among Spirit Flowers, collecting Spiritual Honey and spreading pollen, creating a scene filled with the sounds and scents of nature.
What a picturesque farming scene.
No, to be precise, it was an immortal farming scene.
Upon entering this valley, one felt vibrant and alive everywhere, with even the air feeling exceptionally fresh and smooth.
It’s said that this Eternal Spring Valley is seated atop a top-tier Wood Spiritual Vein. Therefore, living here for a long time has the effect of prolonging life and preventing diseases.
The disciples of Eternal Spring Valley were numerous, but each was busy with their own tasks, scattered across the fields, diligently working away. They were cultivating various Spirit Plants, Spirit Fruits, Spirit Flowers, and Spirit Grass.
Not far away, there was an old farmer in the fields.
His beard was white, wearing a bamboo hat, carefully weeding between the Spirit Fields.
Wang Shouzhe approached, cupped his hands, and said, "Esteemed teacher, may I ask the way to our Eternal Spring Valley’s Dao Transmission Hall?"
The old man glanced at Wang Shouzhe, chuckled, and said, "Young man, what are you looking for the Dao Transmission Hall for?"
Wang Shouzhe replied politely, "I am an outer disciple of Eternal Spring Valley, having cultivated to the Spirit Platform Realm. I’m here as per the rules to take the assessment and receive the Spirit Platform Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique."
As he spoke, he made a gesture, and a small wine gourd appeared in his hand, filled with several pounds of fine Spirit Wine.
He handed it to the old farmer and said, "Please, teacher, guide me."
The old man’s eyes lit up, he opened the wine gourd and took a swig, contently exhaling, "The wine is quite ordinary. But you, young man, are pretty savvy for your age, just to my liking." With that, he casually gave him directions.
After bidding farewell to the old farmer.
Wang Shouzhe followed the paths between the fields, crossing mountain streams, the Spiritual Peach Blossom Forest, Spirit Fish Pond, and so on.
After walking for half an hour, he finally reached the place the old farmer described.
This journey also allowed him to appreciate the extraordinary qualities of the Eternal Spring Valley; truly, there were Spirit Fields every three steps, with Spirit Seeds in sight everywhere.
In front of him.
Loomed an ancient and massive hall, fitting the style of the Eternal Spring Valley.
Even within its wooden corridor structure, there was lush greenery, adorned with some beautiful exotic flowers.
Above the main door of the hall, there was a large plaque, amid the vibrant flowers, vaguely revealing three large gilded characters—[Dao Transmission Hall].
"Looks like this is the place," Wang Shouzhe thought to himself.
Then, he tidied his attire and took out a mirror for a final check.
Ah, still as handsome and elegant as ever, like a jade tree in the wind. Now he was at ease.
Subsequently, he also checked the Storage Ring, filled with prepared gifts. Everything of different styles and tastes was ready to be taken out at any moment.
This is what it means to come prepared.
He had prepared multiple plans.
Even if the Senior Brother Steward of the Dao Transmission Hall intended to make things difficult, Wang Shouzhe could handle it with his skills.
"Ah~" Adults acting so responsibly.
Contemplating this, Wang Shouzhe gracefully stepped into the grand door of the Dao Transmission Hall, first glancing around.
"Oh?"
The scene inside the Dao Transmission Hall was entirely different from what he had imagined.
In his imagination, the place of imparting and transmitting knowledge ought to be dignified and grand, calm and poised, filled with a scholarly atmosphere and a sense of historical significance.
Unexpectedly.
The place was full of a pastoral style, with square boxes made of wooden boards, neatly arranged, filled with various soils, growing all kinds of crops.
Additionally, there were various small arrays, creating and simulating different temperature changes and lighting scenarios.
Near each indoor "field ridge," there would be one or two disciples dressed in Eternal Spring Valley attire, enthusiastically discussing.
Alternatively, there was someone squatting down, intently observing a plant, focused with utmost concentration.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 31: Every Disciple Under Changchun Sect Is Outstanding_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 31: Every Disciple Under Changchun Sect Is Outstanding_2
This...
Such a scene left Wang Shouzhe somewhat shocked. He truly couldn’t figure out which one was the Senior Brother Steward of Dao Transmission Hall?
In the end, he had no choice but to approach a quite attractive female disciple to inquire.
As for why not ask a male disciple? The reason was obviously quite simple.
Wang Shouzhe was so dignified and handsome. If he asked a male disciple, he might provoke jealousy, and unnecessary conflicts might arise.
Such troubles are to be avoided if possible.
"Excuse me, Senior Sister," Wang Shouzhe interrupted a girl who was planting flowers, gracefully saluting her.
"Go away, who dares..." The disturbed female disciple immediately stood up angrily, ready to scold him, but upon seeing Wang Shouzhe, she hesitated, then blushed and said softly, "Junior Brother, what do you need from me?"
Her voice was indescribably gentle, and her eyes were darting over Wang Shouzhe, occasionally blushing as she lowered her head.
This is the advantage of being handsome.
After exchanging a few pleasantries with her, Wang Shouzhe got back to the main point: "Could you tell me where the Senior Brother in charge of preaching is, Senior Sister?"
"So, you’re looking for Brother Jinshan?" The Senior Sister was slightly disappointed but replied, "I’ll take you there."
Then she led Wang Shouzhe inside, all the way to a complex field and, in annoyance, addressed a middle-aged-looking man, "Brother Jinshan, someone is looking for you."
That Brother Jinshan appeared to be around forty or fifty years old, although his actual age was unknown.
His looks were quite plain, and his eyes were a bit cunning.
His attire was equally careless, with mud splattered all over him. He glanced at Wang Shouzhe and casually asked, "Kid, what do you want?"
This attitude wasn’t very good, looking quite impatient.
This is the downside of being too handsome; it’s easy to be disliked by same-gender disciples.
Wang Shouzhe was well-prepared and first courteously said, "I am Wang Shouzhe, an outer disciple under the Eternal Spring Sect. I’ve recently advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm and would like to apply for the follow-up Spirit Platform Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique. Here is my identification plaque..."
However, before Wang Shouzhe could finish his sentence, Brother Jinshan impatiently interrupted, "Eternal Spring True Technique, follow-up technique, right? Show some aura of the Spirit Platform Realm."
Following the instruction, Wang Shouzhe operated his Profound Qi, releasing some of the Spirit Platform Realm’s aura.
Brother Jinshan nodded, then rummaged around the shabby bookshelf next to him, tossing out a book: "This is the Spirit Platform Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique. You can only read here, do not take it outside, memorize it and then talk."
Then he no longer paid attention to Wang Shouzhe, continuing his focus on his field, studying quickly maturing wheat.
Was it really this smooth?
Wang Shouzhe was somewhat taken aback, thinking this would be a difficult task.
He had prepared several alternative plans, thinking he’d have to pass multiple trials.
Alright, simple is fine.
After expressing his gratitude with a small gift to the guiding Senior Sister, Wang Shouzhe found a clean spot and devoted himself to memorizing the Spirit Platform Chapter of the Eternal Spring True Technique.
Given his third-layer bloodline awakening, his memory had greatly improved. Coupled with his meticulous nature and exceptional wisdom.
In less than an hour, he had memorized the Spirit Platform Chapter thoroughly, with ease.
Only then did he return the Spirit Platform Chapter to Brother Jinshan.
Brother Jinshan, who was about to perform an experiment, took the Spirit Platform Chapter and tossed it aside, impatiently waving at Wang Shouzhe, "Go, go, don’t disturb me, my research is at a crucial stage, about to succeed."
Wang Shouzhe glanced at his indoor experimental field, seeing several wheat plants nearing maturation. Brother Jinshan was urging the heavy Wood Profound Qi to accelerate the wheat ears into their final maturity phase.
The Wood Element Technique seemed to have the ability to accelerate plant growth, but it was quite slow. Compared to Wang Shouzhe when he awakened a sparse bloodline, it was tens of times slower.
Moreover, he was visibly struggling, with mist rising from his body, showing signs of insufficient Profound Qi.
"Eh?"
Wang Shouzhe, looking at the maturing wheat ears and robust stems, felt a sense of familiarity.
Before he could speak.
Brother Jinshan, while urging the Profound Qi, started to mutter to himself, "Hmph! I refuse to believe... This little Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species, I, Jinshan, cannot tame you. This time, you’ll surely succeed in secondary cultivation."
Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species?
Wang Shouzhe paused slightly, touched his forehead, and couldn’t help but laugh. No wonder the wheat ears looked so familiar; it was his Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species, cultivated eight or nine years ago.
This Brother Jinshan was actually trying to decipher and duplicate his Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species.
And with such biting teeth and huge resentment, he must have been researching for quite some time.
Isn’t this a waste of effort?
Then Wang Shouzhe sympathetically looked at him and couldn’t help but advise, "Senior Brother, Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species cannot be secondary cultivated from the roots..."
Brother Jinshan glared at him irritably, rolling his eyes.
"You, a little outer disciple, know nothing!? This time I’ll surely succeed."
Alright, take your time. Ah, being handsome makes one easily provoke a hot temper from a senior.
Now Wang Shouzhe decided not to leave, crossing his arms, leisurely waiting for Brother Jinshan’s final outcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 31: Everyone Under Changchun Ascendant’s Sect Is Talented_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 31: Everyone Under Changchun Ascendant’s Sect Is Talented_3
His growth speed was too slow.
Wang Shouzhe waited for a full hour, feeling bored as he watched him take several breaks in between. Consuming Peiyuan Pills, eating portable Spiritual Food, meditating to replenish Profound Qi, and so on.
Only then did he reluctantly complete the last bit of work, allowing the dozen or so Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species to fully mature.
He then excitedly and tremblingly threshed the wheat seeds, carefully soaking them in the specially prepared nutrient solution.
At this moment.
Because Senior Brother Jinshan’s experiment had reached a crucial moment, many fellow disciples gathered around, eager to witness this historic moment.
"Let you, this Outer Disciple, watch closely. I’ll show you the prowess of a core disciple under the Changchun Ascendant." He confidently conjured a surge of cyan Profound Qi.
His Profound Qi emitted a vibrant aura, as if it could promote the growth of all things, enveloping the wheat seeds in the nutrient solution.
Unexpectedly.
A quarter hour passed, then another, and Senior Brother Jinshan’s Profound Qi was depleted.
Yet, none of those dozens of wheat seeds showed any reaction.
The surrounding fellow disciples sighed regretfully, "Senior Brother Jinshan, this is another failure. It seems Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species is indeed not simple."
"Impossible, impossible! I was well-prepared this time, thought everything through thoroughly, activated its Life Factors in advance before planting, and used the most precious materials in the nutrient solution."
Unwilling to give up, he swallowed an elixir and meditated to recover his Qi.
In no time, he jumped back up to grow the wheat seeds again, but there was still no response.
This left him sweating profusely and turning pale, troubled, "What on earth is this damn Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species? Where exactly did my second cultivation go wrong?"
Wang Shouzhe thought privately, you’re here trying to crack the pirated version of my grain seed, yet mumbling curses upon failure. The awareness for intellectual property protection in this world is indeed lacking.
However, Wang Shouzhe was merely observing and confirming that it indeed couldn’t be cracked, not mocking him in any way.
These disciples in Eternal Spring Valley are genuinely dedicated in their research, and it’s said that the Insecticide Powder was also created by them.
Just as he was about to leave quietly.
Suddenly!
A shout came from outside, "Everyone hide quickly, the junior sister has arrived."
Junior Sister? Just as Wang Shouzhe was puzzled.
The fellow disciples watching immediately vanished without a trace.
Some hid inside cupboards, some buried themselves in the ground.
Even more exaggerated, someone opened a secret compartment on an indoor tree and hid inside it.
Even Senior Brother Jinshan’s expression changed drastically, hurriedly squeezing behind a bookshelf and moving two flower pots as cover.
The entire process took no more than a dozen breaths, leaving Wang Shouzhe caught off guard by the swiftness.
Just who is this junior sister to be so terrifying?
At that moment, a young lady in a green dress, appearing to be in her twenties but with an unknown actual age, rushed in. Though she was very pretty, for some reason, everyone wanted to avoid her.
She hadn’t even entered, yet her voice came through, excitedly shouting, "Dear junior brothers and sisters, I have good news for everyone. My Life Factor Fusion Technology has reached the most crucial breakthrough stage. Anyone willing to cooperate in my experiment will get secondary authorship and share..."
Upon entering and finding the Dao Transmission Hall deserted, only Wang Shouzhe was left staring at her blankly, causing her voice to stop abruptly.
There was no place for him to hide, nor did he know what to hide from.
The two stared at each other, creating a somewhat tense and awkward atmosphere.
Then, the green-dressed lady scrutinized Wang Shouzhe, full of curiosity, "Are you a new student this year?"
Wang Shouzhe gracefully cupped his hands and said, "I am Wang Shouzhe, an Outer Disciple of the Academy."
"Outer Disciple? What’s that? Never mind, never mind, seeing how gallant you are, this senior sister is giving you a chance, as long as you cooperate with my experiment and contribute your Life Factor to me."
"I will let you co-sign with me, sharing the honor and leaving your name known in history." The green-dressed lady’s eyes sparkled with excitement, "My Life Factor Fusion Technology is a groundbreaking advancement comparable to the technologies of the Divine Martial Dynasty."
From the rush of everyone escaping and hiding, it’s clear that this senior sister’s so-called experimental cooperation is absolutely not a good thing.
Wang Shouzhe shook his head, "I have no interest in making history, nor do I want to do any experiment."
"Goodbye, senior sister." Then, Wang Shouzhe left without looking back.
"Wait! This experiment is very simple," the green-dressed lady blocked him, pulling out a stack of Gold Notes, "Just give me a little bit of your Life Factor, and this stack of Gold Notes is yours."
Wang Shouzhe: "..."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 32: Watch! Shouzhe’s Methods
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 32: Watch! Shouzhe’s Methods
...
Wang Shouzhe was very puzzled.
He wondered whether the so-called Life Factor that the woman in the green dress mentioned was the same as what he thought.
If it was, then it was too shameful for him.
In two lifetimes, it was the first time someone tried to bribe him for such a reason.
"Sorry."
Wang Shouzhe solemnly refused her, "I’m not interested in your experiment, senior sister can ask someone else." If something like this got out to his wife, he would be dead for sure.
"Don’t rush to refuse; you’ll be part of a great technological revolution." The woman in the green dress, her eyes shining with excitement and madness, said, "Once successful, I can combine people with plants, turning them into Tree-men or Tree-people."
"This way, people won’t need to eat, they can just plant themselves in the soil and sunbathe to survive, and their lifespan could be very long."
"How about it, aren’t you excited to hear this? Any expectations?"
Excited your head, expectations your ghost, Wang Shouzhe was stunned as he looked at the woman in the green dress.
Isn’t this messing with gene experiments too crazily?
He wondered if there was a Moral Ethics Supervision Association in this world to manage these people.
In any case.
Wang Shouzhe’s ideal was to manage his small family well, then grow stronger little by little so that his clan members could live better lives without being bullied.
As for this strange and creepy technology, he wasn’t interested and kept a respectful distance.
This seemingly beautiful and normal young lady turned out to be a genetics madman! No wonder those disciples from the Eternal Spring Valley would hide when they saw her.
Then Wang Shouzhe seriously asked, "If I don’t agree, will senior sister resort to force?"
The woman in the green dress blinked at Wang Shouzhe and said sincerely, "Yes, you’re so handsome, your Life Factor must be excellent."
"So what’s your current cultivation level, senior sister..." Wang Shouzhe thought with a cold sweat. It’s truly a sin to be overly handsome.
Not only does he face hostility from senior and junior brothers. He also becomes the object of senior sisters’ covetousness.
"My cultivation level isn’t high; among my master’s five Direct Disciples, I’m the least accomplished. I’m only in the Late Stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, not even at the Celestial Human Realm." Speaking of this, the woman in the green dress seemed a bit dejected.
That means she probably can’t beat me, and for a moment, Wang Shouzhe’s expression was full of seriousness.
Meanwhile.
Senior Brother Jinshan, hiding behind the bookshelf, laughed secretly in delight.
Stupid kid, being so handsome, you got yourself into big trouble? Next, you’ll surely be tied up by the senior sister for those evil and horrible experiments.
Thinking of the senior sister’s terrifying, various strange and weird experiments made his heart tremble.
But at the same time, he was fiery and eagerly awaited the senior sister’s tough approach. Then watch this handsome Outer Disciple Wang Shouzhe struggle futilely and eventually be captured to meet his tragic fate.
The most important thing is that senior sister will definitely throw him some Qian Gold as compensation afterward.
My senior sister is rich! Among the Direct Disciples, she’s the richest.
The few senior sisters hiding elsewhere were very sympathetic to Wang Shouzhe, but they couldn’t help either, unable to overpower senior sister to have beauty save the hero.
Just as everyone thought Wang Shouzhe would soon be caught for inhumane experiments.
Wang Shouzhe, however, swiped in his Storage Ring and took out some Spirit Fish dry, Honeyed Spirit Meat, Spiritual Honey Candy, and thousands of layers of cake made with Spirit Rice Flour and other ingredients.
"Senior sister is devoted to all humanity, which makes me admire but also pains me a lot."
"Senior sister must be working hard during experiments, right? Look at you, you certainly don’t eat on time. Try this Honeyed Spirit Beef Jerky, which uses Purple Crystal Spiritual Bee Honey and Tier Three Cyan Wood Spirit Bull King Meat, made through dozens of processes. Just one bite can replenish your energy and also beautify your complexion."
Then the senior sister tasted it, her eyes widened, it was indeed delicious.’;
Wang Shouzhe warmly served her a chair, allowing her to eat slowly.
Then Wang Shouzhe swiped again, took out a finely crafted small mirror: "Senior sister works hard for humanity’s rise, truly admirable. However, no matter how hard it is, you still need to take care of yourself. Senior sister, look, there’s a small pimple at your temple, and this area of skin looks dull, clearly from lack of attention to maintenance."
"Even for all humanity, you shouldn’t neglect yourself so much. I recommend this, a [Ice Skin Snow Moisturizing Cream] that I’ve carefully formulated for twenty years."
"What kind of Treasure Mirror is this, showing so clearly? Wow, there is indeed a small pimple." Then the senior sister panicked a bit, applied some cream, and felt a cool, refreshing sensation that penetrated her bones, giving her an all-over icy chill and refreshed feeling, "It’s really effective."
"This bottle [Red Simurgh Purple Phoenix Pill] is used for internal conditioning, sorting out organs and the Tianhui. This bottle of [Ice Skin Snow Moisturizing Cream] is for external application. Before long, senior sister can restore her stunning beauty with icy muscles and jade bones."
As a married man, casually mentioning the Tianhui was naturally comfortable for him.
"I’ll give you as much Qian Gold as you want," senior sister said, holding the exquisite glass bottles and mirror, unable to let them go.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 32: Let’s See! Shouzhe’s Methods_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 32: Let’s See! Shouzhe’s Methods_2
"Senior Sister, you’re contributing to humanity. What is this little bit of sacred-grade maintenance to you? It’s not worth two or three thousand Qian Gold. I’m giving it all to you, along with this Immortal Reflection Treasure Mirror," Wang Shouzhe said generously, with a demeanor full of "magnanimity."
The so-called Immortal Reflection Treasure Mirror was a small, exquisitely crafted mirror.
"Junior Brother, you’re so good to me, even better than my Master, willing to give me sacred-grade items and a treasure mirror." Moved to tears, Senior Sister’s face flushed, "But my Master says not to take things for free. Here’s four thousand Qian Gold for you."
Then she forcibly handed over a large bundle of Qian Gold to Wang Shouzhe. If he didn’t accept, she would get angry.
Reluctantly, Wang Shouzhe accepted the Qian Gold.
Then he proceeded to the next step.
"Senior Sister, your hair is a bit dry; look, the ends are even splitting. How can you neglect yourself so much?" Wang Shouzhe criticized seriously, then took out two beautiful glass bottles, "This green bottle contains Soft and Moist Green Silk, designed specifically to wash Senior Sister’s beautiful hair. It removes dandruff and oily residue in one go, while also moisturizing and nourishing."
"The blue bottle contains Chaotic Butterfly Hundred Flowers Fragrance, specifically for hair care, keeping your hair glossy, silky, and fragrant, attracting even butterflies."
"So effective? How much Qian Gold?" Senior Sister’s eyes widened; this was another sacred-grade item.
"Senior Sister, why talk about money with me? Talking about money is so vulgar. Consider it my contribution to the defenders of humanity," Wang Shouzhe said with a noble air, "It’s not worth three or five thousand gold, just a small matter."
"No way, I can’t take advantage of you; here’s five thousand Qian Gold. Junior Brother, you must accept it."
"Senior Sister, you’re really... sigh!" After several refusals, Wang Shouzhe once again reluctantly accepted the five thousand Qian Gold. In his heart, he marveled at how wealthy the people of the Academy Sacred Land were!
Such extravagant generosity.
After such an operation,
The senior brothers hiding and secretly watching were stunned. Could it be handled like this?
Senior Sister, aren’t you supposed to... quickly capture this handsome man and then conduct those evil and terrifying experiments?
How did it suddenly turn into eating snacks?
And starting to discuss skin care and hair maintenance with him?
The senior sisters, however, were all envious. That Junior Brother Shouzhe, not only handsome and heroic, but also so gentle and delicate. If he could help apply Ice Skin Snow Moisturizing Cream, it would be a dream come true.
It’s just a pity that Junior Brother Shouzhe’s items are so expensive; they couldn’t afford them like Senior Sister could.
And so it went.
After a little more than half an hour,
Senior Sister had acquired a heap of jars and bottles, and Wang Shouzhe’s wallet was swelling.
Seeing the atmosphere was brewing just right, Wang Shouzhe said, "My wife is waiting for me to return, Senior Sister, take your time using these items. If you need more, ask me anytime."
"Wait, what about my experiment when you’re gone?"
Really persistent. Wang Shouzhe thought for a moment and said, "Honestly, I have dull talents and an unremarkable life factor."
"I think you’re quite handsome, how can you be unremarkable?" Senior Sister looked skeptical.
"Senior Sister, you’ve been contributing to humanity in Eternal Spring Valley for so long, but you lack worldly experience. We mustn’t judge a person’s excellence by their appearance. As the saying goes, all glittering on the outside but rotten inside, that’s the kind of person I am," Wang Shouzhe sincerely advised, "I think Senior Brother Jinshan, though not handsome, exudes wisdom from within."
"Therefore, I wholeheartedly recommend Senior Brother Jinshan to you. Senior Sister, you don’t want your tree-man to just have a good appearance but be empty-headed, do you?"
"What you say makes a lot of sense." Senior Sister appeared convinced and sighed regretfully, "But Senior Brother Jinshan isn’t here; who knows where he ran off to."
Hiding behind the bookshelf and secretly watching the fun, Senior Brother Jinshan quietly panicked, "That damned kid is setting me up."
"Senior Sister, don’t worry, Senior Brother Jinshan still retains his childish heart and is playing hide and seek with you. Look behind the bookshelf."
Then Senior Sister ran over, moved the bookshelf, and exclaimed in surprise, "Junior Brother Jinshan, you’re here. Come, quickly, let’s go back for the experiment."
"Help, no, Senior Sister, spare me." Senior Brother Jinshan was nearly in tears, "Please spare me, I haven’t married or had children yet."
"Junior Brother Jinshan, you’re contributing to all humanity. Since you lack this awareness, your senior sister will have to use force,"
Senior Sister waved her hands, releasing a vast stream of blue profound Qi.
A vine, resembling a climbing rose, flew out from her twin sleeves and wrapped around Senior Brother Jinshan.
Senior Brother Jinshan shouted in dismay.
He tried to escape with his body technique, but it was too late. The climbing rose had already caught one of his feet tightly.
Afterward, the vine, full of blossoms, quickly entwined him, binding him in mid-air in a large character position.
Senior Brother Jinshan screamed in agony; the climbing rose was more than just an ordinary vine. Beneath its beautiful appearance lay countless thorns.
As it tightened around him, the thorns pricked into his body.
The pain and poisons paralyzed him, draining his strength to resist.
The scene left Wang Shouzhe silently shocked as well. This Senior Sister’s climbing rose was no simple item, likely a spirit seed.
He wondered how it compared to his Bloodthirsty Vine?
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe was filled with complex emotions, apologizing to Senior Brother Jinshan in his heart. I don’t wish to return and have my wife beat me to death, so I have to trouble you.
"Sigh! This is how adults solve problems."
"It’s not always necessary to fight at the slightest disagreement. Things can be resolved from another angle,"
Wang Shouzhe mused while preparing to sneak away from this place and avoid further trouble.
Suddenly.
A gentle, slightly reprimanding voice spoke: "Lvwei, that’s enough now. Stop bullying Junior Brother Jinshan."
Unnoticed, an elder had appeared in the Dao Transmission Hall, holding a hoe and wearing a straw hat. It was the same old farmer Wang Shouzhe had seen hoeing fields in Eternal Spring Valley’s spirit fields.
Wang Shouzhe froze slightly, then stepped back, puzzled. Could this seemingly ordinary farmer actually be the legendary Changchun Ascendant?
"Ah, Master, what brings you here?" Senior Sister Lvwei suddenly panicked, "I wasn’t bullying Junior Brother Jinshan; he was going to help me with the experiment."
"You, don’t learn unsound experiment techniques from Divine Martial Dynasty relics and start experimenting recklessly." Changchun Ascendant reproved, "Combining humans and plants violates heavenly principles. Do you forget how such a powerful Divine Martial Dynasty eventually fell?"
"Boohoo~" Senior Sister Lvwei was immediately aggrieved, "I just wanted to try it!"
"In our Eternal Spring Valley, we emphasize aligning with the heavenly principles and going with the flow," Changchun Ascendant said indifferently, "You’re forbidden from mentioning that experiment again. Besides, do you even understand what a life factor is?"
"The Divine Martial Dynasty relics mentioned it’s something men possess..." Senior Sister Lvwei retorted defensively.
Changchun Ascendant’s face darkened.
Seeing her Master’s expression change, Senior Sister Lvwei hurriedly released Senior Brother Jinshan and fled, leaving behind a message for Wang Shouzhe: "Junior Brother Shouzhe, I’ll come for more when I’m out of things," and then she vanished.
Having survived, Senior Brother Jinshan gratefully thanked Changchun Ascendant, "Thank you, Master, for saving my life."
"Don’t waste your time idle. Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species surely resulted from generations’ hard work. By simply cracking it, you put their efforts in vain," Changchun Ascendant criticized.
"Yes, Master." Senior Brother Jinshan was drenched in sweat.
Changchun Ascendant no longer paid him any attention but smiled and appraised Wang Shouzhe, saying meaningfully, "You’re quite capable, kid."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 33: Thrilled to Have a Celestial Pride! The Rise of the Xuan Yao Lineage
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 33: Thrilled to Have a Celestial Pride! The Rise of the Xuan Yao Lineage
...
Hearing these words, Wang Shouzhe’s heart suddenly sank.
Although the Changchun Ascendant did not reveal the oppressive aura of the Purple Mansion Realm, nor did he deliberately suppress him, the other party’s casual words still made him feel a chill down his spine, as if a great calamity was impending.
"Ascendant, I was just joking with Junior Sister Lvwei, how could I really want her money?" Wang Shouzhe smiled awkwardly, immediately took out the more than ten thousand Qian Gold and handed it to the Changchun Ascendant, "Please trouble the Ascendant to return this money to Junior Sister Lvwei."
"Although your items were somewhat expensive, they were full of novelty and creativity. Since Lvwei likes them, naturally, let her choose as she wishes." The Changchun Ascendant was indifferent. At his level, he had long since ceased to care about such trivial money. Moreover, it was Lvwei’s own money that she had earned, and how she chose to spend it was her own decision.
"Then what does the Ascendant mean?" Wang Shouzhe was somewhat puzzled.
"Everyone, out."
The Changchun Ascendant did not answer directly but glanced at the others and gave a casual order.
The disciples of Eternal Spring Valley immediately took their leave sensibly.
Inside the Dao Transmission Hall, only the Changchun Ascendant and Wang Shouzhe remained.
The Changchun Ascendant glanced at Wang Shouzhe, who immediately felt as if he had been seen through, with no thoughts able to hide in front of him.
Wang Shouzhe’s nerves instantly tensed.
However, just when he thought the Changchun Ascendant was going to reprimand him, the Changchun Ascendant suddenly sighed and said leisurely, "Lvwei is different from other senior brothers. She is not a noble family descendant but a child I found in the wild. Growing up in the Eternal Spring Valley from a young age, her understanding of many things is not the same as ordinary people."
Pausing for a moment, his tone suddenly became serious, "If she offended you just now, as her master, I apologize on her behalf."
"Ascendant, you are too kind." Wang Shouzhe quickly clasped his hands in return, saying seriously, "I was just joking with Junior Sister Lvwei~ Her personality is innocent and lively, and not annoying at all."
"Hmm. Tolerant and gentle, brave and cunning, indeed a good seedling."
Seeing him like this, the Changchun Ascendant’s mood improved a lot.
He smiled at Wang Shouzhe, praising, "You outer disciple, you are more excellent than many of my core disciples, at such a young age you have already practiced the ’Eternal Spring True Technique’ to such a degree. Truly a jewel of the ocean~"
"Ascendant, you overpraise, overpraise~" Wang Shouzhe said modestly, "I still have a long way to go compared to the senior brothers."
"Earlier, I heard you say that Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species fundamentally cannot be cultivated a second time." The Changchun Ascendant invited Wang Shouzhe to sit down, his attitude gentle, "Can you explain it to me?"
Wang Shouzhe pondered quietly.
Could it be that the Changchun Ascendant already knows that Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species was his doing?
Although Wang’s No. 7 Wheat Species is good, in the eyes of the entire academy, it is just a small thing, the Changchun Ascendant should not covet it.
Hmm, he must just be curious.
With this thought, he immediately answered honestly: "To report to the Ascendant, this wheat species was accidentally created by the disciple. Unlike the grain seeds of other families, my approach is to first cultivate a seed that cannot be reproduced a second time after soaking in a special liquid, and then continuously optimize it to increase its yield."
"I see."
The Changchun Ascendant suddenly realized, then couldn’t help but laugh, "You are quite a peculiar child. Your priority is to prevent others from cracking it. Then you think about the grain’s yield, your approach is good, but a bit too narrow-minded, your vision is not broad enough."
"To report to the Ascendant, as they say: ’When successful, one shares the prosperity with the world; when in poverty, one maintains personal integrity.’ The disciple’s family is small, depending entirely on these grain seeds for livelihood, so naturally, I should be cautious first, gentlemanly later."
The implication was, if the Wang Family had the strength of the Purple Mansion Academy, the ideas and vision would naturally not be the same.
"What you say makes sense. Your thinking is unique and not mere parroting of others." The Changchun Ascendant nodded appreciatively, "Would you be willing to join the academy and become a core disciple under my tutelage?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe was momentarily stunned.
Others are breaking their heads trying to become core disciples but to no avail, and here he is, the Changchun Ascendant is offering him an olive branch without a second thought.
If others found out about this treatment, they would probably die of envy.
So should he accept it or not?
Isn’t it obvious?
"The disciple thanks the Changchun Ascendant for his kindness." Wang Shouzhe bowed deeply to the Changchun Ascendant, "However, Shouzhe is the head of the family, bearing the heavy responsibility of the family, and perhaps cannot stay long in the academy to study. I hope the Ascendant will forgive me."
"However, wherever the Ascendant can use the disciple, just one word, and the disciple will do his utmost."
This was naturally an excuse.
Wang Shouzhe truly had no interest in studying at the academy.
The Changchun Ascendant gazed at him with some unexpected expression, seemingly a bit regretful, but ultimately said nothing more.
"If that’s the case, then so be it."
He merely saw the potential in Wang Shouzhe and did not want a bright pearl to be covered in dust. Since the other party’s aspirations were elsewhere, with his ascendant dignity, he would not invite him repeatedly.
"However, you really do have some potential." The Changchun Ascendant added, "Since today we had the chance to meet, and I drank your Spirit Wine, I’ll give you half an hour. Do you have any questions in cultivation you do not understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 33: Joyfully Gaining a Celestial Pride! The Rise of the Xuan Yao Lineage_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 33: Joyfully Gaining a Celestial Pride! The Rise of the Xuan Yao Lineage_2
Wang Shouzhe was overjoyed.
He thought refusing the Changchun Ascendant might anger him, but unexpectedly, Changchun was so easygoing. Not only wasn’t he angry, but he was also willing to give guidance.
He immediately organized his thoughts and then expressed the confusion, ignorance, and perplexity he encountered while practicing the Eternal Spring True Technique over the years, one by one.
And the Changchun Zhenren, like a sincere mentor, patiently answered all of Wang Shouzhe’s questions.
He spoke in an orderly manner, often dispelling Wang Shouzhe’s doubts in just a few sentences, giving him a sense of sudden enlightenment.
As time passed, Wang Shouzhe’s respect for the Changchun Ascendant grew deeper.
Truly worthy of the title of Ascendant.
Rumor has it that he is also an ascendant of considerable age.
As they conversed through questions and answers, half an hour passed quickly.
All the accumulated questions in Wang Shouzhe’s heart received satisfactory answers, and all the inexplicable and obscure places became clear.
Feeling grateful, he took out the gifts he had prepared for the Changchun Ascendant from his storage ring, one by one.
Before coming here, he had considered many possibilities and even pestered Ancestor Xuanfu to roughly understand the preferences and temperaments of each ascendant in the Purple Mansion Academy.
But Ancestor Xuanfu wasn’t skilled in this regard, and what she said was vague. Wang Shouzhe could only half-guess and half-understand, and then formulate several gift-giving plans tailored for the occasion.
The Changchun Ascendant is the oldest ascendant in the Purple Mansion Academy.
Having lived long and seen many things, desires naturally diminish.
According to Ancestor Xuanfu, the Changchun Ascendant is most uncontentious with the world, of a serene disposition, with no desires or demands.
Therefore, Wang Shouzhe could only prepare some excellent spirit wine and some White Jade Spirit Rice and Red Crystal Spirit Rice Seeds. These seeds were not Wang Shouzhe’s latest varieties but existed as eliminated products in the research process.
Yet even as eliminated products, they have their unique features.
"Ascendant." Wang Shouzhe presented these local specialties one by one, "These are all produced on our Wang Family’s land, just to express our gratitude to the ascendant."
Seeing this, the Changchun Ascendant genuinely found them to be little trinkets.
Contrarily, he was delighted and said, "You are a thoughtful child."
With his temperament, if Wang Shouzhe indeed presented a heap of valuable objects, he might have been immediately driven out.
His fondness for Wang Shouzhe increased a bit more.
There weren’t many seeds of White Jade Spirit Rice and Red Crystal Spirit Rice.
The Changchun Zhenren glanced at them and said, "These two are common spirit rice, but the grains are slightly larger. Presumably, they are new spirit species cultivated by your family."
Wang Shouzhe explained the features of these two new spirit rice varieties. Larger grains and increased yield. He explained to the Changchun Ascendant that their most notable feature is that they can be propagated a second time.
"You are quite spiritual, child." The Changchun Ascendant said, "Many noble families cultivate excellent species, often keeping them to themselves. With these, these two spirit rice species, I will reference and study them without disseminating them outside."
In his lifetime, he had seen countless spirit species, among which many were improved varieties. Wang Shouzhe’s two, though distinctive, were surpassed by a number among the top Black Tortoise Clans.
"Since I’ve given them to the ascendant, how they are handled is also the ascendant’s matter." Wang Shouzhe said indifferently.
The things that can be given naturally have something better in reserve. Moreover, he is well aware that if given time, the Wang Family will have even more powerful spirit species in the future.
Presently, these are just primary spirit species.
"By the way, since your surname is Wang," the Changchun Ascendant suddenly remembered something, "you wouldn’t happen to know Wang Longyan, would you?"
He asked casually, for there are many with the surname Wang in the world. It was just that recently, the Binglan Ascendant mentioned wanting to bring Wang Longyan back into their fold; thus, he expressed some opposition and suddenly thought to ask casually.
Uh...
Wang Shouzhe felt a little inexplicable and a bit uneasy, and couldn’t help but cautiously ask, "The person the ascendant mentioned is my great-grand-aunt, is there any issue?"
What’s the issue?
The Changchun Ascendant’s aura, like an immortal, was momentarily stunned and suddenly became silent.
After a long time, he suddenly sighed and said, "Forget it~ you are an outer disciple, and the traditions of the academy have nothing to do with you."
"Fine, fine, this matter does not concern you. You may leave now."
With that, he waved his hand, seemingly unwilling to discuss further.
Wang Shouzhe felt deeply puzzled, but he did not dare to disobey, so he had to bow respectfully to the Changchun Ascendant and said, "In that case, Shouzhe takes his leave."
His heart was filled with confusion.
Why did mentioning Ancestor Longyan suddenly make the Changchun Ascendant’s attitude towards him colder?
Could it be that Ancestor Longyan has offended the Changchun Ascendant? But it shouldn’t be.
After all, there is quite a gap in status and cultivation between the two.
...
Just a moment earlier.
At another end of the Purple Mansion Academy.
A majestic mountain stood among the peaks, standing out like a crane among chickens, unique and distinguished.
Wispy fog wrapped around the mountain’s waist up to its peak. From afar, the entire mountain seemed covered in a layer of hazy light gauze, infused with spiritual beauty and an immortal aura, making those who see it forget the mundane.
This mountain is called Carefree Peak.
On Carefree Peak, there is a Carefree Hall.
The Carefree Hall sits on the edge of a steep cliff, magnificent and imposing, exuding the style of the immortal family.
It is the station of Master Xuan Yao, one of several ascendants of the Purple Mansion Academy.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 33: Thrilled to Have a Celestial Pride! The Rise of the Xuan Yao Lineage_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 33: Thrilled to Have a Celestial Pride! The Rise of the Xuan Yao Lineage_3
Among the peaks, valleys, and halls, Carefree Peak is not the most powerful lineage. Simply because Master Xuan Yao is the youngest among the ascendants, still less than five hundred years old.
Therefore, when he recruits disciples, he often lowers the threshold and recruits more to enhance his stature. But because of this, although Carefree Peak has many disciples, they are a mixed bag, with varying qualities.
Moreover, he has been in the Purple Mansion Realm for less than two hundred years, and among his disciples, only two or three are direct disciples, and there are merely twenty or thirty core disciples, while there are numerous ordinary and outstanding disciples.
Whenever the Academy starts recruiting disciples, the number of new disciples is quite large. But those who truly stand out are few and far between. Looking at the overall picture, even if not at the bottom, they are merely mediocre.
There is a tradition in Purple Mansion Academy. Every three years after the recruitment conference, each peak, valley, and hall will have elder students take junior students to visit other peaks and valleys for exposure.
Gloriously said, it’s to introduce you to disciples of other lineages. In reality, it’s to showcase the strength of one’s own lineage and the excellence of new recruits.
Based on this unspoken rule.
It naturally gives rise to a feature where elder students only take juniors to those lineages that they can overpower for exposure.
As for those they cannot defeat, they are usually the ones being exposed.
The Xuan Yao lineage usually visits others and is visited by others.
But this time, everything is different.
Inside Carefree Hall, the disciples of Carefree Peak are gathered together.
Master Xuan Yao sits high in the main hall, slightly bowing his head, gazing down at the disciples below the steps.
He is in his prime, with his brows furrowed and his demeanor dignified.
Thin smoke rises from the brass incense burner beside him, blurring his figure but failing to hide his towering aura, resembling mountains standing tall, grand and imposing.
A gigantic stone sword is embedded in the wall behind him, seemingly simple and unadorned, yet it appears to emit a chilling Sword Qi.
Supported by this stone sword, Master Xuan Yao’s entire aura seems more solid and fierce, making one instinctively feel intimidated, unable to look directly.
Gathered in the main hall are the core disciples of Carefree Peak, along with some who are about to become core disciples, totaling more than thirty people. Except for those with special reasons, conducting business elsewhere, all core disciples are present.
This time, each of them is very excited, discussing eagerly amongst themselves; clearly, this year is somewhat different.
"Senior Brother Xiu Ping." A "youthful Junyan" said spiritedly, "Last time, you led the junior brothers and sisters to gain exposure. This time, it should be my turn."
"Junior Brother Yuanbai, do you not know what happened last time? Among the newly accepted junior brothers, none were reliable." That Senior Brother Xiu Ping spoke angrily, "I wasn’t leading them to gain exposure; I was clearly being exposed."
"This time, it was tough to recruit a Celestial Pride, bringing a turning point. You can’t take away my chance for revenge."
Those top-ranking core disciples. Look at one another. Discussing and contesting for the opportunity to lead this year’s junior brothers and sisters for exposure.
Unable to reach a consensus.
Ultimately, they turn their gaze to their master, Master Xuan Yao.
Seemingly waiting for the master’s decision.
Master Xuan Yao slowly stands up, hands behind his back, and beneath his dignified expression, his eyes reveal a hint of undisguised excitement: "Stop arguing. This time, I will personally take the new disciples to gain exposure to other lineages."
His expression is very calm, but inside he’s laughing, he’s laughing heartily.
To have such disciples and such prestigious momentum, how could he miss it? How many years has Xuan Yao’s lineage endured suffocating moments?
The core disciples are helpless; their master is eager to go, what else can they do? They have to find a way to follow and enjoy the prestige as well.
A curious disciple asks, "Master, which lineage will we visit first? Isn’t it straight to Profound Ice Hall?" Profound Ice Hall has been a popular destination for years.
"Humph! This time, Profound Ice Hall is definitely on the list. However, we’ll still make a stop at Eternal Spring Valley first, to warm up."
"Master is wise."
Everyone responds in unison, each showing an excited expression.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 34: Phoenix! Ultimately Soaring High
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 34: Phoenix! Ultimately Soaring High
...
Eternal Spring Valley, in the Dao Transmission Hall.
After bidding farewell to the Changchun Ascendant, Wang Shouzhe turned and walked to the entrance of the Dao Transmission Hall, ready to go out.
Suddenly.
In the vast sky, the stacked clouds suddenly surged up.
A bright laugh pierced the sky, coming from the vast expanse of the sky from afar.
"Changchun Elder, I am Xuan Yao. According to the academy’s rules, today I will personally bring the new disciples to visit you. I wonder if you welcome us?"
The content was humble, but the tone contained an excitement that could not be restrained, as if the things that were about to happen had already made him impatient.
The Changchun Ascendant’s calm and unperturbed face suddenly showed a slight change.
Master Xuan Yao? Why did he personally come this time? Could it be...
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe stopped and said with cupped fists, "What exactly is happening, Changchun Ascendant?"
He was full of doubts, could it be that Master Xuan Yao had a grudge against Changchun Ascendant?
The Changchun Ascendant sighed, "Ah~ this is an undesirable tradition in the academy."
Then he succinctly explained the situation.
Uh...
Wang Shouzhe understood the whole story.
It turns out that after the academy recruits core disciples, they also engage in this kind of thing. But thinking about it, it’s quite normal. After all, recruiting new disciples, there’s always some show-off. It seems that there is indeed a competitive relationship between the various ascendants.
The Changchun Ascendant helplessly said, "My Eternal Spring Lineage has never liked to fight with others. Each time, the other lineages take turns to visit us. This time, Master Xuan Yao’s personal visit indicates that he must have recruited an extremely satisfactory disciple."
"Well, anyway, this happens once every three years."
Under normal circumstances, the Changchun Ascendant could avoid it, out of sight and out of mind.
But this time, Master Xuan Yao came personally, according to etiquette, the Changchun Ascendant couldn’t avoid it.
Seeing the Changchun Ascendant’s unpleasant face, Wang Shouzhe chimed in, "Indeed this tradition is detrimental. It does not favor stable development."
Upon hearing this, the Changchun Ascendant glanced at Wang Shouzhe strangely and said softly, "The Wang Longyan of the noble family is most enthusiastic about this tradition. In the past, every three years, Wang Longyan as a core disciple of the Profound Ice Lineage would bring the new disciples to have a look at our Eternal Spring Valley."
"Uh..."
Wang Shouzhe was speechless, also somewhat embarrassed.
