He finally understood why the Changchun Ascendant’s face looked like that when he mentioned Ancestor Longyan.
He also remembered why Ancestor Longyan seemed hesitant when she mentioned the Eternal Spring Lineage in the past. She only said the Changchun Ascendant lived long and mentioned a senior brother of the Eternal Spring Lineage who seemed quite capable.
Other than that, there was hardly anything positive.
So that’s how it is~
Wang Shouzhe found it somewhat amusing.
Our Ancestor Longyan, it seems, wasn’t exactly a nice person in her youth.
As they talked, the Changchun Ascendant had already passed him, walked to the entrance of the Dao Transmission Hall and addressed the sky with his hands behind his back.
"Since it is a traditional celebration, the Eternal Spring Valley naturally welcomes it. Feel free to bring the disciples."
Even without the Changchun Ascendant exerting any effort, his heavy voice penetrated the clouds, rippling through the sky and spreading far away.
His voice sounded calm and carefree, but Wang Shouzhe sensed a hint of desolate helplessness from it.
If the Changchun True Man truly didn’t care, he wouldn’t have had such a soft voice when he mentioned Ancestor Longyan earlier.
Wang Shouzhe, who originally intended to leave, changed his mind for a moment, deciding to at least see the situation before making a decision.
If indeed there was no one under the Changchun Sect to resist, he would step in to help save some face, repaying the favor from earlier.
Master Xuan Yao’s previous laughter acted as issuing a visitation card.
At this moment, the verdant and colorful square outside the Dao Transmission Hall in Eternal Spring Valley began to have more and more people arriving, all disciples from the Changchun Sect who had heard the news and rushed from all around.
In no time, the entire Eternal Spring Valley was filled with a sense of impending storm, as if a storm was about to break.
Soon, a large crowd had gathered on the spacious square.
"Aha? Junior you came too." It was the senior sister who had guided Wang Shouzhe earlier speaking.
"May I know the senior sister’s name?" Wang Shouzhe asked politely with cupped hands.
"I am Liu Yuqin, a direct vein member of the Chuyun Liu Family." Liu Yuqin said quickly with a blush, "I am twenty-eight years old, at the mid-eighth level of the Qi Refining Realm, not yet married."
Wang Shouzhe was slightly taken aback, his expression somewhat speechless as he sighed.
This senior sister, I merely asked your name, why divulge your family background and marital status? Isn’t the academy supposed to prohibit such things?
However, this type of ability was undoubtedly the correct approach.
In fact, most of the disciples at the Purple Mansion Academy were at such a level. To reach the Spirit Platform Realm by the age of thirty-five and below would already be considered an excellent disciple, with the chance to strive for core disciple status.
Liu Yuqin’s face suddenly changed, as if she thought of something, she quickly whispered, "The academy doesn’t allow mentioning which noble family one is from, just let it be, but don’t spread it around."
"Rest assured, senior sister, I will keep it to myself." Wang Shouzhe solemnly replied.
As he spoke, he suddenly remembered something, "Regarding the Chuyun Liu Family, it seems there is someone named Liu Yunlang, who is he to you?"
"Aha, junior actually knows my cousin Yunlang?" Liu Yuqin was somewhat surprised, "My younger cousin is a good person, but his talent is somewhat lacking."
Nowadays, his talent is not lacking.
Wang Shouzhe thought to himself.
Presumably, their family hadn’t had the chance to notify her.
But notification wouldn’t amount to much. Liu Yuqin was just an ordinary disciple, not yet at the stage where she could look after others.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 34: Phoenix! Ultimately Soaring High_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 34: Phoenix! Ultimately Soaring High_2
The other senior sisters in the Dao Transmission Hall just now also recognized Wang Shouzhe and lamented that those skincare products seemed too expensive while chatting with him.
"Please rest assured, everyone. Those were the ’Luxury Premium Edition.’ We will soon launch an ’Exclusive Edition’ with equally good effects," Wang Shouzhe explained.
Don’t underestimate these seemingly ordinary senior sisters with not much strength.
If you place them elsewhere, they are all considered elite individuals. Moreover, those who come to the Academy to study usually have some status and influence in their families.
As he spoke, he also took out some small samples for the curious senior sisters to try.
Wang Shouzhe was immediately surrounded by a large group of lively young women shouting, "Junior brother, I want some too, I want some too."
This made the senior brothers roll their eyes at Wang Shouzhe.
Our senior brothers from Eternal Spring Valley already find it hard to mix in.
After all, most of these female disciples from Eternal Spring Valley like those senior brothers from Profound Ice Hall and Carefree Peak, who are good at fighting.
And now there’s suddenly this handsome, well-born, and all-around excellent brat jumping out to compete for resources with them?
As for why they know this young man’s family background is good, the reason is simple: those with slightly worse family backgrounds can only randomly carry a Storage Ring?
This world, how is it so unfair~~?
Just at this moment, a piercing sound suddenly came from the sky.
The next moment, a fierce Sword Qi swept across the sky, breaking through the clouds in the blink of an eye, roaring toward Eternal Spring Valley.
The Sword Qi was vast and sharp, seemingly containing the majestic power of splitting heaven and earth.
Instantly, the entire Eternal Spring Valley seemed to be enveloped by the Sword Qi.
The crowd gathered in Eternal Spring Valley was slightly stirred.
"It’s Master Xuan Yao’s Mountain-Opening Sword Light!"
Liu Yuqin’s expression changed slightly and couldn’t help but exclaim in a voice filled with fear and awe.
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but be attracted by that Sword Light as well. A powerful Purple Mansion Realm expert truly had an overwhelming presence, incomparable. The prestige of an Ascendant made him yearn for it, hoping that one day he could reach such a level, making the journey worth it.
I wonder how Changchun Ascendant will respond? Can he handle it?
For a moment, Wang Shouzhe felt a bit concerned for Changchun Ascendant.
After all, he did have some fondness for Changchun Ascendant.
However, before the Sword Light could reach Eternal Spring Valley, a thick dark brown Energy Shield appeared over the valley, blocking the Sword Light outside.
Seeing this scene, Wang Shouzhe breathed a sigh of relief. How could such a grand Eternal Spring Valley not have an array for protection?
This Mountain Protection Array made him envious.
The Sword Light of Master Xuan Yao spun in the sky and in the blink of an eye landed on the open ground outside Eternal Spring Valley.
Soon, the Sword Light dissipated, and a crowd appeared on the open ground.
The leader, a middle-aged man in a blue robe, had a dignified appearance and was none other than Master Xuan Yao.
Behind him were several core disciples of the Carefree Hall and twenty or thirty new disciples.
At this moment, they all had excited smiles on their faces, though it was unclear if it was from witnessing the extraordinary means of Master Xuan Yao or anticipation for the events to come.
"Xuan Yao, your way of greeting hasn’t changed in a hundred years." Changchun Ascendant’s voice suddenly came from the valley, "This is my Eternal Spring Valley’s ’Spring Flowers and Autumn Fruits Array’; no other valley’s array could handle your antics."
When he started speaking, Changchun Ascendant’s voice was still deep within the valley, but by the time he finished, he was already at the entrance of Eternal Spring Valley.
Changchun Ascendant was still wearing clothes like those of an old farmer, but his manner at this moment was like a towering ancient tree reaching into the clouds—lush, full of life, and yet exuding an indescribable powerful pressure.
The excited expressions on the faces of the new disciples behind Master Xuan Yao instantly froze.
They realized that an Ascendant was an Ascendant because of their formidable strength. Even the most mild-tempered Changchun Ascendant among the Ascendants should not be underestimated.
"Disciple greets Changchun Ascendant."
All the disciples hurriedly bowed, not daring to be the least bit neglectful.
"Alright~ guests are guests, come in, everyone."
Changchun Ascendant didn’t pay much mind to the juniors’ behavior and casually nodded at them before turning to lead the way back into Eternal Spring Valley.
Master Xuan Yao’s stern face showed a hint of a smile as he followed with his disciples, hands behind his back.
"Master Xuan Yao."
"Greetings to Master Xuan Yao."
Seeing Master Xuan Yao leading his disciples into the valley, the disciples of Changchun Ascendant in the valley hurriedly greeted him.
"It seems the new disciples of your Xuan Yao Lineage this time are quite remarkable." Changchun Ascendant glanced casually at Master Xuan Yao and said, "Tell me, which disciple managed to catch your attention enough to personally lead them here."
Master Xuan Yao walked with his hands behind him, a trace of irrepressible pride flashing in his eyes when he heard this: "This disciple of mine is no worse than Gong Shengzhe of those years. In the future, my Xuan Yao Lineage may very well rely on her to flourish."
Seeing Master Xuan Yao’s smug demeanor, even the well-cultivated Changchun Ascendant found it a bit hard to bear.
"Alright~ you’ve been talking long enough; at least introduce the person to me. Let this old man see if they are truly as outstanding as you say."

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 34: Phoenix! Ultimately Will Soar_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 34: Phoenix! Ultimately Will Soar_3
"That’s only natural. Even if Master Changchun hadn’t asked, I would have brought my disciple over to pay respects to the elder." Master Xuan Yao spoke with pride.
Saying this, he called out to someone behind him.
"My precious disciple, come out and pay your respects to Master Changchun and all the senior students."
Hearing these words, everyone in Eternal Spring Valley craned their necks to see, eager to glimpse this new disciple praised so highly by Master Xuan Yao.
Even Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but be curious.
At the same time, a vague suspicion arose in his heart...
Just as Wang Shouzhe was pondering this, a graceful figure emerged from the crowd, walking slowly to stand behind Master Xuan Yao.
It was a young woman in her twenties, dressed in a goose yellow outfit, with delicate features and a bright gaze.
However, more captivating than her appearance was her aura.
She seemed born for grand occasions; amidst all the attention, she showed no trace of fear, walking confidently with a serene expression, as if strolling leisurely through a courtyard.
Behind her were several core disciples and a group of new disciples, lending her an air of authority.
As she stood behind Xuan Yao, her phoenix-like eyes surveyed the room, exuding a commanding presence as if she alone could conquer the world, enhancing her exceptional demeanor.
She maintained a calm expression, clasped her hands, and greeted the two Ascendants, "Luqiu pays her respects to Master Changchun and Master."
Master Xuan Yao nodded slightly, very satisfied.
Seeing Wang Luqiu’s extraordinary composure, undisturbed by the presence of the Ascendants, Xuan Yao knew this went beyond mere talent.
It indicated that she possessed an unwavering heart, ready to dominate her era.
Master Xuan Yao became more and more pleased.
Such a rare, peerless disciple was truly exceptional. Compared to himself back then, she had even more drive and a tranquil yet ambitious spirit.
The saying goes, "Celestial Pride is easy to find, but an emperor’s heart is precious." With her steadfast spirit, her future path would surely be much smoother.
Even Master Changchun couldn’t help but show a hint of surprise.
This young woman, unfazed by honor or disgrace, already possessed the demeanor of an unparalleled elite at such a young age. Her potential was truly limitless.
"Xuan Yao, you’ve truly acquired an excellent disciple this time," Master Changchun remarked with admiration and envy.
Why couldn’t someone like this be from Eternal Spring Valley?
Actually, it’s not that Eternal Spring Valley doesn’t produce celestial prides; it’s just that those with Wood Talent aren’t skilled in combat, and the valley’s peaceful atmosphere means their combat power isn’t as high as other branches.
However, among all present, the most shocked was Wang Shouzhe hiding in the crowd.
He had already suspected that the one so valued by Master Xuan Yao, who brought them here personally, might be someone from the Wang Family.
But seeing Wang Luqiu’s impressive entrance, he couldn’t help but slap his forehead.
This girl never fails to become the center of attention.
The admiration and reverence from her peers, the serious gazes from the senior students, and Master Xuan Yao’s unconcealed affection and satisfaction all made her shine like a dazzling star in the spotlight.
It’s no wonder.
How outstanding is Wang Luqiu? Being at the Ninth Layer of Qi Refining Realm is remarkable enough; what’s more important is that she has achieved an Upper Grade D bloodline and awakened her second-tier bloodline during the Qi Refining Realm.
In the whole Daqian Kingdom, she is regarded as a Celestial Pride.
Despite his shock, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but feel a deep sense of admiration, perhaps this was the stage Luqiu preferred, the main theme of her future life.
He felt a sense of pride in his heart as well.
This is his sixth sister, who grew up with him, played, fought, and strived alongside him. Now she was stepping onto a new stage, like a phoenix about to soar into the sky.
No matter what.
Your fourth brother and the family will always be your unwavering support.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 35: Twin Beauties Qi Lin! Double the Joy (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 35: Twin Beauties Qi Lin! Double the Joy (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
...
Master Xuan Yao looked at Wang Luqiu with increasing satisfaction, almost unwilling to take his eyes off her.
He had only been in the Purple Mansion Realm for less than two hundred years, and naturally took in two or three exceptionally talented disciples, some even had higher cultivation than Wang Luqiu at her age.
However, firstly, they are now too old to participate in such events, and secondly, when they were young, they might not have had this unwavering Heart of the Emperor’s Road like Wang Luqiu.
Having high talent is good, but the heart of a strong person is also very important.
"Ascendant Changchun," Master Xuan Yao couldn’t resist boasting to Ascendant Changchun as he watched him, "Can my disciple catch the Ascendant’s eye?"
"Indeed, she appears imposing from the outside. To have such cultivation at her young age with such a calm demeanor is truly rare," Ascendant Changchun evaluated truthfully, "If she can maintain this momentum, the Path of Celestial Human cannot stop her, and she might even have the qualification to challenge the Purple Mansion Realm."
"Hahaha~ The Purple Mansion Realm is too distant. The path of a strong person begins with one’s footsteps, she’s still far from it," Master Xuan Yao responded with a serious tone of humility.
Unfortunately, his eyes expressive of pride made his words lack any convincing power.
"Let’s see how these children shine today," Master Xuan Yao said to the other old fellow. "Come, come~ This is rare Spirit Tea – ’Carefree Immortal’ from my Carefree Peak."
Speaking, Master Xuan Yao brought out a set of chairs, tables, and tea sets, all supported by a mysterious force and suspended in the air.
"Come, come, Ascendant, please sit."
In an overbearing manner, Master Xuan Yao invited Ascendant Changchun to sit down for tea.
Ascendant Changchun was quite helpless, today Master Xuan Yao even brought out the rare ’Carefree Immortal’ tea, he must be very confident, ready to enjoy the show.
But Purple Mansion Academy’s traditions are not built in a day, they cannot avoid the challenge forever.
Ascendant Changchun reluctantly sat down and started drinking the ’Carefree Immortal’ tea.
As an Ascendant, he rarely paid direct attention to the selection of new disciples and really didn’t know how this batch from Eternal Spring Valley was performing.
Hopefully, among the new disciples, there will be slightly outstanding ones, even if they can’t win, to put on a good display and save face for Eternal Spring Valley.
Leaving aside those high up, already gathered Eternal Spring Valley disciples discussed among themselves.
"Who is that imposing girl? She does seem extraordinary."
"Looks like she might be a Celestial Pride."
"This time, Carefree Peak seems to be coming in strong, seems like things are not going well~"
"Brother Jinshan, think of a way, we can’t keep losing in this way."
"Yes, Brother Jinshan, we lose every time, everyone is losing confidence."
Everyone’s gaze turned to Senior Brother Jinshan.
Wang Shouzhe was not far away. Hearing these words, he couldn’t help but look towards Senior Brother Jinshan in the distance.
After all, he is an outer disciple of Eternal Spring Valley and doesn’t want the valley to lose too disgracefully.
Surrounded by junior brothers, Senior Brother Jinshan had a serious expression, frowned, and said: "Don’t panic, stay calm. Who’s in charge of recruiting new disciples this time?"
"Junior Brother Yuze," someone replied, "Look, look, Junior Brother Yuze and they are back."
"Call Junior Brother Yuze over and ask about the new disciples," Senior Brother Jinshan said steadily.
Upon hearing this, a disciple immediately went to invite Junior Brother Yuze.
However, before Junior Brother Yuze could bring the new disciples over, an anomaly suddenly arose in the sky.
Disciples from Eternal Spring Valley and Carefree Peak all looked up, drawn by the anomaly.
In the sky, somehow appeared countless purple butterflies.
They danced gracefully, like elves flying out of a secluded valley, starry soft powder sprinkling from the sky, weaving a dreamlike light and shadow in the air.
Soft celestial music drifted from the void.
The sound, akin to babbling brooks and a nightingale’s calls, unknowingly calmed people’s hearts.
Amidst the nebulous illusions, a graceful silhouette cut through the mist, coming softly from the sky.
It was a supremely beautiful woman.
She had skin as delicate as a young girl of sixteen, yet the alluring curves of a mature woman.
A veil of light fabric covered her face, yet couldn’t conceal her unique aura.
It was an indescribable presence, like a flawless bright moon, ethereal and radiant, yet full of an elf’s grace and playfulness.
When she lowered her eyes in thought, she was as dignified and majestic as the Divine Lady in ancient paintings, yet with a single glance, she was full of charm, each smile capable of bewitching, elusive to grasp.
A well-tailored pale purple dress outlined her figure, accentuating her enchanting curves and mysterious aura, as her waist swayed with captivating grace.
"Lady Illusion Butterfly!"
"Is it really her?"
Seeing this woman, the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley softly exclaimed in shock.
Wang Shouzhe, having previously studied the intelligence on Purple Mansion Academy, quickly realized from the surrounding murmurs.
This must be Lady Illusion Butterfly, one of the few Ascendants of Purple Mansion Academy.
Lady Illusion Butterfly, who governs the lineage of the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies, is known for her mysterious ways and rarely appears in her true form.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 35: Twin Beauties Qi Lin! Double the Joy (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 35: Twin Beauties Qi Lin! Double the Joy (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
However, Lady Illusion Butterfly recruits very few disciples and only accepts female disciples, making the overall combat strength of the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies not very prominent.
Of course, not prominent does not mean they are weak.
In fact, apart from the Profound Ice Hall lineage, few people would choose to visit the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies to gain insight.
The combat style of the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies lineage is extremely bizarre, typically using Spirit Bees, Spirit Butterflies, and other Spiritual Insects, combined with powerful illusion techniques, making them particularly troublesome to deal with.
When fighting them, one often falls into their illusions if they’re not careful and ends up defeated.
Nevertheless, the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies has always acted rather low-key. While they remain unseen by others, they also rarely visit other lineages to observe.
It’s just unclear why they have come this time.
As soon as Lady Illusion Butterfly appeared, she charmingly took out a comfortable leisure chair she had brought herself, sat beside the other two Ascendants, and poured herself some Spirit Tea, saying, "I don’t suppose you two Ascendants mind me watching the fun as your disciples spar here?"
Upon seeing her, even the expression of Master Xuan Yao turned solemn.
He scrutinized Lady Illusion Butterfly’s expression and suspiciously said, "Could it be that Lady Illusion Butterfly has also accepted an incredible disciple this time and wants to gain some insight?"
"Hehehe~" Lady Illusion Butterfly covered her jade lips with a palm fan, giggling charmingly, "Master Xuan Yao, you’re too impatient~ Don’t rush, let’s just enjoy the spectacle for now."
Seeing the situation, an increasingly bitter expression adorned Changchun Ascendant’s immortal-like, Daoist face.
Lady Illusion Butterfly’s coming here so mysteriously likely means she has accepted a Celestial Pride and can’t hold back from making her presence known.
However, this woman is renowned for her cunning mind, possibly intending to assess the situation before making a decision.
Meanwhile.
With Lady Illusion Butterfly’s arrival, the new disciples from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies, led by the core disciples, were escorted into the plaza by the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley.
All these disciples from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies were women.
They wore thin veils similar to Lady Illusion Butterfly, obscuring their faces, with only their lively eyes exposed to everyone’s view.
Their ages varied, as did their figures and temperaments, but amid their graceful postures, each exuded a profound femininity.
Even before they approached, a pleasant fragrance seemed to waft through the air.
Several disciples from the Eternal Spring Valley stared wide-eyed, and even among the disciples from Carefree Peak brought by Master Xuan Yao, many were so nervous they didn’t know where to place their hands and feet.
Of course, this didn’t include Wang Shouzhe.
Despite the dozen or so beautiful female disciples from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies, Wang Shouzhe immediately spotted a familiar figure among them.
Wang Luojing.
Wang Luojing was still dressed in that purple long dress. Amidst a dozen beauties of varying temperaments, she wasn’t conspicuous, yet that couldn’t fool Wang Shouzhe, who was very familiar with her.
So that’s how it is.
Wang Shouzhe suddenly realized why Lady Illusion Butterfly was in such a hurry to come to Eternal Spring Valley. It turns out she also acquired a treasure and was eager to show it off.
Except that seeing Master Xuan Yao seemed to have taken the lead, she temporarily hid Wang Luojing, planning to seize the right moment to make her move.
Wang Shouzhe could guess as much from Lady Illusion Butterfly’s occasional glances towards Wang Luojing, even while chatting with the other two Ascendants.
He also felt a sense of lament; the Eternal Spring Lineage was probably in for some trouble.
One Luqiu is already enough to cause trouble, and Luojing is no pushover either. When the two sisters are together, they never stop until they’ve stirred up something.
As expected.
Before anyone else noticed, Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing’s gazes had already met.
Although they hadn’t spoken, Wang Shouzhe could already sense the sparks flying between them, along with the long-standing rivalry among them.
After all, they have been competing with each other since they were little, neither willing to concede to the other.
As Wang Shouzhe sighed at the impending storm, the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley were lamenting.
What’s wrong with this year’s traditional recruitment event? Usually, it’s rare for any Ascendant to participate, but this time two Ascendants have come to Eternal Spring Valley, bringing their disciples to witness the event.
This is clearly looking down on Eternal Spring Valley, they all want to start warming up with Eternal Spring Valley.
What a sorrowful thing this is!
In the midst of this low-spirited atmosphere, a fairly young disciple from Eternal Spring Valley led a group of young people over.
He cupped his hands and said, "Senior Brother Jinshan, I’ve brought over all the newly recruited disciples this time."
This was the Junior Brother Yuze of Eternal Spring Valley, Li Yuzhe.
He was only in his thirties, yet already in the Spirit Platform Realm, making him one of the most outstanding young disciples in Eternal Spring Valley today.
This time, he was in charge of recruiting new disciples.
Senior Brother Jinshan’s spirit lifted slightly as he looked at the dozen or so new disciples.
But with just one glance, his heart sank to the bottom.
These dozen new disciples all appeared evasive, timid, without a hint of Celestial Pride’s demeanor.
Well, Celestial Prides are not easy to find.
Senior Brother Jinshan understood this point, but comparing Wang Luqiu with his own disciples, he couldn’t help but feel disappointed, shaking his head with a sigh.
Li Yuzhe said, "Senior Brother Jinshan, among the newly recruited disciples, there are actually two who are quite good, both having awakened a layer of bloodline in the Qi Refining Realm, which can be considered core seeds with some potential."
"Core seeds... what use are core seeds?" Senior Brother Jinshan said helplessly, "Back then, weren’t we all core seeds? Wasn’t everyone a good seedling? But we all ended up getting beaten."
However, there’s nothing that can be done, as their Eternal Spring Lineage is simply not adept at combat.
"Enough, since they are good seedlings, they should be encouraged." Senior Brother Jinshan made a leading gesture with his hand.
Li Yuzhe, taking the command, waved his hand and said, "Liu Yunlang, Xu Shanshan, you two come over here."
As soon as he finished speaking, a good-natured girl with doe-like innocent eyes immediately ran over and ceremoniously saluted, "Greetings, Junior Brother Yuze."
"Where’s Liu Yunlang?" Li Yuzhe frowned.
Xu Shanshan hesitated for a moment and said, "He was just here, but he’s vanished at the blink of an eye. Where did he run off to?"
She looked around and exclaimed in surprise, pointing in a direction, "He’s over there."
Everyone turned to look in unison and saw that Liu Yunlang had somehow made his way to the "rival camp."
At this moment, Liu Yunlang was respectfully saluting Wang Luqiu, saying, "Senior Sister, so you are here."
"Yunlang~" Wang Luqiu’s eyebrows raised slightly, immediately recognizing this junior disciple she had taken under her wing, "So you joined Eternal Spring Valley. But with your Wood Talent, joining Eternal Spring Valley is a good choice. Train hard, don’t disgrace me."
After saying this, she gently patted Liu Yunlang on the shoulder, showing the demeanor of a big sister.
"Thank you, Senior Sister, for your encouragement. I will certainly work hard." Liu Yunlang was thrilled to be acknowledged by the big sister, his cheeks even turning slightly red.
Is this it?
The disciples of Eternal Spring Valley exchanged looks, feeling embarrassed that their core seedling, a promising talent, ran over to address someone else as senior sister, behaving in such an ingratiating manner.
How could they face this?
Senior Brother Jinshan’s face turned dark: "Li Yuzhe, is this what you mean by ’potential’?"
Li Yuzhe also broke into a cold sweat. There was some hope before, but now it seemed there was none whatsoever.
Witnessing this scene, Wang Shouzhe could only shake his head.
Eternal Spring Valley’s new disciples probably don’t have anyone who could stand up to Wang Luqiu.
In contrast, the disciples from Carefree Peak seemed even more spirited after witnessing this.
"Senior Brother Jinshan, our Xuan Yao Lineage’s new disciples have come to gain some insight, so would Senior Brother Jinshan mind setting a stage for us today? How shall we compete today?" Senior Brother Xiu Ping laughed, then suddenly spoke aloud.
The faces of Senior Brother Jinshan and the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley turned dark.
How to compete?
Could it be any other way?
Given the current situation, they could only lay low, as always~
However, just as Senior Brother Jinshan was about to speak, a suddenly sharp voice rang out.
"Zhang Xiuping, don’t get cocky. Let’s have some fun if you dare."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 36: Junior Sister! Please Feel Free to Strike
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 36: Junior Sister! Please Feel Free to Strike
...
As the voice fell, a green silhouette descended from the sky and landed in front of Senior Brother Jinshan.
This woman who jumped out at the critical moment was none other than Junior Sister Lvwei, who had just escaped.
With both hands on her hips, she chided the disciples of the Xuan Yao Lineage, "Zhang Xiuping, Mu Yuanbai, aren’t you both quite capable? Come on, let your Senior Sister Lvwei teach you how to behave."
"Junior Sister!"
"Junior Sister, you’re finally here!"
"Junior Sister is mighty, Junior Sister is bold! Teach them a lesson!"
As soon as Junior Sister Lvwei appeared, everyone from Eternal Spring Valley immediately felt emboldened, each face flushed as if they had found someone to back them up.
It was quite clear, even though Junior Sister Lvwei made everyone from Eternal Spring Valley avoid her due to those bizarre experiments.
But undeniably, her combat strength was impressively strong.
Listening to the excited cheers of her junior brothers and sisters, Junior Sister Lvwei couldn’t help but straighten her spine, lift her chin, and exude an increasingly intimidating aura.
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai, the elite disciples under Master Xuan Yao, saw her, and their expressions changed.
They approached together and bowed respectfully, saying, "Xiu Ping, Yuanbai, greet Senior Sister Lvwei."
They didn’t quite have the courage to offend Lvwei. Moreover, the woman’s tactics were enigmatic; if they offended her, something bad might happen later, and no one could predict it.
"If you two want to fight, I’ll accompany you." Junior Sister Lvwei appeared formidable.
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai exchanged glances.
"We wouldn’t dare fight Senior Sister Lvwei," Zhang Xiuping said, "Besides, as a Direct Disciple, participating in our young Core Disciple and newly initiated disciple’s traditional celebration might not be appropriate, right?"
Mu Yuanbai couldn’t help but chime in, "If Senior Sister Lvwei is interested, our Xuan Yao Lineage has Direct Senior Brothers who can accompany you for a good time."
"You!"
Junior Sister Lvwei stomped her foot in anger but had nothing to say.
Because what they said was indeed reasonable.
Doesn’t everyone have a few Direct Disciples? If Direct Disciples all come out to play, wouldn’t it become chaotic?
"Junior Sister," Senior Brother Jinshan walked forward with a wry smile, "Your participation is indeed inappropriate. No worries, we’re all used to it. Anyway, just close your eyes, grit your teeth, everything will pass eventually. Play as you like, after all, in a few years, I’ll be over sixty and won’t be eligible to participate anymore."
Beside him, Li Yuzhe looked sad.
Eternal Spring Valley’s fighting force is really inherited from generation to generation. When Senior Brother Jinshan retires, won’t it be his turn next?
Rules are rules, tradition is tradition.
Lvwei was also helpless, she could only glare fiercely at the two of them as her tone carried a warning, "You two be careful."
There was nothing she could do, so she could only retreat.
"Come on~" Senior Brother Jinshan stepped forward, saying calmly, "According to the usual practice, the appetizer is the young Core Disciple practicing first. Zhang Xiuping, Mu Yuanbai, who among you is coming up this time? Or maybe both together, I’m going all out today to play with you."
As he said, what’s inevitable will certainly come, and what’s past will certainly also pass.
It’s just a matter of being beaten, he can endure it anyway.
Senior Brother Jinshan took off his coat and went on stage, directly posing in a "at-your-mercy" manner, clearly already resigned to his fate.
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai glanced at each other, but both were uninterested.
"Forget it~ Playing with Senior Brother Jinshan every time is really boring." Zhang Xiuping sighed.
"You’re right. In Eternal Spring Valley, only Senior Brother Jinshan can be fun, but playing too much gets tiring." Mu Yuanbai sighed too, "Forget it, let Senior Brother Jinshan peacefully pass through these years until he’s sixty~"
Their disdain was evident.
On stage, Senior Brother Jinshan stumbled and almost fell.
He had prepared his stance, built his mental fortitude, and was ready to close his eyes and bite through the storm.
But it turned out they wouldn’t even play with him, and instead, they despised him!
How could he handle this!
Seeing that Senior Brother Jinshan was almost going to duel Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai due to anger, Li Yuzhe and another junior brother quickly pulled him down, consoling and pulling him off the stage.
"Don’t be angry, Senior Brother, don’t be angry. If they don’t play, you’re spared a thrashing~"
Meanwhile.
On the other side, Zhang Xiuping didn’t pay much attention to Senior Brother Jinshan’s reaction, after finishing that sentence, he turned to Wang Luqiu, "Junior Sister Luqiu, Master said you should take the lead today. Why don’t you decide what we should experience today?"
His attitude was very gentle and polite, just because he knew, maybe now his strength far surpassed Wang Luqiu. However, sooner or later, the strength of this Celestial Pride, Junior Sister, would surpass him.
After all, Master hinted that once Junior Sister Luqiu reached the Spirit Platform Realm, she would be directly accepted as a Direct Disciple.
"Senior Brother Xiu Ping, you’re too kind."
Wang Luqiu returned the gesture with a bow and then calmly glanced at the ten or so new disciples of Eternal Spring Valley.
However, those Eternal Spring Valley disciples either looked up at the sky or lowered their heads, and none dared to meet her gaze.
Wang Luqiu frowned and slowly shook her head, "Senior Brother Xiu Ping, they’re too weak, it’s not satisfying to win."

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 36: Junior Sister! Please Feel Free to Strike_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 36: Junior Sister! Please Feel Free to Strike_2
Zhang Xiuping looked speechless.
Who else do you want to fight if not them?
Wang Luqiu’s gaze swept over the crowd from Eternal Spring Valley, and then suddenly settled on Senior Brother Jinshan. She calmly said, "I’ve heard that Senior Brother Jinshan is quite skilled. Let’s go with him."
What?!
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked.
Wang Luqiu actually wants to fight Senior Brother Jinshan? That’s crazy!
I knew it.
Wang Shouzhe slapped his forehead, feeling speechless.
He had to admit, his sixth sister’s personality hadn’t changed since she was a child. She always aimed for the strongest opponent.
He still clearly remembered how Wang Luqiu once organized a group of younger brothers and sisters to gang up on him.
Senior Brother Jinshan didn’t expect to be chosen. He was startled but laughed angrily, "Alright, alright~ since this junior sister is so interested in me, then let’s do it!"
Saying that, he prepared to go back on stage, rolling up his sleeves.
This is just too humiliating! His old rivals Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai said they wanted to fight him, and he understood. But now a little girl who just joined wants to fight him too?
He was prepared to lose face today, but he had to teach this little girl how to behave!
However, before he could take a step, he was pulled back by a few junior brothers beside him.
"Senior Brother, you can’t~"
"Senior Brother Jinshan, calm down! Impulsiveness is the devil~"
"Well, Junior Sister Luqiu..." On the other side, Mu Yuanbai quickly pulled Wang Luqiu aside and said lowly, "Senior Brother Jinshan is almost sixty years old. You should give him some face. How about lowering the age limit a bit?"
Wang Luqiu thought for a moment, felt that her senior brother made sense, and nodded, saying, "Alright~ under fifty years old then."
Senior Brother Zhang Xiuping’s heart trembled. He rushed over, "Junior Sister Luqiu, you’re only twenty. Fighting those under fifty isn’t quite fitting, how about under thirty?"
This junior sister’s talent is exceptional, and it’s normal for her not to regard peers as worthy opponents.
But the Purple Mansion Academy isn’t the outside world, and there are quite a few who have achieved Spirit Platform Realm between thirty to forty. Those at fifty have been immersed in Spirit Platform Realm for a long time. How could you, at Qi Refining Realm, fight them?
Moreover, he, Zhang Xiuping, is nearly fifty and young among the core disciples. His cultivation reached Spirit Platform Realm Third Layer. Junior Sister Luqiu aiming for under fifty would include him too. How could he stand that?
Upon hearing Senior Brother Xiuping’s words, Wang Luqiu frowned slightly, a bit reluctant.
However, considering Senior Brother Xiuping and Senior Brother Yuanbai were generally quite "reasonable," she decided to give them some face.
She hesitated for a moment and then retreated slightly: "Thirty years is too young. Let’s make it thirty-five~ any younger is meaningless."
Thirty-five!
Even so, both Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai found it incredible. Did Junior Sister Luqiu overestimate her words?
Instinctively, they looked up at the sky towards the three Ascendants.
Master Xuan Yao was also slightly solemn, but since she wanted to try, let her. Even if she lost, it wasn’t embarrassing.
"My dear disciple, then do your best." Master Xuan Yao said calmly, "No matter what happens, your master supports you."
"Thank you, Master."
Wang Luqiu replied with neither joy nor sadness, then turned to Eternal Spring Valley’s crowd, announcing, "Send someone under thirty-five years old."
Upon hearing this, Eternal Spring Valley’s people were outraged.
This is just too arrogant and presumptuous!
This time, Li Yuzhe, who was in charge of recruiting, couldn’t help but step forward: "Little girl, I’m thirty-four this year, just entered Spirit Platform Realm two years ago. Let me see what Carefree Peak is capable of!"
Saying that, he jumped onto the stage first.
Wang Luqiu didn’t seem to notice his anger, calmly stepping onto the stage, saluted to Li Yuzhe, "From Carefree Lineage, Wang Luqiu, please instruct me, Senior Brother."
Li Yuzhe laughed angrily, "Junior Sister Luqiu, I’m over ten years older than you. I won’t take advantage of you. If you can break my defense, you’ll have won."
He then took out a piece of tree bark the size of a palm.
The surface of the tree bark was full of wrinkles, looking simple and weathered, utterly unremarkable.
However, as Li Yuzhe inserted his Profound Qi, the bark expanded instantly. In the blink of an eye, it transformed into a suit of thick tree bark armor enveloping him entirely, leaving only his eyes exposed.
Green Wood Profound Qi slowly circulated on the surface of the tree bark armor, even the wrinkled, uneven folds seemed to emit a faint glow, its aura profound and sturdy.
"Junior Sister Luqiu, this is Eternal Spring Valley’s secret technique—Ancient Tree Armor." Senior Brother Xiuping reminded, "Its defense is astonishing. If you can’t break it quickly, it will repair itself."
Wang Luqiu nodded to indicate she understood.
At this moment, Li Yuzhe had already activated his Profound Qi again, a solid green energy rose from his body, and in an instant, a thick green Profound Qi Shield formed around him.
"Wood Spirit Shield, continuously self-replenishing energy." Senior Brother Yuanbai solemnly reminded, "This Spirit Shield is very troublesome, known for "Profound Qi’s indestructibility, Spirit Shield unbreakable.’ If Junior Sister Luqiu lacks explosiveness, breaking this Spirit Shield might be difficult."
Among the crowd, Wang Shouzhe watched and could not help inwardly clicking his tongue.
No wonder Ancestor Longyan commented that Eternal Spring Valley was "extremely resilient." It seems they are more than just "able to withstand."

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 36: Junior Sister! Feel Free to Strike _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 36: Junior Sister! Feel Free to Strike _3
"Thank you, Senior Brothers, for the reminder." Wang Luqiu turned back, nodding with a slightly grave expression, "This Senior Brother from Eternal Spring Valley. Are you ready?"
"Wait, I’ve got one more thing."
Li Yuzhe pulled out a piece of leaf, green as jade, emitting a vibrant life force, and put it into his mouth.
Immediately, strands of visible green energy flowed out from the leaf, streaming throughout his body.
"Li Yuzhe, do you have any shame?" Senior Brother Xiu Ping burst out angrily, "You’re using the pretext of defense to slowly stack up? Facing a junior sister more than ten years your junior, you’re even using Immortal Tree Leaves, aren’t you ashamed?!"
Disciples of Eternal Spring Valley are known for defense but not for attack, and if other disciples face them, they usually wouldn’t give such ample time for defensive enhancements.
Other disciples from Carefree Peak couldn’t help but loudly condemn Li Yuzhe’s shamelessness.
"Senior Brother Yuze is only defending without counterattacking, what more do you want?" retorted the disciples from Eternal Spring Valley, unwilling to give in.
The quarrel made Wang Luqiu frown slightly.
She extended one hand.
The surrounding quieted immediately.
"Senior Brother, are you ready?" Wang Luqiu looked at Li Yuzhe calmly.
Seeing Wang Luqiu remain so composed, Li Yuzhe felt a trace of embarrassment, wondering if he might have overdone it.
However, recalling Wang Luqiu’s earlier audacious words, his determination hardened.
He felt it was his duty to let this young girl understand that there are always greater people out there, not to underestimate the Eternal Spring Lineage.
"Junior Sister! Attack at will!"
With the Immortal Tree Leaf in his mouth, he nodded slightly, filled with confidence.
The moment he spoke.
Wang Luqiu moved.
In an instant, she drove her War Body to the utmost limit.
This time, not only her eyes but her entire body was shrouded in a crimson energy aura, as if she were cloaked in burning flames.
Though thin, it emanated a powerful aura, making her appear majestic like a young phoenix, not to be underestimated despite her youth.
This was her state upon awakening her Second Layer bloodline. Not only did she enter the War Body state more effortlessly, but its power was incomparable to before.
"Boom!"
She punched the Wood Spirit Shield fiercely.
Layers of ripples spread across the Spirit Shield, nearly breaking it.
Li Yuzhe’s body was immediately sent flying by her punch.
Before he even landed, Wang Luqiu caught up like a flash of lightning, took hold with both hands, and with a thrust, Li Yuzhe shot upwards into the sky with a "whoosh".
This launch took him more than a dozen zhang high.
Dazed and dizzy, Li Yuzhe lost control of his body.
Meanwhile, Wang Luqiu stamped on the ground hard, and with a "boom", she soared into the air, reaching above Li Yuzhe, then descended, stamping hard on him.
"Boom!"
Li Yuzhe smashed into the arena like a cannonball.
The arena, made of ordinary stone, shattered, sending stones flying everywhere.
Li Yuzhe’s face turned pale, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.
But it wasn’t over yet.
In the air, leveraging the force of the stomp, Wang Luqiu rose again, reached a height of nearly twenty zhang, then flipped downward, accelerating her descent.
Seizing the momentum from the skyfall, she punched out.
With her strength gathered, her fist glowed like flames, her whole body engulfed in dazzling red light, unstoppable like a falling meteor.
"Boom~!"
With a deafening roar, Wang Luqiu’s fist, white as jade, smashed into Li Yuzhe fiercely.
Li Yuzhe’s whole body trembled.
Almost instantly, the Wood Spirit Shield on him shattered from her punch, the seemingly indestructible Ancient Tree Armor cracked, and even the arena beneath him was smashed into a big pit, pieces of stone scattered all around.
"Puff!"
Li Yuzhe spat a mouthful of blood, and the Immortal Tree Leaf flew out of his mouth.
Wang Luqiu seemed to have predicted all of this.
After punching, she didn’t pursue further, but calmly withdrew her fist, standing aside, her voice steady, "Senior Brother Yuze, please be serious, okay? Can we officially start the spar now?"
Below the arena, everyone was dumbfounded.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 37: Brother Yuze! The Twin Beauties Take Turns
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 37: Brother Yuze! The Twin Beauties Take Turns
...
How is this possible?!
Although Li Yuzhe had only advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm two years ago, he was still in the Spirit Platform Realm. Even if an ordinary Spirit Platform Realm attacked, it would be impossible to break through his defenses so quickly.
This girl is only in the Ninth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm; how can her explosive power and strength be so terrifying?
The disciples who saw Wang Luqiu’s action for the first time were all in shock, their faces full of disbelief.
The new disciples of the Carefree Peak, however, shrank back in fear, the scene before them quickly evoking memories. Once upon a time, they also thought they were very powerful, until they encountered Wang Luqiu...
Forget it~ Thinking too much only brings tears.
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but nod secretly.
This girl’s use of the War Body is becoming increasingly skilled, and her progress has far exceeded his expectations. At this rate, if she advances to the Spirit Platform Realm, how terrifying would her combat power be?
Tsk~ It seems he really needs to work harder.
It’s one thing not to be able to beat his wife, but if he can’t even beat his younger sister and niece, that would be truly humiliating~
"Not only is my disciple Luqiu exceptionally talented, but her combat awareness is also so strong, knowing how to utilize various environments to maximize lethality. A child worth teaching, indeed~"
In the sky, Master Xuan Yao gently stroked his beard, nodding in satisfaction.
His face still carried that stern and majestic look, but there was an unmistakable hint of smugness in his eyes, leaving Changchun Ascendant feeling a bit frustrated.
Compared to Wang Luqiu, Li Yuzhe was completely a negative example. With a much stronger realm cultivation, his combat awareness was so weak. Just now, he was like a turtle caught by an eagle and dropped on a rock, shattering his shell.
Can’t he use his brain a bit?
"Hehehe~ This girl is quite interesting~" Lady Illusion Butterfly chuckled, covering her mouth, "But she’s too upright, not directly pursuing to win the fight."
Master Xuan Yao laughed and said, "I suppose she wasn’t done playing yet."
"Most likely."
Lady Illusion Butterfly and Master Xuan Yao chatted back and forth, causing Changchun Ascendant’s expression to grow even more complex.
The conversation between the Ascendants did not affect the grand scheme below, and at this time, Li Yuzhe on the platform finally came back to his senses from doubting life.
"Cough, cough!"
He spat blood, his face pale: "Junior Sister Luqiu, I admit I underestimated you. I take back what I said before; let me recover a bit before we fight again."
"Senior Brother Yuzhe, please take your time." Wang Luqiu was in no hurry, standing there with her arms crossed, waiting leisurely.
Li Yuzhe, while still coughing up blood, picked up his Immortal Tree Leaves and put them back in his mouth.
The constant healing energy from the Immortal Tree Leaves coursed through his internal organs, and his face quickly became flushed again.
The Ancient Tree Armor on him also quickly regrew and filled, the cracks sealing up, restoring his full defensive state.
"Junior Sister, wait a bit more."
After taking a few breaths, Li Yuzhe’s Profound Qi surged forth again, condensing into the Wood Spirit Shield.
"Shameless, utterly shameless!"
Seeing this, the disciples from Carefree Peak were so furious they started cursing.
The faces of the people from Eternal Spring Valley also showed slight embarrassment.
However, no matter what, Li Yuzhe was one of their own, and despite his shamelessness, they still needed to back him up a bit.
Thus, another round of cursing ensued.
However, since this was after all the home ground for Eternal Spring Valley, it didn’t take long for the voices of the Carefree Peak lineage to get suppressed, forcing them to retreat.
"Junior Sister Luqiu, come on!"
True to being a disciple of Eternal Spring Valley, with just a bit of time, Li Yuzhe had fully recovered and was ready to battle again, brimming with energy.
"Senior Brother, be careful, here I come."
As soon as Wang Luqiu finished speaking, she dashed out like a rapid leopard king, her body technique so fast that shadows burst forth from where she stood.
In the blink of an eye, she was right beside Li Yuzhe, relentlessly bombarding him with heavy punches and kicks.
This time, Li Yuzhe had learned his lesson. Instead of relying solely on the Wood Spirit Shield for defense, he blocked Wang Luqiu with fists and kicks, only using the Wood Spirit Shield when he couldn’t withstand her attacks.
By doing so, although the Wood Spirit Shield endured significant wear, it could be swiftly replenished, allowing Li Yuzhe to maintain a state of full defense. It was no longer easy for Wang Luqiu to take him down.
"Junior Sister Luqiu," Li Yuzhe said with a smug face, "Now you see the defensive capabilities of our Eternal Spring Valley lineage?"
The disciples from Carefree Peak were a bit worried.
The trouble with the Eternal Spring Valley lineage was precisely this.
If you can’t quickly break through all their defenses, you’ll be dragged into a protracted battle. And when it comes to protracted battles, no one dares to claim the first place over Eternal Spring Valley.
Li Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai exchanged a glance, both feeling a bit regretful.
Junior Sister Luqiu was astonishingly talented, with a strong combat sense, but ultimately she was too young and too confident in herself.
Overconfidence in battle is a big no-no. How could one give Li Yuzhe so much time to catch his breath?
Profound Qi is eternal, inexhaustible, fighting with you until the end of time. This is no joke.
However, regardless of their thoughts, Wang Luqiu remained calm and composed, steadily continuing her combat output. The surrounding comments, sighs of regret, and even some mocking words couldn’t stir a ripple in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 37 Yuze Senior Brother! The Two Beauties Take Turns Brushing_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 37 Yuze Senior Brother! The Two Beauties Take Turns Brushing_2
All her attention was focused on the battle.
Gradually, time passed bit by bit.
One quarter of an hour... two quarters...
Sweat poured from Wang Luqiu’s body, soaking her goose-yellow Black Tortoise Martial Attire without her realizing.
Yet, Li Yuzhe’s defense remained at full capacity, looking as if he could fight for another ten hours without concern.
"Luqiu, you can’t hold on anymore, can you?" Li Yuzhe chuckled, "I admit you are very skilled. Once you reach the Spirit Platform Realm, I definitely won’t be your match. But for now, you’re still too young. Concede, continuing to fight is meaningless."
"Indeed, it’s time to end. Thank you for sparring with me for so long."
Wang Luqiu’s voice carried a hint of panting, yet her tone remained incredibly calm and indifferent.
Before Li Yuzhe could react, she moved.
She pushed off the ground, her figure charging toward Li Yuzhe like lightning.
As her blood boiled, crimson energy enveloped her entire body, her aura surged instantly as if she became a different person.
Simultaneously, a trace of terrifying killing intent flashed through her calm eyes.
A substantive killing aura shrouded Li Yuzhe, as if choking him, freezing his smug smile.
"Brother, you can die now."
The seemingly casual words sounded like thunder in Li Yuzhe’s ears, shaking his very soul.
Fear rose from deep within.
What? She wants to kill me?! That look, that killing aura, she’s not joking!
Li Yuzhe’s mind trembled, his body stiffened, his movements slowed a beat.
And it was this beat that led to his fatal outcome.
Wang Luqiu struck out with an elbow, violently shaking the Wood Spirit Shield, almost shattering it. Following that, she kicked him into the air.
Simultaneously, she leaped high.
In mid-air, Wang Luqiu grabbed Li Yuzhe as if an eagle clutching a turtle shell.
The next moment, she dove down with Li Yuzhe, plummeting from the sky like a meteor.
Crimson flames fueled by burning blood wrapped around her, intertwining with the green Spirit Light from the Wood Spirit Shield, trailing a long flame tail.
"Boom!"
The platform shuddered violently, countless stones whistling and splintering.
Around the platform, disciples quickly raised sleeves to shield faces, unconsciously stepping back.
Moments later, as the debris settled, everyone looked again and saw a massive pit, two zhang square, at the center of the platform, its deepest point a good seven or eight feet deep.
Li Yuzhe lay at the pit’s deepest point, spitting three liters of blood, the Wood Spirit Shield shattered, while pieces of Ancient Tree Armor scattered on the ground.
The armor’s Spirit Light had completely dulled.
Li Yuzhe stared blankly at the sky.
Who am I? Where am I? What happened?
Witnessing this, the disciple’s eyes widened.
After watching a tug of war for two quarters, they’d grown drowsy, convinced Wang Luqiu would ultimately lose. Who could’ve thought in just the blink of an eye, the tide turned?
It’s simply astounding! Completely unexpected!
Everyone looked at each other; the scene fell silent as if no one dared speak.
"Brother Yuzhe, you’ve conceded,"
Wang Luqiu jumped out of the pit, politely bowing to Li Yuzhe.
Li Yuzhe’s body trembled, and in a low voice, he said, "Was Luqiu not intending to kill me?"
"Brother’s joking," Wang Luqiu gave him a look as if he were silly, her tone calm, "I have no grudges with you, what’s the use in killing?"
This left Li Yuzhe bewildered: "But Luqiu just now, that killing aura..."
"Sorry, killed too many people and Fierce Beasts, didn’t control my killing intent," Wang Luqiu replied casually, "Please forgive me."
Her explanation did more harm than good.
After hearing her, Li Yuzhe couldn’t help but shiver.
Luqiu is just around twenty, right? How many has she killed, how many Fierce Beasts, to accumulate such terrifying killing aura?
Actually, he didn’t know Wang Luqiu was merely boasting. She’s indeed captured many Loose Cultivator criminals but truly hasn’t killed many herself.
She merely exudes an aura similar to killing intent when activating her War Body.
However, others didn’t know Wang Luqiu was bluffing.
With her words, both Eternity Spring Valley’s and Carefree Peak’s younger generations showed intense fear in their eyes toward Wang Luqiu.
"Luqiu!"
"Luqiu is incredible, defeating the Spirit Platform Realm in a fair fight!"
At that moment, Carefree Peak’s people regained their senses and began cheering for Wang Luqiu.
It’s one word, exhilarating!
For a time, cheers and applause resonated unendingly below the platform.
The Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies’ female disciples never expected Wang Luqiu to possess such combat strength, turning to watch her with amazement.
Wang Shouzhe felt a bit proud inside.
Indeed, she’s my sixth sister, she truly won.
Yet, Li Yuzhe, despite high cultivation, good bloodline, and outstanding defense, ultimately had scarce battle experience. Moreover, perhaps due to issues within Eternal Spring Lineage, Li Yuzhe’s offense lacked severely.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 37: Senior Brother Yuze! The Two Beauties Take Turns _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 37: Senior Brother Yuze! The Two Beauties Take Turns _3
As a cultivator in the Spirit Platform Realm, such combat prowess can only be described as passable, and cannot be compared at all to the Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppets in the Trial Land.
After all, with Wang Luqiu’s current strength, challenging the Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppets is still slightly insufficient. Only when she reaches the peak of the Qi Refining Realm will there be a possibility of victory.
In stark contrast to the lively atmosphere at Carefree Peak was the situation at Eternal Spring Valley.
Senior Brother Jinshan and the others seemed to have a cloud hanging over their heads, and morale was low.
The new disciples wore expressions of bewilderment, deeply questioning whether joining Eternal Spring Valley was the right decision.
How could the lineage of Eternal Spring Valley be so weak?
"Our Eternal Spring Valley enjoys studying plants and rarely focuses our energy on combat. Furthermore, the rules of the ring match are somewhat unfair to Eternal Spring Valley disciples," Junior Sister Lvwei couldn’t stand it anymore and spoke up to salvage their dignity, "Actually, what we Eternal Spring Valley disciples excel at is defensive battles. Given some time, we can fortify a position like an iron bucket; anyone who dares to come in would meet their demise."
Indeed.
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe nodded silently.
Although these Eternal Spring Valley disciples couldn’t compare to him in stimulating plant growth and couldn’t quickly cultivate plants during battle, they could still generate a large number of combat-ready plants given enough time.
If provided a piece of land to gradually cultivate, they could manage it like a tower defense game, turning it into an impregnable fortress where Black Tortoise Cultivators of the same level would find themselves at a loss.
Just look at Wang Shouzhe’s courtyard.
That courtyard has now been painstakingly cultivated by him to a terrifying degree; even a Spirit Platform Realm Black Tortoise Cultivator would meet a grim fate if they dared to recklessly intrude.
Junior Sister Lvwei’s words somewhat rekindled some confidence among the new disciples.
Meanwhile.
In the sky, Master Xuan Yao was also very pleased with Wang Luqiu’s performance: "My disciple Luoqiu has certainly not let down my diligent teaching and guidance."
Changchun Ascendant’s gaze was somber: "That girl just joined today, right? When and where did you Xuan Yao diligently cultivate and instruct her?"
"Ho ho ho~"
Lady Illusion Butterfly was immensely amused by this and immediately burst into laughter, her body shaking with delight.
The expression on Changchun Ascendant’s face turned even darker.
It was only after quite a while that Lady Illusion Butterfly’s laughter finally subsided.
She flung her hair back with a captivating glance at the two Ascendants beside her: "The new disciple Master Xuan Yao just took in is indeed remarkable. However, isn’t it time for our disciples to take the stage now?"
"Ha ha ha ha ha~ After witnessing my disciple’s strength, the lady still wants to send her disciples up. It seems she is full of confidence." Master Xuan Yao laughed heartily, his eyes filled with anticipation. "In that case, I shall await eagerly."
Upon hearing this, Changchun Ascendant’s face turned even darker.
Having just witnessed the display from Xuan Yao, Lady Illusion Butterfly now couldn’t wait to come up again. Is she truly treating his Eternal Spring Valley as a pushover?!
But who could blame his Eternal Spring Valley, characterized by a slow and steady combat strength? Their initial performance in ring battles is simply lacking, even though he’s frustrated, he has no choice.
The worse Changchun Ascendant’s expression became, the more excited Lady Illusion Butterfly grew; she couldn’t stop her delightful laughter.
"Little darling, it’s your turn to take the stage. Be sure to ’thoroughly experience’ the senior brothers of Eternal Spring Valley." She waved her hand toward the platform.
"Yes, Master."
Upon hearing this, Wang Luojing stepped forward slowly and walked to the platform.
Unlike Wang Luqiu’s aggressive and domineering aura, her demeanor was tranquil as water, yet carried a genuine coldness that emanated from her very bones.
"Disciple of the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies, Wang Luojing." Wang Luojing said lightly, "Senior Brother Li Yuzhe, please recover well before bestowing your guidance again."
What?
The little girl from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies also wants to challenge Senior Brother Li Yuzhe?
The stage was instantly filled with an uproar.
Li Yuzhe, who had just struggled to stand up, wobbled upon hearing this, and his mind went blank.
What’s going on? He never used to be this popular, yet now all the junior sisters are lining up to challenge him.
What did he, Li Yuzhe, do to deserve such honor?
In the crowd, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but facepalm.
How could he forget that one of Luojing’s catchphrases was: "Whatever Luqiu can do, I can do too."
Therefore, if Luqiu can defeat Li Yuzhe, she certainly believes she can as well.
No one can persuade her otherwise on this point. Pity poor Li Yuzhe, who, after being defeated by Luqiu, now has to be defeated once more by Luojing.
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but feel a bit sympathetic towards Li Yuzhe.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 38: Sister Shocked! 4th Brother Is Coming to Fight Us
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 38: Sister Shocked! 4th Brother Is Coming to Fight Us
...
Li Yuzhe laughed angrily, "Fine, fine, fine, you all think I’m made of clay. Little girl, since you want to challenge me, then make your move!"
Wang Luojing glanced at him indifferently and shook her head, saying, "Senior Brother Yuzhe, please recover properly first."
Li Yuzhe was taken aback, finding it both amusing and infuriating.
It was clear she thought his current state wasn’t enough to make the fight enjoyable.
The other disciples of Eternal Spring Valley were also lamenting. What’s with this world? These young new disciples are more arrogant than the next.
The disciples from Carefree Peak and Wang Luqiu were still celebrating over there. Seeing this scene, they all covertly clicked their tongues.
Goodness, this little girl’s tone is no inferior to our Luqiu.
Wang Luqiu’s eyes slightly shifted, and she snorted coldly, "Childish."
Zhang Xiuping suddenly thought of something, "Wait! She just said her name is Wang Luojing."
As soon as he said this, everyone’s gaze turned towards Wang Luqiu, each with suspicions. Could it really be as they suspected?
"You’re right. She is my childish elder sister, older by one year."
Facing everyone’s gaze, Wang Luqiu remained composed, her tone casual as if discussing whether today’s lunch was tasty.
The disciples of Carefree Peak immediately fell silent.
They looked at Wang Luojing on the stage and then at Wang Luqiu, each feeling a sense of lament.
What’s going on? Are both sisters Celestial Prides?
The similar names caught the attention not only of those at Carefree Peak but also the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley, who were buzzing with discussion. "So they’re just a pair of sisters," "No wonder," such discussions were endless.
Hearing the rumblings below the stage, Li Yuzhe on the stage suddenly realized, his face turning serious.
If the younger sister is already so formidable, isn’t the elder sister even more so?
Immediately, he dared not be careless and said honestly, "If Junior Sister wants to challenge, then please wait until I recover."
Having said that, he sat obediently to cultivate and recover.
While Li Yuzhe was recovering, disciples from the Yuan Water Celestial Lake Lineage came to visit, out of habit, to see what was happening, though the Yuan Shui Ascendant was not among them. Apparently, it was just a routine visit for experience.
Seeing this, the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley breathed a sigh of relief.
They were truly afraid another Wang Luochun, Wang Luoxia, or Wang Luodong would show up, and then their Senior Brother Li Yuzhe would be in real trouble.
The disciples from the Yuan Water Celestial Lake Lineage hadn’t expected that there would be three Ascendants present in Eternal Spring Valley. Their initially aggressive demeanor instantly deflated, and after paying respects to the three Ascendants, they quietly watched the fight, not daring to stir up any trouble.
Ancestor Xuanfu and Liua Ruolei, both from the Yuan Water Celestial Lake Lineage, had also come along to join the fun.
Liua Ruolan was also in the crowd, first looking at Wang Luqiu near the stage and then at Wang Luojing on it, before glancing around.
Wang Shouzhe waved to her, "Over here."
Soon, the four of them gathered together.
"Dear wife, you’re not here to see the sights at Eternal Spring Valley, are you?" Wang Shouzhe looked at Liua Ruolan and laughed.
Liua Ruolan covered her mouth with a smile, "I heard about what happened just now. Our Luqiu sister really is impressive. But I don’t like fighting, and I haven’t formally joined the Yuan Water Celestial Lake Lineage, just came to watch the excitement."
For some reason, Wang Shouzhe secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
As long as she didn’t cause trouble, anything was fine. If she started making trouble, even Senior Brother Jinshan would be at a loss.
"Is it time for Luojing sister to show her skills now?" Liua Ruolan looked at the stage, her pretty face full of interest and excitement.
Although she wasn’t interested in fighting, she certainly enjoyed watching a good show.
"Dear wife, please keep your emotions in check," Wang Shouzhe reminded her.
They were, after all, watching the event within the Eternal Spring Lineage.
Seeing the constant unusual glances coming her way, Liua Ruolan stuck her tongue out playfully and stood gracefully beside Wang Shouzhe, watching the spectacle obediently.
Seeing this, Senior Brother Jinshan and his peers couldn’t help but glance askance at Wang Shouzhe.
This fellow isn’t just flirting with sisters in Eternal Spring Valley, but now he’s also mingling with the Yuan Water Celestial Lake Lineage.
However, even if they held opinions, they dared only swallow them.
Because they recognized the lady next to Wang Shouzhe as the core disciple of the Yuan Water Celestial Lake Lineage, Liua Xuanfu. While she’s not fond of fighting, tidying them up wouldn’t be a problem for her.
But let’s set aside gossip for now.
The proficiency aside, the disciples of Eternal Spring Valley were truly astonishingly resilient.
In just a quarter of an hour, Senior Brother Li Yuzhe was fully recovered and lively once again.
"Luojing Junior Sister, do you mind if I first put on some armor?"
Li Yuzhe was straightforwardly cheeky.
"Please, Senior Brother," Wang Luojing replied unconcernedly.
"Then I won’t stand on ceremony."
Li Yuzhe once again took out that piece of ancient tree bark and infused it with Profound Qi. The remaining parts of the Ancient Tree Armor soon spread over his entire body.
After such a long period of self-recovery, the Ancient Tree Armor had repaired itself quite a bit; aside from cracks on the surface, it was largely no different from before. The formidable self-repair ability of the Ancient Tree Armor was thus evident.
Next was the Wood Spirit Shield and Immortal Tree Leaves.
After putting on the full set of equipment, still feeling uneasy, he also pulled out several red fruits.
The fruits were about the size of a fist, with an exterior resembling overlapping scales, emanating a burning aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 38: Sister Shocked! 4th Brother Is Coming to Fight Us_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 38: Sister Shocked! 4th Brother Is Coming to Fight Us_2
When Li Yuzhe took out these few fruits, a look of heartache instantly appeared on his face.
He had painstakingly cultivated only seven of these fruits over ten years. Taking out three at once meant he would need to spend many years to make up for the loss; how could he not feel distressed?
"Fire dragon fruit?!"
However, upon witnessing this scene, the senior sisters from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies instantly turned pale and angrily chastised, "Li Yuzhe, have you no shame? Using fire dragon fruit against your junior sister!"
Some senior sisters quickly warned Wang Luojing, "Junior Sister Luojing, be very careful of that fire dragon fruit. It explodes, and the fire attribute liquid splashed out will stick to your body, burning layers of flames, making it extremely troublesome."
"Thank you for the warning, Senior Sister."
Wang Luojing nodded gravely.
When Wang Shouzhe heard the words "fire dragon fruit," he nearly burst into laughter. He couldn’t help it; those three words were just too ridiculous.
However, judging by the reaction of the senior sisters from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies, the power of this fire dragon fruit was probably not low. After laughing, he became interested.
It seemed that the lineage of Eternal Spring Valley was not without combat power, but the cultivation of those highly offensive plants was extremely challenging, and they were generally reluctant to use them.
"Senior Brother Yuzhe, are you ready?" Wang Luojing asked.
Li Yuzhe had Immortal Tree Leaves in his mouth, which made speaking difficult, so he nodded with a muffled voice, "Junior Sister Luojing, please go ahead."
"Hm."
Wang Luojing nodded, then acted without hesitation.
Her combat style was the complete opposite of Wang Luqiu’s. Before the fight even began, her figure flew rapidly backward, and simultaneously, a flute appeared in her hand.
Holding the insect flute horizontally in front of her, she blew gently, and the high-frequency flute notes began to resonate through the air.
"Buzz buzz buzz~"
Amidst a deep wing-flapping sound, a large swarm of Purple Crystal Spirit Bees appeared in the sky, flying toward Li Yuzhe like a cloud covering the sun.
These Purple Crystal Spirit Bees were all significantly larger than typical ones, their bodies emitting purple crystal light, with leg blades like knives and mouthparts vibrating. Hundreds gathered together, resembling a storm covering the sky and sun, not only visually impactful but also with astonishing combat strength.
In the wild, even Spirit Platform Realm cultivators would have to avoid such a formidable swarm.
"Spirit Insect Master!"
"My goodness, turns out she’s a combat Spirit Insect Master."
"To command such a massive swarm, how powerful must her spiritual sense be?"
Seeing this, everyone from Eternal Spring Valley’s faces changed instantly, heart-racing.
The female disciples from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies had seen Wang Luojing’s combat style before, yet they couldn’t help but marvel again now, "She truly deserves to be Junior Sister Luojing."
Li Yuzhe was also surprised, not expecting Wang Luojing to be a Spirit Insect Master, and apparently a very powerful one, commanding such a huge swarm despite only being at the Ninth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm.
Unfortunately, this bee swarm was useless to him~
Li Yuzhe began to laugh.
Sure enough, the swarms were all blocked outside the Wood Spirit Shield; no matter how they attacked, it had no effect, only creating slight ripples on the shield, like a brief rain.
In fact, even if they breached the Wood Spirit Shield, there was still the more formidable Ancient Tree Armor waiting for them.
"Alas, trouble is looming."
The senior sisters from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies felt sympathy for Luojing.
Such a swarm would usually be very effective against other Spirit Platform Realm practitioners, but was somewhat powerless against the "tortoise" type combatants of Eternal Spring Valley.
"Humph~"
On the stage, Wang Luojing also realized this point. She put away the insect flute, her expression remained calm, seemingly unaffected.
The next moment, she flipped her hand, and a palm-sized red toad appeared in her soft palm.
"Red Bull Fire Toad."
Wang Shouzhe paused, realizing this girl was about to give her all again.
This time, however, he wasn’t overly worried.
Nowadays, Wang Luojing was no longer who she used to be. Not only had her cultivation reached the Ninth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm, she had also awakened her bloodline to the Second Layer using Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid, achieving Upper Grade D-class Talent, and controlling this "Red Bull Fire Toad" no longer required essence blood.
Wang Luojing focused intensely, integrating her spiritual sense with the Red Bull Fire Toad.
In an instant, the palm-sized red toad jumped onto the stage with a "plop" and then grew against the wind, transforming into the size of a small calf, emitting a scorching and horrifying aura.
Relying on devouring Fire Evil Qi to evolve, it was inherently infused with potent evil qi, with even its breath carrying evil poison. If the Black Tortoise practitioner’s cultivation was too low or controlled improperly, they might self-inflict significant damage before even attacking the enemy.
But at this moment, it was as obedient as an ordinary toad before Wang Luojing.
"Moo!"
The Red Bull Fire Toad let out a bull-like cry, causing one’s eardrums to tremble slightly.
With one leap, it landed in front of Li Yuzhe, opening its mouth to spew red flames.
This was the signature profound skill of the Red Bull Fire Toad — the Red Flame Poison.
"This..." Li Yuzhe’s eyes bulged, "What on earth is this thing?"
"Junior Brother Yuze, retreat quickly!" Senior Brother Jinshan shouted desperately from below the stage, "That’s the Red Bull Fire Toad, a ferocious fire poison gu."
But now, even if Li Yuzhe wanted to retreat, it was already a step too late.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 38: Sister Shocked! 4th Brother Is Coming to Fight Us_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 38: Sister Shocked! 4th Brother Is Coming to Fight Us_3
The red flames have already fiercely collided with the Wood Spirit Shield.
In an instant, the Wood Spirit Shield seemed to encounter its nemesis, directly corroding and burning a large chunk. The edges continued to burn, collapse, and spread wildly around.
The Wood Spirit Shield, belonging to the Wood Element Spirit Shields, fears fiery attacks the most. Within a few breaths, the Wood Spirit Shield was reduced to nothingness, without a trace of residual aura left.
However, things did not end there.
The Red Flame Poison, still with momentum, directly licked onto the Ancient Tree Armor.
In a flash, black-red evil flames ignited on the Ancient Tree Armor. The wrinkled Ancient Tree Bark started to rapidly wither, as if drained of its Life Force, with its color turning dull.
In just over a dozen breaths, the Ancient Tree Armor had become dull and lackluster.
The Red Flame Poison quickly spread onto Li Yuzhe.
Li Yuzhe sensed something amiss and hastily waved his hand in surrender: "Stop burning~! Stop burning! I surrender!"
He turned and jumped off the stage.
Seeing this, Wang Luojing immediately maneuvered the Red Bull Fire Toad to cease its attack.
Though Li Yuzhe, who jumped off the stage, preserved his life, the Ancient Tree Armor had already been burned to charcoal. His hair and body also suffered multiple burns, and the fire poison infiltrated his body. The meridians on his skin faintly glimmered with black-red color, appearing highly abnormal.
Fortunately, the Eternal Spring Lineage boasts strong defense and poison resistance. With the Energy of the Immortal Tree Leaves flowing wave after wave, the fire poison was continuously dispelled, and the flame wounds on his body visibly recovered at a slow pace, while the abnormal poison gas also gradually faded away.
Admittedly, the Eternal Spring Lineage may have average combat strength, but their resilience and recovery power are truly extraordinary.
For a moment, there was complete silence below the stage, everyone was startled by the power of the Red Bull Fire Toad.
If the Wood Spirit Shield and Ancient Tree Armor restrained the hive poison insects, the Red Bull Fire Toad instead countered the defensive measures of the Eternal Spring Valley lineage.
In the sky, Lady Illusion Butterfly’s eyebrows curved in delight, her expression fully satisfied.
Master Xuan Yao also sighed with emotion: "Congratulations, Madam, on acquiring a fine disciple."
"Not at all~ Master Xuan Yao’s disciple is also impressive," Lady Illusion Butterfly replied with a smile.
The two thus began complimenting each other.
Only Changchun Ascendant wore a bitter expression.
For so long, this seemed to be the most severe face-smacking Eternal Spring Valley had suffered.
Enough, enough. Better think of a way to improve the fighting strength of the new disciples.
Unfortunately, Eternal Spring Valley’s Cultivation Technique has its limitations, making it difficult to unleash true power on the stage. After reaching the Celestial Human Realm, these restrictions lessen considerably, though offense is still not their strong suit.
At this moment, the disciples below the stage also began to react, starting to cheer. Especially the senior and junior sisters from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies were particularly excited.
Wang Luojing, however, appeared indifferent to the fame and disgrace, merely casting a distant glance at Wang Luqiu, as if to say: I perform faster than you.
"Hmph~" Wang Luqiu’s gaze sharpened, and she slowly walked up the stage, "Five Trouble Girl, how about we spar using the Eternal Spring Valley’s platform?"
"Six Trouble Girl," Wang Luojing replied without backing down, "Let’s compare."
Their eyes clashed, and it seemed as if sparks flew in the air, instantly intensifying the atmosphere.
Seeing the two astonishingly talented Trouble Girls seemingly about to fight, the disciples from the Eternal Spring Valley Lineage not only didn’t rejoice but felt even more demoralized.
Senior Brother Jinshan comforted them: "Though our Eternal Spring Valley Lineage is indeed overwhelmed in fights, we do have our own advantages."
The new disciples perked up: "Senior Brother Jinshan, what advantages do we have?"
"Our ’Eternal Spring True Technique’ has extremely nourishing effects on the body. In the same Cultivation Realm, we will surely be the one who lives the longest."
The new disciples, upon hearing this, didn’t become happy, instead, their morale further declined.
Fighting can’t win, what’s the use of just living long? Aren’t we just turtles?
"Ah~"
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe sighed lightly.
Changchun Ascendant ultimately had been of guidance to him, it seems this time he can’t stay out of it.
With this thought, he slowly ascended the stage and said to Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu, "Outer Disciple Wang Shouzhe of the Eternal Spring Valley Lineage, seeks to witness the strength of you two young ladies."
"What?"
Seeing the fourth brother make an appearance, Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing were instantly dumbfounded.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 39th - : Zhou Xuan! Heart Guard! Dual Spirit Domination
