chapters.content:
Chapter 267: 39th Chapter: Zhou Xuan! Heart Guard! Dual Spirit Domination
...
Not only were they shocked, but the disciples from the Carefree Peak and the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies were also astounded.
This pair of sisters was already so fierce, yet someone still went up to challenge them. Among those under thirty-five from the Eternal Spring Valley, it was probably difficult for anyone to defeat them, right?
Isn’t this looking for trouble!
"This..." Senior Brother Jinshan, who was comforting the new disciples, was also dumbfounded and quickly tried to persuade Wang Shouzhe to step down, "You brat, don’t go up there and seek death~ Those two girls are very fierce."
Although he was very envious of Wang Shouzhe’s handsome and heroic looks, Wang Shouzhe was ultimately still an Outer Disciple of the Eternal Spring Valley. How could he bear to watch him seek his own death?
The senior sisters who had benefited from Wang Shouzhe also panicked: "Junior Brother Shouzhe, don’t mess around! Even Senior Brother Lian Yuzhe couldn’t beat them, how can you, an Outer Disciple, do it?"
"Junior Brother Shouzhe, come down quickly, they’re too dangerous." Even Junior Sister Lvwei, who had been sulking on the side, was very nervous. If something happened to him, where would she go to buy skincare products in the future?
Seeing them so concerned about him, Wang Shouzhe felt deeply gratified.
Though the battle strength of the Eternal Spring Valley was not strong, at least their hearts were in the right place. It was worth it for him to stand up for them.
"Hehe."
In the sky, Master Xuan Yao couldn’t help but chuckle when he saw this scene, "This kid is still an Outer Disciple, yet he dares to challenge two Celestial Prides."
"Master Xuan Yao, don’t underestimate him." Lady Illusion Butterfly giggled, "Although this boy’s age is hard to discern, he’s already reached the Spirit Platform Realm. He might just have a chance to win."
Although Wang Shouzhe was wearing a High-level Breath Concealment Pendant, in the eyes of those at the Ascendant level, wearing it or not made no difference.
"What of the Spirit Platform Realm? He’s ultimately just an Outer Disciple." Master Xuan Yao shook his head and laughed lightly, "Even that excellent disciple Li Yuzhe, a future Core Disciple, was defeated cleanly."
"What’s wrong with being an Outer Disciple?" Changchun Ascendant glanced faintly, "Who says an Outer Disciple is necessarily weaker than a Core Disciple?"
He was also somewhat surprised that Wang Shouzhe went on stage. To be honest, he had a good impression of this boy and even considered recruiting him as a Core Disciple. If Wang Shouzhe hadn’t refused his invitation, this boy would already be a Core Disciple by now.
The only thing that bothered him a bit was Wang Longyan.
Wang Longyan had left a particularly deep impression on him. After all, every three years, he would hear that Wang Longyan had beaten some disciple of theirs again. In terms of the damage caused to the Eternal Spring Valley, Wang Longyan was stronger than these two little girls in front of him.
Wait!
Changchun Ascendant suddenly felt something was off.
These two little girls were both surnamed Wang. Wang Longyan and Wang Shouzhe were also surnamed Wang. Could there be a connection between them?
There were many people with the surname Wang in this world. Under normal circumstances, he wouldn’t have thought much of it. But today’s situation was strange, and it was hard to say for sure...
Changchun Ascendant’s eyes flashed with a glimmer of light.
At this moment, Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu, who were stunned and dumbfounded on the stage, finally reacted.
Wang Luojing was the first to cup her hands towards Wang Shouzhe and said, "Luojing greets Fourth Brother."
Wang Luqiu also hurriedly saluted, then raised her eyebrows with a voice full of confusion, "Fourth Brother, you actually want to stand up for the Eternal Spring Valley?"
The two girls calling him "Fourth Brother" didn’t seem unusual to them, but those around them were all stunned.
How is this possible? They were actually a family?!
Especially the people of the Eternal Spring Valley, who found it unbelievable. An Outer Disciple was actually the brother of these two Celestial Prides?
Indeed!
In the sky, Changchun Ascendant’s heart skipped a beat. They really were a family!
Beside him, Master Xuan Yao and Lady Illusion Butterfly also showed expressions of surprise.
When accepting disciples, they had reviewed the background information of the disciple, who was born in a small town in a border city from an Eighth-Grade Noble Family. The family history was clear and straightforward, checked for dozens of generations.
Such a family, producing one Celestial Pride was already incredibly fortunate, let alone two, surely a blessing from the ancestors.
This Outer Disciple, perhaps, is not just... Yes, otherwise not.
On the stage, however, Wang Shouzhe wasn’t affected by their reactions.
"Listen to what you’re saying." He smiled faintly, "Although I’m an Outer Disciple, I also count as a part of the Eternal Spring Valley. Naturally, I can’t stand seeing you act wild on our turf."
Wang Luqiu puffed her cheeks in a bit of grievance, "Fourth Brother, you’re bullying us."
"Right! We rarely get a chance to show off." Wang Luojing also had a dreamy look in her eyes, half-joking and half-seriously pouting, "You’re just out here to steal our spotlight, too cruel~"
What?
The disciples from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies and Carefree Peak were all dumbfounded.
Many of the newly entered disciples had already idolized Wang Luojing and Wang Luqiu, feeling they were so dominating and formidable, with an invincible aura against their peers!
They were exemplary models, yet here, their Fourth Brother comes up, and these two incredibly domineering girls start acting coy, it completely subverted their expectations.
"No matter what, I’m also under thirty-five." Wang Shouzhe said with a light smile, "You can come to the Eternal Spring Valley on behalf of your lineage, and naturally, I can also stand up for the Eternal Spring Valley. How about this, Fourth Brother won’t bully you, the two of you can come at me together."

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 39 Zhou Xuan! Heart Guard! Dual Spirit Domination_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 39 Zhou Xuan! Heart Guard! Dual Spirit Domination_2
"Well said, Junior Brother Shouzhe! That’s such a bold statement!"
As soon as these words were uttered, the senior sisters from the Eternal Spring Valley cheered.
Senior Brother Jinshan initially considered cheering as well, but seeing the light in the eyes of the junior sisters gazing at Wang Shouzhe, he swallowed his words.
Sigh~ These junior sisters are too young, they don’t know that good-looking men are unreliable.
Back in the day, sigh...
Senior Brother Jinshan secretly shook his head, seemingly reminded of some past events, which made him appear a bit more weathered, as if he had a story to tell...
However, while those from Eternal Spring Valley were happy, the disciples from Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies and Carefree Peak were displeased.
"Junior Sister Luojing, Junior Sister Luqiu, don’t mind if he’s your cousin! This concerns the honor of each lineage. If you need to fight, don’t hold back! The Master is watching from the heavens."
The two lineages’ disciples, disregarding their usual rivalry, all aimed their discontent at Wang Shouzhe, each one calling out in indignation.
However, their shouting was of no use.
The two sisters on the stage remained unmoved.
"I don’t want to fight with Fourth Brother~ You go and test others, Fourth Brother." Wang Luojing glanced at Wang Shouzhe with an inscrutable look, then turned and left the stage without hesitation.
Wang Luqiu hesitated slightly, but eventually said, "Today is not the right time. I’ll learn from Fourth Brother’s skills another day. Farewell."
Saying this, she too turned and left the stage.
Actually, it’s not that she couldn’t fight. After all, she often sparred with Fourth Brother, but fighting would surely damage her future empress image... because the result would undoubtedly be dire!
Seeing the two girls leave the stage without a word, everyone was dumbfounded.
Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies fell silent.
Carefree Peak also fell silent.
Only the spirits of Eternal Spring Valley were lifted significantly, feeling that Wang Shouzhe had won back quite a bit of face for them. Although winning without a fight felt strange, it was better than losing~
"Fine, enough~," said Zhang Xiuping, who was in charge of the team, smiling at Wang Luqiu, "After all, you’re family, it’s normal not to want to fight your brother. Today, we’ll give him some face. Come on, everyone, let’s go to the Profound Ice Hall to see what’s what."
Mentioning the Profound Ice Hall, the brothers and sisters of Carefree Peak were all full of excitement.
Because the Profound Ice Hall has always been powerful, it’s usually them who get to see others. This time, having a chance to visit the Profound Ice Hall is undoubtedly a glorious moment for the Xuan Yao Lineage.
Hearing them say this, Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies didn’t want to be left behind, immediately rallying around Wang Luojing and saying, "Come, come, let’s also go to the Profound Ice Hall."
The two groups were about to set off together.
Suddenly.
Wang Shouzhe’s voice came from the stage.
"Everyone, please wait."
"Friend, what advice do you have?"
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai exchanged a glance, raising their eyebrows slightly as they looked at Wang Shouzhe.
They were only polite to him because of Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing. As core disciples of the Xuan Yao Lineage, they didn’t need to regard an Outer Disciple at all.
"I wouldn’t dare give advice," Wang Shouzhe chuckled lightly, his tone still calm, "Since everyone has seen my Eternal Spring Valley, I naturally have to represent Eternal Spring Valley to see all of you."
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai both smiled at these words.
"Then, Younger Brother Shouzhe, how do you propose to see it?" Zhang Xiuping asked, his tone relaxed and composed.
He thought to himself, Wang Shouzhe probably wanted to earn some face for Eternal Spring Valley. On behalf of Junior Sister Luqiu, it wouldn’t be impossible to send a disciple to go along with him.
Unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe’s gaze rested on him and Mu Yuanbai.
"I heard that anyone over sixty can’t participate in this tradition. Surely, Senior Brother Xiu Ping and Senior Brother Yuanbai aren’t sixty yet," Wang Shouzhe said with an indifferent demeanor, as if stating a simple fact, "I wonder, which Senior Brother can teach me?"
"What?! "
The words caused a collective shock among the members of Carefree Peak.
Luqiu’s brother gone mad? He actually wants to challenge the core disciples!
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai were also quite incensed.
They were outstanding figures of the younger generation, naturally proud and not accustomed to suffering any insults. Besides, how could the dignity of core disciples be trampled upon?
Earlier, they were courteous to him solely because of Junior Sister Luqiu. Since this guy doesn’t appreciate it, they can’t be blamed!
Zhang Xiuping and Mu Yuanbai exchanged a determined glance.
Mu Yuanbai leapt lightly, landing as if walking on solid ground, and ascended the stage with ease.
Seeing this, the disciples from Eternal Spring Valley beneath the stage became nervous. Even the female disciples from Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies couldn’t help but pause.
Mu Yuanbai stood with hands behind his back, his expression serious, his eyes showing a hint of sharpness: "Friend, if we spar, I won’t hold back."
Wang Shouzhe remained as calm as ever, slightly cupping his hands: "Naturally, please teach me, Brother Yuanbai."
"Good!"
Mu Yuanbai became very serious at once.
He placed one hand behind his back, and with his other hand, a sword about a foot long appeared in his palm.
The sword was as thin as cicada wings, with a greenish glow throughout its body, moving around in his hand like a living fish.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 39 Zhou Xuan! Heart Guard! Dual Spirit Domination_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 39 Zhou Xuan! Heart Guard! Dual Spirit Domination_3
The sword edge sliced through the air, producing a melodious chime.
"This sword is named ’Cicada’s Chirping’." He glanced down at the sword in his palm, "It was bestowed upon me by my master, Master Xuan Yao. Agile and sharp, it kills invisibly. Younger Brother Shouzhe, please be cautious."
Wang Shouzhe maintained a calm expression, his hand brushed over the storage ring, and a simple, heavy longsword appeared in his palm.
This sword was about four feet and three inches long, entirely cast in a heavy bronze color. The spirit light was subdued, with ancient runes faintly visible, low-key yet extraordinary.
However, these were not the most attention-grabbing features.
The most striking aspect was that its blade was at least a third thicker and considerably broader than a typical longsword, making it less agile but more robust and imposing.
It seemed less like a sword and more like a double-edged axe.
Clearly, this was a spirit sword adept at both offense and defense, as well as slashing.
No wonder, when Ancestor Zhou Xuan commissioned an Artifact Refining Master to forge this sword back in the day, he must have considered battles against fierce beasts in the Outer Domain, making a light sword impractical.
"This sword is called the ’Cosmic Palace Sword,’ a Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact passed down through my family. Its sword aura is heavy and domineering, capable of slicing through metal and cutting mountains," Wang Shouzhe said, gripping the Cosmic Palace Sword, his gaze becoming increasingly assertive, "Brother Yuanbai, be careful."
Through the broad and thick blade of the Cosmic Palace Sword, he seemed to see scenes from the past where the ancestor held this sword, slaying fierce beasts.
The Cosmic Palace Sword has been enshrined in the Wang Family Ancestral Hall for years, only used by Ancestor Xiaohan during combat to defeat enemies.
As the head of the Wang clan, Wang Shouzhe was the true successor of the Cosmic Palace Sword. It symbolized more than martial power; it embodied the devotion and faith of all clan members, representing the family’s might.
Unnoticed, the profound qi within Wang Shouzhe began to flow, and his entire aura grew increasingly intense.
Seeing the Cosmic Palace Sword, his two imperious sisters, Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing, also turned serious, a hint of reverence appearing in their eyes.
If in normal circumstances, their Fourth Brother’s presence had an intimidation factor of six or seven, once he held the Cosmic Palace Sword, this intensity would rise straight to ten.
At this point, the two of them didn’t even dare to talk back.
"Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact?"
Mu Yuanbai couldn’t comprehend the deep meaning contained within the Cosmic Palace Sword, but his expression immediately changed; it was both solemn and envious.
A Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact—whether in terms of the rarity of materials or the difficulty of forging—far exceeded that of a Lower-Grade Spiritual Artifact, with its total value being several times higher.
This elder brother of Luqiu had a storage ring and a Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact; his foundation was indeed solid.
Just as he was about to announce the start of the duel.
Suddenly.
Wang Shouzhe flipped his hand again, and a shield appeared in his left hand. The shield was the size of a basin, shaped like an inverted pot lid, heavy yet not cumbersome, with runes swirling, spirit light flickering conspicuously.
"This shield is called ’Heart Guard,’" Wang Shouzhe introduced, "It’s a half-physical, half-energy spirit shield with exceptionally strong overall defense. Brother Yuanbai, be cautious."
Two spiritual artifacts?
Mu Yuanbai froze, his expression both solemn and envious.
He was born into an Eighth-Grade family, which had provided considerable support, allowing him to become a core disciple at a young age. But asking for family support for a spiritual artifact was too much.
The various disciples were also very envious of Wang Shouzhe, thinking he was likely a direct lineage successor of the Celestial Human families, so wealthy that it invoked envy.
"Brother Yuanbai, please instruct me,"
Wang Shouzhe held his sword and shield, assuming a combat stance.
"In that case, I won’t hold back."
As soon as Mu Yuanbai finished speaking, the spirit sword "Cicada Wings" in his palm emitted a sharp sword cry.
"Zing~~~~!"
In almost the blink of an eye, it flew before Wang Shouzhe, with a stroke of the sword lifting towards him.
Its speed was so swift that it was difficult for ordinary people to capture it with their sight.
However, how could Wang Shouzhe be an ordinary person?
Just as the spirit sword struck, the spirit shield "Heart Guard" slightly lifted, its shield aura suddenly intensified.
"Clang!"
The rippling shield aura, like waves on a green lake, easily blocked the incoming spirit sword.
Just kidding, the spirit shield "Heart Guard" was an Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact, how could a mere Lower-Grade Spirit Sword easily break its defense?
Without waiting for Mu Yuanbai to be surprised, Wang Shouzhe’s figure already darted forward like lightning, the Cosmic Palace Sword descending swiftly.
An incredibly sharp sword aura suddenly emanated from the sword, slashing towards Mu Yuanbai.
Powerful, domineering, brimming with edge!
Where the sword aura passed, the air itself was torn apart.
A piercing sharp whistle instantly sliced through the air, echoing across the entire arena.
Such powerful sword qi!
Mu Yuanbai’s expression changed, secretly realizing something was amiss.
Above the sky, Changchun Ascendant, Master Xuan Yao, and Lady Illusion Butterfly couldn’t help but cast surprised glances downwards.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 40 Shouzhe Shows His Might! The Power of the Patriarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 40 Shouzhe Shows His Might! The Power of the Patriarch
...
Below the battle stage, the disciples of the Eternal Spring Valley lineage were all stunned.
The Eternal Spring Valley lineage wasn’t devoid of disciples practicing Swordsmanship, but their main cultivation technique, the "Eternal Spring True Technique," provides a weak boost to attacks. Even if they train in Swordsmanship, it’s only as a supplement and not pursued in depth.
A disciple like Wang Shouzhe, who seriously cultivates Swordsmanship and strikes with such ferocity, is exceedingly rare. Some of the younger disciples had never seen the likes of it.
However, Mu Yuanbai is ultimately a formidable practitioner at the Third Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm. Even though Wang Shouzhe’s Sword Qi is fierce, it’s difficult to injure him with a single strike.
Mu Yuanbai’s figure flickered, and he drifted away like a falling leaf, narrowly avoiding the Sword Qi.
The Sword Qi brushed past him and landed on the battle stage.
"Rip!"
The Sword Qi sliced through the stage’s surface effortlessly, like a knife cutting through butter, leaving a long chasm in the stone.
Such power forced Mu Yuanbai to take a sharp breath.
"Body-Protecting Profound Gang!"
There was no trace of slack in him, and he immediately deployed his sect’s Secret Technique.
Thick Profound Qi burst from his body, inflating his garments and causing them to flutter.
A mass of yuan-white energy gathered and instantly formed a tangible layer of Body-Protecting Profound Gang around him, like an energy armor.
This layer of "Profound Gang," in terms of sheer defense, was inferior to the Wood Spirit Shield and lacked its endless vitality.
However, it clung closer and was more agile, more conducive to performing Profound Skills and Body Techniques.
With the protection of the Profound Gang, Mu Yuanbai felt much more secure and immediately engaged in a combat dance with Wang Shouzhe using his Body Technique.
His Body Technique was very graceful, imbued with a sense of lightness and rhythm.
Every step seemed to hit a spatial node, causing ripples in the air. From a distance, his form flickered, appearing as an Exiled Immortal.
"Clang! Clang! Clang!"
The Spirit Sword "Cicada’s Chirping" darted back and forth through the air like a fish, or a snake ready to strike, seizing the opportunity to attack Wang Shouzhe.
He timed his strikes accurately, often not attacking until necessary, but when he did, he struck at the vital points. If not for the Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact "Heart Guard Shield," Wang Shouzhe would likely have been wounded by now.
With each impact of the Powerful Qi, the sound of metal clashing echoed continuously.
"Good!"
The disciples of Carefree Peak couldn’t help but cheer.
"Senior Brother Yuanbai’s ’Flying Cloud Gang Step’ has reached a Refined level, as elegant and carefree as a Carefree Immortal."
"His Body-Protecting Profound Gang is also thick and substantial, making it hard to breach easily."
"Although Brother Luo Qiu’s brother has a remarkable Spiritual Artifact, he is only at the First Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm. If this continues, he might lose."
The disciples of Carefree Peak were abuzz with discussion, all admiring Mu Yuanbai’s displayed prowess.
However, it was clear that not all disciples shared this view.
Brother Jinshan from the Eternal Spring lineage was eloquently commenting on the performance of the two on stage: "I am quite familiar with Junior Brother Yuanbai’s ’Cicada’s Chirping,’ which usually confuses opponents with its sound, launching sudden attacks from unexpected angles."
"Junior Brother Shouzhe’s Spirit Shield has outstanding defensive capabilities, easily blocking most attack angles with a simple wave."
"Look closely, Junior Brother Shouzhe’s fundamentals are very solid, evidently honed through diligent practice. He moves with poise and maintains complete control of the battle rhythm. He doesn’t use Sword Qi recklessly, evidently biding his time, keeping Junior Brother Yuanbai in constant danger."
"Watch closely, isn’t Junior Brother Yuanbai’s ’Flying Cloud Gang Step’ hesitant to stop? If he stops, he will certainly face Sword Qi attacks, and his Body-Protecting Profound Gang can only withstand so much..."
Brother Jinshan’s analysis was well-founded and sounded very credible.
The disciples of the Eternal Spring Valley lineage were thrilled and began cheering enthusiastically for Wang Shouzhe.
"Brother Jinshan, according to your analysis, does that mean our Brother Luo Qiu is sure to win?" Liu Yunlang asked concerned from the side.
"Not necessarily," Brother Jinshan said candidly, "After all, Mu Yuanbai is no pushover. The outcome for both sides should be about fifty-fifty, it depends on who can seize the opportunity."
Although Brother Jinshan’s offensive methods were somewhat lacking, his extensive experience in sparring had given him unique insights into assessing the situation.
In the tense gaze of everyone below the stage, fifteen minutes passed unnoticed.
Mu Yuanbai became increasingly alarmed and anxious as the battle continued.
He hadn’t expected Brother Luo Qiu’s brother to be so challenging. Whether it was his Profound Qi Cultivation, Body Technique, or Swordsmanship, all were remarkably solid, legitimate, complemented by the exceptional defense and wide coverage of the Spirit Shield. Regardless of the angle of his "Cicada’s Chirping" attacks, they were easily blocked.
This made the opponent like a fortress, impenetrable and unconquerable.
"Brother Yuanbai, if you don’t have any powerful moves, you might just get dragged down by me until you exhaust yourself," Wang Shouzhe’s calm voice suddenly emerged, "Although your Profound Qi is thicker than mine, don’t forget, I possess the Wood Bloodline, cultivating the ’Eternal Spring True Technique,’ its greatest feature is strong endurance and endless flow."

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 40 Shouzhe Shows His Might! The Power of the Patriarch_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 40 Shouzhe Shows His Might! The Power of the Patriarch_2
Darn.
Mu Yuanbai felt a sudden shock in his heart.
He almost forgot Luo Qiu’s brother belongs to the Eternal Spring Lineage!
Although he still had sixty to seventy percent of his Primordial Qi left, if he couldn’t overcome the situation soon, he’d eventually be exhausted completely. On the other hand, the longer the time dragged on, the more evident the opponent’s advantage became.
Could it be that despite bullying the younger, he would still lose?!
Shocked as he was, Mu Yuanbai also felt a surge of determination in his heart.
That’s that~ Looks like he had no choice but to use that move.
At this thought, with a wave of his hand, the Spirit Sword "Cicada’s Chirping" instantly spun back into his palm.
Holding the sword in hand, his expression immediately became solemn.
"Luo Qiu’s brother, be careful."
Magnanimous at heart, he deliberately reminded Wang Shouzhe.
With that said, he then activated his Sword Intent.
In the next instant.
A surge of powerful momentum arose, transforming his entire demeanor.
At this moment, he seemed to merge with the Spirit Sword in his hand, exuding sharp edges from top to bottom.
Mu Yuanbai’s face turned pale, clearly indicating that this state caused him immense exertion.
Yet his gaze was extremely firm, and his hand holding the sword did not tremble in the slightest.
Only an invisible sharp aura gradually condensed around him as its center.
A massive Sword Light, several meters tall and several times larger than him gradually emerged behind him, radiating an indescribable sharp edge.
"Senior Brother Yuanbai, he..."
Witnessing this, the disciples of Carefree Peak turned pale simultaneously.
It was their master’s signature Black Tortoise Tortoise Combat Technique—"Mountain-Opening Sword Light"!
They hadn’t expected that Senior Brother Yuanbai had already mastered this move.
Although it was still just a prototype, its momentum was far from comparable to that of Master Xuan Yao, but in the end, it was nonetheless Mountain-Opening Sword Light~!
Even a few Ascendants watching overhead showed slight surprise.
Changchun Ascendant couldn’t help but praise, "Xuan Yao, your disciple Mu Yuanbai indeed has some of your youthful demeanor. The Mountain-Opening Sword Light is executed with some resemblance to you."
"No, no~" Master Xuan Yao stroked his beard with pride, though he remained humble in words, "This boy merely learned some fur and is showing off here; I’ll definitely make him reflect on his mistakes once we return."
Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing’s beautiful faces also couldn’t hide a bit of worry.
Thankfully, they had grown accustomed to seeing their fourth brother perform miracles since childhood, knowing he would never partake in anything without certainty.
Moreover, even as his sisters, they now couldn’t fathom his true depths; they only had an absurd sense: if their fourth brother truly let go, he might even put the Celestial Human Realm in a disadvantageous position.
They suspected he genuinely possessed cards that made even the Celestial Human Realm wary.
With this thought, they relaxed.
In the blink of an eye.
In just a few breaths, Mu Yuanbai’s Sword Light was brewed to its extreme. His face also bore a hint of paleness, evidently surpassing his ability to control.
"Go!"
With his furious shout.
The massive "Mountain-Opening Sword Light" suddenly flew out, overwhelmingly assaulting Wang Shouzhe!
This sword carried a peerless sharpness.
With the Sword Light piercing the heavens, it seemed to have the force to crack the earth.
Sword Intent soared high, seemingly bearing a might to open heaven and split earth.
The icy killing intent instantly locked onto Wang Shouzhe, sending his goosebumps all over.
Luckily, Wang Shouzhe was already prepared.
Almost at the same moment the Sword Light struck, his Eternal Spring Profound Qi frenziedly infused into the Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact "Heart Guard Shield."
Simultaneously, his expression turned solemn as he assumed a shield guard posture.
In an instant.
The Spirit Shield "Heart Guard" erupted with a heavy blue light, instantaneously forming an umbrella-shaped energy shield.
The diameter of the energy shield was about two to three meters, with a thickness of over a foot, with some mysterious and profound runes shining in the center of the shield.
"What a strong Spirit Shield!"
The crowd under the ring widened their eyes in awe.
At this moment, the Mountain-Opening Sword Light collided with the umbrella-shaped energy shield.
"Boom!"
With a deafening roar, two different colored energies erupted like fireworks, forming a circular shockwave with the "Heart Guard Shield" at its center, spreading in all directions.
Wherever the shockwave passed, the air shook violently, debris flew and turned to dust, and the waves of energy were ear-splitting.
Even the spectators around the ring felt impacts from the wave, retreating or employing methods to block.
Everyone’s expression was appalled.
How ferocious was the power of this energy clash? It felt like even two Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm individuals fighting couldn’t create such a remarkable shockwave.
However, among everyone, Mu Yuanbai was the most shocked.
He stared dully at the scattered ring, then looked towards Wang Shouzhe on the opposite side.
At this moment, Wang Shouzhe was in a shield guard posture half-squatted on the other side of the ring; the umbrella-shaped energy shield from the Spirit Shield had shattered, yet his body remained unharmed, only slightly retreating due to the impact force.
What kind of Defensive Spiritual Artifact was this?
Mu Yuanbai’s lips twitched, his heart overwhelmingly shaken.
Take Li Yuzhe’s previous defense as an example. Given the previous Mountain-Opening Sword Light’s power, just half of it, no, only thirty percent was needed to completely overwhelm it.
But Luo Qiu’s brother... no, he should be called "Wang Shouzhe," managed to fully withstand his strongest move.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 40 Shouzhe Shows His Might! The Power of the Patriarch_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 40 Shouzhe Shows His Might! The Power of the Patriarch_3
This indicates that the defense level of that defensive spiritual artifact is far above his Mountain-Opening Sword Light, at least a Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact.
Just as Mu Yuanbai was in a daze, Wang Shouzhe had already stood up.
"Truly worthy of Brother Yuanbai, the power of the Mountain-Opening Sword Light is quite formidable." Wang Shouzhe laughed freely, "However, if Brother Yuanbai has no other stronger methods, I’m afraid you’ll lose."
Lose?
Mu Yuanbai was stunned and couldn’t help but laugh: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I admit you’re very formidable. But saying I’ll lose, that’s a joke."
"Brother Yuanbai, take a look under your feet." Wang Shouzhe said unhurriedly.
Mu Yuanbai looked down, only to see scattered pieces of the arena stones, with some little green shoots growing out from the cracks. They were tender green, like newly sprouted grass, seemingly fragile underfoot.
He was puzzled: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, what are these?"
"Brother Yuanbai, you probably forgot. I’m an Outer Disciple of the Eternal Spring Valley." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "I’m best at farming."
"Good at farming, could this be?" Mu Yuanbai’s expression changed, "Could this be some kind of battle spirit plant?"
He instinctively retreated backward.
But it was too late.
More than half of the arena had unknowingly sprouted with little green shoots, a green expanse, like a spring wheat field.
No matter where he went, the green shoots at his feet would grow crazily, quickly turning into thick vine stems.
They moved like demon tentacles, or the witch’s long hair, eerily dancing, and as soon as they touched Mu Yuanbai, they would immediately grow madly, wrapping from his legs to his waist.
Mu Yuanbai’s expression tightened, and he immediately summoned his spirit sword.
The "Cicada’s Chirping" sword swung swiftly, and the vines were immediately severed.
However, Wang Shouzhe’s Vine Array never acts alone.
In this moment of intense battle with Mu Yuanbai, Wang Shouzhe had already quietly set up the Vine Array.
Vines tore at Mu Yuanbai incessantly; no matter where he went, vines would grow and launch a fierce attack on him.
The current vines were even more formidable than those Wang Shouzhe had in the Trial Land, not only growing faster but also having thicker and stronger stems, with stronger entangling power. Still, even so, they could not withstand the sharpness of a spiritual artifact.
But these vines occupied most of Mu Yuanbai’s energy, forcing him to continually strike to sever them.
In such circumstances, even a casual sword from Wang Shouzhe could injure him.
"Brother Yuanbai, you’ve lost."
Wang Shouzhe gave a calm smile.
As he finished speaking, he held a shield in his left hand and a sword in his right, directly charging at Mu Yuanbai with sword aura and shield defense, every move open and upright.
In less than half a quarter of an hour, Wang Shouzhe broke Mu Yuanbai’s Body-Protecting Profound Gang with a single strike, the impact sending him flying off the arena.
Mu Yuanbai let out an anguished grunt, tapping his feet on the ground several times before he barely steadied himself.
At that moment, he appeared extremely disheveled, but his pale face showed more disbelief!
Defeated!
He was really defeated!
He actually lost to a junior brother who just reached the first layer of Spirit Platform!
His expression turned anxious and dejected, almost to the point of being spiritless.
On the arena, Wang Shouzhe sheathed his sword and shield, bowing to Mu Yuanbai from a distance: "Brother Yuanbai, thank you for letting me win."
Given the situation, Mu Yuanbai was a broad-minded individual.
He bitterly smiled and returned the bow: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I’m impressed."
Their defeat was upright; even if they fought again, the result wouldn’t change. Even if he wanted to be unconvinced, he couldn’t.
With this battle concluded, the reactions from various factions naturally varied.
The morale at Carefree Peak was low, each hanging their heads.
Their Brother Yuanbai was defeated. And not just defeated, he was utterly defeated by a disciple of Eternal Spring Valley with no temper left.
If this scene had happened upon Carefree Peak, it would have been better, but now they were here to witness Eternal Spring Valley and ended up being the one witnessed; naturally, their faces burned with shame.
"Brother Yuanbai, it’s okay." Wang Luqiu, who had a good impression of this elegant senior brother, immediately stepped forward to comfort him, "It’s perfectly normal for you to lose to my Fourth Brother. Even when I team up with Fifth Sister, we can’t beat him."
Mu Yuanbai was speechless; is this even comforting? Also, Junior Sister Luqiu, why didn’t you warn him that your fourth brother was so powerful earlier?
In contrast, everyone from Eternal Spring Valley was flush with excitement.
They had been pushed to the lowest point but unexpectedly rose to the top in the blink of an eye. Such drastic emotional shifts left each of them overwhelmingly excited.
"Junior Brother Shouzhe."
A group of senior sisters from Eternal Spring Valley rushed onto the arena, showering Wang Shouzhe with concern, offering drinks, handing towels, and covertly slipping little notes to him.
Wang Shouzhe felt a faint killing intent approaching, turned to look back. It wasn’t his wife, Liua Ruolan, but rather his sister-in-law, Liua Ruolei, glaring at him with fierce eyes.
His wife, Liua Ruolan, however, remained smiling kindly.
He hurriedly used the Willow Catkin Body Technique to escape back to Liua Ruolan’s side, looking as if to prove his innocence.
"Wife, those senior sisters..."
"Husband, you’ve worked hard." Liua Ruolan picked up a handkerchief and gently wiped his sweat, saying, "Just now on stage, husband was truly valiant. It’s normal for senior sisters to covet your beauty."
"Uh..." Wang Shouzhe was speechless. Before turning into this, our wife was very easygoing.
Suddenly, just then.
Senior Brother Jinshan rushed over, shouting excitedly: "Senior Brother Shouzhe."
Wang Shouzhe was cold with sweat and quickly raised his hands: "Senior Brother Jinshan, please don’t!"
"No no no, as the saying goes, the capable leads first. You defeated Mu Yuanbai, winning immense face for our Eternal Spring Valley lineage." Senior Brother Jinshan exclaimed, full of excitement, clutching Wang Shouzhe’s hands, "How many years, how many years has it been since our Eternal Spring Valley has been so illustrious! All of this is your accomplishment! Forget calling you senior brother, even calling you master would do."
Master?
Uh... stop joking.
Wang Shouzhe hurriedly said: "Senior Brother Jinshan, speak with caution."
Then, he seriously stated: "Ascendant Changchun has shown me kindness and care. At crucial moments, it’s only right for Shouzhe to step up."
While they were conversing, dozens of Eternal Spring Valley disciples gathered around, each too excited to calm down, calling "Senior Brother Shouzhe," all looking at him with admiring eyes.
Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but think to himself, acting this time was not in vain given he indeed brought honor to Ascendant Changchun, and gave face to the valley.
"Senior Brother Shouzhe, why not take us to see the other lineages? We’ve never visited the other lineages."
"How about visiting the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies and meeting the beautiful senior sisters there?"
Senior Brother Jinshan, with a serious face, scolded them, "Your ambitions are too small! Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies, really?"
As he said that, even Senior Brother Jinshan’s eyebrows twitched slightly, scolding them in a slightly floating voice. It would have been quite reassuring if he were not usually so frivolous.
But as soon as he had this thought, Senior Brother Jinshan’s expression changed, and he continued scolding them: "Your ambitions should be grander! Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies and Yuan Water Celestial Lake are all beautiful senior sisters!"
His gaze shifted away, almost dismissing the thought he had just conceived.
Looking at Senior Brother Jinshan with a different look, Wang Shouzhe retracted his earlier comments.
Senior Brother Jinshan, though usually sleazy, was quite reliable at critical times.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 41: Seeking Celestial Pride! The Eternal Spring Lineage Shall Rise too
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 41: Seeking Celestial Pride! The Eternal Spring Lineage Shall Rise too
...
However, as soon as Senior Brother Jinshan said those words.
The disciples from the Eternal Spring Valley Lineage were instantly captivated, bursting into fervor.
To visit the other lineages was already a dream pursued by these disciples in their thirties or forties.
To visit the Profound Ice Hall was something they hadn’t dared to even dream of before today.
Faced with such eager anticipation and fervent excitement from the crowd.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t want to dampen their spirits too much, so he promptly shifted the topic: "Dear senior sisters and brothers, I’m a bit tired after the battle just now."
The implication, of course, was to brush aside the idea of visiting the Profound Ice Hall.
But Senior Brother Jinshan misunderstood, responding seriously, "What Senior Brother Shouzhe says is absolutely right. You need to have a proper rest before confronting anyone at the Profound Ice Hall. Everyone! Ensure that the Dao Transmission Hall’s resting room is spotless and bring in all sorts of delicacies to replenish his Primordial Qi!"
"Yes!"
The young brothers and sisters below cheered enthusiastically and immediately sprang into action.
As long as Senior Brother Shouzhe could take them to the Profound Ice Hall, they were willing to do anything.
Half an hour later, in a chamber within the Dao Transmission Hall, Wang Shouzhe faced Liua Ruolan, Liua Ruolei, Liua Xuanfu, and others.
"Brother-in-law, are you really planning on visiting the Profound Ice Hall?" Liua Ruolei asked worriedly from the side. "The Profound Ice Hall is different from other places. Their disciples, seniors, they are... well, quite formidable and difficult to deal with."
Ancestor Xuanfu also frowned slightly and said, "There aren’t many core disciples at the Profound Ice Hall. If you go there, there’s one person you need to be cautious of."
"His name is Jii Mingyu, a direct lineage disciple of the Longzuo Jii Family brought to the Academy because he’s the second legitimate son."
"This young man is only in his forties but has reached the Third Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm. His bloodline is strong and solid, making him even more formidable than Ancestor Longyan back in the day. He’s led new disciples around for experiences in recent years. Although not quite a real Celestial Pride, he’s not far from it."
Even as Ancestor Xuanfu spoke of him, she had a solemn expression, with a hint of admiration.
"Oh~" Wang Shouzhe was noncommittal, as he actually had no intention of going to the Profound Ice Hall.
Unlike Wang Luqiu, he didn’t have a strong Heart of the Emperor’s Road.
His greatest desire in life was to manage his small family well, so his family could live happily without worrying about cultivation resources.
He wasn’t interested in fighting at all.
"I think, husband, it’s mainly out of concern for Ancestor Longyan’s reputation," Liua Ruolan said with a smile. "If we rush over there, wouldn’t we be putting our ancestor in a tough spot?"
"You understand me best, my dear." Wang Shouzhe gazed deeply at Liua Ruolan, holding her jade hand and said, "With a wife like Ruolan, my journey to the mortal world has not been in vain."
"Becoming your wife is the greatest fortune of my life." A rosy blush appeared on Liua Ruolan’s delicate cheeks, shedding a glow of happiness.
"Tsk!"
Here we go again!
Liua Ruolei shivered slightly. Watching her sister and brother-in-law publicly display their affection made her feel the world was set against her.
The pair of them seemed to enjoy it, ready to flaunt their love anytime and anywhere.
Ancestor Xuanfu’s eyes too began to wander restlessly, revealing she might have felt like drawing her sword.
As they were speaking, a disciple from Eternal Spring Valley respectfully called from outside the door, "Senior Brother Shouzhe, how are you resting? If you’re ready, the Ascendant invites you for a meeting."
As expected!
Wang Shouzhe smiled.
The invitation from the Changchun Ascendant was within his expectations.
His plan to stand out at a crucial moment was indeed aimed at saving face for the Eternal Spring Valley. It was also a gesture of gratitude for the Ascendant’s previous guidance, but largely, it was to build a good rapport with the Ascendant.
He didn’t dare hope to latch onto the Ascendant instantly, but at least to hold some place in the Ascendant’s estimation.
Not just another random face in the crowd, but someone of some utility.
In life, it’s not being used that one should fear, but being devoid of value.
So, if ever he encountered injustice in the future.
He wouldn’t be left without any recourse, at least having somewhere to appeal, a way to move forward.
"My dear, Ancestor Xuanfu, you should rest for a bit. I’ll be right back."
After a few words of advice, Wang Shouzhe then followed the disciple out of the Dao Transmission Hall.
Eternal Spring Valley was nestled atop a peak spirit vein, with spirit fields spread all through the valley, cultivating all kinds of spirit plants radiating spirit light, interspersed with lush spirit trees and spirit tea. A vibrant scene unfolded before the eyes, and even the air was imbued with the fragrance of plants, elevating the spirit.
The deeper into the valley, the higher the grade of spirit fields became.
Before he knew it, the surrounding lands had transitioned from Lower-Grade Spirit Fields to Middle-Grade Spirit Fields, and then from Middle-Grade Spirit Fields to Upper-Grade Spirit Fields. The level of spirit plants within the fields also soared.
It was as if spirit seed treasures were everywhere, within reach at every turn.
Wang Shouzhe sensed an invisible pressure, marveling at the Saint Land of the Academy. He hadn’t even heard of many spirit plants, let alone seen them.
Eventually.
Traversing a slippery rock wall covered with spirit moss, the guide finally stopped in front of a modest-looking thatched hut.
"Senior Brother Shouzhe, the Ascendant is awaiting inside, I am unable to accompany you further." The guiding disciple of Eternal Spring Valley said respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 41: Seeking Celestial Pride! The Changchun Lineage Shall Rise too_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 41: Seeking Celestial Pride! The Changchun Lineage Shall Rise too_2
Not every disciple of Eternal Spring Valley is qualified to call Changchun Ascendant their master.
Only those who reach the level of Core Disciple are considered the true disciples of the Ascendant and are entitled to address him as Master.
"Thank you, Senior Brother."
Wang Shouzhe expressed his gratitude, took out some trinkets, and then carefully observed the straw hut before him.
Compared to the surrounding high-level Spirit Plants brimming with Spirit Light, the straw hut appeared quite ordinary. However, Wang Shouzhe dared not show the slightest disrespect.
The owner of this straw hut was none other than the illustrious Changchun Ascendant.
He tidied his robe, and with a solemn expression, respectfully clasped his hands toward the hut, saying, "Outer Disciple Wang Shouzhe requests an audience with Changchun Ascendant."
"Creak~"
The simple wooden door opened on its own, slowly swinging wide.
A gentle voice from inside the straw hut said, "Come in."
Following the instruction, Wang Shouzhe entered the straw hut and found its interior quite simple. Besides a few basic wooden tables and chairs, there was only a meditation mat.
Changchun Ascendant maintained his rustic farmer appearance but carried an aura of vitality, gentle and substantial, making one inadvertently feel a sense of kinship.
"Shouzhe greets the Ascendant."
Wang Shouzhe promptly stepped forward to pay his formal respects according to the proper etiquette.
"Sit down~"
Changchun Ascendant nodded at him, his demeanor kind.
Wang Shouzhe took a seat as instructed.
"At the crucial moment, why did you stand up for my Eternal Spring Valley? Don’t tell me you have a sense of honor for it," Changchun Ascendant remarked. "Or are you trying to curry favor with me, Shouzhe?"
After speaking, he cast a glance at Wang Shouzhe, seemingly with profound significance.
This glance naturally made Wang Shouzhe feel thoroughly analyzed.
Were an ordinary person in his place, they would likely be overwhelmed by this aura, struggling to speak.
But Wang Shouzhe was far from ordinary. He wouldn’t claim to calculate every step nor affirm that each action carried deep intention.
However, at least this move was far from simple on the surface.
Being summoned this time was something he had pondered over.
Immediately, he calmly explained, "Reporting to the Ascendant, Shouzhe intervened at the last moment first to repay the Ascendant for his previous guidance, and second to build a good relationship, hoping that my Wang Family could gain a foothold in the Academy." He spoke honestly.
This straightforwardness left Changchun Ascendant slightly stunned. Was the kid cunning, or was he candid?
"I have never liked fighting, nor do I interfere in worldly affairs. What I dislike most in this life is someone like Shouzhe, who is adept at scheming," Changchun Ascendant said with a slightly displeased expression, "However, I also dislike owing favors. Therefore, let this piece of Ancient Tree Armor and these two Immortal Tree Leaves serve as your reward for this endeavor."
With that, he produced a palm-sized piece of tree bark and two tender green leaves radiating life essence.
Wang Shouzhe was well aware these were precious, having seen them on Li Yuzhe earlier.
It was quite apparent that Changchun Ascendant intended to draw a boundary between them.
Wang Shouzhe took the Ancient Tree Armor and Immortal Tree Leaves accordingly, then rose to show gratitude to Changchun Ascendant, "Shouzhe thanks the Ascendant for his rewards. If there’s nothing else, I shall take my leave."
"Oh?"
Changchun Ascendant raised his brows slightly, "After all I’ve said to you, you don’t wish to defend yourself at all?"
"The Ascendant speaks the truth; Shouzhe is indeed one adept at scheming. What is there to defend?" Wang Shouzhe replied with a carefree smile, "Ascendant, I bid you farewell."
Saying so, he moved to leave.
"Wait."
Changchun Ascendant suddenly called him back.
His gaze upon Wang Shouzhe was complicated, and he felt somewhat congested inside.
Undoubtedly, he admired the youngster very much.
His stern reprimand was merely to make him aware of his mistakes and return to the right path.
As long as he showed a desire to correct his ways, would not the Ascendant, as a mentor, grant him a chance to amend?
After all, wasn’t he looking to latch onto a powerful figure? Why not promptly bow and become his disciple?
Unexpectedly, this lad positioned himself resolutely, ready to depart without further ado?
This greatly disheartened the Ascendant, who had earnest intentions.
"Ascendant, do you have any other matters?" Wang Shouzhe’s manner was polite and respectful, yet slightly distant.
What do you mean by other matters?
If I had nothing, would I summon you from afar, just to fill time?
Lad, can’t you follow the usual approach?
Despite being perturbed inwardly, Changchun Ascendant continued to present himself as a concerned elder, "Shouzhe, is your bloodline Upper Grade? And is it Wood Bloodline or something else?"
"Reporting to the Ascendant," Wang Shouzhe answered respectfully, "Indeed, my bloodline talent has undergone a Triple Awakening, yet I am unsure about its precise nature."
Nonsense.
This Ascendant had perceived it long ago, and truly, your bloodline is extraordinary.
Furthermore, if not for the Triple Bloodline, would you have defeated the Core Disciple from the Carefree Lineage?
Changchun Ascendant’s expression faltered slightly, encountering yet again a situation of awkward small talk.
Lad, you talk about latching onto a powerful figure, but you can’t become a disciple?
Changchun Ascendant found himself wistful, having been turned down once for Core Discipleship. Would he, head held high, plead with you repeatedly to become his disciple?
However, this lad achieving a Triple Bloodline Awakening at Spirit Platform Realm is effectively a Purple Mansion Seed.
Such Purple Mansion Seeds will inevitably reach Celestial Human Realm in the future, and certainly have the qualifications to strive for Purple Mansion Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 41: Desire for the Celestial Pride! My Eternal Spring Lineage Shall Rise_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 41: Desire for the Celestial Pride! My Eternal Spring Lineage Shall Rise_3
If it were just the Purple Mansion Seed, it wouldn’t be a big deal; he already had several under the Changchun Ascendant’s name.
But this boy was truly a rare talent, far superior to his other direct disciples.
Forget it, forget it.
This Ascendant will once again put on a thick skin to avoid letting a jewel of the ocean go to waste.
After a struggle within, the Changchun Ascendant spoke again: "If I were to accept you as a direct disciple, would you be willing to formally join the Academy?"
"Direct disciple..."
Wang Shouzhe sighed lightly.
It was undoubtedly a huge temptation.
Once becoming a direct disciple of the Purple Mansion Academy, while not claiming the ability to walk horizontally across Longzuo County, at least no one would dare to easily provoke him.
Unfortunately, while tempting, it was not the path he wished to take.
Wang Shouzhe slowly shook his head, "I am deeply grateful for your kind intentions, Ascendant. However, I am the head of my family, bearing the expectations of my clansmen and ancestors."
He refused once again.
The Changchun Ascendant had somewhat anticipated this, but upon Wang Shouzhe’s actual rejection, he felt a sense of loss.
This young man excelled in strategy, calculating in all things, yet in the face of such an easily attainable status and future, he resolutely refused.
For a moment, he couldn’t quite see through Wang Shouzhe.
After a brief consideration, the Changchun Ascendant eventually sighed and said, "Forget it, forget it. Everyone has their own aspirations; some matters cannot be forced. However, considering the fate that brought us together, tell me, what is your true purpose?"
"True purpose..." Wang Shouzhe spoke seriously, "My coming to the Academy is merely to find some backing. I do not seek to bully others, only to ensure that my family is not bullied."
"Is that all?"
The Changchun Ascendant furrowed his brows.
"Of course," Wang Shouzhe laughed lightly, "Surely the Ascendant does not think I came to form factions, bolster my family’s prestige, and then dominate Longzuo County through alliances?"
Um...
The Changchun Ascendant’s eyes flashed with a trace of embarrassment.
He had been somewhat worried that Wang Shouzhe might indulge in power struggles, using the Academy as his pawn.
"What Shouzhe seeks," Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "is nothing more than these eight words: ’Do not offend me, I will not offend others.’ I only wish to wholeheartedly lead my family in farming peacefully, occasionally engaging in research and development, producing new types of grain and fruit trees, or creating products that can improve human life. Based on this, earn some cultivation resources for my family."
The Changchun Ascendant suddenly became interested, "For example, your Wang’s No. 7, and those spirit seeds... Oh, and the skincare and beauty products you sold to Lvwei."
"Indeed," Wang Shouzhe smiled, "But they are just small industries. Compared to the Academy, they are merely humble efforts."
"Good."
The Changchun Ascendant instead breathed a sigh of relief, "Such a disposition aligns with my Dao heart, you pass. The Academy will not engage in family disputes, but should you farm peacefully and someone tries to infringe on your achievements through improper means, you can write to me, and I will stand up for you."
Hearing this, Wang Shouzhe was secretly overjoyed.
Wasn’t this the result he had been painstakingly planning for?
He was not afraid of inventing, nor was he afraid of developing new varieties. What he feared most were those profound family powers coveting his products, and even more, the calamity that might follow.
After all, this is a high martial world!
With the Academy as a backing, he could be bolder and stride further.
The Changchun Ascendant, seeing Wang Shouzhe so pleased, couldn’t help but feel happy himself, relieved that he hadn’t misjudged, and relaxed his mood, "However, if you want me to support you, you need to do something for me."
"Ascendant, please instruct," Wang Shouzhe bowed and said.
"Do you know why the Profound Ice Hall hasn’t come to see us at the Eternal Spring Valley this time?" The Changchun Ascendant lamented, "I guess they think we’re too weak and have long lost interest..."
"Uh..."
Wang Shouzhe gave a sympathetic look, being observed every time was already a miserable thing. But even more miserable was that they now didn’t even want to observe you.
"Since I took over the Eternal Spring Valley, our Eternal Spring Lineage has never gone to the Profound Ice Hall to have a look." The Changchun Ascendant’s eyes held a hint of indignation, "If you succeed in leading the new disciples to see them, I will be your strong backing in the future. As long as it doesn’t involve family disputes or you actively causing trouble, if any unstoppable enemy covets your industry, I can mediate."
"Not for anything else, just because the Profound Ice Hall hasn’t come to our Eternal Spring Valley in the last two sessions, that Binglan takes us lightly."
Wang Shouzhe found it amusing internally.
It is often said, old children are like young ones, our Changchun Ascendant seems to have a little temper too.
If others come to observe, he is displeased. Now that they do not come to observe, he is even more displeased.
However, Wang Shouzhe understood.
Being subordinate for hundreds of years, having such an opportunity to turn the tables and breathe out is understandably hard to pass up.
The only thing that made Wang Shouzhe slightly worried was...
"Boy, are you worried that offending the Profound Ice Hall will make Binglan Ascendant dissatisfied with your family Wang Longyan and thereby vent her anger on her? Rest assured, Binglan Ascendant is not that kind of person."
As they say, the old are wise. The Changchun Ascendant had lived to an age where it was hard to guess, and he saw Wang Shouzhe’s concern at a glance.
"In that case, there’s no problem." Wang Shouzhe agreed with clasped hands, "This time going to the Profound Ice Hall to see things, leave it to Shouzhe."
"Good, very good." The Changchun Ascendant happily stroked his beard and smiled, "But you must prepare. After the fight, leave the Academy as soon as possible to avoid Binglan Ascendant causing you trouble."
This!
Wang Shouzhe stared wide-eyed, "Didn’t the Ascendant say Binglan Ascendant is not that kind of person?"
"No." The Changchun Ascendant responded calmly, "I only said Binglan is not the type to vent her anger on others, didn’t say she’s the type to not seek revenge for grievances. If you offend her, it’s perfectly normal for her to bear a grudge against you and seek revenge afterward."
"This... Ascendant, can I back out?"
"Shouzhe, my heart is actually not that big either."
"..." Wang Shouzhe.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 42: Binglan! Changchun Comes to Witness
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 42: Binglan! Changchun Comes to Witness
...
Meanwhile.
Profound Ice Hall.
The howling cold wind swept through the snowy peaks, seemingly eternal, bestowing a sense of bleak chill upon the expansive palace complex that appeared carved from ice crystals.
Snowflakes descended from the dense clouds, resting upon the eaves that seemed forged from ice and snow, immediately blending into the entire structure.
From a distance, the world appeared a canvas of snow, vast and desolate.
Only the occasional flash of clothing hems among the undulating buildings hinted at a touch of human presence.
At the very pinnacle of this architectural array stood a Profound Ice Pavilion.
This was the long-secluded retreat of the famous Binglan Ascendant, where only core disciples occasionally got summoned to receive some guidance.
Without her summon, even direct disciples were not allowed to enter without permission.
Today.
The Profound Ice Pavilion seemed somewhat different,
The fierce blizzards that usually surrounded it had seemingly dissipated much, and a ray of golden sunlight pierced through the thick clouds, illuminating the Profound Ice Pavilion in radiant splendor.
...
Outside the main hall of Profound Ice Hall.
Besides various functional buildings, the largest area was taken by a plaza akin to an ice crystal.
Several arenas were erected within this plaza. Among them, the largest and sturdiest could withstand the battles of Celestial Human Realm cultivators without easily breaking.
Disciples of Profound Ice Hall would come to these arenas daily, sparring to verify the progress of their Black Tortoise Combat Technique and cultivation techniques.
This bravely progressive atmosphere was naturally quite different from the peaceful and tranquil Eternal Spring Valley.
They immersed themselves in cultivation, enthusiastic about combat.
Because of this,
The Profound Ice Hall lineage was recognized as the most powerful combat force within the Purple Mansion Academy.
Many outstanding young individuals aspired to join the Profound Ice Hall lineage, however, the recruitment standards were the strictest, adhering to the principle of quality over quantity.
Over time, although few in number, the Profound Ice Hall lineage became a gathering of elites.
Therefore, disciples of the Profound Ice Hall lineage were always proud and placed great importance on their identity. When looking at other lineages and valleys, they naturally exhibited a certain superiority.
In front of an ordinary arena.
An outstanding disciple dressed in white martial attire was instructing new recruits, testing them, and making them spar.
This year’s new disciples numbered only a dozen or so, yet each was an elite among the young generation. Every one of them possessed Middle Grade Talent and had awakened a bloodline.
The most formidable among them had a talent reaching Middle Grade A, just a step away from Upper Grade.
Such excellent individuals would inevitably become core disciples in the future, and might even vie for the position of direct disciple.
Although Profound Ice Hall primarily cultivated the "Profound Ice True Technique," it was not necessary to have a Profound Ice Bloodline.
Firstly, the academy’s heart methods encompassed all-inclusive principles.
Secondly, as long as the bloodline didn’t conflict too much with the Profound Ice attribute, the "Profound Ice True Technique" could still exert considerable power.
Even in cases of conflicting bloodlines, there were other cultivation techniques available.
When Ancestor Longyan joined the Profound Ice Lineage, he too awakened a Primordial Water Bloodline, not a Profound Ice Bloodline.
Among this group of new disciples, two were familiar faces.
One was a young man in white martial attire with a somewhat bashful demeanor, none other than Lady Bilian’s brother-in-law—Yuwen Jianye.
The other, looking only sixteen or seventeen, was a youth with an exceptionally tall figure and muscles brimming with strength, the eighth-generation male of the Wang Family, Wang Zongsheng.
Being familiar with each other, they naturally stood together.
They had no trace of arrogance in their hearts.
Understandably, among these dozen individuals, each with a First-Layer Bloodline Awakening, they had no reason for arrogance.
"As disciples of the Profound Ice Hall lineage, we emphasize courage and progress." The outstanding disciple, already at the Spirit Platform Realm, sternly reprimanded, "Anyone who is complacent and lazy should rather choose the Eternal Spring Valley lineage. Understood?"
"Understood!"
The new disciples responded loudly with their heads held high.
"Since you understand, anyone who makes mistakes will be expelled," the outstanding disciple reprimanded as per usual protocols.
Meanwhile.
Not far off, a group of young men in flowing white robes passed by.
They were all strikingly handsome, exuding a powerful aura, like dragons among men.
The leader, looking no more than twenty-something, had a stern expression, with an aura of cold ice seemingly surrounding him, as if merged with snow and ice.
Profound and awe-inspiring.
Upon seeing this group, the outstanding disciple’s eyes lit up, and he whispered, "It’s Jii Mingyu, Senior Brother Mingyu."
Then he respectfully greeted from afar, "Greetings, Senior Brother Mingyu."
"Senior Brother Mingyu?"
The new disciples gazed over with curiosity.
Jii Mingyu and his party stopped.
He flashed a warm smile, "So it is Junior Brother Kant. You’ve worked hard recruiting new disciples this time. Teach them well, and later I’ll lead them to explore the various lineages."
"Yes, Senior Brother Mingyu." Zhou Kangde responded with a slight excitement, saluting, "I will teach them well and make sure they don’t disgrace you, Senior Brother Mingyu."
After encouragement, Jii Mingyu and his party temporarily left, walking deeper into Profound Ice Hall, gradually moving away.
Zhou Kangde watched until Jii Mingyu’s figure disappeared before turning back with pride, "You all heard. Keep yourselves focused because, in the next few days, Senior Brother Mingyu will show you around, which is a great honor."

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 42: Binglan! Changchun Comes to Witness_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 42: Binglan! Changchun Comes to Witness_2
"Brother Jianye, what does it mean to gain insight?" Wang Zongsheng asked in a low voice.
He joined the Profound Ice Lineage. Not because he understood how powerful this lineage was, but merely because of the few words "Ancestor Longyan".
"It means going to other lineages to flaunt a bit." Yuwen Jianye, with his extraordinary background and his family producing many Academy disciples over a thousand years, naturally understood these nuances.
"All of you, shut up." Zhou Kangde reprimanded angrily, "When a senior brother is speaking, it’s not your place to whisper. If you do it again, you will be punished without mercy!"
Wang Zongsheng and Yuwen Jianye shivered and quickly shut their mouths.
Subsequently, Zhou Kangde continued to reprimand the newly admitted disciples.
...
Meanwhile.
Inside the Profound Ice Hall.
Jii Mingyu and his group came to a halt.
One of the core disciples said, "Junior Brother Mingyu, could it be that our master summoned us because Senior Sister Longyan has returned?"
"Most likely that’s the matter," another core disciple said, "Senior Sister Longyan has left the Academy for sixty years now, and I heard there was some trouble at home back then. In recent years, the master has mentioned her several times."
"If Senior Sister Longyan returns to the Academy, it will greatly enhance our Profound Ice Hall’s strength."
"Indeed, when Senior Sister Longyan was dominating the scene, I was just a new disciple, but following her taught me much."
As the two spoke, a hint of expectation gleamed in their eyes.
Jii Mingyu’s eyebrows gently twitched.
That Wang Longyan left the Academy sixty years ago, while he, Jii Mingyu, was only in his forties.
"I heard Senior Sister Longyan only reached the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm at sixty years old, not very formidable," Jii Mingyu’s eyes showed a hint of disdain, "And I will definitely reach the middle stage in three years, or at most five."
The two older core disciples were slightly taken aback and then burst into laughter: "Junior Brother Mingyu was born in the renowned Sixth-Grade Jii Family, naturally more impressive than Senior Sister Longyan."
As the group conversed, they passed through the guards and headed towards the Profound Ice Pavilion.
...
Meanwhile.
Inside the Profound Ice Pavilion.
A woman in palace attire sat elegantly on the main seat.
On her head was a white Jade Crown, pure in jade color, without a single blemish.
However, even against the backdrop of such snow-like white jade, her complexion remained as clear as jade, making it hard to discern whether the jade was purer or her skin was fairer.
A robe of icy blue enveloped her graceful figure, accentuating her qualities as both stern and elegant like snow-covered peaks and drifting snowflakes.
This woman in palace attire was naturally the master of this place, Binglan Ascendant.
On the wall behind her was an Ice Crystal Longsword sheathed within its sword scabbard.
It was her sword "Binglan", with Ice Soul as its bone, forged with the ice spiritual qi from endless snowy mountains, its sword intent like a piercing cold, exuding an endless chill.
Due to the presence of the Binglan Sword, the entire Profound Ice Pavilion was suffused with an invisible aura of intimidation.
It was conceivable that should this sword be drawn, it would be unmatched in its sharpness.
Ancestor Longyan, wearing a Profound Ice silk skirt and a veil, sat elegantly beside Binglan Ascendant.
Her ice-colored white hair cascaded over her shoulders, completely different from the youthful maiden she once was, now instead exuding a matured tranquility with hints of a weathered essence.
Back at home, Ancestor Longyan often dyed her hair black.
Yet, on this Academy trip, Wang Shouzhe repeatedly instructed Ancestor Longyan to present herself with white hair, especially when meeting Binglan Ascendant, she must not dye her hair.
In truth, with Ancestor Longyan’s figure, poise, and charm, that ice-colored white hair only added to her goddess-like aura.
Sitting opposite Ancestor Longyan was a man of striking appearance, seemingly a youth. His demeanor was calm and formidable, his cultivation unfathomable, clearly indicating he was no mere mortal.
This man was none other than Faang You’an, who had previously conversed with Binglan Ascendant, and was one of her direct disciples.
The ice-colored white hair naturally caught Binglan Ascendant’s attention.
She stared for a good half a stick of incense’s time before calmly asking, "Longyan, what’s with your white hair?"
Ancestor Longyan’s voice was placid as she said, "Reporting, Master, about fifty years ago, I have been contending with the Yin Poison, and my hair gradually turned white without me realizing."
Although her tone was calm, the content of her words made Binglan Ascendant and Faang Yoou’an both take notice.
Fifty years, constantly resisting the Yin Poison. The torment and suffering within that period are enough to make one’s scalp tingle just thinking about it.
They could hardly imagine how difficult Wang Longyan’s life had been over the years.
Faang Yoou’an’s face remained unchanged, but in his eyes flashed a fierce light, which quickly faded as he said nonchalantly: "In the future, whenever we encounter disciples of the Yin Sha Sect, I’ll kill a few more for you to vent your anger."
He was considerably older than Ancestor Longyan and had watched her grow up. If not for the rules of the Academy back then, he would have intervened to help long ago.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Yoou’an." Ancestor Longyan’s voice was flat, seemingly devoid of joy or sorrow.
"Hmph!" Murderous intent flickered in the eyes of Binglan Ascendant, "My disciple Longyan has spent fifty years entangled with the Yin Poison, and only absorbed it out of necessity. Anyone who dares speak further, don’t blame me, Binglan, for being merciless."
"Master, I believe although Junior Sister Longyan has suffered greatly, she has tempered her heart, allowing her to accumulate strength and potential." Faang Yoou’an comforted, "Perhaps she might even have an opportunity to advance to the Purple Mansion Realm."
As everyone was speaking.
A young voice suddenly came from outside the Profound Ice Pavilion: "Disciple Jii Mingyu and others, pay respects to Master."
Binglan Ascendant’s fierce expression softened slightly.
"Come in."
Speaking, Binglan Ascendant kindly said to Ancestor Longyan: "Mingyu is a recently accepted core disciple of mine, no less than you were back then."
Following that.
Jii Mingyu and the others entered, those who needed to pay respects did so, and greetings were exchanged.
Especially Jii Mingyu, who displayed elegance and courtesy and enthusiastically praised Ancestor Longyan with frequent addresses of "Senior Sister," calling her warmly.
However, there was a trace of disdain deep in his eyes.
This Wang Longyan was already over 120 years old and barely reached the Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm, her talent was just so-so.
And he, Jii Mingyu, confidently thought that by the age of ninety, he would reach the Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm!
By the time he’s over 120, he plans to be preparing for an attempt at the Celestial Human Realm.
What he was most worried about was Wang Longyan’s return to the sect affecting his future prospects of becoming a direct disciple.
Although both were Master’s disciples, the identity and resources available to a direct disciple compared to a core disciple were vastly different.
...
"Mingyu." After a brief introduction, Binglan Ascendant instructed, "For this Academy tradition, I have postponed it for a day. Tomorrow, you will lead the new disciples to visit each peak and valley."
"Yes, Master."
Jii Mingyu was invigorated, secretly thinking that Master seemed to value him more.
But then, Binglan Ascendant said, "Longyan, you will go along tomorrow as well. You don’t need to take action, just show your face, greet the Ascendants of each peak and valley, and announce your return to the sect."
"Yes, Master."
Ancestor Longyan accepted the order with a bow.
Jii Mingyu’s smile froze, instantly understanding why Master delayed this tradition for a day—it was to pave the way for Wang Longyan.
Could it be that Master intends to make her a direct disciple?
Fury surged in his heart. Why?
At this moment.
From above outside Profound Ice Hall came a hearty laugh from an elder: "Binglan Ascendant, are you here? I’ve brought new disciples from Eternal Spring Valley to your esteemed hall for a visit." The voice seemed plain, yet could not hide its smugness.
What? Eternal Spring Valley’s coming to our Profound Ice Hall for a visit?
There were only six people inside the Profound Ice Pavilion, each with an odd expression, wondering if they’d misheard.
Ancestor Longyan’s eyes were also filled with surprise.
She recalled when she was a core disciple at Profound Ice Hall, she used to lead teams to visit Eternal Spring Valley. How could it be turned around in just sixty years?
Could it be that this Junior Brother Mingyu is not up to par?
Ancestor Longyan looked at Jii Mingyu with eyes full of doubt.
Jii Mingyu was naturally taken aback, feeling aggrieved in the face of Wang Longyan’s gaze.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 43: Is It Too Late for Me to Change My Ways?
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 43: Is It Too Late for Me to Change My Ways?
...
The atmosphere inside the Profound Ice Pavilion suddenly became extremely eerie.
It took quite a while, but the bemused gaze of the Binglan Ascendant gradually turned sharp.
She then laughed out of extreme anger, "Good, good, good! Since when did the Eternal Spring Valley dare to come to my Profound Ice Hall for an ’experience’?"
"Master, please calm your anger," Faang You’an hastily stood and said, "There might be some misunderstanding here; allow your disciple to investigate first."
"No need," the Binglan Ascendant waved her sleeve, the anger or "amusement" in her eyes completely withdrawn, appearing calm and unperturbed, "Since Changchun has come visiting according to the rules, my Profound Ice Hall must not lose its manners. I want to see how Changchun plans to ’experience’ this."
The disciples inside the Profound Ice Pavilion had followed Binglan Ascendant for at least several decades and knew her temperament well.
Seeing her like this, all the disciples couldn’t help but lament inwardly.
This is a big issue now!
Especially Faang You’an who sighed deeply in his heart, "Changchun Ascendant, oh Changchun Ascendant. Why did you leave the comfort of Eternal Spring Valley to provoke my Master?"
Dear elder, don’t you know how... uh, what my Master’s temper is like?
Meanwhile.
Outside the Profound Ice Hall.
All the disciples of Profound Ice Hall were dumbfounded on the spot.
Evidently, the visit from Changchun Ascendant had already exceeded everyone’s wildest imagination, feeling almost unbelievable.
Especially among the new disciples, who looked at each other, clueless about what was happening.
"Brother Jianye," Wang Zongsheng asked softly, "Does this so-called visit to our Profound Ice Hall mean what you just mentioned?"
Yuwen Jianye responded quietly, "If nothing unexpected happens, it seems likely."
"Didn’t Senior Brother De’an say he would take us to ’experience’ other veins? How come we’re the ones being ’experienced’?" Wang Zongsheng asked, bewildered.
"Perhaps others think we’re weak," Yuwen Jianye speculated.
"You two, shut up," Kant An scolded, a bit flustered and exasperated. His heart was more unsettled because this was the first time the lineage of Eternal Spring Valley had come knocking, and he didn’t know how to handle it.
On the plaza of Profound Ice Hall, many disciples were practicing or honing their Black Tortoise Tortoise Combat Techniques, engaged in heated discussions.
The entire plaza seemed to fall into chaos.
At this moment.
A majestic male voice echoed from the sky, "Calm down, all of you."
All the disciples of Profound Ice Hall, as if injected with a dose of stimulant, calmed down slightly, showing a hint of excitement.
"It’s Senior Brother Yoou’an."
"Senior Brother Yoou’an is a legendary figure of Profound Ice Hall, one of the direct disciples; it is said he’s already ascended to the Celestial Human Realm long ago."
Obviously, his status and authority were extremely high, and the chaotic scene was immediately brought under control.
From within the Profound Ice Pavilion, a white figure stepped into the void.
He moved effortlessly in the air, crossing several dozen feet with each step, and in the blink of an eye hovered above the plaza of Profound Ice Hall.
That was Faang You’an.
He wore a white gown, with a sword strapped to his back, looking full of grace. His demeanor was composed yet authoritative, hovering in the sky like a celestial being.
A Celestial Human!
A group of newly admitted disciples looked up at the figure in the sky, their eyes filled with fanaticism and admiration.
This is the Celestial Human Realm. Compared to the unattainable Purple Mansion Realm, the Celestial Human Realm is more familiar to everyone. Some Seventh-Grade Noble Families have Celestial Humans guarding them.
Among these newly admitted disciples, there were also descendants from Seventh-Grade Noble Families, even some from Sixth-Grade Noble Families. The status of a Celestial Human in their hearts was comparable to that of the heavens.
Meanwhile, Faang You’an’s gentle voice resounded in the air, "Changchun Ascendant has come to ’experience’; our Profound Ice Hall welcomes you warmly! Yoou’an is here by Master’s command. I respectfully invite the Ascendant."
As Faang You’an’s voice fell.
Within the thick clouds and snow-filled skies.
A green radiance suddenly appeared, breaking through the dense clouds, shimmering in the sky like a beautiful ribbon, wherever it went, dark clouds parted, and the storm melted.
The atmosphere was truly magnificent.
The green radiance moved extremely fast, and within a few breaths, it had arrived above the plaza of Profound Ice Hall. The radiance spread out, lighting up the ice-laden Profound Ice Hall, casting a spectacular green hue, full of life, creating a unique charm.
Standing atop the radiance was Changchun Ascendant, his face red and radiant, his white mustache and hair fluttering, resembling an immortal sage of otherworldly elegance.
Upon seeing this scene.
The crowd within Profound Ice Hall held their breath, not daring to make a sound, as if afraid to disturb the Ascendant.
In terms of status, if the Celestial Human Realm needed to be looked up upon, the Purple Mansion Ascendant would already be a figure of legend. Countless noble family descendants in Longzuo County might live a lifetime without having the fortune to meet a Purple Mansion Ascendant.
"Oh, isn’t this Yoou’an? How come you’ve already reached the Celestial Human Realm within the blink of an eye?" Changchun Ascendant’s face was adorned with a warm, gentle smile as he spoke.
Faang You’an, wiping a cold sweat, replied respectfully with cupped hands, "Ascendant, you’re joking. Yoou’an ascended to the Celestial Human Realm over fifty years ago."
"Sigh, seeing the young talents of our Purple Mansion Academy grow so splendidly, I feel gratified," Changchun Ascendant stroked his white beard, filled with emotion, "I remember when you, in your youth, led a team to my Eternal Spring Valley for an ’experience’, that spirited scene remains vivid in my mind. I still feel a tinge of nostalgia at the memory."
Floating in the sky, Faang You’an, perspiring slightly, could only helplessly accompany his smile, "Ascendant, you have a remarkable memory."

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 43 Can I Change My Doorway in Time_2
