chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 43 Can I Change My Doorway in Time_2
In the midst of that green glow, Wang Shouzhe found it amusing.
This Changchun Ascendant wasn’t exaggerating; he truly didn’t have much of a forgiving nature. Even events from over a hundred years ago were crystal clear in his memory.
It’s said that in the Purple Mansion Academy, Changchun Ascendant has the best temper, dislikes conflict, and is naturally tranquil.
Rumors are just rumors; the so-called tranquility and lack of desire probably stem from losing in fights, right?
He claims that Binglan Ascendant holds grudges, but isn’t he similar?
Wang Shouzhe mused, realizing that rumors aren’t always trustworthy!
"Changchun, stop showing off in my Profound Ice Hall."
A cold, authoritative female voice suddenly rang out above the Profound Ice Hall. A blizzard, covering the sky and earth, swept in, with Binglan Ascendant at its center, like an embodiment of ice and snow, exuding majestic power.
As soon as she appeared, her sharp gaze locked onto Changchun Ascendant: "Changchun, have you eaten a leopard’s courage? How dare you cause trouble in my Profound Ice Hall! Show me what you’ve got; I’ll handle it all."
"Binglan Junior Sister, your temper is as hasty as ever," Changchun Ascendant laughed, "I’m seldom a guest in your Profound Ice Hall; there’s no rush for sparring. Come, come, taste the Spirit Tea I personally cultivated—Eternal Spring Spirit Tea. Regular consumption of this tea can delay aging, calm the mind, and soothe the spirit."
As he spoke, with a wave of his hand, tables and chairs appeared in the air, and he began brewing tea in an orderly manner.
This trick he learned from Master Xuan Yao; he felt it looked stylish and borrowed it.
"Alright, let’s see what tricks you can perform," Binglan Ascendant said, suppressing her anger with a cold laugh.
The Eternal Spring Spirit Tea was a treasure he usually kept hidden, so even Binglan Ascendant didn’t want to miss the opportunity.
With that, the two ascendants sat in the air and began drinking the Spirit Tea.
Disciples from all over the Profound Ice Hall gathered at the plaza.
Even Ancestor Longyan and Jii Mingyu came down from the Profound Ice Pavilion.
Each wore expressions of slight complexity and seriousness.
They all realized that someone with bad intentions had come, as friendly visitors wouldn’t dare. Changchun Ascendant dared to cause trouble today, indicating he had something to rely on.
After sipping two cups of Spirit Tea, Binglan Ascendant couldn’t hold back anymore and said, "Changchun, you’ve drunk the tea. Shouldn’t you reveal your skills by now?"
"What skills? I’m merely following the tradition of bringing new disciples to see the Profound Ice Hall," Changchun Ascendant said, stroking his beard with an immortal aura, "Since Binglan Junior Sister seems eager, I’ll let the disciples meet you first."
As he spoke, he waved his sleeve, and the floating green glow began to slowly descend.
First, a group of new disciples emerged, all fresh-faced and curios, looking around with great interest.
Then came a group of senior disciples.
And then another group of senior disciples.
And then another... and another...
From that large expanse of green light, over two hundred disciples emerged one after another.
"So this is the Profound Ice Hall, why is there only one color?"
"It’s really cold here; I wonder how the Profound Ice Hall disciples endure it?"
"The constant blizzard makes the atmosphere oppressive."
"Senior Brother, I’m scared." "Don’t be scared; the Profound Ice Hall is also part of our Purple Mansion Academy, not a dragon’s den or tiger’s lair."
The over two hundred disciples who had never been to the Profound Ice Hall were stunned by the sight.
A thick layer of clouds covered the sky, and the endless wind and snow made it look like a northern country.
They lived in the sunny and vibrant Eternal Spring Valley and hadn’t had the opportunity to see other places. Naturally, they couldn’t imagine the Purple Mansion Academy having such a snowy place.
They were in awe, clicking their tongues in wonder, various strange comments emerging.
This scene intimidated the disciples of the Profound Ice Hall.
Binglan Ascendant’s gaze grew increasingly icy.
She squeezed out words through gritted teeth, "Changchun, you brought so many people over. Are you here to observe, or to attack my Profound Ice Hall?"
Yet, in her heart, she was also a bit apprehensive. The older Changchun gets, the deeper his cultivation becomes, and his Divine Technique "Spring Radiance" is truly becoming more formidable, able to fly with over two hundred people.
Speaking of "Spring Radiance," it is Changchun Ascendant’s refined Divine Technique, not only used for defense and flight. Within it, one can continuously heal and quickly restore primordial energy and vitality.
It’s an unparalleled Divine Technique for group battles.
Unfortunately, since it’s a group battle technique, its power in single combat is naturally insufficient.
"Binglan Junior Sister, don’t be anxious." Changchun Ascendant leisurely sipped his Spirit Tea, his smile growing as warm as sunlight, "In fact, it’s our Eternal Spring Lineage’s lack of strength to blame. These disciples have lived until now without visiting the Profound Ice Hall. With this opportunity, let the children gain some experience. Don’t blame them, don’t blame them."
He made it sound as if it was the Profound Ice Hall that did something wrong?
Isn’t it your own lack of strength to blame?
Binglan Ascendant felt a fresh wave of anger, her gaze sharpening as she said, "So you mean to say that your strength is sufficient now?"
"What do you mean by sufficient or not?" Changchun Ascendant remained humble, "I just happened to gain a disciple with some skill and thought it fitting to introduce him to you, Junior Sister Binglan, and also let him learn from the seniors of the Profound Ice Hall."
"Good, very good."
This proud demeanor made Binglan Ascendant strongly suppress the urge to hit someone, responding with a cold smile, "I’ll have to see what kind of extraordinary disciple instills you with such confidence."
With these words, everyone’s attention was immediately focused.
Even Faang You’an, Ancestor Longyan, Jii Mingyu, and others looked on with both solemnity and curiosity. A disciple highly valued by Changchun Ascendant must be someone remarkable.
"Treasure disciple, come out and meet everyone." Changchun Ascendant’s voice sounded.
Amidst everyone’s gaze.
A figure emerged from the green glow, hands behind his back, walking out with a proud expression.
He appeared to be around fifty, with somewhat mischievous features.
This is it?
The disciples of the Profound Ice Hall were all dumbfounded. Seriously? This person not only looked ordinary, but exuded an undeniable mischievous aura, lacking any presence of a celestial pride or hero.
Even Binglan Ascendant’s beautiful eyes flickered with doubt. Was this the person Changchun was relying on?
"Isn’t this Senior Brother Jinshan from the Eternal Spring Valley?"
Finally, someone recognized him.
Senior Brother Jinshan didn’t respond to the crowd. He turned toward the glow, bowed respectfully, and said, "Please, Senior Brother Shouzhe."
Then, all over the two hundred disciples of the Eternal Spring Valley loudly called out, "Please, Senior Brother Shouzhe." The sound was earth-shattering, even dispersing many clouds in the sky.
Shocking the disciples of the Profound Ice Hall.
Then Wang Shouzhe walked out slowly, his face burning a little. This kind of embarrassing entrance was certainly not his idea.
But Senior Brother Jinshan proposed this plan to Changchun Ascendant, who then carefully revised it.
According to them.
Making the first visit from Eternal Spring Valley to the Profound Ice Hall shouldn’t lack ceremony or style.
Thus, Wang Shouzhe followed Changchun Ascendant’s plan, saluted the sky from afar, and said in a loud voice, "Disciple Wang Shouzhe of the Eternal Spring Lineage greets Binglan Ascendant."
At this moment, Ancestor Longyan and Binglan Ascendant watched with both seriousness and curiosity. Hadn’t Wang Shouzhe said before that the focus would be on maintaining a low profile?
But Binglan Ascendant, surprised, thought to herself that he did have a good-looking appearance, though his skills were uncertain...
Before she could finish her thoughts, a big burly boy among the Profound Ice Hall’s new disciples, excitedly jumped up and shouted, "Fourth Uncle, it’s really you!"
The eyes of the Profound Ice Hall disciples suddenly turned to stare at him, as if they intended to kill.
Realizing his misstep, Wang Zongsheng felt a chill spreading through his body.
Heh...

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 44: Tricking Master! I’m a Professional (Big - of 6500 Words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 44: Tricking Master! I’m a Professional (Big Chapter of 6500 Words)
...
Wang Zongsheng hastily shrank his neck and awkwardly chuckled a few times to his fellow disciples around him: "Hehe~ Mistaken identity, mistaken identity."
Meanwhile, he was groaning endlessly in his heart.
Fourth Uncle, oh Fourth Uncle, do you have to put me in this spot? I’ve just joined the lineage of the Profound Ice Hall, and you come knocking to challenge us. How am I supposed to get by in the future?
Luckily, everyone’s attention wasn’t on Wang Zongsheng, and for the moment, he managed to muddle through.
In the sky, Changchun Ascendant stroked his beard, finding Wang Shouzhe more pleasing the more he looked at him: "Binglan Junior Sister, what do you think of this new disciple I’ve taken in?"
His tone was filled with undisguised pride.
Binglan Ascendant’s gaze was as cold as ice: "He doesn’t look bad, and at a young age, he’s already reached the Spirit Platform Realm, far better than you back in the day. But I’m not sure how much real skill he actually has. However, if you’re showing off so, this kid must have some ability. I’ll be keeping a close eye."
"Haha~ You’ll see, Binglan Junior Sister," Changchun Ascendant said with a hint of pride, "I think he’ll surely give Junior Sister a surprise today."
He knew that his Junior Sister Binglan had always been drawn to looks, and the core disciples and direct disciples she took in were all very good-looking.
Binglan Ascendant sipped her spirit tea and didn’t want to deal with him any longer.
She then turned her gaze to Faang You’an and said, "Yoou’an, make some arrangements."
"Yes, Master."
Feng You’an responded respectfully, then scanned the disciples of the Profound Ice Hall, his voice gentle as he said, "Who is responsible for recruiting new disciples this time? Are there any outstanding prospects?"
Immediately, Zhou Kangde stepped forward, his voice slightly excited as he said, "Reporting to Senior Brother Yoou’an, I recruited the new disciples this time. We recruited a total of fourteen new disciples, all of whom have experienced a First-Layer bloodline awakening, and their talents have reached Middle Grade. Among them is one whose talent has reached Middle Grade A with a Profound Ice Bloodline. Yunhao Junior Brother, come out and greet Senior Brother Yoou’an."
Soon, a young man about twenty years old, dressed in a dark-patterned Black Tortoise Martial Attire, and carrying a dignified and handsome presence, walked out with a steady demeanor and said loudly, "I am Jiang Yunhao, greeting the two Ascendants and fellow Senior Brothers."
This young man had an extraordinary presence.
Faced with such a grand scene, he showed no trace of fear, indicating that his family background was likely not ordinary.
A Middle Grade A talent is already a rare genius, even more so with a Profound Ice Bloodline.
Even in the Profound Ice Hall, such a level of disciple is very rare. Back in the day, when Ancestor Longyan first entered the Profound Ice Hall, she was merely a Middle Grade C with a Primordial Water Bloodline.
Later, before she advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm, she underwent a bloodline transformation through Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid to achieve Middle Grade A with a Profound Ice Bloodline.
Currently, the renowned Jii Mingyu, the pillar of the younger generation in the Profound Ice Hall, is also a Middle Grade A with a Profound Ice Bloodline.
As a result, the high-ranking members of the Profound Ice Hall regarded Jiang Yunhao with increased seriousness.
If this young man does not fall short and continues to practice diligently, he should be on the same level as Jii Mingyu in the future. With proper cultivation, achieving the Celestial Human Realm shouldn’t be out of reach.
Such individuals might only emerge once every forty or fifty years.
Binglan Ascendant’s gaze softened with a touch of comfort.
The Profound Ice Hall was quite fortunate this time.
The only problem is, this young man is just about twenty years old, and his cultivation is merely at the Ninth-Layer Middle Stage of the Qi Refining Realm.
As for that boy named Wang Shouzhe, his age is clearly several years older, and he has already reached the Early Stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, meaning Jiang Yunhao is likely far from being a match.
Instantly, under the veil, Binglan Ascendant’s jade-like lips moved slightly.
Direct Disciple Faang You’an immediately understood and elegantly smiled, "Junior Brother Yunhao is indeed extraordinary. In a couple of days, I will invite you for tea."
Faang You’an then added, "Today, Changchun Valley is visiting our Profound Ice Hall for a visit. As hosts, we should naturally offer them a warm welcome. Who among the outstanding disciples is willing to step forward and entertain the juniors from Changchun Valley?"
His implication, of course, was that Yunhao Junior Brother might not be a match and shouldn’t embarrass himself by stepping forward.
However, before any of the outstanding disciples could speak, Jiang Yunhao’s handsome face changed expression.
He stepped forward and said, "Senior Brother Yoou’an, I am willing to take on the challenge."
This was a great opportunity to shine in front of the two Ascendants and the surrounding Senior Brothers, one he didn’t want to miss.
"This..."
Faang You’an’s brow furrowed.
Jiang Yunhao added, "Please rest assured, Senior Brother. Since childhood, I’ve diligently trained and also had my own fortuitous encounters. I’ve even once challenged the Spirit Platform Realm across different levels without defeat. Even if I’m no match for the older Senior Brother from Changchun Valley, I certainly won’t bring shame."
Seeing his confident demeanor, Faang You’an considered for a moment and then nodded, "In that case, Yunhao Junior Brother, go ahead and learn from the expertise of the Senior Brother from Changchun Valley. Don’t fear losing, after all, age is on his side."
"Yes, Senior Brother."
Jiang Yunhao’s spirit heightened as he was the first to leap onto the arena, giving Wang Shouzhe a respectful bow: "I am Jiang Yunhao, please teach me, Senior Brother."
Wang Shouzhe looked speechless.
Originally, he wanted to finish this match quickly. He and Changchun Ascendant had already agreed to just one bout.
Facing a little Celestial Pride six or seven years younger, how could he muster the enthusiasm?
Just as he was about to decline, suddenly, a powerful spiritual sense enveloped him.
He heard Changchun Ascendant’s voice echoing in his ears: "Kid, just participate in an extra match, it would let your Master enjoy himself a little longer."

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 44: Tricking the Master! I’m a Professional (6500-word - )_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 44: Tricking the Master! I’m a Professional (6500-word Chapter)_2
"This..."
Wang Shouzhe slightly furrowed his brow.
"I’ve already created a small space with my spiritual sense, so you can speak freely. No one else can hear." Changchun Ascendant’s voice echoed again.
Binglan Ascendant frowned, glancing at Changchun Ascendant with a peculiar look.
Was she supposed to not exist here?
However, she didn’t stop them and wanted to hear what the young man had to say.
"Ascendant, we agreed to fight only one match," Wang Shouzhe said, "I need to save some strength for the tougher opponents later."
"If you fight one more match, I’ll give you three qian of Eternal Spring Spirit Tea," Changchun Ascendant offered directly as a bribe, "Your opponent is merely in the Qi Refining Realm; it won’t cost you much effort."
"One liang."
Of course, Wang Shouzhe knew the Eternal Spring Spirit Tea was a great thing, so he directly asked for a lion’s share.
"One liang! Do you take my Eternal Spring Spirit Tea to be like the wild tea spirit seeds outside?" Changchun Ascendant’s mustache twitched, "No more than five qian!"
"Five qian is too little." Wang Shouzhe shook his head, "This opponent is a Middle Grade A, at least eight qian, or else you can let other disciples go up."
Other disciples?
What kind of joke is that? To go up and embarrass themselves? Among the young ones from the Eternal Spring Valley, aside from Wang Shouzhe, who can fight a Middle Grade A Little Celestial Pride? They surely can’t send disciples in their thirties up to embarrass themselves, right?
"Eight qian then." Changchun Ascendant gritted his teeth, feeling pained, "But you have to fight well, showcasing the dignity of our Eternal Spring Valley."
Binglan Ascendant nearby twitched her brows, inwardly mocking.
This pair, the old and the young, really know how to play. Do they take my Profound Ice Hall for a dish? Such haggling, truly as if my Profound Ice Hall has no means? Hehe, you just wait.
Eight qian of Eternal Spring Spirit Tea, he indeed earned it.
Wang Shouzhe was unaware that Binglan Ascendant was spectating from the side. Having received the benefits, any reluctance in his heart naturally vanished.
He walked lightly onto the arena, cupping hands to Jiang Yunhao, "Brother Yunhao, I am many years your senior. Even if I win, it would lack honor. How about we call off this battle and you step down?"
Unexpectedly, Jiang Yunhao sneered a few times, "This elder brother, you should worry about yourself first. If you lose to me, wouldn’t it be a disgrace?"
Well, this is a case of good intentions being mistaken for liver and lungs~
Wang Shouzhe sighed in his heart but maintained his graceful demeanor, cupping his hands again, "If that’s the case, please, Brother Yunhao, make your move first."
"Alright!"
Jiang Yunhao did not hesitate and immediately drew the Ice Iron Cold Sword, displaying body techniques, and attacked Wang Shouzhe.
His body technique fundamentals were solid, like lightning, and his swordsmanship was outstanding, with sword momentum flowing seamlessly, fast and intricately woven.
Coupled with his powerful Profound Ice Bloodline, he summoned ice crystal snowflakes, seemingly forming an Ice Domain, chilling the surrounding air significantly.
Don’t underestimate his Ice Domain; the difference between masters often lies in tiny details. Being influenced by the domain, even a slight delay in movement means one word—defeat!
The boy’s strength was extraordinary, appearing barely a notch below the likes of Wang Luqiu or Wang Luojing, both celestial prides.
No wonder he had such a strong tone.
Unfortunately, his opponent was Wang Shouzhe. Nowadays, even if the five and six sisters joined forces, they wouldn’t be able to gauge his depths.
Let alone Jiang Yunhao, this Little Celestial Pride.
Wang Shouzhe merely flickered slightly, drifting away like a willow catkin, causing all of his opponent’s sword techniques to miss completely.
"Humph~ Putting on airs."
Jiang Yunhao’s expression turned cold, tightening his offensive, and his swordsmanship became even fiercer.
Yet, Wang Shouzhe continued to carry his hands behind his back, drifting casually on the arena as if a willow catkin in a storm, unfathomable.
Although Jiang Yunhao’s offensive was as dense as a torrential downpour, not a single strike landed on Wang Shouzhe.
Ultimately, he underestimated Wang Shouzhe.
Neither in his previous nor his current life did he slack off in cultivation, especially in honing the foundational Black Tortoise Tortoise Combat Technique Body Techniques, which he drilled tirelessly for over a decade.
He always understood one principle: no matter how good the talent, one must be grounded, as water eventually wears down stone.
"How is this possible?"
Jiang Yunhao’s face turned extremely unsightly.
He had battled against Spirit Platform Realm cultivators in his family before, confident in holding his own, yet he didn’t imagine Wang Shouzhe would be so troublesome.
His original plan was merely to entangle him, persisting as long as possible, forcing him to reveal as many trump cards as possible.
But now, Wang Shouzhe’s unpredictable body technique made him feel as if he was being played with.
"Brother Yunhao has good fundamentals." Wang Shouzhe praised, "When you reach the Spirit Platform Realm, you’ll surely be a formidable expert."
Jiang Yunhao was so embarrassed he wished he could find a hole to hide in.
His face flushed with shame and frustration, causing him to further accelerate his offensive.
No matter how he attacked, deploying any technique, Wang Shouzhe never engaged, merely using body techniques to maneuver around him.
Time ticked away, and Jiang Yunhao, merely in the Qi Refining Realm, gradually found it hard to sustain.
In contrast, Wang Shouzhe remained calm and collected, strolling leisurely, not even a hint of change on his face.
Faang You’an’s pupils slightly contracted as well.
He originally thought that even if Jiang Yunhao, the junior, would ultimately be defeated, he should be able to uphold the scene and probe the opponent’s foundations, yet he didn’t expect the opponent to merely toy with him using body techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 44: Tricking the Master! I’m a Professional (6500-word - )_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 44: Tricking the Master! I’m a Professional (6500-word Chapter)_3
"Enough, Junior Brother Yunhao, just admit defeat and step down," Faang You’an said loudly.
Continuing to fight will only end in him being worn out.
The disciples of Eternal Spring Valley excel at prolonged battles; once given the chance, they could drag things out indefinitely.
There’s no point in fighting any longer.
Jiang Yunhao looked unwilling, but had no choice. He immediately withdrew his sword techniques, feeling ashamed, and said, "I lost. This Senior Brother is truly impressive."
Admitting defeat, he felt a sense of awe.
This is indeed the Purple Mansion Academy, a place full of hidden talents, unlike his small Guardian City.
"Thank you for going easy~" Wang Shouzhe beamed, cupping his hands, "It’s just that Shouzhe is a few years older. When Junior Brother Yunhao reaches my age, you’re unlikely to be inferior to me."
He’s a mature adult.
He came to the Academy to expand his network, not to make enemies, so naturally, he had to save face for others.
Sure enough, upon hearing this, Jiang Yunhao’s expression relaxed considerably, and his appreciation for Wang Shouzhe increased significantly.
Immediately, Jiang Yunhao humbled himself and, genuinely impressed, said, "Senior Brother Shouzhe has great character! I hope to learn more from you in the future, if possible."
Speaking thus, he willingly jumped off the stage.
What was initially a cause for enmity was deftly turned around by Wang Shouzhe, planting a seed of friendship for the future.
This junior is quite something.
Faang You’an inwardly praised, yet maintained a smiling demeanor, and said loudly, "Junior Brother Shouzhe is exceptionally skilled. Any excellent disciple from the Profound Ice Hall want to go up and spar?"
Several excellent disciples in their thirties and forties immediately chimed in with "Let me," "I’ll spar."
This attests to the fighting spirit of the disciples from the Profound Ice Hall.
Even facing Wang Shouzhe’s formidable skill, they were utterly undaunted, instead spurred on to compete.
"Everyone!" Jii Mingyu said loudly, "I believe Junior Brother Shouzhe possesses the qualities of Celestial Pride. I can’t resist the itch to spar, so please give me a chance, brothers and sisters."
Upon hearing that Jii Mingyu was joining, those who had been eager to participate previously promptly backed down.
If Jii Mingyu steps in, Wang Shouzhe is sure to lose!
"Jii Mingyu."
Seeing him getting involved, Wang Shouzhe murmured softly.
Though expecting this scenario, he discreetly signaled towards the sky.
Changchun Ascendant understood and once again enveloped the two of them with his expansive spiritual sense, asking, "Kid, what’s up now?"
"I’ve heard of Jii Mingyu," Wang Shouzhe frowned, appearing troubled, and said, "His strength is extraordinary, I fear I am not his match."
"Kid, at this crucial time, how can you shrink back? At least hold your ground before retreating, right?"
Changchun Ascendant was feeling cheerful, but upon hearing Wang Shouzhe’s intention to withdraw, felt discomforted. Although he knew Jii Mingyu was indeed formidable, chances were high that Shouzhe wouldn’t win.
"Ascendant, it’s unavoidable," Wang Shouzhe sighed "helplessly", "I heard he possesses a Middle Grade Upper Profound Ice Element bloodline, is twenty years older than me, and his cultivation is nearing Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm. Without going all out, I hardly stand a chance."
"What?" Changchun Ascendant and Binglan Ascendant, eavesdropping, were both stunned.
The kid’s implying that if he gives it all he’s got, there might still be a chance.
Binglan Ascendant laughed furiously, his voice ringing within the space held by Changchun Ascendant’s spiritual sense, "You brat, you boast too much! Do you think my disciple Jii Mingyu is one of those random stragglers that anyone can just beat?"
"Well... to inform Binglan Ascendant," Wang Shouzhe explained softly, "I mean, I need to go all out to stand a chance."
Isn’t that the same?
Binglan Ascendant was quite upset, letting out a cold snort.
"Fine, fine, fine." Changchun Ascendant, on the other hand, was surprised and delighted, saying, "Kid, let’s go all out to win this one, so Binglan Ascendant can have a good look."
"No, the cost is too high," Wang Shouzhe shook his head.
"A price, huh? Alright then, I will make up for that," Changchun Ascendant said, brimming with bold spirit, "If you win, I’ll give you five Immortal Tree Leaves."
Immortal Tree Leaves are remarkable items, even a single one greatly functional during battles. For those seriously injured, consuming it quickly leads to recovery.
They’re treasures difficult to buy outside.
Binglan Ascendant’s eyebrows twitched upon hearing, thinking, Changchun, you’re really willing to pay to win one over me.
Unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe still shook his head and said, "I’m not lacking Immortal Tree Leaves, and I’m quite capable of healing myself. It’s merely a superfluous benefit for me."
"Then what do you want? Anything I can provide," Changchun Ascendant said with a determination to go all out.
"Since the Ascendant is so sincere." Wang Shouzhe finally said contentedly, "Give me a Longevity Fruit, and I’ll deliver a satisfactory result in this battle."
"Longevity Fruit!" Changchun Ascendant said in surprise, "You, you, you brat, how do you know I have a Longevity Fruit left? Could it be that Lvwei told you?"
"Ascendant, I was just asking casually, who knew you’d actually have one," Wang Shouzhe said leisurely, "To win this battle, the price is too great and needs to be compensated with a Longevity Fruit."

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 44: Tricking the Master! I’m a Professional (6,500 Long - )_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 44: Tricking the Master! I’m a Professional (6,500 Long Chapter)_4
"Changchun! You actually hid a Longevity Fruit." Binglan Ascendant’s voice carried a hint of anger, "When I asked you for it some time ago, how did you respond?"
"This... well, it was not easy for me to save one." Changchun Ascendant’s voice was full of helplessness, "The Longevity Tree requires the top-tier Wood Spiritual Vein to grow, and only after a hundred years will it yield a fruit. After consuming this fruit, it has the effects of healing severe injuries, extending lifespan, and replenishing depleted lifespan."
Wang Shouzhe had already learned about the fruit’s effects from Sister Lvwei Xiaoxue.
Reportedly, if a mortal consumes it, they can undergo Bone Marrow Purify and break the shackles of lifespan, living up to a hundred plus years.
If someone at the Spirit Platform Realm consumes it, hidden injuries will dissipate, and depleted lifespan can be replenished, possibly living past two hundred years as long as they are not killed in battle.
Even those in the Celestial Human Realm can supplement their depleted lifespan, potentially adding ten to eight more years to their life.
Of course, for cultivators at the Purple Mansion Realm, the effect is not as significant,
at most prolonging life by one or two years.
Even so, the Longevity Fruit is a rare and invaluable Heavenly and Earthly Treasure.
"Kid, do you really need the Longevity Fruit as a supplement to win?" Changchun Ascendant asked, struggling, "You wouldn’t happen to sell it, would you?"
"Truth be told, that Jii Mingyu is truly formidable," Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "If I hadn’t inadvertently overheard about the Longevity Fruit’s effects, and this treasure didn’t have some utility for me. No matter how much subsidy the Ascendant offers, I wouldn’t use my trump card in this battle."
Hearing his sincere words, Changchun Ascendant pondered for a moment before saying, "Well, to be honest, the Longevity Fruit doesn’t do much for me either. But you must agree to two conditions. First, you’ll only get the Longevity Fruit if you win. Second, you must use it for yourself, not sell it."
"Deal." Wang Shouzhe agreed readily.
Binglan Ascendant slightly furrowed her brows, her eyes flickering a few times, but in the end, did not stop it. Even if Wang Shouzhe might have some hidden means, thinking of defeating Jii Mingyu was undoubtedly wishful thinking.
Once this matter passed, she had ways to compel Changchun Ascendant to hand over the Longevity Fruit willingly.
This exchange among the three took place within a small circle, unknown to outsiders.
Once the conversation ended,
Jii Mingyu was already standing on the arena, dressed in the elegant and dashing uniform of the core disciples of Profound Ice Hall, with a long sword on his back, resembling a transcendental sword cultivator.
Seeing Wang Shouzhe come to his senses, Jii Mingyu cupped his hands and asked, "Junior Brother Shouzhe, are you ready? If not, take some more time to prepare. We are in no rush."
"Thank you for your consideration, Brother Mingyu." Wang Shouzhe courteously returned the gesture, "I am ready and can spar at any time."
"In that case, Junior Brother Shouzhe, please make your move." Jii Mingyu said gently and gracefully, like a refined gentleman.
In terms of both age and cultivation, he far surpassed Wang Shouzhe. If he still needed to seize the initiative in such a spar, it would lose its elegance, more disgraceful than losing the fight.
"Thank you."
After saluting, Wang Shouzhe immediately took a shield in his left hand and a sword in his right. He also donned a layer of Ancient Tree Armor, ensuring his defense was impeccable.
The Ancient Tree Armor was heavy, clearly slowing down Wang Shouzhe’s body technique.
"Smart! With such a large disparity in cultivation, Senior Brother Shouzhe’s body technique, no matter how refined, is likely no match for the nearly fifty-year-old Jii Mingyu," Brother Jinshan explained to the new disciples beside the arena, detailing Senior Brother Shouzhe’s tactical intentions, "Hence, with maneuver tactics unfavorable, there’s only room for defensive counterattacks. Senior Brother Shouzhe is playing to his strengths while avoiding his weaknesses."
With Brother Jinshan’s explanation, the surrounding new disciples looked at Wang Shouzhe with eyes full of admiration.
At this moment,
After a brief preparation, Wang Shouzhe said, "Please strike, Brother Mingyu." After all, the other party had already shown courtesy; it would not be in good taste to take advantage of it all.
"Very well, Junior Brother Shouzhe, be careful." Jii Mingyu did not hesitate; his eyes flashed sharply, and with a clang, he drew the treasure sword from his back.
The sword, about four feet long, was crystal-like ice, its icy spirit light fluctuating unpredictably. As soon as it appeared, the surrounding air turned several degrees colder.
This sword was evidently not an ordinary treasure sword.
Jii Mingyu didn’t bother introducing the sword to Wang Shouzhe, merely stepping repeatedly in the air, as if treading on solid ground, ascending step by step, breathing in and out, reaching over ten zhang high.
With his Profound Qi erupting, countless ice crystals and snowflakes circled around him, drifting unpredictably.
Suddenly.
He descended rapidly from the sky, his sword striking like a dragon, wrapping a fierce ice storm as he attacked Wang Shouzhe, the temperature on the arena suddenly plummeting.
"Profound Ice Sword Technique."
Wang Shouzhe was somewhat familiar with the Profound Ice Sword Technique, as his family’s Ancestor Longyan was also proficient in this sword technique.
However, although Jii Mingyu’s Profound Ice Sword Technique hailed from the same lineage as Ancestor Longyan, the styles were vastly different.
Ancestor Longyan’s sword technique was ethereal and enigmatic.
Whereas Jii Mingyu’s sword technique was open and full of grandeur, the sword momentum was majestic and overwhelming.
With this strike down, it was indisputably domineering, as if unmatched in the world.
Even as an opponent, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but secretly admire it in his heart, indeed living up to its reputation.
Jii Mingyu was undoubtedly extraordinary.
Wang Shouzhe restrained his aura, "Heart Guard Shield" spirit light suddenly appeared, the shield light unfurled like a thick arched pot cover, blocking the imposing blow.
"Boom!"
Countless ice crystals, snowflakes, and energy, like shockwaves, spread in all directions, causing the entire arena to tremble slightly.
The disciples standing too close to the arena retreated one after another, their faces filled with astonishment. Was the power of this touch too great?
"What a spirit shield! What a defense!" Jii Mingyu, seeing this, was not surprised but delighted, praising, "Come, come, take another strike from me."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 45: Longevity Fruit Acquired! Bloodthirsty Vine Achieves Merit (6300-Word - )
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 45: Longevity Fruit Acquired! Bloodthirsty Vine Achieves Merit (6300-Word Chapter)
Sure, here is the translation:
...
"Clang! Clang! Clang!"
Sword aura scattered across the arena, with snow and ice flying all around.
Jii Mingyu’s offensive was like a tidal wave, one after another, relentless, leaving no room for breath.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe was executing defense to the extreme, not seeking merit but avoiding mistakes, defending every move flawlessly.
He didn’t even waste Profound Qi to let the Cosmic Palace Sword unleash Sword Qi to attack but focused all his attention on defense.
As a result, the fight naturally didn’t look impressive.
The Profound Ice Hall crowd was thrilled, shouting eagerly, "Senior Brother Mingyu, keep pushing, break his turtle shell, he can barely hold on."
In contrast,
The disciples of Eternal Spring Valley were slightly disappointed, as Senior Brother Shouzhe was clearly being suppressed and hadn’t found a chance to counterattack.
Some even started discussing it privately.
"What do you know?" Senior Brother Jinshan scolded softly, "Choosing tactics according to your opponent is the norm. Our Eternal Spring True Technique excels in endurance. As long as you keep exhausting him, Jii Mingyu will eventually run out of Profound Qi and be defeated."
"But Senior Brother Jinshan," a new disciple whispered, "Senior Brother Jii Mingyu is already at the Third Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm. His Profound Qi is extremely abundant. How can it be exhausted?"
"This..." Senior Brother Jinshan hesitated, "Maybe Senior Brother Shouzhe has other plans." Even he didn’t sound confident anymore.
People both below the arena and in the sky were discussing this battle fervently.
But Jii Mingyu and Wang Shouzhe were both immersed in their fight, ignoring everything else around them.
Wang Shouzhe was amazed by the immense strength of Jii Mingyu’s offense.
And Jii Mingyu was equally amazed by Wang Shouzhe’s unparalleled defense, seemingly at just the First Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm, yet his Profound Qi was endless, as if a bottomless pit.
What shocked Jii Mingyu even more was.
His Profound Ice Sword Qi and a few Ice Blades had broken through Wang Shouzhe’s defense several times, tearing his Ancient Tree Armor and inflicting some injuries.
But this guy just shed a few drops of blood, then seemed fine, continuing to fight energetically.
Fearsome defense ability, fearsome recovery ability, fearsome Profound Qi bottomless pit.
"Junior Brother Shouzhe," Jii Mingyu said with a calm smile, "If you think you can exhaust my Profound Qi with defense, you’re mistaken. This is the Profound Ice Hall, set atop a top-tier Profound Ice Spiritual Vein, giving me a home-court advantage to continuously replenish my Profound Qi."
"Although it can’t match my consumption, it’s enough to exhaust you."
"This is bad, I knew something was wrong! Overlooked the home-court of the Profound Ice Hall." Senior Brother Jinshan’s expression changed, "If it were in our Eternal Spring Valley, Senior Brother Shouzhe would have a chance, but here..."
With even Senior Brother Jinshan’s expression changed, the other disciples of Eternal Spring Valley naturally felt demoralized and started doubting Senior Brother Shouzhe’s chances.
At the same time.
On the arena stage.
Wang Shouzhe chuckled lightly, saying, "Brother Mingyu, before boasting, maybe check your footing."
"Footing?"
Jii Mingyu was slightly startled, only to see some green tender branches mysteriously appearing on the arena floor.
Those tender branches were growing extremely fast, shooting up at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Suddenly!
A branch wrapped around Jii Mingyu’s foot.
Jii Mingyu’s expression changed immediately, realizing it was bad. He, too, had overlooked that Wang Shouzhe was a disciple of the Eternal Spring Valley.
The disciples of Eternal Spring Valley excel at cultivation.
Some experts even cultivate various battle plants.
If it were the ordinary disciple of Eternal Spring Valley, this advantage could be ignored. But Wang Shouzhe himself was already a tough opponent.
"Swish, swish, swish."
Jii Mingyu’s sword moved like a dragon, and wherever the Sword Aura passed, it was like mowing grass, quickly cutting the wildly growing vines into countless pieces.
Yet regrettably.
Wang Shouzhe had already spread the vine seeds across the entire arena during the fight just now.
Although Jii Mingyu cut fast, he couldn’t stop the vines from growing wildly.
Soon, the entire arena gradually turned into a sea of green, with vines dancing through the air, like the Witch’s long hair floating, chilling the heart.
The situation seemed to have turned around.
The ocean of the Vine Array was occupying much of Jii Mingyu’s attention. He couldn’t stop; otherwise, being entangled by the vines would make him sink deeper, eventually immobilizing him.
"Hahaha," Senior Brother Jinshan laughed, "I told you, our Senior Brother Shouzhe sure has a trick up his sleeve. Jii Mingyu fell for it, just like before with Mu Yuanbai, sooner or later it’s defeat."
"Senior brother, that’s two words."
Senior Brother Jinshan’s face changed: "What do you know, kid? I’m just telling a joke to relax everyone, maybe even distract Jii Mingyu a bit."
"Senior Brother Jinshan is wise." The new disciples broke out in sweat.
With the change in situation, it was now the Profound Ice Hall disciples’ turn to worry.
Meanwhile.
Yuwen Jianye and Wang Zongsheng hid in a corner, fearing they wouldn’t be able to resist cheering for Wang Shouzhe and then get beaten as a result.
Yuwen Jianye commented in a whisper, "Zongsheng, I thought Luqiu Big Sister was already impressive, but I didn’t expect your Fourth Uncle to be even tougher. He’s suppressing even the famous Jii Mingyu."
"Of course," Wang Zongsheng said proudly, "My Fourth Uncle rarely steps in, but even if Fifth Aunt and Sixth Aunt joined forces, they aren’t a match for Fourth Uncle."

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 45: Longevity Fruit Acquired! Bloodthirsty Vine Achieves Merit (6300-Word - )_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 45: Longevity Fruit Acquired! Bloodthirsty Vine Achieves Merit (6300-Word Chapter)_2
"Impressive, impressive, your Fourth Uncle should be the most formidable among your younger generation, right?" Yuwen Jianye expressed his admiration and envy.
"Well..." Wang Zongsheng chuckled twice, secretly thinking that though Fourth Uncle is formidable, it’s the Fourth Aunt at home who is truly the most fearsome.
Of course, this is not something he can openly say.
While the new disciples of Profound Ice Hall were worried about Jii Mingyu.
Some core disciples, Faang You’an, and Binglan Ascendant all remained calm.
Thinking to deal with Jii Mingyu with just this is truly underestimating him.
Sure enough.
After a scuffle with the Vine Array, Jii Mingyu’s gaze gradually turned angry, "Junior Brother Shouzhe, really clever tactics, I’ve learned a lot. It seems that if I don’t get serious, I can’t defeat you."
With that!
Jii Mingyu’s expression sharpened, and the Ice Crystal Treasure Sword twirled around him, quickly slicing through the vines around him within a considerable range.
Meanwhile.
He slowly floated into the air with the sword raised, as an intense and domineering aura of Profound Ice spread from him, surging skyward.
The thick snow-cloud layer above Profound Ice Hall was slowly rotating, drawn by this Qi Force.
Immediately, large flurries of snowflakes and ice crystals descended in a whirlwind onto the arena.
In just a breath.
The arena was covered with a vast expanse of ice crystals and snow, which continued to intensify.
How is this possible?
Even Wang Shouzhe, with all his wit and resourcefulness, looked somewhat bewildered.
No way!
This Jii Mingyu hasn’t reached even the Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, yet he can stir up clouds and change the weather. Although the affected area is not large, it’s astonishing.
Because even in the Celestial Human Realm, one must use various external means under the right conditions to barely manipulate some Heavenly Dao Laws.
How can Jii Mingyu possess such abilities?
Under such rapid freezing.
Even Wang Shouzhe felt the penetrating cold, as all moisture in the air froze into frost.
Those vines of his, although evolving again and again,
considering elements of heat resistance and cold endurance, Wang Shouzhe had already factored them in. The energy and substances contained within their seeds were already enough to grow once, without absorbing nutrients from the earth.
But these vine seeds are ultimately not at the level of Spirit Seed, facing such a terrifying cold, they froze instantly into green icicles.
"Crack, crack!"
Shattering across the ground.
They were as dead as could be, injecting Profound Qi Energy was futile.
The most crucial point is.
Within the arena, the speed of the snowstorm continued to strengthen.
Even clad in Ancient Tree Armor, Wang Shouzhe felt his body stiffen, slowing his movements by a beat or two.
When masters vie, even a slight delay in speed makes a difference in the battle.
"Junior Brother Shouzhe, let me teach you a lesson," Jii Mingyu said icily, "Visiting various sects and valleys is not a simple task. You must endure their home advantage. And likewise, we at Profound Ice Hall have our home advantage, which is not easily experienced.
To show my respect for you, I will wield the sword imbued with the profundity of Profound Weapon Celestial Dao. To send you to defeat.
An aura of extreme cold and profound significance grew stronger around Jii Mingyu, as his might gradually climbed higher.
Such a terrifying Cold Ice Sword Momentum, even at Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, might be challenging to withstand?
In the sky, Binglan Ascendant nodded secretly, acknowledging that Jii Mingyu not only has good talent but also strives hard.
Even leveraging the home advantage to achieve this is extremely difficult.
He might be considered for inclusion as a Direct Disciple if opportunities arise.
At the same time, she shot Changchun Ascendant a cold smile: "Changchun, you can save your Longevity Fruit. I’ll ask you for it later, and if you try to deceive me, don’t blame me for being ruthless."
Changchun Ascendant wore a troubled expression, thinking: Shouzhe, you promised you had a trump card to fight desperately, right?
But now, as defeat looms, the trump card hasn’t appeared.
"Changchun..." As Binglan Ascendant was about to speak, her expression suddenly shifted slightly as she exclaimed something was wrong.
On the arena.
The situation had changed again.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
Bursts of flames erupted.
The air shook violently, and snowflakes were chaotically swept around.
Fire Dragons elegantly danced in the air.
In an instant, the arena became a battleground of ice and fire. Ice crystals and snowflakes melted into water under the fiery heat of the Fire Dragons, creating plumes of white mist, as if the entire arena was inside a giant steamer.
"Those are my Fire Dragon Fruits." Junior Brother Li Yuzhe shouted excitedly, "I spent ten years painstakingly cultivating them." His words were full of pride.
Fire Dragon Fruit is difficult to cultivate, with a long growth cycle and high cost.
Li Yuzhe kept it as a trump card, usually reluctant to use even one.
He was ultimately defeated by Wang Luojing, holding back partly due to reluctance to use them and partly because defeat came too swiftly.
Later, hearing Wang Shouzhe was taking everyone to experience Profound Ice Hall.
Li Yuzhe, in a moment of excitement, handed the Fire Dragon Fruit to Wang Shouzhe as a trump card for self-defense.
Turns out it came in handy.
Yet while Li Yuzhe felt comforted, there was a pang in his heart.
"Senior Brother Shouzhe, can’t you use them more sparingly? I’ve painstakingly cultivated those Fire Dragon Fruits for so long, and you used them all at once without any hesitation or heartache."

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 45: The Longevity Fruit Is Obtained! Bloodthirsty Vine’s Meritorious Deeds (6,300-Word - )_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 45: The Longevity Fruit Is Obtained! Bloodthirsty Vine’s Meritorious Deeds (6,300-Word Chapter)_3
This gave him a sense of not caring about selling off the ancestral land.
Li Yuzhe sighed deeply.
On the arena.
Wang Shouzhe threw out handfuls of Fire Dragon Fruits, causing the arena to burst open, while the icy storm erupted simultaneously. The primary effect was to interrupt Jii Mingyu’s powerful attack, which was being prepared.
"Pfft!"
The counterforce turned Jii Mingyu’s face pale, and he spat a mouthful of blood.
While he was bewildered, he suddenly heard Wang Shouzhe’s voice in his ear: "Brother Mingyu, I thought I’d teach you a lesson. Your big attack takes a bit too long to accumulate power, not really suitable for arena combat."
"Plus, you’re too talkative, which can give the enemy a chance to turn the tables."
"Pfft!" This statement provoked Jii Mingyu, causing him to spit out another mouthful of blood. He angrily rebuked, "Aren’t you also being too chatty, giving me an opportunity at the comeback?"
As soon as Jii Mingyu finished speaking, he suddenly screamed in terror, "What, what is this? It’s, it’s sucking my blood." The pervasive steam obstructed his view, allowing him to rely only on spiritual sense.
"Swish."
Jii Mingyu casually slashed, feeling as if he had cut through something. The profound qi within him billowed, dispersing the dense steam around him.
Focused his eyes.
In his view was a severed, red tentacle resembling an earthworm. It twisted incessantly on the ground, blood oozing from the broken end, exuding an evil and terrifying aura.
He glanced again at his ankle, which now bore a bloody hole. Blood seemed unable to stop pouring out, dripping onto the arena, merging with the icy water, and the dense scent of blood permeated everywhere.
In an instant, a shiver of horror swept through his heart.
"Brother Mingyu, I’m not like you. I talk nonsense to distract you." Wang Shouzhe said cheerfully, "Did you enjoy the power of my Bloodthirsty Vine? Let me tell you a secret, unless you use profound qi to seal the blood vessels, your wound won’t heal anytime soon."
"Bloodthirsty Vine."
Jii Mingyu’s expression turned cold just as he was about to reply.
An extremely weak and obscure sense of danger attacked him from behind.
He cursed inwardly, almost getting distracted again.
Hurriedly leaping forward, he flipped over, and only then did he see the creature attempting a sneak attack.
It was like a blood-red giant serpent-like vine.
But, unlike a smooth serpent’s body, it was covered with dense tentacles, each bearing sharp bloodsucking barbs, moving like seaweed, grotesque and hideous.
Just by looking at it, one knew it was absolutely frightening and evil. Jii Mingyu couldn’t help but shout angrily, "What is this monstrosity?"
"It’s a Bloodthirsty Vine." Wang Shouzhe chuckled, "Brother Mingyu, please enjoy it slowly."
At this moment.
The steam that had just been dispersed rose again, the whole arena becoming a white expanse. As a result, the crowd couldn’t see what was happening inside. All they heard was Jii Mingyu’s continuous angry roars and howls.
Meanwhile.
In the sky, Binglan Ascendant and Changchun Ascendant exchanged grave looks.
"Isn’t this a Bloodthirsty Vine?"
The young disciples were unfamiliar, but how could they not understand? At the Purple Mansion Academy, they often excavated relics of the Divine Martial Dynasty. Although they haven’t unearthed particularly valuable relics yet,
their research on the Divine Martial Dynasty is extensive.
This Bloodthirsty Vine is wildly found in many relics, having previously caused substantial losses to many explorers.
The accursed artifact is extremely malevolent and fierce; once it reaches its peak, even Purple Mansion Realm cultivators might be drained alive.
In short, it’s incredibly dangerous.
Where did this young lad get the Bloodthirsty Vine from a relic, and how did he nurture it into a battle plant?
The two Ascendants’ faces were filled with doubts.
But if it’s only a Bloodthirsty Vine of this level, it probably can’t deal with Jii Mingyu!
Yet, aside from the Bloodthirsty Vine, Wang Shouzhe was still on the arena, and the steam filled the entire arena.
Within the white mist formed by the boiling steam.
Jii Mingyu’s angry and fearful roars became increasingly intense.
He didn’t know how many Bloodthirsty Vine tentacles he had severed. But most of the tentacles had bitten him like leeches before snapping.
Don’t underestimate these bites.
The speed at which these tentacles sucked blood was so fast, they could drain a big gulp almost instantly.
Even more alarming was that after being bitten, there was no pain or abnormality at the wound site. Yet the blood flowed out uncontrollably.
This forced him to allocate a lot of profound qi to seal the blood vessels at the wound.
And that troublesome Wang Shouzhe also joined the fight, continuously suppressing and harassing him. One streak of sword qi after another slashed towards him.
Time was passing rapidly.
And Jii Mingyu felt himself weakening at an alarming pace.
When the mist above the arena dissipated, everyone changed color dramatically upon seeing Jii Mingyu: "Senior Brother Mingyu, please stop, you can’t continue fighting."
Only because Jii Mingyu’s previously spirited and splendid attire was now full of holes, looking utterly disheveled with blood stains everywhere.
Even more frightening was.
His complexion was now ghastly pale, even scarier than a dead person’s.
Binglan Ascendant’s expression also changed drastically. With a clear voice, she berated, "Mingyu, surrender quickly."
Upon hearing his Master’s voice, Jii Mingyu’s mind suddenly cleared a bit. He hurriedly complied, shouting, "I surrender!"

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 45: The Longevity Fruit Is Obtained! Bloodthirsty Vine’s Meritorious Deeds (6,300-Word - )_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 45: The Longevity Fruit Is Obtained! Bloodthirsty Vine’s Meritorious Deeds (6,300-Word Chapter)_4
Then he fled down the platform as if escaping.
Since he had already surrendered, Wang Shouzhe naturally didn’t pursue. Instead, he leisurely put away the Bloodthirsty Vine, and from afar, cupped his hands towards Jii Mingyu, saying, "Brother Mingyu, thank you for conceding!"
Upon hearing this,
Jii Mingyu’s body swayed, his legs went soft, nearly collapsing. Several core disciples hurriedly rushed forward to support him. Some elixirs were poured into his mouth like they were free.
Only at this moment did Jii Mingyu feel fear and lingering dread.
He was completely limp, without a trace of strength left, as if all his energy and essence blood had been sucked dry.
Like the legendary tale of being exhausted by several dozen maidens successively, a state of utter collapse.
Binglan Ascendant’s face was extremely grim.
With one glance, she could see that this core disciple was almost drained dry, thankful that she called a halt early, otherwise, if his foundation was damaged, it would be troublesome.
She glared fiercely at Wang Shouzhe, "You brat, clearly having the advantage, couldn’t you have shown some mercy?"
"Reporting to Ascendant." Wang Shouzhe responded calmly, "Brother Mingyu is so formidable. If he hadn’t surrendered, how dare I withdraw? What if he turned the tide and won?"
In his heart, he added muttering, if I lost, would you pay for the Longevity Fruit?
Binglan Ascendant was rendered speechless by the retort, with nothing to say.
However, she gave a fierce glare at Changchun Ascendant, her eyes vicious as if intending to kill.
This left Changchun Ascendant utterly baffled, thinking, "Ice Hall Junior Sister, it was clearly that brat who retorted you, what does this have to do with me?"
"Hmph!" Binglan Ascendant already felt too embarrassed to stay. She instructed several core disciples to take good care of Jii Mingyu, then flew back into the Profound Ice Pavilion.
As soon as she left,
Changchun Ascendant immediately became lively, laughing heartily, "Good boy, that was a brilliant match, really brought honor to our Eternal Spring Valley."
The other disciples of Eternal Spring Valley naturally cheered enthusiastically as well.
Especially a group of senior disciples, each with tears in their eyes; including Senior Brother Jinshan, several broke into sobs, creating a truly magnificent scene.
This had been the aspiration of so many generations of Eternal Spring Valley disciples.
And today, it had been realized.
In contrast, the disciples from Profound Ice Hall looked utterly dejected, all with drooping heads. Particularly some of the senior disciples, they had lived their entire lives, and this was the first time they were shown up by the Eternal Spring Valley.
And they were successfully shown up!
Even Jii Mingyu, the strongest among the younger generation of core disciples, had been defeated.
Seeing Changchun Ascendant full of smug satisfaction, Wang Shouzhe seized the opportunity to say, "Ascendant, the thing you promised me."
"Rest assured, you brat." Changchun Ascendant said helplessly, "I, as a respectable Ascendant, would not default on what I owe you, right?"
Saying this, he pulled out a box of Eternal Spring Spirit Tea leaves, carefully measuring out eight qian of spirit tea for Wang Shouzhe, not a qian more.
Then he took out a jade box, painfully handing it to Wang Shouzhe, "This is the Longevity Fruit. Boy, I see you’re in good health without dwindled lifespan, and a long future ahead, this thing isn’t practical for you, so don’t greedily eat it."
Wang Shouzhe accepted the jade box, opened a small slit to take a peek.
Sure enough, an enchanting aroma spread out. Inside was a fruit the size of a fist, resembling a gourd in appearance.
Based on the information gathered from Junior Sister Lvwei earlier.
This indeed was the Longevity Fruit!
A mortal consuming it has a high chance of living up to over a hundred years, truly a treasure fruit.
Wang Shouzhe immediately cupped his hands and said, "Many thanks for the gift from Changchun Ascendant."
"You brat, I think you’re deliberately extorting my Longevity Fruit." Although Changchun Ascendant was extremely delighted today, the price paid was not small, muttering, "Didn’t you say you’d have to risk a great deal and reveal your trump cards to win?"
Wang Shouzhe stared at him with a surprised expression, "Ascendant, I even exposed my trump card, the Bloodthirsty Vine, hasn’t the price paid been big enough?"
Seeing his earnest expression, Changchun Ascendant almost spat blood.
Was this considered a huge price? It was vastly different from what he imagined as a huge price.
This Longevity Fruit.
Wang Shouzhe intended to use it for Ancestor Longyan. Although Ancestor’s body had restored to health, previous injuries had ultimately shortened a considerable amount of her lifespan.
She was now over a hundred and twenty years old.
Wang Shouzhe also worried that she’d exhaust her lifespan without being able to ascend to the Celestial Human Realm, which would be a big trouble.
Just at this moment,
A cold voice emerged from within the Profound Ice Pavilion: "Boy, instead of keeping that Longevity Fruit for yourself, why not sell it to me, I’ll ensure the price is satisfactory."
Wang Shouzhe was slightly startled.
Binglan Ascendant had expressed interest in the Longevity Fruit several times, despite it being of no use to her.
Could it be...
Suddenly, he thought of a possibility.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 46: Binglan Ascendant Is Quite Playful
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 46: Binglan Ascendant Is Quite Playful
...
That’s right.
Binglan Ascendant recently asked Changchun Ascendant for the Longevity Fruit, which means she recently had such a need.
Also, it’s precisely at this time that Ancestor Longyan is preparing to return to the sect. Binglan Ascendant most likely wants the Longevity Fruit for Ancestor Longyan.
Of course, this is just Wang Shouzhe’s speculation; perhaps she has other plans.
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and said, "Reporting to the Ascendant, we can discuss this matter first. But I cannot guarantee that I will definitely sell it to the Ascendant."
Binglan Ascendant was silent for a while, clearly digesting her displeasure.
From her past behavior, she is not someone with a good temper.
Asking a junior for something, and the junior keeps declining; how can that be satisfactory?
Moreover, this junior is acting high and mighty over their Profound Ice Hall, even acquiring the Longevity Fruit by suppressing Profound Ice Hall.
Only after a long time did she manage to swallow her anger and say in a calm tone, "If that’s the case, then come into my Profound Ice Pavilion to discuss this matter."
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe, guided by the senior brother inside the Profound Ice Hall, entered the Profound Ice Pavilion from the main hall.
Not to mention he couldn’t fly directly up to the high Profound Ice Pavilion, even if he could, if he dared to fly up, Binglan Ascendant would probably swat him down.
Changchun Ascendant, seeing this, followed Wang Shouzhe with a wag, taking the opportunity to enter the Profound Ice Pavilion together.
Upon seeing Changchun Ascendant, Binglan Ascendant’s delicate brows furrowed, "Changchun, what are you doing here?"
Changchun Ascendant seemed unaware of her anger, looking around casually, and sighed slightly, "Binglan Junior Sister~ To think, it’s been two hundred years since I last came to your Profound Ice Pavilion. Remembering the past leaves one filled with emotions~ Don’t worry, I have no other intentions, I’m just accompanying my disciple inside to support him, afraid he’ll suffer a loss."
"Hmph~" Binglan Ascendant sneered, "If I want him to suffer a loss, can you stop me?"
However, for some reason, she didn’t drive Changchun Ascendant out, only staring coldly and authoritatively at Wang Shouzhe.
Faced with this pressure, Wang Shouzhe remained as calm as ever, seemingly unaffected.
He cupped his hands respectfully, "Wang Shouzhe, greets Binglan Ascendant."
At the same time, he glanced at Ancestor Longyan and the dignified Faang You’an out of the corner of his eye.
The former gave him a sideways look, as if saying, "You really know how to play, even daring to provoke my Master."
The latter, however, nodded slightly, smiling warmly, as if showing goodwill.
Seeing that her imposing gaze had no effect on Wang Shouzhe, Binglan Ascendant had to withdraw her sharp gaze and said, "Tell me, what price do you want to sell it for?"
The difference in their generations and ages was too vast, and she couldn’t bring herself to forcibly exert her powerful aura.
Wang Shouzhe remained neither arrogant nor obstinate, saying, "How much to sell it for is not up for discussion. Shouzhe wants to know, who is the Ascendant planning to use this Longevity Fruit for?"
Binglan Ascendant was quite exasperated.
I am a dignified Ascendant, do I need to report to you who I’m buying a Longevity Fruit for?
However, she couldn’t help but glance at Ancestor Longyan.
With this, there was no need for further words; Wang Shouzhe had nine-tenths certainty.
He immediately shook his head, "Since that’s the case, I’m afraid Shouzhe cannot sell this Longevity Fruit to Binglan Ascendant."
"You!"
Binglan Ascendant’s eyes sharpened, her tone unfriendly, "Boy, not even your master dares to tease me like this!"
Beside him, Changchun Ascendant was also sweating coldly.
Brat, if you don’t want to sell it to Binglan Ascendant, just refuse! Why provoke enmity by dragging it out?
"If you don’t give me a satisfactory explanation," Binglan Ascendant said coldly, threatening, "I’ll, I’ll... I’ll beat your master up!"
The poor Changchun Ascendant was so shocked his beard curled up, "If this kid doesn’t explain to you, why hit me?"
Binglan Ascendant glared at him.
If she doesn’t hit him, can she really take action against a kid that’s more than five hundred years younger than her? She couldn’t handle such embarrassment.
Furthermore, Profound Ice Hall had just suffered a major setback at Wang Shouzhe’s hands. Taking it out on him now would seem like revenge born from private interests, which would ruin Profound Ice Hall’s reputation if word got out.
Wang Shouzhe barely held back his laughter.
He cleared his throat, controlled his expression, and calmly said, "Reporting to the Ascendant, this Longevity Fruit is prepared for my family ancestor. Our family ancestor was injured in a battle in her youth, damaging her foundation and losing lifespan, urgently needing this Sacred Fruit to make up for the deficit."
Binglan Ascendant’s eyes paused, but she waved her hand irritably, "In consideration of your filial piety, I won’t argue with you. Go away, go away~ For both our sakes, don’t let me see you again. I’m afraid I won’t be able to resist hitting someone."
"Pfft~"
At this, Ancestor Longyan could no longer hold back her laughter.
She gave Wang Shouzhe a fierce sideways look, "You brat, did you come to Profound Ice Hall just to make trouble for me and annoy my Master?"
"Hehe~"
Wang Shouzhe chuckled dryly, cupping his hands to Ancestor Longyan, "Ancestor, speaking of this matter truly shows the capriciousness of fate. If I’d known Binglan Ascendant wanted to procure the Longevity Fruit for you, why would I put in so much effort?"
"You’ve put in effort?"
In front of her master, Ancestor Longyan seemed much younger in spirit, glaring at Wang Shouzhe, "I saw you enjoying your match with Junior Brother Mingyu, where’s the effort? Hmph~ I’ll settle this with you later."

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 46 Binglan Ascendant Is Quite Playful_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 46 Binglan Ascendant Is Quite Playful_2
While speaking, she hurriedly bowed to the befuddled Binglan Ascendant, saying, "Master, this brat is my great-great nephew. He’s been mischievous since childhood; he has offended you now, please forgive him. Shouzhe, hurry up and apologize to the Ascendant!"
Binglan Ascendant looked perplexed by these words, and Faang You’an appeared slightly surprised.
This young man, so formidable, is actually a descendant of Junior Sister Longyan’s family?
Upon hearing the ancestor’s reprimand, Wang Shouzhe quickly reined himself in and sincerely apologized to Binglan Ascendant: "Shouzhe apologizes for any offense earlier, I hope the Ascendant will forgive me."
Binglan Ascendant’s eyebrows twitched twice.
She certainly intended not to forgive this brat, but since he was a descendant of Longyan, could she really hold onto the grudge?
Helplessly, she glanced sideways and asked, "Is this Longevity Fruit meant for Longyan?"
"Yes," Wang Shouzhe replied earnestly, "That’s exactly why Shouzhe couldn’t sell the Longevity Fruit to the Ascendant."
"That’s just perfect," Faang You’an interjected with a smile, "Both Master and Shouzhe intended it for Junior Sister Longyan, doesn’t that make everyone happy?"
"Who told you everyone would be happy?" Binglan Ascendant shot him a cold glance. "When I give it to Longyan, it’s my gift; when he gives it, it’s his. Don’t lump them together."
"Well... Master is right," Faang You’an said, sweating a bit coldly, naturally not daring to speak further.
Having followed the master for years, he was quite familiar with her temper.
At this moment, she’s surely holding back a belly of anger. Due to cultivation and seniority, she can’t vent it on Wang Shouzhe, but beating Faang You’an up to vent would be quite reasonable.
"Here are a thousand Spirit Stones, consider it a premium for buying your Longevity Fruit." Binglan Ascendant tossed out a large bag of Spirit Stones, speaking coldly, "This Longevity Fruit is only useful for those below the Celestial Human Realm; its value is far lower than Sixth-Grade Pills such as the Bone Marrow Purify Pill."
"Ah... Ascendant, that’s not necessary." Wang Shouzhe smiled wryly, "This is also intended for my ancestor, is it really necessary to go to such expense?"
"This Sacred Fruit is meant for my disciple’s return to the sect, a gift she currently needs." Binglan Ascendant stated calmly but forcefully, "If I gift it to you, what do I offer her? You’ve taken the Spirit Stones, now hand over the item."
Ascendant, your logic is impeccable. So bold even when purchasing forcefully!
Wang Shouzhe, helpless, under her steely gaze, obediently handed over the Longevity Fruit.
Holding the Longevity Fruit, Binglan Ascendant then handed it to Ancestor Longyan, saying, "Longyan, back then I was regrettably constrained by the Academy’s rules, unable to help much. Consider this as a small token of my remorse."
"Master, that can’t be!" Ancestor Longyan quickly responded, "What happened back then was entirely my fault; if blame is to be placed, it should be on me for being too impulsive. Besides, were it not for the master’s letter, our Wang Family would have vanished long ago."
Binglan Ascendant, not skilled at consoling with words, coldly glanced at Faang You’an.
Faang You’an swiftly understood and advised, "Junior Sister Longyan, Master has been thinking of you all these years. You must know, the Purple Mansion Academy has strict agreements with the Daqian Imperial Family, limiting the assistance we could offer."
"Moreover, you know the Master’s character; if you don’t accept it, the Master might struggle to overcome this mental barrier."
With words spoken to this extent, Ancestor Longyan had no choice but to kneel and bow, saying, "Disciple thanks the Master for the gift."
Holding the Longevity Fruit, she appeared visibly moved and joyous. Not for the fruit, but the Master’s deep care and concern.
Only then did a trace of gloom vanish from Binglan Ascendant’s gaze.
Both master and disciple rejoiced.
Wang Shouzhe, watching from the side, couldn’t help but twitch at the mouth corner.
This Binglan Ascendant sure has strange logic and clever maneuvers; despite it being meant for Ancestor Longyan, after this roundabout way, he gained an extra thousand Spirit Stones!
Since she liked it this way, Wang Shouzhe didn’t hesitate to store them in his Storage Ring.
At this moment.
Binglan Ascendant sighed regretfully, saying, "It’s a pity, Longyan, you wish to guard the family, constrained by the Academy’s rules, so I cannot award you the Direct Disciple status."
And Ancestor Longyan said, "Honored by the Master’s help in my return to the sect, I’ve already been blessed. From now on, I’ll be an Outer Disciple, naturally still a disciple of the Master."
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe interjected with a suggestion beside them, "Ancestor, you could ask Binglan Ascendant to take you as a Named Direct Disciple."
Named Direct Disciple?
Binglan Ascendant and others were slightly stunned, what level of disciple is that?
"Speaking of which, I’m also a guardian of the family and can’t stay long-term at the Academy. But, the Master especially wants to take me as a disciple, so at the very least, there’s a formal teacher-disciple recognition. Thus, we agreed after this battle, to accept me as a Named Direct Disciple." Wang Shouzhe explained, "We won’t use the Academy’s cultivation resources, but the Master can appropriately subsidize us. Thus, we naturally needn’t guard at the Academy."
"If there’s ever an affair at the Academy in the future, we can step in. It’s essentially an upgraded version of Outer Disciple."
Binglan Ascendant listened, her eyebrows jumping straight!
An upgraded version of Outer Disciple?
You two master-disciple pair sure know how to play.
However, Named Direct Disciple.
Clearly sounds much better and brings you closer together.
It’s great then, Binglan Ascendant promptly accepted the advice, making the pleasant decision.
After resolving the matter, Binglan Ascendant felt much better.
She looked at Wang Shouzhe and coldly said, "Considering Longyan, I reluctantly forgive you. But my Profound Ice Hall won’t forgive you; I’ll have Jii Mingyu train well and find this score later."
Wang Shouzhe wasn’t bothered.
Jii Mingyu can’t beat him now; after a decade or so more, the gap between them will only widen.
At this moment, Jii Mingyu had just finished recovering and came to apologize.
Approaching the door, hearing the master’s grand words.
His complexion—having regained some color—suddenly turned pale again, not so, the Master wants him to settle the score. That Bloodthirsty Vine is terrifying?
Having nearly been drained dry, Jii Mingyu certainly did not want to battle Wang Shouzhe again.
"You brat, off you go." Binglan Ascendant released her harsh words, impatiently rushes Wang Shouzhe, "Leave as far as possible, don’t let me see you again." She truly feared losing control and beating this brat up to vent.
"In that case, Shouzhe bids farewell to the Ascendant." Wang Shouzhe was accustomed to her fiery temperament, respectfully saluted, and then retreated from the Profound Ice Pavilion.
Seeing this, Changchun Ascendant shrank his head and prepared to sneak away together.
Unexpectedly, hearing Binglan Ascendant’s sweet yell, "Senior Brother Changchun, where are you going? It’s rare for you to visit, you should at least have a cup of tea before leaving."
"Senior Brother? Binglan Junior Sister, you’re finally calling me Senior Brother again!!" Changchun Ascendant, trembling with excitement, "It’s been years, Junior Sister, you are finally forgiving me."
Just withdrawing to the door, Wang Shouzhe involuntarily gasped.
Thinking to himself, there seemed to be some unresolved entanglements between Changchun Ascendant and Binglan Ascendant.
"Forgive you, haha." Binglan Ascendant sneered coldly, "I’ll never forgive you in this lifetime; it’s just that Senior Brother rarely visits my Profound Ice Pavilion. As a Junior Sister, I must host you properly; come, follow me inside."
Inside? Wang Shouzhe was stunned; truly commendable of an Ascendant, the pace seems a bit swift.
"Inside?"
Unexpectedly, upon hearing this, Changchun Ascendant didn’t show any joy; instead, he trembled and hurriedly shook his head like a rattle, "No, no, foolish brother has business to attend, must take leave first."
"If you won’t go, we’ll discuss what unforgivable things you did back then at the Dao Transmission Hall entrance in Eternal Spring Valley."
Such explosive information?
Wang Shouzhe’s ears perked up.
Ready to listen to the details, yet was pulled out from the Profound Ice Pavilion forcefully by Ancestor Longyan.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 47: Lici! Vice Dean, I’ve decided to support you!
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 47: Lici! Vice Dean, I’ve decided to support you!
...
Faang You’an wisely stepped out of the Profound Ice Pavilion.
Oh dear, Ancestor, you’re not interested in such juicy gossip?
Meanwhile, faint voices could be heard from within the Profound Ice Pavilion.
"Junior Sister, you..." Changchun Ascendant wailed as if attending a funeral, "Alright, alright, I’ll go with you! Junior Sister, take it easy."
The conversation made Wang Shouzhe’s eyebrows jump; such wolfish words were quite fierce.
It seemed that the relationship between Changchun Ascendant and Binglan Ascendant might not be ordinary indeed.
Seeing Wang Shouzhe’s eyes roll around, Ancestor Longyan quickly pulled him aside and warned in a low voice, "Don’t let your imagination run wild. Master’s inner chamber is a whole Profound Ice Space; she’s always cultivating inside, it’s not what you think..."
"Uh, actually, Ancestor, I hadn’t thought that wildly until you explained it."
But now, I really am starting to have some wild thoughts.
Faang You’an was also breaking into a cold sweat and quickly interjected, "Junior Brother Mingyu, why don’t you escort Junior Brother Shouzhe out."
Being a direct disciple, he knew some insider stories.
Their love-hate relationship was indeed complicated, but not as sordid as Wang Shouzhe imagined.
Letting him stay longer would only make things worse.
Meanwhile.
Next to the arena on the Profound Ice Hall’s plaza, Wang Zongsheng and Yuwen Jianye were surrounded by a group of eager senior disciples.
Each of them was already in their thirties or fifties, with the weakest being in the Ninth Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. Poor Wang Zongsheng and his companion looked as pitiable as lambs lost among a pack of wolves.
Oh no, it’s all over~! Fourth Uncle was too aggressive.
These senior disciples must have suffered grievances and are looking to take it out on Wang Zongsheng!
Wang Zongsheng was on the verge of tears.
Oh well, so be it; it’s just a good beating, right? I’ll be back in shape in a few days, but poor Brother Jianye, dragged into this and getting hit for nothing. His frail body, can it even withstand a beating?
At that moment.
Wang Shouzhe and Jii Mingyu walked out of the Profound Ice Hall.
The two were chatting and laughing as if they were long-lost friends.
The senior disciples about to teach Wang Zongsheng a lesson halted their actions.
"Brother Mingyu, take good care of your injuries when you return," Wang Shouzhe said with genuine concern, "Once you’re recovered, come visit me in Changning, and I’ll be sure to show you around."
"Younger Brother Shouzhe," Jii Mingyu bowed politely, "Our discussion has been truly regrettable that we didn’t meet sooner. I’m certain we’ll be friends."
The two bid each other reluctant farewells.
Then Wang Shouzhe saw Wang Zongsheng, smiled at him, and threw him an encouraging glance before striding off.
Jii Mingyu smiled as he patted Wang Zongsheng on the shoulder and said, "You must be Younger Brother Shouzhe’s nephew. His nephew is like my nephew. Feel free to let me know if anyone bothers you in the Profound Ice Hall."
After encouraging him, Jii Mingyu glided away.
And then, those wolf-like senior disciples’ eyes changed.
"Wang Zongsheng, were you shocked just now? The senior brothers were just teasing you~"
"Hahaha, it’s one of our Profound Ice Hall’s unique customs."
Then the group of senior disciples gathered around Wang Zongsheng, warmly building a rapport with him.
"I, I..."
Wang Zongsheng was utterly confused.
It seems like I, Wang Zongsheng, am on a rise.
...
Meanwhile.
At the peak of the Purple Mansion Academy.
Amidst the swirling mists, there was an ordinary-looking courtyard.
The courtyard seemed like it hadn’t been maintained for a long time, looking somewhat shabby. Inside were no exotic flowers, spirit fruits, or spirit grasses, just some ordinary plants.
Everything seemed so ordinary.
In the courtyard, inside a worn stone pavilion, sat a man and a woman on old stone benches.
The woman was around her twenties, with a bit of baby fat and an innocent look in her eyes, making her appear younger than she actually was.
The man looked about thirty but, upon closer inspection, one could see the marks left by time on his face.
His gaze was cold and composed, like an unfathomable deep pool.
If placed on Earth, with a suit and watch, he’d be a quintessentially domineering CEO.
"Senior Brother," the woman said with a face full of grievance, "When will Master exit seclusion as you said?"
The man’s cold face showed a hint of a smile, his voice gentle, "Junior Sister, don’t worry. I have already sent a message to Master. He will come out to see you soon."
"Senior Brother, I’m hungry," the woman said weakly, frowning, "I haven’t eaten anything since climbing the mountain with you."
"Sorry, sorry, it’s entirely my fault. I forgot that Junior Sister, being in a low realm, can’t go without food for long," the man said, wiping his storage ring and handing over a few buns. "Junior Sister, these buns are made from spirit grain flour; they’re very filling and can effectively replenish your energy and blood."
"Is that it?"
The woman’s eyes widened in disbelief, "Senior Brother, didn’t you say that our Master is the Vice Dean? With power and influence, with access to all kinds of delicacies, and you’re making me eat this?!"
"Well... Junior Sister, sorry, sorry, but after we see Master, I’ll take you for some good food, just make do for now."

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 47 Lici! Deputy Dean, I’ve decided to support you_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 47 Lici! Deputy Dean, I’ve decided to support you_2
This chubby-faced woman is naturally none other than the eighth generation of the Wang Family, Miss Wang Lici.
She had just shown her face at the recruitment conference when this middle-aged senior brother talked her into believing that he was recruiting on behalf of the vice-dean of the Academy.
Once she confirmed that meals and lodging were included, she gleefully followed him.
Who would have thought that she would be waiting for two days in this shabby yard without even meeting her Master?
The senior brother, who kept insisting that the dean was in seclusion and that the vice-dean wielded the most authority in the Academy, only offered her cold mantou to eat.
How could someone of Miss Lici’s stature be so unfortunate?
Unable to withstand her hunger, Wang Lici began to nibble on the cold mantou with tears in her eyes.
Those few mantou were gone after just a few bites.
"Senior brother, I’m hungry," Wang Lici looked at her senior brother with teary eyes again.
"Ah?" The senior brother, startled, opened his half-closed eyes, "You finished them already?"
Then, he took out a few more mantou: "Lici, eat slowly, don’t choke."
