With that, he closed his eyes to meditate again.
However, no sooner had he closed his eyes, than he heard Wang Lici’s tearful voice say: "Senior brother, it’s not enough, I’m hungry."
A little while later.
"Senior brother, I’m hungry."
"Senior brother, I’m hungry."
...
A quarter of an hour later.
The voice, like a magical chant, seemed to have brainwashed him.
He didn’t dare to close his eyes anymore because as soon as he did, the adorably pretty junior sister would pitifully say: "Senior brother, I’m hungry."
All the food he had stored for a month had been completely devoured by his junior sister.
Yet she was still calling out in hunger.
The senior brother’s expression started to look unnatural, this junior sister seemed to have quite an appetite.
The Yunyang Lineage had always emphasized self-discipline and reducing external material needs to train the mind and achieve the state of unity between man and nature.
He had just returned from a mission outside and happened to encounter the Academy recruiting new disciples. Coincidentally, he saw Wang Lici and discovered her exceptional talent, reaching the Upper Grade C celestial pride level.
Furthermore, upon conversing with her, he found her naturally simple, without blemish or mischief in her heart, most fitting with the Yunyang Lineage’s temperament. He was overjoyed to find such a treasure and accepted her on behalf of his master, bringing her up to Yunyang Peak.
However, at this moment, he had a vague sense of foreboding.
This junior sister.
It seems like he might have been a bit hasty in accepting her.
Just as he was about to ask a few questions, a profound and resonant voice came from the old buildings within the courtyard.
"Mingda, you mentioned in your message that you’ve recruited a celestial pride as pure as jade. Is it this young lady?"
As the words fell.
An elder in coarse cloth and linen clothing appeared in the old stone pavilion.
The elder had a gaunt appearance, an ethereal manner, and his deep eyes held a gentle, wise expression.
As soon as he appeared, his gaze fell on Wang Lici.
With just a casual glance, he seemed to understand Wang Lici completely.
"Good, good, good! Thick bloodline, simple gaze, truly a rare fine talent!" A joyous expression appeared on his face, "Mingda, you have great luck to be able to seize such a talent from the hands of various peaks and lineages; I shall commend you for this."
Mingda cautiously reminded, "Master, our junior sister seems to have quite an appetite."
"Has quite an appetite?" The elder was indifferent, "Young people, you see, having a big appetite is a blessing, who hasn’t been through this? Mingda, you also had quite an appetite when you were young, and did I not still raise you well?"
Then the elder looked at Wang Lici, appearing more and more satisfied as he said, "I am Master Yunyang, humbly serving as the vice-dean of the Academy. Are you willing to take me as your master? With your talent, with just a little effort, you could inherit my teachings."
He was full of confidence, thinking Wang Lici would surely agree wholeheartedly and bow in acceptance.
However, Wang Lici shook her head repeatedly: "I’m not willing."
"What?"
Master Yunyang was stunned.
Such a response was obviously illogical. Besides, this was merely a formality. In reality, the paperwork was done, and this girl was already part of the Yunyang Lineage.
Without waiting for them to speak, Wang Lici shook her head and said: "Our lineage is too poor, the house is so rundown. Eating cold mantou all the time and not even getting full, I don’t want that."
"Senior brother Mingda lied to me, saying that I could eat as much as I wanted if only I could manage it."
"This." Master Yunyang and his disciple looked at each other in dismay, did this girl have to be so blunt?
Master Yunyang’s face immediately grew serious as he said, "Mingda, this is your fault, how could you let the junior sister eat cold mantou?"
Then Master Yunyang, with warmth and confidence, said: "How could your master, being a Purple Mansion Ascendant and also the dignified vice-dean, possibly not manage to properly take care of a little girl like you?"
"I promise you, as long as you can eat, eat as much as you want."
"Really?" Wang Lici widened her eyes, slightly skeptical, looked around hesitantly, and said, "Our place here looks a bit impoverished."
"I am a dignified Purple Mansion Ascendant, and your senior brother Mingda has long been a Celestial Human Realm Cultivator." Master Yunyang said confidently, "Raising a little girl like you is hardly a challenge."
Saying this, he waved his hand and tossed a bag of spirit stones to Senior Brother Mingda: "Mingda, here are a hundred spirit stones. Take your junior sister to the Celestial Food Pavilion inside the Academy, and have a good meal. Feast to your heart’s content, and don’t save money for my sake. Use the remaining spirit stones to purchase fresh ingredients from the Eternal Spring Valley to serve as your junior sister’s meals."

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 47 Lici! Deputy Dean, I’ve decided to support you_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 47 Lici! Deputy Dean, I’ve decided to support you_3
"I need to go into seclusion for a few more days. I’ll leave the little junior sister in your care for now."
"Yes, Master." Brother Mingda suddenly felt a bit more confident and said with a cheerful grin, "Come on, little junior sister, I’ll take you to eat something delicious."
"You’re so nice, brother." At the mention of delicious food, Wang Lici couldn’t move an inch, even forgetting to reject the idea of becoming a disciple.
Thus, these happy days passed for two days.
The setting was still the same rundown little courtyard.
Brother Mingda looked a bit worn out.
With a flicker, Master Yunyang appeared before him, his expression showing slight displeasure, "Mingda, didn’t I tell you that your master is in seclusion? Why have you summoned me again?"
"Reporting to Master." Brother Mingda said cautiously, "The little junior sister has run out of her food money."
What?
"Didn’t I give you a hundred spirit stones?" Master Yunyang’s eyelids twitched rapidly, "Could it be that the Celestial Food Pavilion dares to recklessly raise prices?"
"That’s not the case. In consideration of our Yunyang lineage, the Celestial Food Pavilion has already given us a discount." Brother Mingda weakly replied, "Besides that hundred spirit stones, we’ve also accrued a debt of thirty spirit stones."
In just two short days, we’ve spent one hundred and thirty spirit stones on eating.
Master Yunyang was also a bit unsteady, looking at Wang Lici in disbelief.
"Master, you did say to eat freely." Wang Lici said with an innocent and helpless look.
In fact, the Wang Race had long dared not speak the words "eat freely" in front of Wang Lici.
If this girl really ate freely, it would be a bottomless pit.
"Lici, let Master check your bloodline." Master Yunyang, being well-informed, felt something was amiss. Previously, according to Mingda’s report, little sister Lici was supposed to be some kind of third-layer war body bloodline.
War body types generally have a large appetite, but not nearly to this extent.
With Master Yunyang’s pressure falling on Wang Lici.
Suddenly.
The delicate and innocent aura of Wang Lici abruptly changed, and a fierce and domineering aura emanated from her.
Then.
Behind her, a horrifying and grotesque monster illusion with a blood-red mouth and massive belly began to coalesce.
Compared to when she was in the Qi Refining Realm back then.
This fierce beast illusion was clearly more than twice the size. It seemed to feel threatened, glaring menacingly at Master Yunyang while roaring aggressively, as if a beast had encountered a threat and was using intimidation tactics.
This is a Dharma Illusion.
The master and disciple looked at each other, as mid and high-ranking members of the Academy, they were naturally familiar with Dharma Illusions.
Most of the mid-tier Celestial Human Realm members in the Academy, including Brother Mingda, due to their powerful bloodlines, could usually form their own Dharma Illusions.
However, forming a Dharma Illusion in the Spirit Platform Realm was rare.
Of course, as long as the bloodline concentration was sufficient, with a bit of luck, it’s possible for someone in the Qi Refining Realm to form a Dharma Illusion as well.
But none of that was important.
This girl’s Dharma Illusion was clearly something quite extraordinary.
"Master, is this a devouring type Dharma Illusion?" Brother Mingda asked, somewhat unsure.
"Devouring type Dharma Illusions, I’ve seen a few, but none had such presence." Master Yunyang said with a shocked expression, "Could it be, this is the legendary ultimate devouring bloodline, the Heaven-Devouring Taotie Bloodline?"
Excellent, excellent, excellent! If this is indeed the bloodline, it is truly remarkable and has astounding potential!
Master Yunyang was overjoyed, determined to nurture this child!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Modified - 48 - Wife, Do Not Plot to Harm Your Husband! (Tasks Available in the Review Section)
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Modified: Chapter 48 - Wife, Do Not Plot to Harm Your Husband! (Tasks Available in the Review Section)
...
Listening to Master Yunyang’s bold words, Senior Brother Mingda’s expression was solemn, with a hint of worry.
Oh Master, it’s best not to be too hasty when saying that. Our junior sister really has an incredible appetite.
"Mingda~" After Yunyang finished his grand declaration, he glanced at his original cherished disciple with a hint of disdain, "Why are you still here? Shouldn’t you be off doing tasks?"
Senior Brother Mingda was a bit surprised: "Master, I just came back from completing a task."
"Mingda, things are different now," Yunyang said earnestly, "We have another junior sister to take care of. Go, take on more Academy tasks, and try to pick the profit-making ones."
"Yes, Master."
Senior Brother Mingda’s eyelids trembled slightly.
It seems like the situation might not be too good~ But orders from the Master cannot be disobeyed. What else can he do but comply obediently?
After saying goodbye, Senior Brother Mingda descended the mountain and began his task-driven journey to earn money.
Once Yunyang’s pressure was withdrawn, Wang Lici’s Dharma Illusion receded.
She looked a bit apprehensive and asked, "Master, is there anything wrong with my bloodline?"
"No issues at all. You just need to cultivate peacefully, eat and drink... no, just cultivate peacefully. The rest will be handled by me and your senior brothers," Yunyang smiled amiably at Wang Lici, his brow filled with joy, as if he had found a supreme treasure.
The Yunyang Lineage is truly fortunate to have such an excellent disciple, destined to thrive~
Then, Yunyang sent messages to his disciples, instructing them to take on profitable tasks at the Academy and gather as many ingredients as possible during their quests.
All this care and concern melted Wang Lici’s heart.
Her Master and senior brothers treated her so well. Fourth Uncle was right; the Academy truly is a good place, and she made the right decision coming here.
...
Leaving aside Wang Lici’s carefree days with the Yunyang Lineage, and how long those carefree days would last.
The following days.
Wang Shouzhe, holding the Direct Disciple Token from Changchun Ascendant, immersed himself in the Academy’s library, and with the help of Junior Sister Lvwei, he studied a large number of ancient maps of the Divine Martial Dynasty.
Based on the structure of the large map and inferences from changes over time, Wang Shouzhe finally identified the location of the Divine Martial Army’s training ground of the Divine Martial Dynasty.
However, this location...
Wang Shouzhe sighed deeply, his mood growing heavier.
That place is deep within the Outer Domain, over ten thousand miles away.
How perilous is the Outer Domain? Even a thousand miles in is already extremely dangerous for a Spirit Platform Realm Black Tortoise Practitioner, let alone ten thousand miles.
The current autumn hunting team of the Ping’an Wang Family has gone in a maximum of only five hundred miles.
Beyond this range, further strengthening is necessary. More importantly, every step must be taken cautiously and gradually advanced. Wang Shouzhe would never casually risk the lives of his clansmen.
What’s more, venturing over ten thousand miles into the Outer Domain inevitably involves encountering Tier Five and Six Ferocious Beasts, and possibly even Tier Seven Ferocious Beasts.
Forget it, forget it, let’s put this matter aside for now.
Wait until the family’s strength grows before gradually advancing in that direction.
After leaving the library, Wang Shouzhe returned to Eternal Spring Valley.
However, as soon as he entered, he was stopped by a group of senior sisters.
"Junior Brother Shouzhe, do you have any more of those skincare and cosmetic products?"
"The previous samples have all been used up. Our skin really improved, becoming so smooth and supple."
"Unfortunately, there wasn’t enough."
A group surrounded him, chattering incessantly.
"Ladies, please calm down." Wang Shouzhe had prepared in advance and took out a stack of pamphlets, "These illustrate and price cosmetics, skincare products, shampoo, and conditioner. I’ll hurry back to procure precious materials and try to produce more. You can place orders through my nephew, Wang Zongsheng. Every six months, I’ll arrange for Qiaan’s Trading Company to ship a batch over."
Wang Shouzhe thought to himself: Nephew Zongsheng, Fourth Uncle can only help you so much; you’ll have to seize the opportunity yourself~
"Half a year?"
The senior sisters were all quite disappointed.
"Dear senior sisters of Eternal Spring Valley, each of you is naturally beautiful, lessening the use for a while isn’t a problem," Wang Shouzhe said with a bright smile, "Moreover, every order from our prestigious senior sisters will be at a 20% discount."
20% off!
Their eyes sparkled, and everyone praised Wang Shouzhe endlessly.
Wang Shouzhe barely managed to pacify the group of senior sisters and hadn’t taken a few steps when he was surrounded by a group of male disciples from Eternal Spring Valley.
"Senior Brother Shouzhe, your vine seeds, ’Witch No. 3,’ are simply amazing," said an excited male disciple, "Yesterday, after sparring with a senior brother from Carefree Peak, I completely overwhelmed him. Even the junior sisters from our Eternal Spring Valley look at me differently now."
The other male disciples eagerly shared their enthusiasm.
As men, who doesn’t want to get stronger? Who doesn’t want to show off their might in front of junior sisters and senior sisters?
Just thinking about their tender cries of "Senior Brother, go for it," and "Senior Brother, you’re amazing," was enough to get their blood boiling.
This exhilarating feeling was something they had never experienced before.
It was not only thrilling but also addictive!
"Witch No. 3" is the seed Wang Shouzhe currently uses for his Vine Array. At present, these seeds can only be cultivated by him, and no one else can replicate them.
Recently, at the strong request and anticipation of the Eternal Spring Valley disciples, Wang Shouzhe gifted them a few, allowing them to experience the power of a weakened version of the Vine Array.
Of course, due to bloodline reasons, they could only activate them with the "Eternal Spring True Technique," which was much slower than Wang Shouzhe.
However, since these vine seeds were slowly improved by Wang Shouzhe over eight years, focusing on rapid growth, they eventually stored a lot of energy when condensed into seeds. This allows them to be activated with only a small amount of Eternal Spring Profound Qi.
As a result, these disciples of Eternal Spring Valley could barely use "Witch No. 3" for combat.
Seeing the "hungry and thirsty" eyes of these male disciples staring at him, Wang Shouzhe gently consoled them, "Fellow senior and junior brothers, I didn’t bring many seeds this time. Moreover, cultivating these vine seeds is no easy task, so you’ll have to give me some time."
"Alright, everyone take a booklet." Wang Shouzhe pulled out a stack of booklets and distributed them to the crowd. "I will entrust Qiaan’s Trading Company to bring a batch every six months. If you have any needs, you can contact my nephew Wang Zongsheng to place an order."
With this, Wang Shouzhe finally placated these male disciples.
This was also a tactic Wang Shouzhe came up with. Back on Earth, before online shopping existed, mail-order shopping relied on such booklets.
Whether it’s mail-order or online shopping, neither can do without logistics.
Nowadays, branches of Qiaan’s Trading Company are spread throughout the entire Longzuo County. Its scale is immense and has already begun to take shape in logistics, barely able to meet the demands of mail-order business.
Wang Shouzhe is quite interested in developing express delivery and logistics, but with the current strength and size of the Ping’an Wang Family, they simply can’t manage it. Even cooperating with Qiaan’s Trading Company wouldn’t help as they wouldn’t acknowledge you, and even if you presented a business plan, it would just benefit them.
Ultimately, it’s because the overall strength of the Ping’an Wang Family is too weak.
If one day his two sisters, Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing, reach the level of a Purple Mansion Ascendant, only then would the Wang Family have the eligibility to truly cooperate with Qiaan’s Trading Company.
However, that’s something that would happen at least two or three hundred years from now.
Suddenly.
A thought occurred to Wang Shouzhe.
However, this idea requires careful consideration.
No need to hurry for now.
...
Afterwards, Wang Shouzhe stayed at the Academy for another seven or eight days, expanding his connections, before bidding farewell to his nephews and nieces and his two sisters.
During this time, he also learned that his eldest niece, Wang Lici, had joined the Yunyang lineage under the deputy director.
Regarding this, Wang Shouzhe secretly expressed sympathy for the deputy director.
Fortunately, every member of the Wang Family has found a suitable path for themselves, with a promising future ahead.
After the farewell, Wang Shouzhe’s convoy slowly started moving back to Changning.
When they started off, it was early spring in February, but by the time they returned to Changning, it was already May. During this time, the weather was somewhat sultry and marked the beginning of the rainy season.
Continuous torrential rains could potentially cause the Anjiang River to overflow, resulting in floods throughout the Ping’an region.
In the over one hundred years of Ping’an Town’s history, there have been a total of two major flood disasters, with smaller floods occurring almost every few years.
Humans like to live by the water, and water is essential for both living and farming. But once a flood comes fiercely, it can cause tremendous harm to humans.
Things like reduced crop yields and collapsed houses are minor issues compared to the real fear of an epidemic if too many people and livestock die due to a flood.
Therefore, just after his transmigration.
Wang Shouzhe was already very concerned about water management in Ping’an Town.
In the past eight years, he has ordered people to gradually understand the entire geography of Ping’an Town. Not only has he created detailed topographic maps, but he has also painstakingly made a huge topographic sand table.
Regardless of the ancestors’ pioneering efforts or the protection offered by generations of ancestors, the family has a deep emotional attachment to this land.
Although Ping’an Town is nominally part of the Daqian, Wang Shouzhe has privately long considered it his cherished domain, managing and building it as his own territory from start to finish.
Upon returning, he was informed that this year’s rainy season was continuing and signs of floods seemed apparent, immediately immersing himself in intense work.
The huge sand table displayed the topography and landscape of Ping’an Town in minute detail.
Over the past eight years, the manpower and resources he has invested in water management are innumerable.
Fortunately, Ping’an Town is just a small area. To the north is the Anjiang River, arching like a guardian around Ping’an Town, stretching from the Dragon Gorge in the west to Falling Eagle Gorge in the east, spanning about 140-150 miles along the riverbank.
If the water level of the Anjiang River rises, any section of the 140-150 miles of riverbank could breach and flood into Ping’an Town.
Of these, the Dragon Gorge in the west is particularly vexing to Wang Shouzhe.
This is because the terrain is narrow there, with the gorge acting like a throat, pinching the upper reaches of the Anjiang. This causes the water flow along the section by Ping’an Town to be rapid and somewhat fierce.
On normal days, this isn’t a big deal, but if the flood season comes, it’s a major hidden danger.
Behind Ping’an Town, there are branches of Liping Mountain intertwined, isolating Ping’an Town from the Outer Domain.
Thus, once the flood enters Ping’an Town, there’s no flood discharge channel, and as the water level continually rises, it could turn the entire Ping’an Town into a lake.
Wang Shouzhe scrutinized all the terrains on the sand table, continually deducing the weak points.
After a long time, Liua Ruolan brought some snacks and gently said, "Husband, have something to eat and take a break."
"This Dragon Gorge..." Wang Shouzhe grumbled, "Someday, I will level it."
"Pfft~" Liua Ruolan covered her mouth and laughed, "Husband truly has grand ambitions. When that day comes, I’ll work with you."
Places like Dragon Gorge are excellent for hydropower. Before he transmigrated, Earth’s Three Gorges was such a project.
Of course, such massive water conservancy facilities have their pros and cons, with their damage to the ecological environment being quite severe.
Wang Shouzhe temporarily set aside all distractions, savoring the "love snacks" made by Liua Ruolan.
Hmm.
As usual, they tasted terrible.
Yet he continued to pretend to enjoy them: "My wife’s culinary skills are amazing."
"If husband likes them, I’ll take care of all your meals every day in the future," Liua Ruolan’s pretty face blushed with happiness.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression changed, and he said hurriedly, "My dear, do not harm your husband."
Do not harm your husband?!
Liua Ruolan’s expression gradually changed.
Oops!
Wang Shouzhe’s heart skipped a beat, realizing he might have spoken too candidly.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 49 Evolution! Ping’an Town Gradually Becomes Stronger
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 49 Evolution! Ping’an Town Gradually Becomes Stronger
...
In a life-and-death moment, Wang Shouzhe’s mind raced.
He looked at Liu Ruolan with a face full of fondness and depth: "I truly adore my wife’s cooking skills. If you cook for me every day, how could I possibly control myself? Wouldn’t I end up overeating? Over time, it would surely be bad for my health. Wouldn’t it be like plotting against your own husband?"
"Therefore, my wife should cook occasionally, so I can have something to look forward to."
The coldness on Liu Ruolan’s face gradually dissipated, and she gave Wang Shouzhe a happy sidelong glance: "Husband really is talented. Even your compliments are so breathtaking and inventive."
To divert Liu Ruolan’s attention, Wang Shouzhe wrapped his arm around her waist and whispered: "I’ve been away from home all these days, and many things have been inconvenient. I haven’t experienced my wife’s ’Profound Water True Technique’ in quite some time."
Liu Ruolan’s pretty face flushed slightly, and she whispered: "I also haven’t checked my husband’s ’Eternal Spring True Technique’ cultivation progress for a while. It’s just that the two children are still studying in the next room..."
The couple had been away on business for too long, and hadn’t monitored their studies in a long time, which led the little ones to completely let themselves go, now catching up in haste.
The little troublemakers are indeed troublesome.
Wang Shouzhe regretfully shook his head, just as he was about to focus his attention on the sand table.
Liu Ruolan, however, blushed and bit her lip, saying, "Oh well~ they’re not falling behind in schoolwork just for one or two days. I’ll ask Qiao’Er to look after the kids, and we’ll go to the Water Moon Celestial Pavilion to train~"
"Alright. Fine then."
After some consideration, Wang Shouzhe decided he couldn’t really argue with Liu Ruolan, and followed suit as she wished.
Half an hour later.
In the study.
Wang Liyao and Wang Zong’an, the siblings, were earnestly working on their homework with serious expressions.
Mother did say she would come check the homework later.
Even at their young age, they had already learned to read the room, understanding that they would rather offend their father a hundred times than provoke their mother’s anger even once at home.
Therefore, they wrote diligently, putting in a great deal of effort.
However, they had waited for a long time, and there was no sign of their mother coming to check the homework.
"Aunt Qiao’Er," Wang Liyao blinked her beautiful eyes, full of doubt, "could it be that mother has gone to train with father again?"
"Well..." Qiao’Er broke out in cold sweat, chuckling dryly as she explained, "Miss and Sir are both Celestial Prides; it’s only right for them to train hard."
The siblings looked at each other.
Alright, today’s homework was done for nothing again.
Once the parents start training, they probably wouldn’t return for two or three days.
"An’an, let’s go, sister will take you out to play," Wang Liyao suddenly lit up.
"Um, sister, isn’t this a bit inappropriate?" Wang Zong’an felt a bit guilty.
He wasn’t as bold as his sister.
"What are you afraid of? You know our parents well enough; they’ve just found a place to hide for some peace and quiet,"
Wang Liyao grabbed Wang Zong’an and strutted out, casually adding, "Aunt Qiao’Er, you must cover for us."
Qiao’Er looked speechless, grumbling inwardly.
Miss, Sir, how many years have you used that excuse? Even the little miss can’t be fooled anymore. Could you come up with something new?
...
In the following days, the weather continued with heavy, continuous rain.
The water level of Anjiang kept rising.
Wang Shouzhe received information that several low-lying areas along the middle and lower reaches of Anjiang had already experienced flooding, leading to waterlogging.
Since Changning Guard is on the north side of Anjiang, with steep coastal terrain and a higher inland topography, as long as the drainage is handled well, it wouldn’t flood easily for a while.
However, Ping’an Town predominantly has hilly terrain with many low-lying areas, making its overall elevation much lower than the north side of Anjiang.
This is also why no one has come to cultivate the land in Ping’an Town. If it were a good piece of land, it wouldn’t have been left to Ancestor Zhou Xuan.
Nevertheless, for the Wang Family, Ping’an Town is their foundation, and there’s no choice but to manage it carefully.
Water management projects are never a matter of a single day. Since arriving, Wang Shouzhe has never relaxed on this front.
The dredging and filling at Zhuwei Lake was just the beginning.
Over the years, he has continually worked on dredging rivers, opening water channels, strengthening embankments, and constructing flood discharge gates, among other tasks. This downpour is precisely the time to test the arrangements he has painstakingly made over the past eight or nine years.
The entire Wang Family, and even many collateral branches of the Wang Family, participated in this flood prevention work.
The foremost is the embankment along Anjiang.
From Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s time, the construction and strengthening of the embankment has been ongoing. Every year, part of the manpower and resources would be spent on it.
By the time of Wang Shouzhe, even more emphasis was placed on the construction and reinforcement of the embankment along the Ping’an stretch of Anjiang.
Currently, besides wealth, the Ping’an Wang Family has another powerful tool in their hands, the legendary foreign cement.
Simply mixed with gravel and water in certain proportions, it becomes the famed concrete.
However, the time left for Wang Shouzhe was too short, and currently, only the most dangerous sections have been built with stone slopes and concrete embankments, roughly accounting for just one-third of one hundred fifty miles.
But even so, compared to the original embankment, the flood resistance capability is incomparable.
Wang Shouzhe braved the rain, inspecting the embankments along the way.
As the water level rose, some previously relatively safe embankments now had some hidden dangers. He immediately dispatched clan members to organize tenant farmers and commoners to temporarily reinforce those embankments.
At the same time, he also inspected the flood discharge gates.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 49 Evolution! Ping’an Town Gradually Becomes Stronger_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 49 Evolution! Ping’an Town Gradually Becomes Stronger_2
On Earth, some flood gates use high-power pumps for drainage. The simple manufacturing of a pump is not difficult; the challenge lies in the absence of electricity in this world.
However, human wisdom is boundless.
In this world, there are naturally some water wheels for irrigation as well.
Over the years, Wang Shouzhe has worked on many projects, including researching with professionals for water wheel improvement plans.
Among the three major flood gates, the Fenggu Gate located at Fenggu Farm was originally built by Ancestor Zhou Xuan.
In the past eight years, Wang Shouzhe has undertaken multiple renovations and reconstructions of this gate, making it a primary flood outlet.
Now, there are two "Water Dragon Arrays" on either side of the tall gate.
The "Water Dragon Array" sounds impressive, but it is essentially a large water wheel with a relatively simple structure.
When the river flows, it drives the water wheel, similar to a small Ferris wheel, into motion. The water wheel’s rotation works on a simple reciprocating pump through precise and durable bearings and gears crafted by Artifact Refiners.
This reciprocating pump then pumps the water inside the gate into the Anjiang River.
Inside the gate, the waterways connect seamlessly, linking to all the channels and lakes within Ping’an Town.
Wang Shouzhe possesses quite a bit of Earthly knowledge. Though it’s not his expertise, he understands the overall direction, and the world is not short of clever craftsmen and Artifact Refiners.
Through their collaboration, the "Water Dragon Array" was developed.
Of course, this large water wheel is not simply exposed in the river path.
Wang Shouzhe drove piles along the river edge and constructed a large base with concrete, forming a funnel-shaped channel broader at the front and narrower towards the back along the gate’s embankment.
In this way, the funnel mouth can draw in more water, and as the channel narrows, the flow speeds up, generating more power for the water wheel.
At the channel entrance before the water wheel, there is a two-zhang wide winch lift gate. When the water wheel’s operation is unnecessary, you just need to lower the gate to cut off the water flow.
Additionally, at the funnel mouth, an iron grid is set up to intercept larger debris or waterborne ferocious beasts rushing with the flow, preventing damage to the water wheel.
The two Water Dragon Arrays at the Fenggu Gate, though having simple principles and structures, took Wang Shouzhe five full years to communicate with craftsmen and Artifact Refiners, continually testing and improving small-scale structures before formal construction, costing over ten thousand Qian Gold in total.
Obviously, the effects are very noticeable.
The person in charge of this gate is a capable member of the Wang Family’s collateral line. Upon meeting Wang Shouzhe, he enthusiastically reported, "Reporting to the Patriarch, both Water Dragon Arrays are operating very smoothly."
Amidst the turbulent channel, the massive water wheel rotates steadily. It appears slow, but in fact, it is not slow; the large perimeter of the water wheel merely creates this mirage.
Driven by the water wheel, water continuously sprays out from the pipe mouth pointing at the Anjiang, resembling two white and grand Water Dragons.
Such a scene is the origin of the Water Dragon Array’s name!
"Monitor all twelve hours, and if the Water Dragon Array encounters any failure, spare no cost for repair."
Seeing his many years of hard work and huge investment in the Water Dragon Array play an active role, Wang Shouzhe felt quite proud.
He regarded Ping’an Town as his territory, as his home, naturally wishing to fortify it to withstand all kinds of natural disasters.
Previously calculated, a large Water Dragon Array in full operation can drain about two hundred thousand cubic meters in a day.
Across the three flood gates, there are six in total. At full speed, they can drain about one million two hundred thousand cubic meters per day.
It sounds like a lot.
But in fact, taking Zhuwei Lake as an example, it covers about ten thousand acres, holding approximately twenty-eight million cubic meters of water when fully stored.
These six large Water Dragon Arrays would need over twenty days of full operation to empty Zhuwei Lake!
Needless to say, the capacity from the myriad of large and small rivers, channels, and sheep-scattered small lakes within Ping’an Town.
Thus, before the rainy season each year, these six Water Dragon Arrays must start pre-operational drainage to lower the internal water levels of Ping’an Town, preventing the awkward situation of being too late in flood drainage when the flood season hits.
Even as it continues to rain now, though the majority of rainwater is absorbed by the land or enters underground water channels, the remaining small portion that flows into the channels is still not negligible.
As such, even under full operation, the water in the river channel continues to rise bit by bit.
Slowly, but still rising.
Fortunately, by starting early drainage before the rainy season, Ping’an Town’s water level was at a relatively low state. Otherwise, many wheat fields might already be flooded by river water backflowing now.
Wang Shouzhe’s expression was somewhat heavy.
Six Water Dragon Arrays are ultimately too few.
Even if this year’s flood season is far from reaching the levels of the historical two floods, it is almost at the limits of the Water Dragon Vehicles.
Having spent eight years gradually building hydraulic infrastructure is ultimately just a fledgling effort, Wang Shouzhe thought to himself. Once this flood season passes, more investment must be made into water management construction again.
After all, now the entire Ping’an Town belongs to the Wang Family, and investing even more is just long-term investment. Preventing one flood disaster recoups the cost.
In the following six or seven days, the entire Wang Family led Ping’an Town’s forty thousand people in a tense flood-fighting effort.
At times like this, no outsiders could assist the Wang Family.
After all, during the fierce flood season, every place faced the threat of flooding.
During this period, breaches appeared in three river embankments, and the situation nearly spiraled out of control. Wang Shouzhe and his wife personally stationed themselves on the front lines to join the flood fight.
In the face of nature’s grand forces, their Spirit Platform Realm abilities were limited, but with them present, everyone had a backbone. Together with the Wang Family and all the town’s citizens, they sealed the breaches time after time, preventing flooding from occurring.
Finally.
After two consecutive days of clear skies, the turbulent flow of the Anjiang slightly abated, and the total water level began to slowly decrease, dropping over half a meter in two days.
This heralded the end of the flood season.
It also signified that Ping’an Town successfully crossed the tribulation, surviving the flood-prone flood season.
Nevertheless, all of Ping’an Town remained vigilant, still united in reinforcing weak spots in the embankments to guard against the flood season’s return.
Thus, after several more days.
The water level of the Anjiang continued to drop, and the water flow gradually stabilized.
The flood season finally passed completely, and Ping’an Town promptly fell into a joyful celebration.
This flood season arrived menacingly; a decade or two ago, flood disasters would have been nearly unavoidable, causing significant damage.
But this time, apart from some areas experiencing reduced yields after waterlogging, the overall grain production remained at a high level.
Most importantly, only a few people died during this flood season.
This was a great victory!
Although Wang Family’s prestige in Ping’an Town was already sky-high, after this, public sentiment soared to a new level.
Celebrations filled Ping’an Town, but the Shouzhe couple lay exhausted at home, not stepping out for two whole days.
They were utterly worn out.
Two days later, only when Wang Shouzhe’s trusted "favorite general" Wang Mei came secretly to report work did Wang Shouzhe manage to muster up a bit of energy.
Wang Shouzhe privately received Wang Mei in his study.
He reviewed the intelligence Wang Mei had compiled, and a cold smile appeared on his lips.
Heh~ After so many years, he set out so many baits, and finally, the mastermind behind the scenes from sixty years ago couldn’t hold back and exposed a flaw!
Next, things might get turbulent again.
The entire Changning Guard is likely about to enter some turmoil.
"Wang Mei, you’ve worked hard." Wang Shouzhe’s expression was slightly complicated as he glanced at Wang Mei.
The complexity in his expression was due to her appearance today.
She wore a peculiar attire.
Her evil makeup technique had reached an innovative stage.
If she was thrown into the academy, she would undoubtedly be like some sort of goddess senior.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 50: Making a Name for Themselves! Young Men of the Wang Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 50: Making a Name for Themselves! Young Men of the Wang Family
...
Every time she came to report on work. The image she would present was completely unpredictable.
But is this really good? He had just returned from the Academy, which didn’t mean he had developed a liking for the senior sisters’ mature style.
Wang Mei’s eyes flashed with a hint of fervor and she said, "To serve the Patriarch, I would die without regret."
Despite her passion, she couldn’t help but feel a bit of regret.
Our Patriarch is great in all aspects, except for ignoring her allure, which isn’t good.
However, she could afford to wait, and was diligently cultivating, striving to reach the Spirit Platform Realm soon.
By then, with an increased lifespan, she would have plenty of time to serve the Patriarch again.
Wang Shouzhe gave up on continuing to deal with her and focused on intelligence reports, meticulously examining the original documents and some analysis reports.
Over the years, he not only expanded the intelligence department but also continually infiltrated the two major suspects — the Celestial Human Lei Family and the Celestial Person Huangfu Family.
Of course, those two are Celestial Human Families, making infiltration tremendously difficult and risky.
Therefore, as of now, these infiltrations are limited to the periphery.
Additionally, he periodically released some baits.
These baits have almost no effect on families uninterested in the Wang Family.
But imagine if a Celestial Human Family had ever sought to harm the Wang Family.
Even if their actions were incredibly secretive, with no flaws exposed thus far.
Nevertheless, they would inevitably watch every move of the Wang Family. If the Wang Family showed signs of rising, it could easily stimulate their sensitive nerves.
The reasoning is simple: a guilty conscience.
They fear that someday, if the Wang Family truly rises, it might trace back to events of the past and seek revenge against them.
However, this enemy is extremely cautious, hiding deep, and previously, the baits thrown out by Wang Shouzhe had virtually no effect.
Thus indeed.
Wang Shouzhe gradually increased the intensity of the baits, even going so far as to expose facts about the Wang Family’s young generation of Celestial Pride in the Academy, forcing the opponents’ sensitive nerves into disorder.
Finally, some families couldn’t sit still and began to show some cracks.
"Fortune Gambling House!"
This place, a mix of dragons and snakes, is also a den of vice. Here, unbelievably, some clues had been uncovered by Wang Mei.
Moreover, he had once been indirectly connected to the Fortune Gambling House; back then, when Wang Zongwei entered the city, it had been where the incident occurred.
"What to do next, please enlighten me, Patriarch." Wang Mei asked respectfully.
"Continue to keep a close watch on them, but you and your people should be careful. It won’t be long before our opportunity for executing the plan comes." Wang Shouzhe had never been one to prefer having control in others’ hands.
The hidden manipulator in the dark was like a Sword of Damocles, always hanging over the Wang Family, unpredictable when it might descend.
Instead of that, it’s better to hold the initiative in his own hands.
...
Meanwhile.
Outside of the Wang Family’s Main Residence.
A black and a white horse came galloping from afar, their speed extremely fast, soon reaching the square outside the main gate.
A male and a female knight dismounted from their horses.
The male and female knights were both wearing the standard fierce beast leather armor unique to the military, with armor on their heads and broad-bladed swords hanging from their waists.
They looked to be in their twenties, the man handsome and tall, with a composed and stable demeanor.
The woman was younger, only about eighteen or nineteen, with a curvaceous figure under the leather armor and a pretty and valiant appearance.
Once they dismounted, a Household General led several household servants to greet them.
The attitude of the Household General was very respectful: "Sixth Young Master, you have returned."
"Is my fourth brother at home?" The young man raised his eyebrows and asked.
This young and heroic military man was Wang Shouzhe’s sixth of the Shou Generation—Wang Shou Lian.
With his third uncle Wang Ding Race having advanced his cultivation into the Spirit Platform Realm in recent years, he was elevated by the Lord Mansion Master of the City Chief’s Mansion to become a leader of the Changning Guard Patrol Camp.
And Wang Shou Lian, in the past two years, had been developing alongside his father in the Patrol Camp.
"To inform Sixth Young Master." The Household General replied, "The Patriarch has been in the courtyard for the past two days; does Sixth Young Master wish to see the Patriarch? I will report immediately."
Wang Shou Lian smiled and said, "No need, I can go myself."
Then, he turned to the young woman dressed in the same military uniform and said, "Qingning, come with me to see my fourth brother."
"This..." Zhou Qing Ning’s pretty face, seasoned with some heroism, hesitated, "Shou Lian, I’m a bit afraid. What if your fourth brother thinks we are inappropriate? Many family lineages don’t quite wish for their members to marry women from a Military Family."
Wang Shou Lian laughed and held her hand, gently comforting her: "Although my fourth brother is the Patriarch, he is open-minded and likely respects our choices."
"This..." Zhou Qing Ning hesitated again, "Perhaps, I should change clothes before meeting your fourth brother; maybe he prefers the demeanor of a serene noblewoman."
"Qing Ning, you are you. Just be yourself." Wang Shou Lian held her hand, his expression solemn as he said, "You aren’t a noblewoman, but you are the woman I’m destined to spend my life with. You must have confidence in me, and in my fourth brother. As long as he agrees, neither my father nor your father will pose any issue."
"Alright, Shou Lian, I’ll follow your lead." Zhou Qing Ning’s pretty face blushed slightly, showing a hint of happiness.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 50: Making a Name for Themselves! Young Men of the Wang Family_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 50: Making a Name for Themselves! Young Men of the Wang Family_2
At this moment.
Inside the main residence.
A young man quickly walked out with a bright smile and greeted them. "Sixth Uncle, why didn’t you notify the family when you came back? I could have gone to Dingpu Ferry to pick you up."
This young man looked about twenty-two or twenty-three years old, with a striking appearance. His walk was like a dragon or a tiger, exuding vigor and indicating considerable cultivation.
Upon seeing him, Wang Shou Lian laughed and gave him a hearty slap. "Zongchang, it’s been half a year since I last saw you, and you’ve already broken through to the mid-phase of the Seventh Layer in the Qi Refining Realm. Congratulations!"
This young man was the second son of the eighth generation "Zong" line of the Wang Family—Wang Zongchang.
He was the second son of Wang Shouxin, and the younger brother of Wang Lici.
Rubbing his shoulder with a wry smile, Wang Zongchang said, "Sixth Uncle, you’re just a year elder than me, and you’ve already reached the high phase of the Seventh Layer in the Qi Refining Realm. I can’t catch up no matter how hard I try."
Wang Shou Lian was twenty-two years old, and Wang Zongchang was twenty-three.
Although they belonged to different generations, they were close in age and had been good friends since childhood.
Achieving such cultivation at a young age made them outstanding talents among the noble family descendants, surpassing even the likes of Chen Fangjie in their youth.
While speaking.
Wang Zongchang caught sight of Zhou Qing Ning and immediately adopted a more serious expression. "Sixth Uncle, is this the Miss Qingning you mentioned in your letters?"
"Indeed," Wang Shou Lian said with pride, "Zongchang, shouldn’t you greet your Sixth Aunt?"
Wang Zongchang hurriedly and somewhat theatrically paid his respects. "I greet Sixth Aunt."
Zhou Qing Ning blushed, lightly chiding Wang Shou Lian with a sidelong glance, "I haven’t agreed to marry you yet."
"Haha." Wang Shou Lian laughed, "I’m certain about you, Qingning. In life, I am your Zhou Qingning’s person, in death, your Zhou Qingning’s ghost. You can’t get rid of me even if you want to."
"You’re such a scoundrel," Zhou Qing Ning blushingly scolded, though the corners of her eyes crinkled with a hint of a smile.
Seeing this, Wang Zongchang quietly gave his uncle a thumbs up, thinking that his uncle indeed had a thick skin that rivaled Fourth Uncle’s back in the day.
"By the way, Zongchang, you came at the right time to accompany me to see Fourth Brother." Wang Shou Lian said.
Upon hearing that he had to meet Fourth Uncle.
Wang Zongchang became nervous, "Sixth Uncle, you know as well as I do that I’ve feared meeting Fourth Uncle since I was little."
"I’m afraid too," Wang Shou Lian said, grabbing him, "Going together helps share the pressure."
Thus,
Wang Shou Lian escorted Wang Zongchang, along with Zhou Qing Ning, into the main residence, heading towards Wang Shouzhe’s courtyard.
Before he could announce their arrival,
a dashing and regal female senior, with a touch of academy elegance and goddess-like demeanor, emerged from the courtyard.
The goddess senior smiled slightly at Wang Shou Lian and said, "No need to report, Sixth Young Master, the Patriarch has invited you in."
After speaking, she gracefully saluted and then left.
"This..." Wang Shou Lian was utterly baffled, scratching his head, "Zongchang, who is this senior? Did Fourth Brother bring back a senior from the Purple Mansion Academy when he visited?"
"No." Wang Zongchang also scratched his head, puzzled, "We didn’t see this senior during our disaster relief efforts some time ago."
The two exchanged glances, somewhat uncertain and suspicious. Could it be...
This seems to foreshadow trouble.
At that moment, a gentle male voice sounded in their ears, "Shou Lian, Zongchang. What are you dawdling at the door for? You’ve brought a guest with you; don’t forget your manners. Come in quickly."
Wang Shou Lian and Wang Zongsheng hastily straightened their faces and saluted towards the courtyard, "Yes, Fourth Brother/Fourth Uncle."
Then the two dutifully led Zhou Qing Ning in to pay their respects.
All three of them walked into the courtyard.
At the center of the courtyard, a steady, heroic, and slightly imposing young man stood with his hands behind his back.
He didn’t pay immediate attention to his younger brother and nephew.
Instead, he first smiled slightly at Zhou Qing Ning and said, "You must be Miss Qingning. I apologize for not welcoming you from afar."
With Wang Shouzhe’s intelligence network, how could he not know Zhou Qing Ning?
If he didn’t even know who his sixth brother’s girlfriend was, what was the point of trying to match wits with the master schemer from the past behind the scenes?
Zhou Qing Ning hurriedly paid her respects, "Qingning greets Patriarch Wang."
Wang Shou Lian and Wang Zongchang also hurriedly saluted.
After exchanging greetings.
Wang Shouzhe hosted them in the side hall.
As the hostess, Liua Ruolan personally served spirit tea and fresh fruits and snacks to her younger brother, nephew, and Miss Qingning.
This was the proper courtesy.
The three of them also hurriedly stood up to thank Liua Ruolan.
Ordinarily, Liua Ruolan would not intrude on their family conversations.
But today, with Zhou Qing Ning present, she accompanied them and engaged in light-hearted chatter with Zhou Qing Ning to ease the young woman’s anxiety.
"Sixth Uncle has good taste and good fortune." Liua Ruolan praised Zhou Qing Ning, "Miss Qingning is not only beautiful but also possesses a heroic demeanor, clearly a spirited and frank young lady. Such a good girl is hard to find."
These words made Zhou Qing Ning blush, and she bowed her head slightly in timid silence.
Wang Shou Lian took her hand and said to Wang Shouzhe, "Fourth Brother, this matter depends on you. After all, Qingning comes from a military family. My father, he..."
Military families and local families usually belong to two different systems and typically do not intermarry, which was a barrier between Wang Shou Lian and Zhou Qing Ning.
Before he could finish speaking, Wang Shouzhe interrupted, "You need not say more. As long as you are determined to spend your life with Miss Qingning, I will speak to Third Uncle on your behalf."
Wang Shou Lian was overjoyed and thanked Wang Shouzhe profusely, "Thank you, Fourth Brother, for deciding for us."
His Fourth Brother was a formidable figure, and since he agreed to it, he would certainly make it happen.
Zhou Qing Ning also blushed and expressed her gratitude to Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe turned to Liua Ruolan and said, "Dear, Sixth Brother’s marriage is a significant matter, especially since she comes from a military family. We must handle the matchmaking and courtesies with great care and alignment with their traditions, to avoid drawing critiques. As the main wife of the Wang Family, it is up to you to handle this affair."
"Yes, my lord," Liua Ruolan nodded, "Regarding Sixth Uncle’s affair, I will handle it properly."
Wang Shou Lian and Zhou Qing Ning naturally expressed their gratitude again.
They hadn’t expected the matter to go so smoothly, and their hearts were filled with joy.
After dealing with this matter,
Wang Shou Lian took on a serious expression and spoke about the main issue, "Fourth Brother, Father sent me back to report to you. Due to the recent floods, our Changning Guard’s western side has suffered significantly. Moreover, the losses in the two Guardian Cities of Dingnan Zhen Marsh are even worse. Especially Zhenze Guard, which has almost become a vast expanse of water, with many victims."
"Many of the surviving refugees have been moving east, with some gradually arriving at our Changning Guard."
Wang Zongchang’s expression changed, "The losses are so severe?"
During the previous flood relief efforts in Ping’an Town, everyone worked together to overcome the difficulties. He thought the flood wasn’t that serious, but he didn’t expect that the upstream areas had suffered so severely.
"If the water recedes over there, it might lead to an epidemic, right?" Liua Ruolan also frowned in concern.
Epidemics are extremely frightening, as once they spread, they become a disaster of massive proportions.
"We cannot be careless." Wang Shouzhe said solemnly, "Zongchang, today you must make a trip to East Sea Guard and Hundred Islands Guard to purchase as many medicinal supplies as possible."
"Yes, Fourth Uncle."
Wang Zongchang replied seriously. Now that he was an adult, he was gradually becoming a pillar of the family, no longer the fledgling youngster he used to be.
"Moreover, Father heard from the Mansion Master of the City Guardian’s Mansion that the Purple Mansion Academy has already dispatched a Direct Disciple to lead a team for disaster relief. The Mansion Master directed that all Patriarchs of Eighth Grade and Seventh Grade must personally meet the disaster relief team from the Purple Mansion Academy in Qinzhou." Wang Shou Lian added.
"A Direct Disciple from the Academy?" Wang Shouzhe raised his eyebrows slightly, "Any word on which Direct Disciple it is?"
"Well..." Wang Shou Lian shook his head helplessly, "The Mansion Master didn’t say, and Father didn’t dare to ask too many questions."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 51: Got Hooked! The Mastermind Took the Bait
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 51: Got Hooked! The Mastermind Took the Bait
...
"I understand this matter now." Changning Shouzhe had already grasped the situation in his heart, and changed the topic, saying, "Wang Shou Lian, your fourth sister-in-law made some pastries for me. I’m reluctant to eat more, so I saved some for you."
Wang Shou Lian’s complexion subtly changed, forcing a smile: "Thank you, fourth brother, for your consideration. I already ate some dry food on the way."
"You’re a grown man, how can you just eat dry food?" Liu Ruolan reproached gently, "Eat some pastries first to fill your stomach, and later your fourth sister-in-law will personally cook for you."
Wang Shou Lian’s face turned as pale as a sheet, forcing a smile, he said: "Many thanks, fourth sister-in-law."
Wang Zongchang’s legs were trembling, and he said: "Fourth uncle, I’ll go complete the task now."
"Why the rush?" Liu Ruolan, with the demeanor of a senior aunt, replied, "You are all in the prime of youth, you should eat your fill before doing anything. No one is allowed to leave, all stay for a meal."
Then, Liu Ruolan went to prepare the meals.
She said she would personally cook today.
The faces of the three Wang family men were heavy, the atmosphere was oppressive, as if the apocalypse was about to come.
...
Almost at the same time.
Northwest of Changning Guard City, there lies a vast and lush pasture.
Here, there are herds of cattle and sheep, as well as groups of sturdy horses, running and being trained under the guidance of the herdsmen.
This is the famous "Huangfu Ranch," one of the main pillars of the Celestial Human Family Huangfu.
The Huangfu Family has rooted itself in Changning Guard for hundreds of years, having completed a Celestial Human succession, it is said to be ever-lasting and holds an unshakable position.
In the middle of this vast ranch, lies a dormant ring-shaped volcano.
This is a ring-shaped volcano, which has resulted in the land of this large pasture being full of volcanic rock, making large-scale farming difficult, and hard to develop into fertile land.
Yet the land contains a large amount of volcanic ash and minerals, making it suitable for mass growth of pasture grass, which benefits the development of animal husbandry.
This makes the beef and lamb produced by Huangfu Ranch of high quality, the horses are also quite robust, resulting in considerable economic benefits.
Right at the center of the ring-shaped volcano, below the crater a hundred yards deep, there is a huge piece of red rock.
On this rock, there is a stone house.
Beside the stone house, there is a red lake spanning dozens of yards. But in this small lake, what has accumulated is not water, but constantly bubbling red magma.
The scorching heat permeates the air, making the entire surrounding distorted.
From time to time, bubbles of magma ascend from the magma lake, bursting and releasing wisps of black smoke. These are ashes formed by the impurities in magma being incinerated by the intense heat.
The whole area around the magma lake is frighteningly hot, ordinary people entering here would be roasted in a short period of time.
Yet, in this absolute terrain, there is a red-haired elder, sitting cross-legged on a piece of exposed red volcanic rock.
The volcanic rock is situated in the middle of the magma lake, where magma bubbles continuously burst as if igniting flowers of fiery red flames. The surrounding air is also fluctuating, showing the extreme temperature.
However, the red-haired elder remains leisurely in this environment, as naturally as a fish in water.
His eyes are closed tightly, his breathing long and constant, he breathes like a dragon.
Every time he inhales, the air carrying extreme heat enters his lungs extensively, every time he exhales, a blast of white air shoots out.
In each cycle of breath, the surrounding air temperature seems to decrease, and the magma in front is disturbed to create waves.
Thus, the cycles repeat.
His face gradually turns red as if drunken, and bluish smoke rises from his head.
Just at this moment.
On the stone steps leading inside Ring Mountain, a majestic middle-aged man in gorgeous clothing is descending swiftly.
His breath is steady, strides strong and confident, though fast, as if walking on flat ground, he exudes an air of composure.
His body is covered in a thin layer of red aura, helping him resist the terrifying heat under the volcano crater.
But even so, when he reaches the stone house by the magma lake, his face is already sweaty, and his complexion heated and reddened, clearly not feeling easy.
Yet he only dares to watch the red-haired elder from afar, not daring to interrupt carelessly.
After a long while, the red-haired elder finishes his cultivation.
He steps barefoot on the boiling magma, walking to the stone house as if on flat ground.
Only then does the dignified middle-aged man in gorgeous clothing bow and say: "Greetings, Ancestor."
As he spoke, he shook open a coat with his own hands to cover the Ancestor.
"Brocade Ring." The red-haired elder casually glanced at him, "You know my ’Red Dragon True Technique’ is at a critical point in cultivation; without important matters, I believe you would not dare disturb me."
"Reporting to Ancestor." The middle-aged man in gorgeous clothing bowed and said, "Does Ancestor still remember the Ping’an Wang Family?"
"Ping’an Wang Family?"
The red-haired elder’s brows slightly furrowed, as if pondering something.
After quite a while, he suddenly understood: "I remember now. That family of explorers called Wang Zhouxuan. Even in a small place like the Changning Guard area, there are already two Celestial Human Families, yet he dared to aspire for Celestial Human status, ridiculous~!"
The man in gorgeous clothing said: "Indeed, according to Ancestor’s directions back then, we took advantage of the beast tide to set obstacles for them at will, causing them to fall."

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 51: Got Hooked! The Mastermind Took the Bait_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 51: Got Hooked! The Mastermind Took the Bait_2
He spoke in a very relaxed manner.
Back then, they had no grievances with the Wang Family, it was merely a casual erasure.
The red-haired elder’s brow furrowed slightly: "Now that you mention it, I recall it as well. This family seems to have some connection with the Longzuo Wang Family. Back then, the Longzuo Wang Family sought a letter from the Academy, which helped preserve that little family. Why are you suddenly bringing up this little family? Could they really turn the skies upside down?"
"Ancestor," the man in gorgeous clothing said solemnly, "this little family is indeed on the verge of upheaval. Recently, our clan members at the Purple Mansion Academy returned with news that the Ping’an Wang Family, for some unknown reason, has produced three Celestial Prides. Among them, two are being cultivated as direct disciples by the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies and the Carefree Peak."
"And their patriarch, Wang Shouzhe, is even more remarkable..."
He explained to the ancestor the recent events in the Academy.
Naturally, the matters of Wang Longyan and Wang Lici were kept low-key and unknown to outsiders, so they received no news of them.
"Ancestor, at this rate, in less than two hundred years, the Wang Family is likely to climb over our heads. Will they investigate the events of back then?"
"Those two in the Academy are still too young and cannot pose a threat in the short term," the red-haired elder said calmly, "And the masters of the Academy wouldn’t casually interfere in the disputes among local powerhouses. The real threat is that patriarch of the Wang Family, Wang Shouzhe."
His gaze was steady: "Back then, due to the Academy’s warning, we couldn’t root them out completely. This time, we will act more covertly, ensuring a deadly strike that hits them at their weakest point."
"Yes, Ancestor," the middle-aged man continued, "Also, our spies have uncovered a piece of classified information. The ’foreign cement’ which recently gained fame in the East Sea Guard is, in fact, the creation of the Ping’an Wang Family."
Speaking of this, his eyes sparkled.
No wonder the Ping’an Wang Family has risen so swiftly in recent years, likely earning many resources through foreign cement.
"Foreign cement?"
The red-haired elder clearly wasn’t familiar with this item.
The middle-aged man explained it to him and continued, "Foreign cement is quite expensive. But in recent years, many buildings in Ping’an Town, including roads and river embankments, have used large quantities of foreign cement. Thus, we can infer that the manufacturing cost of foreign cement should be very low, making it highly profitable. If we can take over this business..."
Upon hearing this, even the red-haired elder’s breath grew slightly heavier.
For a family to grow and thrive, resources are indispensable.
The Huangfu Family is indeed powerful, with numerous industries and a vast scale, boasting an annual total revenue of around thirty thousand Qian Gold.
However, their expenditures are even more astonishing.
With one ancestor at the Celestial Human Realm, a dozen Spirit Platform Realm mainstays, two Celestial Human Seeds, a dozen Spirit Platform Seeds, and two to three hundred important clan members, alongside over a hundred household generals and tributes, and other servants and slaves numbering well over a thousand.
Such a multitude of people results in astronomical annual expenses.
How much of those thirty thousand Qian Gold can be saved?
As the saying goes, "Every family has its own difficult book to read," and while Seventh-Grade Noble Families seem illustrious, they have their issues, just like Ninth-Grade Noble Families.
Due to insufficient family accumulation, the red-haired elder doesn’t dare to fully commit to cultivation or aim for the Purple Mansion Realm. Otherwise, he’d become a resource black hole, hindering the growth of the rest of the descendants.
Currently, their plan and direction are aimed at achieving the Sixth-Grade Noble Family status.
But if they can seize the foreign cement industry, leveraging their foundation as a Celestial Human Family, the value generated by foreign cement will far surpass that of Ping’an Town.
By then, not to mention a Sixth-Grade Noble Family, with substantial accumulation over one or two hundred years, they might even be qualified to challenge the Purple Mansion Family status.
As the saying goes, "An innocent mans possession is his own curse." The Ping’an Wang Family is walking a path towards destruction.
A thick greed flashed in the eyes of the red-haired elder, as a strong and suffocating aura gradually emanated from him.
"Jinhuan, you can go ahead with this matter, just ensure no traces are left behind."
"Yes, Ancestor."
The middle-aged man felt invigorated, knowing the ancestor had embraced his idea.
He excitedly declared, "This is destined to be the time for our Huangfu Family to rise. During this period, I’ll make arrangements, and once the Purple Mansion Academy’s relief team departs, we’ll make our move."
...
Several days later.
Changning Guard.
City Chief’s Mansion.
As the political center of Guardian City, the City Chief’s Mansion is built square and upright, exhibiting detail without losing its majesty. At the center stands a tall tower, allowing one to overlook the entire city.
Outside the City Chief’s Mansion, in four directions, are expansive plazas.
The plazas are paved with bluestone, interspersed with rune bricks, forming a large guardian array encircling the mansion.
It can be said, this City Chief’s Mansion itself is an incredibly sturdy fortress, capable of resisting even a Tier Seven Ferocious Beast for quite some time.
However, at present, these expansive plazas are already filled with carriages, each bearing different family crests, belonging to the various noble families attending the meeting at the City Chief’s Mansion.
At this moment, in the main hall, most of the Eight-Grade Noble Families have already mostly arrived.
There’s Liua Gaowang, the clan leader of Shanyin Liu Family, along with Ancestor Liua Zhisheng.
Evidently, since clan leader Liua Gaowang hasn’t reached the Spirit Platform Realm, he came to support Ancestor Zhisheng.
Additionally, there’s Chen Dewei, the clan leader of the East Port Chen Family.
Being a Spirit Platform Realm clan leader, he came alone.
Correspondingly, there’s the clan leader of the Shanyang Gongsun Family—Gongsun Yan.
Gongsun Yan, only twenty-three years old, is already at the seventh layer peak of the Qi Refining Realm, possessing a calm and reserved demeanor without lacking grandeur, making him the new generation clan leader of the Gongsun Family.
As for his father, Gongsun Qiang, who served a lifetime as Young Clan Leader, ultimately did not become clan leader, and having achieved the Spirit Platform Realm, moved on to become an Elder.
Regarding the maternal family of Wang Shouzhe, the Yingxiu Lu Family, they currently have only two Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, falling short of the Eight-Grade Noble Family threshold. Accordingly, they are not eligible to participate in this particular reception.
Additionally, the clan leader of the seasoned Eight-Grade Noble Family, the Changning Xu Family, Xu Anbang, was already waiting here early.
Besides them, there’s the clan leader of the Westpeace Dang Family, Dang Zhenghe, the clan leader of the Qianma Huangfu Family, Huangfu Deyun, and other renowned family heads of big families such as the Wangxia Lei Family have all arrived.
Among them, the Qianma Huangfu Family and the Wangxia Lei Family are branches spun off by the two Celestial Families, the Huangfu Family and Lei Family, in Changning. With the nurturing of their main families, they have developed into Eight-Grade Noble Families within just a short one or two hundred years.
Together with the Ping’an Wang Family, now the eight Eight-Grade Noble Families in the Changning Guard region are gathered.
When Wang Shouzhe, led by a House General from the City Guardian’s Mansion, walked into the main hall, all eyes in the room fell upon him.
The Shanyin Liu Family, Shanyang Gongsun Family, and East Port Chen Family naturally all cast friendly and cordial glances his way.
Whereas the look from the clan leader of the Changning Xu Family, Xu Anbang, was clearly more complex.
Once upon a time, as a seasoned Eight-Grade Noble Family, the Changning Xu Family was high and mighty, extraordinarily prestigious, and their relationship with the Ping’an Wang Family was highly complex.
Over time, the connections between the two sides gradually dwindled, leaving only the direct veins occasionally maintaining marital relations.
But now, within a mere ten years, the Ping’an Wang Family has rapidly risen, monopolizing Ping’an, an entire territory. Not only is their strength on the brink of surpassing the seasoned Eight-Grade Noble Families, but their future potential is also immeasurable.
The other Eight-Grade Noble Family clan leaders also viewed Wang Shouzhe with deep intentions, all seemingly harboring their own schemes and plans.
"Cousin Shouzhe," the youngest clan leader present, Gongsun Yan, was the first to greet Wang Shouzhe, offering a bow, "Cousin, why have you come only now? Everyone has been waiting for a long time."
"Cousin Yan," Wang Shouzhe replied with a smile, returning the gesture, "I am from Ping’an Town, a place far away, so it’s natural for me to be late."
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe exchanged greetings and pleasantries with each clan leader.
They were all people of status; intimacy between allies and in-laws was normal, and even if there had been some past conflicts, on such formal occasions, everyone maintained their decorum, greeted each other with smiles, and conversed as though they were old friends who hadn’t met in years.
Nonetheless, the conversations held in this setting were devoid of substance.
In the midst of this lively scene.
The House General outside announced, "Celestial Human Clan Leader Huangfu Jinhuan arrives..."
The people engaged in conversation immediately halted and looked towards the entrance.
In came a middle-aged man in gorgeous clothing, confidently stepping with a powerful gait.
His gaze swept through the room, and immediately, he broke into a smile: "Apologies, everyone, for my late arrival."
After the usual courtesies, his gaze landed on Wang Shouzhe.
And Wang Shouzhe’s gaze fell on him.
Their eyes met in a collision.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 52 Academy Direct Disciple! Arriving at Changning Guard
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 52 Academy Direct Disciple! Arriving at Changning Guard
...
After a few moments, Huangfu Jinhuan came forward with a smile: "I assume you must be Clan Leader Wang Shouzhe of the Ping’an Wang Family? As rumored, you are indeed a contemporary outstanding talent."
Wang Shouzhe also smiled broadly and cupped his hands: "Shouzhe pays respects to Elder Huangfu. Your praise is too generous, too generous indeed. Shouzhe is still young and hopes to learn more from you, Elder."
The two Patriarchs supported each other’s hands, smiling and complimenting one another, displaying a sense of meeting too late.
The other families also came up to greet Huangfu Jinhuan, exchanging pleasantries. Everyone wore cheerful smiles, and the atmosphere was so harmonious.
Before long, the Patriarch of the Celestial Human Lei Family also arrived at the venue, naturally bringing another round of cordial greetings.
With the two major Celestial Human Families residing in the same city and without any marital alliances between them, if someone were to claim their relationship was truly harmonious, no one would believe it.
But such was the Black Tortoise Clan; unless a situation reached a breaking point, they would maintain a surface harmony in formal occasions.
Thus, two Seventh-Grade Celestial Human Families and eight Eighth-Grade Noble Families had already gathered together. This was quite rare in the history of the Changning Guard.
After waiting for a moment.
Another House General announced outside, "Lord City Guard has arrived."
As soon as the words fell, all the clan leaders halted their conversations, eyes serious with respect, turned toward the main entrance.
Outside the vermilion-painted gate, a middle-aged man in black armor was stepping over the threshold, accompanied by several Deputy Generals, striding towards them.
He had a typical military face, features upright, with a few short sideburns, walking with a straight back, steady steps, exuding a demeanor like that of a tiger coming down the mountain or a fierce beast exiting its cage, carrying an air of lethality throughout.
It was the fierce prestige only possessed by a battle-hardened general, which, even without intentionally exuding his aura, made people feel a sense of awe.
With his entrance, the entire main hall fell silent.
This was one of the three Celestial Humans of the Changning Guard—Xiahou Hongde.
He did not originate from any local powerful family, but was born into a Military Family, belonging to the Daqian Military System, following a development route completely different from local powerhouses like Wang Shouzhe.
As his eyes scanned the crowd, all the clan leaders slightly lowered their heads, their eyes showing a hint of awe.
Not only was he a strong Celestial Human Realm cultivator, but he also represented the national prestige of the Daqian Kingdom, guarding the entire Changning Guard.
In name, this person was the foremost individual in the Changning Guard.
However, unlike local powerful families, to avoid the guardian treating one place as their fiefdom, developing and managing it too autonomously, over time forming an unwieldy force, Lords from the Military System had a fixed tenure.
In towns like this Guardian City, the tenure is usually twenty to thirty years per term.
Xiahou Hongde, having served for over a decade, handled affairs justly, and being of upright character, had accumulated considerable prestige in the Changning Guard, earning genuine respect from the clan leaders.
Leaving aside trivial talk for the time being.
After exerting his aura, Xiahou Hongde then put on a hearty smile, warmly and kindly greeting each clan leader.
When it was Wang Shouzhe’s turn, his eyes paused, seeming somewhat unusual, and his smile was a bit more cordial than to the others: "Clan Leader Shouzhe, you’ve developed Ping’an Town extremely rapidly over these years; many common people wish to migrate there. If there is a chance, I shall definitely visit Ping’an Town to learn, and please do not hesitate to share your governance experience, Clan Leader Shouzhe."
"Lord City Guard overpraises." Wang Shouzhe replied respectfully with a smile, "It would be our fortune to have you visit Ping’an Town, and we would certainly welcome your guidance, which will surely elevate Ping’an Town to new heights."
The two continued with a few more polite exchanges, but Wang Shouzhe could sense that Xiahou Hongde had an implicit intention to draw him closer.
Apparently, this rarely appearing Lord City Guard was perceptive and had his own sources of intelligence. What happened in the Academy had likely reached his ears to some extent.
Then, Lord City Guard turned to other families, offering his warmth and showcasing his diplomatic charm.
...
Almost simultaneously.
Hundred Islands Harbor.
This harbor’s history is nearly as long as that of the Hundred Islands Guard itself. At the entrance of the pier, some places on the archway’s red paint have peeled off, the inscriptions on the plaque have started to fade, and the bluestone bricks on the port pier even show weathered marks.
However, to this day, it remains as bustling as ever.
Streams of people and carriages continue to pass beneath the archway, filling the port with the sounds of merchants haggling, buyers negotiating, and dockworkers shouting as they load ships, bustling and vibrant.
Tall sea vessels moored in the deep-water port, laden with cargo after cargo, and returning bounty from ocean forays. Occasionally, stinking fish and shrimp are picked out from the ships, tossed back into the sea.
Under the scorching sun and in the moist sea breeze, the entire pier was permeated with a salty, fishy aroma.
This was the scent of the sea.
In the southeastern corner of the dock, a large sea vessel was quietly moored at the deep-water port, flying a prominent flag at the mast, boldly marked with a waterproof-painted emblem.
Anyone knowledgeable would immediately recognize it as a large merchant ship belonging to the East Port Chen Family.
Wang Zongchang, a promising talent among the younger generation of the Wang Family, was directing two Household Generals and over ten household servants, loading the ship with precious herbs they had procured, along with some Spirit Treasure pearls from the sea, among other things.

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 52: Academy Direct Disciple! Arriving at Changning Guard_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 52: Academy Direct Disciple! Arriving at Changning Guard_2
"Brother Wang Hu, be careful with that big box." Wang Zongchang reminded a household general who was moving a box onto the ship, "Those are all sea snacks and small fish, put them in my cabin later. I’m worried the mice on the ship might steal them."
Traveling to the Hundred Islands Guard this time, he naturally paid for some snacks out of his own pocket to bring back and share with his younger siblings and some elder relatives. The rest he planned to send to the Purple Mansion Academy to satisfy his sister Wang Lici’s cravings.
Although his sister Wang Lici was a foodie, she still had the demeanor of a big sister and treated her younger siblings very well.
"Second young master, rest assured." The twenty-five or twenty-six-year-old household general Wang Hu laughed, "I’ve packed everything tightly as you instructed, so they won’t get damp or be stolen. I will also keep an eye on Little Leopard to prevent him from sneaking a bite."
This Wang Residence was the son of the old household general Wang Zhong. He had been nurtured by the family since childhood, started working for the family at sixteen, and after nine years of service, he is now a direct lineage household general of the Wang Family, with a considerable status in the family hierarchy.
As resources within the family gradually increased, his father Wang Zhong also received supplements, allowing him to reach the sixth layer of the Qi Refining Realm at a young age, significantly surpassing his father’s achievements back in the day.
He is even more formidable than the talented direct lineage of the Liu Family, Liu Yongzhou, at that time.
"Brother." The sixteen or seventeen-year-old Wang Bao, who had just joined the household generals, said with a dark face, "The second young master has already given me quite a bit. Why would I sneak a bite?"
This young man was very spirited and was the second son of the household general Wang Zhong. With his talent reaching Lower Grade C from a young age, he happened to catch the family hierarchy path, receiving the best cultivation resources. He is now already at the fifth layer of the Qi Refining Realm, surpassing his father’s achievements at thirty-five, with unlimited future potential.
The Wang Family is wealthy now and spares no effort in cultivating these direct lineage household generals.
As the Wang Family members loaded and boarded their ship.
A shabby carriage arrived at the dock, and several people dressed as traveling merchants got out.
They seemed to be seasoned traveling merchants, carrying quite a bit of cargo and needing to hire dock laborers to help load it onto the ship.
One of the young traveling merchants appeared somewhat nervous, his gaze slightly shifty.
