The bald traveling merchant beside him patted his shoulder and whispered, "Little Zheng, stay calm. With the elder injured this time, such an important escort mission fell to us. But this is a lucrative task, and if we succeed, the young master will surely reward us handsomely."
"Brother Li," the young traveling merchant whispered, "I heard that the item can..."
The bald man’s expression tightened upon hearing this, and he whispered a rebuke, "Speak cautiously! There are many ears here, and this matter is of great importance, with no room for any errors."
Then, he whispered reassuringly, "Don’t worry, there won’t be any issues this time. Someone will meet us as soon as we reach East Port."
He exuded great confidence.
He had traversed this trade route many times, smoothing out all aspects of it.
As they spoke, their cargo had been entirely loaded onto the ship.
Wang Zongchang noticed this group of traveling merchants but did not pay much attention to them.
The East Port Chen Family’s merchant ships indeed provided a service for traveling merchants and charged handsomely for it. Such traveling merchant teams were common at the docks, like fish swimming up the river, one group after another.
In less than half a day, the seafaring merchant ship was fully loaded with goods and set sail for East Port.
...
Meanwhile.
At the main gate of the East Gate of Changning Guard.
The City Guard had cleared the area early. At this moment, aside from soldiers holding long knives and a group of noble family heads, no idle persons were present at the East Gate.
The continuous heavy rain had accumulated quite a bit of water in the low-lying areas outside the city. A single careless step could splash yellow muddy water everywhere.
Fortunately, the noble family heads present all had Profound Qi protecting them; otherwise, they would have ended up with muddy feet, losing all semblance of decorum.
Nevertheless, the attention of those noble family heads was not on such minor issues.
They were currently gathered around the City Guard Xiahou Hongde, eagerly gazing into the distance, seemingly awaiting someone.
The new Clan Leader of the Shanyang Gongsun Family, Gongsun Yan, grew up hearing tales of Wang Shouzhe’s exploits and was extremely close to him.
He was slightly nervous and stayed glued to Wang Shouzhe, unable to resist asking curiously, "Cousin Shouzhe, I’ve heard that direct disciples at the academy are all Celestial Human Realm cultivators, and each of them is very young with great potential, far beyond what our local families can compare."
"Not all of them are Celestial Human Realm cultivators, but the potential and future prospects of direct disciples are indeed very great," Wang Shouzhe explained. "However, they walk a different path from ours. The more they receive, the more they must give in the future."
He had not spent his time in the academy in vain over the past few days.
He naturally knew that academy disciples, especially those who were exceptional, received high-quality training and resources from the academy but also needed to shoulder heavy responsibilities.
After all, the academy did not cultivate disciples to let them go into society to dominate and lord over others.
Just consider, the Binglan Ascendant had three direct disciples, yet only the youngest, Faang You’an, stayed by his side.
Where did the other two go then?

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 52. The Academy’s Direct Disciple! Arrives at Changning Guard_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: 52. The Academy’s Direct Disciple! Arrives at Changning Guard_3
Naturally, they went to undertake their responsibilities and tasks.
Changchun Ascendant has five direct disciples, yet only Senior Sister Lvwei stays by his side. Clearly, they all have their own destinations.
This world is vast, and Changning Guard is merely a small corner. There are many things they still don’t know.
"I see," Gongsun Yan, a steady and intelligent young man, instantly understood. "But even so, I still deeply envy them."
Since childhood, he had an unreliable father, and in such helpless circumstances, he could only mature on his own.
But which teenager doesn’t have the desire to explore the world and satisfy their curiosity?
The world is so big that everyone wants to see it.
However, once one becomes the clan leader, they must shoulder the entire family’s future. The core of future life also becomes the family, and the opportunity to roam freely is no longer available.
This is what Wang Shouzhe meant when he said they’re not walking the same path.
The other patriarchs were whispering quietly, all talking about the disciples of Purple Mansion Academy.
For most eighth-grade and ninth-grade noble families, having a child enter the academy is already a matter of bringing honor to their ancestors. To become a core disciple would change the entire family’s status.
This is why, in recent decades, the rapid development of the Shanyin Liu Family has been so noticeable, to the point where even the City Guard, Lord Xiahou Hongde, is quite courteous to them, showing signs of goodwill at every turn.
When other patriarchs spoke with Liua Gaowang, they always mentioned Ancestor Xuanfu, as if having a core disciple from an academy in Changning Guard made the locals proud.
Amidst the discussions.
The clear call of a crane suddenly came from the sky.
Amidst the crane’s call, a Red-crowned Immortal Crane with black and white feathers and a long neck burst out of the thick clouds, diving towards the ground.
It was a Tier Four flying spiritual bird, the Red-crowned Immortal Crane nurtured by Purple Mansion Academy!
Behind it dragged a flying chariot radiating with spirit light.
The flying chariot had a frame of dark brown spirit wood, draped with spiritual silkworm silk as curtains. The carriage was spacious and elegantly carved, with runes inscribed on its body. It shimmered with the clear light of an array, standing out like a small sun against the dusky sky.
Upon seeing this flying chariot.
Lord City Guard Xiahou Hongde’s expression immediately turned serious. The other patriarchs, who were whispering, also followed suit in becoming serious.
At the same time, their eyes were filled with envy.
Such a spirit beast flying chariot, even regular Celestial Human Families can’t afford to keep it. Only wealthy entities like Purple Mansion Academy can equip their direct disciples with a spirit beast flying chariot for travel.
Wang Shouzhe was somewhat envious too.
Even reaching the Celestial Human Realm, the profound qi is insufficient to support long-distance flight. Having a spirit beast flying chariot would make traveling anywhere extremely convenient.
Unfortunately, this item is too rare, and he cannot afford it for now.
...
Meanwhile.
In the sky, within the immortal crane’s flying chariot, several young men and women were seated.
The leading young man wore a water-blue arrow-sleeved robe, with handsome features, a gentle temperament, yet possessing an all-encompassing aura that was captivating. Inside the flying chariot, both men and women were led by him.
This young man was none other than Faang You’an, the direct disciple under Binglan Ascendant of Profound Ice Hall.
Sitting on his left and right were three core disciples, two men and one woman. Though young, they all had extraordinary auras, among them Jii Mingyu was prominently present.
"Brothers," a core disciple riding the spirit beast flying chariot for the first time looked down at the earth through the window strings, unable to suppress the excitement in his heart, "So this is Changning Guard? From this angle, it truly looks grand and majestic."
"Senior Brother Yang De," Jii Mingyu said, "You’ve said this countless times since we came, but later, maintain your composure to avoid losing face in front of the local influential families of Changning Guard."
"Junior Brother Mingyu, I’m not like you, born a noble, knowledgeable from a young age," Senior Brother Yang De chuckled, "This is the first time I’ve basked in Senior Brother Yoou’an’s glory and enjoyed the benefits of a spirit beast flying chariot. Don’t worry, I won’t lose the academy’s prestige; I’ll show the calm and steady demeanor fitting of a core disciple."
"Changning Guard, Changning Guard. Why does that name sound so familiar?" a core female disciple furrowed her brows slightly, "Where have I heard it before? Senior Brother Yoou’an, is this your hometown?"
Faang You’an smiled wryly and said, "Discussions about family matters are forbidden in the academy, but Junior Sister Longyan has special circumstances."
"So it’s Senior Sister Longyan’s hometown," Jii Mingyu said, slightly excitedly, "Doesn’t that mean we can meet Wang Shouzhe?"
Everyone looked at him with peculiar eyes.
Weren’t you just beaten by Wang Shouzhe recently?
Why are you so excited when mentioning him?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 53: Picking Up a Bargain! The Wang Family’s Future Development Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 53: Picking Up a Bargain! The Wang Family’s Future Development Plan
...
As they spoke, the flying chariot gradually descended outside the East City Gate of Changning Guard.
"Caw~"
The red-crowned immortal crane elegantly landed on the yellow mud ground, raising its head to let out a soft cry.
The previously chatty carriage instantly fell silent, and even Jii Mingyu among the three core disciples subconsciously tidied up their attire, presenting their best demeanor.
"Let’s go~"
Faang You’an led the group off the carriage.
The cloudy weather made the light outside the city not very good, but as soon as the four appeared, they still gave people a refreshing feeling.
In terms of appearance and temperament, all four were extraordinary individuals, dragons among men, especially with their vigorous demeanor and spirited expression, making it easy for people to feel good about them.
Without a doubt, each one of them was a celestial prodigy.
Especially Faang You’an, who stood out with his exceptional air and unparalleled temperament, giving the impression of being like a crane among chickens, even compared to the City Guard Lord, who was also in the Celestial Human Realm.
The heads of several noble families present could not help but feel a touch of admiration and envy, spontaneously wishing that their family could also produce such a celestial prodigy.
Even Huangfu Jinhuan, the head of the Celestial Human Huangfu Family, and the head of the Celestial Human Lei Family, were no exceptions.
Could it actually be them?
In the crowd, Wang Shouzhe raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised.
He had also wondered who the direct disciples from the Academy would be this time, but he had not expected it to be Faang You’an and his group.
Nevertheless, upon reflection, it seemed reasonable.
There weren’t many idle direct disciples at the Purple Mansion Academy, and it was only reasonable for Faang You’an to bring some junior brothers and sisters for such a major mission.
Just as he was pondering,
Lord City Guard Xiahou Hongde had already approached with a full smile, bowing to greet them, "Are you all the celestial prodigies of the Purple Mansion Academy? I am Xiahou Hongde, City Guard of Changning City Guardian’s Mansion. I have met the Academy’s celestial prodigies. Forgive me for not giving you a proper welcome."
Saying that he also pulled out his identity token for the other party to inspect.
Faang You’an also followed the procedure, sweeping his spiritual sense over the identity token. After confirming the identity, he politely cupped his hands in return, saying, "Lord City Guard is too kind. I am Faang You’an from the Profound Ice Hall of the Purple Mansion Academy, here with several junior brothers and sisters under orders to assist the lords in managing disaster relief in the Changning Guard area."
While speaking, he also took out his token and the appointment letter jointly issued by the Purple Mansion Academy and the Governor’s Mansion.
Xiahou Hongde dared not be negligent and followed protocol, carefully inspecting the token and appointment letter.
After confirming there were no issues, he respectfully bowed and said, "This official pays respects to the Inspector General and all Inspectors."
Regarding both the appointed position and the identity as a direct disciple of the Academy, he couldn’t afford to be careless.
Not to mention that Inspector General Faang You’an had profound cultivation at such a young age; behind him was the one from the Profound Ice Hall—among the Purple Mansion Ascendants at the Academy, that person was definitely not someone to be trifled with.
Moreover, he had heard that disciples from the Profound Ice Hall at the Purple Mansion Academy had exceptionally strong individual combat abilities, and every core disciple was an extraordinary combat champion, not to mention a Celestial Human Realm direct disciple. How could he dare to look down on them?
"Lord City Guard, you’re too kind. Please, call me You’an; you are a senior." Faang You’an, with his gentlemanly demeanor, was one of the rare good-tempered individuals in the Profound Ice Hall.
"I wouldn’t dare, Inspector General You’an." After a brief exchange of pleasantries, Xiahou Hongde said, "Let me first introduce you, Inspector General, to the clan leaders of Changning Guard."
No sooner had he finished speaking.
The two clan leaders of the Celestial Human Lei Family and the Celestial Human Huangfu Family, who had been waiting for quite some time, immediately approached with full smiles, followed by the other clan leaders.
The arrival of a figure at the level of a direct disciple from the Purple Mansion Academy at Changning Guard was a rare event, and if they were fortunate enough to strike up a rapport, forming a friendly relationship would only benefit their family.
As for Wang Shouzhe, he acted a step slower, falling to the end.
His marriage allies were not particularly enthusiastic either. After all, they had been exposed to much more alongside Wang Shouzhe recently.
Although a direct disciple of the Academy had a prestigious status, they were not easily fawned upon; holding onto Shouzhe’s backing was more practical.
"Inspector General You’an, all Inspectors. These two are Lei Qiwei, the clan leader of the Celestial Human Lei Family, and Huangfu Jinhuan, the clan leader of the Celestial Human Huangfu Family."
Following the protocol, Xiahou Hongde first introduced the two Celestial Human families.
Lei Qiwei and Huangfu Jinhuan immediately smiled warmly as they cupped their hands, saying, "Greetings to the Inspector General and all Inspectors."
Faang You’an was not a person who ignored earthly matters. He understood that to get things done locally, one must rely on the local powerful figures, and hence did not condescend to them.
Just as he was about to return the salute and introduce his junior brothers and sisters,
suddenly,
Senior Brother Yang De exclaimed, "Isn’t that Junior Brother Shouzhe?"
Junior Brother Shouzhe?
These words immediately drew everyone’s attention.
Faang You’an also noticed Wang Shouzhe at the back of the crowd.
He was slightly stunned, somewhat delighted, and immediately cupped his hands apologetically toward Lei Qiwei and Huangfu Jinhuan, saying, "Pardon me, you two. I’ve run into an acquaintance and will go greet them first."

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 53: Picking Up Leaks! Wang Family’s Future Development Plan_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 53: Picking Up Leaks! Wang Family’s Future Development Plan_2
Under the leadership of Faang You’an, a group of disciples from the Profound Ice Hall approached Wang Shouzhe with smiles. The members of the Changning Guard stepped aside as they passed.
Before Faang You’an could speak, Wang Shouzhe greeted him courteously first: "Shouzhe greets Senior Brother Yoou’an, and greets all the senior brothers and this senior sister."
Faang You’an returned the greeting warmly: "Junior Brother Shouzhe, it’s been over two months since our hurried farewell at the Academy. I didn’t expect we would meet under such circumstances."
Jii Mingyu, Li Yangde, and another core female disciple, Qian Cailing, also hurriedly returned the greeting, all calling him "Junior Brother Shouzhe."
They all knew Wang Shouzhe was the named direct disciple of the Changchun Ascendant.
Although carrying the term "named," they all understood it was a result of circumstances, and the Changchun Ascendant could take Wang Shouzhe as a direct disciple whenever he desired.
Moreover, they felt it was only natural. This Junior Brother Shouzhe was not even thirty yet, and he had already defeated Jii Mingyu; even if he wanted to join the Profound Ice Hall, their master, the Binglan Ascendant, would likely accept him as a direct disciple.
This is the ethos of the Academy, not concerning one’s background or origin. If your skills are lacking, even if born into a Purple Mansion Family, some core disciples and direct disciples wouldn’t take you seriously.
However, individuals like Wang Shouzhe, who have earned their status purely through their own abilities, even Jii Mingyu respected him greatly, and dared not challenge him again.
After some brief pleasantries, Wang Shouzhe learned their names and greeted them: "Brother Yangde, Senior Sister Cailing. Once this matter is settled, don’t hurry off, allow Shouzhe the chance to host you properly."
Seeing their familiarity, the expressions of various Eighth-Grade Noble Families became somewhat subtle. Marriage allies naturally wore pleased expressions, while others appeared slightly complex.
The Clan Leaders of two Celestial Human Families, Lei Qiwei and Huangfu Jinhuan, showed obvious embarrassment.
They were at the forefront, aiming to gain favor with the Academy’s direct and core disciples but didn’t expect them to be so familiar and closely connected with Wang Shouzhe.
Even Lord City Guard Xiahou Hongde paused for a moment before stepping forward, laughing, "Who would have thought Clan Leader Shouzhe is so acquainted with the esteemed figures here, truly enviable. However, this is not the place for conversation; I have already prepared a banquet at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion, ready to welcome the esteemed figures."
Clearly, he had also noticed the awkwardness among other families and sought to ease it.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe’s status in his mind was raised a few levels. It seemed the information he received from the Academy was not comprehensive; he still underestimated Wang Shouzhe!
Faang You’an and the others, naturally did not refuse Xiahou Hongde’s gesture, and, following orders, entered the city with the group.
Escorted by the City Defense Camp, the group went straight to the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
Of course, the Hundred Flavors Pavilion in the Changning Guard couldn’t compare to the headquarters in Longzuo County.
Upon arriving at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion, they found the shopkeeper Qiaan Xue’an of the Qiaan’s Trading Company Longzuo branch had long been waiting at the door.
He, with his growing belly resembling the Maitreya Buddha, smiled welcomingly to Faang You’an and the core disciples of the Purple Mansion Academy.
Upon seeing Qian Cailing, he bowed deeply and called, "Xue’an greets Aunt Cailing."
"So it’s Xue’an." Qian Cailing sized him up, "Just two or three years and you’re fatter again. I didn’t expect you to be in the Changning Guard."
Qian Cailing had a significant impression of Qiaan Xue’an.
Originally just an unremarkable direct lineage son, yet now rising steadily with commendable achievements for the family, even the family ancestors mentioned his name twice.
What an honor! Even Qian Cailing, a core disciple of the Academy, increasingly remembered Qiaan Xue’an.
Naturally, this was because Qiaan Xue’an was quite adept at networking, seizing opportunities to visit the Academy every two to three years.
Qiaan Xue’an frequently bestowed benefits to Qian Cailing, leaving her with a deep impression.
Though this exchange seemed trivial, the patriarchs of the Changning Guard once again became serious, marking a significant reminder in their hearts.
Among the core disciples of the Academy, this female core disciple named Qian Cailing seemed the least notable; yet she hailed from the Qiaan Family.
In the entire Longzuo County, the Qiaan Family was a famous Fifth-Grade Noble Family with significant prestige, almost unchallenged.
Even Wang Shouzhe cast several glances at Qian Cailing, surprised that Senior Sister Cailing was the aunt of Qiaan Xue’an.
The Purple Mansion Academy indeed was a place teeming with hidden talents.
Or rather, the heritage of the Longzuo Qiaan Family was indeed profound.
Afterward, naturally came a warm reception, with Qiaan Xue’an, a master of ceremony, the atmosphere became much livelier.
After three rounds of drinking.
Faang You’an’s expression turned serious and he addressed the table, "My friends, we have eaten and drank, but the disaster cannot be neglected. I’ve been entrusted by the Governor’s Mansion and the Academy to oversee and manage the disaster, and I’ll need everyone’s help. Lord City Guard, I saw quite a number of refugees gathered near the Changning Guard earlier, has this matter been properly arranged?"
At the mention of serious business, everyone’s faces turned solemn.
Xiahou Hongde spoke gravely, "The floods in the downstream of the Anjiang have been extremely severe, with numerous refugees moving east. As only thirty percent of Changning Guard’s territory was affected, many refugees have gathered here and are reluctant to leave. I’ve ordered the construction of several temporary refugee camps and opened the granary to provide porridge to refugees. However, as the number of refugees keeps growing, our food reserves in Changning Guard’s warehouse are limited, and eventually, we won’t be able to sustain them."
Faang You’an frowned, "Our group of senior brothers arrived first, and a few junior disciples are coming via land, collecting supplies along the way, but distant resources cannot quench present thirst. We need local families to lend their strength."
Upon hearing this, everyone fell into a period of silence.
Westpeace Dang Family Dang Zhenghe smiled bitterly, "Inspector General, our Westpeace Dang Family has been completely flooded, and tenant farmers and civilians from our jurisdiction have fled to Lin Town’s territory. Without assistance, our Family might..."
The other families also showed bitterness, indicating that it wasn’t harvest season, and each family is living off reserves, with each suffering considerable losses.
"Food is not a big issue." Shopkeeper Qiaan Xue’an said, "I can manage to gather some, which should suffice for the short term. But as the refugee numbers grow, will we have to send them elsewhere? From what I know, upstream Dingnan Town and Zhenze Guard are suffering from more severe disaster, countless fields and houses destroyed, especially Zhenze Guard, perpetually submerged with countless casualties. Those remaining tenant farmers and civilians are likely homeless."}
"Hmph!" A trace of killing intent flashed in Faang You’an’s eyes, "Dingnan and Zhenze Guards neglected flood defenses, leading to this calamity. The days of those two city guards might be numbered. For now, these refugees need placement; please kindly make arrangements."
Hearing this, the noble families again silently pondered and calculated.
Wang Shouzhe understood it wasn’t their fault.
After hundreds of years of development, most family territories in Changning Guard were saturated. Increasing tenant farmers and laborers wouldn’t significantly boost the economy but rather increase consumption, becoming a burden.
Yet they couldn’t easily ignore Faang You’an’s request, considering his role as "Inspector General."
Despite his gentlemanly demeanor and amiable appearance, angering him might lead to the destruction of an Eighth-Grade Family as a warning.
After brief deliberation, the family heads expressed their positions: one family would accept one or two thousand refugees, another would take two thousand; despite their utmost efforts, the refugee accommodation was but a drop in the ocean.
Some even suggested diverting refugees to East Sea Guard or other guards.
At this moment, Huangfu Jinhuan stood and said, "Our Huangfu Family is willing to accommodate five thousand refugees."
Lei Qiwei quickly added, "Our Lei Family is also willing to accept five thousand refugees."
With this, Faang You’an’s look of concern eased considerably, at least these local powers weren’t entirely shirking.
"Senior Brother Yoou’an." After deliberation, Wang Shouzhe stood and said, "Our Ping’an Town is willing to accommodate forty thousand refugees."
What?
Forty thousand refugees?!
Everyone was shocked, their gazes fixed on Wang Shouzhe, filled with unbelief.
Wang Shouzhe seemed regretful.
Were it not for an inability to handle all at once, he hoped to accommodate all refugees, as Wang Family’s upcoming development plans demanded numerous populations.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 54 Expansion! The Great Development of Ping’an Town
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 54 Expansion! The Great Development of Ping’an Town
...
Liua Gaowang, the father-in-law of Wang Shouzhe, fiercely winked at him.
Even though you have a good relationship with the people at the Academy, how can we in Ping’an Town possibly handle the influx of forty thousand people?
Chen Dewei from the East Port Chen Family also looked at Wang Shouzhe with some concern. Isn’t the current total population of Ping’an Town only forty thousand?
Faang You’an looked deeply at Wang Shouzhe, his eyes showing a hint of being moved: "Junior Brother Shouzhe, I can see your determination to solve the problem. But these forty thousand people are ultimately too many. We can still consider other solutions."
Faang You’an had come this time with a major task, and as the Inspector General, if this disaster relief inspection is not handled properly, it will also affect his future development. How could he not be moved by Wang Shouzhe’s cooperation?
"Senior Brother Yoou’an, since there is a problem, we must solve it." Wang Shouzhe said earnestly, "Our Wang Family has stored some grain over the past two years. If we purchase some more from other places, we can barely support forty thousand refugees for one or two years. Just at this time, our Ping’an Town needs to dredge the rivers, reinforce the dikes, and there is overall a lack of manpower in the territory."
"Very well. Since Junior Brother Shouzhe is so determined," Faang You’an said, "I will advocate on behalf of Junior Brother to strive for a three-year tax exemption for Ping’an Town. Brother, you can collect the full tax as usual for your own use." If he could make such a proposal, he must have some confidence, and it is a way of reciprocating.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Yoou’an." Wang Shouzhe clasped his hands in gratitude.
"What spirit, what courage," Lei Qiwei from the Lei Family praised, "Since Younger Brother Shouzhe has such spirit, our Celestial Human Lei Family cannot lag behind, and will take an additional five thousand people."
Other families also expressed their willingness to take in more refugees.
Among them, the Shanyang Gongsun Family, the Shanyin Liu Family, and the East Port Chen Family. All received a subtle hint from Wang Shouzhe and finally gritted their teeth to take in an additional ten thousand people collectively.
Under the leadership of Wang Shouzhe, what was initially a very difficult refugee problem was resolved smoothly.
Faang You’an’s mood suddenly improved immensely, and he raised his spirit wine: "In the face of disaster, it’s heartening to see our Changning Guard stand united. On behalf of those refugees, I thank everyone here for stepping up to take responsibility."
With this situation, everyone was naturally delighted.
After this welcoming banquet.
The entire Changning Guard entered emergency disaster relief mode.
And under a decision by Wang Shouzhe, the Ping’an Wang Family went into full operation, embarking on a grand plan.
Clan members, household generals, outstanding branch family members.
All poured into the work at hand.
Expanding temporary refugee camps, redirecting grain supplies, organizing the intake of refugees, registering them, as well as making various subsequent arrangements.
Of course.
Once the refugees settled down a little, the Wang Family would organize them to either build dikes or dredge the waterways.
In Wang Shouzhe’s large planning model of Ping’an Town, the future waterways were interconnected in a network, requiring the excavation or expansion of some new channels.
His plan was to gradually transform the entire Ping’an Town into a granary with countless fertile fields.
As the head of the family, he naturally only needed to manage the major aspects and make overall arrangements.
...
Xingsheng Farm is one of the main foundational farms of the Wang Family.
After continuous development and expansion, compared to ten years ago with less than four thousand acres, Xingsheng Farm now boasts seven thousand acres of fertile land, nearly doubling in size.
Then, by this time, Xingsheng Farm had entered a development bottleneck, making it difficult to scale up quickly.
The reason is simple; it is surrounded by hills and mountains. The terrain suitable for irrigation has already been developed.
What remains are highlands where converting them into farmland makes irrigation a major issue. If water resources were manually transported, the production costs would be so high, not even the Wang Family could bear it.
Issues like this developmental bottleneck have spread throughout Ping’an Town.
After long-term development and Wang Shouzhe’s cultivation incentives,
now throughout the entire Ping’an Town.
The Wang Family owns more than sixty thousand acres of clan fields, comprising thirteen farms of various sizes. The rest of the land owned by commoners totals over one hundred thousand acres.
Altogether, it totals one hundred seventy thousand acres of fertile fields, ranking among the top three in the entire Changning Guard region.
If further development is desired, it can only be achieved by making the less arable terrain suitable for farming.
Ping’an Town is surrounded by mountains, and its internal land also consists mainly of hills of varying elevations. In a total area of roughly four thousand square kilometers, more than seventy to eighty percent comprises hilly and mountainous terrain unsuitable for cultivation.
In the face of so many hilly landscapes in Ping’an Town, the best solution Wang Shouzhe could think of was the terracing model.
Agriculture in this world has also developed for a long time. Developing terraces in such hilly areas is not an original idea by Wang Shouzhe; there are many similar records in the Academy.
Yet in this world, terracing is not mainstream, nor even considered niche.
The reason is simple: the cost of developing each acre of terraced field is several times that of ordinary farmland, the difficulty of farming is also higher, coupled with transport and irrigation challenges.
This results in the production cost per unit acre far exceeding the purchase price of grain.
Given this situation, which Noble Family would develop terraces?
On this day, Wang Shouzhe arrived at Xingsheng Farm.
The current manager of Xingsheng Farm is a female collateral relative named Wang Juan. She has been intelligent from a young age and studied at the Clan Academy in the Wang Family’s Main Residence, and has since continuously developed within Xingsheng Farm.

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - 54 Expansion! The Great Development of Ping’an Town_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 54 Expansion! The Great Development of Ping’an Town_2
With her diligent responsibility and long-term accumulation, her performance became increasingly outstanding. From steward to steward to chief steward, she was considered exemplary among the collateral family members.
"Wang Juan, pay respects to the Patriarch." Wang Juan, accompanied by some stewards from the farm, greeted Wang Shouzhe upon his arrival.
She was now only about twenty-six or seven years old, yet she appeared composed and competent, even Ancestor Xiaohan consistently praised her.
"Rise." Wang Shouzhe waved his hand nonchalantly, "I came here mainly to inspect the development of the terraced fields and technical advancements. Wang Juan, you take me to see them first."
In his original plan, the large-scale development of terraced fields was to be completed within a year or two. However, the recent flood had resulted in a huge number of refugees becoming homeless.
Thus, establishing terraced farms was urgent, otherwise, merely dredging rivers and building dikes wouldn’t require so many people. The Wang Family, no matter how wealthy, couldn’t afford to support too many idle people.
"Yes, Patriarch." Wang Juan didn’t waste words and directly led Wang Shouzhe all the way to the experimental field of the terraced fields.
This large expanse of experimental terraced fields was built on the northern slope of Xingsheng Farm.
The southern-facing northern slope was well-lit by the sun, the slope was small, and the space available for development was substantial.
The northern slope already had stretches of terraced fields built, and it was now the time when wheat was beginning to shape and fill. At a glance, Wang Shouzhe saw a lush green ocean, with layers stacking and intersecting, quite spectacular.
"Report to the Patriarch." As Wang Juan continued with Wang Shouzhe, she reported, "This stretch of experimental terraced fields covers approximately 300 acres and grows our Wang Family’s No. 19 wheat strain. Because it’s easier to control irrigation, we can work more precisely. Therefore, the growth momentum is very good, and the quality of the wheat produced might be better."
"Terraced farming is not easy, mainly reflecting on difficulties in development, irrigation, and transportation." Wang Juan succinctly stated, "First, transportation is difficult because of the varied terrain of the terraces, with high transportation costs, often requiring human labor to carry. According to the Patriarch’s instruction, I built ribbon-shaped cement roads between terraces. So now we can use ox carts, horse carts, or human carts for transportation. While the initial investment is high, it saves long-term transportation labor."
Upon seeing it, Wang Shouzhe noticed a winding concrete road snaking up between the high and low terraced fields, reaching the top of the terraces.
"In addition, the single-track transportation car requested by the Patriarch for experimentation has also been built." Wang Juan said, "At the highest point of the terraces, there’s a winch that can be driven by ox power to pull the single-track transport car to the highest point. Once loaded with grain, the single-track transport car can slide down by itself. The harvesting speed is somewhat faster than the regular farmlands."
While speaking, Wang Juan looked at Wang Shouzhe with eyes full of admiration. Indeed, the Patriarch had ingenious ideas everywhere.
The single-track transportation car was something Wang Shouzhe had craftsmen build over the years for experiments. It was not suitable for flat lands but was instead suitable for areas with elevation differences. On Earth, some mountain orchards use this.
The only problem is that it requires a huge amount of iron. Even just building the single track is extremely iron-consuming.
As a result.
Over the years, Ping’an Town has been purchasing large amounts of rough iron externally, even at a premium.
The demand for rough iron in Ping’an Town is significant; iron is needed everywhere.
"What about irrigation?" Wang Shouzhe inquired.
"We’ve planted a large number of water retaining trees at higher altitudes to maintain a certain water volume. Additionally, we have excavated and repaired a reservoir using cement. The reservoir can effectively irrigate the entire terraced field, with excess water flowing into channels and then into the river." Wang Juan stated, "I also want to seek the Patriarch’s permission to build a large reservoir at the top of the cliff in Falling Eagle Gorge, utilizing the natural concave sky trough, and construct an aerial canal to connect all the reservoirs of the terraced fields. Once it’s the dry season with water shortages, we can use the Water Dragon Array built beneath Falling Eagle Gorge to pump water to the top."
This plan?
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback. Isn’t this a bit grandiose? This girl’s imagination seems bigger than mine.
However, this girl’s mind has always been good, she’s very diligent, with a deep cultural foundation.
He had experienced this when she helped Wang Lici with her studies.
Clearly, she had put a lot of effort into her studies at the clan academy when she was young.
And it was this time that brought her into Wang Shouzhe’s scope of notice.
"Patriarch." Wang Juan said, "I have surveyed a large amount of terrain and drawn preliminary blueprints. Though the initial investment is considerable, once successful, the surrounding slopes and hills of Xingsheng Farm could all be transformed into terraces, solving the irrigation problem during the dry season."
That last sentence convinced Wang Shouzhe: "Just organize a detailed plan and the preliminary budget then come back to me."
"Yes, Patriarch." Wang Juan’s eyes were bright, appearing very excited. She felt very fortunate to have encountered a Patriarch who could fully bring out her abilities.
"Also organize a plan for the large-scale development of terraced fields." Wang Shouzhe instructed.
The biggest problem with terraced fields is the cost issue if ordinary grains are planted, it could lead to the bankruptcy of the Wang Family. However, if the Wang Family’s No. 19 wheat strain is planted, it’s still profitable in the long run.
"Yes, Patriarch."
...
Nighttime, East Sea Entrance.
A large ocean-going cargo ship, after braving the winds and waves, arrived at the calmer waters of the entrance.
In the cabin.
Wang Zongchang had just finished organizing the last bit of the account book and, after a thorough check, found no problem. He stretched lazily, feeling somewhat relaxed.
They were about to arrive at East Port, and he had completed the majority of this task. Rising, he left the cabin and went to the bow to get some fresh air.
The moonlight was bright today, and the sky was filled with stars.
Suddenly, a voice of anger came from the cabin: "Little Zheng, are you crazy? How dare you touch this thing."
"Get lost, anyone who blocks me dies!" An incredibly violent voice roared.
"Clang, clang, clang."
A series of sounds of swords clashing echoed.
"How dare you! Aren’t you afraid of the Young Master... ah~" A scream rang out.
"I want power, I want revenge. Boss, I’m sorry!"
"I told you, anyone who blocks me dies." The voice roared relentlessly.
A few workers from the Chen Family instinctively rushed over.
"Bang, bang, bang!"
As soon as they reached the cabin door, they were flung back onto the deck, their throats slashed, and their lives ended.
A blood-covered youth rushed out from the cabin, holding a steel saber with a ferocious face, his eyes full of brutality and crimson.
Without hesitation, he rushed towards the ship’s side, preparing to jump into the sea.
"Father, Sister! I have gained power!" The youth’s eyes flickered with red light, shouting as if somewhat deliriously, "Wait, wait! I will surely avenge you."
At this point, they were close enough to the port that if he escaped into the sea, the vast world would be at his disposal.
Suddenly!
A white sword aura cut through the night, slashing towards the youth.
Though the youth’s state was unusual, his reaction was swift, and he swung his saber to deflect.
"Clang!"
A heavy sound of metal echoed.
The youth seemed to crash into an invisible wall, retreating four or five steps. His crimson eyes looked at the opponent with some fear, roaring: "Who are you? How dare you block my way."
A heroic young man in Black Tortoise Martial Attire, holding a wide-blade battle sword, calmly replied: "You scoundrel, you dare to think of running after killing someone? Surrender and come with me to East Port to face justice."
This heroic young man, naturally none other than Wang Zongchang who had come to the bow for some fresh air, found himself stumbling upon this scene.
As an ally of the East Port Chen Family, he naturally wouldn’t stand by idly.
"Anyone who blocks me will die!" The red-eyed youth roared madly, charging at Wang Zongchang with violent intent.
"You still dare to fight?" Wang Zongchang spun his wrist, and a flashing sword aura flew towards him, powerful and direct with the formidable Wang Family’s Profound Origin Swordsmanship.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - 55: Calm and Outstanding! Young Talents of the Wang Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 55: Calm and Outstanding! Young Talents of the Wang Family
...
The Willow Catkin Body Technique and the Profound Yuan Swordsmanship of the Wang Family have both reached the Middle Grade level. Compared to the inheritance of ordinary families, they are considerably more superior, and the more one cultivates, the more remarkable the power they display.
However, body technique profound skills require long-term, relentless honing, and there are not many shortcuts to take. Even some simple profound skills, under years of constant honing, can unleash impressive power.
Since Wang Shouzhe took on the role of Patriarch, the cultivation conditions of the Ping’an Wang Family have continuously improved. As long as you are willing, everyone can become a Spirit Platform Seed and enjoy the corresponding resources.
Yet, accompanying this came a very rigorous examination system and a contribution point system.
Cultivation progress, basic body techniques, sword skills, string control, riding skill, and even cultural courses are all included in the assessment. Once the total score of the assessment falls below the critical point, a warning is issued. If one fails to meet the standards after the warning, they will be deprived of cultivation resources.
Therefore, the younger generation of the Wang Family trains extremely diligently. They are no less dedicated than Wang Shouzhe was when he was a Spirit Platform Seed.
Compared to his brother Wang Zongwei, Wang Zongchang was more sensible from a young age and could calmly continue to hone himself. Over time, his foundation became extremely solid.
The Willow Catkin Body Technique is elegant and natural, agile like a butterfly when dodging and flashing, with faint afterimages appearing under the hazy moonlight.
His Wang Family’s Profound Origin Swordmanship has been honed to a mellowness like jade. Each move seems simple but has the weight and simplicity of finely tempered steel.
Therefore, Wang Zongchang particularly favors the wide and heavy Battle Sword. Although his Battle Sword is not a Spiritual Artifact, it is a rare Hundred-refined Steel Sword weighing over twenty pounds.
"Clang clang clang!"
That young man, for some reason, possessed exceptionally powerful internal energy. Yet, even so, he could not withstand Wang Zongchang’s continuous and increasingly forceful sword techniques.
He was forced to retreat continuously, with his whole body in turmoil.
How is it possible!
The youth’s eyes were filled with a more frenzied look. He had already fused with that thing and could clearly feel the continuous terrifying power.
How could he possibly be utterly suppressed by a young man who appeared out of nowhere?
"Go to hell!" the crimson-eyed young man roared angrily, swinging his blade, sending a wave of sinister and gloomy sword qi rushing towards Wang Zongchang.
The surrounding air instantly became cold and terrifying.
"Yin Sha Evil Qi!?" Wang Zongchang’s complexion changed dramatically, and he hurriedly retreated, narrowly avoiding the strike.
He felt both shocked and furious, never expecting to encounter a practitioner of the Yin Sha Evil Dao. The Wang Family had historic grievances with Yin Sha; Ancestor Longyan was critically injured by Yin Sha Power, in agony for fifty years.
Fortunately, Wang Zongchang was not a novice. Since he was thirteen, he undertook family tasks, earning considerable Merit Points and receiving ample experience.
During the annual autumn and winter hunts, although his performance couldn’t match that of his two aunts and sister, he did his best to fight with ferocious beasts within his ability scope.
After a brief panic, he calmed down. No longer risking a head-on clash with the young man, he adopted defensive tactics to avoid being poisoned by Yin Sha.
This was an East Port Chen Family merchant ship. As long as he could hold him off for a bit, help would soon arrive.
Immediately, he floated like willow catkins in the wind, continuously entangling with the young man, blocking his escape route to the sea.
"You!!" The young man’s eyes were entirely crimson, extremely irritable, and no longer hid the Yin Sha Power, but no matter how hard he tried, Wang Zongchang fended him off each time.
Could neither kill nor escape!
Without a doubt, Wang Zongchang’s strategy was very prudent.
Shortly after, support from the Chen Family arrived. The person who came was the responsible person for this merchant ship—Chen Fanghua!
Chen Fanghua was an exceptional member of the Chen Family’s direct line. His strength was not weak. After the Chen Family entered a period of significant development, it also generously supported and cultivated talented clan members.
At just over thirty years old, Chen Fanghua’s cultivation had reached the peak of the Qi Refining Realm’s Seventh Layer, already a modestly skilled warrior.
He joined the battle, holding a spear, his face filled with anger: "You treacherous dog, how dare you cause chaos on my Chen Family’s merchant ship."
"Be careful, Uncle Fanghua," Wang Zongchang warned, "He is a practitioner of the Yin Sha Evil Dao, and there is something odd about him. Avoid direct confrontation; entanglement is priority."
Yin Sha Evil Dao?
Chen Fanghua’s expression changed dramatically, immediately becoming more vigilant, joining forces with Wang Zongchang to engage the young man.
As a result, the crimson-eyed manic young man vomited blood incessantly. Either one of these two was stronger than him. Now, they joined forces and entangled him!!!
What a blatant bullying.
But he had no means, as the initiative was not in his hands.
Soon after, several Chen Family Household Generals appeared, while Wang Hu and Wang Bao also rushed over after hearing the commotion.
"All Household Generals, guard the ship’s sides." Wang Zongchang ordered while engaging the youth, "Bring out the nets on the ship, today we will capture a live Yin Sha practitioner."
He felt delighted because if he could bring a live Yin Sha practitioner back, he would surely receive praise and accolades from his fourth uncle; it was like Merit Points falling from the sky.
"This person is already a trapped beast. Do not give him any chance to escape. Also, ensure no one gets hurt, as treating Yin Sha poison is extremely challenging."
Under Wang Zongchang’s strategic command, the young man was continually drained, while none of their own were injured.
This also credited Wang Shouzhe’s effective teachings. Under his example and guidance, the younger family members were very conservative and would use the most prudent strategies when possible.
"It’s almost time, get ready to close the net."
After a stick of incense, the crimson youth was almost worn out.
Yet at that moment, Wang Zongchang still didn’t want to take any risks. He suddenly pulled out a handful of emerald green seeds from his bosom.
These seeds looked very peculiar, each as large as a walnut, with a faint green glow moving subtly on their surface.
Wang Zongchang’s expression was a bit distressed, but to be cautious, capturing the Yin Sha Evil Dao safely was paramount. He still crushed the wax coating on those seeds and tossed them out.
Bam! Bam!
The seeds bounced twice on the deck, and as their wax coating shattered, it was as if they were suddenly activated. A green-blue glow burst forth, and the walnut-sized seeds began sprouting and rooting rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Their roots, like sharp claws, pierced into the deck. Long, tender green vines grew wildly like the witch’s long hair, getting thicker and quickly turning a dark brown color.
They seemed to have intelligence, entwining towards the crimson youth.
"So many Witch No. 5? The Second Young Master sure has a lot of Merit Points."
Wang Hu and Wang Bao, the two household generals, were full of envy. In the family resource exchange list, Witch No. 5 was a popular combat tool. Each Witch No. 5 seed was personally cultivated and planted by the Patriarch.
It requires no wood element bloodline or profound qi, nor does it need nurturing.
Simply crushing the wax coating will quickly activate the stored energy inside, automatically catalyzing into clusters of entangling vines. Once entangled, even a Late Stage Qi Refining Realm expert would struggle to break free.
Having a few as spares was indeed an excellent life-saving trump card.
The only drawback was the high Merit Points cost - ten points were needed to exchange for one.
This wasn’t Wang Shouzhe gouging the clan members. In truth, cultivating and producing this pre-stored profound qi Witch No. 5 vine seed was quite labor-intensive for him as well.
Being in the exchange list also provided clan members and household generals more life-saving cards.
The higher exchange price would make them use it cautiously rather than treating it as a routine combat plaything.
No matter how energetic Wang Shouzhe was, he couldn’t withstand such consumption.
On the battlefield.
Seven to eight Witch No. 5 vines had already entangled the crimson youth. At the same time, several household generals ready with nets began to cast them.
Five to six nets flew out, ultimately wrapping the crimson youth like a dumpling.
The crimson youth’s eyes were completely scarlet, and he roared beast-like, appearing mad. However hard he struggled, he couldn’t escape the entanglement of Witch No. 5 and the nets.
Still, Wang Zongchang was very cautious. As he approached warily, his sword flashed and severed the tendons in the youth’s hands and feet.
This wasn’t cruelty from Wang Zongchang.
Rather, it’s caution against a Yin Sha Evil Dao criminal who’s already killed several people.
But right at that moment.
An abrupt mutation occurred.
The crimson youth’s entire body twitched and twisted, his heart thumping wildly as if about to burst open.
"Not good!"
Wang Zongchang sensed something amiss and quickly retreated.
Suddenly!
"Bang!"
The youth’s chest exploded, shattering the nets and vines simultaneously.
A blood-colored worm, only the size of a pinky, shot like lightning towards Wang Zongchang. He hastily wielded his sword to block, but it missed.
The blood-colored worm, like a sharp arrow, pierced into his body, burrowing alive into his spine.
"Ah!"
Wang Zongchang screamed in agony, but he still remained rational, roaring instantly, "Quick, bind me up."
He had personally witnessed the madness and brutality of that crimson youth.
Perhaps, it was all the fault of that blood-colored worm.
"Quick, quick!" He felt his blood boiling and a terrifying uncontrollable power surging up.
Chen Fanghua and the household generals immediately lunged forward and, taking advantage of Wang Zongchang’s rationality, tied him up securely with layers upon layers of rope.
"Quick, speed up bringing the ship to port." Chen Fanghua, a seasoned veteran, immediately commanded, "Raise the distress flag, letting the clansmen at the port promptly notify Ancestor Ruhong for rescue."
After all, Wang Zongchang was part of the young generation of the Wang Family, a child heavily nurtured and valued by Clan Leader Wang. If something happened on their Chen Family’s boat, what would become of them?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 56: Wedding Robe Blood Gu! Blessings and Misfortunes Intertwined
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 56: Wedding Robe Blood Gu! Blessings and Misfortunes Intertwined
...
Ping’an Town, Zhuwei Lake.
In the vast expanse of water spanning tens of thousands of acres, the water is pure and misty.
From time to time, a large fish would leap out of the water, creating ripples upon ripples.
Suddenly.
In the distance, a "vessel" rapidly sped across the water, leaving two long trails behind. The fish were startled, scattering wildly as if in a chaotic dance.
Upon closer inspection, it was no vessel at all, but rather a gigantic turtle. It was the Guardian Spirit Beast of the Wang Family—the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle.
It extended its long, gigantic turtle~~~head, its four paws paddling like oars, moving at an extremely fast speed.
On its thick turtle shell, a boy and a girl were seated.
The girl appeared to be around eight or nine years old, with delicate and lively eyes, resembling a Little Princess.
The boy, about four or five years old, sat obediently on the turtle, holding a large backpack, his youthful eyes filled with worry.
He hesitated for a moment, then said, "Sister, you’ve upset the teacher again today. The teacher said Father must personally take you to the Upper Clan Academy, or he won’t teach you anymore. What should we do?"
"Don’t worry, Brother, I have already made arrangements," the girl said confidently, "Before dismissal, I gave the teacher’s treasured great-grandson a good beating. That little brat will go back and talk some sense into the teacher."
The boy broke into a cold sweat, was this your arrangement, Sister?
He weakly said, "Sister, if you keep fighting with the teacher like this, I’m worried he’ll go crying to Father sooner or later."
"Let him cry then, we’ll see if his precious great-grandson can handle a beating," the girl said nonchalantly, "The clan academy has reformed now. Who told that old teacher to still cling to outdated male-favored ideas? He’s only so tyrannical because he taught Father back in the day. Anyway, as long as he doesn’t change his mindset, I’ll fight him to the end."
The boy looked helpless, Sister, your feud with the teacher is dragging me down, and now even my homework is double the usual amount. Life is getting too hard.
He really wanted to tell his sister, vengeance only leads to more vengeance, can’t you just bow your head to the teacher and make peace?
This boy and girl are naturally the children of Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan, Wang Liyao and Wang Zong’an.
"An’an, what are you afraid of?" Wang Liyao crossed her arms, "As long as you have justice in your heart, resolutely refuse to bow to evil forces. As a boy and the Young Clan Leader of our family, you can’t be too soft."
Wang Zong’an muttered to himself, being soft is wrong. But it’s also not right to solve problems with violence like you do, Sister.
The siblings talked as the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle transported them to the dock behind the Wang Family’s ancestral residence. Wang Liyao patted its head affectionately, and said, "Thank you, Spirit Turtle, I’ll bring you some treats tomorrow morning."
The Primordial Water Spirit Turtle was also very affectionate toward Wang Liyao, rubbing against her before reluctantly leaving.
It’s no wonder, Wang Liyao’s Primordial Water Bloodline was very thick, though not reaching the level of a Primordial Water Spirit Body, it was still very rare. The person and the turtle felt very close to each other.
"Yaoyao, An’an." Qiao’Er approached, picking up their backpacks, her expression slightly grave, "Miss asked me to bring you back."
"Ah?"
Mother didn’t come to pick them up this time.
Wang Liyao asked worriedly, "Aunt Qiao, has something happened?"
Qiao’Er led them back as she said, "Young Master Zongchang had a bit of trouble, the Patriarch and Miss are helping to heal him."
Second Brother is in trouble?
Wang Liyao and Wang Zong’an became worried immediately.
Brother Chang had always been very good to them since they were young. They certainly didn’t want anything to happen to him.
...
Meanwhile.
In the side hall of Shouzhe’s Courtyard.
Liua Ruolan was entertaining Ancestor Ruhong, expressing her gratitude, "Thank you, Ancestor Ruhong, for helping suppress the blood gu in Zongchang’s body and personally bringing him back."
Ancestor Ruhong waved it off repeatedly, "Ruolan, no need to be so formal. Our East Port Chen Family and Ping’an Wang Family are marriage allies, aiding each other is only natural."
Ancestor Ruhong dared not underestimate Liua Ruolan. He had witnessed her capabilities firsthand at the Trial Ground in the Outer Domain.
When this Mrs. Wang erupted, even he felt a subtle tremor of fear. Her future prospects were likely beyond imagination.
Currently, the major strategic plan of the East Port Chen Family was to firmly hold onto the strong alliance with the Ping’an Wang Family.
At the same time, in the adjacent room of the side hall.
Wang Zongchang was tied to the bed, his face distorted, eyes exuding a crimson and violent aura, his heart pounding rapidly. His blood surged, and the blood vessels seemed on the verge of bursting at any moment.
Wang Shouzhe’s cyan profound qi coursed through his system, soothing the constantly damaged blood and blood vessels. His brows were furrowed, a creature resembling a Blood Gu was hidden within Wang Zongchang’s spinal column.
Previously, Ancestor Ruhong had tried his best to suppress it, yet he couldn’t expel it.
Moreover, once the suppression was lost, it would become active again. It released something unknown, causing Wang Zongchang’s blood to boil unceasingly.
If not for Wang Shouzhe’s cyan profound qi, with its powerful healing abilities, Wang Zongchang might have already died from an internal explosion.
All Wang Shouzhe could do was merely help him sustain his life.
Wang Liyao and Wang Zong’an, the two children, returned and immediately became very well-behaved, silently praying for Wang Zongchang.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 56: Wedding Robe Blood Gu! Blessings and Misfortunes Intertwined - Part 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 56: Wedding Robe Blood Gu! Blessings and Misfortunes Intertwined - Part 2
Another half-day passed.
Faang You’an, who was stationed at Changning Guard for disaster relief, was summoned back by Wang Shouzhe. He came in to examine Wang Zongchang briefly and listened to the household generals recount the events of that time.
Immediately, his expression became extremely grave, and he said in a deep voice, "Let’s not discuss why the Yin Sha Evil Dao appeared in Hundred Islands Guard for now. According to this Blood Gu, it’s probably the infamous Wedding Robe Blood Gu."
"Wedding Robe Blood Gu?"
Wang Shouzhe continued to use Cyan Profound Qi to help Wang Zongchang sustain his life. Additionally, he placed a Longevity Tree Leaf into his mouth. The leaf had powerful healing abilities, which eased Wang Shouzhe’s burden.
"The Wedding Robe Blood Gu is an evil technique developed by some radical organization within the Divine Martial Dynasty to enhance bloodlines." Faang You’an said heavily, "They plant the Blood Gu into the bodies of young fierce beasts, and as they rapidly grow, the Wedding Robe Blood Gu continuously devours their bloodline essence. The day the fierce beast reaches maturity becomes its death date."
"Then, they extract the Wedding Robe Blood Gu and implant it into the spine of a human. Utilizing the blood-producing ability of the bone marrow, they continuously inject the fierce beast’s bloodline essence into the human body, thereby achieving the goal of transplanting the beast’s bloodline into humans."
As Faang You’an explained, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but gasp. That Divine Martial Dynasty, which perished ten thousand years ago, really seemed formidable; this was clearly genetic transplantation technology.
"In reality, I understand the human desire to become stronger. That organization wants every human to become a Celestial Pride." Faang You’an said, "But the Wedding Robe Blood Gu is too vicious and goes against the Heavenly Dao. Our academy obtained a Wedding Robe Blood Gu over two hundred years ago, and a few people died as a result. Not everyone can withstand the tyranny of the Wedding Robe Blood Gu."
He then mentioned some additional matters concerning the Wedding Robe Blood Gu.
After hearing this, Wang Shouzhe understood that using the Wedding Robe Blood Gu was extremely dangerous, and if one couldn’t endure it, death was assured! However, if one could endure it, Wang Zongchang’s bloodline could transform.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe focused all his attention and energy on Wang Zongchang.
Time passed bit by bit.
After several days, Wang Shouzhe almost reached the point of exhaustion due to his continuous treatment. Fortunately, after these days, Wang Zongchang’s complexion finally slowly returned to its original color, indicating that he had survived.
Only then did Wang Shouzhe truly relax, starting to eat, drink, meditate, and cultivate Qi to recover his losses. Yet he remained by Wang Zongchang’s side for twelve hours a day to prevent any accidents.
Three or four days later.
Wang Zongchang awakened, feeling a bit dazed throughout the process but generally aware of what had happened. He struggled to get up and thanked Wang Shouzhe, "Zongchang thanks Fourth Uncle for the lifesaving grace."
"It’s nothing, we’re all family, and protecting each other is what we should do." Wang Shouzhe noted his energetic spirit without any signs of weakness, and after a brief check, he found that Wang Zongchang’s physical condition had undergone a great transformation.
Only then did he rest easy, as Zongchang had indeed turned misfortune into fortune this time.
However, this bloodline transformation would not be apparent overnight. Therefore, Wang Shouzhe decided to let him rest for a few days and slowly explore the changes in his bloodline.
The emergence of the Yin Sha Evil Dao also raised Wang Shouzhe’s vigilance. Even if they were all dead, there would still be many clues left behind.
With a single order, the intelligence departments under him would pursue this matter to the end.
At this time, Liua Ruolan kindly brought in some of her homemade food: "Zongchang has suffered these days, Fourth Aunt made some spiritual food for you to nourish your body."
"This..." Recently escaped from the threat of the Wedding Robe Blood Gu, Wang Zongchang’s face turned pale, but he dared not oppose Fourth Aunt, only giving a bitter smile of thanks, "Zongchang thanks Fourth Aunt for the consideration."
"Poor child, look at your face, you’re so starved it’s turned white. Start eating, and Fourth Aunt will make another pot for you."
Then, Wang Shouzhe looked at the child with a sympathetic gaze.
...
Several days later.
To the east of Changning Guard City, there is a cluster of buildings arranged in an orderly fashion.
Here, the gates are tall, and the vigilance is strict; you can tell it’s the territory of some powerful family.
Golden characters are inscribed on the gate header.
"Changning Xu Family"
The entire Changning Guard knows that the Changning Xu Family is an established Eighth-Grade Noble Family.
Over two hundred years ago, the Changning Xu Family was already an Eighth-Grade Noble Family.
Moreover, they have been established in Changning Guard for more than three hundred years. After generations of management, their foundation is very strong, unlike those recently established Eighth-Grade Noble Families that are less than a hundred years old.
However, the days of this established Eighth-Grade Noble Family haven’t been going well recently.
Several years ago, the Qianma Huangfu Family seized an opportunity to enter the textile industry. The Changning Xu Family was struck down consecutively, losing too many material suppliers in a short period.
The reason is simple: the Qianma Huangfu Family has the Celestial Person Huangfu Family backing them. In commercial competition, it’s hard to say they’re ruthless, but they certainly act without scruples.
Meanwhile, the Changning Xu Family has stretched their financial chain to the limit to challenge becoming a Celestial Human Family. Now, this situation has almost hit their lifeblood.
At this moment.
A carriage slowly stopped at the main gate of the Changning Xu Family’s main residence.
Inside the carriage.
There’s a middle-aged couple holding a toddler around two or three years old.
The woman is well-preserved, still showing charm in the form of a modest mature woman.
The man has a square face, looking quite dignified and stable.
This couple is the seventh generation of the Wang Family, Wang Shouxin and Xu Family couple.
Wang Shouxin is the eldest of the Shou Generation, now fifty-two years old, older than Wang Ding Race and Wang Dinghai of the Ding Generation.
"Wang Shouxin, do you think this outfit looks good on me?"
Today, Xu Family is obviously meticulously dressed, wearing a set of water-blue ice silk skirt. The hairpin on her head is also an uncommon ice blue pearl pendant, and the bracelet on her wrist is a costly ice blue treasure bracelet.
Making her look like an aristocratic lady under forty.
"It’s alright." Wang Shouxin glanced casually, holding a boy, his tone clearly a bit perfunctory.
"Wang Shouxin!"
Xu Chunyun raised her eyebrows, her fiery temper flaring up, "You’ve started getting wealthy leaning on Fourth Uncle’s influence, possibly aiming for Spirit Platform Realm. Are you starting to dislike me, preparing to marry a few concubines?"
"Xu Chunyun! Don’t make unfounded accusations." Wang Shouxin frowned, "When did I say I wanted to marry concubines?"
"Anyway, I don’t care. I, Xu Chunyun, married into the Wang Family, gave birth to two sons and two daughters, and now we even have a grandson." Xu Family raised her eyebrows, "Even Fourth Uncle praises me as a great contributor to the Wang Family. If you dare to have your heart set on marrying concubines, I’ll go cry to Fourth Uncle."
"Alright, alright, stop messing around." Wang Shouxin’s tone softened, "I’ve also accompanied you back to your family considering the incident with Zongchang the other day, leaving me anxious and uneasy."
"Fourth Uncle also said that Zongchang turned misfortune into fortune." Xu Family replied, "Moreover, if Fourth Uncle hadn’t said to accompany you back, how many years has it been since you accompanied me back?"
Talk about this matter.
Wang Shouxin’s face also showed some helplessness: "Chunyun, it’s not that I don’t accompany you back. It’s just that your brothers and sisters-in-law have their eyes set on us like thieves, thinking we’re here to take advantage of them every time."
"Alright, alright, you old thing are petty." Xu Family rolled her eyes, "Quickly, tell me how this dress looks?"
"Beautiful."
"Hmph, nice of you to say. Today, accompany me and earn back our dignity." Xu Family secretly pinched his thigh, "Later, I’ll let you do whatever you want."
"This... old couple, our grandson Shining is still here."
"Oh wow! Wang Shouxin, you dog, you really want to marry concubines."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 57: Holding Her Head High! The Eldest Sister-in-Law Visits Relatives in Fine Clothes
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 57: Holding Her Head High! The Eldest Sister-in-Law Visits Relatives in Fine Clothes
...
Xu Anming, an ordinary direct line member of the Changning Xu Family.
Now eighty years old, he retired from the family business many years ago to become a clan elder, spending his days playing with grandchildren or tending to flowers and plants.
In his younger years, he had cultivated to the High Stage of the eighth level in the Qi Refining Realm, but as he aged, his vigorous vitality gradually faded.
He didn’t make a point of consuming a large amount of Spiritual Food or Elixirs to maintain it, so his cultivation currently only remains at the eighth level of the Qi Refining Realm without falling.
Xu Anming’s life didn’t hold any great achievements, but he had his own pride.
He had three sons and two daughters, with fifteen grandchildren and great-grandchildren; now there are even four great-grandchildren.
His life can be considered fulfilling and complete.
As a clan elder, Xu Anming lived in Lixiang Garden, located in the western part of the main residence. This house is close to the main hall and quite large, considered respectable even within the various sections of the Changning Xu Family’s main residence.
During springtime, Lixiang Garden was lush with greenery, flourishing well.
Under the careful tending of the household servants, various kinds of flowers bloomed in a disordered array, vying for beauty, making the whole garden pleasing to the eye and vibrant with life.
Early this morning, the main pathways in the garden were scrubbed two or three times with clean water by the servants, and the used water was swept into specially dug drainage channels, so even in this rainy season, there is no need to worry about water accumulation affecting the master’s mood.
Xu Anming also dressed in a brand-new robe early in the morning, sat solemnly in the main hall, with a slightly expectant look on his dignified face, as if he was waiting for someone.
His sons and grandsons usually lived nearby, and today they all gathered in Lixiang Garden, the whole family together, resembling the style of a large family within a smaller family of stature.
"Xu Zhenxing, go out and see if your sister has arrived?"
Elder Xu Anming frowned slightly, seemingly unable to calm down.
Out of his three sons and two daughters, he was most concerned about his second daughter, Xu Chunyun. Because one time, the patriarch personally stepped in to arrange her marriage to Wang Shouxin, a direct line member of the Ping’an Wang Family.
How was the Ping’an Wang Family doing then? Not only located in the remote countryside, the family had only one word written all over—"poor."
What kind of life could his daughter have married into?
Xu Zhenxing, being the eldest son, is now in his fifties. Over the years, he has taken over his father’s responsibilities and held a managerial position in an important department in the Weaving Workshop of the Changning Xu Family, making him quite a figure.
Upon hearing this, he bowed to his father and said, "Yes, Father."
Before he could leave, the second son, Xu Zhenye, also smiled and said, "I’ll go with my brother. After all, I haven’t seen my sister for three years. Moreover, this time, I heard brother-in-law Shouxin is also coming."
With that, the two brothers went out together, without any hint of displeasure in their manners or gestures.
In fact, before they left, each instructed their wives to take good care of the elder while getting everything needed ready.
At the front gate of the Changning Xu residence.
Under the slanting sunlight, the exquisitely beautiful wooden archway towered high, solemn and dignified.
On the archway hung a plaque with the four characters "Changning Xu Family," and the official seal representing the status of an Eighth-Grade Noble Family glimmered brightly.
Outside the archway was a wide long path paved with bluestone.
The higher the rank of the noble family, the wider this long path would be. For example, a Ninth-Grade Noble Family could only build it one zhang wide, while an Eighth-Grade could have it two zhang wide, and for a Seventh-Grade, bluestone bricks could be replaced with carved bricks, with higher specifications going further up. This was the dignity granted to noble families by the Daqian Imperial Court.
At this moment, a beautifully decorated carriage, emblazoned with the Ping’an Wang Family crest, slowly came to a stop on the long bluestone path under the escort of household generals and servants.
The household servants at the gate quickly and eagerly went up to greet them, showering them with flattering words.
The Wang Family’s coachman set the stepstool and respectfully invited the master to alight.
Only then did Wang Shouxin and his wife descend, holding a child under three years old, surrounded by the respectful attendants.
Wang Shouxin was now over fifty years old; although he didn’t look aged, his demeanor was calm and reserved, appearing quite dignified under the escort of household generals and servants.
However, his originally neat brocade robe seemed a bit disheveled, and the tiger-shaped jade belt buckle at his waist was also crooked, as if it had been hurriedly fastened.
His gaze was evasive and uncomfortable when looking at the coachman, and his expressions were even more complex when facing his wife Xu.
This wife, always bold and fearless, but he didn’t expect such audacious behavior.
Xu Chunyun’s brows slightly carried a hint of spring, seemingly a bit smug and satisfied, and even her still charming face seemed slightly flushed and more radiant.
The Wang Family’s coachman drooped his eyelids, looking as if he hadn’t woken up.
What happened just now? He didn’t see it, didn’t hear it, and knew nothing.
As a coachman with generations of service in the Wang Family, he had solid professional ethics, being deaf and mute was foundational, and occasionally, his eyes could choose to be selectively blind.
Sure enough, Lady Xu secretly slipped him a Qian Gold, warning in a low voice, "Old Wang, you know very well, I have a bad temper, so don’t let any gossip spread."
"What did you say, Lady Xu?" Old Wang had a look of being hard of hearing, but quietly, that Qian Gold had already been hidden close to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 57: Holding Her Head High! The Eldest Sister-in-Law Visits Relatives in Fine Clothes_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 57: Holding Her Head High! The Eldest Sister-in-Law Visits Relatives in Fine Clothes_2
At this moment.
Within the main residence of the Changning Xu Family, two middle-aged men in brocade robes walked out.
Although they were both fifty or sixty years old, their bodies and appearances did not show much age due to long-term cultivation. Moreover, because of their noble birth, they occupied high positions for a long time, holding authority, exuding a natural air of composure and dignity.
The leader, Xu Zhenxing, upon seeing his younger sister and brother-in-law, immediately smiled and went to greet them: "Chunyun, Shouxin, you’ve reached the doorstep. What are you dawdling for?"
Xu Chunyun, unhurried and elegant, paid her respects, saying: "Chunyun greets the two brothers."
Wang Shouxin also stepped forward to greet them with cupped hands: "Shouxin greets the two elder brothers."
His attitude was neither arrogant nor humble, adhering to the proper etiquette.
"Shouxin, no need to be so formal."
Xu Zhenxing and Xu Zhenye hurried forward, supporting him on both sides.
Their faces were full of smiles, their demeanor exceedingly warm.
"Our brothers haven’t seen each other in years. This is no place for conversation, quickly come inside with us."
"No need to rush, elder brothers." Xu Chunyun said, "There are still some things in the carriage, all local specialties that our Shouxin brought for father."
Xu Zhenxing paused for a moment, then laughed and patted his head: "Look at your brother, too happy to see you."
With that, he waved his hand, and several household servants came out from the main residence to help move the items.
Good heavens.
An entire bag, over a hundred pounds of White Jade Spirit Rice, a whole jar of Spirit Wine brewed from Red Crystal Spirit Rice, a fifty to sixty-pound piece of Iron-backed Wild Boar front leg meat, along with a large jar of no less than sixty to seventy pounds of Salted Spirit Fish flesh, ten pounds of ordinary tea leaves, and one or two ounces of Spirit Tea.
Additionally, there was a gift list, including a large quantity of ordinary grains, melons, fruits, and vegetables, as well as chicken, duck, fish, and geese.
However, because the quantity was too large, the carriage couldn’t hold it all, and a separate carriage would deliver the rest later.
Xu Zhenxing and Xu Zhenye, who were quite prominent figures within the Changning Xu Family, were usually worldly and knowledgeable, but even they were taken aback by this scene.
Just returning to the maternal home, and yet they had prepared such abundant gifts. To those unaware, it might have seemed like they were here to arrange a marriage.
The brothers exchanged looks, their voices lowered significantly.
"This... Chunyun, Shouxin, isn’t this a bit too much?"
"Elder brothers." Xu Chunyun’s eyes were full of pride, "Our Shouxin said that over the years, father’s vitality has decreased. He needs to eat more spiritual food to nourish his body. This way, he can extend his years and live past a hundred."
At these words, the two brothers looked a little embarrassed, their faces slightly flushed.
The Changning Xu Family is a long-established Eighth-Grade Noble Family. As a clan elder, Xu Anming annually receives quite a bit for his sustenance.
The reason for his deteriorated vitality in recent years is naturally because he has been using his sustenance to support his grandchildren.
This is something that many clan elders do, after all, their lives have reached twilight, while the younger generation still has room to grow.
However, when Xu Chunyun brought it up, it naturally stirred discomfort in the hearts of the two brothers.
Fortunately, they had always understood Xu Chunyun’s temperament, so they immediately laughed it off and brushed the matter aside.
The Changning Xu Family has a long history and large population, naturally much bigger than the Ping’an Wang Family. At the main entrance, people were always coming and going.
Seeing this scene, with a little inquiry, it was clear that it was Xu Chunyun, who married into the Ping’an Wang Family, coming back for a visit.
The gift list quickly spread, causing quite a stir within the clan.
"This homecoming gesture is quite grand, isn’t it?"
"Clan elder Xu Anming surely has a good daughter~ Looks like he can enjoy the blessings of his descendants."
"I always said Uncle An Ming was blessed, see, wasn’t I right?"
Many people were quite envious of Clan Elder Xu Anming, especially those clan elders around his age, who were particularly jealous.
It’s worth noting that when choosing someone to marry into the Ping’an Wang Family, their family also had daughters on the candidate list, but they found ways to decline.
Who could have thought, just decades later, the wheel of fortune would turn around?
Amidst the discussions, Wang Shouxin and Xu Chunyun, along with Xu Zhenxing and Xu Zhenye, carrying a multitude of gifts, grandly entered the Lixiang Garden where the old father Xu Anming resided.
In the main hall.
Xu Anming, not having seen his daughter for years, was filled with tears, holding his daughter’s hand, inquiring warmly.
To him, no matter how old his daughter was, she always remained his precious girl.
The family, except for the Third who was away, and the eldest daughter married into the Wangxia Lei Family, was gathered in full.
Of course, the younger generation wasn’t present, as they never liked such social gatherings among relatives.
Wang Shouxin also stepped forward to greet: "Greetings to father-in-law."
"Shouxin~"
Xu Anming wiped away his tears and quickly helped Wang Shouxin up.
His expression was somewhat complex. When his daughter first married Wang Shouxin, he was wholeheartedly against it. Given the situation of the Ping’an Wang Family at the time, what good days could his daughter expect?
Fortunately, although the Wang Family was poor, it did not mistreat his daughter. Moreover, he knew Wang Shouxin cherished Xu Chunyun dearly, which made him feel much better.
Unexpectedly, in recent years, the Ping’an Wang Family turned their fortunes around.
