Wang Shouxin had suddenly risen to success, ten years ago he was not even at the seventh layer of the Qi Refining Realm, but now he possessed an extraordinary bearing, with profound qi, deep and unfathomable.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 57: Holding Her Head High! The Eldest Sister-in-Law Visits Relatives in Fine Clothes_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 57: Holding Her Head High! The Eldest Sister-in-Law Visits Relatives in Fine Clothes_3
Could it be that the Ping’an Wang Family is preparing for Wang Shouxin to impact the Spirit Platform Realm?
Not only was Xu Anming filled with doubts, but even Xu Zhenxing and Xu Zhenye appeared calm on the surface while their hearts were filled with turmoil.
They had never held Wang Shouxin in high regard, but to their surprise, his potential was so strong that he seemed to be surpassing them.
Even the three sisters-in-law of Xu Chunyun were meticulously dressed today, yet compared to Xu Chunyun, they all seemed to lose their luster.
Look at her outfit—an ice blue long skirt made of the latest Ice Spirit Silk, adorned with Water Blue Ice Jade Jewelry, her complexion a healthy rosy tone from a life of luxury and comfort, like a noble matron.
Anyone who didn’t know might think she was the daughter of the Changning Xu Family returning home.
They all wore smiles, chatting with Xu Chunyun about family affairs, but their eyes secretly glanced at their own husbands.
Look at the sister, and then look at us. Isn’t it embarrassing? Is the illustrious Changning Xu Family truly so much inferior to the Ping’an Wang Family?
The Xu Zhenxing brothers felt full of bitterness.
Well, this is quite troublesome now.
That outfit on the sister must have cost at least a thousand Qian Gold to assemble. With that spare money, it would be better to support the children’s cultivation, not squander it like this.
The two brothers hurriedly shifted their attention, picking up the two or three-year-old Wang Shining.
This child is the son of Wang Zongwei, the first member of the ninth-generation "Shining" generation of the Ping’an Wang Family.
As such, the conversation naturally shifted to the younger generation.
"Zongwei, that kid, was quite unruly in his youth," said Xu Zhenxing, as the elder brother, "But in recent years, he has settled down and works diligently. By the way, I recall he married into the direct vein of the Gongsun Family?"
At the mention of her eldest son, Xu Chunyun’s face showed a hint of pride: "Zongwei was indeed a bit wild when he was young. Fortunately, Fourth Uncle personally stepped in and mentored him, helping him find his way back."
"Now, that boy is developing in the East Sea Guard, managing quite a few responsibilities. His wife was arranged by Lady Gongsun herself. She is smart and capable, just the one to handle that brat."
"Aunt is indeed blessed," second sister-in-law from the Dang Family said with a smile, "Yet our Younian is not lacking either, already at the Peak of the Qi Refining Realm Seventh Layer even before turning thirty, praised several times by the family Ancestor."
At the mention of her son Xu Younian, the Dang Family sister-in-law’s eyes also showed a slight sense of pride.
Meanwhile, the eldest sister-in-law from the Lei Family looked a bit uneasy, as her own children did not stand out, at least not compared to Xu Younian.
"I didn’t realize Younian is so accomplished now," Xu Chunyun said joyfully, then added nonchalantly, "By the way, our Zongchang has also been quite busy these years and hasn’t come to visit all of you."
At these words, Xu Zhenye’s face immediately turned awkward.
He glared at his wife from the Dang Family and scolded, "You women, so ill-informed. Our Zongchang is already a renowned young expert at just twenty-two, much more accomplished than Younian."
Xu Zhenxing hesitated for a moment before asking, "Sister, I heard Lici went to take the Purple Mansion Academy exam. Do you know if she passed?"
Purple Mansion Academy exam?
The crowd, unaware of this matter, immediately became interested.
Simply qualifying to take the Purple Mansion Academy exam is already an achievement. If she passes, even as an ordinary disciple, she is destined to become a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
As for her daughter Wang Lici, Xu Chunyun hadn’t paid much attention, and Wang Lici’s actual cultivation status was kept secret, not even fully known to her mother.
Xu Chunyun thought for a moment and said, "These matters were all arranged by Fourth Uncle Shouzhe. After Lici completed the exam, she stayed at the Academy, so she probably passed."
Upon hearing this, the Xu Family members were all thrilled and proud.
Privately, they might feel envy and jealousy, but if Wang Lici could become a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, all her uncles and aunts would also rise with her success.
It would not only bring them prestige but also substantial benefits!
Who knows, one day, Lici’s success might be the family’s pillar of support.
"Wonderful, wonderful," Xu Anming was moved to tears, deeply gratified, "With Lici entering the Academy, she is sure to become a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator in the future. Who would’ve thought one of my grandchildren could reach the Spirit Platform Realm?"
Wang Shouxin watched in silence.
Xu Chunyun didn’t focus much on her daughter’s matters, and since her daughter intentionally kept things hidden, she naturally didn’t know the truth, which Wang Shouxin knew very well.
His daughter Wang Lici was not a future Spirit Platform Realm cultivator; she had already become a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
Moreover, he had heard from Shouzhe that Lici had taken on an extraordinary master, giving her very promising future prospects.
Wang Shouxin thought to himself that Lici’s master was likely a Celestial Human Realm cultivator, which explained Shouzhe’s secrecy. If this leaked out, it could cause quite a stir.
Watching Xu Chunyun’s expression of springtime pride, eager to flaunt her children’s talents to the world, he felt a wave of embarrassment.
Well, let her stay in the dark.
It was a pity that even Wang Shouxin himself was kept in the dark. Wang Lici’s mentor wasn’t just a Celestial Human Realm cultivator, but a distinguished Purple Mansion Ascendant, one of the leading vice deans.
Just as everyone was lavishly praising Wang Lici...
Suddenly, a dignified and cheerful voice came from outside the door: "Third brother, I heard that Chunyun and Shouxin came. Why wasn’t I informed?"
This voice...
The entire family of Xu Chunyun’s brothers and sister-in-law were stunned.
Isn’t this the voice of Patriarch Xu Anbang?
Since when does the direct vein of the Changning Xu Family need to inform the Patriarch about visiting home?
If everyone did so, the Patriarch would be overwhelmed.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 58: Shouzhe Sets the Plan! Stirring Up the Storm
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 58: Shouzhe Sets the Plan! Stirring Up the Storm
...
However, since the Patriarch has arrived, there was no room for Xu Anming’s family to think too much. They hurried forward to welcome Patriarch Xu Anbang inside.
Compared to Xu Anming’s ordinary direct vein small family, Xu Anbang, who is already at the peak of the Early Stage in the Spirit Platform Realm, is clearly an influential figure in Changning Guard. Whether in terms of vision, intelligence, or other sources of information, Xu Anbang holds an absolute advantage.
Xu Anbang’s attitude was very amiable. He was polite to Xu Anming’s family, exchanging kind greetings, and then posed as an elder to Xu Chunyun, showing great care as if she were a legitimate daughter married off from the Changning Xu Family.
This left Xu Chunyun somewhat flattered and startled.
In her life, she had never spoken even two words alone with Patriarch Xu Anbang.
Ultimately, Xu Anbang focused his attention on Wang Shouxin, with a gentle and friendly demeanor, "Shouxin, you are the son-in-law of our Changning Xu Family, we are all one family. Visit us often and keep the relationships warm."
After offering his regards, Xu Anbang did not disturb their small family reunion further, only advising Wang Shouxin to stay a few more days with the Changning Xu Family.
Then, he left.
Once Xu Anbang left, the members of Xu Anming’s small family immediately became lively again.
The three sisters-in-law were exceptionally warm and intimate towards Wang Shouxin and his wife. They even arranged for a household servant to inform the younger generation to return, saying they wanted them to formally meet their aunt and uncle.
Afterwards, naturally, there was another round of lively interaction not to be mentioned for now.
By evening time.
In the private study of Patriarch Xu Anbang of the Changning Xu Family, Wang Shouxin sat across from Xu Anbang, drinking Spirit Tea.
There was also a middle-aged couple accompanying them.
The woman appeared to be around forty years old, with a pleasant appearance, exuding a graceful charm and elegance.
The man likewise had a very dignified appearance, with a composed and unhurried demeanor and a face calm as still water, clearly an important figure in the Changning Xu Family.
The woman was named Wang Liuqin, the fifth among the Liu generation of sixth-generation females from the Ping’an Wang Family, and thus the Fifth Aunt to Wang Shouzhe and Wang Shouxin.
The man was named Xu Anfeng, the thirteenth in the An generation of the Changning Xu Family.
Both Wang Liuqin and Wang Shouxin were direct vein members of the bloodline connection through marriage between the Ping’an Wang Family and Changning Xu Family, serving as bonds of bloodline and relationship between the two families.
As the eldest brother of the Shou generation, Wang Shouxin always felt heavy pressure and burden, maintaining a stable personality without ever being rash or aggressive.
Because of this, many people assumed that Wang Shouxin was somewhat dull by nature.
However, Wang Shouzhe knew that his elder brother Wang Shouxin was also very intelligent and extremely patient.
He began working at the Xingmao Silk Farm under their father Wang Dingchuan when he was eighteen, and now at fifty-three, he had long been able to handle things independently. Under his management, the Silkworm Manor had steadily developed over the years, becoming one of the Wang Family’s key industries.
How could such a figure be simple?
Patriarch Xu Anbang was reading a letter.
After reading it, his brows relaxed, and he said with a smile, "I understand the intention of Patriarch Shouzhe. Regarding the cooperation between our two families, Patriarch Shouzhe has fully entrusted it to you."
As he spoke, Xu Anbang regarded Wang Shouxin with even more importance.
From the letter, it was clear that Wang Shouzhe placed great trust and reliance on Wang Shouxin, even possibly having intentions of cultivating Wang Shouxin to reach the Spirit Platform Realm.
If this move succeeded, Wang Shouxin would become a pivotal figure within the Wang Family for the next hundred or more years.
"Patriarch Xu." Wang Shouxin’s expression was solemn, "My fourth brother once said that the Changning Xu Family and our Ping’an Wang Family have been in-laws for over a hundred years, with our bloodlines long merged. Moreover, when our Ping’an Wang Family faced its most difficult times, the Changning Xu Family did much to take care of us. Just the purchase of raw cocoons at a premium from the Silkworm Manor alone is something our Ping’an Wang Family will never forget."
Wang Shouzhe has always been a grateful person.
Despite the past grievances and the fading of feelings between the two families, the Changning Xu Family ultimately held onto the affinity of the past and took care of the Ping’an Wang Family.
This is a favor that must be acknowledged.
Aside from being somewhat mercenary and overly conservative, the Changning Xu Family has no major faults.
"Shouxin, just call me Fifth Uncle~ calling me Patriarch seems too distant." A trace of gratification appeared in Xu Anbang’s eyes.
Although the care previously given to the Ping’an Wang Family was only out of familial ties, with no expectation of return,
a family that always remembered the kindness you showed them is naturally more suitable for deepened relations and mutual collaboration than those who turn a blind eye.
Once the basis for cooperation was confirmed, Xu Dingbang spoke solemnly, "To be honest, our Changning Xu Family is facing trouble."
"This is to be expected." Wang Shouxin said calmly while sipping Spirit Tea, "The Changning Guard is just such a small place, already quite crowded with two Celestial Human Families. Neither the Celestial Person Huangfu Family nor the Celestial Human Lei Family is keen to see another Celestial Human Family rise."
The only difference is whether they would abandon scruples and directly intervene.
"Our Changning Xu Family also has its own weaknesses. Despite nearly two centuries of meticulous work in the weaving field, the foundation remains too weak. This has given the Huangfu Family an opportunity to target you. As my fourth brother puts it, living too comfortably leads to unawareness of danger."
"This..."
Although Xu Anbang felt somewhat uncomfortable at heart, he knew what was spoken was the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 58: Shouzhe Makes a Plan! Stirring Up the Storm_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 58: Shouzhe Makes a Plan! Stirring Up the Storm_2
His expression was grave and unpleasant: "The Qianma Huangfu Family somehow acquired new weaving techniques. Whether for silk reeling or weaving silk, their costs are only half of ours."
"Now they’re purchasing all the cocoons in the surrounding areas at a price 50% higher than us, forcing us to raise our purchase price to meet the demand for raw silk and silk production and supply. But in doing so, we’re not only unable to profit, but we’re also continuously incurring losses."
"Under normal circumstances, our Changning Xu Family could still hold out. But now, our ancestors of the Changning Xu Family are gathering resources for a breakthrough to the Celestial Human Realm and are still short of over a hundred thousand Qian Gold. We had hoped to rely on silk income from the next ten years to secure a loan, but we didn’t expect to be intercepted by the Qianma Huangfu Family."
Xu Anbang worriedly said, "You know that our ancestors are already a hundred and sixty-five years old. The longer this drags on, the lower the chances of successfully entering the Celestial Human Realm."
"Have you considered selling off a large portion of assets again?" Wang Shouxin casually suggested.
"Shouxin, you may not know." Wang Liuqin spoke up for the first time, "Actually, the family has already mortgaged some assets. If we sell off more, it would severely injure the core of our family. If the ancestor’s breakthrough fails, the Changning Xu Family might decline rapidly."
Once a family shows signs of decline, it’s very likely to fall into a vicious cycle and continue to deteriorate.
Wang Liuqin’s concerns were not unfounded.
For a Celestial Human Family, completing the Celestial Human transition is no simple feat.
Failure once results in severe injury, and twice might mean the family can’t sustain itself.
For an Eighth-Grade Noble Family aiming to become a Celestial Human Family, it’s even more challenging, requiring fate, luck, and accumulation over a century or two.
A hundred and fifty years ago, the Changning Xu Family attempted to break into the Celestial Human Realm, but that ancestor failed and perished under the Celestial Tribulation.
It was from that time the Changning Xu Family began to show subtle signs of decline.
If we sell assets and attempt another failed breakthrough, maintaining even the Eighth-Grade Noble Family status over the next decades would be questionable for the Changning Xu Family.
Noble Families always find ascending difficult, but descending is frighteningly fast.
"The ancestor implies that he has at most a fifty percent chance of breaking through to the Celestial Human Realm this time." Xu Anbang said helplessly, "Even the ancestor himself is unwilling to stake everything. Otherwise, if he fails, how would he face our ancestors?"
These words have merit, because the Changning Xu Family is a three-hundred-year-old lineage. If they recklessly risk everything, what would become of the family?
Though entering the Celestial Human Realm is crucial, it’s more important for the family to continue peacefully and securely.
Xu Anbang took a deep breath, somewhat embarrassed yet still spoke: "Shouxin, Five Uncle knows our Ping’an Wang Family is doing very well now, with quite a cash surplus. I shamelessly ask you, could the Ping’an Wang Family lend us a hundred thousand Qian Gold, giving our ancestor a chance to break into the Celestial Human Realm."
Wang Shouxin frowned deeply: "The biggest issue now for the Changning Xu Family is that their pillar industry is being targeted, casting doubt on their future repayment capacity. If not for this, I believe the Changning Xu Family wouldn’t have approached us."
"That’s right." Xu Anbang’s face was somewhat defeatist, "The Huangfu Family’s attack at this moment is also intended to shake our ancestor’s resolve to attempt the Celestial Human breakthrough."
"They even sent intermediaries to hint that as long as the ancestor gives up this attempt, they don’t wish to rupture relations and will withdraw from the weaving industry."
Ascending to become a Celestial Human Family is the mutual desire of every Eighth-Grade Noble Family.
Yet the Changning Xu Family now faces a dilemma.
"Five Uncle, pardon my candidness." Wang Shouxin said sternly, "Once you start something, it becomes difficult to retract. Perhaps the Huangfu Family might keep their promise and withdraw from the weaving business temporarily. But who can guarantee that they won’t act against you in thirty or fifty years? Or does the Changning Xu Family intend to be suppressed generation after generation?"
Xu Anbang realized that the Ping’an Wang Family’s Wang Shouzhe likely had long considered this.
He immediately said, "Shouxin, let’s not beat around the bush. What’s Patriarch Shouzhe’s view?"
"We can lend the hundred thousand Qian Gold." Wang Shouxin stated, "But in the future woven industry sector of the Changning Xu Family, our Ping’an Wang Family must permanently hold a 40% share."
Xu Anbang’s expression changed drastically: "Shouxin, that’s going too far, isn’t it? Trying for 40% of our Xu Family’s shares for a mere hundred thousand Qian Gold seems like opportunism."
Seeing the tension rise, Wang Liuqin quickly intervened: "Patriarch, please hold your anger. I’m confident that Shouzhe and Shouxin aren’t opportunists; there must be more to this."
Xu Anbang’s expression eased slightly, though he still felt a bit displeased.
He fixed a cold gaze on Wang Shouxin, curious about his explanation.
"Actually, Five Uncle, you might not know." Wang Shouxin, after stirring his tea leaves, calmly dropped a bombshell, "For these years, our Ping’an Wang Family has also been researching silk reeling and weaving technologies. If it weren’t for our familial ties with the Changning Xu Family, it might not have been the Huangfu Family who forced them out first, but us."
What?!
Xu Anbang was so shocked that his teacup nearly slipped from his grasp.
Wang Liuqin and her husband were equally taken aback.
No matter how much they racked their brains, they didn’t foresee this. Yet proving such a thing would be straightforward, and Wang Shouxin had no reason to deceive them.
Wang Shouxin had seemingly anticipated their reaction, maintaining his composure.
The Silkworm Manor had always been his responsibility, and under the guidance of his fourth brother, he, along with the estate managers, gradually developed new technologies. No one was more qualified to speak on this matter than he was.
He candidly explained some of the manpower or water-powered reeling and weaving equipment efficiencies developed by the Ping’an Wang Family. He then said, "Five Uncle, once our two families collaborate, with our advanced technology, we can instead ensnare the Huangfu Family, making it impossible for them to extricate themselves."
Xu Anbang’s expression grew increasingly fascinating.
Being a capable patriarch with a deep understanding of the family’s pillar industry—textiles—his mind raced with possibilities.
If everything Wang Shouxin said was true, it wouldn’t just be as simple as holding back the Huangfu Family.
The future could potentially see a massive expansion in production capacity, involving continuous mergers and growth. In such a case, even granting 40%, 50%, or 60% of the shares, the Changning Xu Family would still profit greatly.
However, after the initial excitement, he settled back into thoughtfulness: "Patriarch Shouzhe is indeed a capable figure who can revitalize the Wang Family. This move of his seems to involve us facing off against the Huangfu Family, at least requiring them to divert some of their efforts and resources, right?"
"Naturally. Otherwise, why should our Ping’an Wang Family loan out a hundred thousand Qian Gold for only a 40% stake?" Wang Shouxin answered calmly, "Moreover, Five Uncle needn’t overly fear the Huangfu Family. Shouzhe’s fourth brother has a strategy that can make the Huangfu Family end up failing to outwit us, dragging them into a costly quagmire."
Xu Anbang’s eyes sparkled, nearly consenting immediately.
Nevertheless, he eventually said, "This is a significant matter, and I need to discuss it with our ancestors. An Feng, Liuqin, please see Shouxin back to his rest."
"Yes, Patriarch."
Wang Liuqin and Xu Anfeng responded in unison.
Subsequently, Wang Shouxin rose to bid farewell.
His mission for today was already accomplished. Faced with such a temptation and underlying resentment towards the Huangfu Family, his objective was achieved.
He spent a little more time talking with Fifth Aunt and Fifth Uncle, making small talk. Only when night fell did he return to his room in Lixiang Garden.
But when he did, his legs nearly gave out beneath him, and he almost ran away.
Only to see Xu Chunyun, a little drunk, her cheeks slightly flushed, beckoning him with her finger: "Husband, come here."
No, I’m not going over there. You’re so bewitching, you’re going to eat me alive?
"Shouxin, get over here now!"
"Chunyun, don’t be impulsive. Let’s talk this over properly."
"No, today I’m excited. Do whatever you want."
"No, don’t do anything hmf..."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 59 Xunfeng Wind Element Bloodline and My Dominant Sister
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 59 Xunfeng Wind Element Bloodline and My Dominant Sister
...
Wang Family’s Main Residence.
Martial Arts Arena.
Today is a rare sunny day recently, the green-brick ground of the Martial Arts Arena is not as slippery as before, and the specially planted trees around are unusually spirited, adding a touch of vitality to the entire arena.
Inside the Martial Arts Arena, two youths are sparring.
One of them is relatively immature, wearing a sleek Black Tortoise Martial Attire, holding a wide-blade battle sword with both hands, each move is broad and powerful, like a Powerful Splitting Hua Mountain.
The blade whistles, the sword light is like a tide, the Sword Aura falls like rain.
The other youth is slightly older, wearing a casual brocade robe, looking relaxed and comfortable.
As his wrist moves, his Sword Aura shines like stars, seemingly casual yet marvelous, effortlessly breaking down all the moves of the young opponent, embodying the demeanor of "let the wild storm rage, I remain unshaken".
This pair of sparring youths are naturally Wang Zongchang, who fortunately woke up from misfortune, and the Patriarch of Ping’an Wang Family, Wang Shouzhe.
Although the uncle and nephew both practice the Wang Family’s Profound Origin Sword, due to their different personalities, their fighting styles also differ greatly.
Wang Zongchang prefers a more open and powerful style, while Wang Shouzhe’s Sword Momentum is more delicate and exquisite, never wasting any Profound Qi.
"Fourth Uncle, try this move of mine!"
After fighting without success for a long time, Wang Zongchang flipped and landed more than ten feet away, immediately holding his wide-blade battle sword tightly, assuming a posture to build momentum.
Suddenly.
He moved.
Bursting Profound Qi suddenly erupted around him with him as the center, the Qi Force surged, and his figure shot towards Wang Shouzhe like an arrow.
Strangely, it seemed as though an invisible Qi Force supported him, giving his whole body a floating sensation, the misty aura around him was like a breeze, making his speed faster and his movements more agile than usual.
A sword swept upward from below.
The Sword Momentum, akin to a dragon rising from the abyss, fast and domineering.
"Well done!"
Wang Shouzhe praised as he observed this.
His nephew not only trains diligently, with solid basics, but he also has a very sharp mind. He managed to integrate his newly awakened Bloodline Talent into combat right away.
He remained unperturbed, casually pointing out a sword.
The Sword Aura seemed utterly ordinary, without any momentum.
However, this sword precisely struck the weakest point of Wang Zongchang’s move.
"Clang!"
A dragon-like metallic clash resounded.
Wang Zongchang’s magnificent Sword Momentum was instantly shattered like an avalanche.
He staggered back a few steps, almost unable to hold his sword, his Qi and blood raging within.
With a wry smile, he said, "Fourth Uncle, I’m done. This is too frustrating, this was a move I came up with after much effort."
"Fourth Uncle is just helping you test it out. Any newly created move will inevitably have many flaws; it’s only through combat, polishing, and rectifying deficiencies that it can become more powerful," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Come, let’s spar again~ Fourth Uncle just got excited."
Immediately, the two were engaged in combat once more.
After half a day’s effort.
Wang Zongchang was so exhausted he almost collapsed, eyes turning white, constantly shouting "I’m done," "I’m done."
Yet Wang Shouzhe still had a look of relish: "Ever since your Fifth Aunt went to the academy, I haven’t had such an enjoyable fight in a long time."
"Zongchang, you need to work hard, come to spar with Fourth Uncle more often whenever you have time. How about this, let’s do this every three days. In Fourth Uncle’s opinion, your Xunfeng Wind Element Bloodline still has a lot of potential to be tapped."
Indeed, Wang Zongchang, after the Wedding Robe Blood Gu entered his body, eventually completed the bloodline transformation, benefiting from the disaster, awakening the Xunfeng Wind Element Bloodline.
Moreover, the bloodline awakening degree is not low.
Although it hasn’t been tested with the Spirit Testing Array, based on his performance, Wang Shouzhe could roughly deduce that Zongchang’s talent should be around "Middle Grade A".
This is already quite remarkable.
When Wang Luqiu and Wang Luojing hadn’t used the "Basic Bloodline Improvement Liquid," their talents were approximately this level.
If he grows further, attends trials to win prizes, and in the future, he is very likely to become another Celestial Pride.
He would then be the second male Celestial Pride of Ping’an Wang Family.
This made Wang Shouzhe feel slightly melancholic, finally somewhat alleviating the atmosphere of overwhelming femininity.
Wang Zongchang almost fainted, realizing his Fourth Uncle had made him the replacement for Fifth Aunt.
How would he endure the future days?
He’s not as abnormal as Fifth Aunt, who no matter how much she gets beaten, remains filled with Primordial Qi and a fighter’s spirit.
"After half a day’s fight, I’m feeling a bit hungry. Your Fourth Aunt must have prepared a lot of delicious food. Come on, accompany me to have a meal,"
Wang Shouzhe cheerfully proposed once more.
Wang Zongchang’s face turned pale in an instant: "Fourth Uncle, I, I’m not hungry..."
"No, you are hungry."
Wang Shouzhe still smilingly insisted, but his tone was irresistible.
This time, Wang Zongchang didn’t almost faint; he actually passed out.
Just abused by Fourth Uncle, now to be abused by Fourth Aunt, life was unlivable!
...
Afternoon!
Wang Shouzhe lounged in his Master’s Chair for a brief nap.
Surrounded by dense green plants, blocking the scorching sun, creating a cool atmosphere in his yard. And various exotic flowers attracted bees and butterflies, keeping busy.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 59 Xunfeng Wind Element Bloodline and My Dominant Sister_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 59 Xunfeng Wind Element Bloodline and My Dominant Sister_2
Now the Wang family has grown, and many clan members have the ability to stand on their own. Most of the time, he only needs to focus on the big picture and strategically plan.
The Cloud Mist Spirit Tea from his wife’s family is especially suitable for enjoying during this hot summer, its sweetness quenches thirst and calms the spirit.
Stealing half a day’s leisure in this fleeting life.
The days are still quite pleasant.
Suddenly!
Qiao’Er came running in a hurry: "Patriarch, something terrible has happened."
"What has you so flustered?" Wang Shouzhe slightly frowned and replied calmly, "First, calm down and collect yourself; nothing is unresolvable."
"It’s just that..." Qiao’Er took a breath and calmed herself, "Miss Liyao burned Elder Master Wang’s beard in the clan academy. She also gathered a group of classmates and trapped the elder in the office, claiming that if today she doesn’t make things clear, she’ll write her surname backward. The teachers in the academy can’t handle it and request your quick presence..."
"I... writing her surname backward, it’s still not... wait!"
Then Wang Shouzhe realized and suddenly leapt up, rushing over quickly.
But halfway through, he turned back, pulling Qiao’Er aside to whisper: "Make sure not to let my wife know about this."
Qiao’Er hurriedly nodded, her cheeks slightly red, thinking, Patriarch, you pulled me over here so fiercely; I thought you intended something else.
Then Wang Shouzhe dashed out again.
Even Wang Shouzhe, faced with such a situation, felt a bit overwhelmed yet found it amusing.
Who knew at this stage of life, he could still experience being called in as a parent. His precious daughter truly keeps him on his toes.
Wang Shouzhe arrived at the backyard dock.
He jumped onto a small boat, which looked quite peculiar with no oars or paddles, nor even a rail. It was more like a water snowboard, very nimble.
Profound Qi surged through his feet, propelling the lightweight, sharp boat like an arrow off the string.
As a Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator, he could temporarily hover and glide, easily darting over a hundred feet. But attempting to fly directly across Zhuwei Lake was unrealistic.
Alternatively, he could tread water with swift, dragonfly-like skips, though it would be quite an ordeal.
Thus, he modeled this small boat after a water snowboard. Powered by Profound Qi, it was swift, effortlessly stylish, and fun.
With his hands behind his back, he tilted slightly as if snowboarding, resembling a Sword Immortal gliding on a Flying Sword, a slight shift sending a spray of water.
Unfortunately, this water-gliding boat could only be handled by those at the Spirit Platform Realm. Normal Qi Refining practitioners would quickly deplete their Profound Qi.
Soon, he saw a large complex of buildings on the opposite shore.
It was the first, second, and third phases of Zhuwei Mansion, developed extensively by Wang Shouzhe.
This massive project, filling in marshland from Zhuwei Lake’s dredged silt, laid a solid financial foundation for Wang Shouzhe in the early days.
In a sense, this marked the starting point of the Wang family’s rise to wealth.
Today, Zhuwei Mansion is no longer the desolate marshland it once was.
The gathering of many houses, farmlands, and people first led to the emergence of a small market here.
Then Wang Shouzhe ramped up investment, developing numerous business outlets, forming a bustling commercial center. Even affluent households from other towns and Changning Guard purchased many properties here, seeing it as a long-term investment.
Later on,
Wang Shouzhe simply built a new Wang Clan Academy here.
The new academy was large; even the currently developed section could accommodate over a thousand teachers and students.
The earliest Wang Clan Academy only taught and cultivated Wang family descendants and some excellent peripheral lineage offspring.
But now, as long as they are residents of Ping’an Town, whether tenant farmers, civilians, artisan families, or unranked Black Tortoise Race, they can apply to study at Wang Clan Academy under certain conditions.
Soon, Wang Shouzhe arrived on the opposite lake shore.
Over there, a long protective embankment and landscape belt were established, allowing tourists to enjoy the lake view. A small dock accommodated several boats for lake tours and sightseeing.
Wang Shouzhe’s small boat sent a spray of water as it stylishly docked, catching the attention of many nearby.
At the dockside.
A giant turtle also raised its enormous head, blinking at Wang Shouzhe. It wondered why its master, with whom it had a bloodline contract, was coming in such a hurry.
Indeed, this giant, highly spiritual turtle was the Wang family’s House Guardian Spirit Beast, the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle.
Nowadays, it’s a beautiful sight and mascot at Zhuwei Lake, boosting the prestige and property prices as an Auspicious Beast.
Of course, its primary task now is to daily transport Miss Wang Liyao and Young Master Wang Zong’an to and from school.
Wang Shouzhe mandated that all Wang family descendants attend the clan academy unless there were special reasons.
This included his own children.
Wang Shouzhe believed that socializing with peers and learning systematically in school would offer children a wholesome life, promoting mental and physical health.
At present.
Wang Shouzhe didn’t have time to pay attention to the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle. He jumped ashore and hurried towards the academy.
The Ping’an Wang Clan Academy was built by the water.
In theory, it could already be considered Ping’an Academy.
However, Wang Shouzhe still used the name Wang Clan Academy because the children nurtured here are meant to build talents for the whole Ping’an Town, becoming cornerstones and pillars of society going forward.
Ping’an Wang wasn’t a charity. Every child attending the academy needed a guarantor and required parents to sign a contract.
All Wang Shouzhe’s efforts ultimately aimed to strengthen Ping’an Wang and make Ping’an Town even more robust.
The Wang Clan Academy, planned to cover over a hundred acres, currently only used twenty percent of its area.
But the number of students, ranging across ages, already exceeded five hundred, preparations for the Wang family’s future.
Talents aren’t confined to top-tier combat prowess; they manifest in all aspects of the Wang family.
In Wang Shouzhe’s vision for the future grand layout of the Wang family, the need for talent is always pressing.
Wang Shouzhe quickly arrived at the clan academy he dedicated much effort to constructing.
A female teacher was already waiting at the academy gate, hurrying up to meet him as soon as she saw Wang Shouzhe: "Director, you’re finally here, please, hurry and persuade Miss Liyao. She said if the elder doesn’t come forward to apologize, she’ll burn down the entire academy."
Wang Shouzhe nearly fainted from anger. Wang Liyao, oh Wang Liyao, does your father find it easy to painstakingly build up family assets to establish the academy? What did it do to wrong you to reach for a torch?
Isn’t this a pitfall for your old man?
He quickly followed the female teacher inside.
That female teacher, in her thirties, was quite graceful, exuding rare intellectual beauty. Among women, she was a rare cultured teacher, open-minded, and was hired by Wang Shouzhe at a hefty price.
After all, with the academy’s growth and the increasing number of female students, having more female teachers was highly necessary.
Soon, Wang Shouzhe witnessed the scene.
Gathered in front of the newly built teaching building, constructed at a significant expense, were students of various ages, mostly girls. They clustered around an eight or nine-year-old girl, beautifully carved like jade.
The little girl, with a cold and composed expression, stood there exuding a domineering aura, like a ruler of the world.
Beside her was a five or six-year-old boy, almost on the verge of tears, shivering. Sister, can’t we tone it down?
If mother finds out, we’re bound to receive a severe punishment.
The key issue is whenever sister causes trouble, he also gets caught up in it, and then mother punishes him even harder!
Having such a sister is a misfortune!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 60: Behind the Scenes! Managing Changning (7000-word - )
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 60: Behind the Scenes! Managing Changning (7000-word Chapter)
...
Just as Wang Zong’an was trembling in fear, Wang Shouzhe arrived at the scene.
"Wang Liyao!" Wang Shouzhe scolded with a grumpy tone, "What are you doing on the stage? You..."
However, the second half of his scolding couldn’t even be uttered.
Because as soon as Wang Liyao saw her father, the composure and authority on her pretty little face disappeared instantly. Her little mouth quivered, and tears welled up.
Then she flew into Wang Shouzhe’s arms, crying aggrievedly: "Daddy, finally you’re here, wah~"
Seeing his precious daughter’s distressed look, Wang Shouzhe’s heart melted instantly. How could he stay angry?
He hurriedly held his precious daughter steady, stroking her hair with a face full of heartache: "You child, standing so high on the platform, aren’t you afraid of falling?"
"Daddy, the old teacher bullied people." Wang Liyao pouted, tears in her eyes, and her pretty cheeks puffed up in anger.
A drop of cold sweat appeared on Wang Shouzhe’s forehead.
Why does the whole scene look like you’re the one bullying the old teacher?
Then Wang Shouzhe scolded his son: "Wang Zong’an, what are you standing there doing? Just standing by blankly without knowing to advise your sister."
Wang Zong’an’s eyes widened suddenly.
This, this is my fault too? I’m only five years old, okay?
Besides, I clearly advised her many times, but would my sister listen to me?
"You still dare to glare at me?" Wang Shouzhe said with authority, "As the Young Clan Leader of the Ping’an Wang Family, it’s your fault if you can’t control the situation. I’ll deal with you when we get back."
Alright then!
Wang Zong’an had a look of utter despair.
This time, it seems a spanking is unavoidable. But he was used to it; every time his sister got into trouble, he couldn’t avoid being implicated.
As the Eldest Legitimate Son of the Wang Family, it was really difficult for him~
Afterward, Wang Shouzhe looked at the students gathering and causing trouble; as his gaze swept over them, they all trembled.
However, this time Wang Shouzhe wasn’t in the mood to care about them, and he said, "Disperse, go and do what you need to do."
But what Wang Shouzhe could never have imagined was that, although those kids were scared, they didn’t obediently disperse. Instead, they looked eagerly at Wang Liyao.
Hiding in Wang Shouzhe’s arms, crying and acting coquettishly, Wang Liyao waved her hand and said, "Didn’t you hear what my dad said? Disperse, everyone."
As soon as she finished speaking, a large group of students of all ages scattered, going off to do what they needed to do.
This provoked another drop of cold sweat from Wang Shouzhe.
How is it that in this Clan Academy, his authority is not as effective as his daughter’s?
Then he noticed a few familiar figures among the kids trying to sneak away and avoid his gaze.
"Wang Luolan! Wang Shouming! Wang Luoqing! Wang Zongyao! Wang Lili!"
Every time Wang Shouzhe called out a name, someone in the crowd would tremble and then come back obediently.
From the oldest, Wang Luolan, to the youngest, Wang Luoqing, they all lined up before Wang Shouzhe, each with their heads lowered, not daring to look at him.
"Wang Luolan," Wang Shouzhe glared, "how old are you? Still joining in the mischief with your nephews and nieces!"
"Fourth Brother," Wang Luolan chuckled dryly, weakly saying, "It’s just because the old teacher was a bit too bullying. I was just supporting Yaoyao a little, didn’t do anything else wrong."
Once the little eight-year-old in Wang Shouzhe’s arms, Wang Luolan had grown into a beautiful young lady of fourteen or fifteen years old.
"Hmph!"
Wang Shouzhe snorted, still somewhat displeased: "That old teacher, I’m familiar with him. Although a bit rigid, he is still an elder of the Wang Family’s collateral line. If there’s really any issue, can’t it be resolved properly? It seems to me you’re just bored. Your Fourth Sister is a bit overwhelmed, so you can organize a refugee team over there to dredge and expand the river channel, with a target of no less than thirty miles."
"Yes, Fourth Brother."
Wang Luolan felt a bit aggrieved but obediently accepted the order.
She had done similar work more than once.
The Wang Family’s children were good in this regard, while needing to study and cultivate, they also had to participate in family affairs.
Not only Wang Luolan but also Wang Luomiao, and previously Wang Luqiu, Wang Luojing, and other girls, engaged in family affairs alongside their studies.
This gave them significant training, allowing them to grow quickly. There wasn’t a single complete pampered princess among the Wang family’s young ladies.
Then Wang Shouzhe turned his attention to Wang Shouming and Wang Zongyao.
These two boys, one eight and the other nine, were the continuations of Wang Family’s bloodline, the foundation of the family’s future.
Especially Wang Shouming, the youngest male of the Shou Generation, was the second son of Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai, taking the place of Wang Shouye as the youngest seventh-generation male.
Just being glanced at by Wang Shouzhe made him tremble and honestly say, "Fourth Brother, I was wrong."
"Fourth Uncle, I was wrong too," Wang Zongyao was equally frightened, his heart trembling, "Please don’t tell my father."
He was the second son of Second Brother Wang Shouyi. Although Second Brother had a gentle temperament, he was very strict with his children. If this were to reach his ears, Zongyao would be in big trouble.
"You two have already begun nurturing your meridians, entering the initial stage of cultivation, with strength not inferior to that of Ordinary People," Wang Shouzhe said, "You both go to the refugee camp to take on the task of porridge distribution and soothing refugees, so you can understand how difficult life is."

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 60: Behind the Scenes! Manipulating Changning (7000 Words)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 60: Behind the Scenes! Manipulating Changning (7000 Words)_2
The two of them, upon hearing this, were not frightened but rather delighted. They cupped their hands towards Wang Shouzhe and said, "Thank you, Fourth Uncle/Fourth Brother." Doing these tasks not only doesn’t require the family’s head to intervene but also can earn some merit points.
Finally, Wang Shouzhe’s gaze fell on Wang Lili and Wang Luqing.
The two little girls looked at Wang Shouzhe with a bit of fear, appearing as if they were ready to receive their fate.
Wang Luqing, being the ninth in the Lu Generation, was likely to be the youngest of her generation if nothing unexpected happened.
Of course, one couldn’t rule out Sixth Uncle Wang Dinghai having a sudden burst of youthful vigor and giving Wang Shouzhe another younger sister.
Now that the family’s conditions have improved, economic pressure and burdens have eased considerably, and the birthrate has increased quite a bit.
"Fourth Brother." This year, Wang Luqing was only six years old. With her watery eyes, she blinked at Wang Shouzhe and said in a childish voice, "Sister Yaoyao said that the old master was too much of a bully."
"That is your niece Yaoyao, you mustn’t confuse the generations." Wang Shouzhe affectionately rubbed her little head, "Besides, how could the old master bully you?"
This mischievous girl was the youngest in age, yet her seniority was high, even Wang Zongwei, who was already thirty, had to honestly call her Ninth Aunt.
"Fourth Uncle," Wang Lili said with a bit of grievance, "I also think Sister Yaoyao is right. The old master shouldn’t look down on those female teachers in the clan academy."
Wang Lili was the eldest daughter of Second Brother Wang Shouyi, and she was only seven this year. Although she was a year older than Wang Luqing, they were practically little girls of the same age.
Given their young age, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t bear to scold them harshly. He could only pinch her cheek and say, "Your goal now is to study well. If there’s truly a problem, report it to Fourth Uncle, and Fourth Uncle will solve it."
"Fourth Brother, we were wrong, and we’re willing to be punished." Wang Luqing seemed quite responsible, "We’re also willing to help in the refugee camp."
"Alright, once I finish dealing with this matter, none of you will get away." Wang Shouzhe said, giving Wang Liyao a glance, "You too, understand?"
"Understood, Father." Wang Liyao wasn’t afraid of punishment. "I also heard from Seventh Aunt and Fourth Aunt that refugees have been arriving in Ping’an Town one after another, and there’s a lot of resettlement work to be done."
"Good girl~"
Wang Shouzhe praised her and then let her go, following her and the female teacher into the old master’s office.
Inside the office sat an elderly man in his seventies. The old man’s appearance was quite pitiable. His originally imposing white beard was half burnt off, and his face was blackened in patches, looking rather sorry.
He was supporting himself with a cane and even up until now was still trembling slightly, as if he had not yet recovered from his fright.
"Shouzhe, how do you usually discipline your children? Look at your Wang Liyao, she’s causing trouble in the clan academy every day."
Upon seeing Wang Shouzhe, the elder finally found a vent for his emotions and began sharply criticizing him.
"Mr. Wang, calm down, calm down. Let me first inquire about the situation."
Wang Shouzhe held a great deal of respect for this elder, who had diligently served the Wang Family for half his life, and readily tried to soothe him.
This old man was named Wang Yangjie, a member of the Wang Family’s collateral line and a very outstanding scholar. He had traveled the world and had vast knowledge, even having served in a civil position at the Changning Capital City Mansion.
Back then, it was Ancestor Longyan who personally brought him back to serve as a professor in the clan academy. He had taught many people, including the previous Wang Shouzhe was also one of his students, thus his efforts and contributions could not be denied.
Hence, he served as the vice dean in the new clan academy.
As for the official dean, of course, it was merely a title for Wang Shouzhe. Due to his busy affairs, he was typically not involved in the clan academy’s management.
Wang Shouzhe’s stature as the family patriarch still held significant weight. Once he spoke up, the old man did indeed quiet down.
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe turned his gaze to his beloved daughter.
His daughter had already turned eight and was way past the age of being clueless about things.
With her arms crossed and puffed-up cheeks, she spoke with a bit of grievance, "Father, haven’t you always said boys and girls are the same? But the old master always favors those boys."
"When those boys make mistakes, he just lightly scolds them. But if the girls in the clan academy make mistakes, the old master always talks about sending them back home. Also, the old master often says there shouldn’t be female teachers in the academy, constantly reprimanding them. I got really angry and that’s why I opposed him."
This was something Wang Shouzhe was aware of.
Mr. Wang Yangjie indeed had this problem of favoring males over females. Perhaps this was one of the reasons why Luqiu and the others were never keen on studying.
Moreover, Luqiu and Luojing back then hadn’t clashed with Wang Yangjie infrequently.
"But you can’t go around burning the old master’s beard. If there’s a problem, it needs to be solved," Wang Shouzhe said sternly. "Now, what do you suggest we should do?"
"I think there should be a female vice dean in the clan academy." Wang Liyao had clearly thought about this issue long beforehand. As soon as Wang Shouzhe asked, she crossed her arms and earnestly began to talk, "There should also be strict rules in place, and anyone who makes a mistake should be punished, regardless. Boys and girls shouldn’t be treated differently."
"Hmm, what you say makes some sense." Wang Shouzhe said, "However, Yaoyao, your way of handling this is too extreme. First, apologize to the old master."

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 60: Behind the Scenes! Manipulating Changning (7000 Words)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 60: Behind the Scenes! Manipulating Changning (7000 Words)_3
Wang Liyao showed great respect to her father. Although she still felt aggrieved in her heart, she sincerely apologized.
Then, Wang Shouzhe also cupped his hands to Wang Yangjie and said, "Sir, I too apologize on behalf of my daughter."
His attitude was exceedingly sincere.
Wang Yangjie was taken aback and hurriedly returned the courtesy, saying, "Patriarch Shouzhe, I was merely momentarily upset, not deliberately making things difficult for Miss Liyao."
The current Wang Shouzhe was not the same naive boy he had once taught.
Now, Wang Shouzhe held immense power in all of Ping’an Town. Just one word from him could influence the fate of thousands; how could he accept such a courtesy?
"However, what this child said also makes some sense," Wang Shouzhe stated solemnly. "For our Wang Family to reach this point, many women have made extraordinary contributions. Whether it is Aunt Gongsun Hui or Ancestor Longyan, both are outstanding among women. I hope that you, sir, can adhere to the principles of ’impartial handling’."
"Yes, Patriarch."
For some reason, a chill rose in Wang Yangjie’s heart, and he hurriedly agreed with solemnity.
"Liyao, are you satisfied with this resolution?" Wang Shouzhe asked seriously.
"Satisfied. As long as the sir can adhere to impartial handling, I am also willing to respect him," Wang Liyao earnestly nodded.
"In that case, we should also punish where punishment is due," Wang Shouzhe said with a stern expression. "There is a saying, ’When a daughter is not taught properly, it is the father’s fault.’ It is because of my neglect that you have become somewhat unruly and willful. This time, your father, you, and An’an will all be punished together."
"Yes, father." Wang Liyao seemed to understand her mistake and accepted the punishment sincerely.
But Wang Zong’an had a naive look on his face.
Once again, he was implicated.
Being the Young Clan Leader is too difficult!
...
Changning Xu Family.
As a well-established Eighth-Grade Noble Family with a history spanning three hundred years, the true foundation of the Changning Xu Family was far from simple.
In the deepest part of its main residence, there was an ancient hall known as the "Spirit Hall," which served as the Xu Family’s ancestral shrine.
However, this was not merely a simple ancestral shrine.
Inside, it housed the fundamental treasure upon which the Changning Xu Family depended for its survival.
This treasure, known as the "Dragon Suppression Stele," was a precious heirloom passed down through the Xu Family.
Paired with the grand formation within the Spirit Hall, it could unleash earth-shattering power. Even a Celestial Human Realm cultivator attempting to force in might be suppressed and eventually ground down to death.
Unfortunately, this "Dragon Suppression Stele" had its flaws.
First, it could not be moved and had to be used in conjunction with the grand formation.
Secondly, faint cracks had already appeared on its surface, indicating that its usable times were limited.
This also made sense; otherwise, how could the Changning Xu Family have had the right to establish themselves in Changning?
It was precisely because of this formidable weapon that other parties were deterred.
At this moment.
Under the Dragon Suppression Stele, an old man in a gray robe sat cross-legged.
His hair and beard were white, and his skin was no longer as smooth as in his youth, with many wrinkles on his forehead, showing that he had truly entered old age.
However, his aura was deeply restrained, making it impossible for others to gauge his depth.
In front of him stood a middle-aged man in a brocade robe, the head of the Xu Family, Xu Anbang.
"Ancestor, this is how the situation unfolded," Xu Anbang said respectfully, with his hands lowered. "Based on my deductions, although it seems like the Wang Family acted to help us, their true intent is likely to make our Changning Xu Family the first to confront the Huangfu Family, thereby attracting all their attention."
Upon hearing this, the illustrious old man slowly opened his eyes, showing neither joy nor sadness: "Anbang, what do you think?"
Xu Anbang replied in a deep voice, "If we reject the Ping’an Wang Family, we will inevitably have to live under the influence of the Huangfu Family in the future, with our wealth and lives hanging on their whims. However, if we collaborate with the Wang Family, we would completely sever ties with the Huangfu Family, leaving no room for compromise. This matter is of great importance, and I dare not decide on my own. I seek the ancestor’s guidance."
A flicker of emotion passed through the old man’s deep eyes as he looked at Xu Anbang: "From the moment you came in, I sensed it. Since you already have ideas, why not share them?"
Xu Anbang took a deep breath and said, "From my observations, Ping’an Wang Family’s Wang Shouzhe is no simple man. This time, he probably has grand intentions."
He voiced his observations of anomalies during the reception of the Purple Mansion Academy’s direct disciple and his understanding of Wang Shouzhe over time.
"Wang Shouzhe seems inconspicuous on the surface but is extremely cautious and never acts without certainty. His move against the Huangfu Family this time must have been fully considered, and he may already have a complete plan against them."
"Interesting, interesting~"
The old man’s ancient face showed a faint smile.
Back then, the ancestor of the Ping’an Wang Family, Ancestor Zhou Xuan, was also a remarkable hero.
Who would have thought that not long after Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s passing, the Ping’an Wang Family would produce another impressive young fellow?
"In that case, we’ll join that young man from the Wang Family in this venture."
The old man decided resolutely.
Upon hearing this, Xu Anbang’s eyes shone with fervor: "This is also what I had in mind. Our Changning Xu Family has been suppressed for so long; it’s time to show the Huangfu Family that we are not easy targets!"

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 60: Behind the Scenes! Manipulating Changning (7000 Words)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 60: Behind the Scenes! Manipulating Changning (7000 Words)_4
As the words fell, the powerful aura of the Spirit Platform Realm instantly rose from his body, filled with a sense of battle readiness.
The Changning Xu Family, with its three-hundred-year-old legacy as an Eighth-Grade Noble Family, naturally possessed its own confidence and courage.
...
After handling clan academy matters, Wang Shouzhe set aside all other affairs.
With his daughter and son, they joined the riverbank construction work, taking on the identity of ordinary people.
Liua Ruolan also rushed over upon hearing the news, and upon understanding Wang Shouzhe’s intentions, she joined the team.
The couple both understood.
Now is the crucial period for their children’s growth, requiring them to lead by example, teaching them to endure hardships and understand the difficulties of life, thereby establishing the correct values.
If their values are not correct and their conduct is improper, any future success would be nothing more than a castle in the air, liable to collapse unexpectedly.
Even if it doesn’t collapse, it might mostly become a source of disaster.
Wang Shouzhe in his past life on Earth had seen and heard of many such situations.
The children had their independent thoughts, opposing the educator’s teaching methods and prejudices, which in itself was not a problem.
However, the means they employed involved too little thought, acting based merely on momentary feelings, a point Wang Shouzhe did not agree with.
Moreover, the educator was old, and had worked diligently for the Wang Family all his life, and even if his thoughts were truly outdated and no longer suited the present Wang Family, he shouldn’t be treated in such a manner.
As such.
Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan concealed their identities. Together with their two children, they helped construct the riverbank, allowing them to truly experience the hardships faced by their ancestors during the early days of pioneering in Ping’an Town.
Concealing their identity also allowed them to interact more with ordinary children and civilians.
Preventing them from developing a sense of superiority, feeling inherently like young masters or ladies.
During this period, even Wang Shouzhe and Liua Ruolan gained many life insights, feeling the struggles of ordinary people’s survival.
They also sensed the willingness of people to follow Ping’an Wang Family in building a homeland, aiming to create a secure haven for future generations.
Naturally, it also served as a solid lesson for their children, greatly benefiting their future life paths.
...
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, summer had ended, and autumn had arrived.
Under the leadership of the direct disciple of Purple Mansion Academy, Faang You’an, the disastrous aftermath of the flood was gradually being addressed.
Disaster victims were being settled, affected areas began to be reconstructed, and everything was being organized systematically, reviving hope amidst the ruins.
However, within these short two to three months, the entire Changning Guard was in a state of undercurrent and turmoil.
The old Eighth-Grade Noble Family, Changning Xu Family, completely fell out with the Qianma Huangfu Family and entered into conflict.
Their battle focused on raw silk, a particular material.
Raw silk prices in Changning Guard, and its surroundings, continued to rise repeatedly, increasing more than threefold in a short period compared to the original price.
Some astute merchants even transported raw silk from distant locations, making substantial profits in the process.
However, the two families seemed unwilling to stop, continuing to compete with high prices to seize the outputs from various families’ Silkworm Manors.
In less than three months, both sides had invested over 200,000 Qian Gold.
There was no doubt that this was a battle that caused damage to both sides.
This was no longer a mere commercial activity but a life-or-death struggle to completely drive the other out of this industry.
Even though the City Guardian’s Mansion attempted to mediate multiple times, neither side showed any intention of stopping, much like two gamblers blinded by loss, continuously raising stakes until one side could no longer withstand and collapsed.
Their decisions were clear to any discerning onlookers.
Behind the Qianma Huangfu Family faintly stood the support of the Celestial Human Huangfu Family, while the Changning Xu Family was not fighting alone, backed by their in-laws, the Ping’an Wang Family.
Wang Zongwei of the Ping’an Wang Family was the link among them.
Over the past few months, he had almost become a resident of Changning Town.
On this day,
Changning Ping’an Wang’s Fish Stall.
A luxurious carriage slowly made its way down the street.
The shop assistants and vendors around all cast curious glances at the carriage.
"That’s the carriage of Young Master Zongwei, right," a vendor remarked, "heading to the main residence of the Changning Xu Family again."
"Tsk tsk, Young Master Zongwei has been quite impressive these past two months. He is the link between the Ping’an Wang Family and the Changning Xu Family, and now that the Changning Xu Family is in such fierce conflict with the Qianma Huangfu Family in the raw silk industry, all relying on the Ping’an Wang Family for financial backing, Young Master Zongwei’s status has certainly risen."
"If the Changning Xu Family manages to establish their footing, Young Master Zongwei will surely become a highly sought-after figure in the future."
Amid a series of discussions, the carriage headed toward the east city.
What no one knew was,
Inside this carriage was not only Wang Zongwei but also a woman dressed in an exceedingly alluring and enchanting manner.
She exuded a captivating charm, seeming to convey an enticing aura in every smile and glance.
Yet, Wang Zongwei sat upright, keeping his head down, not daring to look at her.
As if the woman before him was an untouchable femme fatale.
"Hehe," the seductive woman giggled charmingly, "Young Master Zongwei, are you afraid I’ll eat you? I’ve heard you’ve won quite a bit recently at the Fortune Gambling House."
"Well...," a drop of cold sweat trickled down Wang Zongwei’s forehead, his voice shaky as he replied, "Miss Mei, please don’t joke. I’m just following orders. Otherwise, I wouldn’t dare return to the gambling house."
Though she was only of household general status, there were clear differences between household generals. Moreover, her means were formidable, seemingly observing through the eyes everywhere, being fully aware of every move.
If he offended her, he feared there wouldn’t be any good days ahead.
"Oh, it’s no fun seeing you so nervous," the seductive lady giggled, then suddenly turned serious, "But, don’t get the titles wrong. From now on, I am to be called—Lady Jii."
"Yes, Lady Jii," Wang Zongwei responded honestly, hesitant as he asked, "May I know if there’s anything important Lady Jii needs from me this time?"
At the mention of business, the seductive woman adopted a serious expression, a hint of fanaticism passing through her eyes: "I’ve received the patriarch’s secret order; the entire net has been set, and action can be taken. Here is the secret order document from the patriarch, commanding you to fully cooperate with this major operation."
At the mention of a major operation, Wang Zhongwei’s eyes tightened as he checked the secret order to ensure its authenticity.
Despite feeling a tinge of fear, he maintained a solemn tone: "For the ancestors, for the Wang Family, and for the sake of my wife and children."
"I’ll obey Lady Jii’s instructions."
"Hehe!" Lady Jii’s laughter was exceptionally enchanting and alluring, "Young Master Zongwei needn’t be so nervous. Your task isn’t difficult, yet the merit points are tremendously high. It’s quite enviable indeed."
Though the laughter made Wang Zongwei’s hair stand on end, a slight fervor passed through his heart.
No doubt, this time his task offered high merit points.
If he could earn enough merit points, along with some borrowing, he could afford a Spirit Awakening Pill and a drop of Stone Marrow for his child.
With the Stone Marrow and Spirit Awakening Pill, Shining’s future starting point would be much higher.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 61: Vicious Poisonous Woman! Lady Jii
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 61: Vicious Poisonous Woman! Lady Jii
...
Fortune Gambling House.
One of the three major money-draining pits of the Changning Guard.
It is said that at the beginning of the development of Changning Guard, Fortune Gambling House already stood firmly on this land.
Some of the pioneers, after accumulating wealth, would often splurge thousands of gold at the gambling house, with the result being mostly tragic.
The hidden owner of Fortune Gambling House is very secretive, some say it is the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, some say it is the Celestial Human Lei Family, and others claim it is the first generation City Lord secretly controlling everything behind the scenes.
But none admit to it.
After all, making money through a gambling house could be considered a blemish for the noble families standing on high.
In any case, the background of this Fortune Gambling House is unfathomable. To this day, no one has been able to owe the gambling house money and not repay it.
At the gambling house entrance, Wang Zongwei’s carriage slowly came to a stop.
This is a three-story pavilion with a rather substantial footprint, adorned with carved beams and painted rafters, a scene of splendor. The tall vermilion-painted archway at the entrance is made quite grand, and at first glance, it resembles a restaurant more than a gambling house.
Only the fabric banner hanging under the archway, embroidered with the word "gambling," swaying slightly in the early autumn breeze, signifies its identity as a gambling house.
At the entrance of the gambling house, a few burly men in standard gambling house uniforms stood with their hands behind their backs at both sides of the threshold. They were Black Tortoise cultivators specially raised by the gambling house to oversee the place and deter troublemakers. Their cultivation seemed to be at the fifth or sixth layer of the Qi Refining Stage, quite strong indeed.
Before Wang Zongwei could get down from the carriage, a middle-aged man came out to greet him with a smiling face.
Following behind him were several personal attendants who were not weak in strength.
The middle-aged man had a small mustache, and his appearance gave off a vibe of amiability and wealth; he was none other than the second shopkeeper of the Fortune Gambling House, Ding Youde.
Just listening to his name and looking at his appearance, one might think he was a person of great virtue and prestige. However, only those familiar with him, or those who suffered losses because of him, would know how ruthless Ding Youde truly was.
"Young Master Zongwei." Ding Youde greeted him with a smile, personally helping Wang Zongwei down from the carriage, "It’s been about seven or eight days since you last visited, could it be you’re dissatisfied with the way Brother Youde has been hosting you?"
"Not at all, not at all."
At this time, Wang Zongwei was already in his thirties, sporting a small moustache, exuding the vibe of a mature man who has achieved success in his career.
He laughed, "I just won too much a few times back, and I feared that Elder Brother might dislike me, and wouldn’t welcome me anymore."
Ding Youde was taken aback, but then burst into hearty laughter, "Young Master Zongwei sure knows how to joke. In running a gambling house, winning and losing are purely matters of luck. How could there be a reason for us not to welcome a distinguished guest just because they won a bit of money?"
"Young Master Zongwei has been on an unstoppable winning streak recently, blessed with great fortune. Winning money is only natural. Even if you drive our gambling house to bankruptcy, that would be your skill."
"Just joking around, Brother Youde, don’t take it to heart." Wang Zongwei coolly smiled, then walked into the Fortune Gambling House with Ding Youde.
The Fortune Gambling House was as lively as ever, with the main hall crowded with male and female gamblers at each table.
No matter when, gamblers are never in shortage; there are always people addicted to the thrill of winning without working for it.
"Young Master Zongwei, would you like to warm up your hands in the main hall first, or should I arrange a private room for you?" Ding Youde asked warmly.
"A person’s luck is limited, how could one waste it on small games here?" Wang Zongwei swept a glance at the main hall with his hands behind his back, looking rather disinterested.
The bets in the main hall were generally small. Many tables were still calculating wagers in large copper units, and even at the more advanced tables, the wins and losses amounted to merely dozens of Qian Gold by day’s end.
Back when he was twenty and careless, he gambled outside at such games.
"That’s true." Ding Youde smilingly flattered, "Young Master Zongwei, someone of your stature, surely shouldn’t be playing with these peasants."
Having said that, he led Wang Zongwei upstairs to the private rooms.
The decor on the second floor was much more refined than on the first floor. Not only were the floors covered with thick carpets, but the small tables in the corridors were all made of Golden Rattan Wood, and exquisite calligraphy and paintings hung on the walls, making it much classier than the first floor.
Along both sides of the corridor was a row of private rooms.
These private rooms were clearly soundproofed, as standing in the corridor, one could only faintly hear the blurry sounds of shouting and laughter from inside the rooms, unable to discern any specific conversations.
The levels of the private rooms varied, with "Human" rooms starting at a hundred Qian Gold, and "Heaven" rooms starting at a thousand Qian Gold, to cater to customers of different levels.
These past two or three months, Wang Zongwei had been playing in the "Human" rooms, gradually winning a couple of thousand Qian Gold.
"This time, I’ll play in the ’Earth’ room." Wang Zongwei said, "I’ve already won quite a bit from your gambling house before; if luck is not on my side today, I’ll lose it all."
Yet, despite his words, a glint of greed flashed in his eyes.
Evidently, he had great confidence in his recent luck.
"Young Master Zongwei is indeed bold."
Ding Youde couldn’t wait for him to place larger bets, so naturally, he praised him fervently along with the personal attendants.
In conversation, they all walked into the "Earth" room.
Compared to the corridor, the decor inside the room was even more luxurious. Not only was the carpet craftsmanship more complex and exquisite, but the antique ornaments and paintings used for display were also of a higher grade. Setting up this single room, just from these antiques and paintings alone, might have cost no less than a couple of thousand Qian Gold.
A red copper incense burner stood on the tall stand by the wall, burning a seductive incense, filling the room with swirling smoke, giving it a mysterious and enticing atmosphere that elevated adrenaline levels.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 61: Vicious Poisonous Woman! Lady Jii_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 61: Vicious Poisonous Woman! Lady Jii_2
Every gambler in the "Earth" numbered private room is accompanied and served by beautiful maidservants, and even the dealers at the gambling tables are meticulously trained beauties. Not only are their actions swift and skillful, but their appearances are pleasing to the eye.
It’s still early today, and aside from the maidservants and dealers, there are no other people in the Earth numbered room. It’s not surprising, since the wins and losses in the Earth numbered room easily reach hundreds or thousands of Qian Gold, it’s not every day that wealthy guests visit.
Wang Zongwei’s eyes lit up, looking at the stunning maidservants and dealers, his eyes squinting in an enamored manner.
"Is Young Master Zongwei satisfied?"
With a face full of smiles, Ding Youde’s eyes inadvertently passed a trace of contempt.
"Good! Exchange five hundred Qian Gold chips for me first."
Wang Zongwei, full of interest, pulled out a pile of Gold Notes.
Two beautiful maidservants assisted him to the gambling table, and thoughtfully exchanged chips for him and brewed a pot of Spirit Tea.
Wang Zongwei, holding the chips, immediately lit up and joined the gambling.
"You two attend to Young Master Zongwei well." After instructing, Ding Youde departed with a smile, "I won’t disturb Young Master Zongwei’s winnings."
He also knew that once a gambler enters the zone, they dislike disturbances around them.
Sure enough, Wang Zongwei waved his hand, not even blinking an eyelid.
After leaving the Earth numbered private room, Ding Youde gestured to his personal attendants to guard the door, then headed straight to the third floor.
Third floor.
Inside a heavily guarded room, a middle-aged man in his forties or fifties, dressed in Gorgeous Clothing, was lying on a comfortable Master’s Chair, puffing on a tobacco pipe.
His complexion was somewhat sallow, appearing as if his body had been drained.
Beside him, two seductive and alluring women were serving him submissively.
"Chief Shopkeeper Huang." Ding Youde reported cautiously, "That Wang Zongwei has returned to the gambling den. Clearly, the bait we laid out, let him taste the sweetness. However, this time he’s in the ’Earth’ numbered private room, obviously aiming for a big win. How should we deal with him? Awaiting Chief Shopkeeper Huang’s guidance."
Chief Shopkeeper Huang, eyes half-closed, spoke indifferently: "It’s about time. Since he’s come to us, let’s close the net."
"Yes, Chief Shopkeeper."
Ding Youde responded, a trace of cruelty flashing in his eyes.
Wang Zongwei, oh Wang Zongwei, do you really think you’re fortuitous beyond measure?
Ding Youde snickered inwardly.
I’ve been flattering you for almost three months, it’s about time you pay back with interest.
Meanwhile.
In the Earth numbered room, Wang Zongwei had good luck and soon won over a hundred chips of Qian Gold.
The two beautiful maidservants flattered him cheerfully: "Young Master Zongwei truly has great luck! Seems today you’re set to conquer."
"Hahaha, indeed, lately my fortune has been remarkable." Wang Zongwei laughed heartily, rewarding each maidservant with a Qian Gold chip.
"Thank you, Young Master Zongwei!" The maidservants’ eyes brimmed with allure, almost sticking to him.
As if confirming Wang Zongwei’s words, moments later, he won another hundred plus Qian Gold.
Under the maidservants’ constant flattery, he felt light-hearted like an immortal, quickly agreeing to the maidservants’ suggestion to increase his bets while his luck was good.
But in a blink, before he knew it, the more than two hundred Qian Gold chips he won were lost completely.
Wang Zongwei seemed anxious.
After losing several rounds in a row, he increased his bets hoping to win back the lost chips.
But the more he did so, the more his wishes went against him.
After about an incense stick’s time, the five hundred chips he exchanged were also gone.
"Young Master Zongwei’s luck isn’t good today." One maidservant advised, "Why not stop now and come again next time?"
"It was just a temporary mishap." The other maidservant immediately advised sweetly, "Young Master Zongwei, your fortune covers the heavens, you’ll surely win back quickly."
"Exchange another one thousand Qian Gold chips!"
Wang Zongwei’s breath grew hurried, having already lost five hundred Qian Gold today, seemingly unwilling.
The two maidservants gazed at Wang Zongwei with admiring eyes: "Young Master Zongwei truly is bold, even the legitimate sons of Eighth and Ninth-Grade Noble Families lack this courage."
With the thousand Qian Gold chips, Wang Zongwei seemed more cautious, calculating much during betting, and gradually, he won some again.
But as the maidservants magnified the Enchanting Soup effect, Wang Zongwei became elated again, gambling recklessly.
In a losing more than winning situation, the mere thousand Qian Gold didn’t last long before it was all lost.
"Exchange another two thousand Qian Gold chips." Wang Zongwei slammed the table, seeming somewhat frantic.
Half a quarter of an hour later.
"Another two thousand Qian Gold!" His low, hoarse shout echoed again.
Thus, in this repeated cycle, his eyes were now bloodshot, his Gorgeous Clothing torn, revealing his chest, hair messy, body drenched in sweat.
He took a powerful gulp of Spirit Tea, frustrated: "Give me another two thousand!"
But this time, the previously obedient maidservants ignored him and withdrew to the side, bowing.
"You..."
Wang Zongwei angrily turned back to scold.
However, his words stopped abruptly.
Because in the Earth numbered room, Ding Youde and numerous personal attendants had already quietly gathered behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 61: Vicious Woman! Lady Jii_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 61: Vicious Woman! Lady Jii_3
His smile was somewhat sinister: "Young Master Zongwei, that’s enough for today. Why not come and play another day?"
Wang Zongwei suddenly felt a chill, as if sensing something was off, and immediately regained some clarity: "Brother Youde is right, luck is not on my side today, it’s not suitable to continue, so I’ll take my leave first."
As he spoke, Wang Zongwei lowered his head and walked out of the room.
"Hold on."
Ding Youde clasped his hands behind his back and sneered coldly.
As soon as he spoke, several burly personal attendants immediately blocked the door, trapping Wang Zongwei inside the "Earth" room.
"Brother Youde, what is the meaning of this?" Wang Zongwei’s face turned somewhat pale.
"Young Master Zongwei, our casino has its rules," Ding Youde said, his smile not reaching his eyes, "The young master should settle the debts before leaving."
"Debt? How much do I owe?" Wang Zongwei’s face grew more uncomfortable, sensing something was amiss.
Ding Youde took out a stack of signed notes at a leisurely pace: "Young Master Zongwei has exchanged a total of 8,600 Qian Gold today, 500 of which have been paid, leaving 8,100 Qian Gold outstanding. Young Master Zongwei, please settle the account."
"Over 8,000 Qian Gold?!"
Wang Zongwei’s expression was both shocked and angry, mixed with disbelief.
He had only played for less than two hours, how could he have lost so much?
"Young Master Zongwei may want to take a closer look." Ding Youde sneered, "Every single note here is clearly black and white paper. If you don’t agree, I will have the brothers ’help’ you recall."
Wang Zongwei hurriedly went over to check the notes.
Sure enough, each one was authentic.
He had unknowingly accrued such a debt.
He immediately broke out in a cold sweat and bowed to Ding Youde: "Brother Youde, these notes are indeed correct. But I left in a hurry this time and didn’t bring that much money. How about..."
Before he could finish, Ding Youde interrupted him with a wave of his hand.
He smiled gloomily: "No worries, no worries. As long as Young Master Zongwei signs, I will take the brothers to the Ping’an Wang Family and ask Wang Shouzhe for the money."
"Go to my fourth uncle to collect the debt?!" Wang Zongwei shivered all over, both shocked and angry, "Brother Youde, this is too much! Are you not pushing me to the brink? Rest assured, I will repay this debt soon."
"Bah!" Ding Youde sneered, "With the meager support of Wang Zongwei, only God knows when you’ll repay this debt? It seems Young Master Zongwei has yet to realize the situation. People, help the young master wake up!"
"Brother Youde! Don’t be impulsive! Ah, ah, ah~~~~~"
A series of screams instantly echoed in the "Earth" room.
...
Dusk was gradually falling.
Outside Changning Guard City, there was a manor understated yet lavish.
This manor was under the name of a distant, unknown wealthy individual, but in reality, it was the secret palace of the Celestial Human Clan Leader Huangfu Jinhuan, where many clandestine conversations took place.
It can be said that this seemingly ordinary manor frequently influences some of the changing dynamics of Changning Guard.
The sky grew darker, yet the manor remained brightly lit.
Beneath all the corridors hung intricately crafted palace lanterns, illuminating the courtyard as if it were daylight, with lush green trees and red flowers, rich and vibrant.
