At this moment, deep inside the manor’s conference hall, three people were sitting together in secret talks.
These three, two men and one woman, were all dressed in embroidered robes, their demeanor extraordinary.
In the corner of the room, a red copper incense burner emitted curling smoke like ethereal mist, paired with the exquisite and luxurious furnishings, making the place resemble an Immortal Palace. It also imbued the seated trio with an additional touch of immortal aura.
Logically, Huangfu Jinhuan was the true owner of this manor, yet sitting in the main seat was a woman in her thirties, exceptionally attractive, alluring, and charming.
She was born with amorous peach blossom eyes, even her posture while lounging was lazy to the core, yet her demeanor was like that of an Immortal Consort, commanding a kind of transcendent nobility, as if everyone was born to heed her.
Her luxurious spiritual silk brocade robe, intricately embroidered, and the huge Sea Spirit Pearl embedded in her embroidered shoes, all bespoke her extraordinary identity.
Behind her stood two elder men, one on each side, who appeared unremarkable.
They seemed simple and reserved, yet only true masters could sense the terrifying power within them.
Indeed, these two elders were Spirit Platform Realm Cultivators.
For some eighth and ninth-grade Black Tortoise Noble Families, each Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator was an ancestor at home, esteemed and a pillar of support.
Yet they stood behind this woman, their heads bowed, seeming like two loyal old servants.
This, in turn, highlighted the woman’s even more extraordinary background.
She leaned nonchalantly on the main seat, as if it were only natural.
Meanwhile, the illustrious Huangfu Jinhuan sat on the secondary seat, a faintly ingratiating expression on his initially dignified face.
As for the other middle-aged man, he was the Clan Leader of the Qianma Huangfu Family, Huangfu Deyun.
This Clan Leader of an eighth-grade Noble Family was a notable figure throughout Changning Guard. Yet here, he merely occupied the last seat.
In fact, having a seat at all was still lucky.
Did you not see that the two Spirit Platform Realm Cultivators behind the woman could only stand like old servants?

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 61: Vicious Poisonous Woman! Lady Jii_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 61: Vicious Poisonous Woman! Lady Jii_4
Therefore, Huangfu Deyun was not seated firmly, but only had half his backside on the chair, leaning his upper body forward, looking extremely deferential.
Indeed, this enchanting and alluring woman, with her noble and extraordinary demeanor, was Lady Jii!
Lady Jii’s seductive face showed some displeasure: "Patriarch Deyun, you previously promised to swiftly eliminate your rivals and completely control the raw silk and silk industry. And you promised to expand the raw silk production base to encompass the entire Changning Guard and its surrounding regions within twenty years, making it one of the supply bases for our Jii Family."
"But now, dealing with a minor Eighth-Grade Noble Family like the Changning Xu Family has proven so challenging. Aren’t you going to give me an explanation?"
In the face of Lady Jii’s imposing pressure, Huangfu Deyun appeared slightly panicked, wiping the sweat from his forehead, he said, "Lady Jii, I don’t know what has gotten into Changning Xu Family? They’ve gone mad, competing with us for raw silk materials, but rest assured, they won’t hold out much longer."
"Can’t hold out? Lady Jii let out a series of cold laughs, "I heard that the Ping’an Wang Family is backing the Changning Xu Family."
"Although the Ping’an Wang Family is also just an Eighth-Grade Noble Family, it’s said that their territories are well-managed and financially solid."
Huangfu Deyun was at a loss for words, looking at Huangfu Jinhuan as if pleading for help.
"Ahem!" Huangfu Jinhuan’s expression turned serious and said, "Lady Jii, do not worry. The Ping’an Wang Family is only secretly supporting the Changning Xu Family financially due to their marriage ties. If we intensify our efforts in the confrontation, the Changning Xu Family will eventually crumble. We assure you that the interests of the Longzuo Jii Family will not be delayed."
"Hmph! I hope so." Lady Jii’s expression eased slightly, "Both Patriarchs of the Huangfu Family, our Jii Family trusts in your absolute control in the Changning Guard, which is why we chose you as partners. If you truly can’t resolve this, don’t blame us for being ruthless when the time comes."
With that, Lady Jii stood up, flicked her sleeves, and left.
The two old servants from the Spirit Platform Realm followed suit, not even lifting their eyelids.
Huangfu Jinhuan and Huangfu Deyun stood up, cupped their hands, and bid farewell: "Lady Jii, do not worry. We will resolve this issue as quickly as possible."
Lady Jii did not look back, gradually walking away, disappearing from the two men’s sight.
After she left.
Huangfu Deyun’s face turned somewhat unpleasant as he said, "Uncle Jinhuan, if the Ping’an Wang Family is dead set on supporting the Changning Xu Family, what shall we do?"
"Hmph." Huangfu Jinhuan’s gaze was unpredictable, sneering, "Having the opportunity to cooperate with the Jii Family and become one of their primary silk supply bases is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for our Huangfu Family. Whoever stands in our way, I, Huangfu Jinhuan, will not spare them."
The Changning Huangfu Family is a family capable of normal Celestial-Human succession.
But without a doubt.
To satisfy the Celestial-Human succession, most resources are prioritized for the Celestial Human Seeds.
Although Huangfu Jinhuan is the Clan Leader, he’s not the next Celestial Human Seed. Unless there are excess resources and the family advances towards the Sixth Grade after satisfying the Celestial-Human succession, he might then obtain resources to cultivate to the Celestial Human Realm.
The Longzuo Jii Family.
Is a well-known old Sixth-Grade Noble Family in the entire Longzuo County.
The family’s foundation is unfathomably deep, with numerous Celestial Humans in the family, and a substantial number of Spirit Platform Realms, just half a step away from the Fifth-Grade Purple Mansion.
This time, their external cooperation and move into the silk industry are clearly to position themselves for promotion to the Fifth-Grade Family.
As long as they firmly cling to the Jii Family’s coattails and transform the Changning Guard and surrounding areas into a raw silk-silk base.
The Huangfu Race will then have the qualification to ascend to the Sixth Grade, and Huangfu Jinhuan will have the capital to strive for the Celestial Human Realm.
Thinking of this, a fervent gleam flashed in Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes. With enough resources, he too had a chance to reach for the Celestial Human Realm, even if only with a two to three chance, he would still go for it.
"Uncle Jinhuan," Huangfu Deyun frowned, "after thinking through this matter, I still find something fishy about it. We dared to increase our purchase capital because we have received the Jii Family’s advanced technology. Yet, even with the Jii Family’s advanced technology, at this point in the competition, we would still suffer considerable losses."
"But why are the Ping’an Wang Family and the Changning Xu Family so audacious? If we incur substantial losses, wouldn’t they be bottomless?"
"Why, with such losses, are they still tenaciously holding on, competing with us for raw silk resources?"
Huangfu Jinhuan said in a deep voice, "Indeed, there is something fishy about this. Initially, I thought the Changning Xu Family was simply making a last-ditch effort. However, things are likely more complicated now. Fortunately, I have already laid out some plans; it should be time to close the net."
While the two were talking.
Huangfu Jinhuan’s personal guard came in to report, whispering a few words in his ear.
Huangfu Jinhuan’s expression turned serious, and he said, "Quickly invite Chief Shopkeeper Huang’s men in."
In a short moment.
A young and capable man walked in, saluted Huangfu Jinhuan, took out a thick secret letter, and handed it over, saying respectfully, "Our shopkeeper said, fortunately, we did not fail in our mission."
"Good, good, good." Huangfu Jinhuan stroked his beard and smiled, "I must see what tricks the Ping’an Wang Family and the Changning Xu Family are playing in secret?"
He took the thick secret letter, opened it, and as he read, the smile on his face gradually froze, becoming increasingly grim!
"Bang!"
An exquisite purple sandalwood table pulverized in his palm.
"Good, good, good!"
"Xu Family, Wang Family, you are courting death!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 62: Suddenly Gained a Wife for No Reason! Being the Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 62: Suddenly Gained a Wife for No Reason! Being the Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy
...
"Uncle Jinhuan, what exactly happened?" Huangfu Deyun was a little on edge, sensing that something was amiss.
Recent changes have indeed been overwhelming, often catching people off guard.
"Hmph~ see for yourself!"
Huangfu Jinhuan’s face was extremely unsightly as he handed the secret letter to Huangfu Deyun.
After a close read, Huangfu Deyun’s expression immediately changed: "No wonder the Ping’an Wang Family dares to join forces with the Changning Xu Family to oppose us. It turns out they have already achieved a major breakthrough in silk reeling and weaving technology."
"Even though the price of raw silk has more than tripled due to the competition between the two sides, they can still turn a profit because of technological breakthroughs. No wonder, no wonder they dare to compete with us! Damn~~~"
He was suddenly in a panic.
This time, the gamble on cooperation with the Jii Family, though silently led by the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, was heavily anticipated by their Qianma Huangfu Family, who also invested almost all their funds.
If it fails, the Qianma Huangfu Family will surely be severely injured, and centuries of accumulated wealth will vanish overnight.
Moreover, this is not the worst part.
The worst part is that not only have the two families joined forces, but they also brought in the Golden Sand Xu Family.
There was originally a tributary in Golden Sand Town; because the sands in that area contained gold, it once attracted numerous family loose cultivators to Gold Town to pan for gold.
That place was once extremely chaotic, and there were countless conflicts. However, centuries have passed, the gold in Golden Sand Town has long been exhausted, and with the land being barren and most places unsuitable for cultivation, it gradually became desolate.
Only the Golden Sand Xu Family continued to hold onto that area, slowly developing their family. Now, relying on their abilities, they have gradually established a foothold.
"If what’s said in the secret letter is true," Huangfu Deyun’s face was heavy and gloomy, "Ping’an Wang Family’s new technology can actually use water wheels as a power source to process cocoons into raw silk. The poor place of Golden Sand Town, because of the Golden Sand River, has crisscrossing waterways and rapid currents, and with large tracts of wasteland, is most suitable for building silk reeling and weaving workshops."
Huangfu Jinhuan sneered continuously: "That Wang Shouzhe of Ping’an Wang Family is truly a remarkable talent. I thought of waiting until those from the Purple Mansion Academy left before arranging to slowly deal with them, but unexpectedly, they dare to jump out and oppose us. Since that’s the case, they can’t blame us for being ruthless."
A hint of killing intent flashed in Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes.
"Someone, invite ’Mr. Yin’ here."
"Yes, Patriarch." An attendant immediately took the order and left.
"Mr. Yin?!" Huangfu Deyun was shocked, his eyes a bit worried, "Uncle Jinhuan, the direct disciple from Purple Mansion Academy is still presiding over disaster relief in our Changning Guard. Would inviting Mr. Yin to take action cause..."
"The less we’re suspected during such times. Besides, do we have any other choice at this point?" Huangfu Jinhuan’s gaze was somber, "If this matter isn’t settled, is Lady Jii easy to deal with? Her patience is thin, and we cannot bear the wrath of the Longzuo Jii Family."
Huangfu Deyun’s eyes were indecisive, as if he wanted to say something but stopped.
"Rest assured, Deyun." Huangfu Jinhuan began to reassure, "Though the matter with the Xu Family and Wang Family is disgusting to us, from another perspective, if handled correctly, their two clans can instead make a wedding dress for us."
"Think about it, if we can obtain more advanced silk reeling and weaving technologies, as well as the raw silk materials they’ve stockpiled at great cost, we can expand ourselves through cooperation with the Jii Family. In the future, not to mention becoming a Sixth-Grade Noble Family, even a Fifth-Grade Purple Mansion Family is within reach."
At that point, Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes were filled with a fervent meaning.
He was not content to remain merely a Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator for life and also wanted to reach the Celestial Human Realm to see that extraordinary scenery.
If there’s also a chance to glimpse the Purple Mansion, he would be content for this life.
These words likewise provided considerable stimulation to Huangfu Deyun.
Which family doesn’t want to rise, to achieve higher status, strength, and power!
If the Changning Huangfu Family has the opportunity to become a Sixth-Grade Family, then their Qianma Huangfu Family would have the qualifications to become a Seventh-Grade Family, and all family members would thrive accordingly.
Not long after.
The close attendant led a man in a black robe into the room.
The man in the black robe had a rather ordinary demeanor, but his face, hidden under the hood, was slightly pale, as if he hadn’t seen sunlight for a long time.
But on closer inspection, one would find that his eyes were almost void of any emotion, like the icy waters of an eternal deep pool, unsettling in their stillness.
As this person arrived, both Huangfu Jinhuan and Huangfu Deyun promptly stood up, bowing and greeting him: "Greetings, Mr. Yin."
Mr. Yin’s eyes, as calm as an ancient well, scanned them lightly, his tone indifferent and cold: "Huangfu Jinhuan, what about the results of the investigation I entrusted you with a while back?"
Huangfu Jinhuan hurriedly said: "Mr. Yin, you should know that the direct disciple Faang You’an of the Purple Mansion Academy is currently stationed at my Changning Guard, so I truly dare not openly investigate. However, there have been some leads. If you give me a bit more time, I can definitely find out who has robbed the young master’s treasure."

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 62: Gaining a Wife Out of Nowhere! Being a Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 62: Gaining a Wife Out of Nowhere! Being a Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy_2
"Hmph~"
Mr. Yin sneered with a cold smile: "Huangfu Jinhuan, it’s been almost three months, yet you’ve found nothing. If my young master arrives at the Changning Guard and you still haven’t produced any results, neither you nor I will gain any benefits!"
"Mr. Yin, don’t worry," Huangfu Jinhuan said earnestly. "The young master’s affairs will certainly be my priority. However, I also have a matter that I would like Mr. Yin to assist me with."
As he spoke, Huangfu Jinhuan explained to Mr. Yin what he wanted to be done.
Mr. Yin’s eyelids slightly lifted as he said coldly: "Huangfu Jinhuan, you just said that there’s a direct disciple of the Purple Mansion Academy commanding disaster relief in Changning Guard, yet you want us to take action and commit such a serious crime. Are you overestimating me or underestimating the direct disciples of the Purple Mansion Academy?!"
"Please rest assured, Mr. Yin," Huangfu Jinhuan said confidently, "Since I’ve decided to have you take action, everything will naturally be arranged properly. Just recently, my ancestral forefather achieved minor success in cultivating the ’Red Dragon True Technique’ and has just come out of seclusion. It’s a perfect opportunity to fulfill our duty as hosts and extend our gratitude to the people of the Purple Mansion Academy."
"This time, not only will we invite people from the Purple Mansion Academy, but we will also host all the heads of the eighth-grade noble families, including the Changning Xu Family, the Ping’an Wang Family, and the Qianma Huangfu Family. This way, you can take the opportunity to act."
"In short, we’ll catch them off guard and attack where they’re least prepared. With Mr. Yin’s abilities, along with the support of the two Spirit Platform Realm ancestors from the Qianma Huangfu Family, how could this plan possibly fail?"
According to his estimate, the workshop on the Golden Sand Xu Family’s side likely has only two or three Spirit Platform Realm cultivators stationed. Even under the assumption of strong defense, this many Spirit Platform Realm cultivators acting together guarantees success without any risk.
To alleviate Mr. Yin’s concerns, Huangfu Jinhuan added, "I will arrange an escape route for you, Mr. Yin, ensuring that Faang You’an won’t be able to trace the slightest evidence."
Mr. Yin’s eyes narrowed slightly. Instead of immediately agreeing, he said, "It doesn’t sound difficult, but why should we kill and silence people for you and then take the blame?"
Huangfu Jinhuan laughed heartily, "Mr. Yin, you’re mistaken. We’re partners, after all, and naturally should look out for each other. As long as Mr. Yin accomplishes this task, we Huangfu Family will spare no effort in assisting with the young master’s matters as well."
Upon hearing this, a sharp glint flashed in the once calm eyes of Mr. Yin.
After a long pause, he agreed: "Huangfu Jinhuan, do not forget what you’ve said today. I’m sure you’re aware of my young master’s temper."
With that, Mr. Yin made a slight bow and then turned to leave, leaving behind only one sentence.
"Inform me whenever you’re ready."
After people left.
Huangfu Deyun’s eyes were heavy with worry, "Uncle Jinhuan, our constant entanglement with them is far too dangerous. If things are exposed, I’m afraid we won’t have a place in the entire Daqian."
"Deyun, don’t worry," Huangfu Jinhuan said coldly, "I’ve already given this matter a lot of thought. Ultimately, we’re still too weak. If we could reach fifth-grade, no, sixth-grade, it would be easy to sever ties with them. Right now, we still need to rely on their strength to get things done."
After a pause, Huangfu Jinhuan instructed, "Deyun, this is a significant matter, and it must be led by the two elders of the Qianma Huangfu Family. We need to make it known that it was a passing disciple from the Yin Sha Sect who committed the crime, and that it has nothing to do with us."
"Once successful, it will mark the joint rise of our two families."
Huangfu Deyun’s face turned solemn, and he bowed, "Yes, Uncle Jinhuan."
...
Several days later, a major event occurred in the Changning Guard.
One of the two seventh-grade noble families within the Changning Guard, the ancestor of the Changning Huangfu Family, Ancestor Hua Ye, came out of seclusion.
Always low-key, he declared that he had achieved minor success in the cultivation of the ’Red Dragon True Technique.’
To celebrate, Ancestor Hua Ye decided to hold a banquet at the main residence of the Changning Huangfu Family, inviting all the eighth-grade noble families of the Changning Guard, as well as the group from the Purple Mansion Academy who were overseeing disaster relief.
The ’Red Dragon True Technique’ is a divine skill passed down by the Huangfu Family, said to be an upper grade technique leading directly to the Purple Mansion Realm. Now that he has declared minor success, he is likely smoothing out the early obstacles of the Celestial Human Realm, and it won’t be long before he reaches the middle stage of the Celestial Human Realm.
Currently, Ancestor Hua Ye is only two hundred and sixty or seventy years old. If he manages to smoothly enter the middle stage of the Celestial Human Realm, he might have a chance to glimpse the Purple Mansion in this lifetime.
Unquestionably, he is now at the forefront of the top experts in the Changning Guard.
This is undoubtedly great news for the interests of the Changning Huangfu Family, the Qianma Huangfu Family, and other interest groups. However, for families that oppose it, it is a blow in addition to their troubles, adding more pressure.
And an invitation extended by such a person, even someone as proud as Faang You’an, couldn’t casually refuse.
He immediately replied, expressing his willingness to lead his junior brothers and sisters to accept the invitation.
The Changning Xu Family and the Ping’an Wang Family also received invitations.
On that day,
the southern city area of the Changning Guard became extraordinarily lively, with even some loose cultivators joining in the excitement. For anyone who spoke a few congratulatory words at the gate of the Changning Huangfu Family, there was a reward of two or three Qian Gold.
Loose cultivators, accustomed to poverty, would never miss out on such a good opportunity, and they naturally praised Ancestor Hua Ye’s generosity enthusiastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 62: Suddenly Gained a Wife for No Reason! Being the Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 62: Suddenly Gained a Wife for No Reason! Being the Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy_3
According to Wang Shouzhe, Ancestor Hua Ye’s skill at grabbing the spotlight is no small feat.
Now that Ancestor Hua Ye, the top expert of Changning Guard, had extended an invitation, Wang Shouzhe naturally would not openly offend him.
Following the custom, he prepared enough gifts and leisurely arrived at the south of Changning Guard City by carriage.
The south of Changning Guard City is where the main residence of the Huangfu Family is located. Besides the main residence, there are also many properties belonging to them here, and naturally, the large numbers of direct and collateral descendants of the Huangfu Family.
A family with a history of five hundred years has an extremely large number of direct and collateral descendants. Some of the outstanding ones among them have become the backbone of various industries of the Huangfu Race, providing a continuous flow of financial and material support for the growth of the family.
Let’s set aside idle chatter for now.
As Wang Shouzhe’s carriage, surrounded by his Household Generals, arrived at the south of the city, it was stopped.
The one who stopped the carriage wasn’t someone else, but Household Generals of the Changning Xu Family.
The general had an imposing aura and notable strength, showcasing the heritage of an old Eighth-Grade Noble Family.
He politely cupped his hands and said, "Patriarch Wang, our Patriarch Xu invites you to share a carriage ride."
"Since Uncle Xu has invited, then I won’t refuse,"
Wang Shouzhe was not surprised. He smiled, gave some instructions to his accompanying Household Generals, and publicly boarded the carriage of Patriarch Xu Anbang of the Changning Xu Family, without any intention of hiding the act.
Such a scene would naturally catch the eye of interested parties.
However, it was no secret that the Changning Xu Family and the Ping’an Wang Family were getting closer, joining hands to support and look out for each other, so it wasn’t much of a surprise to anyone.
Yet, as soon as Wang Shouzhe sat in Xu Anbang’s carriage and before he could exchange pleasantries, the carriage was stopped again.
He lifted the curtain and saw a plain and simple old man, like an old servant, standing there. Yet, the aura and strength he held within were not something that could be hidden from a Black Tortoise Cultivator of the Spirit Platform Realm.
There was no doubt that this was a strong person of the Spirit Platform Realm.
The old man cupped his fists toward Wang Shouzhe and said, "Patriarch Shouzhe, my Lady wishes to meet with you."
The corner of Wang Shouzhe’s mouth twitched.
Even with makeup and disguise, could he not recognize his own Ancestor Xiaohan?
Needless to say, the "Lady" in the carriage behind, pretending to be "Lady Jii", was actually Wang Mei.
This was not in his plans, and he had no idea what she was up to.
As he was pondering how to decline, he saw the curtain opposite being lifted, and an exceptionally charming and alluring woman stepped down from that carriage, gracefully approaching him, and looked at him and Xu Anbang with a smile.
"Patriarch Shouzhe, Patriarch Xu, would you two give me the honor?"
Whether for the sake of courtesy or otherwise, Wang Shouzhe and Xu Anbang had no way to refuse any longer, so they politely invited her onto the carriage.
The three of them shared a carriage, heading toward the Huangfu Family’s main residence.
Such a scene naturally quickly reached the ears of Huangfu Jinhuan, who was preparing for the banquet.
Upon hearing the news, he couldn’t help but sneer twice: "That woman with the surname Jii truly has no patience, acting so eagerly. This move of hers, playing both sides, not only applies pressure on us but also allows her to make bets on both ends. What a clever strategy."
Huangfu Deyun, a bit worried, said, "Uncle Jinhuan, could she really be cooperating with the Changning Xu Family and the Ping’an Wang Family?"
"Hmph~ no worries." Huangfu Jinhuan sneered, "After tonight, she’ll know who the true master of Changning Guard is!"
...
At this moment, the aroma of tea filled Xu Anbang’s carriage, but the atmosphere was somewhat awkward.
Actually, the interior of the carriage was already relatively spacious, but with Lady Jii there, Wang Shouzhe and Xu Anbang had to squeeze to one side, sitting opposite Lady Jii.
Lady Jii looked at Wang Shouzhe with seemingly unspeakable grievance in her eyes.
However, Wang Shouzhe ignored her entirely, not sparing her grievances a glance.
Kid me not~ even if she were more aggrieved, he couldn’t sit next to her. Otherwise, this day next year might be his death anniversary~
"Shouzhe, you this..."
Xu Anbang looked at the enchanting Lady Jii, then at Wang Shouzhe. His eyes flickered nervously, feeling somewhat uneasy.
Could it be that he had learned some earth-shattering secret?
"Ahem~ ahem~"
Wang Shouzhe hurriedly coughed twice, explaining to Xu Anbang, "Uncle Xu, this Lady Jii is a business partner of Shouzhe’s. Please don’t misunderstand."
"No misunderstanding, no misunderstanding." Xu Anbang acted as if he understood, nodding repeatedly, "I know, she’s your business partner, definitely not anyone else."
After a pause, Xu Anbang, showing a very loyal demeanor, said, "Don’t worry, Shouzhe, I’ll take this secret to the grave."
"Alright then." Seeing this, Wang Shouzhe knew any further explanation would be futile. He didn’t bother to explain more, glanced at Lady Jii, and said, "Lady Jii, now that you’ve boarded our carriage, aren’t you afraid of Huangfu Jinhuan’s suspicion?"
"Patriarch Shouzhe jests." Lady Jii covered her mouth with a graceful laugh, her eyes sparkling with charm, "I am merely in a cooperative relationship with the Changning Huangfu Family, not one of his subordinates. Do I need to report to him whose carriage I board?"
"Moreover, the idea now is to let him suspect. The more he overthinks, the more his heart will be in turmoil. The more chaotic it gets, the more likely he is to make mistakes."

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 62: Suddenly Gained a Wife for No Reason! Being the Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 62: Suddenly Gained a Wife for No Reason! Being the Young Clan Leader Isn’t Easy_4
She really is a enchantress; a casual smile from her looks ever more captivating. Clearly, she has deeply delved into this aspect. As far as Wang Shouzhe knows, she has collected quite a few charm cultivation techniques!
"What you said makes a lot of sense."
Wang Shouzhe nodded, uninterested in arguing with her further.
She was obviously using public matters for personal gain, yet seamlessly, making recourse meaningless.
He changed the subject: "Uncle Five, is there any urgent matter that prompted you to invite me onto the carriage?"
"No urgency," Xu Anbang stroked his beard and said, "It’s just that when the moment arrives, there’s always a bit of panic in the heart. Besides, I never imagined this turmoil would be orchestrated by Shouzhe."
"Regarding this matter, Shouzhe solemnly apologizes once again, Uncle Five." Wang Shouzhe’s expression became serious, cupping his hands in respect, "Although I have played a role in stirring up this situation, you should also be aware, with the Huangfu Family’s aggression, it was bound that two tigers couldn’t live on one mountain."
"Since the Changning Xu Family wishes to rise to a Seventh-Grade Noble Family, confrontation is inevitable unless Uncle Five is willing for the Changning Xu Family to remain obediently as an Eighth-Grade Noble Family forever."
"Shouzhe, I admit your words make sense," Xu Anbang nodded slightly in agreement and then shifted his tone, "But your scheming to pull our Xu Family into the fray to serve as the vanguard, is not something I can overlook. Today, if you can calculate us, how can you assure me you won’t do it again someday? With that suspicion, the relationship between our two families will only drift further apart."
Hearing his veiled message, Wang Shouzhe smiled: "Then what does Uncle Five mean by that?"
Xu Anbang pretended to ponder deeply before speaking: "Regaining trust is actually simple. If we follow the tradition among noble families, it would be possible. Speaking of which, it’s been some time since there was a marriage alliance between our two direct lineages, hasn’t it?"
"Direct lineage marriage alliance?"
Wang Shouzhe furrowed his brow slightly.
Actually, the Ping’an Wang Family still harbors some resentment over this matter, especially the elders of the Xiao generation who still feel indignant when mentioning that incident from back then.
Seeing Wang Shouzhe’s frown, Xu Anbang immediately understood his concern.
"Shouzhe, I’ve actually heard about Aunt Zhenmei’s incident," he said solemnly, "My father regretted it bitterly his whole life, saying it was his lack of care for Aunt Zhenmei. Because of this matter, my father was depressed his entire life, never reaching the Spirit Platform Realm, and passed away over a decade ago."
At this point, he couldn’t help but sigh.
Indeed, this was the event that caused a decades-long rift between the Ping’an Wang Family and the Changning Xu Family.
The center of this matter was the lady named "Wang Zhen Mei."
She was the fifth generation direct daughter of the Ping’an Wang Family. At that time, when the Wang Family faced calamity, Ancestor Longyan decided to marry Wang Zhen Mei off to the eldest legitimate son of the Changning Xu Family—Xu Guorui.
This was to cement the bloodline relationship between the Wang Family and the Xu Family, and also in hopes that the Xu Family could be a strong support to the Wang Family during their toughest times.
However, plans couldn’t keep up with changes.
Not long after Wang Zhen Mei married into the family, she was pregnant with the bloodline of the direct lineage, but tragically died during childbirth.
At that time, the elders of the Xiao generation even rushed to the Changning Xu Family to cause a ruckus.
Ancestor Longyan was also heartbroken, dragging her frail body to personally investigate the matter, ultimately finding Wang Zhen Mei’s cause of death to be without mystery, indeed it was an accident, hence letting it go.
Yet, even so, the rift was hard to eliminate between both sides.
Especially for the Ping’an Wang Family, the matter has always been a sore spot, thus only marrying within direct veins after that, not involving direct lineages.
Currently, the Xu Family Patriarch, Xu Anbang, is the eldest legitimate son born after Xu Guorui remarried following that era.
If it weren’t so, the current Xu Family’s direct lineage should have had abundant Wang Family bloodline.
Wang Shouzhe hesitated slightly, and said: "Uncle Five, for other matters I can make decisions, but for this matter, Ancestor Longyan must speak first. Moreover, your family doesn’t seem to have a direct lineage that matches with our Miaomiao, right?"
"Shouzhe, please don’t misunderstand," Xu Anbang shook his head and said, "I don’t have my eyes on Miaomiao."
As soon as this was said, Wang Shouzhe’s expression immediately turned cold: "Uncle Five must be looking at our Yaoyao?"
Wang Liyao is his precious darling, who dares to make a move on her?
If Xu Anbang dared to nod even once, let alone Uncle Five being only nominally related, even if it was blood, he wouldn’t hold back from giving a beating!
Facing his gaze, Xu Anbang couldn’t help but shiver.
Even though he is a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, at this moment he still felt uneasy, hastily clarifying: "Shouzhe, please don’t misunderstand. My father once held my hand before passing and said our family owes the Ping’an Wang Family a direct daughter."
Wang Shouzhe was taken aback upon hearing this, his expression slightly relaxed but then puzzled: "Uncle Five, I’m already married."
Xu Anbang quietly breathed a sigh of relief and explained seriously: "You may not know this, but my troublesome son just had a little daughter, two years old now. Though she isn’t the eldest legitimate daughter, she is our family’s direct granddaughter, our precious gem. If you don’t mind, I’d like to have her betrothed to your An’an."
"Marry to An’an?"
Wang Shouzhe’s brows relaxed immediately, contemplating inwardly.
Currently, the Changning Xu Family and Ping’an Wang Family are like grasshoppers tied on the same rope, no, comrades in arms! To be honest, without direct lineage marriage, the connection and bond between them is indeed too fragile.
Mutual suspicion, cooperation under apprehension, isn’t a good long-term prospect for either family.
Direct lineage marriage is indeed imperative.
"Alright, I agree to this marriage." Wang Shouzhe, being straightforward, decided immediately, "Once this situation passes, I’ll arrange to propose to the Xu Family."
The Changning Xu Family is an old Eighth-Grade Noble Family, with a profound heritage. If the plan goes smoothly, there is a high possibility of becoming a Seventh-Grade Noble Family in the future.
For a Celestial Human Family’s direct granddaughter, it wouldn’t be a disgrace to Wang Zong’an.
"Very well, very well." Seeing Wang Shouzhe agree, Xu Anbang clearly breathed a sigh of relief, "In this case, pulling our Xu Family into the fray this time is wiped clean, I will no longer mention it."
Honestly, he was quite anxious.
Wang Shouzhe is truly too mysterious and formidable, without a direct lineage marriage as a bond, he truly fears one day he might be sold by him and still count the money for him.
"Hehehe~" Lady Ji also laughed, covering her mouth, "Congratulations, Patriarch Shouzhe, you have gained another daughter-in-law."
Wang Shouzhe gained a daughter-in-law, his mood lightened considerably.
While at this moment, poor Wang Zong’an is still in the Wang Family ancestral residence diligently doing his coursework, completely unaware that during his father’s outing, his own bride has already been arranged.
Poor Wang Zong’an, only five years old, completely clueless~
Ah~ It’s not easy being a Young Clan Leader~
...

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 63: Golden Sand Xu Family! I Shall Rise Too
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 63: Golden Sand Xu Family! I Shall Rise Too
...
Changning Huangfu Family, a family with a history of five hundred years.
Back when the Changning Guard was first established, the Changning Huangfu Family migrated from Southern Desert County. During the early days of development, they made numerous contributions and accomplishments.
Of course, those who migrated were a branch of the famous Southern Desert Huangfu Family, not the main family.
The Southern Desert Huangfu Family relied on beast taming and breeding on the great grasslands as their main industry.
Because of this,
This branch of the Changning Huangfu Family also possesses remarkable breeding techniques.
This is also quite normal.
In this world, many family relationships are deeply entangled and extremely complex.
There are very few families that arise from loose cultivators starting from scratch, and they usually have low status.
Sometimes, even a seemingly insignificant small family, if traced back, could be linked to a Purple Mansion Family.
The Daqian Kingdom has been established for over seven thousand years.
The migration of family branches is an extraordinarily complex and epic story.
Today.
The Changning Huangfu Family is hosting a night banquet, and now it is nearing dusk, with the sky gradually darkening. However, the lights on both sides of the street have already been lit, making it as bright as day.
This is also the Huangfu Family displaying their financial power, as even these burning lights represent a large expenditure.
The Huangfu Family’s main residence is high gated and heavily guarded, so ordinary people cannot even reach the entrance without permission.
The walls surrounding the main residence are comparable to city walls, resembling a city within a city.
The towering courtyard walls are built with bluestone, bearing the marks of five hundred years of weathering, and the bluestone bricks are already mottled with traces. It seems as if one can faintly witness the storms and the journey of the Changning Huangfu Family over these five hundred years through those bricks.
At the four corners of the courtyard walls stand tall watchtowers, with exquisite copper bells hanging under the flying eaves.
These copper bells have eight sides, they do not ring with the wind, and their surfaces are carved with intricate patterns, appearing quite unique.
The Southern Desert Huangfu Family originally established themselves on the great grasslands with their superb Beast Taming Techniques, and their clan treasure, the Octagonal Dragon Soul Bell, is well-known throughout the Daqian.
These copper bells are imitated from the Octagonal Dragon Soul Bell, signifying that the Changning Huangfu Family never forgets the protection of their ancestors.
Inside the main residence, it is already brightly lit. Numerous servants and stewards are busily making final preparations, repeatedly checking various details of the arrangements.
In their backdrop, even the buildings with a long history seem to have gained a bit of vitality, radiating new energy.
There is no endless stream of carriages at the entrance of the main residence, it is rather quiet.
After all, this time the Huangfu Family has only invited Eighth-Grade Noble Families, and some key figures of the Changning Guard.
Such as Lord City Lord of the City Chief’s Mansion, Shopkeeper Qiaan of Qiaan’s Trading Company, or some heads of large commercial organizations, etc.
Only a dozen or so people are qualified to be invited.
"Lady Jii, Younger Brother An Bang, Younger Brother Shouzhe," Huangfu Jinhuan dressed formally to personally welcome the distinguished guests, seeing Wang Shouzhe, Xu Anbang, and Lady Jii alighting together from the carriage, with no signs of displeasure.
Instead, his face was full of smiles, with the etiquette being very proper.
Wang Shouzhe and Xu Anbang naturally exchanged cordial pleasantries with Huangfu Jinhuan, as if they were longtime friends, friendly and warm.
As the invitees, they also presented gifts that matched the status of the family.
As if there had never been any animosity before, neither side had ever engaged in deadly business competition.
This is the facade of harmony among the Daqian Kingdom’s noble families.
No matter how fierce the competition behind the scenes may be due to some matter,
As long as no face has been publicly torn, the surface etiquette must still be maintained.
This differs from the situation between the Wang Family and the Liu Family and the Zhao Family back then, as the Wang Family had already completely broken ties with them, leaving no room for reconciliation.
The venue for the Huangfu Family’s night banquet is in the front hall.
With rounds of cordial greetings and discreet probing for information among each other,
The guests arrived one after another.
Among them, Lord City Lord Xiahou Hongde, and Purple Mansion’s Direct Disciple Faang You’an, were personally received and hosted by the Huangfu Family’s ancestor, Ancestor Hua Ye.
This is the set rule and etiquette applicable everywhere—cultivation level and status determine the difference in identity. It was appropriate for Ancestor Hua Ye to personally greet and host them.
As for those core disciples from the Purple Mansion Academy, they all sat at the head seats with Faang You’an.
After all, they are core disciples, with a great possibility of becoming Celestial Human Realm cultivators and guarding a region for the Purple Mansion Academy in the future.
While Wang Shouzhe and representatives of the Eighth-Grade Noble Families were arranged at the secondary seats, accompanied by Huangfu Jinhuan himself.
It was the first time Wang Shouzhe had met Ancestor Hua Ye.
Due to cultivating the "Red Dragon True Technique" to a profound level, Ancestor Hua Ye’s hair was as red as fire, giving him an energetic and naturally imposing aura of arrogance.
Not surprising,
Ancestor Hua Ye is the third-generation Celestial Human Ancestor of the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, once having reached a talent level of Middle Grade B. It is said that he ascended to the Celestial Human Realm around the age of one hundred and forty.
Compared to the celestial pride like Faang You’an in the academy, naturally it was not on par. But among the core disciples, he would be among the leading ranks.
Because of his rapid ascension back then, the Celestial Person Huangfu Family had a period of about sixty years when they had two peak Celestial Human Realm ancestors in the family.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 63: Golden Sand Xu Family! I Shall Rise Too_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 63: Golden Sand Xu Family! I Shall Rise Too_2
During that period, the Huangfu Family overwhelmed the Celestial Human Lei Family to the point where they could hardly lift their heads.
Unfortunately, the good times didn’t last long.
Seventy years ago, the previous generation’s Celestial Human Ancestor of the Huangfu Family passed away peacefully in his sleep at the age of over 370, and the momentum of the Huangfu Family began to wane.
Various reasons contributed to Ancestor Hua Ye’s grandeur.
A lifetime without much adversity gave Ancestor Hua Ye an intense confidence in his speech and demeanor. Even when facing a Celestial Pride like Faang You’an, he remained at ease with banter.
"Brother Yoou’an," Ancestor Hua Ye said with a sense of nostalgia and sigh, "your master, Binglan Ascendant, is one of the few Ascendants I admire most, not only for her extraordinary strength but also as one of the pillars of Longzuo County and even the whole Great Country. Her character is impeccable, and I also heard that she hopes to go further."
Faang You’an gracefully cupped his hands and said, "Elder Huangfu overpraises. My master often says things like, ’The road is long and difficult, and I must strive tirelessly,’ comparing herself to a child just learning to walk in the vastness of the Heavenly Dao."
City Lord Xiahou Hongde, who was accompanying them, laughed heartily and said, "Brother Yoou’an, you’re too modest. If the famous Binglan Ascendant is just a child learning to walk, then we haven’t even begun to babble."
Faang You’an smiled gently and chose not to refute.
While there was a hint of Binglan Ascendant’s humility in those words, he also understood the ideals and responsibilities borne by a Direct Disciple in an academy were different from those local powerful families.
Nevertheless, he wouldn’t underestimate any of the local powerful families.
Coming from a noble family himself, he was acutely aware that the Daqian Kingdom was made up of one noble family after another.
Each noble family was a cornerstone of Daqian, a cradle for a continuous stream of talents.
Moreover, neither Ancestor Hua Ye nor City Lord Xiahou Hongde were simple characters to have reached their current positions.
Afterward.
The night banquet began.
The Huangfu Clan, with "household generals exceeding a hundred" and "household servants exceeding a thousand," selected many of their serving maids with care.
They presented an array of delicious high-end spiritual foods and exquisite spirit wines, instantly livening up the atmosphere.
...
Meanwhile.
In a remote part of Changning Guard, there was a place called Golden Sand Town.
This was a barren land, with a total population of less than ten thousand for decades.
This town had only a small Ninth-Grade Noble Family—the Golden Sand Xu Family used it as their stronghold.
Apart from the difficult-to-cultivate mulberry fields used to produce raw silk for the Changning Xu Family,
the major industry here was still panning for gold, producing a small amount of gold year after year.
Compared to its zenith.
Golden Sand Town’s current gold production was very low, barely enough to support some local commoners and the Golden Sand Xu Family’s livelihood, making it extremely challenging to develop.
This suggests that.
The Golden Sand Xu Family was not a powerful family.
Yet it was a family very closely linked to the Ping’an Wang Family.
In recent years, frequent marriages between their direct veins have occurred, as evident with Wang Luojing and Wang Shounuo’s mother, Xu Zhirou, that gentle and intelligent woman, who came from the Golden Sand Xu Family and even took care of Wang Shouzhe and Wang Luoyi for a long time when they were young.
Second brother Wang Shouyi’s wife also came from the direct line of the Golden Sand Xu Family and gave birth to the current Little Celestial Pride of the Purple Mansion Academy, Wang Zongsheng, and younger siblings Wang Zongyao and Wang Lili.
Elder sister Wang Lumei and second sister Wang Luohuo of Wang Shouzhe also married into the Golden Sand Xu Family. There, they bore children, giving Wang Shouzhe many nieces and nephews.
This situation seemed like two impoverished and declining families warming each other in their struggles, which led to deep relationships and frequent interactions between them.
Fortunately, in recent years, the Golden Sand Xu Family’s situation has improved significantly.
The sand with extremely low gold content, previously considered useless and filling the riverbanks and waterways with waste,
suddenly became useful.
With the massive application of foreign cement from Changning Guard, the price of river sand soared. Particularly, in constructing cement roads for the Ping’an Wang Family, building cement soil river embankments, or other infrastructure projects, vast amounts of river sand were indispensable.
Supplying just the Ping’an Wang Family brought much-improved living conditions for the Golden Sand Xu Family. Moreover, they also supplied quality river sand to areas like the East Sea Guard.
Golden Sand Town seemed to have suddenly become a true Golden Sand Town.
As the economy gradually improved and an influx of hired workers arrived, Golden Sand Town’s total population reached about twelve to thirteen thousand, with recent reports of them absorbing refugees.
Now.
The Golden Sand Xu Family is greeted with an excellent opportunity for development and rise.
Due to the crisscrossed waterways of Golden Sand Town, the wide riverbanks often being rocky stretches present many suitable places for constructing hydraulic workshops.
The silk technology in Longzuo County, from mulberry cultivation to sericulture, raw silk reeling, up to weaving plain silk, already had a well-practiced and complete process.
However, this process, particularly in silk reeling and weaving, required tremendous manpower and time.
In recent years, Wang Shouzhe, along with older brother Wang Shouxin, has been continually developing and improving silk reeling and weaving technologies.
In drawing a complete schematic on his own, Wang Shouzhe would likely struggle, let alone understanding some principles thoroughly.
But with abundant fragmented knowledge from his past life and very clear directional guidance, combined with collective wisdom, they eventually managed to contrive relatively primitive water-powered silk reeling machines and water-powered weaving machines.
The foundational inventions were not difficult; the challenge primarily lay in direction and methodology. As long as one explored and continually improved along a certain path, success was inevitable.
(On inventing, Old Ao has more to say than other authors since he has his patents, which are in production and profitable...)
The so-called water-powered structure appeared very simple, essentially a scaled-down and modified version of a large Water Dragon Array.
Before this, silk reeling technology relied on foot-powered silk reeling carts. One person per cart could simultaneously reel three hammers of raw silk.
But the current water-powered silk reeling carts can simultaneously drive hundreds of spindles, accomplishing human-spindle separation. Approximately ten silk reelers suffice for operating a single water-powered silk reeling cart.
Compared to foot-powered silk reeling carts, not only is the per capita output ten times higher, but the raw silk produced is also smoother and finer.
Meanwhile, the principle behind water-powered weaving machines was consistent. The weaving structure had undergone further improvements, though Wang Shouzhe did not know how much these devices differed in shape from the fuzzy Jenny Loom remembered from his past.
Undoubtedly, its production efficiency far exceeded that of today’s ordinary foot-powered weaving machines.
As long as water resources were abundant, it could operate day and night requiring only minimal manpower assistance.
Disregarding construction and manufacturing costs,
once the water-powered weaving machines commenced operation, their production efficiency would be terrifyingly high.
The unit labor efficiency was about forty times that of foot-pedaled looms.
Furthermore, both the silk reeling carts and weaving machines were not purely wood-based structures; Wang Shouxin directed blacksmiths to create many mechanical structures.
Some critical parts even involved Artifact Refiners!!
This ensured the stability of both these mechanical structures, which, with proper maintenance, could remain in long-term use.
Given their numerous advantages,
The clan leader of the Golden Sand Xu Family—Xu Anze, was so excited recently that he could hardly sleep.
Day and night, he guarded the construction site because he knew that once operations began, it would mark the rise of the Golden Sand Xu Family. With twenty or thirty years, they might even advance to an Eighth-Grade Noble Family.
Even if they just operated as the lowest-tier processing unit of the tripartite collaboration, he believed that neither the Changning Xu Family nor the Ping’an Wang Family would treat them unfairly.
After all, one was the Main Vein, and the other was a very close in-law family.
Moreover, Patriarch Wang Shouzhe was a leader known for his generosity toward allies.
Nonetheless, Xu Anze also knew that if they wished to rise, a significant hurdle remained.
As night fell!
Several gray shadows appeared on the Golden Sand Xu Family’s grounds. Standing on high ground, they gazed at the cement buildings forming the workshops, a glimpse of coldness and murderous intent flashed in their eyes.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 64: Dragon Suppression Stele! Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 64: Dragon Suppression Stele! Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler
...
Golden Beach was originally a famous gold-panning site. As the gold mining industry declined, the Chaotic Stone Beach here had been abandoned for a long time.
It is surrounded by water on three sides, with one side against the mountain. Once the area is leveled, it is the most suitable place to build a workshop.
Under the dim night, the cement workshop, which was more than halfway built, crouched on the Chaotic Stone Beach like a monster.
On the high ground.
There weren’t many outsiders, only a mere five people.
Among them, two were dressed in black night attire, with faces covered, clearly those who couldn’t reveal their identities easily.
The other three had withdrawn their breath-concealing disguises, exuding an eerie and sinister aura without any restraint.
None of them seemed to be righteous people, unconsciously sending a chill down one’s spine.
The old man in the lead was especially filled with Yin Sha Evil Qi, as if a monstrous demon ready to devour someone.
He coldly glanced at the masked person and said indifferently, "Old Man Huangfu, it’s just a small workshop we’re destroying. We have five Spirit Platform Realm cultivators here, and you and I are both at the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm. Even if we encounter an ordinary Celestial Human Realm, we can still fight. Why are you so secretive?"
"Mr. Yin." The masked man named Huangfu spoke calmly, "We both have families and businesses, we have children and grandchildren; naturally, we must be cautious. If today’s action is exposed, our entire family will be implicated."
"Hmph~"
Mr. Yin sneered, seemingly disdainful.
"To think we’ve been lurking long enough." A sinister smile spread across his corpse-like cold face, "We’ve been suffocated for too long; it’s time to see some blood."
After saying this, his body flicked and instantly he soared down from the high ground like a bird, gliding along the wind.
In just a dozen or so breaths, he used the advantage of high altitude to glide obliquely downward, spanning a hundred feet to land in front of the workshop.
His two subordinates and the two masked men immediately followed closely.
The Spirit Platform Realm cultivators were capable of brief aerial flight, so gliding down from high ground was a breeze.
All five Spirit Platform Realm cultivators stood confidently and imposing in front of the workshop.
"Gentlemen, our intelligence reports that all the cocoons are already inside the workshop," Old Man Huangfu said, "Our goal is to kill everyone here. The receiving ships and personnel will transport all the raw materials of the cocoons, as well as the new silk reeling tools and textile equipment."
They were certain of their success.
Once they got hold of these new tools, it wouldn’t take more than two years to easily replicate them.
Upon hearing this,
a look of excitement appeared in the eyes of the two masked men.
This would be a turning point for their Qianma Huangfu Family’s destiny!
Yet suddenly,
before they could break in, a young man’s voice came from inside, "Commander, was my intelligence wrong? There are indeed people from the Yin Sha Sect active in our Changning Guard."
As he spoke, a group of people emerged from the cement workshop.
The leader was dressed as a military general. He was tall, with a stern face, clad in black armor, exuding an unmistakable military aura.
Following behind him were a young man and woman. The young man was handsome and heroic, while the woman was also brave and valiant.
This young couple was none other than Wang Shou Lian and his fiancée, Zhou Qing Ning.
Sometime ago, with Wang Shouzhe’s consent and Liu Ruolan’s mediation behind the scenes, this marriage was finally arranged.
However, Zhou Zhenwu, as the commander of the Patrol Third Battalion in Changning Guard, had some concerns in his heart. He felt that the current Lord City Lord Xiahou Hongde had only three years left in his term, and it might be better to act after Xiahou Hongde left when the new City Lord arrived and had not yet established himself, to avoid problems.
Therefore, the relationship between the two parties remained confidential for the time being.
Besides Wang Shou Lian and the other two, there were two men in gorgeous clothing.
One of them was the Patriarch of the Golden Sand Xu Family, Xu Anze. However, he was only in his early forties, with strength only at the ninth layer of the Qi Refining Realm, so today was not his time to show off.
The true representative of the Golden Sand Xu Family was the person in front of him.
That was the Golden Sand Xu Family’s ancestor, Xu Ningwei, Ancestor Ningwei.
Ancestor Ningwei had a dignified appearance and extraordinary demeanor, though his face already showed some signs of aging.
However, the Golden Sand Xu Family was not strong, and Ancestor Ningwei, over a hundred years old, was only at the early stage of the Spirit Platform Realm.
Fortunately, the founding ancestor who branched out from the Changning Xu Family in the early years obtained a spiritual artifact, the "Spiritual Yao Shield," to serve as the Clan’s Spiritual Artifact for the Golden Sand Xu Family. This enabled Ancestor Ningwei to hold his own among many early-stage Spirit Platform Realm ancestors.
Moreover, the "Spiritual Yao Shield" had outstanding defensive powers; even against a mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, it had life-saving capabilities.
Ordinary Ninth-Grade Noble Families were like this; their heritage and such naturally couldn’t compare to Eighth-Grade Noble Families.
However, now that the Golden Sand Xu Family had latched onto the substantial support of the Ping’an Wang Family, their future development potential was bound to increase steadily.
As these five emerged,
Mr. Yin and his four companions were all taken aback, sensing an ominous feeling.
Unexpectedly, they had even invited the Patrol Camp to stand guard here, clearly a well-calculated plan.
Yet, before they could react, Zhou Zhenwu, the commander of the Patrol Third Battalion, had already fixed his tiger-like eyes on them.
"Dare the Yin Sha Sect make disturbances in our Changning Guard, truly unaware of their impending doom." His gaze landed on Mr. Yin, sneering, "Men, encircle them!"

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 64: Dragon Suppression Stele! Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 64: Dragon Suppression Stele! Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler_2
Upon his command.
A troop of soldiers from the patrol camp, who had long been lurking within the workshop where Foreign Cement was produced, rushed out immediately.
At the same time, some coverings were lifted on Golden Beach, which seemed silent and deserted. The soldiers from the patrol camp, who had been ambushed here long ago, dashed out one after another.
A full hundred soldiers divided into two waves surrounded the five intruders from afar.
They were ordinary soldiers under the City Chief’s Mansion. Though their individual strength wasn’t particularly strong, most were only at the fourth, fifth, and sixth layers of the Qi Refining Realm, resembling elite Household Generals.
Only a few at the Team Captain Level reached the seventh or eighth layer of Qi Refining Realm. Even the two deputy commanders were merely at the ninth layer of Qi Refining Realm.
However, do not underestimate this camp of soldiers.
Each of them was fully armored, comprehensively equipped.
At the front row were the sword and shield soldiers, followed by the long spear soldiers, and finally, the back row consisted of elite archers with treasure sabers at their waist, holding bows and arrows. They were well-trained, proficient in formation and combination techniques, and extremely difficult to deal with. Even regular Spirit Platform Realm cultivators caught in the battle formation would struggle to escape a fate of defeat.
The eyes of the five surrounded individuals were extremely grave and solemn.
Especially the two masked ancestors from Qianma Huangfu Family who involuntarily stepped back two steps, evidently harboring fear.
Being part of the patrol camp under Cheng Chief’s Mansion, regardless of their combat strength, fundamentally, they were still the official army, nominally belonging to the Daqian Imperial Family.
As the saying goes, civilians do not fight with officials. Once they resist arrest and confront them, even innocence becomes guilt. There’s even a high probability of implicating the entire family.
Seemingly perceiving the resistance of the two from Qianma Huangfu Family, Mr. Yin’s eyes flashed, and he abruptly sneered: "We have two Late-stage Spirit Platform Realm, two Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, and one Early-stage Spirit Platform Realm. They only have two Early-stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivators. If we fight head-on, while we will certainly suffer casualties, ultimately, victory will be ours."
As he spoke, he looked sinisterly at Zhou Zhenwu opposite, his voice already tinged with murderous intent: "Zhou Zhenwu, are you truly willing to capture us, ignoring your subordinates’ deaths and injuries?"
"Indeed, why not let us retreat, and let today’s events be considered as if they never occurred?" Upon hearing these words, the old man Huangfu also mustered courage, following up with threats.
However, just at this moment.
A woman’s cold snort suddenly echoed, like a clap of thunder jolting everyone’s ears to a faint ache.
"Humph! You cowards hiding your heads and exposing your tails, thinking that by wearing a cover-up, no one can recognize you? Huangfu Jinyuan!"
As her words fell, a woman dressed in an icy white long dress and wearing a veil on her face gracefully descended from the mountains behind Golden Beach.
Her gaze was chilling like ice, possessing an aura isolated and stunning, akin to the Nine Heavens Profound Lady. Especially her iconic white hair was exceptionally striking under the night sky.
"Wang Longyan!"
Huangfu Jinyuan recognized her at once, his pupils slightly constricted.
This woman was an ancestor of the Ping’an Wang Family, famous since childhood, especially in recent years. It was rumored that Wang Longyan had already advanced to the Late-stage Spirit Platform Realm. Upon seeing her now, her aura was indeed profoundly concealed, hard to decipher, seemingly not inferior to Huangfu Jinyuan.
As Ancestor Longyan appeared, her gaze directly locked onto the three from Yin Sha Sect, a cold hatred seeping forth, murderous intent erupting.
"Yin Sha Sect! So it’s indeed related to your Huangfu Family!"
"Wang Longyan, don’t speak groundless accusations!"
Huangfu Jinyuan tore off the mask on his face, revealing an angry yet extremely old face, as if standing at the end of life’s path.
He knew he couldn’t hide anymore today and wanted to sever ties with the family, angrily gritting: "This is just my personal matters with friends from Yin Sha Sect, completely unrelated to the Qianma Huangfu Family or Celestial Person Huangfu Family!"
"Humph~"
The voice of an old man echoed again in the sky.
Though his voice was aged, it resonated deeply like a bell: "Whether the family is connected to Yin Sha Sect, capture and interrogation will reveal the truth."
As his words fell, a gray-robed elder descended from the sky.
With hands clasped behind his back, though his appearance revealed some age, his spirit remained vibrant, especially the divine light and sharpness in his eyes, no less than that of the young.
The years that once flowed through him didn’t diminish his edge but granted him deeper wisdom and broader compassion, his every move exuding dominance.
His gaze swept over the five individuals, finally landing on Huangfu Jinyuan with some regret: "Huangfu Jinyuan, you and I belong to the same generation. You were once a prodigy, but unexpectedly have fallen to such depths."
"Xu Beichen!" Huangfu Jinyuan’s face changed drastically, "I didn’t expect even you to make a move!"
Indeed, this Xu Beichen was the eldest and highest-ranking ancestor of the Changning Xu Family, Beichen Ancestor.
He had been preparing to break through to the Celestial Human Realm.
Since he appeared here, the last trace of hope in the hearts of Huangfu Jinyuan and others was completely shattered.
Everything had been calculated by the other side.
Even, this hydraulic workshop was likely bait thrown by them.
Fell into the trap!
Huangfu Jinyuan and Mr. Yin, the two Late-stage Spirit Platform cultivators glanced at each other, both seeing the same decision in each other’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 64: Dragon Suppression Stele! Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 64: Dragon Suppression Stele! Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler_3
Break through!
Now, only breaking through can possibly save lives; whoever can run should run.
"Yin the Seventeenth, Yin Ershao." Mr. Yin’s voice was cold and icy, "Let’s break through separately and meet at the rendezvous point."
As soon as he finished speaking, the three of them moved, sprinting off in different directions.
Meanwhile.
Huangfu Jinyuan also said softly to the family member beside him: "Follow me and charge. At the crucial moment, don’t worry about me, run if you can. Remember, the collaboration with Yin Sha Sect is a personal act and has nothing to do with the family."
With the last word "family", a surge of fiery energy exploded from Huangfu Jinyuan’s seemingly aged body.
In an instant, he was engulfed in flames.
Under the blazing firelight, with every step he took, the entire Golden Beach seemed to tremble. At this moment, he was like a Venerable Flame walking the earth, exuding a terrifying might.
He had already exposed himself, and now it was time to pave a bloody path for the younger generation!
The decisive resolve and reaction speed of the five were extremely fast.
However, today’s series of incidents was a deadly trap meticulously laid out by Wang Shouzhe for a long time; how could he let them succeed easily?
Take Yin Ershao for instance, on the surface he seemed merely at the early-stage Spirit Platform Realm, but once he started moving, it was apparent that he was definitely extraordinary.
His speed was incredibly fast, not weaker than a mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, and his violent dashes left fleeting afterimages; moreover, his hands were adorned with a pair of sharp Ghost Claws.
He dared not leap into the air; Spirit Platform Realm cultivators cannot fly far, and changing directions is difficult, making them easy targets for formal army archers.
Currently, a squad of soldiers blocked his path. Eight sword and shield bearers formed a semicircular shield wall, with large shields planted into the ground, ready to defend, while long spearmen behind them stood prepared.
The archers pulled their strings, ready to shoot at any time, showing no fear of him despite his Spirit Platform Realm status.
Yin Ershao charged to the encirclement with great speed, Ghost Claws thrust forward, with a loud "clang", propelling a sword and shield bearer, shield and all, flying away.
But he was also in discomfort; his rapid charge instantly halted, and four or five long spearmen seized the opportunity to thrust their spears at him like a forest.
Yin Ershao swung his claws continuously, blocking while retreating.
Before he could steady himself, the remaining sword and shield bearers pushed their battle shields towards him, blocking his path for breaking through left or right.
Meanwhile.
"Clang, clang, clang!"
The endless sound of bowstrings echoed, under the Continuous Arrow Technique, dozens of arrows rained down enveloping Yin Ershao.
His pair of Ghost Claws danced tightly, as if enveloping his entire body.
"Clink, clink, clink!"
In a series of metallic clashes, all the arrows were deflected, leaving him unscathed.
Truly a Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
Yet, even so, after being continuously suppressed by the deflection, Yin Ershao’s attempt to break through failed, forcing him to retreat back into the encirclement.
Such is the horror of the army’s battle formation, that even a squad of twenty soldiers can push Yin Ershao back!
Of course, this doesn’t mean the squad of soldiers was stronger than Yin Ershao.
Were this squad alone to face Yin Ershao in the wild, the outcome would inevitably be their annihilation.
Though the cost to Yin Ershao would be uncertain.
However, currently, it is on the front lines.
Moreover, the main force of the army had already formed a surround advantage, naturally eliminating all of Yin Ershao’s agile and elusive advantages.
Should he fail to break through, and the soldiers continuously whittle him down, he would eventually die.
Yin Ershao’s battle was merely a corner of the overall battlefield.
As he attempted to break through the formation, changes unfurled elsewhere too.
Huangfu Jinyuan, truly a late-stage Spirit Platform powerhouse, nearly transformed into a Venerable Flame, charged with fists and feet of fire, scattering a whole squad of patrol camp soldiers with chaos.
Alongside him, a family member suddenly blew a whistle, its clear and bright sound piercing the sky.
Suddenly.
A crisp bird call sounded, in the dim and gloomy sky, a giant shadow several meters wide swooped down.
Its speed was incredibly fast, seemingly reaching the ground in just a few breaths.
Only then did everyone see clearly.
It turned out to be a giant bird with wings spanning several meters, not quite an eagle or a vulture, fully blood-red, with a beautiful flame-like tail akin to burning red blood flames.
"Red Blood Pigeon."
This was a fierce bird highly adept at flying, and given its massive and spiritual nature, it should be a Tier Three Spirit Beast reared over a long time.
"Huangfu Jinyuan, do you still plan to escape?"
The Beichen Ancestor of Changning Xu Family was his own, not afraid to be shot down by the patrol camp archers, he immediately flew into the air. With a brush on his storage ring, a black tower-like stele appeared in his palm.
The stele was black as ink, adorned with numerous mysterious and inscrutable silver runes.
As soon as the black stele appeared, it exuded an unyielding might.
The Beichen Ancestor pinched a finger technique, those mysterious runes emitted a dazzling light,
"Buzz!"
With the black stele trembling, a sound like a morning bell and evening drum resonated, followed by, a gigantic silver energy phantom radiating force, pressed towards the two.
"Dragon Suppression Stele!"
Huangfu Jinyuan’s face changed, quickly shouting: "Kang Ping, retreat and leave me."
This "Dragon Suppression Stele" was definitely not the clan treasure enshrined in the Xu Family’s ancestral hall.
It was merely a replica. But even as a replica, it was a spiritual artifact crafted with great effort by Xu Family’s ancestors, reaching the quality of a middle-grade spiritual artifact.
Its power was still extraordinary.
Once suppressed by its energy phantom, one would feel like bearing a heavy mountain, unable to move.
Truly deserving of an old eighth-grade Noble Family, its heritage much thicker than typical eighth-grade Noble Families.
However, Huangfu Jinyuan was no pushover either; he was the founding ancestor of Qianma Huangfu Family. Though now aged, with signs of stagnation and decline in cultivation and profound qi, he remained a late-stage Spirit Platform strongman.
And the Qianma Huangfu Family was likewise an eighth-grade Noble Family, with heritage that may not match Xu Family, but still held the prestige of an eighth-grade Noble Family.
With a wave of his hand, a ruler about a foot long appeared in his hand.
The ruler was entirely yellow and smooth as jade, engraved with numerous runes and illustrations of a dragon and tiger on both sides, shimmering with a faint golden glow.
Following the infusion of Huangfu Jinyuan’s profound qi, with a "buzz", the ruler emitted a colossal red-golden ruler phantom, with seeming shadows of dragons and tigers roaring within.
"Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler!"
This was a renowned divine power spirit treasure throughout the Daqian Capital, powerful enough to shatter mountains and sever rivers.
Yet undeniably, it was a replica spiritual artifact.
But even as a replica, it wielded unquestionable power, especially in the hands of a late-stage Spirit Platform like Huangfu Jinyuan, fierce and domineering!
Ruler phantom and Dragon Suppression Stele phantom clashed, sending out shockwaves that ground the rocks on Golden Beach to powder, dispersing everywhere. Patrol camp soldiers dared not approach.
But nobody noticed.
Under the hazy night, a giant turtle gently floated along from the upper reaches of Golden Sand River.
A woman with a treasure sword at her waist stood gracefully on the turtle.
Her ice silk skirt swayed gently in the night breeze, as if an ethereal fairy.
Most intriguingly, a water-blue bead circled slowly and nimbly beside her, occasionally nudging her, exhibiting an exceptionally "intimate" manner.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 65 Ruolan at your service! Sending greetings on behalf of my husband
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 65 Ruolan at your service! Sending greetings on behalf of my husband
...
This newly appeared woman is none other than Mrs. Wang, Liua Ruolan.
Her clear eyes attentively scanned the entire Golden Beach, her expression solemn, with a hint of gravity in her gaze.
The events of today are part of a grand scheme her husband, Wang Shouzhe, has been plotting for a long time. It also concerns the changing landscape of Changning Guard, the fate and transformations between various noble families.
Although everything has proceeded according to plan so far, the stakes are high, and there can be no room for error, thus everything is meticulously arranged.
Meanwhile, at the Chaotic Stone Beach, holding the "Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler," the ancestor of the Qianma Huangfu Family, Huangfu Jinyuan, also blocked the "Dragon Suppression Stele" of the Beichen Ancestor of the Changning Xu Family.
Cloaked in crimson flames, despite the overwhelming power of the "Dragon Suppression Stele" pressing him until his veins bulged, he didn’t retreat a single step.
"Kangping, if you don’t leave now, when will you?!"
Seeing his grandson standing motionless, he gritted his teeth and whispered harshly.
"Grandfather!"
Huangfu Kangping’s eyes reddened, filled with grief.
He wished he could stay behind to cover the retreat, but he knew now was not the time for sentimentality.
The events of today clearly fell into the opponent’s trap, and the situation was already dire.
If he, the family’s second ancestor, were to fall here as well, the entire Qianma Huangfu Family would plummet in status, making it difficult to rise again.
Suppressing his inner sorrow, Huangfu Kangping quickly mounted the Red Blood Pigeon, stroking its head: "Old partner, today it all depends on you."
From a young age, he showed remarkable talent in the Beast Taming Technique.
Thus, his grandfather, Huangfu Jinyuan, personally sought out Ancestor Hua Ye, leveraging Hua Ye’s influence and paying a great price to obtain from the Southern Desert Huangfu Family an egg of a Fierce Beast known as the Red Blood Pigeon, which he nurtured and raised.
Now, over a hundred years have passed, and the once youthful Huangfu Kangping has grown into a mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm ancestor, while the fledgling Red Blood Pigeon has become a Tier Three Spirit Beast.
The resources and efforts expended were countless. But for an Eighth-Grade Noble Family, possessing a Tier Three Spirit Beast is a formidable asset.
After all, spirit beasts have exceptionally long lifespans, capable of defending the family for hundreds of years.
Indeed, the Tier Three Red Blood Pigeon comes into play at this crucial moment.
"Chakaka~!"
The Red Blood Pigeon raised its head, emitting a deep cry, and then spread its wings several meters wide, soaring swiftly into the sky, carrying Huangfu Kangping away.
Here lies the difference between noble families and sects like the Yin Sha Sect. Members of the Yin Sha Sect escape for their lives individually, relying solely on their own skills and luck.
Whereas the two ancestors of the Qianma Huangfu Family are a closely bonded grandfather and grandson, deeply connected by bloodline and affection. At the critical moment, Huangfu Jinyuan could sacrifice himself to protect Huangfu Kangping from powerful enemies, assisting him in escaping.
Fearing the archers of the Patrol Camp, Huangfu Kangping did not dare to fly high, nearly skimming the river’s surface as he flew away.
The Red Blood Pigeon soared at incredible speed, within moments, he was already over ten meters away.
In the dim night, the Golden Sand River was tranquil, except for the "splashing" sounds of water hitting the shore; everything was serene.
Huangfu Kangping let out a sigh of relief.
Witnessing this while struggling against the Beichen Ancestor, Huangfu Jinyuan’s eyes flashed with a trace of gratification.
His lifespan was limited, enabling him to preserve the promising future of his grandson, thus leaving some primordial energy for the Qianma Huangfu Family. As long as the main family, Celestial Person Huangfu, remained strong, they would still be an Eighth-Grade Noble Family.
However, just when they began to relax.
Suddenly.
A drastic change occurred!
A massive whirlpool appeared abruptly over the surface of the Golden Sand River. The whirlpool spanned over ten meters wide, covering nearly one-third of the river’s width!
Viewed from the sky, it seemed as if a giant eye had suddenly emerged on the river’s surface.
What made Huangfu Kangping feel a chill in his heart was the massive Primordial Water Spirit Turtle at the center of that giant eye.
Standing on the turtle’s back was a woman in a blue dress.
Her toes lightly touched the turtle’s shell, as if she were walking on air, floating gracefully, appearing ethereal and celestial.
At this moment, she was gazing up at Huangfu Kangping in the sky!
In the night, her face was as bright as the moon, devoid of any expression, only a hint of stern coldness flickered deep in her eyes.
"Tide rise."
As her cherry lips parted slightly, she softly uttered two words.
As her voice fell, waves of water-blue profound qi burst swiftly from her, and waves upon waves surged across the river surface immediately.
"Buzz~"
The Primordial Water Spirit Pearl was seemingly sensing something, spinning rapidly.
Blue light surged from within the pearl, continuously flowing into Liua Ruolan’s body, transforming the profound qi aura around her from light blue to deep blue.
In an instant, the surging waves transformed into colossal waves, layers of water screens soared into the sky, their momentum so vast it nearly obscured the entire night sky!
In the blink of an eye, everything happened within a very short period.
"Go!"
Huangfu Kangping’s face changed dramatically, immediately maneuvering the Red Blood Pigeon to ascend higher into the air.
But it was already too late.
Just as the Red Blood Pigeon’s body rose less than a meter, the massive waves, like a towering wall, viciously struck the Red Blood Pigeon.
"Boom~!"
The force of the waves slammed the Red Blood Pigeon and Huangfu Kangping, both man and bird alike, from the sky, wrapping them up into the Golden Sand River.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 65: I, Ruolan! Greet on behalf of my husband_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 65: I, Ruolan! Greet on behalf of my husband_2
"Kangping!"
Witnessing this scene, Huangfu Jinyuan’s eyes were about to burst, and he roared as he desperately tried to rush to the rescue.
But before he could act, he was suppressed and restrained by Xu Family’s Beichen Ancestor.
He furiously bellowed, "Xu Beichen, get out of my way!"
