"Huangfu Jinyuan." Beichen Ancestor, driving the Dragon Suppression Stele with overwhelming power, trapped the opponent, and shouted, "You collude with the Yin Sha Sect to rob other clans’ properties. You already defy the heavens. Thinking to escape alive today is sheer delusion!"
"Xu Beichen! I’ll fight you to the death!"
Huangfu Jinyuan, furious beyond belief, spat a mouthful of essence blood onto the Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler. With the support of the essence blood, the ruler’s aura swelled a few feet again, and faintly, the sounds of dragon roars and tiger howls could be heard.
The power of the Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler surged once more!
Beichen Ancestor’s expression grew heavier, the power of the Dragon Suppression Stele increasing, blocking Huangfu Jinyuan completely and giving him no chance.
Meanwhile, as Huangfu Jinyuan fought desperately, Huangfu Kangping had already leaped out of the Golden Sand River first.
His black combat attire was soaked, looking quite bedraggled, but he managed to escape. However, the Red Blood Pigeon, being an air-flying bird, feared water the most.
It floundered and struggled helplessly in the water, unable to escape on its own power.
"Old fellow!"
Huangfu Kangping, extremely anxious, immediately stepped on the water and reached out to grab the Red Blood Pigeon, intending to rescue it from the water.
Unexpectedly.
Amidst the turbulent current, a massive shadow with a diameter of over ten feet silently and quietly approached.
Just as Huangfu Kangping reached out, that shadow darted its head, instantly biting onto the neck of the Red Blood Pigeon like a spirit snake striking.
At the same time, it rapidly sank, dragging the Red Blood Pigeon under the water, almost instantly.
This shadow was, of course, the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle, which had long been coveting the Red Blood Pigeon.
The Tier Three Spiritual Bird was indeed a precious tonic, and it would not miss the chance with its craving nature.
"Old fellow!!!"
Huangfu Kangping was in immense pain.
The Red Blood Pigeon had been his companion for a hundred years, and the bond between them was as deep as that of blood relatives.
Immediately, he wanted to dive into the water to save the Red Blood Pigeon.
Unexpectedly, a cold yet somewhat lazy feminine voice suddenly sounded near his ear.
"Huangfu Kangping, I advise you not to act rashly."
Huangfu Kangping, stepping on air and water, startled and looked back, only to see an extraordinary lady standing on the river waves not far away.
A water-blue spirit pearl slowly orbited her.
Under the moonlight, she exuded an aura of purity and grace, her demeanor elegant, her expression relaxed and carefree, as if she was a noble family’s lady out on a leisurely trip.
"It’s you! Who exactly are you?!"
Huangfu Kangping’s pupils shrank with great apprehension; he recognized her almost immediately. This was the woman who had used a big move to knock him and the Red Blood Pigeon from the sky just now.
"The Qianma Huangfu Family, relying on the Changning Huangfu Family as backing, truly have eyes above their heads, collecting intelligence on opponents so carelessly," Liua Ruolan glanced at him, her expression calm, not taking him too seriously, her words exceptionally serene, "I am Liua Ruolan, sending regards to your patriarch on behalf of my husband, Wang Shouzhe."
Liua Ruolan.
Huangfu Kangping had vaguely heard this name before. But he never imagined that a mere Mrs. Wang would hide such terrifying power!
Run, run, run!
Every hair on Huangfu Kangping’s body stood on end, and he immediately turned to flee.
At this moment, he had only one thought in his mind, which was to escape across the river and strive to survive. Not just for himself, but to preserve a spark for the Qianma Huangfu Family.
On the river, Liua Ruolan stood on the waves, merely watching him escape, not attempting to intercept, but instead focusing her attention on the battlefield at the Golden Beach.
And just as Huangfu Kangping stepped onto the water to cross the river, an elderly man, hands clasped behind his back, blocked his path.
In the hazy moonlight, the old man’s hair and beard were all white, his eyes calm, simply standing there, exuding an awe-inspiring aura, unfathomable.
Moreover, his blood and qi were exceedingly vigorous, clearly still in the prime of his golden age.
"Huangfu Kangping." His voice carried an undeniable weight, "We’re about the same age. Let me face you."
"Liua Qingbai!" Huangfu Kangping’s steps faltered, his face turning extremely unsightly, "Even you came! Doing this so thoroughly, aren’t you afraid Ancestor Hua Ye will retaliate against you?!"
Liua Qingbai chuckled lightly, "Brother Kangping, you do know how to joke. Your Qianma Huangfu Family colluding with the Yin Sha Sect has already committed one of the gravest sins. Even if I kill you, Ancestor Hua Ye can’t find a flaw."
"Moreover, you two Huangfu families are so aggressive, giving others no leeway. What choice is left but life or death for both sides?"
Liua Qingbai—Ancestor Qingbai, was the most powerful ancestor in the Shanyin Liu Family besides Liua Xuanfu, and famed throughout the entire Changning Guard.
Not too old, just over one hundred twenty years, he had already reached the peak of the Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, promising a glimpse into the Path of Celestial Human in his lifetime.
Besides, he had very close blood ties with the Ping’an Wang Family, being the son of Wang Family Ancestor Zhou Xuan’s beloved daughter, Wang Zhuwei, and the direct grandson of Ancestor Zhou Xuan, the elder brother of Ancestor Xuanfu, Liua Xuanfu!

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 65: I, Ruolan! Greet on behalf of my husband_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 65: I, Ruolan! Greet on behalf of my husband_3
This battle is of great significance, especially with his granddaughter Liua Ruolan personally overseeing and commanding it. How could he not come to boost morale?
"Good, good, good!" Huangfu Kangping laughed in anger, "Since I’ve fallen into your trap today, our Qianma Huangfu Family admits defeat. However, thinking you can capture me with just you, Liu Qingbai, is nothing but wishful thinking!!"
With that, he drew the sword from his waist and charged forward.
The sword was like a dragon, and the rain of swords fell like a waterfall.
Backed by the Changning Huangfu Family, a Celestial Human family as blazing as the midday sun, the Qianma Huangfu Family was not lacking in cultivation techniques.
The "Profound Cyan Technique" he cultivated, though not as renowned or powerful as the "Red Dragon True Technique" which could be practiced all the way to the Purple Mansion Realm, was still a genuine cultivation technique that could be trained to the Celestial Human Realm.
Moreover, the "Profound Cyan Technique" was all-encompassing, with a long-lasting primordial qi, similar in marvel to the Wang Family’s Profound Origin Technique.
The swordsmanship he performed was also a well-known middle-grade sword technique within the Changning Guard, called the "Spring Rain Sword Technique." When displayed, it felt like a spring breeze caressing the face, graceful and gentle, intoxicatingly charming. In an instant, the sword momentum would transform into thousands of raindrops, leaving one defenseless and ultimately to perish!
To break through, Huangfu Kangping skipped the spring wind phase altogether, transforming the sword momentum directly into a thunderstorm, enveloping Liua Qingbai.
Countless sharp sword auras rained down, resembling the mighty descent of heavenly wrath.
Liua Qingbai’s eyes gleamed slightly, a thrill in his heart, prompting a praise: "Truly worthy of being the future hope of the Qianma Huangfu Family, even if distracted by beast taming, the swordsmanship skill is still so refined."
With that, he also drew his accompanying spirit sword and faced off.
He wielded the family-inherited ultimate skill of the Liua Family — "Primordial Water Sword Technique." The Primordial Water Sword Technique emphasized the Primordial Water Realm, sometimes gentle and lingering, sometimes domineering and pervasive, also considered a very formidable and tenacious middle-grade sword technique.
The two engaged, with sword auras crossing and profound qi surging, the battle was intensely fierce.
Judging by the cultivation level of both, it seemed unlikely for a quick victory to be achieved by either side.
Whether it was the battle between Huangfu Jinyuan and Beichen Ancestor, or the fierce fight between Liua Qingbai and Huangfu Kangping, it was merely a corner of the battlefield, where on another side, three from the Yin Sha Sect were also breaking through.
Yin Ershao tried to break through once but was surrounded by a squad of soldiers, repeatedly unleashing deadly attacks, managing to kill several soldiers.
Patrol Third Battalion’s commander, Zhou Zhenwu, distressed by his brothers’ casualties, immediately joined the battle wielding a battle saber.
He hailed from a military family, trained in the art of fighting enemies on the battlefield, and his style was typical of a soldier, open and direct with no frills.
Yet, every move carried a domineering, ruthless, decisively tragic momentum.
As for all the soldiers, he had already ordered them to retreat, only to surround rather than kill the enemy. He treated his brothers well, this time bringing them to earn merits, not to seek death.
"Brother Zhenwu, let me give you a hand."
Meanwhile, another elder’s voice rang out.
As his words fell, a gentlemanly elder joined the battlefield with a crimson fire fan in hand.
This elder was Lua Mingsheng of the Yingxiu Lu Family, Ancestor Mingsheng.
Although Ancestor Mingsheng was not a top-tier Ancestor Spirit Platform, with a hereditary "Li Fire Fan," he could still battle an average mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
As he waved the "Li Fire Fan," a fire crow condensed and soared up, spewing flames towards Yin Ershao.
This time, coming to assist Zhou Zhenwu, served two purposes: picking the softest fruit to squeeze and trying to foster a good relationship with the commander of the patrol camp.
Zhou Zhenwu, seeing this, laughed heartily and said: "Thank you for your assistance, Ancestor Mingsheng!"
In the midst of speaking, he swung his battle saber, quickening his attack.
Under the joint force, Yin Ershao could only flee in distress, yet he was trapped within the battle formation, unable to break through despite his efforts.
In such a situation, the downfall of Yin Ershao was merely a matter of time.
Additionally, there was Yin the Seventeenth, a mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm expert, who encountered an ambush while attempting to break through.
The attacker was the first ancestor of the Shanyang Gongsun Family — Gongsun Ao — Ancestor Ao.
The Gongsun Family named offspring rotating through the elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, and this Ancestor Ao was evidently two generations senior to Ancestor Mang.
Currently over one hundred and forty years old, Ancestor Ao had reached the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, though further advancement to the Celestial Human Realm seemed improbable within his lifetime!
However, he was content to see the rise of the Shanyang Gongsun Family during his lifetime.
This time, he personally intervened to make a proper contribution to the Gongsun Family within the marriage alliance, as a way to repay Wang Shouzhe’s continuous care for the Shanyang Gongsun Family.
Indeed, he even brought along the family’s hereditary spiritual artifact.
It was a demon-subduing pestle type spiritual artifact, particularly suitable for cultivators of the war body type, with formidable and dominating power.
His opponent, Yin the Seventeenth, clearly wasn’t easy either, surrounded by a dense Yin Sha Evil Qi. His weapon was a fierce beast bone whip, with a sinister skull embedded at its tip.
The bone whip swung with the skull howling mournfully, ceaselessly spewing Yin Sha evil poison.
This person was extremely difficult to deal with.
To prevent any mishaps, Ancestor Ningwei from the Golden Sand Xu Family stepped forward to assist, joining Ancestor Ao in the struggle against Yin the Seventeenth. His earth defense spiritual artifact, the "Spiritual Yao Shield," was a sturdy and comprehensive defensive asset.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 65: I, Ruolan! Greet on behalf of my husband_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 65: I, Ruolan! Greet on behalf of my husband_4
This way, one focuses on defense while the other on attack, forming an exceptionally close cooperation.
Of course.
Among the five attackers, the most difficult to deal with was undoubtedly Mr. Yin.
The one intercepting Mr. Yin’s escape was none other than Ancestor Longyan of the Wang Family, Wang Longyan.
The Longyan Sword produced a soul-stirring gentle sound, and under Ancestor Longyan’s spiritual sense, it was like a wisp of smoke, slashing towards Mr. Yin.
Throughout her life, her hatred for the Yin Sha Sect exceeded even that for the Huangfu Family.
The evil poison of Yin Sha had tormented her for a full fifty years.
"Humph! A mere cultivator who just entered the late Spirit Platform Realm dares to block me?"
As Mr. Yin moved, although his actions seemed extremely slow, it was as if he was traversing through space. Just by crossing his hands behind his back, he effortlessly evaded the attack of the Longyan Sword.
Among those present, in terms of cultivation, the only one who could possibly match him was Ancestor Xu Beichen of the Changning Xu Family! Yet, Mr. Yin was so confident that even if Xu Beichen were to intercept him, he would escape.
Since Xu Beichen didn’t come to stop him, how could merely Wang Longyan, who had just entered the late stage, along with a group of patrol camp soldiers, possibly hold him back?
That patrol camp squad could handle an initial Spirit Platform Realm tier.
But what kind of person was Mr. Yin?
Just half a step away, he might step into the Celestial Human Realm.
If not for the need to gather resources to ascend to the Celestial Human Realm, why would he join the "Young Master" and act on his behalf?
Facing Wang Longyan, who blocked his breakthrough, and a bunch of patrol camp soldiers, his withered face remained calm as usual. He merely swiped his storage ring, and a banner appeared in his hand.
The banner was about a foot long, but with the infusion of Yin Sha Killing Profound Qi, it instantly came alive.
It floated into the air and expanded with the wind, transforming into a giant banner six feet wide and over a yard long. Under the hazy moonlight, it waved in the wind, and streams of Yin Sha Evil Qi swept in all directions like a storm.
"Yin Sha Shura Banner!"
Wang Longyan’s expression changed slightly as she immediately shouted, "All soldiers retreat, don’t get caught by the Yin Sha Evil Qi."
She too was a core disciple of the Purple Mansion Academy, and sixty years ago, it was definitely not her first battle against disciples of the Yin Sha Sect. She knew quite a bit about one of the Academy’s main enemies, the Yin Sha Evil Sect.
The Yin Sha Shura Banner is a renowned Divine Power Spirit Treasure of the Yin Sha Sect.
With the release of this spirit treasure, the entire battlefield would be engulfed in a Yin Sha storm. Those who were weaker among them, if caught inside, would soon have their bones scraped and souls dissolved by the storm, dying a painful death.
It was a terrifying spirit treasure that could sway the battlefield’s course.
The one in Mr. Yin’s hand was surely not the original Divine Power Spirit Treasure, but even so, this object was certainly nothing to be trifled with.
The two front-line sword and shield soldiers retreated a bit slowly, caught in the Yin Sha storm, and immediately fell to the ground, rolling in unbearable pain, screaming continuously.
"Humph!"
Wang Longyan flew forward and rescued the two soldiers, placing her palm on their backs. The Profound Force erupted, extracting the invading Yin Sha Evil Qi from their bodies and absorbing it into herself.
The two soldiers were saved and expressed immense gratitude to Wang Longyan.
This scene actually shocked Mr. Yin: "How is it possible? You... you can actually absorb Yin Sha Evil Qi?"
"Buzz!"
With a wave of her jade hand, Wang Longyan called the Longyan Sword back to her hand, nimble as a fish. At the same time, her left hand raised, and a palm-sized Turtle Scale Armor Shield floated in the air, emitting a bright blue energy spirit shield.
The spirit shield was quite peculiar, resembling interconnecting turtle shells, forming a suspended and rotating multifaceted turtle armor.
The Turtle Scale Armor Shield!
This spiritual artifact was personally bestowed to Wang Longyan by the Binglan Ascendant, precisely because she was known for her aggressive nature and not her defensive capability. This treasure was given to cover her weaknesses.
However, this spiritual artifact, though strong in defense, also consumed an immense amount of Profound Qi.
Without another word, employing her body technique, she advanced to Mr. Yin, reasoning that if she couldn’t handle him at range, she would test him with close combat!
Wang Longyan slashed with her sword.
In an instant, the air within a few feet radius froze, seemingly causing even the Yin Sha Evil Qi and the water vapor within that range to freeze together, condensing frost that drifted in the night wind.
"Profound Ice Sword Technique!"
"Are you truly an Academy core disciple or a direct disciple?"
At this moment, Mr. Yin finally lost composure, his withered face changing color abruptly.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 66: Yin Sha Poison Corpse! Banquet at Hongmen
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 66: Yin Sha Poison Corpse! Banquet at Hongmen
...
No wonder Mr. Yin was so shocked.
Daqian’s Academy system has cultivated generations of outstanding talents, and the Yin Sha Sect and the Academy have been entangled for thousands of years, with countless battles between their elite disciples.
Therefore, he knew well that the core disciples and direct disciples of the Academy were not to be trifled with.
And the core disciples and direct disciples from the lineage of the Profound Ice Hall were even more formidable!
"Hmph~ Enough nonsense! Prepare to die!"
Wang Longyan’s face was like frost, and a cold killing intent shot out from her eyes.
The Longyan Sword, wrapped in an icy storm, howled out, and within the several-zhang-wide Profound Ice Domain, everything seemed frozen. The weaker cultivators would instantly freeze up, or even die from the cold.
Even those with considerable strength would be significantly affected within the Profound Ice Domain, slowing by at least half.
Yet, Mr. Yin seemed unaffected by this Profound Ice Domain.
With just a slight sway of his body, he easily dodged that sword.
His body technique was elusive and ghostly, hard to grasp. Somehow, with a single flick and float, he circled around to Wang Longyan’s back.
Under the moonlight, his gaunt face appeared even more sinister.
After living for over a hundred years, as a Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm expert, his psychological resilience far surpassed ordinary people. At this moment, he had already regained his calm and composure, a ghastly smile crossing his zombie-like face: "Hmph~ Arrogant! So what if you’re an Academy disciple? It’s not like I haven’t killed one before."
With those words.
A hand suddenly appeared from the wide sleeve.
It was a withered, dark cyan hand resembling that of a zombie. It formed a sword-finger and pointed towards Wang Longyan.
Thick Yin Sha Killing Profound Qi surged up to the fingertip, instantly transforming into a qi force that shot out!
"Hiss~!"
The highly concentrated pale cyan qi force tore through the air, accompanied by a sharp whistling sound.
"Yin Sha Xuan Finger!"
This was one of the signature Black Tortoise Combat Techniques of the Yin Sha Sect, not only possessing strong piercing capability but also causing extreme damage if the Yin Sha Evil Qi infiltrated the body, continuously eroding the internal organs, causing unimaginable pain.
In the past, Wang Longyan suffered from the torment of Yin Sha Evil Qi thanks to this "Yin Sha Xuan Finger."
And at this moment.
Wang Longyan’s sword slashed through the air, leaving her no time to turn around or change tactics. She could only swiftly accelerate her profound qi circulation to block this finger with the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield.
"Boom!"
The azure energy spirit shield released by the Turtle Scale Treasure Shield vibrated violently, rippling like water and dissolving the Yin Sha Finger into nothingness.
Seizing this brief moment, her figure flickered, darted out instantly, and the Longyan Sword transformed into countless ice beams, enveloping Mr. Yin!
At this point.
Both of them realized how troublesome the other was.
They engaged in rapid exchanges, each countering the other’s moves, seemingly at a stalemate.
What vexed Mr. Yin the most was that Wang Longyan, not only excelled in offense and defense, but his prized "Yin Sha Shura Banner" had no effect on her.
More terrifying, as she moved around, she didn’t shy away from the Yin Sha Evil Qi; instead, she utilized her profound qi to absorb it into her body.
The Yin Sha storm created by the "Yin Sha Shura Banner" didn’t hinder her at all but became nourishment for her qi replenishment.
Under the cover of the Yin Sha storm, she fought more valiantly, her attacks becoming more piercing.
"So that’s it! So that’s it!" Mr. Yin exclaimed in shock and rage, "You actually cultivated our Yin Sha Sect’s Yin Transformation Technique!"
He could hardly believe it.
The Academy and the Yin Sha Sect have always been at odds. This woman dared too much. Didn’t she fear questioning from those Ascendants in the Academy?!
Wang Longyan couldn’t be bothered to answer him directly, merely using words to weaken his fighting spirit: "Your Yin Sha Shura Banner is not bad. It’s perfect as my supplement."
While exchanging sharp words, they continued battling fiercely.
Not right, something’s off!
Mr. Yin hesitated in disbelief, as even other core disciples or direct disciples from the Yin Sha Sect couldn’t manage what this woman in front of him did.
They might indeed suffer less influence from the Yin Sha storm but couldn’t directly absorb the Yin Sha Evil Qi.
He couldn’t have anticipated that Wang Longyan had been refining Yin Poison for fifty years, constantly resisting it, during which her body underwent passive changes and evolution.
After mastering the technique to absorb the Yin Sha Power, she discovered that her body adapted to Yin Sha Power even more than the Profound Ice Power, leading to the current situation.
What frustrated Mr. Yin the most was not being able to retract the "Yin Sha Shura Banner."
If he retracted it, the soldiers would surround him, and if they just slightly stalled him, he’d be doomed.
Under such adverse conditions, Mr. Yin’s calm mindset vanished entirely, becoming increasingly anxious.
If he couldn’t break through, there was only a dead end for him.
Immediately, a look of determination surfaced on Mr. Yin’s face.
He swept his hand over the storage ring.
The next moment.
A black stone coffin, over ten feet long and three feet wide, crunched down onto the ground, creating a dent in the sandy surface.
Under the moonlight, the material of this stone coffin seemed to connect with the abyss, devouring all surrounding light. Strange, crimson runes covered the entire surface of the stone coffin, appearing as if they were dripping blood.
Wisps of eerie cold air seeped from the gaps in the stone coffin, instantly making the air on the Chaotic Stone Beach several degrees colder.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 66: Yin Sha Poison Corpse! Banquet at Hongmen_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 66: Yin Sha Poison Corpse! Banquet at Hongmen_2
"This is..."
Wang Longyan’s expression changed slightly.
The difficulty with the Yin Sha Sect lies in their endless array of bizarre techniques.
Some formidable members of the Yin Sha Sect even refine "Yin Sha Poison Corpses." These are extremely evil and terrifying battle tools.
If she wasn’t mistaken, this black stone coffin should be the "Corpse Storage Coffin" that her senior brother mentioned to her.
As for what’s inside the "Corpse Storage Coffin," it’s likely the "Yin Sha Poison Corpse"!
The patrol camp soldiers responsible for surrounding the area also had a drastic change in their expressions upon witnessing this scene, becoming exceedingly nervous.
As expected.
The moment the "Corpse Storage Coffin" hit the ground, Mr. Yin had already bitten his tongue and spat a mouthful of essence blood onto the black coffin board.
To acquire this treasure, he had even specially customized his storage ring as a Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact. But now, to save his life, he had no choice but to sacrifice it.
The black stone slab was exceedingly strange, instantly absorbing the essence blood as it landed.
The next moment.
It began to tremble violently, and a constant "clang clang" sound emanated from beneath the coffin lid, as if an unparalleled fierce beast was about to break out of the coffin.
The patrol camp soldiers responsible for the encirclement unconsciously moved back.
"Boom~!"
The heavy lid of the Corpse Storage Coffin was suddenly flung away.
A dark cyan zombie hand reached out from the Corpse Storage Coffin and grasped the edge of the coffin with force.
The next moment.
An ugly Yin Sha Poison Corpse crawled out of the Corpse Storage Coffin staggering.
Its size was several times that of a human, and under the moonlight, the blue-black body covered in corpse spots looked particularly grotesque and horrifying, as if it had undergone some kind of mutation.
But upon closer inspection, one would find its body surface covered with a metallic sheen, resembling gold and stone. This was because its body was refined through special means, with hardness and defensive power equal to that of metal.
Moreover, a dense black poisonous gas continuously seeped out from it.
That was Yin Sha Poison Gas, a combination of Yin Sha Evil Qi and a powerful toxin, which was even more bizarre and powerful than the Yin Sha Evil Qi.
"Go!"
Mr. Yin gave a fierce shout, and the Yin Sha Poison Corpse immediately leaped out from the Corpse Storage Coffin, charging towards Wang Longyan with an agility that belied its massive size.
"Thump! Thump! Thump~!"
The ground kept trembling.
It crashed around like an ancient giant elephant on the ground, reckless and unorchestrated, but exuding a seemingly unstoppable terrifying force.
Wang Longyan’s expression was grave as she wielded the Longyan Sword, retreating while unleashing waves of Profound Ice Sword Qi against the Yin Sha Poison Corpse.
The sword qi was fierce, leaving deep wounds on the poison corpse, but the Yin Sha Poison Corpse was completely insensitive to pain, rendering Wang Longyan unable to stop its charge, no matter how she moved.
For a moment, Wang Longyan was completely tied up.
"Hahaha~ You can stay here and play with my Yin Sha Corpse Puppet! I won’t be keeping you company~"
Mr. Yin let out a sinister laugh and then used the "Yin Sha Shura Banner" to break away.
Layer after layer of dense Yin Sha Evil Wind roared from the banner. It was enough to leave even Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, let alone the ordinary patrol camp soldiers, with injuries, possibly even lasting damage if they entered the Yin Sha storm’s range.
Daunted by the Yin Sha’s might, the patrol camp soldiers could only retreat continuously.
At this rate, Mr. Yin was about to break through the encirclement.
Suddenly.
A deep voice rang out from the night sky: "Ancestor Longyan, I’ll handle this Yin Sha Poison Corpse. You continue to deal with that Yin Sha Sect evildoer."
As the voice faded, an elder in a blue robe descended from the northern slope high ground, sweeping with a long spear to hold back the Yin Sha Poison Corpse for Ancestor Longyan.
This elder had a dignified demeanor, exuding an aura of majesty.
He seemed to merge as one with the long spear in his hand, every move and stroke carrying an overwhelming dominance.
Under his offensive, the rampage of the Yin Sha Poison Corpse was forcibly restrained.
This elder was none other than the renowned Ruhong Ancestor of the East Port Chen Family.
It turned out that Liu Ruolan had noticed the situation here changing, signaled with the Golden Sand River Water, and Ruhong Ancestor immediately came to support.
Seeing him, a slight expression of joy flickered in Wang Longyan’s cold eyes, while Mr. Yin’s face stiffened.
"Another expert?!"
How could this be?! How many experts did the opponent place outside, as more kept coming, seemingly endless?!
Unfortunately, Mr. Yin simply didn’t understand his opponents.
If he had the chance after death to meet with the two elders of the Liu Family and the Zhao Family, they would surely tell him one thing thoroughly — never underestimate Wang Shouzhe.
And just as Mr. Yin was in shock, Wang Longyan, now free, flickered forward, her icy expression blocking Mr. Yin’s path.
...
Meanwhile.
In the main hall of the Huangfu Family’s Main Residence.
The atmosphere was harmonious, with various dignitaries exchanging toasts and engaging in cheerful conversations during the banquet.
To enliven the atmosphere, the Huangfu Family even arranged for a troupe of glamorous singing girls to perform. Musicians played melodious music while dancing girls gracefully danced, their movements elegant and full of grace.
The Huangfu Family spends a considerable amount each year to maintain this singing girl troupe.
However, this is the hallmark of a Celestial Human Family. Most Celestial Human Families maintain such singing girls and musicians, and even engage in comparisons.
From this, it’s evident that the influence and wealth of a Celestial Human Family are indeed incomparable to that of an ordinary Black Tortoise Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 66: Yin Sha Poison Corpse! Banquet at Hongmen_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 66: Yin Sha Poison Corpse! Banquet at Hongmen_3
At least as far as Wang Shouzhe knew, he had never seen an Eighth-Grade Noble Family specifically raise singing girls.
If one wanted to watch singing and dancing performances, they could only go to "special" places.
However, because the entertainment industry on Earth had reached a pinnacle of development, Wang Shouzhe, having been "deeply affected" by it in the past, found no interest in these spiritless dancing movements.
But the other patriarchs of the noble families were all watching with great interest.
Especially Gongsun Yan, who had just taken over as patriarch not long ago, and his eyes were fixed intently.
Wang Shouzhe was more focused on the "Lady Jii" arranged in the principal seat. Although this identity had been thoroughly investigated before, it fit this plan perfectly.
And with Wang Mei’s abilities, she was naturally already well-versed in Lady Jii’s life and behavior habits.
But after all, there was still a legitimate second son of the current Jii Family sitting in the principal seat—Jii Mingyu.
At this time, the patriarch Huangfu Jinhuan also went over to offer a toast. If it turned out that Jii Mingyu couldn’t recognize Lady Jii at all, it would cause some trouble.
Originally, Wang Shouzhe was still slightly worried about Wang Mei.
Unexpectedly, Wang Mei, playing the role of Lady Jii, was the first to start talking to Jii Mingyu, her eyes slightly accusing and playful: "Brother Mingyu, I’ve been sitting here for quite a while, and you haven’t even acknowledged me?"
The address "Brother Mingyu" made Jii Mingyu’s hair stand on end. His gaze was surprisingly uncertain as he looked over Lady Jii and asked weakly, "May I ask, who might this be, no, madam?"
The other party’s attire was clearly that of a mature woman who had been married, like a ripe peach.
Their conversation attracted everyone’s attention. Especially Huangfu Jinhuan, whose eyebrows twitched slightly, and Jii Mingyu couldn’t recognize Lady Jii?
"Brother Mingyu, you really can’t recognize me anymore." Lady Jii’s beautiful eyes glared sideways, full of grievance as she said, "I am Youwei, the younger sister from your Ninth Uncle’s family. I used to always follow you around as a child."
"Youwei?" Jii Mingyu was stunned for a moment, then slapped his head and said, his eyes filled with joy, "I remember now, you’re the second girl from Ninth Uncle’s family."
Lady Jii’s charming face turned red, rolling her eyes slightly annoyed, she coquettishly said, "Brother Mingyu, there’s no need to mention my childhood nickname in public, is there?"
"Sorry, sorry." Jii Mingyu hurriedly stood up to apologize, "Sister Youwei, I haven’t seen you for over twenty years. I misspoke in the heat of the moment, please don’t blame me."
Jii Mingyu went to the Academy when he was eighteen and had been there ever since. The Academy is such a fun place with all kinds of powerful characters, where one can fight everywhere. Although he returned home once every few years to visit family, he naturally couldn’t meet everyone each time.
The Jii Family isn’t a small family, with a large number of people.
"Brother Mingyu is a pride of the Academy, so it’s normal you couldn’t recall your sister for a moment. But Brother Mingyu, you’ve always been my idol." Lady Jii raised her slender wrist, smiling charmingly, "I toast to you, wishing you an early breakthrough to the Celestial Human Realm."
Jii Mingyu felt a little guilty in his heart, raising his glass in return. After drinking the wine, he said a bit strangely, "By the way, I remember you, Youwei, seemed to have married into the Zhou Family, how come you are in the Changning Guard?"
At the mention of the Zhou Family, Lady Jii’s expression turned somewhat unpleasant, pouring a glass of Spirit Wine and drinking it in one go, looking as if she had something to say but hesitated, with a bit of anger.
"Brother Mingyu, you are a noble child of the Academy, and it’s understandable that you don’t pay much attention to the family affairs." Huangfu Jinhuan, who was toasting nearby, said with a similar indignant expression, "That Zhou boy isn’t a good person. Not only did he mess around after marriage, but he also brought some women back home. Lady Jii, in anger, forced him to write a divorce letter and returned to her family."
"Bang!"
Jii Mingyu’s expression changed, and he actually crushed the cup in his hand, his face as cold as ice as he said, "Good, good, good, that Zhou boy is truly audacious, daring to insult my sister Jii Mingyu. Before I return to the Academy, I will give him a good thrashing."
"Brother Mingyu, thank you for your concern. However, I will take revenge for this myself." Lady Jii’s eyes flashed with a trace of hatred and ruthlessness, "Aren’t they best at weaving and making garments? I’ve already persuaded the family to crush them in these two industries. Make him, and the entire Zhou Family, regret it."
"Good, truly worthy of being my sister Jii Mingyu, and worthy of being a member of our Jii Family." Jii Mingyu was very gratified, "Some people really need to be taught a lesson."
After a session of "recognition" and friendly chat, Jii Mingyu and Lady Jii quickly became much more familiar, repeatedly calling each other Brother Mingyu and Sister Youwei.
Hearing this, Wang Shouzhe, seated not far away on a secondary seat, got goosebumps.
But Huangfu Jinhuan was even more excited. They had thoroughly investigated the origin and identity of Lady Jii before, and there was indeed such a Jii Youwei Lady Jii in the Jii Family.
And she did indeed marry into the Celestial Human Zhou Family and indeed got divorced and returned.
They believed her at first, partly because of the glow of the Jii Family, partly because she had indeed shown silk reeling and weaving techniques supposedly from the Celestial Human Zhou Family, and partly because the other party was very commanding, with two Spirit Platform Realm guards, spending very generously.
They didn’t have the capability, nor too much time and energy to investigate deeply. But the techniques did not lie; they were indeed quite advanced, able to improve labor efficiency by two to three times.
Now hearing Jii Mingyu’s "personal certification," Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes shone even brighter, sneering coldly in his heart: "Xu Anbang, Wang Shouzhe. After tonight, you will experience the gap between you and us, the Huangfu Family."
Lady Jii, you will also see who the real local tycoons are!
At this thought, Huangfu Jinhuan directed his gaze at Xu Anbang and Wang Shouzhe, smiling faintly as he said, "Lady Jii is a distinguished guest of our Huangfu Family, a long-time collaborator. Your status is esteemed, often unaware of the sinister intentions of some small families in the local area, so you need to be extra cautious."
Upon hearing this, Wang Shouzhe chuckled silently to himself; it was finally happening.
No matter how beautifully Huangfu Jinhuan crafted the surface, it ultimately couldn’t conceal the fact that this was a banquet at Hongmen.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 67: Reversal! Counterkill
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 67: Reversal! Counterkill
...
"Hmph!"
Patriarch Xu Anbang of the Changning Xu Family snorted discontentedly, "Patriarch Huangfu, your words are incorrect. In business, it’s naturally about each showcasing their ability. Moreover, both our Changning Xu Family and Ping’an Wang Family are founded on integrity. Patriarch, don’t start defaming us lightheartedly."
"Fifth Uncle is absolutely right," Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "We often teach our children that to establish oneself, one must first establish virtue. If one’s virtue is insufficient, how can they stand firm? Especially families like ours, without virtue and conduct, how can we survive?"
"Heh~"
Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes flickered twice, but he did not debate further with them.
After tonight, the Changning Xu Family and the Ping’an Wang Family will be like grasshoppers after autumn, unable to jump for long. Let them enjoy their moment of pride~
...
As the Changning Huangfu Family’s main residence was bustling with music and dance, the battle near the workshop on Golden Beach had reached a fever pitch.
The Patrol Third Battalion had the Golden Beach surrounded impenetrably, with various Spirit Platform Realm experts engaged in combat. Unless unforeseen events arise, this would be a complete annihilation battle.
Among them, the fight between Wang Longyan and Mr. Yin was the most crucial.
Mr. Yin’s manifestation of combat power evidently wasn’t in direct confrontation but in various deceitful maneuvers.
Forced to unveil numerous trump cards, each dismantled one by one, even though his cultivation was slightly superior to Wang Longyan, he became a tiger without claws under Wang Longyan’s dominant and unrelenting assault.
If it weren’t for his peculiar body technique and endless tactics, he might have already been slain.
Seeing no hope of escape, a hint of ruthless determination flashed in his eyes, and he suddenly spoke, "Young lady, we have no grievances or feuds. Why pursue me so relentlessly? I know a major secret, which I can share with you to help you ascend to the Celestial Human Realm."
At this moment, he could only throw out his final trump card.
He firmly believed that any late-stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivator would be irresistibly tempted by the prospect of advancing to the Celestial Human Realm. At the very least, the other party would be interested in knowing what secret he held.
As long as the other party hesitated slightly, he was confident in persuading them.
Who knew!
Faced with such temptation, Wang Longyan didn’t even blink, her hatred only deepening.
She abruptly intensified the activation of the Profound Ice Sword Technique, with the Longyan Sword raising a layer of frost suddenly soaring, the sword qi growing colder, and the aura ever sharper.
The layers of sword qi immediately overwhelmed Mr. Yin.
Clearly, she had no intention of listening to what Mr. Yin had to say, determined solely to kill him.
"You!" Mr. Yin choked with emotion, his face suddenly turning extremely unsightly, "Are you crazy?! Killing me, what benefit do you gain? I can swear a Nether River Oath to share this secret with you, I can even vow to aid you in advancing to the Celestial Human Realm first. You know that although our Yin Sha Sect is antagonistic to your Purple Mansion Academy, we wouldn’t lightly violate a Nether River Oath."
The Nether River Oath is an oath highly valued by the Yin Sha Sect. Once such an oath is made, it’s rarely broken unless it concerns life and death.
Throwing out even the Nether River Oath showed he was truly desperate.
"I admit your proposal is enticing, and I understand the significance of your Yin Sha Sect’s Nether River Oath, but unfortunately..."
Ancestor Longyan, her enchanting body hovering in mid-air, with her delicate hands tightly gripping the Longyan Sword, her face cold and a gaze like a majestic ice peak, unusually firm.
Suddenly.
Her wrist shook, slicing out a sword with a fierce edge.
At the same time, her resolute voice came from the sky, "If I abandon past grievances and cooperate with your Yin Sha Evil Sect, how can I face the ancestors? How can I face the elders of the academy? How can I face the descendants of the family?"
Wang Longyan deeply understood that the character "virtue" is the foundation of a family’s standing!
If one only considers immediate benefits, abandoning the moral bottom line, how are they different from the selfish and greedy Huangfu Family? Such a foundational family may flourish for a while, but absolutely not for a lifetime.
As her voice fell, thousands of frosts suddenly converged into an ice storm, once again enveloping Mr. Yin.
The sword aura formed by the Longyan Sword was omnipresent, lethally so!
"Damn it, this damned woman!"
This is a pesky lunatic!
Mr. Yin roared internally, his suffering unbearable.
Despite his endless tricks, he was beaten into extreme disarray, wounded in multiple places, his body nearly frostbitten, his movements slowing evermore.
Continuing on this path, death awaited.
"Enough, enough~"
Mr. Yin’s zombie-like face twitched fiercely, as if resolving on a decision.
Right now, he only had that one move left.
Immediately, he began to activate a secret technique, reversing his qi and blood.
In an instant, the essence blood within his body boiled and ignited, blood leaked from his orifices and pores, looking grotesquely terrifying.
Blood is the foundation of life, and essence blood forms the core of a cultivator’s foundation.
Any manipulation of one’s essence blood inevitably harms cultivation foundations and can even affect lifespan. Burning essence blood, even if it secures survival, likely results in being severely injured.
"The favor of today, Yin will remember." He glared icily at Wang Longyan, then transformed into a blood rainbow, swiftly soaring toward the sky, "In the future..."
Before he even flew seven or eight feet away, before finishing the word "future," Wang Longyan had already acted.
As if expecting it, she raised her fair hand, the Longyan Sword spinning violently and whizzing towards him.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 67: Reversal! Counterattack_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 67: Reversal! Counterattack_2
The entire ice storm suddenly gathered onto the Longyan Sword, piercing straight at that streak of blood like an icy drill missile.
Swift as lightning, its edge unmatched.
Mr. Yin heard a "whoosh" by his ear, and then a heart-wrenching pain pierced his chest.
The harsh words he was mouthing came to an abrupt halt. Looking down, his sinister eyes immediately revealed an expression of panic and disbelief.
How, how is this possible?
What was reflected in his eyes was a bowl-sized bloody hole in his chest.
His gaze gradually grew unfocused, his body flew forward a distance due to inertia, and then finally lost all power, crashing heavily onto Golden Beach.
Truly deserving of being a late-stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivator, just a step away from the Celestial Human Realm, his life force is indeed resilient.
Even at this moment, his eyes remained open, still filled with disbelief, staring fixedly at Wang Longyan.
Wang Longyan’s eyes remained calm as ever. With a casual motion of her jade hand, the Longyan Sword, which she had just thrown, returned to her hand like ethereal smoke.
She casually slashed out once more.
Mr. Yin’s head, with wide-eyed disbelief, flew off, rolling a few times on the ground, with a look of unwilling death.
"You were too confident, you shouldn’t have taken the time to utter harsh words, it delayed your speed." Only after his death did Wang Longyan speak with cold eyes, "Moreover, the Blood Escape Technique of the Yin Sha Sect is so renowned, how could I not guard against it?"
She, as an ancestor, with a unique-thinking junior like Wang Shouzhe around, naturally understood the reason villains die from talking too much.
Actually, Wang Longyan was clear that once a Yin Sha Sect disciple was forced to use the Blood Escape Technique, their survival was basically left to luck.
Even if Mr. Yin truly escaped, there was over a seventy to eighty percent chance he would die directly due to the Blood Escape Technique.
Yet even so, Wang Longyan didn’t want to give him even the slightest chance, so she had long been wary of that move, unleashing her long-prepared killing strike while he was uttering threats.
Poor Mr. Yin, if he could live again, certainly wouldn’t talk so much.
Seeing that troublesome enemy leader Mr. Yin had fallen, the soldiers of the Patrol Third Battalion immediately cheered, and our members were all invigorated.
Ruhong Ancestor was the first to achieve success.
The Water Dragon Spear pierced through the head of the Yin Sha Poison Corpse like a rainbow through the sun, causing its huge body to collapse with a boom.
This Yin Sha Poison Corpse had considerable strength, comparable to the combat power of a late-stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivator.
But in the end, if no one commanded it, its low intelligence was far from enough to support combat; it was just a large target, with an intelligence gap vastly different from the Demon Puppets in the Divine Martial Army’s Trial Ground, utterly incomparable.
With Wang Longyan and Ruhong Ancestor’s hands freed, the other battlefields quickly received support.
Soon, the other two members of the Yin Sha Sect, Yin Ershao and Yin the Seventeenth, were suppressed and killed on the spot, with no chance to display the Blood Escape Technique.
After all outsiders were killed, people then surrounded Huangfu Jinyuan.
At this point, Beichen Ancestor stopped his actions, regretfully looking at Huangfu Jinyuan: "Brother Jin Yuan, you and I are of the same era, once competing against each other in our youth. In terms of talent, you are slightly better than me. Back then, you were so full of vigor. You split off from your family for a better future, and I even praised you from behind. Yet unexpectedly, you’ve reached this point today."
"Xu Beichen, what do you know?" Huangfu Jinyuan’s face was ashen, utterly defeated, "You are of the direct lineage of the Changning Xu Family, with resources at home available only to you. While back then, I was merely an ordinary disciple of the direct vein in the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, what choices did I have? Even if I split off, how can I truly live without relying on my main family’s influence?"
"Brother Jin Yuan, surrender. So long as you make amends and reveal the true mastermind behind it all, we can appeal for leniency for you." Beichen Ancestor advised, "Things have come to this point, why continue in blind loyalty?"
"Hehe~ Just a matter of success and failure."
Huangfu Jinyuan laughed, as if aged several years in an instant.
He gradually straightened his posture, his eyes filled with determination: "Colluding with the Yin Sha Sect, plotting against fellow townsmen, it was all my decision alone, no one else involved. Even Huangfu Kangping was merely forced by me. Xu Beichen, you and I were acquainted in our youth, it counts as destiny, so let it be you to give me a swift end."
"You..." Beichen Ancestor, unable to persuade him, said helplessly, "Brother Jin Yuan, since you have made up your mind, what I can give you is only a swift end."
With that, he flipped his palm.
The Dragon Suppression Stele instantly materialized, suppressing downward.
"Boom!"
This time, Huangfu Jinyuan did not resist, crushed to death beneath the Dragon Suppression Stele.
A generation of founding ancestors, thus perished.
After suppressing and killing Huangfu Jinyuan, Beichen Ancestor’s eyes also showed intense regret, sighing: "In truth, Huangfu Jinyuan was also a remarkable person, extremely gifted and strong-willed, but unfortunately born into the wrong family. Even though he wished to break free from the control of the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, he was helpless, only sinking deeper. If he were in my place, at this moment, he might already have reached the Celestial Human Realm."
Ruhong Ancestor and Wang Longyan, among others, were silent.
Though enemies, they couldn’t help but feel some sympathy for Huangfu Jinyuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 67: Reversal! Counterattack_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 67: Reversal! Counterattack_3
But the enemy is ultimately still the enemy.
Everyone has a family and a business, children and grandchildren. Just as Huangfu Jinyuan said, it’s merely a matter of winners and losers.
As for Huangfu Kangping, after witnessing Huangfu Jinyuan’s fall, he roared in anger and wanted to fight desperately.
Unfortunately, he was isolated and powerless and was ultimately captured alive with his hands and feet broken.
At this moment, the battle at Golden Beach finally came to an end.
As an official figure, Zhou Zhenwu, the captain of the Patrol Third Battalion, said gravely, "Although this battle is over, there is still a lot of work to be done in the later stages. Whether the Celestial Person Huangfu Family was involved, no one can say for sure, but the Qianma Huangfu Family probably cannot escape involvement. I need to report everything truthfully to Lord City Guard, and the final decision on how to handle it will be up to him."
After speaking, he cupped his hands to the crowd: "Ladies and gentlemen, I, Zhou, will take my leave first and attend to the follow-up matters."
...
Almost at the same time.
Fortune Gambling House.
Night had deepened, and the gambling house finally closed its doors, ending the day’s business.
On the third floor, in a well-guarded room, Chief Shopkeeper Huang was lounging in a master’s chair, leisurely puffing smoke while being attended by two seductive maids, his expression one of great enjoyment.
"Chief Shopkeeper Huang." Ding Youde, with a fawning look, rolled a tobacco leaf for him and carefully lit it, "You truly see things with foresight. That kid Wang Zongwei indeed didn’t have the guts to report; he’s been behaving very well these past few days."
Chief Shopkeeper Huang took a calm puff of the tobacco leaf, his eyes half-open and half-closed, looking serene.
He had dealt with similar matters more than once, so naturally, he wasn’t as easily excited as Ding Youde.
He inhaled deeply, savoring the taste of the tobacco leaf. After a long while, he said, "You did well on this task. Follow me and work hard in the future, and you’ll be rewarded."
With that, he waved his hand.
The seductive maid next to him immediately brought over a tray, on which two bundles of Qian Gold were neatly stacked. Each bundle could be made up of one hundred coins, so two bundles amounted to a full two hundred Qian Gold.
Ding Youde was instantly overjoyed, gratefully accepting the bundles while nodding and bowing constantly, showering him with compliments.
Although it seemed like he managed a lot of money every day, it was all the gambling house’s money, and the portion he could actually touch was not much. These two hundred Qian Gold were already a significant sum for him.
As the two were talking, suddenly the door of the gambling house was kicked open by someone, and a squad of soldiers in Patrol Camp armor barged in like wolves and tigers.
"What’s going on?"
Chief Shopkeeper Huang sensed something was amiss and went downstairs with his people to check. Upon seeing the scene, his expression changed immediately.
"Officers, let’s talk this over. Is there some misunderstanding here?" Ding Youde’s eyes flickered as he quickly moved forward, attempting to make contact with the soldiers.
However, the soldiers seemed not to notice him at all, ignoring him completely, sealing both the front and back doors of the gambling house and blocking all exit routes.
Amidst the chaos, there suddenly came a series of respectful salutations from outside the door.
"Commander."
"Greetings to the Commander!"
Chief Shopkeeper Huang and Ding Youde’s attention was immediately drawn over.
They heard the sound of extremely faint footsteps, and shortly after, a dignified figure slowly appeared at the door.
He looked middle-aged, wearing the standard officer’s armor of the Patrol Camp, with a severe expression and an extraordinary demeanor.
The light of the palace lantern at the entrance fell on his face, illuminating his well-defined profile.
"Wang Ding Race!" Chief Shopkeeper Huang’s eyes narrowed, his heart instantly understanding, "Are you here for Wang Zongwei?"
It turned out that this officer at the door was none other than the only member of the Ping’an Wang Family currently developing within the official system, the third young master of the "Ding" generation, Wang Ding Race.
More than two years ago, Wang Ding Race had successfully advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm.
Afterwards, Wang Shouzhe had spent considerable effort on his behalf.
Wang Ding Race himself had also put in significant effort, leading teams to exterminate several groups of Loose Cultivator bandits operating within the Changning Guard area, successfully gaining promotion and becoming the commander of the Patrol Second Battalion of the Changning Guard.
Wang Ding Race glanced at Chief Shopkeeper Huang but didn’t respond to him, instead directly issuing an order.
"Search it!"
"How dare you?!" Chief Shopkeeper Huang was furious, the menace clear in his triangular eyes, "If you act so rashly, aren’t you afraid that Lord City Guard will hold you accountable?!"
This Fortune Gambling House had a minority share held by the City Guardian’s Mansion; every year, a generous tribute was offered to Lord City Guard. He couldn’t believe Wang Ding Race would dare risk offending Lord City Guard to search the Fortune Gambling House!
The soldiers of the Patrol Camp were evidently aware of this as well, hesitating for a moment.
Wang Ding Race shot Chief Shopkeeper Huang a glance and said coldly, "I, the commander, have received reliable reports that the Fortune Gambling House has been colluding with an enemy of the state, the Yin Sha Sect. According to Daqian Law, any individuals or organizations found colluding with the Yin Sha Sect must be dealt with immediately, with delays being treated equally as treason. Now that Lord City Guard is not in the mansion, I have no choice but to take immediate action, apprehending those committing treason and then reporting to Lord City Guard."
"What?!"
The soldiers of the Patrol Camp were utterly shocked.
Before coming, Wang Ding Race, fearing a leak, had only informed them of the assembly point, and only a few trusted circles knew about the operation against the Fortune Gambling House.
At this moment, they had just learned the truth of the matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 67: Reversal! Counterattack_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 67: Reversal! Counterattack_4
Chief Shopkeeper Huang’s face turned deathly pale.
Even within the Huangfu Family, matters concerning the Yin Sha Sect were confidential, known to very few. The affairs on the gambling side were all personally handled by him, not even the maidservants around him knew.
Except for...
Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat as he turned sharply behind him, but Ding Youde’s figure was already gone.
"A wise man submits to circumstances. Chief Shopkeeper Huang, apologies~"
Unbeknownst to the moment, Ding Youde had sneaked over to Wang Ding Race’s side, bowing and scraping obsequiously.
"Ding Youde, how dare you?!" Chief Shopkeeper Huang trembled with rage, "Don’t forget, your mother and son are still in our hands!"
The matter of the Yin Sha Sect was of vital importance. Had he not held Ding Youde’s fatal weakness, how could he dare trust him to handle it?
However, regardless of how careful Chief Shopkeeper Huang was, he wouldn’t have anticipated that Wang Shouzhe had already investigated Ding Youde’s background months ago and had someone secretly protect his mother and son.
In this way, how could Ding Youde not obediently submit?
Though Chief Shopkeeper Huang had cultivation of the Spirit Platform Realm, surrounded by hundreds from the Patrol Camp troops, he couldn’t stir up a storm, let alone Wang Ding Race’s cultivation which was equally formidable.
Wang Ding Race paid no heed to the conflict between Ding Youde and Chief Shopkeeper Huang, instead coldly scanned all the soldiers: "What are you waiting for? Search!"
"Yes, Lord Commander!"
The Patrol Camp troops agreed in unison, subsequently rushing into the various rooms of the gambling house, searching in a trained manner.
Seeing this, Ding Youde quickly gave Wang Ding Race a fawning smile: "Lord Commander, I know which room Huang Huai’an hid the account book. Let me take you there."
Chief Shopkeeper Huang heard this and his vision darkened in furious despair, directly spitting out a mouthful of blood. This treacherous villain truly sold him out thoroughly.
...
Time passed swiftly~
The night banquet hosted by Ancestor Hua Ye had unknowingly stretched on for several hours.
The closer it drew to the end, the more restless Huangfu Jinhuan became, constantly looking out, as if waiting for something.
Eventually, he sidled up to Ancestor Hua Ye and whispered a few words.
Ancestor Hua Ye furrowed his brow in thought, then rose and said, "I thank everyone for attending this banquet. I have lived nearly three hundred years, seeking nothing else but unity among the various families of Changning Guard to forge a future together. Our Huangfu Family, as a Celestial Human Family, will do our part as leaders and work with all families for development."
"Well said, Ancestor," applauded Huangfu Deyun and others in unison.
Meanwhile, Faang You’an and Lord City Lord Xiahou Hongde exchanged glances, both understanding Ancestor Hua Ye’s implication, and stood to say a few polite words.
Neither Faang You’an nor Xiahou Hongde were locals of Changning Guard, making it imprudent to oppose Ancestor Hua Ye on this matter.
Rather, Wang Shouzhe and Xu Anbang exchanged bewildered glances.
This Ancestor Hua Ye appeared overly presumptuous, not to mention he hadn’t reached the Celestial Human Realm middle stage yet. Even if he did, who acknowledged him as the leader? Acting in such a manner, where does this leave the Celestial Human Lei Family and other families?
Sure enough.
Lei Race Patriarch Lei Yangyu, who had come to attend, frowned. He had kept a low profile today, not wanting the conflict with the Huangfu Family to surface.
Yet unexpectedly, as the banquet drew to a close, Ancestor Hua Ye’s speech elevated the Huangfu Family so highly. At this point, if he didn’t speak, it would lead everyone to believe Changning Guard solely belonged to the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, with no status for the Lei Family.
Immediately, Lei Race Patriarch Lei Yangyu stood and spoke cheerily: "Ancestor Hua Ye, Changning Guard has been established for five hundred years, with each family attending to their own. Is it your intention today to share your family’s pastoral business with us all?"
Ancestor Hua Ye’s eyes narrowed, revealing a hint of displeasure, yet he ultimately considered Lei Yangyu as the younger generation.
At this moment, Huangfu Jinhuan stepped forward and said, "Brother Lei, you are mistaken. Ancestor means that if Changning Guard remains a scattered entity as it had been, it will lead nowhere. If the Lei Family is willing to step up and take responsibility, we welcome it."
Lei Yangyu smiled wryly but said without feeling: "Let’s not. Our Lei Family always focuses on minding our own affairs, and we do not wish to be controlled by others. If your family truly desires to lead, first elevate to a Sixth Grade Noble Family."
With these words, and without waiting for a rebuttal, Lei Yangyu cupped his hands and said, "Everyone, I have urgent matters at home to attend to and will take my leave first."
Upon hearing this.
Quite a few people stood up, cupped their hands, and bade farewell.
Such a scene brought a sharp glint to Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes.
But just then, an abrupt change occurred.
Outside came the commotion of household servants, shouting: This is the Huangfu Family, how dare you barge in?
Along with sharp cries demanding: Make way, or be arrested for conspiring with the Evil Sect and betraying the Daqian!
Huangfu Jinhuan’s face changed dramatically, frowning in anger and shouting: "Who is causing the commotion outside?"
Just as he spoke, a fully armored team of soldiers stormed in viciously, surrounding the main hall.
Following them, an authoritative commander stepped in.
Upon entering, he announced loudly: "Changning Guard Patrol Third Battalion is here to seize those from the Qianma Huangfu Family who collude with the Yin Sha Sect in treason against the nation. Anyone who dares harbor or obstruct official duties will be charged as accomplices."
Zhou Zhenwu!
This was none other than Zhou Zhenwu, who had returned with the fastest speed from Golden Sand, leading the troops.
Today’s achievement, how could he miss?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 68: The End! Cutting the Arm of the Celestial Human (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 68: The End! Cutting the Arm of the Celestial Human (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
...
Such a sudden change.
Both members of the Huangfu Family turned pale.
Especially Ancestor Hua Ye, who was hosting tonight’s banquet, yet didn’t expect members of the Patrol Camp to barge into the Huangfu Family’s Main Residence, loudly accusing "Qianma Huangfu Family of colluding with the Yin Fiend Sect to betray the country."
What kind of utter humiliation is this?!
Rage surged in his heart, and he fiercely looked at the City Lord Xiahou Hongde: "Lord City Guard, what is the meaning of this? I, Huangfu Huaye, have never offended you. During your term guarding the Changning Guard, our Huangfu Race has been diligently assisting."
Xiahou Hongde’s face also instantly turned serious.
Obviously, today’s scene was also beyond his expectations.
Immediately, he shouted gravely with a stern expression: "Zhou Zhenwu, what are you doing?"
"So the City Guard Lord is also here, that’s even better," Zhou Zhenwu seemed to only notice Xiahou Hongde now, and immediately saluted, "While executing official duties, I discovered the Qianma Huangfu Family colluding with the Yin Fiend Sect, conspiring to rebel against Daqian. According to intelligence, the Clan Leader of Qianma Huangfu Family, Huangfu Deyun, is here, so I led my brothers to arrest him."
"Absurd!" Ancestor Hua Ye could no longer hold back and rebuked coldly, "Do you think the Main Residence of our Huangfu Family is just any place?"
Zhou Zhenwu glanced at Ancestor Hua Ye, and said with a smirk, "As Commander of the Patrol Camp, I have the responsibility of safeguarding the nation. Is there anywhere I cannot go? Or should I just watch as your Huangfu Family harbors traitors?"
As Ancestor Hua Ye was about to get angry, Huangfu Jinhuan hurriedly stepped forward to smooth things over: "Commander Zhou, our Ancestor didn’t mean that. It’s just that our Huangfu Family is a dignified Seventh-Grade Noble Family sanctioned by the Imperial Court to co-manage local affairs. You led troops in rashly, constantly claiming we harbor traitors. Once this spreads and becomes rumor, tarnishing our reputation, can you bear such responsibility?"
"Patriarch Huangfu," Zhou Zhenwu said with a blank expression, "since I brought troops here to capture people, I naturally have ample evidence. The fact that the City Guard Lord is here is perfect for me to report to him."
With that, Zhou Zhenwu saluted Xiahou Hongde again, and recounted the key parts of the before and after situations one by one.
Finally, he declared in a loud voice: "The entire affair, with over a hundred brothers from our Patrol Third Battalion as witnesses, has evidence of collusion. Since City Guard Lord is present, I ask you to order the arrest of the treasonous Huangfu Deyun and those from the Qianma Huangfu Family."
With Zhou Zhenwu’s explanation, the expressions of everyone changed, all casting odd and wary glances at the people from Qianma Huangfu Family.
Conflicts, frictions, and confrontations inevitably arise between families due to interests or other factors. But to routinely conspire with the Yin Fiend Sect to annihilate other families, how terrifying is that?
Even though Zhou Zhenwu only mentioned Qianma Huangfu Family from beginning to end, without implicating Changning Huangfu Family, wise individuals knew that Qianma Huangfu Family always looked to the main family for direction.
Huangfu Jinhuan and Huangfu Deyun exchanged a glance, both seeing terror and rage in each other’s eyes.
The matter was so hidden, yet not only was it uncovered, but also a big trap was set to catch all their people in one swoop.
Especially upon hearing that Ancestor Huangfu Jinyuan had already died in battle, Huangfu Deyun’s face instantly turned pale, and his heart twisted with pain.
If not for the environment being considered, he might have already wept bitterly.
The Patriarch of the Celestial Human Lei Family, Lei Yangyu, had initially planned to leave, not expecting this grand show. Moreover, the fact that the Huangfu Family colluded with the Yin Fiend Sect was truly lawless.
He decided not to leave, and said mockingly, "So the Huangfu Family led as the head sheep in this manner, truly eye-opening."
Patriarch of the Changning Xu Family, Xu Anbang, was also "furious beyond restraint": "Huangfu Deyun, you’ve gone too far! We simply didn’t want to cooperate with you, and you colluded with the Yin Fiend Sect to harm us. Fortunately, Commander Zhou received intelligence and saved our clansmen. This matter cannot end here! Please, City Guard Lord, bring justice for us!"
Having said that, Xu Anbang "tearfully emotional" bowed to Xiahou Hongde, appearing as if severely impacted.
Xiahou Hongde’s face was also extremely grim.
Never could he have expected that within his jurisdiction, a local family would collude with the Yin Fiend Sect people, especially exposed in front of the Purple Mansion Academy’s Direct Disciples.
This undoubtedly dealt him a hard slap in the face, how could he not be furious?
Moreover, he was about to leave office, and such an event was happening, clearly aiming to prevent him from leaving smoothly.
If this matter was not handled appropriately today, his reputation in the officialdom would surely suffer. Not to mention promotions, he might even be banished to some remote corner.
Just as he was about to speak.
Huangfu Jinhuan suddenly stepped forward, clasping his hands, and said: "City Lord, please wait. Although Commander Zhou speaks with assurance, I believe it is the private actions of Huangfu Jinyuan and Huangfu Kangping, unrelated to the Qianma Huangfu Family."
While speaking, Huangfu Jinhuan gave a subtle eye gesture to Huangfu Deyun, indicating that since the opponent had sufficient evidence, they could only sacrifice the car to protect the king now.
Huangfu Deyun was heartbroken, but he had to step forward and say: "Upon hearing this matter, I, Huangfu Deyun, am also deeply shocked. Never could I have imagined... I could never have imagined that the two elders in my family dared to attempt such an outrageous act against the world! Alas~~ But I can assure you, this has nothing to do with our Qianma Huangfu Family. It must have been the decisions those two elders made privately."

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 68: The End! Cutting Off the Celestial Human’s Arm (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 68: The End! Cutting Off the Celestial Human’s Arm (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
"Ridiculous!" Xu Anbang’s eyes were blazing as he angrily said, "Huangfu Deyun, both your first and second ancestors have been involved, and you still dare claim that the Qianma Huangfu Family knows nothing about it? Do you take us for fools?!"
"Xu Anbang, as they say, ’Catching an adulterer in the act, catching a thief with the loot.’" Huangfu Jinhuan sneered as he supported, "What Commander Zhou mentioned only concerns those two old scoundrels, Huangfu Jinyuan and Huangfu Kangping, colluding with the Yin Sha Sect. What evidence do you have to prove that the entire Qianma Huangfu Family is involved?"
"Could it be that if one or two people in the family commit a crime, the whole family must be implicated?"
"Brother Xu~" Huangfu Deyun pitifully pleaded, "I truly knew nothing of this matter. My family’s two ancestors... alas, how foolish they are."
"Whether known or not, arrest them and interrogate thoroughly." Xu Anbang laughed angrily, "Both your family’s ancestors are involved, how can you distance yourself from it?"
Both sides were at an impasse, and all eyes turned to City Lord Xiahou Hongde.
At this moment, Xiahou Hongde was also at a loss.
The day’s events had unfolded too suddenly, catching him completely unprepared.
He glanced discontentedly at Zhou Zhenwu. If he had received the report, why didn’t he inform him?
Yet, as this was an internal affair of the City Guardian’s Mansion, he couldn’t lose his temper here and expose his weakness.
He took a deep breath, his expression stern, "Commander Zhou, is there any evidence to prove this is an action by the Qianma Huangfu Family? Or has Huangfu Kangping confessed?"
"Reporting to the City Lord, though Huangfu Kangping has confessed, he doesn’t admit it was orchestrated by the Qianma Huangfu Family." Zhou Zhenwu reported honestly, "How to handle it, we await your command, Lord City Guard."
Xiahou Hongde, having cultivated to the Celestial Human Realm and governing this region, wasn’t foolish. He naturally understood this involved family feuds.
Though Huangfu Kangping hadn’t confessed, it seemed unlikely the entire Qianma Huangfu Family was uninvolved. It’s even possible the Celestial Person Huangfu Family could be implicated.
Every decision he made could influence the open and covert struggles of the situation.
Immediately, he spoke in a deep voice, "The Qianma Huangfu Family, after all, is a noble family of the eighth grade, granted an official seal by the Imperial Court. Everything must be based on evidence. Since Huangfu Kangping hasn’t confessed, how can our City Guardian’s Mansion arbitrarily arrest people?"
This wasn’t Xiahou Hongde shirking responsibility; once something involves family feuds, it becomes exceedingly complex.
Whether it’s the Huangfu Family, Xu Family, or Wang Family, each has its own foundation and connections. Offending any of them would be unwise.
He could only act based on evidence to avoid favoritism and prevent future trouble, especially as he had only three years left in his term.
"We comply with Lord City Guard’s orders."
Though Zhou Zhenwu wished to achieve greater merit, without the City Guard’s backing, he could only act based on evidence.
Though Huangfu Jinhuan’s expression remained grim, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
This scheme’s failure, while costly, was better than implicating the entire Qianma Huangfu Family, or even dragging the Celestial Person Huangfu Family down. The priority was to extricate both families from this mess.
As for the grievances, there would be opportunities to settle them later.
Some neutral families and units perceived the oddities of this event and understood it was a contest between the Changning Xu Family and the Huangfu Family, naturally involving the Ping’an Wang Family and others.
Though it seemed like the Xu Family and Wang Family were gaining the upper hand, unless a decisive blow was dealt to the Qianma Huangfu Family, future issues could arise.
Families allied with the Huangfu Family breathed a sigh of relief.
Though the Qianma Huangfu Family suffered significant losses, it retained some vitality. Stabilizing their position would allow them to plan their counterattack.
The Shopkeeper Changning of Qiaan’s Trading Company, a friend of Wang Shouzhe, couldn’t help but worry for his brother Wang Shouzhe, fearing that if the snake wasn’t thoroughly defeated, it could retaliate.
The crowd present harbored various thoughts, and the atmosphere in the hall remained tense, yet Wang Shouzhe appeared calm, composed as ever.
At this point.
There was another uproar from outside.
The distant shouts of household servants and Household Generals could be heard, "Are you patrol camp troops mad? One group just came, and now another?"
There was a commanding shout from outside, "Move aside, or I’ll arrest you all for obstructing justice and colluding with external enemies."
As he spoke, a steady-looking middle-aged commander led his team in forcefully.
The newcomer was Wang Ding Race, with his Patrol Second Battalion.
This scene infuriated the Huangfu Family’s people.
Ancestor Hua Ye trembled with rage, shouting, "First the Patrol Third Battalion comes, and now the Patrol Second Battalion! Xiahou Hongde! Do you really consider our Huangfu Family to be clay?"
This even put Xiahou Hongde in an uncomfortable position, sternly reprimanding, "Wang Ding Race! As a commander of the Patrol Camp, do you really intend to involve yourself in family feuds? Do you know the taboos you’re violating?"
"Reporting to the City Lord." Wang Ding Race calmly replied, cupping his hands, "I am merely carrying out my duties and don’t understand what the City Lord is referring to."
"Fine, fine! I want to see what duties you’re performing!" Xiahou Hongde laughed angrily, "If I find out you’re abusing your power to oppress other families, don’t blame me for being merciless!"

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 68: The End! Cutting Off the Celestial Human’s Arm (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 68: The End! Cutting Off the Celestial Human’s Arm (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
"Yes, Lord City Guard."
Wang Ding Race replied calmly.
Then with a wave of his hand, a few soldiers brought Ding Youde in.
Wang Ding Race said, "This is Ding Youde, the Second Shopkeeper of the Fortune Gambling House. He acted as my state witness, reporting that the Fortune Gambling House, Brocade Manor, and Qianma Huangfu Family were all hiding the evil Yin Sha."
It was the first time in Ding Youde’s life that he had seen so many bigwigs gathered in one place.
He immediately knelt trembling, "I am Ding Youde, and have been working at the Fortune Gambling House for twenty years."
Although he was not a major figure, he was known in the Changning Guard for being ruthless and devious in debt collection; many present had heard of or recognized him.
"It is indeed Ding Youde."
The crowd discussed in agreement, confirming Ding Youde’s identity.
"Lord City Guard, in addition to Ding Youde, the Chief Shopkeeper Huang Huai’an of the Fortune Gambling House has also been apprehended." Wang Ding Race solemnly clasped his hands and said, "After preliminary interrogation, Huang Huai’an confessed to his crimes and pointed out the involvement of the Chief Steward of Brocade Manor and Huangfu Deyun of the Qianma Huangfu Family."
As he said this, he took out the signed and sealed confession and handed it to Xiahou Hongde, "Please take a look, Lord City Guard."
Upon inspection,
The confession was indeed complete, legal, and valid.
Immediately, his expression changed, and he looked menacingly at Huangfu Deyun.
Previously, constrained by evidence, he had halted Zhou Zhenwu’s request to make arrests. Yet unexpectedly, within less than half an hour, Wang Ding Race threw the evidence right in his face.
Huangfu Jinhuan swiftly stepped forward and said, "Lord City Guard, Wang Ding Race is a member of the Wang Race. Emotionally and legally, he shouldn’t be involved in this matter."
"Lord City Guard." Wang Ding Race coldly stated, "I merely acted on insider information, reporting that the Fortune Gambling House and Brocade Manor, as well as Qianma Huangfu Family, were suspected of collusion with the enemy. I handled this case according to the law and came to arrest those involved, as per my duty. How is this related to the Wang Race?"
Huangfu Jinhuan’s face stiffened, but he argued, "The people from the Fortune Gambling House are mere lowlifes. For Commander Wang to arrest based solely on their accounts is rather hasty, isn’t it? If it’s really like this, I could easily find a hundred beggars to claim that the Wang Race is colluding with the Yin Sha Sect; would you then arrest Wang Shouzhe?"
"None of the evidence implicates the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, so why is the Huangfu Race so restless?" Wang Ding Race remained calm, "I wouldn’t arrest anyone based on a single account. Bring in the physical evidence."
He then signaled, and two soldiers brought in a large crate of accounting books.
Wang Ding Race reported in an orderly manner, "These are the yet-undestroyed books from the Fortune Gambling House and Brocade Manor; although the records are concealed, some funds are unaccounted for. Upon investigation, they were used to purchase resources for the Yin Sha Sect disciples in the Hundred Islands Guard black market, ultimately transferred to Brocade Manor. All accounts match. Patriarch Huangfu, if you wish to view the detailed evidence, please apply at the City Guardian’s Mansion according to Daqian Laws."
"Moreover, we have locked down Brocade Manor, where traces of the Yin Sha Evil Dao’s life and cultivation can be found." Wang Ding Race said with a serene expression, "The existing evidence is enough to arrest those involved. A thorough interrogation will clarify the entire situation."
With both testimonial and physical evidence in place.
City Lord Xiahou Hongde looked sternly at Huangfu Deyun, "Patriarch Deyun, Commander Wang’s evidence is substantial. I advise you to go with him."
"Rest assured, Lord City Guard." Wang Ding Race said, "Once we apprehend Huangfu Deyun and others, I assure you we will investigate this matter thoroughly, sparing no wrongdoer."
Upon hearing this, not only did Huangfu Deyun’s face pale, but even Huangfu Jinhuan and Ancestor Hua Ye’s expressions changed.
Even though the Celestial Person Huangfu Family had kept themselves clean on the surface, and the accounts couldn’t be traced to them, if Huangfu Deyun couldn’t withstand interrogation...
Patriarch Xu Anbang of the Changning Xu Family sneered disdainfully, "Huangfu Deyun, I thought you were a character, yet it turns out you really were colluding with the Yin Sha Sect."
He then bowed and said, "Lord City Guard, in my opinion, the energy of a mere Eighth-Grade Noble Family is limited; how could they have such deep ties with the Yin Sha Sect? Please, for the long-term peace of Changning Guard, thoroughly investigate this matter and restore a clear sky for Changning Guard!"
