Patriarch Lei Yangyu of the Celestial Human Lei Family also seized the opportunity to jab, "Qianma Huangfu Family has always followed the Celestial Person Huangfu Family. If you say the Celestial Person Huangfu Family knew nothing of this, I, Lei, am the first not to believe it."
"You are talking nonsense, slandering the Celestial Person Huangfu Family." Huangfu Jinhuan angrily rebutted, somewhat panicked himself.
If City Lord Xiahou Hongde were determined to investigate, no matter how deeply hidden the Celestial Person Huangfu Family was, it would be uncovered.
At this moment, Ancestor Hua Ye’s face gradually filled with rage, and he laughed in anger, "Good, good, good. Our Huangfu Family has always adhered to our duty of protecting Daqian, but unexpectedly, our branch family produced such a disgrace. It’s my fault for not managing them well."
Having said that!
A powerful and unmatched aura emanated from him, and with a flicker of his figure, he was in front of Huangfu Deyun, his palm engulfed in swirling flames as he aimed it at his head, "I will cleanse you, this disgrace, on behalf of the ancestors of the Huangfu Race!"

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 68: The End! Cutting Off the Celestial Human’s Arm (Seeking Monthly Votes)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 68: The End! Cutting Off the Celestial Human’s Arm (Seeking Monthly Votes)_4
"Boom!"
Amidst the sparks, Huangfu Deyun was slapped to death, his body immediately ignited, turning into a pile of ashes.
In this, although part of it was due to Huangfu Deyun not anticipating Ancestor Hua Ye’s move, or being too intimidated by accumulated awe to resist, it also showcased the unfathomable strength of Ancestor Hua Ye.
A dignified Spirit Platform Mirror Early Stage cultivator was instantly killed with a slap!
The other two Celestial Human Realm cultivators on site simply watched this scene without stepping in to help. After all, Qianma Huangfu Family was a branch of the Changning Huangfu Family, and in a sense, this was indeed an internal affair of the entire Huangfu Family.
However, this also means a high suspicion of silencing witnesses.
The scene fell utterly silent.
Some maintained a calm demeanor, while others showed fear in their eyes.
Only Patriarch Xu Anbang of the Xu Family sighed beside them and said, adding fuel to the fire, "Old Brother Deyun died so quickly, now it’s hard to investigate the mastermind behind this. Ancestor Hua Ye acted too impulsively, hasn’t he cut off the trail?"
Patriarch Lei Yangyu of the Lei Family also spoke with a sarcastic tone, "Brother Xu, your words are incorrect. A degenerate colluding with evil Yin Sha figures emerged among the same clan’s bloodline, and Ancestor Hua Ye’s righteous act of eliminating such scum is already not easy. Thus, it shows that this mastermind is definitely unrelated to the Celestial Person Huangfu Family."
"You two brats!" Ancestor Hua Ye’s face darkened, and he exclaimed in rage, "You dare behave so rudely. Even your family ancestor wouldn’t dare be so presumptuous in front of me..."
Although Ancestor Hua Ye is elderly, he has had a smooth life, and no one dares to defy him, hence his fiery temper isn’t small.
Huangfu Jinhuan also snapped back from his shock, sweating profusely, and hurriedly urged, "Ancestor, please calm down. It is our failure in leading our branch families that has led to some idle talk, which is normal. I implore that the ancestor not be angry with the juniors today."
By saying this, he implied that since they had already decided to kill someone publicly to silence them, today was not the time to stir up any more waves. Everything should wait until the matter calms down to avoid falling into the opponent’s calculations once more.
"Hmph!" The various changes of today had pushed Ancestor Hua Ye’s expression to its utmost of unpleasantness. He cupped his hands toward Xiahou Hongde and Faang You’an, saying, "I’ve embarrassed myself in front of both worthy brothers today. I’m feeling unwell, so I shall excuse myself."
Having said that, Ancestor Hua Ye could no longer bring himself to stay on the scene and left directly.
With his departure, the matter was settled.
Xiahou Hongde maintained his usual stance that everything should proceed according to procedures and evidence. Although Huangfu Deyun was dead now, with ample evidence, some key figures from the Qianma Huangfu Family couldn’t escape involvement.
He immediately ordered, "Zhou Zhenwu, Wang Ding Race, heed my command. I order you two to jointly oversee this case, ensuring strict procedures and lawful actions. Arrest and try those who need to be caught and interrogated."
"Yes, Lord City Guard."
Zhou Zhenwu and Wang Ding Race received the orders in unison and led people to the task.
With Xiahou Hongde’s final hammer fall, the Qianma Huangfu Family was utterly doomed, with no chance for recovery.
All participants of the evening banquet had no mood to stay, and they rose to leave.
In an instant, the previously bustling and vibrant Huangfu Family’s Main Residence suddenly turned desolate.
A mournful sense of people leaving the empty buildings and birds scattering to the winds lingered.
...
Along a wide boulevard.
A carriage moved slowly, with Wang Shouzhe and Xu Anbang sitting inside.
Once inside the private carriage, Xu Anbang shed his disguise and instantly entered a state of excitement, raising his fist and saying, "Shouzhe, this time we’ve won a huge victory, knocking off the claws of the Yin Sha Sect rogues and the Qianma Huangfu Family. Moreover, after all this, the Changning Huangfu Family’s reputation is ruined; who will still dare to trust them? Now the Huangfu Family is a general without an army. Ha ha, did you see Huangfu Jinhuan’s face at the end? As amusing as it gets."
"Uncle, have some spirit tea to calm your nerves." Wang Shouzhe leisurely brewed a pot of spirit tea, pouring him a cup, "The claws may be gone, but the Celestial Person Huangfu Family remains a giant we cannot underestimate."
Having succeeded in this scheme, Wang Shouzhe was also very excited, but being someone who had weathered great storms, he could still keep calm.
"Afraid of them?" Xu Anbang drank the spirit tea, feeling high-spirited, "When our Eighth-Grade Noble Families unite, we are overall stronger than them. Moreover, our Ancestor Beichen is only half a step away from the Celestial Human Realm."
The Xu Family of Changning had been suppressed by the Huangfu Family for hundreds of years, always the third within the guard of Changning. Now it finally has a chance to rid itself of the Huangfu Family’s shackles, how could Xu Anbang not be excited?
Today’s engagement was a huge victory, but it was also the result of Wang Shouzhe’s years of planning. Achieving a phased victory was to be expected. However, dealing with the Changning Huangfu Family, which had been hurt, wouldn’t be as easy going forward.
"Wait, this spirit tea seems like mine?" Xu Anbang drank the spirit tea, finding it more and more palatable, and took a closer look, realizing, uh-oh, this was his carriage!
It made him a little amused and annoyed that Shouzhe had indeed managed to outshine him as a guest in his own carriage. Earlier, he’d been careless and thought he’d entered his own carriage.
Just then.
Outside the carriage, the cheerful voice of Lei Yangyu from the Lei Family could be heard, "Old Brother Anbang, Younger Brother Shouzhe, may I join you in the carriage for a chat?"
Lei Yangyu was one of the two Celestial Human Family clan leaders in Changning Guard, a person whose status and position were not inferior to Huangfu Jinhuan, ferocious and influential in Changning Guard.
Such a person of stature.
Xu Anbang and Wang Shouzhe naturally didn’t dare show any negligence, hurrying to personally invite him into the carriage while exchanging pleasantries and offering him spirit tea.
The three of them chatted for a bit, and after a few rounds of tea, their relationship seemed to noticeably close.
Lei Yangyu then spoke with a chuckle, "Brother Anbang, Younger Brother Shouzhe, I have to say your workshop techniques were so top-notch that the Qianma Huangfu Family saw it necessary to conspire with the Yin Sha Sect to sabotage and steal them. Undoubtedly it’s top-tier technology in Longzuo County. Tut-tut, I must say, you really kept it well-hidden, only pulling it out at such a key moment. With this, your family’s rise is just around the corner."
"Afraid of them?" Xu Anbang answered, a bit high-spirited after drinking spirit tea, "With our collective strength, we can overshadow them. Moreover, our family’s Ancestor Beichen is only half a step away from the Celestial Human Realm."
The Changning Xu Family had been oppressed by the Huangfu Family for hundreds of years, always remaining as the third within the Changning Guard. It had always been the plan of Wang Shouzhe for years, and achieving a phase victory was only natural. However, it was to be expected that dealing with the wounded Changning Huangfu Family will not be so easy in the future.
Suddenly!
Outside the carriage came a slightly authoritative voice, "Patriarch Shouzhe, may I have a word?"
It was no wonder that Lord City Guard was in a bad mood.
Throughout all the events of today, he had been used as a tool.
There wasn’t even an opportunity to refuse or react, he was just silently put in line!
Lei Yangyu of the Lei Family, along with Xu Anbang of the Xu Family, couldn’t afford any negligence, so they personally went to invite him onto the carriage, exchanging pleasantries and sharing spirit tea.
The three exchanged small talk; after a few cups of tea, their relationship seemed to grow closer.
Lei Yangyu continued with a slightly scornfully sarcastic tone, "It’s truly unfortunate for the Qianma Huangfu Family’s founding Ancestor Huangfu Jinyuan, once a Little Celestial Pride of his generation, could not ultimately escape the control of the main family and ended up in such a fate."
Wang Shouzhe and the others shared the same sentiment, sighing at the thought. Even comparing the relationship of the Black Tortoise Clan’s main family with its branches, it was reminiscent of many ordinary modern families on Earth, where many cannot escape the influence and unseen control of their original families.
Biological and psychological imprints often accompany a person throughout their life.
Suddenly!
Outside the carriage, a voice slightly tinged with sternness called out, "Is Patriarch Shouzhe inside?"
The voice carried a sense of unresolved anger.
No wonder Lord City Guard was not in a good mood.
From all that happened today, he had been arranged without even the chance to resist or speak against it!
Lei Yangyu of the Lei Family and Xu Anbang of the Xu Family dared not show any sign of disrespect to him; they quickly stepped down to invite him onto the carriage, exchanging courtesy and serving spirit tea.
Keeping his composure, Wang Shouzhe gave them a reassuring look and responded gracefully in a loud voice, "Lord Xiahou City Guard has summoned, how can Shouzhe not comply?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 69 Gradually Becoming a Big Shot Wang Shouzhe
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 69 Gradually Becoming a Big Shot Wang Shouzhe
...
Following this, Wang Shouzhe and the three others got off the carriage together. After exchanging greetings with clasped hands, Lei Yangyu immediately found an excuse to leave, and even Xu Anbang casually made up a reason to depart the carriage.
This caused Lei Yangyu to glance at him sideways: "Brother Anbang, isn’t this your carriage?"
Xu Anbang shrugged helplessly.
What else could he do?
Ah~ It’s not easy being a noble family head these days~
Meanwhile, putting their subtle exchanges aside, Wang Shouzhe invited Xiahou Hongde into the carriage.
Inside the carriage, the two sat facing each other.
Faced with Xiahou Hongde’s slightly sharp gaze, Wang Shouzhe maintained a calm and serene demeanor, as if the Lord City Guard opposite him wasn’t here to cause trouble.
He elegantly brewed a pot of Spirit Tea, and served a cup with folded sleeves: "This is ’Jade Hook Green,’ a treasured tea from Patriarch Xu of the Changning Xu Family. It’s refreshing and subtly bitter, with a lingering taste, most suitable for savoring in this crisp autumn weather."
The tea leaves resembled small jade hooks, perfectly complementing the mutton fat jade porcelain tea bowls in which it’s served.
Xiahou Hongde remained silent, keeping his majestic stance. He took a sip of tea and slightly frowned: "It’s bland."
"Perhaps I didn’t consider enough." Wang Shouzhe chuckled lightly, warm as jade, "Xiahou City Guard, being a hero from the military family background, values grandiosity and strength beyond measure. Naturally, the mild taste of this Spirit Tea isn’t to your liking."
"Strength beyond measure? That’s grand!" Xiahou Hongde’s eyes lit up, revealing a longing expression, "Could this be the feat of some senior from the Purple Mansion? But, I doubt even a Purple Mansion Ascendant could move a mountain. Maybe a senior specializing in War Body could manage a smaller one?"
"..."
Wang Shouzhe’s eyelids twitched, he almost couldn’t keep it together.
I was talking about mental realms, and you’re discussing the feasibility of practical operations? Are these the same thing?!
However, he understood.
The education received by those from military family backgrounds is vastly different from that of local Black Tortoise Clans, leading to differing perspectives.
They emphasize passion, courage, military discipline, and camaraderie.
No wonder the statement resonated with the counterpart.
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe brushed his storage ring and brought out a flask of wine, pouring a glass with the finest glassware: "Xiahou City Guard, try a taste of my personally brewed ’Fire Crystal Burn.’"
Fire Crystal Burn?
Xiahou Hongde fixed his gaze on the transparent glass, in which the wine was a fiery red color, with its potent aroma soon permeating the carriage.
He frowned slightly: "It seems to be spirit wine brewed from Red Crystal Spirit Rice, like ’Red Flame Mist’ but with a more intense fiery color and clearer wine."
Red Flame Mist, a spirit wine wildly popular among officers in the military camps, famed for being available at the Hundred Flavors Pavilion.
As for why officers prefer it? Naturally, it’s because the modest pay of ordinary Profound Warrior Soldiers cannot afford "Red Flame Mist."
"Indeed, my ’Fire Crystal Burn’ is also brewed from Red Crystal Spirit Rice." Wang Shouzhe introduced with a smile, "However, the method and craftsmanship differ greatly. Xiahou City Guard, please have a taste first."
Truthfully, at today’s night banquet, the Huangfu Family also served excellent wine, and Xiahou Hongde drank quite a bit. With cultivation at his level, getting drunk wasn’t easy.
He truly didn’t think Wang Shouzhe would have something superior to the treasured wines of the Huangfu Family.
However, for Wang Shouzhe to bring it out so earnestly, this wine must have its uniqueness. Besides, it did seem particularly rich in aroma.
Slightly curious, Xiahou Hongde picked up the wine glass and drank half in one go.
"Hiss!"
The wine slid down his esophagus into his stomach like silk, first leaving a refreshing cool sensation, then burning fiercely in the stomach as if set aflame. For a master of Xiahou Hongde’s cultivation level, even he felt his blood abruptly quicken, and a uncontrollable flush bloomed on his face.
His eyes widened in astonishment.
After a dozen or so breaths, he finally relaxed, letting out a comfortable breath, eyes bright with praise: "A fine ’Fire Crystal Burn’ indeed! Truly excellent wine, with enough strength! Compared to this, Red Flame Mist is for the little ladies."
He was full of praises for Fire Crystal Burn, completely forgetting how much he once loved Red Flame Mist. He clutched the glass tightly, his gaze fixed on Fire Crystal Burn, as if having found a new passion.
No wonder he had such a reaction — Fire Crystal Burn was not made through ordinary brewing methods, but was a high-proof spirit distilled by Wang Shouzhe.
Coupled with the flame energy contained in the Red Crystal Spirit Rice, it naturally achieved the refreshing smoothness of high-proof alcohol upon entry, followed by the delightful sensation of fiery burn.
The renowned "Red Flame Mist" is merely akin to rice wine with an alcohol content of little over ten degrees, while "Fire Crystal Burn" ranges from sixty to seventy degrees, hot enough to be ignited.
Incomparably different.
"You, young man, indeed know how to gauge people’s hearts, truly a skill." Xiahou Hongde, half a glass of Fire Crystal Burn down, already felt somewhat elated, his speech less guarded and more genuine, "No wonder, with you at the helm, the declining Ping’an Wang Family could transform so drastically in just ten years."
Talking about this matter, Xiahou Hongde couldn’t help but feel a mix of emotions.
He has been seated at the City Guard’s position in Changning Guard for seventeen years.
During the first seven of those, he barely noticed the so-called Ping’an Wang Family. In his view, it was merely a small, declining family struggling to survive in the remote corners of Ping’an Town, on the brink of collapse.
Yet he never expected that one day, this declining small family would rise. The two other families residing in Ping’an Town suddenly disappeared, just like that...
If it was just that, it wouldn’t be remarkable in Xiahou Hongde’s eyes. But he could hardly imagine how the family continued to soar, not only becoming an Eighth-Grade Noble Family, but growing to its current stature, possessing the capability and qualifications to influence the affairs of Changning Guard.
This time, he secretly stirred the winds and clouds, involving most of the powerful families of the Changning Guard. Through unique negotiation, he indirectly confronted the Huangfu Family, causing the esteemed Celestial Person Huangfu Family to suffer a major blow.
"Xiahou City Guard praises me too much." Wang Shouzhe smiled and respectfully filled his glass with wine, "Shouzhe is only the Patriarch of the Wang Family, and I merely strive to let my clansmen live better lives, hardly anything worth calling skillful."
"However, don’t think I’ll forgive you so easily."
After the praise from Xiahou Hongde, he immediately became serious, his immense Profound Qi surged out, enveloping the entire carriage.
The mighty pressure descended on Wang Shouzhe like a mountain.
"You secretly stirred up trouble, causing great waves in the Changning Guard without mentioning it. You even dared to use me, the City Guard, as a knife, involving even the Patrol Second Battalion and Patrol Third Battalion as tools in your family’s power struggle. Wang Shouzhe, tell me, how should I deal with you as the City Guard?"
He was somewhat embarrassed and angry, realizing unknowingly, he had been maneuvered by this kid! He really wanted to ask him, where do you place me as the City Guard? Perhaps you’d like to be the City Guard instead?
Anyone else at the Spirit Platform Realm, facing the overwhelming pressure of a Celestial Human Realm practitioner, would likely be drenched in sweat.
However, Wang Shouzhe remained calm and steady amidst the pressure, like a lone boat in the stormy waves, seemingly dangerous yet unable to be overturned by the towering waves.
He smiled calmly: "Xiahou City Guard jokes. I believe the City Guard, having served in Changning for nearly twenty years, must be familiar with Changning’s situation and know much about my Wang Family’s past."
"My Ping’an Wang Family just wants to quietly farm, develop the economy, and earn more resources to secure a good future for the descendants. But as they say, when the tree desires calm, the wind won’t cease. My Wang Family’s actions are merely to avoid repeating past mistakes. I hope the City Guard can overlook the incident where he was offended."
Wang Shouzhe did not deny his actions, while he manipulated events from behind the scenes. Yet among the big figures of the Changning Guard, who is there merely eating for nothing?
"Forget it, forget it." Xiahou Hongde, seeing that he begged for mercy, his anger dissipated, and he drank the Fire Crystal Burn in his cup in one gulp.
In reality, he also had no way to deal with Wang Shouzhe.
This kid handled things flawlessly, although using the Patrol Camp and Xiahou Hongde as knives, the actual engagement with the Yin Sha Sect was well-proven.
"The Qianma Huangfu Family indeed brought their misfortune upon themselves." Xiahou Hongde waved his hand, licked his lips, still reminiscing about the Fire Crystal Burn, saying, "Let’s see, a hundred jin, no, two hundred jin of Fire Crystal Burn, and then the City Guard will forgive you."
Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but silently laugh.
Xiahou City Guard, your forgiveness is a bit too cheap~
Although Fire Crystal Burn is brewed from Red Crystal Spirit Rice, the expense isn’t insignificant, but the cost of two hundred jin of wine is at most a few hundred Qian Gold. Compared to the worth of a Celestial Human Realm practitioner, it’s really nothing.
However, he didn’t respond directly, instead bringing out a Mutton Fat Jade Porcelain Flat Sea Bowl, filled it with more than half a bowl of Fire Crystal Burn, and said, "Just now, the way to drink Fire Crystal Burn wasn’t authentic, let me show Xiahou City Guard the traditional method."
Xiahou Hongde’s attention was immediately drawn in.
He stared at the Sea Bowl, curious to see what tricks Wang Shouzhe could play?
Wang Shouzhe took out a piece of Fire Spirit Stone, operated Profound Qi to ignite it, and the Fire Spirit Stone immediately burst into flame.
Then, Wang Shouzhe placed the burning Fire Spirit Stone into the Sea Bowl.
In an instant.
The Fire Crystal Burn in the flat Sea Bowl spontaneously ignited without warning, flames blazed, forming a beautiful blue flame at the mouth of the Sea Bowl.
"This, this, this..."
Xiahou Hongde was shocked; the Fire Crystal Burn could actually catch fire, no wonder it was so fierce.
Xiahou Hongde didn’t know that only high-alcohol spirits above fifty degrees could ignite. For liquors at seventy degrees, the flame they produce when burning looks very impressive.
"Honorable City Guard, please drink this wine while it’s hot."
Wang Shouzhe made a gesture of invitation.
Xiahou Hongde hesitated slightly. He had lived a lifetime and never drunk burning wine before.
This was just so thrilling~
However, driven by curiosity, he relied on his cultivation in the Celestial Human Realm, steeling his mind, he picked up the Sea Bowl and tossed back the Fire Crystal Burn and Fire Spirit Stone in one go.
Wang Shouzhe looked on, twitching his mouth.
Intense flame flavor instantly ignited Xiahou Hongde, sliding down the throat into his stomach, he felt engulfed by flames, his whole face flushed red.
All over his body, the pores opened in an instant, faint streams of water vapor began to emerge.
This fierce stimulation was something he had never experienced in his two hundred-plus years of existence.
Long after, he finally regained his senses and excitedly slapped his thigh: "Good, good wine! This is Fire Crystal Burn! The authentic way to drink Fire Crystal Burn. Enough punch~! Though pairing it with a piece of Fire Spirit Stone each time is a bit costly~"
"Um..." Wang Shouzhe wiped the sweat from his forehead and softly said, "Honorable City Guard, did you eat the Fire Spirit Stone too?"
"I did, it feels quite exhilarating." Xiahou Hongde smacked his lips, savoring it but furrowed his brows, "It’s still burning in my stomach, I can only wrap it with Profound Qi... what’s next? Digest it?"
"This, this this..."
Wang Shouzhe was speechless, indeed a monster of the Celestial Human Realm.
He coughed, cautiously explained, "Honorable City Guard, you’d better find a secluded spot to spit it out later. It was just meant for ignition..."
Alas~ invited for a drink, and lost a Fire Spirit Stone.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 70 Tragedy! Lord City Guard’s Double Happiness
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 70 Tragedy! Lord City Guard’s Double Happiness
...
"This..."
Xiahou Hongde’s eyes were as wide as copper bells, staring at Wang Shouzhe with a fiery gaze.
Such an important matter, you brat didn’t mention it earlier? He even thought that swallowing the Fire Spirit Stone was a necessary step for drinking Fire Crystal Burn~!
Who would have thought, it was just to light a fire... or to add some ceremonial feeling.
Instantly, Xiahou Hongde felt the burning sensation in his stomach becoming stronger.
The difficulty of using Profound Qi to envelop the Fire Spirit Stone in the stomach is not small! Moreover, that "Fire Crystal Burn" is not simple either. After gulping down more than half a sea bowl, his whole body was heated, and his blood kept accelerating.
This was simply double the pleasure.
He hesitated whether he should first get off the carriage and expel that damned Fire Spirit Stone.
"However, Xiahou City Guard is indeed worthy of being a Celestial Human Realm Cultivator." Wang Shouzhe said while cupping his hands towards Xiahou Hongde, showing admiration, praising incessantly, "To swallow a burning Fire Spirit Stone calmly, truly has profound skills that reach the sky."
It’s known that once the Fire Spirit Stone is activated, it can burn without oxygen, releasing scorching heat waves. This stimulation, most people cannot endure.
Upon hearing this.
Xiahou Hongde immediately dismissed the thought of getting off the carriage to vomit.
"It’s just a trivial trick. When you, Patriarch Shouzhe, advance to the Celestial Human Realm, you will naturally be able to do it too."
He forcefully endured the intense discomfort and strange sensation, as if his organs were being roasted in a fireplace, and managed to display an air of mystery and nonchalance.
He picked up the Spirit Tea, which he had previously found bland, and slowly "savored" it, maintaining the demeanor of a serene expert even in the face of the collapse of Liping Mountain: "What were we talking about just now? Oh, yes, give me three hundred jins of Fire Crystal Burn, then this City Guard will forgive you this time."
This Fire Crystal Burn is really good stuff~
After just one drink, he was hooked. Even though he swallowed the Fire Spirit Stone, his stomach couldn’t handle it.
It’s very suitable for people like him, um, powerful soldiers who can lift mountains and cover the world. This made him nostalgic for the days when he was in the Spirit Platform Realm, fighting alongside his brothers on the battlefield.
Unconsciously, he raised the stakes by another hundred jins.
"A mere three hundred jins of Fire Crystal Burn is nothing. Besides, how long can a little Fire Crystal Burn last?" Wang Shouzhe nonchalantly refilled his tea, leisurely saying, "Xiahou City Guard is now just over two hundred years old, in the prime of life. Even if you only drink a hundred jin a year, you’d need to consume fifty or sixty thousand jins in your lifetime."
Fifty or sixty thousand jins?
Xiahou Hongde stalled, wondering why he hadn’t thought of this calculation?
Oh, right, this brat included his Purple Mansion Realm lifespan as well.
This brat really knows how to talk.
I like it.
However, he made a good point; even if he drinks a hundred jins a year, he’d still need to consume ten to twenty thousand jins in his lifetime, right?
Suddenly, he hesitated and asked, "Patriarch Shouzhe, how much does this wine cost per jin?"
Even the Red Mist Burn, which he was now bored of, costs several Qian Gold per jin. A "unparalleled fine wine" like Fire Crystal Burn probably wouldn’t be less than ten Qian Gold, right?
With his salary, he could afford to drink it.
But Xiahou Hongde was not a lone wolf; he had a big family to support, and his children and grandchildren were scattered across various military camps. He always had to subsidize them a bit.
Moreover, a Celestial Human Realm cultivator has Celestial Human Realm expenses; daily cultivation consumes resources, accumulating into astronomical figures over time. If one has ambition and seeks advancement, it’s not unusual for a Celestial Human Realm cultivator to spend tens of thousands of Qian Gold on cultivation each year.
This is also why some families that are not good at managing finances and have insufficient financial resources cannot advance to the Celestial Human Realm, or even if they do somehow, without quickly opening a source of income, a single Celestial Human Realm member could bring down the family.
Of course, if a Celestial Human Realm member appears, the family’s status changes.
With the protection of the Celestial Human Ancestor, they can quickly develop industries and expand financial resources. At the very least, the Celestial Human Ancestor can go hunt in the Outer Domain to maintain it.
However, hunting in the Outer Domain is ultimately a dangerous task, and missteps could lead to falling in battle. Therefore, it’s not a long-term strategy.
Putting aside idle chatter for now.
Wang Shouzhe leisurely said, "If sold externally, I tentatively set the price at ten Qian Gold per jin."
As expected!
Xiahou Hongde’s eyes slightly narrowed, a thousand Qian Gold is not an astronomical figure for a Celestial Human Realm cultivator. However, a long-term annual expenditure becomes an enormous cost.
"How about this, I offer you a price of seven Qian Gold per jin, with an annual quota of three thousand jins for Xiahou City Guard." Wang Shouzhe, who preferred drinking Spirit Tea, said, refilling his own cup, "After all, our Wang Family doesn’t solely rely on selling wine for a living."
Seven Qian Gold per jin? Three thousand jin quota! And annually at that!
Xiahou Hongde’s eyes glazed over.
If he could resell them, wouldn’t he make an extra twenty thousand plus Qian Gold out of thin air?
He fell silent, looking at Wang Shouzhe with an unusual gaze.
This kid, with a single word, proposes a business worth tens of thousands of Qian Gold annually, appearing as if it’s just a casual move. No wonder... he managed to unite so many noble families in a short time, and even the Changning Xu Family seems to regard him as a leader.
This is a God of Wealth~ Who wouldn’t like the God of Wealth?
"Patriarch Shouzhe, you’re bribing me," Xiahou Hongde said gravely, "What’s your purpose?"
As a City Guard, he had seen the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 70 Tragedy! Lord City Guard’s Double Happiness_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 70 Tragedy! Lord City Guard’s Double Happiness_2
He dared to take a share of the profits from the Fortune Gambling House because it was implicit income understood by successive city guards—it would be a waste not to take it.
But if Wang Shouzhe wanted to use money to force him, dragging him into a noble family feud, wouldn’t that be counterproductive?
"Xiahou City Guard, you worry too much," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile. "If I wanted to involve you in family struggles, would I bring it up afterward? I’m simply leveraging your military connections to sell wine and expand our family’s sources of income. It’s purely a business collaboration, nothing more."
"Of course, should there be anything appropriate, reasonable, and legal within your jurisdiction that you can assist with, I would be most grateful. It would be an act of mutual support."
"Fine." Xiahou Hongde eventually couldn’t resist the temptation and agreed with a smile, "I can only promise that during my term, I’ll provide your family some convenience in line with Daqian Law. At the same time, I’ll subtly hint to the Huangfu family not to cause trouble during my term."
"In that case, thank you, Xiahou City Guard."
Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands in thanks, his smile becoming even more sincere.
He indeed believed Xiahou Hongde would subtly warn the Huangfu Family, as it concerned the peace of Changning Guard during his term.
However, it was in vain; Xiahou Hongde overestimated his deterrent power over the Huangfu Family and underestimated the immense pressure they faced for survival and promotion.
The way things would develop was destined to disappoint Xiahou Hongde~
With the benefit of cooperation, Xiahou Hongde’s attitude towards Wang Shouzhe changed somewhat.
After exchanging a few more words, Xiahou Hongde left with a few jugs of Fire Crystal Burn gifted by Wang Shouzhe.
Once he got off the carriage, his calm and collected appearance vanished without a trace, his face flushed red with embarrassment and discomfort.
Finding a corner, he no longer cared about anything else and immediately darted towards the City Guardian’s Mansion.
Because that damn Fire Spirit Stone unknowingly slipped beneath his stomach, entering an indescribably complex, longest organ of the human body.
...
Meanwhile, over on Wang Shouzhe’s side, just after sending off Xiahou City Guard, he welcomed another wave of guests.
It was the Direct Disciple Faang You’an from Purple Mansion Academy.
He maintained his warm and jade-like demeanor, a composed noble young master, even displaying a particularly graceful posture while savoring the spirit tea.
Smiling, he teased, "Junior Brother Shouzhe, you seem too popular. Now, to meet you, I have to queue."
"Hehe, Senior Brother Yoou’an, you’re joking," Wang Shouzhe replied with a slightly apologetic expression, "I know Senior Brother Yoou’an’s intentions. Indeed, it was my fault today, stirring up a storm while you’re in Changning Guard using the Academy’s prestige to deter Ancestor Hua Ye, making him hesitate temporarily."
Even though Faang You’an and the other academy disciples had not spoken or expressed opinions during the whole incident, it didn’t mean they weren’t part of Wang Shouzhe’s calculations.
In fact, if not for their presence, given the influence the Celestial Person Huangfu Family and Ancestor Hua Ye have in Changning Guard, they might have been able to cover up the matter, and Xiahou Hongde wouldn’t have decided to handle it impartially so decisively.
After all, the Academy’s influence on the official front is substantial. Xiahou Hongde also feared that his hesitation would affect his subsequent promotion and reputation.
Thus, the presence of Faang You’an and the other academy disciples became the most critical factor in executing this plan perfectly.
"No matter, being able to leverage the situation is your skill," Faang You’an said with a bland smile. "Besides, the opponent indeed had connections to the Yin Sha Sect. Since you’ve taken care of it, it’s considered a contribution to Daqian."
"Thank you, Senior Brother Yoou’an, for understanding," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile. "Senior Brother Yoou’an, your timing is perfect. Here, try the ’Ice Mountain Fire Burn’ I personally brewed."
With that, he snapped his fingers, producing another jug of spirit wine.
"..."
Faang You’an was a bit curious.
"Ice Mountain Fire Burn" was also a high-proof spirit. However, Wang Shouzhe’s "Ice Mountain Fire Burn" was brewed using White Jade Orchid Spirit Rice, complemented by Ice Dew Grass, making it crystal clear and sparkly like ice, emitting a faint chill.
When the liquor was poured into a specially thickened glass, strands of white mist spiraled and rose, lending it an aura resembling immortal rhyme.
"This wine pairs well with Ice Spirit Stones."
As he said this, Wang Shouzhe took out an Ice Spirit Stone, activating it with his Profound Qi before putting it into the glass.
In an instant, the white mist transformed into frost, and a layer of gorgeous ice flowers formed at the rim of the glass.
"Interesting, let me try it."
Faang You’an picked up the thickened glass, ready to take a sip.
Recalling the previous lesson, Wang Shouzhe quickly reminded him, "Senior Brother Yoou’an, don’t drink the spirit stone with it."
Faang You’an gave Wang Shouzhe a sideways glance filled with an unusual look: "Junior Brother Shouzhe, is there really a need for such a reminder? I’m not foolish enough to swallow a spirit stone."
"Uh... haha~ It’s just me talking too much." Wang Shouzhe chuckled awkwardly and gestured, "Please, Senior Brother Yoou’an."
Faang You’an inhaled the aroma slightly and then gracefully took a sip.
The next moment, his calm expression shifted slightly, then changed again, followed by yet another change, his eyes becoming somewhat hazy as if lost in some memory.
It took a full ten breaths before his eyes cleared up, and he expressed his mild wonderment, "Now I understand why this wine is named ’Ice Mountain Fire Burn.’ It’s like drinking chilled wine when it enters the mouth, leaving one’s whole body icy and refreshing. Yet after the refreshing surge, the organs feel like they’re burning. Good wine, good wine. However..."
"Might Senior Brother Yoou’an find it lacking?" Wang Shouzhe asked humbly.
"There’s nothing lacking; it’s just that the name could be different." Faang You’an’s eyes slightly squinted, "This wine, at first glance, is like a pure, gentle lady, and the initial sip is exquisite. But when you truly drink it, you discover its nature is rather fiery, aggressively tormenting you to the point of pain. Yet, upon reflection, you’ve fallen in love with its indescribable taste. Why not rename it—’Ice Woman’?"
"..."
Wang Shouzhe was speechless, thinking that Senior Brother Yoou’an must have quite the colorful life experience~
Wondering which Senior Sister handled him so deftly that even Senior Brother Yoou’an was moved.
But Ice Woman—
Alright! As long as you’re happy, you’re the Celestial Human Realm Cultivator. With big fists, you have the say.
Wang Shouzhe decided that the promotional words on the wine’s future packaging would cite Senior Brother Yoou’an’s description. And it must be credited.
Even the Academy’s Direct Disciples rave about the wine. Don’t you want to give it a try?
Subsequently, Wang Shouzhe used his usual tricks to send Faang You’an off to sell the wine.
Despite being an Academy Direct Disciple, a Disciple is only human and needs to gather resources to ascend to the Purple Mansion, don’t they?
It’s mutual benefit~
...
After Faang You’an left, the carriage Wang Shouzhe "borrowed" welcomed another guest.
It was "Lady Jii" dressed by Wang Mei.
In the recent operation to cut off the Huangfu Family’s claws, she played a significant role. Moreover, her identity remained useful for the subsequent strategic arrangements.
Especially after the unintentional endorsement by Jii Mingyu, her identity representing the "Jii Family" was now "beyond doubt."
"Wang Mei," Wang Shouzhe still "entertained" her with "Jade Hook Green," saying, "You’ve indeed worked hard this time, and I still need you to endure a little longer."
"Patriarch Shouzhe, please call me ’Lady Jii,’" Lady Jii said, full of alluring charm, her eyes filled with a bit of long-term resentment, "Don’t call out the wrong name."
"Hiss~"
Wang Shouzhe could only feel helpless. Wang Mei was great in every way, but once she entered the role, it was quite overwhelming for him.
"Well..." Wang Shouzhe coughed lightly, "Aren’t you afraid the Huangfu Family will be enraged at seeking me out at such an hour?"
"Afraid of what?" Lady Jii shot a charming glance, her voice inexplicably alluring, "The more provoked they are, the more they’ll fear losing me, and the more they will value me. Just like men..."
Uh...
You make such good points, but I’m afraid my wife might not understand.
Wang Shouzhe sighed inwardly.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 71: The Foundation of a Strong Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 71: The Foundation of a Strong Family
...
Facing the somewhat ethereal Lady Jii, Wang Shouzhe sipped his "Jade Hook Green" to calm his nerves and quickly changed the topic: "Let’s talk about the reward, shall we? You’ve achieved such a great feat this time; your merit points are naturally enormous. What would you like to exchange from the clan treasury? If it’s not available, I can find a way to have someone procure it."
"Anything can be exchanged?" Lady Jii’s eyes twinkled slightly, her charming gaze fixed intently on Wang Shouzhe.
"Of course..." Wang Shouzhe wanted to say that anything available in the clan could be exchanged. But her gaze was so off, like she wanted to devour someone, that he quickly held back his words, "Naturally, not everything can be exchanged."
"Oh, then it’s not interesting anymore." Lady Jii regretfully withdrew her gaze, "Currently, cultivation resources are sufficient, and merit points just pile up with nowhere to spend. I suggest, Patriarch Shouzhe, expand the exchange list, don’t limit it to just cultivation materials. This way, clan members will have more motivation to strive."
Wang Shouzhe broke into a cold sweat; this logic is way too strong. For the development of the clan, should I, the Patriarch, even put myself on the exchange list?
...
While Wang Shouzhe was in a small carriage, receiving wave after wave of guests,
the main residence of the Celestial Person Huangfu Family was shrouded in gloom.
The normally arrogant household servants and generals did not dare to make a sound, feeling the oppressive heaviness enveloping the entire clan.
In the secret chamber,
Ancestor Hua Ye, who started off spirited but left in anger, had an especially grim expression. His red hair stood on end without wind, cloaked in a faint layer of flame.
A strong and overwhelming aura permeated the secret chamber, seemingly venting the frustration within him.
"Changning Xu Family, Ping’an Wang Family, you’ve gone too far." Ancestor Hua Ye’s voice was low and repressed, "I will not let this matter rest."
Patriarch Huangfu Jinhuan shared the same aggrieved expression, eyes flickering with intense hatred. As if he wished to immediately gather the household generals to annihilate the Changning Xu Family, and along the way, crush the Ping’an Wang Family as well.
But he was well aware that now was not the right time to act.
As the head of a clan, Huangfu Jinhuan carried a heavy burden. Suppressing the raging anger in his heart, he advised, "Ancestor, now is not the time for retaliation. Given the recent major incident, eyes from all sectors are on us."
"Moreover, the disciples of the Purple Mansion Academy are currently in our Changning Guard overseeing disaster relief, and they seem to have a good relationship with the Ping’an Wang Family. Please, Ancestor, endure a little longer; the relief work is nearly complete, and they will leave soon."
In the end, Ancestor Hua Ye, with his hundreds of years of life experience, after venting and being comforted, slowly withdrew the anger and killing intent from his eyes, speaking in a cold tone: "I just didn’t expect, for a small group of pests, to dare flaunt their dominance in front of me. Jinhuan, how’s the investigation into the foreign cement production base going?"
"That matter is progressing very smoothly. Our people have infiltrated their peripheral industries and gathered significant information." As soon as this was mentioned, Huangfu Jinhuan’s spirit immediately lifted, "However, their defenses are strict, and they’re extremely cautious."
"This is an industry that can propel the clan to great heights, so strict defense is to be expected." The greed in Ancestor Hua Ye’s eyes was intense, "You must act carefully, proceed steadily, and remember not to alarm the prey by being too hasty. Only by ultimately monopolizing the foreign cement formula can the Huangfu Family’s rise be truly heaven-sent."
The weaving industry, though also substantial, is crowded with giants, and one can expect blockades while truly trying to rise.
But the foreign cement industry is different, a fundamental material needed throughout the entire Longzuo County, no, even the Daqian Kingdom, far outstripping the weaving industry.
"Rest assured, Ancestor." Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes burned with excitement, "The matter at Golden Beach was our inadvertent error seized upon by others. But regarding foreign cement, we are purposefully scheming against the unguarded."
"Good, very good." Ancestor Hua Ye’s eyes flamed with fervor as well, "Once we control the foreign cement industry, we’ll even be able to acquire longevity treasures. By then, I will fully support your breakthrough to the Celestial Human Realm."
"Thank you, Ancestor." Huangfu Jinhuan’s heart swelled with warmth.
"Lady Jii must also be engaged to maintain and enhance relations. Ideally, through her, we can gradually connect with the Jii Family. The Longzuo Jii Family was once a Purple Mansion Family, even though their current power isn’t what it once was, they are far from being comparable to us." Ancestor Hua Ye instructed.
"Yes, Ancestor."
...
The next day!
At Golden Beach in Golden Sand Town.
The autumn season, neither dry nor flooded, is the best time for operating water-powered silk reeling and weaving machinery.
Driven by large waterwheels, the silk reeling machines began their rumble, achieving a semi-automated silk reeling process through a relatively simple structure.
With just a few skilled workers, a silk reeling machine can be watched over. And the output of this reeling machine is at least equal to the output of several dozen foot-operated silk reeling workers.
Wang Shouzhe, Changning Xu Anbang, Golden Sand Xu Anze, and Ancestor Beichen were all present. Each with eyes full of amazement, watching the operation of the water-powered silk reeling machines.
"Ingenious craftsmanship." Ancestor Beichen of the Xu Family exclaimed, "Patriarch Shouzhe truly has remarkable creativity to invent such a wondrous thing; truly, he is a sage reincarnate."
"Ancestor Beichen, you’re too kind." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and smiled, "I merely offered a few suggestions and improvements upon seeing how laborious it was to work on the foot-treadle silk reeling machine. The actual work was mostly done by my elder brother, Wang Shouxin, and Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou, who, along with the craftsmen, devoted themselves entirely to exploring and refining it bit by bit."
Wang Shouzhe was not being modest. His role was mostly to direct the overall direction or to provide insights when they hit a technical bottleneck with his "extraordinary" "knowledge."
If he were to fully dedicate himself to the development of a particular product, he certainly could achieve results. But as the family patriarch, should he spend all day on research and development without attending to anything else?
His elder brother, Wang Shouxin, was a down-to-earth person, more straightforward than Wang Shouzhe. After receiving the task, he became engrossed in it, spending years to achieve such results.
It’s worth mentioning Wang Shouzhe’s Fourth Aunt, Xu Zhirou. She was a very patient and skillful woman. After Wang Shouzhe lost his mother as a child, she took care of him and his siblings.
Back then, she made many small toys to keep Wang Shouzhe happy.
After the Wang Family embarked on the fast track of development and family industries were short of talent everywhere, Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou volunteered to manage the silk reeling section at Silkworm Manor, taking on some of the family’s burdens.
Of course, part of the reason was to earn more merit points for her son, Wang Shounuo.
Moreover, she hailed from the Golden Sand Xu Family.
Aside from a small amount of gold mining and some fertile land, most of the Golden Sand Xu Family’s land was used for mulberry tree cultivation, following land reclamation, resulting in many silkworm manors of varying sizes.
Having grown up with this backdrop, Fourth Aunt was no stranger to silk reeling, which is why Wang Shouzhe accepted her offer to take on the responsibility.
Later on, in the area of the mechanical structure of the water-powered silk reeling machine, Fourth Aunt Xu Zhirou suddenly displayed exceptionally strong talents and abilities. Her hands-on skills were remarkable, and many of the smaller constructions were ultimately designed and improved by her.
The seemingly simple little water-powered silk reeling machine and weaving machine actually contained the fruit of many years of effort from the Wang family’s related members.
Such achievements also made Wang Shouzhe feel at ease and proud. The Ping’an Wang Family was not solely supported by him nor led by a king among a group of bronze; every family member was striving to contribute to the family’s growth and strength.
While Wang Shouzhe and various patriarchs and ancestors were discussing these matters, Xu Zhirou finished her thorough inspection of the water-powered silk reeling machine and came over to report, "Shouzhe, this installation is very qualified, and the operation is quite smooth. The only issue is the need to consider water regulation during the wet and dry seasons."
"Thank you, Fourth Aunt." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands and said.
This workshop was overseen by Xu Zhirou, with each water-powered device being methodically installed by her and the craftsmen.
"Thank you, Second Sister." The Patriarch of the Golden Sand Xu Family, Xu Anze, quickly came forward with words of concern, showing great care for Xu Zhirou.
In truth, he also genuinely worried about Second Sister. After marrying into the Ping’an Wang Family and giving birth to Wang Shounuo, Wang Luotong, and Wang Luojing, her husband Wang Dingbang tragically passed away at thirty-seven.
From then on, she raised her children alone, and at that time, the Wang Family’s circumstances were not favorable, making life even more challenging. The Golden Sand Xu Family, as her natal family, provided support within their capabilities.
This is also why Xu Zhirou volunteered for the entire project of building the workshop on Golden Beach, both to serve the family and to return the care and support her maternal family had shown her and her household.
"Sister Zhirou," Changning Xu Anbang also approached with concern, "These days, we owe much to you. Recently, our Xu Family acquired some Beauty Pills. I thought they would be perfect for Sister Zhirou, so I brought them." As he spoke, he straightforwardly handed them to her.
Instantly, Xu Anze’s eyes widened. Though he and Xu Anbang were both of the An generation, the families split a hundred years ago. Xu Anbang’s casual address of "Sister Zhirou" sparked a bit of jealousy within him.
His eyes rolled, and he hurriedly produced a bottle of elixirs: "Second Sister, this bottle of Peiyuan Pills is for Luojing. She’s currently studying at the academy, and as her uncle, I must do my part." Before Xu Zhirou could decline, he firmly placed it in her hands.
Peiyuan Pills are second-grade elixirs, costing twenty to thirty Qian Gold each. Presenting a bottle of several pills was no small expense for the Golden Sand Xu Family.
"This..." Xu Zhirou held the bottles of Beauty and Peiyuan Pills, feeling troubled, and glanced towards Wang Shouzhe for assistance.
Before Wang Shouzhe could speak, Changning Beichen Ancestor laughed cheerfully and waved his hand, "Zhirou is indeed a rare talent from our Xu Family. She has dedicated herself to the developmental efforts of the three clans. You two patriarchs are being too stingy. Don’t you think so, Xu Ningwei?"
Xu Ningwei, also known as Ancestor Ningwei, was the Old Ancestor of the Golden Sand Xu Family and a nephew of Beichen Ancestor. The founding ancestor of the Golden Sand Xu Family was Beichen Ancestor’s direct brother, Xu Beixing, known as Ancestor Beixing.
Ancestor Beixing and Ancestor Zhou Xuan were of similar age and were geniuses of their generation. Unfortunately, due to resource limitations, he remained in the Initial Tier of the Spirit Platform Realm throughout his life.
And Ancestor Ningwei, Xu Ningwei, is Xu Beixing’s grandson and the second-generation ancestor of the Golden Sand Xu Family. Facing Beichen Ancestor, he naturally took a lower stance, hastily cupping his hands and saying, "The Ancestor is right."
With the Ancestor’s words, the two patriarchs naturally upped their offers, continually flattering Xu Zhirou.
As a result, Wang Shouzhe couldn’t help but quietly chuckle. Fourth Aunt had truly made a name for herself.
Nonetheless, this also showed the formidable nature of allied kinship. After all, they shared various blood ties and naturally trusted each other.
Wang Shouzhe was also secretly proud that the strength of a family couldn’t rely solely on him. Everyone doing their best would be what truly made the family grow stronger.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 72: Harvest! The Marriage Alliance Beams with Joy
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 72: Harvest! The Marriage Alliance Beams with Joy
...
After each Patriarch had witnessed and visited the silk reeling and weaving workshops, the Golden Sand Xu Family hosted a victory celebration in the main residence.
This time, due to the collaboration between the Wang Family and the Changning Xu Family, the Golden Sand Xu Family truly benefited greatly.
As long as the workshops can be operated smoothly, great future growth is anticipated!
Therefore, Clan Leader Xu Anze spared no expense to host a high-standard Spiritual Food Banquet to entertain the Patriarchs and Ancestors.
After rounds of toasting and drinking.
Wang Shouzhe suggested taking this opportunity to distribute the spoils of battle. The Ancestors and Patriarchs immediately perked up, each looking expectantly with bright expressions.
It’s no wonder, given the grand scale of this battle, the obtained spoils were also quite valuable.
Previously, Liua Ruolan had overseen the organization of the spoils, followed by a unified distribution.
Although everyone belonged to allied families, with the Ping’an Wang Family subtly in the lead, the distribution of interests is no trivial matter.
While speaking, Liua Ruolan, sitting next to Wang Shouzhe, handed over a detailed list of the battle spoils.
Wang Shouzhe took it casually and read aloud: "In the Battle of the Golden Beach, the spoils collected on site include one Middle-Grade Evil Dao Demon Artifact ’Yin Sha Asura Banner,’ with a black market valuation of eighty thousand Qian Gold."
"One Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifact ’Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler,’ with a black market valuation of ninety to one hundred and twenty thousand Qian Gold."
"One Middle-Grade Storage Ring, estimated at one hundred and twenty thousand."
"One Corpse Storage Coffin and Yin Sha Corpse Puppet Remains, estimated at fifty thousand."
"One Lower-Grade Demon Artifact ’Bone Whip,’ damaged, estimated at twenty-three thousand."
"A pair of Lower-Grade Demon Artifacts ’Ghost Claw,’ estimated at twenty-five thousand."
"One Lower-Grade Spiritual Artifact ’Nameless Sword,’ estimated at twenty-eight thousand."
"One Lower-Grade Storage Ring, estimated at thirty thousand."
"Various Gold Notes, Qian Gold, and other cash, totaling thirty-one thousand."
"Elixirs, consumables, Spirit Stones, etc., estimated totalling twenty thousand."
"The total value of all materials is approximately between four hundred seventy-seven thousand and five hundred thousand."
As Wang Shouzhe announced each item, every Ancestor showed a look of delight, especially when they heard the total value was around fifty thousand, their eyes gleamed with even more intensity.
Even the Ancestors of each family had no means to maintain their composure in the face of such massive profits.
Wealth moves the heart.
In this world, wealth represents resources. With resources, a family can grow and thrive, entering a virtuous cycle.
It can also prevent promising children in the family from being buried.
Therefore, no matter how good the relationship between families is, when it comes to economic interests, everything must be clearly delineated, straightforward and honest.
Wang Shouzhe was able to unite the families not only because he was willing to lead them in making money, but also because he could ensure fairness and justice in distributing the profits.
"Next is calculating the Merit Points based on contributions." Wang Shouzhe casually pulled out another list, "In this battle, as the leading party, our Wang Family with the planning and hidden effort gets 12 points. Wang Ding Race and Wang Zongwei earn 7 points for the casino effort. Ancestor Longyan earns 10 points for going to battle. Liua Ruolan and Spirit Turtle earned 7 points for overseeing commands, totaling 53 points."
"The Changning Xu Family assisted in the planning, initially earning 5 points; Beichen Ancestor earns 10 points for going to battle; Ancestor Ning City, as a backup, did not make a move, earning 5 points, a total of 20 points."
"The Golden Sand Xu Family assisted in planning, initially earning 2 points; Ancestor Ningwei earns 6 points for going to battle, totaling 8 points."
"Shanyin Liu Family’s Ancestor Yuanbai goes to battle, earning 8 points, additional help scores 5 points, totaling 13 points."
"East Port Chen Family’s Ancestor Ruhong goes to battle, earning 8 points, additional help scores 5 points, totaling 13 points."
"Shanyang Gongsun Family’s Ancestor Ao goes to battle, earning 8 points, additional help scores 5 points, totaling 13 points."
"Yingxiu Lu Family’s Ancestor Mingsheng goes to battle, earning 6 points, additional help scores 4 points, totaling 10 points."
"The entire Patrol Third Battalion Zhou Zhenwu goes to battle, earning 10 points, additional help scores 5 points, totaling 15 points."
"This is the Merit Points allocation for each family unit in this operation. Does anyone have any objections?" After Wang Shouzhe finished speaking, he seriously scanned the surroundings, "Any objections should be raised here and now, to be discussed clearly, do not grumble privately."
"Ahem!" Xu Anbang cleared his throat, "The Merit Points allocation done by Shouzhe is naturally fair. However, regarding the Ping’an Wang Family’s Merit Points calculation, I think it’s still undervalued. In the overall planning, Shouzhe, your side managed and contributed considerably with resources and manpower, at least 20 points. Ding Race’s effort to eliminate the casino also deserves 10 points. Ruolan and Spirit Turtle’s combat strength and contributions are significant, also deserving 10 points."
"Indeed." Ancestor Ruhong said, "Shouzhe, you mustn’t be too strict with your family just because you lead the distribution. Someone like me, Chen Ruhong, was nothing but a sole fighter coming to provide a bit of aid and earned 13 points. Your efforts are so plentiful, the points were unjust."
Other Ancestors also expressed their opinions one after another.
"No worries, then I’ll add another 2 points, our Ping’an Wang Family takes 55 points." Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Ultimately, it’s our Wang Family that sought revenge, it’s only right to exert more effort."
Despite further persuasion, Wang Shouzhe waved his hand and decisively said: "Thus, the total score is 155 points. For easy calculation, each point is settled as approximately 3,150 Qian Gold in income. Now, regarding the distribution of the battle spoils, our Wang Family wants that ’Yin Sha Asura Banner,’ since its black market price only reaches eighty thousand, we are willing to offer 26 points. Does anyone else wish to claim it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 72: Harvest! The Marriage Alliance Beams with Joy_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 72: Harvest! The Marriage Alliance Beams with Joy_2
This price slightly exceeds the Yin Sha Shura Banner by half a point, but as they are all in a marriage alliance, Wang Shouzhe is unwilling to take advantage.
The reason for wanting the Yin Sha Shura Banner is that this middle-grade demon artifact is very suitable for Ancestor Longyan, as it can assist her in cultivating the Yin Sha Power and can be used as a control tool in battlefield situations, greatly enhancing the overall strength of the Wang Family.
Since Wang Shouzhe wants this demon artifact and other families are unable to use such an artifact, it is naturally impossible for anyone to compete for this item.
After Wang Shouzhe asked three times and no one bid, the Yin Sha Shura Banner went to the Wang Family.
With this middle-grade spiritual artifact level demon artifact, Ancestor Longyan gains another powerful weapon. As a result, Ancestor Longyan’s combat power is nearly equivalent to the highest level in the Spirit Platform Realm.
"Middle-grade spiritual artifact ’Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler’, does anyone need it? Starting bid 28 points." Wang Shouzhe started to handle the next treasure, "Each increase must not be less than 1 point."
As soon as he finished speaking, several Ancestors’ eyes lit up instantly, their breathing became more intense.
The "Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler" was previously the clan’s spiritual artifact of the Qianma Huangfu Family and also the renowned spiritual artifact of Huangfu Jinyuan.
Unlike the Yin Sha Shura Banner, which basically no one could use, the Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler is very suitable as a combat spiritual artifact for families.
Moreover, it is a rare middle-grade spiritual artifact.
It is known that lower-grade spiritual artifacts are relatively easy to obtain on the market, while middle-grade or higher are almost in a state of being priced but not traded, always being hard to come by.
Even if one goes to auctions, it depends on luck to encounter one, and whether there are powerful families competing, missing out is common.
Only some established eighth-grade or seventh-grade noble families, after hundreds or thousands of years of accumulation, have some middle-grade spiritual artifacts in stock. Or, like Ancestor Zhou Xuan at the time, by pioneering in the Outer Domain, they can suddenly gather a handful of middle-grade spiritual artifacts.
"Everyone, please act according to your capability, let’s not harm the harmony." Seeing them a bit carried away, Wang Shouzhe immediately reminded and said, "Besides, my Wang Family will not compete this time."
For Wang Shouzhe, although the Dragon Tiger Demon-Subduing Ruler is good, it’s bullying to compete after having obtained the Yin Sha Shura Banner at the base price.
Moreover, whether it’s Wang Shouzhe’s "Heart Guard Shield", Liua Ruolan’s "Qiushui Sword", or Wang Lici’s "Big Hammer", they are all upper-grade spiritual artifacts.
Once Luqiu and Luojing cultivate for a while longer and reach the peak of the Qi Refining Realm and venture into the Trial Land, they can obtain two more upper-grade spiritual artifacts.
Why compete with the allied families?
Besides, in such close cooperation, enhancing their strength is indirectly enhancing the Wang Family’s strength.
The Ancestors exchanged glances and instantly understood why Wang Shouzhe was giving way, feeling moved again.
Wang Shouzhe is indeed befittingly Wang Shouzhe.
Just maintaining calm in the face of middle-grade spiritual artifacts, his composure and spirit instantly overshadowed them.
With Wang Shouzhe setting the standard, naturally, they could not appear too greedy.
Liua Yuanbai Ancestor coughed twice and said, "Everyone, such a quality middle-grade spiritual artifact can serve as a clan’s spiritual artifact. Let us speak with strength, my Liua Family bids 30 points."
The Liua Family currently has only 13 points, and the remaining deficit has to be compensated with Qian Gold. Each point must be supplemented by 3150 Qian Gold.
The price was immediately raised significantly by him.
"Yuanbai old brother is right, treasures are rare, everyone should contend." said Ancestor Ao of the Shanyang Gongsun Family, "Our Gongsun Family bids 32 points. My family’s Gongsun Mang has achieved minor success in the Geng Metal Battle Body, this treasure suits him best."
"This..."
Ancestor Beichen of the Xu Family frowned, he wanted this treasure too. But the Xu Family already has the "Dragon Suppression Stele", and secondly, he has become impoverished collecting resources for the Celestial Human Realm breakthrough and the partnership investment with the Wang Family.
An established eighth-grade noble family now still owes the Wang Family a substantial debt. Furthermore, if he successfully enters the Celestial Human Realm, future expenses will be greater...
Fine, better save some money.
Beichen Ancestor sighed, "Our Changning Xu Family withdraws from the competition."
Chen Family Ancestor Ruhong initially wanted to compete, but upon seeing Shanyang and Shanyin confronting each other, he furrowed his brow and announced withdrawal as well.
He has 13 points, which can be converted into over 40,000 Qian Gold.
Rather than butting heads, it’s better to save some foundation for the family and build more merchant ships.
The Golden Sand Xu Family and Yingxiu Lu Family, being insufficient in ninth-grade noble family foundation, knew they couldn’t compete against eighth-grade families and backed down to avoid offending anyone.
Thus, only Ancestor Yuanbai and Ancestor Ao were left competing.
Each point costs 3150 Qian Gold, and the two Ancestors were constantly deliberating and bidding.
Following the bid from 33 points to 34 points, and then Ancestor Ao called 36 points. Ancestor Yuanbai sighed, "Forget it, forget it, Ao old man, you truly have a stubborn temper, my Liua Family withdraws from the competition."
Liua Yuanbai was also considering Wang Shouzhe’s favor.
After all, he knows Wang Shouzhe spent significant effort establishing this alliance, and he doesn’t wish to confront the Shanyang Gongsun Family again over this matter.
"Congratulations Ancestor Ao." Wang Shouzhe relaxed and congratulated with a smile, "36 points for this middle-grade spiritual artifact is not a loss."
He knows this treasure, if well managed in an auction, can be sold for a high price of over ten or twenty thousand. 36 points, just over eleven thousand, is not a loss.
"Hahaha, thanks to old brother Yuanbai for yielding." Gongsun Ao’s face relaxed greatly, "If it weren’t for Mang’er’s battle body best suiting this treasure, I wouldn’t dare compete so boldly."
Gongsun Mang is currently in his nineties, still young and full of potential, with the Geng Metal Battle Body being highly formidable. Now the Gongsun Family has grown wealthier and is gradually cultivating him as a Celestial Human seed.
With this treasure, Gongsun Mang will be like a tiger gaining wings, and his combat power can immediately soar.
"Shouzhe, our family’s development is too rapid lately, surplus gold is limited." Gongsun Ao did not fear losing face, directly clasped his hands toward Wang Shouzhe, "We would still need to borrow fifty thousand Qian Gold from the Wang Family, and repay with Qian Gold including interest over five years."
"Naturally possible." Wang Shouzhe smiled, "Then let’s follow the usual regulations."
Now that the marriage alliance is very unified, mutual lending is quite normal, and Wang Shouzhe has established a set of regulations, with the annual interest generally at 5%.
This is the proper accounting between brothers.
The brothers within the same family must account clearly. Financial transactions between noble families must be conducted straightforwardly and transparently.
Otherwise, this marriage alliance would be close to disintegrating.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 73: Jin’s Chief! The Strongest 8th Grade Noble Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 73: Jin’s Chief! The Strongest 8th Grade Noble Family
...
Subsequently, some of the lower-grade demon artifacts, the corpse storage coffin, and the already ruined Yin Sha poison corpse, having attracted no interest, ultimately entered the unsold phase.
Wang Shouzhe proposed, "For this portion of the spoils, I will first inquire with the Academy to see if they want to purchase them. If they don’t, they’ll be sold to the black market of the Hundred Islands Guard."
Once it enters the black market system, it is bound to be bought by some hidden troublemakers, and it might eventually find its way back to the territories of the Yin Sha Sect.
However, those items are quite valuable, and Wang Shouzhe, as the leader of the alliance, can’t just hold onto them without selling, considering it concerns the interests of every family.
And the Academy, already of high status, earns astronomical sums just from the Insecticide Powder tax revenue. To prevent these demon artifacts from aiding the enemy, they might have no trouble buying them.
Moreover, there is the lower-grade spiritual artifact "Nameless Sword," which is not actually named Nameless Sword but rather unknown. Whoever buys it can name it themselves.
In the end, this sword fell into the hands of Ancestor Yuanbai of the Liua Family, who acquired it for the low price of 10 points, making a small profit.
Wang Shouzhe guessed that Ancestor Yuanbai bought this sword, most likely for his brother-in-law, Liua Yuanhui. After all, Liua Yuanhui had just advanced to the Spirit Platform Realm not long ago, and this lower-grade spirit sword was most suitable for him.
With this, Liua Yuanhui’s combat power would increase significantly, and his survival ability would also greatly improve.
Finally, there were just two storage rings left.
After some hesitation, Ancestor Ruhong of the Chen Family directly acquired a lower-grade storage ring for 10 points.
This was also the first storage ring for the East Port Chen Family.
While storage rings are quite useful, they do not enhance combat power, so many lower-ranked families prefer to carry items inconveniently rather than purchase storage rings. After all, these items are not cheap, and even if they had the money, they would surely prioritize buying lower-grade spiritual artifacts to enhance their strength.
Then, there was a middle-grade storage ring.
Everyone looked around at each other, yet no family placed a bid.
The Changning Xu Family, although coveting it, merely did so with longing.
Involving the Space Law, storage rings are a special spiritual artifact with strict material and crafting requirements, and their rarity ensures their value never declines.
Given the choice, they’d rather spend the money on a middle-grade spiritual artifact to significantly enhance their family’s combat strength and foundation.
"Ladies and gentlemen, then I’ll offer 38 points," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile when no bids were forthcoming, "consider it a small bargain for me."
Naturally, no one objected.
Amidst unanimous approval, Wang Shouzhe secured ownership of this middle-grade storage ring.
Unlike others, Wang Shouzhe had substantial requirements for storage rings.
After all, he plans to venture into the Outer Domain, and the more supplies he can carry, the better, along with having more hidden trump cards.
Moreover, he possesses an upper-grade spirit shield, a middle-grade spirit sword, and Bloodthirsty Vine combat tactics, so he naturally prioritizes enhancing his carrying capacity.
The extra storage ring could be given to Ancestor Longyan, as her elderly self had already reached the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, and she should maintain some prestige when going out.
However, in total, the Wang Family spent 64 points, owing a deficit of 9 points in the spoils pool, amounting to an outstanding debt of over 28,000 Qian Gold.
Following that, it’s time to repay the finances as needed and distribute the funds accordingly.
As for Zhou Zhenwu’s share, it will naturally be sent to him.
Amongst this, neither the Golden Sand Xu Family nor the Yingxiu Lu Family obtained any treasures from the spoils, so their points will be directly converted into Qian Gold.
With Qian Gold, they can naturally procure the resources they need.
Such a distribution of spoils made all families feel extremely fair and satisfied, and their goodwill towards Wang Shouzhe soared again.
What they didn’t know was that Wang Shouzhe’s approach was simply a loot distribution principle he learned from organizing raids in games in his past life.
Applying it in this Mystical World, it fit perfectly.
After distributing the spoils, it naturally led to a period of feasting and drinking.
Finally, everyone parted ways happily.
...
After the night banquet of the Changning Huangfu Family, the Qianma Huangfu Family was sealed under the charge of "treason and treason," and their downfall spread quickly, causing a great uproar in the Changning Guard.
The merchants, tenant farmers, craftsmen, and others relying on the Qianma Huangfu Family were all in a state of unease, feeling lost about the future.
The common people who were not implicated showed interest, secretly speculating about whom the Qianma Huangfu Family might have offended to have their roots exposed.
Of course, most people condemned the Qianma Huangfu Family for treason, deeming them worse than pigs and dogs.
Yet, the various noble families of Changning Guard fell into an eerie calm.
Only beneath the surface, subtle undercurrents continued to flow.
The majority of things in this world are like this; by the time the ordinary people get word of it, many rounds of power struggles have usually occurred, and everything has settled.
As for the dangers behind the scenes, aside from the participants, outsiders rarely know the details.
Thus, after some time with arrests, closures, interrogations, and a series of procedures, the case against the Qianma Huangfu Family quickly reached a conclusion.
The implicated Huangfu family members, household generals, key members, and others were all apprehended and sentenced to reclaim the Barbaric Region, facing a life-or-death outcome with scant chances of survival in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 73: Jin’s Chief! The Strongest 8th Grade Noble Family_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 73: Jin’s Chief! The Strongest 8th Grade Noble Family_2
And some ordinary clansmen who were not involved, the elderly, women, and children will be scattered and sent to remote areas to survive.
There, far from home, life will not be as good as in Changning Guard.
Moreover, they will be under strict jurisdiction of the local City Guard’s Mansion, often unable to turn their situation around for hundreds of years.
The Daqian has a history of over seven thousand years, and the Noble Families colluding with foreign Evil Sects to stir up trouble domestically, the Qianma Huangfu Family is neither the first nor the last. Naturally, there are precedents to follow. Everything is handled according to established procedures.
Besides.
Is the handling of the seized assets of the Qianma Huangfu Family, for such matters, Daqian also has a complete set of procedures.
Usually, it’s the City Guard’s Mansion that intervenes to auction off all their fixed assets. Three-tenths of the proceeds are returned as settlement money to innocent clansmen for their survival in a new place. The remaining seven-tenths are collected into the City Guard’s Mansion’s official treasury and, after application and approval from superiors, can be used for public facilities construction, city wall maintenance, disaster relief, etc.
Of course, only the local families in Changning Guard are eligible to participate in the auction.
Families in the Outer City Guard, even if eligible, would encounter unanimous opposition from local forces.
The day the City Guard’s Mansion hosted the auction, the entrance was bustling with people.
To ensure fairness, the auction was held in the square at the entrance of the City Guard’s Mansion. This way, not only could various Noble Families come to watch, but even civilians and Loose Cultivators could join the fun.
However, there were no seats for those merely watching the fun.
Only representatives sent by the major Noble Families had the privilege to take a seat.
And at this rare scene seen once in a century, most families, even if not planning to bid, would still come to join in the excitement.
Some Ninth-Grade Noble Families came early and, under the arrangement of City Guard’s Mansion officials, were seated in their designated places.
Followed then by the Eighth-Grade Noble Families.
Nowadays, Changning Guard has only seven Eighth-Grade Noble Families remaining, namely: Shanyin Liu Family, Shanyang Gongsun Family, East Port Chen Family, Westpeace Dang Family, Wangxia Lei Family, Ping’an Wang Family, and Changning Xu Family.
Originally, the recognized strongest Eighth-Grade Noble Family was the Changning Xu Family.
It is said that the Changning Xu Family altogether has six Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, with one even being a Spirit Platform Realm Household General.
And now, seemingly on the surface, the Changning Xu Family is still the strongest.
However, internally within the Marriage Alliance, privately everyone believes that the Ping’an Wang Family has become increasingly dominant.
The Ancestors and Patriarchs of the Marriage Alliance all know that the Wang Family now has Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, aside from Ancestor Longyan, including Wang Shouzhe and his wife, the Big Girl Wang Lici, Patrol Second Battalion Leader Wang Ding Race, Ancestor Xiaohan, plus a Tier Three Primordial Water Spirit Turtle.
Just these on the surface amount to seven Spirit Platform Realm combat forces, and given Wang Shouzhe’s usual nature, it’s hard to say if he doesn’t have any Spirit Platform Realm hidden away.
Moreover, those in the know understand that Wang Shouzhe and his wife are both extraordinary.
Especially Liua Ruolan, back in the Qi Refining Realm, once transformed, she could directly fight and kill Spirit Platform Realm Demon Puppets. Now that she’s reached Spirit Platform Realm, she’s even more fathomless.
It’s said that after reaching Spirit Platform Realm, no one has seen her Qiushui Sword unsheathed until now.
In the last battle at Golden Beach, she casually made a move and blasted Huangfu Kangping along with his bird down.
Several friendly Ancestors privately discussed but never confirmed her true power.
In short, even now as Ancestor Ruhong in the late stage of Spirit Platform Realm, who always thought himself not much worse than the core disciples of the Academy, he still admitted that facing Liua Ruolan at the initial tier of Spirit Platform Realm, he wasn’t certain of victory, believing it was at most a forty-sixty chance.
And it’s Liua Ruolan sixty...
Mrs. Wang, unfathomable!
Furthermore, the younger generation of the Wang Family is also extremely excellent, with a high chance of advancing to Spirit Platform Realm in the future, even those in the Ding generation like Wang Dinghai, the Shou generation among them, are all striving for progress, with a great inclination towards collectively aiming for Spirit Platform Realm.
It won’t take long before the Wang Family enters a Spirit Platform Realm boom period.
That’s also why the Marriage Alliance subtly positions Ping’an Wang Family at the forefront, because, even without mentioning scheming and methods, the potential shown by Ping’an Wang Family after years of careful management by Wang Shouzhe is really intimidating.
On the square.
Representatives of Eighth-Grade Noble Families arrived one after another.
Finally, Wang Shouzhe and Xu Anbang appeared together, naturally drawing a stir of attention.
According to past customs, officials arranged for Changning Xu Family to sit in the chief seat.
But Xu Anbang did not take the seat. Instead, he looked at Wang Shouzhe beside him: "Shouzhe~ you should sit in this Eighth-Grade chief seat."
"Fifth Uncle is joking." Wang Shouzhe directly declined, saying, "You are an elder and from an established Eighth-Grade family, naturally it’s your seat."
"I dare not take it, I dare not take it." Xu Anbang said solemnly, "As the saying goes, those who are capable should take the seat. In the past, you kept a low profile not wanting to attract attention from certain families, but now there’s no need. When it’s time to build up reputation, you should do so to accumulate more resources to oppose certain families."
