"Besides, our family’s Ancestor Beichen is in seclusion heading towards the Celestial Human Realm at the ancestral hall. If successful, we’ll be Seventh-Grade. If not, what qualification do we have to sit above you?"
Wang Shouzhe thought it over, found the reasoning sound, and stopped being stubborn, courteously saying, "Then, thank you Fifth Uncle for yielding."
Afterward, under Xu Anbang’s negotiation with the hosting official, despite showing a peculiar expression, the official still switched the seating accordingly and then smiled broadly to Wang Shouzhe: "Patriarch of Wang Family, please take the Eighth-Grade chief seat."
"Thank you."
Wang Shouzhe gracefully returned the salutation, then sat in the Eighth-Grade chief seat under the watchful eyes of all.
This seating arrangement was not surprising within the Marriage Alliance, as everyone gradually got used to following Wang Shouzhe’s lead.
But it was entirely different for other Eighth and Ninth-Grade families.
Their eyes uncontrollably revealed shock. The Ping’an Wang Family has already developed to this extent?
Even the veteran third family, Changning Xu, voluntarily gave up the chief seat?
Unless they truly thought themselves inferior, who would willingly forfeit their seating position. While there’s seen tussles over seating between families of similar strength, never seen a stronger family conceding their seat.
Briefly, discussions buzzed among the Ninth-Grade families, and when looking at the Wang Family, their gaze had changed.
The Eighth-Grade chief seat was second only to the two Celestial Human Families. Even when Ancestor Zhou Xuan was alive, it wasn’t as auspicious.
When Wang Shouzhe’s gaze swept over those Eighth and Ninth-Grade families, most patriarchs smiled at him, their eyes involuntarily filled with friendliness.
Subsequently.
Two Celestial Human Families’ patriarchs, Huangfu Jinhuan and Lei Yangyu, nearly mutually agreed to enter simultaneously.
In terms of overall strength, the Celestial Human Huangfu Family is actually half a step stronger than the Celestial Human Lei Family. But the Lei Family never submits to the Huangfu Family, always competing to be ahead, at least unwilling to lag behind.
Their seats were higher, divided left and right, regardless of precedence and stature, to prevent their disputes.
With the entrance of the Celestial Families, there’s naturally a different atmosphere, many patriarchs subconsciously stood up to show respect.
"Patriarch Shouzhe." Lei Yangyu upon seeing Wang Shouzhe, proactively approached with a warm greeting, "After such a hurried half-month separation, I’ve missed you terribly."
Seeing him thus, Wang Shouzhe also rose to greet and gracefully returned the gesture: "Seeing Patriarch Yangyu brings Shouzhe great excitement as well."
The two drew closer, Lei Yangyu directly grasped Wang Shouzhe’s hand and in a low voice said: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, foolish brother supports you, we absolutely cannot let the old bandit Huangfu seize advantage. Many industries in Qianma Town are about Spirit Pasture Grass and Spiritual Feed, belonging to the upstream industry of Huangfu Family’s pasture. By securing this part, it’s like seizing Huangfu Family’s throat."
Wang Shouzhe naturally understood, also knowing his intentions aren’t purely kind, at least harboring a strategy to incite conflict and leverage forces.
But, such goodwill is also what Wang Shouzhe needs.
You Celestial Human Lei Family intend to suppress Huangfu Family, I can cooperate naturally, however, you cannot shirk your efforts.
He immediately whispered a few words into his ear.
Upon listening, Lei Yangyu squinted his eyes, nodded knowingly with a cooperative expression: "Younger Brother Shouzhe, I find you’re truly unyielding. Alright, I’ll act per your plans."

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 74: Wang Family Expansion! Shouzhe Has a Big Appetite
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 74: Wang Family Expansion! Shouzhe Has a Big Appetite
...
Huangfu Jinhuan saw this scene from afar, and his expression darkened a bit.
He snorted disdainfully, crossed his arms behind his back, and sat down in his seat, half-closing his eyes as if contemplating something.
Suddenly.
Lei Yangyu’s cheerful laughter came from beside him: "Brother Jinhuan, you look quite well~"
"Hmph!" Huangfu Jinhuan opened his eyes, his face sullen, "Lei Yangyu, what do you mean to say?"
"Sorry, I’m just curious," Lei Yangyu chuckled, "Your family’s branch committed such a big incident, did you come here today to bid on the properties of the Qianma Huangfu Family?"
Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyelids twitched twice, and he replied with a cold laugh: "Lei Yangyu, what business is it of yours regarding the affairs of the Huangfu Family? Is it possible that I can just watch as the branch family’s properties fall into others’ hands?"
"Hahaha~" Lei Yangyu laughed loudly, "I’ve just heard a ridiculous joke; the Celestial Person Huangfu Family has already screwed over the Qianma Huangfu Family, used them as scapegoats, and even silenced them to save themselves, only to end up swallowing their properties. What a strategy, truly a clever strategy!"
Lei Yangyu’s voice was loud enough that even the onlookers heard it. Everyone’s faces couldn’t help but show expressions typical of gossiping, quietly starting to discuss among themselves.
Throughout history, common folks have always been delighted to enjoy such gossip, indulging in it with great pleasure.
Yet, those patriarchs of the Eighth and Ninth-Grade Noble Families had somewhat complicated expressions.
As members of noble families, their channels for information were far superior to those of loose cultivators and commoners.
Everyone knew that the Celestial Person Huangfu Family and the Qianma Huangfu Family were so close they were practically wearing the same pants, with the latter always looking to the former as a leader.
The collusion between the Qianma Huangfu Family and the Yin Sha Sect for treason — how could the Celestial Person Huangfu Family be entirely unaware?
Moreover, the events at the banquet that night had already spread, and after the incident was exposed, the dignified Ancestor Hua Ye even killed the most important witness, Huangfu Deyun.
Even a fool could see this was murder to silence.
It’s just that the Celestial Person Huangfu Family acted cautiously, leaving no concrete evidence. However, in the eyes of all noble families, the Celestial Person Huangfu Family could not be completely unrelated to the incident with the Yin Sha Sect.
It’s likely that the one colluding with the Yin Sha Sect was the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, and the Qianma Huangfu Family was merely pushed forward as the scapegoat.
People simply didn’t speak publicly about it, but discussions had long occurred in private.
Regarding the actions of the Huangfu Family, they all felt a chill in their hearts and quite a bit of disdain. At least, they genuinely wished to keep their distance from the Huangfu Family, avoiding any entanglement.
Because you never know when the Celestial Person Huangfu Family might betray you for some reason.
Now that Lei Yangyu had unveiled this cover, it naturally stirred up a wave in the hearts of the people, feeling unjust for the Qianma Huangfu Family on one hand and a sense of shared fate on the other.
However, although they were clear in their hearts, the Eighth and Ninth-Grade Noble Families, constrained by face and taboos, remained silent at their respective seats, drinking tea or eating pastries as if they hadn’t heard Lei Yangyu’s words.
But the commoners and loose cultivators had no such concerns.
A group of insider sources suddenly appeared out of nowhere, vividly recounting the events of that day.
The Celestial Person Huangfu Family secretly colluded with the Yin Sha Sect for treason, and after the conspiracy was exposed, they let the Qianma Huangfu Family take the blame, washing their hands of the matter... A series of events was told with thrilling ups and downs, well-documented, as if witnessed firsthand.
As it turned out, the Qianma Huangfu Family was just the scapegoat, and the true mastermind, the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, not only remained at large but was also planning to seize and annex the assets of the Qianma Huangfu Family!
The gossip-loving crowd felt an irresistible rage after hearing this.
Of course, there were also those purely indulging in the gossip, who, given how stimulating the news was, followed along, spreading it further.
In any case, the rumors spread like a plague at an incredible speed.
As for evidence, that’s something the Daqian Government Office needs to concern itself with. The commoners are happily enjoying their gossip, that’s all the thrill they need; who cares about evidence?
For a moment, Lei Yangyu’s words were like a stone thrown into a thousand waves, causing an uproar in half the square.
Huangfu Jinhuan sat in the main seat, his face extremely grim. With so many people’s eyes and scrutiny on him, he felt as if he was sitting in a fireplace, unable to sit still.
This move was too ruthless, as if it struck right at the heart of the Huangfu Family. Considering Lei Yangyu’s earlier whispering with Wang Shouzhe, how could Huangfu Jinhuan not realize that it was Wang Shouzhe advising behind the scenes?
Immediately, Huangfu Jinhuan’s gaze, sharp as a blade, fixed on Wang Shouzhe.
And Wang Shouzhe met his gaze across the distance, bowed with a smile to Huangfu Jinhuan, baring his teeth.
It was as if telling him: Yes, it was my advice; what can you do to me?
Huangfu Jinhuan was so angry he almost coughed up blood, a trace of hatred flickering in his sinister eyes.
Fortunately, at this moment, City Guard Xiahou Hongde arrived, surrounded by his personal guards.
He moved with a majestic stride, his face stern as he surveyed the scene with his tiger-like eyes, silencing the crowd at once.
Even the noisy onlookers and loose cultivators fell silent.
"Everyone is present, let’s start the auction."
Xiahou Hongde was actually in a good mood. Despite the scandal that erupted with the Qianma Huangfu Family, as the City Guard, he not only personally oversaw the case but also eradicated a group of Yin Sha Sect traitors, which counted as an achievement.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 74: Wang Family Expansion! Shouzhe Has a Big Appetite - Part 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 74: Wang Family Expansion! Shouzhe Has a Big Appetite - Part 2
He has always been swift and decisive in handling matters, disliking tedious formalities.
Immediately, an accompanying official stepped forward with a square tray of rosewood, piled with thick stacks of papers, including house deeds, property deeds, and contracts of household servants and slaves.
The official stepped forward and said loudly, "The auction of properties in Qianma Town officially begins. Item No. 1, a main residence covering three hundred acres, estimated value forty thousand Qian Gold."
"Item No. 2, Celestial Crane Ranch, consisting of eight hundred tenant farmer households, thirty thousand acres of pastureland, over five thousand oxen, thirty thousand sheep, a thousand horses, eighty acres of lower-grade spirit fields, and ten Spiritual-Horned Yaks. Total estimated value, one hundred and seventy thousand Qian Gold."
"Item No. 3, Qianma Farm, consisting of five hundred tenant farmer households, twenty thousand acres of bean fields, seventy acres of lower-grade spirit fields, and uncounted poultry and livestock, total estimated value eighty thousand Qian Gold."
"Item No. 4, Xingwang Ranch, consisting of five hundred tenant farmer households, forty thousand acres of pastureland, one hundred acres of lower-grade spirit fields, and uncounted poultry and livestock, total estimated value ninety thousand Qian Gold."
Subsequently, there are some small estates producing grain crops, houses, and shops within Changning Guard City, all long-term fixed assets.
The main industries of the Qianma Huangfu Family are those four large farms, with a total estimated value of over three hundred thousand.
If all the assets of the Qianma Huangfu Family, including the main residence, were to be acquired, it would probably require at least over five hundred thousand Qian Gold.
These are just their fixed assets. Some liquid funds, easily movable property resources, or antiques and famous paintings, have probably been confiscated long ago.
After all, it is an Eighth-Grade Noble Family, with a very solid foundation.
Meanwhile, Wang Shouzhe had also noticed something strange from the list. The production from the three giant ranches and farms of Qianma is mostly the materials needed for the pastures, and the number of cattle and sheep raised by the Qianma Huangfu Family is not particularly large.
It is quite obvious that most of the production from the pastures has already been supplied to the Celestial Person Huangfu Family.
This simple industry chain is quite common among noble families. The Silkworm Manor of the Ping’an Wang Family has also been providing raw silk materials to the Changning Xu Family. The Qianma Huangfu Family taking on feed planting is also normal and cannot be considered exploitation.
However, if these feed production bases were to fall into the hands of outsiders or enemies, the Celestial Person Huangfu Family would be troubled. They would have a hard time finding alternatives in a short time.
This information was something Wang Shouzhe had already grasped, and naturally, he came prepared today, ready to challenge the Celestial Person Huangfu Family.
"The auction officially begins." The official announced loudly, "First to be auctioned is..."
"Wait!"
Wang Shouzhe raised his hand and interrupted, "Sir, I have a proposal."
The official’s expression stiffened, seeming somewhat displeased. But upon seeing that it was the Eighth-Grade Chief Family Wang Shouzhe who interrupted him, he forced a kind smile and said, "So it’s the Patriarch of the Ping’an Wang Family, may I ask what proposal Patriarch Shouzhe has?"
If it were the Clan Leader of a Ninth-Grade Noble Family, he would have already scolded them. Even if it were an ordinary Eighth-Grade Noble Family, he would not be so amiable.
But the Ping’an Wang Family not only took the seat of Eighth-Grade Chief but also had a momentum that was unmatched, even daring to confront the Celestial Human Family. Such a person, he could not afford to offend.
"Everyone’s time is very precious, auctioning item by item is too much of a waste of time." Wang Shouzhe suggested with cupped hands, "Why not bundle them for auction, the highest bidder wins."
Bundle auction?
The official was taken aback, the Qianma Huangfu Family was a rightful Eighth-Grade, their accumulated properties were vast, even with a discount, the total bundled price would be fifty-four thousand!
This was an astronomical sum.
Fifty-four thousand!
That was more than enough to buy a Sixth-Grade "Immortal Ascension Pill," with plenty left over.
You must know, the "Immortal Ascension Pill" is a precious pill used by Late-Stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivators to aid in breaking through to the Celestial Human Realm, not only rare but also exceedingly expensive.
Many Spirit Platform Realm cultivators dream their whole life of acquiring an Immortal Ascension Pill. But in reality, most Spirit Platform Realm cultivators in this world would not even have the chance to get a whiff of it before they die.
From this, it can be seen.
Fifty-four thousand Qian Gold, what a hefty amount. Most Celestial Human Families could not come up with such cash in one go.
"This..." The official dared not make the decision and immediately looked towards Xiahou Hongde, the Lord City Guard, "Lord City Guard, what do you think?"
Xiahou Hongde also took a keen interest, looking Wang Shouzhe up and down from a distance. This kid’s ability and ambition far exceeded his expectations.
Did he intend to swallow all the fixed assets of the Qianma Huangfu Family in one go?
"Xiahou City Guard." Huangfu Jinhuan quickly stood up and said, "This is against the rules, it’s more reasonable to stick to the original rules and auction item by item."
This disaster came too suddenly, even though he wanted to acquire all the assets of the Qianma Huangfu Family, he was unable to do so with just one effort. With great effort and by borrowing from various sources, he had only hurriedly raised forty thousand Qian Gold, preparing to secure the three crucial ranches, or at least two of them.
If it were a bundle auction, the money he prepared would be far from enough.
"Rules?" Wang Shouzhe laughed and said calmly, "Patriarch Jinhuan sure knows how to joke. In the Daqian Law, which law or regulation states that the property of convicted ministers must be auctioned item by item?"
"Indeed, Patriarch Shouzhe is right, everyone’s time is precious." Lei Yangyu from the Lei Family echoed, "What nonsense about having to auction piece by piece, haha~ why don’t you auction cow by cow. If you can’t afford it, just sit aside and watch the fun."

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 74: Wang Family Expansion! Shouzhe Has a Big Appetite_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 74: Wang Family Expansion! Shouzhe Has a Big Appetite_3
"Lei Yangyu!" Huangfu Jinhuan shouted angrily, "As the heads of Celestial Human Families, do you really want to go against me?"
"Oh dear, what an overbearing tone, it really frightens me," Lei Yangyu said sarcastically. "Is this Changning Guard your Huangfu Family’s personal domain now? Do the Celestial Human Lei Family not even have the right to speak the truth?"
This Lei Yangyu was clearly someone unafraid of stirring trouble, especially at a time when the Huangfu Family was down. If not now, when should you kick a man while he’s down?
The heads of two major Celestial Human Families were clashing.
Naturally, this made the spectators excited and thrilled.
"Everyone, shut up." Xiahou Hongde felt a headache coming. Clearly, Wang Shouzhe had prepared in advance, planning to catch the Celestial Human Huangfu Family off guard. Whether he truly aimed to acquire all assets of Qianma Huangfu Family or just wanted to raise the price to disgust Huangfu Jinhuan was unknown.
What was this kid really planning? Was he truly set on breaking ties with the Huangfu Family?
But Xiahou Hongde owed Wang Shouzhe a favor. As the saying goes, "A man who takes is soft-hearted," and if it was legal and reasonable, he naturally had to be partial.
Immediately, Xiahou Hongde said rather "impatiently," "There are no regulations in Daqian for auctions, and coincidentally, this city guard has other matters shortly, so let’s auction it as a package."
When he said this, Xiahou Hongde had a ridiculous thought—could it be that Wang Shouzhe had calculated all this for the auction today?
If so, the depth of this kid’s scheming was remarkable. No wonder the Celestial Human Huangfu Family suffered such a setback at his hands. Likely, they would face another setback today.
With Xiahou Hongde’s statement.
The matter was settled decisively.
The official respectfully accepted the order and then announced, "The auction officially begins, all assets of Qianma Huangfu Family are being sold as a package, starting price is 540,000 Qian Gold."
"Five hundred forty thousand," Wang Shouzhe raised his hand.
"You..." Huangfu Jinhuan almost spat blood, glaring daggers at Wang Shouzhe, "Wang Shouzhe, are you really going against our Huangfu Family?"
"Hehe~ The Patriarch Yangyu is right." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "Your Huangfu Family truly sees Changning Guard as its own domain? Just a normal competitive bidding, are threats necessary if you can’t afford it? I am truly frightened."
He shared the same plan as Lei Yangyu, which was to take the opportunity to throw stones at the Huangfu Family while they were struggling. Although this wouldn’t kill them, it would significantly damage the reputation and prestige of the Celestial Human Huangfu Family.
As the spectators laughed recklessly, the gazes of the heads of the Eighth and Ninth-Grade Noble Families on stage revealed contempt and sarcasm.
This prestigious Celestial Human Huangfu Family turned out to be so incapable, not only unable to swallow the branch’s wealth but also couldn’t compete with an Eighth-Grade Noble Family in the auction.
The direction of Changning Guard seemed to be changing.
The crowd looked at Wang Shouzhe as if watching a rising star.
The auction official, clearly someone adept at reading minds, seeing Xiahou City Guard siding with Wang Shouzhe, realized the inner inclination was towards the Wang Family.
Immediately, he slightly frowned and said, "Patriarch Huangfu, this is a serious auction. Either bid or quit. I warn you not to bid recklessly. If the money isn’t found in three days, our Patrol Camp isn’t joking around."
"Five hundred fifty thousand!" Huangfu Jinhuan, with a gloomy face, shouted a price, thinking ways to cover the shortfall of fifteen thousand within three days was still possible.
"Petty." Wang Shouzhe shook his head, "Six hundred thousand."
"You..." Huangfu Jinhuan shouted angrily, "Wang Shouzhe, are you really intending to acquire those pastures? The Wang Family doesn’t raise livestock; what’s the use of pastures?"
"I don’t mind, just joining in the excitement," Wang Shouzhe said with a smile, "Just bidding casually, if the Patriarch bids high, I’ll back out, consider it contributing a little more to Changning Guard’s development fund. If the Patriarch can’t afford it, I’ll acquire it as an investment, operate for a few years then sell gradually, it’s still profitable. The Patriarch may continue..."
Continue, continue your soul.
Huangfu Jinhuan wanted to curse directly, six hundred thousand? How many Celestial Human Families can come up with six hundred thousand instantly?
"Alright, alright, alright!"
Huangfu Jinhuan’s face turned red and white, "Wang Shouzhe, you’re ruthless, let’s wait and see."
"Lord City Guard." Wang Shouzhe cupped his hands to Xiahou Hongde, "I report the Huangfu Family, they’re threatening me. If anything happens to me soon, it’s definitely the doing of the Huangfu Family. Due to the threat, I apply for a Patrol Camp to protect me."
"Huangfu Jinhuan, you better behave with this city guard and don’t provoke me." Xiahou Hongde felt extremely dissatisfied with the Huangfu Family recently. If Wang Shouzhe hadn’t solved the Yin Sha Sect’s issue, something major might have happened before his transfer.
"Xiahou City Guard, I merely lost a bid, hence some anger," Huangfu Jinhuan cupped his hands, "Our Huangfu Family abides by the law, certainly won’t violate Daqian Law."
"Also you, Patriarch Shouzhe," Xiahou Hongde glared, "My City Guardian’s Patrol Camp has the responsibility of protecting the city and citizens, not to be used as your personal bodyguard."
After a pause, he took out an item with a frown: "This object is a Cloud-piercing Cannon, a military aid item. As long as you’re within a hundred miles of City Guardian’s Mansion, we can receive a distress signal. Only one use, don’t act recklessly."
It was truly an unexpected delight.
Wang Shouzhe merely accused Huangfu Jinhuan with some falsehood, knowing well that the Huangfu Family was planning something big, definitely not dispatching Ancestor Hua Ye for an assassination.
However, acquiring fixed assets of Qianma Huangfu Family as a bonus, and obtaining the aid Treasure Cloud-piercing Cannon, was naturally pleasing.
It’s just a shame that Huangfu Jinhuan never dreamed the vital role those pastures would play if Wang Shouzhe acquired them. If he knew, he’d give an arm or leg to bid for them.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 75: Besides being rich and handsome, what else do you have
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 75: Besides being rich and handsome, what else do you have
...
On the other side.
After enduring the auction’s end with great difficulty, returning to the Huangfu Family’s Main Residence, Huangfu Jinhuan could finally unleash his suppressed anger.
"Too much bullying!! Too much bullying! Good for you, Lei Yangyu! Good for you, Wang Shouzhe! If I, Huangfu Jinhuan, don’t avenge this, I swear I am not human!!"
He was so furious he kicked over the stone table in the yard and still felt unsatisfied, punching directly at the training stone cauldron beside him.
"Bang!!"
The stone cauldron exploded into countless fragments instantly.
The fragments splashed everywhere, but Huangfu Jinhuan didn’t care at all. He had Profound Qi protecting his body, so these flying stone fragments would be repelled by the protective Profound Qi before they could touch him.
After smashing the stone cauldron, he still felt unsatisfied and wanted to take out his anger on other things in the yard.
"Ah~ Patriarch, Patriarch, please calm down, calm down."
The steward who entered was frightened and rushed forward trying to stop Huangfu Jinhuan.
However, how could Huangfu Jinhuan listen to him?
With a casual gesture, he shook off the old steward, then lifted his leg and kicked over an ornamental tree.
The steward’s old face instantly wrinkled like a bitter gourd.
The stone cauldron, the stone table, were both specially made, even the ornamental tree was a century-old tree, together they were worth at least a hundred Qian Gold~ all ruined in a blink.
The family’s money had been drained away, and there wasn’t much left in the accounts~
But he dared not complain, dared not provoke the Patriarch’s ire at this time, and dared not let Huangfu Jinhuan vent any longer, only he could suppress his fear and advised, "Patriarch, anger cannot solve problems. You must calm down to make those who hit you while you’re down pay the price, don’t you think?"
"You’re right, I must make them pay the price."
Hearing these words, Huangfu Jinhuan’s head, almost filled with anger, finally calmed down a little.
He carried his hands behind his back, sneering coldly, "Pulling out hundreds of thousands of Qian Gold all at once just to disgust me, I want to see how he’s going to handle it. Livestock farming isn’t that easy to do."
"Yes, yes, yes!" The old steward nodded vigorously, "You’re right."
"The livestock industry has high professional technical requirements. My Huangfu Family has been managing it for hundreds of years to develop the ranch to its current scale." Huangfu Jinhuan became more confident as he spoke, and his eyes gradually grew sharp, "That bunch of laymen rashly entering the livestock industry, who knows how much they will lose? When the time comes, they’ll have nowhere to cry."
"Yes, yes, yes! Everything you’re saying is right!"
...
Time flew by.
After the Qianma Huangfu Family’s property auction, half a month had passed, and all the clamor and discussions gradually settled.
The reputation and prestige of the Celestial Person Huangfu Family fell drastically in this event, no longer retaining the image of an exalted and admirable Celestial Human Family from past days.
The Ping’an Wang Family seized this opportunity to significantly boost their reputation, suddenly becoming red-hot in the Changning Guard, and even the ordinary members of the Ping’an Wang Family became much sought-after, garnering much admiration.
There are three Pill Workshops in Changning Guard.
These three Pill Workshops belong to three different forces, among them, one is operated by the Changning Xu Family.
As a Noble Family develops, its population grows, leading to a greater demand for Low-Tier Elixirs. In such cases, relying entirely on external purchases for all elixirs can easily leave them vulnerable, and the costs would become prohibitive.
Even though a "Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill" only costs ten Qian Gold each, when quantities rise, it still becomes a significant expenditure.
If a family wishes to grow stronger, they often train their own Alchemists.
Even a mature Tier One Alchemist can save the family significant expenses over time.
The Ping’an Wang Family’s "Shou" generation Seventh, Wang Shouye, is the first Alchemist trained by the Wang Family.
He was arranged from a young age to learn in the Pill Workshop of the Changning Xu Family, following Alchemists to learn the knowledge of Alchemy, and now has been there for over nine years. With his efforts and family support, he has had a smooth journey in the Alchemy Dao, now being a relatively mature Tier One Alchemist.
On this day.
As usual, Wang Shouye first went to pay respects to his master, Xu Ningchao, and took the opportunity to inquire about several baffling questions. Suddenly enlightened, he then went to his exclusive pill furnace room in the back courtyard of the Pill Workshop.
This pill furnace room is a standard Tier One pill furnace room. From structural design to the furnace fuel used, it can only produce Tier One Pills.
In the pill furnace room, the fire was raging.
Seeing Wang Shouye enter, the two attendants fanning the furnace immediately stood up and cupped their hands in salute, "Seventh Young Master."
They were the on-duty Furnace Attendants.
In Wang Shouye’s exclusive pill furnace room, there were four exclusive Furnace Attendants like them.
They were only fourteen or fifteen years old, selected with great care from the Wang Family’s collateral relatives or household servants, household generals, tenant farmers, and other systems. Each was intelligent and clever, with some cultivation potential.
They began assisting Wang Shouye at the age of twelve. After learning for a few years, once they grasped the basics of Alchemy and became familiar with the Alchemy process, they could begin learning Alchemy themselves.
Wang Shouye also went through this process back then.
As their skills matured, the Ping’an Wang Family would have its own Alchemy team.
It was only the marital relationship between the Changning Xu Family and Ping’an Wang Family, plus the secret advantages the Wang Family had given, that allowed such an arrangement to be realized. Otherwise, no Pill Workshop would train Alchemists for another family.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 75: Besides being rich and handsome, what else do you have_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 75: Besides being rich and handsome, what else do you have_2
"No need for formalities."
Wang Shouye waved his hand, reminding, "Keep a close eye on the heat for this batch of Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills. My master said, if the pill formation rate reaches seventy percent again, I could be allowed to attempt a Tier Two elixir."
The Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill is the most widely used Tier One Pill, indispensable for any family.
As long as it can be refined, there’s no worry about the market. Over the years, Wang Shouye has refined the Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill the most.
Most of the raw materials are supplied by the Ping’an Wang Family, yet Wang Shouye has lost over twenty thousand Qian Gold on this.
That’s right, it’s a loss.
The training of an alchemist has always been extremely costly. An alchemist can only rapidly grow through accumulating experience from countless failures.
Due to the large number of people refining the Minor Primordial Cultivation Pill, its price has never exceeded ten Qian Gold per piece.
However, the cost to refine a single batch of these pills is as high as sixty Qian Gold. Only if a batch yields six pills will there be no loss. Reaching this level is barely considered to be a qualified Tier One alchemist.
Currently, Wang Shouye’s average yield per batch is 6.3 pills, mostly between six to seven pills, with occasional slips producing less than six.
If he could consistently maintain a yield of seven pills per batch, he could achieve long-term profitability. The twenty thousand Qian Gold previously lost by the Wang Family could be gradually earned back.
"Really?!"
Upon hearing he could attempt Tier Two elixir refinement, the on-duty furnace attendants were instantly wide-eyed in disbelief.
"Of course it’s true." Wang Shouye gave them a glare, "Do you think I would deceive you?"
"That’s awesome!!"
The furnace attendants instantly became excited.
They knew the Seventh Young Master had long been learning all kinds of theoretical knowledge about Tier Two elixirs. Once he becomes a genuine Tier Two alchemist, his status and position would naturally change.
Their own status and position as furnace attendants would also rise accordingly.
For a moment, they all became highly motivated, controlling the heat with exceptional focus and care.
Wang Shouye naturally performed the alchemy process skillfully.
Over two hours later, the pill furnace was opened amidst a cloud of steam.
"One, two, three, four..." The furnace attendants immediately crowded around to count, announcing the numbers loudly as they went.
Wang Shouye’s heart instantly rose in anticipation.
"Six... seven!" The furnace attendants exclaimed excitedly, "Seventh Young Master, there are seven Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills!"
"Phew~ That’s great~"
Wang Shouye breathed a sigh of relief, joining in their excitement.
This was already the third successive batch yielding seven Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills, which meant he earned ten Qian Gold from this batch. It also indicated a significant improvement in his recent standards!
Wang Shouye couldn’t help but beam with joy.
In reality, the pressure on him had been immense over the years.
The cost of fifty-year-old Purple-leafed Heshou and auxiliary materials was not low, yet the supply from his fourth brother never ceased. Initially, every batch he refined resulted in total loss, then gradually achieved a pill formation rate of one to two, until now, after more than nine years of effort, the yield reached six to seven pills.
The hardships and pressure within were indeed difficult to express to outsiders.
The news of Wang Shouye successfully refining seven Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills yet again quickly spread throughout the Pill Workshop.
This signified he had become a mature Tier One alchemist capable of stable profitability, rather than an alchemist in the narrow sense who could only refine Tier One pills.
An alchemist at this level could establish themselves firmly in any Pill Workshop and possess certain social status.
Meanwhile.
In the street-facing shop of Xu’s Pill Workshop, two stationed Tier One alchemists were left staring at each other upon receiving the news.
They were both middle-aged men in their fifties, and back then it took them over thirty years to become profitable Tier One alchemists.
Yet Wang Shouye had only taken nine years.
Truly comparing oneself to others is exasperating, comparing goods to goods is the same~
Alchemist A sighed quietly, "This Wang Shouye... apart from having a good family background, being wealthy, and good-looking, in what other way does he surpass us?"
"Back when we were tested and found to have alchemy talent," Alchemist B was also quite dissatisfied, "but after apprenticing to learn the craft, starting as furnace attendants, wasn’t each step arduous? Occasionally having a chance to refine a batch of pills was already a blessing. As for Wang Shouye, it’s only because he relies on his wealthy family that he can disregard costs and refine batch after batch. It’s all built by sheer volume."
"If I had such a family background, I’d surely be faster than him."
While the two middle-aged alchemists were engaging in all sorts of envious complaints.
In the alchemy workshop.
Suddenly, two groups of young maidens appeared.
One group was led by a young maiden of eighteen or nineteen, dressed in a water-blue ice silk skirt, beautiful with an elegant demeanor.
The leader of the other group was a vivacious and beautiful maiden dressed in a fiery red Fire Spirit Silk Martial Attire, giving off a fierce, pepper-like vibe.
Each led four or five similarly aged female companions, highly fawned upon, clearly coming from illustrious backgrounds.
The red-dressed maiden cast a mocking look at the one in the water-blue skirt, her eyes gleaming with scorn, "Huangfu Qianqian, do you really have the face to come support our Shouye? Aren’t you aware of how your Huangfu Family has clashed with our Wang Family?"

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 75: Besides being rich and handsome, what else do you have_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 75: Besides being rich and handsome, what else do you have_3
"Lei Yanyun, Shouye is not a member of your family, nor are you part of the Wang Family." Huangfu Qianqian’s eyes displayed anger as she spoke, "Conflicts between Noble Families are inevitable, but they can’t influence the sacred feelings I have with Shouye."
The conversation between these two girls implies they both have impressive backgrounds. One is from the Huangfu Family, while the other is from the Lei Family.
It seems Wang Shouye has more admirers than just these two, but those of lesser backgrounds have already been squeezed out. As for these two, with similar standings, neither is willing to back down to the other.
Here we go again!
Middle-aged Alchemists Jia and Yi, witnessing this scene, couldn’t help but shake their heads in secret.
Young girls these days really have no sense of shame.
When they were young, girls were so reserved and modest. Forget chasing after boys—when they diligently pursued a girl, she wouldn’t spare them a glance.
Alas~~ times have changed, people are no longer as they used to be.
Huangfu Qianqian and Lei Yanyun both had eyes full of intense hostility.
Then, each had an accompanying person unfurl a banner they had prepared.
Each banner read:
"Congratulations to Shouye on becoming the youngest outstanding Tier One Alchemist of Changning Guard."
"Best wishes to Shouye on becoming the youngest Tier Two Alchemist of Changning Guard soon."
The two girls then stared each other down, full of mutual hostility.
Wang Shouye, having heard the news, hurried out, bowing his thanks to both young ladies. He repeatedly declared that he was still a beginner in alchemy and unworthy of the word "outstanding," ashamed because of their misplaced affection.
"Shouye, I heard you’re going to start refining Tier Two Peiyuan Pills," Huangfu Qianqian said. "I don’t have much to support you with, but take these few Centennial Purple-leafed Polygonum multiflorum to practice."
"Shouye, don’t take her stuff," Lei Yanyun advised, "The Celestial Person Huangfu Family is too shrewd. They might just trick you one day. Shouye, why not come to our Lei’s Pill Workshop? My grandfather admires you, and he promises to teach you well."
"Lei Yanyun, you’re speaking nonsense." Huangfu Qianqian stomped angrily, "It seems you’re the one with ill intentions, trying to lure Shouye into your family."
"I didn’t say Shouye should marry into our family; I just want to help him."
"You have ulterior motives, surely plotting step by step. I’m not like that; even if Shouye asks me to elope, I’d do it."
Their exchange left middle-aged Alchemists Jia and Yi exchanging serious glances, shaking their heads heavily; times have changed, times have changed.
Now, however, they dared not speak ill of Wang Shouye.
A bald alchemist in the Pill Workshop had once been ambushed by those girls.
Wang Shouye felt deeply troubled; he only wished to quietly learn alchemy, but how could it be so difficult? These young ladies were just too troublesome.
As he lamented.
A slightly hoarse yet charming voice reached his ears: "Hehe~~ Shouye, you’re quite the busy one." As she spoke, a graceful silhouette dashed inside Xu’s Pill Workshop.
She arrived like a whirlwind, sweeping through the entrance of Xu’s Pill Workshop.
Middle-aged Alchemists Jia and Yi, and some casual guests, stared wide-eyed.
The woman wore a black cloak over red armor, her figure tall and agile. Her fiery red Black Tortoise-style outfit was crafted not from Spiritual Silkworm Silk but from the leather of a Tier Three Fire Demon Beast.
The red leather armor was not new, bearing marks of claws or tearing by some beast. Yet she clearly cherished her battle armor, with parts treated and regularly maintained, giving a faint sheen of polish.
A long sword hung from her waist, with a scabbard of sanded leather worn but clean, the handle glossy from frequent use. This sword was evidently not a mere accessory but a true weapon.
Beneath her flowing black cloak, her long, white neck bore a scar from a claw. This complemented her graceful demeanor with a palpable air of danger.
"This is..."
Seeing the friendly greeting to Shouye from this woman, Huangfu Qianqian and Lei Yanyun immediately reacted as if confronted by a formidable adversary, their expressions growing severe and tense.
This woman was both agile and beautiful with a wild charm, resembling a hunting leopardess, exuding an indescribable mature allure.
She starkly contrasted the sheltered Noble Family girls of Changning Guard, her demeanor vastly different.
Upon seeing her, Wang Shouye’s eyes lit up, yet before he could speak, she seized his arm, pulling him inside, affectionately saying, "Shouye, I’ve come this time for something important. Let’s go to your room to talk."
As they watched Wang Shouye being led away forcefully.
The two noble young women exchanged glances, feeling both outraged and threatened. Compared to the mature allure of this new woman, they felt suddenly like undeveloped girls.
She was in a league beyond the admirers they had previously chased away.
As their eyes met, they understood each other’s intent: first deal with external threats, then internal ones. Resolute, they followed her inside.
Middle-aged Alchemists Jia and Yi were left wide-eyed.
Such indecency, such indecency.
Why weren’t there any girls indecent towards them?
What makes Wang Shouye so special?
Is it just a good family background?
Good looks?
And being very wealthy?
Hmph, what’s so remarkable about that!
Middle-aged Alchemists Jia and Yi were increasingly indignant and sorrowful, wondering why the disparity between people had to be so vast.
...
(Group established, 837185062)

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 76: I Just Want to Quietly Practice Alchemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 76: I Just Want to Quietly Practice Alchemy
...
The agile woman in red armor and black cape who escorted Wang Shouye away was, of course, none other than Wang Shouye’s fourth sister, Wang Luotong.
These days, Wang Luotong is already twenty-seven or twenty-eight years old, but she looks no more than twenty-four or twenty-five.
Her demeanor has grown increasingly composed and charming, like a peach with deadly allure. However, the slight hint of murderous aura that she inadvertently reveals gives off the vibe of a dangerous fierce beast.
The current her is completely different from the girl who once stood in front of Wang Shouzhe, seeming a bit delicate and somewhat aggrieved.
"Fourth Sister."
As soon as he returned to his room, Wang Shouye respectfully saluted Wang Luotong, and then took out his treasured Spirit Tea to start brewing tea for his sister.
Although he is a direct vein of the Wang Family, his treatment in the Pill Workshop is no different from that of an alchemist of the same level. The room is also standardized.
However, his room is meticulously decorated, with just a few simple furnishings and paintings, creating a warm atmosphere, indicating a lot of thought was put into it.
This also reflects Wang Shouye’s character from another angle, patient, meticulous, hardworking, with clever ideas in subtle places.
This is also why Wang Shouzhe specifically chose him to study alchemy among many Wang Family disciples.
After brewing the tea smoothly, Wang Shouye offered the cup to his sister Wang Luotong with both hands: "Fourth Sister, it’s time to prepare for the autumn and winter hunt, right? How come you have time to see me today?"
The autumn and winter hunt has always been a traditional hunting festival for the Black Tortoise Clan.
Firstly, it can supplement the clan with spiritual food; secondly, it can train the new generation of young people, reminding them not to forget the hardships and achievements of their ancestors who pioneered arduously.
Nowadays, many Black Tortoise Clans, especially those in prosperous areas, have treated the autumn and winter hunt as purely a festival and rarely venture into the Outer Domain to explore and hunt fierce beasts, but the Wang Family has always adhered to this tradition.
Wang Luotong has always been a devoted supporter of the autumn and winter hunt. She actively participates every year, prepares diligently, and her performance has always been quite good.
That’s why Wang Shouye is puzzled about why she came to find him at this time.
"I have urgent matters to attend to, so I’m afraid I won’t be able to participate in this year’s autumn and winter hunt." Wang Luotong, while sipping Spirit Tea, couldn’t resist teasing her seventh brother, "Those two young ladies earlier were quite good-looking, how about bringing them along and having a few more children for our family?"
Wang Shouye blushed immediately, smiling bitterly as he pleaded, "Fourth Sister, please don’t tease me anymore. I just want to focus on alchemy and strive to earn back the money the family lost as soon as possible. They’re making trouble in the Pill Workshop every day, causing a lot of annoyance among my colleagues, and I’m really troubled."
"Don’t take it too hard," Wang Luotong laughed and comforted him, "Any family needs to make significant investments in the early stages to cultivate an excellent alchemist. Unlike those alchemists who enter the Pill Workshop on an indenture contract, your task is to quickly master Tier Two Pills, and in the future, even Tier Three Pills and Tier Four Pills. When you can one day refine a Tier Five ’Celestial Spirit Pill,’ our family will be truly remarkable."
"Tier Five Celestial Spirit Pill!" Wang Shouye’s face fell, he smiled bitterly, "Fourth Sister, now I feel even more pressured. My master, Ancestor Ning Chao, has spent a lifetime refining only Tier Three Pills, and that barely makes a profit. Tier Five Pills, that’s impossible. Losing money all the time makes me uncomfortable."
"Don’t rush, don’t rush," Wang Luotong savored her Spirit Tea, her eyes filled with laughter, "You’re only twenty years old and about to start refining Tier Two Pills. You’ll only lose more in the future. After losing seventy or eighty thousand Qian Gold, you’ll probably start refining Tier Three Pills, and after losing a few hundred thousand Qian Gold, you’ll be able to refine Tier Four Pills. The family will always be your unwavering support!"
"%￥*&#..."
Wang Shouye’s eyes rolled up as he looked to the sky, lamenting, my name is Wang Shouye, how come it now seems like I’m Wang Spendthrift! The more Fourth Sister comforts him, the greater his internal pressure grows.
"Fourth Sister, I can already make a profit from refining Tier One Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills," Wang Shouye said weakly, "I can earn ten Qian Gold from each batch. And as I become more skilled, I’ll surely earn twenty or thirty Qian Gold per batch in the future. I want to rely on refining Minor Primordial Cultivation Pills to supplement the family’s expenses."
"You earn ten Qian Gold per batch, but it takes you two days’ work," Wang Luotong shook her head, "Doing so, you’ll have to toil for one or two months just to have one attempt at refining Tier Two Pills, and it will take decades to become a qualified Tier Two Alchemist. Your fourth brother’s idea is to let you try refining Tier Three Pills as much as possible after ten years."
Each batch of Tier Two Pills costs two to three hundred Qian Gold. If it’s ruined, it’s a total loss.
Especially in the early stages, the probability of ruining a whole batch is not small.
With improved skills and proficiency, you can slowly produce one or two Tier Two Pills, which can somewhat slow down the loss.
However, once you become a mature Tier Two Alchemist, opening a batch of pills can at least earn tens of Qian Gold, and with good luck, you can even earn one or two hundred Qian Gold.
At that time, if Wang Shouye focuses on refining Tier Two Pills, he becomes a money-making machine, and within just seven to eight years, he can recover all the previous losses.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 76 I Just Want to Quietly Practice Alchemy_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 76 I Just Want to Quietly Practice Alchemy_2
At that time, Wang Shouye was only about forty years old.
However, it was very clear that this kind of achievement was not what Wang Shouzhe wanted. He simply didn’t need Wang Shouye to make money, just to spend money, speeding up to become a Tier Three, or even Tier Four Alchemist.
"Then I can only occasionally refine a Tier One Pill to keep my hand in practice." Wang Shouye, understanding his fourth brother’s grand ambitions, said helplessly, "Fortunately, refining more High-Tier Elixirs also enhances one’s understanding of Low-Tier Elixirs."
"You can’t slack off on your cultivation either. Train your furnace attendants well, and let them handle the heat on ordinary days," Wang Luotong advised. "Your fourth brother is raising you like a Celestial Human Species; raising an Alchemist isn’t easy, naturally it’s best to live as long as possible."
As a result, Wang Shouye felt even more pressure.
But he also understood his fourth brother’s mindset. Raising him as an Alchemist regardless of cost, aiming for at least a Tier Four Alchemist, possibly even a Tier Five, it was surely because they hoped he would tread the Path of Celestial Human.
Otherwise, after becoming a qualified Tier Four Alchemist, before even contributing to the family, to die of old age and lifespan exhaustion, wouldn’t that be an enormous joke?
"I will certainly work hard and not let fourth brother down," Wang Shouye said gravely, then shifted the topic to Wang Luotong, "What about you, fourth sister? All these years, have you not found someone you fancy?"
"No," Wang Luotong said straightforwardly, then glanced at Wang Shouye and teased, "It’s just that the men in our family are too outstanding. Not to mention your fourth brother, just talking about you, Shouye, at only twenty, you are already at the mid-seventh layer of Qi Refining Realm, a mature Tier One Alchemist, and so handsome and elegant."
"Across the entire Changning Guard, even the noble family direct lineages, who can compare to you? How can your fourth sister look at those crooked melons and cracked dates? Sigh, having outstanding brothers is also a heavy burden~"
"Uh..." Wang Shouye shook his head helplessly, "So fourth sister, are you not planning to get married?"
"I’ll see how it goes," Wang Luotong laughed gracefully, "Anyway, I want to reach the Spirit Platform Realm, otherwise I won’t be content for life. At worst, I’ll pick a pleasing Loose Cultivator to marry into the family for some bloodline."
"Indeed, fourth sister, you are so outstanding, ordinary direct lineage youth are probably really hard to catch your eye. But I believe, there will certainly be a fate belonging to fourth sister." Wang Shouye shifted the topic, "Let’s not discuss this. This time, fourth sister, are you here on important business in Changning Guard? Is there anything you need my help with?"
"Your fourth brother sent me to Qianma Town to take over the fixed assets of the Huangfu Family. I passed by Changning Guard and came to see you, to give you some encouragement," Wang Luotong smiled, "Don’t worry, this time Ancestor Xiaohan will be overseeing, and I, Shouyong, and Zongwei are just there to assist."
Assist.
That was naturally Wang Luotong being modest.
In reality, Ancestor Xiaohan wouldn’t personally oversee every detail as an ancestor; the real management had to rely on the younger generation like Wang Luotong, Wang Shouyong, and Wang Zongwei.
For the younger generation of the family, as long as they were willing to grow, Wang Shouzhe always spared no effort in grooming them. His requirements were also high, expecting them to be sufficiently trained to handle things independently.
This was unavoidable.
The family developed too quickly and didn’t have many members, so Wang Shouzhe naturally set high standards for the younger generation.
Under high standards and strict requirements, the results were gratifying. Nowadays, the younger generation of the Wang Family had all been trained and were beginning to have the ability to handle things independently.
This time, it was to test the capabilities of Wang Luotong, Wang Shouyong, and Wang Zongwei.
As they were talking.
Outside the house suddenly came the voices of two girls: "Is Shouye here?"
"Again..."
Wang Shouye slapped his forehead, rather speechless.
He just wanted to quietly refine pills, why was it so difficult?
Reluctantly, he walked out the door, cupped his hands to the two girls, and prepared to say a few perfunctory words to send them away.
Suddenly.
A group of gorgeously clad young people rushed in from outside the door.
The leader was a man in his twenties.
He was dressed in luxurious Black Tortoise Martial Attire, a Jade Crown on his head, a Treasure Sword at his waist, exuding an imposing aura.
Seeing Wang Shouye and Lei Yanyun, along with Huangfu Qianqian and others standing together, his face abruptly darkened.
"Brother, why are you here?" Lei Yanyun’s pretty face changed.
The man, whom she called "Brother," had a stern expression: "Lei Yanyun, you still acknowledge me as your brother? As a Miss of the Direct Lineage of the Celestial Human Lei Family, you disgrace yourself by not considering your status."
"Brother, how am I disgracing myself?" Lei Yanyun’s pretty face turned white, she retorted in a pitiful voice, "What’s wrong with having someone I like? Even father didn’t say anything."
Wang Shouye recognized the luxurious man as the current second son of the direct lineage of the Celestial Human Lei Family—Lei Bowu.
In Changning Guard, Lei Bowu was considered one of the top idle playboys, famously notorious, almost no one dared to provoke him.
Wang Shouye and he had always had little interaction.
"Lei Yanyun, what nonsense are you saying?" As soon as he heard Lei Yanyun dare to retort, Lei Bowu became furious, "The family raises you and provides for you, not for you to act so wantonly. Don’t you know? The Zhang Family, a Celestial Human Family from An Yuan Guard, has already come to propose marriage."

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 76: I Just Want to Quietly Practice Alchemy_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 76: I Just Want to Quietly Practice Alchemy_3
"An Yuan Celestial Zhang Family?!"
Lei Yanyun’s delicate body trembled.
An Yuan Guard is a guardian city to the north of Changning Guard.
Once upon a time, when Changning Guard was still a barbaric outland, An Yuan Guard was the frontier of the Daqian, which is the origin of the city’s name.
Compared to Changning Guard, An Yuan Guard’s history is much longer, and the Celestial Zhang Family is an old and well-established Celestial Human Family.
Her and Lei Bowu’s great-grandmother from the Zhang Family was a legitimate daughter of the An Yuan Zhang lineage. Without any surprises, father is most likely to agree to this proposal.
Her eyes glowed, suddenly showing a resolute look: "It’s just a marriage proposal, and father hasn’t agreed yet. I’ll go find my father right now. Whether it’s the Celestial Zhang Family or any other Celestial Family, I refuse to marry."
With that, she was about to walk out, full of anxiety.
"Impudent! Stop right there!" Lei Bowu was furious, "Aren’t you just infatuated with that Wang Shouye boy? Not to mention that the Ping’an Wang Family is just an Eighth-Grade Noble Family. This boy isn’t even of the direct lineage, how could he be worthy of you?"
"You are not allowed to speak of Shouye like that!" Lei Yanyun stomped her foot in anger, "Shouye is much more outstanding than you think."
"Outstanding?" Lei Bowu sneered, "If you say he’s outstanding, then let me test him."
With that, he looked at Wang Shouye with a malicious expression, drawing his long sword with a "clang" and pointing it at him.
"Pretty boy, draw your sword and let me measure just how capable you are."
Wang Shouye was speechless for a moment.
He just wanted to quietly refine some pills, why was it so hard?
He intended to refuse.
Unexpectedly.
Lei Yanyun rushed forward to stand in front of him, spreading her arms like a hen protecting her chicks: "Brother, you are six or seven years older than Shouye and have already reached the peak of the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. You’re bullying him!"
"Hmph! Didn’t you say he’s outstanding?" Lei Bowu sneered continuously, "What, doesn’t he even have the courage to fight me? He’s just a silver-like lead gunpoint, flashy but useless, tricking you naive young girls only."
As he spoke, he aimed his words once again at Wang Shouye: "Wang Shouye, you’d better go back to Ping’an Town as soon as possible. Otherwise, I’ll beat you every time I see you. What, you don’t accept this? If not, you can go back and ask your brother Wang Shouzhe..."
"Shut up!"
Wang Shouye was also angry.
Lei Bowu could say whatever he wanted about him, but not about his fourth brother!
He pushed Lei Yanyun away with a serious expression, his eyes showing a fierce glint: "Lei Bowu, do you even deserve to call my fourth brother by name? You just want a spar, right? I’ll indulge you!"
With that said, he was about to draw his sword.
But before his hand could reach the sword hilt, it was caught by a slender, jade-like hand.
At the same time, a lazy yet somewhat charming voice sounded in his ear: "Shouye, you are an alchemist, there’s no need to engage with such prodigal brutes."
Fourth sister?
Wang Shouye was taken aback for a moment, then saw Wang Luotong leisurely making her way out from behind him.
She was dressed in red armor with a black cape, exuding both valiance and a touch of savage wildness, her presence significantly stronger than Wang Shouye’s.
Her phoenix eyes sized up Lei Bowu with scorn, letting out a light scoff: "You don’t even look human, how dare you shout at my brother? We’re about the same age, since you’re eager to be beaten, I’m willing to accommodate."
Lei Bowu’s face momentarily froze: "Who are you?"
"Ping’an Wang Family, ’Luo’ generation, fourth daughter, Wang Luotong." With a casual grasp of the sword hilt, Wang Luotong placed it, scabbard and all, in front of her leisurely, "Please, enlighten me."
Though her posture appeared careless, her body was like a coiled spring, cultivated through years of hunting fierce beasts. She was like a female leopard poised to strike, ready to deliver a lethal blow to her opponent at any moment.
"Good, good, good! A Wang Family woman dares challenge the legitimate son of a Celestial Human Family." Lei Bowu laughed in anger, his eyes suddenly sharp.
Though he was a good-for-nothing, he was still the second legitimate son of the Celestial Human Lei Family, pride deeply ingrained in his bones, unyielding to any provocations.
With a flick of his longsword, he pointed it at Wang Luotong: "Changning Lei Family, ’Bo’ generation, seventh son, Lei Bowu, please, enlighten me!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 77: Foundations! The Rise of the Wang Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 77: Foundations! The Rise of the Wang Family
...
The conversation between the two was filled with the technical language of a duel challenge.
One side issues the challenge, and the other side responds, agreeing to the duel.
Once the duel is confirmed, unless one side surrenders, there are no complaints about being injured or killed, and even the Daqian Law does not pursue it.
At this time, there were already many spectators.
In addition to the alchemists and furnace attendants from the Xu’s Pill Workshop, there were also customers who had ordered elixirs from the workshop gathered to watch the spectacle.
They were spectators, and also witnesses.
Wang Shouye, along with the young boys and girls who came with Lei Bowu, Lei Yanyun, and Huangfu Qianqian, also conscientiously made space to avoid affecting the two’s display.
Let’s not talk about trivial matters for now.
Once entering the duel state, Wang Luotong’s somewhat lazy gaze immediately became sharp, her eyes were like those of a female leopard eyeing its prey as she looked at Lei Bowu.
Lei Bowu felt an inexplicable tremor in his heart, a trace of instinctual fear arose.
Unable to control himself, he made the first move, thrusting his sword toward Wang Luotong.
Although he was a playboy, he was after all a disciple of the Celestial Human Lei Family, and the education and training he received from a young age were different from ordinary people.
This strike.
Was precisely the first move "Spring Thunder" from the Celestial Thunder Sword Technique, the Upper Grade Sword Technique of the Celestial Human Lei Family.
This move is known for its speed and explosive power, unpredictable like thunder in spring. His basic skills were quite solid, the move was executed competently, with a certain flair of lightning speed.
"Boo Wu, Young Master, mighty!"
Seeing this, those followers all cheered enthusiastically.
"Hehe~ That’s all?"
Wang Luotong just chuckled lightly, her delicate body flickered, and she floated up like a willow catkin.
This was precisely the Wang Family’s family body technique—"Willow Catkin Body Technique."
Her Willow Catkin Body Technique had reached a refined level, her figure was elusive, even bringing out a string of afterimages faintly.
No matter how swift Lei Bowu’s sword light was, it couldn’t even catch her shadow.
Despite Wang Luotong being a girl, her personality was extremely stubborn from a young age, and because her grandfather favored boys over girls somewhat, she somewhat disliked her identity as a girl.
Once given a chance, she was more desperate than anyone else.
Whenever fierce beasts appeared in Ping’an Territory, she was always the first to appear on the scene.
She never wanted to give up any opportunity, pushing herself to keep getting stronger.
It can be said that in the young generation of the "Wang" family, except for Wang Shouxin, Wang Shouyi, and Wang Shouzhe, no one could match her.
Even her legitimate brother Wang Shounuo might not be her match.
"This..."
Lei Bowu’s face turned somewhat unnatural after several moves were easily dodged by her. He hurried to intensify his attacks, continuously striking toward Wang Luotong with each move.
The Celestial Thunder Sword Technique faintly carried sounds of thunder, electric glow flickering, extremely splendid.
But such splendid sword techniques could not even touch the hem of Wang Luotong’s clothes.
Prompting Wang Luotong to scoff in her heart.
Floral fist and embroidery legs.
Unexpectedly, a legitimate disciple of the Celestial Human Lei Family only had this level of skill.
She put away her Battle Sword, casually unbuckled her long whip from her waist.
"Snap!" "Snap!" "Snap!"
The whip shadow layered over itself, flipping and flying around like a black snake dancing. As the tip of the whip cut through the air, the air immediately produced a crisp "snap" sound.
Compared to the Wang Family’s Profound Origin Swordsmanship, Wang Luotong preferred the Whip Technique.
However, the family only had an ordinary Lower Grade Whip Technique, and this whip technique didn’t even have a name, its various moves were fundamentally basic. Nevertheless, even with simpler moves, with rigorous practice, the destructive power was remarkably wicked.
Especially with a generous amount of Profound Qi infused into the soft whip.
Her Whip Technique, simple moves like "whip," "wrap," "stab," "dance," seemed injected with soul, like a snake tongue flickering, akin to a Jiaolong maneuvering, dazzling the onlookers.
Wang Luotong’s basic skills were exceedingly solid, and her cultivation was profound, stronger than Lei Bowu of a similar age.
Within ten breaths, Lei Bowu was completely suppressed, falling into a disadvantage.
"Snap!"
The whip tip struck his shoulder like a serpent attacking, with a crisp tear, his embroidered garment ripped, his arm muscles quickly bore a whip mark.
"Ah!!"
Under the excruciating pain, Lei Bowu screamed, almost dropping the sword in his hand.
A feeling of unbearable numbness mixed with severe pain spread from his arm throughout his body.
He was both shocked and angry: "You, you, you, you poisoned the whip! So contemptible!"
"Fool~ It’s just a bit of chili sauce."
Wang Luotong laughed disdainfully.
The whip shadow howled, directly hitting his chest.
"Snap!" Another crisp sound, Lei Bowu’s clothes split open, skin and flesh lacerated, the sword in his hand clattered to the ground, and he fell miserably onto the floor, clearly having lost his combat power.
However.
Wang Luotong had no intention of stopping.
The whip shadows layered, enveloping Lei Bowu like a storm.
Her voice emerged in the gaps between the whip shadows: "Weren’t you so arrogant? Didn’t you want to hit my brother? Surrender or admit defeat, otherwise, I’ll whip you to death."
"Snap! Snap! Snap!"
Whip after whip, the leather whip continuously struck Lei Bowu.
Even though Wang Luotong had withdrawn the Profound Qi, her technique was skillful, each whip landing in different places, and the force stopped immediately upon flesh contact, causing him extreme pain without truly harming his muscles or internal organs.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 77: Foundations! The Rise of the Wang Family - Part 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 77: Foundations! The Rise of the Wang Family - Part 2
She is a mature woman who knows her limits.
After all, no matter how annoying Lei Bowu is, he is the second legitimate son of a Celestial Human Family. It’s fine to injure him in a normal duel, but if he gets crippled, it would mean trouble for the Ping’an Wang Family.
These days, the main enemy of the Ping’an Wang Family is the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, so they cannot afford to add the Lei Family to their enemies.
Unexpectedly.
Lei Bowu turned out to be quite stiff-necked, despite screaming in pain, he refused to surrender, just howling, "Beat me to death! If you have the guts, beat me to death! This young master will not surrender, just... ouch, ouch!"
"Smack, smack, smack!"
Whip shadows like a fast wind, whip ends like torrential rain, quickly let the young master of the Lei Family taste what it’s like to be "beaten to death."
He curled up in pain on the ground, soon losing the strength to talk tough, only knowing to howl in agony.
"Surrender! We surrender on behalf of the young master!"
Lei Bowu’s several lackey attendants immediately got anxious and hurriedly shouted.
"Sister, stop beating him! I also surrender on behalf of my brother." Lei Yanyun was extremely anxious, rushed forward and grabbed Wang Luotong, "Sister, please spare my brother just this once."
Despite having a fierce conflict with Lei Bowu earlier, he is ultimately her brother. How could she really stand by and watch as he gets beaten to death?
"You call me sister?"
Wang Luotong squinted slightly at her, her expression half mocking, half smiling.
Lei Yanyun’s face turned red suddenly, said weakly, "Just now, I mistakenly assumed you were... I was wrong, please forgive me, sister."
"Giggle~" Wang Luotong laughed and pinched her delicate face, "Alright then, since my sister-in-law pleads, I, as the sister, shall naturally agree to spare him."
With that, she flicked her fair wrist, and the long whip curled like a spirit snake in her hand, draped it back at her waist.
Seeing Lei Bowu on the ground still howling nonstop, she coldly laughed, "Surely a silver-like lead gunpoint; looks impressive but useless. Remember this, the one who beat you is Wang Luotong. If you’re not convinced, come at me whenever! If you bully my brother, big or small, this lady will come to block your Lei Family’s gate, see if your Lei Family can afford the embarrassment."
Between noble families, there are all kinds of rules. Between peers, if the age is about the same, if you lose in a duel, though disgraceful, you have to accept it.
If Wang Luotong really goes to block the gate and challenges Lei Bowu every day, and Lei Bowu dares not respond, the Lei Family’s reputation would truly be tarnished.
However, at this moment Lei Bowu had no strength to reply to her?
He was curled up on the ground gasping for air, could only stare fixedly at Wang Luotong but couldn’t manage to say a complete sentence.
Wang Luotong looked away disdainfully, then giggled at Wang Shouye: "Alright, your fourth sister has important matters to attend to, won’t disturb your ’alchemy’."
Then she winked at Lei Yanyun, teasingly said: "Sister-in-law, I’d advise you to quickly return home, act cute to your father, and don’t miss the good opportunity."
After speaking, she pointed her toes, like a willow catkin floating on the water, swiftly drifted away with the wind.
Such was the case of coming like the wind and going like the wind, indeed a dashing arrival and departure.
Wang Shouye didn’t even get a chance to bid farewell, could only bow his hand towards her back.
Among the spectators, the middle-aged alchemist A and B were shaking their heads repeatedly. How people’s hearts have changed~ This Wang Shouye’s sister is truly vigorous and peppery~
However, as they felt fearful, they couldn’t help following her departure with their eyes.
"Young master, young master, are you okay?"
At this time, Lei Bowu’s several lackey attendants finally reacted, hurriedly swarmed over to support Lei Bowu.
"Ouch~ Be gentle, be gentle! You bunch of trash, be gentle with this young master!" Lei Bowu cried out in pain repeatedly.
"Young master, what shall we do? Should we gather some brothers and go to Ping’an Wang Family for revenge?"
"Revenge your head! Do you have any brains at all?!" Lei Bowu almost choked with rage from this group, "They won the duel fair and square. If I gather people to gang up on her after the event, does the Celestial Human Family’s face matter at all?"
"Moreover, the Ping’an Wang Family is the Eighth-Grade Chief, do you truly think they grow up chanting scriptures and eating only vegetarian?"
"Ouch~ Ouch~ It’s killing this young master, damn pepper juice! Quick, quickly take me back. Damn it, in my life, this is the first time seeing such a woman, she’s got grit!"
"Young master, don’t talk nonsense..."
"Mind your own damn business! Ouch ouch~ How satisfying! Woman, I won’t let you off!"
Seeing Lei Bowu and his entourage shouting and leaving, Wang Shouye was quite speechless.
This Lei Bowu must truly have mental issues? After being beaten like this, he still wants to provoke the fourth sister, surely a sign of trouble?
Then, he even more speechlessly watched the two approaching girls.
"Shouye, the Lei Family is too despicable, they are bullying with their influence," Huangfu Qianqian said charmingly, "Moreover, Lei Yanyun is definitely going to marry into the Celestial Human Zhang Family. But I’m different, if you’re willing, I can elope with you."
"Huangfu Qianqian, my brother is my brother, it has nothing to do with me!" Lei Yanyun said angrily, "I can plead with my father and beg the Ancestor. If they don’t agree, I can also elope with Shouye."
"Now that the foreign enemies are gone," the two girls started arguing, pins against needles.
Hearing them talk about eloping over and over, Wang Shouye felt an unbearable headache.
Fourth brother worked so hard to train him as an alchemist, not for eloping with them.
Girls, truly too troublesome~
Still, alchemy is enjoyable!
...
Geographically, Ping’an Town and Changning Guard face each other across the river. The river that separates them is called Anjiang.
Anjiang’s width is vast, yet the water flows swiftly. Along the one hundred or so miles of river section through Ping’an Town, the narrowest part is the "Broken Dragon Gorge," only a hundred feet wide, but the most perilous part is the "Falling Eagle Gorge."
A branch of Liping Mountain separates Ping’an Town from the Outer Domain like a screen, yet stretches diagonally across Anjiang. Under Anjiang’s perennial onslaught, it formed the renowned Falling Eagle Gorge.
The mountain ridge opposite Falling Eagle Gorge slices the land into two as if with a blade, the south holds the Shanyang Gongsun Family, while the north is the Shanyin Liu Family.
They face each other across mountains, resembling the two poles of yin and yang.
On the Ping’an Town side of Falling Eagle Gorge, however, the cliffs are steep like a blade, with numerous stone blade seams, extremely perilous, seemingly only accessible by eagles.
And on the right bank of Falling Eagle Gorge lies a large chaotic stone beach. Legend says it is the remains of a cliff once destroyed by Anjiang’s waters.
Once, this chaotic stone beach marked the boundary between the fishing grounds of Ping’an Wang Family and Ping’an Zhao Family. But with the decline of Ping’an Zhao Family, the entire one hundred plus miles of Anjiang river section had long been wholly owned by the Wang Family.
Thus, this boundary marker no longer has any meaning.
However, the chaotic stone beach that was once nearly useless showed some anomaly. Beside the cliff edge along with Falling Eagle Gorge, there used to be a small bay shaped like a cashew.
This bay, nestled against the cliff, sheltered from wind and waves, allows fishing boats temporary rest. However, this small haven has shallow water, and beneath it are chaotic stones where medium to large vessels cannot enter.
It’s uncertain when.
The entrance of the bay seemed unchanged, but inside, there had been a huge transformation.
The chaotic stones underneath had been cleared bit by bit, and some stubborn rugged riverbeds had been excavated and organized. If an outsider comes, they’d likely be shocked.
How could this still be the shallow water haven? It had clearly turned into a small deep-water port!
And now.
A small fishing boat swiftly entered the bay, docked at the harbor.
From that fishing boat, emerged none other than the recently famous Patriarch of the Ping’an Wang Family, Wang Shouzhe!
Outsiders likely never dreamed that currently popular overseas commodities like "foreign cement," "foreign glass," and other products originate from this hidden small deep-water port.
This, is the core location that Wang Shouzhe has managed for many years.
It’s also the true "foundation" of the Wang Family.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 78: Struggle of Destiny! Winds Rise in Falling Eagle Gorge
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 78: Struggle of Destiny! Winds Rise in Falling Eagle Gorge
...
In the small deepwater port, a young man in his twenties had already been leading a group waiting there. Though his appearance was not striking, there was an air of calmness and competence about him.
As soon as he saw Wang Shouzhe come ashore, he immediately led the group to greet him, cupped his hands, and said, "Wang Gui greets the Patriarch."
There was a touch of excitement in his voice.
Indeed.
This young man was none other than Wang Gui, the servant who had grown up alongside Wang Shouzhe.
After Wang Shouzhe got married, it was no longer suitable for him to stay in the courtyard. Wang Shouzhe simply dispatched him to establish a secret production base and organize the investment and production.
Having grown up together, coupled with his lineage from the Wang Family’s collateral branch, Wang Gui’s loyalty was beyond question. Even when handling affairs outside, no one dared to underestimate him.
Now, he was the Chief Steward here, indirectly presiding over the major affairs on behalf of Wang Shouzhe.
"No need for formalities."
Wang Shouzhe was quite happy to see Wang Gui.
He glanced at Wang Gui and noticed that compared to their last meeting, Wang Gui’s aura was much more stable and refined, clearly having made a breakthrough in Wang’s Profound Origin Technique.
Wang Shouzhe’s face showed a slight smile as he praised, "It seems you’ve been diligent in your cultivation lately, reaching the Seventh Layer of the Qi Refining Realm. But you must continue to strive, to cultivate to the Spirit Platform Realm soon, so you can accumulate more future resources for your children."
"Yes, Patriarch."
At the mention of children, Wang Gui also showed a contented smile.
Years ago, Wang Gui used to think about Wang Mei.
But as Wang Mei’s power and status grew, along with her nature beyond his control, he gradually gave up.
Finally, with Wang Shouzhe as a matchmaker, Wang Gui married a collateral woman with cultivation talent from the Yingxiu Lu Family.
Over the past six or seven years, the couple bore two children, the elder of whom was already attending classes in the Clan Academy, while the younger was still nursing with his wife caring for him at home.
"Patriarch, please come inside."
After exchanging pleasantries, Wang Gui led Wang Shouzhe inside.
He walked with his head slightly lowered, half a step behind Wang Shouzhe, occasionally responding to questions posed by Wang Shouzhe.
Evidently, as the Chief Steward of this secret production base, he had been very diligent, answering every query with proficiency.
Even though Wang Shouzhe’s last visit to this secret base was before his trip to Purple Mansion Academy, about eight or nine months ago, with his control power, no event, big or small, within this secret base escaped his notice.
Passing through the corridor, the view suddenly opened up.
It was a gorge.
This gorge had originally existed semi-naturally, and with Wang Family’s continuous excavation, development, and site leveling, its scale had become increasingly large, increasingly industrial in atmosphere.
On either side, some mountain bodies had been excavated with numerous cavities to store water-sensitive raw materials and finished materials. In fact, many rock chambers were used for people to live.
On the open ground, several large storage buildings were built against the mountains, storing heaps of raw materials like a mountain.
Most importantly, several large kilns stood impressively within the gorge.
The kilns were coal-fired.
In this world, coal wasn’t valuable because besides firing kilns and forging, coal had little use.
In the winter, commoners used charcoal for heating, and noble families used the finest smokeless charcoal.
But indeed, if coal were used to heat water in a boiler, then circulate the hot water through pipes and radiators to form central heating, it would be much more effective than using a charcoal stove.
Wang Shouzhe had already instructed the craftsmen to first build a small boiler heating system in their spare time for a trial in his own room.
Otherwise, the winter weather being constantly damp and bone-chilling caused discomfort.
Though Spirit Platform Realm cultivators already had extraordinary physiques, comparable neither in cold nor in heat tolerance to mere mortals, why not make oneself more comfortable if possible?
Setting that aside for now.
Currently, this secret base almost operated around the clock, producing "foreign cement." The cement kilns burned yearlong, day and night, without pause.
The cement production process, to be honest, wasn’t complex.
It only required grinding limestone, iron ore slag, and clay into powder, then mixing them proportionally, using a coal kiln for high-temperature calcination, and finally grinding it into powder again to become clinker.
Afterward, mixing the clinker with a certain proportion of gypsum powder resulted in ordinary cement.
This is known as the two-grind one-calcine process.
And limestone, iron ore slag, clay, coal, and gypsum powder were all extremely cheap raw materials, seemingly ubiquitous.
After processing, however, cement’s market price could reach half that of grain crops, and the profit was immense.
Moreover, before shipping raw materials to this processing base, limestone and iron ore slag were pre-ground into powder, thus here only needed calcination and other follow-up processing techniques.
