Unfortunately, the only downside was the production capacity.
Despite joint production efforts by the Lua Family, Liua Family, Gongsun Family, and Wang Family, now, the entire cement system’s annual output could only reach 100,000 tons.
100,000 tons sounded like a lot, but compared to Earth, such output was tremendously backward.
Wang Shouzhe vaguely recalled that before his transmigration, Huaxia’s per capita annual cement consumption was about one and a half tons. The disparity was as vast as the heavens and the earth.
Nothing could be done.
Current cement production technology in all facets was still quite backward, especially in raw material extraction and grinding; most production methods were fairly primitive, still temporarily using animal-powered gear grinding cars.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 78: Battle of Destiny! Winds Rise in Falling Eagle Gorge_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 78: Battle of Destiny! Winds Rise in Falling Eagle Gorge_2
Even so, the Marriage Alliance’s annual revenue from cement alone has already exceeded two hundred thousand Qian Gold.
Moreover, all the raw materials are sourced from our own industries, produced in our jurisdiction, things that ordinarily wouldn’t sell at all, yielding extremely low costs.
And in recent years, since the reputation of "Foreign Cement" has been established, sales channels have improved significantly, making it difficult to meet demand.
Now, the entire Marriage Alliance is planning to increase production and intends to implement hydraulic windlass grinding cars in practical production within the next year or two.
It is expected that within ten years, production will increase fivefold, with annual revenue exceeding a million Qian Gold.
Putting aside the matter of Foreign Cement,
Foreign Glassware is also a flagship product of this production base.
Most glassware, such as those small glasses, bottles, plates, and jars, is produced here. Overall, the craftsmanship is actually much simpler than firing ordinary porcelain. However, the price of glassware is several times higher than that of ordinary porcelain.
And the raw material for glassware is similarly simple, just quartz sand.
Under the banner of overseas imports, these "exquisite" glasswares have gradually become popular among the Noble Families. Within just a few years, they have allowed the Wang Family and the Marriage Alliance to earn a fortune, even more profitable than selling cement.
If it weren’t for Wang Shouzhe needing to continuously expand cement production to lay the groundwork for future Outer Domain development and city-building plans, he would genuinely want to stop producing cement and solely focus on glassware.
Unfortunately, he knows that technology must be accumulated bit by bit. For the future, cement production and research and development must be continued.
As for the specific research and production process, Wang Shouzhe himself doesn’t have the energy or time to get involved. What he can do is merely provide some directional guidance and inspiration.
Fortunately, in this world, there is no shortage of intelligent and diligent craftsmen, which has made his various ideas become a reality.
Of course, the production base and the research base are separate.
This is merely the production base; the Wang Family’s real research base is not located here.
Afterward.
Wang Shouzhe, assuming the guise of inspection, "took a casual stroll" around the production base, announcing that he would stay at the production base for a few days to guide the upcoming work.
Very soon, this news "spread" throughout the entire production base.
...
Deep within this production base lies a concealed chamber.
The chamber is not large, but it is well-equipped, allowing anyone residing here to stay indoors for ten days to half a month without any problems. If they were a Black Tortoise Cultivator, it would be even less of an issue.
At this moment.
On the Arhat Couch inside the chamber, a tall, elderly man sat cross-legged.
It was clear that he was quite old, with many wrinkles on his face, exuding a weathered aura, yet his entire presence remained as firm and steady as a mountain, carrying an awe-inspiring calmness.
Particularly his eyes, which were as deep as a dark pool.
Even though he wore plain robes, it didn’t conceal the fact that he had an extraordinary identity.
Wang Shouzhe sat cross-legged opposite him, personally serving him a pot of tea, his face full of apology: "Ancestor Zhoubo, I apologize for the inconvenience you have faced these past six months."
Indeed, this distinguished elder was none other than the Celestial Human Ancestor of the Longzuo Wang Family—Wang Zhoubo, Ancestor Zhoubo.
He had been secluded in this production base for nearly six months.
"Your arrangements were very thorough. Not only did I have Tier Three Spiritual Flesh to eat daily, but you also covered the elixirs I used for cultivation." Ancestor Zhoubo chuckled heartily, "This has led to significant progress in my cultivation recently. How could I have any reason to complain? It’s just another retreat."
"Furthermore, Zhou Xuan was my cousin. When his family and he were harmed to such an extent, it’s a rare opportunity for me to seek vengeance for him now. The Huangfu Family is as cunning as foxes; no amount of preparation is too much."
"The Huangfu Family is indeed very cautious." Wang Shouzhe said while sipping Spirit Tea, "Even though they themselves are connected with the Yin Sha Sect, they managed to make their accounts nearly flawless, ultimately making a branch shoulder the blame while the Main Vein remained unscathed. It’s no wonder the Huangfu Family has stood firm in Changning Guard for five hundred years—not by mere chance."
"To hunt such a fox, we must strategize repeatedly. Fortunately, all our years of preparations are finally coming to fruition."
Hearing this, Ancestor Zhoubo’s heart moved: "Shouzhe, do you think the other party is about to lose patience?"
"By collapsing the Qianma Huangfu Family and exterminating those few agents from the Yin Sha Sect, we effectively severed two arms of the Celestial Person Huangfu Family." Wang Shouzhe analyzed eloquently, "And by purchasing all the fixed assets from the Qianma Huangfu Family, we’ve essentially grabbed the Huángfǔ Ranch by the throat. Additionally, our overt and covert support of Beichen Ancestor’s breakthrough to the Celestial Human Realm poses no small threat to them."
"With all this, the Huangfu Family’s anger has long been seething. Their previous inaction was mere patience in the dark, waiting for the right moment. Just yesterday, Senior Brother Fang Yoou’an and others from the Purple Mansion Academy successfully completed disaster relief and returned to the academy. City Guard Xiahou Hongde also took the academic flying chariot to report to the Governor’s Mansion in Longzuo County. This back-and-forth would take at least ten days, possibly up to a month."
"This is the best opportunity for the Huangfu Family to act. Once missed, it will be hard to find another such perfect chance." Wang Shouzhe said calmly, "And my personal visit to the secret production base for a few days serves as the last tempting bait."

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 78: Struggle of Destiny! Winds Rise in Falling Eagle Gorge_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 78: Struggle of Destiny! Winds Rise in Falling Eagle Gorge_3
"What if the other side doesn’t take the bait?" Ancestor Zhoubo asked.
"If they don’t take the bait even in this situation, once Xiahou City Guard returns from his duties, they won’t dare to make a move for at least three years. After all, the Cloud-piercing Cannon given to me by Xiahou City Guard is not given for nothing." Wang Shouzhe laughed, "And the longer they drag it out, the stronger the Wang Family’s marriage alliance will become. If they delay any further, Beichen Ancestor might succeed in advancing to the Celestial Human Realm. They can’t afford to delay."
"Shouzhe, you’ve really outmaneuvered them." Ancestor Zhoubo sighed with admiration, "If Zhouxuan had your cunning, he wouldn’t have ended up that way."
"Sigh~ I’m left with no choice, it’s all forced upon me." Wang Shouzhe also sighed with emotion, "As the saying goes, once bitten by a snake, you’ll fear a rope for ten years. The Huangfu Family is like a venomous snake, lurking in the shadows, ready to strike at any moment. How can the Wang Family live peacefully like this? Instead of constantly guarding against them, it’s better to take the initiative into our own hands."
Wang Shouzhe also felt deeply moved. If not for the heavy burden on his shoulders, he would rather not spend every day plotting and scheming. How nice it would be to cultivate peacefully and play with his children?
Unfortunately, when the tree desires tranquility, the wind will not cease.
In any world, it’s not quiet just because you wish it to be. If you want to truly grow strong, you must actively take control of your destiny.
...
That night.
At the main residence of the Huangfu Family in Changning Guard.
In the study, the luxurious palace lantern embedded with spirit stones emitted a bright white light, illuminating the whole room like broad daylight.
Huangfu Jinhuan sat at the broad ancient wooden desk, opening a secret letter.
The letter was sealed with sealing wax and had a special seal to prevent forgery. The signature was drawn with simple lines outlining the shape of a fish, seemingly some sort of special code.
Huangfu Jinhuan opened the letter with a somewhat casual attitude.
However, after just a few glances, his eyes lit up, and the more he read, the more excited he became. Moments later, he was so excited that he slapped the letter onto the table and stood up directly.
"Good~ good~ good! A heaven-sent opportunity, truly a heaven-sent opportunity!"
These days, he had been feeling stifled.
The Yin Sha Sect experts and all the branches of the Huangfu Family in secret contact had been eradicated, even the fixed assets of the Qianma Huangfu Family fell into the hands of the Wang Family.
The prestige of the dignified Celestial Human Huangfu Family in Changning Guard plummeted, and former allied forces treated them warily, keeping a respectful distance. Even those Ninth-Grade small families that used to visit frequently were now nowhere to be found.
The main residence gates that once saw a constant stream of guests were now deserted.
All these seemed to indicate that the once-glorious Celestial Human Family was gradually declining.
But who would know that the Huangfu Family still had the power to counterattack? He was just waiting, waiting for the right opportunity to strike back.
Now, that opportunity had arrived.
Huangfu Jinhuan hurried to see Ancestor Hua Ye to report this rare piece of good news. The hidden spies he had painstakingly placed finally proved their worth.
...
Several days later.
It was a dark and windy night.
Below Falling Eagle Gorge, the water flowed rapidly, constantly slapping against the cliff walls, making a "pa pa pa" sound. Cold winds whistled over the cliff tops, their path blocked by treetops and rocky crevices, creating a weeping, ghost-like wailing sound.
Amidst this eerie atmosphere, three masked figures appeared at the top of the cliff that legend said only eagles and falcons could perch upon.
The leader stood with his hands behind his back.
Although masked, his signature red hair unmistakably revealed his identity to even the blind. He was none other than Ancestor Hua Ye of the Celestial Human Huangfu Family.
Clearly, this time his masked disguise was rather perfunctory, or perhaps his heart was filled with confidence. The mask was merely a formality.
"Jinning, Jinyu," Ancestor Hua Ye looked down at the production base within the gorge, with a tinge of heat and disdain in his voice, "According to the intelligence, the Wang Family’s marriage alliance’s secret production base is annually guarded by one of the alliance’s Spirit Platform Realm cultivators in rotation. The current guard is Chen Junyao of the East Port Chen Family."
Ancestor Junyao was the second ancestor of the East Port Chen Family. Being relatively young, he hadn’t even reached the mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm. In the eyes of ordinary people, he was already a formidable ancestor.
But in the eyes of Celestial Human Families, a mere initial stage Spirit Platform Realm cultivator was not worth mentioning.
No wonder Ancestor Hua Ye spoke with disdain.
He continued, "Besides him, Wang Shouzhe is secretly here to oversee things. This is a heaven-sent opportunity. First, you must subdue Wang Shouzhe, then capture some key production stewards to temporarily control the production base and extract the manufacturing secrets of foreign cement and foreign glass as quickly as possible."
"Yes, Ancestor."
The other two masked elders replied solemnly.
Their hair was grayed, and their voices carried the tone of those in their twilight years, seemingly older than Ancestor Hua Ye.
These two elders, one named Huangfu Jinning and the other Huangfu Jinyu, were of the "Jin" generation of ancestors in the Celestial Human Huangfu Family.
Celestial Human Families are distinct from Eighth and Ninth-Grade families.
The foundation of an old Seventh-Grade Noble Family is incredibly terrifying and unfathomable.
These two Jin-generation ancestors were of the same generation as Huangfu Jinyuan, who split off to establish a family in Qianma Town.
They were once pillars of the Celestial Human Huangfu Family, with Huangfu Jinning even serving as the patriarch for decades.
However, they were now old, with only ten to twenty years of lifespan left, and no hope of reaching the Celestial Human Realm, so they had long since retired to become clan elders.
Under normal circumstances, they would enjoy their remaining years within the family until their life expired.
This is the normal cycle of a Celestial Human family.
Considering a Celestial Human Realm cultivator has a lifespan of nearly four hundred years, under usual circumstances, a Celestial Human family rotates through their Celestial Human Ancestors about every two hundred years.
Aside from a few fortunate direct descendants, the vast majority do not have the qualifications to become Celestial Human Seeds, nor even have the opportunity to strive for the Celestial Human Realm.
Even someone with superior talent like Huangfu Jinyuan had no choice but to branch out, laboring all his life, ultimately without a chance to attempt the Celestial Human Realm.
Instead, it was Beichen Ancestor of the Changning Xu Family who was incredibly lucky and found the opportunity to attempt the Celestial Human Realm.
"Jinning, Jinyu," Ancestor Hua Ye gazed at the starry sky, expressing with a sigh, "I know you’ve both felt somewhat aggrieved in your lives. If the Huangfu Family were a Purple Mansion family, you might have had the chance to become Celestial Humans."
If raised from childhood as Celestial Human Seeds, both Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu would each have a thirty percent chance of entering the Celestial Human Realm.
As for the deceased founding ancestor of the Qianma Huangfu Family, Huangfu Jinyuan, he would have had a sixty to seventy percent chance, nearly on par with Ancestor Hua Ye back in the day. But amidst the grand tides of destiny, what does it all matter?
"But the path to the Purple Mansion is not ordinary. Now, an excellent opportunity lies before the Huangfu Family, and you must strive for a chance for future generations."
"We understand, Ancestor." Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu replied with determined expressions, eyes ablaze, "For the future of the Huangfu Family, we will do our utmost and not betray Ancestor’s trust."
"Go~" Ancestor Hua Ye waved his hand lightly, his tone calm and confident, "We have the advantage of preparation, and with this Ancestor overseeing."
"This matter will succeed."
As these words fell.
"Boom!"
Beneath Falling Eagle Gorge, a torrent crashed against the cliff, splashing seven to eight feet high.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 79: Ancestor Hua Ye! I Lied to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 79: Ancestor Hua Ye! I Lied to You
...
Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu were shaken to the core, and immediately clasped their fists in salute to accept the order.
"Yes, Ancestor."
With those words, the two leapt past Ancestor Hua Ye and directly jumped down from Falling Eagle Gorge.
The cliff was steep enough to make any ordinary person shudder with fear, yet the two paid no heed. As soon as they descended less than ten feet, an invisible Qi force held them aloft, slowing their fall abruptly.
This was the power of a Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm Cultivator.
Having been immersed in the Black Tortoise path for over 170 years, their control over Profound Qi had reached a refined state, as if it were an extension of their limbs. Although they couldn’t fly like Celestial Human Realm Cultivators, gliding a short distance with Qi manipulation was effortless.
Looking down in the dark, the two seemed like feathers, fluttering and drifting down, landing silently in the hidden base.
As soon as they landed.
Huangfu Jinning took out a Jade Colour Bone Whistle and blew it gently a few times.
The Bone Whistle vibrated but emitted no sound.
This Bone Whistle produced a high-frequency sound inaudible to human ears; only those wearing the same type of bone fragment could feel the frequency’s vibration.
This was a specially made Bone Whistle for contacting hidden sentries; small in size but of considerable value.
Not long after.
Someone emerged stealthily from the darkness.
This person was dressed in gorgeous clothing, seemingly of some status, but his demeanor was somewhat cringing and sly. He bowed towards Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu, saying, "Subordinate Hidden Fish, greets the two Elders."
As he spoke, he retrieved a fish-shaped ancient jade artifact from his bosom for the two to inspect.
"At ease." After inspecting it, Huangfu Jinning waved his hand, his voice aged and deep, "Do you know the task this time?"
"Subordinate knows." The middle-aged man replied respectfully, "I’ve already received the secret orders to assist the two Elders to the target’s residence. Rest assured, I have arranged the route."
"Lead the way."
A trace of joy flickered in the eyes of Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu.
Under the lead of the middle-aged man, the three advanced secretly without alerting anyone. Soon, they reached a courtyard in the middle of the gorge.
"Two Elders, the target is inside."
The middle-aged man stopped and bowed to the two behind him.
This courtyard had been built several years ago, specifically as a small villa for Wang Shouzhe to have a place to stay while overseeing the secret base.
Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu exchanged a glance, emboldened by their skills, and flew directly into the courtyard.
Under the dim moonlight, the courtyard was lush with greenery, resembling a verdant forest, even making the air feel fresher.
"Humph! Wang Shouzhe sure knows how to enjoy himself, even a temporary villa is so exquisite." The two Elders of the Huangfu family exchanged a glance and nodded in agreement, "Let’s do it."
The layout of the villa was simple, the main and secondary buildings clearly distinguished. The two were clear about their target, grabbed their weapons, and moved through the courtyard straight towards the main house.
However, just as they were about to charge into Wang Shouzhe’s room like wolves and tigers.
Suddenly.
Thick vines spiraled out, lightning-fast, entangling their legs.
In an instant, numerous shadows writhed in the darkness.
The vines hidden in the courtyard writhed like giant pythons, each thick and seemingly alive, crazily entangling around Elders Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu.
"Not good!"
The faces of the two Elders changed dramatically, a surge of Profound Qi erupted from within, rolling outwards like a blast wave, aiming to break the vines.
However, the vines were incredibly tough, with only slight cracks appearing under the explosion of Profound Qi.
This action instead triggered more vines to surge up from all directions, entangling them like countless tentacles of giant pythons.
In no time, even the space above the small courtyard was laced and entangled with vines. There was no escape route in any direction.
"What kind of vines are these, so sturdy?" The two Elders’ faces were extremely grim, and they immediately raised their Spirit Swords.
"Swish, swish, swish~"
Thick Profound Qi turned into sharp Sword Aura.
Yet the expected sight of flying vine shards did not occur as the Sword Aura passed through. Instead, each Sword Aura could only cut through two or three vines.
But just as those two or three vines were severed, more vines swarmed over, increasing in number.
Though they continuously slashed at the invasive vines with sword light, they still couldn’t break free for the moment.
As time went on, the faces of the two Elders grew increasingly grim, and a hint of unease seeped into their eyes.
Under the night sky, every vine was as thick as an arm, with a metallic sheen on the surface, almost like metal chains.
This was the Iron Python Vine meticulously cultivated by Wang Shouzhe.
During their growth, they needed to absorb a large quantity of iron ore slag.
Their root systems were so extensive that they could penetrate dozens of feet underground, and the vines themselves were thick and hard. The outer skin especially resembled a coat of iron fibres, making them hard to cut with ordinary blades.
Even Spirit Platform Realm Cultivators couldn’t treat them like mere weeds.
Their biggest drawback currently was that, unlike the Witch Series vines, they couldn’t be used as portable battle plants; they must be planted on site and once planted, cannot be moved.
Moreover, their growth cycle spanned several years, growing extremely slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - 79: Ancestor Hua Ye! I Lied to You_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 79: Ancestor Hua Ye! I Lied to You_2
Correspondingly, once they mature and form a vine battleground, they are also much stronger than the Witch Series. Even a cultivator at the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, once entangled by the Vine Array, would find it difficult to escape for a while.
Of course.
It’s only difficult to escape for a while; it’s almost impossible to trap and kill them directly. Given some time, cultivators at the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm can eventually break free and escape.
This Iron Python Vine battleground, Wang Shouzhe has been cultivating for many years, waiting for this day.
"The two of you are quite skilled; if the intelligence I’ve gathered is not mistaken, you should be the elders Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu of the Changning Huangfu Family, correct?"
Amidst the chaotic dance of vines, Wang Shouzhe walked out slowly.
His expression was calm, and though he was in the midst of the frenzied forest of pythons, his demeanor was as leisurely as if he were strolling in a garden, relaxed and free.
Where he stepped, the surrounding vines retreated automatically, with many vines even prostrating themselves on the ground, as if in submission.
This scene further highlighted his formidable aura.
"Wang Shouzhe!!"
Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu, the two elders of the Huangfu Family, were shocked, and their faces changed color simultaneously.
At this point, how could they not understand?
They’ve been tricked!
They’ve clearly fallen into a pre-arranged trap!
Immediately, while fending off the vines, they both fixed their gazes on the middle-aged man in gorgeous clothing — Hidden Fish!
"Traitor!"
"How dare you betray the Huangfu Family?!"
Their anger was overflowing, and they both cursed vehemently.
However, the middle-aged man seemed oblivious and instead took a few steps back, leisurely cupping his hands to Wang Shouzhe and saying, "Reporting to Patriarch Shouzhe, I have brought the two big fish according to your instructions."
"Not bad." Wang Shouzhe nodded slightly, "In that case, let us proceed according to our previous agreement. I will give you a generous reward and send someone to relocate you and your family to another county for a new life. You should have heard, I am a man of my word, always keeping my promises."
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man was greatly moved and made a deep bow to Wang Shouzhe: "Thank you, Patriarch Shouzhe."
Having said that, he also bowed to the two Huangfu Family elders, saying, "My apologies to the two elders. Since my identity was inadvertently exposed, my family came under control. For the survival of my family, I had no choice but to betray the Huangfu Family."
"Good, good, good!"
The two Huangfu Family elders, furious to the extreme, laughed: "Wang Shouzhe, you truly have a talent! But if you think you can capture us with just some vines, you severely underestimate us!"
With that said, they both burst into action, madly cutting down the vines in an attempt to escape.
"Truly worthy of elders at the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, the Celestial Human Family indeed has a deep heritage, with masters gathered within the clan." Wang Shouzhe was still unhurried, speaking in a calm and composed manner, "To show my respect to the two of you, I’ve prepared a special gift for each of you."
After speaking, he called towards a side room, "Ancestor, these two enemies are yours to deal with personally."
As soon as he finished speaking,
a woman flew out from the side room.
She was clad in white Black Tortoise Martial Attire, her long hair like frost and snow, icy white, and her face veiled. She was the Ping’an Wang Family’s foremost ancestor, Wang Longyan, Ancestor Longyan.
As soon as she appeared, the surrounding air instantly turned much colder.
"Wang Longyan!"
The faces of the two Huangfu Family elders involuntarily changed.
Back in the day, she was renowned in the Changning Guard. If not for that incident more than sixty years ago, she might have already been a peak figure of the Spirit Platform Realm.
Even so, in recent years, she has risen to fame again, having personally slain Mr. Yin of the Yin Sha Sect not long ago, and is now at the height of her fame.
In normal times, even in a one-on-one scenario against Wang Longyan, they wouldn’t dare claim victory, let alone now when they’re entangled by vines and their combat power greatly diminished; how could they not change color?
Wang Longyan’s cold gaze swept over their faces, and then she snorted coldly, shaking her hand to throw something out.
"Swoosh!"
A flag, filled with a sinister aura, floated in the air, swelling in the wind, billowing with the night breeze.
Wave after wave of evil qi emanated from the flag, swirling like a sinister wind, quickly filling the surrounding space.
"Yin Sha Shura Banner!"
The eyes of the two Huangfu Family elders were filled with horror.
Being seasoned and experienced, having seen and known much, and having complex ties with the Yin Sha Sect, they naturally recognized this item at a glance.
Although it’s just a replica of that famous Divine Power Spirit Treasure, it is a very rare middle-grade spiritual artifact with extremely powerful features.
Even in the Celestial Human Family Huangfu, there are only about three middle-grade spiritual artifacts. At least, elders like them, who have retired and whose lifespans are nearing their end, have no qualifications to wield such artifacts.
What makes the Yin Sha Shura Banner most terrifying is its ability to whip up waves of Yin Sha’s evil qi, enveloping a range of several tens of meters, creating an environment perfect for disciples of the Yin Sha Sect to display their strengths, while unsuitable for ordinary Black Tortoise Cultivators to battle in.
This makes it even more troublesome than ordinary middle-grade spiritual artifacts.
"I’ll let you experience the viciousness of Yin Sha’s malevolent poison."
Wang Longyan’s eyes were filled with intense hatred as she pinched a finger technique to activate the Yin Sha Shura Banner.
If it weren’t for the Celestial Person Huangfu Family secretly scheming back then, which led to the deaths of her grandfather Ancestor Zhou Xuan and other clan members like nephew Qiong Yuan, the Ping’an Wang Family would not have fallen to its earlier condition.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 79: Ancestor Hua Ye! I Lied to You_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 79: Ancestor Hua Ye! I Lied to You_3
If not for the Celestial Person Huangfu Family, she wouldn’t have been tormented by the Yin Sha Evil Qi for fifty full years.
Now, it’s finally time for her revenge.
"Swish~"
The Yin Sha Shura Banner surged with momentum, ascending higher under Ancestor Longyan’s command, even the patterns on the flag seemed to come alive.
The Yin Sha Evil Qi pervading the air suddenly became denser, like Yin Blades moving through the air, enveloping the two Elders of the Huangfu Family and starting to erode them.
Terror struck their hearts; they hurriedly circulated their Profound Qi, forming a thin Profound Qi Shield on their bodies to resist the erosion of the Yin Sha Evil Qi.
At the same time, they had to continuously cut through the relentless Iron Python Vines.
If they only faced either threat alone, they might have a chance to escape, but at this moment, they could only barely maintain their defense.
Human strength is ultimately limited.
Even though their Profound Qi is exceptionally thick, continuous consumption would eventually deplete it, making them unable to escape the entanglement of vines and the infiltration of Yin Sha Evil Qi, culminating in erosion, decay, and torment to death.
Although their lifespan is running short, it doesn’t mean they can face death calmly, especially when dying like this.
Panic painted their faces; they exchanged a glance and seemed to make a resolute decision, simultaneously letting out a piercing howl.
At this moment, when all is silent, their cries shattered the tranquility, echoing through the skies.
Before the howl ceased, a streak of fire had already roared from the horizon, turning into a figure in the sky in the blink of an eye.
This figure exuded an astonishing aura, fiery red hair flying, surrounded by swirling flames—who else could it be but Ancestor Hua Ye?
"Jinning, Jinyu!"
Seeing the scene in the courtyard, Ancestor Hua Ye was filled with shock and anger.
He anticipated there might be arrangements within the base, that the two might not have smooth operations, but didn’t expect them to be driven to such dire straits with their strength!
Without delay, he raised his hand and unleashed a palm strike.
Instantly.
The red Profound Qi transformed into a giant Heaven Covering palm, roaring downwards.
Midway, the giant palm erupted into blazing flames, its intense light nearly illuminating the entire courtyard. The towering force pressed down from the sky, causing hearts to tremble before it even touched the vines.
Seeing this, Ancestor Longyan intensified the Yin Sha Shura Banner’s energy, with dense Yin Sha Evil Qi pouring forth to obstruct the fiery giant palm.
However, the flames seemed to have a suppressive effect on the Yin Sha Evil Qi.
As the rich Yin Sha Evil Qi touched the flames of the giant palm, it burned up in hissing sounds, turning into black smoke.
Where the fiery giant palm passed, the surrounding Yin Sha Evil Qi emptied in an instant.
Even the Iron Python Vines under Wang Shouzhe’s command were scorched away in large quantities.
In a blink of an eye, a gap opened in the sky over the courtyard, alleviating the pressure on Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu.
Witnessing this, the two Elders’ spirits immediately lifted.
"Hahaha~ Wang Shouzhe, Wang Longyan, with Ancestor Hua Ye present, let’s see how arrogant you can be!"
The two’s confidence soared, as they summoned all their remaining strength to break through.
Unexpectedly.
At this crucial moment.
A low, elder voice suddenly emerged from within the courtyard: "Ancestor Hua Ye, since you’re here, stay."
As the words fell.
A fierce and unparalleled aura soared from the courtyard.
Ancestor Hua Ye’s eyes narrowed, seeing a figure stepping out from the main house.
Tonight, the night was as dark as ink, with no light from stars or moon.
Yet, this figure emitted a sharp golden radiance, enhancing his already mountain-like presence to be even more majestic, reminiscent of a bronze statue of a deity, invoking reverence.
This is a manifestation of a strong person’s power being externalized.
Only those who have reached the Celestial Human Realm and specifically trained in the War Body among Black Tortoise Cultivators would exhibit such phenomena. Due to the rich Geng Metal Qi contained in the Body Tempering’s Profound Qi, the light appeared sharp and metallic.
This elder turned out to be Ancestor Zhubo of the Longzuo Wang Family, who had been lurking within this base for a long time.
Upon his appearance, Ancestor Zhubo casually struck a palm toward Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu.
Just when they were struggling to break free, they were slapped back.
The rescue attempt was foiled, leaving Ancestor Hua Ye staring at Ancestor Zhubo in disbelief: "You, you, you, are you Wang Zhoubo from the Longzuo Wang Family? How is this possible?! For nearly half a year, our spies in Longzuo County have been shadowing your Longzuo Wang Family. Weren’t you constantly active in Longzuo?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - 80 Evolution! Bloodthirsty Vine
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 80 Evolution! Bloodthirsty Vine
...
How could the Huangfu Family not pay attention to the intelligence about the Longzuo Wang Family while dealing with the Ping’an Wang Family?
If it weren’t for the definite news that Wang Zhoubo has been active in Longzuo County, they would have considered him in their plans.
But unexpectedly, Wang Zhoubo, who has been active in Longzuo County City, abruptly appeared here!
Had it not been for the undeniable strength of the Celestial Human Realm, Ancestor Hua Ye would have almost believed he was seeing things.
"Sorry, the Ancestor Zhoubo in Longzuo County City was impersonated by someone I arranged. For the past half year, Ancestor Zhoubo has been my guest here." Patriarch Shouzhe said with a loud laugh in the courtyard, "I might have disappointed Ancestor Hua Ye, my apologies, my aim was to lure you into the trap."
"You!!"
Ancestor Hua Ye was so furious that a surge of blood rushed to his head, almost causing him to vomit blood.
Before Ancestor Hua Ye could speak.
Patriarch Shouzhe looked at the two elders of the Huangfu Family, his smile fading, and his voice suddenly became cold: "Jinning and Jinyu, two elders, since you have lured Ancestor Hua Ye here, your usefulness ends here."
Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu, the two elders, were immediately overwhelmed with a chilling sensation.
They understood instantly.
It turned out that Patriarch Shouzhe had only trapped them without immediately taking action, not merely targeting the two of them, but to draw out Ancestor Hua Ye.
Ridiculous that they sought help from Ancestor Hua Ye when facing a hopeless situation, thinking they had summoned a savior, only to find out everything was within the opponent’s calculation.
Such a grand scheme, such a vicious thought!
However, now that they understood, it’s too late.
With Patriarch Shouzhe’s words.
An elderly man suddenly flew out of the small courtyard.
He was slender, and though his appearance showed signs of aging, his complexion remained ruddy, and his gaze sharp, entirely different from the two elderly Huangfu Family elders shrouded in twilight aura.
Obviously, his blood and Qi remained abundant, his life force vibrant, radiating a powerful vitality.
This elder was indeed the leading ancestor of the Changning Xu Family—Ancestor Beichen.
"Xu Beichen." The two elders of the Huangfu Family showed despair in their eyes, exclaiming, "Weren’t you in seclusion, trying to break into the Celestial Human Realm?"
Ancestor Beichen chuckled and said, "Breaking into the Celestial Human Realm is certainly important, but resolving future troubles is equally crucial. For this, what’s the matter of delaying my advancement?"
Then, his smile disappeared, and his eyes quickly flashed with a resolute killing intent.
Meanwhile, he raised his hand, revealing a treasure-glowing Dragon Suppression Stele in his palm.
"Wang Shouzhe, Xu Beichen, do you dare!" Seeing this, Ancestor Hua Ye roared in anger, his voice booming and causing the valley to tremble slightly.
Jinning and Jinyu are his bloodline descendants, especially Huangfu Jinning, who is his direct line great-grandson, once held the position of patriarch for decades.
Even a tiger wouldn’t eat its cubs; how could he watch them face death with open eyes?
Immediately, Ancestor Hua Ye flew down, trying to stop all of this.
But how could Ancestor Zhoubo let him succeed?
Even before Ancestor Hua Ye could strike, he flew over to block him, saying in a subdued voice, "Huangfu Huaye, don’t forget, I’m your opponent."
"Wang Zhoubo, get out of my way!!"
Ancestor Hua Ye struck in anger, one punch engulfed in flames heading forcefully toward Ancestor Zhoubo.
The surrounding air couldn’t bear the blow, producing bursts of explosions. This punch’s power was unexpectedly several magnitudes stronger than before.
"Good punch!"
Ancestor Zhoubo, with furrowed brows, wasn’t scared but rather delighted.
Immediately, he circulated his vast profound qi, his body emanating a golden light, akin to a Vajra Arhat, meeting Ancestor Hua Ye’s punch directly.
His task today was exceptionally clear—to hold back Ancestor Hua Ye.
"Boom boom boom~~!"
Immense energy clashed continuously, with the two Celestial Human Ancestors fiercely battling in the air.
Bitter winds howled, flames mingled with Geng Metal Qi, resonating with rumbling thunder within the canyon.
Although in terms of cultivation, Ancestor Zhoubo was only at the second layer of the Celestial Human Realm, a notch weaker than Ancestor Hua Ye. However, if it was merely holding Ancestor Hua Ye off, he felt he could manage it for at least two quarters of an hour.
While Ancestor Hua Ye was forcibly held back by Ancestor Zhoubo.
Inside Patriarch Shouzhe’s small courtyard.
Ancestor Beichen cast a glance at Wang Longyan, saying relaxedly, "Ancestor Longyan, let’s each pick one. Do you want Huangfu Jinning or Huangfu Jinyu?"
His manner was as if picking out merchandise.
Wang Longyan raised her delicate eyebrows slightly from behind her veil, her beautiful eyes fixed on Huangfu Jinning: "This is the direct line of the Huangfu Family, I’ll choose him."
As soon as the words fell.
Wang Longyan wielded the Longyan Sword, unleashing a frozen storm towards Huangfu Jinning.
Since she chose Huangfu Jinning, Ancestor Beichen naturally could only choose Huangfu Jinyu.
"Although they are of the Jin generation. Compared with Huangfu Jinyuan, they’re far inferior." He glanced at Huangfu Jinyu, a bit disdainfully.
Although Huangfu Jinyuan carried an infamous reputation to his death, Ancestor Beichen still respected him somewhat.
As for the other Jin generation members, he simply didn’t regard them at all.
With the last word "far" spoken.
The Dragon Suppression Stele in Ancestor Beichen’s hand let out a "hum", sounding deep like a bell at dawn and dusk.
The Dragon Suppression Stele continued to grow larger, in the blink of an eye, forming a solid-looking stele-shaped shadow like a small mountain, attacking Huangfu Jinyu.
Huangfu Jinyu gritted his teeth, swinging his spirit sword desperately to defend.
Though they had been drained once, Huangfu Jinning and Huangfu Jinyu still retained their combat capabilities. For the time being, Ancestor Longyan and Ancestor Beichen suppressed their opponents, but no victor emerged yet.
The battlefield was immediately divided into three parts as each side ferociously engaged.
Meanwhile.
The rotating stationed Ancestor Junyao Chen Junyao hurriedly arrived, gracefully landing beside Patriarch Shouzhe, reporting with a bow: "Patriarch Shouzhe, I followed your previous instruction. At the start of the battle, all relevant personnel were evacuated and arranged inside the mountain’s secret chamber."
His eyes glanced over the various battlefields, hesitating slightly, he said, "Should I step forward to assist in the battle?"
"Ancestor Junyao is thoughtful." Wang Shouzhe politely cupped his hands in return, "The situation is now well under control. Ancestor Junyao only needs to stay alongside and observe the battle."
Chen Junyao’s expression slightly froze, feeling somewhat helpless.
The two elders from the Huangfu Family were both cultivators at the late stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, while Chen Junyao himself had not yet reached the mid-stage of the Spirit Platform Realm. It’s likely that Patriarch Shouzhe felt his strength was lacking and feared he would be in danger.
This made Chen Junyao feel a bit introspective.
Truly, times have changed too fast; he, as a common Ancestor Spirit Platform, is almost unable to involve himself in the battles. Fortunately, he is only eighty or ninety years old, very young, and still has the opportunity to strive forward.
In fact, Wang Shouzhe also had some reflections.
He recalled more than ten years ago, when he and Ancestor Longyan went to handle matters at the Hundred Islands Guard, they traveled on the "Junyao" merchant ship.
The Junyao merchant ship was named after Ancestor Junyao, to intimidate villains.
Yet now.
The Ping’an Wang Family had grown to such a stage that even a Spirit Platform Realm ancestor like Ancestor Junyao was no longer needed in battle.
After feeling emotional, Wang Shouzhe quickly set aside his distracting thoughts and focused his attention on the Spirit Platform Realm battlefield.
He didn’t let Ancestor Junyao take action because he had long planned to intervene personally.
The Huangfu Family once harmed the Ping’an Wang Family, thinking of it as nothing more than a casual move, much like casually crushing an ant that might potentially threaten them in the future.
However, the idle move they set up inadvertently brought about a nearly annihilating disaster to the Ping’an Wang Family, causing many clan members to lose their lives.
When the opportunity for revenge arises, he certainly wants to take action himself.
Immediately, he seized the opportunity.
A solid and dense cyan profound qi spread outward from his feet, as if it were a swimming dragon, continuously extending forward.
This profound qi was full of vigorous life and was exceptionally lively, as if it had eyes of its own, automatically and instinctively falling onto those charred and broken Iron Python Vines.
Energy infiltrated into the roots.
In an instant, something miraculous happened.
Those charred, broken Iron Python Vines that had lost their vitality suddenly reawakened!
The charred skin cracked and peeled away, revealing fresh new vine skin beneath, and the broken tendrils began to sprout new buds. In a mere moment, they reared their heads again, like living creatures, surging wildly toward the two Huangfu Family elders.
"How is this possible!"
The two Huangfu Family elders, Huangfu Jinning and Jinyu, were immensely shocked.
They were barely managing to cope with their respective opponents, and now with the Iron Python Vines aiding in battle, how could there be any chance of victory?
Since the moment Wang Shouzhe casually intervened, the two Huangfu Family elders were ensnared in a bitter struggle, barely managing to fend off attacks, and defeat was already imminent.
On the side, Chen Junyao watched with a silent sigh in his heart.
No wonder Patriarch Shouzhe did not need his assistance. It turns out he could effortlessly support two of his own men on his own.
Despite being at the early stage of the Spirit Platform Realm, why is there such a big difference?
In the midst of his sigh.
Suddenly.
Huangfu Jinyu, unable to evade, was entangled by an Iron Python Vine.
In a panic, he severed the vine with a sword, but his actions were still a beat slow, allowing the virtual shadow of the Dragon Suppression Stele to collide with him head-on.
"Bang!"
His body trembled violently, spewing blood as he flew backward several zhangs, eventually falling heavily to the ground.
"Cough cough~ cough cough cough~"
As he struggled to get up, he didn’t notice a vine in the surrounding thickets, colored completely differently from the Iron Python Vines, silently approaching.
It emitted a crimson blood aura, looking sinister and bloodthirsty.
Silently, it wrapped around Huangfu Jinyu’s calf.
The leech-like sharp spike stealthily pierced his blood vessels, with a cool sensation numbing his senses so much that he didn’t feel any pain.
When his blood was being continuously drawn through the hollow spike, Huangfu Jinyu finally sensed something unusual.
Seeing that scene on his calf, his eyes were filled with horror and terror, "What kind of monster is this?!"
Instinctively, he swung his sword and severed the spike with a "swish".
Blood immediately sprayed out.
This action, however, seemed to enrage the "monster."
It instantly surged fiercely, revealing its terrifying true form.
It was a thick vine resembling a scarlet python, covered in needle-like barbed mouthparts, evil and cold, exuding an unsettling aura.
In the blink of an eye, it wrapped itself around Huangfu Jinyu’s body like a frenzied python.
Simultaneously, dozens of blood-sucking spikes pierced into him. In a breath of time, the once fairly desiccated vine stem began to swell with blood, bulging visibly.
"Ah!"
Huangfu Jinyu screamed in terror.
However, at this moment, his whole body was numb, as if under a huge dose of anesthesia, completely powerless. Even if he wanted to struggle, he had no way to do so.
Within a few breaths, his entire body turned emaciated and skeletal, eyes bulging, looking horrifyingly as if he had been drained of blood.
"This..."
Even Beichen Ancestor, witnessing this scene, couldn’t help but feel a chill all over, filled with dread, and quietly took a step back.
Indeed, this monstrous creature-like a scarlet python was Wang Shouzhe’s "Bloodthirsty Vine."
After draining all of Huangfu Jinyu’s blood, it swelled, its vine visibly filled with blood, appearing plump and full, staggering drunkenly back to Wang Shouzhe’s side and lazily lying down.
However, at the same moment, an intimidating and powerful aura began to emanate from it.
It was actually entering an evolutionary state at this moment!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - 81: Battle of the Celestial Human! The Rise of the Wang Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 81: Battle of the Celestial Human! The Rise of the Wang Family
...
"You insolent brat! How dare you!"
In the sky, Ancestor Hua Ye was both shocked and enraged upon witnessing this scene.
He was entangled with Wang Zhoubo, thinking that even though Jinning and Jinyuu were in the late Spirit Platform Realm, they wouldn’t be easily slain by the Ping’an Wang Family, so he wasn’t too anxious.
Little did he expect, in just the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, one of them would already fall!
"Why shouldn’t I dare?" Wang Shouzhe looked up at him, a cold smile on his calm face, "Huangfu Huaye, you once plotted against my Wang Family, and now you come to seize our assets. Do you think we should just prepare our necks for you to slaughter us?"
"You’re courting death!"
Ancestor Hua Ye couldn’t remember the last time a junior dared to be so insolent in front of him, and his anger flared, filled with hatred.
With a swipe of his finger over the storage ring, a long halberd appeared in his hand.
The entire halberd was forged from precious red refined iron and, upon its appearance, blazed with intense flames.
"Li Fire Battle Halberd!"
This was the fire element magical treasure passed down by the Changning Huangfu Family, possessing extraordinary power.
The only small issue was its extremely demanding usage conditions, requiring a Celestial Human Realm and above Black Tortoise Cultivator who practiced fire element techniques to wield it.
The founding ancestor of the Huangfu Family, Huangfu Hongyu, once relied on the "Red Dragon True Technique" and the Li Fire Battle Halberd to open territories, and slew the Tier Five Ferocious Beast that claimed the Changning area, then a Barbaric Wilderness, establishing a great name and achieving unparalleled feats.
This laid the foundation for the Huangfu Family to dominate the Changning Guard for five hundred years.
It must be admitted, the original Huangfu Hongyu was indeed a great hero of his time, his achievements and reputation surpassed Ancestor Zhou Xuan by several measures.
In the record of achievements by ancestors in the Celestial Human Realm in Changning Guard, he was virtually the top.
When recalling Huangfu Hongyu’s battle records and boldness, even Wang Shouzhe had some admiration.
Unfortunately, by the time it reached Huangfu Huaye, the third-generation Celestial Human Ancestor, everything had changed.
The Huangfu family no longer expanded outwards, shifting their strategic thinking from the family’s development to suppressing other noble families to ensure their leading position.
Throughout history, Wang Shouzhe understood this clearly.
Once a family adopts such an inwardly competitive mindset, it’s hard to find the motivation and courage for progress.
Perhaps, it was at that moment of mindset shift that they sowed the seeds of disaster. Even without Wang Shouzhe and the Ping’an Wang Family, another noble family would eventually replace them.
However, no matter how many seeds of disaster the Changning Huangfu Family sowed, a dying camel is still larger than a horse. To topple a gargantuan like a Celestial Human Family, they’re bound to face a desperate counterattack!
With the Li Fire Battle Halberd in hand, Ancestor Hua Ye’s aura immediately surged!
Under the night sky, his fiery red hair flew wildly, and blazing flames enveloped his body, making him appear like a War God emerging from fire, exuding a terrifying aura.
Behind him, a faint Dharma Illusion of a red fire jiaolong emerged.
The jiaolong coiled, red flames surging to the heavens.
"Moooo~~~"
A dragon roar, deep and resonant like an ox’s moo, suddenly echoed, shaking the spirit.
Standing beside Wang Shouzhe, Junyao was caught off guard, his spirit startled and his face turning pale, as if encountering a natural enemy; even Ancestor Longyan from the late Spirit Platform Realm and Beichen Ancestor didn’t fare well.
Though Wang Shouzhe had some prevention, his expression wasn’t very pleasant.
This was the terror of a Celestial Human Realm cultivator.
Every Celestial Human Realm cultivator was a true powerhouse capable of reigning over an area, and their full battle power was extremely fearsome.
This was the very reason he set up this trap here.
In the series of actions against the Huangfu family, he needed to squeeze the Huangfu Family’s living space through commercial means and sever their economic lifeline. By then, they would certainly face a desperate counterattack from Ancestor Hua Ye.
A Celestial Human Realm cultivator is most terrifying not when they rule a domain, but when they lose all scruple and reason.
To the Wang Family, this was like the Sword of Damocles hanging overhead. Without severely wounding or even exterminating it, the Wang Family’s development would be perpetually constrained.
"Brat, give me your life!"
Ancestor Hua Ye swung the battle halberd, and overwhelming flames accompanied by domineering pressure descended.
Amidst the flames, he charged straight at Wang Shouzhe with the battle halberd, hair and beard puffed out, resembling a jiaolong possessing unstoppable momentum.
Wang Shouzhe sneered, stepped lightly like a willow catkin, and lightly retreated.
Seemingly slow, but actually fast.
Simultaneously, countless Iron Python Vines coiled together, weaving a thick vine wall in front of him. The Iron Python Vine’s skin was like iron; though it surely couldn’t withstand a strike from a Celestial Human ancestor, it was enough to stall.
The Li Fire Battle Halberd reached immediately, yet the vine wall hindered its speed momentarily.
Though in just the next instant, the vine wall was mostly destroyed in the blazing flames, Ancestor Hua Ye’s movement was still slowed by a beat.
At that moment, a powerful shout resounded from the sky.
"Hua Ye, your opponent is me!"
With these words, a domineering golden sword light cleaved downwards, its sword intent tumultuous, with the power to split mountains and shatter the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 81: Battling the Celestial Human! The Rise of the Wang Family_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 81: Battling the Celestial Human! The Rise of the Wang Family_2
Amidst the blade light, a golden battle saber was distinctly visible.
The battle saber had a primitive appearance, made entirely of the extremely expensive Secret Copper, and blended with about one-tenth of Geng Metal. Its blade was engraved with dense, mysterious runes, currently emitting a dazzling golden light.
"Geng Metal Battle Saber!"
Ancestor Hua Ye’s expression changed.
It turned out that Ancestor Zhubo, seeing Wang Shouzhe in danger, also took out a Magical Treasure Battle Saber.
This saber was a replica magical treasure of the famous Divine Power Spirit Treasure "Geng Metal Battle Saber," just like his Li Fire Battle Halberd, it was a magical treasure passed down through generations of the Longzuo Wang Family.
Though a replica, its power was absolutely not weak.
The Longzuo Wang Family was once a Purple Mansion Family, even though now it barely maintains the alternation of Celestial Human, its foundation was still not to be underestimated, far superior to those newly risen Celestial Human Families struggling to compete.
As the blade light appeared, Ancestor Zhubo also arrived.
He had pushed his Profound Skill to its limits, with dazzling golden light all around, even faint golden hues appeared on his exposed skin.
Behind him, there loomed a faint Dharma illusion.
It was the illusion of a Four-armed Vajra, eyes glaring in anger, imposing and majestic, seemingly able to smash all demons.
Most cultivators who reached the Celestial Human Realm had decent bloodline talents. For example, Ancestor Hua Ye, who had a Middle Grade B Li Fire Bloodline during the Qi Refining Realm, later ascended to the Spirit Platform Realm, where his bloodline transformed once, and upon reaching the Celestial Human Realm, his bloodline evolved once again.
Currently, it seemed like he had awakened a triple bloodline, although there was still a significant gap to the legendary "Li Fire Separation Body," the appearance of a Dharma Illusion during the triple bloodline surge was normal.
Ancestor Zhubo, who had cultivated to the Celestial Human Realm, naturally could not be underestimated either.
Now, while he was still far from a true "Geng Metal Body," he had, after all, awakened a triple bloodline at the Celestial Human Realm, only one cultivation level short compared to Ancestor Hua Ye, without any substantial difference.
If Ancestor Hua Ye ignored Ancestor Zhubo and continued to chase Wang Shouzhe, he would inevitably suffer severe injuries.
Having no choice, Ancestor Hua Ye had to abandon the pursuit of Wang Shouzhe, engaging in a battle with Ancestor Zhubo.
For Ancestor Zhubo, defeating Ancestor Hua Ye was extremely difficult, but if the intention was merely to hold him off, it was much simpler.
All at once.
The sky resounded with the drum sounds of thunder, reverberating endlessly.
Tremendous energy waves swept repeatedly from the sky, dispersing the surrounding clouds entirely. The foreign cement structures within the canyon occasionally suffered misfortune, even the surface of Anjiang River on the other side began to churn, raising wave after wave.
At the same time.
Having escaped danger, Wang Shouzhe also dropped the Bloodthirsty Vine in his hand.
In this short moment, the Bloodthirsty Vine had rapidly absorbed the spoils of battle, as its old skin cracked and peeled away, the new skin was deep red and more intense, exuding a chilling bloody scent.
Even outsiders unfamiliar with the Bloodthirsty Vine could instantly tell that it had grown stronger.
"Go!"
Wang Shouzhe flicked his finger, and a stream of Eternal Spring True Qi landed on the Bloodthirsty Vine.
The Bloodthirsty Vine erected its body, greedily casting a glance at Huangfu Jinning, who was still lively and jumping about, then bounced and shot towards him.
Its speed was so fast that it left streaks of afterimages in the air.
Its hunting desire was exceedingly strong, its nature so ferocious, exceeding the common understanding of vines.
Initially, when Liua Ruolan helped Wang Shouzhe choose the Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species, she merely thought it should be suitable for a cultivator like Wang Shouzhe, who had a Wood Element Bloodline.
But no one expected the Bloodthirsty Vine to be so terrifying.
In fact, even when Wang Shouzhe first acquired it and nurtured the Bloodthirsty Vine Spirit Species with his blood as per instructions, he was also startled by it.
Its thirst for blood and aggressiveness, and its later displayed hunting nature towards fierce beasts sometimes truly gave Wang Shouzhe goosebumps, feeling like he had unleashed a demon.
The only consolation for Wang Shouzhe was its deep attachment to and trust in its "master," feeling somewhat "in sync" with him, obedient to his commands.
It could only be said that being one of the highest rewards in the Divine Martial Dynasty’s Trial Ruins, its value exceeded a precious Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact by far.
From this perspective, Liua Ruolan’s Primordial Water Spirit Pearl was certainly no ordinary item. Or perhaps the remaining few treasures were all rare and formidable things.
Meanwhile.
On the other side, seeing the Bloodthirsty Vine lunging at him, Huangfu Jinning’s expression changed drastically, engulfed in extreme fear.
If it were to let him face the bloodthirsty creature one on one, he would certainly triumph. But now, where was the opportunity for a one-on-one battle?
Attempting to flee, he was tightly entangled by Ancestor Longyan and the Iron Python Vine, unable to escape.
The outcome was already sealed.
Soon, he was ensnared by the Bloodthirsty Vine, meeting the same fate as Huangfu Jinyu.
Drained of blood, turned into a desiccated corpse.
And, having absorbed the blood, the Bloodthirsty Vine entered a lazy digestion phase. However, this time it was unlikely to advance further.
The two Spirit Platform Realm late-stage elders of the Huangfu Family, figures that once dominated the entire Changning throughout their lives, now became nourishment for the growth of the Bloodthirsty Vine, without even a peaceful end.
If this were to spread now, it would undoubtedly shock the entire Changning Guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 81: Battle of the Celestial Human! The Rise of the Wang Family_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 81: Battle of the Celestial Human! The Rise of the Wang Family_3
"Jinning!"
Ancestor Hua Ye roared in immense grief.
He was desperately trying to rescue Huangfu Jinning, but was blocked by the damned Wang Zhoubo. The hatred and anger in his heart surged to the extreme at this moment.
"Wang Zhoubo! Wang Shouzhe! Fine, fine, fine, I’ll swear to repay today’s issues tenfold!"
After speaking, he frantically urged his magical treasure, the "Li Fire Battle Halberd," to push Ancestor Zhoubo back and transformed his body into a fiery meteor, fleeing towards Anjiang.
It was clear that he had no intention to continue fighting. He intended to temporarily withdraw, regroup, and then fight the Wang Family to the death.
However, he had only flown a short distance before he suddenly saw a white line of water roaring from afar on the once turbulent Anjiang.
The next moment.
A massive wave surged to the sky, layer upon layer, towering high into the sky before crashing down on him.
The waves reached the sky, terrifying in momentum, as if the heavens were falling!
"How could there be such a large wave on Anjiang?!"
Ancestor Hua Ye looked up in disbelief, only to see a giant Primordial Water Spirit Turtle leisurely swimming atop the monstrous wave.
Mere winds and waves felt as gentle as spring breezes to turtles, a species with innate affinity for Primordial Water.
And on its back stood a remarkable woman.
She stood with a sword, her delicate and elegant face stern, clothed in a water-blue dress fluttering in the wind, resembling the legendary Goddess Xiangjun, akin to a celestial being.
Needless to say, the woman was none other than the esteemed Madam Wang of Ping’an Wang Family, Liua Ruolan.
Beside her, a blue Primordial Water Spirit Pearl was spinning wildly, releasing torrents of Primordial Water Spiritual Qi into her body.
She appeared to be struggling, her expression tense, her face pale, and there were faint beads of sweat forming on her temples.
Clearly, the massive wave was formed under her control!
Obviously, this had been planned earlier, and it might have started brewing a while ago.
Though the waves didn’t all contain Primordial Water Spiritual Qi, and their actual power couldn’t compare to the formidable magic performed by a Celestial Human Realm Cultivator under Heaven-Human Communication, these waves cleverly utilized the momentum of Anjiang River, sweeping in with the torrent of the river waters.
The force was as mighty as the power of heaven and earth!
Ancestor Hua Ye realized the danger and immediately planned to change direction.
However, it was too late.
The next moment.
The surging waves swept down, crashing onto Ancestor Hua Ye!
"Boom~~!"
In the deafening sound of water, Ancestor Hua Ye was forcibly knocked from the sky into Anjiang, even the fire protecting him dimmed significantly.
"Damn!"
Ancestor Hua Ye’s expression turned extremely unpleasant.
This attack caused little actual harm, but its humiliation was immense, akin to a slap on the face!
Despite his anger reaching its peak, he dared not linger underwater.
A Tier Three Aquatic Ferocious Beast, on land, he could defeat it in a few rounds. But underwater, it would become several times more troublesome. Moreover, his "Red Dragon True Technique" focused on fire, how much power could it wield underwater?
With the advantages and disadvantages shifting, coupled with the water-controlling woman, he might just suffer an unexpected defeat.
"Splash~~!"
With a splash, Ancestor Hua Ye immediately leaped out of the water, looking extremely disheveled.
Yet with even a slight delay, Ancestor Zhoubo had already tightly pursued like a persistent parasite, firmly entangled with Ancestor Hua Ye.
Meanwhile, Ancestor Longyan, Beichen Ancestor, and Wang Shouzhe had also arrived.
Everyone quickly joined the siege against Ancestor Hua Ye.
Wang Longyan and Xu Beichen, known for top-notch combat prowess at the Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm, were still quite far from the Celestial Human Realm, but with Ancestor Zhoubo entangled with Ancestor Hua Ye, they found it much easier to execute their moves.
Especially since their ultimate attacks and special skills also had ample time to be prepared and deployed.
Even someone as strong as Ancestor Hua Ye dared not face their ultimate attacks directly!
Their only downside was the inability to fly long in the sky, needing to occasionally rest on a cliff, on the water, or on a turtle’s back before taking to the air again to join the battle.
Besides, Liua Ruolan also joined the battle.
However, she attacked from a distance, occasionally summoning a water dragon to harass Ancestor Hua Ye. Even if it missed, the water dragon would burst mid-air, turning into heavy rain.
Water innately countered fire, and Ancestor Hua Ye’s flame power was greatly diminished.
But of all these people, the one Hua Ye loathed and felt helpless against the most was Wang Shouzhe.
Wang Shouzhe fought with shield in one hand and sword in the other, exclusively engaging in long-distance harassment by occasionally unleashing sword qi from afar.
Such harassment wouldn’t be a problem normally, the key issue arose when he after managing to drive back Xu Beichen or Wang Longyan, they even suffered some injuries.
But unexpectedly, Wang Shouzhe would approach and in mere moments, heal their wounds.
Each person received a lush green leaf to keep in their mouths while fighting, sustaining their vitality consistently.
With such tactics, the fight naturally became unmanageable.
Ancestor Hua Ye tried several times to retreat, but was persistently pursued by Ancestor Zhoubo, armed with the Geng Metal Battle Saber, pressed above the water’s surface by about fifty feet.
If the situation couldn’t be reversed, continuing to exhaust himself, the mighty Celestial Human Realm combatant might be worn down alive!
Ancestor Hua Ye felt shocked and chilled inside.
By this point, he no longer underestimated Wang Shouzhe.
He gritted his teeth, his face suddenly revealing an expression of heartache and resolve: "Wang Shouzhe, Wang Zhoubo, you’ve pushed me this far!"
By this point, if anyone was most hated, Wang Shouzhe had definitely topped the list.
After speaking, he seized an opportunity and extracted a palm-sized scale from his storage ring.
The scale was entirely crimson, as crystalline as jade, with red streams gliding over its surface, appearing extraordinary.
"Red Fire Dragon Scale?!" Ancestor Zhoubo, with extensive ancestral knowledge, immediately recognized the item, his face changing drastically, "Isn’t this supposed to be exhausted? Huangfu Family still have this?!"
Due to his opposition to the Huangfu Family, he collected a lot of their intel.
"Snap!"
As he spoke, Ancestor Hua Ye squeezed casually, and the Red Fire Dragon Scale shattered into powder instantly.
The frightening flame energy gushed out, surging into his body through his palm.
"Roar!"
Ancestor Hua Ye roared in immense pain.
In an instant, flames spewed from every pore of his body, amidst the raging fire, a terrible aura started to envelop.
"Hateful one, this is the last Red Fire Dragon Scale of my Huangfu Family!" Ancestor Hua Ye glared with extreme hatred at Wang Shouzhe through fiery eyes, "You deserve to die a thousand deaths to quell my hatred!"
The preciousness of the Red Fire Dragon Scale was unmatched. Its price surpassed many Middle-Grade Spiritual Artifacts, and most importantly, it was extremely rare, only Southern Desert Huangfu Family’s Purple Mansion Realm experts could refine it using Secret Techniques.
When Huangfu Hongyu split from the main vein to open up Changning Guard, he only received three scales.
Two of them were used back when Huangfu Hongyu was developing the land.
The last one had been passed down within the Huangfu Family for over five hundred years, not only serving as a family treasure, but also symbolizing legacy and beliefs, a means of survival and enemy attack in crucial moments.
Unexpectedly, today he was forced to use this item due to Wang Shouzhe’s pressure.
It’s understandable he deeply resents this, as today’s loss is too great!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 82: Killer Move! Summon Another Wife
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 82: Killer Move! Summon Another Wife
...
With Ancestor Hua Ye’s move, the situation on the field seemed to change instantly.
He directly aimed at Wang Shouzhe, and Ancestor Zhou Xuan and others hurried forward to block.
His aura became strong and dangerous, forcing Ancestor Zhou Xuan, Ancestor Beichen, and Ancestor Longyan to retreat step by step, nearly unable to withstand.
"Shouzhe, he has a deep-seated hatred for you, you should withdraw first." Ancestor Zhoubo wielded the Geng Metal Battle Saber, stirring up golden Sword Aura, barely defending against Ancestor Hua Ye as the main defense.
"Shouzhe, don’t worry about us."
Wang Longyan also pushed the Sword Intent of the Profound Ice True Technique to the limit. Each sword strike gathered countless ice crystals and frost flowers into fine cold shards, sweeping up a powerful storm of Profound Ice, creating considerable pressure on Ancestor Hua Ye.
Determination and fierceness flickered in her eyes, even at the cost of her life, she was determined to protect Shouzhe’s life.
Under the night sky, Wang Shouzhe floated above Anjiang River Water, his clothes fluttering, and his brows furrowed.
Truly, they are a family with a five-hundred-year legacy of Celestial Human Families. Their foundation is indeed deep and not to be underestimated.
It seems that he can only use that move.
If it weren’t for the pressing situation, Wang Shouzhe really wouldn’t want to use his hidden trump card.
Immediately, Wang Shouzhe’s figure flickered and landed on the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle, his gaze falling heavily on Liua Ruolan.
Liua Ruolan, who was continuously stirring up Water Dragons and cooling down Ancestor Hua Ye with night rain, paused slightly as unease welled in her heart. At such a critical moment, why was her husband just staring at her instead of finding a way to fight?
"Dear wife," Wang Shouzhe said in a deep voice, "The situation is critical now. There’s something I must be honest about. Actually, I’ve liked our sister Ruolei for a long time."
"Hmm?" Liua Ruolan’s eyes widened, staring at Wang Shouzhe in shock, and after a few breaths, she finally frowned and said, "I have noticed that Ruolei has some feelings for you, but I didn’t expect you to feel the same way."
"Dear wife, I know I’m too much, but I can’t control this thought. How about you vent some anger and hit me?" Wang Shouzhe said with a "guilty" expression.
"Forget it, it’s not worth getting angry over. After all, Ruolei seems quite fond of you." Liua Ruolan shook her head seriously and said, "In that case, once we get through this crisis today, I’ll write to Ruolei to return from the Academy and ask for her opinion. If she agrees, she can marry you as a secondary wife, adding more bloodlines to our family."
"Pfft!"
Wang Shouzhe nearly spurted old blood and was somewhat dumbfounded, was this actually acceptable?
"Husband, don’t make that expression." Liua Ruolan said, "I have considered this before. After all, given the road to Purple Mansion Realm you might tread, life is long over eight hundred years..."
"Well, let’s discuss this later. Dear wife..." Wang Shouzhe, realizing this wasn’t working, hurriedly changed the topic, "Dear wife, after tonight, I have a few newly comprehended techniques..."
"Tch, why are you talking about this now?" Liua Ruolan blushed slightly and stomped the ground, whispering angrily, "Is this the time to discuss such matters?"
With her stomp, the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle underneath shook a few times, feeling innocent and aggrieved. Why take it out on Master Turtle when you couples are arguing? If this Master Turtle could defeat you, humph!
"Would you agree, Liua Ruolan, I’ve been holding it in for a long time." Wang Shouzhe noticed a chance and pressed forward, speaking with more force.
Liua Ruolan blushed even more, a different meaning glistened in her eyes, as she bit her lip softly and said, "Fine, I’ll agree this time, but not again. Hurry and find a way to resolve the crisis, Ancestor Zhoubo can’t hold out much longer."
Really? She didn’t get angry. Wang Shouzhe was instantly dumbfounded, what was he supposed to do now? When she said find a way to resolve the crisis, wasn’t he brainstorming now?
If these two things didn’t provoke anger, Wang Shouzhe was truly at a loss. He racked his brain and boldly threw another card saying, "Dear wife, I think Ancestor Xuanfu has a great figure..."
Then, a cold aura rose from Liua Ruolan, and she said coldly, "Wang Shouzhe, what did you say?"
"I’m talking about Ancestor Xuanfu, her figure is enchanting, surpassing my wife..." Wang Shouzhe saw a reaction and took a risk by pushing harder.
"Boom!"
An icy killing intent, palpable and real, engulfed Wang Shouzhe, making him feel as if he was targeted by an unparalleled fierce beast, his breath stifled.
Liua Ruolan’s originally gentle eyes suddenly turned icy blue, even her black hair shimmered with an ice-blue hue.
She seemed like a sovereign overlooking tiny beings.
The Primordial Water Spirit Turtle was highly sensitive to killing intent and quickly retracted its head, closing its eyes tightly. Connected by blood to this owner, it thought, this time I can’t help you, you’ll have to fend for yourself.
"Dear wife, don’t misunderstand." Wang Shouzhe hurriedly smoothed things over, "I was saying, even if Ancestor Xuanfu’s figure is good, she is far behind my dear wife. Let’s not discuss this now, do you see that old man burning with flames in the sky? He said he wants to attack me, kill me, wants our precious children to not have a father."
Liua Ruolan’s ice-blue eyes gazed into the sky, and a cold aura full of endless killing intent surged toward Ancestor Hua Ye, as she coldly snorted, "Courting death!"
With the word "death," the Spirit Pearl orbiting her responded to her emotion, engaging in intense activity and exuding powerful Power of Primordial Water.
With a casual gesture, Liua Ruolan absorbed the massive energy from the Spirit Pearl.
Then she kicked off, launching like a cannonball into the sky, causing the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle beneath her to plunge down.
"Buzz!"
At the same time, the Upper Grade Spiritual Artifact Qiushui Sword emitted a dragon-like resonating sound. As the sword was swung with force, a bright blue Sword Aura cut through the sky like a radiant meteor, aimed straight at Ancestor Hua Ye.
Such a terrifying might.
Even Ancestor Hua Ye, who had used the Red Fire Dragon Scale to greatly increase his power, felt a strong sense of threat.
He was slightly startled and quickly shifted from attack to defense, wielding the Li Fire Battle Halberd to block the formidable Sword Aura infused with the Primordial Water energy.
"Boom!"
The energies of Primordial Water and Li Fire collided fiercely, creating a shock wave that spread outward like fireworks blooming in the air.
"How is it possible?" Ancestor Hua Ye felt the faint trembling from the hand gripping the Li Fire Battle Halberd, shocked. From her appearance, she seemed only at the Early Stage of the Spirit Platform Realm.
Her previous performance and intimidating presence had already far surpassed her Realm, making her hard to underestimate.
But in the blink of an eye, she seemed to have transformed.
The danger she posed was no less than Xu Beichen and Wang Longyan. To note, both Xu Beichen and Wang Longyan were considered top-tier forces within the Spirit Platform Realm.
Even Celestial Human Realm cultivators couldn’t entirely dismiss them. And the combat prowess she displayed, how many within the Changning Guard could overcome her?
With Liua Ruolan joining the battle, three peak Spirit Platform Realm warriors, plus Ancestor Zhubo wielding the Geng Metal Battle Saber, along with Wang Shouzhe’s occasional long-range harassment and healing for his teammates.
The situation of five against one changed again. Ancestor Hua Ye, who absorbed the Red Fire Dragon Scale, could no longer dominate, but merely hold a slight advantage.
At this moment, theoretically, the strengthened Ancestor Hua Ye had the ability to flee the battlefield.
But he was unwilling.
This operation cost him two Late Stage Spirit Platform Realm elders and the last Red Fire Dragon Scale.
Yet he ended up gaining nothing!
How could he accept this?
All of this fell into Wang Shouzhe’s calculations.
Wang Shouzhe!
Ancestor Hua Ye fiercely spat a mouthful of Essence Blood onto the Li Fire Battle Halberd, its blazing flames surged several times more, wielding it like a Flame War God!
"Boom!"
He took on Wang Longyan’s attack head-on, enduring his injuries, suddenly tearing through Liua Ruolan and others’ blockade lines, his figure like a meteor rushing towards Wang Shouzhe, as the Li Fire Battle Halberd pierced through the sky, enveloped in layers of flames targeting Wang Shouzhe.
He planned it all out!
Even if injured, he must eliminate the great threat that is Wang Shouzhe.
Finally, here it comes!
Almost as if he anticipated this moment, Wang Shouzhe didn’t use the Heart Guard Shield for defense but touched his Storage Ring.
Suddenly!
He had a palm-sized purple sword-shaped Jade Talisman in his hand.
The object was small and exquisite, seemingly inconspicuous. Yet as soon as he took it out, Ancestor Hua Ye’s face drastically changed, how could it be, how could this kid have such a thing.
A deep chill rose from the bottom of his heart.
Oh no, ultimately fell into his calculation.
He wanted to escape, but it was too late.
Wang Shouzhe, without hesitation, crushed the purple sword-shaped Jade Talisman.
"Snap!"
As the Sword Talisman shattered, a vast and unmatched terrifying energy instantly condensed, transforming into a sword-shaped purple shadow several zhang in size.
The purple sword-shaped shadow floated in the air, as if divine majesty descended onto the world, seemingly capable of annihilating all.
"Go!"
Wang Shouzhe’s forehead constantly dripped cold sweat, with his cultivation realm, forcibly commanding the purple sword-shaped shadow with Spiritual Sense was still somewhat strenuous.
The purple Sword Aura immediately tore through space, carrying endless might, slashing towards Ancestor Hua Ye.
Indeed, this Purple Mansion Sword Talisman contained the full energy strike of a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator. It was the trump card prepared against Ancestor Hua Ye!
Back when he went to the Trial Land in the Outer Domain, besides spending much effort and resources to buy the Bone Marrow Purify Pill, the greatest gain was this Purple Mansion Sword Talisman!
Originally intended for defense against Tier Five Ferocious Beasts from the Outer Domain, now used on Ancestor Hua Ye, just right!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 83: Severe Blow to Hua Ye! Changning Guard’s Situation Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Chapter 83: Severe Blow to Hua Ye! Changning Guard’s Situation Changes
...
At the moment when the purple sword aura was unleashed, Wang Shouzhe felt a pang of heartache.
This Purple Mansion Sword Talisman was not easy to come by; it took a lot of time to gather, not to mention that it was extremely expensive.
It was an ancestral treasure of a fallen Celestial Human Family from Linyang Guard. This item requires a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator to deplete their own cultivation to seal their Sword Essence Sword Intent into the jade talisman.
Generally speaking, only when a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator has no hope of breaking through and is about to exhaust their lifespan, would they damage their cultivation to craft such disposable sword talismans or spell talismans, leaving a few clan treasures for their descendants.
That Celestial Human Family was so poor that they couldn’t even complete a generational transition, forcing them to sell off their last clan treasure, giving Wang Shouzhe a great deal.
Of course, this was also related to the high price Wang Shouzhe offered.
Families that can casually produce hundreds of thousands of Qian Gold are often very powerful themselves and do not need such Purple Mansion Sword Talismans.
However, this item was most suitable for the Wang Family.
Used at a critical moment, it can indeed decide the outcome of the battle, completely changing the current situation.
No sooner said than done.
When the Purple Mansion Sword Aura struck at Ancestor Hua Ye up close, even under the hazy night, Wang Shouzhe could clearly see the fear twisting Ancestor Hua Ye’s face.
He switched from offense to defense at the fastest speed, drawing in the Li Fire Battle Halberd, which began to rotate violently, bursting with fiery light like a blazing sun, forming a shield.
"Boom!"
