The Purple Mansion Sword Aura mercilessly struck the Li Fire Battle Halberd, the violent energy erupted in all directions, the shield barely lasted a moment before it shattered, and the intact sword aura dissolved into countless fragments of energy, part of which pierced into his body.
Ancestor Hua Ye couldn’t withstand such a strong impact, as if he were hit by a missile, he was sent flying backwards, crashing hard into the steep cliff of Fallen Eagle Gorge.
"Bang!"
With an explosive sound, he smashed a big pit into the cliff, the entire Fallen Eagle Gorge seemed to tremble faintly, with countless rocks rolling down. In the process, his Li Fire Battle Halberd also flew out of his hand, "thump," it fell into the Anjiang River, the blazing flames weren’t extinguished immediately, causing that small area of water to boil continuously, sizzling with water vapor.
However, water naturally counters fire, and the flames burning on the Li Fire Battle Halberd quickly went out without the supplement of profound energy.
"Puff!"
Ancestor Hua Ye spat out a mouthful of blood, his image now devoid of any mighty aura of a Celestial Human Ancestor, his clothes torn by the sword qi, with numerous wounds inflicted by the shattered sword qi all over his body. Even more terrifying, exotic sword qi invaded his body, continuously eroding his internal organs.
"Ah~~~" The intense pain caused the veins on Ancestor Hua Ye’s body to bulge, unable to stop himself from roaring: "You little brat, you deserve to die!"
Such a powerful strike not killing Ancestor Hua Ye instantly was naturally within Wang Shouzhe’s expectations. After all, the power of that Purple Mansion Sword Talisman was only equivalent to the full-force blow of a Purple Mansion Realm powerhouse.
If it encountered a newly promoted, weaker Celestial Human Initial Tier, there was a chance of killing in one strike. But Ancestor Hua Ye was different, he was a veteran of the Celestial Human Realm.
"Heh! Who will die is not certain yet." Wang Shouzhe said coldly, "All ancestors, while he’s down, finish him off."
Ancestor Longyan, who bore the most hatred towards Huangfu Huaye, charged first. Shortly after, Ancestor Zhubo, Beichen Ancestor, and Liua Ruolan each used their body techniques to surround him.
Ancestor Hua Ye’s face instantly turned deathly pale, he forcibly suppressed the exotic sword qi within him, preparing to leap into the water quickly to retrieve his Li Fire Battle Halberd. That was the clan treasure of his Celestial Person Huangfu Family, passed down by the first ancestor, Huangfu Hongyu.
But before he could enter the water, he saw a huge turtle emerge first, with the Li Fire Battle Halberd held in its giant turtle mouth!
Then, the turtle paddled rapidly towards Wang Shouzhe, holding the Li Fire Battle Halberd high, as if showing off to its master.
Witnessing such a scene, Ancestor Hua Ye was overcome with anger, spitting out another mouthful of blood. He wanted to go forward and kill that damn turtle, but it was impossible as Ancestor Zhubo and the others had already surrounded him.
Without the Li Fire Battle Halberd, he could only rely on his fists to barely defend himself, retreating in midair while constantly moving backward.
"Damn, damn it!"
Out of all options, Ancestor Hua Ye roared in rage. Helplessly, he was forced to take out the life-saving item passed down by his ancestors, a crystal-clear jade talisman.
It looked somewhat similar to Wang Shouzhe’s Purple Mansion Sword Talisman, except it didn’t contain a stored sword qi.
As Ancestor Hua Ye crushed the jade talisman, a vast pure white energy erupted, enveloping him, and in a blink, he vanished into the distance.
"Wang Shouzhe! You wait for me..."
Before leaving, Ancestor Hua Ye couldn’t resist leaving some harsh words. However, the speed of the escape light was extremely fast, and he was already gone from the night sky before he had finished speaking.
"Spirit Escape Talisman!" Ancestor Zhubo, well-informed as he was, looked slightly embarrassed. "I never thought that old Hua Ye would have such a life-saving item in his hands."
Spirit Escape Talisman?
Wang Shouzhe narrowed his eyes slightly at this scene. He had heard of this treasure before; it’s a jade talisman of extremely high refining difficulty. While not as extravagantly valued as the Purple Mansion Sword Talisman, it’s still far from cheap.
Most importantly, no one in the entire Daqian Kingdom could refine it.
The existing Spirit Escape Talismans were all unearthed from ancient relics, and they become scarcer with each use. Families who acquire them generally keep them as a last resort foundation card, not willing to sell them unless absolutely necessary.
"Shouzhe..." Ancestor Longyan’s gaze was somewhat disappointed. The sure-kill setup against Ancestor Hua Ye today had been laid by Shouzhe over many years.
It was utterly unexpected that Huangfu Huaye would have such a life-saving item, allowing him to escape at the crucial moment.
"No matter," Wang Shouzhe said calmly. "In fact, I had also considered the possibility of not being able to kill Huangfu Huaye. This situation is already very favorable. He took a direct hit from the Purple Mansion Sword Talisman and forcibly used the Spirit Escape Talisman to flee. Even if he survives, he’ll be barely hanging on."
"Haha, Shouzhe is right," Ancestor Beichen laughed and agreed. "I observed that the exotic sword qi from the Purple Mansion Sword Talisman invaded his body. The exotic sword qi from the Purple Mansion Realm is not easily dispelled. In the short term, that old thing won’t be able to cause trouble again. Unless I’m mistaken, I should be able to ascend to the Celestial Human Realm within a few years. By then, the structure of the Changning Guard will change."
"Ancestor, this time let’s consider it as collecting a bit of interest from the Huangfu Family," Wang Shouzhe said with a good mood. "The exotic sword qi from the Purple Mansion Realm will give Huangfu Huaye some serious trouble, comparable to when you were afflicted with Yin Poison back in the day. Let him taste the pain you experienced."
Meanwhile.
Wang Shouzhe retrieved the Li Fire Battle Halberd from the turtle’s mouth. Although the flames had extinguished, holding it still gave a scorching and hot sensation, making one feel the powerful energy contained within.
However, because it had taken a blow from the Purple Mansion Sword Qi earlier, there was now a not-too-shallow nor deep sword mark on the Li Fire Battle Halberd.
It’s truly worthy of being a magical treasure; under such a terrifying strike, it wasn’t severed in half.
"Shouzhe, you came out ahead in this round," Ancestor Beichen said with envy, while also a bit covetous. "Although that old Hua Ye escaped severely injured, he left behind his family treasure. Coupled with the loss of a Spirit Escape Talisman, it has greatly weakened the Huangfu family’s vitality."
It’s no wonder he was envious.
The value of a magical treasure typically runs into several hundred thousand Qian Gold, more expensive than a Spirit Escape Talisman, and at least not cheaper than the Purple Mansion Sword Talisman Wang Shouzhe shattered.
And for a Celestial Human Realm Cultivator, having a magical treasure or not completely alters their combat capability.
"Shouzhe, don’t split this magical treasure," Ancestor Zhubo said beside him. "I came to help fight not only for the bond with Zhou Xuan but also to repay you for your assistance to the Longzuo Wang Family."
Beichen Ancestor also quickly put on a serious face and said, "Ancestor Zhubo is right. Our Xu Family and the Wang Family are one. You’ve helped the Xu Family too much, while our repayment has been too little. This time, I came to help fight to repay the Wang Family."
Wang Shouzhe was about to speak but was repeatedly persuaded by them, especially since in this battle, he had shattered a Purple Mansion Sword Talisman; his battle losses were significant. With the Li Fire Battle Halberd as spoils, he could at least offset some losses.
"If that’s the case, I shall accept gratefully," Wang Shouzhe pondered for a while and didn’t continue to refuse their kindness.
After all, favors need to be reciprocated. It was understandable they didn’t want to owe the Ping’an Wang Family more favors. Moreover, the Wang Family’s expenses were currently vast. Both the Purple Mansion Sword Qi Jade Talisman and the purchase of the property from the Qianma Huangfu Family had incurred significant loans.
This Li Fire Battle Halberd, Wang Shouzhe decided to sell on the black market to alleviate the financial pressure. After all, no one in the family could use this magical treasure. Even if Ancestor Longyan breaks through in the future, a fire element treasure wouldn’t be suitable.
While Wang Shouzhe was contemplating how to handle the Li Fire Battle Halberd, an icy voice rang out: "Wang Shouzhe, come with me."
Then, a few ancestors, seeing this scene, immediately excused themselves. Even the Primordial Water Spirit Turtle sensed something was off and submerged into the Anjiang, disappearing completely.
It wasn’t long before.
On Falling Eagle Gorge.
Wang Shouzhe stood in opposition to the transformed Liua Ruolan, ready for a duel.
Under the biting cold wind, Liua Ruolan’s hair, now an icy blue, fluttered in the wind. She stared intently at Wang Shouzhe: "Repeat what you just said."
A chill spread throughout his body.
Wang Shouzhe felt a sudden panic in his heart, realizing he was about to be scolded by his wife. Urgently, he needed to think fast!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 84: How to Handle 2 Wives?
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 84: How to Handle 2 Wives?
...
The character of a wife after transformation and before transformation is worlds apart. One is as gentle as water and never argues, while the other is as cold as ice, with a temper that’s unusually irritable.
Under her gaze, even someone with Wang Shouzhe’s mental state and strength couldn’t help but feel a subtle apprehension. The combat power she displayed earlier, though still somewhat lacking compared to the Celestial Human Realm, might already be among the very best in the local Spirit Platform Realm cultivators.
Compared to Ancestor Longyan or even Beichen Ancestor, she was no less formidable. Hence, upon seeing the situation, Ancestor Longyan didn’t even try to mediate. She left under the pretense of having something to do, leaving the young couple to solve their problems on their own. First, she couldn’t mediate it. Second, she’d been tricked and suffered losses before.
With Wang Shouzhe’s confidence, he also felt that his chances of defeating the transformed Liua Ruolan were less than thirty percent. A wave of helplessness rose in his heart. Could it be that today he was really going to get a beating from his wife?
"Wang Shouzhe, what are you looking around for?" Liua Ruolan said coldly, "Could it be that you want to run away?"
This?
Suddenly!
A bright idea flashed across Wang Shouzhe’s mind.
Right, with her previous temperament, if she really wanted to pick a fight with me, she would have already drawn her sword and attacked. How could she be like this, speaking harshly?
At that moment, Wang Shouzhe regained his composure and spoke to her gently, "Wife, that was a last resort in a moment of urgency. If you’re really angry, why not punch me to vent your anger?"
"Hmph!" Liua Ruolan’s eyes turned cold, "Remember, you’re not allowed to take concubines, especially not Liua Ruolei. Even if she agrees, you can’t. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude."
"This..." Wang Shouzhe was at a loss for words and said honestly, "Rest assured, wife, I have no such intention."
Only then did her expression improve slightly. She glanced up and down at Wang Shouzhe, "And what about the things you said just now..."
"I absolutely didn’t mean it." Wang Shouzhe’s expression turned serious, vigorously shaking his head like a rattle, "I just wanted to provoke you earlier, spoke nonsense..."
"I agree."
"Bec..." Wang Shouzhe swallowed the word he was about to say, looking dumbfounded at the transformed Liua Ruolan.
"What are you still standing there for?" Liua Ruolan, full of authority, grabbed Wang Shouzhe and drifted down towards Falling Eagle Gorge, landing on a small black awning boat docked at the port.
The small boat moved without oars, propelled by profound qi, speeding towards the center of Anjiang like a speedboat.
Before long.
The boat began to rock violently.
From inside came the faint voice of Wang Shouzhe, "Wife, what are you doing?"
Then soon, the boat rocked even more fiercely. In the wave-ridden Anjiang, it floated like a leaf, drifting back and forth.
...
A little while later!
Huangfu Family’s Main Residence in Changning.
The patriarch Huangfu Jinhuan was in a good mood, even specially drinking some spirit wine today, lying somewhat tipsily in the master’s chair.
Two young concubines of decent status in purple served by his side, one helping to massage his legs and shoulders, the other offering tea and water. These two concubines, both had lower grade cultivation talent.
Yet their status was not high, even if they had children with Huangfu Jinhuan, they would be illegitimate, their status far less than the direct lineage, not even as high as the direct vein.
Today, the ancestor went out on business, all tasks were arranged and managed entirely by him, with absolute assurance that there would be no issues.
The ancestor was a grand Celestial Human Realm cultivator, in this small Changning Guard, though not all-powerful, he could almost do whatever he wished. With him acting, how could things not succeed?
Changning Huangfu Family, will surely usher in a brand new era.
And he, Huangfu Jinhuan, as the patriarch of the direct lineage, will also gain his opportunity, possessing the qualification to rush for the Celestial Human Realm. You must know that previously, while maintaining the family situation, it could barely support one Celestial Human Seed.
And who should serve as the Celestial Human Seed isn’t just about talent, but also luck. Each Celestial Human transition cycle lasts about two hundred years. The further one’s birth is from this cycle point, the lesser the opportunity.
The reason is simple, just one word: "Poverty"!
To nurture a Celestial Human Realm cultivator requires an enormous amount of resources. Just the resources for the initial sprint are not what an ordinary cultivator can enjoy. To advance to the Celestial Human Realm requires that Immortal Ascension Pill for breakthrough, which is an astronomical cost of several hundred thousand Qian Gold.
Even for a Celestial Human family, it takes a long time to accumulate those hundreds of thousands of Qian Gold. Don’t be fooled by the extensive family assets and seemingly abundant income of a Celestial Human family, but maintaining the current situation already has hefty annual expenses.
There are more than a dozen Spirit Platform Realm cultivators in the family, whose annual support is a huge expenditure. In addition, there is a need to nurture the younger generation successors to keep the Celestial Human family thriving.
A Celestial Human family that can endure cannot rely solely on the ancestor, the entire family up and down, inside and out, is a massive and functioning whole.
No matter how capable the ancestor is, one person can’t hold up everything!
Most of the time, the ancestor is just a mascot placed there for worship, even to awe opponents.
Thus, although the Changning Huangfu Family occupies half the sky of Changning Guard, appearing glamorous on the outside, pulling together tens of thousands of Qian Gold in one go still requires pooling from various places.
This is still the current situation. In the decades after Ancestor Hua Ye completed the Celestial Human transition, it was the Huangfu Family’s poorest phase. Any surplus each year had to be used to pay off various mortgages and loans.
From this, one can see that the development of a family absolutely cannot leave the support of resources. And where do the resources come from? It’s still dependent on economic income.
If the economy is not enough, no matter how good the talent is, even with natural two-layer bloodline awakening, cultivation progress will be very slow, and over time, one will become just like everyone else.
There are countless commoners throughout Daqian; hasn’t any of them ever given birth to a child with excellent talent?
Of course, there have been!
But the vast majority of them never even had the chance to step onto the Spirit Testing Platform, ultimately spending their lives aimlessly in the lower echelons.
"Wang Family, oh Wang Family, letting the foreign cement industry fall into your hands is like letting a Treasure Pearl gather dust." Huangfu Jinhuan’s eyes flickered unpredictably, his heart excitedly and vigorously stirred, "Only in the hands of our Celestial Person Huangfu Family can it realize its greater function. By then, our Huangfu Family shall rise..."
He hadn’t even finished speaking.
A figure shot rapidly from the sky outside, with a "boom," it crashed into the residence, shattering a house. The sound was as loud as a meteor crashing down.
"What’s going on?"
Huangfu Jinhuan was startled, quickly rushing out, joining the night watch Household Generals to the scene of the incident.
Then, he was dumbfounded.
What fell like a meteor was actually the Huangfu Family’s Dinghai Needle—Ancestor Hua Ye. At this moment, Ancestor Hua Ye was as wretched as could be, veins bulging all over his body, in immense pain, as strands of exotic Sword Qi, sharp as blades, roamed through his organs.
"Ancestor, Ancestor, what happened to you?"
"Jinhuan, this time we are defeated! Ping’an Wang Family, Changning Xu Family, Wang Shouzhe, may you all die a miserable death!" Huangfu Huaye roared like a mad beast.
Huangfu Jinhuan was stupefied, how could it fail, how could it!
After a long while, he finally reacted, hurriedly shouting to the Household Generals, "Quick, quickly help Ancestor back, call for the tributor physician."
The Ancestor’s state was dire, the injuries severe, even Huangfu Jinhuan was panicking. All along, the Ancestor had been the mainstay of the Huangfu Family, the Dinghai Needle in everyone’s mind.
But now that the Ancestor was in trouble, it was like the sky had fallen for the Huangfu Family.
...
In Anjiang.
A small boat was docked beside Anjiang, by a hidden little pier.
Wang Shouzhe, in tattered clothes, gazed complexly at the equally disheveled Liua Ruolan.
She tidied up a bit as if nothing had happened, then coldly warned Wang Shouzhe, "Don’t let her know about this."
Wang Shouzhe, of course, knew whom she was referring to. His lips moved slightly, but he didn’t retort.
"Next time you need me, just call for Liua Ruoling." She said domineeringly, "You don’t have to say any more nonsense."
Liua Ruoling?
Wang Shouzhe was speechless and bitter; there’s even a name now, is this a dual personality or a twin soul?
Is it because of that Innate Dao Embryo?
According to Ancestor Xuanfu, that Innate Daoist Embryo Spirit Species was obtained from the relics of the Divine Martial Dynasty, something she acquired tagging along with her master on high-level instance adventures.
The Divine Martial Dynasty sounds prestigious; its various items are quite formidable and it’s an advanced civilization.
But the more time passed, the more Wang Shouzhe found problems in that dynasty.
The things they developed were bizarre. Just like his Bloodthirsty Vine, extremely wicked.
And the Wedding Robe Blood Gu that his nephew Wang Zongchang was afflicted with, even though it ultimately changed his bloodline nature and fate, that Wedding Robe Blood Gu always seemed evil.
That Divine Martial Dynasty was so malevolent that its downfall might be tied to its internal reasons.
In the future, he had to be cautious when dealing with items from the Divine Martial Dynasty.
Amid Wang Shouzhe’s wild thoughts, the blue glint in Liua Ruolan’s eyes faded, and her hair color magically reverted to black. She looked around bewilderedly, then noticed her own disheveled clothes, and glanced at Wang Shouzhe, who was similarly in a state of disarray.
"Husband, what just happened to me?" Liua Ruolan asked curiously.
"You were too exhausted and fell asleep," Wang Shouzhe calmly replied while fixing his clothes, "so I brought you back."
"Husband, even though we’re married, you can’t just do strange things while I’m asleep, right?" Liua Ruolan gave Wang Shouzhe a peculiar look, seemingly displeased.
It’s not that I did strange things to you; actually, it’s you who did...
Forget it!
Wang Shouzhe hastily shouted, "Liua Ruoling." At this moment, it was hard to explain.
Then, her gaze once again turned into a cold, light blue state, staring at Wang Shouzhe, "What do you want?"
"I was just testing..." Wang Shouzhe exclaimed in surprise, "It seems to work quite well; never mind, nothing’s happening, let’s clean up the scene and you can go back."
"..." Liua Ruoling, "Wang Shouzhe, you’re courting death!"
Then, the boat began to sway violently again, as if it would fall apart at any moment.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 85: Tragedy! The Decline of the Huangfu Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Chapter 85: Tragedy! The Decline of the Huangfu Clan
...
The battle at Falling Eagle Gorge.
Though it was a covert confrontation, apart from the few noble families involved, others knew nothing about it.
Yet, the undercurrents were so turbulent, and the change in the situation seemed to have just begun.
These past few days.
Rumors about Ancestor Hua Ye’s severe injury and imminent death in Changning Guard spread tumultuously thanks to some instigators, sparking endless debates.
Some say Ancestor Hua Ye was exploring the Outer Domain seeking opportunities and unfortunately encountered a Tier Five ferocious beast. After a fierce battle, both were heavily injured, and Ancestor Hua Ye retreated gravely wounded, on the brink of death.
Yet others claim it was due to a rift between Ancestor Hua Ye and the Jiaolong Gang, resulting in a fierce battle with Vice Gang Leader Sikou Luoxia, a renowned expert, with both sides suffering heavy injuries.
And some say...
There are no less than five or six versions of the "rumors" about Ancestor Hua Ye’s battles with various experts.
In short, each version is described as if witnessed firsthand. The only consistent detail among these versions is that Ancestor Hua Ye is gravely injured, teetering on the edge of death, with uncertainty about when the injuries might take a fatal turn if they are not controlled.
Being part of the two Celestial Human Families in Changning Guard, the Huangfu Clan was naturally outraged by such numerous unfavorable "rumors."
While they publicly "debunked" the rumors, they dispatched household generals, clan members, and even hired many loose cultivators to "extinguish" the rumors everywhere, even violently attacking and warning several groups discussing the matter.
They attempted to use such a simple and crude method to stamp out and suppress the rumors.
Unfortunately, if they were still in their once strong heaven-covering level, even the Celestial Human Lei Family wouldn’t dare provoke them at their true wrath.
But for this matter, the true mastermind was Wang Shouzhe.
Although he wasn’t a fervent bystander in his past life on Earth, his extensive passive exposure made him well-versed in various insidious schemes.
Before long, fires erupted everywhere in Changning Guard, with endless and vivid "exposes" blasting forth.
For example, the Huangfu Family’s bullying and domination, extorting and seizing businesses.
Another example being Patriarch Huangfu Jinhuan’s oppression of declining noble families, using power to seize two direct vein clan members as concubines.
One scandal after another seemed to unveil the "filthy" and "unbearable" scene beneath the glamorous surface of the Changning Huangfu Family, leaving people in "awe."
Was this the true moral standard of a Celestial Human Family?
The Daqian Imperial Court’s intent in granting noble family status was for them to explore and hold the land, securing the nation and the people, not for them to dominate and oppress the good local populace.
Hence, the court expects certain standards of conduct from noble families. Should public dissatisfaction grow rampant, they might face reprimands, at worst a downgrade in rank, or even removal of their noble family status and decree.
While the Huangfu Family was in a state of chaos, the Celestial Human Lei Family delivered another heavy blow.
Upon "hearing of" Ancestor Hua Ye’s injury, Lei Family’s ancestor personally invited Gu Hanyu, the best physician in Changning Guard, to diagnose Ancestor Hua Ye.
Gu Hanyu was originally a loose cultivator with a unique wandering doctor heritage, different from other loose cultivators.
She wasn’t stationed in Changning Guard, only invited by the Purple Mansion Academy this year to control the pestilence due to severe flood disasters. She was known for her kindness, often sending disciples to treat refugees for free, earning her a great reputation.
Besides her medical prowess, she was skilled in pill refining, known as the Dual Excellence of Alchemy and Medicine.
Although only possessing Middle Tier Spirit Platform Realm cultivation, her fame in Changning Guard was considerable, with many followers, a prominent figure. In terms of pure reputation, she was second only to the two Celestial Human Ancestors and Xiahou City Guard.
Nearly on par with Wang Shouzhe and Beichen Ancestor.
Her intervention in diagnosing Ancestor Hua Ye put him in a situation where avoiding was impossible, and avoiding was impossible. He realized there was no hiding it, so he simply let her diagnose and treat him, as her medical skill was unparalleled in Changning Guard now.
The diagnosis results made the Huangfu Family both worries and a little relieved. Gu Hanyu’s intervention did temporarily alleviate some of Ancestor Hua Ye’s injuries.
But she indicated that the root of Ancestor Hua Ye’s injury was exotic sword qi from the Purple Mansion Realm infiltrating his body, exacerbated by using secret techniques to forcibly escape, causing great harmful consequences.
With her skills, she could only provide slight relief and suppression, but driving out the exotic sword qi completely would take decades.
The best approach would be to seek treatment at the Purple Mansion Academy, likely needing Changchun Ascendant from Eternal Spring Valley to personally treat him, which might achieve full recovery within a few years.
Moreover, during this period, it’s best not to engage in combat, as it would worsen the injuries and potentially affect his lifespan.
This was a glimmer of hope for the Huangfu Family. The issue was that Changchun Ascendant, being a renowned old Purple Mansion, was not easily approachable.
What’s more, even if Changchun Ascendant agreed to treat him, it would take several years, and he certainly wouldn’t do it without compensation.
However, Ancestor Hua Ye was the pillar of the Huangfu Family. The family’s current grand establishment, along with the suppression and offenses of many families behind the scenes, would face destruction if anything happened to the ancestor.
The true details of Ancestor Hua Ye’s injuries soon "unintentionally" spread across Changning Guard. Just as the Huangfu Family feared, some families and forces once suppressed and bullied began to stir.

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 85 Tragedy! The Decline of the Huangfu Clan_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 85 Tragedy! The Decline of the Huangfu Clan_2
In particular, in areas involving conflicts of interest, those Noble Families that once showed restraint gradually adopted a more assertive attitude.
This is a bad signal.
For the Huangfu Clan, this is a dilemma. If they choose to suppress strongly again, it might provoke public outrage and unite everyone against them. Without an Ancestor to hold the fort, how can they manage to suppress them? Besides, there might even be the Celestial Human Lei Family and the Ping’an Wang Family stirring up trouble behind the scenes.
But if they choose to retreat, they might fall into a situation where each step back leads to another, retreating without an end.
Therefore, there is only one way left for the Huangfu Clan: to quickly send the Ancestor to Purple Mansion Academy for treatment. As long as the Ancestor is healed, all difficulties can be resolved.
...
During this tumultuous time.
Xiahou Hongde, the Changning City Guard, returned to report on his duties, and he was in a relatively good mood. Due to his outstanding performance in disaster relief, he was praised by his superiors. In the next transfer, he might have the opportunity for a promotion.
However, upon returning to Changning Guard, he found himself at a loss. Who was he, where was he, and what exactly was happening? How did Changning Guard fall into chaos just a month after he left?
Faced with the various rumors, Xiahou Hongde was quite angry. Each Noble Family in this Guardian City appeared obedient on the surface, but in private, they were more audacious and presumptuous than the other.
With such blatant power struggles and intrigue, do they not regard his position as City Guard at all?
Especially that Wang Shouzhe!
Could it be that they think Xiahou Hongde is a fool? There must be that brat’s fingerprints all over this.
Immediately, an annoyed Xiahou Hongde planned to order someone to bring Wang Shouzhe over. He needed to question that brat face to face, and see if he could let him complete his last two or three years peacefully and leave smoothly.
But as soon as this thought arose, he quickly suppressed it himself.
The influence of that brat Wang Shouzhe has already formed. Even if he called him over to scold him, it would only result in a few perfunctory responses. The actions the brat should undertake in private, none would likely be lacking.
Moreover, that brat handles things very thoroughly, almost impossible to leave him with any official charge. It’s not easy to make things difficult for him. With that brat Wang Shouzhe’s capabilities, he might truly be unable to suppress him.
Forget it, forget it!
Isn’t it just two or three more years before leaving office? Why bother having conflicts with the Wang Family?
If they want to fight, let them. As long as they don’t commit murder in broad daylight, he’ll just turn a blind eye to it.
...
Time passed swiftly.
A month later.
The renowned Purple Mansion Academy in Longzuo County remains as grand and solemn as it always has been.
Even when it’s not the academic season, there are still endless streams of people coming and going outside the gates of Purple Mansion Academy.
Most numerous are the Loose Cultivators who gather from all over the country. They all have a dream, hoping to be admired by Purple Mansion Academy, to change their fate upon joining. Among them, there are indeed some Loose Cultivators with decent talents.
However, Purple Mansion Academy has its rules for admitting students. If Loose Cultivators want to join, the conditions are extremely stringent. They must prove their origin with documents from the Commandery-level and County-level Government Offices, and have a Prominent Family as a guarantor.
Under such conditions, naturally, very few qualify, and they still have to undergo further assessments and selections. Therefore, for those from a Loose Cultivator background, joining Purple Mansion Academy is as difficult as ascending to heaven.
The Academy would rather look for students from Prominent Families with clean backgrounds. After all, these families have a history, with roots that can be traced back a few hundred years at the least or thousands at the most, and their ancestry can be thoroughly checked.
This is also to prevent infiltration by enemy forces.
Of course, Noble Families might not be completely blameless either, as there might be cases of treason. However, once verified, the entire family will be exterminated, and even collateral relatives will be implicated.
Therefore, the reliability of Noble Families far exceeds that of Loose Cultivators, making them less susceptible to infiltration.
Aside from Loose Cultivators, various other forces, families, and others come to Purple Mansion Academy with requests, to visit relatives, or like the Qiaan Family, for business partnerships.
All these people must register and wait in the Outer Courtyard for arrangements.
On this day.
In a certain residence in the Outer Courtyard, the Huangfu family seeking medical treatment was staying here. Besides the accompanying Household Generals, there were also several important clan members serving Ancestor Hua Ye, who came for treatment.
The most important figure among them was a direct lineage Elder named Huangfu Chengpeng.
He is the father of the current Patriarch Huangfu Jinhuan, now over eighty years old, and he once served as Patriarch for a period to gain experience.
Now, his status in the family is second only to Ancestor Hua Ye. The reason is simple: Huangfu Pengcheng is the present Celestial Human Seed of the Huangfu Clan. Despite his young age, he has already reached the Peak of Mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm, just half a step away from the Late Stage.
Huangfu Pengcheng’s most important task is not to manage family affairs but to focus on cultivation, striving to break through to the Celestial Human Realm and complete the Celestial Human transition with minimal cost.
With such cultivation at this age, even in the Academy, he would be considered a Core Disciple. This time, interrupting his seclusion to accompany the Ancestor is also to support their presence.
Those in Purple Mansion Academy hold talents with outstanding aptitude in high regard, often treating them with added respect.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 85 Tragedy! The Decline of the Huangfu Clan_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 85 Tragedy! The Decline of the Huangfu Clan_3
Today.
A cheerful male voice came from outside the temporary residence of the Huangfu Family: "Is Brother Peng Cheng here?"
Huangfu Peng Cheng, who was serving the Ancestor, was delighted. He quickly ran to the door and bowed deeply to the visitor: "Peng Cheng greets Senior Brother Jinshan. Please come inside; I have prepared some top-grade Spirit Tea."
He treated Senior Brother Jinshan with great respect and kindness. Firstly, because he needed something from him this time. Secondly, this "Senior Brother Jinshan" was not yet sixty years old but was already a mid-stage Spirit Platform Realm expert. He was a core disciple of the Eternal Spring Valley line and handled many miscellaneous affairs as a core disciple.
Such a significant figure, how could Huangfu Peng Cheng dare to look down on him? Therefore, he spent a considerable amount of effort and wealth to forge a connection with Senior Brother Jinshan and became close with him, hoping to request an audience with Changchun Ascendant through him.
"Well..." Senior Brother Jinshan, still with his usual appearance, had a somewhat solemn expression this time, "I won’t be drinking the Spirit Tea. I’ve come this time to notify Brother Peng Cheng of something."
Huangfu Peng Cheng, who had served as a Patriarch, felt his heart skip a beat at these words. After currying favor with Senior Brother Jinshan before, they had become very close.
Now he wouldn’t even enter to drink tea, which likely meant something had taken a turn for the worse.
As expected.
Senior Brother Jinshan coughed twice and said, "It was a bit presumptuous of me, Jinshan, to say I would introduce you to my Master. Unexpectedly, my Master suddenly went into closed-door cultivation. I shall return all the things Brother Peng Cheng sent."
As he spoke, he took out a Storage Ring and handed it back to Huangfu Peng Cheng.
Huangfu Peng Cheng was flustered and hurriedly said, "Senior Brother Jinshan, how long will the Ascendant need to be in seclusion? We can wait!"
"How would I know how long my Master will be in seclusion?" Senior Brother Jinshan replied perfunctorily, somewhat impatiently, "It could be as short as five or six years, or as long as several decades. I dare not casually ask about my Master’s affairs. Farewell, farewell."
Saying this, he ignored Huangfu Peng Cheng’s attempts to keep him and hastily left, as if fleeing.
Huangfu Peng Cheng’s heart sank to the bottom.
This, this, this... Previously, Senior Brother Jinshan was very enthusiastic, confidently assuring that he would help. But unexpectedly, things changed in the blink of an eye.
What exactly happened, what should be done?
In a place where Huangfu Peng Cheng couldn’t see, as soon as Senior Brother Jinshan stepped out, he turned a few corners and encountered a young girl in a purple long dress. She looked quiet, gentle, and pretty, exuding a clean and pure aura like a girl-next-door.
Upon seeing her, a hint of apprehension and fear flickered in Senior Brother Jinshan’s eyes. It wasn’t that he couldn’t defeat this girl, but her reputation within Purple Mansion Academy was already somewhat frightening, and in some ways even surpassed another’s.
Most importantly, she was Wang Shouzhe’s sister! He couldn’t afford to provoke Junior Brother Shouzhe.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Jinshan." The girl respectfully saluted and handed over a few bottles of Spiritual Honey, "These bottles of Hundred Flowers Spiritual Honey are a small token of my appreciation; please do not refuse, Senior Brother Jinshan."
This girl was, of course, the fifth lady of the Wang Family, Wang Luojing.
Senior Brother Jinshan hurriedly accepted the Hundred Flowers Spiritual Honey, looking both honored and surprised: "Junior Sister Luojing, there’s no need to be so polite. I am in the same sect as Shouzhe. Had I not known, it might be different, but knowing the inside story, how could I possibly aid the unjust? However, this matter must remain confidential, as I could be seen as having participated in a noble family rivalry."
These small bottles of Hundred Flowers Spiritual Honey were worth less than a tenth of what the Huangfu Family offered, yet Senior Brother Jinshan was quite pleased. This little devil girl seemed quiet but had always been indifferent, never giving the time of day to various senior brothers.
"Senior Brother Jinshan, you truly are a good person." Wang Luojing smiled faintly, expressing her gratitude, "Some of my senior sisters from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies have spoken highly of Senior Brother Jinshan, saying you are a kind-hearted person."
Senior sisters from the Valley of Ten Thousand Butterflies?
Senior Brother Jinshan became spirited at once and eagerly asked, "Which senior sister had such insight? Indeed, I am a kind-hearted person, Jinshan. Junior Sister Luojing, tell me their names, and I’ll visit with gifts."
"..." Wang Luojing was momentarily speechless.
...
